Hidden Valley Datastore

> The Chain That Binds is the cornerstone of our organization, the rock that supports the great tree of the Brotherhood and its myriad branches. It holds that:

1. Orders are to flow from on high down through the ranks. An order from a superior must always be obeyed, that their wisdom may be carried out without hesitation.

2. Orders are to observe the flow and not skip ranks. A superior may only give orders to his direct subordinates, and not to those beneath them. In this way harmony of intent and cohesion of thought is maintained.
translation:
隐谷数据存储

> “忠如锁链”是我们的组织基础，是支撑兄弟会这棵参天大树与其繁茂枝叶的根基。它的内容如下：1. 命令由上级传达至下级。必须服从上级的命令，毫不犹豫地贯彻他们的思想。

2. 命令必须逐级下达，不得越级。上级只可指挥其直接下属，不得对更下一级发布命令。如此一来，方能保持意见一致，思想统一。

original: Hidden Valley Datastore\n\n> Let the record show that I have stood witness to the dismissal of David James from the post of Elder today, March 17th, 2265. Brother James was charged with destroying an unknown device recovered from a recent expedition. The purpose and function of the device remain unknown, and Brother James has thus far proven unwilling to discuss the matter with anyone.
translation: 隐谷数据存储\n\n> 这一刻值得记录——2265年3月17日，就在今天，我见证了戴维德·詹姆斯被免除了长老职位。詹姆斯被指控损坏了最近回收的一台不明仪器。仪器的目的和功能尚不清楚，詹姆斯目前仍不愿与他人谈及此事。

original: Hidden Valley Datastore\n\n> Be it known that from this day, the 7th of October, 2259, Kenneth Jones shall no longer bear the title of Elder. Brother Jones has willfully gone against the Chain That Binds and has been forced to step down. Head Paladin Lindquist succeeds him as Elder.
translation: 隐谷数据存储\n\n> 众人需谨记，2259年10月7日，肯尼斯·琼恩斯被免去长老头衔。琼恩斯因蓄意违反“忠如锁链”的纪律而被弹劾下台。圣骑士长林奎斯特继任长老一职。

original: Hidden Valley Datastore\n\n> Let it be recorded that on this day, April 23rd, 2237, Raymond Lorn was dismissed from his post as Elder for committing the crime of murder. Brother Lorn was known to have hostile feelings toward the victim, Senior Scribe Ritter. The guilty party insists that Ritter's death was a tragic case of friendly fire (the bunker was under attack at the time), but the tribunal felt they could not let him persist as Elder with such suspicion hanging over him.
translation: 隐谷数据存储\n\n> 让我们铭记这一天：2237年4月23日，雷蒙德·洛恩因犯下谋杀罪而被免去长老职务。洛恩与被害者高阶学士里特尔的矛盾人人皆知。被告坚称里特尔的死是误伤所致的悲剧（当时地堡正遭到攻击），但审判庭认为，在嫌疑尚未洗清的情况下，不宜让其继续担任长老。

To: Margie Walker, Truckers' Union Rep
Subject: Bad news

Body: I'll apologize up front if there are any mistakes in this message. I'm trying out a new dictation headset. Margie, the boss man just ordered some kind of newfangled robot that's supposed to take over some of your deliveries. I'm not supposed to talk about it, but you should hear about it soon. I'll write again when I know more. Do not pass this along.
translation:
夕阳沙士公司内部网络

收件人：玛吉·沃克，卡车司机工会代表
标题：坏消息

正文：如果这封信的拼写有误，我先提前道个歉，我正在试用新的语音输入耳机。玛吉，老板好像订购了一批全新的机器人，打算接手你的一部分业务。我本不该说这些的，但我还是希望你能知道。如果有新情况，我会再转告你的，不要把这封邮件传出去。

original:
Sunset Sarsaparilla Company Intranet

To: Margie Walker, Truckers' Union Rep
Subject: Worse news

Body: We've got trouble. That hush-hush experimental robot I told you about the other day? The damn thing is single-handedly running all of our distribution in the Vegas area now. Your boys aren't on temporary leave. It's permanent. Damn, the president wants to see me in his office. I'll finish this later.
translation:
夕阳沙士公司内部网络

收件人：玛吉·沃克，卡车司机工会代表
标题：更坏的消息

正文：我们有麻烦了。还记得我之前跟你提过的那个神神秘秘的实验机器人吗？那该死的玩意儿打算一手包下我们在维加斯地区的运输业务。你们也不必再担心什么临时停职了，铁定是要下岗了。该死，总裁叫我去他办公室一趟。待会儿再写。

To: Lucas Nash, VP of Sales, RobCo Corp.
Subject: RE: How do you like your new toy?

Body: Lucas, I couldn't be happier with the performance of the new model. If it's current performance is any measure, it promises to reinvent my company's entire distribution network. I'd like to tentatively discuss purchasing a few more in the near future. How soon do you expect more to become available?
translation:
夕阳沙士公司内部网络

收件人：卢卡斯·纳什，罗科公司销售副总监。
标题：回复：你对你的新玩具怎么看？

正文：卢卡斯，我对这款新产品的表现简直不能更满意了。如果要对它的能力做一个评估的话，我敢说我们的整个供应链都将从此改变。我已经有初步意向，未来再进一批。不知你那儿还要多久才能有货？

original:
Sunset Sarsaparilla Company Intranet

From: Lucas Nash, VP of Sales, RobCo Corp.
Subject: How do you like your new toy?

Body: Kenneth, I hope you've been impressed thus far with your recent purchase. Your company has been and continues to be a valued customer. Contact me if you have any questions.
translation:
夕阳沙士公司内部网络

发件人：卢卡斯·纳什，罗科公司销售副总监。
标题：你对你的新玩具怎么看？

正文：肯尼斯，希望您新近购买的产品质量能让您满意，贵公司始终都是我们宝贵的顾客。如有任何问题，欢迎致电联系。

original:
Sunset Sarsaparilla Company Intranet

To: Marcus Brody, VP of Technology
Subject: While the iron is hot

Body: Marcus, I have a few ideas about how we can turn this whole contest situation to our advantage. I'm going to need you to work with the advertising guys on a very special project. A meeting request will be sent out soon. By the way, how do you feel about cowboys?
translation:
夕阳沙士公司内部网络

收件人：马可世·布罗迪，技术部副主任
标题：趁热打铁

正文：马库斯，关于如何利用当下的比赛，我有了一个新想法。你和广告部的人拟定一个特殊计划。我们很快就会召开一次会议。对了，你觉得牛仔怎么样？

original:
Sunset Sarsaparilla Company Intranet

To: Nathan Stanley, Director of PR
Subject: RE: What contest?

Body: Stanley, are you out of your mind? Have you seen the latest sales figures? We're up 300% since these rumors started and you're asking if I want you to make it stop? Please stop by my office so we can further discuss the issue.
translation:
夕阳沙士公司内部网络

收件人：内森·斯坦利，公关总监
标题：回复：什么比赛？

正文：斯坦利，你疯了吗？你看过最新的销售数据了吗？自从流言传开后，我们的销量长了300%，你却要让我叫停它？请你有空来我的办公室一趟，我要和你好好谈谈这个问题。

original:
Sunset Sarsaparilla Company Intranet

From: Nathan Stanley, Director of PR
Subject: What contest?

Body: Sir, the rumors of some sort of contest are quickly growing out of control. We're getting flooded with calls and messages asking if it's true we're redeeming bottle caps for prizes. Do you want me to make an official statement denouncing this rumor?
translation:
夕阳沙士公司内部网络

发件人：内森·斯坦利，公关总监
标题：什么比赛？

正文：先生，有关我们在举办某项比赛的传言正在迅速扩散，几乎要失控了。不断有顾客打电话发发信息问我们可不可以用手上的瓶盖换成奖品。您觉得我们是否有必要发表一个公开辟谣的声明？

original:
I don't know what's happening. The sirens went off twenty minutes ago and I hear something like thunder in the distance. We're not allowed to leave the building and I can't see what's happening in the street. I'm scared... I think this might be it. Everything that we've been building up for. This might be the last thing I ever write, so to whoever finds it, if I don't make it tell my family that I love them.

---
Elise Walton
CPA
GAO, Dept. of Research Subsidies
translation:
我不知道发生了什么，在警报停止前20分钟，我听到远处有打雷的声音。我们被禁止离开这里，也看不到大街上发生了什么。我很害怕……我想这可能是那个。这一切都是我们的报应，这可能是我最后的记录，今后无论谁发现它，如果我不能把这个告诉我的家人，请转告他们，我爱他们！

——
艾丽丝·沃尔顿
注册会计师
总审计局，研究津贴部门

Mission Directive: Establish and enforce Enclave presence among general populace, disposal of genetic non-compliance offenders.

I.	Establish constituency enforcement point at coordinates 39.138 x -77.070.  Monitor civilian movement in area, and debrief superior regarding any events of notable significance or regularity.

III.	Genetic non-compliance offenders should be detained at checkpoint.

任务指导：建立及加强英克雷在普通平民中的基地，处置基因反抗者。

original: Field Report - Prepared by NCO J.Tuckman by audio dictation on behalf of PFC Matthew Scott.  PFC Scott’s voice is the only source recorded in the following text.\n\n<<BEGIN FILE>>  Sir, I encountered three Ferals on my patrol.  This was somewhere around 0300 hours, I think, and it was dark, so they saw me first.  I discharged my firearm four times, fatally striking two of the three.  My weapon jammed before I could fire on the third target, and just then I realized it wasn’t engaging.  I knew our orders were to report on anything unusual, and well -- I thought that was pretty strange.  He actually followed me back here on his own.  We put him in the trailer with the other and he's been quiet as you like.  Strangest thing I’ve ever seen.  << END FILE>>
translation: 野外报告 — 由NCO J.达克曼通过听取PFC马修·斯科特的录音口述并整理。PFC斯科特的声音是以下文件中唯一的录音资源。\n\n>先生，我在巡逻途中遇到了三个野兽。那时差不多0300，我想，而且很黑，因此他们先看见了我，我开了几枪，打死了其中2个，在我正准备向第三个开枪时我的武器卡壳了，但在这时我发现剩下的那只没有向我进攻。我知道我们的任务是报告一些异常的东西,正好—我觉得这特别奇怪，它居然自己主动跟着我回到了这里。我们把他和其他人一起放在拖车里，他也一直像你喜欢的那样安静，这真是我见过的最奇怪的事情。>

By Dorothy Proud

Capital Post Staff Writer

In the late evening hours of January 10th, brave American Army forces launched an all-out offensive against the entrenched Chinese Communist invaders in the beleaguered seaport of Anchorage, Alaska, destroying all opposition and finally liberating the city after more than ten years of Chinese occupation. 

No red-blooded American can ever forget that terrible winter of 2066, when Chairman Cheng’s commie cutthroats mercilessly invaded the icy extension of the United States, in an unprecedented act of foreign aggression that sent shockwaves all the way back to our nation’s Capital.

But the nightmare is finally over, and America, always the home of the brave, is once again the land of the free.
translation:
来自 多萝茜·普劳德

《首都邮政》特约记者

1月10号的深夜，英勇的美军战士们启动了针对围攻入侵阿拉斯加安克雷奇港口的中国入侵者的全面反击行动，消灭了所有的共匪并最终解放了这座被中共军事占领长达10年之久的城市。

没有一个热血的美国人能够忘记2066年那个恐怖的冬天，当中共党魁程主席无情地向美国铁血扩张时，这个史无前例的外来入侵给我们国家的首都带来了强大的冲击。

但是噩梦终究完结了，美利坚，这个永恒的英雄家园，再次恢复了自由之身。

original:
By Dorothy Proud

Capital Post Staff Writer

In a move that is being widely viewed as both necessary and overdue, the United States military today declared that they will begin the immediate annexation of the country of Canada.

The decision comes after a long and contentious relationship with the Canadian government that began shortly after the Chinese invasion of Anchorage, Alaska in the winter of 2066. The Canadian leadership at that time expressed its opposition to American troops passing through their country or traversing their airspace, but ultimately capitulated.

Tensions with our neighbor to the north have only escalated since then as the United States has found itself relying heavily on Canada’s natural resources - including wood cultivated from the country’s great Timberland forests - to maintain the war effort against China.

But it was a recent near-sabotage of the Alaskan pipeline that finally tipped the American military’s hand. 

"That was the last straw," said Buzz Babcock, commander of U.S. forces in Canada. "You know what’s been stopping the Reds from pouring into downtown Juneau? American soldiers, that’s what. And now we’ve got to worry about someone - Chinese, Alaskan, or otherwise - taking out the pipeline? I don’t think so. Effectively immediately, United States troops are beginning a complete takeover of all Canadian assets and resources. Little America is ours. But let’s face it - it always has been."
translation:
来自 多萝茜·普劳德

《首都邮政》特约记者

一个迟来的必然的进步，合众国的军队今天宣布，他们将很快与加拿大合并。

在中国于2066年的冬天入侵位于阿拉斯加的安克雷奇后不久，经过与加拿大政府漫长而充满争议的双边洽谈，终于达成了这个决议。当时，加拿大的领导层表达了对于美国军队穿越他们的领土和领空的反对，但是他们最终屈服了。

当我们发现不得不严重地依赖于加拿大的自然资源——包括来自大森林的木材——以支撑这场同中国的战争之后，我们和北方邻居的紧张关系不断升级。

但是最近这条由美国军队控制的阿拉斯加输油管道一直受到蓄意破坏。

“这是他们的困兽之斗”在加拿大的合众国指挥官巴兹·巴布克如是说，“你知道是什么在阻止赤色涌入朱诺的商业区么？正是美国的战士。然后我们现在要让某些人——中国人，阿拉斯加人，或者其他人——来占领输油管道么？我不这样认为。事实上，美国军队很快就将要全部接收加拿大的财产和资源。“小美国”是我们的。请正视这一点——它一直如此。”

By Walter “Street Beat” Munroe

Capital Post Staff Writer

It would appear that Washington’s tolerance for American social disorder has finally reached its breaking point. 

In a recent public statement, White House spokesman Warren Eccleston said:

"Okay, Americans are hungry. We get it. Well I’ve got news for you - things are tough all over, people. The President himself has been forced to substitute cube steak for his nightly prime rib, and the only wine available is a detestable Chateau Montrose 2043. But does he whine? Does he take to the streets like a rabid Red? So please, good people, please. Wait in line. Get your food. And then go home. We’re Americans! We do not solve our problems with violence."
translation:
来自 瓦尔特·史惴特法艾特·门罗

《首都邮政》特约记者

看起来，华盛顿对于美国社会无序状态的容忍能力终于到了极限。 

在一份最近的公众声明中，白宫发言人沃伦·英克雷斯顿说：

“好吧, 美国人民在挨饿。我们了解这一点。嗯，我有一些消息给你们——到处都很艰难，各位。总统已经被迫用方牛排来代替往日晚餐的上等牛肋条，仅有的一瓶酒也是2043的劣质“蒙特罗斯庄园”。但是他抱怨过吗？像那些疯狂的激进分子走上街头吗？所以，求求你们，伟大的人民，求求你们，排队，领取食物，然后回家。我们是美国人！我们从不用暴力解决我们的问题！”

By Walter “Street Beat” Munroe

Capital Post Staff Writer

In a startling turnaround from their previous policy of complete covert development, the United States Army has confirmed that they are indeed working on a new super weapon, one designed specifically to crush the Red Chinese invasion force and liberate occupied Anchorage, Alaska once and for all.

Speaking at an Army press conference at the Pentagon, General Constantine Chase stated: "No more secrets. The time has come to lay all our cards on the table, so the Chinese can see with their own eyes that we’ve got the winning hand. The United States Army is proud to announce that for the first time in history, General Atomics International and RobCo have joined forces to create for this great country a super weapon that will leave every single yellow-bellied Red shaking in their Commie booties."

Unfortunately for our readers, that’s as specific as Chase is willing to get. While he and the Army are ready for China to know the U.S. is developing a new weapon, they’re not quite ready to divulge just what it is, or when it will be ready for deployment.

"All in due time, all in due time. Rest assured, when this weapon is complete, liberty will come to Anchorage… and Hell will follow."
translation:
来自 瓦尔特·史惴特法艾特·门罗

《首都邮政》特约记者

惊人的转变！合众国的军队不再执行以前的地下发展政策，有证据表明他们确实在研究一种新式超级武器，以用于将中国的红色侵略者一次性击溃，以解放被占的阿拉斯加的安克雷奇。

在五角大楼召开的军方新闻发布会上，将军康士坦丁·蔡斯谈到:“没有什么秘密了。是时候全部摊牌了。中国人可以用他们自己的眼睛看看，我们已经稳操胜券。合众国的军队将历史上第一次骄傲地宣称，通用原子国际和机器人集团加入到了军方为这个伟大国度研制超级武器的行列当中，这将会让每一个黄皮鸟在他们的战利品上发抖。”

很不幸我的读者们，那个方案还未具体实施。当军队让中国知道合众国正在研究新式武器的时候，他们并没有准备完全透露那到底是什么，或者什么时候可以展开部署。

“一切尽在掌握。一切尽在掌握。毫无疑问，当这武器完成的时候，自由将会降临安克雷奇（地狱也将随之而来）。”

By Dorothy Proud

Capital Post Staff Writer

In a crushing blow to foreign relations and world peace, the United Nations yesterday was completely disbanded, leaving its member nations to fend for themselves in these trying times.

Many had considered the United Nations the best hope for brokering a ceasefire between the European Commonwealth and the nations of the Middle East, but such an intervention is now impossible. 

In a somber press conference at the United Nations building in New York City, United Nations president Sakugama Okiri had this to say: "It is a sad day for the United States. Sadder still for the world. An era of relative peace and prosperity has come to a tragic end. The Resources Wars are upon us, and in my humble opinion the United Nations is needed now more than ever. Sadly, the world disagrees."

Those nations that have not already moved out of the immense headquarters will have completely vacated the premises by the end of the week. Several organizations have already begun bidding on the prime real estate, but children’s toy retailer Bumbalo's seems determined to transform the building into their new East Coast superstore.
translation:
来自 多萝茜·普劳德

《首都邮政》特约记者

对于国际关系和世界和平这是一个致命的打击，昨天联合国彻底解散了，只留下成员国自己去渡过这段艰苦的日子。

很多人本来认为联合国是欧盟和中东国家之间停火的斡旋人，但是这种介入已经不再有可能了。

在纽约市联合国大会召开的这次压抑的新闻发布会上，联合国主席萨古伽玛·欧凯瑞就此问题谈到:“这对于联合国来说是悲伤的一天。对世界而言更糟。一段相对和平和繁荣的时期终于走到了悲惨的尽头。资源战争关乎我们每一个人，而且就我个人意见，我认为联合国比以往任何时候更有存在的必要。很遗憾，世界不答应。”

还未从这所巨大的总部中搬出的组织将在本周末之前完全撤离。另一些组织已经准备要承包这栋大楼的所有权，但是儿童玩具零售商邦巴拉公司看起来已经下定了决心，要把这栋楼变成他们的新的东海岸商店。

original:
Security Log:

Two more reports of Mirelurk noise from the bow section. There isn't a damn thing that can be done about it. As soon as we clean out one nest, another moves in. I just wish everyone would stop bitching about it.

Railing on the flight deck is still broken. Problem has been referred to the council.

Brock got in a fight with that Sister character. If it happens again, I'm going to have to kick Sister off the ship.

Caught James Hargrave stealing food at Gary's Galley. Tammy paid the fine, although she blistered my ears the whole time.
translation:
安全记录：

舰艏区又有两次关于听到泥沼蟹活动的报告，对此我们真他娘束手无策。我们好容易刚刚清除一个巢穴，要不了多久另一个就搬进来了。真希望没人再提起这件事。

飞行甲板的栏杆还是坏的，问题已经提交了理事会讨论。

布洛克和那个叫“修女”的打了一架。如果这种事情再发生，我就把那个“修女”赶下船去。

逮住了詹姆斯·哈格雷夫，他从加里的厨房偷东西吃。塔米替他交了罚款，期间不停地絮絮叨叨。

original: Patrick's Farewell
translation: 帕特里克的诀别

original:
Hey there, Tabby Kat.

I know this wasn't fair to you.  I'm sorry.  Everything you've done for me since Anchorage, you were the best chance I had at making a normal life again, but I just don't think it's possible for me.  You deserve a life of your own.

Tell Mikey the bike is his when he gets his license next summer.  She'll need a new toroidal coil soon.  I'm also leaving the Commie pistol.  Please, take it to dad.  He'll want that.  Everything else I leave to you.  I know it isn't much.

I love you, Kat.  Please, forgive me one more time.

Patrick.
translation:
嘿，泰比·卡特。

我知道这对你来说不公平，对不起。我们定居下来后你为我所做的一切，本来这是我回到正常生活的最佳机会，但对我来说这不可能。你应该过你自己的生活。

告诉米奇等他明年夏天拿到执照，摩托车就是他的了。她的线圈不行了，可能需要换个新的。我把焊枪也留下了，他会需要的。其他所有东西都留给你了，我知道这远远不够。

我爱你，卡特。请再原谅我这一次。

帕特里克。

original: Report from first survey party
translation: 第一调查团的报告

original:
As our tests suggested, the immediate vicinity of the vault is no longer dangerously irradiated, although the background radiation is still well above safe levels.  Pockets of more intense radiation appear to still be common, and all surface water seems to be undrinkable. We will need to carry ample supplies of Rad-X with us on all future surveys. But hazard suits do not seem to be necessary for general exploration.

Our old maps are largely useless. The town of Springvale is an abandoned ruin, and all pre-War roads have disappeared or are no longer passable.

We encountered a group of monstrous ants which appeared to confirm Mackay's theories of mutation due to extended exposure to radiation. We drove off the ants with gunfire and collected several specimens for study upon return to the vault (see Exhibit A).

The good news is that human civilization still survives, despite everything! We discovered a settlement known as "Megaton" (see Exhibit B), whose inhabitants, although somewhat wary at first, soon welcomed us into their town. 

We spent a good deal of time in Megaton, and learned a great deal about the "Capital Wasteland" (as the area around Washington D.C. is now called) from them. Megaton is a fortified outpost of "civilization" (of sorts), but it seems that Giant Ants are the least of the dangers of this new world. We agreed that it was prudent to return to the Vault immediately to revise our survey plans in light of what we have learned. Lewis and Agnes remained in Megaton to serve as "ambassadors" and continue to collect information until we return.

Anne Palmer, Survey Team Leader
February 10, 2241
translation:
根据我们的测量，避难所的周围已经没有危险的放射性照射了，然而周边的辐射程度依然在安全等级之上。 一些强烈的辐射依然很常见，暴露在外的水源看起来都无法饮用。在日后的考察行动中，我们需要带上足够的放射线X用做补给。不过在一般的探险过程中也没有必要穿着防护服。

旧地图基本已经没用了。斯普林威尔已经成了一片废墟，所有战前的公路，有的已经消失了，有的无法通行。

我们遭遇了一群巨大而畸形的蚂蚁，那些蚂蚁看起来验证了麦凯的理论，长期暴露于辐射之下会导致变异。我们击退了那些蚂蚁，还收集了一些它们的标本（见附件A），日后回到避难所的时候可以用于研究。

好消息是，尽管经历了那么多的灾难，人类文明依然延续了下来！我们发现了一个名叫“兆吨镇”（见附件A）的定居点，那里的居民开始还有些警惕，但很快就接待我们进入了镇子。

我们在兆吨镇的那段时间很不错，并且从居民那里了解了很多关于“华盛顿废土”(指的就是华盛顿特区以及它的周围。这是新的叫法)的事情。兆吨镇是一个“文明”(勉强的说法)的加强前哨站，但那些大蚂蚁看上去只是这个新世界里一种微不足道的威胁。我们一致认为现在明智的做法，就是立即返回避难所，按照我们之前所了解的信息，重新修改我们的考察计划。路易斯和艾格尼丝作为“使者”留在了兆吨镇，继续收集着信息直到我们回去

安妮·帕尔默，侦察小队队长
2241年，2月10日

original: Here I am, trapped in a room by myself typing on a terminal trying to keep myself busy. Hell trying to keep myself sane.  I don't know what it is about this place, but I want to get out of here.  Yeah, get out of here -- I can't even bring myself to open that damn door again.  I hear those things wandering around outside, sniffing, screaming, doing whatever they do.  When I first got here I thought the place was abandoned and went around looking for anything to scavenge.  Five minutes later, I'm in this room scared half out of my mind.  Things started chasing me, I fired a few shots, missed, and ran through the darkness.  Ahh shit. Told ol' Billy to meet me here and bring some extra ammo and grenades.  That was three days ago, poor guy probably didn't make it too far. Those things better have given him a quick death.  Listen to me, babbling like a damn fool.  Billy's all right.  I'll just stick here until those things go away and meet up with him.  Hah, what a story I have for him.
translation: 我在这儿，独自一人被困在这屋子里，在终端机上打字，试着让自己保持忙碌状态。困境试图让我自己保持清醒。我不知道这儿是什么地方，但是我想离开这里。对，离开这 — 我甚至没有自己再打开这该死的门。我听见那些东西在外面徘徊，嗅闻，尖叫，肆意妄为。当我第一次来到这儿的时候，我以为这个地方被遗弃了，还到处找东西清扫。5分钟后，我在这个房间里被吓的半疯癫。有东西开始追我，我开了几枪，但打偏了，子弹消失在黑暗中。真是操他妈的，告诉老比利到这来见我，多带些子弹和手榴弹。那是三天前，可怜的家伙很可能没坚持多久。那些东西最好让他死得快些。听我说，胡说就像该死的白痴。比利很好。那些东西消失或者和他见面前，我会坚持在这。哈，我为他的故事。

original: The Guardians of Gillyfrond
translation: 吉莉佛兰德的守护者

original:
“Whatever shall we do, Mister Wollingsworth?” Molly asked. “Mother will be home shortly, and I’ve yet to clean my room!”

“Heavens my, heavens me. Don’t fret, Molly-Golly. We'll enlist a little help, that’s all.” Mister Wollingsworth then waddled his little teddy bear body into the center of the room, and called out - in a voice both sweet and strong - to those lying dormant on shelves, in the toybox, under the bed. 

“Come now, you lot! Molly-Golly needs our help, and as we’re her Guardians, that means we all get cracking! Come on now, shake off those dust bunnies and hop too!”

There then rose a rustle and rumble from all corners of the room, as rocking horse and railway car, bookend and baby doll, toy and game alike all blossomed into impossible life.

“Mister Wollingsworth! But I… I never knew… I thought it was just you! Oh, this is just wonderful!” Molly exclaimed.

“Wonderful? Bah! I was having a nice nap and a nice dream, and now you’ve gone and woken me up. And for what? Manual labor! That wasn’t in the job description, Wollingsworth!” This small, squeaky voice of dissent belonged to one Mousy Maguire, Molly’s favorite stuffed animal, and one of the few companions granted the right to sleep on her bed. 

“Oh, Mousy! You’re alive!” Molly ran to her bed and embraced the nonplussed plushy, squishing his body in a nearly stuffing-bursting bear hug.

“Aggh! Ohh! All right… Enough! Enough! You're... crushing… me!” Molly released her hold and dropped Mousy back on the bed, feeling at once excited and immensely disappointed that her favorite stuffed toy had just come to life… and seemed to be a complete cretin.

“Now you listen here, Maguire!” Wollingsworth said. “Being Guardians of dear Miss Molly-Golly means we protect her in any way we can, even if that means unclogging the potty, or taking out the trash, or, yes, tidying up her room! And when the Crawly Creeps come - oh, and they will come - you’ll get to do what was in your ‘job description,’ you mark my words…”
translation:
“沃因斯沃什先生，现在怎么办？”莫莉问到。“我妈妈马上就要回来了，我还没有打扫房间呢！”

“我的上苍，上苍保佑我。别担心，莫莉-格丽。我们会寻求一些帮助，现在要做的就是。”沃因斯沃什先生摇晃着他那小泰迪熊般的身子，走到了房子的中间，用悦耳洪亮的声音， - 对着那些摆放在架子上、玩具盒里、床下的东西大声的喊着。

“出来吧，你们这些家伙！莫莉-格丽 需要我们的帮助，并且作为她的守护者，我们现在都得开始干活了！现在都出来吧，把那兔子和蹦床上的灰弄干净！”

这时，房间的每一个角落响起了沙沙的声音，木马和小火车，书夹和洋娃娃，玩具和游戏机都如同鲜花盛开般有了生命。

“沃因斯沃什先生！我…我？我原来都不知道？我以为这里就你一个人！哦，这一切太奇妙了！”莫莉激动的喊着。

“奇妙？呸！我刚才正在舒服的打着吨，做着美梦，现在你跑来吵醒了我。为什么呀？体力劳动！沃因斯沃什，职责描述里可没有这条！”一个名叫属属-马奎尔的玩具发出了细小，吱吱的抗议声，它是莫莉最喜欢的玩具，也是为数不多的，被允许睡在她床上的玩家。

“噢，属属！你活了！”莫莉跑向她的床，将那个有点不知所措毛绒绒的小东西紧紧的抱在了怀里，几乎要把那个小东西身体里的填充物也压了出来。

“啊哈！BB弹弹！好了？够了！够了！你……你快压坏我了！”莫莉松开了手，把属属放回了床上，她刚才的激动全没有了，她感到非常的失望，因为她最喜欢的玩具有了生命之后似乎是个完全的白痴。


“现在，马奎尔，你过来听好了！”沃因斯沃什说。“身为我们亲爱的莫莉-格丽的守护者，意味着我们必须用各种方式保护她，甚至包括疏通厕所，或者扫垃圾，或者，没错，整理她的房间！还有,你给我记好了，等那些爬行动物来的时候 - 噢，他们总会来的 - 那时你就可以按着职责描述做你要做的事了。

translation: 弗雷迪的VDS症状越来越严重了。大多数时候他甚至不能起床。当他能控制自己的时候，弗雷迪隐藏起自己的不安，把自尊藏在那副严厉的面具下面。\n\n避难所科技公司医疗规程指示，当出现VDS（避难所抑郁症）时要配发抗焦虑药物，但是我真的想把孩子的余生都挂在镇定剂上面么？

original: Stanley continues to suffer from severe and chronic head pain. I’ve been feeding him aspirin like it's candy, but I’m reticent to give him anything stronger. He blames the lighting in his quarters, and though eyestrain is certainly compounding the problem, the headaches are actually a symptom of overwork and lack of sleep. \n\nKnowing Stanley -- and the schedule the Overseer has him on -- the problem isn't likely to get better anytime soon. So it's aspirin, indefinitely.
translation: 斯坦利仍然在承受那剧烈且不断的头痛。我拿阿司匹林当糖块一样喂他吃，我没法给他更有效的药物了。他抱怨灯光照到他的位置，虽然眼疲劳确实与头痛有关，但是他的头痛事实上是因为过于疲劳和缺乏睡眠。\n\n按斯坦利的状况——还有监督者对他的“时间安排”——这个问题在短期内估计不可能好转。所以还是用阿司匹林，虽然不确定这有没有用。

original: CGDadComputerAmata
translation: 阿玛塔的医疗报告

original: Once again, the Overseer has insisted on being in the room for Amata’s examination, throwing any inkling of doctor-patient confidentiality right out the window. I know he doesn’t trust me; he never has. But I honestly believe the reason he attends his daughter’s medical appointments is because he doesn’t trust her. That’s as ridiculous as it is sad. Amata’s a great girl, and the chance of her doing something stupid - pregnancy, syphilis, whatever - is so unlikely it’s not even worth mentioning.
translation: 监督者再一次坚持要留在阿玛塔的手术室里面，把医患之间的隐秘关系置于脑后。我知道他不相信我——从来没相信过。但是我坦白的说，他关注他女儿的手术是因为他不信任她。这听起来真是荒谬。阿玛塔是一个好女孩，但是她做的那些蠢事 — 怀孕，梅毒，或者其他什么 — 也值得好好提一提。

original: The cells are still replicating normally. No mutation. Thank God. If whatever’s out there could penetrate this Vault, I can’t even begin to imagine what the Overseer would do.
translation: 细胞还在正常复制。没有变异。感谢上帝。如果外界的什么东西渗入了这个避难所，我甚至不敢想象监督者会做什么。

original: After "borrowing" a few more water chips and rerouting some of the power here in the clinic, I’ve finally been able to affect the latest sample. It’s not much, but considering what I have to work with it, a definite step in the right direction. \n\nBut this new experiment was also monumental for another reason: it’s the first time Jonas has assisted me. He’s suspected forever, I know, so I guess it was inevitable. And his help has been invaluable. I just hope he knows what he's gotten himself into.
translation: 在又“借”了一些净水芯片并改动了一下诊所的动力电线之后，我终于可以研究这最后的样品了。改善并不多，但是想想我得在什么情况下工作，就会知道这是一个很大的进步了。 \n\n这次试验依然意义重大，这是因为乔纳斯第一次帮助我了。他总是怀疑一切，这我知道，而且我猜这是合理的。他的帮助很有价值。我只希望他知道他在干什么。

original: Every time I try to get Amata to open up, she just pushes me further and further away. Since she was a child, I’ve tried to instill in her those virtues that have made this Vault what it is today: loyalty, honesty, commitment, hard work. \n\nShe does try, and with a lot of guidance has grown into a fine young woman. That makes it all the sadder that she continues to alienate me. She looks at me and sees the Overseer, not the father that has cared for her alone -- alone! -- since she was an infant.
translation: 每次我尝试着要和阿玛塔好好谈谈时，她总是避而远之。当她还是个孩子的时候，我就试着灌输她这些美德：忠诚、诚实、守信，努力。正是这些要素，避难所才被建设成为今天的这样子。\n\n她尝试着，凭着各方指导，成长为一个年轻的好女孩。她一直试图疏远我，这让一切都变得更糟。她面对我的时候，只把我当作监督者，而非父亲。当她尚在襁褓中时，就是那么的孤独！

original: If Butch and his leather-clad delinquents accost Amata one more time, they'll have more to deal with than their acerbic teacher. \n\nTheir “services” have come in handy upon occasion, I must admit, but they’re starting to become… unruly. If dogs become feral, they must be put down. I'll have to remind Butch of that upon our next meeting.
translation: 如果布奇和他那些穿皮衣的小痞子再去跟阿玛塔搭讪的话，他们将会要比他们的尖酸老师担更多的差事。\n\n他们的“服务”迟早会有用的，我必须承认，但是现在他们已经开始变得？难以驾驭了。狗如果咬人，就应该被干掉。我应该在与布奇的下次会面时提醒他这一点。

original: Just what Vault 101 needs -- an absent-minded, sexually repressed sycophant. Beatrice has served Vault 101 admirably for years, but her mind is growing feeble. I'll have to speak with our good doctor about some kind of long-term pharmaceutical solution. \n\nWe may at least be able to keep her comfortable -- and quiet -- until she passes on.
translation: 这恰好是101号避难所需要的 — 一个健忘的，性压抑的马屁精。比阿特丽斯已经为101号避难所很好的服务很多年了，但是她的思想在逐渐退化。我将不得不同我们的优秀医生谈一谈关于长效药剂的事情。\n\n最起码，我们要让她保持舒服 — 而且安静 — 直到她去世。

original: I never should have assigned Jonas as James' assistant. He was always too idealistic for his own good. Now he spends every waking minute with the good doctor, who gleefully fills his ears with even more idealistic nonsense. \n\nI’ve considered re-assigning him, but the truth is Jonas is a fine medic in his own right, and hiding him down in maintenance would be a terrible waste of resources.
translation: 我不应该像詹姆斯那样期待乔纳斯的协助。他对于自己的事情总是过于理想化。现在他把每一分钟都花在好好博士身上，那个对于这些废话、空想欣喜若狂的家伙。\n\n我本应该考虑把他重新分配一下的，但是事实上，乔纳斯本身是一个很好的医师，把他雪藏起来对于资源是一种极大的浪费。

original:
People often innocently ask me "Confessor, why do you worship a bomb?" Like curious children, they come to me with questions about the most visible and perhaps controversial aspect of our faith. The innocent among us hear my sermons before the great symbol, the see us bathe in the waters, and they wonder if it is danger we seek -- a suicide pact, perhaps. And while you may be tempted to answer their curiosity with anger, my gentle Children of Atom, you must never do so.

The core of Atom's philosophy teaches us peace. That we must educate the curious and work towards alleviating their ignorance, that we must teach them to accept the glory of the Division of the past and to seek the glory of the Division that is to come. 

Teach them, my Children, teach them how the miserable rotten meat of their bodies will give birth to countless lives at the time of Division. Teach them that they should not mourn the world that has passed, but praise and celebrate those that have already been Divided. Teach them the blessing, the glory, that the peace of our communion and the satisfaction that can be found in our blessed work.

Teach them, my Children. Teach them well, and in the teaching, find your peace and your place. This is the core of Atom's message to us. Spread. Grow. Communicate.

Go in peace, my precious Children. Walk in Atom's Glow.
translation:
一些无罪的人们经常天真地、像小孩子似地问我：“教主，你为什么要崇拜个炸弹呢？”这是一个显而易见却又引人深思的问题。那些无罪之人曾聆听过我在伟大的神物前的训诫，看到过我们在圣水之中的沐浴，他们可能会想知道我们这样做是否在玩火自焚。这种时候，你们可能会想要怒斥他们的好奇，我的友爱的子民们，你们万万不可这样。

原子哲学的核心部分教导我们要和谐处世。对于那些好奇的人，我们要用耐心的教导来消逐他们的无知，我们要教导他们去接受审判日曾经带给我们的荣耀，去寻找审判日未来将会带给我们的荣耀。

去教导他们，我的子民们，教导他们那些腐烂的躯壳是怎样在审判日来临之时升华为数不尽的鲜活生命的。教导他们不要为了曾经失落的世界哀伤，而要去歌颂与赞扬审判过后的透彻。教导他们去祝福，教导他们去荣耀，教导他们在我们教众的神圣引导之下过上舒适安逸的和谐生活。

去教导他们，我的子民们，努力教导他们。在教导中找到你自己的和谐生活与安身之所。这就是原子神学的核心：散播、成长、感染。

和谐地出发吧，我至亲的子民们，带着原子的光和热出发吧。

original:
Congratulations on receiving your new DCTA Standard-Issue Laser Pistol!

Please take a few minutes to go over the guidelines posted in the DCTA Employee Handbook; Section 28.1.1.b, and reprinted below for your convenience.

Section 28.1.1.b - Proper Laser Pistol Usage

It should be noted that all DCTA property should be handled with the utmost care, and used only when necessary. Maintaining personal safety during a Communist attack is a good example of proper usage of your standard issue laser pistol. However, rodent population control is an inappropriate use and subject to disciplinary action, as noted in Section 11.3.5.c

Section 28.1.1.b.1 - Maintaining Safe Conditions With the Laser Pistol

Using this laser pistol in the DCTA Metro facility can be beneficial in many ways, but the operator must observe his or her surroundings before deciding to fire. The subway utility pipes often serve as conduit to transport highly flammable gasses. Firing the laser pistol in the presence of a gas leak could cause an undesired explosion and/or severe personal injury.

Section 28.1.1.b.2 - Operating the Laser Pistol Within Proper Specifications

It is required that all DCTA Employees keep the laser pistol pulse energy, length and repetition rate within the specifications diagrammed in the Laser Pistol User's Manual. Failure to do so could result in severe reprimands from the DCTA Regulatory Committee as well as serious personal injury.
translation:
恭喜您收到了一支全新的DCTA标准版激光手枪！

章节28.1.1.b - 激光手枪的正当用途

DCTA对自己资产的谨慎态度是闻名于世的，除非必要是绝对不允许动用的。一个正确使用您的标准发行激光手枪的好例子就是保证自己幸免于共产党的攻击。无论如何，控制啮齿目动物数量不是一个正当的用途并且会遭到纪律处分，这一点已经记录在了章节11.3.5.c

章节28.1.1.b.1 - 激光手枪的使用环境

在DCTA的地下设施中会有很多情况下要用到激光手枪，但是在决定开火之前使用者一定要注意其周围的环境。地下管道中包含很多瓦斯管道，在有瓦斯泄漏的地方开火有可能会导致瓦斯爆炸并造成大量伤亡。

章节28.1.1.b.2 - 严格按照规则使用激光手枪

所有的DCTA雇员都要时刻保持激光手枪中的脉冲能量，长度与重复频率参见绘制在激光手枪用户手册上的详细说明。懈怠行为将会导致来自DCTA管理委员会除了人身伤害外的严厉惩罚。

original: Lab Report: Prototype ZRIN-363\n\nExperimental prototype makes extensive use of hardware common to liquid ammunition flame projection weapons.  While initial test results were impressive, extreme weight of unit (118.3kg) and fume inhalation rendered most test subjects incapable of firing the unit or remaining conscious under typical field conditions.
translation: 实验报告：原型ZRIN-363\n\n实验原型广泛应用于装配液体弹药火焰喷射武器。最初的测试结果令人印象深刻，过沉的重量（118.3公斤）以及大量烟尘的吸入导致大部分测试科目失败于人员在典型的战场条件下无法正常开火或者无法保持清醒状态。

original: Terminal Entry
translation: 终端机记录

original: Lab Report: Prototype ZRIN-375\n\nPrototype introduces proprietary ammunition type.  Conventional 10mm shells house a caplet containing amalgamating agents.  When the caplet was broken in lab tests, localized fireburst and shrapnel projection met requirements for project.  However, in field tests amalgam caplet ammunition proved too fragile, and several detonated from excessive vibration or walk speed.
translation: 实验报告：原型ZRIN-375\n\n原型采用了专有的弹药类型。常规的10毫米弹壳内被放入了一个含有汞齐化作用剂的囊片。实验中，囊片被破坏时会产生局部的焰爆，同时必将导致弹片纷飞的结果。不管怎样，实弹实验中汞合金囊片的弹药被证实非常的脆弱，有些甚至会在震动和急行军的过程中被引爆。

original: Terminal Entry
translation: 终端机记录

original: Lab Report: Prototype ZRIN-401\n\nPrototype attempts to refine results of acumist coating within weapon barrel.  Initial tests showed promise.  As predicted, delivery friction super-heats projectile as it is delivered from the weapon, and conventional 10mm ammunition can be used.  However; during live-fire testing, subjects firing the weapon in rapid succession suffered severe burns to the fingers and palm.
translation: 实验报告：原型ZRIN-401\n\n我们试着通过将混合涂层涂在枪管的内壁来完善原型。最初的测试让人看到了希望。同预料的一样，发射的时候子弹会因为摩擦力而过热，而且能够使用常规的10毫米弹药。然而，实弹射击实验中发现，持续不断的开火会导致手指与手掌的严重烧伤。

original: Terminal Entry
translation: 终端机记录

original: Lab Report: Prototype ZRIN-418\n\nPrototype refines acumist barrel experiments by addition of retardant jacketing, as well as internal heat diffusers.  Rate of fire diminished from un-modified version of weapon.  Conventional 10mm ammunition does not fully liquefy until impact, giving the 418 exceptional accuracy compared to earlier prototypes.  Live-fire tests report no major casualties.  Recommend ZRIN-418 as production candidate.
translation: 实验报告：原型ZRIN-418\n\n通过加上缓冲层，原型的混合涂层枪管更加完善了，内部散热问题也得到了解决。改进后的原型射速略低于更改前的武器。但是除非强烈的撞击常规的10毫米弹药是不会解体的，而且这赋予了418比先前的原型更加优越的精准度。实弹射击实验中没有什么重大事故，推荐ZRIN-418作为生产用枪。

original: Analysis ->\nFurther research regarding Laser Weaponry has not revealed much we didn't already know.  Small production run of prototype weapons developed by US Military, most of these weapons were recovered from military armories where the weapons were being tested by live-fire groups of active duty personnel.
translation: 分析 ->\n对激光武器的进一步研究并未揭示出太多我们尚未知晓的信息。美国军方已开发出小批量的原型武器，其中大多已从军械库中回收，当时这些武器正由现役人员组成的实弹小组进行测试。

original: Research Note - Laser Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 — 激光步枪

original:
Critical Components ->
Power drawn from Micro fusion Cell is processed through a Wave/Particle Diverter (manuf:Gen Atomics Intnl).  Diverters are protected by carbon-fiber housing, preventing frequent malfunction, but when a diverter fails the weapon becomes unusable, and this part is extremely difficult to replace or repair.

Precision-cut lenses focus optic energy.  Lenses are prone to damage and can grossly affect precision of the firing weapon's firing mechanism.  Lenses are easily replaced with any clear glass, but require a great deal of skill to fabricate.
translation:
关键部件 ->
由微型聚变电池提供的电力通过波/粒分流器（制造商：通用原子国际）进行处理。分流器由碳纤维外壳保护，可防止频繁故障，但分流器一旦失效，武器将无法使用，且此部件极难更换或维修。

精密切割的透镜用于聚焦光学能量。透镜容易受损，并会严重影响开火武器发射机构的精确度。透镜很容易用任何透明玻璃替换，但制造需要极高的技艺。

original: Research Note - Laser Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 — 激光步枪

original: Field Operation ->\nA fully charged cell will discharge 20 bolts from a pistol, and 12 shots from the rifle model.  Recoil is negligible compared to ballistic weapons, so long range combat requires less marksmanship ability of the soldier.
translation: 实地操作 ->\n一块充满电的电池可为手枪提供20发能量束，为步枪型号提供12发。与弹道武器相比，其后坐力微乎其微，因此远距离作战对士兵的射击技能要求较低。

original: Research Note - Laser Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 — 激光步枪

original: Maintenance ->\nThe chassis are easily opened, allowing the weapon to be serviced in the field.  Purified water and a clean cloth can be used to wash mirrored and glass components, slowing wear on the weapon.  The weapon can also overheat after a period of intense use.  This can be counteracted by submerging the barrel of the weapon in water, which helps cool heat sinks located beneath the chassis shell in that area.
translation: 维护 ->\n底座易于打开，便于在野外进行维修。可以使用纯净水和干净的布来清洗镜面和玻璃部件，以减缓武器的磨损。长时间高强度使用后，武器可能会过热。这可通过将武器枪管浸入水中来抵消，这样做有助于冷却位于该区域底座外壳下方的散热片。

original: A Birthday Poem
translation: 一首生日诗

original:
Gray walls, impenetrable steel.
Suffocation! Condemnation!
Little hands groping in subterranean uncertainty.
Mommy? Daddy? Am I dead?
Nay! Nay! Reborn into purifying fluorescence!

A face emerges, strong and male.
Father to me? Father to all! 
Overseeing our lives, our eternities.
Harshness of discipline. Harshness of love.
Obedience my savior!

Larva to pupa, pupa to worker.
Buzz, buzz! One with the steel honeycomb.
10 lies within the 101, significant at last.
Till gray seeps from walls to hair, to soul.
Then, eternal slumber, the sweet sleep of incineration.
translation:
阴暗的围墙，不可逾越的铁壁。
令人窒息！罪孽的宣告！
小手在这未知的地下摸索。
母亲？父亲？我已经死了吗？
没有！还没有！去为净化这荧光而重生吧！

一张脸浮现了出来，坚毅而阳刚。
是我的父亲吗？不 他是万物之父！
他俯视着我们的今生与来世。
严厉的训诫，严厉的爱。
服从你！我们的造物主！

虫化蛹，蛹化蜂。
在这铁铸的蜂房间飞舞。
101号避难所的十大谎言，深意最终也会彰显。
直到这黑暗从墙缝中流出，透进发丝，渗进灵魂。
那时，甜美地睡在焚身的烈火中，永恒的长眠。

original:
By Walter “Street Beat” Munroe

Capital Post Staff Writer

What American child alive hasn’t heard the story of the Pint-Sized Slasher, that diminutive demon in a clown mask who stalks and slashes the innocent residents of supposedly safe suburbia? It’s just one of the many folk stories parents use to scare their youngsters into behaving themselves. Or is it?

According to Germantown police chief Joseph Field, the Pint-Sized Slasher may be more real than many people would like to admit. “After reviewing the autopsy results of the Linden Street slayings, we have confirmed that the force and direction of every knife wound are consistent with an attack from a much smaller assailant. A child, to be precise.”

Add to the sinister forensic findings this statement from Christopher Atkinson, the one surviving victim of the adolescent assassin, and it becomes clear that the Pint-Sized Slasher does indeed walk among us: “The clown! The clown! He’s going to kill us all, do you understand me? He stabbed my brother Shaun right in the face! He killed my brother! The little clown!”

But assuming the Pint-Sized Slasher is indeed a real, tangible threat to the peace loving residents of D.C. suburbia, one question remains: why? What could possible motivate a child to don a clown mask and murder innocent people in cold blood? We may never know. At least not until the miniature maniac is brought to justice. Until then, all we can do is lock our doors, kiss our children goodnight… and pray they live to see morning.
translation:
来自 瓦尔特·史惴特法艾特·门罗

《首都邮政》特约记者

哪一个美国的儿童没有听过那个小开膛手的故事？这个迷你的恶魔，带着小丑的面具，偷偷地潜入家里，杀害那些住在郊区的无辜的居民，而他们一直都以为那儿很安全。这是众多民间故事中的一个，家长用来吓唬孩子，以使他们懂得要守规矩。是这样吗？

根据日耳曼敦警察局长乔瑟夫·菲尔德的说法，小开膛手可能是真实的，而不是大多数人想的那样只是个谣传。“在重新检查过了林登大街凶杀案的尸检报告之后，我们确信，每一道刀伤的力度和角度，都来自于一个体型很小的凶手。 准确而言，一个孩子。”

 而克里斯多弗·艾金森，少年遇袭案的一个幸存者，他的证言证实了这一点：小开膛手就游荡在我们周围，千真万确。“小丑！小丑！他想杀了我们所有人，你明白吗？他刺中了我弟弟肖恩的右脸！他杀了我弟弟！这个小丑！”

但是如果这个严重威胁华盛顿郊区这些热爱和平的居民的小开膛手确有其事的话，那还有一个问题：动机。谁有可能诱使一个孩子披上小丑的面具去冷酷的残害无辜的居民？可能我们永远不会知道。至少有一点，这个小疯子还没有受到制裁。在那之前，我们能做到，就是要锁好门窗，然后给孩子道晚安，送入眠。

original:
The RC hydroponics have been restored to basic functionality - easy enough after all our research. The limited amount of clean water we can produce is enough for growing basic foodstuffs.

Still no progress on any mass-purification tests, and with all of the maintenance that has to be done around here, there's hardly any time to attempt new experiments.

* 传言在特区的奴隶贩子、掠夺者，变种人的活动有所增加，丹佛斯需要加强保卫小组的战斗训练以确保城市安全。

* 李博士被叫走处理无土栽培系统问题。

original: Regional Health Hazards
translation: 地区性卫生灾害

original:
Apart from the standard dangers, Rivet City provides a few uncommon problems for long-time residents:

* Lockjaw: Muscle spasms, especially of the jaw, from getting cuts on the rusty ship hull. Treat with penicillin, when available.

* Red-lung: Respiratory problems from regularly inhaling rust particles - particularly a problem for hangar deck residents and shut-ins. Treat with steam therapy and time outside to flush system.

* Fish poisoning: Less of a problem nowadays, but occasionally someone finds a fish in the river and is dumb enough to try to eat the thing. Radiation levels spike and mercury poisoning drives most victims crazy. No cure, but at least people nearby get a reminder not to do it.
translation:
除了一些常规病例之外，铆钉城一直以来都有些不算常规的地方病：

*破伤风：肌肉痉挛，尤其在颚部，一般是被生锈的船体割伤导致的。及时发现可以使用盘尼西林医治。

*红肺症：长期呼入锈颗粒引起的呼吸系统问题 - 多发于长期呆在机库平台的人和足不出户的人，应用蒸汽疗法或多出去走走以清理肺部。

*鱼中毒：如今很少见，但偶尔有人会在河里发现一条鱼并且蠢到去吃它。极高的辐射水平以及重金属中毒会让受害人陷入疯狂，无药可救。至少在他抓鱼的时候，附近的人应该提醒他不要那么做。

original: Patient Files
translation: 病人资料

original:
Bannon: Still suffering from his "social problem." Keep on penicillin, and try to convince him to watch out in the future.

Brock: Another day, another broken nose. Rare to see him as a patient, but at least the people he "refers" are still alive. Barely.

Cantelli, Paulie: Treatment for the steady stream of his addictions would be a steady income, but I can't waste the resources on him if he's just going to get hooked again.

Holmes, Seagrave: Chronic case of red-lung from all his repairs below-decks. Prescribed a few hours of fresh air up top every night.

Staley, Gary: Exhaustion. The man really needs to take a rest at some point. But then again, who doesn't?

Trinnie: Surprisingly healthy, apart from the alcoholism and other chronic dangers of her line of work. Guess they grow them strong in Lamplight.
translation:
班侬：仍然因为他心中的“社会问题”而收到煎熬，继续服用盘尼西林。尝试说服他将眼光看向长远的未来。

布洛克：又被打坏了鼻子。他作为病人来我这里可是很难得，不过至少他的对手还活着。嗯，算是还活着吧。

保利·坎特利：虽然一次次的处理他的上瘾症状可以给我提供稳定的收入，但话说回来，这可真是对医疗资源的浪费。

西格雷夫·福尔摩斯：他在低层甲板上进行的修理工作，让他已经体现出了红肺症的慢性症状。规定他每天晚上必须到顶部去呼吸几个小时的新鲜空气。

加里·斯塔利：过劳了。有时候他真的需要休息，但这里谁不是这样？

崔妮：令人惊喜的良好健康状况，就她的工作环境来说，她至少应该中点毒啊或者得点其他什么慢性病，可是竟然都没有。小灯镇长大的孩子就是不一样。

original: Rebuilding Proposal
translation: 重建建议

original:
"We excel at destroying the old world, and we excel at building a new one."
- Chairman Cheng

Two hundred years ago, Chairman Cheng led his armies to defeat the decadent rulers of this land. Now, his humble descendant, Comrade Cheng, shall lead its noble people to rebuild a brighter land in its place!

By uniting to work together, we can eradicate the twin dangers of lawlessness and disease. With unified soldiers, we can cleanse the land of beasts and highwaymen. With organized farmers, we can overcome starvation and poverty. 

When competing villages are destroyed, all must unite under the glorious leadership of Comrade Cheng and the Tenpenny Commune!
translation:
“我们擅长于摧毁旧的世界，同时我们也擅长于建立一个新的。”
- 陈主席

两百年前，陈主席带领他的军队推翻了这个大陆上腐朽的政权。现在，他谦卑的后代，陈同志，将领导他高尚的人民在这里重建一个生机勃勃的大陆！

我们并肩作战，必将摧毁动乱和疾病这对孪生兄弟。通过有纪律的士兵，我们能够清洗这个大陆上的禽兽和逃犯。通过有组织的农民，我们能够战胜饥饿和贫穷。

当所有敌对村庄被消灭后，所有的人都将团结在光荣的领袖陈同志和特佩尼公社之下！

You're standing in the dusty market square of a quiet town.   Many of the shops and homes lie abandoned, and the citzens that can be seen speak in hushed voices, casting furtive glances at the darkened skyline in the distant north.  The ringing of an anvil breaks the silence regularly, where a mustachioed blacksmith bends over his work in a nearby tent.

The blacksmith is here, working.

A priest is here, drinking.

你站在一个寂静的小镇里的集贸广场上，这里布满了灰尘。许多店铺和住房已经被搁置很久，居民们交谈也都带着萧寂的声音，时不时瞥上一眼远处北方昏暗的天空。清脆的打铁声适时的打破了这里的宁静，一个留着八字胡的铁匠正弯着腰在附近的帐篷干活。

这里有一个铁匠，正在工作。

这里有一个牧师，正在喝水。

A small cemetery of crooked headstones lies in the shadow of the cracked steeple.  The dirt path winds westward through a great, featureless plain.

A zombie totters aimlessly nearby.

There is an open grave nearby.

你站在一条肮脏的小路的尽头，对面是一个小教堂。泥灰的墙体早已褪色，屋顶上许多瓦片也不知去向。巨大的橡木门紧锁着，也看不到一个教会的人。教堂的尖塔满是裂纹，一小块破败的坟地静静的躺在它的影子下面。这条肮脏的小路向西弯弯曲曲的穿过一个毫无特色的大平原。

一个僵尸踉踉跄跄的游荡在周围。

original: You are standing on a narrow stone path in a dark marsh.  Greasy bubbles float to the top of the bog-waters on either side and pop lazily, spattering your legs with muck and slime.  A short, stone tower squats here.  No door is visible, and the stones are smooth and polished.  A balcony juts out midway up the tower's face.  The heady smells of incense mix with the nauseating stench of the swamp.  The stone path unfurls eastward, towards a broad plain beyond the marshes.\n\nA wizard is here, gesticulating wildly from his balcony.

The priest notices your approach and looks up from his swilling.
"Grelok is come, and we are forsaken!", he cries.  "Urp!", he continues.

As you recover from the stench of the priestly belch, you are told that the priest has fled from his nearby chapel.  When Grelok arrived on the mountain, the dead in his cemetery began to rise, and his congregation scattered. 

"If you could rid the place of the zombies", he tells you, "I'll give you the key, and you can help yourself to the apothecary"
translation:
牧师注意到你向他走来，停止了痛饮，抬头望向你。

“如果你能从僵尸手里拯救这个地方”，他说，“我会把这把钥匙给你，它可以用来帮助你成为药剂师。”

The huge man swipes sweat from his bald head and looks up from his work.\n\n"There's no shortage of work to be done with Grelok scarin' everyone witless.  Leave me to filling my orders, stranger." 铁匠粗声的问候你并准备把你赶出去的时候，你从包里拿出了那颗璀璨的宝石。他把他的锤子放在了一边，小胡子激动的不停颤抖。

牧师醉醺醺的咒骂着玷污了他的教堂的不死生物。你给他看了背包里的僵尸头颅。

translation:
你站在一条肮脏的小路的尽头，对面是一个小教堂。泥灰的墙体早已褪色，屋顶上许多瓦片也不知去向。巨大的橡木门虚掩着，也看不到一个教会的人。教堂的尖塔满是裂纹，一小块破败的坟地静静的躺在它的影子下面。这条肮脏的小路向西弯弯曲曲的穿过一个毫无特色的大平原。

教堂的门没有上锁。

附近有一个被打开的墓穴。

original: A text note
translation: 一条信息

original: Dust motes hang lazily in the shafts of colored light stretching across the chapel from peaked windows.  The pews, pulpit, and everything else are covered in a fine mist.  There is a very deep stone cistern near the entrance.  It is full to the brim with blessed water.\n\nThere is more than enough water here to fill your tiny flask.
translation: 无数的浮尘在小教堂的尖顶窗户透进来的彩色光线中懒洋洋的游荡。条凳，讲坛，以及其他的所有事物都笼罩在一片美好的氛围下。教堂的入口处有一个非常深的石槽，里面满溢着圣水。\n\n这里有足够的水装满你的小瓶。

original: A text note
translation: 一条信息

original:
The wizard beckons wildly at you from his balcony.  "You're here, you've arrived!", he exclaims.  After an awkward silence, he jabs an excited finger into a crystal ball, nearly knocking it into the bog.  

"I've seen, you see.  You're the one to defeat Grelok.  Hoo-hoo!" The little man hops onto the railing, spinning a pirouette.  "Now the time's come to play my part.  Toss up the gem!"  

The wizard's brow furrows.  "Got things a bit out of order, have I?  Come back when you've got a powerful gemstone.  Soon - I've never got to fulfill a prophecy before!"
translation:
巫师在他的阳台上对你急切的打着招呼。“你终于来了！终于来了！”，他激动的喊道。一阵尴尬的沉默之后，他激动的用一个颤抖的手指猛地戳向一个水晶球，几乎把它撞进沼泽里。

“我看到了，你看。你是击败格惹洛克的那个人。吼-吼！”，这个小巧的人儿跳上了栏杆，兴奋的转了一圈。“是该我出场的时候了，把那个宝石扔上来！”

巫师的额头皱了起来，“我有点操之过急，是不是？等你找到一颗强大的宝石再回到我这里吧！快！ - 我还没有实现过一个预言呢！”

original: A text note
translation: 一条信息

original: The wizard is shooing you away, his sleeves flopping about.\n\n"Go!  Find the gemstone and return, so I can play my part!"
translation: 巫师很远就看到了你，挥舞着他长长的袖管。\n\n“快去！找到宝石然后回来，我等不及要出场了！”

original: A text note
translation: 一条信息

original:
"Hoo-hoo!  The slayer of Grelok approaches, raw stone in hand, just as I've seen!"  The wizard's pointy hat bobs excitedly as he points a finger at you.  Suddenly, a pale orange arc of light extends from the knobby finger and draws the gemstone from your bag before you can react.  The gemstone halts and hovers in the air before the wizard's nose.

"Essence be true, powers renew, Fatty-Hoo-Do!"  With that, he slaps the hovering stone, smashing it against the smooth stone of the tower.  In a burst of light, the stone splits into two, and one lands in each outstretched palm of the hopping little wizard.

"Shard for the sword.  Wrap her in iron and she'll find Grelok's black heart for you.  Take the chaff, too.  You'll need payment for a smith to forge the weapon."  He tosses the stones down which you leap forward to catch safely.
translation:
“吼-吼！格惹洛克的克星来了，手里拿着宝石，就像我曾经看到的那样！”，巫师指着你，尖尖的帽子兴奋的跳动着。突然，巫师多节的手指上出现了一道淡橘色的弧光，还没等你反应过来，宝石已经被它从包里拽走了。快到达巫师鼻头的时候，宝石悬停在了那里。

“就是这个，强大的能量，太好了！”。随即，他拿起宝石在塔的墙体上猛击。随着一道闪光，宝石分成了两半，各自躺在这个忙碌的小个子巫师伸出的两个手掌里。

“这是为你的剑所准备的，把她嵌在剑里，她会为你找到格惹洛克那颗黑暗的心脏。拿上这些玩意，付锻造费的时候你会用得着。”，他把石头扔了下来，你赶紧冲上去接住。

original: A text note
translation: 一条信息

original: "Get you to a smithy!  Forge the shard with sword, and defeat Grelok!"\n\nThe wizard tosses some pebbles down to shoo you away and busies himself conjuring colored puffs of smoke.
translation: “找到铸剑的地方，把碎片嵌进去，然后去击败格惹洛克！”\n\n巫师向你扔小石子赶你走，然后陶醉的吸起了他那带着魔幻色彩的烟。

original: A text note
translation: 一条信息

original:
When you draw your sword, Grelok lowers his great horned head and bellows laughter in your face.  You grit your teeth and swing a mighty two-handed blow, the magical blade ringing clearly, even amid the tumult of throaty cackling.  

You swing the sword so fiercely, it escapes your grip and hurtles into the open maw of the monstrosity, lost from sight in the arid darkness of Grelok's throat.  You step back as Grelok jerks his mouth shut and stands upright.  He is still for a moment, then starts clawing at his neck.  Muffled, a ringing can be heard as if from a great distance.

Suddenly, Grelok's chest bursts in a fount of viscous, green blood.  The Ringing can be heard clearly now, and as thick lifeblood oozes around the protruding tip of the magic sword, the stormclouds swirling the peak are already clearing.  Grelok is defeated!

            THE END
    (Thanks for playing!)
translation:
你决然的拔出手中的长剑，对面，格惹洛克正低着他那颗长着怪角的硕大脑壳高声嘲笑你。你紧咬着牙关，双手抓着剑柄奋力的挥舞起来，如此噪杂的环境，仍然能够清晰的听到魔法剑破空发出的铮鸣声。

你奋力的挥舞并掷出手中的长剑，它呼啸着飞了出去，没入了对面那个怪物黝黑而干瘪的喉咙当中。格惹洛克僵立在原地，面部不停的抽搐，你小心翼翼的后退着。片刻之后，这个家伙开始抓挠自己的脖子。一种奇怪的响声从那下面传了出来，就像是从远处传来的一般。

突然间，粘稠的绿色血液染上了格惹洛克的胸口，响声也清晰了起来。随着粘稠的血液顺着魔法剑缓缓的流了出来，盘旋在峰顶的暴风云也渐渐消失了。格惹洛克被击败了！

            剧终
    （感谢您的参与！）

original: Field Entry: A001 "Wild Dog"
translation: 实验记录: A001 "野狗"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Chordata
Class: Mammalia
Order: Carnivora
Family: Canidae
Genus: Canis

Despite extensive testing I cannot further identify the origins of this mammal.  It is clearly canis familiaris but generations of mutation have caused it to become its own new breed.  An educated guess would place it as Canis Lupus or possibly Canis Indica.  Even with the order’s characteristically thick skull, the subject’s brainwaves have been mutated, and territorial aggression amplified.  While domestication is still possible with some subjects, the creature should generally be considered hostile.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 脊索动物门
纲： 哺乳动物纲
目： 食肉目
科： 犬科
属： 犬属

尽管已经进行了广泛的测试，我仍然无法进一步地鉴定出这种哺乳动物的来源。它们明显是一种食肉目犬科的动物，但是几代的变异已经使它们成为了一个新的物种。如果凭经验猜测，它们应该是狼属或者有可能是印度狼属。尽管它们有着这个目的典型特征 — 厚实的头盖骨，但是一些试验样本的脑波已经产生了变异，领地的侵略性也增强了。虽然一些样本依然可以被驯化，但是总的来说应该将它们归纳为攻击型生物。

original: Field Entry: A002 "Large Scorpion"
translation: 实验记录: A002 "大蝎子"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Class: Arachnida
Order: Scorpiones
Family: Scorpionidae
Genus: Pandinus

Based on research, it first glance appears to be an enlarged Pandinus Imperator, but further testing is required to make a more precise identification.  The subject’s vesicle has mutated to match its enlarged hypodermic aculeus and the neurotoxin now acts on the potassium and calcium channels.  Captive subject was hostile and should be considered a minor threat, though they could prove a problem in larger numbers.  Anecdotal reports of specimens even larger than those we have observed exist, but it is likely that such reports are exaggerations.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 节肢动物门
纲： 蛛形纲
目： 蝎形目
科： 蝎科
属： 帝王属

根据研究，这个物种初步被认为是巨型化的将军巨蝎，但是想作出更精确的鉴定还需要进一步的实际测试。这个物种的毒腺发生了变异以便能适应它们增大后的尾刺，毒腺里的神经毒素现在能作用于细胞内的钾、钙离子通道。抓捕到的标本具有攻击性，应当考虑到他们可能带来的潜在威胁，虽然问题可能只有在他们的数量变得更多的时候才出现。据说这个物种甚至会比现在我们已经观察到的还要庞大，不过这种说法多是有些夸张的成分。

original: Field Entry: A003 "Mole Rat"
translation: 实验记录: A003 "鼹鼠"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Chordata
Class: Mammalia
Order: Rodentia
Family: Bathyergidae 

Subject most closely resembles a Heterocephalus Glaber with enlargement due to heavy radiation.  While much larger in size than generational ancestors, the local variety seems to have similarly low brain function, possibly due to an exceedingly tiny brain organ.  Subject’s incisors show increased enamel and dentine growth, making them razor sharp.  Further study reveals extremely low levels of Substance P giving this subject an incredible tolerance to pain.  I will take skin samples of my next subject as I believe the lack of Substance P can be spliced and manipulated for beneficial research, but this theory requires testing in a more fitting lab.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 脊索动物门
纲： 哺乳动物纲
目： 啮齿目
科： 滨鼠科 

该试验对象和受到重度辐射而增大化的裸鼹形鼠十分相似。这种本地动物的体型远大于它们种族的祖先，但脑部功能似乎和它们的祖先一样低下，也许是因为它们的脑部组织都很小。试验对象门齿的珐琅质与牙质的增长，使得他们的牙齿如剃刀般锐利。进一步的试验表明该对象体内的磷化物含量极低，使得他们对疼痛具有难以置信忍耐力。我会在下一个试验对象身上取一些皮肤样本，因为我相信这种低磷化物产生的机制可以用于日后有实际意义的研究工作，但是我需要一个更好的实验室来进一步测试这个理论。

original: Search Party Log #1
translation: 搜索小队日志#1

original:
First time I’ve thought to update the log since leaving Canterbury.  Guard at the Citadel wouldn't let us in, but said a scribe had given Cheryl the medicine at least two weeks ago and sent her along to the Rangers.  From the sounds of it, Myles didn't make it as far as Citadel.  Damn shame, he was a good mutt.

Still no sign of Cheryl.  Rumors about the city are true - place is a death trap.  Mutants and psychos at every turn.  Cheryl's tough enough, but I'm worried, especially with Myles missing.  Emmet just about went to pieces the first time we ran into a centaur.

We should be able to reach the Ranger Compound in before sundown tomorrow.  Kaya scouted ahead and it looks like the coast is clear for now.  With any luck, Cheryl’s holed up with them and we can start back home.  

Here lies Henry.  Muties saw him going for water in the street; there was nothing we could do to help him.  If anybody else has to come looking for us, we’ll leave word with the Rangers.
translation:
这是我离开坎特伯雷之后第一次想更新自己的日志。五角大本营的守卫不让我进去，但他们说至少两个星期前，一位学士已经医好了谢丽尔，然后将她送往了游骑兵那里。照这么说来，迈勒斯是没能到达五角大本营了。真该死，他是个好蠢货。

依旧没有谢丽尔的踪迹。关于这座城市的传言也是真的 - 这里就是死亡的陷阱。变种人和疯子们无处不在。谢丽尔十分的坚强，但我依然很担心，特别是因为迈勒斯的失踪。我们首次遭遇多脚兽这种怪物时，艾米特几乎都要崩溃了。

在明天日落之前，我们应该能到达游骑兵营地。卡娅侦察过了前方，那里的海岸现在看起来暂时是安全的。但愿，谢丽尔和他们藏好了，找到她之后我们就可以启程回家了。

亨利就躺在这里。他来这街上找水时变种人发现了他；我们也无能为力。如果已经有其他人出发来寻找我们了，我们会在游骑兵那里留下消息。

original:
<MEMO>
attn: Warehouse/Repair Employees

Please make sure the main platform in the Repair Sector is properly raised before releasing the repaired bots from their pods.  All units receive fimware programming to make their way to the main entrance and await pickup.  Let's get them there safely and not repeat last week's accident involving a Protectron falling to the lower level.  That error cost us time, money, and was an embarrassment to the company and our DCTA account client.

-- Management
translation:
attn：仓库/修理工人

在从分离舱释放那些修理机器人之前，请确保在维修区的基本站台是适当地升起来的。所有收到稳定器计划的单位正向主要出口一路前进，并等待接收。把他们安全地送到那里，不要再重演上星期保护器落到最底层那样的意外。那个致命的错误花费了我们大量的时间和金钱。同时，那错误不论对我们公司来说，还是对我们的DCTA注册客户来说，都是一个尴尬和阻碍。

-- 管理处

original:
I can't take it anymore, Bob.  I don't trust those turrets in Sector A.  I swear I saw one track me the other day when I left work a little late.  If that thing opens up on me, I'm screwed, since the bastard Feds suspended workman's comp as part of the "war effort."  Hell.

Snake helped me smuggle in some pulse grenades that I locked away in the box under my desk.  I tried one out on our Handy at the house and the missus nearly killed me!  Knocks 'em out like a light.  If you ever need one just grab the key from behind my terminal and use it to unlock the box. You can't say I never did anything for you!  See you around buddy.

Oh, and stop throwing those staples over at me, they get on the floor and you know how I like to take my shoes off during the day.
translation:
我不能再想象了，鲍勃。我不相信在A区的那些炮塔。我发誓在前几天我晚下班的时候，我看见有个炮塔在瞄准我。如果那东西向我开火的话，我肯定会晕头转向的。因为讨厌的联邦政府工作人员把暂停工人抚恤金作为“战争成就”的一部分，该死的。

斯内克帮我偷运进来一些脉冲手榴弹，我把那些手榴弹锁在我的书桌下面。我就在我家附近试用了一个，但它差点把我给杀死了。当它爆炸时，就像闪过一阵光一样。如果你也需要一个的话，只要拿到在接线端后面的钥匙，就可以打开我的盒子。你不会说我从来没有为你做过什么吧！再见了朋友。

噢，还有，不要再向我丢那些钉子了，那些钉子都掉在地上，你也知道平日我是喜欢怎样脱掉鞋子的。

translation: 给汉尼根找一本医学书。

translation: NCR监狱里的汉尼根想让你帮他找一本医学书。

original: Bannon's Request
translation: 班侬的请求

original: Bannon has asked me to search Seagrave Holmes' room to see if I can find anything incriminating about him. Then Bannon can stop him from taking over his council seat.
translation: 班侬让我到西格雷夫·福尔摩斯的房间看是否能发现指控他的证据，这样一来班侬可以避免西格雷夫？福尔摩斯代替他在理事会的位置。

original: Seagrave's Incriminating Letter
translation: 西格雷夫的涉嫌信

original: You've turned us down twice now, Holmes. This is my last appeal. We used to be friends. We used to do business together. All I want is to sell our product in Rivet City. I'm sure the city could use slaves to help with the rebuilding. Paradise Falls has slaves to sell, at a good price. You used to sell me wastelanders you captured, before you got all full of yourself. You aren't as pure as you pretend. Help me and we can both make a nice profit.\n\nEulogy Jones
translation: 你已经拒绝了我们两次了，福尔摩斯。好吧，我再说最后一次。我们曾是朋友，我们曾是生意伙伴。我只是想把东西卖给铆钉城。我敢肯定铆钉城需要奴隶来搞那些重建工作。堕落天堂有的是奴隶卖，价钱也好。你发财之前又不是没朝我卖过你抓住的那些废土客。别装纯洁了，好啦帮帮我，大家都有好处。\n\n尤勒基·琼斯

original: Note For Ted
translation: 给泰德的笔记

original:
Ted,
 
The Mirelurks busted out of the storage area and have been raisin' hell through the whole facility. Price says the bastards get smarter every day. He says I'm paranoid, but I think somebody might be sabotaging things around here.  We've taken on so much extra help, I don't know who I can trust around here anymore.  Things don't look too good.

I don't think I'll be walking out of here, and I figure you should be the one to get our stash. I managed to get it hidden pretty well in case something like this happened. 

I don't want any of these damn fools tripping over it, so I threw a couple of curves in, but it's nothing you can't handle.  Start with my terminal -- just log in and follow the instructions. And if for some reason you’ve forgotten the password, you might want to sit down and have a think with a Nuka-Cola, if you catch my drift.

If this damn meat weren't in such high demand, I'd have pulled out of this racket before the word go.  I got too greedy, Ted.
translation:
泰德，
 
那些泥沼蟹逃出了仓库区，现在整个设施内都他妈的是这些鬼东西了。老钱说这些混蛋们每天都会变得更聪明。他还说我多疑了，但我认为是有些人正在这附近搞破坏。我们雇了很多额外的帮手，我不知道身边谁还能够信任。这事可没有看上去那么简单。

我不认为我还能活着走出去，我想那个去取走我们收藏品的人应该是你了。我先前设法将它好好的藏了起来，就是怕会有今天这样的事发生。

我可不希望这里的某个该死的笨蛋不经意间发现了它，所以藏它的时候费了不少功夫，不过没什么你应付不了的事。去我的终端机那登陆进去然后按着上面的指示来。如果你因为某些原因忘了密码，那我看你可能得坐下来喝点核子可乐然后好好的想想了。

如果这些该死的肉没那么高的需求量，我可能早都洗手不干了。泰德，我真是太贪心了。

original: Access Codes
translation: 许可密码

original: Terminal Instructions
translation: 终端机说明

original:
Ted,

Remember, I hid this stash for you to find.  Don't trust anybody, especially anybody who works for me.  Do this alone.

I busted the storage door, down near the service entrance.

There's a floor safe in the Clinic that contains the parts to fix the broken door.  I also left you a repair manual, just in case you've gotten rusty, but you were always a wizard with a wrench, so I'm sure you'll be fine.  Now get going.
translation:
泰德，

记住，我藏了一些东西让你来找。别相信任何人，特别是我的手下。自己一个人来。

我把下面储藏室的门弄坏了，就是维护通道旁的那个。

original:
O Prince, O Chief of many Throned Powers, 
That led th' imbattelld Seraphim to Warr 
Under thy conduct, and in dreadful deeds 
Fearless, endanger'd Heav'ns perpetual King; 
And put to proof his high Supremacy, 
Whether upheld by strength, or Chance, or Fate, 
Too well I see and rue the dire event, 
That with sad overthrow and foul defeat 
Hath lost us Heav'n, and all this mighty Host 
In horrible destruction laid thus low, 
As far as Gods and Heav'nly Essences 
Can Perish: for the mind and spirit remains 
Invincible, and vigour soon returns, 
Though all our Glory extinct, and happy state 
Here swallow'd up in endless misery. 
But what if he our Conquerour, (whom I now 
Of force believe Almighty, since no less 
Then such could hav orepow'rd such force as ours) 
Have left us this our spirit and strength intire 
Strongly to suffer and support our pains, 
That we may so suffice his vengeful ire, 
Or do him mightier service as his thralls 
By right of Warr, what e're his business be 
Here in the heart of Hell to work in Fire, 
Or do his Errands in the gloomy Deep; 
What can it then avail though yet we feel 
Strength undiminisht, or eternal being 
To undergo eternal punishment?
translation: 大王，掌权天使的首长啊，在您的指挥之下，掌权者们率领英勇的撒拉弗天军去作战 毫无畏惧，投入到冒险的行动中， 使天上永生的王陷于危急， 他支持自己至高无上的权力以及， 靠的是暴力、侥幸，和命运， 我目睹了这次可怕的事件， 哀痛于这可悲的覆没，可耻的败绩。 这使我们失去天界； 这样的大军竟惨遭如此之大的失败， 沦落于这样的地狱中 我们原是神灵，气质轻清， 现在破败到穷途末路 但因为我们还留有不可战胜的心志和精神， 不久将元气大振。 虽然黑暗驱走我们的全部光辉， 无尽的悲惨吞噬了我的快乐； 可是我们的征服者，他使我们还保存这些精力， 也许是要使我们更能忍受痛苦， 受尽苦难，承受他那报复的怒火； 或者是要我们在地狱猛火的中心来干苦活，在幽暗的深渊中为他奔走。这样，我们将永受无穷刑罚 ，即使是自己觉得力量还没衰退，甚至是永生的，那又有什么好处？

original: Autonomic Nervous System
translation: 自主神经系统

original:
In my seven dozen years studying the ghoul anatomy, I discover more and more evidence to support my theory on the nature of the not-radiological human, or "ghoul" as they are commonly called. 

In summary: I theorize that our unnaturally long lifespan is due to a mutation within the autonomic nervous system of certain individuals following exposure to specific combinations of ionizing radiation with wavelengths below 10 picometers. This mutation, it seems, disrupts the normal process of decay in the neurotransmitters along the spinal cord. 

Specifically, the transmitters effected are those responsible for cardiac and respiratory function in a healthy human. According to my studies, these transmitters are continually regenerated after mutation, carrying sufficient oxygen to sustain the life of the subject while being insufficient to retain skin elasticity and avoid necrosis, the result of which is the corpse-like appearance of post-mutation humans.  It should be noted that exposure to radiation typically result in sickness followed by death and the x-factor that will lead to mutation upon exposure in lieu of the typical outcome remains unknown to this researcher.

In the coming months, I will be assembling my findings on this subject into a full study.
translation:
凭借我几十年的尸鬼解剖学研究，我发现了越来越多的证据可以证明我的尸鬼在本质上并不是由于辐射造成的理论。

归纳一下：我们这种不正常的长寿是由于自主神经系统某些内部变异，这些变异是因为个体暴露于一种可以产生10微微米以下波长电离辐射的特殊制品造成的。看起来，这种变异抑制了外周传出神经系统轴突的正常老化。

众所周知，外周传出神经系统主要负责一个健康人类的呼吸，心跳等内脏的非自主肌肉运动。根据我的研究，这些外周传出神经系统在变异后可以不停的再生，导致人的内脏永远有活力，但是皮肤却会由于缺乏氧供应而逐渐坏死。但关于为什么暴露于常规的辐射会导致疾病乃至死亡，而暴露于这种不明物质的辐射却会造成这样的结果暂时还不清楚。

接下来的几个月，我将全力以赴汇总我的发现以求能解开这个谜。

original:
The brain structure of a Luminous Necrotic Post-Human (colloquially referred to as a "Glowing One") indicates that the regenerative ability of the neurological systems that affords typical Necrotic Post-Humans their longevity, does not extend into the higher reasoning functions of the brain itself. (This subject is further covered in report on the dissection of Feral Necrotic Post-Humans)

The distinctive luminescence that is the trademark of the Glowing One can be best attributed to an unusual amount of radioactive chemicals that building up in the bloodstream and muscle tissue of a typical Ghoul. Upon the transformation into a Feral Ghoul, the neurological systems of the body cease filtering these particles from the blood and tissue, instead causing them to build a distinctive bioluminescence that is distinctive of the "Glowing Ones".

Their social structure seems to be different from that of the Feral Ghoul. They actively seek out others of both their strain and those afflicted with Ferocious Post-Necrotic Dystrophy, particularly those who may have been injured. Studies on the nature of their healing effects on other ghouls continues with no conclusive results as of yet.
translation:
荧光坏死型新人类（俗称“发光尸鬼”）的大脑结构表明使普通坏死型新人类获得长寿的神经系统再生能力还未能对大脑的高等思考能力发挥作用。（此观点在对疯狂坏死型新人类的解剖中被进一步证实。）

对发光尸鬼所发出的独特光芒的最好解释就是这些尸鬼血管与组织中充斥着的许多不寻常的放射性化学物质。在转变成狂尸鬼时，它们身体中的神经系统会停止对血液和组织中这些微粒的过滤作用，反而使它们构建出独特的生物发光系统，也就是“发光尸鬼”的独特之处。

它们的社会结构似乎和狂尸鬼不一样。他们积极地寻求同族和那些深受狂暴性坏死后脑萎缩折磨的同类，特别是那些有伤在身的。对它们给其他尸鬼进行治疗的原理的研究目前还没有得出结论。

original: The brain structure of a Feral Necrotic Post-Human indicates that the regenerative ability of the neurological systems that affords typical Necrotic Post-Humans their longevity does not extend into the higher reasoning functions of the brain itself. This is a condition that I refer to as Ferocious Post-Necrotic Dystrophy.\n\nAs the reasoning and high order thinking portions of the brain deteriorate, the Post-Human subject becomes increasingly hostile, giving into a carnal need to feed as opposed to the capacity for thinking that reasoning that a typical Necrotic Post-Human retains. It remains unclear exactly what precipitates this change in biology and psychology, but anecdotal evidence seems to indicate that non-social ghouls, or those in isolation, are more prone to the condition.
translation: 疯狂坏死型新人类的大脑结构说明了能使普通坏死型新人类长寿的神经系统再生能力还未能对大脑的高等思考能力发挥作用。我称其为狂暴性坏死后脑萎缩。\n\n由于大脑部分推理能力和综合思考分析能力的退化，新人类对周遭环境显得越来越敌对，对满足本能的需求远远超过了一般坏死型新人类具有的理性思考能力。到底是什么确切地引起了这些物理和心理上的变化尚不清楚，但一些传闻表明，比较孤僻的尸鬼或是那些居住环境与世隔绝的尸鬼更倾向于发生狂暴性坏死后脑萎缩。

translation: 佣兵的命令

original:
By now, your handler's given you the location of the job and your basic orders.  Here are the details.

Traders have been making a killing with Mirelurk meat, and we've been losing business because of it.  One of our people got involved with a caravan supplier, and we finally know where it's all been coming from.

The meat's mostly coming from one group holed up along the river smack in the middle of the ruins.  There's a huge old facility under some war memorial where they've herded up a nest of Mirelurks and have been breeding and butchering them.  They've been in business for months and are sure to be sitting on a pile of caps.  Take what you can carry -- we just want them out of the meat market.  The rest is up to you.

This isn't the biggest job, but pull it off clean and there's plenty more work for a man with your skills.  Get back to your handler as soon as the job is done and we'll be in touch.
translation:
现在，你的负责人给你了任务地点和指示。以下是详细内容:

有些商人已经开始宰杀泥沼蟹并出售它们的肉，搞得我们的生意一落千丈。我们有个人和一个商队的供货商有点交情，最后我们总算查到那些肉的来路了。

这些肉大部分来自同一伙人，他们就藏在沿着河的那片废墟的正中央。在一个什么战争纪念馆的地下有一个巨大的设施，在那里他们有一个泥沼蟹的巢穴，饲养屠宰那些泥沼蟹。这生意他们已经进行了一个多月了，肯定挣了不少，估计都躺在瓶盖堆上了。你能拿什么就拿什么 -- 我只想让他们滚出肉类市场。其他事随你便。

这也不算啥很棘手的任务，不过处理的利索些，像你这么老练的人，还会有很多工作等着你干呢。任务完成后就立刻回到负责人那，到时我会和你联系。

original: Recipe - Mirelurk Cakes
translation: 食谱 - 泥沼蟹肉蛋糕

original:
1 bucket Mirelurk meat
12 eggs, mixed up
1 loaf bread, stale and crumbled
1 bottle mayonnaise (see Marjorie for mayo)
1 branch scrub plant, dried and crushed
2 fists of Salt
Oil (for pan)

Remove any shell from lurk. In bucket, toss together bread, egg, scrub and mayo until moistened, but do not over mix. Add any available spices for taste

Ball up 25-30 cakes, 1/2 to 3/4 inches thick. Place in freezer until they firm up. Sprinkle batch with salt.

In a heavy pan, fry cakes in oil, turning once until both sides are brown
translation:
1桶泥沼蟹肉
12个鸡蛋，打碎搅拌
1块面包，放到变硬了之后，然后碾碎
1瓶蛋黄酱（见“玛丽乔的蛋黄酱”）
1枝灌木植物，烘干之后碾碎
2把盐
油（锅里用）

将肉去壳。和面包，鸡蛋，植物末还有蛋黄酱一起放在桶里，稍微拌匀，不过别搅拌过头了。根据口味放点香料。

捏成球形蛋糕，准备25-30个，厚度1/2到3/4英寸。放在冰箱里直到它们变硬。再撒上一把盐。

在大锅中油炸蛋糕，注意翻面，直到两面都的颜色都变成了棕黄

    -The molerats are starting to get more aggressive.  I think we will have to push back our checkpoints a bit to make up for it.  I wonder if my experiments with isoprene have somehow triggered their sudden increase in aggression.  I wouldn't be so worried about it if I had something to show for it.  There's got to be some way to make this meat taste better.

Chucky won't shut up about the one he kept as a pet being eaten by the others.  I think I'll shoot him, that sort of thing seems to impress these raider types.
translation:
试验报告 #87
    - 那些鼹鼠变得更具攻击性。我准备重审试验流程来解决这个问题。我猜测那些鼹鼠突然迸发的攻击欲望是否与我在试验中使用的那些胶质物有关。但假设这能让试验成功就无须在意那些了。一定有办法能让这些肉变得更可口。

Chucky或许会为他的宠物被当做食物而喋喋不休吧。我想我应该让他见识下我的实验成果，或许那样就能让那些恶棍们闭嘴。

original: Diary of Candace Keller
translation: 堪达斯·凯勒的日记

original:
Dad just won't listen to a word I say. 

He keeps leaving the bunker to salvage supplies from the rest of the base. In understand he's bored, cooped up in here, but so are the rest of us. 

And the bunker is secure! Every time he leaves, he exposes all of us to that damned radiation. 

After all the effort it took to get us all in here, dad's willing to throw it all away just because he's a bit ansty.

I really hate him sometimes.
translation:
我说什么爸爸都不听。

他不断的离开地下室回收基地剩下的补给。我知道终日困在这里很无聊，但我们其他的人也一样啊。

重要的是这个地下室非常安全！可他每次离开，都会将我们暴露在那该死的射线底下。

在经过极大的努力把我们都弄到这里之后，爸爸却又要把这一切抛掉，仅仅是因为他有些坐不住。

有时候我真是非常的恨他。
