original: Research Note - Laser Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 — 激光步枪

original:
Subject -> Laser Rifle/Pistol
Researcher -> J. T. Benning

Analysis ->
Further research regarding Laser Weaponry has not revealed much we didn't already know.  Small production run of prototype weapons developed by US Military.  

Critical Components ->
Power drawn from Micro fusion Cell is processed through a Wave/Particle Diverter (manuf:Gen Atomics Intnl).  Diverters are protected by carbon-fiber housing, preventing frequent malfunction, but when a diverter fails the weapon becomes unusable, and this part is extremely difficult to replace or repair.

Precision-cut lenses focus optic energy.  Lenses are prone to damage and can grossly affect precision of the firing weapon's firing mechanism.  Lenses are easily replaced with any clear glass, but require a great deal of skill to fabricate.

Field Operation ->
A fully charged cell will discharge 20 bolts from a pistol, and 12 shots from the rifle model.  Recoil is negligible compared to ballistic weapons, so long range combat requires less marksmanship ability of the soldier.  

Maintenance ->
The chassis are easily opened, allowing the weapon to be serviced in the field.  Purified water and a clean cloth can be used to wash mirrored and glass components, slowing wear on the weapon.  The weapon can also overheat after a period of intense use.  This can be counteracted by submerging the barrel of the weapon in water, which helps cool heat sinks located beneath the chassis shell in that area.
translation:
主题 -> 激光步枪/手枪
研究员 -> J. T. 本宁

分析 ->
对激光武器的进一步研究并未揭示出太多我们尚未知晓的信息。美国军方已开发出小批量的原型武器。

关键部件 ->
由微型聚变电池提供的电力通过波/粒分流器（制造商：通用原子国际）进行处理。分流器由碳纤维外壳保护，可防止频繁故障，但分流器一旦失效，武器将无法使用，且此部件极难更换或维修。

精密切割的透镜用于聚焦光学能量。透镜容易受损，并会严重影响开火武器发射机构的精确度。透镜很容易用任何透明玻璃替换，但制造需要极高的技艺。

实地操作 ->
一块充满电的电池可为手枪提供20发能量束，为步枪型号提供12发。与弹道武器相比，其后坐力微乎其微，因此远距离作战对士兵的射击技能要求较低。

维护 ->
底座易于打开，便于在野外进行维修。可以使用纯净水和干净的布来清洗镜面和玻璃部件，以减缓武器的磨损。长时间高强度使用后，武器可能会过热。这可通过将武器枪管浸入水中来抵消，这样做有助于冷却位于该区域底座外壳下方的散热片。

original: Research Note - Plasma Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 - 等离子步枪

original:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Plasma Rifle

Researcher -> R. R. Rasting

Analysis -> The Plasma Rifle, like the Laser Rifle, uses a micro fusion cell as its power supply.  It taps into the cell, essentially a small fusion reactor, to produce a toroid of plasma that is ejected down a superconductor barrel.  A typical micro fusion cell can supply the rifle with around eight shots.  Further research needs to be done to determine exactly how the plasma retains its density while traveling through the air toward its target.
translation:
=== 武器研究 ===

主题 -> 等离子步枪

研究员 -> R.R. 瑞斯丁

分析 -> 等离子步枪与激光步枪类似，使用微型聚变电池作为其能源。它利用该电池（本质上是一个小型聚变反应堆）来产生一等离子体环，该等离子体被喷射通过一个超导枪管。一块标准的微型聚变电池可为步枪提供大约八次射击。需要进一步研究以确定等离子体在空气中向目标移动时如何保持其密度的确切机制。

original: Research Note - Minigun
translation: 研究笔记 — 转管机枪

original:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Minigun

Researcher -> H. P. Smith

Analysis -> Why am I researching such old technology?  Practice, practice, practice, blah, blah, blah.  Anyway, the Minigun uses a much smaller round than most of the rifles found throughout the Wastes.  However, the rate of fire of the Minigun makes up for the small, 5mm round, sending a hail of bullets toward its target.  Its shear size, coupled with its trademark sound, is enough to send anyone in its path running for cover.  It's a great weapon for suppressing fire, letting others flank the unsuspecting enemy.  A typical cartridge holds around 100 rounds.
translation:
=== 武器研究 ===

主题 -> 转管机枪

研究员 -> H.P.史密斯

分析 -> 为什么我要研究这么老旧的技术？练习，练习，练习，巴拉，巴拉，巴拉。总之，转管机枪使用的子弹远小于废土大多数步枪的子弹。然而，转管机枪的射速弥补了5mm口径子弹的不足，能够向目标倾泻如雨点般的子弹。其庞大的体积，加上标志性的轰鸣，足以让路上的任何人四处寻找掩护。这是一把极佳的压制火力武器，能让其他人从侧翼包抄毫无防备的敌人。一个标准的弹匣大约能装100发子弹。

original: Research Note - Pulse Grenade
translation: 研究笔记 - 脉冲手雷

original:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Pulse Grenade

Researcher -> L. J. Rogers

Analysis -> The Pulse Grenade is the most effective weapon against robotics.  Upon detonation, an intense electromagnetic pulse is emitted, severely crippling any robotics within the explosion radius.  They are extremely handy against the many robots and turrets found throughout the Capital Wasteland.
translation:
=== 武器研究 ===

主题 -> 脉冲手雷

研究员 -> L.J. 罗杰斯

分析 -> 脉冲手雷是对抗机器人最有效的武器。爆炸时，会释放出强烈的电磁脉冲，使爆炸范围内的所有机器人瘫痪。用来对付遍及首都废土的众多机器人和炮塔非常方便。

original: Research Note - Enclave Armor
translation: 研究笔记 - 英克雷装甲

original:
=== Armor Research ===

Subject -> Enclave Armor

Researcher ->T. T. Bowser

Analysis -> After several radiation experiments, I can safely conclude that the Enclave Armor is more radiation resistant than Power Armor, although not by much.  Regardless, more research and tests are needed to determine exactly what makes it more resistant.
translation:
=== 护甲研究 ===

主题 -> 英克雷装甲

研究员 ->T.T. 鲍泽

分析 -> 通过数次辐射实验，我能肯定地说，英克雷装甲具有的防辐射性能优于动力装甲，尽管相差不大。不管怎样，要确定其具有更强抗辐射性能的原因，仍然需要更多的研究和测试。

original: Research Note - Missile Launcher
translation: 研究笔记 - 火箭弹发射器

original:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Missile Launcher

Researcher ->J. J. Browne

Analysis -> After several attempts to modify the Missile Launcher to increase its accuracy, I conclude that it cannot be done.  In fact, this is third one I've "broken" in the past month.  I will pass the task on to L. J. Rogers, who seems confident enough that it can be modified and that I merely overlooked obvious miscalculations.  Technically, the Missile Launcher I've recently worked on is not broken.  It just does not function properly.  I have since locked it up in Weapons Storage.
translation:
=== 武器研究 ===

主题 -> 火箭弹发射器

研究员 ->J.J. 布朗

分析 -> 经过多次尝试修改火箭弹发射器以提高其精确度后，我得出的结论是，这无法实现。事实上，这是我过去一个月内“弄坏”的第三个了。我会把这份差事交给L.J. 罗杰斯，他似乎对此很有信心并认为我忽略了明显的计算错误。从技术上讲，我最近研究的那个火箭弹发射器并没有坏。它只是无法正常工作。因此，我已经将其锁在武器库中。

original:
Field Report
Protector Casdin
0700 Surface Patrol (Fairfax)

We've secured the building and are currently implementing our orders for the occupation of Fairfax.  

Raider activity in town has increased dramatically ever since we've taken up positions in and around the fort.  We've killed a lot of them and scared off plenty others, but they just keep coming back.  While there seems to be no limit to people willing to reduce themselves to their way of life, we don't have the luxury of surplus personnel, so we must remain vigilant.  

That the raiders take such continued risks to invade our facility appears to confirm suspicions that we've had an intelligence leak, and they're after our technology.  They've tried tenaciously to infiltrate the base, but so far haven't stood a chance.  Our objective remains the same - protect the research personnel and keep this fort safe until more reinforcements arrive.
translation:
战地报道
守护者卡斯丁
0700 外部巡逻(费尔福克斯)

我们已经拯救了那座大厦，我们现在正在执行对抗费尔福克斯侵略的任务。

从过去到现在，在城里的掠夺者数量已大大增加。我们在要塞里外占据了位置，并杀死了很多掠夺者，还有很多掠夺者被我们吓跑了，可他们一直想要卷土重来。然而，那里的人们似乎并不愿意减少他们生活上的限制，我们的人已经所剩无几了，所以我们只好保持警惕。

掠夺者持续冒险侵略我们的设施，很明显就是想要证实我们存在智能技术漏洞的怀疑。但他们的技术比不上我们。他们在顽强地尝试侵入我们的基地，可目前为止，他们仍然没有这个机会。我们的目标依然没变 — 保护研究人员，确保要塞的安全，直到有更多的增援到达。

original:
Field Report
Defender Rockfowl
0300 SpecOps Recon Patrol

Defender Morgan and I executed a reconnaissance mission last night to gauge Raider entrenchment in the structural underground of Fairfax.  We located three entrances into underground utility tunnels.  

We are able to confirm that the enemy has occupied and fortified positions within the underground, though some appear undefended.  We also identified a small weapons cache in the southeast section of the tunnels.  While deploying explosives to demolish the cache we were discovered by a Raider patrol.  In accordance to mission parameters, we did not engage the enemy, instead retreating to Fort.  Raiders will be likely to set up defenses and attach more patrols to the area as a result.
translation:
战地报道
卫士罗克浮
0300空间侦察巡逻

昨晚，我和卫士摩根在执行一个侦察任务，我们要去侦察掠夺者在费尔福克斯的地下结构的防卫工事。我们找到三个到地下的多用途隧道入口。

我们可以确定的是，敌人已经占据了地下的有利位置，尽管还有些敌人毫无防备。我们还发现一个位于隧道东南方向的武器藏匿处。在布置炸药准备毁灭这个武器藏匿处时，我们被掠夺者的巡逻兵发现了。这与我们当时考虑的任务变数是一致的，我们并没有马上跟敌人交战，而是选择马上撤退回要塞。掠夺者很有可能会布置防线并增加更多的巡逻兵。

original:
I, Roger Maxson, Captain, serial number 072389 have started this log because it doesn't look good for any of us, and I'd like for people to know what really happened here.

All hell broke loose when we finally discovered what those scientist bastards were up to. The Colonel has locked himself in his office and seems to be having some sort of breakdown. 

The men are screaming for blood. They're looking to me for answers, and I'm not sure what to do. Someone has to do something, though, before this place sinks into an anarchistic bloodbath.
translation:
我，罗杰·麦克森上尉，编号072389，因战友们情况均不容乐观，特此开始记录，以便让后来者知道这里发生过的事情。

当我终于弄清了那些搞科学的混蛋干的事情后，恐怖的事情开始发生了。上校把他自己关在办公室里日渐衰弱。

战友们开始变得嗜血，他们求助于我，但我对此无能为力。如果没有人来做些什么，这里将会上演恐怖屠杀。

original: Every time we get a report from higher up things get worse here. The war is going in a very bad direction and this place is about to go into full mutiny, with all the chaos that entails. \n\nI stopped one of the men from executing a scientist today, and demanded that we interrogate them to find out what their orders were.
translation: 每一次上级给我们带来的都是坏消息。战局越来越坏，叛变将要发生，混乱接踵而至。\n\n我今天在一名士兵准备处决一个科学人员时阻止了他，我希望通过审讯这些科学人员来得知他们是受谁的指示。

original: I killed a man today. I was interrogating Chief Scientist Anderson and he was giving me the full details of their inhuman experiments. He said his orders came from the government, but I didn't buy it. He started screaming about how he was following orders, how he was a military man, and I just shot him. I tell myself it was to keep him from causing a full mutiny among the men, but I'm not so sure.
translation: 今天我处决了一个家伙。起因是我审讯了科学人员头领，他把这些非人道试验的内容向我全盘托出了—他说他们执行的是政府的命令，看我对此不买账，于是他开始扯自己多么忠于军队，多么服从命令，于是我一枪把他给毙了。我告诉我自己，这么做是为了防止兵变的发生，但实际上我并不能肯定自己的做法是否是正确的。

original: I tried again to speak to the colonel through the door, but he seems to have completely lost touch with reality. I broke down the door with several of the men just in time to watch him blow his head off. Right before he pulled the trigger he said he was sorry.
translation: 我尝试隔着门与上校交流，但听上去他已经丧失了理智。我和几个手下撞开了门，但看到的却是上校正用枪顶着自己的脑袋，他只说了一句很抱歉后，就扣响了扳机。

original: By killing the egghead, I seem to have confirmed my position as leader of the men. They follow me without question now. The interrogations invariably end up being executions.\n\nShellman held out the longest, but the end result was the same. Her arguments about her orders were a bit too specific to be completely made up. I'm getting a real bad feeling in my gut about how this is all going to end up. I don't even lie to myself anymore about my reasons for executing the scientists.
translation: 在处决了那个搞学问的之后，我在战友之间树立了威信，他们变得服从我的指令了。现在每次审讯结束后受审者都会被处决掉。\n\n因为萨尔曼的供词有些具体信息需要补足，所以她是活得最长的，但最终也难逃一死。关于处决，我已经变得连眼睛都不眨了。

original: I finally replied to the outside world over our radio. I don't know why they never sent anyone here to see what was happening when we stopped responding to their transmissions. \n\nIt doesn't make any sense. Well, they'll come now. I declared ourselves seceded from the union. They remember Jefferson Davis. What will history say about me?
translation: 我终于通过无线电和外界取得了联络，我不知道为什么在失去这么久的联系之后，军方一直没有派人来这里。\n\n真是荒唐！好吧，事已至此，我决定对外宣称我的部队正式独立。不知后世之人会怎么评价我？会不会和杰斐逊·戴维斯一样？

original: What the hell is going on? We declare ourselves to be in full desertion from the Army and no longer under the government's command and what happens? Nothing. Something bad is coming down.
translation: 活见鬼，我宣布了我们彻底背叛了军队，不再听从政府指挥，但是你猜发生了什么？屁事都没！看来外面大事不妙了。

original: I can't believe those bastards finally did it. Damn them all to hell. They finally let the A-Bombs fly. We were right in the middle of trying to pry the real story out of von Felden when we completely lost contact. \n\nI have a feeling the research center was hit hard. I don't know why, just call it a gut feeling. It seems inconceivable that we were not targeted. I'm sure China will make up for that oversight real soon. Luckily, we had moved our families from outside into the facility the day before yesterday. We do not yet know if the fallout has reached this area.
translation: 我不敢相信那些王八蛋真的这么做了，我操他们大爷的，他们居然真的发射了核弹！就在我正要把冯·非欧德外面发生的事情经过查个水落石出时，与外界的联络彻彻底底的中断了。\n\n我感觉研究中心遭到了严重破坏，不知道为什么我会这么想，可能是直觉使然吧。不可思议的是，我们这里居然没有遭到打击。不过那些中国佬应该用不了多久就会发现失查而攻击这里的。幸运的是，我们的家人在前天已经全部移居到这里了。目前尚不清楚辐射是否会蔓延到这里。

original: Sgt. Platner volunteered to go outside today to take specific readings on the atmosphere. It seems the radiation has not spread this far. Since he was wearing his Power Armor, there was no threat to him from radiation, but if he had been exposed he would have had to be exiled. We don't have adequate decontamination facilities here.
translation: 普拉特纳中士今天自愿到外面采集了大气数据，看上去空气中的放射物还没有消散。由于穿着动力装甲，放射物对他不能构成威胁，但是如果他裸露在外的话，应该早就没命了。我们这里没有净化空气的设备。

original: I convinced the men that we should bury the scientists. I don't know why... perhaps it was to ease my conscience. I finally started to believe their stories when the last one was dying.\n\nMy God, what have I become?
translation: 我说服大家去埋葬科学人员的尸体。我也不知道我为什么要这么做……可能是为了免受良心的谴责吧。在那些科学人员中的最后一人死掉时，我终于开始相信他们的故事了。\n\n神啊，我怎么会变成了这个样子？

original: We're leaving this godforsaken place today. I'm leading the exodus to the old government bunker at Lost Hills. I'm leaving this log behind to be buried when this place goes in the next exchange. \n\nWho knows, maybe someone will find it someday.....
translation: 我们今天准备离开这个不毛之地了。我将会把幸存者们带往位于失落丘的政府掩体中。我把此日志留于此处。\n\n或许有朝一日会有人找到它，我就不得而知了……

original:
Born -- NA
Died -- 2135

Second in command of the security team stationed at the West Tek research facility; later relocated to the Mariposa Military Base.

Assumed command after nervous breakdown of security team leader Colonel Robert Spindel. Executed scientists after learning of their research into the Forced Evolutionary Virus, or FEV.

Deserted from military just before the war. Maxson ordered the families of all base personnel brought inside the facility, thereby sparing their lives.

Led survivors in their Exodus to the Lost Hills bunker. Maxson's wife was killed on the journey.

At Lost Hills, Roger Maxson formed the Brotherhood of Steel. As the organization's first High Elder, he formed the Orders of Paladins, Knights and Scribes.
translation:
出生日期 — 不详
死亡日期 — 2135年

西部科技研究所防卫队副指挥，随后调到马里波萨军事基地。

在防卫队长官罗伯特·斯宾铎上校神经失常之后临时担任总指挥。在得知研究人员从事于强制进化病毒的研究工作后处决了他们。

麦克森战前背叛了军队，他命令基地所有工作人员的家属撤入研究所来保全生命。

随后他带领幸存者抵达失落丘掩体。在行进过程中，麦克森的妻子被杀害了。

在失落丘掩体，罗杰·麦克森正式成立了钢铁兄弟会。作为首位高级长老，他为圣骑士、骑士和学士制定了行为法则。

original:
Born -- NA (teenager of unspecified age in 2077)
Died -- 2155

Took over command of the Brotherhood of Steel as High Elder in 2135, when his father, Roger Maxson, died of cancer.

In 2155, while hunting down a group of Raiders knows as the Vipers, Maxson (who was unhelmeted at the time) was grazed in the head by an arrow. A deadly Viper poison killed him within hours.
translation:
出生日期—不详（2077年年龄不详的青少年）
死亡日期—2155年

在2135年他的父亲罗杰·麦克森死于癌症的时候，成为钢铁兄弟会的元老而接管指挥权。

2155年，在追击一群被称为毒蛇袭击者的时候，马克松（那时没有戴头盔）被一支毒箭擦破了头，几个小时后，箭上携带的致命蛇毒杀死了他。

original:
Born -- 2097
Died -- NA

Son of Maxson II and grandson of Roger Maxson.

A gifted soldier, John Maxson was promoted to the rank of Paladin at age 38, in the year 2135. Soon after, he was promoted once more to Head Paladin.

In 2155, Maxson was promoted to the illustrious position of High Elder when his father Maxson II was killed in glorious battle with the Raiders known as Vipers.

Records indicate John Maxson had some dealings with a mysterious figured identified only as the "Vault Dweller" in the year 2162, at the age of 65.
translation:
出生日期 — 2097年
死亡日期 — 不详

麦克森二世的儿子，罗杰·麦克森的孙子。

他是一个天生的战士，在2135年，也就是他38岁的时候被晋升为圣骑士。不久之后，他再一次被晋升为圣骑士长。

2155年，当他的父亲麦克森二世在同被称为毒蛇袭击者的圣战中战死后，麦克森被提升为更高的职位。

记录显示约翰·麦克森在2162年，也就是他65岁的时候与一个被称为“避难所居民”的神秘人物有过交易。

original: The state of Maxson, in the New California Republic, was built in close proximity to the Lost Hills Bunker, and enjoyed the protection of the Brotherhood of Steel.\n\nNo additional information is available at this time.
translation: 位于新加利福尼亚共和国的麦克森州，距离失落丘掩体十分近，并享有钢铁兄弟会的保护。\n\n这个时候没有额外的信息可以获得。

original:
Further investigations into the U.F.O. codenamed "Palandine" have confirmed our suspicions. 

On the evening of May 3, 2062, an alien craft of unknown make and origin did indeed breach the airspace just north of Hagerstown, Maryland and crashed into a heavily wooded, non-residential area.

Unfortunately, attempts to retrieve the craft proved unsuccessful. It simply could not be located, either due to some kind of advanced invisibility shielding, or because the occupants managed to make repairs and vacate the crash site before our arrival.

Despite our failure of recovery, the significance of this event cannot be denied. 

We are not alone.
translation:
对代号为“普兰顿”的UFO进行的深入调查确定了我们的猜测。

2062年5月3日，一架制造方与来源不详的外星飞行器闯入了马里兰州黑格斯敦北部的领空，并在非居住区的一片浓密的森林里坠毁。

不幸的是，试图寻找飞行器的尝试失败了。仅仅是由于无法定位，或者是因为某种先进隐身防护层，或许是由于驾驶员成功地修好了飞行器并在我们到达前离开。

尽管我们的寻找失败了，很明显的是这个事件是不可以被忽视的。

我们并不孤单。

original: Bill of Sale
translation: 卖身契

original:
We, the representatives of the Consul Officiorum, have this day bargained and purchased from Jeannie May Crawford of the township of Novac the exclusive rights to ownership and sale of the slave Carla Boone for the sum of one thousand bottle caps, and those of her unborn child for the sum of five hundred bottle caps, the receipt whereof is hereby acknowledged. We warrant the slave and her young to be sound, healthy, and slaves for life. We covenant with the said, Jeannie May Crawford, that we have full power to bargain and sell said slave and her offspring. Payment of an additional five hundred bottle caps will be due pending successful maturation of the fetus, the claim to which shall be guaranteed by possession of this document.

M. Scribonius Libo Drusus et al.
Administrators of M. Licinius Crassus, Consul Officiorum ab Famulatus
translation:
吾等作为事务官的代表，兹与诺瓦克镇的珍妮·梅·克劳福德达成协议，商定从其手中购得卡拉·布恩的奴役权和独有贸易权，价格为1000枚瓶盖，其未来的子女总价值为500枚瓶盖，立契为证。吾等保证此奴隶及其子女四肢健全、身体健康，且终身为奴。特与珍妮·梅·克劳福德约定，吾等将全权享有此奴隶及其后代的定价与贸易权。额外的500瓶盖将在奴隶产下婴儿后支付。空口无凭，执此存照。

斯克里伯尼斯·利伯·德鲁斯厄斯 等人
奴隶事务部总长李锡尼·克拉苏下属事务官

original: Pennsylvania Ave Explosives Note
translation: 宾夕法尼亚大道爆炸物笔记

original:
The explosives have been placed along Pennsylvania Ave as instructed.  The electrical switch is located on the first level of the scaffolding on PA avenue.  Simply flip the switch, take cover, and get ready for one hell of a show.  I'm going to stick around a little longer to see if I can pick off a couple more mutants.

Merc. Thompson
Talon Company
translation:
按照指示，炸弹已经沿着宾夕法尼亚大道被放置好了。开关就放在宾州大道脚手架的一层，轻轻按下开关，找个掩护，准备观看一场地狱秀吧。我出去多转一会儿，看能不能多找到些变种人。

佣兵汤普森
鹰爪公司

original:
Born -- 2267
Died --  

Only son of Jonathan and Jessica (both deceased).

Last of the Maxson bloodline.

As an infant, sent to the Citadel to be fostered by Elder Owyn Lyons. The reason for this decision was two-fold:

1.) Recent internal conflict amongst the Western Brotherhood of Steel created an unsafe environment for the child. It was believed that the Citadel -- despite being located in hostile territory -- would increase his probability of survival.

2.) Elder Lyons, at that time, was in high favor with the Western Elders, and deemed a perfect candidate to provide care and training to the Squire. 

Recent events have led to a lack of communication with the Western Elders. As a result, Squire Maxson will remain at the Citadel indefinitely.
translation:
出生日期 -- 2267年
死亡日期 -- 

乔纳森和杰西卡(二人均已过世)的独子。

麦克森家族最后的传人。

婴儿时期，被送到大本营由长老欧文·里昂斯抚养长大。做出这个决定的原因有两个：

1.)近段时间以来发生在西方钢铁兄弟会的内部冲突，给孩子的成长环境带来了不安的因素。人们相信在大本营--尽管处在敌人的势力范围中--还是会大大增加它的生存几率的。

2.)里昂斯长老，在那个时候受到韦斯特长老的高度宠信，认为是照顾侍从并训练他的完美候选人。

最近的事情导致和韦斯特长老的联系变少。因此，侍从麦克森将长期呆在五角大本营。

original:
Good Ole’ Craggy, King of Rockopolis. 

He offered Argyle and me shelter back in the summer of ’48. Unfortunately, there was a little incident with his daughter, and we were exiled. 

We sought shelter again a couple years later, but Craggy didn’t take to kindly to us luring the Slavers into his hidden underground city. 

That was the last time I ever saw Argyle -- right after he saved my hide for the hundredth time.
translation:
老伙计峭壁君，岩石城之王。

48年的夏天，他为阿盖尔和我提供了庇护。可惜的是，出了点和他女儿有关的插曲，我们就被流放了。

几年后，我们再次寻求庇护，然而峭壁君对我们把奴隶主引到他隐秘的地下城很不满。

那是我最后一次见到阿盖尔——就在他第一百次救我小命之后。

original: Miss Penelope Chase -- Two-timing bitch. She got what she deserved.
translation: 佩内洛普·蔡斯小姐——水性杨花的贱人。她咎由自取。

original:
My dearest Destiny. 

Harlot par excellence and the proprietor of the Blue Destiny Brothel. One of the loveliest women I’ve ever had the pleasure to pleasure.

Sadly, she died from cholera in the summer of '49 (an event that closed down the brothel forever).
translation:
我最亲爱的命运。

风月场的头牌，蓝命运妓院的主人。她是我有幸取悦过的最可爱的女人之一。

令人痛心的是，她在49年夏天死于霍乱（这场疫情导致妓院永久关闭）。

original:
The best manservant a guy could ask for. 

Tough, loyal, and a hell of a good friend (even if he did smell like a bag of rotten meat, but what’s a Ghoul gonna do?). 

The last time I saw Argyle was in Rockopolis, decades ago. I know he's still out there... somewhere.
translation:
天底下最棒的男仆。

坚韧、忠诚，铁哥们中的铁哥们（虽然他闻起来像一袋腐肉，但尸鬼能有什么办法呢？）。

我最后一次见到阿盖尔是在几十年前的岩石城。我知道他还在某个地方……某个角落。

original: Slaver leader and psychotic cannibal, circa 2250. See entry on Paradise Falls.
translation: 奴隶贩头目兼精神变态食人魔，活跃于约2250年。详见“天堂瀑”条目。

original:
The most dangerous dump in the Capital Wasteland. 

The Slavers there would have bought and sold anything with a pulse. They still will, from what I hear. 

Back in my day, they were more disorganized, though. Their leader was a guy named Harmon Jurley, a psychotic son of a bitch who was rumored to eat the slaves he couldn’t sell.
translation:
首都废土最危险的垃圾场。

那帮奴隶贩子当年连喘气的活物都敢倒腾。听说他们现在还是这样。

不过在我那个时候，他们更像一盘散沙。当时的头目叫哈蒙·杰利，是个丧心病狂的杂种，传言他会吃掉卖不掉的奴隶。

original:
An underground city. 

Not a bad a accomplishment, all things considered, but their leader, King Crag, became too isolationist for his own good.

Okay, so I accidentally led the Slavers there and those bastards cleaned the place out. It was an honest mistake.
translation:
一座地下城。

总体来说，还算不赖。但是他们的统治者，峭壁王，因过于孤立主义而反受其害。

好吧，我不小心把奴隶贩子带到了那里，这些混蛋居然把那里洗劫一空。但这真的是个无心之失。

original: The best damn whorehouse in the Capital Wasteland. Strong booze and soft women. It shut down in the summer of ’49 when most of the ladies died from a cholera outbreak.
translation: 华盛顿废土最棒的妓院。满是玉酒美女.妓院在49年的夏天因为一场突发的霍乱导致大部分妓女丧命而关门大吉了。

original:
A city of the dead. Or undead, as some would believe.

Underworld was, and is, a settlement of Ghouls, established in an old art exhibit in the Museum of American History.

Argyle and I used to go there quite a bit. I was even voted "Honorary Ghoul" back in '51. I really should go back and visit sometime.
translation:
一座亡者之城。抑或如某些人所坚信的——不死者之城。

冥界曾是、且至今仍是尸鬼的聚居地，建立于美利坚历史博物馆的旧艺术展厅内。

阿盖尔和我以前常去那儿。我甚至在51年当选过“荣誉尸鬼”。真该找时间回去看看。

original:
A town built around an undetonated atomic bomb. My kind of place!

Megaton is pretty well fortified now, but back in my day it was even more ramshackle. Great place to grab a drink or a broad.

I hear Moriarty even has his own place now. Guess that shouldn't surprise me. That guy had been playing the angles since the day he ended up in this country, as a kid.
translation:
一个围绕着未引爆原子弹而建的小镇。很对我的胃口！

如今的兆吨镇防御森严，但在我那个年代，那儿就是摇摇欲坠的破烂堆。绝佳的喝烂酒、找乐子的去处。

我听说莫里亚蒂现在都有自己的地盘了。倒也不意外，毕竟这小子打小流落到这儿起，就精于钻营算计。

original: Goddamn walking crabs. \n\nTough to kill, but pretty delicious afterwards. The outer carapace is hell to penetrate, though. Good thing their face isn’t armored (and Argyle had such a good right jab).
translation: 天杀的陆行甲壳怪。\n\n难啃的硬茬子，但肉质倒是意外鲜美。就是那背甲硬得能弹开子弹。幸好面部没防护（而且阿盖尔的右勾拳相当了得）。

original:
Ghouls gone bad. Their brains had rotted through so much, they lost the ability to think straight.

Argyle and I fought these hapless zombie bastards more times than I can count. 

I think he actually liked killing them -- saw it as some sort of revenge against God for his own situation, or something.
translation:
彻底变质的尸鬼。他们的脑组织烂到连基本理智都维持不住。

我和阿盖尔跟这些不幸的丧尸混蛋交过的手不计其数。

我觉得他其实挺喜欢杀这些家伙的——大概是把这当作某种对上帝的报复，为了他自己的遭遇之类的。

original: I've been a lot of places in my day, and everywhere you'd find those damned Radscorpions.\n \nRumor was they'd descended from Emperor Scorpions, which you could find in pretty much any pet store in the country when bombs fell. I guess that explains their population.
translation: 我这辈子走过不少地方，到哪儿都能碰到那些天杀的辐射蝎。\n\n传闻说它们是帝王蝎后代。核弹砸下的那时候，这玩意儿可是全国宠物店都在卖。大概这就是它们泛滥成灾的原因吧。

original: Bears, or the Capital Wasteland's equivalent, anyway. \n\nYou're not going to find one of these babies balancing on a big rubber ball, though, I can tell you that much. They're are vicious as they come -- razor sharp claws, razor sharp teeth. Nasty, nasty temperament.
translation: 熊，或者首都废土的类似生物，随你怎么说。\n\n但别指望这些宝贝会踩着大皮球卖萌。它们的凶残突破天际——爪子赛刀片，獠牙如钢锯。脾气，更是坏到极点。

original:
I have to admit, I've always been fascinated by these things. 

Such an ingenious creation -- a robot powered by a brain, and a sexy dame's voice. Of course, I always had to wonder. Were they human brains? Were they actually the brains of sexy dames?? Or is it all monkey brains and recordings?

Anyway, I got hit by one of their mind blasts once. Hell of a headache for three days.
translation:
不得不承认，我向来痴迷于这些玩意。

如此天才的发明——用大脑驱动的机器人，还配着性感女郎的嗓音。当然，我总忍不住琢磨，那些是人脑吗？真装着性感女郎的脑子？？还是说全是猴脑加录音？

总之，我有次挨了它们的意念冲击波。头疼欲裂了整整三天。

original:
Here are the results of the latest robot diagnostic:

Mobility -- 0%
Navigation Translation -- 0%
Internal Processors -- 46%
Weapons Systems -- 45%
Power Management -- 37%
Voice Module -- 100%

Scribe Rothchild is confident that by redistributing power from the Weapons and Mobility subsystems, we'll be able to bring Power Management up to at least 67% -- enough to successfully carry out a full activation sequence.
translation:
机器人诊断结果报告：

行动力--0%
导航系统--0%
内部处理器--46%
武器系统--45%
动力系统--37%
发声模块--100%

学士罗斯查德系统确认，如果重新分配武器和动力系统的能源，动力系统的状态将可以至少提升到67% -- 在此状态下将可以保证完全激活程序完成。

original:
Scribe Rothchild has completed a new full diagnostic of the robot. Here are those results:

Mobility -- 0%
Navigation Translation -- 0%
Internal Processors -- 12%
Weapons Systems -- 13%
Power Management -- 1%
Voice Module -- 100%

It has been determined that the recent feedback spike, which resulted in overall system degradation, was in fact caused by the installation of the new power capacitor, as Scribe Rothchild suspected.

Until further notice, Scribes are ordered to cease any and all experiments that involve the re-routing of power from any of the robot's sub-systems.
translation:
学士罗斯查德系统对机器人重新检测完毕，结果如下：

M行动力 -- 0%
导航系统 -- 0%
内部处理器 -- 12%
武器系统 -- 13%
动力系统 -- 1%
发声模块 -- 100%

根据学士罗斯查德系统对反馈信息进行的判断，系统性能整体下降的原因是新的能源电容器的安装。

除非得到通知，否则学士罗斯查德系统将终止一切此机器人的子系统闭路充能工作。

original:
Another day, another setback. 

We had tried, of course, re-routing power from Weapons to the robot's other sub-systems several times. Each attempt ended in failure, thanks to the robot's overly aggressive combat subroutines. It's almost as if there's some hidden pocket of AI that keeps pushing against us, refusing to let anyone drain power from the weapons systems.

I guess that shouldn't surprise me, considering why he was constructed in the first place.

That's why I began work on the Neural Dampener in the first place. I was convinced I could "trick" the robot into thinking I had actually re-distributed the power from some other sub-system. But the damned thing proved smarter than that. Certainly smarter than me. 

All I managed to do was fry some of his circuitry (again) and set us back another three months.
translation:
失败接二连三。

我们为把机器人的能量从武器系统上转移到别的子系统中，已经尝试了很多次，但这些尝试均以失败告终，这可能是因为由于机器人在设计时，AI内容中编译进了特殊的代码，阻止敌人从武器系统上抽取能量。

对此我早有预料，因为这个机器人就是为服务于战争而设计的。

我曾以为我可以“骗过”这台机器人，让它以为我在从别的系统中转移能量。但是这个倒霉玩意儿比我想象得要聪明很多，至少是要比我聪明很多。

我现在唯一能做的就是把它的线路焊回原样，从头来过。

original:
I'm tired of trying to re-route power like some kind of snot-nosed Initiate.

I don't care what kind of drain it puts on the Scribes' ability to research and maintain the weapons and armor -- I'm proceeding with the AVF experiments.

If I can successfully create an Accelerated Vector Fusion module (similar to the technology I saw Doctor Li working with all those years ago), we'll have our first real chance of getting the robot fully operational. 

Maybe then the Western Elders will realize our worth.
translation:
尽管嘲笑我吧，我已经决定放弃对能量转移的尝试了。

接下来我准备无视学士罗斯查德系统给出的分析结果，尝试一下使用增速矢量融合装置。

只要我成功制造出一个增速矢量融合装置（就像我前几年看到的李博士弄的那个东西），我们就有机会让这台机器人动起来。

也许到那时韦斯特长老将会对我们另眼相看。

original:
Unfortunately, the Accelerated Vector Fusion (AVF) experiments haven't gone as planned. 

Bowditch suffered 2nd degree burns, and at one point we accidentally channeled so much power to the robot's head laser, it discharged and nearly killed Elder Lyons. 

He was not pleased.
translation:
不幸的是，增速矢量融合装置（AVF）并未像我们预计的那样正常工作。

因我们不小心给机器人的头部激光发射器充入了过多能量，导致的能量泄露差点让里昂斯长老因此丧命。

他对此十分不快，鲍蒂奇也因此而受到2级烧伤。

original:
General Chase,

I'm sorry, but you're being completely unrealistic. There is simply no way the robot will be combat ready in three months. 

The chassis is complete, all weapons systems are online, and the voice module has been programmed as requested. But power consumption is still our primary concern, and neither doctors Honeywell nor Park have yet found an acceptable solution.

We had hoped to sub-contract Vault-Tec, and utilize the talents of Doctor Braun. But apparently he's gone into seclusion, working on one of their own projects, and they couldn't reach him at this point if they wanted to. So that's out. 

I'll give it to you straight, General -- this is the biggest robot the world has ever seen, and we just haven't been able to find a power source small enough, and powerful enough, to get the damn thing running with all its systems online. 

In three months we might be able to guarantee the robot can walk into downtown Anchorage, but all of his weapons systems will be OFFLINE.

Maybe he can just step on the Red Chinese?

Doctor Stanley Bloomfeld
Project Lead
translation:
彻斯将军，

别介意，但你的想法完全不切实际。三个月时间根本不可能让机器人参战。

纵然底座完成了，武器系统已完善，同时声音模块也顺利通过了测试。但能量消耗仍是牵制全局的最大难关，目前为止，霍尼韦尔和帕克两位博士的方案都没能彻底解决这个问题。

我们正在和避难所科技交涉，希望借助布劳恩博士的智慧来改变现状。但事实是，他正参与着他们某个方案的开发而受到了信息封锁，他们的工作人员也没办法把我们的问题传达给他。所以那办法也行不通了。

恕我直言，将军阁下—这是世界上最巨型的机器人，而我们迄今都没能找到那种够小又够劲的动能来供给那个大家伙所有系统的运行所须。

三个月后我或许可以保证机器人能信步于安克雷奇市，不过是手无寸铁。

不知能否让他踩那些中国军队？

医生斯坦利·布鲁非欧
项目负责人

original:
Classified Eyes Only

Military Contract 38917: Codename "Liberty Prime"

Project Goal: No less than the creation of the most powerful combat robot the battlefield has ever seen, with the express goal of liberating occupied Anchorage, Alaska from its Chinese aggressors.

Summary: The United States Army has succeeded in contracting both RobCo and General Atomics International to work on their first joint project.

The robot they create, Liberty Prime, will be the very embodiment of American military might -- a walking, talking, nuke-tossing hero who will remind the world what it means to be a super power.

I am fully confident that the presence of Liberty Prime at the Anchorage Front line will be to the Chinese what the Hiroshima bomb was to the Japanese in 1945.

General Constantine Chase
translation:
机密内容

军事编号38917: 代号“自由一号”

目标内容：创造迄今最为强大的战斗机器人，将服役于解放被中国侵略军攻占的阿拉斯加州安克雷奇市。

概要：美国陆军成功说服RobCo以及General Atomics两大国际巨头公司联手进行开发。

他们所创造的名为自由一号的，会走路、会讲话、使用核能驱动的机器英雄无疑会成为美国陆军力量的中流砥柱，它将会向世人展示什么是所谓的超级力量。

当它现身安克雷奇市之时，中国军队将有如1945年广岛核弹下的日本人一般迎接末日。我对此深信不疑。

康斯坦丁·彻斯将军

original:
Dear Consumer:

Thank you for your participation in the exciting Shocker Glove pilot program.  You're receiving a prototype FSGv118-b model of the Shocker Glove.  Please reference this prototype number in any future correspondence.  We encourage you to make this prototype a part of your daily life, and look forward to your valuable feedback.

Thanks from all of us at the Shocker Glove R&D Team!

PS: Shocker Glove prototypes are not for use in water, public, near small children or domesticated animals.  This is not a kitchen appliance and should not be used near uncooked food.  Use of Shocker Glove prototype constitutes a binding agreement to hold manufacturer harmless for any and all legal purposes.  During prolonged use, severe electrical burns may occur.  Do not look directly at Shocker Glove while operating.  Some prototype models have proven sensitive to certain radio frequencies during use.  If you suspect radio interference, please submit a malfunction report listing FCC broadcast frequencies in operation at the time, and report to nearest emergency medical facility in your area.

感谢你的参与，震慑者拳套的试验性计划是激动人心的。你收到的这个震慑者拳套型号为FSGv118-b，它是一个原型产品。在今后的信件中也请参考这个原型产品的型号。我们鼓励你将这个原型产品带入你的日常生活，并且期待着你的回馈信息。

我们震慑者拳套研发小组的全体成员在这里表示衷心的感谢！

补充说明：震慑者拳套不能在如下场合里使用，水中，公共场所，儿童或家畜附近。这个产品不是厨具，请勿在未煮熟的食物附近使用。为了保证制造商的权益，请务必严格约束自己，将震慑者拳套原型产品用于合法的目的。如果长时间使用可能会导致电烧伤。实际操作时请不要直接注视着震慑者拳套。一些原型产品在使用时对特定的无线电频率过于敏感，这点已经得到证实。如果你不相信无线电对本产品的影响，使用时还听着联邦电信委员会的广播，那么在你向最近的医疗站报告之前，请别忘了提交一份故障报告。

original: Search Party Log #2
translation: 搜索小队日志#2

original: Bad news.  Rangers haven't seen Cheryl and got troubles of their own.  Muties been snatching people left and right.  Reilly’s men are going to keep an eye out round here.   They suggested we head to the western ruins, across the river and search there, so I guess that’s what we’ll do.  Damn it, sis, why didn't you just wait for us?
translation: 坏消息。游骑兵们还没见到谢丽尔，而且现在他们自己也有麻烦了。变种人在到处抓人。莱莉的手下也要监视着附近的情况。他们建议我们前往西部的废墟，过河之后搜索那里的区域，我看我们下一步也只能这样了。该死啊，小妹，为什么你就不等等我们呢？

original: Search Party Log #3
translation: 搜索小队日志#3

original:
Has to be a month gone since we was at Citadel.  Tracking mutants in the city is no easy job.  Helps to have mentats keep everyone focused, but we still have to be careful.  These green bastards seem like they're on the move.  You never hear em talk about it, but they're looking for something.  And people.  Anyone they can get their hands on.

Tracking Muties through the city isn't the hard part.  They're good with metal, always ripping up junkers and building crap out of the bits.  Just follow their freak sculpture shows.  Hard part is staying hidden.  Emmet took a bad cut on the leg from one of the spikes., took two shirts to stop the bleeding.  I hope these freaks can’t smell blood.  We’re headed towards the Citadel, maybe they’ll help us patch him up.

Relief to be outside of the city for a day.  We’ll use the bridge and cross over to check beyond the ruins on the west side.  We can’t hold out down here much longer.  I can’t just give up on Cheryl, but I might not end up having a choice.  Emmet’s in bad shape.  We'll wait to cross the bridge until tomorrow.
 
RIP, Emmet.  Poor kid left Canterbury so fresh I didn’t want him along, but he really came into his own these past few weeks.  He died in the night.  No point bothering with those pricks at the Citadel now.  We head into the city tomorrow.
translation:
我们离开大本营已经一个月了。在城市里跟着变种人可不是简单的事情。在曼塔特的作用下每个人还很清醒，但我们依然要小心。这些绿皮混蛋们一直在前进着。始终没听到过他们说话，但是他们在找一些东西。以及活人。任何他们能抓到的人。

跟着变种人穿过城市并不是最难的。他们很善于使用金属的东西，总喜欢撕扯开一些废品然后在周围盖起一些破玩意。跟着这些怪胎们的杰作走就行。最难的是保持隐蔽而不被发现，艾米特的大腿被钉子切开了一个大口子，用尽了两件衬衣的布料才止住了血。但愿那些怪胎们闻不到血腥味。我们正向着大本营前进着，或许他们能帮忙缝上艾米特的伤口。

在城市外面待一天是一种解脱。沿着桥过河之后我们会穿越西边的废墟。我们在这里坚持不了多久。我不能就这么放弃了谢丽尔，但是我真的没有其他办法了。艾米特的情况现在很糟。等到明天我们就过桥。
 
安息吧，艾米特。可怜的孩子还是这么的稚嫩，就已经离开了坎特伯雷，我本来不想让他跟着我们，但这几个星期来他真自己坚持了下来。晚上的时候他死了。现在再去找五角大本营的那帮混蛋们也没什么用了。明天我们就进入城市。

original: Search Party Log #4
translation: 搜索小队日志#4

original:
Found something.  Muties have a bunch of folks trussed up in a park nearby.  Going to hole up and see what happens.  Too risky to check for Cheryl until we know more.

Kaya crept down and checked tonight.  Cheryl's not there and most of the people are dead, or close to it.  Still, going to keep an eye on them from here a little longer.

Bastards are cleverer than they look.  They stake people up, attracts attention.  Saw a couple mercs get snatched investigating.  One didn't put up much fight, they took him alive.  May be hope to find Cheryl yet.

Stakes aren't just to attract people.  Big 'ol mother came by today, yanked a stiff from one of those spikes and gnawed every scrap of meat off the bones.  Looks like they were waiting for the biggun to pack up.  They're on the move.  I’ve got a feeling they'll take these folks the same place they must have taken sis.

Close call today, damn fool brotherhood scout nearly exposed us.  Muties got him.  Poor kid never had a chance.  Finally clear of the city.  Kaya refused to go any further, left for Canterbury.  The mutants are headed west, and I still aim to find where they’re taking these people.  Going to be harder to stay concealed out there in the open, but at least I don't have to worry about ghouls crawling up my ass all night.
translation:
我们有了新的线索。在附近的一个公园里，变种人将一群人捆在了一起。我们一直等待着。观察着。在没查探清楚前，不能直接过去找谢丽尔，那样太危险了。

今天晚上卡娅爬了过去打探了一下。谢丽尔不在那里，大部分人都死了，有的奄奄一息。我们又继续在这里对那些变种人监视了一段时间。

那群混蛋比他们看起来的要聪明。他们把人捆在木桩上，作为诱饵。两个雇佣兵打算上前查看一下，就被抓了起来。一个人没怎么反抗，那群混蛋们没杀他。看样子还有希望找到谢丽尔。

捆人的木桩不只是用来做诱饵的。今天来了个大家伙，从钉子上拔下了一具死尸，吃光了骨头上的每一块肉。看上去他们正等着老大来收拾行装。他们出发了。我有预感，他们带着这些人要去的地方，小妹也会被带到那里。

今天真是惊险万分，一个该死的兄弟会侦察兵差点暴露了我们。变种人抓住了他。那可怜的孩子很倒霉。终于整个城市都搜查遍了。卡娅拒绝再往前走了，她返回了坎特伯雷。变种人们正在西行，我的目标还是要找出他们想把那些人带到哪里。在野外想保持隐蔽更难，但至少整晚我都不用担心会有爆掉我的后庭了。

original: Wasteland Merchant Note
translation: 废土商人的笔记

original:
Trading Caravan Log

By tomorrow I should reach the green mountain. The people there may be weirdos, but hey, they trade great stuff for the weapons and ammunition, so who am I to complain? 

Last time I was there, they told me that someone named the Great One wanted to speak to me, and that I should drink some of their homemade hooch and join them in some kind of ceremony. I'll probably take them up on it this time -- I haven't had a good drink in a while and I'm a day ahead of schedule.
translation:
商队贸易日记

明天，我应该就能抵达那座青山。那儿的人可能有些古怪，但嘿，他们会用很棒的东西来交易武器和弹药，我又有什么好抱怨的呢？

上次我去那儿的时候，他们跟我说有个叫“圣贤”的人想和我谈谈，还说我应该喝点他们自制的烈酒，然后和他们一起参加某种仪式。这次我很可能会答应他们——我已经有一阵子没痛痛快快喝上一场了，而且我的行程比计划提前了一天。

original: Attempt #172\n    - Quite close now.  I'm fairly certain the key ingredient is some form of ThermoStarch.  My next attempt will be using Wonder Glue, the adhesive component contains a great deal of the stuff.  Luckily we have a small store of the stuff available here, and I'm offering a handful of caps to the raiders for every bottle they can bring me.  Those greasy villains are handy when you've got the money.
translation: 试验报告 #172\n    - 重点找到了。我几乎能确定左右试验的关键点取决于如何运用这种糊状物质。下一步，我打算加入强力胶，因为这种粘稠物中包含了大量的上述物质。幸运的是我们手头还有少量库存可供使用，同时我也和掠夺者们达成了以钱易胶的约定。钱能轻易地让那些肮脏的恶棍们为你所用。

original: Attempt #171\n  - I've noticed positive reactions with base dextrin substances.  I'll continue testing different forms to see where it leads me.  If there was ever a time for a breakthrough it would be right now.  Masquerading as one of these foul murderers grows tiring, once the theatrics of it wear off.  One thing is true, though - we can all be rich if the experiment succeeds.  Molerat is one of the easiest meats to get hold of, yet the most disgusting.  If I can turn it into a viable food source...
translation: 试验报告 #171\n  - 我注意到了以那种胶质为主的混合物确实有效。我打算深化各种实验以便完全掌握它。我打赌这会是我最有可能获得成功的机会。我敢肯定，为此—实验的成功会让我们一夜暴富。鼹鼠肉是最简单易捕的肉类之一，同时也是最令人作呕的。但假设我能成功地让它成为可口的肉食来源的话……

original: Attempt #86\n    -I introduced a small component of isoprene, didn't seem to make a difference in taste or composition.  I'm not hopeful, but in the next round I'll increase the concentration, if only because the damn stuff is so plentiful.
translation: 试验报告 #86\n    - 我掺入了少量胶质物，但无论对口味还是口感似乎都没有改善。我虽没抱太大希望，但如果真是材料过大造成的问题，那我得在下一次的试验中加大使用计量。

original: Springvale Raider Mining Log
translation: 斯普林威尔掠夺者挖掘日志

original: Some of the scabs got tired of digging the tunnel and started using mines to get into the caves.  Not a half bad idea, the explosions damn near knocked the building apart.  We got a new window or two on the side of the building. haha.  I'm going to have some of the boys knock over a caravan for more explosives, but we'll have to use fewer in the blasts, or some assholes from Megaton will come looking.
translation: 一些家伙厌倦了挖掘地道开始在洞穴里使用地雷。不错的主意，爆炸震到了附近的建筑物。我们在建筑物上搞出了一两扇新的窗户，哈哈。我需要一些小子来为我抢到更多的炸药，但是我们必须尽量少用，否则从兆吨镇来的那些屁眼儿们会找过来的。

original: Springvale Raider Mining Log
translation: 斯普林威尔掠夺者挖掘日志

original: Boppo died like a bitch.  He didn't have half a bad idea, setting up here.  We had a good thing going, picking off caravans and traders on their way into Megaton.  He was stupid to try and raid the town.  Dumbass deserved the bullet Simms put in his head.  \n\nAnyway, there's sweeter water to be had here.  That damn Vault's what we should be trying to get into, not that rag-ass town.  If we can get in there, ain't none of us going to want again for the rest of our lives.
translation: 波普像个婊子样的死掉了。驻扎在这里，算是他出的一个好主意。我们不错的生意做，就是在旅队和商人去兆吨镇的路上把他们干掉。可他个白痴，居然试图去袭击这个镇子。白痴理所当然会被西姆斯的子弹爆头了。\n\n无论如何，这地方还有甜头，我们应该试着进入那个该死的避难所，而不是那个狗屁的城镇。一旦我们能进到那里面，我们下半辈子就不用愁了。

original: Oasis Coordinates
translation: 绿洲坐标

original: ///Encrypt: Bailain///\nLONG: 8347*&$\nLATI: 324897.347

Diary Entry 64D-A3: Mutant Chips\n\nI have had to alter the chips for the mutants to account for their greater size.  Fortunately, they exhibit a higher intellect than the ghouls and can be controlled to an even greater extent.  The enthralled mutants have mentioned legends of even larger mutants, almost twice as big as the ones I’ve captured.  If only I could get my hands on one of those… the experiments… the fun.
translation: 日记条目64D-A3：变种人芯片\n\n我不得不改进变种人芯片来适应它们较大的体型。幸运的是，他们比尸鬼智力高的多，对它们的控制甚至能达到更高的程度。这些受控制的变种人们曾提到过体积更加庞大的变种人的传说，据说其个头是我抓到的这些的两倍大。要是我能抓到其中的一个来？R#&实验#@$7*有趣。

original: Diary Entry 2R-A0: The first ghoul chips\n\nSome of my earlier chip prototypes(C6-A and C6-L) have started to malfunction causing the chips to overheat and eventually detonate the implanted charge.  In retaliation I have upgraded the P7 series and above to counter the malfunction.  I have also altered the Y2 series in the mutants as a precaution.  Ghouls are easily replaceable, mutants are not.
translation: 日记条目2R-A0：最初的尸鬼芯片\n\n一些我早期开发的芯片原型（C6-A与C6-L）发生故障，导致芯片温度过高，最终引爆了内置的炸药。为了不使灾难重演，我改进了P7系列以上的芯片使它们足以应对故障。我同时还预防性地改良了变种人使用的Y2系列芯片。尸鬼很容易再抓，变种人则不然。

original: Diary Entry 07-C: Stefan\n\nMy masterpiece!  Stefan is now under my control!  The latest chip I installed in him seems to have taken and he is now mine.  The effort to capture one of these glowing ghouls was immense but finally I can take solace in the fact that I have one under my control.  His limited intellect means I will have to keep him downstairs with the rest of the ghouls but I pity any rabble that pokes their head in here now.
translation: 日记条目07-C：史迪芬\n\n我的杰作！史迪芬现在在我的掌控之下了！我给他安装的最新芯片看起来起作用了，现在他是我的了。虽然抓一个活生生的发光尸鬼所要花费的代价是巨大的，但毕竟我已经成功掌控了一个尸鬼，这给了我足够的安慰。可惜他有限的智商意味着我只能将把他扔到下面，和其他的尸鬼一块，现在我对外面那些对这地方探头探脑的乌合之众感到遗憾。

original: Diary Entry L-2\n\nI have used materials from the small explosives cache I found to further safeguard myself from my experiments.  I have wired the building to broadcast a signal from this terminal that in emergency will detonate all chips.  I pray that day never comes.
translation: 日记条目 L-2\n\n我已经使用材料加强了自身保护，这些材料是来源于这个小型爆炸性存储器。  我已经用电线装备了整栋楼房以便于能从这个终端发送出信号，一个关于引爆所有芯片的紧急信号。  我祈求那天不要来临。

original: Field Entry: "Bloatfly"
translation: 实验记录: "辐射蝇"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Class: Insecta
Order: Diptera
Family: Tabanidae
Genus: Tabanus Linnaeus

Field observation suggests that the Bloatfly is a mutation of the Tabanus horse fly with provocative advances.  These evolutionary forebears possessed neither the significant body mass, nor projectile sting of the Bloatfly.  Dissection has revealed that this stinger is engorged with living pupae and neurotoxins.  These projectiles are capable of incapacitating large prey on which the bloatfly and it's gestating young can freely feed.  These neurotoxins are only nominally effective on humans, but can cause localized necrosis at the wound site.  This observation is contrary to earlier assumptions that the Bloatfly was primarily a scavenger.  The Bloatfly can be dispatched easily with light weapons, but nonetheless present a threat to field operatives, especially when encountered in numbers.  They are hostile and can strike before the target is aware of its presence.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 节肢动物门
纲： 昆虫纲
目： 双翅目
科： 虻科
属： 虻属 

野外实地的观测表明辐射蝇是马虻蝇受激增生后的一个变种。这些动物进化上的祖先既没有巨大的体型，也没有抛射刺针的能力。解剖后可以发现，这种有刺动物体内充斥着大量的蛹和神经毒素。这些发射出的针刺可以使一些大型的猎物麻痹，进而辐射蝇就可以在猎物身上取食并繁育幼虫。这些神经毒素对人体的作用很有限，但是会在伤口处造成局部的坏疽。这次观测的结果，与早期设想的变异蝇主要靠食腐为生的结论相反。 轻武器就可以很简单地处理掉这些辐射蝇，但对于野外人员说仍然是一种威胁，尤其遇到它们成群出现的时候。它们充满敌意，并且能够在目标察觉之前发起攻击。

original: Field Entry: "Great American Cockroach"
translation: 实验记录: "美利坚大蟑螂"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Class: Insecta
Order: Blattodea
Family: Blattidae
Genus: Periplaneta

The insect colloquially known as the Radroach is one of the most ubiquitous denizens of the modern American landscape.  I believe it to be of the species P. Americana, the American cockroach, albeit a genome strain affected by years of exposure to heavy radiation levels.  While winged, they are incapable of flight.  I theorize that this is due to the evolutionary failure of the wing appendages to grow in strength commensurate to the surge in body mass.  Radroach wings still seem to serve some purpose, however, in inter-species communication.  Dark, damp, irradiated habitats, such as the metro tunnels, provide an ideal environment for breeding.  Caution should be taken while exploring such areas, but the threat to operatives is minimal, even in great numbers.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 节肢动物门
纲： 昆虫纲
目： 蜚蠊目
科： 蜚蠊科
属： 大蠊属

这种被俗称为辐射蟑螂的昆虫是现代美洲大陆上最常见的居民。我确信它是美洲蜚蠊的一种，也就是美洲蟑螂，但它们长期暴露在重度辐射下，导致了基因突变。虽然它们有翅膀，但是飞不起来。我推测这应该是一种进化上的失败，翅膀没能跟得上他们身体重量的大幅增长。不过，它们的翅膀还是起到了一点作用，可用来与自己的同类交流。像地铁隧道这样阴暗、潮湿、充满辐射的地方为它们提供了理想的繁殖环境。在这类地区探索时需要十分的小心，不过即使它们成群出动，对野外人员来说也没什么威胁。

original: Field Entry: "Giant Ant"
translation: 实验记录: "巨蚁"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Class: Insecta
Order: Hymenoptera
Family: Formicidae
Genus: Camponotus

I've determined with near certainty that the aboriginal Ants are of the genus Camponotus. My best guess would be that a majority of the ants encountered are black carpenter ants (Camponotus pennsylvanicus). However, given that this particular genus consists of over a thousand different species, classification has been difficult.  Prior generations of the genus were only considered a nominal threat to humans, but their social and fiercely territorial nature, combined with the greatly increased mass of current varieties has made them extraordinarily dangerous.  The antennae of the ant is the primary sense organ, and soldiers report disabling this to be a successful tactic, as it sends the ant into a frenzy whereupon it attacks anything nearby, human or ant.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 节肢动物门
纲： 昆虫纲
目： 膜翅目
科： 蚁科
属： 弓背蚁属

我现在基本可以确定这种本地的蚂蚁是弓背蚁属的。据我估计，这些蚂蚁多数都是黑木工蚁（弓背蚁属田野种）。尽管如此，想要在这个属里的近千种生物中确定它们的身份，十分的困难。该生物属的早期种群对人类的威胁一度被认为是可以忽略的，但是它们的群体性与强烈的领地性再加上现在这个新种群的庞大规模使得它们极度危险。蚂蚁的触须是他们最主要的感知器官，在士兵的报告中提到过打断它们的触须是一种有效的战术，这样会使他们进入一种狂躁的状态，攻击身边的一切生物，不论人还是同类。

original: Field Entry: "Mirelurk"
translation: 实验记录: "泥沼蟹"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Subphylum: Crustacea/Chelicerata???
Class: Merostomata / Malacostraca / ???
Order: ???
Family: ???
Genus: ???

After going to enormous lengths to procure DNA samples of hypothesized forebears, we cannot explain why ancestry evidence is present from two vastly different creatures; the Limulus polyphemus (horseshoe crab) and the Callinectes sapidus (blue crab).  It's obvious that a mutation occurred, giving this creature bipedal movement and massive growth, but I cannot explain the presence of multiple subphylum markers in DNA/RNA.  Given their mystifying origins, I have decided the species deserves its own classification, and have thus dubbed them "Scylla Serrata Horrendus."  They can often be found in sewers and caves and should be considered hostile and very dangerous, as their chitnous shell provides excellent resistance to both firearms and hand-held weapons.  They are disgusting creatures, and I cannot fathom their popularity as a food source among the citizens of the Wasteland.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 节肢动物门
亚门： 甲壳类/螯肢动物亚门？？？
纲： 肢口纲/ 软甲亚纲 / ？？？
目： ？？？
科： ？？？
属： ？？？

即便艰难的获取了这种动物假定祖先的DNA样本之后，我们仍然无法解释为什么他们祖先DNA的特征会出现在两种截然不懂的生物上。很明显变异使这种生物后具有了两足行走的能力，并且体型急剧的增加，但我无法解释为什么不同门的生物的DNA/RNA会同时出现在一种生物身上。鉴于它们谜一般的起源，我决定将它们列为一个新的物种，并且给它们起名为“恐怖锯齿青蟹”。它们在下水道与洞窟中很常见，极具攻击性而且十分的危险，因为它们天生的甲壳对于轻武器和手持武器有着极佳的防护力。它们是一种令人作呕的动物，令我不解的是对于废土居民来说，它们竟然能作为一种食物来源而大受欢迎。

original: Field Entry: "Two-Headed Brahmin"
translation: 实验记录: "双头牛"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Chordata
Class: Mammalia
Order: Artiodactyla
Family: Bovidae
Genus: Bos

The Brahmin has been encountered both in domesticated and wild varieties.  They are hardy animals, and their utility has made them valuable to humans, in turn allowing these animals to reproduce in quantities beyond what they would otherwise be likely to acheive.  They are commonly employed as pack animals.  In addition to having two heads, dissection has revealed that these creatures have eight stomachs, but otherwise do not differ significantly from their likely ancestors of the Bovidae Family.  Typically docile in demeanor, these creatures are useful as both as beasts of burden and a food source for field operatives.
translation:
界： 动物界
门： 脊索动物门
纲： 哺乳动物纲
目： 偶蹄目
科： 牛科
属： Bos

双头牛很常见，野生的驯养的都有。它们是一种能吃苦耐劳的动物，对人类也有重要的作用，也使得它们的繁殖数量超出了它们应有的数量。双头牛一般被当作驮畜来使用。他们长了两个头，在解剖中还发现它们有8个胃。别的方面与它们的牛科祖先没什么很大的差别。它们的个性温。对于野外人员来说，它们是最好的驮畜和食物来源。

original:
Day 45: 

Jason found a terminal suitable to our needs in the nearby ruins.  With some work, we may be able to move this workstation closer to where our research has been taking place.  Must keep an eye out for a portable source of power.  Must remember to translate my notes onto this thing when I have some time to do so.

While Jason was scavenging the ruins, I caught a glimpse of the group by the pool in the afternoon.  Contrary to what most people think, they don't fear the daylight at all, but they do seem to prefer indoor habitats.
translation:
第45天：

杰森在附近的废墟里找到了一台电脑终端。或许我们能设法把它移动到我们的观测站附近。必须留意下附近是否有小型的发电装置。之后我会抽时间把我心得的都记录其中。

中午当杰森搜索废墟的时候，我瞥见了傍池而居的那个群体。与多数人的认知相反，他们毫不畏惧白天，但他们更喜欢在非露天的环境下生活。

original: Day 51:\n\nI've conducted an informal experiment this week.  I've filled some heavy basins with water, each with different levels of radiation.  Consistent with my predictions, they seem to prefer water with high rad content.  Thanks to these radiation suits, I was able to irradiate one of the basins with a typically lethal level of radiation, and to my amazement, this has worked better than any of our attempts at constructing a lure to attract them into our research area.  This is very exciting!
translation: 第51天：\n\n本周我进行了一次尝试性的试验。我在几个池子里加入不同辐射等级的水。如我所预测的一样，他们更喜欢辐射高水池。依靠防辐射装的帮忙，我将其中一处池水的辐射等级提升到了可以致命的程度，而让我吃惊的是，这比我们所有已尝试过的吸引他们进入研究范围的方法都更有效。真是太振奋人心了！

original: Day 53:\n\nJason's recovered and repaired a generator, which should allow us to move this terminal and some of my equipment out to a better position for observation of the group's behavior.
translation: 第53天：\n\n杰森修复了在附近找到的一台发电机，这下我就可以带着电脑终端和其他带来的装备，转移到更有助于观察那个群体行为方式的观测点了。

original: Day 58: \n\nAmazing!  Today I was approached by one of them.  I've decided to call her "Melinda."  I'm not actually sure if there's a way to establish gender, but Melinda moved in a way that appeared very feminine to me.  She caught me off guard while I was checking water levels in the experimental basins.  For a moment there, I wished I had taken that damned pistol Jason insisted upon me carrying.  She grasped my arm, but instead of attacking, she appeared to sniff my arm where some of the scavenged resin I've been using to irradiate the basins had spilled on my suit.  Moments later, she was gone.  Must consider some way of tagging them.
translation: 第58天：\n\n太刺激了！今天它们中的一个接近了我。我决定为她取名为“梅林达”。事实上它们并没有明显可供分辨的性特征，但梅林达的行动让我感觉充满了女人味。她在我测量试验池水的辐射程度时抓住了我。一刹那，我咒骂自己为什么不带上杰森曾坚持让我随身携带的那把手枪。她抓住了我的胳膊，但她并没有攻击我，而是使劲嗅着从试验池水溅到我外套上的充满腐臭的树脂。片刻之后，她离开了。必须想办法把他们吸引出来。

original:
Day 63: 

No sign of the group for days.  Could Melinda have returned to the group with some news of our brief encounter?  Perhaps they're scared of us?

Jason's beginning to get concerned, but I believe we're close to learning what we came here for.  The poor man's been through Hell for me. I don't know if I could have achieved so much without him, but there's so much left to learn.
translation:
第63天：

连续几天都没有再看到那个群体。是因为我们与梅林达短暂的相遇被它传达给了它的群体吗？难道是因为他们害怕我们吗？

杰森越来越担心了，但我相信我们来这里的目的马上就要达到了。这个可怜的男人陪伴我走过了地狱般的旅程。没有他我无法想象能做到这种程度，但我们未知的仍有很多。

original: Day 67: \n\nI insisted on sleeping at the research site last night, much to Jason's protest.  I'm sure I saw motion in the far ruins, but the moon had slid behind a cloud, so I couldn't make out for certain their shapes.  I don't think mutants would have moved like that, and most people in the city know enough to hunker down at night.  Could it have been our group, returning home?
translation: 第67天：\n\n我没有理睬杰森的抗议，坚持睡在调查点。我确信在远处的废墟中有生物的存在，由于云层阻断了月光，让我看不清他们的形态。我不认为那是变种人的行为方式，而这里的人们在夜晚都会隐藏起来。那它是否是那个群体中的一员而正在回家的路上呢？

original: Day 68:\n\nSlept outdoors again last night.  Jason insisted on staying with me this time, and built a camouflage screen for us to sleep in.  I irradiated the main body of water as heavily as I could to try and draw them out.  My plan seems to have worked, because I saw few - I think Melinda was among them - come into the open at dusk and settle into the water.  After dark, one I believe to be the alpha male - I've called him "Samuel" - emerged with the rest of the group.  I had to switch my geiger counter off when he arrived to avoid being heard.  I can't imagine the radiation levels the glowing ones must be infused with.  I think that must be why he's the alpha - the others are so drawn to him because of his immense irradiation.
translation: 第68天：\n\n昨晚又一次露天而眠。这次杰森坚持要陪着我，并用具有伪装效果的遮蔽物做成我们临时的床。我尽可能把整个身体浸入水中试图以身上的树脂味把他们吸引出来。我的计划似乎奏效了，因为黄昏时我发现了一小群 — 梅林达似乎也在其中之一 — 穿过出口来到岸边。天黑后，雄性首领 — 我为它取名塞缪尔— 带领着其余的成员出现了。为了不让它听见我必须关掉我的盖革计数管。我无法想象那个发光者的受辐射程度。我认为这一定是它之所以成为首领的原因 — 他散发的庞大的射线量吸引着其他成员自然地听命于他。

original: Day 75:\n\nI need to make contact again.  I've coated my suit in resin, and will try approaching the group tomorrow at dusk.  Observation hasn't revealed anything new; direct contact is required if I'm going to continue to learn about them.  I know Jason would never understand, but this won't work if his suit isn't also irradiated.  I'll coat it while he's gone scavenging during the afternoon, and we'll set up camp tonight by the water before dusk.
translation: 第75天：\n\n我计划再去一次。把外套涂满树脂并在次日黄昏接近他们。远距离的观察并没有告诉我更多;如果要更深入了解他们那直接的交流是必须的。杰森也许不会理解，但如果他不穿上涂满树脂的外套一切就无济于事。我会利用他中午进行净化实验时给他的衣服涂上树脂，然后我们会赶在黄昏前在那条河边露营。

original: As Requested
translation: 如你所命

original:
S,

Here's that stuff you wanted. If anyone asks where you got it -- say it was a gift from your grandma.

Happy hunting!

E
translation:
S,

这就是你需要的东西。如果有人问你从哪得到的 — 就说是你祖母送给你的礼物。

狩猎快乐！

E

original: Nothing says “equality” like a fistful of caps.  I think these Talon Company mercs are about the most cordial smoothies I've met, as long as their boss is getting paid.  Luckily, money's no issue; I've hoarded plenty of it up since before these guys' parents were knee-high on a Brahmin.\n\nOf course, if I succeed in this, it won't matter how many caps any of these rat bastards have.
translation: 就像在一堆瓶盖里找"平等"是不可能的。我想这些鹰爪公司佣兵在他们的老板得到回报时是我遇到过最真诚恳切，举止优雅的人了。幸运的是， 钱不是问题; 我在这些家伙的父母还没双头牛高时就已经储备好了一批巨款。\n\n当然了，如果我在这方面成功了，这些混球究竟拥有多少瓶盖也不会是问题了。

original: Thanks to a little creative wiring, I was able to tap us into a power source.  They're less common up here, but if you know where to look, there are still plenty of live power lines buried all over the Wasteland.  For all their arrogance, they knew a thing or two about engineering before the bombs.  I have to admit; it's remarkable that there's still power to be had after all these years.\n\nNow that we've got all the power we'd want, I can bring our defensive turret online and try to get the dish motors operational.
translation: 多亏了一根小小的富有创造性的电线，才得以使我们能够接进力量源。  在上面它们可不如此平凡， 只要你知道往哪找， 还是能发现许多生存能量线隐藏在整个废土的。  由于生性傲慢， 他们在轰炸前还是对工程学略知一二的。  我不得不承认; 有个事实很明显，那就是过了这么多年还依然存在能量。\n\n 现在，我们已经得到了所需的能量，  我可以连线防卫炮塔并且设法取得碟形发电机的操作权。

original: Finally got to begin on my work in earnest today.  Dish motivators are offline, but I was able to input some basic coordinates and ping nearby satcom arrays to the southwest and east.  There was some interference pinging the NN-03d array.  Probably Radroaches or something making a nest in the dishes.  It may be worth sending one or two of the mercs over there to clean it out in case I can use those towers to amplify my own signal.\n\nThere were dozens of military satellites in orbit, just from the old records I found in the ruins.  There must have been hundreds before the war.  If I can find just a few operational platforms...
translation: 最终在一个充满热情的日子里开始了我的工作。  碟形天线未连线，  但我可以输入些基本的坐标， 附近从西南至东面的卫星通讯阵列发出砰砰的声响。  卫星通讯阵列NN-03d还存在被干扰问题。  也许是Radroach或其他什么东西在碟形天线里做巢。  也许派一两个佣兵去把那清理干净很有必要，以便我可以使用那些塔楼来增强信号。\n\n我刚在从废墟里找到的旧时记录里发现，那儿曾经有数百万的军事卫星在绕轨道飞行。  不过那也肯定是大战前数百年的事了。   如果我只能找到一些操作平台。。。

original: First attempts at atmospheric pinging returned negative.  Considering that the motivators are still non-functional, it's going to be difficult to catch much of anything that doesn't pass directly over us.  Still, I cannot rule out other mechanical failure.  I haven't got much astronomical reference material with me, but maybe I can find an old chart and wait until a celestial body passes over to confirm signal.  Of course, that may take years.  I'll have to keep working on the motivators.
translation: 起初在大气脉冲上所做的尝试无功而返.  考虑到操作机仍然不起作用, 这将给探索未直接经过我们的玩意带来困难.  我仍然不排出其它机械故障.  我还没有得到大量相关材料, 但也许我可以找一块旧图表,然后一直等到天上的物体失去了有效信号.  淡然, 那可要费些时日.  我不得不还继续在操作机上费点工夫.

original: What a lucky break!  I pinged an orbiting body successfully today.  Registration ID is USDOD-21TXH, callsign “Highwater Trouser”.  I'll begin tracking it and cross-reference the registration information with the data I've got.
translation: 多幸运的一次突破！我今天成功的接收到了一个绕轨道飞行物体的声纳脉冲信号。注册ID是USDOD-21TXH，呼号"Highwater Trouser"。我将开始对其展开追踪, 并对其注册信息和我个人所得数据进行前后对照。

original: Turns out I don't have specific data on my satellite, but the registration format suggests that it's a stationary micro-nuclear weapons platform.  Tracking data appears to confirm this; the thing hasn't moved in the week I've been tracking it.  Without a targeting platform at my disposal, sending an activation code would only cause it to drop a payload directly on top of this area.  Not exactly what I'm aiming for, but I'll keep the codes handy just in case.
translation: 结果证明我还在卫星上还没找到详细精确的数据, 但注册信息显示这是一座固定的微型核武器平台.  追踪数据证实了这点; 在我追踪它的这一周,它还未移动过.  如果装置中没有目标平台的话,  发送激活代码只能使它直接坠落.  我瞄准的也不一定准确, 但我会把代码放在手头边以防万一.

original: We were mobilized in the early evening.  My security clearance isn't high enough to know this on an official level, but I have it on good authority that we're under threat of a Chinese attack.  I don't dare to share this with the girls; most of them are a solid sort, but I can't trust that some won't desert to try and protect themselves or their families, and wind up spreading panic, especially on flimsy rumours based on flimsier intelligence from DoD.\n\nWe haven't been debriefed yet, but it's probably safe to assume we'll be on an evacuation detail in the rural areas.  Our unit scored somewhat poorly in the last round of drills, and the high-flyers always get the urban details; we'll be stuck herding farmers and hermits in the hills.
translation: 我们在黄昏时被动员起来。我的安全级别还不足以了解情况，但是我有确实的根据说明我们正受到中国进攻的威胁。我不敢告诉女孩们这一情况；她们大部分是可靠的，但是我认为总有人会逃跑，放弃保护自己和家人的机会，四处散布恐慌。尤其是当谣传建立在DoD那些没信誉的情报人员上时。\n\n我们还没有被询问到，不过倒是可以假设我们将会撤到乡下地区。我们的单位在最后一次训练中表现得不好，而那些野心家们总是能得到城市的详细资料；我们会被骗去山沟里种地放羊。

original: This can't have happened.  We don't even know if it was the Chinese, but DC was hit.  My God, Andrea's unit was on evac detail right on the Belt Loop.  \n\nDear God.  More bombs.  What's happening?
translation: 这不能够啊。我们甚至还不知道那到底是不是中国人干的，但是华盛顿已经被袭击了。我的天，安德烈的队伍还在环地进行干扰作业。\n\n亲爱的上帝啊。炸弹又来了。到底发生了什么？

original: Our unit has been assigned to a National Guard Detachment.  They drove all night from Pennsylvania.  We're doing our best to keep the survivors placated while these boys get their strength up.  The looting gets worse every day, and it's a small town.  There can't be much left, and there's already been one scuffle at the canteen.  These Guardsmen arrived just in time, I fear.
translation: 我们的单位已经被指派去国民警卫分遣队。他们从宾夕法尼亚连夜赶路。我们正尽最大努力安抚幸存者。抢劫现象每天都在增加，而这只是个小镇。那里剩不下什么东西了，店里已经混乱一团。恐怕这些守卫来得正是时候。

original: Dolores and Rebecca deserted in the night.  They had the goodness not to rob us blind on her way out; I had trusted Becky with the keys to the canteen and the artesian well we locked up on Day One..  Several of our survivors were talking rubbish about seeking refuge in a nearby Vault, the girls must have decided to go with them.  Damned fools; if anybody made it into those things in time, they bloody well aren't letting any of us in now.  I suppose I should just be glad we have a few less mouths to feed.
translation: 多洛雷斯和丽贝卡在夜里逃走了。他们还算有良心没有在走的时候打劫我们；我曾经那么信任贝基，给他店里和自流井的钥匙，那自流井还是我们在第一天就锁上的..我们的几个幸存者还在徒劳地讨论在附近的避难所里找个藏身处，那些女孩应该是已经决定跟他们一起去了。该死的白痴们；即使有人能及时赶到那里，他们也肯定不会放我们任何一个进去的。我猜我应该庆幸可以少喂几张嘴了。

original: I took the NCO's advice and set up a quarantine for the worst of the radiation victims.  We know better than to think they're contagious, but most of our survivors don't, and it helps keep them calm.  We also have an easier time smuggling the bodies out at night.  It's not so much that people die; it's how they look when they go.  They all think they'll just lose a bit of hair, maybe get a rash.  It gets so much worse than that.
translation: 我接受了NCO的建议，安排了对严重辐射病患的隔离检疫。我们还没有白痴到以为他们会传染，但是大多数幸存者们并不懂，而这可以安抚他们。如此一来我们就可以在夜里更容易的悄悄运走尸体。人死了并没什么大不了的；关键是死的时候看起来是什么样子。他们都以为只不过是掉几根头发，或者再得几个疹子。实际情况远比他们想的糟。

original: We're low on Prussian Blue.  Most of them don't know what that really means, for which I'm thankful.  One of the local doctors in our camp knows about a cancer treatment facility not too far from here.  We're sending some of the guardsmen out to investigate.  If they can recover any filgrastim, we might be able to stave off widespread radiation sickness a little longer.
translation: 我们缺少普鲁士蓝。谢天谢地，他们大多不懂这是什么意思。一个我们营地里的本地医生知道附近有个癌症治疗设备。我们正派人前去调查。如果他们能带回点惠尔血，我们也许就可以拖延辐射病的蔓延。

original: These days I feel like more of a preacher than a nurse.  We've lost hope that the reservists will be back.  I can only hope they died with some scrap of honor and didn't abandon us.  Without medication, people are succumbing to radiation sickness, for which there is no hope of treatment.  We can do nothing more than make our patients comfortable as we await the end.  When the painkillers and whiskey run out, prayer is all we can offer them.  I've taken to wearing a headwrap; I don't want them to see how much of my own hair has fallen out.
translation: 这些天往我觉得自己更像是个牧师而不是护士。我们已经放弃了军队回来的希望。我只希望他们死的荣耀，没有丢下我们。没有药品，人们对辐射病没有任何抵抗力，毫无治愈希望。我们什么也做不了，最多让病人们在等死的时候舒服点。当止痛药和威士忌用完之后，我们只能帮他们祈祷了。我戴上了头袋；我可不想让他们看到我掉了多少头发。

original: I suppose it seems only right to say goodbye.  I ought to know it's hopeless, but maybe one of my sisters is still out there, and I couldn't go without leaving some kind of farewell.  Just know that I did everything I could.  I tried, and I only wish that I could be the last to go, so I could have helped all the others before they met their own end.
translation: 我想现在正是说再见的时候。我应该清楚这是没希望的，但是也许我的一个妹妹还在那，我也不能连再见都不说就走了。我已经做了所有能做的。我试过了，我只希望我是最后一个走的，这样我就算是帮了其它所有人，在他们见到自己的归宿之前。

original: I finally got everyone to agree to let me set up some generators for power.  I can understand their nerves, considering what technology did to us all, but not making use of every resource is wasteful, and a sure path to Hell in this situation.  Coming out into the light has done wonders for everyone, but we all can get a little stir crazy, even out here.  I'm setting this thing up for everyone to use.
translation: 最终，我让所有人都同意我建立一些发电机以获取能源。我能理解他们为什么神经过敏，想想看科技对我们每一个人做过的事情就明白了。但是，不能将每一样资源物尽其用，就是浪费，在现在这种情况下，这很明显，就是自寻死路。产生光对每一个人都有好处，但是我们每一个人都有一些疯狂，即使在这里。我要把这东西建立起来，让每一个人都能使用。

original: We set up an irrigation system!  Thank God for Miles' experience on the farm – I never would have thought of this on my own, but what a great idea.  I really thought this ground was useless, but the stuff he had us plant in the dirt we dug up is actually sprouting, and the little rivers keep it all nice and wet.
translation: 我们建立了一个灌溉系统！感谢上帝！感谢迈尔斯的农场经验！从没想过我们会搞这个，但真是个好主意。我曾以为这没有用，但它使植物萌芽，并令小河保持湿润。

original: My turn to be boss this month.  Seems stupid to me, I don't want to be in charge.  I'm just going to do whatever Jim tells me to.
translation: 这月轮到我作主。看起来很傻，我并不想掌权。我只想做吉姆叫我做的。

original: I want to remind everyone to come by my tent every day for your radiation screening.  Even if you don't think you've been exposed to radiation, the test takes only minutes.  Take my word for it; you'd much rather be inconvenienced in the morning than come down with a case of radiation sickness.  I'm more than happy to give a detailed account of that scenario to the next person who misses an appointment.
translation: 我想提醒每个人，每天都要来我的帐篷领取你的防辐射罩。即使你认为你并没有暴露在放射线中，这个测试也只需要几分钟，记住我的话，即使每天早上过来一趟很不方便，也远胜于感染上辐射病。我很乐意为每一个错过了约定的人介绍情况细节。

original: my name is ty an i'm a big dum hed!!!
translation: 我叫做Ty…我是一个大儿！！！

original: Hey Rochelle, remind me what a big stupid head I am the next time you need me to repair you and Vu's distillers, okay?  What gives, Edgar?  Can't you put a password on this thing?
translation: 嘿，拉洛歇尔。下次当你要我修理你和酿酒炉的时候，提醒我一下，我是头蠢蛋，好吗？那是什么，埃德加？你不能给这玩意儿加个密码？

original: Been a good few months for us since the coming out.  Going by the dosimeter tests, we're taking some exposure to radiation, but as long as Doc Johanson keeps folks on their meds, we don't seem to be having trouble with rad sickness.  Irrigation and fertilization has been good, and though we lost the goats and chickens, the cows have done good.  Those hardy beasts don't seem to mind this new world.  Miles and Jacky are devoting some time to husbandry to keep the cows breeding and available.
translation: 我们外出来已经有好几个月了。通过辐射剂量器的测量，我们正部分暴露在辐射当中，但只要约翰森继续给大家放射药，我们就似乎不会惹上辐射病的麻烦。灌溉和施肥运行良好，而且虽然我们失去了山羊和鸡，但是牛仍然长得很好。这些坚强的动物看起来并不会介意这个新世界。迈尔斯和杰克正致力于农业，以保障牛的繁殖和存活。

original: I'm trying to fabricate a windmill for us.  If anybody spots any long, flat sheets of metal, you let me know.  I have most of the other parts I need, but haven't found good metal for the blades yet.
translation: 我想给我们建一个磨房。如果谁看到一些又长又平的金属板，告诉我一声。其他部分我已经准备好了，但还没找到适合做刀口的金属。

original: Nobody ought concern themselves too much with Miguel's scouting report.  While he did spot some folk out past the valley, they rode by and weren't like to have noticed him or us.  Let's all just keep to the homestead for a few days and avoid using open fires for a few days, just to be safe.
translation: 有了米格尔的侦察报告，就没有人需要过多担心什么了。当他看见村庄外一些居民正骑着坐骑经过，而且并没有打算通知他或者我们。来吧，我们仅仅要保护好农庄，避免动用武力，仅仅保持安全就行了。

伦德斯·普朗基特最后一次被发现在坎特伯雷社区，犯下了盗窃与谋杀的罪行。实施抓捕行动的人请务必格外小心，据称该赏金对象拥有一种罕见的本领，精通使用一把小而隐蔽的刀片。

original: Letter from Vault-Tec
translation: 来自避难所科技的信

original:
Dear Mr & Mrs Gomez: 

Congratulations on your family's recent inclusion in the Vault 101 community!

You will find outlined in your application materials a full review of rules and procedures related to preparing for shelter in a Vault-Tec facility, but we will outline a few key points here:

* Vault-Tec provides all clothing, bedding, and accommodations for residents.  Personal belongings must be reviewed and approved of by an authorized Vault-Tec hermetics technician before such belongings can be delivered to your reserved quarters within the Vault.  In the event of an emergency entrance to the Vault, no personal belongings will be permitted beyond the main door of the facility.
* All Vault residents must attend an orientation seminar.  If you did not attend such a seminar as part of the application process, you must make an appointment with your Vault-Tec representative.
* In the event of a Vault activation, whether actual or drill, Vault-Tec will sound a siren audible in the immediate vicinity of the Vault facility entrance, and residents will be contacted via holotape message at the phone number provided in their resident profile records.  Please report promptly to Vault 101 to await admittance and processing upon such a notification.

Vault-Tec looks forward to having you and your family as valued residents!  Be sure to present this letter to your Vault-Tec representative to receive your special, commemorative Vault Boy bobble-head toy!  Sincerely;

Vault-Tec 
Dept of Public Relations
Washington, DC
translation:
亲爱的戈麦斯先生和戈麦斯夫人：

祝贺您全家成为101号避难所这个大家庭的一部分！

在你的申请材料里，有完整的规章制度以及进入避难所科技公司设施避难前准备工作的相关程序，但我们在这里列出了几个关键点：

* 所有的服装，寝具以及居住设施均由避难所科技提供。你的私人物品在投递到避难所内预定的住处之前，必须先由避难所科技授权的内部技术人员进行检查与核准。  倘若在紧急状态下需要进入避难所， 则不允许携带私人物品进入避难所的大门。
* 所有避难所的住民必须参加一个定位研讨会。 这个研讨会是申请程序的一部分，如果你还未参加，请与避难所科技的代表进行预约。
*如果避难所的大门被打开， 无论是演习还是实战避难所科技都会拉响警报，在紧邻避难所设施入口处的地方就可以听见， 我们将会根据居民档案记录里的编号，经由电话上的全息通讯系统与居民联络。请立即前往101号避难所等待入所批准，并按照以上的注意事项进行下一步的程序。

尊敬的避难所居民，避难所科技期待你和你的家人的到来！请务必将这封信呈交给你在避难所科技的代表，你会收到一个别致而又有纪念意义的小玩具—避难所小子的摇头娃娃！您真诚的；

避难所科技公司 
公共事务部
华盛顿特区

这些避难所科技公司设施里都有可用的居住场所，建造在诸如俄克拉荷马州以及新被吞并的加拿大等等这样激动人心的地方，请与当地的避难所科技代表联系！

避难所科技公司祝你和你的家人在不可预知的未来里能有好运气。 真诚的问候； 

避难所科技公司
公共事务部
华盛顿特区

original: Neighborly Letter
translation: 友好的信

original:
Samantha - 
I would never want to be known as a killjoy, and I realize your family is very much anticipating this year's Halloween, but if I see your little hooligan running and hollering across my yard in that Chinese Commando costume of his again, I swear I'm reporting him to the Vigilant Citizen's Hotline. 
You may find his cheekiness adorable, but perhaps you'll think differently when they haul your boy off to an internment camp with all the real Chinamen he's so keen to give me a heart attack by impersonating. 
Yours most dearly; 
Gabriella
translation:
萨曼莎 - 
我并不是想煞风景，我也知道你和你的家庭十分期待今年的万圣节。但如果再让我看到你家的那个小子穿着中国突击队员军服尖叫着跑过我的院子，我发誓我会报告市民热线。
你可能会觉得他的老脸厚皮很可爱，但当他们把那小子抓起来关进一个全是中国人的集中营去的时候，恐怕你就不会那么想了。要知道他那模仿让对我的心脏难以承担。
你最亲爱的：
加布里艾拉

original: Finally done.  Maggie wanted us to sign up at a Vault-Tec shelter, but I've never trusted those bastards.  It took a lot of work, but Frank helped me get all the parts together and hauled out to the acreage to build this shelter.  Air filtration, chemical toilets, artesian well, the whole nine yards.  Frank's connections got us the generator cheap, too.  And we don't have to worry about sharing quarters with whoever got their name on some waiting list when the day comes.\n\nWish I could say “if” the day comes, but it just seems like a matter of time now.  How could it have come to this?<//end>
translation: 完工了。玛姬希望我们能加入某处避难所科技公司掩体，但我却信不过那些混蛋。花费了很多功夫，在富兰克的帮助下，终于把所有要用的东西搬到了我们准备建立住所的地方，并组装了起来。空气过滤系统，盥洗室，饮用水体统等等，一共是九大部分。因为富兰克的关系，我们买到了便宜的发电机。我们不必担心某天需要与名单上某个不速之客分享住所。\n\n我希望能一直维持这样的生活，但这似乎只是昙花一现。为什么会这样？

original: Robin wanted to play with the computer for Christmas, so I siphoned some juice from the fusion generator to power this old thing.  I know she'd rather be playing outside in the snow, but she's a good kid.  Knows that we can't go outside yet.  I'll check the fallout levels again tomorrow while she's playing, but I doubt we'll be heading out anytime soon.  Damn commies must have hit us hard.<//end>
translation: 圣诞节到了，罗宾提出想玩电脑，于是我从核聚变合发电机分流出一部分电力启动了那台旧电脑。我十分明白其实她更渴望能去户外玩雪，她真是个懂事的孩子。目前为止我们还不能出门。明天我会趁她玩电脑时再测试下户外的辐射浓度，我猜应该不久就能出门了。该死的共军真是把我们害惨了。

original: MARRY CRISMAS!  \n\nCute kid, huh?  <//end>
translation: 圣诞快乐！ \n\n可爱的孩子们，嗯？

original: don't believe it.  Frank showed up today.  He was on a sales trip when the blast hit, selling generators to a mining operation in Pennsylvania.  Being in those shafts probably saved his life, but the shock wave also knocked out every power line feeding light them light and air.  Falling debris killed the foreman standing right next to him.  He doesn't even know how long he was crawling around those tunnels before he got outside, the poor bastard.  \n\nSounds like the water's boiling.  Some hot soup will do him good, even if it's that powdered crap we hauled in here last year.<//end>
translation: 难以置信。弗兰克还活着。在被核爆殃及之前，他一直以行商的身份，为宾夕法尼亚某处的矿坑开掘工程提供发电机。他躲在矿坑里虽逃得一命，但冲击波却摧毁了为他们供给电力和氧气的能源。震落的石块让他背后的一个工头死于非命。他已经述不清自己用了多久才穿过了一条条隧道而逃生，可怜的家伙。\n\n汤已经煮沸了。一些热汤应该对他有所帮助，即使是用去年捕获的早已成干粉的猎物煮的汤。

original: Frank's in bad shape, arms and face are all burned up.  He's got a lot of blisters that look infected.  He went through hell out there.  Hardly anybody alive, and those he met almost did him in.  He tried getting into a Vault near Burkittsville.  They wouldn't open up and he was almost killed in an ambush on his way out of there.  He said those folks wore skins of men.  Cannibal bastards must just wait for their next meal to come looking for help at the Vault.  Frank steered clear of them and headed straight here after that.  He's been on his feet for weeks.<//end>
translation: 弗兰克的情况很糟，双臂和脸部都被严重灼伤了。被感染的部分长满了水泡。他从地狱般的地方逃命，侥幸地生还了。在那里他所遭遇的一切都能要了他的命。他试图进入博科思城附近的一处避难所。他不仅没能成功地说服他们开门，还差点死于归路上的一次伏击。他说伏击他的是人类。那群婊子养的食人族把向避难所求助的人们当成了下一顿肉宴。之后弗兰克设法避开了他们并最终回到了这里。他一直步行了数个星期。

original: His hair was falling out within a week of him showing up.  I wanted to believe we could save him, but there's no way a few iodine tablets a day was going to reverse the radiation he must have been exposed to out there.  He was a good man.  He deserves better, but I can't go out there and give him a proper burial.  Maggie's going to stay up with Robin and let her play some holotapes loud tonight.  That's when I'll take Frank in the back and cremate him.  I wish our furnace was big enough to hold him in one piece.  God help us.  How could it have come to this?<//end>
translation: 他从回来直到现在，整整一星期都在不停脱发。我祈祷他痊愈，但依靠每天少量的碘片却不可能去除他在那所受到的辐射。他是个好人。他的命运不应该如此悲惨，但我却连好好安葬他都做不到。把玛姬交由罗宾照看同时以大音量播放着一些全息磁带。我准备趁这时候把弗兰克背去火化。我祈祷我们的火炉足以容纳他的全尸。我的上帝啊。为什么会这样？

original:
Manny,

You made the right choice, putting us up and keeping it quiet. This weasel Benny's been twitchy since we stole that package from his boss. Making me nervous as hell. But when I found out we'd be passing through on our way to Boulder City, I was sure we could count on you. Let the other Khans say what they want. I know where your loyalty is. 

One day you'll remember where you belong, and your brothers and sisters will welcome you back like you never left. You know where to find us.

McMurphy
translation:
曼尼，

你为我们提供了歇脚的地方，还没有声张，这个决定非常正确。那个黄鼠狼本尼自从我们偷了他老板的包裹后就神经兮兮的，让我非常紧张。不过当我发现我们在前往巨石城的途中会经过你那儿时，我就打定主意要投奔你了。我不管其他大汗帮怎么想，我知道你心里真正向着哪一边。

总有一天你会想起自己的归宿，到了那时，你的兄弟姐妹一定会张开双臂欢迎你回家的。以后有事尽管招呼我们。

麦克墨菲

original: Most of what is recorded here is a mess of incomprehensible psychotic gibberish. It seems to express a general frustration towards a set of brahmin who are allegedly keeping the author awake at night by screaming inside his head whenever he closes his eyes.
translation: 这份磁带中记录的大部分是如同精神病一般难以理解的呓语，似乎表达了作者对于双头牛的恐惧心理。据作者说，无论夜晚什么时候闭上眼睛，都能听到双头牛在其脑内尖叫。

original: Mr. RADical's Journal
translation: 核子先生的日志

original:
Day 1: Love the suit. Can scavenge anywhere now, screw the rads. I hereby christen myself Mr. RADical. Get it? Ha!

Day 4: Suit passed first test with flying (yellow) colors. Overnight visit to Yucca Mountain. Didn't go too deep because something big moving around further down tunnel. Rad level high even where I was, and I didn't feel a tickle. Go, rad suit, go!

Day 5: Vomited all morning. Didn't splash on suit or I'd be pissed. Must be something I ate.

Day 9: Exciting! Ran across old woman's scrap yard. Bought glowing container for measly 50 caps. Heading for Clark Field to prove suit at higher rad levels. If it holds up, I'm going to pop this jar of goop open and pour it all over me! I bet I could swim in this stuff if I had enough of it! Oh yeah!
translation:
第一天：爱死这套衣服了。现在我可以穿着它去任何地方拾荒了，去他妈的辐射！我在此把自己改名为“辐射先生”。懂了吗？哈哈！

第四天：衣服通过了第一个测试，很成功（黄色就是好）。通宵前往丝兰山。没往里走，因为有个巨大的东西在隧道中徘徊。辐射量在这儿都很高，但我一点感觉也没有。冲啊，防辐射服，冲啊！

第五天：一早上都在呕吐。还好没沾到衣服上，不然我会抓狂的。一定是我吃了什么东西才这样。

第九天：激动人心！我路过老太太的垃圾场，花了50个瓶盖买了个闪闪发光的容器。我要去克拉克化工厂，证明一下这套衣服能承受更高的辐射。如果能行的话，我就把罐子打开，把里面黏糊糊的东西浇在身上！我打赌，要是量够的话，我甚至可以在这液体里面游泳！噢耶！

original: Troop Transfer
translation: 部队调令

original: They're transferring away three more of my men. They tell me it's all to keep the situation at the Dam under control, but what about this place? The situation here has become dangerous for my men and I  - I know it, my men know it, and the prisoners know it. It's only a matter of time before something happens.
translation: 又有三名部下被调走了。他们告诉我这都是为了确保大坝的安全，可这个地方呢？对我和其他部下来说，现在监狱的情况变得不稳定了- 我知道，部下们知道，囚犯们也知道。依我看，出问题是迟早的事。

original: Caesar's Legion
translation: 凯撒军团

original: I've seen the reports of this so-called "Caesar's Legion". It sounds like they're just another bunch of raiders, but the higher-ups back west seem to think they're a serious threat.
translation: 我读过所谓的“凯撒军团”的报告。感觉不过是一帮掠夺者，可西部老家里那帮当官的却把他们当成严重的威胁。

original: Conspiracy Suspicions
translation: 怀疑有阴谋

original: Something's going on, and I'm sure that Cooke is behind it all. No evidence yet, but something just feels... off.\n\nAbout Cooke. He's quite popular among the younger prisoners, and many of them seem to have been taken in by his anti-NCR dogma. Cooke's group are all model prisoners, especially Cooke himself. They don't fight and they always do what they're told. They make me nervous, and I'd have them watched every second of every day if I could.
translation: 开始不对劲了，我认为都是库克指使的。现在虽然还没有证据，但是总感觉……不太对。\n\n说到库克。他在年轻囚犯中很受欢迎，许多人似乎已经被他的反NCR教条洗脑了。库克小组里的人全是狱中模范，尤其库克本人。他们从不打架，别人说什么就做什么。他们让我很紧张，如果可以的话，我真想时时刻刻盯着他们。

original: Letter of Protest
translation: 抗议书

original:
James,

You and I served together for seven years, and I'm calling in a favor. I need you to convince General Oliver to stop transferring my men out of here and to deliver the replacements I was promised. I'm expected to put these prisoners to work making new rail lines and fixing the existing ones, but I can't do that if I don't have any guards to keep an eye on them. Does the general really expect the handful of men I have left to be able to keep several dozen hardened men in line?

You owe me for that one time in Modoc. Don't let me down.

Nathan
translation:
詹姆斯，

你我共事七年，现在我想请你帮个忙。我想请你说服奥利弗将军，别再把我的人调走了，让他按照承诺，派些增补的兵员过来。我想让这些囚犯去修新的铁路，顺便把已有的维护一番，但没有守卫盯着他们可不行。将军不会真以为我剩下的那点人能让几十个囚犯守规矩吧？

你在莫道克的时候欠我一个人情。别让我失望。

内森

original: Letter of Introduction
translation: 介绍信

original:
Cooke,

This man has been useful to us down here at the prison, and he's been of great help keeping the NCR away. Since he's proven to be competent and trustworthy,  I sent him in your direction. Maybe he can help.

If so, we're even.


Eddie
translation:
库克，

这个男人在监狱这头帮了我们很大的忙，他成功协助我们阻击了NCR。既然他这么能干又可靠，我决定派他到你那儿去，或许能帮你一把。

这样一来咱们也算扯平了。


埃迪

Cooke,

This woman has been useful to us down here at the prison, and she's been of great help keeping the NCR away. Since she's proven to be competent and trustworthy, I sent her in your direction. Maybe she can help.

If so, we're even.


Eddie
translation:
库克，

这个女人在监狱这头帮了我们很大的忙，她成功协助我们阻击了NCR。既然她这么能干又可靠，我决定派她到你那儿去，或许能帮你一把。

这样一来咱们也算扯平了。


埃迪

original: Mr. Petersen,\n\nIf you want to see your wife alive again, bring the cash in small unmarked bills to the Bison Steve on Tuesday.
translation: 彼得森先生，\n\n如果你还想再见到你的妻子，就准备好没有标记的小额现金，于周二带到野牛史蒂夫旅馆。
