original: Initial Trials
translation: 初步尝试

original: Pending the successful launch of ARCHIMEDES II, we ought to be able to begin field trials with the handheld rangefinder within a few weeks. \n\nOur small-scale tests have already proven the viability of sending power as microwave radiation from the plant to a remote receiver and converting it back into a useable form. All that remains is to extrapolate it to full scale and then prove out the long-range communication/targeting system on the rangefinder.
translation: 等到阿基米德II系统成功启动，我们应该就能在几周后开始手持测距仪的野外实验了。\n\n小规模实验已经证明，将电力以微波辐射形式从发电站射往远程接收器，并把其转化成可用形式的做法是完全可行的。剩下的就是要在全功率输出的情况下，试验测距仪的远距离通信/瞄准系统。

original: Upcoming Visit
translation: 即将来访

original: Brig. Gen. Scott Lowe of the U.S. Army will be visiting the facility starting next Monday and staying onsite indefinitely.  When ARCHIMEDES goes live, he will be the only person here allowed to authorize its use for anything other than a test. Civilian employees are not required to salute, but it is expected of everyone that you observe thorough grooming and hygiene regimens and dress neatly while the general is with us. The general expects the best from all his men, and Poseidon men should be no different in the presence of such a fine and decorated soldier.
translation: 美军准将司各特·洛维将在下周一到访本工厂，并稍作停留。届时阿基米德系统将会启动，在场人员中，只有将军本人才能使用该系统执行任何与测试无关的操作。文职人员不要求敬礼，但我希望将军来的时候，每个人都能仪表端庄，干净得体。将军对他的部下要求颇高，在这样一位功勋卓著的军人面前，海神公司的员工们也应当以高标准来要求自己。

original: "Can I Tell Him?" A Poseidon Energy Publication for New Employees
translation: "我能告诉他吗？"海神能源公司新员工须知

original:
"Can I Tell Him?" A Poseidon Energy Publication for New Employees

As a member of the Poseidon Family, it will be natural for you to become enthusiastic about the incredible endeavors you'll be undertaking with us, and to want to tell others. But just a second there, my good man! Let's take a minute to consider what could happen if company information fell into the wrong hands, and whose hands those might be.

"Can I tell my wife?" Well, let's say you do. You tell her not to tell anyone. Your bond is sacred. But a woman's idle tongue is the devil's plaything. No sooner do you leave for work the next day than she's on the phone telling her best friend Candy. Then Candy tells Gertie, Gertie tells Maxine, Maxine tells Lulu, and while Lulu is telling Doris, a Chinese agent posing as an American operator listens in, and the next thing she's on the line with the Forbidden City, singing like a treasonous canary. The following day you and your wife are bound in shackles and China is sitting at the controls of our entire arsenal. 

"Can I tell my children?" What father wouldn't want his kids to look up to him? Don't be that father. One day at school, Ivan Bullykov will get more than lunch money out of your kids. He'll have national secrets! And while they're parading him through Red Square as a national hero, your children will be working in forced labor camps, right next to you and your beautiful young wife, who's now wrinkled and homely since the communists have banned makeup because it expresses individuality. 

"Can I tell my drinking buddies?" Surely if there's somewhere safe a man can place his trust, it is with his other male friends. But how much do you really know about them? Are they friends... or *comrades*? Don't be too sure. Even the most transparent window can hide secrets when it's lined with Iron Curtains.

Always remember: you are a member of two families now. And you have obligations to both. But your obligation to the Poseidon Family is greater, because while your children may misbehave and your friends may change and your wife may nag and cheat on you, Poseidon Energy will always be paying for and protecting your way of life. Don't tell anybody about anything about the projects of Poseidon Energy. When pressed, tell them that your job is repetitive and not worth discussing, but the Company is nurturing and gives good benefits and is always looking for new talent.
translation:
“我能告诉他吗？”海神能源公司赠与新员工的读物

作为海神家庭的一员，你自然会对将来工作中遇到的各类不可思议的事物表现出巨大热情，并迫不及待地想与他人倾诉。但先等一等，好哥们！让我们花一分钟想一想，假如公司的情报落入坏人之手会发生什么，而那些坏人又有可能是谁。

“我可以告诉我的妻子吗？”好吧，假如你告诉了她，你让她不要告诉别人。你们的结合是神圣的，但女人闲散的舌头是魔鬼的玩物。很快，第二天你去上班了，她会坐在电话前，把这些秘密统统告诉她最好的朋友坎迪。然后坎迪告诉格蒂，格蒂再告诉玛克辛，玛克辛又告诉露露，露露最后告诉多丽丝，而多丽丝恰巧是一个假扮成美国商人的中国特工，接下来她就会和紫禁城通电话，声音像一只叛逆的金丝雀。第二天，你和你的妻子就会锒铛入狱，而中国人则坐享其成，一举占领了我们所有的军用设施。

“我可以告诉我的孩子吗？”有哪个父亲不想让孩子崇拜自己呢？但这样的父亲做不得。等孩子回了学校，伊万·布雷科夫会塞给他一笔比午饭钱还多的美钞，接着国家机密就到了他手里！当他被人簇拥着走过红场，被当成民族英雄来歌颂的时候，你的孩子却只能在劳教所里辛苦工作，身边还站着你和你那漂亮的妻子。你的妻子现在满脸皱纹，因为老共禁止她化妆，他们觉得化妆会凸显个性。

“我可以告诉我的酒友吗？”当然，男人最信任的就是他的酒肉兄弟，可你对他们又了解多少呢？他们究竟是朋友，还是*同志*？别想得太简单，在铁幕之下，即便最透明的窗子也可能藏着秘密。

永远记住，你现在是两个家庭的一员，你对两个家庭都负有责任，但你对海神能源公司的责任更大，因为你的孩子会胡作非为，你的妻子会对你唠叨，背着你出轨，但海神能源公司却会为了保护你现有的生活而不惜一切。千万不要告诉任何人有关海神能源公司的项目情报。如果有人逼问，就告诉他们，你的日常工作无非按部就班，没什么可说的，但公司对员工向来悉心培育，关怀有加，他们始终期待着优秀人才的加入。

original: Prepared Speech of Gus Olson, Ombudsman, for the Annual Overseer Election
translation: 戈斯·奥尔森等人竞选年度监督的演说底稿

original:
Prepared Speech of Gus Olson, Ombudsman, for the Annual Overseer Election

Good afternoon. Each year it is the appointed task of the ombudsman not only to officiate the election, but to chronicle it in hopes that after the last overseer has finished his term and walked to his death in the chamber beneath his office, and the vault has become still, that one day some excavator from humanity or perhaps some yet-unknown race of super beings might find our records and incorporate them into historical canon. 

But lately it's occurred to me that that's not really why. I think the real reason we do it is because we want to believe that somewhere in the archives there's an answer to all of this, or perhaps there will be one when the historical records are completed and the whole story is told. We want it to make sense. To understand why the vault's mainframe will kill us if we do not offer one of our own as a yearly sacrifice. To fully comprehend why we continue to have these elections despite the unfettered corruption that has plagued it for what must be decades by now. There was a simpler time when elections meant shaking hands and kissing babies. But now with the rise of the voting blocs and this infestation of bribery, drug trafficking, smuggling, and God knows what else, we want to know why.

Well I've been through the archives, and I can tell you you won't find the answer there. You'll find an account of the first overseer, who entered the vault as the only citizen aware of the sacrifices that would have to take place. But he didn't have the answers either. If he did, surely he would've foreseen the citizens' anger when he broke the news. Surely he would've guessed that they would want to choose a sacrifice democratically, in the way that we citizens are accustomed to washing our hands of terrible deeds, and that his name would be at the top of the polls, and that the simultaneous vacancy of overseer and martyr would forever fuse the two positions here in Vault 11. But he didn't. He had the answers no more than any of us, and the records state that after the citizens discovered that the sacrificial chamber's password was his wife Betty's first name, and its door was unsealed so he could be offered as the first sacrifice, he walked down into that room crying like a child. 

I can only wonder if there are no answers to be found, and we are just going along with this because we don't see another choice. Nevertheless, I still hold onto hope that we can find one. I urge you all to take the journey I took - to remember that it wasn't so long ago that we were ruled by our civility and our dignity, and that those were times when we didn't have to be quite so ashamed. Thank you.
translation:
年度监督者选举巡视官戈斯·奥尔森的演讲稿

下午好。每年政府指派的巡视官要完成的任务不仅仅是指导竞选，还要将其记录在案，以便将来最后一名监督者结束任期，前往他办公室下的房间中从容赴死后，来自人类文明或某个未知种族的高等生物也能从这归于平静的避难所中发掘出我们留下的记载，将它们编入史册。

但最近，我突然这并非是我们记载历史的原因。恐怕真正的理由在于，我们总认为这堆案盈几的史料中存在着一个我们想要的答案，或许当所有历史都已见诸笔端，所有故事都已迎来结局时，答案才会浮现。我们只想弄明白，为什么我们每年如果不选出一个牺牲者，避难所的主控电脑就会杀光我们所有人。为什么类似的竞选数十年来早已被不受约束的腐败所操控，我们却仍要继续。在过去那个纯真朴素的时代，竞选的方式是相互握手、亲吻婴儿，可如今，伴随着选票集团的兴起，行贿、贩毒、走私，天知道还有什么别的勾当，种种恶行愈发肆无忌惮，对此，我们只想知道原因。

老实说，我已经查阅过了所有档案，我可以告诉你们，里面并没有答案。你们会发现第一任监督者的资料，只有他在进入避难所之前就已经知道必须要有人做出牺牲，可他对此也没有答案。如果他有的话，他就会预见到这个消息公布时所会引发的众怒；预见到居民们必然会选择用民主投票的方式来挑出牺牲者，以摆脱这一可怕事实对自己良心的叩问；预见到他必然会成为这候选名单上的头一人，而11号避难所监督者与殉道者的同时空缺，将使得这两个职位永远地被捆绑在一起。但他没有。他知道的不比我们多。历史只记载着，当他发现牺牲室的密码正是他妻子贝蒂的名字，而那扇门并未封锁，意味着他注定要成为第一位牺牲品时，他哭得像个孩子似的走进了那间屋子。

我怀疑也许从来就没有答案，我们之所以墨守成规，是因为我们别无选择。尽管如此，我仍然期待着能有一个答案。我由衷希望你们能踏上我所经历的旅途，好让你们记得，不久之前，我们还在礼仪与尊严的约束下文明地生活；记得那个时代，我们尚且不必像现在这样为自己感到羞愧。谢谢。

Q. You were telling us of a discussion you allegedly had with Roy Gottlieb of the Justice Bloc.
A. Not allegedly. Had. We've been through this.
Q. It's still just your word against his, Ms. Stone. But please, the discussion.
A. [Sighs] He said my husband's name had come up in their meetings.
Q. The candidate endorsement meetings?
A. Yes. They were going to endorse him.  He wouldn't say why, but I know my husband had a regular poker game with some of them, and he'd been on a winning streak lately.
Q. And according to you, what did Mr. Gottlieb offer?
A. He said he could sway his bloc. Prevent the endorsement. But only if I...
Q. Only if you what, Katherine? 
A. Only if I...
Q. Only if you performed sexual favors.
A. Yes. 
Q. Was this just for Mr. Gottlieb?
A. No. All the bloc leadership. Their friends. 
Q. And you agreed.
A. What else could I do? They had a majority. 
Q. How long did this go on before the endorsements came out?
A. I don't know. A month, maybe. 
Q. And when they came out, and your husband was endorsed despite your supposed agreement, was that when you decided to kill members of the bloc?
A. Yes. I thought, their majority is pretty slim. If I thinned things out a little, especially in the leadership, someone else might get elected.
Q. Assuming you weren't caught.
A. No, Mr. Miles. I expected to be caught. That was my best chance. Now they'll elect me.
Q. A confessed murderer? You think voters would be willing to risk putting you in charge?
A. They have to pick somebody and live with their reasons. 
Q. Yes, but-
A. Wait and see.
translation:
由避难所律师杰拉德·迈尔斯从被告人凯瑟琳·斯通的证词中摘录
问：好的，凯特，就从我们上次没谈到的地方开始吧。
答：叫我凯瑟琳。
问：噢，对，凯瑟琳，我又忘了。
答：只有我丈夫才能叫我凯特。
问：上次你宣称，你曾经和正义团的罗伊·戈特利布谈过话。
答：不是宣称，是确有此事。这件事我们之前聊过了。
问：但是斯通女士，这只是你的一面之词。你不妨说说那次谈话的内容吧。
答：（叹气）他说在他们在开会时提到了我丈夫。
问：是候选人提名会吗？
答：是的，他们打算提名他。他没有说明理由，但我知道我丈夫经常和他们中的一些人打牌，而且他最近赢了不少。
问：按照你说的，戈特利布先生开出的条件是什么？
答：他说他可以内部操作，防止我丈夫被提名，只要我……
问：只要你什么，凯瑟琳？
答：只要我…
问：只要你提供性服务。
答：是的。
问：只提供给戈特利布先生吗？
答：不是，提供给集团所有领导层，以及他们的朋友。
问：你同意了？
答：我还能怎么办？他们人多势众。
问：在提名结果出来之前，这种事持续了多久？
答：我不知道，大概一个月。
问：当结果公布的时候，尽管你之前答应了请求，但你的丈夫依然获得了提名，是否在那个时候，你就产生了谋杀集团成员的念头呢？
答：我想是的，他们虽然人数占优，但散沙一盘。只要我杀掉他们几个人，尤其是领导层，他们就可能会选其他人。
问：前提是你不被抓住。
答：不，迈尔斯先生，我是故意被抓住的。这样一来我才有胜算。现在他们肯定会选我的。
问：所以你承认自己是凶手了？你认为选民们会甘愿投票让你上台吗？
答：他们总得选出一个人，再为自己找借口开脱。
问：没错，但是——
答：等着瞧吧。

收件人：皮尔斯·伊斯利，瑞普康公司
发件人：卡尔·鲁克

皮尔斯，你好，

既然交接工作已经启动，我将担任你和罗科公司的联络人，负责与他们联系。在贵司加入罗科大家庭的过程中，我将负责处理一切可能遇到的问题。我的首要任务是加强你们的安保。如你所知，罗科有非常多的保密项目。正因如此，瑞普康公司需要大幅增加安保系数。我会派工程师和安保人员前往贵司安装增强安保设备。它们大多是无害的，但全体员工都必须始终佩戴安全徽章。

请务必让贵司员工在正式与我们建立合作关系前开始佩戴安全徽章。这样交接工作会进展得更顺利。在我赴任前，这些安全措施都不会启用，希望到时大家都能适应新规矩。

有劳之处，不胜感激，

卡尔·鲁克

original:
REPCONN Inter-office Correspondence #3457477

To: Steve Reynolds, Launch Facility Project Manager
From: Piers Isley, General Manager

Steve,

Can you send an e-mail out to your engineers reminding them about our security policies? I'll be sending a message next week about some increase security procedures.

Thanks,

Piers
translation:
瑞普康公司内部通信 #3457477

收件人：斯蒂夫·雷诺兹，发射设施项目经理
发件人：皮尔斯·伊斯利，总经理

斯蒂夫，

可以给你的工程师发一份邮件，提醒一下我们的安保政策吗？我会在下周发一条关于增强安保措施的信息。

谢谢，

皮尔斯

original:
REPCONN Inter-office Correspondence #3457785

To: IT Services
From: Carl Rook, Vice President

Hello,
I will need someone to come over, as soon as possible, and clear the old Vice President's data off of this terminal, as well as reformat it with my personal information. 

Thank you,

Carl Rook
translation:
瑞普康公司内部通信 #3457785

收件人：信息技术服务部
发件人：卡尔·鲁克，副总裁

您好，
我希望你们尽快派人过来，从这台旧终端上删除前副总裁留下的所有数据，并用我的个人信息将其重新格式化。

谢谢，

卡尔·鲁克

original:
REPCONN Inter-office Correspondence #3262091

To: Leonard Steeple, Vice President
From: Piers Isley, General Manager

Leo,

It is good to have you back in the office, I hope Lisa is feeling better as well. That was a nasty bug going around, hopefully the kids didn't catch it. Either way it is good to have you back in the office.

While you were out of the office I met with some executives at RobCo. They are very interested in the potential that our organization has been showing, and are making an excellent offer to buy out. I'll have one of my assistants run over with the draft they gave me. Take a look at it and let me know what you think.

Piers
translation:
瑞普康公司内部通信 #3262091

收件人：莱纳德·斯蒂普，副总裁
发件人：皮尔斯·伊斯利，总经理

莱纳德，

很高兴你又回到办公室了，希望丽莎也能感觉好点。该死的害虫，希望孩子们没有得病。不管怎样，你能回来就好。

你不在的时候，我和罗科的一些高管见了面。他们对我们公司展现出来的潜力非常感兴趣，并提出愿意高价收购。我会让助理审阅一下他们提供的方案。你也看看，告诉我你的想法。

皮尔斯

original:
REPCONN Inter-office Correspondence #3262099

To: Piers Isley, General Manager
From: Leonard Steeple, Vice President

I have no interest in selling my portion of the company to RobCo. We went over this with Poseidon. These companies deal in defense contracts. That isn't what we are about, and isn't something that I'm willing to support.

I'm sending back the package. I'm sure you have a fairly solid idea where I think that you can put it.

Yours Truly,

Leonard Steeple
translation:
瑞普康公司内部通信 #3262099

收件人：皮尔斯·伊斯利，总经理
发件人：莱纳德·斯蒂普，副总裁

我没兴趣把我持有的那部分公司股权卖给罗科。我们已经和海神公司谈过这件事了。这些公司是做军方合同的，这不是我们的业务范围，我也不支持这种事。

附件退给你。我相信你有一个非常坚定的想法，但你应该把它用在该用的地方。

真诚的，

莱纳德·斯蒂普

original:
REPCONN Inter-office Correspondence #3262105

To: Leonard Steeple, Vice President
From: Piers Isley, General Manager

Leo,

I've heard more from my contacts over at RobCo, and it sounds like they've already started buying up some of our public shares. With just a little bit of support from our stockholders and board members, it is not inconceivable that this amicable relationship could turn very hostile.

It is in everyone's best interest if we take this deal while it is still sweet. I don't think that it will stay this way for long.

Piers
translation:
瑞普康公司内部通信 #3262105

收件人：莱纳德·斯蒂普，副总裁
发件人：皮尔斯·伊斯利，总经理

莱纳德，

我在罗科认识一些人，他们告诉我罗科已经在收购我们公开发行的股票了。如果再得到股东和其他董事会成员的一点支持，那原本友好的谈判转变成恶意收购也并非不可想象。

我认为，如果能抓住当前有利时机做成这桩买卖，那对我们每个人都有好处。我不认为这种现状能维持很久。

皮尔斯

original: Log 672
translation: 日志672

original: We've been picking up a lot of activity from China's satellite network. The tension is pretty high around here. Frank's been talking about securing a place in one of those vaults for himself and his family, and when he didn't show up to work yesterday, I think we all knew where he went.
translation: 我们从中国的卫星网络中接收到了许多不寻常的信息。广播站里的气氛变得十分紧张，弗兰克一直在说想去避难所里找一块地方，好安顿他和他的家人。他昨天就没来上班，我估计大家都知道他去了哪里。

original: Log 674
translation: 日志674

original: Oh my god. It's actually happening. We have readings across the board of launches happening everywhere. They must've thrown everything they had, and it looks like we didn't hold back either. The computer says we have 2 minutes until the first missile drops.
translation: 噢，我的天，真的发生了。面板上的读数显示各地都在发射核弹。他们肯定是把所有的弹头全都丢了出去，而我们似乎也没有保留。电脑显示我们距第一枚核弹命中还有两分钟。

original: Log 675
translation: 日志675

original: I can bsrely type. The mountian shielded us from the wost or the blasd but thr's too mucsd radiattttttttttttttttttttttttttttttt
translation: 我几乎不能打字了。虽然这座山为我们挡住了巨大的爆炸和冲击波，但这儿的辐射太太太太太强了

original: Meeting Notes
translation: 会议记录

original: Note written by Marcus
translation: 马可世的笔记

original: Log 676
translation: 日志676

original: Wow, I can't believe these old machines still work. This place looks pretty defensible, and the radiation should keep the majority of people away. Looks like we've found a home, at least for now. First things first, though. We've got to get these corpses out of here. Poor bastards.\n\nMarcus
translation: 哇哦，我几乎不敢相信这些旧机器还能用。这个地方看起来固若金汤，并且辐射应该可以让大部分人类无法靠近。看来我们找到了一个能安家的地方，至少目前而言是这样。不过首先，我们得把尸体从这里搬出去。这群可怜的家伙。\n\n马可世

original: Tabitha Journal 2
translation: 塔比瑟的日志2

original: Great news! A ghoul entered our camp today who has experience fixing machines! He seems to really like it here, so I hope he can stay long enough to fix Rhonda.\n\nWeird, Rhonda just asked me why she would need fixing. She has a point. What was I thinking?
translation: 重大消息！今天有个尸鬼走进了我们的营地，他还会修机器！看起来他非常喜欢这里，所以我打算留他住下来，一直到朗达被修好。\n\n奇怪了，朗达刚才问我为什么还要修理她。她说得对啊，我在想什么呢？

original: The leader of this community, Marcus, said I should start keeping a journal to get my mind off of Rhonda. He also said I might find something interesting inside this stupid old building. What could possibly be interesting here? The only think that works in here is this junky old terminal.
translation: 这个组织的领袖马可世说我应该开始写日记，好把我的心思从朗达身上移开。他还说，我或许会在这幢愚蠢的老建筑中发现一些有意思的东西。哪会有什么有意思的啊？这地方唯一能用的就是这台破烂的老电脑了。

original: It's amazing! This place is a radio station! If we can get it repaired, we can broadcast music across the wastes, just like Rhonda and I used to listen to. Ah Rhonda, how I wish you hadn't gone away. I asked all of the mutants here for help, but none of them could do anything for you. Which makes me doubt they can fix this place...
translation: 天啊！这儿是个广播站！如果我们能修好它，我就能朝废土播放音乐了，我和朗达以前也听过。啊，朗达，我多希望你没走。我求助过这里的所有变种人，可没人救得了你。我都怀疑他们是否能修好这个地方了……

original: The radio station is fixed, and we've begun sending our message out into the desert. Marcus thinks I spend too much time in here, but what does a first gen know? Rhonda says they're just one step up from dumb dumbs, and I agree.
translation: 电台修好了，我们开始向沙漠中发送信息。马可世觉得我在电台前待得太久了，可他们第一代变种人又知道什么？朗达说他们和蠢蛋差不多，我也这么觉得。

original: There was a fight in the yard today between some of us and the first gens. Marcus made a speech about how we need to work together, but why should we? We were the master's favorites! We don't need their help. Rhonda says we'd be better off without them.
translation: 今天在院子里，我们和第一代变种人起了冲突。马可世做了一番讲话，希望大家团结，但我们干嘛要团结？我们以前可是主教手下的精英！我们不需要他们的帮助。朗达说我们出发的时候最好不要带上他们。

original:
Marcus and the others left today. Finally, we have the whole place to ourselves! No more listening to lectures about what we can and can't say on the air. The airwaves will be free! 

Now Rhonda and I can host our own radio show like we've been planning. I don't know why Marcus always refused to let us do it before. He always started getting real nervous when I told him what Rhonda thought about things. Rhonda says he was afraid she was too smart to control.

Anyway, this is the start of a new era! The only downside is most of the dumb dumbs chose to stay.
translation:
今天马可世和其他人都走了。这地方终于属于我们了！再也不用听人在广播里说教，说什么该做不该做了。整个电台频段都空着了！

现在朗达和我可以按照计划主持自己的电台节目了。我不知道为什么马可世之前总是不允许我们这么做。当我告诉他朗达对事物的看法时，他总是变得十分紧张。朗达说马可世一定担心她太聪明，以至于难以控制。

不管怎样，这是一个新时代的开始！唯一不好的是还有很多蠢蛋选择留了下来。

original: Safe!
translation: 安全！

original: I finally got Raul to finish installing the security measures on my door. Now I can have all the privacy I want.\n\nJust in case I have a dumb dumb moment, I've placed the spare key under the stairs behind my building. No one ever goes back there, so it should be safe from discovery.
translation: 终于让劳尔给我的大门装好了门禁。现在我可以尽情享受个人空间了。\n\n为了防止我不小心被锁在门外，我把备用钥匙放在这幢建筑后面的楼梯下。没人会到那里去，所以它应该不会被人发现。

original: System Recording: Vault 11 Front Entrance
translation: 系统记录：11号避难所入口

original: Vault 11
translation: 11号避难所

original: Four corpses at the front entrance of Vault 11 and a strange recording point to sinister events. Determine what happened to the citizens of Vault 11.
translation: 11号避难所门口倒卧着四具尸骸，还有一卷奇怪的录音带，暗示这里曾经发生过罪恶的事件。搞清楚11号避难所的居民究竟出了什么事。

original: Black Mountain Investigation Note
translation: 黑山调查报告

original: It was a fool's errand to send us into these mountains. The road seemed deserted at night, just like our scout said, but halfway up we found ourselves attacked from random directions by enemies we couldn't see. In the chaos that followed, the squad got split up, and now I don't know where my men are. Hopefully, some of them made it.
translation: 派我们进山实在是个蠢主意。虽然侦察兵告诉我们这条路到了晚上就没人走了，可在半山腰上，我们却遭遇了看不见的敌人的伏击。随之而来的混乱冲散了我们的队伍，我不知道我的战友都去哪儿了，但愿他们能活下来。

original: Roy Gottlieb's Terminal Password
translation: 罗伊·戈特利布的终端密码

original: This password was found shamefully close to its creator's computer terminal.
translation: 真丢脸，密码刚好就掉在其主人所使用的电脑旁边。

original: Inter-office Correspondence #3458503
translation: 办公室内部通信3458503

original:
REPCONN Inter-office Correspondence #3458503

To: Xuan Duong, Senior Staff Engineer
From: Carl Rook, Vice President

Xuan,

One of my contacts at Poseidon energy found the specs for the canceled SEMELE plasma rifle. I'm sending them over to your team. From what I can tell they've managed to resolve the matter conversion issue you've been having with the Heisenberg Compensation field. Combined with the data from the sabotaged launch, I think you should have everything you need to complete the Q-35. Colonel Moretti is expecting results with this project, I don't need to tell you what a favorable evaluation from his desk will do for all of our stock portfolios.

Carl
translation:
瑞普康公司内部通信 #3458503

收件人：董轩，高级工程师
发件人：卡尔·鲁克，副总裁

轩，

我在海神能源公司的线人已经找到了被取消的塞默勒等离子步枪的技术参数。稍后我会把详细资料发给你们小组。据我分析，他们已经解决了你在海森堡补偿力场上遭遇的物质转化问题，再结合那次发射事故中得到的数据，我想制造出Q-35已经万事俱备。莫雷蒂上校正期待着项目的结果，毋庸讳言，如果他最终能在评估报告里对我们给予肯定，那必将对我们的股价大有好处。

卡尔

original: Milling Specifications
translation: 铣削加工参数

original: This holotape contains milling and grinding specifications used in the creation of the Gun Runners' weapons.
translation: 这盘全息磁带包含着制造“军火走私者”武器的铣削和磨削工艺规范。

original: Retrieve the Corpse of Ranger Morales
translation: 回收游骑兵莫莱拉斯的尸体

original: Private Morales has asked me to find and retrieve the corpse of her dead husband.  His body is apparently being used as a lure to draw in NCR troops and slaughter them.  Better keep a look out for traps and snipers...\n\nThe body is just east of Repconn HQ and I should carry it to the troopers camped out on the north side of the railroad tracks.
translation: 列兵莫拉莱斯让我去找回她死去丈夫的尸体。他的尸体显然被做成了诱饵，恶魔帮用它来吸引NCR士兵，好对他们实施埋伏。必须对尸体附近的陷阱和狙击手保持警惕。\n\n这具尸体就躺在瑞普康总部的东边，我要把它带到位于铁轨南部的NCR哨站。

original: Silent Treatment
translation: 一言不发

original: The NCR has captured a centurion of Caesar's Legion alive and they have him in custody at Camp McCarran, but he's not talking. Talk to Lieutenant Boyd about getting access to the prisoner.
translation: NCR活捉了一个凯撒军团的百夫长，把他关在了麦卡伦营地的牢房里，但他不肯开口。去找博伊德中尉，并见见那个囚犯。

original: McCarran Arms Request
translation: 麦卡伦军火需求单

original:
Isaac,

I need to increase the number of weapons and crates of ammunition from our previous arrangement.  Things might heat up with Caesar's Legion again and we'd like to be prepared.  We need to increase the number of weapons by 25% and ammunition by 50%.

-Contreras
translation:
艾萨克，

之前议定的武器和弹药数量，我还需要再增加一些。凯撒军团的活动日益猖狂，局势可能会进一步升级，我们得提前做好准备。再给我多进25%的武器和50%的弹药来。

——孔特雷拉斯

original: East Terminal Warning
translation: 东侧终端警告

original: Warning: Radiation has been detected by the filtration system. No leaks are detected within this facility please investigate external causes to correct this issue.
translation: 警告：过滤系统已检测到辐射。设施内未检测到泄漏，请进行户外检查以修复此问题。

original: Motor-Runner Bounty
translation: 轰鸣恶煞悬赏令

original: Hsu told me that he'd pay me for taking out Motor-Runner. I can find him at Vault 3, and the NCR will pay well if I'm able to take him out. Hsu also mentioned the last soldier he sent to take care of Motor-Runner has missed his scheduled radio contact.
translation: 许上校说如果我能干掉轰鸣恶煞，就能得到奖赏。我可以在3号避难所找到他，只要我能取他的性命，NCR就会付给我一笔不菲的赏金。许上校还提到他曾派了另一名士兵前去消灭轰鸣恶煞，但直至现在都还未收到他的报告。

original: Medical Supplies
translation: 医疗补给

original:
Blake,

I need the usual package of medical supplies.  You can trust the person with this note to get it to me in one piece.  I know.  I know.  You'll need a payment for the next order.  I'll take care of that in a few days.

-Contreras
translation:
布莱克，

像之前一样，我需要医疗物资。你可以放心地把货物交给持有这张纸条的人，让他回来向我复命。我知道，我知道，你想要钱款，我几天后就会安排好的。

——孔特雷拉斯

original: Crimson Caravan Invoice
translation: 深红商队的货单

original: This holotape contains an invoice for various bits of scientific equipment shipped from Shady Sands, California. The intended recipient for the holotape is Doctor Thomas Hildern.
translation: 这盘全息磁带里装的是从加州绿洲运来的各种科学仪器的发票。它的收件人是托马斯·希尔丹博士。

original: Crimson Caravan Payment
translation: 深红商队的报酬

original: Alice McLafferty at the Crimson Caravan Company in New Vegas has told you to return in a few days for payment as a result of your undetected theft of the Gun Runner's manufacturing secrets.
translation: 新维加斯深红商队公司的爱丽丝·麦克拉弗让你几天后再来找她，鉴于你成功盗取了军火贩子的机密，她会支付你一笔赏金。

original: Food Processor Parts List
translation: 食物处理机配件列表

original:
You need these parts to fix the food processor

-2 pilot lights
-2 pressure cookers
-2 conductors
-2 firehose nozzles
-4 fission batteries
-2 steam gauge assemblies
-2 sensor modules
-5 scrap metal
-1 pot
translation:
要修理食品加工机，你需要以下这些东西
-2个点火器
-2个压力锅
-2个导体
-2个消防带喷嘴
-4个裂变电池
-2个气压计
-2个传感器模块
-5块废金属
-1个锅

original: Activation Code
translation: 激活密码

original: This appears to be the activation/deactivation code for some sort of explosive.
translation: 这似乎是某种炸弹的激活/取消密码。

original: Ammunition for the Scorpions
translation: 给毒蝎帮的弹药

original: Yvette, the leader of the Scorpions on the Westside of New Vegas, wants you to set up a steady supply of ammunition from the NCR quartermaster at Camp McCarran. Her gang recently acquired new firearms but lack the ammunition to put them to use.
translation: 伊韦特，新维加斯西区毒蝎帮的首领，想让你与位于麦卡伦营地的NCR军需官建立联系，以向她稳定供应弹药。她的团伙最近得到了不少新的武器，但缺乏必须的弹药。

original: HostetlerTerminalNote2
translation: 霍斯泰特勒终端机记录2

original:
To: Don Hostetler
From: Angie Beckers
Subject: Emergency Meeting

Mr. Hostetler,

I really need to schedule an urgent meeting with you. Can you clear an hour this afternoon? I promise it will be worth your while.

-Angie
translation:
收件人：唐·霍斯泰特勒
发件人：安吉·贝克斯
主题：紧急会议

霍斯泰特勒先生，

我真的需要和你安排一次紧急会议。你可以在今天下午腾出一个小时吗？我保证会让您不虚此行的。

—安吉

original: HostetlerTerminalNote3
translation: 霍斯泰特勒终端机记录3

original:
To: Don Hostetler
From: Angie Beckers
Subject: Re: You're so sexy

I had an amazing time last night, Don. Aren't you glad you decided to stay late? :-) Can't wait to do it again.

xoxo

-Angie

PS I found some pre-War lingerie at the market today. I think you'll like it.
translation:
收件人：唐·霍斯泰特勒
发件人：安吉·贝克斯
主题：回复：你超性感

唐，昨晚真是妙不可言。相信你也对晚点走的决定感到很开心吧？:-)我真忍不住想再做一次。

吻你，抱你

——安吉

附：我今天在市场上发现了一些战前女性内衣，我想你会喜欢的。

original: HostetlerTerminalNote1
translation: 霍斯泰特勒终端机记录1

original:
To: Don Hostetler
From: Angie Beckers
Subject: Tuesday meeting with Accounts Receivable

Mr. Hostetler,

Just a reminder your meeting with Accounts Receivable was moved to Tuesday. I've cleared your schedule and moved your lunch plans ahead to 1:45.

-Angie
translation:
收件人：唐·霍斯泰特勒
发件人：安吉·贝克斯
主题：周二关于应收账款的会议

霍斯泰特勒先生，

提醒你一下，关于应收账款的会议调整到了周二。我已经帮你腾出了日程表，并且把午餐时间提前到了1:45。

—安吉

original: Vault 22 Additive Note 3
translation: 22号避难所添加剂记录3

original: Not much to report today. The mood is unusually somber in the wake of Dr. Peter's passing. There's a strange rumor going around that the commotion downstairs was caused by, of all things, Dr. Peter's corpse suddenly animating and attacking people. I don't know who would start such a vicious rumor, but it's in exceptionally bad taste.
translation: 今天没什么可汇报的，彼得博士的死讯令我感到无比震惊与难过。有一则奇怪的流言，说楼下的骚乱是由于彼得斯博士的尸体突然起身攻击他人而引起的。我不知道是谁在散布这个恶毒的谣言，实在是太下流了。

original: Vault 22 Oxygen Note
translation: 22号避难所氧气记录

original: Could maintenance look into the duct work here on level 2 again? I know you guys took a look at this last week, but I swear the noise is back. I even have other people that can back me up on it this time, too.
translation: 可以让维修人员看一下第二层的管道吗？我知道你们上星期检查过了，但我发誓又听到噪音了。这次甚至有其他人可以为我作证。

original: Vault 22 Cave Door Terminal Note 1
translation: 22号避难所洞穴大门终端记录1

original: Assistant Mathers went into the caves at 18:46 today and still hasn't returned. Requesting security escort for science personnel to conduct a search.
translation: 助理玛瑟斯在今天18:46进入了洞穴，到现在还没回来。请求增派科研安保人员进行搜索。

original: Keely note 6
translation: 基利的记录 6

original: I've finally found some of the bodies of the scientists that lived here. They appear to be overgrown with some form of lichen. They blend in so well with the other growth that I walked right by several of them without even noticing them. I've taken the proper precautions, but the lichen doesn't seem to be contagious, at least to ghouls.
translation: 我终于找到了一些曾经住在这里的科学家们的尸体。他们身上似乎长满了某种苔藓。尸体和其他植物完全融为一体，我经过的时候几乎都没注意到。我已经采取了适当的防护措施，但苔藓看起来不具备传染性，至少对尸鬼来说是这样。

original: Keely note 7
translation: 基利的记录 7

original: This level appears to be where they performed most of the research NCR is interested in. I've been able to collect a little, but the vast majority of the data from the research done here is inaccessible. I'll have to find the main backup and download from there.
translation: 这一层似乎就是他们过去做实验的地方，NCR真正感兴趣的应该就是这里了。我已经收集到了一些数据，但大部分研究治疗都无法访问。我必须找到备份资料库，然后从那里下载数据。

original: Vault 22 Cave Door Terminal Note 2
translation: 22号避难所洞穴大门终端记录2

original:
We need a medical team up here now!

Dr. Peters just returned with one of the security escorts, who is horribly wounded. When I asked them where the other security officer was, he just paled and shook his head.

In the meantime, Dr. Bailey has ordered that the door to the caves be sealed until a further investigation can take place.
translation:
我们需要一个医疗队！

彼得斯博士刚刚在一名安保人员的陪同下回来了，那个人受了重伤。我问他其他安保人员在哪里，他脸色苍白，只是摇头。

与此同时，贝利博士已经下令封锁通向洞穴的大门，直到进一步调查结束。

original: Vault 22 Cave Door Terminal Note 3
translation: 22号避难所洞穴大门终端记录3

original: Is anyone down there?? Security is trying to hold off, well, I don't know what they're trying to hold off. Please, send security up at once!\n\nWith Dr. Bailey watching over his sick wife and daughter in their quarters down in the Common Area, I'm officially in charge of the level, and I am requesting security at once!
translation: 有人吗？？安保人员正在进行戒备，我不知道他们在戒备什么。请立刻派安保人员过来！\n\n贝利博士正在公共区的房间内照看他生病的妻子和女儿，因此现在由我正式接管这一楼层，我要求立刻派安保人员过来！

original: Vault 22 Additive Note 1
translation: 22号避难所添加剂记录1

original: Yields continue to improve. Splicing together cultivar GN188 with the existing corn samples has produced a hybrid that responds better to the artificial lights we have.\n\nOn a side note, Dr. Peters has missed his third straight day due to illness. His work ethic hasn't exactly been stellar to this point, so I'm requesting confirmation from the clinic that he is in fact sick.
translation: 产量继续提高。通过将栽培品种GN188和现存的玉米样本进行杂交，我们培育出了一个能适应人造光线的品种。\n\n另外，彼得斯博士由于生病已经缺席三天了，到目前为止，他的职业操守都不太合格，我已经要求诊所确认他的病情。

original: Keely note 1
translation: 基利的记录 1

original: I've established a temporary camp inside the entrance of the vault. Power inside is minimal, but still running, and I've managed to hack into one of their security terminals. The logs show that several people have entered the vault over the past few months, but none have left. It's getting late, so I'll resume the expedition in the morning.  Keely out.
translation: 我在避难所入口搭了一个临时营地。里面虽然没什么电，但仍在运转，我试着入侵了他们的安保终端。记录显示过去几个月有几个人闯进过避难所，但没有人离开。天色越来越晚了，我打算明天一早再进行考察。基利报告完毕。

original: Keely note 2
translation: 基利的记录 2

original: The growth in the interior matches the exterior to a tee. It's a little surprising given the scarcity of sunlight in the entrance room, but even more surprising is that they seem to originate from further below. Maybe that fool Hildern was onto something after all.\n\nSince my Pipboy is on the fritz, I'll try to keep a running log of my discoveries in whatever computers I can find and collate the data before leaving.
translation: 室内与室外的植物增长情况完全一致。这一点令人惊讶，因为入口处几乎没有阳光照射，更奇怪的是，这些植物仿佛是从地底深处长出来的。看来那个白痴希尔丹确实是发现了什么名堂。\n\n由于我的哔哔小子坏了，我会尝试在能找到的电脑上把我的发现记录下来，并在离开前整理好数据。

original: Vault 22 Additive Note 2
translation: 22号避难所添加剂记录2

original: On a lark, the guys down in pest control sent up a sample of a substance one of their specimens secretes to attract insects. Tests show that the substance has a mood-altering effect on smaller mammals. If anyone volunteers, we can begin human testing soon.\n\nQuite a number of the staff have begun to show symptoms of some sort of viral infection. I've begun to order them to stay in bed and recover, but at this rate there won't be anyone left to do research!
translation: 虫害防治区的那帮家伙开玩笑似的送来了一个样本，这是他们培育的植物所分泌出的一种可以吸引昆虫的物质。测试表明该物质对小型哺乳动物具有改变情绪的功效。如果有志愿者，我们可以立刻开始人体测试。\n\n相当多的工作人员开始显示出病毒感染症状。我命令他们上床休息，但就这个传染速度，很快就不会有多余的人手去做研究了！

original: Vault 22 Maintenance Note 1
translation: 22号避难所维修记录1

original:
Problem: Noises in vents

Action: Sent a team to inspect

Result: Source of problem not detected.
translation:
问题：通气口出现噪音

解决方法：派一个小组去检查

结果：未检测到问题来源

original: Vault 22 Maintenance Note 2
translation: 22号避难所维修记录2

original:
Problem: Reports of possible gas leak - several people have complained of coughing fits and other respiratory symptoms

Action: Complete diagnostic of air circulation system

Result: Discovered minor discrepancies in the mass of the air being pumped through the vault, but no harmful gasses were detected. Also, a strange residue was detected on the air filters, which has been forwarded for identification. Swapped out the filters, just in case.
translation:
问题：可能发生了瓦斯泄漏，有几个人抱怨说出现了咳嗽及其他呼吸系统疾病症状

解决方法：对空气循环系统进行全面诊断

结果：发现输送进避难所的空气在重量上存在细微差异，但未检测到有害气体。另外在空气过滤器上检测到一个奇怪的残渣，已被送去进行鉴定。为了以防万一已更换过滤器。

original: Keely note 3
translation: 基利的记录 3

original: This level seems to have been devoted to the study of atmospheric effects on plants, with a concentration on producing plants with a high oxygen yield. Given the "problems" these vaults were known to have, it sounds like a reasonable avenue of research.
translation: 这一层似乎用于研究大气对植物的影响，重点是如何在高氧浓度下培育植物。鉴于避难所确实存在一些人所共知的客观“问题”，这种研究手段也是合理的。

original: Vault 22 Clinic Note 1
translation: 22号避难所诊所记录1

original: Patient: Peters, Harrison T.\n\nCondition: Dr. Peters is suffering from a severe case of pneumonia, the result of the spread of some sort of microorganism in his lungs. I've applied the usual treatment and requested that he refrain from working and stop by twice a day for observation.
translation: 病人：哈里森·T·彼得斯\n\n症状：彼得斯博士患上了严重的肺炎，这是肺部的某种微生物扩散的结果。我已经采用了通常的治疗方法，并要求他减少工作量，每天定期检查两次。

original: Vault 22 Clinic Note 2
translation: 22号避难所诊所记录2

original: Patient: Peters, Harrison T.\n\nUpdate: Dr. Peters isn't responding to the treatment, or, more accurately, his body is actively rejecting the treatment. His condition has worsened and I'm on the cusp of ordering exploratory surgery.
translation: 病人：哈里森·T·彼得斯\n\n更新：彼得斯博士的治疗没有任何效果，更准确地说，他的身体正在抗拒治疗。他的症状更严重了，预计要进行外科探查手术。

original: Vault 22 Clinic Note 3
translation: 22号避难所诊所记录3

original: Patient: Peters, Harrison T.\n\nUpdate: Dr. Peters is dead. His vitals flatlined ten minutes before he entered surgery. I decided to perform an autopsy immediately, and discovered his lungs were filled with some sort of fungal infection. Strangely, the fungus still shows evidence of growth despite the death of its host. I'll consult with one of the mycologists on the fifth level and see if they can identify it.
translation: 病人：哈里森·T·彼得斯\n\n更新：彼得斯博士死了。他在动手术前十分钟失去了生命体征。我决定立即进行尸检，结果发现他的肺部完全被某种真菌感染了。奇怪的是，尽管真菌的宿主已经死亡，可它们仍然显示出增长的迹象。我会向第五层的一位真菌学家咨询，看看他们是否能进行鉴别。

original: Vault 22 Clinic Note 4
translation: 22号避难所诊所记录4

original: Patient: Peters, Harrison T.\n\nUpdate: I don't really know how to describe what just happened. One minute I was closing up for the day and the next Dr. Peters' corpse sat up and attacked me. I was able to flee the office and seal him (it?) inside until security arrived, but what the hell is going on? If all the recent illnesses are the same thing...
translation: 病人：哈里森·T·彼得斯\n\n更新：我真的不知道该如何形容刚刚发生的事。我刚结束一天的工作，彼得斯博士的尸体突然站起身来袭击了我。我逃离了办公室并把他（它？）关在了里面，等待安保人员抵达，可这到底是怎么回事？如果最近出现的几起病例都是同样的诱因……

original: Vault 22 Clinic Note 5
translation: 22号避难所诊所记录5

original: Patients: Mitchell, Pam; Cordella, Michael; Horton, Samwise; Fujimoto, Naoki; Derrida, Kenneth\n\nUpdate: This entire group showed up throughout the course of the day displaying the same symptoms. They're remarkably similar to Dr. Peters' condition when he first came in a week ago. I hope we don't have a contagion on our hands.
translation: 患者：潘姆·米歇尔；迈克尔·考德拉；山姆怀斯·霍尔顿；藤原直树；肯尼斯·德里达\n\n更新：今天来的这批患者全部出现了相同的症状。他们的情况和一周前彼得斯博士刚来时非常相似。希望我们没有爆发传染病。

original: Vault 22 Clinic Note 6
translation: 22号避难所诊所记录6

original: Patients: Bailey, Elizabeth; Bailey, Marsha; Garfield, Hayes, Amy; Herman; Jenkins, Veronica; Keyes, James;  Kirkpatrick, Robert; Lowry, Amanda; Orlando, Donald;  Pamino, Iris; Rado, Steven; Reyes, Yolanda; Sarkin, Kelly; Valdez, Nicholas; \n\nUpdate: Another group with chills, a fever, and a terrible racking cough. I'm recommending that they be separated from the general populace.
translation: 患者：伊丽莎白·贝利；玛莎·贝利；海耶斯·加菲尔德；赫尔曼·艾米；维罗妮卡·詹金斯；詹姆斯·凯耶斯；罗伯特·基里克帕特里克；阿曼达·洛瑞；唐纳德·奥兰多；伊里斯·帕米诺；斯蒂文·拉多；约兰达·雷耶斯；凯里·莎金；尼古拉斯·瓦尔德斯；\n\n更新：又一组人出现了发热、畏寒和严重咳嗽的症状。我建议对他们采取隔离措施。

original: Keely note 4
translation: 基利的记录 4

original: It's strange, but some sections of the machinery down here appear to have been modified for some unknown purpose. The restraints regarding oxygen content and systemic pressure have been bypassed.
translation: 奇怪，这里的机械装置有一部分似乎出于不明原因而进行过改装。含氧量和系统压力的限制被解除了。

original: Keely note 8
translation: 基利的记录 8

original: I guess no one will miss this ridiculous trivia game. The questions weren't even that hard.\n\nIt looks like this is where most of the people were when they died. The medical reports I found suggested that most of them succumbed to some kind of airborne infection. I'm going to see if I can convert some of the growlamps into UV spectrometers to test the air for contaminants.
translation: 我想没人会输掉这个可笑的小游戏。这些问题一点也不难。\n\n这里似乎就是多数避难所居民最后死去的地方。我搜到的医疗报告显示大多数人死于某种通过空气传播的疾病。我要试试看能不能把手里的荧光灯改造成紫外线光谱仪，然后用它来测试空气中的污染物。

original: Keely note 9
translation: 基利的记录 9

original: After numerous attempts, I've found a range that highlights the particles in the air that I believe killed everyone in this vault. Preliminary tests show them to be spores of some kind. I've set up spectrometers on several of the levels now and the concentration appears to increase in the lower levels. At this point, I'm concerned that the plants here may constitute a danger to the people of the NCR.
translation: 经过无数次尝试之后，我发现了一个光谱范围，可以照射出空气中的某种颗粒物，我相信正是它杀死了避难所里的所有人。初步测试表明它们是某种类型的孢子。我已经在不同的楼层设置了光谱仪，随后我发现下面几层的颗粒浓度似乎有所增加。我担心这种植物可能会对NCR的老百姓造成危害。

original: Vault 22 Pest Control Note 1
translation: 22号避难所害虫控制记录1

original: Species: BE908\n\nA distant relative of the more commonly known venus fly trap, species BE908 seems to be performing well. The plants are a threat to creatures up to five times their size due to the violent nature of their closing maws. Those that aren't swallowed whole are often incapacitated by their initial "bite". The plants' lack of mobility is offset by their ability to lure prey into reach by means of a nectar they secrete from their bodies.
translation: 品种：BE908\n\n作为广为人知的捕蝇草的远亲，BE908的灭杀效果相当不错。即便是那些体型比它们大上五倍的生物，它们都能对其构成威胁，这一切都要归功于它们那凶残的捕虫夹。即便无法完整吞噬猎物，它们也会通过第一下“撕咬”使其动弹不得。虽然该植物缺乏移动能力，但它们会利用自身分泌出的花蜜吸引猎物进入攻击范围，以此弥补这一不足。

original: Vault 22 Pest Control Note 2
translation: 22号避难所害虫控制记录2

original: Species: Mantis Religiosa\n\nOf all the species we brought with us, the common mantis exceeds the rest in terms of predation. The insects are voracious, and their camouflage allows them to attack prey by surprise. Also, they complement our botanical specimens by hunting down those pests that avoid or escape our other measures. Lastly, mantises will begin to cannibalize one another when other food is scarce, making their numbers self-regulating when prey is scarce.
translation: 品种：薄翅螳螂\n\n在我们研究的所有品种中，螳螂的捕食欲望要远超其他生物。这种昆虫极度贪婪，它们通体的迷彩伪装可以使其发动突然袭击。它还会捕杀那些对灭杀措施免疫的害虫，从而与我们的植物种群形成互补关系。此外，当食物短缺时，螳螂会吃掉自己的同类，这样即便在猎物缺乏时，其群体数量也能控制在合适的范围内。

original: Vault 22 Pest Control Note 3
translation: 22号避难所害虫控制记录3

original: Species: Beauveria Mordicana\n\nAn entomopathogenic fungus, B. Mordicana has been developed to colonize the bodies of most common pests. Once it has fully colonized a host body, the host technically dies, but the body continues to move by means of the fungal colony within it. In this manner the fungus moves amongst more of its prey, occasionally spraying spores in a radius around the host body, infecting all who come near it. Its drawbacks include the time it takes to kill prey (10-20 days) and its limited effectiveness when dealing with unsocial pests.
translation: 品种：白僵菌\n\n白僵菌一种昆虫病原真菌，已经进化到可以寄宿在大多数常见害虫的身上。一旦完全侵占宿主的身体，宿主从通常意义上说已经死亡，但其躯体会在体内繁殖的真菌作用下继续活动。如此一来，真菌就可以通过控制宿主行动来寻找更多的猎物，并时不时地向宿主四周喷洒孢子，感染附近的任何生物。其缺点在于需要杀死猎物的时间较长（大约10到20天），并且对非群居性害虫效果有限。

original: Keely note 5
translation: 基利的记录 5

original: I've been hearing a strange chittering sound for some time now, and finally discovered its source. There's some kind of giant mantises that've taken up residence in the vault. I almost ran smack into one the other day, but the creatures don't appear to react to my presence at all. Perhaps the others sent here ran afoul of the creatures, but I can't see how a few scattered insects could pose much of a problem to experienced mercs.
translation: 之前偶尔会听到奇怪的碎裂声，现在我终于发现它的源头了。有一种巨大的螳螂占据了避难所。我前几天差点撞上一只。但这些生物似乎对我的出现毫无反应。也许被派到这里来的其他人和这些生物发生过冲突，可我不明白为什么这些到处乱爬的虫子会对经验老道的雇佣兵造成那么多麻烦。

original: Dermot's Ledger
translation: 德莫特的账目

original:
DERMOT'S NEW LEGER

Going to be a little different than the one I kept for hauling scrap ha ha. But Ive always been a strong believer in keeping straight books. 

TO MOTOR RUNNER:
Teen girl - 500 caps
Adult man, 38 - 0 caps

True to his word paid top money for the girl. Plus bonus for first delivery. But paid nothing for girls father who took a swing at him when untide. Got to keep em more secured. Also keep SJ off the girls as even fiends dont want used goods.

TO MOTOR RUNNER:
Adult woman (28) - 250 caps
Old woman - 25 caps
Old man - 25 caps
Baby (boy?) - 0 caps

Got to be more careful selecting what we deliver. Runner liked the woman of course but the babys worthless except to make sure the woman does as shes told. Her parents next to worthless. Shouldve killed and left them. On the bright side Runner says we can start dealing with fiends closer by so no more dragging folks all the way to vault three.

TO NEPHI:
Teen girl - 400 caps
Teen boy - 150 caps
Child girl (7?) - 50 caps

More like it. Learned from past and got rid of mom and dad along the way. Tried to get more for the young one I said hey give her time to sprout. But Nephi wouldn't have it. Kept SJ off the girls so long as he got his damn teddy. Hes a sick one but I guess the work calls for it.

TO COOK COOK:
Adult woman - 200 caps
Teen girl - 400 caps
Teen girl - 400 caps
Teen boy - 100 caps

Did not like dealing with this cook cook. Didn't know if hed pay us or burn us. I guess what they do with them once they got them is up to them isnt my business but he didn't even wait for us to turn the corner before he was torching the boy and making the womenfolk watch. Lets hope to deal with Nephi next time.
translation:
德莫特的新帐单

估计和我平常收废品时记的帐不太一样，哈哈。但我一直坚信凡事都需要根烂笔头。

给轰鸣恶煞:
年轻女孩 - 500 枚瓶盖
成年男性，38岁 - 0 枚瓶盖

确实如他所说，年轻姑娘价钱最高。因为是第一次，还加了奖金。但这女孩的父亲却分文不值，因为我为他松绑的时候，他直接就扑了上来。得把他们看得更紧点。一定要让SJ和女孩保持距离，恶魔帮不要二手货。

给轰鸣恶煞:
成年女人(28岁) - 250 枚瓶盖
老年妇女 - 25 枚瓶盖

Thank you all for your patience with our little reorganization. Now, get out there and make the best gosh-darn tools in the West!

Cindy-Lou Kreb
H&H Tools Human Resources Department

收件人：*全体居民*

大家好，
很抱歉通知大家，我们几个星期前检测到的漏水情况似乎比原先想象的更加严重。我们只能先排空那片区域的水管，来阻止水压对系统的其他部分造成损伤。
糟糕的是，这也意味着我们不得不开始对水实施定量配给。我向每一位居住在受影响区域的人道歉。我们会尽快解决这个问题。

谢谢，
文森特

original:
From: Vincent Vanmiller
To: Jennifer Lawson

Hi Jenny! It was great getting a chance to talk to you. I am glad to hear that things are going well for you. I'm curious if you'd like to meet me for dinner one day next week. I know we don't talk that often, but I feel like we really clicked last night. I hope you feel the same way.

Looking forward to hearing from you soon,
Vin
translation:
发件人：文森特·范米勒
收件人：珍妮弗·罗森

嘿！珍妮！能有机会和你说话真棒。很高兴你一切安好。不知下周你是否有空，我想约你一起吃个晚饭。我知道我们很少说话，但我觉得昨晚我们真的挺聊得来。我希望你也有同样的感觉。

期待尽快收到你的来信，
文森特

original: HouseToolsJournalFail
translation: 豪斯工具厂日志失败

original: [FAILED] There appears to be a hidden file buried in the network, but you aren't skilled enough to crack it.
translation: [失败] 在网络中似乎有一个隐藏的文件，但是你没有足够的技术去破解它。

original: HouseToolsJournalSucceed
translation: 豪斯工具厂日志成功

original: [SUCCEEDED] You've accessed a hidden, distributed file network buried in the net code for this terminal. It appears to be part of a journal.
translation: [成功] 您打开了该终端网络代码中一个隐藏的分布式文件网络。它似乎是一段日志。

original: Camp McCarran Order #172
translation: 麦卡伦营地命令#172

original:
Missile Launchers: 7
Missiles: 200

We'd like this order expedited, if possible. The situation at the Dam requires it.
translation:
导弹发射器：7
导弹：200

如果可能的话，我们希望这个订单能加速生产。大坝那儿需要。

original: Crimson Caravan Reparations
translation: 深红商队的赔款

original: One of the Crimson Caravan guards, identified as Robert Wilson, decided it would be funny to take a shot at our Vendortron. He's lucky he didn't get a .308 through his idiot skull.\n\nWe're currently negotiating with McLafferty for reparations, but in the mean time we need to update the Vendortron's recognition software to filter out all Crimson Caravan employees. We'll also need to pull some strings over at McCarran and get them temporarily barred from purchasing ammo there, as well.
translation: 深红商队有一个叫罗伯特·威尔逊的守卫，似乎很喜欢朝我们的贩卖机器人开枪。他居然没有被一颗.308子弹爆掉他那愚蠢的脑袋，也算他福大命大。\n\n我们正在和麦克拉弗蒂商量赔偿事宜，但与此同时，我们需要升级贩卖机器人的身份识别软件，将所有深红商队的员工全都拉入黑名单。另外，我们也要和麦卡伦营地通通气，暂时禁止他们在此地购买弹药。

original: New Name for the Vendortron
translation: 为售卖机器人起的新名字

original: Seriously, can we stop calling the Vendortron a "Vendortron?" Let's give the thing a proper name, like Bob (we're not calling it Bob). We'll vote on it at the end of the week. Please, please, please come  up with something decent.
translation: 说真的，我们能不能别再叫它“贩卖机器人”了？给这东西起一个合适的名字吧，比如说鲍勃（但千万别叫它鲍勃）。我们计划在周末就这事搞一个投票。请诸位务必、务必、务必多出些点子。

original: Redhead
translation: 红发姑娘

original: Jones -\n\nI transferred that redhead you liked over to Admin. You'll be sitting next to her all day, so don't come crying to me if you can't get her in your bunk. Oh, and you owe me big time for this favor. I'll let you know when I think of something.
translation: 琼斯—\n\n我已经把你喜欢的那个红头发姑娘设为管理员了。你会一整天都坐在她身边，到时候你要是没本事让她坐到你床上，可别来找我哭鼻子。噢，还有你这回欠了我一个大人情。今后如果我有什么需要，你可得随叫随到。

original: Reminder
translation: 提醒

original: REMINDER:\n\nAll personnel must secure their terminals before leaving their post. We don't need another situation like the one Private Crenshaw created last week.
translation: 注意：\n\n所有人员在离开岗位前务必给电脑设置好密码。上周列兵克伦肖闹出了事端，我们不希望此类事件再次发生。

original: Hey, buddy
translation: 嘿，兄弟

original: What's up, Jones? Crenshaw here. So you've got your eye on that pretty redhead, huh. I'll be sure to fill her in on your farting probably, seeing as how we're buddies and all.\n\nP.S. You didn't secure your terminal very well. Choose a better password next time.
translation: 最近怎样啊，琼斯？我是克伦肖。看来你盯上了那个红发妞了？也许我会在她面前替你美言几句呢，毕竟咱俩是好兄弟嘛。\n\nPS：你的电脑防护措施不怎么样啊，下次选一个好点的密码吧。

original: Meat Vendor List
translation: 肉类采购清单

original: There are a few different vendors who sell snacks and meat.  You might try Fitz.  He has a small shop with a couple other merchants.  Ruby Nash in Primm has some interesting items.  Lastly, Crimson Caravan should be able to handle a good amount of supply for us.  Try and convince them to trade for some of our overstock if you can.  We need to reserve caps if possible.
translation: 有不少供应商出售零食和肉类。你可以去菲茨那里看看，他和几个商人一起开了家小店。普瑞姆的鲁比·纳什也有卖零食。最后，深红商队或许可以为我们解决大部分的补给。如果你能说服他们，我可以用多余的库存粮食和他们换取物资。我们要尽可能多地省钱。

original: Camp McCarran Weapons Manifest
translation: 麦卡伦营地武器货单

original:
Camp McCarran Weapons Manifest

50 Hunting Rifles
-28 in use
-10 in repair
-8 in storage*

50 Assault Rifles
-25 in use
-6 in repair
-12 in storage*

20 Battle Rifles
-10 in use
-2 in repair
-5 in storage*

*Increase Gun Runners weapons shipment and modify manifests to make these numbers match the earlier totals.  Boyd is getting too suspicious.
translation:
麦卡伦营地武器清单

50 把猎枪
-28 在使用
-10 在维修
-8 在库*

50 把突击步枪
-25 在使用
-6 在维修
-12 在库

20 把战斗步枪
-10 在使用
-2 在维修
-5 在仓库

*增加军火贩子的武器运货量，修改清单，确保总数与之前的相符。博伊德已经开始怀疑我了。

original:
From: Lincoln Davis
To: All Residents

Greetings Everyone,
As you all saw in the message from Vincent, we're going to have to start rationing water until we can resolve the leaking issues. Unfortunately, we don't currently have the parts required to fix the underlying cause of the leak. At this point, we have no alternative, but to seek the parts that we need from outside the Vault.
To facilitate this, I'm proud to announce that Michelle Dallian will be forming a new committee, with the goal of creating ties with whatever civilization there may be in the outside world. Michelle and I both have high hopes that we'll have no problem finding the assets we need, and hopefully forming some lasting relationships with the outside world.

Thank you,
Overseer Davis
translation:
发件人：林肯·戴维斯
收件人：全体居民

大家好，
你们应该都看到了文森特的消息，在我们解决漏水问题前，我们要开始对水进行定量分配。不幸的是，我们现在没有修理漏水部位所需的零件。我们别无选择，只能去避难所外面寻找。
为了推动这项工作，我很骄傲地宣布米歇尔·达利安将会组建一个委员会，目的是与外界可能存在的文明社会取得联系。米歇尔和我都希望我们能尽快找到所需的物品，并且与外面的世界建立长久的关系。

谢谢
监督戴维斯

original:
From: Lincoln Davis
To: Michelle Dallian

Michelle,
Thank you again for agreeing to take charge with our external relations. I am sure that you will do represent us, and our interests well. Let me know if I can be of any assistance.

-Link
translation:
发件人：林肯·戴维斯
收件人：米歇尔·达利安

米歇尔，
再次感谢你同意负责我们的外联事务。我相信你会代表我们向外界谋取利益。如果有什么需要帮忙的就告诉我。

林肯

original:
From: George Stault
To: Lincoln Davis

Dear Lincoln,
Thank you for your endorsement at the Town Hall meeting last night. You are so well respected by the residents, that I am sure it will greatly increase my chances of following you to the "Big Chair." Since Michelle started making plans and gathering people for her External Association Committee the Isolationists have been gathering followers, as you well know. I think having me follow you as Overseer will serve to slow their efforts.

Thanks Again,
George
translation:
发件人：乔治·斯图尔特
收件人：林肯·戴维斯

亲爱的林肯，
谢谢您昨晚在市政厅会议上对我的举荐。您深受居民们的爱戴，有您一席话，我接替您的位置当选避难所领导人的机会也就大大增加了。您也知道，自从米歇尔开始筹划和组建外联委员会后，支持孤立主义的势力也在抬头。如果由我来担任监督，一定程度上可以遏制他们的活动。

再次感谢，
乔治

original:
From: Laura Robinson
To: Daniel Raati

Hey Mr. Raati,
Can you look over my final paper for comp lit? I think this is so unfair! I totally completed the assignment, and she gave me a D! I worked so hard, and she can be so mean. I mean, I know it is up to her what grade she gives me, but I've never gotten anything lower than a B on anything. EVER! So can you take a look at the paper for me? I swear, if you think it is worth a D, I'll let it drop.

Thanks, Laura
translation:
发件人：劳拉·鲁滨逊
收件人：丹尼尔·拉蒂

嘿，拉蒂先生，
您可以帮我看看比较文学科目的期末论文吗？我觉得太不公平了！我绝对达到了要求，可她只给了我一个D！我学得那么用功，她实在太坏了。我当然知道学生成绩是老师说了算，但我从来没有在任何一门科目上得过B以下的分数，从来没有！所以您能帮我看一下这篇论文吗？我发誓，如果您也觉得这篇论文就是D的水平的话，我就认了。

谢谢，劳拉

original:
From: Daniel Raati
To: *ALL PARENTS*

Parents,
It is with a heavy heart that I tell you that we are not going to be able to complete this school term. I'll be running some private tutorials in the screening room, but they will be informal, and attendance will not be required.
I've asked Michelle to look in the surrounding areas, to see if there are any local schools that will be willing to take on some of our teachers and students. Between this prospect and the hopes of speedy repairs, this unexpected recess will be short.

Sincerely,
Daniel Raati
translation:
发件人：丹尼尔·拉蒂
收件人：*全体家长*

各位家长：
我怀着沉重的心情通知你们，这学期我们无法完成学校的课业了。我会在放映室里开设私人课程，但这是非正式的，不强制学生们参加。
我已经让米歇尔去附近问问，看有没有本地的学校愿意接收我们的老师和学生。如果有这种可能，或者维修能尽快完成的话，那停课的时间应该不会太长。

真诚的
丹尼尔·拉蒂

original:
From: Daniel Raati
To: *ALL STUDENTS*

Hello,
I'm sure you've heard by now that the doors of the schools will be close for an undetermined amount of time. Your individual classroom teachers will be sending all of you updated reading lists, and some workbooks to continue your studies. Please spend some of your newfound free time taking care of these assignments.

Thank you,
Daniel
translation:
发件人：丹尼尔·拉蒂
收件人：*全体学生*

你们好，
你们应该已经听说学校会关闭一段时间，关闭时长还没有确定。各班的班主任会把最新的书单和练习册发到你们手上，以便你们继续学习。请务必花些空余时间来关心一下这些作业。

谢谢，
丹尼尔

original:
From: Michelle Dallian
To: Sarah Kimper

Sarah. I'm curious if you've given any more thought to joining my task force. I'd love for the opportunity to work with you again, and I think you'd be a great fit. I really need someone with your keen interpersonal insights for dealing with the people outside.

Michelle
translation:
发件人：米歇尔·达利安
收件人：莎拉·金珀

莎拉，不知道你有没有兴趣加入我的外联团队。我很想再次和你合作，我觉得你很合适。我真的需要像你这样有着敏锐的人际关系洞察力的人来和外界的人们打交道。

米歇尔

original:
From: Michelle Dallian
To:  *ALL RESIDENTS*

Hello Everybody,
I'm looking for volunteers for the External Association Committee. We have enough core personnel, but we can always use the extra hands. All residents are welcome to apply, and we hope to be able to accommodate any of you who are willing to donate your time. Feel free to contact me and I'll send you an application for membership.

Thanks,
Michelle
translation:
发件人：米歇尔·达利安
收件人：*全体居民*

大家好，
我正在招募对外联络委员会的志愿者。委员会的核心成员已经确定，但我们也欢迎额外人手的加入。全体居民均可申请，我们乐于接纳任何有余力的人。有意向的人请联系我，我会寄给你一份成员申请表。

谢谢，
米歇尔

original:
From: Michelle Dallian
To: *ALL VEAC MEMBERS*

Hi! Thanks again for agreeing to help out with this momentous task. Sarah and I are going to be organizing you into teams. Teams will be in charge of trading, inventory, politics, and miscellaneous. Many of you have asked why we don't have team dedicated to security. Well, I've talked long about this with George, and we both agree that we don't want to appear belligerent to the outside world. We are certain that once the people out there realize that we are just like them, and won't threaten them at all, they'll be happy to form long lasting relationships with us. We'd like to present an open hand instead of a closed fist.

Thank you!
Michelle
translation:
发件人：米歇尔·达利安
收件人：*全体报名成员*

你们好！再次感谢大家愿意为外联事务出一份力。莎拉和我会把你们分配进各个小组中去。不同小组分别负责贸易，库存，政事和杂务。很多人问我为什么没有专门负责安全的小组。好吧，我和乔治就这件事商量了很久，我们一致同意不应该对外界表现出敌意。我们觉得，如果外面的人意识到我们和他们是同胞，并且不会对他们产生威胁，那他们一定会乐意与我们建立长久的联系。与其握紧拳头，我们倒不如伸开手臂。

谢谢大家，
米歇尔

original:
From: Michael Robinson
To: Michelle Dallian

I can't believe you are going forward with this na?ve idea that the world is going to be peaceful and welcoming to us. We have no idea what we are going to see out there, or how the world has changed. I strongly suggest that we, at least at first, just open the doors long enough to get what we need. Allowing people to come in and out of the Vault unscheduled, can only lead to trouble.

- Mike
translation:
发件人：迈克尔·鲁滨逊
收件人：米歇尔·达利安

我不敢相信你居然抱着那么幼稚的想法，相信外部世界一片和平，会张开双臂欢迎我们。我们根本不知道外面的情况，也不知道这个世界发生了怎样的变化。我强烈建议我们——至少在刚开始的时候——只将大门短暂开放，能做贸易就够了。允许人们自由进出避难所只会给我们带来麻烦。

迈克

original:
From: Michael Robinson
To: Michelle Dallian

Michelle, please reconsider. Take some weapons with you. Arm yourselves. I just know that you are going to bring trouble back onto all of us.

- Mike
translation:
发件人：迈克尔·鲁滨逊
收件人·米歇尔·达利安

米歇尔，请你再考虑考虑吧。带一些武器。至少用来防身。你这样会给我们所有人都惹来麻烦的。

迈克尔

original:
From: Michael Robinson
To: Undisclosed-Recipients

I'm sorry to hear that all of you have abandoned the cause. Am I the only one left who sees the folly of this plan? I'm sure the outside hasn't recovered. Nevada was a desert before the bombs fell. I can hardly think to imagine what it must be like out there now. You are all cowards, and your fear is going to lead to our deaths.

- Mike
translation:
发件人：迈克尔·鲁滨逊
收件人：未公开的收件人

听说你们都放弃了自己的立场，我很遗憾。难道只有我一个人看出这个计划有多么愚蠢吗？外面的世界肯定还没有复原。内华达在炸弹落下之前就是一片沙漠，我很难想象现在会是什么样子。你们都是懦夫，你们的恐惧会给我们带来灭顶之灾。

迈克尔

original:
From: Michael Robinson
To: Michelle Dallian

Ok Michelle. I was wrong. The wasteland isn't as dangerous as I thought it was. AS DANGEROUS. That doesn't mean it is safe. We've had some luck trading, and it looks like we are going to be operating at full capacity soon. Let's lock the doors for a little while, set up some guards. Let's be smart. We've all seen those freaks with the strange hats lurking around outside. Every day they get a little closer, let's show them that we aren't going to be easy targets. Let's be safe and smart.

Kindly,
Michael
translation:
发件人：迈克尔·鲁滨逊
收件人：米歇尔·达利安

好吧，米歇尔，我错了。废土确实不如我想象的那么危险——注意我说的是“危险”，但这不意味着它就是安全的。我们很幸运，做了几单成功的生意，估计接下来就要全面开放了。就把门关上一小会儿，安排几个守卫，放聪明些好吗。我们都见过那些戴着古怪帽子的怪人，成天在外面游荡。感觉他们每天都在步步逼近，要让他们知道我们不是好惹的。保持安全，放聪明点。

友好的，
迈克尔

original:
From: George Stault
To:  Janet Kimper

Hi Janet,
How is the school year going so far? I've heard good things from your teachers. They say you are one of the top students in your class.
Your birthday is tomorrow, sweet 16 at last! Can you even believe it? It seems like yesterday my sister told me she was going to have a little girl. Do you have big plans for your birthday? I think if you are interested, I could talk to some folks and get the dining room reserved for a couple hours. Let me know if that sounds like fun and I'll start getting the ball moving.

Uncle George
translation:
发件人：乔治·斯图尔特
收件人：珍妮特·吉珀

嗨，珍妮特，
这学期成绩怎么样？我刚从你的老师那儿听到了好消息。他们说你是班里最优秀的几个学生之一。
明天是你的生日，终于到了甜蜜的16岁！你能相信吗？我还记得我妹妹和我说她要生女儿了，仿佛就像昨天刚发生的一样。你对生日有什么计划吗？如果你想搞派对，我可以和人提前打个招呼，让他们把餐厅腾出几个小时。想要的话就和我说，我马上替你操办。

乔治叔叔

original:
From: Michael Robinson
To: George Stault

George, we've been friends for a while, so I hope you didn't take my candidacy for Overseer personally. I'm going to do whatever I can to keep our friends and family safe, and if that means taking our exposure to the outside world slow, and keeping to ourselves (outside of what we need, of course), then that is what I'm going to push for. No one knows what it is going to be like out there. There could be horrific mutants, or strange wandering vagabonds, aliens, murderous gangs. WE have no idea. Let's be smart about this.

- Mike
translation:
发件人：迈克尔·鲁滨逊
收件人：乔治·斯图尔特

乔治，我们也算老朋友了，所以希望你对我这次参选监督者的事情别太往心里去。我只是想保护朋友和家人的安全，要达到这个目的，就应当放慢对外开放的脚步、减少与外界的接触（当然，贸易是必不可少的），而我正好打算推动这一政策。没有人知道外界是怎样的。可能会有恐怖的变种人、奇怪的流浪者，或是外星人和杀人团伙。我们什么都不知道。所以应该保持清醒的头脑。

麦克

original:
From: George Stault
To:  *ALL RESIDENTS*

Greetings Everyone!
Thank you all for putting your trust in me. I am honored to serve as your Overseer for the next term, and hopefully beyond. I am going to do everything I can to get Michelle's committee outside as soon as possible. We'll get our water issues resolved, and form lasting bonds with our neighbors in the world outside.

Thanks again for putting your trust in me.
George Stault, Overseer
translation:
发件人：乔治·斯图尔特
收件人：*全体居民*

大家好！
感谢大家对我的信任。我很荣幸成为你们的新一任监督者，希望将来还可以连任。我会尽快让米歇尔的委员会开始对外运作。我也会解决用水问题，并且和我们外界的邻居达成长久的合作。

再次感谢你们对我的信任。
监督乔治·斯图尔特。

original:
From: Michelle Dallian
To: George Stault

George,
I'm not sure what Michael is planning, but I suggest that you leave the weapons in those two submerged storerooms. I'm pretty sure he doesn't have any support, and there is no need to give him the opportunity to arm himself.

Michelle
translation:
发件人：米歇尔·达利安
收件人：乔治·斯图尔特

乔治，
我不知道迈克尔在打什么鬼主意，但我建议你把武器留在两间被水淹没的储藏室内。他现在肯定孤立无援，最好别给他机会武装自己。

米歇尔

VAULT AUTOMATED MESSAGE SYSTEM

收件人：*全体居民*

提醒：避难所选举将近，初选将于两周后开始。如果你有意参选，请提前申报你的竞选资格。

避难所自动邮件系统

VAULT AUTOMATED MESSAGE SYSTEM

To: *ALL RESIDENTS*

Hi Everyone! I just received a relay message from Michelle's initial party, and they are doing well. She asked me to pass this along to anyone that was worried about her.
translation:
发件人：威廉·梅森
收件人：*全体居民*

大家好！我刚刚收到了米歇尔的外联小组传回来的消息，他们目前情况良好。她让我将这条消息转发给那些为她担心的人。

original:
From: Nara Robinson
To: Michelle Dallian

Michelle, do you know what happened to the trading party? They were supposed to be back a few hours ago. This is the first time anyone has been late. Do you think something could have happened to them?

Nara
translation:
发件人：娜拉·鲁滨逊
收件人：米歇尔·达利安

米歇尔，你知道贸易小组的情况怎样了吗？他们本应该在几小时以前回来的，这是他们第一次迟到。你觉得他们是不是出事了？

娜拉

original:
From: Michelle Dallian
To: Nara Robinson

I'm sure they'll be back soon. The Vault door is unlocked, and it'll stay that way until they get in. If we don't hear from them in another hour I'll send out another party.
translation:
发件人：米歇尔·达利安
收件人：娜拉·鲁滨逊

我相信他们很快就会回来的。避难所的门是打开的，会一直开到他们回来。如果再过一个小时还是没有他们的消息，我就再派一队人出去。

original:
From: Nara Robinson
To: Daniel Raati

Hi Danny,
Laura is going to send you a message about her grades. Could you take some time and talk to her? She's pretty upset. I know she slipped a little bit near the end of the semester, but she works really hard, and she genuinely wants to do well.

Thanks,
Nara
translation:
发件人：娜拉·鲁滨逊
收件人：丹尼尔·拉蒂

嘿，丹尼尔，
劳拉会给你发一条关于她成绩的邮件。你能不能花点时间和她谈谈？她很难过。我知道她在学期末有点退步了，但她学得真的非常努力，她很想取得好成绩。

谢谢，
娜拉

original: Accident Report Log
translation: 事故报告

original:
Incident: Broken Glass

Kevin dropped one of the glass tubes today while forming it.  He ended up with a nasty cut on his hand from the broken glass.  Fortunately no one else was hurt.  I bandaged his hand and had him clean it up before sending him home.  One more accident like that and I may have to let him go.  Kid's too accident prone.

Incident: Elevator

One of the elevators to the upper loading dock broke down again.  Unfortunately Johnathan was inside waiting to unload and the sudden stop caused one of the signs to slip of its pallet and it broke his leg.  He'll be out for at least a month while it heals.
translation:
事故：玻璃碎裂

凯文在吹玻璃管的时候掉了一个到地上。结果他的手被碎玻璃割伤。很幸运，没有别人受伤。我替他包扎了伤口，做了清理，然后让他回去了。要是再出这样的事故，我可能就要解雇他了。年轻人做事太马虎。

事故：电梯

通往上层装货区的电梯又坏了一部。乔纳森当时正好在电梯里等待卸货，电梯突然停运，其中一块标牌从运货架上滑落，砸伤了他的腿。他至少要修养一个月伤口才能痊愈。

original: Holotape
translation: 全息磁带

original: Mojave Express Delivery Order (6 of 6)
translation: 莫哈维快递送货指令(6/6)

original:
INSTRUCTIONS

Deliver the package at the north entrance to the Vegas Strip, by way of Freeside. An agent of the recipient will meet you at the checkpoint, take possession of the package, and pay for the delivery. Bring the payment to Johnson Nash at the Mojave Express agency in Primm.

Bonus on completion: 250 caps.

MANIFEST

This package contains:

One (1) Oversized Poker Chip, composed of Platinum

CONTRACT PENALTIES

You are an authorized agent of the Mojave Express Package until the delivery is complete and payment has been processed, contractually obligated to complete this transaction and materially responsible for any malfeasance or loss. Failure to deliver to the proper recipient may result in forfeiture of your advance and bonus, criminal charges, and/or pursuit by mercenary reclamation teams. The Mojave Express is not responsible for any injury or loss of life you experience as a result of said reclamation efforts.
translation:
指令

将包裹递送至维加斯长街的北入口，位于自由城旁边。收件人的代理人会在约定的地点和你见面，拿到包裹后付钱给你。把钱交给普瑞姆的莫哈维快递负责人约翰逊·纳什。

完成任务的奖励：250枚瓶盖

清单

该包裹包含：

一枚（1）由白金制成的超大号筹码。

合同处罚

直到快递交付，并受到邮递费之前，你都是莫哈维快递的授权代理人，需按合同规定完成交易。任何因渎职而造成的后果及损失必须由你自行承担。未能成功投递会没收你的预付款和奖金，并面临刑事指控，同时寄送人将（可能）指派雇佣兵追回包裹。莫哈维快递不会对你在追回过程中所受的伤害及死亡负责。

original: Holotape
translation: 全息磁带

original: Not many patrols out here lately, which means not much loot.  Our crew is thinking we should make a move soon.  Follow the tracks up north; head towards the Strip. You in?  Ain't on the chain gang anymore, but we still gotta stick together.
translation: 最近巡逻队少了，因此战利品也不多。我们的人正在考虑迁移。沿着轨道向北走；朝长街的方向走。你要来吗？虽然我们不再被铁链拴在一起，但我们仍是一根绳子上的蚂蚱。

original: Misfits Rifle Report (Good)
translation: 后进生的射击报告（优秀）

original: Squad CG554-2 demonstrates a markedly increased proficiency in basic small-arms skill and CQB acumen. Squad accuracy is up 35% from previous examinations, and squad members work together as a cohesive unit to achieve goals.\n\nFinal Analysis: Excellent
translation: CG554-2小队在制式轻型武器的操作和近距离作战的战术修养方面有了显著的进步。小队射击命中率比先前的测试提高了35%，队员们在完成目标的时候配合十分默契。\n\n最终评价：优秀

original: Misfits Rifle Report (Bad)
translation: 后进生的射击报告（糟糕）

original: Squad CG554-2 demonstrates consistently poor marksmanship and lacks basic firearms skills. Team coordination is minimal at best, and individual rivalries crop up frequently. Recommend further basic training and team-building exercises.\n\nFinal Analysis: Poor
translation: CG554-2小队的枪法依旧拙劣，尚未掌握基本的枪械操作技能。团队协作水平低下，队员间经常发生冲突。建议继续开展基础训练及团队协作训练。\n\n最终评价：差

original: Misfits Grenade Report (Good)
translation: 后进生的手雷投掷报告（优秀）

original: Squad CG554-2 has shown good proficiency with explosive weapons, and has readily demonstrated the proper tactical uses of said weaponry. Based on this evaluation, full field certification is recommended.\n\nFinal Analysis: Excellent
translation: CG554-2小队对爆炸类武器的使用已经十分熟练，并且对该武器的战术性用途也有了较为充分的了解。基于这一成绩，建议对其进行全面的实战评估。\n\n最终评价：优秀

original: Misfits Grenade Report (Bad)
translation: 后进生的手雷投掷报告（糟糕）

original: Squad CG554-2 has demonstrated an appalling lack of skill with regards to the basic explosive armaments of the NCR Army. It is, to speak frankly, a miracle they retain all of their limbs. Extensive retraining with dummy rounds is highly recommended.\n\nFinal Analysis: Poor
translation: CG554-2小队在NCR制式爆炸武器的操作技能上表现出了极其糟糕的水准。坦白地说，他们的胳膊腿还在，本身就是一个奇迹。建议采用空包弹对其进行拓展训练。\n\n最终评价：差

original: Misfits Rifle Report (Good)
translation: 后进生的射击报告（良好）

original: ACCESS DENIED - Ranger Detachment reports not available from this system.
translation: 禁止访问——游骑兵先遣队报告不可经由此系统访问。

original: Nellis Missile Metal
translation: 内利斯导弹金属

original: Raquel, the Master at Arms for the Boomers, would be grateful if I brought her some missiles.
translation: 如果我能给大炮族的军需官拉奎尔带去一些导弹，她一定会非常感激。

original: Nellis Scrap Metal
translation: 内利斯废金属

original: Jack at Nellis is looking for scrap metal. He can't pay me, but earning the trust of people with that much artillery seems like a decent idea.
translation: 内利斯的杰克正在收购废金属。他无法付钱给我，但如果能和这帮成天与大炮作伴的人交上朋友，那一定会很有好处。

original: Busted Radio
translation: 坏了的收音机

original: The radio at the Prospector Saloon in Goodsprings was broken by a visiting Great Khan. Trudy has offered to pay you if you can fix it.
translation: 清泉镇淘金客沙龙的收音机被一个大汗帮给砸坏了。如果你能修好它的话，特鲁迪会给你一笔报酬。

original: Jack's Love Story
translation: 杰克的爱情故事

original: Jack let me know there is a girl he is interested in at Crimson Caravan. He knows she has red hair, but that is all he knows. He'd like me to talk to her and see if she is interested in meeting him.
translation: 杰克告诉我他对深红商队的一个女孩颇有好感。他知道她长了一头红发，但除此之外就不太清楚了。他请求我替他带去问候，看她有没有兴趣认识杰克。

original: Nellis Solar Array
translation: 内利斯太阳能阵列

original: Loyal, one of the Boomer elders, requested that I take a look at the solar array and see about fixing them.
translation: 罗亚尔，大炮族的一位长老，希望我能检查一下太阳能电池阵列，并想办法修好它们。

original: Mr. Cuddles
translation: 抱抱先生

original: Lindsay, one of the Boomer kids, lost her teddy bear, but she isn't sure where she lost it.
translation: 林赛，一个大炮族的小孩，弄丢了她的泰迪熊，但她已经记不清楚自己是在哪里弄丢它的。

original: Mr. Cuddles
translation: 抱抱先生

original: Lindsay, one of the Boomer kids, lost her teddy bear, she last remembers seeing it when she was playing hide and seek in the main hangar.
translation: 林赛，一个大炮族的小孩，弄丢了她的泰迪熊。她记得最后一次见到它是在机库玩捉迷藏的时候。

original: Matchbook
translation: 火柴盒

original: The following is scrawled across the back of the matchbook:\n\nSteam Room. 4 PM.
translation: 以下文字潦草地写在火柴盒背面：\n\n蒸汽房，下午四点。

original: Omertas Stopped Buying From Mick
translation: 黑手党不和米克交易了

original: Mick from Mick & Ralph's says the Omertas stopped buying guns suddenly without giving a reason why.  Maybe I should ask around and see if I can find out why.
translation: 米克与拉尔夫杂货店的米克说黑手党最近突然停止购买军火了，毫无任何理由。或许我应该向四周打听一下，看看能不能找到原因。

original: Goodsprings Schoolhouse Safe
translation: 清泉镇校舍保险柜

original: Sunny Smiles told you that the old Goodsprings schoolhouse contains a safe which no one in town has been able to crack. She helpfully provided you with some bobby pins and a copy of the magazine "Locksmith's Reader" in case you wanted to take a shot at opening the safe.
translation: 微笑桑妮告诉你，旧清泉镇校舍里有一个镇上谁都没法打开的保险箱。她很热心地给了你几根发夹和一本《锁匠必读》杂志，也许你可以试着打开那个保险箱。

original: Alpha Station Password
translation: 阿尔法驻站口令

original: Bravo Station Password
translation: 布拉沃驻站密码

translation: 查理驻站密码

translation: 德尔塔驻站密码

original: Echo Station Password
translation: 艾柯驻站密码

original: Foxtrot Station Password
translation: 狐步舞驻站密码

original: Chairmen Job Offer
translation: 董事会工作合同

original: Thought you'd like to know that one of the Chairmen bigwigs from the Tops is looking to hire muscle for a job out by Goodsprings. I don't what it's about, though - the details are all hush hush.\n\nThe pay seems too good to be true, but I figured I'd pass the info your way in case it's all on the level. Let me know and I'll put you in contact with this Benny fellow.
translation: 我想你大概会感兴趣，有个九重天来的董事会大佬想要雇个帮手陪他去清泉镇走一趟。但我不知道究竟要干什么，所有的细节都是保密的。\n\n报酬相当优厚，简直不像真的，但我寻思还是告诉你一声吧，万一是真的呢？想去的话就告诉我，我会让这个叫本尼的家伙联系你的。

original: Followers Need Supplies
translation: 天启追随者需要补给

original: Julie Farkas from the Followers would like me to arrange a trading agreement with someone to supply Med-X, Rad-Away, and Fixer.  The Crimson Caravan are apparently asking for too many caps for the supplies.  I'll need to ask around to see if I can work out a deal.
translation: 天启追随者的朱莉·法卡斯想让我帮忙找一个能供应吗啡针-X，辐特宁和瘾头解的物资商。深红商队的要价显然太高，也许我得去其他地方问问。

original: Philippe's Recipes
translation: 菲利普的食谱

original: This is a stack of hand-written recipes, obviously experimental, with many sections crossed out and notes scribbled in the margins. The one that seems to have gone through the most revision is called "Sweet Veal," however the notes indicate a desire to make it taste not like veal but human flesh.
translation: 这是几张手写的食谱，显然只是试验性的，很多段落被划掉了，在空白处有笔记，涂改过最多次的那道菜叫做“蜜汁小牛肉”，然而注释上写着作者想让它尝起来更像是人肉，而不是小牛肉。

original: Ambassador Crocker's Note
translation: 克罗克大使的便条

original:
I wish to speak with you immediately in regards to important matters. 

I trust you have learned enough in your travels to know that the New California Republic is an honorable nation engaged in a beneficent mission in the Mojave in general and New Vegas in particular. It is in addition a wealthy nation that well rewards persons who dedicate themselves to its national interests, whether for reasons patriotic or material. 

Allow me to reassure you that if you have committed any crimes or misdemeanors against the republic, it is in my power to pardon misconduct of this sort. 

I stand ready to receive you at your earliest convenience in my offices at the New California Republic Embassy at the south side of the Vegas Strip. 

God bless the New California Republic, 

Dennis Crocker
Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary
Department of State, New California Republic
translation:
兹有要事相商，烦请速来与我会面。

想必阁下在旅途中已听闻不少有关新加州共和国的事迹。作为一个高尚的国家，她为莫哈维，尤其是新维加斯的繁荣发展做出了巨大的贡献。此外，她也是一个富裕的国家，凡是甘愿为其利益奉献自我的人们，无论是出于爱国情操，还是物质诱惑，都将得到慷慨的奖赏。

我可以担保，无论阁下以往对共和国犯下过多么严重的罪行，我都有能力将其赦免。

若阁下愿拨冗莅临，我将随时在维加斯长街南部的新加州共和国大使馆办公室中敬候大驾。

愿上帝保佑新加州共和国，

丹尼斯·克罗克
新加州共和国国务院
特命全权大使

original: Troike Blackmail Note
translation: 卓伊克敲诈记录

original:
Hey Boss,

We took care of Troike, just like you asked. The stupid bitch that tried to run away made the perfect patsy. We get the double benefit of her stinking body serving as a warning to the rest of the girls. Troike was so fucked up on that spiked Jet we could have stabbed him in the balls and he wouldn't have said daisy.

We're going to take a little vacation for a bit, Troike may have seen one of our faces while he was drifting in and out. We don't want him to get suspicious. Hopefully that scrawny little fuck does some good business for you.

Thanks for the bonus boss.
translation:
嘿，老板，

我们已经照你的吩咐搞定了卓伊克。那个蠢婊子想逃跑，我们索性拿她当了个完美的替罪羊。我们要用她发臭的尸体警告其他女孩，达到一石二鸟的效果。卓伊克嗑下那支烈性杰特之后，整个人睡得就像头死猪一样，哪怕戳爆他的蛋蛋，我估计他都不会有半点反应。

我们想出去避避风头，卓伊克进进出出的时候可能看到了我们其中某个人的脸。我们不想让他起疑，但愿这个瘦不拉几的废物能对您有点用处。

老板，多谢你的奖赏。

original: Big Sal's Password
translation: 大萨尔的密码

original: Jack Wilson
translation: 杰克·威尔森

original: You've discovered that Jack Wilson is the civilian contractor responsible for running the operations at Quarry Junction and Boulder City. While it would make sense for the NCR to simply reuse the rubble lying around Boulder City, it seems that a report from the Office of Science and Industry has deemed the rubble unusable - a fortunate turn of events for Jack Wilson.\n\nIke, the bartender at the Big Horn Saloon in Boulder City, informed you that Wilson frequents Gomorrah, one of the casinos along The Strip in New Vegas.
translation: 你发现杰克·威尔逊包揽了采石场枢纽和博尔德城的生意。虽然NCR完全可重复利用博尔德城的瓦砾，但科工部的一份报告指出，瓦砾堆太过脆弱，这也为威尔逊提供了机会。\n\n博尔德城大角酒馆的酒保艾克告诉你威尔逊经常光顾蛾摩拉，那是新维加斯长街上的一家赌场。

original: Recon of the Lucky 38
translation: 侦察幸运38

original: The Followers of the Apocalypse have asked you to gather information on the Lucky 38 and its master, Mr. House.  They have given you a bug to install at an access point to the Lucky 38's data network.  Mr. House will be in the penthouse of the tower.
translation: 天启追随者请求你帮助收集幸运38和它主人豪斯先生的信息。他们给了你一个监听器，让你安装到幸运38数据网络的一个接入点中。豪斯先生应该在塔的顶层。

original: Snuff Tapes
translation: 鼻烟磁带

original: These tapes contain horrific sounds of murder and violence. You hear Clanden engaging in violent sex with women, and then hear the sounds of visceral and violent murder being carried out.

original: A Story to Be Told
translation: 一段传说

original:
Vault 21 has a story unlike any other Nuclear Fallout Shelter - you are about to learn why!

It is common knowledge that some vaults were built and organized with motives that went beyond their function as safeguards of our last great hope: the hope that humanity would survive even the worst catastrophe imaginable - Nuclear War.

Vault 21 was one of these experimental vaults. In the spirit of Las Vegas, our vault was built and organized around gambling!

Everything you will see here follows the idea that humans can coexist and organize their lives based on the principle that skill is the only factor that should tip the blind balance held by Lady Luck.

We embodied the perfect equilibrium between self-reliance and social equality.

Each level of Vault 21 was symmetrical and transparent. Each room looked exactly like the next, and every gambling place was built in plain sight, so that no person would have advantage over another.

Thanks to this, quarrels in our society were solved from an equal starting ground - the best won, just like our American Dream promised so long ago!

After two-hundred years of living in harmony, we finally awoke to the nature of the outside world when Mr. House, in his able wisdom, resurrected our lost city as New Vegas!
translation:
21号避难所有着与其他核辐射避难所截然不同的历史——我们将向您揭示其中的缘由！

众所周知，部分避难所的建造目的并不是为了实现它们原本的功能：保护我们伟大的希望，让人类能够在有史以来最可怕的灾难——核战争中延续自身的火种。

21号避难所就是这样一处实验性避难所。它继承了赌城拉斯维加斯的精神，整座避难所都是围绕着赌博而修建的！

这里的生活秉持着一个理念：人类能够在统一的规则中和谐共处、安居乐业，在规则的制约下，只有纯粹的技巧才能撬动幸运女神公正的天平。

我们以此实现了自力更生与社会平等的完美平衡。

21号避难所的每一层都是对称而透明的。所有房间格局完全一致，每间赌场都被设计得可以一览无余，这样也就没有人能抢占先机。

正因如此，在我们的社群中，所有纷争都能在同一起点上获得解决。强者得胜，正是数百年前“美国梦”所允诺的真理！

我们度过了两百年的和睦时光，直到豪斯先生凭借自己的英明将地上那座残缺之城以“新维加斯”的名义重现于世人眼前，我们才得以再度认识外面的世界。

original: Opening to a New World
translation: 展望新世界

original:
Seven years ago, Mr. House rebuilt and organized the great city of New Vegas. Vault 21 rests in the middle of The Strip, and it was inevitable that it would become part of the city's bright future. Mr. House contacted our community and offered us to participate in the resurgence of New Vegas.

Most Vault 21 dwellers refused the offer - life was comfortable, safe and fruitful. We had grown so accustomed to the benefits of our isolated society that we could not conceive leaving it behind for an unknown future teetering on a precarious balance. Still, there were some among us who disagreed with the prevailing wisdom.

They challenged, on Mr. House's behalf, each of the vault-levels' representatives that supported continuing our isolation. According to the custom, a game would be set up where the winner would decide the course of the community's future.

A game of blackjack was scheduled and held in this very level of Vault 21. After many hours of grueling struggle, Mr. House's supporters won in an extremely risky, and fateful, gambit. They decided to open up the doors to the outside world.

The rest upheld our system and remained true to their promise to abide by the victor's decision.

After almost two hundred years within Vault 21's halls, we released the seals of the ancient doors. We opened to a new world.
translation:
七年前，豪斯先生重建了伟大的新维加斯。21号避难所恰好就坐落在赌城长街的中央，毫无疑问，它必将成为这座城市光明未来的一部分。豪斯先生因而找到了我们，希望我们能参与新维加斯的复兴。

大多数21号避难所的居民拒绝了这一邀请，以往的生活安宁舒适，也令每个人受益匪浅。我们早就习惯了与世隔绝所带来的好处，抛弃它去追寻一个前途未卜的明天，对我们而言是无法想象的。然而在压倒性的意见中，也有一小部分人持相左的观点。

他们决定支持豪斯先生，而每一层赞同实行隔绝政策的居民们也选出了各自的代表，双方就此展开较量。根据惯例，将举行一场比赛，由胜者决定大家的未来。

当时这场21点大赛的举办地就在这里。经过数小时的紧张较量，豪斯先生的支持者以一种极其冒险的策略获得了险胜，他们宣布将对外界打开大门。

剩下的人也依照规则履行了他们的承诺，听从胜利者的决定。

在21号避难所生活了大约两百年后，我们打开了这扇古老的大门，我们打开了一个新世界。

original: A Tribute to Our Benefactor
translation: 致牺牲烈士的颂词

original:
Mr. House, with the help of The Families, had transformed the mostly unharmed ruins of Las Vegas into a paradise. It resembled the city that we remembered thanks to the stories and items that our forefathers told and secured in Vault 21 after The Cataclysm.

We were awe-struck and cautious, at once. Slowly, we left the confines of the vault and settled within New Vegas, aiding in its reconstruction.

Vault 21, a giant complex of functioning machinery, became a great source of materials with which to rebuild New Vegas.

Mr. House stripped the vault and filled its empty husk with concrete - only leaving behind part of the vault's top level. This section is where you now find hospice and where the warmth of our ancient home remains alive for all to enjoy!

We have come to recognize the wisdom of Mr. House in forging a new and brighter future for all generations of New Vegas' inhabitants. Without his leadership, the barren wasteland would have remained uncivilized, savage and brutal for all time.

We sincerely hope that you join us in celebrating the glory of New Vegas and the memory of Vault 21's legacy!
translation:
在三大家族的辅佐下，豪斯先生将拉斯维加斯保存尚好的遗迹变成了一座天堂。它与我们记忆中祖先们口耳相传、并记载在避难所史料中的那座赌城惊人地相似。

我们不禁肃然起敬，但也战战兢兢。渐渐地，我们离开了避难所的护佑，在新维加斯定居下来，为它添砖加瓦。

21号避难所，一个巨大而复杂的机械堡垒，成为了重建新维加斯主要的材料来源地。

豪斯先生把避难所里的东西都拆光了，只留下了一个灌满水泥的空壳。如今，唯有避难所的顶层保存了下来，但你依然可以在这里享受舒适的居住环境，回味我们古老家园所带来的温暖！

我们深切地认识到，豪斯先生将会为新维加斯世世代代的人民创造一个崭新美好的未来。没有他的领导，贫瘠的废土将永远是一片尚未开化、蛮荒而残酷的土地。

我们真诚希望你能同我们一道感受新维加斯的辉煌，怀念21号避难所曾经的荣光！
