original: From the depths of my ebbing soul
translation: 发自我衰弱灵魂的深处

original:
Hey, lil sis!

How are you holding up? I miss you so much, Sarah! This place makes me want to run back to our home, every single day. I just had to write you so that I could feel a bit warmer. The warehouse's cold air weighs on me as heavily as the concrete that Mr. House dumped in our vault. Damned be his soul!

Yeah, I imagine that you did not expect that outburst from your "cool bro" but I am reaching the end of the corridor, here. Emptiness is my muse - doubt is my only mistress. Everything that once inspired my art slowly drifts back into nothingness, into an unfathomable void where neither I find light nor its radiance searches for the spring of my soul.

Bah, don't I sound pathetic? I do not wish to worry you, lil sis. I just wish that I could be there with you, right now. Perhaps once I find my strength again, once I finish the latest "suggestion" for Mr. House, I'll venture into the Strip and visit you.

My thoughts are with you, hot-headed roadster!
translation:
嘿，小妹！

别来无恙？我可想你了，莎拉！这地方让我每天都巴不得逃回家。我只能靠给你写信来换取些许温暖。仓库里的冷空气沉重地压在我身上，就和豪斯先生浇筑在我们避难所里的混凝土一样！愿他的灵魂遭天谴！

是啊，我估计你从未想过你的“酷老哥”也会发火吧？但我实在是忍不下去了。空虚是我的女神——困惑是我唯一的情人。曾经激发过我艺术灵感的一切正在逐渐消散，遁入飘渺莫测的虚空，在那儿我既找不到光明，我的灵魂之泉也无法获得滋养。

呸，听起来是否很可悲？我不想让你担心，小妹妹。我只希望此时此刻能与你团圆。也许等我哪天重拾信心，等我完成了豪斯先生最新的“请求”，我就会去长街拜访你。

我深深地挂念你，小冒失鬼！

original: Hey, you!
translation: 嘿，你！

original:
What's shaking, my cool bro!

You'll be happy to know that our vault is packed and coasting along! Even with those legionnaires bad news we still get plenty of NCR squares down here. They are all chirpy and don't appear to mind that Cesar is crusin' for a bruisin' all over the place. Maybe the NCR is stronger than we thought, uh? Don't know... you think we can trust them over Mr. House?

I still feel all clutched over what he did to our home! I mean, yeah it is good that we got to keep part of our vault but I can't shake the thought that one of these days he'll just push me out into the open - once he does not need us any more. I tell you, we should have never accepted his challenge. That shuckster cheated us, I am sure!

Anyway, you've heard all of that before and I just wanted to bring you a smile! Cheer up, buttercup! I miss you!

Sarah.
translation:
你还好吗，我的酷老哥！

我们的避难所最近人气旺得很，经营得也还不错，你一定很高兴吧！虽然时常能听见军团作恶的坏消息，但来我们这儿的NCR百姓依然络绎不绝。他们相当热情，似乎也不担心凯撒的威胁。可能NCR比我们想象的要强大？不知道……你觉得比起豪斯先生，我们更应该信任他们吗？

说起那家伙，我还是对他毁灭我们家园的事情耿耿于怀！没错，我们是能保留一部分避难所，可我总是担心，万一他哪天不需要我们了，就会把我一脚踹出去。我和你说，当初我们就不该接受他的挑战。这个老狐狸绝对出了老千，我百分百肯定！

不管怎样，虽然都是些老生常谈，但我还是希望你能有好心情！振作起来吧，宝贝！我想你！

莎拉

Dear Miss Weintraub,

This is Charlene Tann writing to say thank you for the great experience we had at your hotel! I can't wait to tell to my inner circle. As you recall, my husband Biff is a very respected and influential man in our wealthy community.

Ms. Shot, Ingrid Denger and lady Booften will soon come for tea to our estate and I will direct them your way. They will love the quaint and rustic feel of your cramped underground hole - tres chic!

Even Biff still talks about his new favorite ranging garb, "the leather from my Vault 21 suit contains the scent of unwashed ages" he says to all our visitors! But he won't let them try it on for one minute, dear.

With most sincerity,

Ms. Tann

我是莎琳·坦恩，由衷感谢您的酒店给我们带来的美好体验！我真想尽快将这段经历与我的密友们分享。您也许还记得，我的丈夫比弗在上流阶层中颇有名望，也极富影响力。

肖特夫人，英格丽·邓戈和布奥芬女士很快就会来我们的庄园做客，我会把您的酒店介绍给她们。她们一定会喜欢上你那座狭小地穴中古雅质朴的气质的，真是太时髦了！

连比弗都对他最喜爱的服装赞不绝口：“21号避难所的皮衣上有一种未经洗涤的岁月所散发的清香”，他对每位客人都这么说！可他就是不肯让我穿，天哪。

致以最诚挚的敬意，

坦恩夫人

original:
Monday:
* Observed patrol of 3 Raiders - radioed position but no intercept was sent.

Tuesday:
* Received yet another shipment of ammunition. This is the seventh shipment we have received without request.
* Running low on Fancy Lads.

Wednesday:
* All Clear.

Thursday:
* Sighted Legion scout party bound for Bitter Springs. Intercept arrived two hours after we called it in - sent complaint to Hanlon about NCR militia taking forever.
* Shipment arrived with more .308 rounds (not requested). Sent complaint to Hanlon but didn't get a response.

Friday:
* Rabid jackal wandered into camp providing much needed target practice.
* Found crate of rifles in with some rations shipped last week - where are all these surplus weapons coming from?
translation:
周一：
*观察到三名游荡的掠夺者-用无线电通报了位置，但没有部队前来阻截。

周二：
*又收到一批运来的弹药。这是我们收到的第七批不请自来的物资。
*奇想小子快吃完了。

周三：
*一切无事。

周四：
*观察到军团斥候小队在苦泉附近出没。发出增援请求两小时后，部队才到达，我们向汉隆提交了一份NCR部队反应过慢的投诉。
*又运来了一批.308弹药（并未向上级申请）。寄给汉隆的投诉信没有得到回复。

周五：
*疯狂的豺狗帮成员闯进了营地，给我们练习枪法提供了很好的靶子。
*在上周运来的口粮中发现了一箱步枪——这些多余的武器究竟是哪儿来的？

original: Kudlow's Log
translation: 库德洛的日志

original:
After Action for Incident FS-87,

Victims include 4 NCR Militiamen - squad was most likely on an unregistered patrol as they were not being observed until after the attack. Assailants believed to be raiders (likely Great Khans) with hunting dogs (two dog corpses were left in the scuffle - tracks suggest as many as a dozen in the attacking pack).

Threat Assessment: Trivial. Great Khans with dogs present virtually no matter of trouble. Incident likely caused by unskilled NCR patrolmen failing to radio us for an eyes-on backup.

Radioed HQ with report at 12:40, received Hanlon's confirmation at 12:42 that he received the details.
translation:
FS-87事故应对报告，

受害者包括4位NCR民兵，该小队很可能正在执行一次未经报备的巡逻，因为直到袭击发生前，都无人观察到其动向。袭击者应该是掠夺者（可能为大汗帮），携带犬只（战斗现场发现两只狗的尸体，现场痕迹表明参与袭击的犬类可能多大数十只）。

威胁评估：小。携带犬类的大汗帮并不会造成太大威胁。这起事故极有可能是缺乏经验的NCR巡逻士兵在观测到情况后未能及时向总部联络呼叫增援所致。

已于12:40用无线电向总部报告，12:42收到汉隆的确认，他说他已了解相关细节。

original: Sgt. Reyes List
translation: 雷耶斯中士的表单

original:
Here's what I need you to research.

1) Several casualty reports have come in saying that Alpha Station sustained heavy casualties and injuries in the vicinity of Hoover Dam - yet no new reinforcements have been sent in weeks. Speak with Senior Ranger Rebecca Lineholm, get an accurate casualty count and asses the situation, as several of us have been worried that something horrible is stalking the Hoover Dam area if it can claim NCR's elite Rangers.

2) Ranger Station Bravo hasn't requested a resupply in four months. While the Rangers I can reach on the radio say things are 'just fine' I need you to speak to Ranger Ericsen, the commanding officer, and find out how they've been running on no supplies for so long.

3) Charlie station received a substantial shipment of medical supplies despite having only a few serious injury reports. Check up on them and see if they have a surplus that could be redistributed to needed locations - I'm having a hard time getting anyone on the radio lately.

4) Delta station radioed in a report of an NCR Trooper cadre being murdered to the last man in a horrifying display of brutality. The report mentioned a squad of Super mutants wearing Caesar's colors. This report has unsettled NCR command I need you to speak to Senior Ranger Pason to confirm the report and get an accurate count of Super mutants spotted.

5) Echo Station has had a five-fold spike in reported enemy contacts, but NCR crews dispatched to follow up have a mere 10% success rate in intercepting these hostiles. The ghouls I've reached by the radio insist everything is 'just fine' but the numbers disagree - so speak Senior Ranger Erasmus for me please. Perhaps they're short-handed and need more spotters.

6) Foxtrot station called in a report of an NCR Trooper patrol slaughtered by a Great Khan hunting team with trained Deathclaws. Senior Ranger Kudlow called in the report but I can't seem to contact her for a more detailed account of the incident - please to speak to her and confirm/deny this rather disturbing report.
translation:
我需要你帮忙调查以下几件事。

1) 最近有报告称游骑兵阿尔法驻站在胡佛大坝附近遭遇重大伤亡，但数星期过去仍没有得到增援。请你向高级游骑兵丽贝卡·莱霍姆了解具体伤亡数字，并且评估状况。如果NCR的精锐游骑兵都能遭到如此重大损失，我们担心胡佛大坝可能存在严重威胁。

2）游骑兵驻站布拉沃4个月来都没有申请物资补给。我通过电台联系到了该地的游骑兵，他们回答情况“还不错”，但我需要你和该驻站的指挥官埃里克森进行确认，弄清楚他们究竟是怎样在没有补给的情况下坚持那么长时间的。

3）游骑兵驻站查理最近只发生了几起重伤事故，却收到了大量的医疗物资。查一下他们的情况，看看他们有没有多余的药品可以重新分配给其他急需的地方——我最近很难通过无线电联系到他们。

4）游骑兵驻站德尔塔用无线电上报称有一支NCR精锐部队被残忍地全数歼灭。报告提到了一队身着凯撒军团服装的超级变种人。这份报告中还有未执行的NCR命令，我要你和高级游骑兵帕森谈谈，确定报告的真实性，并了解超级变种人部队的具体规模。

5）游骑兵驻站艾柯最近报告的遇敌数量多了整整五倍，但派出的NCR增援部队却只拦截到了10%左右的敌人。我用无线电联系了驻扎在那里的尸鬼，他们一口咬定情况“还不错”，但报告上的数字却存在出入。所以请替我向高级游骑兵伊拉斯谟了解情况。也许他们缺乏人手，需要更多的侦察人员。

6）游骑兵驻站狐步舞报告说有一支NCR巡逻队被驯养了死亡爪的大汗帮狩猎小队屠杀了。报告是高级游骑兵库德罗提供的，但我联系不到她，也无法确认袭击的具体细节。请务必向她求证这起令人不安的事件是否真实。

Ambassador Phillip Granger's Final Report
translation: 菲利普·格兰格大使的最后报告

original:
Final Report - Ambassador Phillip Granger

With my term here coming to a close, I'm taking a moment to reflect on my accomplishments here. Sadly, they are few and far between. The politics between the families and Mr. House have made it incredibly difficult to deal with any of them. 

The Omertas are a group of sleazy lowlifes pretending to be something they aren't. The White Glove Society gives me the creeps (there's something strange going on with them, and I'm not sure I want to know what it is.) The Chairmen are thugs that dress themselves up in fancy suits pretending to be cool. 

I'm surprised that they've lasted this long without killing each other, although it's probably due to Mr. House and his Securitron's.

We have our work cut out for us here. I wish my term here was more fruitful than it was, but I'm glad to be returning to the NCR.


Phillip Granger
translation:
菲利普·格兰格大使的最后报告

在我的任期即将结束的时候，我决定花一点时间回顾自己在这里的成就。很遗憾，值得一书的成绩凤毛麟角。豪斯先生与三大家族之间存在的政治联系，使得与其中任何一方打交道都变得极为困难。

黑手党是一群肮脏的下等人，成天想着癞蛤嫫吃天鹅肉。白手套社团让我恶心（他们身上散发着一种奇怪的气质，但我并不想要深究）。董事会的人就是一群穿得花里胡哨、喜欢耍酷的恶棍。

我很惊讶他们居然相安无事了那么长时间，这很有可能要归功于豪斯先生和他的电子保安。

我们依旧面临着艰巨的工作。我希望我在任上所取得的成果能比前人更加丰硕，但我很高兴能够返回祖国。


菲利普·格兰格

original: Ambassador Susanna Edith's Final Report
translation: 苏珊娜·伊迪丝大使的最后报告

original:
Final Report - Ambassador Susanna Edith

The past two years serving as the NCR Ambassador to the Strip have been trying at best and downright horrid at worst.

Living here in New Vegas has been horrible. The accommodations here are barely serviceable, which is a deliberate and malicious act by Mr. House to hinder the NCR's efforts here in New Vegas. On top of that, I have constantly surrounded by drunken idiots who gamble away their money.

My work here has been fruitless. I've been unable to get anywhere with Mr. House (or actually meet Mr. House since all I have dealt with are his Securitron's that only serve to frustrate me further.) Still after all this time, we have been unable to find a common understanding between Mr. House and the NCR's goals for the area.

I look forward to returning home to the NCR and I wish my successor luck. You're going to need it.


Susanna Edith
translation:
苏珊娜·伊迪丝大使的最后报告

回顾过去两年担任NCR驻维加斯长街大使的经历，总结起来就是吃力不讨好。

新维加斯的生活条件非常糟糕。这里的房屋基本难以住人，纯粹就是豪斯先生为了阻挠NCR在新维加斯的发展而恶意安排的。除此之外，我还得经常对付那帮赌博输得身无分文又喝得酩酊大醉的白痴。

我在这里的工作没有取得多少成果。我无法和豪斯先生进行沟通（哪怕见上他一面都不行，因为我一直在和他的电子守卫打交道，这给了我更深的挫败感）。这么长时间以来，我们与豪斯先生也始终无法就这片地区的发展目标达成共识。

我期待着能回到NCR的家里。祝我的继任者好运。这是一句实话。


苏珊娜·伊迪丝

original: Informant Report
translation: 线人的报告

original: Latest information from our inside source reports that the Omertas are unhappy with House. We may be able to use this as leverage against him.
translation: 根据我们的内部线报，黑手党对豪斯存在不满。或许我们可以利用这一点来对付他。

original: Freeside Report
translation: 自由城报告

original: Reports are coming in from Freeside detailing a rise in violence against NCR Citizens. We're going to need to look into this. All sources indicate that Pacer is involved, of course.
translation: 自由城的报告显示近来针对NCR公民的暴力事件有愈演愈烈的趋势。我们有必要调查一下这件事。所有的消息都表明，佩瑟很有可能与此事有关。

original: Farming Report
translation: 耕种报告

original: Our farms on the east side of New Vegas are producing a good amount of crops. With the additional water allocated from Hoover Dam, we can increase the number of farms over the next few years by a substantial amount. That means more residents inclined to vote for annexation.
translation: 我们位于新维加斯东边的农场收成良好。有了胡佛大坝带来的额外水源，我们可以在未来几年大幅扩充农场的数量。这样一来也就会有更多当地居民倾向于加入共和国。

original: Fiend Report
translation: 恶魔帮报告

original: The Fiends have been more active outside New Vegas. The NCR troops stationed at Camp McCarran are handling this for now, but the situation needs to be monitored.
translation: 恶魔帮最近在新维加斯外围的活动愈发频繁。驻扎在麦卡伦营地的NCR军队正在处理这件事情，但需要有人来监督进展。

original: Liza O'Malley's Personal Files
translation: 莉莎·奥马利的个人文件

original: Personal Log - Liza O'Malley\n\nThings have been getting a little busy around here lately. I have a feeling that a lot of things are going on that I'm not aware of. There's a lot more papers and reports getting passed around, but also a lot of things under the table. All I know is that I need a vacation. I'm getting a little tired of spending all my time at the Embassy and need to get out. Maybe I'll hit up the casinos one of these nights.
translation: 个人日志-莉莎·奥马利\n\n最近这里开始变得忙起来了。我预感肯定有大事发生，只是我不知道罢了。往来的文件和报告越来越多，台面下的交易也不少。我只希望能休个假。我把时间都花在了大使馆上，真有些累人，需要出去走走。或许我该挑一个晚上去赌场试试手气。

original: Generic Embassy Info
translation: 大使馆通用信息

original:
NCR Embassy Status Report #01-50
New Vegas

Increased gang activity in Freeside needs to be monitored. Mr. House doesn't seem to care about anything outside the city's walls. The NCR may have to step in.

Ambassador Crocker has once again requested a meeting with Mr. House, a response has yet to be received.

Current supplies at the Embassy are within normal ranges.

Captain Pappas reports no unusual activity on the Strip.

-end-
translation:
NCR大使馆情况汇报#01-50
新维加斯

自由城日益频繁的帮派活动需要密切注意。豪斯先生似乎对墙外的事情漠不关心。NCR有介入的必要。

克罗克大使再次要求与豪斯先生会面，但尚未收到回应。

大使馆目前的物资储备正常。

帕帕斯队长报告说没有在长街发现异常活动。

-结束-

original: Report from Captain Pappas
translation: 来自帕帕斯上尉的报告

original:
Ambassador Crocker,

Captain Pappas dropped off a report for you while you were out. The report is attached.

Liza


Security Lacking at Checkpoints

There have been recent cases of civilians and some troopers sneaking in restricted items into the Strip. Security needs to be increased to make sure that this stops right away. I'm instructing the MP's to tighten security at the checkpoints and any violations will be severely punished.

Recently confiscated items have been stored in the store room at the Military Police Headquarters. I have locked the room and have the key with me.

Captain Marie Pappas
translation:
克罗克大使，

帕帕斯队长在你外出的时候给你送了一份报告，请详见附件。

丽莎


检查站安保缺失

最近发生了数起普通公民或少数士兵携带违禁品进入长街的情况。为了制止这一行为，需要增派安保人手。我已指示宪兵加强检查站的安检，任何违规行为都将受到严厉的惩罚。

近来没收的物品都存放在了宪兵总部的仓库里，我上了锁，钥匙在我这里。

玛丽·帕帕斯队长

original: Strip Security Report
translation: 长街安全报告

original: I've notice and increase in the amount of smuggling of restricted items into the Strip. I'm increasing security at the checkpoints to prevent more of this. A report has been sent to Ambassador Crocker via Liza to address this.
translation: 我注意到最近长街走私违禁品的数量有上升的趋势。我已经在检查站增派了安保人员，以杜绝这一情况。为了解决这个问题，我已经让丽莎给克罗克大使递交了一份报告。

original: Jake Erwin Report
translation: 杰克·欧文的报告

original: Private Erwin has been causing trouble again. His pranks are starting to go a little too far. One more complaint and I'll put him behind bars.
translation: 列兵欧文又惹麻烦了。他的恶作剧开始变得有点过分了。如果下次再听到有人告他的状，我就把他丢进监狱。

original: Shift Reports
translation: 交班报告

original:
Shift Reports from the MP's:

Two drunk troopers were causing a ruckus on the Strip. MP's got involved and were able to resolve the situation before Securitrons showed up.

MP's received a complaint of suspicious activity near the Lucky 38. The complainant reported seeing a man hugging several trees.

An intoxicated man was sleeping in the lobby of the Tops.

A woman reported a drunk man vomiting in the fountain in front of the Ultra-Luxe. MP's were unable to find the man once arriving at the scene.

MP's responded to a report of a young woman behind Las Vegas Station who locked herself in handcuffs.

MP's broke up a fight between twin brothers near the Gomorrah. The brothers stated they were fighting over one of the dancers at Gomorrah.
translation:
宪兵的交接班报告：

两名喝醉的士兵在长街上引发骚动。宪兵及时介入，在电子保安出现前成功控制了事态。

宪兵收到举报称在幸运38赌场附近发现可疑行为。举报人说看到有个男人在拥抱树木。

一个醉汉跑到九重天的门厅里闷头大睡。

一位女士报告说有一名醉汉在奢华殿堂前面的喷泉里呕吐。但宪兵赶到现场后却找不到那个人。

宪兵在拉斯维加斯车站后解救了一位将自己锁进手铐里的女士。

宪兵制止了一起发生在蛾摩拉附近的双胞胎兄弟斗殴。这对兄弟说他们打架的原因是为了争夺一个蛾摩拉的舞女。

original: President Kimball's Itinerary
translation: 金博尔总统的路线

original:
Hoover Dam Presidential Visit Schedule

The President will visit Hoover Dam to give a speech to the troops and award a medal to Private Watson for his bravery and service to the NCR.

The President is scheduled to arrive via vertibird from California. The vertibird will land on the top of the Visitor's Center where Colonel Moore will meet the President and escort him out to the stage.

After a brief introduction by Colonel Moore, the President will give his speech. The speech will only take approximately four minutes. During the speech the President will award a medal to Private Jeremy Watson for his service to the NCR.

Once the speech is over, the President will be escorted directly back through the visitor center to his vertibird for immediate departure.

In event of an emergency, the speech will be canceled and the President will be rushed to the vertibird for immediate departure. If the is a problem with the vertibird, a room on the second level of the visitor center will be used as a safe room to keep the President secure until any threat is over. Access to this room has been restricted and Colonel Moore has the key in her desk.
translation:
胡佛水坝总统访问日程

总统将访问胡佛水坝，向士兵做一场演讲，并为列兵沃森颁发NCR卓越功勋奖章。

总统将乘坐飞鸟直升机从加州抵达这里。飞鸟直升机将降落在访客中心顶层，莫尔上校会在那里迎接总统，并护送他前往演讲台。

在莫尔上校做完简短的介绍后，总统将发表演讲。演讲大约持续四分钟。演讲过程中，总统会为列兵杰里米·沃森颁发NCR服务勋章。

演讲结束后，总统将在军方的护送下回到访客中心，然后乘专机启程离开。

一旦发生紧急事态，演讲立刻取消，总统必须马上乘坐飞鸟撤离。假如飞鸟出现问题，访客中心二层的一个房间将作为安全屋，用以保障总统安全，直到危机解除。该房间严格限制人员入内，只有莫尔上校的书桌抽屉里才有房间钥匙。

original: Prison Break
translation: 越狱

original:
A promising development, if I do say so myself! It seems things went to hell at the NCR Correctional Facility north of here, and escaped prisoners are roaming free. 

Sounds like a bad thing - and would be, if not for the political acumen and interpersonal alchemy of yours truly, Mayor Joseph B. Steyn, Esq. I sent the Jims out to make contact with the prisoners (or "Powder Gangers," rather - they insist on this name) to let them know Nipton's open for trade - with free turns with the girls as door prizes. 

Ha! You know they went for that deal. As sold by Little Jim, anyway. Big Jim, R.I.P.

I see a lot of potential here so long as I can keep the NCR troops and Powders (ridiculous name) from running into each other and shooting it out in the streets. Luckily, the troopers only come at night (double entendre), so if the Powders will only come during the day (again), I'll have them coming (third time, the charm) and going. 

Yours in confidence, 

Mayor Joseph B. Steyn, Esq.
translation:
我可以大言不惭地说，局势有了可喜的发展！北边的NCR监狱似乎出事了，逃犯们正在四处作乱呢。

虽然听上去是坏事，但若不是你有敏锐和政治头脑和人际交往方面的天才，恐怕就真要把它当坏事了，我敬爱的约瑟夫·B·斯泰恩镇长先生。我已经派吉姆兄弟出去和那些犯人联系（也可以叫他们“炸药帮”，他们坚持要用这个称呼），让他们知道尼普顿已经开放贸易——做完生意还能抽奖，中奖的人能免费和姑娘睡一觉。

哈！他们肯定吃了这一套。反正小吉姆是这么说的。安息啦，大吉姆。

在我看来，局势大有可为，不过我得确保NCR士兵和炸药帮（真是个怪名字）不会在街上撞见然后打成一团。好在士兵们只在晚上来（这是个双关语），所以只要炸药帮在白天来（又一个双关），我就能确保他们每个人都有来有回（第三次双关，漂亮）。

敬礼，

约瑟夫·B·斯泰恩镇长先生

original: Hidden Valley Info
translation: 隐谷信息

original: The initial testing of ARCHIMEDES was a success, though not an unqualified one. Several minor systems were overloaded despite all precautions taken, and the two and a half minutes of downtime following the test is something we can work on improving.\n\nMore importantly, we received reports from nearby facilities that they experienced system-frying power fluctuations at the time of the test, notably the Black Mountain communications array and the military bunkers at Hidden Valley. We're going to make it a priority next time to prevent such collateral damage.
translation: 阿基米德的初次测试虽然不能算合格，但至少是成功的。尽管预防措施已经相当周全，但仍有一部分系统发生超载，测试后还出现了两分半钟的宕机，这些都是需要改进的地方。\n\n更重要的是，我们从附近设施收到报告，他们在测试期间经历了足以烧毁整个系统的电力波动，尤其是黑山通讯天线和隐谷的军事掩体。为了预防类似间接损害的发生，我们下次会对这一事态优先考虑。

original: Guess Whose Luck Keeps Rolling?
translation: 猜猜谁的运势依旧坚挺？

original:
I can hardly believe my luck. Literally. I'm agape. 

Just now I was approached by a rather intense young man calling himself "Mr. Fox." (Yeah, right.) When we were alone in my office, he let it be known that he is a member of Caesar's Legion (!!!). 

He knew that NCR troops and Powder Gangers often spend time in Nipton. It turns out that the Legion hates and wishes to make an example of both groups, the NCR for obvious reasons, and Powder Gangers for harassing Legion raiding parties on this side of the river.

I didn't have to think a moment about Mr. Fox's proposition before accepting it. All I have to do is convince the Powders to kidnap the NCR troops at night. When both groups are in town, the Legion boys will scoop everyone up. Ha!

For this simple task, I have been offered 8,000 CAPS!!! I could almost go back to the NCR right away... but who knows how much else I might make off this Legion lackey?

I'm going to start stockpiling some supplies in a safe house between here and the Mojave Outpost, just in case I decide to head back home in a hurry...

Very exciting!

Signed, with a steady hand,
(on the keyboard) 

Super-Mayor Joseph B. Steyn, III Esq.
translation:
我简直不敢相信自己的运气。一点也不夸张，我整个人都目瞪口呆。

刚才有位十分热情的年轻人登门来访，他管自己叫“狐狸先生”（千真万确）。我留他在办公室里私聊，他居然告诉我自己是凯撒军团的一员。（！！！）

他知道NCR军队和炸药帮经常来尼普顿消遣。看来军团对这情况相当不爽，他们想给两边各自一点颜色看看。原因嘛，NCR自然不用说，炸药帮则是因为他们经常骚扰河流沿岸的军团突击队。

我没有半点犹豫就接受了狐狸先生的提议。我只需要说服炸药帮在半夜去绑架NCR的人。等两帮人都进入镇子后，军团的人就会把他们一网打尽。哈！

这样一桩简单的差事，我居然能赚到8000枚瓶盖！！！我都能拿着这些钱回NCR老家了……可谁知道那个军团狗腿子还能给我捞到多少油水呢？

我得开始在莫哈维前哨站附近的安全屋里屯些物资了，免得哪天突然要回老家……

太令人兴奋了！

用一只稳稳的手签名
（在键盘上）

超级镇长约瑟夫·B·斯泰恩三世 先生

translation: 图纸 - 土制炸药

translation: 这张图纸可以教你制作土制炸药。

original: Declaration of Vital Essence
translation: 生命精元的宣言

original:
I, Harry Collins, hereby declare sole proprietorship of vital essence and claim hereto all legitimate rights  in defending said essence versus all comers, QED.

Town's been going to hell ever since Mayor Steyn waltzed in from out west saying he'd put Nipton on the map. Well, we know the real reasons he come to town. He come for my vital essence.

And then more come. The town's been growing by the day. All of them coming for my vital essence, as if I didn't know it.

And then more come. Asking questions like "Harry, why you spend all your time in that house of yours? You got something special in there?" Sniffing around for my essence is what they're doing.

I've had enough. I'm locking up my essence, and I'm setting up defenses. No one's going to get their hands on my vital essence except ol' Harry himself.

Come what may, 

Harry Collins
translation:
我，哈利·柯林斯，在此声明生命精元为我独有，并借助该声明，对任何试图夺取精元的不速之客保留诉诸武力的合法权利。

自从西边凭空冒出一个斯泰恩镇长，说要将尼普顿建设成地标后，整个小镇就变得一团糟。我们知道他来到这个小镇的真实目的，他是来抢我的生命精元的。

现在人越来越多，小镇也越来越拥挤。所有人都是为了我的生命精元而来的，别以为我不知道他们的目的。

又来了更多的人，他们老问我这样的问题，比如：“哈利，为什么你一直呆在房子里？里面是不是有些特别的东西？”到处打探我的生命精元，这就是他们的所作所为。

我受够了，我已经把精元锁了起来，并在周围建立了防御。谁也休想碰它，除了我自己。

放马过来吧，

哈利·柯林斯

original: Ambitions!
translation: 理想！

original:
Things are finally looking up! I got both Gutsies up and running, and this terminal working too so I can keep a regular journal! 

Fixed up a terminal for Mayor Steyn too, so he can run his numbers, and got a free turn with Rose as payment! Dare I say: Yeah!

All I need now is for a new gal to come to Nipton, one who doesn't know anything about me. If I can get to her and show her my Gutsies before anyone else can turn her against me, she'll be impressed and that'll do it. It *has* to do it. It's not like every man out there can fix up a robot. I'll tell her she'd never have to do housework, that'd be the clincher. It would be so nice not to have to pay Rosie.

This writing stuff is harder that I thought. I'd better stop here.

p.s.
For maximum impact, only show one Gutsy to gal, let admiration take hold, *then* reveal second Gutsy.
translation:
事情终于迎来转机了！我的两架勇敢先生都开始运转了，这台终端也能正常工作了，以后我就能随时更新日志了！

我为斯泰恩镇长修好了终端，好让他能继续数钱，作为回报，我可以和罗茜免费睡一觉！真是太爽了！

现在，我只需要再找个姑娘来尼普顿，一个对我一无所知的姑娘。只要我能带着她回来，让她看我的勇敢先生，趁镇上的人还没来得及挑唆她讨厌我，她一定会留下好印象，那时候就大功告成了，绝对能成。天底下可不是每个男人都懂得捣鼓机器人。我会告诉她，她永远都不用再做家务，这可是俘获她芳心的杀手锏啊。到了那时候，就不必再花钱找罗茜了。

写这东西比我想象得要难，我还是停笔吧。

附：
为了保证效果，我打算先给女孩看一台勇敢先生，等崇拜之情在她心里扎根，再给她看第二台。

original: New Terminal
translation: 新的终端

original:
Tony was kind enough to build this terminal and set it up for me. All for 30 caps worth of Rosie. Ha!

The life of a Mayor suits me just fine. I'm glad I didn't go any further east. I'm making plenty of caps right here off Rosie and Sylvia, who attract plenty of interest from troops at the Mojave Outpost. (Guess you spend enough time standing around that backwater and you're ready to hop on something that looks like a Molerat and doesn't smell much better.) And the local "shops" are all giving me a percentage of sales to the troops because it's my girls who bring them in. Ha! They think they're shrewd negotiators for getting me to accept a 15% cut instead of 20%.

Another year in this dump, two at the most, and it's back to Hub for me. Maybe I'll run for office there! Ha!

Mayor Joseph B. Steyn
(Doesn't that look official!)
translation:
托尼真是好人，他替我倒腾好了这个终端，而报酬只是和那个值30块钱的婊子罗茜睡了一觉。哈！

镇长的日子很适合我，我很高兴没有继续往东走。我已经靠着罗茜和西尔维娅赚了不少瓶盖，她们招徕了许多莫哈维前哨站的士兵。（我估计人只要在这穷山恶水的地方待得足够久，就会对所有和鼹鼠长得差不多的东西产生性趣，哪怕气味不怎么样。）当地的“商店”卖东西给士兵时还会给我一定比例的回扣，因为是我的姑娘帮他们拉来了客人。哈！他们和我商定只准拿15%，还以为自己个个都是谈判专家呢。

在这个垃圾场再呆一年，至多两年，我就回枢纽市。等到那时，我说不定还能讨到一官半职呢！哈哈！

镇长约瑟夫·B·斯泰恩
（是不是很正式！）

original: Henchman Message to Andy Scabb
translation: 手下给安迪·斯卡布的字条

original:
Looks like you were right.

The Hostetler man always carries a full pouch back to their house, every night. The same pouch's empty whenever he goes work to Crimson Caravan, Fred's seen it himself.

No chance in hell this is all a coincidence. He's bringing something with him whenever he leaves work. That's gotta be his daily cut from the business.

Alice's gonna have to find all that dough for us. If we get caught near their place her bitch mother's gonna snap for the big guns... That'll make Crandon, or worse, Jules, come after us. I ain't too happy about risking my neck for nothing, Andy.

Let's make sure Alice's a good doggie first, then do whatever you want with her once we are outta this fucking hole.

M.
translation:
看来你说中了。

霍斯泰特勒家的男人每晚都带着满满一袋子东西回家。第二天他去深红商队上班的时候，袋子就空了，弗雷德也看到了。

这绝不可能是巧合。他每次下班都带东西回家，里面装的肯定就是他每天生意的收成了。

这笔钱就让爱丽丝帮我们偷吧。要是我们在她家附近被抓到，她那臭老娘肯定会端出那把大号鸟枪对准咱们…更糟的是，克兰登，甚至儒勒，都会来找我们麻烦。我可不想白白丢掉性命，安迪。

先让爱丽丝乖乖听话，等我们离开这鸟不拉屎的鬼地方，你想怎么处置她都行。

M.

original: Overseer's Journal Fragment
translation: 监督的日志残片

original: Page 67\n... fighting settled slightly following the announcement of the damage to the reactor before panic overtook the vault's residents. The technicians struggled to repair the damage to the reactor and main computer systems. We learned too late that as part of an automatic safety protocol the reactor had been reconfigured to use alternative pipe lines for its cooling systems, unfortunately with the damage to the mainframe the system was unable to detect the structural damage to the vault. Radioactive gasses pumped through the broken pipes and irradiated the vault. On top of it all, we cannot open the vault's main door. All systems appear to be on autopilot and manual override functions have been disabled. We'll just have to hope we can survive long enough for the door to open automatically...
translation: 67页\n……反应堆受损的状况公布后，战斗逐渐平息下来，不久恐慌便席卷了整个避难所。技术人员虽然在努力修复反应堆和主计算机系统，但我们知道的太晚了，作为自主安全协议的一部分，反应堆已经重新启动备用管道来充当其冷却系统，不幸的是，由于中央主机遭受了毁坏，系统无法检测避难所遭受到的结构性损坏。放射性气体通过裂开的管道渗进了避难所。最重要的是，我们没法打开避难所的大门，所有系统似乎都是自动运行的，手动操作被禁用了。我们只能寄希望于活到大门自动打开的那一天……

original: Overseer's Journal Fragment
translation: 监督的日志残片

original: Page 65\n... real trouble began when a fair number of residents began to call for population control. Foreseeing the issue spiraling out of control I ordered one of the technicians to hook up a locking mechanism linking the armory door to the terminal in my office. The news of the armory being closed off angered a sizable group of residents, they stated it was their right to defend themselves and demanded that they be given access to the armory once more, and I of course denied this request...
translation: 65页\n……已经有相当数量的居民呼吁进行人口控制，真正的麻烦开始了。我早预见到局势最终会失去控制，便命令一位技术人员在军械库门口安装了一个闭锁系统，它直接连到我的办公室。军械库关闭的消息惹恼了很大一部分居民，他们声称自卫是应有的权利，要求再次获准进入军械库。我当然拒绝了他们的要求…

original: Overseer's Journal Fragment
translation: 监督的日志残片

original: Page 66\n... riots began soon after; during the peak of the violence, the group calling for free access to the armory stormed the vault's exit and left. The door was sealed after them and additional guards were stationed at the exit; this proved to be a grave mistake. With the additional guards at the exit there were fewer to patrol the halls, none of them were prepared for the group that ambushed the armory. The guards were able to defend their position, but not before the damage was done, during the fight one of the reactors cooling vents was damaged.
translation: 66页\n……骚乱进一步升级；在混乱中，要求进入军械库的那伙人打开了避难所的大门，逃之夭夭。他们离开后，我封闭了大门，还派了更多警卫把守；事后证明这是一个严重的错误。出口处的警卫多了，大厅中巡逻的警卫就少了，一小撮人伏击了军械库，而警卫们对此毫无戒备。虽然最终守住了阵地，但依然付出了代价——在争斗中，一个反应堆的冷却通风口坏了。

original: Tomas's Journal
translation: 托马斯的日记

original: The last entry of the journal reads:\n\nThings finally seem to be turning around. I made a nice bundle of caps turning in some scrap in the last town I passed, and now I have a new traveling companion. Her name is Jacklyn, and she's pretty cute. I'm not going to get ahead of myself here, but things are looking up! And to think, I was actually beginning to doubt the power of my lucky necklace!
translation: 日记的最后一个条目是这样的：\n\n事情终于看起来有点转机了。我在上个镇子的垃圾堆里找了一点废品，用它们换来了一把瓶盖，现在我终于有一个新旅伴了。她的名字叫做贾克琳，她很可爱。我知道有些话不能说的太早，但是一切都在变好！仔细想想，也许那条幸运项链真的起作用了。

original: Note from Corporal White
translation: 怀特下士的字条

original:
Trent,

I know no one in the NCR military believes you when you say water's gone missing, but I do. I'll meet up with you at the fields tomorrow and go over the evidence with you. Once I've confirmed my findings, I can go to Lieutenant Romanowski and get to the bottom of this once and for all.

- White
translation:
特伦特，

你说我们的水流到别处去了，部队里的其他人都不相信你，但我信。我明天来找你，我们一起去寻找证据。只要确凿无疑，我就去找罗曼诺夫斯基中尉，一定把它查个水落石出。

——怀特

original: Reprimand Recommendation
translation: 谴责信

original:
Boyd,

Corporal White has once again been wasting my time with his crazy ideas about a water shortage. He was borderline insubordinate, and you need to put your people on a tighter leash. White's gone off to Westside to speak with that Follower of the Apocalypse, Tom Anderson, so look for him there.

- Romanowski
translation:
博伊德，

怀特下士又来浪费我的时间了，他老说什么我们缺水。这个人桀骜难驯，我看你得好好管教一下你的属下才是。怀特去西区找天启追随者的汤姆·安德森了，你要找他就去那儿吧。

—— 罗曼诺夫斯基

original: Note to Tyrone
translation: 泰隆的字条

original:
Tyrone, you cheating bastard. Those supplies were paid up in full - you can't just raise the price all of a sudden. I can't afford the price, and besides, what am I going to tell Melissa?

When you get this note, come up to Sloan. We need to talk.

- Chomps
translation:
泰隆，你这个骗人的混蛋。那些货我已经付了全款，你不能突然提价。我给不了那么多钱，另外，我该怎么和梅丽莎交代？

你如果收到这张便条，就来斯隆找我，我们需要谈谈。

——托姆斯

original: Hoover Dam Security Duty Roster
translation: 胡佛大坝安保执勤名单

original:
Attn: Security Personnel
RE: Security Assignments for President's Visit

The basic assignments are this: 
-Rangers will secure the perimeter and keep an eye out for any external threats.
-Additional Rangers will be stationed around the stage and the crowd. Their primary job is to keep an eye on the crowd to make sure nothing funny happens.

I want sharpshooters positioned at the following potential sniper locations:
Visitor Center Roof
Western Ridge
Dam Tower 1 Roof - I want a radio up here to check in.

Stay frosty today. Nothing bad is going to happen on our watch.

-Grant
translation:
收件人：安保人员
回复：总统访问的安保执勤表

基本安排如下：
- 游骑兵负责外围安保，时刻留意外部威胁。
- 另一部分游骑兵安排在演讲台和观众附近。他们的主要工作是盯住人群，防止出现意外情况。

下列可能出现狙击手的位置必须部署神枪手：
接待中心的屋顶
西部山脊
水坝塔楼1层屋顶——在这里架设一台无线电，以便随时联络。

保持清醒。有我们在，今天绝不会出任何麻烦。

——格兰特

original: Hoover Dam Security Report
translation: 胡佛大坝安全报告

original:
Security Report - Ranger Grant

With the President's arrival today, security is running a final sweep of the area making preparations.

Only members of the security team will have weapons at the President's speech. This means that all Troopers at the speech must relinquish their weapons beforehand.

We will limit people allowed to see the speech to a small number to reduce any potential risk to the President.

I've gotten word that the President is traveling with only two Rangers, so our security team will need to be on full alert.

I'd still like to log my concerns about not having enough time to prepare for this, but we'll do our job here today.

-Grant
translation:
安全报告——游骑兵格兰特

总统今天就要来访，安保人员正在对来访区域做最后的排查。

只有安保小组成员在总统演讲时才能配备武器，这意味着在演讲开始之前，所有士兵都必须将武器上缴。

我们会尽量控制观众人数，以减少总统可能面临的风险。

听说总统身边只有两名游骑兵保护，因此我们的安保团队必须时刻保持高度戒备。

我确实很想抱怨，给我们准备的时间实在太少，但今天我们一定会履行好自己的职责。

格兰特

original: Hoover Dam Engineering Report
translation: 胡佛大坝工程报告

original:
Engineering Report - Mike Lawson

We've received word that the President's vertibird is having some issues with the flight control computer. I've had some of the techs here examine the logs that were sent and we think we can fix the issue with a small computer update. Ranger Grant has given me permission to have one of the NCR Engineers examine the vertibird when it arrives as well as having our computer update the vertibird's systems after it arrives.

Mike Lawson
translation:
工程报告——麦克·罗森

我们收到消息说总统乘坐的飞鸟直升机的飞控电脑出了点问题。我派了几个技师检查了系统日志，我们觉得只要稍微更新一下系统就能解决这个问题。游骑兵格兰特已允许我在总统抵达之后带一名NCR工程师上机检查，并用我们的电脑更新飞鸟的控制系统。

麦克·罗森

original: Legion Slave Ledger
translation: 军团奴隶清单

original: This ledger is an extensive record of the Legion's prior dealings with tribal societies it has encountered in its expansion.\n\nOf particular interest is the fate of the Twisted Hair tribe of Arizona, who formed an alliance with Caesar to serve as his army's scouts during the conquest of that region. Once the Arizona wastes were pacified, the Legion turned on its erstwhile allies, stripped them of their tribal identity, and forced them into slavery. Those who resisted were crucified along the remains of Interstate 40.
translation: 这份清单详细记述了军团在扩张过程中与沿途各部落所进行的交易。\n\n其中值得一提的是亚利桑那的缠发部落，他们曾与凯撒缔结盟约，在凯撒征服该地区的过程中为他充当眼线。亚利桑那平定后，军团迅速将矛头指向昔日的盟友，剥夺了他们的部落身份，强迫他们成为了奴隶。而所有反抗者的尸体都被钉在了40号州际公路的边上。

original: Karl's Journal
translation: 卡尔的日志

original: This journal consists of detailed records and observations from Karl's time with the Great Khans. Many of the entries go into great detail about his opinion of their "savage, barbarous customs," and at several points he waxes philosophic about how it's very likely that Caesar's Legion will have to execute the lot of them.
translation: 这本日志包含了卡尔对大汗帮详细的观察记录，其中不少地方明确表达了他对大汗帮的看法：“行为肮脏的野蛮人”。他甚至深刻地指出，也许凯撒有一天会不得不把他们赶尽杀绝。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: It took some doing, but a few of us got together and managed to distract the people in the clinic long enough for me to get in and do some looking around, I found restraints and enough sedatives to kill a horse. She must be using them to control us, to make us forget, we're just pawns in her sick game.
translation: 虽然费了一番周折，但我们几个人总算想办法将诊所里的人全都引开了，我趁机溜进去调查了一番。我发现了拘束用的绑带，以及量大到足够杀死一匹马的镇静剂。她肯定是用这些来控制我们，强迫我们忘记的。我们只是她这场病态游戏中的棋子。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: We confronted the doctor today, she refused to give us any information, and we were thrown out of the clinic, some of us quite literally. We tried talking to the overseer, but acted as if he didn't know anything about it. I don't believe him, I don't trust him, and I don't trust any of them.
translation: 我们今天与医生当面对质，但她拒绝给我们透露任何情报，我们被轰出了诊所，有些人几乎是被抬出去的。我们去找了监督，可他好像完全不知情。我不相信他，我不信任他，我不信任他们任何人。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: Some of the Blues caused some trouble in the clinic today. I bet they were stealing drugs, I've heard the vents coming on late at night, others have too, and I bet they are using the drugs to poison us; stealing supplies from the clinic and using them to kill us all.
translation: 今天有几个蓝军的人跑到诊所里捣乱。我打赌他们是来偷药的，我听见通风口半夜有声响，其他人也听见了，我敢打赌一定是他们在对我们下药；他们从诊所里偷了药品，还企图用这些药来残害我们。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: No, I know the truth, the commotion at the clinic, it was a trick, the doctor must be giving them the drugs, and she must be in on it. She never leaves her office; it must be because of the poison being pumped through the vents. Her office must be the only one that is safe.
translation: 不，我知道了，诊所里的骚动只不过是假象，药是医生给他们的，她也是帮凶。她从来就没出过办公室的门，肯定是因为毒气就是从通风管里排出来的，而只有她的办公室才是唯一安全的地方。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: There's something strange about that other overseer; I think he's up to something. Maybe we were given different orders? Maybe this is all just in my head; the experiments we are conducting must be starting to affect me. The noises, I'm sure there is a perfectly logical explanation for them. I'll have write him, after all we aren't to be seen speaking to each other. Tomorrow then, maybe after a good night's sleep my mind will be in better order.
translation: 另一个监督有点奇怪，他可能在搞什么鬼名堂。也许我们接到的指令不一样？也可能这一切都是我臆想出来的。一定是我们正在进行的实验影响到了我。这个噪音，它肯定有一个合理的解释。我要写出来给他看，毕竟我们不能相互沟通。明天再说吧，也许睡个好觉我的头脑就会清醒一些。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: Again, not two hours after I had fallen, asleep I heard that noise again, it's mechanical, like something heavy being pushed then, it's hard to describe, something that sounds like an elevator perhaps? I've seen the blueprints of the vault, there's no way there could be an elevator there; what would it lead to? I think I'll take a walk around on the second floor, it is late no one will notice me, besides if anyone did it might be good for the experiment anyway.
translation: 又一次，在我睡着后不到两小时，我又听到那个噪音了，这是机械发出来的噪音，感觉是某种重型设备启动了，很难描述，大概听起来像电梯？我看过避难所的设计图，这里不可能有电梯。那它究竟是从哪儿来的？我要去二楼看看，现在很晚了，没人会注意到我。再说，就算有人注意到了，也许对实验反而更有帮助。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I saw the Red's overseer walking around on our floor last night, he looked like he was searching for something and he was mumbling to himself.
translation: 我昨晚看到红军的监督跑到我们的地盘上晃荡，他好像在寻找什么东西，而且他还一直喃喃自语。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original:
-data corrupted-
... fake medical records. Paranoia must be induced through non-violent and non-chemical means in order for the experiment to be considered a success. 
-data corrupted-
...a group of technicians have been assigned to run the reactor, they are currently researching methods to improve the reactor efficiently. The reactor floor is fully staffed and completely self sustained. The only access between the vault proper and the reactor level is through the elevator hidden under the desk in this room. Currently the password to open this passage is 'Hyacinth'; please change this password a...
-data corrupted-
...has not been informed of the research being undertaken in the lower levels.
translation: #NAME?

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: Voices, I can hear them through the vents. They sound like plotting, they sound like hate, the Blues never sit with us, they treat us as if we have a disease; maybe we do, this whole vault is sick.
translation: 有说话声，我可以从通风口里听到。他们像是在密谋什么，好像是仇恨，蓝军从来不和我们坐在一起，仿佛我们身上有传染病似的，也许真的有吧，整个避难所都病了。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: The others keep telling me not to worry, but I feel it sometimes; I think there's something in here with us. I can always hear weird noises coming from above my room.
translation: 其他人都告诉我不要担心，但我有时还是能感觉到；我觉得这地方似乎有东西。我经常能听到房间上方传来奇怪的噪音。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I haven't been able to sleep lately, one of the Blues, he's always creeping around by the security door, and I think he's trying to get in.
translation: 我最近睡不着，蓝军中有一个人经常在安全门前鬼鬼祟祟的，我觉得他是想进去。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I think they're in my head, sometimes I hear thoughts not my own. I think the Reds have done something to the intercom system, rigged it somehow to broadcast into our brains.
translation: 我觉得它们就在我的脑海里，有时我会听到不属于自己的想法。我敢肯定红军对通讯器做了手脚，他们在利用语音对我洗脑。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I've been reading the bulletin boards for months now; I believe we have a spy among us, one of the Reds pretending to be a Blue. They are using the bulletin boards to communicate; I believe they want me to see it.
translation: 最近几个月我一直在坚持阅读公告板，我敢说我们中间出了间谍，有红军的人假扮成了蓝军。他们在用公告板传递情报，肯定是故意让我看见的。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I've noticed one of the lights flickering past the door in the Reds' hallway. I believe it to be morose code, from what I can tell it's an S.O.S.
translation: 我注意到红军走廊的门后面有一盏灯在不停地闪烁。我相信那是莫尔斯代码，可以辨认出来那是求救信号。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: Greetings residents,\nWe regret to inform you that there is a problem with one of the water purification filters. We assure you that we are working diligently to fix this problem; however, until the filter has been fixed please try to keep water usage limited and report directly to the clinic if you begin to feel ill in anyway.
translation: 各位居民好，\n我们很遗憾地通知你们，有一个净水器的过滤设备坏了。我向你们保证，我们正在努力解决这个问题，但在过滤器修好之前，请尽量节约用水，如果你感到不舒服，可直接向诊所报告。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I can hear noises through the intercoms sometimes, dad says he can't hear it, but I can. It's really high pitch and sometimes I can hear a voice, but I can't make out the words. Mom says it's my imagination and that I shouldn't talk about it, that it might worry people, but I've talked to some of the other kids, they say they've heard it too.
translation: 有时候我会从对讲机里听到噪音，爸爸说他听不见，但我可以。声调很高，有时候我能听出是人在说话，但听不出说了什么。妈妈说这都是我胡思乱想，叫我不能说出去，因为可能会引起别人的恐慌，但我已经和其他几个小伙伴谈过了，他们说他们也听到了。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I've been asking around, there is no reason for those filters to fail, it must have been sabotaged, there's a rumor going around that one of the Reds did it. It wouldn't surprise me, whenever I walk by a group of them in the cafeteria they all start whispering, I bet they're plotting out what to do next.
translation: 我问了一些人，过滤器没理由坏掉，肯定是有人捣乱。有传言说是红军干的。我一点也不觉得惊讶，每次我去餐厅，经过他们身边的时候，都能听到他们在窃窃私语。我打赌他们一定在耍什么阴谋诡计。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I couldn't sleep a few nights ago, so I stayed up reading, around 1:30 in the morning the vent above my bed began to push out more air than usual; it lasted for about five minutes then turned off. I did not think much of it at the time, but I had trouble falling asleep again last night; once again around 1:30 AM the vents turned on for about five minutes then turned off.
translation: 我几个晚上前就开始失眠了，所以我通宵读书。在大约凌晨一点半的时候，我床上方的通风管开始喷出比平时更多的气体。它持续了大约五分钟，然后停止了。我当时没有想太多，但我昨晚又失眠了，同样是在凌晨一点半，通风管打开了大约五分钟后就关闭了。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I've been getting headaches; I think someone is poisoning us. I've been up every night this week, and night after night, an extra boost of air comes through the vents, it lasts for about five minutes, and then turns off. I spoke with one of the neighbors; he said he noticed the same thing in his room as well. We made a report the maintenance officer; he informed us that the system was running perfectly and that there was nothing to worry about, I don't believe him, maybe he's in on it.
translation: 我开始头痛了，我怀疑有人在给我们下毒。这周我每天晚上都会醒来，而每晚也都会有大量的气体从通风口中涌出来，持续大约五分钟然后关闭。我和一个邻居说了这件事，他说他的房间里也出了这种事。我们把这一情况报告给了维修人员，他却说系统运转良好，无需多虑，我不相信他，也许这件事他也有份。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I don't trust that doctor; she has bodyguards, what kind of doctor has bodyguards? I've seen the guards bringing her meals; I don't think she ever leaves her office. There's always one posted outside at night too. I wonder what she's hiding.
translation: 我不信任那个医生；她身边有保镖，什么样的医生会配保镖？我亲眼看见保镖给她带饭；我觉得她从来就没离开过办公室。晚上也有人在诊所外面站岗。她肯定藏了什么猫腻。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: I've been working with a friend, he's been trying to hack into the doc's computer, and so far, we haven't had much luck.
translation: 我打算和一个朋友合作，他正在尝试入侵医生的电脑。不过到目前为止，我们都还没取得什么成果。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: It took some convincing, but I finally got him to show me what he found on the doc's computer. He was right, I wouldn't like it. The patient files looked like those from an asylum, the patient names were all in code, but some of them seemed to fit the people around us. But they can't be us! I don't remember being insane, I think I would remember something like that. But, it must be true; it explains the doctor's behavior and the bodyguards, I don't know why I can't remember. It must be that doctor, maybe she's drugging us. I need to get into that office.
translation: 我好不容易才说服他，最后他终于给我看了他在医生电脑中找到的文件。他说的对，我不会喜欢的。这些病历简直就是疯人院里的大杂烩，所有患者的名字都是乱码，但部分人的情况却和我们周围的人极其相似。这不可能啊！我不记得自己发过疯，如果真的有，那我至少也该有点印象。但病历是确凿无疑的，这样一来，医生那古怪的行为和保镖也就能说得通了。我不知道为什么我完全不记得。一定是医生干的，也许她给我们下了药。我必须进入那间办公室。

original: V19Note
translation: 19号避难所字条

original: Maybe, I am insane, maybe this isn't happening, maybe the war never happened, and maybe I'm just trapped in my head.
translation: 也许是我疯了，也许这一切都没有发生过，也许根本就没有战争，也许这全是我脑海中的幻象。

original: Log Entry #1836
translation: 日志条目#1836

original:
Camp Searchlight Quartermaster's Log 

Entry #1836

Supplies being shipped to the camp recently are lower than usual. I asked the Comm Officer if there were any problems with communications and he insisted that everything was fine. I contacted our supply base and was simply told that all inventory requests were being filled and that every item on my request list had been shipped to the camp. Either I'm being lied to or someone is intercepting my shipments. I'll have to look into this matter further.
translation:
探照灯营地军需官日志

日志#1836

最近送到营地的补给比平常少了。我问通讯官是不是通讯系统出了问题，他坚持说一切都很好。我联系了我们的补给站，但他们只是简单地告诉我物资申请表已经处理完毕，我申请的每件东西都已经被发往了营地。要么是我被骗了，要么就是有人半路打劫了我的补给。我要继续调查这件事情。

original: Log Entry #2257
translation: 日志条目#2257

original:
Camp Searchlight Quartermaster's Log 

Entry #2257

During my off duty hours I decided to investigate the trade route being used to bring the supplies to the camp. I met a traveler on the road and asked him if he had seen any NCR supplies bound for Camp Searchlight. He told me he had seen some NCR crates being moved somewhere outside of Nipton but didn't know where they were being taken. He also mentioned that the men with the supplies didn't look like NCR soldiers. Next time I have enough time off I'll have to make my way to Nipton to see if anyone there knows where the supplies are.
translation:
探照灯营地军需官日志

条目 #2257

我利用空闲时间调查了一下营地用于运送物资补给的道路。我在路上遇到一位旅行者，问他有没有看到送往探照灯营地的补给品。他告诉我他在尼普顿外面见到过一些标有NCR字样的板条箱，但他不知道那些箱子后来去了哪里。他也提到了押送那些箱子的人并不像NCR士兵。下次如果时间允许的话，我要亲自去尼普顿看看，也许那里会有人知道补给的下落。

original: Generator Diagnostics
translation: 发电机诊断模式

original: Attention all structural engineers:\n\nThere was a problem with the remote diagnostic protocols set up for the generators on the dam. It turns out that activating the remote diagnostics has a good chance to cause the generators to overload. Because of this the diagnostic program is going to be disabled.
translation: 全体建筑工程师注意：\n\n水坝发电机组的远程诊断协议存在一个漏洞。启动远程诊断将大概率造成发电机过载。因此该诊断程序将被禁用。

original: Halford's Note
translation: 哈尔福德的笔记

original: I've found it possible to create a sort of makeshift weapon using all of the dog tags I've been collecting over the past month. One of these days the NCR is going to pay for their continual mismanagement and idiotic bravado.\n\n<On the backside of the page is a schematic drawing of the dog tag fist weapon.>
translation: 我发现可以用过去一个月里收集的所有狗牌做一种临时武器。总有一天NCR会为他们持续不断的管理不善和愚蠢的虚张声势付出代价。

original: Comm Station Password
translation: 贸易站密码

original: This is Veronica's password to a comm station she used to communicate with Father Elijah, former elder of the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 这是维罗妮卡的通讯密码，她用这个来和以利亚联系，他是钢铁兄弟会的前任长老。

original: Log Page 12
translation: 日志第12页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sergeant Banner Reporting

Day 12

We managed to get the rest of the path cleared. Some pre-war fencing was mostly intact, and we were able to set it up as a makeshift barrier, on the more dangerous cliffs. I hope none of these jarheads fall off. We found a few cave entrances, as we were clearing rubble. They lead back to each other, with just a single collapsed path which appears to lead down into the mountain. The damn survey team didn't mention any caves. I hope we don't find any more little surprises.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第十二天

我们把剩下的道路全都清理干净了。战前留下的围栏有一部分仍旧完好，我们把它们立了起来，在陡峭的悬崖边做了一些临时的屏障。希望这些士兵不会掉下去。我们在清理废墟的时候发现一些洞穴入口，它们是相互贯通的，只有一处崩塌的隧道似乎通往山里。该死的调查小组根本没有提到这儿还有个洞。希望不会再发现什么小惊喜。

original: Log Page 18
translation: 日志第18页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sergeant Banner Reporting

Day 18

We finally got the radio from McCarran. I've set it up on the peak so anyone on overwatch duty can quickly radio in if the Legion makes a move. I'd like to know which genius back at command decided to send a squad to this location, but didn't think to give us a radio so we could actually call in an attack. Probably another politician's son.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第十八天

我们终于从麦卡伦那里拿到了无线电。我把它架设在山顶，这样任何一个放哨的人看到军团有所行动，就能立刻发出广播。也不知道指挥部里是哪个天才想的主意，往这里派侦察队，却没想到要配一台用来通报情况的无线电。大概又是一个官二代吧。

original: Log Page 13
translation: 日志第13页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sergeant Banner Reporting

Day 13

It's been almost a week, and still no sign of a radio from McCarran. I'm sending a runner to Bravo to see if they can spare a handheld or any other radio gear, until McCarran can get around to sending the gear I requested. I swear those dumb bastards back at command expect us to use carrier pigeons or something.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第十三天

已经快一周了，麦卡伦还是没有批给我们无线电设备。我派了一个人去布拉沃驻站，问他们能不能借一台手持的无线电设备给我们，好让我们能撑到电台批下来为止。我估计大本营里的那些混蛋是打算让我们用信鸽来传递情报了。

original: Log Page 20
translation: 日志第20页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sergeant Banner Reporting

Day 20

More surprises. Collins came across a cave entrance right behind our damn tent. The survey team should have caught this if they'd done a thorough job. I have no idea if anything is in there, but we don't have the manpower to deal with any serious pests. I'm going to have some choice words for Burke the next time I see him. This isn't the first time that idiot skipped over details while surveying an area. I hope to god we're not sitting on some kind of nest. I'm going to send in Frakes and Collins to scout the caves tomorrow. If we have to, we'll use explosives to collapse the cave.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第二十天

惊喜不断。柯林斯在我们那该死的帐篷背后居然发现了一个洞口。如果调查小组有彻查过的话，他们应该早就发现了才对。我根本不知道里面有什么，我们也根本没有足够的人手来对付野生动物。下次见到伯克的时候，我一定要好好拿他是问，这已经不是第一次那白痴在勘察地形的时候粗心大意。希望我们不是驻扎在动物的巢穴边上。明天我要让柯林斯和弗雷克斯侦察一下这个洞穴。如果有必要的话，我们会用炸药把它炸塌。

original: Log Page 7
translation: 日志第7页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sgt. Banner Reporting

Day 7

Okay, we're making good headway cleaning up the paths. With only the 12 of us, I'm amazed we've moved this much rock in such a short time. Kale and I made it to the top yesterday. The survey team was right. Guardian Peak has one hell of a view, but we still have a lot of work ahead of us. I sent our runner to Bravo to request a radio from McCarran. There isn't much point in having an overwatch camp here if it takes us at least an hour to sprint to Bravo to report a Legion Assault.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第七天

很好，清理道路的工作进展非常顺利。我们虽然只有12个人，但我很惊讶我们居然可以在那么短的时间里搬运那么多沙石。凯尔和我昨天到了山顶。调查队没说错。守护者山峰视野极佳，但仍然有很多工作等着我们。我派人去了布拉沃驻站，向麦卡伦要了一套无线电设备。如果军团打过来时，我们还要花一个小时跑到驻站去报告，那在这里建造观察所就没什么意义了。

original: Log Page 3
translation: 日志第3页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sgt. Banner Reporting

Day 3

This place is a mess. Most of the old hiking trails are buried in landslides, and the rest is so dusted you can't tell which direction you're supposed to go. I don't know what the hell the survey team was thinking when they said this was a strategically sound location. At least we were issued plenty of rations and the river has plenty of fresh water. We could eat for months. Let's hope tomorrow brings some headway cleaning this place up.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第三天

这地方一团糟。古老的登山步道大多被泥石流掩埋，其余的道路则泥泞不堪，根本不知道该往哪个方向走。调查队说这是一个易受难攻的战略要地，我真不知道他们是怎么想的。还好我们有足够的口粮，有条河可以提供足够的淡水。我们可以靠这些维持好几个月。希望明天清理这个地方的工作能有点进展。

original: Mercenary Note
translation: 雇佣兵的字条

original: The Brahmin barons are an important part of Senator Morales' political base, and he's up for reelection soon. The mutants at Jacobstown need to be driven off or provoked into an attack. The senator wants to be able to show he's taking a strong stance against the mutant presence, but there can't be any blood on our hands.\n\nSo, use the same tactics as you did against those squatters back in Oak Creek. Harass the hell out of the mutants, but don't kill them unless they attack first.
translation: 双头牛大亨们是莫莱拉斯参议员重要的政治基本盘，而他马上要再度参选。因此，盘踞在雅各布斯镇的的变种人要么赶走，要么只能想办法迫使他们主动袭击人类。参议员希望能在变种生物的问题上表达强硬的立场，但我们也绝不能引火烧身。\n\n所以，你可以采用在橡树溪时对付流民的那套方法。不停骚扰那帮变种人，直到他们首先挑起事端，再动手剿灭他们。

original: Nighstalker Data
translation: 夜行兽数据

original: Astonishingly enough, the local Nightstalkers have developed a mutation not unlike the stealth field generated by Stealth Boys. Even more importantly, the brains I've dissected have shown heightened levels of endorphins and other neurochemicals, similar to what I've seen in Nightkin brains. If this mutation is natural, perhaps a cure could be synthesized from the Nightstalkers. As far as I can tell, the Nightstalkers don't suffer from schizophrenia like the affected Nightkin.
translation: 令人惊讶的是，当地的夜行兽已经发生了一种突变，它和隐身小子产生的隐形力场不同。更重要的是，我解剖的大脑显示，夜行兽脑中内啡肽和其他神经化学物质的含量有所提高，这与我在夜行族的大脑中发现的相似。如果这一突变是自然现象，也许可以从夜行兽身上合成出一种新药。目前据我所知，夜行兽不像夜行族那样会受到精神分裂症的影响。

original: Stealth Boy Prototype
translation: 试用型隐身小子

original: The Stealth Boy Mark II prototype is functional - sort of. The Enclave data wasn't complete so I had to make a few guesses here and there. Unfortunately, the data also suggests that while the stealth field has a greater duration, the negative effects on the user are exponentially greater. I can use this to my advantage - the brain wave changes will be more pronounced and it'll be much easier to to figure out what exactly is needed to cure the Nightkin schizophrenia.\n\nLily has graciously volunteered to be my test subject, despite the risk.
translation: 隐身小子二型的原型设备看起来还算运转良好。英克雷的数据不完整，所以我只能进行推测。更糟糕的是，数据表明虽然隐身立场的持续时间延长了，但对使用者的副影响也变大了，并以指数级增加。我可以充分利用这一点，因为脑波变化会更加明显，也就更容易发现治疗夜行族精神疾病的关键。\n\n莉莉不顾危险，她很热情地自愿想做我的实验对象。

original: Keene
translation: 基恩

original: Keene seems to have caught on about the Stealth Boy Mark II prototype. I told him that it was in no way functional, but I'm not entirely sure he believed me. I'll have to keep an eye on him.
translation: 基恩似乎听说了隐身小子二型原型机的事情。我告诉他现在这东西还不能用，但他似乎不相信我说的话。我以后得多加留意他。

original: Log Page 5
translation: 日志第5页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sgt. Banner Reporting

Day 5

We've managed to shovel most of the debris up to the first bridge. This thing looks like a wreck. Thankfully, there were a few wooden shacks around we can dismantle for scrap to rebuild. I just hope we don't run out of scrap before we finish the trail. Jackson says he heard some kind of howling the other night. It sounded like the wind to me.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第五天

我们把大部分的残砖碎瓦都铲到了第一座桥下。这桥看起来快散架了。值得庆幸的是，周围有几间小木屋，我们可以把它们拆掉来修补桥面。我只希望在修完栈道之前不会把这些废料用光。杰克逊说他晚上听到了嚎叫声，我觉得那只是风刮过的声音。

original: Log Page 14
translation: 日志第14页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sergeant Banner Reporting

Day 14

It's been a week and still no sign of a radio from McCarran. At least Bravo was nice enough to give us a handheld so we can relay to them in the meantime should Caesar try anything. Halford will get the radio set up if and when it finally arrives. For now he is in charge of the handheld and daily reports to Bravo.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第十四天

已经一周了，仍然没有从麦卡伦那里得到无线电的消息。好在布拉沃驻站很友善，他们给了我一台手持设备，万一凯撒突然轻举妄动，我们也不至于干瞪眼。电台到了以后，哈尔福德会把它架设好。目前由他暂时掌管这个手持电台，他会每天向布拉沃报告情况。

original: Log Page 19
translation: 日志第19页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sergeant Banner Reporting

Day 19

Ok, now I'm starting to hear noises. During my watch last night, I definitely heard splashes down in the water. I requested an additional survey from McCarran, but they blew it off as nerves. Fish don't make that much damn noise! I sent down half of the squad with lamps, but they couldn't see anything. We can't find any other cave openings. Maybe I've caught a little crazy from Jackson. I wish we had some Cateye. Can't see shit at night.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第十九天

很好，现在我也开始听到怪声了。昨晚我在放哨的时候，确凿无疑地听到了有什么东西落入水中。我请求麦卡伦再做一次调查，但他们居然说我神经过敏。妈的！鱼的动静才不会那么大呢！我派了一半人马提着灯下去查看，但什么也看不见。我们也找不到其他的洞穴入口。也许我被杰克逊传染了。真希望我们能有一些猫眼药，晚上真是什么也看不见。

original: Log Page 15
translation: 日志第15页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sergeant Banner Reporting

Day 15

The handheld is working well enough and we finished building steps up the steeper sections of the path. We can finally move the rest of our gear to the top. Last night Jackson came screaming into the tent swearing up and down he saw shadows moving in the water. I know Legionaries are know to be fast runners, but swimming across the river? I sent half of the men in pairs to search the area, but again we came up empty-handed. I'm starting to think Jackson is unstable and may need counseling. I'll request a replacement when we get the radio from McCarran.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第十五天

手持设备工作良好，我们也修好了陡坡上的台阶。终于可以把其他设备送到山顶了。昨晚杰克逊尖叫着冲进帐篷，大声发誓自己看到水中有一个影子在游动。我知道军团士兵都跑得很快，但万一他们还会游泳渡河呢？我立刻派出一半人手两两组队搜索这个地区，但我们再次空手而归。我开始觉得杰克逊有点不正常，或许他需要看心理医生。等麦卡伦营地的无线电到了，我会申请把他调走。

original: Log Page 8
translation: 日志第8页

original:
Camp Guardian Daily Log
Sgt. Banner Reporting

Day 8

More complaints of strange noises by Jackson. I'm starting to think he still has some unresolved issues after seeing his last squad wiped out by a Legion slaver squad to the south. I sent out a few men to investigate, but they couldn't find anything. I think should keep Jackson away from the munitions until he calms down.
translation:
守卫者营地日志
班纳军士汇报

第八天

杰克逊又在抱怨奇怪的声音了。我估计他在南方亲眼目睹自己的小队被军团奴隶贩子消灭后，精神就有些不太稳定。我派了一些人去调查，但他们什么都没发现。我应该让杰克逊远离军火库，直到他情绪平复下来为止。

original: Camp Searchlight Comm Officer's Log \n\nA radscorpion made it into the camp last night. Some of the troopers patrolling the border are getting sloppy. The only reason anyone noticed it was because several of the comm stations were acting oddly. When the trooper on duty went outside to check the transmitter dishes he found the scorpion chewing on several of the cables. What's the point of having patrols if shit like this is going to keep happening?
translation: 探照灯营地通讯官日志\n\n昨晚一只辐射蝎爬进了营地。看来有些巡逻的士兵是越来越马虎了。若不是几个通信站工作出现了异常，也许还不会有人发现。值班的士兵出去检查天线的时候正好看到蝎子在电缆上爬来爬去。如果今后老出这种岔子，那还要巡逻队有个屁用！

original: Communications Entry #937
translation: 交流记录#937

original:
Camp Searchlight Comm Officer's Log 

After the radscorpion incident the night patrols were shifted again.  This is the third time in the past month. I don't think they realize the problem isn't the patrols it's the troops. Every time their patrols get shifted they get confused and holes open up in the rotations for two or three days until they're used to the new schedules. I really hope the Legion doesn't figure it out and take advan...

SUDDEN TEMPERATURE INCREASE. EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN INITIATED.
translation:
探照灯营地通讯官日志

辐射蝎事件之后，夜间巡逻又换了一批人。这个月已经连续换了三次。他们怎么就没意识到，出问题的是士兵，而不是巡逻队。每次换人就会乱成一锅粥，然后警戒缺口大开，得花两到三天的时候才逐渐适应。我真希望军团不会发现这一弱点……

[[温度突然升高。执行应急关机]]

original: Communications Entry #842
translation: 交流记录#842

original: Camp Searchlight Comm Officer's Log \n\nThe Quartermaster has been bitching to me again about missing supplies and bad communications. I keep telling him that nothing is wrong with the comm system and that his numbers must be off. I don't think he believes me. The bastard will probably keep bugging me until I can either prove he's wrong or find someone else to blame. Damn it I hate this shit.
translation: 探照灯营地通讯官日志\n\n军需官又来和我啰嗦什么补给丢失和通讯不良了。我和他说了无数遍通讯系统没问题，可能是他的编码器坏了，但他似乎不相信我。这混蛋估计还会继续骚扰我，除非我能证明他错了，或者把黑锅丢到其他人头上。我真他妈的烦透了！

original: Torn Diary Page 2
translation: 撕下的日记第2页

original: Dear Diary,\n\nI took a chance today and left the animals alone to go look for Mom and Dad.  I found them in that camp, they had become horrible feral ghouls!  I didn't know what to do, they came at me so fast.  Oh god what have I done...
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n\n我今天抓住了机会离开了动物们，独自去找爸爸妈妈。我发现他们在那个营地里，他们已经变成了可怕而又野蛮的尸鬼了！我不知道应该怎么办，他们飞快地向我扑来，噢，天啊！我做了什么……

original: Torn Diary Page 3
translation: 撕下的日记第3页

original: Dear Diary,\n\nI hate being all alone, I want my Mom and Dad back, but I can't have them back because I killed them.  I didn't want to kill them but I had to kill them, otherwise they would have eaten me.  I hope the animals don't eat me.  Can animals become ghouls?
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n\n我讨厌独自一人，我想让爸爸妈妈回来，但他们再也回不来了，因为我杀了他们。我不想杀他们，但我不得不这样，否则他们就会吃了我。我希望农场里的动物不会吃了我。动物会变成尸鬼吗？

original: Torn Diary Page 4
translation: 撕下的日记第4页

original: Dear Diary,\n\nThe animals, they are evil.  They tried to eat me in my sleep.  They want the farm for themselves.  Now that Mom and Dad are gone they want the farm for themselves.  They are plotting against me, plotting to eat me.  They are becoming ghouls like my parents and they want to eat me like my parents did.  Too many of them to kill them all.  I know what I'll do, I'll burn the house down around me, then the animals can't eat me because there will be nothing left for them to eat!
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n\n那些动物，它们很邪恶。它们试图在我睡着的时候吃掉我。它们想把农场据为己有。现在爸爸妈妈都死了，它们想占领农场。它们在计划，计划吃掉我。它们变成了和我父母一样的尸鬼，它们就像我父母一样想要吃掉我。它们太多了，杀也杀不完。我知道该怎么办，我要把房子烧了，这样那些动物就不能吃我了，因为没有任何东西留给他们吃！

original: Torn Diary Page 1
translation: 撕下的日记第1页

original: Dear Diary,\n\nMom and Dad went into the NCR camp nearby to trade for supplies but they haven't come back yet. I hope nothing bad has happened to them.
translation: 亲爱的日记，\n\n爸爸妈妈为了买东西去了附近的NCR营地，但他们现在还没有回来，我希望他们不会出什么事。

original: Nellis Artillery Timing Details
translation: 内利斯火炮发射间隙详情

original: The key to avoiding the artillery is to move from building-to-building up the northwest side of town toward the front gate. Stick to the high cover in the northeast corner of the two buildings, then make a bee line for the gate. The Boomers won't shoot at their own people, so stick to the fence until you make it to the gate. Also, I know there is an old train tunnel that enters the area from the south, but no one has ever come back out of there to say it is safe.
translation: 躲避高射炮的关键是利用建筑物作为掩体，快速向城市西北方的大门移动。紧贴东北方的两幢较高的建筑，以8字形朝大门方向跑。大炮族不会向自己人开炮，所以沿着栅栏就能安全到达大门处。还有，我知道附近有一座旧火车隧道可以从南部进入他们的领地，但去那儿的人都没有回来，说明里头并不安全。
