original: I could've sworn we were under attack. Did you see those rockets?
translation: 我敢肯定我们受到攻击了。你看见那些火箭没？

original: If you're planning on staying awhile, the Dino Dee-lite's got plenty of room.
translation: 如果你打算暂住一阵，快乐小恐龙客房充足。

original: I really hope that incident at REPCONN doesn't drive people away. Novac was starting to do well!
translation: 真心希望瑞普康的事故不会把客人都吓跑。诺瓦克才刚开始有点起色！

original: With all the people passing through lately, the town's been doing better than, well, ever.
translation: 最近来往的人群多了起来，小镇现在，嗯，空前繁荣。

original: All the noise at REPCONN scared the hell out of me.
translation: 瑞普康的动静可是把我给吓坏了。

original: Don't listen to a word No-bark says. I don't think he ever sleeps, so it's no wonder he spouts nothing but nonsense.
translation: 疯嘴说的话也能信？我觉得他是太长时间没睡觉了，所以才满嘴疯言疯语的。

original: Gathering junk's not the most exciting work, but it's a living.
translation: 捡破烂虽然不是什么好差事，但好歹也能混口饭吃。

original: Good thing none of those rockets crashed into Novac.
translation: 幸好那些火箭没有一头栽进诺瓦克。

original: If it weren't for the water caravans, Novac would've turned to dust a long time ago.
translation: 如果不是送水队帮忙，诺瓦克早就成为废墟了。

original: Those rockets over at REPCONN were the NCR's doing. Trying to keep us scared so they can stick around to "protect" us.
translation: 那些从瑞普康头上飞过去的火箭准是NCR干的好事。他们就是想吓唬我们，好继续赖在这儿"保护"我们。

original: The salvage business has really slowed down since those ghouls took over REPCONN.
translation: 自从那些尸鬼霸占了瑞普康以后，废品回收业务就大受影响。

original: {Player not in NCR gear}Gotta wonder what the hell a civilian is doing here.
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}我想知道一个平民在这做什么。

original: {Player in NCR gear}You from Camp Golf or McCarran? Never mind. Don't really care.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}你从哪来？高尔夫还是麦卡伦？算了，反正我也不是真的在乎。

original: What do you want now?
translation: 你现在想要什么？

original: {Player in NCR gear}I don't remember getting informed about any new transfers to this post.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}我不记得有通知说有人要调到这个哨站来。

original: {Player not in NCR gear}This is a military post. You sure you're in the right place?
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}这里是军事驻地，你确定你没走错地方？

original: Is there something you need from me?
translation: 我能帮你什么？

original: Think you can beat the house, baby?
translation: 你以为你能赢庄家吗，宝贝？

original: Lucky 21, baby!
translation: 幸运21，宝贝！

original: Feeling lucky? I got the best table in the joint!
translation: 想试试手气吗？这可是本赌场里最好的赌桌！

original: Scram, baby, I'm on my break.
translation: 一边去，宝贝，我在休息呢。

original: Can't you see I'm taking it easy here?
translation: 没看见我正在休息吗？

original: Look, I'll be back at the table soon, baby, don't fret.
translation: 你看，我很快就回桌子边来，宝贝，不要着急。

original: Little birdies are chirping about the big Cheese of the Legion going deadsville real unexpected-like. Crazy old world, ain't it?
translation: 小鸟都叽叽喳喳地说，军团的老大不着怎么就一命呜呼了。这世界太疯狂了，不是吗？

original: You hear some crumb tried to kill the president of the NCR? Gutsy, baby. Real gutsy.
translation: 听说有些小混混想要暗杀NCR的总统？有种，宝贝。太有种了。

original: {Neutral - doesn't care that the player killed the President, but impressed that the player walked into a casino full of people who do}Ain't you the cat that tried to ice the President? Gutsy, baby, showing your face in here.
translation: {Neutral - doesn't care that the 玩家 killed the President, but impressed that the 玩家 walked into a 赌场 full of people who do}你不就是那个想要做掉总统的小猫咪吗？真有种啊，宝贝，还敢在这里露脸。

original: {Playful, teasing}Uh-oh, here comes trouble!
translation: {Playful, teasing}啊哦，这里有麻烦了！

original: {Playful, teasing}Ha ha, this cat's crazy!
translation: {Playful, teasing}哈哈，小猫咪发狂了！

original: {Playful, teasing}Baby, you bring crazy with you!
translation: {Playful, teasing}宝贝，你玩得真野！

original: Hey, play it cool, baby, we just got the place fixed up.
translation: 嘿，冷静点，宝贝，我们刚把这地方收拾好。

original: They, ah, checked your weapons at the door, right?
translation: 他们，呃，在你进门的时候搜走了你的武器，对吗？

original: Baby, you are some kind of crazy.
translation: 宝贝, 你太疯狂了。

original: Well, I guess your money's good here.
translation: 好吧，我想你的钱还是好用的。

original: Just do what you came to do and get out.
translation: 要干什么就快干，完事了赶紧滚。

original: We don't need your kind of trouble.
translation: 我们不需要像你这样的麻烦鬼。

original: You got some kind of nerve strolling around in here like this.
translation: 你是不是哪根神经搭错了。

original: Christ, who let you through security?
translation: 天啊，是谁让你通过安检的？

original: You ain't welcome here, so just take a hike.
translation: 这里不欢迎你，快点走人吧。

original: This place is the bees knees!
translation: 这个地方棒透了！

original: I dig this crazy slang!
translation: 我就喜欢这热闹劲！

original: Ehh, the broads are better looking at Gomorrah.
translation: 呃，还是蛾摩拉的婆娘好看一些。

original: Buy a gal a drink?
translation: 要给小姑娘买杯酒吗？

original: Hey, handsome.
translation: 嘿，帅哥。

original: Why don't you come up and see me sometime?
translation: 你为什么不抽空来看看我呢？

original: Don't get too close to Mr. Benny
translation: 别往本尼先生身边凑。

original: No sudden moves around the boss, got it?
translation: 在老板身旁的时候老实点，懂了？

original: I got my eye on you, so no funny business.
translation: 我会盯着你的，别动歪脑筋。

original: Keep those hands where I can see 'em.
translation: 把手放在我能看见的地方。

original: Ring-a-ding, baby.
translation: 狂欢吧，宝贝。

original: How's it hangin'?
translation: 最近怎么样？

original: Heya, baby, what's the haps?
translation: 嘿呀，宝贝，你好呀？

original: You dig this crazy scene or what?
translation: 你喜不喜欢这种疯狂场面啊？

original: This guy right here! This is the guy!
translation: 瞧瞧这家伙！就是他！

original: This gal right here! This is the gal!
translation: 瞧瞧这姑娘！就是她！

original: Hang loose, baby.
translation: 别着急，宝贝。

original: Baby, good to see you!
translation: 宝贝，见到你真是太好了！

original: Hey hey, there's my guy!
translation: 嘿、嘿！这不是我说的那位吗！

original: Hey hey, there's my gal!
translation: 嘿、嘿！这不是我说的那位吗！

original: Yeah, baby, now we can start the party!
translation: 对，宝贝，现在我们可以开始派对了！

original: Hope Swank's smarter than Benny.
translation: 希望斯万克比本尼聪明点儿。

original: Wonder where Benny got off to?
translation: 不知道本尼哪去了？

original: I thought Benny was a stand up guy - hard to believe he was a fink all along.
translation: 我还以为本尼是个光明磊落的人——想不到他居然一直在密谋造反。

original: Hey, play it cool, baby, we just got the place fixed up.
translation: 嗨，冷静点，宝贝，我们才刚把这地方收拾好。

original: Oh no, not again!
translation: 哦、不！又来！

original: You're the fink that killed Benny!
translation: 你就是那个害死本尼的叛徒！

original: I wonder where Benny ran off to.
translation: 我想知道本尼跑哪去了。

original: Heh. Guess those Omerta finks got what was coming to them.
translation: 呵。我猜那些黑手党的叛徒也已经自食其果了。

original: Who thought it was a good idea to give the robots missile launchers?
translation: 之前谁说给机器人装导弹发射器是个好主意来着？

original: If Mister House ain't the top dog on the Strip, whaddya suppose that means for us?
translation: 你有没有想过，如果豪斯先生不是长街的老大，对我们意味着什么？

original: Those Securitrons handing out obituaries? Creepy.
translation: 那些电子警卫是在发讣告？真恐怖。

original: You're the gasser who killed Caesar, ain't ya? Ring-a-ding!
translation: 你就是杀了凯撒的那个大牛，对不对？帅呆了！

original: Ain't seen no soldier boys for a while. Guess they're all scared of coming out after that big boom.
translation: 有阵子没看见那些大兵哥了。估计是那场大爆炸吓得他们都不敢出来了。

original: Looks like the troops are back. Good thing, too, this place was deadsville without their caps.
translation: 看来那些军队又回来了。也好，这地方要是少了他们的瓶盖子，可就死气沉沉的了。

original: Ain't you the cat that stopped Kimball getting iced? Gutsy, baby, but don't expect no free drinks for it.
translation: 你不就是救了金博尔的那只小野猫吗？你太棒了，宝贝，但别指望酒水会免费啊。

original: You hear some crazy crumb killed the president of the NCR? Gutsy, baby. Real gutsy.
translation: 你听说没，有个疯子杀了NCR的总统！有种啊，宝贝。太有种了。

original: Hey, I heard about you - you're the one who saved the President! Here, this one's on me.
translation: 嘿，我听说过你——你救了总统的命！来，我请客。

original: I heard the Kings over in Freeside got their asses handed to 'em. Lousy no-good bums.
translation: 我听说自由城的猫王帮全栽了。一群整天就会瞎嚷嚷的废物。

original: Way I hear it, some big-leaguer NCR rangers are coming to town to dance a two-step all over Caesar's head.
translation: 据我所知，有一支精锐的NCR游骑兵部队马上就要进城了，他们正打算在凯撒的脑袋上跳舞呢。

original: You dig these new rangers all dressed to the nines? Baby, the new fashion is killer-robot-chic!
translation: 你知道这些新来的游骑兵打扮得多时髦吗？宝贝儿，机械杀手装马上就要变成新时尚了！

original: I got a pal who says the Legion's calling in their 18-karat big-leaguers. We're talking the boys from Arizona, baby.
translation: 我听一哥们说，军团正在召集他们的王牌大表哥。我是在说那些从亚利桑那来的汉子，宝贝儿。

original: Baby, you couldn't pay me enough to step off the strip these days. Legion cats are out there thick as fleas on a dog, and they ain't no bums, neither.
translation: 宝贝儿，现在就算你倒贴钱给我，我也不会离开长街。外面的军团多得就跟狗身上的跳蚤一样，而且他们也不是什么等闲之辈。

original: Hey, there's the high-roller!
translation: 嘿，来了个大玩家！

original: Baby, it's as tense as a virgin at Gomorrah out there. Things are heating up and if they don't cool down it's straight endsville.
translation: 宝贝，蛾摩拉眼下的局势比没开苞的姑娘还紧。事态还在不断升级，他们要是再不设法控制一下，就有好看的了。

original: At least in the old days we could up and split when things got too heavy. Right now I miss those days.
translation: 换做以前，要是事情没法收拾，我们还能走人了事。现在我是真怀念那时候啊。

original: Baby, it's gonna be open war out there soon. If it was up to me we'd pack our toys, put this town to our backs and say "next stop: Scramsville."
translation: 宝贝儿，外面马上就要打仗了。要我说，咱们还是赶紧收拾细软离开这地方吧，下一站：风紧扯呼。

original: Why's the Lucky 38 take to shining all of a sudden? I smell a caper.
translation: 为什么幸运38的灯突然全亮了？肯定有问题。

original: House selling out to the NCR? Who woulda figured him for a fink?
translation: 豪斯把我们卖给NCR了？谁能想到他居然是叛徒？

original: {Player in NCR gear}I don't know what you did to pull runner duty to a post this far out in the wasteland, but you have my sympathies.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}我不知道你做了什么才被发配到这个鸟不拉屎的鬼地方来，但我很同情你。

original: {Player not in NCR gear}If you're here to sell something, we don't want any.
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}如果你是来推销的，我们什么也不需要。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: {Player in NCR gear}You don't walk like any trooper I've ever seen, but I'll let it slide. What do you want?
translation: {Player in NCR gear}你走路的姿势不像士兵，不过我也懒得深究了。你想干什么？

original: {Player in not in NCR gear}What brings you to Ranger Station Bravo?
translation: {Player in not in NCR gear}你来游骑兵驻站布拉沃干什么？

original: Something up?
translation: 出什么事儿了？

original: {Player not in NCR gear}{fearful}You're here for the money. I told the Omertas I was good for it! I just need more time!
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}{fearful}你是来讨钱的吧。我跟黑手党说了，钱没有问题！只要再给我点时间就行了！

original: {Player in NCR gear}{paranoid}You're not part of my unit... no, you're here for the money! I told the Omertas I was good for it!
translation: {Player in NCR gear}{paranoid}你不是我们的人……不，你是来讨钱的！我跟黑手党说过了，钱没有问题！

original: Oh, uh, hey.
translation: 哦，啊，嘿。

original: {Player in NCR gear}No run-ins with the Great Khans, I hope? They've been more restless than usual.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}没和大汗帮发生冲突吧？最近他们比以前更嚣张了。

original: {Player not in NCR gear}This area isn't safe for civilians. You don't want to get caught by the Great Khans.
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}对平民来说，这个地区可不太平。小心别被大汗帮给撞见。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Thanks for setting me straight.
translation: 多谢你助我踏上了正途。

original: Get lost.
translation: 走开。

original: {Surprised}Oh! What are you doing here?
translation: {Surprised}噢！你在这里干什么？

original: Aren't you the guy that helped wipe out Nelson?
translation: 你不就是那个帮助摧毁纳尔逊的家伙吗？

original: Holy shit man, that's fucking crazy!
translation: 真见鬼，老兄，简直他妈疯了！

original: Aren't you the gal that helped wipe out Nelson?
translation: 你不就是那个帮助摧毁纳尔逊的娘们吗？

original: Holy shit, that's fucking crazy!
translation: 真见鬼，简直他妈疯了！

original: Aren't you the one that saved President Kimball? That must have been some speech, eh?
translation: 你不就是救了金博尔总统的那个人吗？肯定有不少能说的吧，嗯？

original: I heard President Kimball was assassinated during his visit to Hoover Dam. Doesn't surprise me, we're all going to end up dead soon anyway.
translation: 我听说金博尔总统在访问胡佛水坝时被暗杀了。我一点也不吃惊，反正我们迟早都会死。

original: I heard President Kimball almost got killed during his visit to Hoover Dam. Good thing he didn't come here, he would be dead for sure.
translation: 我听说金博尔总统在访问胡佛水坝时差点遇刺。他没来这里真是太好了，要是他敢来的话就死定了。

original: You're new here aren't you? Don't tell me we're actually going to get reinforcements.
translation: 你是新来的吧？可别告诉我你就是我们等待的援军。

original: Look at the big hero. You here to save us?
translation: 瞧瞧大英雄来了。你是来这里拯救我们的吗？

original: I've heard of you. Did you figure on coming out here and helping us lowly troopers out?
translation: 我听说过你。你是主动到这儿来帮助我们这些卑微的士兵脱离苦海的吗？

original: Just what we need around here, a loose cannon causing more trouble.
translation: 真是哪壶不开提哪壶，来了个只会给我们帮倒忙的家伙。

original: I've heard of you, what do you want?
translation: 我听说过你，你有何贵干？

original: What the fuck are you doing here?
translation: 你他妈的在这干啥？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: We're all going to die out here. They're out there right now, waiting for us... waiting to kill us.
translation: 我们都会死在这里。他们现在就在外面，等着我们…等着杀了我们。

original: We're all fucked!
translation: 我们全完蛋了！

original: I don't want to be seen with the likes of you. Get lost.
translation: 我可不想被人看见和你这样的人在一起。赶紧消失。

original: You're still here? I'm surprised you're not dead or gone by now.
translation: 你居然还在这儿？我很吃惊你居然还能活蹦乱跳的。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: {Player in NCR gear}Got a second, trooper? I've got something important that needs to get done, but nobody's stepping up to help me out. I'm hoping you're different.
translation: {PlayerinNCRgear}有空吗大兵？我有件很重要的事情，但没有人肯帮我。希望你跟他们不一样。

original: {Player not in NCR gear}Hey, you're not one of the troopers... got a second? I have work I need done and nobody here at the camp has the time or inclination to help me out.
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}嘿，你不是士兵……有空么？我有件事要做，可营地里的人不是没空就是不肯帮忙。

original: {NCR victory}{grinning}You should've heard the cheers over the radio when news of the victory came back from the Dam.
translation: {NCRvictory}{grinning}你真该听听水坝传来捷报后电台里的欢呼声。

original: {Legion victory}{fear}I've been trying to sort out the rumors from the facts, but with the Legion coming, I guess it doesn't matter. The news is all bad.
translation: {Legionvictory}{fear}我也试过辨别谣言，不过随着军团的进犯，这些都无关紧要了。反正都是坏消息。

original: {Other victory}{puzzled}Lots of confusion over the radio. Somehow the NCR lost the Dam, but the Legion didn't get it, either?
translation: {Othervictory}{puzzled}越听收音机越糊涂。好像NCR丢了水坝，可占领水坝的却不是军团？

original: {curious}Hey, what did Chief Hanlon have to say about those false reports we uncovered?
translation: {curious}嘿，我们发现假报告的事，汉隆军士长怎么说？

original: Welcome back.
translation: 欢迎回来。

original: Player won Battle for Hoover Dam, for Independent Vegas with Securitrons
translation: 玩家赢得了胡佛水坝之战，利用电子保安让维加斯独立了

original: Player assaulted The Tops Casino.
translation: 玩家攻击了九重天赌场。

original: Player killed Benny at The Tops.
translation: 玩家在九重天杀死了本尼。

original: Player caused Benny to flee the Strip.
translation: 玩家吓得本尼逃往长街。

original: Player survived Benny's ambush.
translation: 玩家中了本尼的埋伏，但是活了下来。

original: Player foiled RACKET.
translation: 玩家识破了骗局。

original: Player enters Lucky 38.
translation: 玩家进入了幸运38。

original: Securitrons on the Strip upgraded.
translation: 长街的电子保安升级了。

original: Mr. House unplugged.
translation: 豪斯先生的导管被拔了。

original: Mr. House killed.
translation: 豪斯先生被杀死了。

original: Player has Mark of Caesar.
translation: 玩家拥有凯撒的徽记。

original: Caesar cured.
translation: 凯撒痊愈了。

original: Player known to have killed Caesar.
translation: 人们知道玩家杀了凯撒。

original: Caesar dies during operation.
translation: 凯撒死在手术台上了。

original: Caesar killed by lieutenants.
translation: 凯撒被上尉杀死了。

original: Player upgraded Securitron Army.
translation: 玩家升级了电子保安军队。

original: Player destroyed Securitron Army.
translation: 玩家摧毁了电子保安军队。

original: Monorail at McCarran destroyed, no NCR troops on Strip for 3 days
translation: 麦卡伦的列车被毁，长街3天都不会有NCR士兵

original: Monorail at McCarran destroyed, NCR troops start visiting again
translation: 麦卡伦的列车被毁，NCR士兵再次开始出现

original: Player frees Silas from McCarran
translation: 玩家从麦卡伦释放了西拉斯

original: Player saves President Kimball
translation: 玩家救下了金博尔总统

original: Player fails to kill President Kimball
translation: 玩家没能杀死金博尔总统

original: Player kills President Kimball
translation: 玩家杀了金博尔总统

original: President Kimball assassinated (player not a suspect)
translation: 金博尔总统被刺（玩家不是嫌疑犯）

original: Chief Hanlon dead, treason unexposed
translation: 军士长汉隆死了，叛国罪行未败露

original: Chief Hanlon dead, treason exposed
translation: 军士长汉隆死了，叛国罪行败露

original: Motor-Runner killed
translation: 轰鸣恶煞被杀

original: Fiend bosses killed
translation: 恶魔帮大佬被杀

original: Legion attacks Bitter Springs camp
translation: 军团进攻了苦泉营地

original: Great Khans join Caesar
translation: 大汗帮加入了军团

original: Great Khans sign treaty with NCR
translation: 大汗帮和NCR签订了协议

original: Great Khans leave the Mojave
translation: 大汗帮离开了莫哈维

original: Great Khans wiped out
translation: 大汗帮被消灭了

original: Kings wiped out (probably by NCR)
translation: 猫王帮被消灭了 (可能是NCR所为)

original: Kings resolve differences with NCR
translation: 猫王帮与NCR消除了分歧

original: Brotherhood of Steel destroyed
translation: 钢铁兄弟会被毁

original: Player wipes out Legion at Nelson
translation: 玩家在纳尔逊消灭了军团

original: Player wipes out NCR at Forlorn Hope
translation: 玩家在飘零希望消灭了NCR

original: Player wipes out both locations
translation: 玩家消灭了双方势力

original: 1st Recon transferred to Forlorn Hope
translation: 第一侦察营转移到了飘零希望

original: Ranger Station Charlie
translation: 游骑兵查理驻站

original: Boulder City Khans killed by NCR
translation: 巨石城的大汗帮被NCR杀了

original: Player killed Boulder City Khans
translation: 玩家杀了巨石城的大汗帮

original: The Khans escaped alive
translation: 大汗帮活着逃跑了

original: Primm led by new Sheriff
translation: 普瑞姆被新的治安官领导

original: Primm accepts NCR rule
translation: 普瑞姆接受了NCR的统治

original: Legion's dogs killed
translation: 军团的狗被杀

original: Rumors of Black Armor Rangers coming
translation: 黑甲游骑兵到来的谣言

original: Black Armor Rangers arrive
translation: 黑甲游骑兵抵达

original: Legion Veterans arrive
translation: 军团老兵抵达

original: Player has made a splash on the Strip
translation: 玩家在长街引起了轰动

original: Middle Game has begun
translation: 游戏到达了中期

original: Late game has begun
translation: 游戏到达了后期

original: Battle for Hoover dam available
translation: 胡佛水坝之战可用

original: Player won Battle for Hoover Dam
translation: 玩家赢得了胡佛水坝之战

original: Player won Battle for Hoover Dam, for the NCR
translation: 玩家帮助NCR赢得了胡佛水坝之战

original: Player won Battle for Hoover Dam, for Caesar's Legion
translation: 玩家帮助凯撒军团赢得了胡佛水坝之战

original: Player won Battle for Hoover Dam, for Mr. House
translation: 玩家帮助豪斯先生赢得了胡佛水坝之战

original: Player won Battle for Hoover Dam, for Independent Vegas without Securitrons
translation: 玩家为了维加斯在没有电子保安的情况下独立，赢得了胡佛水坝之战

original: Player assaulted The Tops Casino.
translation: 玩家攻击了九重天赌场。

original: Player killed Benny at The Tops.
translation: 玩家在九重天杀死了本尼。

original: Player caused Benny to flee the Strip.
translation: 玩家吓得本尼逃往长街。

original: Player survived Benny's ambush.
translation: 玩家中了本尼的埋伏，但是活了下来。

original: Player foiled RACKET.
translation: 玩家识破了骗局。

original: {Player not in NCR gear}I'm not supposed to let civilians just walk around this place. There better be a good reason for you being here.
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}我的职责就是确保没有平民在这附近转悠。希望你是有要紧事。

original: {Player in NCR gear}I'm pretty sure you're not authorized to be here, whatever unit you happen to be from. What do you want?
translation: {Player in NCR gear}我非常肯定你没有获得进入此地的批准，不管你从属于哪个部队。你想干什么？

original: Why are you still here?
translation: 你怎么还在这儿？

original: {Player not in NCR gear}No sudden moves and you and I will do all right. What do you want?
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}老老实实的，对你我都好。你想干什么？

original: {Player in NCR gear}Haven't seen you around the post before. I'm busy, so keep the chit-chat to the point.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}我从没在哨站附近见过你。我很忙，所以你有话直说。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: {Player in NCR gear}Hey there. Is McCarran having you check up on us?
translation: {Player in NCR gear}嘿，你好。是麦卡伦营地派你来我们这巡查的吗？

original: McCarran doesn't like it when civilians wander into military outposts, so if you're here on business, better make it quick.
translation: 麦卡伦营地肯定不会喜欢有平民在军事哨站乱逛，如果你有事，赶紧说。

original: You're back. What's up?
translation: 你回来了。怎么样啊？

original: {Player not in NCR gear}This post isn't someplace a civilian ought to be.
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}这个前哨站可不是平民该来的地方。

original: {Player in NCR gear}You a transfer from one of the other posts? I haven't seen you around before.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}你是哨站之间的通讯员？以前没见过你。

original: You're really not supposed to be here.
translation: 你真的不应该来这的。

original: {Player in NCR gear}{suspicious}You're not part of this post as far as I know. What do you want?
translation: {Player in NCR gear}{suspicious}据我所知，你并不是我们的人。你想要干什么？

original: {Player not in NCR gear}{suspicious}This is a military outpost. Why are you here?
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}{suspicious}这里是军事前哨站。你来这里做什么？

original: Did you need something else?
translation: 你还需要什么吗？

original: You new to Freeside? Haven't seen you around.
translation: 刚来自由城吗？以前从没见过你。

original: You looking to join the Kings?
translation: 你想加入猫王帮？

original: Do I know you? Whatever.
translation: 我认识你吗？一边去。

original: I hear you're working out pretty well. The King's taken a shine to you.
translation: 我听说你表现很好。猫王对你的印象也不错。

original: Stick by the Kings, and the Kings'll stick by you.
translation: 跟着猫王帮混，好处少不了你的。

original: I've been hearing good things about you. Keep it up.
translation: 我已经听到有人在表扬你了。加把劲啊。

original: Hey pal, what's shaking?
translation: 嘿，伙计，怎么样？

original: You're okay in my book.
translation: 你这人，还行吧。

original: Hey there. You should stop by Freeside more often.
translation: 嘿。你应该多来自由城看看。

original: You got guts, showing your face around here.
translation: 胆子不小啊，还敢在这出现。

original: You're lucky the King's a forgiving man.
translation: 你很幸运，猫王是一个宽宏大量的人。

original: I don't need to talk to you.
translation: 我没心思理你。

original: I wish you never came to Freeside.
translation: 我希望你永远别来自由城。

original: Back again? What's next, burn down the Wrangler?
translation: 又来了？这次要干什么？烧了原子牛仔？

original: You're not wanted around here. Scram.
translation: 你不受这里欢迎。滚蛋。

original: Some people seem to think you've helped the community, but I have my doubts.
translation: 有人说你对周边贡献很大，但我表示怀疑。

original: There's talk of you being a menace, but I think you mean well.
translation: 有人说你就是个祸害，不过我倒觉得你本意是好的。

original: Well, you definitely accomplished some things here, but I can't tell if Freeside is better for it or not.
translation: 你闹出来的动静还真不小，但我不知道这对自由城是好是坏。

original: You have got to be the craziest asshole I've ever met.
translation: 你是我见过最疯狂的混蛋。

original: A couple of us started a pool trying to guess what you've going to do next.
translation: 我们这群人开了个盘口，专赌你下一步要做什么。

original: Don't take this the wrong way, but are you, like, crazy or something?
translation: 别再这样了，你是疯了还是怎么的？

original: Heard there was some excitement in one of the casinos in the Strip. Bunch of people got hurt when some nut started attacking people.
translation: 听说长街有家赌场出了大事。有个疯子突然大开杀戒，伤了不少人。

original: Things are tense on the Strip right now. The head of one of Mr. House's Families was killed. Time to lay low, you ask me.
translation: 长街现在局势紧张。豪斯手下一个家族的老大都被杀了。要我说，还是低调点好。

original: Some nut attempted to kill the head of one of Mr. House's Families recently. Whoever did it is either crazy or has balls the size of Freeside.
translation: 最近有个疯子想要谋杀豪斯手下一个家族的老大。我看这人不是脑子坏了，就是胆儿有自由城那么大。

original: Did you hear someone managed to fight their way through the Chairmen and flee the Strip after being caught? Wonder if they're hiding out in Freeside.
translation: 你听说了吗？有人大闹董事会，最后还从长街逃出来了。搞不好他们现在就躲在自由城里。

original: Looks like Gomorrah's under new management. I wonder what happened?
translation: 看样子蛾摩拉换老板了。不知道出了什么事？

original: There's talk of someone going into the Lucky 38 to talk to Mr. House. That's bullshit. Everyone knows Mr. House doesn't talk to anyone.
translation: 据说有人进了幸运38，还跟豪斯先生见了面。扯蛋，天下人都知道豪斯先生不见客。

original: Man, I thought those tin cans of Mr. House's were tough before. Have you seen the shit they can do now?
translation: 老兄，我还以为豪斯先生手下的铁皮罐子以前就够厉害了。你看见它们居然又变强了吗？

original: Turns out Mr. House wasn't so safe up in his tower after all!
translation: 结果豪斯先生躲在塔里也不怎么安全嘛！

original: I wonder how Mr. House died. I figure it wasn't old age.
translation: 我想知道豪斯先生是怎么死的。反正肯定不是老死的。

original: How are we supposed to sleep with the Lucky 38 lit up 24/7?
translation: 幸运38这么全年无休地亮着灯，我们怎么睡觉？

original: Holy crap! You're the one they're saying killed the Legion honcho right?
translation: 我的妈呀！你就是他们说的那个宰了军团老大的家伙，是不是？

original: Word on the street is that the leader of the Legion bought it. Too bad, someone was finally going to do something about all the NCR around here.
translation: 据说军团的首领死了。太糟了，我还指望有人能收拾这里的NCR呢。

original: You hear how Mr. House said "uncle?" Vegas is gonna join the NCR. So much for Freeside.
translation: 你听见豪斯先生是怎么"认输"的没有？维加斯就要加入NCR了。自由城离那一天也不远了。

original: Did you hear? Someone bombed the monorail down at McCarran, so everyone's been forced to come through here to get to the Strip. Business is booming.
translation: 你听说了吗？有人炸了麦卡伦的单轨列车，今后所有人要去长街都必须经过这里了。生意要兴隆啦。

original: Seems like they've got things straightened out in McCarran now, but we're still seeing a big increase in traffic here.
translation: 看来他们已经把麦卡伦的事故摆平了，不过我们未来的人流量依然会大幅增加。

original: I can't believe someone stopped the NCR president from getting killed. If anyone deserves it, it's that jerk.
translation: 不敢相信居然有人阻止了针对NCR总统的暗杀行动。依我看，那家伙最该死了。

original: Someone took a shot at the NCR president, but the lucky bastard got away. Oh well, it was a good try.
translation: 有人朝着NCR总统来了一枪，但那家伙狗屎运，躲开了。好吧，吓吓他也挺不错。

original: Hey, did you hear the NCR president got whacked? Good for whoever did it, I say. Couldn't have happened to a nicer guy.
translation: 嘿，你听说NCR总统遇袭的事没有？活该，这就是报应。不管是谁干的，我要为他叫声好。

original: There's mutterings from the NCR people around here that some local hero of theirs died. Whatever.
translation: 据附近NCR的人说，他们有个平民英雄死了。管他呢。

original: Turns out some military hero the Squatters admired was actually a slimeball. An NCR soldier who's actually a dick? Who would've thought?
translation: 没想到那帮流民崇拜的英雄居然是个混蛋。谁想得到哟？NCR军队内部竟然还能出败类？

original: Heh, word is the leader of the Fiends got taken down. I would have done it myself, it he ever had the courage to step into Freeside.
translation: 呵，据说恶魔帮的头目被人给干掉了。我还想亲自动手呢，可惜他没胆子来自由城。

original: I heard that some of the bosses of the Fiends were killed. Wouldn't be surprised if the NCR had something to do with it.
translation: 我听说恶魔帮的几个大人物都被人干掉了。多半跟NCR脱不了关系。

original: You hear the Legion attacked Bitter Springs? If we're lucky, the NCR will pull some of their soldiers away from here and send them that way.
translation: 你听说军团攻击了苦泉镇没有？如果我们运气好的话，NCR会从这地方调一些士兵到那里去。

original: Word is the Khans signed a treaty with the NCR. Never saw that coming.
translation: 据说大汗帮和NCR签了协议。真是想不到。

original: The Khans used to be a big deal around here, but look at them now. There's talk that they were all killed up in the mountains.
translation: 大汗帮以前在这地方可不得了，但你现在再看看他们。据说他们全都死在了山里。

original: Weird, someone just told me that the Khans split the Vegas area. Wonder where they went, and why.
translation: 怪了，刚有人跟我说大汗帮离开了维加斯。也不知道他们要去哪，为什么要离开。

original: I can't believe the King is dead. What's going to happen to us now?
translation: 真不敢相信猫王已经死了。我们会怎么样？

original: If you had asked me a month ago, I'd have said we'd never willingly work with the NCR. But look at us now.
translation: 要是放在一个月以前，我们死都不会勾搭NCR。可你看看现在。

original: I still can't believe the King agreed to work with the NCR. But he's the King, and the King knows best.
translation: 我还是不能相信猫王竟然同意与NCR合作。但他是猫王，猫王的决定总是正确的。

original: So far working with the NCR hasn't been too bad. If anything, things seem to be getting better.
translation: 到目前为止，与NCR的合作还不算太糟。非要说的话，情况似乎在好转。

original: Great, just when you think the NCR can't possibly sink their claws deeper, the town of Primm signs up to join the Republic.
translation: 棒极了，本以为NCR的爪子不会再伸长，谁知一转眼普瑞姆就加入了共和国。

original: Sounds like the NCR and the Legion are both gearing up for a fight. We've been seeing a lot more soldiers around.
translation: 似乎NCR和军团都已经准备好干一仗了。我们这附近的士兵越来越多。

original: The big showdown between the NCR and the Legion is coming soon, believe you me.
translation: 相信我，NCR和军团的大决战就要来了。

original: I heard some Squatters talking about some fancy pants Rangers coming into the area soon. Like we need more NCR here.
translation: 我听流民说，马上又有一批盛装打扮的游骑兵要来。是嫌这里的NCR还不够多吗。

original: Word is those tough guys rangers are here. I ain't seen them myself, but how scary can they be?
translation: 据说那些凶悍的游骑兵已经到了。我还没亲眼看见他们，不过他们能恐怖到哪去呢？

original: Everyone's talking about Hoover Dam nowadays. I wish the battle would just happen already. The suspense is killing me.
translation: 最近大家都在谈论胡佛水坝。要打赶紧打嘛，整天担惊受怕，还要不要人活了。

original: Hey, isn't that the King's dog?
translation: 嘿，这不是猫王的狗吗？

original: Heya Rex, how you doing boy?
translation: 你好呀，雷克斯，你还好吗？

original: I see you've hired a Follower doctor. Smart move, Freeside being what it is.
translation: 我看见你雇的天启追随者医生了。明智之举，自由城人就该帮自由城人...

original: That friend of yours NCR? He looks like he's NCR.
translation: 你那个朋友是NCR的吗？他看着就像NCR的。

original: Hellooo, cowgirl! You mind if talk to your lady friend a bit instead of you?
translation: 噫呀，牛仔姑娘！介意我和你的美女朋友聊两句吗？

original: Huh. Nice robot. You with the Followers or something?
translation: 呵。这机器人挺不错呀。你是天启追随者的人？

original: Whoa. That's a whole lotta mutant you got with you there. Still, long as it doesn't cause trouble it's all good.
translation: 哇哦，你身边居然跟了一个这么高大的变种人。算了，只要它别惹麻烦就没问题。

original: Nice to see a human palling around with a ghoul. I see a lot of people around here avoid them.
translation: 人类与尸鬼和睦相处，这场面真温馨。我们这儿的多数人对他们可是避之不及呢。

original: Your girl's kinda cute, but not my type at all. I don't go for smart chicks.
translation: 你马子还挺可爱的，可惜不是我中意的类型。我不喜欢太精明的姑娘。

original: Watch yourself. There's some unsavory types about.
translation: 你自己小心。这儿有些坏蛋可不好惹。

original: The Squatters have been more and more trouble lately.
translation: 那些流民最近越来越爱惹事了。

original: Man, I'm hungry. I'd give anything for a Fancy Lad. Wait, I mean- you know what I mean!
translation: 老天，我饿坏了。给我来个奇想小子吧，要我干啥都行。等等，我不是说——你明白我意思吧！

original: Squatters aren't happy about the water rationing, but then when are they ever happy?
translation: 流民对淡水的配给量不是很满意，可他们什么时候满意过？

original: It's gotten so bad that even I think twice before going out at night around here.
translation: 这地方治安太差了，我都不敢晚上随便出门。

original: The bodyguards at the gates aren't so bad. Except that Orris guy. That bastard runs his mouth a little too much.
translation: 大门口的那些保镖都还不错。除了那个叫欧里斯的家伙，这混蛋嘴太碎了。

original: Can't wait to hit the Wrangler tonight. Just me and my favorite girl.
translation: 我都等不及今晚去原子牛仔了。我要和我最喜欢的姑娘泡一晚上。

original: I've been saving up for one of those sweet pistols at the Silver Rush. That'll get me some respect.
translation: 我一直在攒钱，好哪天能从银色冲击买一把漂亮的手枪。这样别人就不敢小瞧我了。

original: Saw a guy try to rush through the south gate a few days ago. Nothin' left but dust, you know?
translation: 前几天有个家伙居然想硬闯南门。你猜怎么着？他变成了一堆灰。

original: Those Squatters think they're entitled to everything.
translation: 那些流民觉得全世界都欠他们的。

original: Man, I still can't believe the Van Graffs took Pacer out.
translation: 老兄，我还是不敢相信范格拉夫家的人居然把佩瑟干掉了。

original: Shame about Pacer. We all tried to tell him to kick the habit, with that condition of his. He always did his own thing, I'll give him that.
translation: 佩瑟那就是活该。我们都劝过他，什么时候了还不收敛点。他倒好，死活听不进去。

original: I used to guard at the gate, but there's no money in it these days. Only the big name guards get any business.
translation: 我也在大门那儿当过保镖，不过没挣到什么钱。只有名气大的保镖才能揽到活儿。

original: Thank god the Followers are here. I'd probably be dead now if it weren't for their doctors.
translation: 感谢上帝，这儿还有天启追随者。要不是他们的医生，我早就死了。

original: It's never dull in Freeside, is it?
translation: 自由城永远都不会无聊，对不对？

original: Heya, what's shakin'?
translation: 嘿，忙什么呢？

original: Hey there.
translation: 嘿你好。

original: What's going on?
translation: 发生了什么？

original: I don't speak with outsiders, smoothskins especially. Talk to our leader, Jason Bright.
translation: 我不和外来者说话，尤其是滑皮肤。去和我们的首领辐光杰森谈吧。

original: Sorry, we don't talk to outsiders. Talk to Jason if you have business here.
translation: 对不起，我们不和外来者说话。你如果有事就去找杰森谈。

original: Jason will lead us to the Far Beyond!
translation: 杰森会带我们去遥远的彼岸！

original: Jason will deliver us from the pain of this world!
translation: 杰森会让我们脱离这个世界的苦难！

original: All praise the Great Journey! All praise the creator's divine will!
translation: 赞美伟大旅程！赞美造物主的神示！

original: The holy fire will carry us to our salvation!
translation: 神圣的火焰会带给我们救赎！

original: Thank you for taking care of the demons, smoothskin.
translation: 谢谢你解决了那些恶魔，滑皮肤。

original: Now that the demons are gone, we can finally begin our final steps.
translation: 恶魔已经死了，我们终于可以开始最后一步了。

original: The demons are really gone? Bright shines!
translation: 恶魔真的死了？光明终于来临了！

original: Not now, smoothskin!
translation: 现在没空，滑皮肤！

original: Welcome to REPCONN Headquarters, Rocketeer! Come all this way to see our little facility, have you?
translation: 欢迎来到瑞普康总部，火箭专家！您是专程来参观我们的设施的，对吗？

original: I'm here to answer any and all questions you may have - within specified parameters - and if you'd like, I can provide a tour of our museum.
translation: 无论您有什么问题，只要在权限范围内，我都会为您解答。如果您愿意的话，我还可以带您参观一下我们的博物馆。

original: Welcome back! Interested in a tour of the REPCONN museum? Or did you have a question about the company I could answer?
translation: 欢迎回来！想参观瑞普康博物馆吗？还是您对我们公司有什么疑问，希望由我来解答？

original: Yes? Did you have a question?
translation: 是的？您有什么问题吗？

original: {Player not in NCR gear}{pleased}A customer! Not many people come into Boulder City these days.
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}{pleased}终于有客人光临了！最近可没几个人来巨石城啊。

original: {Player in NCR gear}Howdy, trooper. I thought the Big Horn was off limits to you guys, but who am I to complain? A customer is a customer.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}你好啊，长官。我以为上司不准你们进大角酒吧呢，但我又有什么好抱怨的？来者都是客。

original: {Great Khans left alive}Surprising that the Khans are going to walk out of here after all that fuss.
translation: {Great Khans left alive}大汗帮闹出了那么大动静还能安然无恙地离开，真叫人惊讶。

original: {Great Khans dead}Guess those Khans got what was coming to them, huh?
translation: {Great Khans dead}大汗帮也算是得到了应得的下场，对吧？

original: {NCR troops dead}Hope those Great Khans don't come trash my saloon. I'm not part of the NCR!
translation: {NCR troops dead}希望大汗帮别来砸我的店。我和NCR可没关系！

original: Welcome back to the Big Horn. What can I get you?
translation: 欢迎回到大角酒馆。想来点什么？

original: {Player attacked NCR, NCR troops not all dead}Kill every last one of those NCR troopers and then we'll talk.
translation: {Player attacked NCR, NCR troops not all dead}你去把NCR士兵都杀光了再来找我。

original: {astonished, but in a manly way}What the hell? You're that courier Benny wasted back in Goodsprings. You're supposed to be dead.
translation: {astonished, but in a manly way}活见鬼了！你是那个在清泉镇吃了本尼枪子的邮差。你不是应该死了吗？

original: {slight threat}I'm getting real tired of talking.
translation: {slight threat}我现在真的没心情和别人说话。

original: Still got a bit of a walk ahead of us. Talk fast.
translation: 我们要走的路还长着呢。有话快说。

original: We've got a situation with some Great Khans right now. The brass at McCarran has ordered me to lock down the ruins until it's been resolved.
translation: 我们和几个大汗帮的人闹出了一点状况。麦卡伦的长官命令我封锁这片废墟，直到问题解决。

original: {Player attacking Great Khans, Great Khans not all dead}Can't talk. We didn't get all the Great Khans yet.
translation: {Player attacking Great Khans, Great Khans not all dead}没空说话。我们还没彻底搞定大汗帮呢。

original: {Player not helping Monroe}Where do you think you're going? I can't let you go into the ruins, not without a reason.
translation: {Player not helping Monroe}你往哪走呢？没有正当理由我可不能让你进入废墟。

original: {Speech path}How are negotiations with the Great Khans going?
translation: {Speech path}你和大汗帮谈得怎么样了？

original: {Speech path - deal reached}I'm glad you were able to get my people freed, but there's a new problem. I just got orders to take out the Great Khans, hostages or not.
translation: {Speech path - deal reached}你能把我的人都救出来真是太好了，但现在又有个新问题。我刚接到命令，要把大汗帮的人都干掉，不管有没有人质。

original: {Speech path - player attacked Great Khans}When I heard the shots, I figured your negotiation went bad. What the hell happened?
translation: {Speech path - player attacked Great Khans}我听到枪声就知道谈判破裂了。到底怎么回事？

original: {Speech path - bribe paid}The Great Khans can go, just as we agreed.
translation: {Speech path - bribe paid}大汗帮的人可以走了，就按商量好的条件。

original: {Sneak path}Ackerman and Gilbert aren't back yet. What's the holdup?
translation: {Sneak path}阿克曼和吉尔伯特都还没回来。怎么会这么久？

original: {Both hostages rescued}Thanks for getting both of my people out of there.
translation: {Both hostages rescued}感谢你把我的两个人都救了出来。

original: {Sneak path - one hostage rescued}I'm sorry that you couldn't get both hostages out alive, but that's how it goes sometimes. Thanks for your help.
translation: {Sneak path - one hostage rescued}很遗憾你没能把两个人质都救出来，但有时候现实就是这样。谢谢你的帮助。

original: {Sneak path - hostages dead}I'm sorry that you couldn't get either hostage out alive, but that's how it goes sometimes. Thanks for your help.
translation: {Sneak path - hostages dead}很遗憾你没能把人质救出来，但有时候现实就是这样。谢谢你的帮助。

original: I really don't have the time to chatter right now.
translation: 我现在真的没空和你闲聊。

original: Thanks for the rescue.
translation: 多谢搭救。

original: Man, I thought I was dead for sure.
translation: 老兄，我还以为死定了。

original: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢你把我从那里救出来，我欠你一个人情。

original: I'm glad that's over. Thank you.
translation: 很高兴一切都结束了。谢谢你。

original: You here to pay your respects, too?
translation: 你也是来致敬的吗？

original: Hello again. Is there something you need from me?
translation: 又见面了。你需要点什么？

original: What the fuck are you doing? My brother died at the Battle of Hoover Dam. You're desecrating a war memorial.
translation: 你他妈的在干什么？我兄弟在胡佛水坝战役中牺牲。你竟敢破坏战争纪念碑。

original: I've got nothing else to say to you.
translation: 我和你没什么好说的。

original: Hi, REPCONN Quest Stuff, have at it!
translation: 嗨，瑞普康测试员，看这里！

original: <groan>
translation: <呻吟>

original: <grunt>
translation: <咕噜声>

original: {Prison under attack}I don't want to get shot!
translation: {Prison under attack}我可不想吃枪子！

original: It's about time a new customer showed up around here. Was getting sick of dealing with the same faces all the time.
translation: 可算是有新主顾来了。总是和那些老面孔打交道，我都要吐了。

original: {After prison battle}I can't believe the NCR actually showed up. We sure showed them, though. Right?
translation: {After prison battle}我没想到NCR真的会出现。不过我们还是好好地让他们开了开眼，对吧？

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: {Prison under attack}There's still more troopers out there!
translation: {Prison under attack}外面还有更多敌兵！

original: {Male Player in Powder Ganger gear}I know {emphasis "all"}all the guys I did time with around here and you ain't one of them. Can't fool me with that Powder Ganger getup.
translation: {Male Player in Powder Ganger gear}我认识{emphasis "all"}和我一起驻守在这里的每一个人。靠炸药帮的制服可骗不了我。

original: {Female player in Powder Ganger gear}Okay, I know I wasn't serving time with no girl, or I'd have heard about it. You come to play with the Powder Gangers?
translation: {Female player in Powder Ganger gear}好吧，据我所知我们的人里没有姑娘，否则我一定会知道的。你是来给炸药帮找乐子的么？

original: {Male PC}Look at you, walking in here like you're one of us. Don't you know this is Powder Ganger territory?
translation: {Male PC}看看你，就这么大摇大摆地走进来，好像你跟我们一伙儿似的。你不知道这里是炸药帮的地盘吗？

original: {Female PC}Hey there, girlie. You here to party with the Powder Gangers?
translation: {Female PC}嘿，小妞。你是来找炸药帮寻开心的么？

original: {After NCR attack}{gleeful for killing a guy}Did you see me take out that NCR trooper? Right through his eye!
translation: {After NCR attack}{gleeful for killing a guy}你看见我是怎么搞定那个NCR士兵的没？一枪打穿眼睛！

original: {slightly hostility}What do you want now?
translation: {slightly hostility}你还要干嘛？

original: {Prison under attack}I knew I should've gone with Cooke!
translation: {Prison under attack}我早知道就和库克一起走了！

original: Heard there was a new face around. I'm the doctor around here... sort of.
translation: 我早听说这儿来了个新面孔。我算是这里的医生……之类的。

original: {After prison battle - relieved}That... was close. I really need to find some nice, quiet place to settle.
translation: {After prison battle - relieved}真是……惊险。我就该找个清静地方呆着。

original: Sticking around, I see.
translation: 你在闲逛呢？

original: {Waiting in Primm for Pardon}Have you gotten my pardon from the NCR yet?
translation: {Waiting in Primm for Pardon}NCR愿意赦免我了吗？

original: {Sheriff of Primm}Thanks for getting me that pardon. Me and the boys will take good care of Primm, don't you worry.
translation: {Sheriff of Primm}谢谢你让他们赦免了我。我会和弟兄们守好普瑞姆的，别担心。

original: {Sheriff of Primm}I can do right by this town, they were in need of some frontier justice.
translation: {Sheriff of Primm}我要在这个镇上洗心革面，这里需要有人秉公执法。

original: {Prison under attack}Sounds like the NCR is finally getting off their ass to settle things around here. Don't expect me to get in their way.
translation: {Prison under attack}听起来NCR终于忍不住要来解决这儿的麻烦了。可别指望我会去和他们作对。

original: {Player is in Combat}Maybe you ought to worry about the guys trying to kill you first.
translation: {Player is in Combat}也许你该先担心那些想杀你的人。

original: Didn't know anyone would willingly walk into this place, not unless they were looking for trouble. What's your story?
translation: 如果不是找麻烦，一般人是不会来这里的。所以，你想干什么？

original: Need to talk about something?
translation: 想谈点什么吗？

original: What are you looking at?
translation: 你在看什么？

original: Will you quit bothering me?
translation: 能不能别再烦我了？

original: {Prison under attack}No time to talk. We've got trouble.
translation: {Prison under attack}没时间闲聊。我们有麻烦了。

original: {impressed}Not half bad in a fight, are you? I figure you had a lot to do with me still breathing after all that.
translation: {impressed}看不出你还挺能打的嘛？我能活下来，还是有你很大一份功劳的。

original: I don't have any more work for you, but feel free to stick around as long as you want. You never know when the NCR will be back.
translation: 我没什么事可以给你做了。不过你可以在这儿想待多久都行。天知道NCR什么时候又会回来。

original: Dawes said he let somebody in. So, you going to give me a reason not to kill you and throw your body back outside?
translation: 道斯说他放了个人进来。你最好能给我个理由，不然我就宰了你，再把尸体扔出去。

original: You're the one Cobb mentioned. Maybe you feel like helping us out around here.
translation: 你就是科布提起过的那个人。也许你会愿意帮助我们脱离险境。

original: {After prison battle}Not bad in a fight, are you? I really thought the NCR had us in their sights that time.
translation: {After prison battle}看不出你还挺能打的嘛？我刚才真以为NCR要干掉我们了。

original: {Powder Ganger Good Rep 2+ reached}I've been thinking that since you've been good to us, we can be good to you.
translation: {Powder Ganger Good Rep 2+ reached}我一直在想，既然你对我们好，我们也应该对你好。

original: We've got plenty of spare powder and dynamite around. Say the word and we can give you some of it every couple of days.
translation: 我们这附近的火药和炸药管够。只要你说话，我们每隔几天就能送一些给你。

original: {Powder Ganger Mixed Rep 2+ reached}I don't know what to make of you, you know that? I know I can't really trust you, that's for sure.
translation: {Powder Ganger Mixed Rep 2+ reached}知道吧，我不懂你究竟是个怎样的人。但我肯定不能信任你。

original: Still, you've helped us out some, so maybe I ought to repay you some. I've spread the word about you to a bunch of guys out in the wasteland.
translation: 不管怎么说，你确实帮了我们不少忙，所以我应该适当给你点回报。我已经和废土上的伙计们通报了你的事。

original: As long as you're not an enemy, they'll cut you some slack when you're near their camps. Trespass too long and they'll come after you.
translation: 只要你不和他们为敌，在他们营地附近的时候，他们还是会待见你的。不过你要是随便乱闯的话，他们依旧会对你动手。

original: {abrupt, slightly hostile}What?
translation: {abrupt，slightly hostile}什么？

original: {Combat in progress}Shut up and fight!
translation: {Combat in progress}闭嘴！战斗！

original: I'm Sergeant Lee. Lieutenant Hayes radioed ahead to say you were on the way.
translation: 我是李中士。海耶斯中尉已经电告了你的到来。

original: We've got surprise on our side, and that's about it. Once we blow a gap in the fence, we've got to pour on the fire and keep them disorganized.
translation: 我们准备了一个惊喜，就在这边。一旦在围墙上打出缺口，我们就会迅速发起突袭，打他们个措手不及。

original: Our goal's to take out their leader, some assbag named Eddie. With the ringleader gone, the rest will fold.
translation: 我们的目标是干掉他们的头目，一个叫埃迪的混蛋。没了领头的，剩下的全都不堪一击。

original: That's all the briefing you're going to get. Let's go.
translation: 任务简报到此为止。我们上。

original: We can take it from here. We might have some cleaning up to do, but Eddie's a deadie. Gangs with no leadership don't last long.
translation: 我们可以在这里动手。那样可能会需要大干一场，不过肯定能解决埃迪。树倒自然猢狲散。

original: I'll radio Hayes to let him know the prison's ours. But you should swing by to see him the next time you're near Primm.
translation: 我会发报给海耶斯，通知他我们已经拿下了监狱。不过你下次路过普瑞姆时还是应该去看看他。

original: Thanks for the help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

original: You just walked into the wrong camp, my friend. Hand over everything you've got and we might let you live.
translation: 你走错地方了，朋友。把东西全交出来，我们可能会饶你一命。

original: I got the message. You won't see me around these parts again.
translation: 我收到消息了。你不会再在这附近看见我了。

original: {Mixed Rep reached}Hey, I've been sent to tell you that, while you're not exactly a friend, we know you've helped us out some all the same.
translation: {Mixed Rep reached}嗨，有人让我给你带个话，虽然你不能算是朋友，但我们一直记着你帮了我们。

original: We figure some kind of truce is in order. As long as you don't come too close to any of our camps, we'll let you pass without trying to kill you.
translation: 看来咱们应该暂时休战。只要你别太靠近我们的营地，我们可以让你安全通过。

original: Of course, the truce is off once we know you're an enemy.
translation: 当然，如果你表现出敌意，那就别怪我们动手了。

original: Got nothing else to say to you.
translation: 没什么和你说的。

original: {Irritated Warning}Don't go messing around with the Fiends.
translation: {Irritated Warning}别惹恶魔帮。

original: {Irritated Warning}We ain't here to help you, get out.
translation: {Irritated Warning}我们不是来帮你的，滚出去。

original: {Irritated Warning}What the hell are you doing here? Civilians shouldn't be here.
translation: {Irritated Warning}你他妈到这来干什么？好市民不该在这里出现。

original: {Slight Concern for the player}It's not safe around here.
translation: {Slight Concern for the player}这附近都不安全。

original: {Slight Concern for the player}Try not to get killed, okay?
translation: {Slight Concern for the player}小心别让人给宰了, 好吧？

original: {Slight Concern for the player}You should go topside.
translation: {Slight Concern for the player}你该回上面去。

original: Can I help you with something, stranger?
translation: 我能帮上你吗，陌生人？

original: I hear tell you pretty well wiped out the Fiends around here. Not bad, not bad.
translation: 我听说你横扫了附近的恶魔帮。不错，不错。

original: Welcome back, merc.
translation: 欢迎回来，雇佣兵。

original: Have you taken care of those squatters?
translation: 你处理了那些流民？

original: Have you run off those greasers?
translation: 你轰走那群油腻帮了吗？

original: Good to see you around. Take care, merc.
translation: 很高兴在这里见到你。小心点，雇佣兵。

original: You're still around, huh?
translation: 你还在这儿啊？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: Piss off!
translation: 滚开！

original: We're going, we're going!
translation: 我们马上走！马上走！

original: What are you doing here? Get out before I blow your head off!
translation: 你在这里干什么？再不滚蛋我就打爆你的脑袋！

original: I can't believe this shit. You again?
translation: 真他妈不敢相信。又是你？

original: So, what's up?
translation: 那，有什么事吗？

original: I hope you've got some good news about Alice.
translation: 我希望你有关于爱丽丝的好消息。

original: {Reining Immense Anger}I should kill you, right here, for what you've done.
translation: {Reining Immense Anger}你居然干出那种事，我真该现在就宰了你。

original: Hello there! Welcome to the Crimson Caravan Company. How can I help you today?
translation: 你好！欢迎来到深红商队公司。有什么能为你效劳的吗？

original: Need anything?
translation: 有什么事吗？

original: I owe you an apology, stranger. We almost lost her forever, and I'm glad that things didn't turn out for the worse.
translation: 我欠你一个道歉，陌生人。我们差点就永远失去她了，很高兴最终事情没有朝坏的方向发展。

original: Oh. Hello, there.
translation: 噢。你好啊。

original: I hope you're not planning on visiting {spoken with distaste} the Strip.
translation: 希望你不是打算要去{spoken with distaste}长街。

original: The rest of this city has gone absolutely to seed!
translation: 这座城市其他的部分都只剩下废墟了！

original: Any news from out of town?
translation: 外面有什么消息吗？

original: Don't recall seeing you here before.
translation: 我不记得你以前来过这里。

original: Welcome to North Vegas, stranger!
translation: 欢迎来到北维加斯，陌生人！

original: Don't rush me. We're going, okay?
translation: 别催我。我们马上就走，行了吧？

original: What the hell are you looking at, punk?
translation: 你他妈瞎看什么呢，混混？

original: Rot in hell.
translation: 滚到一边去。

original: Back off! I know how to use this gun, and I'm not afraid to shoot if you try anything!
translation: 后退！我知道怎么用枪，要是你敢乱来，我就开枪了！

original: I've put up with their shit long enough. No more! I'll... I'll kill them if they get in my way!
translation: 我已经受够那群王八蛋了。够了！要是他们……要是他们再敢烦我，我就把他们全宰了！

original: What are you looking at, huh? Answer me, or I'll get trigger-happy real quick.
translation: 你看什么呢，嗯？告诉我，否则就让你吃枪子。

original: {Overtly Suspicious, Confident in Himself}Humph... I see lots of folks come and go, but none fit your type. Where you come from, stranger?
translation: {Overtly Suspicious， Confident in Himself}嗯……我见过形形色色的人，不过你倒是个异类。你从哪里来，陌生人？

original: Look, I'm willing to let you slide, but you're asking for it. Tell me what's your business in my town.
translation: 你看，我是很乐意放你过去的，可你偏要找事。告诉我，你到我的小镇来有什么事。

original: What's eating you?
translation: 你有什么事情吗？

original: You again? Get out here, smoothface.
translation: 又是你？滚出去，滑皮肤。

original: Get lost!
translation: 滚蛋！

original: I've got nothing to say to you, punk. Scram!
translation: 我和你没什么好说的，混蛋。滚开！

original: What the fuck you want, huh?
translation: 你他妈的想干什么，啊？

original: Hey, you! What the hell are you doing? Keep snooping around here and I'll skin you like a fucking Gecko.
translation: 嘿，说你呢！你到底在干什么？ 你要是再在附近鬼鬼祟祟的，小心我把你的皮像他妈的蜥蜴那样扒下来。

original: Andy's not gonna be happy. Where the hell's that crazy bitch?
translation: 安迪不会高兴的。那个疯婊子哪去了？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: ... Huh?
I've got nothing to say to you, stranger.
translation: 我对你没什么好说的，陌生人。

original: I was blind to what was happening in my own family. We don't have much, but please take this.
translation: 我以前太忽视家庭了。我们的东西不多，但还是请你收下这个。

original: What... what have I done!? Mother...
translation: 我……我都干了什么！？妈妈……

original: Look what you've done, you bastard!
translation: 看看你干的一切，你这个混蛋！

original: Oh no! Alice... Alice, baby! I'm sorry, so sorry...
translation: 噢、不！爱丽丝……爱丽丝，宝贝！ 对不起，对不起……

original: She... Alice left, didn't she? I can't believe you let her go! Some help you've been!
translation: 她……爱丽丝走了，是不是？我不敢相信你真的让她走了！你都帮了些什么倒忙啊！

original: Good to see you again. I'm just passing through here; staying at this refugee camp, under the wing of NCR thugs, is the last thing on my mind.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你。我只是路过这里。待在难民营里，受那群NCR暴徒管制，是我最不想遇到的事情。

original: {Chance encounter on the road}Hey there! I'm on my way to Novac to find a new home, even if it lasts just a little while. See you around.
translation: {Chance encounter on the road}嘿！我正打算去诺瓦克安家，虽然不一定会住太久。回见。

original: Hello again. Well, this is my place now. With time, I'll turn it into a good home.
translation: 又见面了。你看，现在这是我的地盘了。假以时日，我就能把它变成温馨的家。

original: Don't you see everything is going to hell? I'm gonna go find someplace safe to hide out at.
translation: 你没发现情况越来越糟了吗？我得去找个安全的地方躲起来。

original: I love this place, but I can't take this kind of stress anymore. I'm going to head back west to see my grandkids.
translation: 虽然我很喜欢这地方，但我受不了这种压力。我要回西部去看孙子了。

original: Hello there youngster. Welcome to my baby.
translation: 你好啊，年轻人。欢迎来看我的宝贝。

original: Troublemaker, don't you dare hurt my baby.
translation: 捣乱的家伙，你休想伤着我的宝贝。

original: Always good to see a friendly face, you're always welcome to visit my baby girl.
translation: 能有贵客来访可真好，欢迎你来看我的小姑娘。

original: You keep yourself outta trouble around my baby, I'm watching you.
translation: 你最好别在我的宝贝周围惹麻烦，我盯着你呢。

original: Welcome back to my baby.
translation: 欢迎来看我的宝贝。

original: {snort} NCR, no better than common thieves. Where do they get off stealing our armor?
translation: {snort}NCR，跟小偷没什么区别。他们什么时候才能不再偷我们的护甲？

original: {Player just won the battle}Caesar on the cross, been a long time since I've seen the kind of work you've laid down today... a {emph}damn long time.
translation: {Playerjustwonthebattle}凯撒兵败身死，我已经好久没见过有人能像你今天这样……立下卓越的战功。

original: {Wistful}And the screams of those Legion bastards as they kicked dirt running East... like a choir of angels to my ears.
translation: {Wistful}听听那些军团渣滓们仓皇逃回老家时的哀嚎吧……对我来说简直就像天籁。

original: Speaking of - that crazy lightshow over the Fort, what the fuck was that, some kind of thumb from God you called down? {Wistful}Amazing, fucking amazing.
translation: 说到这个，城堡上的那场烟火秀到底是他妈怎么回事，难道连上帝都被你招来显灵了？{Wistful}漂亮，太他妈漂亮了。

original: Could use a hundred of you, just scatter you over the East like jacks, give those plumed fucks the what-for.
translation: 要是能给我一百个像你这样的士兵，把你们全派到东部去，岂不是能把他们翻个底朝天。

original: Well, you took your sweet ass time coming here.
translation: 我说，你他妈动作也真是够慢的。

original: Let's get down to brass tacks, we need to get this thing moving if we want to keep the element of surprise.
translation: 言归正传吧，如果还想要出其不备的话，手脚就得麻利点。

original: That was a fine bit of work back there. Truth told, I'm surprised you made it out of there in one piece. {Under his breath}You and the Dam.
translation: 你干得真不赖。说实话，我没想过你能活着回来。{Underhisbreath}也没想过水坝能安然无恙。

original: I'm impressed to say the least, and that's no easy thing. You've secured NCR's future - the administration sends its thanks, for what it's worth.
translation: 老实说，我真得对你另眼相看了。你守护了NCR的未来——我们的政府会向你致谢的。

original: Damn Brotherhood, bunch of elitist jerks. What were we to do, leave good armor out in the wastes to rust?
translation: 该死的兄弟会，一群道貌岸然的白痴。我们究竟为的什么，把上好的护甲扔在废土上生锈？

original: Whatever it is, make it quick. I don't have time for idle chatter.
translation: 有话就快说。我可没时间闲聊。

original: {Angry, frustrated}As if I didn't have enough to worry about, one of our facilities was recently broken into and its power diverted.
translation: {Angry,frustrated}估计老天爷嫌我的烦心事还不够多，最近我们有一间设施遭到入侵，电力也被截流了。

original: Have you seen that damned tower in the Strip, all aglow? Of course you've seen it. Everyone's seen it.
translation: 你看到长街那座该死的塔了么，就是灯火通明的那座？你肯定看到了。谁都看得到。

original: That was {stressed}our power that did that, and I {stressed}will find out who did it. {beat, realizes the player's there, rant ends}Did you have something to report?
translation: 我们的电就是被送到那儿去了，我{stressed}一定会查出来是谁干的好事。{beat,realizestheplayer'sthere,rantends}你有什么要报告的？

original: Not right now, I'm busy.
translation: 没空说话，我很忙。

original: You again. What do you want?
translation: 又是你。你要干啥？

original: Good, you made it. I've been receiving reports about the "savior of the NCR" for a while now, and wanted to meet you myself.
translation: 太好了，你来了。我最近一直听手下说什么"NCR的大救星"，早就想亲自见见你了。

original: You've proven yourself especially capable, and right now I can use all the capable people I can get.
translation: 你证明了自己有过人的才能，我现在恰好需要这样的人。

original: Crocker gets handed the fluff missions that no one else wants to do. When people need something really important done, they come to me.
translation: 克罗克手上的都是些没人愿意干的杂活。真正遇到要紧事，大家才会来找我。

original: Usually, I dispatch one or more rangers to see these things through, but I'm a little shorthanded at the moment. Think you're up for a real mission?
translation: 放在平时，我只要派几个游骑兵，就能把事情摆平了，但我现在有点缺人手。你想不想接一些正经事干？

original: Good, you made it. I've been receiving reports of your activities for a little while now, and wanted to meet you myself.
translation: 太好了，你来了。我最近一直听部下提起你的事迹，早就想亲自见见你了。

original: Even though you've caused us a great deal of trouble, you've proven yourself very capable, and right now I can use all the capable people I can get.
translation: 虽然你给我们惹了不少麻烦，但你也确实证明了自己有过人的才能，我现在恰好需要有才能的人。

original: Crocker gets handed the fluff missions that no one else wants to do. When people need something really important done, they come to me.
translation: 克罗克手上的都是些没人愿意干的杂活。真正遇到要紧事，大家找会来找我。

original: Usually, I dispatch one or more rangers to see these things through, but I'm a little shorthanded at the moment. Think you're up for a real mission?
translation: 放在平时，我只要派几个游骑兵，就能把事情摆平了，但我现在有点缺人手。你想不想接一些正经事干？

original: Good, you made it. I've been receiving reports of your activities for a little while now, and wanted to meet you myself.
translation: 太好了，你来了。我最近一直听部下提起你的事迹，早就想亲自见见你了。

original: The reports label you a troublemaker, but also extraordinarily capable, and right now I can use all the capable people I can get.
translation: 报告上说你虽然喜欢闯祸，但确实才能出众，我现在恰好需要有才能的人。

original: Crocker gets handed the fluff missions that no one else wants to do. When people need something really important done, they come to me.
translation: 克罗克手上的都是些没人愿意干的杂活。真正遇到要紧事，大家找会来找我。

original: Usually, I dispatch one or more rangers to see these things through, but I'm a little shorthanded at the moment. Think you're up for a real mission?
translation: 放在平时，我只要派几个游骑兵，就能把事情摆平了，但我现在有点缺人手。你想不想接一些正经的事干？

original: Good, you made it. I've been receiving reports of your activities for a little while now, and wanted to meet you myself.
translation: 太好了，你来了。我最近一直听部下提起你的事迹，早就想亲自见见你了。

original: You've proven yourself especially capable, and right now I can use all the capable people I can get.
translation: 你证明了自己有过人的才能，我现在恰好需要有才能的人。

original: Crocker gets handed the fluff missions that no one else wants to do. When people need something really important done, they come to me.
translation: 克罗克手上的都是些没人愿意干的杂活。真正遇到要紧事，大家找会来找我。

original: Usually, I dispatch one or more rangers to see these things through, but I'm a little shorthanded at the moment. Think you're up for a real mission?
translation: 放在平时，我只要派几个游骑兵，就能把事情摆平了，但我现在有点缺人手。你想不想接一些正经的事干？

original: Yes, did you have an update on the Khans?
translation: 嗯，你有大汗帮的新消息吗？

original: Have you discovered what the Omertas are up to?
translation: 你搞清楚黑手党到底在打什么主意了吗？

original: Report. Is Mr. House still a threat?
translation: 报告吧。豪斯先生还会构成威胁吗？

original: Has the Brotherhood been found?
translation: 找到兄弟会了吗？

original: Is the president safe?
translation: 总统安全吗？

original: It's best not to keep the general waiting.
translation: 最好别让将军等太久。

original: Ah, our hero returns. What can I do for you?
translation: 啊，我们的英雄回来了。我能为你做什么？

original: {Player sent to Lanius by Caesar or Lucius}You are the courier Lord Caesar has spoken of. The slaughter begins, then.
translation: {PlayersenttoLaniusbyCaesarorLucius}你就是凯撒大人提到的那个邮差了。看来屠杀可以开始了。

original: Greetings, courier. We caught word the battle was about to begin. We arrived before the road was closed off; our warriors are here to assist you.
translation: 你好，邮差。我们已经收到通知，战斗即将打响。我们在道路被封锁前赶到了这里。我们是来协助你的。

original: Alpha Squad reporting in. Thanks for the support back there. We've been assigned to ensure you make it to the Legate. How can we be of assistance?
translation: 阿尔法小队报到。感谢您此前的支援。我们受命护送你前去会见特使。不知您有何指示？

original: We are excecuting your commands.
translation: 我们正在执行你的命令。

original: Go on.
translation: 继续。

original: Not now!
translation: 不是现在！

original: You shouldn't be here. It's best if you just move along.
translation: 你不该在这里出现。赶紧走开。

original: Get out of here already.
translation: 赶紧滚。

original: {Low, vicious, angry}And who is this before me in the colors of the Legion. An envoy... dressed as an insult to all that carry out Caesar's will.
translation: {Low,vicious,angry}瞧瞧我面前这位穿着军团制服的人。一位使节……可你这身行头，简直是对所有凯撒臣民的侮辱。

original: {Suspicious, slow}And who are you to come before me... you bear the insignia of the Bear, yet you do not wear it as a soldier of the West wears it.
translation: {Suspicious,slow}你又是何方圣神……披着狗熊的制服，但仪表却与那群西部人明显不同。

original: {Suspicious, slow}And the West seeks to appease me by sending a woman? Such gifts are meant for the cowards of Vegas, not for the Legion.
translation: {Suspicious,slow}难道西部人想要送一个女人来诱惑我？这样的礼物只适合维加斯的那群懦夫，不适合军团。

original: {Suspicious, slow}An envoy of Vegas, yet you carry yourself for battle. If so, you cannot *truly* be of that city of cowards.
translation: {Suspicious,slow}一位维加斯的使节，但你依然勇敢地投身战场。这样看来，你与城里那帮懦夫截然不同。

original: {Suspicious, slow}And who are you to come before me... you don't bear the mark of the Bear, yet are ready for battle.
translation: {Suspicious,slow}站在我跟前的这位又是何人……你身上虽然没有狗熊的标志，可你却也做好了与我们决一死战的准备。

original: {Final Combat}{Beat, then disdain}Your words have done nothing but delay the inevitable. {Beat}Now, see what my hounds and my blade will bring to you.
translation: 无论你的话有多高明，也无法扭转必然的结局。{Beat}现在，来领教一下我的狼犬和利刃吧。

original: {Cold, finality}For the Legion.
translation: {Cold,finality}为了军团。

original: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.
translation: [失败] 够了。

original: {Uneasy}Guess it ain't no secret how you, uh... I say, can you ask them to put their weapons down. Was just reaching in my coat to give you a cigar.
translation: {Uneasy}看来这也不是什么秘密了，呃……我说，能不能让它们把武器放下。我只是想从大衣里给你掏根雪茄。

original: Come on, men - we're pulling out.
translation: 来吧，兄弟们——我们撤。

original: {Mutters as walking away}Got leveled by a goddamn courier - screw the message, it's the messenger that'll fuck you.
translation: {Muttersaswalkingaway}居然被一个邮差摆了一道——去他娘的口信吧，送信的人才要命呢。

original: What the hell? No, get away from me, you goddamn TV on wheels!
translation: 什么鬼东西？不，离我远点，你这个脚上装着轮子的电视机！

original: {Sensing unpleasant reversal}What is this Brahmin shit. I'm not getting the feeling we're all about to sing koombahyah here.
translation: {Sensing unpleasant reversal}这他娘又唱的哪出。我有种不详的预感，这帮家伙肯定不是来和我们搞联欢的。

original: Fucking Mr. House was holding the cards the whole goddamn time. Him and his little errand boy.
translation: 妈的，原来豪斯一直都藏着杀手锏。他和他手下的那跑腿小弟都是。

original: Fucking Mr. House was holding the cards the whole goddamn time. Him and his little errand girl.
translation: 妈的，原来豪斯一直都藏着杀手锏。他和他手下的那跑腿小妞都是。

original: {Walking away, grumbling}Should have known, Greeks and gifts. That, and next time, shoot the messenger.
translation: {Walkingaway,grumbling}我就知道，黄鼠狼给鸡拜年。下次，见到送信的就直接打死。

original: We don't have time to talk, let's get this fight going.
translation: 没时间聊了，该我们上战场了。

original: {experiment in progress}Please don't interrupt me right now.
translation: {experiment in progress}现在请不要打扰我。

original: Keene has never liked me. If anyone can talk him into backing down, it'll have to be you.
translation: 基恩从来都不喜欢我。如果还有谁能让他改变主意的话，那肯定就是你了。

original: Marcus isn't going to be happy about the deaths, but I guess they were unavoidable. At least I got a lot of useful data from the experiment.
translation: 马可世要是知道这些人死了一定会不高兴的，不过我想他们也难逃一死。至少我从实验中得到了大量的有效数据。

original: This brief test might not yield a cure any time soon. If the prototype was constantly in use on a living subject, however...
translation: 这样简单的实验恐怕难以在短时间内帮我们找出有效的治疗手段。但如果原型机能持续作用于一个活体身上的话，那就……

original: Perhaps Lily might be willing to wear the prototype for a longer duration. The data would be invaluable.
translation: 也许莉莉会愿意再穿一段时间的原型机。那些数据都是无价之宝啊。

original: I think those Nightkin are going cause a lot of trouble, but I guess giving them the specs was better than killing them.
translation: 虽然我也认为那些夜行族是烫手的山芋，不过把实验型设备给他们总比杀了他们强。

original: I did get a lot of useful data from the experiment, and I'm much closer to a cure than I was before.
translation: 通过实验我获得了大量的有效数据，我感觉自己就快要成功了。

original: It's occurred to me that this brief test might not yield a cure any time soon. However, if Lily were to continue to wear the prototype...
translation: 我早就知道这样的简单实验难以在短时间内帮助我们找出有效的治疗手段。但如果莉莉能继续穿着原型机的话…

original: Nice work with the Nightkin. I've never seen anyone able to talk their kind out of anything once they had their mind set to it.
translation: 夜行族的事，你干得不错啊。我还从没见过有人能说服他们那帮家伙改变主意的。

original: I got a lot of useful data from the experiment and am a lot closer to a cure than before.
translation: 通过实验我获得了大量的有效数据，我感觉自己就快要成功了。

original: It's occurred to me that this brief test might not yield a cure any time soon. However, if Lily were to continue to wear the prototype...
translation: 我早就知道这样的简单实验难以在短时间内帮助我们找出有效的治疗手段。但如果莉莉能继续穿着原型机的话…

original: Have you come to a decision on Lily? I'll need to know before I can do anything else.
translation: 莉莉的事情你有打算了吗？请告诉我，否则我无法继续下一步工作。

original: My request is perfectly reasonable. Give us the Stealth Boy specs and there will be no need for us to splatter the room with your insides.
translation: 我的要求非常合理。把隐身小子实验型交给我们，这样我们就不必把你的内脏涂得满屋子都是。

original: Don't you still have business with Doctor Henry? You and I are done.
translation: 你不是还有事要找亨利医生吗？我这边已经没什么问题了。

original: That Keene, always causing trouble.
translation: 那个基恩，总是惹麻烦。

original: Be careful with Keene. He's got a mean temper.
translation: 小心基恩。他的脾气可不怎么好。

original: If you're down on your luck and need some caps, I buy just about anything. Of course, I've also got plenty of things for sale, too.
translation: 如果你手气不好，需要瓶盖，我这基本什么东西都能当。当然，我也有充足的货物可供出售。

original: Here to do business?
translation: 来做生意吗？

original: Howdy. Name's Bob, but folks around here call me Klamath Bob. What can I do you for?
translation: 你好。我叫鲍勃，这里的人都叫我克拉马斯·鲍勃。有什么事吗？

original: Hey, stranger. Hope you been well. What do you need?
translation: 嘿，陌生人。祝你安康。有事吗？

original: Nng. Hi.
translation: 嗯，嗨。

original: Nng. Hi again.
translation: 嗯，又见面了。

original: Hi there. Welcome to the Westside Co-op. I'm Clayton Ettienne. Let me know if you have any questions.
translation: 你好。欢迎来到西区合作社。我是克莱顿·埃迪尼。如果你有什么不清楚的，尽管问我。

original: Welcome back. How can I help you?
translation: 欢迎回来。需要点什么？

original: Uh... hi.
translation: 呃……嗨。

original: Oh, hello.
translation: 哦，你好。

original: {kid who just got caught in the act}Agh! I wasn't doing anything!
translation: {kid who just got caught in the act}啊！我什么都没做！

original: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

original: Hello? Can you help me?
translation: 你好，你能帮帮我吗？

original: Have you decided to help me?
translation: 你决定要帮我了吗？

original: Please hurry! She's on the ridge, past the broken radio tower.
translation: 请快点！她就在山脊上，那座坏掉的无线电塔后面。

original: Sorry I tricked you, but thanks for clearing out the Geckos. Now I can get to that stash up there... after I deal with you.
translation: 对不起我骗了你，但是谢谢你帮我清理了那些大蜥蜴，现在我终于能拿到那个箱子了……不过我得先干掉你。

original: I hate it here, fucking sulfur stinks.
translation: 我讨厌这里，该死的硫磺臭。

original: This vault gives me the creeps.
translation: 这个避难所让我毛骨悚然。

original: Have you read the logs on the computers? Fucked up shit.
translation: 你看过终端机上的日志了吗？太鸡巴惨了。

original: Fucking geckos.
translation: 该死的蜥蜴。

original: No way I'm going back to prison.
translation: 我绝对不会回监狱的。

original: So much for Lem, you should have seen it, guts flying everywhere.
translation: 莱姆已经完了，你应该看到了，内脏飞得到处都是。

original: Lem was going to turn us all in to the NCR, I'm glad he's dead.
translation: 莱姆打算把我们所有人都交给NCR，很高兴他已经死了。

original: We can finally relax with Cooke gone.
translation: 库克不在了，我们终于可以松口气。

original: Cooke left the vault, good thing too he was going to get us all killed.
translation: 库克离开了避难所，这真是个好消息，我们不会被他全害死了。

original: Cooke is going to get us all killed.
translation: 库克会把我们全害死。

original: Lem wants to run back to the NCR and turn himself in, spineless bastard.
translation: 莱姆打算找NCR自首，软骨头的废物。

original: I hear the Great Khans are pretty tough, I hope we can join them.
translation: 我听说大汗帮相当厉害，希望我们可以加入他们。

original: Join the Great Khans, what the hell is Cooke thinking?
translation: 加入大汗帮？库克到底在他妈想些什么？

original: I don't know about this whole Great Khan thing...
translation: 我不太了解这个所谓的大汗帮……

original: Did you hear? We're going to join the Great Khans.
translation: 你听说了吗？我们要加入大汗帮了。

original: I don't want to join the Great Khans, but I guess it's better than going back to prison.
translation: 我不想加入大汗帮，但这总比回监狱强。

original: Hmm, join the Great Khans or die in the wasteland? Good fucking plan Cooke.
translation: 唔，要么加入大汗帮，要么横死废土？库克这计划真他妈棒。

original: I don't want to join the Great Khans.
translation: 我不想加入大汗帮。

original: {Player not in Powder Ganger gear}{part of an act - he's not really a merchant and trying to see if the player is really a Powder Ganger}Better be careful around these parts. I hear there's Powder Gangers around and dangerous for merchants like me.
translation: {Player not in Powder Ganger gear}{part of an act - he's not really a merchant and trying to see if the player is really a Powder Ganger}在这附近的时候要小心点。我听说这一带有炸药帮出没，对我这样的商人来说，他们可是很危险的。

original: {Male PC, in Powder Ganger gear}{triumphant}Well, well. It's about time one of you guys came along. I figure the NCR would pay a pretty good bounty for a Powder Ganger.
translation: {Male PC, in 炸药帮 gear}{triumphant}哎呀，哎呀。你们这些家伙来得真是时候。NCR给炸药帮开出的悬赏可是不低。

original: {Female PC, in Powder Ganger gear}{puzzled}Hadn't heard there were women Powder Gangers, but a bounty's a bounty. The NCR will probably pay up either way.
translation: {Female PC，in Powder Ganger gear}{puzzled}虽然没听说过炸药帮里还有女的，不过悬赏就是悬赏。NCR不管男女都会照付。

original: You won't see me around here again.
translation: 你不会在附近看见我了。

original: What brings you back?
translation: 你怎么回来了？

original: {Curious Beep}<Makes beeping sounds>
translation: {Curious Beep}<发出哔哔声>

original: {Happy Beep}<Makes beeping sounds>
translation: {Happy Beep}<发出哔哔声>

original: Oh, you here to work? I think I have an extra shovel around here somewhere.
translation: 哦，你是来干活的？这儿倒是还多一把铲子。

original: Sorry, I don't have time to talk right now. Talk to Trent, he might be able to help you out.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没时间聊天。去跟特伦特说吧，也许他能帮你。

original: Greetings! {Slight Pause}Pardon my enthusiasm. I'm not accustomed to meeting so many new people, but I find you fascinating.
translation: 你好啊！{Slight Pause}请原谅我的热情。本来我是不习惯见到这么多生面孔的，但我觉得你人不错。

original: I've tried to learn as much as possible about the surface world since our community left our home.
translation: 自从离开家园之后，我就一直在适应地面的生活。

original: Hello again, outlander.
translation: 又见面了，外乡人。

original: {Dumbfounded}Why are the outlanders killing each other? Why do they treat us like machines?{Lamenting his fate} I wish we had remained in the safety, and sanity, of our Vault.
translation: {Dumbfounded}那些外乡人为什么要自相残杀？为什么他们把我们当机器对待？{Lamenting his fate}早知道我们就应该待在安全又平静的避难所里。

original: Hello, outlander.
translation: 你好，外乡人。

original: It's good making your acquaintance.
translation: 能和你结识真是太好了。

original: Excuse me, I'm{dubitative}... not from around here.
translation: 很抱歉，我{dubitative}……不是本地的。

original: Horowitz is our leader.
translation: 霍洛维茨是我们的领头。

original: {Emotional to meet savior}You're the one who saved us! Thank you.
translation: {Emotional to meet savior}是你救了我们！谢谢你。

original: {Complicit and congratulatory}I heard you talking to Horowitz, and can't thank you enough for what you've done for us.
translation: {Complicit and congratulatory}我听到你跟霍洛维茨说的话了，你为我们做了这么多，真不知道怎么谢谢你。

original: {Emotional to meet savior}I hope everyone on the surface is like you.
translation: {Emotional to meet savior}希望地面上的每个人都能像你这样。

original: {Sincere thankfulness}We're in your debt. Thank you, outlander.
translation: {Sincere thankfulness}我们都欠你一份情。谢谢你，外乡人。

original: {Lamenting fate}I wish we were back at our Vault.
translation: {Lamenting fate}我想回我们的避难所去。

original: {Lamenting fate}The surface world is a cruel place.
translation: {Lamenting fate}地上的世界太可怕了。

original: {Angry disbelief}Why are you people treating us like this?
translation: {Angry disbelief}你们为什么要这样对待我们？

original: {Angry Disappointment}We're heading back home. I hope our troops do the same. This land can't be saved.
translation: {Angry Disappointment}我们要回家了。希望我们的军队也能一起回去。这片土地没救了。

original: {Sorrowful}Trying to grow crops in this heat, with so little water, is bad enough, but now we've got radiation seeping into the farmlands east of New Vegas.
translation: {Sorrowful}在这种又热又缺水的地方种庄稼已经够糟了，现在我们在新维加斯以东的农田又受了辐射污染。

original: {Angry Disappointment}We're done. Let the people of these hell-hole deal with their problems, I say.
translation: {Angry Disappointment}我们受够了。要我说，就让这鬼地方的人去自生自灭吧。

original: I can't wait to get back to NCR lands.
translation: 我都等不及要回到NCR的领地去了。

original: {Sorrowful}All our work was for nothing.
translation: {Sorrowful}我们做了那么多全是白费。

original: {Angry Disappointment}We should've never come here.
translation: {Angry Disappointment}我们就不该来这里。

original: {Angry Disappointment}Good riddance, Mojave.
translation: {Angry Disappointment}永别了，莫哈维。

original: Welcome to the NCR Embassy, how can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到NCR大使馆，有什么可以帮您的吗？

original: I'm kind of busy, what do you want?
translation: 我有点忙，你有什么事？

original: Welcome back. What can I do for you this time?
translation: 欢迎回来。这次你又有什么事？

original: If you're looking for Ambassador Crocker, he's not here. He was removed form office and sent home.
translation: 如果你想找克罗克大使，他不在。他已经被革职回家了。

original: I guess they disagreed with how he handled some of the events out here. It's unfortunate. He was a good man.
translation: 我想上级可能对他在部分事务上的做法有些不满。可惜了，他人还挺不错的。

original: So you're the one that saved President Kimball. Damn glad to have you on our side.
translation: 原来你就是救了金博尔总统的那个人。真高兴你能站在我们这一边。

original: What can I help you with?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: I heard there was an attempt on President Kimball's life. I'm glad he's alright. Don't know what the NCR would do without him.
translation: 我听说有人想谋害金博尔总统。总统安然无恙真让我欣慰。真不敢想象没有了他NCR该怎么办。

original: I've had to increase security around the Strip due to the President's assassination. I can barely believe he's dead myself.
translation: 由于发生了针对总统的刺杀事件，我不得不增强长街周边的安保力度。我可不敢想象他死了该怎么办。

original: So you're the one causing all the ruckus at The Tops. You're lucky you're not under my jurisdiction or I'd have tossed you in a cell for that.
translation: 原来把九重天闹得鸡飞狗跳的人就是你啊。没落到我手底下算你走运，不然你早进大牢了。

original: I heard you killed Benny over at The Tops. I bet you think you're some sort of tough guy.
translation: 我听说你在九重天杀掉了本尼。我想你应该很厉害吧。

original: A piece of advice, if you mess with any of my men, you'll regret it.
translation: 给你个建议，最好别招惹我的部下，否则你会后悔的。

original: I heard you killed Benny over at The Tops. I bet you think you're some sort of tough cookie.
translation: 听说你在九重天杀了本尼。我想你应该很厉害吧。

original: A piece of advice, if you mess with any of my men, you'll regret it.
translation: 给你个建议，最好别招惹我的部下，否则你会后悔的。

original: I wanted to thank you for stopping the Omertas. That could have gone poorly for us if it wasn't for you.
translation: 我要感谢你阻止了黑手党的计划。没有你，我们都会遭殃的。

original: I hear you've been meeting with Mr. House in the Lucky 38. I bet you think you're pretty special, don't you?
translation: 听说你在幸运38里见到了豪斯先生。你肯定觉得自己很特别，对吧？

original: Special or not, stay out of trouble and more importantly stay out of my way.
translation: 我才懒得管你特不特别，只要别惹麻烦就行了。还有，不要跟我过不去。

original: What the hell is with those Securitrons? Looks like they got some sort of change or upgrade. I don't like the look of this.
translation: 那些电子保安到底怎么回事？看起来好像是升级了。我可不喜欢这样。

original: I heard Mr. House is out of the picture now. Guess that leaves us in charge of the Strip.
translation: 我听说豪斯先生已经玩完了。这么说来，该我们掌管长街了。

original: Make it quick, I've got a shitstorm to deal with due to the damn monorail being blown up.
translation: 有话快说，我还得去收拾单轨铁路被炸后的狗屁烂摊子呢。

original: So you're the one running errands for Ambassador Crocker. I don't want to know details, just don't cause any trouble.
translation: 原来你就是那个给克罗克大使跑腿的人。我不想知道你都干了啥，只要你别惹麻烦就行了。

original: Keep your nose clean on the strip, soldier.
translation: 别在长街惹是非，士兵。

original: {Surprised, Happy}Wow, I didn't expect to see you here. What can I do for you?
translation: {Surprised,Happy}哇哦，没想到能在这见到你。我能为你做什么？

original: Good to see you around here. What can I do for you?
translation: 非常高兴能在这见到你。我能为你做什么？

original: {Threatening}You make one wrong move around here and I'll be all over you in a heartbeat. You hear me?
translation: {Threatening}你敢乱来，我就敢马上把你撂倒。听懂了？

original: {Threatening}You better watch yourself around here.
translation: {Threatening}你最好自己注意点。

original: You've got a lot of nerve showing your face around here. You're lucky I don't shoot you right now.
translation: 你居然还有胆子来这个地方。我没一枪毙了你算你走运。

original: You better have a good reason for being here.
translation: 你最好能说明自己的来意。

original: So you're the new hotshot on the Strip. Just because you can walk around on the Strip with your guns doesn't make you a big shot.
translation: 你就是最近长街上热议的那个大红人吧。别以为你能挎着枪在长街上乱晃，就可以无法无天了。

original: You make any trouble for me or my men and I'll make sure you regret if for a very long time. You got that?
translation: 如果你敢给我的人找麻烦，我保证让你肠子都悔青。听懂了吗？

original: Now are you here for something or are you just wasting my time?
translation: 你是有什么事，还是单纯地想浪费我的时间？

original: Make it quick.
translation: 快一点儿。

original: Didn't you save President Kimball? You're my new hero!
translation: 你不就是救了金博尔总统的那个人吗？你是我的新偶像！

original: What can I do for you, friend?
translation: 我能为你做什么，朋友？

original: I heard President Kimball was attacked at Hoover Dam. I can barely believe it.
translation: 听说金博尔总统在胡佛水坝被人袭击了。真不敢相信。

original: I'm just glad nothing bad happened to him.
translation: 好在他安然无恙。

original: Some bastards killed President Kimball. Who's going to lead the NCR now?
translation: 有个狗杂种杀了金博尔总统。现在谁来领导NCR？

original: Aren't you the guy that was shooting up The Tops?
translation: 你就是大闹九重天的那个家伙吧？

original: Guess you must have some special deal with House to be able to do that and not get in trouble.
translation: 你肯定是跟豪斯签了什么特别协议，不然你闯了那么大的祸，怎么可能安然无恙。

original: Aren't you the gal that was shooting up The Tops?
translation: 你就是大闹九重天的那个姑娘吧？

original: Guess you must have some special deal with House to be able to do that and not get in trouble.
translation: 你肯定是跟豪斯签了什么特别协议，不然你闯了那么大的祸，怎么可能安然无恙。

original: I heard you snuffed that Benny guy. Good riddance, guy was a scumbag.
translation: 听说你干掉了本尼那家伙。干得好，他本来就是个混蛋。

original: I heard you stopped the Omertas plan to attack the Strip. Good job, you're a real hero.
translation: 听说你阻止了黑手党进攻长街的计划。干得好，你真是个英雄。

original: So you're the one that went into the Lucky 38. I bet that was pretty creepy.
translation: 原来你就是进入幸运38的那个人。我打赌里面肯定很恐怖。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: I thought those Securitrons were creepy enough already. Now, they have soldier faces on them, that's even creepier.
translation: 本来那些电子保安已经够吓人了。现在它们全换成了士兵脸，比以前更恐怖了。

original: Holy shit, did you here about the Monorail being destroyed? How the fuck did that happen?
translation: 妈的，你是来调查铁路被炸毁的事的吗？这他妈到底是怎么回事？

original: I'm just glad to be safe over here on the Strip.
translation: 还好我一直在长街，这里很安全。

original: If it isn't the Ambassador's new best friend. What can I do for you?
translation: 这不是大使的新朋友嘛。有什么需要我效劳的？

original: I can't believe it's gone. It's all gone. How the fuck did this happen?
translation: 真不敢相信就这样没了。全没了。这他妈的到底是怎么回事？

original: Hey, you just get in for some R&R?
translation: 嘿，要不要来放松一下？

original: Well look who it is! Glad to have you here, buddy! What can I do for you?
translation: 瞧瞧这是谁来了！很高兴在这见到你，伙计！需要我做点什么？

original: Wow, look who it is! What can I help you with?
translation: 哇哦，快看是谁来了！需要我帮忙吗？

original: I don't want any trouble, mister. What do you want?
translation: 别惹麻烦，先生。你有什么事？

original: I don't want any trouble, lady. What do you want?
translation: 别惹麻烦，女士。你有什么事？

original: I probably shouldn't be talking to you, but what do you want?
translation: 我也许不该跟你说话，不过，你想要什么？

original: {Hostile}You're the last person I expected to see here. What do you want?
translation: {Hostile}我最不想见到的人就是你。你要干嘛？

original: {Hostile}What do you want?
translation: {Hostile}你要干嘛？

original: Hey, stranger. What's happening?
translation: 嘿，陌生人。最近怎么样？

original: What's going on?
translation: 发生了什么？

original: Hello again. Feeling thirsty?
translation: 欢迎再次光临。口渴了么？

original: Howdy! Interested in a refreshing beverage or a tasty snack?
translation: 你好！想来点提神饮料还是美味小吃？

original: Greetings, citizen.
