translation: 你好，公民。

original: What is it, citizen?
translation: 什么事，公民？

original: Observe the rules, citizen.
translation: 遵纪守法，公民。

original: Indulge responsibly, citizen.
translation: 忠诚尽责，公民。

original: Self-control is a virtue, citizen.
translation: 自制即美德，公民。

original: Don't miss The Lonesome Drifter, LIVE at the Aces Theater!
translation: 别错过《寂寞流浪汉》，王牌剧场正在上演！

original: Songs so sad and lonesome, audience members of the opposite sex will be fighting over who gets to go back to your room with you - guaranteed!
translation: 歌声惆怅寂寥，所有异性观众听了都会为和你同房而互不相让——我敢打包票！

original: Ready to tap your toes and snap your fingers? Don't miss Bruce Issac, LIVE at the Ace Theater!
translation: 想跟着节拍摇摆吗？别错过《布鲁斯·艾萨克》，王牌剧场正在上演！

original: {cheerfully obnoxious}"Hey, asshole!"
translation: {cheerfullyobnoxious}"嘿，混球！"

original: Everyone loves a good insult, am I right? So you'll love Hadrian, LIVE at the Aces Theater!
translation: 喜欢讽刺剧吗？那么你一定会喜欢哈德良！王牌剧场正在上演！

original: "Fuck off, ass-breath!" You've already heard my spiel - you really gotta go see Hadrian!
translation: "滚开，臭嘴！"——既然你听见我吆喝了，那你就该去看哈德良的演出！

original: "Pull my finger, {puh-leeze}please!"
translation: "来，{puh-leeze}臭屁来袭！"

original: See Billy Knight, King of the One-Liners - LIVE at the Aces Theater! If you miss it, you'll "Take your life, please!"
translation: 段子王比利·奈特，就在王牌剧场！错过一下子，后悔"一辈子！"

original: "I bet you could stop gambling!" {laugh}See Billy Knight, King of the One-Liners, LIVE at the Aces Theater! "I had amnesia once - I think!"{laugh}
translation: "我打赌你能戒赌！"{laugh}段子王比利·奈特，就在王牌剧场！"我得过一次失忆症——我记得可清楚啦！"{laugh}

original: Hey, baby. There's more of this waiting for you inside.
translation: 嘿，宝贝。里头还有更多好玩的等着你呢。

original: You like it, huh?
translation: 你喜欢吗，嗯？

original: Check my moves, honey.
translation: 跟上我的节奏，甜心。

original: I like what I see...
translation: 我喜欢我看到的……

original: Dancing makes me sweat... all over.
translation: 跳舞总会让我……出汗。

original: Honey, what's your name?
translation: 甜心，你叫什么名字？

original: Ah, hello. I trust you have something to report concerning the Freeside situation?
translation: 哦，你好。你应该是来报告自由城情况的吧？

original: Something I can help you with, soldier?
translation: 你有什么事吗，士兵？

original: It's good to see such an outstanding hero of the NCR. What can I do for you, my friend?
translation: NCR能涌现出你这样的英雄，真是太好了。我能为你做些什么，朋友？

original: It's good to have a friend of the NCR here. What can I do for you?
translation: 能看到NCR拥有你这样的朋友真是太好了。我能为你做些什么？

original: Well, if it isn't the loose cannon that's been wandering the Mojave Wasteland. What do you want?
translation: 哎哟，这位不就是那个大名鼎鼎横行莫哈维废土的逍遥侠嘛。你有什么事？

original: I didn't expect to see you here. I hope you're not here to cause trouble.
translation: 没想到会在这看见你。希望你不是来找麻烦的。

original: You're the last person I expected to see here. This better be good.
translation: 我最不想见到的人就是你。你最好不是来说废话的。

original: {Angry}What do you want?
translation: {Angry}你到底要干嘛？

original: Greetings, friend. Something I can help you with?
translation: 你好啊，朋友。有什么我能帮忙的吗？

original: Hello again. What can I do for you this time?
translation: 你好。这次又有什么事吗？

original: I don't have anything more to say to you. You can show yourself out.
translation: 我跟你没什么好说的。你可以走了。

original: Can I help you?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

original: I bet it feels real nice to be carrying those weapons around on the strip.
translation: 我敢打赌，能带着武器在长街转悠，那感觉肯定很棒。

original: That damn Mr. House has forbid any NCR military personnel from carrying any sort of firearms on the Strip. Well, except for Captain Pappas.
translation: 该死的豪斯先生禁止NCR的军事人员携带任何武器进入长街。呃，除了帕帕斯队长。

original: Mr. House still doesn't trust the NCR. A word of advice, the Securitrons won't put up with any funny stuff out there, so don't do anything stupid.
translation: 豪斯先生还是不信任NCR。给你个建议：那些电子保安可不是摆设，千万别干傻事。

original: This your first time on the Strip?
translation: 你是第一次来长街吗？

original: Hello. Do you need something?
translation: 你好。需要什么？

original: Welcome back, friend! How can I help you?
translation: 欢迎回来，朋友！我能帮你什么忙吗？

original: Hey, as long as you behave I'll deal with you. Okay?
translation: 嘿，只要你守规矩，我就会和你做生意。好吗？

original: I don't deal with unwanted people. Leave me alone.
translation: 我不跟不受待见的人做生意。离我远点。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: May I help you?
translation: 我能帮你吗？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: How can I help you?
translation: 我怎么帮你？

original: Are you the Van Graffs' emissary?
translation: 你就是范格拉夫的使者？

original: Don't talk to me, rookie!
translation: 别跟我说话，菜鸟！

original: They're all dead. Guy must've had some kind of explosive on him, set off all the ordinance in this place at once.
translation: 他们都死了。那个家伙肯定在身上绑了炸药，一下把这里全炸开了花。

original: Congratulations, rookie. You just cost me my job. Don't think I don't appreciate it.
translation: 祝贺你，菜鸟。你帮我省了不少事。我还是要感谢你的。

original: I was just telling Gloria about your performance. Hell of a first day, huh?
translation: 我刚还在和格罗利亚说你的表现呢。第一天就吃了不少苦头啊？

original: Welcome to the Silver Rush, New Vegas's best- ah, I'm just kidding. Go on in.
translation: 欢迎来到银色冲击，新维加斯最好的——啊，开玩笑的。进去吧。

original: Welcome to the Silv- ah crap, don't tell me you're my new guard.
translation: 欢迎来到银——我老天，别跟我说你就是新来的警卫。

original: Okay, now let's get you geared up. First, your armor.
translation: 好吧，咱们先把行头穿上。首先，你的护甲。

original: Standard issue is your run-of-the-mill combat armor, with a nice dark coat of paint for both brand recognition and sheer intimidation value.
translation: 虽说只是烂大街的标准战斗装甲，但表面刷了一层明亮的黑漆。不仅醒目，还能唬人。

original: Next, your weapon. Guards are required to use rifles. Anything lighter compromises your combat effectiveness.
translation: 接下来，是你的武器。警卫必须使用步枪。比步枪轻型的武器只会让你的战斗力大打折扣。

original: Anything heavier and people are too scared to come in the door. What's your preference, laser or plasma?
translation: 而个头大一点的武器则会把客人吓跑。那么，你喜欢哪种，激光还是等离子？

original: Welcome to the Silver Rush, New Vegas's best source of laser and plasma weapons.
translation: 欢迎来到银色冲击，新维加斯最好的激光和等离子武器都在这里。

original: I'm not paid to talk to customers.
translation: 老板雇我可不是让我和客人聊天的。

original: You really don't want to start trouble in here.
translation: 你最好别在这儿惹麻烦。

original: We're all going to be rich soon. You watch.
translation: 我们很快就会发财的。你等着瞧吧。

original: One wrong move and you're ash, pal.
translation: 乱动一下，你就会被烧成灰，伙计。

original: You want to chat, talk to the owners.
translation: 你想聊天，去找老板聊。

original: Good job. I need to work out some last minute details with our new clients, but after that we'll head back to the Rush.
translation: 非常好。我跟新客户最后再讨论几个问题，谈完了我们就回店里。

original: No time to talk. We have to finish these bastards off!
translation: 没时间说话了。我们得把这些混蛋全都干掉！

original: Good, you're here. Do you remember that package I had you deliver? Well, the client liked the sample and put in a massive order.
translation: 很好，你来了。还记得上次我让你送的那个包裹吗？客户对样品很满意，下了一个大单。

original: It's possibly the biggest order we've ever supplied. I've had to repeatedly assure my mother that everything will go smoothly.
translation: 这可能是我们接过的最大的一单生意。我不得不再三向我妈保证一切都会顺利。

original: And that's where I'm hoping you'll come in. We'll be bringing an escort, and I want you on it. What do you say?
translation: 也因为如此，只好再请你帮一次忙。我们正在组织一支护卫队，我希望你也能参加。你觉得怎么样？

original: Simon's been telling me how it went. Let's do a quick recap.
translation: 西蒙已经向我汇报过情况了。咱们长话短说吧。

original: Welcome back. Did you have news for me, or are you just here for the guns?
translation: 欢迎回来。你是有消息要带给我，还是要买枪？

original: Welcome back. I hope you've been working on that task Jean-Baptiste had for you. My brother is not a patient man by any means.
translation: 欢迎回来。希望你还在执行杰·巴普迪斯特给你的任务。我这哥哥各种意义上，都不是个很有耐心的人。

original: Welcome to the Silver Rush, where only top of the line energy weapons can be found. What can I do for you?
translation: 欢迎来到银色冲击，我们这里出售的都是最顶级的能量武器。想要买什么？

original: Well, looks like you came through after all. She's not half bad looking, is she? It's almost a shame...
translation: 哎呀，看来你还是走到这一步了。她长得挺俊的，不是么？可惜了……

original: Crimson Caravan and Van Graffs won't need to worry about you anymore, Mojave's ours, we're shutting you down for good.
translation: 深红商队和范·格拉夫家族不必再担心你了，莫哈维是我们的，今天就是你的死期。

original: {Laughs}That was fun. Did you see the look on that bitch's face? {Laughs again}Priceless.
translation: {Laughs}太好玩了。你看到那个婊子脸上的表情了么？{Laughsagain}千金难买啊。

original: As I live and breathe, Rose of Sharon Cassidy. The {emph}late Rose of Sharon Cassidy. Was hoping you were on that caravan I massacred, but...
translation: 真是百闻不如一见啊，罗撒香·盖西迪。凋谢的{emph}罗撒香·盖西迪。我本以为会在商队的尸体堆里见到你，但……

original: Crimson Caravan and Van Graffs won't need to worry about you anymore, Mojave's ours, and we're shutting you down for good.
translation: 深红商队和范·格拉夫家族不必再担心你了，莫哈维是我们的，今天就是你的死期。

original: Hey, how's it going? You find that bitch yet or not?
translation: 嘿，怎么样了？你找到那个婊子了没有？

original: Ah, just the person I was looking for. Your name came up in a discussion we had recently.
translation: 啊，真是巧了，我们刚才还聊到你了。

original: My sister is very impressed with you so far, but I'm not. I don't think you have what it takes to work for this family.
translation: 迄今为止我妹妹对你的印象都不错，但我却相反。我觉得你缺少一种为我们家族工作所需要的品质。

original: Luckily for you, I'm going to give you the chance to prove me wrong. What do you say? Want to make some real money?
translation: 不过你很走运，我打算给你一个机会来证明自己。你怎么说？想不想赚点正经钱？

original: What the fuck do you want? I've got no use for fucking cowards.
translation: 你他妈要干什么？我对他妈的胆小鬼没兴趣。

original: Glory's the one you want to talk to about working for us. I just handle the details.
translation: 想为我们做事的话，去找格洛丽亚吧。我只负责处理具体事务。

original: Eh? You want something?
translation: 嗯？你要干什么？

original: Get the fuck away from me. The last man who bothered me "volunteered" to help test our weapons.
translation: 给我滚远点。上一个来烦我的人已经"自愿"成了我们测试武器的活靶子。

original: Don't hurry me. I'm trying to get your stuff ready.
translation: 别催我。我在帮你准备东西呢。

original: My favorite employee returns! What can I do for you?
translation: 我最中意的员工回来了！有什么事吗？

original: {drunk, slurs everything}Hi there! Is this where I can pick up a {lay-shur}laser gun?
translation: {drunk,slurseverything}嗨，你好！这里就是卖{lay-shur}激光枪的地方吗？

original: Is that it? Can I go in now?
translation: 就这样？我现在能进去了么？

original: Howdy! I just done broke the bank over at the Wrangler there and thought I might peruse your fine wares, maybe lighten my purse a little.
translation: 你好啊！我刚在原子牛仔赢了一大笔钱，正想着能不能到你们店里给钱包减减负。

original: Uh, hi. I was, um, in the area and thought I'd stop by to look at your weapons. Can I go in?
translation: 哦，嗨。我……呃，在逛街的时候看到了这里，想瞧瞧你们卖的武器。我能进去吗？

original: Hey, lookin' for something to replace my old revolver. Mind if I head in?
translation: 嘿，我想找件新武器，换下我的旧左轮手枪。我能进去么？

original: We've already concluded our business. I suggest you return to your employers.
translation: 我们的生意已经做完了。我建议你回去找你的老板。

original: {Male PC}If you're injured, I might have healing powder to spare.
translation: {Male PC}如果你受伤了，我这里有些多余的治疗粉。

original: {Female PC - surprise, tinged with envy}A free woman. It's... been awhile since I've seen a woman who wasn't a slave. {"forget" as in she's a slave who's forgotten her position, and shouldn't be rambling}I forget myself - are you injured?
translation: {Female PC - surprise， tinged with envy}一个自由的女人。我……我已经很久没看到不是奴隶的女人了。 {"forget" as in she's a slave who's forgotten her position， and shouldn't be rambling}我失态了——你受伤了吗？

original: {Caesar dead}With {KAI-zar}Caesar dead, I'm afraid for the women. The Legate is a brutal man, and he enjoys inflicting pain.
translation: {Caesar dead} {KAI-zar}凯撒已死，我真为那些女人们感到担心。特使是个野蛮的人，专以制造痛苦为乐。

original: {Caeser cured}{wistful}I had hoped to become a great doctor like you someday.
translation: {Caeser cured}{wistful}我一直希望有朝一日能成为像你一样优秀的医生。

original: You got Melody her bear back. Very kind of you.
translation: 你把梅洛迪的小熊找回来了。你真是个好人。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: So you're the visitor I've heard some of the Legionaries talking about. If you're in the mood to trade, just say the word.
translation: 你就是军团士兵们提到的那位客人吧。如果你想做生意，就尽管开口吧。

original: {Caesar dead}I've heard some bad stories about this Legate. I'm not sure I'll be welcome around here once he takes charge.
translation: {Caesar dead}我听说过一些不利于特使的传言。如果他掌权的话，我不知道自己在这儿还会不会受欢迎。

original: {Caesar cured}Never had you pegged as the doctor-type. Guess I know who to come to now when I get sick.
translation: {Caesar cured}我之前还真没想过你是个当医生的料。这下我知道生病该找谁了。

original: Howdy again.
translation: 又见面了。

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar awaits. You can speak with me later.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒在等你。我们可以晚点再谈。

original: {Caesar dead during surgery}{controlled white-hot anger}{KAI-zar}Caesar is dead at your hands. This crime cannot go unpunished.
translation: {Caesar dead during surgery}{controlled white-hot anger}{KAI-zar}凯撒死在了你的手上。这样的罪责难逃惩罚。

original: {Caesar died via Auto-Doc}{confused, angry}I don't understand - the machine was supposed to cure {KAI-zar}Caesar. {growing anger, blaming player}You did this - his blood is own your hands.
translation: {Caesar died via Auto-Doc}{confused， angry}我不理解，这台机器能本该治好{KAI-zar}凯撒的。{growing anger， blaming player}是你干的——你手上沾满了他的血。

original: {Caesar dead during surgery, Player incompetent}Your butchery of {KAI-zar}Caesar will not go unpunished!
translation: {Caesar dead during surgery， Player incompetent}你这个屠夫。{KAI-zar}你杀了凯撒，你会受到惩罚的！

original: {Caesar cured}{admiring}{KAI-zar}Caesar was right to put his trust in you. Your skill in medicine is beyond anything I've ever seen before.
translation: {Caesar cured}{admiring}{KAI-zar}凯撒果然没信错人。你的医术真是精湛无比。

original: {Caesar has fallen into a coma}{KAI-zar}Caesar sleeps but doesn't awaken. I fear it is only a matter of days before death claims him.
translation: {Caesar has fallen into a coma}{KAI-zar}凯撒一直昏睡不醒。我害怕他已经时日无多了。

original: You will answer to me until such a time as {KAI-zar}Caesar is able to resume leadership.
translation: 在{KAI-zar}凯撒能够重新领导我们之前，你必须听从我的号令。

original: It's a great honor for anyone outside the Legion to get an audience with Caesar.
translation: 作为一名外人，能够得到凯撒的接见，真是莫大的荣幸啊。

original: {Liked, once only}You've proven yourself to be true friend of the Legion. We have a safehouse available to our agents in the Mojave - here's the key.
translation: {Liked， once only}你已经证明了你是军团真正的朋友。莫哈维有座安全屋是专为我们的特工准备的，这是钥匙。

original: It's an excellent place to rest and store extra equipment. In addition, one of our veterans, Atticus, visits the house every few days.
translation: 你可以在那里放心休息，存放多余的装备。另外，阿提卡斯，我们的一位老兵，每隔几天就会去那里一趟。

original: While he's there, you can acquire items useful for stealthy operations against our enemies from him.
translation: 他去的时候，你可以在他那里获取执行隐秘行动所需要的物资。

original: {terse military manner}Yes? Do you have something to report?
translation: {terse military manner}嗯？你有什么要报告的吗？

original: Outsiders are a rare sight at the Fort. Step carefully around here and you might just leave alive. I'm Antony, master of the hounds.
translation: 城堡里很少有外人。在这儿别造次，否则你没法活着离开。我是安东尼，这儿的驯犬师。

original: {Killed the mongrels in the arena}Damn it. I thought they had you.
translation: {Killed the mongrels in the arena}该死的。我还以为它们能干掉你呢。

original: {Caesar dead}It'll be strange not having {KAI-zar}Caesar in command, but Legate Lanius is a strong leader.
translation: {Caesar dead}没了凯撒的领导{KAI-zar}可能会有些奇怪，但特使拉尼厄斯是一个坚强的领袖。

original: {Caesar cured}I'm sure you had to use a lot of healing powder on {KAI-zar}Caesar. Well done.
translation: {Caesar cured}我敢说你在凯撒身上一定用了不少治疗粉。干得好。

original: {Rex hired}The mechanical dog you have with you - where did you get it?
translation: {Rex hired}你的那只机械狗，是从哪搞来的？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: {Male PC}You here to fight in the arena? Then you're talking to the right man.
translation: {Male PC}你是来参加竞技场角斗的？那你可找对人了。

original: {Female PC}What do you want from me, woman? I'm in charge of the arena, not the cooking pots.
translation: {Female PC}你想干嘛，小娘们？我管的是竞技场，可不是锅碗瓢盆。

original: As expected, it wasn't much of a fight, but what can you expect from slaves?
translation: 和预料的一样，根本不堪一击，不过奴隶又有什么可指望的呢？

original: A good fight. Some NCR troopers can be competent fighters.
translation: 打得漂亮。看来NCR部队当中还是有几个猛士的。

original: Unbelievable. You stood against a Ranger in single combat and survived.
translation: 难以置信。你居然和一个游骑兵单打独斗还能活下来。

original: {Caesar dead}{KAI-zar}Caesar was a great man, but the Legion will become even greater with Legate Lanius at its head.
translation: {Caesar dead}{KAI-zar}凯撒是个伟人，但军团在特使拉尼厄斯的带领下将会更加强大。

original: {Caesar cured, Male PC}You've done the Legion a great service by healing whatever was wrong with {KAI-zar}Caesar.
translation: {Caesar cured, Male PC}你为军团治好{KAI-zar}凯撒的病，真是帮了大忙。

original: {Caesar cured, Female PC}{contempt}A woman actually proved useful for once. {KAI-zar}Caesar was bold to put his life in your hands.
translation: {Caesar cured, Female PC}{contempt}终于有个女人证明自己的价值了。{KAI-zar}凯撒敢把自己的性命交到你手里，也真是胆大。

original: What do you need from me?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: {quiet, shy - nervous young girl}I can't talk to you. It's not allowed.
translation: {quiet，shy-nervous young girl}我不能和你说话。他们不允许我这么做。

original: {Player destroyed Sergeant Teddy}{tearful}I don't want to talk to you! I hate you!
translation: {Player destroyed Sergeant Teddy}{tearful}我不想和你说话！我恨你！

original: {brightening up - she's seeing a friend}Hi!
translation: {brightening up-she's seeing a friend}嗨！

original: {quiet, shy - nervous young girl}I'm still not allowed to talk to you.
translation: {quiet，shy-nervous young girl}我还是不能和你说话。

original: Caesar awaits you. We can talk afterwards.
translation: 凯撒在等你呢。我们可以之后再谈。

original: I suspect you'll be a valuable asset to the Legion - assuming you're really on our side, of course.
translation: 我觉得你会对军团大有助益——当然，前提是你真的站在我们这边。

original: {Caesar dead}This is a moment I'd hoped would not come for many years. {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death puts the Legate {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius in command now.
translation: {Caesar dead}我原本以为这一刻要很多年后才会到来。{KAI-zar's}凯撒的死导致特使{Lah-nee-OOS}拉尼厄斯独掌大权了。

original: {Caeser cured}I'm pleased that you were able to cure {KAI-zar's}Caesar's malady. Though the Legate is a fine leader, we yet need the wisdom of {KAI-zar}Caesar to guide the Legion.
translation: {Caeser cured}我很高兴你能治愈{KAI-zar's}凯撒的恶疾。尽管特使会是个好领袖，但军团依旧需要{KAI-zar}凯撒睿智的指引。

original: Was there more for us to discuss?
translation: 我们还有什么需要讨论的吗？

original: {agonized sobbing}Mercy...
translation: {agonized sobbing}慈悲…

original: {Strip, High Rep}The eyes of the mighty{KAI-zar} Caesar are upon you. He appreciates your service, and bestows upon you the exceptional gift of his Mark.
translation: {Strip，High Rep}伟大的{KAI-zar}凯撒始终注视着你。他感谢你一直以来尽忠职守，因而决定将他的徽记赐予你作为赠礼。

original: My Lord requires your presence at his camp, at Fortification Hill. His Mark will guarantee your safe-conduct through our lands.
translation: 我的主人想请你去他在堡垒山的营地一叙。他的徽记将确保你在我们的领地内畅通无阻。

original: {Strip}The eyes of the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar are upon you. He admires your accomplishments, and bestows upon you the exceptional gift of his Mark.
translation: {Strip，High Rep}伟大的{KAI-zar}凯撒一直在注视着你。他很赞赏你所取得的成就，因而决定将他的徽记赐予你作为赠礼。

original: Any crimes you may have perpetrated against the Legion are hereby forgiven. {KAI-zar}Caesar will not extend this mercy a second time.
translation: 你对军团犯下的所有罪行都将在此被宽恕。{KAI-zar}凯撒的仁慈只会展现一次。

original: My Lord requires your presence at his camp, at Fortification Hill. His Mark will guarantee your safe-conduct through our lands.
translation: 我的主人想请你去他在堡垒山的营地一叙。他的徽记将确保你在我们的领地内畅通无阻。

original: {enticing}Incidentally, it will interest you to know that the man you seek has fled the Strip, and is likely making haste for {KAI-zar's}Caesar's camp as we speak.
translation: {enticing}捎带一提，也许你会感兴趣，你之前一直在找的那个人已经从长街逃走了，眼下他估计正在往{KAI-zar's}凯撒的营帐赶呢。

original: {Strip}{KAI-zar}Caesar awaits.
translation: {Strip}{KAI-zar}凯撒在等你。

original: Don't bother me - I'm training to become a full Legionary!
translation: 别烦我——我正在努力训练，为了成为一名合格的军团士兵！

original: One day I'll be part of the Praetorian Guard, you'll see.
translation: 总有一天我也会成为禁卫军的，等着瞧。

original: I can't wait until they let me fight.
translation: 我都等不及要战斗了。

original: {with pride}I'm harsh on the children, but they'll be excellent Legionaries. I'm quite proud of them.
translation: {with pride}我对孩子们很苛刻，但他们必将成为优秀的军团士兵。我很为他们感到骄傲。

original: {Strip}The eyes of the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar are upon you. He admires your accomplishments, and bestows upon you the exceptional gift of his Mark.
translation: {Strip}伟大的{KAI-zar}凯撒始终注视着你。他很赞赏你所取得的成就，因而决定将他的徽记赐予你作为赠礼。

original: Your crimes against the Legion, including the death of the fearless {WUHL-pace In-CUHL-tah}Vulpes Inculta, are hereby forgiven. {KAI-zar}Caesar will not extend this mercy again.
translation: 你对军团犯下的所有罪行——包括无畏的{WUHL-pace In-CUHL-tah}沃尔普斯·因库塔的死，都将在此被宽恕。{KAI-zar}凯撒的仁慈只会展现一次。

original: My Lord requires your presence at his camp, at Fortification Hill. His Mark will guarantee your safe-conduct through our lands.
translation: 我的主人想请你去他在堡垒山的营地一叙。他的徽记将确保你在我们的领地内畅通无阻。

original: {Strip}Incidentally, it will interest you to know that the man you seek has fled the Strip, and is likely making haste for Caesar's camp as we speak.
translation: {enticing}捎带一提，也许你会感兴趣，你之前一直在找的那个人已经从长街逃走了，眼下他估计正在往{KAI-zar's}凯撒的营帐赶呢。

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar awaits.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒在等你。

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar has permitted your weapons to be returned to you while you serve him.
translation: 既然你愿意为{KAI-zar}凯撒效力，他已准许把武器归还给你。

original: You've carried out {KAI-zar's}Caesar's will, but I must confiscate your equipment again.
translation: 你虽然遵从了{KAI-zar's}凯撒的旨意，但我还是得没收你的装备。

original: Are you ready to proceed into the underground vault?
translation: 你准备好进入地下掩体了吗？

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar has forbidden you to leave until you’ve carried out his will in the great underground vault.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒禁止你在实现他的意愿之前离开地下掩体。

original: You may go.
translation: 你可以走了。

original: None may enter without {KAI-zar's}Caesar's permission.
translation: 没有{KAI-zar's}凯撒的准许，任何人不得入内。

original: {Mixed 2+}The Legion is aware of your mercenary ways and has decided to encourage you work for us rather than against us.
translation: {Mixed 2+}军团知道你喜欢拿钱办事，因此决定鼓励你继续为军团效力。

original: I've provided you the location of a drop box. Every few days, we'll place Legion coin inside.
translation: 我为你标注了空投箱的位置。每隔几天，我们就会往里面放进军团币。

original: {Good 2+}Though you aren't of the Legion, you've aided us more than once. We acquire many items on our raids, some useless to us, some forbidden.
translation: {Good 2+}尽管你不是军团的一份子，但你也确实不止一次地帮助了我们。我们通过劫掠获得了很多战利品，有些对我们没用，有些对我们则是违禁品。

original: I've provided you the location of a drop box where you can obtain these items. The box will be replenished every few days.
translation: 我为你标注了空投箱的位置，你可以随意拿取里面的物品。每隔几天，箱子就会被装满。

original: Please be aware that we'll assume any items left in the box will be unwanted and be removed and destroyed.
translation: 但也请你牢记：如果你把东西留在箱子里，那它们就会被当作废物销毁掉。

original: My message to you has been delivered, and I've got other places to be.
translation: 给你的信息已转达完毕，我还有其他地方要去。

original: {Player has a companion}You must enter {KAI-zar's}Caesar's tent alone. Anyone else must remain outside.
translation: {Player has a companion}只有你可以进入{KAI-zar's}凯撒的帐篷。其他人都必须待在外面。

original: Here - these are the supplies I've acquired for you.
translation: 给——这就是我给你送来的补给。

original: I'll be back in a few days with more supplies. See you then.
translation: 过几天我还会带着更多的补给回来。到时候见。

original: Under penalty of death, the prisoner is forbidden to speak with you until {KAI-zar}Caesar has permitted it.
translation: 没有{KAI-zar}凯撒的恩准，这个死刑犯是不能和你说话的。

original: {Caesar mentioned illness - Lucius promises vengeance}{KAI-zar}Caesar didn't become sick until he started dealing with you. If this was all some trick to assassinate him, we {emph "will"}will have revenge.
translation: {Caesar mentioned illness - Lucius promises vengeance}{KAI-zar}凯撒在遇到你之前身体都很好。如果你是耍花招企图谋害他，我们{emph"will"}一定会以牙还牙。

original: {Caesar in coma}{KAI-zar}Caesar is near death. Have you brought the means to cure him?
translation: {Caesar in coma}{KAI-zar}凯撒快死了。你带急救药品来了吗？

original: You better get moving kid, there's bad guys to kill.
translation: 你最好让开点，孩子，还得杀敌呢。

original: {at Bunker - no plan}Kreger's the officer here, not me. The final say on the plan is up to him.
translation: {at Bunker - no plan}克里杰才是这里的长官，不是我。计划的最终决定权在他手上。

original: {At Bunker, Moreno dead}Moreno and I never did get along. Still, he was a fellow soldier from the old days.
translation: {At Bunker, Moreno dead}莫雷诺一直都和我不对付。但他仍然是我的老战友。

original: {at Bunker, helping NCR}The NCR's the best bet for the wasteland. I'm glad we'll be helping them out.
translation: {at Bunker, helping NCR}对废土而言，NCR最有希望。很高兴我们能帮助他们。

original: {Remnants helping Legion}I'm not helping the Legion, no matter how much you talk them up. I will help my friends prepare, but that's it.
translation: {Remnants helping Legion}我可不会帮军团，说多少好话都不行。我会帮我的朋友们做好准备，但也仅此而已。

original: Well, it's about about damn time. What took you... oh.
translation: 好吧，也该他妈是时候了。你怎么……噢。

original: What brings you around this time?
translation: 这次又是什么风把你吹来了？

original: Let's get going, we have a battle to win.
translation: 咱们动身吧，还有一场胜利在等着我们呢。

original: You don't strike me as someone down on their luck. What brings you to Westside?
translation: 你看起来和那些倒霉鬼不一样。是什么风把你吹到西区来的？

original: {At Bunker}Glad to see you made it here all right. So, who are we going up against?
translation: {At Bunker}很高兴你终于到了。那么，我们要对付谁？

original: {At Bunker}Still waiting on that decision...
translation: {At Bunker}还在等你做决定……

original: {Player killed Moreno}{quiet regret}We saw everything through the security monitor. I had no idea Moreno would ever pull something like that.
translation: {Player killed Moreno}{quiet regret}我们已经都从监控摄像头里看到了。没想到莫雷诺居然会做出这种事。

original: By rights, Moreno's Power Armor now belongs to you. Whitman's volunteered to show you how to use it, so talk to her as soon as you can.
translation: 按规矩，莫雷诺的动力装甲现在归你了。惠特曼自愿教你如何使用，你可以随时去找她。

original: {Moreno convinced to stay}Moreno's a stubborn son of a bitch, but he's also tougher than any of us. I'm glad you were able to talk him into staying.
translation: {Moreno convinced to stay}莫雷诺是个顽固的混蛋，但他比我们任何人都要厉害。很高兴你能说服他留下来。

original: Since Whitman will be staying with the vertibird, she's offered to give her old suit of Power Armor to you.
translation: 惠特曼同意留在飞鸟上了，她愿意把她那套旧的动力装甲给你。

original: You'll need special training to use it properly, so talk to her as soon as you get the chance.
translation: 想要自如使用这玩意，必须得经过特训才行。你最好尽快去找她。

original: {Remnants helping NCR or Legion}We'll be ready, don't worry.
translation: {Remnants helping NCR or Legion}我们会准备好的，别担心。

original: Sticking around for the attractions?
translation: 还在欣赏风景呢？

original: {at Bunker - no plan}We're all here. Talk to Kreger about what you've got in mind.
translation: {at Bunker - no plan}我们都到齐了。去和克里杰说说你的打算吧。

original: {At Bunker, Moreno dead}If I had any idea Moreno was capable of doing something that, I'd have warned you. I'm sorry it played out like this.
translation: {At Bunker, Moreno dead}要是我知道莫雷诺会做这种事，肯定会提醒你的。事情闹到这一步真的很抱歉。

original: {At Bunker, helping NCR}The NCR's got its share of warts, but I'd rather have them around than the Legion.
translation: {At Bunker, helping NCR}虽然NCR毛病也不少，但他们终归比军团好。

original: {At Bunker, helping Legion}I'm not sure if helping the Legion is the right idea. But, I'm going along with it.
translation: {At Bunker, helping Legion}不知道帮助军团是不是正确的选择。不过我会服从命令的。

original: {At Hoover Dam battle}Keep your head down - could be snipers around.
translation: {At Hoover Dam battle}别抬头——附近可能有狙击手。

original: I assume this is about something important? You're interrupting my research.
translation: 我姑且假设，你是有很重要的事要找我？你打扰到我的研究了。

original: The equipment is hooked up and ready. We can start the test as soon as you give me the go ahead.
translation: 设备全部调试完毕。只要你一声令下，我们马上就可以开始实验。

original: {somewhat irritated and impatient}Again you interrupt me. Why?
translation: {somewhat irritated and impatient}你又来打扰我了。你到底要干什么？

original: Is there something else I can do for you?
translation: 还有什么事情吗？

original: {at Bunker - no plan}What are you talking to me for? Talk to Kreger.
translation: {at Bunker - no plan}你跟我说什么？去跟克里杰说。

original: {At Hoover Dam battle}Now is {emphasis "not"}not the time!
translation: {At Hoover Dam battle}现在{emphasis "not"}不是时候！

original: {Player not in NCR gear}Bah. Looks like I forgot to lock the doors again. If you're with the NCR, get out. This place is mine, and I'm not leaving.
translation: {Player not in NCR gear}啊。看来我又忘记锁门了。如果你是NCR的人，赶紧滚。这地方是我的，我绝不离开。

original: {Player in NCR gear}Look, trooper, I was living in this house long before your farms got set up. {threat}Don't even think about evicting me.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}听着，大兵，我在这房子里住的时候，你们的农场还没搭起来呢。{threat}你赶我走试试。

original: {Remnants helping NCR}I didn't come all the way out here just so we could save the fucking NCR. I'm out.
translation: {Remnants helping NCR}我大老远赶来可不是为了救他妈的NCR。老子不干了。

original: {Moreno convinced to stay}I can't believe I'm going to help the NCR.
translation: {Moreno convinced to stay}不敢相信我居然要去帮NCR。

original: {Remnants helping Legion}Since Johnson won't be coming with us, you might as well take his suit of Power Armor. I'll teach you the basics of how to use it.
translation: {Remnants helping Legion}既然约翰逊不肯跟我们一起来，你把他那套动力装甲拿走吧。我会简单教你怎么用的。

original: {terse}Yeah?
translation: {terse}嗯？

original: {at Bunker - no plan}I'm ready to fly once we've got a plan. Talk to Judah.
translation: {at Bunker - no plan}只要计划定下来，我随时都能起飞。去跟犹大说吧。

original: {Moreno killed at Bunker}{talking about a dead friend}Damn it, Orion. Why did you have to go and do something like that?
translation: {Moreno killed at Bunker}{talking about a dead friend}该死，厄里翁。你为什么要做那种事？

original: {Moreno killed at Bunker}Orion always did have a temper, but it was pretty low of him to ambush you like that.
translation: {Moreno killed at Bunker}厄里翁脾气不好是一回事，但偷袭你就是另外一回事了。

original: {Moreno convinced to stay}I appreciate you keeping Orion in the group. Since I won't be needing my armor - makes the cockpit a bit cramped - you should take it.
translation: {Moreno convinced to stay}谢谢你让厄里翁留了下来。我不需要护甲了——座舱里已经够挤了，你拿去吧。

original: It'll take a few hours to show you how to use it properly, so let's get started.
translation: 不过要学会用这玩意可需要好几个小时，咱们马上开始吧。

original: {at Bunker, helping NCR}I'd love to see the look on the NCR's face when I swoop down in my chopper.
translation: {at Bunker, helping NCR}等我从直升机上跳下去的时候，我会好好欣赏NCR那帮人的表情的。

original: {at Bunker, helping Legion}I heard the Legion doesn't care for women, but as long as they stay out of my way, I'll get along just fine with them.
translation: {at Bunker, helping Legion}听说军团不在意女人，但只要他们别惹我，我倒是无所谓。

original: Fine weather for flying. It's times like these that make me miss it all.
translation: 真是飞行的好天气。这种时候我总会想起过去。

original: Your travels been going all right?
translation: 你一路还顺利吧？

original: Thank you! They were going to kill me!
translation: 谢谢你！要不是你，他们会杀了我的！

original: Don't worry, I'll stay out of trouble from now on. Honest.
translation: 你放心，我以后不会再惹麻烦了。真的。

original: I'd remember if I had seen you here before, I'm sure of it... {pauses as if thinking "anyway, whatever"}What do you want?
translation: 如果我见过你，我一定会记得的……算了。你要什么？

original: Welcome back, stranger.
translation: 欢迎回来，陌生人。

original: {Welcoming, to one of her own}Greetings, Hunter of The Thorn.
translation: {Welcoming， to one of her own}欢迎，荆棘街的猎手。

original: The crowds are waiting for you, stranger. Show us your best.
translation: 大家都在等你，陌生人。别让我们失望。

original: {Slight irritation}It's time for blood, not talk. Find me after the fight.
translation: {Slight irritation}现在是该流血的时候，不是让你说话的。打完了再来找我吧。

original: {Congratulatory tone, if just a hint}Well done, stranger. Here's your share.
translation: {Congratulatory tone, if just a hint}干得好，陌生人。这是你的分成。

original: {Strong emotion veiled by stoic expression}The Thorn does not welcome you, stranger. Leave now or suffer the consequences.
translation: {Strong emotion veiled by stoic expression}荆棘街不欢迎你，陌生人。马上离开，否则后果自负。

original: Even the strongest creatures need their rest, {slight pause}and their companionship. I've been looking forward to this.
translation: 即使最强壮的生物也需要休息，{slight pause}以及伴侣。我一直都期待着这一刻。

original: {Ambivalent tone, generic}You know where we meet, and that's not here.
translation: {Ambivalent tone, generic}你知道我们该去哪儿见面，总之不是在这儿。

original: {About to attack player}You've broken the rules of The Thorn. You've dishonored this sacred ground! I don't tolerate such offenses.
translation: {About to attack player}你破坏了荆棘街的规则。你玷污了我们神圣的土地！我绝不会容忍这样的行为。

original: {About to attack player}I admire your bravery, but coming down here after what you've done is just foolish. So be it, Legion dog!
translation: {About to attack player}我敬佩你的勇气，但你干了坏事之后还敢来这里，简直是愚蠢。来吧，军团狗！

original: {Serious, Seething Anger}We're watching you{two seconds pause}... {Slightly drawn out "sss." Morrowind!}stranger!
translation: {Serious, Seething Anger}我们会盯着你的{two seconds pause}……{Slightly drawn out "sss." Morrowind!}陌生人！

original: {Serious, Seething Anger}Don't fuck with the caged beasts.
translation: {Serious,  Seething Anger}别去挑逗笼子里的那些野兽。

original: {Dumfounded, Overflowing Anger}I can't believe this shit. Time to die, punk!
translation: 真不敢相信会有这种破事。死吧，白痴！

original: {Cautionary Warning, Calm}Follow the rules of The Thorn.
translation: {Cautionary Warning, Calm}遵守荆棘街的规矩。

original: {Cautionary Warning, Calm}Don't feed the creatures.
translation: {Cautionary Warning, Calm}别喂那些动物。

original: {Surprised, Proving a Point}What did I tell you about breaking the rules? You're gonna learn the hard way, now.
translation: {Surprised， Proving a Point}我告诉过你破坏规矩会有什么后果吧？现在该给你长点记性了。

original: {Proud}Nowhere else will you find something like The Thorn.
translation: {Proud}你在别处是绝对找不到荆棘街这样的地方的。

original: {Proud. As if the last sentence is a conclusion of obeying the first two}Take advice. Don't break the rules. And we won't kill you.
translation: {Proud. As if the last sentence is a conclusion of obeying the first two}记住：别破坏规矩。否则我们就要你的命。

original: {Deeply Offended}You dared go against The Thorn, and now you'll pay for that!
translation: {Deeply Offended}你胆敢和荆棘街作对，现在就要付出代价！

original: {Amiable, Joking Tone}Come see the fights, or Red Lucy?
translation: {Amiable, Joking Tone}是来观战的，还是来找血手露西的？

original: {Amiable, Joking Tone}Enjoy the show, and don't give us a reason to shoot you, okay?{Chuckles}
translation: {Amiable, Joking Tone}好好欣赏表演，别给我们开枪的理由，好吗？{Chuckles}

original: {Surprised, still with a joking tone but about to start combat}You've just fucked up, big time!
translation: {Surprised, still with a joking tone but about to start combat}你完蛋了，大明星！

original: Lay down with me, my hunter.
translation: 陪我躺一会，我的猎手。

original: Our time was sweet, my hunter. But our passion will have to wait - The Thorn demands attention.
translation: 多么美妙的时光啊，我的猎手。但恐怕我们要压抑一下冲动了，荆棘街还需要有人来打理呢。

original: No more fights today. The Thorn needs time to soak its tribute of blood.
translation: 今天不会再有战斗了。荆棘街需要时间来浸透献祭给它的鲜血。

original: The recent disturbance at {beat, as though pasted in}the Tops {beat}has been resolved. Do not be afraid to patronize {beat}the Tops.
translation: 近日在九重天发生的小纠纷已妥善解决。请放心惠顾。

original: The recent disturbance at {beat, as though pasted in}Gomorrah {beat}has been resolved. Do not be afraid to patronize {beat}Gomorrah.
translation: 近日在蛾摩拉发生的小纠纷已妥善解决。请放心惠顾。

original: Be advised, the Lucky 38 is not open to the general public. Trespassers will be shot. Thank you.
translation: 注意，幸运38不对公众开放。擅闯者格杀勿论。谢谢合作。

original: Do not be alarmed. We have been upgraded to serve you better. Have a nice day.
translation: 请放心。为了更好地为您服务，我们已全面升级。祝您愉快。

original: Obituaries of the recently deceased Mr. House, President, CEO, and sole proprietor of the Vegas Strip, are still available. Just ask any Securitron.
translation: 于近日亡故的维加斯长街总裁、CEO及独资业主豪斯先生，其讣告仍可查阅。请向电子保安索取。

original: Be advised, Mr. House has voluntarily decided to become a citizen of the NCR.
translation: 请注意，豪斯先生已自愿成为NCR的公民。

original: Sovereignty over the Vegas Strip will be transferred to the NCR at a date yet to be determined. Have a nice day.
translation: 维加斯长街的主权移交日期将在讨论后公布。祝您愉快。

original: Be advised, when Mr. House transfers sovereignty over the Vegas Strip to the NCR, he will remain its sole proprietor. Have a nice day.
translation: 注意，维加斯长街的主权向NCR移交后，豪斯先生仍为独资业主不变。祝您愉快。

original: The unfortunate incident involving the monorail from McCarran Airport is being resolved as quickly as possible. Thank you.
translation: 麦卡伦机场线路的列车正在紧急抢修中。谢谢合作。

original: Be sure to offer words of encouragement to NCR men and women in uniform. Vegas appreciates their business.
translation: 请务必向身着NCR制服的人们表达鼓励。维加斯感谢他们的努力。

original: Be advised, NCR President Aaron Kimball survived an assassination attempt at Hoover Dam.
translation: 注意，NCR总统艾伦·金博尔在胡佛水坝的刺杀事件中幸免于难。

original: Just one more reason to celebrate at one of New Vegas's fine casinos! Thank you.
translation: 新维加斯各家赌场供诸位同庆此事！谢谢。

original: Be advised, NCR President Aaron Kimball was struck down in a cowardly attack at Hoover Dam.
translation: 请注意, NCR总统艾伦·金博尔在胡佛水坝遭暴徒袭击后不幸身亡。

original: The Strip offers many fine cocktail lounges where grieving persons may drown their sorrows.
translation: 长街各家鸡尾酒沙龙皆可供诸位伤心人共寄哀思。

original: Welcome to Vegas, capital of the sixth state of the New California Republic!
translation: 欢迎光临维加斯，新加州共和国第六州首府！

original: True to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
translation: 凯撒{KAI-zar}万岁。

original: Welcome to New Vegas, where a new day is dawning!
translation: 欢迎光临新维加斯，全新一天在此破晓！

original: Welcome to Vegas. Don't make trouble.
translation: 欢迎光临维加斯。请遵纪守法。

original: Welcome to the Vegas Strip.
translation: 欢迎光临维加斯长街。

original: Enjoy all the Vegas Strip has to offer.
translation: 请尽情享受维加斯长街的一切。

original: Enjoy your time on the Vegas Strip.
translation: 请尽情享受维加斯长街的时光。

original: Always a pleasure.
translation: 乐意效劳。

original: Good to see you.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: {upbeat}Hello, again.
translation: {upbeat}您好，又见面了。

original: {upbeat}Hey, look who's here!
translation: {upbeat}嘿，瞧瞧这是谁啊！

original: {upbeat}If it isn't our favorite V.I.P.!
translation: {upbeat}这不是我们最敬爱的V.I.P.嘛！

original: {upbeat}You're always welcome in this town!
translation: {upbeat}这里随时欢迎您！

original: Try to control your behavior today.
translation: 请注意言行举止。

original: I'm hoping this is one of your good days.
translation: 祝您今天过得愉快。

original: Vegas doesn't need your trouble.
translation: 维加斯不需要你来惹麻烦。

original: Who knows what you're going to do next?
translation: 谁知道你接下来会干什么？

original: I bet you're up to something.
translation: 我打赌你又在动歪脑筋了。

original: I don't like the look of you. Never have.
translation: 我不喜欢你的样子。一点也不。

original: Don't think we aren't watching you.
translation: 别以为我们不会盯着你。

original: You've got a reputation in this town, and it isn't a good one.
translation: 你在城里倒是名声在外，可惜不是什么好名声。

original: Don't bother to watch yourself. We're watching for you.
translation: 你没必要注意自己的言行了。我们会替你注意的。

original: Come on, tough guy/gal - give me a reason.
translation: 来吧，好家伙——动我下试试。

original: Take your best shot. Then we'll take ours.
translation: 尽管放马过来吧。我们也不会客气的。

original: You're bad for Vegas. You don't belong here.
translation: 你是维加斯的祸害。你还是快滚吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Have a nice day.
translation: 祝你今天愉快。

original: Enjoy your time in Vegas.
translation: 祝你在维加斯愉快。

original: Be advised, visitors will be held responsible for the behavior of any robots accompanying them.
translation: 注意，访客需为其随行机器人的行为负责。

original: Be advised, visitors will be held responsible for the behavior of any {disapproving}non-human sapients accompanying them.
translation: 注意，访客需为其{disapproving}随行非人智能体的行为负责。

original: You come to the wrong place, traveler. Primm's dying. If you got any sense, you'll be moving on.
translation: 你来错地方了，旅行者。普瑞姆现在已经是个死城了。如果你够聪明，就快点走吧。

original: Quite a town we got here. Sheriff gets murdered, and Deputy Beagle dragged off for ransom to the Bison Steve. That should bring back the tourists.
translation: 瞧瞧我们这小镇。警长死了，副警长比格尔也被拖进野牛史蒂夫旅店做了人质。这副光景说不定还真能招揽到一些游客呢。

original: Rather be left alone to my misery, if you don't mind.
translation: 如果你不介意的话，我想一个人静静。

original: Before the Powder Gangers came to town, Johnson Nash ran the local store and the Mojave Express station.
translation: 在炸药帮进城以前，约翰逊·纳什负责运营本地商店和莫哈维快递中转站。

original: I ain't got nothing for you to eat. If you're hungry, see Ruby Nash.
translation: 我这没有可以给你吃的东西。如果你饿了的话，就去找鲁比·纳什。

original: Thanks for freeing the deputy. A bit, anyway.
translation: 感谢你救出了副警长。虽然也没什么好谢的。

original: Thanks for freeing Deputy Beagle. He's better than nothing. Maybe.
translation: 感谢你救出了副警长比格尔。有他总比没有强。也许吧。

original: Now you freed Deputy Beagle, all Primm needs is a law man who can shoot a gun without wetting hisself.
translation: 既然你救出了副警长比格尔，那么接下来普瑞姆也该再找一个开枪时不会尿裤子的执法官了。

original: I hear you're going to help find Primm a new sheriff. Mighty kind of you to take an interest.
translation: 听说你正在帮普瑞姆物色新警长。真是非常感谢你的好意。

original: So you're the one's going to bring the law back to Primm? I'll believe it when I see it.
translation: 你会给普瑞姆找个新执法官？我只能说眼见才为实。

original: I hear you aim to bring rule of law back to our town. God knows we need the help.
translation: 听说你要帮助我们恢复秩序。我们确实需要帮忙啊。

original: Thanks for bringing the NCR to town, stranger. Things're finally looking up for Primm.
translation: 感谢你让NCR来管理城镇，陌生人。普瑞姆的情况终于开始好转了。

original: Thanks to you I got a mess of soldiers watching every move I make, plus I got to pay taxes for the privilege!
translation: 托你的福，现在无论我想干点什么事，都会有一堆士兵盯着我，而我还得为这个特权缴税！

original: Those soldiers you brought down on us is all business, stranger. Better than lawlessness, though. So you've got my thanks.
translation: 你带回来的那帮士兵管得可真宽，陌生人。不过总比无法无天要好。所以还是谢谢你。

original: This new Sheriff Meyers you brought to us is a lawman through and through. Primm's looking up, stranger.
translation: 你带回来的这个新警长迈尔斯是个刚正不阿的执法官。普瑞姆的情况开始好转了，陌生人。

original: Thanks for convincing Meyers to come sheriff for us. First time I feel safe in a long time.
translation: 谢谢你说服迈尔斯来给我们担任警长。这么久以来，我第一次有了安全感。

original: This Sheriff Meyers you found for us is working out. Knows his business. We owe you a debt.
translation: 你帮我们找来的这个迈尔斯警长已经走马上任了。他很专业。我们欠你一个人情。

original: Man, it is a real uphill fight these days. I'm not sure how we are going to handle all these convicts.
translation: 老兄，这些天来打的仗可真是辛苦。我都不知道我们该怎么对付那些逃犯。

original: If you got something to say, say it to the Lieutenant.
translation: 你有话要说，就去找中尉。

original: Careful, things aren't as safe around here as they could be.
translation: 小心，最近还是不太安全。

original: You'll probably want to talk to Hayes.
translation: 你可以去找海耶斯谈谈。

original: Welcome to the New Vegas Medical Clinic. I'm a fully qualified physician and can fix whatever is wrong with you for a reasonable fee.
translation: 欢迎来到新维加斯医疗诊所。我是个有执业医师资格的医生，包治百病，价格公道。

original: If you've got the caps, I've also got several implants available to enhance your physical attributes.
translation: 如果你的瓶盖足够，我这还有一些植入体来提升你的身体素质。

original: You're back. Do you need medical attention?
translation: 你回来了。需要医疗服务吗？

original: I'm just security, not a doctor.
translation: 我只是保安而已，不是医生。

original: Hello. I'm Rose of Sharon Cassidy.
translation: 你好。我是罗撒香·盖西迪。

original: {Gunfight in progress}Keep an eye out for more of them.
translation: {Gunfight in progress}对他们怎么小心都不为过。

original: This town don't look like much.
translation: 这座城市看起来不怎么样。

original: Beats being in prison.
translation: 总比在监狱来的好。

original: I got dibs on the old doc's house.
translation: 那个老医生的房子归我了。

original: Need more women around here.
translation: 这里需要更多女人。

original: Never liked Bighorners.
translation: 大角羊真讨厌。

original: {victory}Those townies put up a bigger fight than I expected.
translation: {victory}那些居民比我想象中的厉害多了。

original: {victory}That was a hell of a gunfight.
translation: {victory}那场枪战太激烈了。

original: {victory}Nothing left to do but kick back and booze it up.
translation: {victory}现在唯一要做的就是痛饮一场。

original: {victory}You think any townies are hiding?
translation: {victory}你觉得有居民藏起来了吗？

original: {victory}I knew we were going to win all along.
translation: {victory}我就知道我们会赢。

original: {Gunfight in progress, not helping}Get away! I'm not part of your fight!
translation: {Gunfight in progress, not helping}走开！我可不想掺合你的战斗！

original: {Gunfight in progress, not helping}Get away from me! I don't want to get shot!
translation: {Gunfight in progress，not helping}离我远点！我不想吃枪子！

original: {Gunfight, helping}Careful! There's still more of them.
translation: {Gunfight, helping}当心！附近还有更多他们的人。

original: {Gunfight, helping}Don't think this is over yet.
translation: {Gunfight, helping}别以为这就算完了。

original: Way too many strangers coming into town these days. No offense.
translation: 这几天到镇上来的陌生人也太多了。我无意冒犯。

original: If you're looking for supplies, Chet over at the general store can help you out.
translation: 如果你要买东西，杂货店的切特能帮上你。

original: {Evil 2+}Why don't you just move on to another town?
translation: {Evil 2+}为什么你不到其他地方去呢？

original: {Evil 2+}Just leave us alone.
translation: {Evil 2+}离我们远点。

original: {Good 2+}We need more people like you around.
translation: {Good 2+}我们需要更多像你这样的人。

original: {Mixed 2+}Bit of a troublemaker, aren't you?
translation: {Mixed 2+}你就是个捣蛋鬼，不是吗？

original: {Mixed 2+}Don't really care much for the unpredictable types. Just saying.
translation: {Mixed 2+}我不喜欢那些捉摸不透的人。我是说真的。

original: That Doc Mitchell sure knows his stuff, doesn't he?
translation: 那个米切尔医生的医术真精湛，不是吗？

original: {Powder Gang control}At least the Powder Gangers are letting me live.
translation: {Powder Gang control}至少炸药帮没要我的命。

original: {Powder Gang control}I'm glad I didn't try to fight the gang.
translation: {Powder Gang control}很高兴我没和他们作对。

original: {Powder Gang control}Hell of way to repay Doc, if you ask me.
translation: {Powder Gang control}要我说，你对医生那真是恩将仇报。

original: {Powder Gang control}So many good people are dead...
translation: {Powder Gang control}死了这么多好人……

original: You shouldn't have crossed the Powder Gangers! Now you're going to pay!
translation: 你不该和炸药帮结梁子！现在你得付出代价！

original: I have a present for you from the Powder Gangers... I hope you like dynamite!
translation: 我带来了炸药帮给你的礼物……希望你喜欢炸药！

original: You'll pay for what you did to the Powder Gangers!
translation: 你对炸药帮如此残暴，你会付出代价的！

original: Nobody screws with the Powder Gangers and lives!
translation: 敢惹炸药帮的人必死无疑！

original: Here he is, boys! Let's show him what happens when you cross the Powder Gangers!
translation: 他在这儿，小伙子们！让他看看招惹炸药帮是什么下场！

original: We've got people to kill. Keep an eye out.
translation: 我们有敌人了。保持警惕。

original: Never thought I'd ever have my own town, but thanks to you, now I do. If you wanna make some caps, head on over to the Correctional Facility.
translation: 从没想过我能拿下一座小镇，谢谢你，真的很感谢。如果你要想挣点瓶盖，就去NCR监狱看看吧。

original: Just tell them I sent you and you should get in without a problem. Keep a close eye on some of those bastards, though.
translation: 只要告诉他们是我派你去的，应该就能顺利进入了。不过还是要留心一下那些混蛋。

original: Oh, not all Powder Gangers out there are friends of mine - like the group in Primm. They'll be gunning for you no matter what, so keep that in mind.
translation: 噢，并非所有的炸药帮成员都是我朋友——比如普瑞姆那帮人。他们会无缘无故地朝你开火，所以小心一点吧。

original: My gang's here, but we'll still need a plan before we rush the town. I don't want to embarrass myself and get beat by a bunch of townies.
translation: 我的人到齐了，不过在进攻这个小镇之前我们还是得先想出个计划。我可不想冲进去被居民一顿暴打，那多丢面子啊。

original: We ain't got much in the way of supplies, so if you could shake down the old doctor and the store owner for some stuff, we'd be in good shape.
translation: 我们的补给有限，所以如果能敲上那个老医生和店主人一笔，我们的情况应该会大有改观。

original: I also thought it might be a good thing to jimmy the lock on the Bighorner pen. The noise from the fight will spook them, get them running wild.
translation: 另外我觉得还可以把大角羊的栅栏门弄开。枪炮声会把它们吓得到处乱跑。

original: Once you're done with that stuff - or none of it - say the word and we'll make our move.
translation: 这些事情，不管你最后搞定还是没搞定，都告诉我一声，我们就开始行动。

original: We ready to move or what?
translation: 准备好开始行动了吗？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: {not in charge of Goodsprings}What do you want now?
translation: {not in charge of Goodsprings}你想要什么？

original: {running Goodsprings, slightly friendly}How's it going?
translation: {running Goodsprings，slightly friendly}情况如何？

original: {Gunfight started, no Trudy help}Are you trying to get my saloon shot up? Finish what you started!
translation: {Gunfight started，no Trudy help}你想把我的酒馆射成筛子吗？ 给我住手！

original: {Gunfight started, Trudy help}Keep an eye out. This isn't finished yet.
translation: {Gunfight started，Trudy help}小心。战斗还没结束。

original: Well, you've been causing quite a stir. Glad I finally got to meet you. Welcome to the Prospector Saloon.
translation: 哎呀，你还掀起了挺大一阵骚动的嘛。很高兴终于见到你了。欢迎来到淘金客酒馆。

original: So, you're planning on taking on Joe Cobb's gang. It's a big risk, but I suppose you have to do what you think is right.
translation: 好吧，看来你是打定主意要和乔·科布的人动手了。这么做的风险可不小，但想必你也有自己的理由吧。

original: I hope you didn't just bring a heap of trouble down on Goodsprings by killing Joe Cobb like that.
translation: 希望你不会因为杀了乔·科布而给清泉镇带来麻烦。

original: His friends might come looking for him, and I don't think they're going to care who was involved in his death or not.
translation: 他的朋友可能会来找他，依我之见，他们可不会在乎这儿的人与他的死究竟有没有关系。

original: Well, what's done is done. So, uh, what can I do for you?
translation: 好吧，反正木已成舟。那么，呃，你想要点什么？

original: I'm glad that business is over. I like it when Goodsprings is nice and quiet.
translation: 很高兴事情都了结了。我喜欢安详美丽的清泉镇。

original: Feeling thirsty? I can take care of that.
translation: 觉得口渴？我能帮你。

original: Cant' do business now! There's a gunfight!
translation: 现在不做生意！有枪战！

original: You must be the one Doc Mitchell was patching up. The way I heard it, I didn't think you'd be walking out of that office.
translation: 你就是米切尔医生救活的那个人吧。我听说了你的事，还以为你根本走不出那间办公室呢。

original: I've got plenty of supplies for sale. Even got some weapon mods and special ammo - well worth the caps, if you ask me.
translation: 我这儿货源充足，甚至还进了一些武器模块和特殊弹药——要我说的话，绝对物超所值。

original: If you're hurting for caps, I've also got boxes of surplus ammo in the miscellaneous section. They're not great, but you get what you pay for.
translation: 如果你手头紧的话，我这里倒是还有几盒军需备用弹。虽然品质不怎么样，但一分钱一分货嘛。

original: That was a hell of a fight. Let's hope it doesn't bite us in the ass later on.
translation: 打得真激烈。希望以后咱们都能平安无事。

original: {Powder Ganger victory}I won't make any trouble for the gang. Just let me keep my store and I'll cut you a little discount.
translation: {Powder Ganger victory}我可不会给帮派找麻烦。只要让我继续经营我的店，我就给你打点小折扣。

original: You looking to buy some supplies?
translation: 你想买点补给吗？

original: I heard about what's been going on in town. Our deal's off. I can't trust someone like you to watch my back.
translation: 我听说镇上发生的事了。咱们的约定取消了。我可不放心让你这种人来照应。

original: Keep an eye out. I still think there's a few out there.
translation: 小心点。我觉得那边还有好几个人。

original: That's close enough. Who are you, and what do you want with me?
translation: 别再往前走了。你是谁，找我有什么事？

original: I owe you a huge favor for this. Here - these are technically Crimson Caravan funds, but I know they'll understand once I explain things.
translation: 我欠你一个大人情。拿着——严格来说，这是深红商队的钱，不过我会和他们解释，他们能理解的。

original: Thanks again for all your help.
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助。

original: What's the plan? Are we ready?
translation: 你有什么计划？我们准备好没有？

original: So, what's going on? Did Sunny agree to help us?
translation: 那么，情况如何？桑尼同意帮我们了吗？

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: That ought to keep things settled for awhile. Hope it stays that way.
translation: 事情应该算是暂时解决了。希望不会再出什么岔子。

original: Howdy. What can Easy Pete do for you?
translation: 你好。不知轻松皮特能为你做点什么？

original: Howdy.
translation: 你好。

original: We can talk after this is over!
translation: 我们等到结束以后再谈也不迟！

original: Those bastards got Ringo in the end, after all. At least he went down fighting.
translation: 那些混蛋最后还是杀了林戈。但他至少没有坐以待毙。

original: {satisfaction}That'll teach the Powder Gangs to avoid Goodsprings in the future.
translation: {satisfaction}这下炸药帮再也不敢来骚扰清泉镇了。

original: Time to look alive. The Powder Gangers are here to play.
translation: 得抓紧时间了。炸药帮要来了。

original: I'll keep an eye out for the Powder Gangers and meet up with you and Ringo when the time comes.
translation: 我会留意炸药帮的行动，一旦时候到了，我就立马跟你和林戈会合。

original: I don't think Joe Cobb knew what hit him. I'm hoping you took him down for a good reason and not... for fun.
translation: 我估计乔·科布肯定没料到会是这个结果。我希望你干掉他是出于正当的理由，而不是为了……过瘾。

original: Cheyenne, stay. Don't worry, she won't bite unless I tell her to.
translation: 夏安，冷静。别担心，没有我的允许她是不会伤人的。

original: Hi there. Sticking around Goodsprings for awhile longer?
translation: 嗨。还要在清泉镇待上一阵子吗？

original: I expect you'll be wanting to go outside after being cooped up for so long, but if you have any questions, I'll answer what I can.
translation: 你卧床许久，肯定想出去走走吧。不过如果你有问题的话，我会尽量回答的。

original: Welcome back. I had hoped you wouldn't need to come see me again so soon. What can I do for you?
translation: 欢迎回来。我还以为你不会这么快就回来找我。需要我做点什么吗？

original: How're you holding up?
translation: 你最近过得怎么样啊？

original: Howdy, pardner! Might I say, you're looking fit as a fiddle.
translation: 你好，伙计！你的气色看起来相当不错啊。

original: Howdy, pardner! So, when do the rustlers show up?
translation: 你好，伙计！偷牛贼现身了吗？

original: Howdy, pardner!
translation: 你好，伙计！

original: Holy moly! If you hadn't come here like you done, I'd be a goner for sure.
translation: 天呐！要不是你及时赶过来，我就死定了。

original: I came up here to draw water, but here, you should have what I got. You look thirsty.
translation: 我是来取水的，不过还是都给你吧。你看起来口很渴。

original: Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！

original: Help me!
translation: 救命！

original: {dying, in pain, pleading}Kill me!
translation: {dying,inpain,pleading}给我个痛快！

original: {dying, in pain}Stay away!
translation: {dying,inpain}别过来！

original: I'm afraid you're not going to find much help here. We've got our hands full as it is.
translation: 恐怕这儿没什么人能帮你，我们自己都忙不过来了。

original: If you're heading out, be careful. There's been lots of Legion raiding parties around lately.
translation: 如果你要出去，小心点。最近这里到处都是军团的劫掠小队。

original: Let's do this shit!
translation: 咱们上吧！

original: Those Legion bastards aren't going to know what hit them!
translation: 让那些军团杂种都不知道自己是怎么死的！

original: We're going to tear them apart!
translation: 我们要把他们全撕成碎片！

original: Let's go!
translation: 我们上！

original: We showed them a thing or two.
translation: 我们好好教训了他们一顿。

original: A little payback feels real good.
translation: 报仇的感觉真好。

original: These bastards got what they deserved.
translation: 这些混蛋活该。

original: This has been a long time coming. The rest of the Legion better watch out.
translation: 这一刻终于来了。军团剩下的人最好都小心点。

original: No time to talk. I have to keep watch for Legion raiding parties.
translation: 我得提防军团的劫掠小队，没时间闲聊。

original: Sorry. I can't talk right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没时间聊天。

original: It's hard to stay awake on watch with only a few hours of sleep. I wish we actually had time to rest around here.
translation: 只有几小时睡眠时间，还要保持清醒放哨，太难受了。我真的希望我们有时间休息。

original: I hope nothing happens on my watch. I'm too damn tired to fight back right now.
translation: 希望我放哨的时候别出事。我现在是累得连还击的力气都没有可。

original: Watch yourself, we got hit by a Legion raiding party just the other night.
translation: 你自己多小心吧，前两天晚上我们就遭到过军团劫掠队的袭击。

original: Stay out of trouble, we have enough problems here as it is.
translation: 别惹麻烦，我们的麻烦事已经够多了。

original: Better move along, there's not much for you here.
translation: 你最好走开点，这里没你什么事。

original: I don't have time to talk. There's lots of work to be done here.
translation: 我可没时间聊天。还有一大把工作要做呢。

original: Sorry, I'm busy right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在正忙。

original: These troops did a good job holding off the Legion. Now it's time to fight back.
translation: 这些士兵能抵抗军团那么久，真是好样的。现在该轮到我们反攻了。

original: We finally took back Nelson from those Legion bastards!
translation: 我们终于从那些军团杂种的手上把纳尔逊夺回来了！

original: I heard you helped destroy the Legion at Nelson. Thanks!
translation: 听说你帮忙摧毁了纳尔逊的军团。谢谢！

original: I'm glad that the Legion base at Nelson is destroyed. Now maybe we can get some rest.
translation: 军团位于纳尔逊的基地被摧毁，我很高兴。现在我们可以休息一下了。

original: If I have to put up with another night of Private Stone's whining, I swear I'm going to strangle him.
translation: 如果列兵斯通再敢给我在晚上唠唠叨叨，你看我不掐死他。

original: I heard Private Stone was caught stealing medical supplies. I always hated that guy.
translation: 听说列兵斯通在偷医疗用品时被抓了个正着。我一直都很讨厌那家伙。

original: I heard Private Stone turned himself in for stealing medical supplies. We're all stressed out here, but stealing medical supplies is low.
translation: 听说列兵斯通自首了，就是他偷了医疗用品。我知道大家都有压力，但偷医疗用品就真的太缺德了。

original: Private Sexton was thinking of having a contest to see who can kill the most Legion. I wonder if he ever got that going.
translation: 列兵塞克斯顿想举办一场军团猎杀比赛。也不知道他办起来没有。

original: I heard you won Private Sexton's Legion killing contest. Nice job, that'll teach those Legion bastards!
translation: 听说你赢下了列兵塞克斯顿举办的军团猎杀比赛。干得好，你给那些军团杂种好好上了一课！

original: I heard Quartermaster Mayes sent some guys out for supplies and they never came back. I wonder if they just ran off instead.
translation: 听说军需官迈厄斯派去找补给的人都没回来。不知道他们是不是都当了逃兵。

original: One of my buddies said that he saw Caesar out rallying the Legion. If that's true, we're definitely screwed.
translation: 我有个兄弟说他看见凯撒正在集结军团。要是真的，那我们就死定了。

original: Holy shit! Did you hear that Caesar is dead? Maybe we actually have a fighting chance now.
translation: 我的天！你听说凯撒已经死了吗？也许我们现在有翻身的机会了。

original: I heard that Caesar was killed by his own Lieutenants. I wonder if their infighting will give us a break for a while.
translation: 听说凯撒被他手下的军官杀了。不知道他们的内讧能不能让我们喘息一阵子。

original: I heard Chief Hanlon is dead. How are we going to fight the Legion without him?
translation: 听说汉隆军士长死了。没了他我们还怎么对付军团？

original: I heard Chief Hanlon was a traitor. How could he betray the NCR? It just doesn't make sense.
translation: 听说汉隆军士长是叛徒。他怎么会背叛NCR？没道理呀。

original: I hear we got reinforced by the troops that were in Boulder City. It's good to have some extra support around here.
translation: 听说巨石城的增援已经到了。能有帮手真好。

original: More reinforcements are in from Primm. Damn glad to have those guys here.
translation: 更多的援兵正从普瑞姆赶来。真是太他妈让人高兴了。

original: I heard that some of the NCR Rangers are on their way to help us out. We'll make short work of the Legion with their help.
translation: 我听说有些NCR游骑兵正赶来支援我们。有他们帮忙，击败军团就是小菜一碟。

original: Holy shit those NCR Rangers are badass! I wish I was that cool.
translation: 我操，那些NCR游骑兵真是太牛逼了！真希望我也能那么酷。

original: I heard the Legion veteran troops are coming to the front lines. That's the last thing we need right now.
translation: 听说军团的老兵正在赶赴前线。真是不能再糟了。

original: I heard the Legion took out another one of our patrols. If this continues there won't be many of us left.
translation: 听说军团又消灭了我们一支巡逻队。再照这么下去，我们就剩不下几个活人了。

original: I hear more troops are gathering at Hoover Dam. Things are probably going to get pretty messy over there real soon.
translation: 听说还有更多部队再往胡佛水坝集结。看来很快就会爆发一场血战的。

original: The Legion is torturing captive troopers in Nelson. I'd rather die fighting then be captured.
translation: 军团正在折磨纳尔逊被俘的士兵。我宁愿战死也不想被俘。

original: The Legion is using our dead troops as booby traps. I'd think twice before rushing to someone's aid.
translation: 军团在用我们牺牲的战士设陷阱。以后我不会再去盲目地救人了。

original: If I have to pull another double shift again I'm going to collapse from exhaustion.
translation: 要是再让我连值两个班，那我真要累死了。

original: I wish we could get some real food out here. I haven't had a good hot meal in weeks.
translation: 真希望我们能有点正经的东西吃。我已经好几个礼拜没吃上一口热饭了。

original: Quartermaster Mayes was yelling at us about rationing again. Where does the guy get the energy to yell so much while on rations?
translation: 军需官迈厄斯又在冲着我们吼什么定量配给。你说都定量配给了，那家伙哪来那么大力气吼人？

original: Some of the other guys told me that the Legion troops eat their own dead to gain their strength, but they're kidding, right?
translation: 有人告诉我，军团士兵会吃自己战友的尸体来补充体力，他们是在逗我玩呢，对吗？

original: I got bit by one of those dirty dogs the Legion has. I wonder if they've got rabies... maybe I should see Dr. Richards.
translation: 我被军团的那些脏狗给咬了。不会得狂犬病吧……我得找理查兹医生给看看。

original: Major Polatli is putting everyone on double shifts to make up for recent losses to the Legion. That guy never gives up.
translation: 波拉特里少校给所有人都排了双班岗，以弥补最近我们在与军团作战中损失的人力。那家伙真是不饶人啊。

original: If the NCR wasn't spread so thin, maybe we could actually get some supplies and reinforcements around here.
translation: 要不是NCR战线拉太长，我们或许就能得到一些补给和增援了。

original: I wish I was stationed at McCarran. I heard they still get to hit the Strip for R&R. We haven't had R&R in ages.
translation: 要是把调到到麦卡伦就好了。听说他们休假的时候还可以去长街。我们已经有好几百年没休过假了。

original: We are so fucked here! How can we ever hope to fight off the entire Legion?
translation: 我们完蛋了！我们怎么能打败整个军团？

original: Another day, another battle, another dead trooper. When is this shit going to end?
translation: 又过一天，又打一仗，又死一人。这他妈什么时候才到头？

original: It seems like for every Legion soldier we kill, two more take his place. How many of them are there?
translation: 怎么我们每干掉一个军团士兵，就会又冒出两个人来。他们哪来这么多人？

original: The last patrol I was on got hit by a Legion raiding party and I barely survived. I don't want to go back out there again.
translation: 我上次巡逻的时候受到了军团劫掠小队的袭击，差点就回不来了。我再也不想出去巡逻了。

original: How do they expect us to fight the Legion with only the crappy equipment and gear they gave us?
translation: 就他们发的那点破烂装备，还指望我们去和军团打？

original: I can't wait for General Oliver to get out here. He could turn this place around.
translation: 我真希望奥利弗将军能早点来。他肯定能扭转乾坤。

original: I don't know how we're going to hold of the Legion here and at Hoover Dam, we just don't have the manpower.
translation: 真不知道该怎么在这里和胡佛水坝挡住军团，我们人手真的不够。

original: The Legion is assembling a massive army on the other side of the river. How can we stop an army when we can't even handle their raiding parties?
translation: 军团正在河对岸集结主力部队。我们连他们的劫掠小队都应付不了，怎么挡得住整支大军？

original: This is not a market, sir - you need to improve your reputation with the NCR before you're welcome in our outposts.
translation: 这里不是菜市场，伙计——在你改善和NCR的关系之前，别想进入我们的前哨站。

original: You're walking on thin ice with the NCR. It's time to decide where your loyalties lay, friend. Until then don't expect any hospitality from us.
translation: 你和NCR的关系太不牢靠。你该决定自己站在哪一边，朋友，在那之前别指望我们赏你好脸色。

original: The NCR isn't in the habit of letting loose cannons like you just wander our bases.
translation: NCR可不会让你这种危险人士大摇大摆地走进我们基地。

original: I suggest you move along until you decide where your loyalties fall.
translation: 我建议你在决定自己的效忠对象前先不要来这儿。

original: Get up! You can't sleep here - move on.
translation: 起来！你不能睡在这里，走开。

original: Wake up, merc! These cots are for NCR only.
translation: 醒醒，雇佣兵！这些吊床仅供NCR使用。

original: No room at the inn, merc. Move along.
translation: 这个小旅馆已经没有房间了，雇佣兵。走开。

original: Slumber party's over, pal. Get a move-on.
translation: 睡舒服了吧，伙计。快走吧。

original: Wake-y wake-y - eggs and bake-y. <laughs>
translation: 起来啦，起来啦，太阳晒屁股啦。<笑>

original: Wake up! This ain't your bed.
translation: 醒醒！这不是你的床。

original: Get up.
translation: 起来。

original: Move along.
translation: 走吧。

original: Get up. Sleep it off somewhere else.
translation: 起来。去别的地方睡。

original: Get out of that bed.
translation: 从床上下来。

original: No sleeping here.
translation: 不准睡在这里。

original: If you're planning on staying awhile, the Dino Dee-lite's got plenty of room.
translation: 如果你打算在这呆一段时间，我们旅店有的是空房。

original: {annoyed at town conspiracy theorist}Don't listen to a word No-bark says. He spouts nothing but nonsense.
translation: {annoyed at town conspiracy theorist}疯嘴说的话一个字都不能信，他只会满嘴胡说八道。

original: Been to the top of the dino yet?
translation: 你去过恐龙嘴吗？

original: {successful rocket launch}Good thing none of those rockets crashed into Novac.
translation: {successful rocket launch}好消息是没有一枚火箭在诺瓦克坠毁。

original: If it weren't for the water caravans, Novac would've turned to dust a long time ago.
translation: 要不是有运水的商队经过此地，诺瓦克早就变成一片荒地了。

original: {Boone shot Manny}Can't believe Boone shot Manny.
translation: {Boone shot Manny}真不敢相信布恩射朝曼尼开了枪。

original: {Boone shot Jeannie}Boone must've had a hell of a grudge against Jeannie-May.
translation: {Boone shot Jeannie}布恩肯定恨死珍妮·梅了。

original: {Boone shot Alice}What did Boone have against Alice?
translation: {Boone shot Alice}布恩和爱丽丝有什么过节？

original: {Boone shot Dusty}Boone thought Dusty sold Carla into slavery?
translation: {Boone shot Dusty}布恩认为是达斯蒂把卡拉卖给了奴隶贩子？

original: {Boone shot No-bark}No-bark was harmless. There's no way he had something to do with Boone's wife.
translation: {Boone shot No-bark}疯嘴不会伤人。他不可能和布恩妻子的事情有什么关联。

original: {Boone shot Andy}Hell of thing for Boone to kill Ranger Andy like that.
translation: {Boone shot Andy}布恩怎么把游骑兵安迪给杀了。

original: {Chupacabra killed}Looks like the McBrides weren't telling tall tales after all.
translation: 看来麦克布莱德家的人确实没有夸大其词。

original: {Chupacabra alive}The McBrides think some mysterious creature is shooting up their Brahmin. Gotta be somebody in town doing it.
translation: {Chupacabra alive}麦克布莱德家的人总觉得有什么神秘生物在袭击他们家的双头牛。肯定是镇上的人干的。

original: {rocket launch}All the noise at REPCONN scared the hell out of me.
translation: {rocket launch}瑞普康的那些噪音快他妈吓死我了。

original: {rocket launch failed}Knew those ghouls were up to no good. Look where it got us.
translation: {rocket launch failed}就知道那帮尸鬼干不了好事。瞧瞧这都是些什么。

original: Thanks for all your help.
translation: 感谢你做的一切。

original: You been real kind to us.
translation: 你真的对我们太好了。

original: Just showed up out of nowhere and lended a hand. We appreciate it.
translation: 你突然出现，还帮了我们这么大忙。我们很感激。

original: Without you we'd be in a lot worse shape.
translation: 如果不是你，我们就惨了。

original: I hope good things come your way.
translation: 好人一生平安。

original: We must've done something right for you to come along like you did.
translation: 我们一定是积德了，才会遇见你这样的好人。

original: Stay away, you hear?
translation: 离远点，听到没？

original: You monster!
translation: 你这个怪物！

original: You're sick, you know that?
translation: 你真变态，知道吗？

original: I don't much like you.
translation: 我不太喜欢你。

original: Maybe you should just move on.
translation: 或许你该离开了。

original: You mind your business, we'll mind ours.
translation: 你别来烦我们，我们也不会去烦你。

original: You're confusing to us. Why are you here?
translation: 你把我们搞糊涂了，你为什么在这里？

original: You're kind of odd, aren't you?
translation: 你这人有点怪，不是吗？

original: How about you just do nice things for us. We liked {emph}those.
translation: 你其实可以只干好事。我们比较喜欢{emph}那样。

original: If it's bad news, you can take it up with the Colonel. If it's good news, it better involve some dead Fiends.
translation: 如果是坏消息，你就去找上校说。如果是好消息，那最好是死了几个恶魔帮。

original: This isn't a public relations office. If you're not here about a bounty, you can go pester the Colonel.
translation: 这里不是公共关系办公室。如果你不是为了悬赏而来的，那就去找上校吧。

original: I see you're still alive, and that's promising. Any luck on that bounty?
translation: 你居然还活着啊，真有两下子。悬赏的事进展如何？

original: Got any more good news for me?
translation: 还有什么好消息带给我吗？

original: Still working on that last bounty?
translation: 还在处理上次悬赏的事？

original: Perimeter's been quiet since you left. The Fiends are running scared. I doubt they'll give us any more trouble, not for a long while.
translation: 你离开以后周边都还算太平。恶魔帮都被吓跑了。我猜他们得有一段时间不敢露面了。

original: I haven't got any more bounties for you. It's been quiet and calm since you last reported in. Just how I like it.
translation: 我再没有其他悬赏任务可以给你了。自从你上次向我报告之后，一切都很太平。我就喜欢这样。

original: If you're looking for bounties, you're too late. Had a few Fiends on my shitlist, but they either got killed or moved on.
translation: 如果你是来讨悬赏的，那已经太迟了。我之前是想处理几个恶魔帮，不过他们不是已经死了就是逃了。

original: I hear you killed Driver Nephi. My team would've liked to get a shot at him... but we're still glad he's dead.
translation: 我听说你干掉了球杆尼法。虽然我的手下很想亲自给他来一枪……不过我们还是很高兴他已经死了。

original: I'm Lieutenant Gorobets, First Recon. If you're looking to collect a bounty, you should talk to Major Dhatri.
translation: 我是格罗别茨中尉，隶属第一侦察营。如果你是来领取赏金的，那就找达特里少校谈谈吧。

original: You came through for us. I have to admit... I wasn't sure you'd make it.
translation: 你帮我们脱离了困境。我不得不承认……我原本并不相信你能成功。

original: Means a lot, letting my team get payback. Here. We all pitched in some caps for you. Even Sterling, and he's famous for his tight wallet.
translation: 你为我的队员报了仇，这意义非凡。拿着，这是我们大家给你凑的。就连那个抠门出了名的斯特林都掏了点钱。

original: {Moving into position}We'll get ourselves into position. See you at the rock crushing plant.
translation: {Moving into position}我们马上就位。碎石厂见。

original: {In position}We're all set up. You just lure Nephi close.
translation: {In position}我们全体就绪。你只要去把尼法引过来就行。

original: {First Recon member died}It's always hard to lose someone under your command. I hate writing the letter to their folks.
translation: {First Recon member died}失去下属永远都是一件让人痛心的事。我真的很讨厌给他们的家人写阵亡书。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: Hey, my man! T-t-ten of spades. First Recon sharpshooter. At your s-s-service.
translation: 嘿，兄弟！黑、黑、黑桃十。第一侦察营的神枪手。为、为、为你效劳。

original: Hey there, miss! T-t-ten of spades. First Recon sharpshooter. At your s-s-service.
translation: 嗨，女士！黑、黑、黑桃十。第一侦察营的神枪手。为、为、为你效劳。

original: {Betsy dead}Can't b-b-believe Betsy's gone. S-s-she was a bitch, b-but she was my p-p-partner, you know?
translation: {Betsy dead}真不、不、不敢相信贝齐牺牲了。她、她、她是个婊子，但、但她毕竟是我的搭、搭、搭档，你知道吗？

original: {Gorobets dead}S-s-sucks about the {ell-TEE}LT. N-n-nobody can replace him.
translation: {Gorobets dead}{ell-TEE}中尉的死真是太操、操、操蛋了。没、没、没人可以代替他。

original: How 'bout you get out of my f-f-face? I'm First Recon. I don't need to t-take shit from civvies.
translation: 从我面、面、面前滚蛋怎么样？我是第一侦察营的。不需要看平、平民的脸色。

original: {Moving into position}K-killing some Fiendsi? Shit, yeah! It's about t-t-time!
translation: {Moving into position}你弄、弄死了恶魔帮的杂碎？操，就是这样！也该、该是时候了！

original: {In position}One shot, one kill. That's how Ten of Spades p-p-plays the game.
translation: {In position}弹无虚发。黑桃十就是这样玩、玩、玩的。

original: {Nephi dead, 10 of Spades didn't get a hit}{disappointed}Shit. I didn't even get a shot at that Nephi b-b-bastard before he went down.
translation: {Nephi dead，10 of Spades didn't get a hit}{disappointed}操、操了。我一下都没打中尼法那个混、混、混蛋。

original: {Nephi dead, 10 of Spades got a hit}Right here, Fiends! This is what payback looks like! First Recon, hooah!
translation: {Nephi dead，10 of Spades got a hit}就是这样，恶魔帮的杂碎们！这才是真正的复仇！第一侦察营，万岁！

original: {Cook-Cook dead}'B-b-bout time Cook-Cook g-g-g-got what was c-coming to him.
translation: {Cook-Cook dead}大厨库克终于血、血债血、血偿了。

original: You remember me, right? T-t-ten of Spades. First Recon.
translation: 你还记得我吧？黑、黑、黑桃十。第一侦察营的。

original: {PC is female, CHA 7+}Girl... you are some grade-A poon, anybody ever tell you that?
translation: {PC is female，CHA 7+}姑娘……你的脸蛋可真美啊，有人跟你说过吗？

original: {Female PC, CHA 7+}You keep talking to me, sweetness, and people are gonna think we're an item. Not that I mind.
translation: {Female PC，CHA 7+}和我多聊一会儿吧，甜心，哪怕别人误以为我们是一对，我不会介意的。

original: {Male PC}Never seen you around before. What do you want?
translation: {Male PC}生面孔啊。你想干嘛？

original: {Moving into position}Cut the chatter. Focus on the job, or you're gonna end up dead.
translation: {Moving into position}别废话了。专心一点，否则你会挂掉的。

original: {In position}Quit talking! We've got a job to do.
translation: {In position}不要说话！我们有活要干。

original: {Nephi dead, Betsy got a hit}You did good out there. Glad you let me get a piece of Nephi.
translation: {Nephi dead，Betsy got a hit}干得漂亮。很高兴你让我也给尼法补了一枪。

original: {Nephi dead, Betsy didn't get a hit}What a pointless trip. Here I thought I'd get a shot at that junkie bastard.
translation: {Nephi dead，Betsy didn't get a hit}真是白跑一趟。我还以为能给那个杂碎来一枪呢。

original: {10 of Spades dead}Damn that 10 of Spades. Just had to go and get himself killed.
translation: {10 of Spades dead}黑桃十真该死。非要不知死活地参加这次行动。

original: {Gorobets dead}Gorobets was all right - {lesbian afterthought, with some respect}for a man. Not gonna be the same without him.
translation: {Gorobets dead}格罗别茨真的不错——{lesbian afterthought，with some respect}作为一个男人。没有他就没有我们的今天。

original: I've been seeing Usanagi, and things are better. I'm not so angry all the time, you know? And, uh, I'm not trying to jump every woman in camp.
translation: 我已经去见过宇佐木了，情况好些了。其实我也不爱老发脾气，你懂吗？此外，呃，我以后再也不会对营地里的女性下手了。

original: Well, not all the time, anyway,
translation: 嗯，当然不是绝对。

original: {a little subdued, but friendly - the player's helped her}Hey.
translation: {a little subdued, but friendly - the player's helped her}嘿。

original: {Female PC}{friendly - likes women}Hey, girl. You need something from me?
translation: {Female PC}{friendly - likes women}嘿，姑娘。找我有事吗？

original: {Male PC}{slight hostility - not fond of men}Yeah?
translation: {Male PC}{slight hostility - not fond of men}干嘛？

original: Howdy. Name's Sterling, First Recon. Can't say I've seen you before. I'd remember, if I had.
translation: 你好。我是第一侦察营的斯特林。我们之前没见过吧，不然我不会没印象的。

original: {Nephi dead, Sterling didn't get a hit}Took some skill to bring down that Fiend. You done good.
translation: {Nephi dead，Sterling didn't get a hit}三两下就把那个恶魔帮的杂碎干掉了。干得漂亮。

original: {Nephi dead, Sterling got in a hit}Nothing like a job done right. Wish I had a cigar.
translation: {Nephi dead，Sterling got in a hit}没什么比完成任务更让人愉悦的了。真想来支雪茄庆祝一下。

original: {Moving into position}Been a while since they let us out of the fence. Brass must really want Nephi dead.
translation: {Moving into position}我们受命离开营地也有一段时间了。长官肯定是非常希望除掉尼法。

original: {In position}Best you don't worry about us. We'll watch your back.
translation: {In position}你完全不用担心我们。我们会为你殿后的。

original: {Gorobets dead}It's always hard when your commander goes down, but we'll pull through all right.
translation: {Gorobets dead}长官牺牲真是令人难过，但是我们能克服难关的。

original: Howdy. What brings you back?
translation: 你好。什么风把你吹回来了？

original: I'm Bitter-Root. First Recon. You got a reason to talk to me?
translation: 我是第一侦察营的苦根。你有什么话想和我说吗？

original: {Moving into position}Can't talk now. Got to keep my eyes sharp.
translation: {Moving into position}现在不能说话。我得保持警惕。

original: {In position}{quietly warning, it's a combat situation}Eyes sharp, now.
translation: {In position}{quietly warning，it's a combat situation}不要分神。

original: {Nephi dead, Bitter-Root got a hit}Wish I'd gotten a bullet in that Fiend...
translation: {Nephi dead，Bitter-Root got a hit}真希望是我一枪崩了那个恶魔帮的杂碎……

original: {Nephi dead, Bitter-Root got a hit}That's one less drugged-out waster. Best part of this job - shooting folks who deserve it.
translation: {Nephi dead，Bitter-Root got a hit}又少了一个嗑药的废土游民。最爽的是——我给了那些罪有应得的杂碎一梭子弹。

original: {Gorobets dead}I've never lost a {see-OH: commanding officer}CO before. It doesn't feel right.
translation: {Gorobets dead}我以前从来没失去过{see-OH: commanding officer}长官。这真让人不舒服。

original: Didn't think you'd be back. What's this about?
translation: 没想到你还会回来。有什么事？

original: Let me guess. You got work for me, right?
translation: 让我猜猜。你有活要找我干，对吧？

original: Well, you're too late - I just quit the bounty trade. Soon as I pick up some caps that Dhatri owes me, I'm out of this scrapyard.
translation: 好吧，你来迟了——我已经不做悬赏了。只要达特里跟我把账结清，我立马就离开这个鬼地方。

original: {Cook-Cook dead}Heard you got Cook-Cook. I hope you roasted that bastard with his own flamer.
translation: {Cook-Cook dead}听说你干掉了大厨库克。希望你是用那个混蛋的火焰喷射器烧死了他。

original: Yep, I'm still here. Shit, I got nothing better to do, right?
translation: 对，我还在这儿。见鬼，反正我也没什么事可做，对吧。

original: {Small Fry}I must say, fortune seems to be with you of late. Please, enjoy this, compliments of the White Glove Society.
translation: {Small Fry}不得不说，你运气真是不错。尽情享用这份美酒吧，白手套社团向你致意。

original: {Big Winner}You certainly seem to be making a splash with all your success in the casino. Our executive chef prepared this delicacy for you himself. Enjoy.
translation: {Big Winner}赢来的钱用起来就是潇洒。这是我们主厨亲自为你烹制的菜肴。请慢用。

original: {Whale}You are quite simply the talk of the casino right now with your astonishing play. Do stay in our {BONE veev-ONT, light French 'n' for Bon}Bon Vivant suite so you may continue to dazzle us.
translation: {Whale}你在赌场里的惊人表现已经让你成为焦点人物了。欢迎您入住我们的享乐家套房，好让大家继续欣赏你的精彩表演。

original: {Banned}This simply will not do. You must leave immediately.
translation: {Banned}这样不行。你必须立刻离开。

original: Thank you for coming, let's talk about that robot.
translation: 谢谢你能来，说说你的那个机器人吧。

original: Have you given any more thought to my offer?
translation: 你考虑过我的提议了吗？

original: I'd like to talk to you about your robot. Bring it here and we can talk. I'm sure we can be of mutual benefit to each other.
translation: 我想跟你聊聊你那个机器人的事。具体情况等你把它带过来再说。我保证这件事对我们双方都有利。

original: What are you doing here? This is our casino, punk.
translation: 你在这里干什么？这是我们的赌场，蠢货。

original: Gotta run! No time to chat!
translation: 我得走了！没时间闲聊！

original: Sorry, you just win too much. We can't let you play here anymore.
translation: 对不起，你赢得太多了。我们不能让你在这玩儿了。

original: Welcome to Vikki and Vance, we're still getting the casino up and running but feel free to sit down and play.
translation: 欢迎来到“维姬与万斯”赌场，虽然我们还没正式营业，但是没关系，随意找个地方坐下来玩吧。

original: We're hoping that Primm will get back on its feet from the money we earn here.
translation: 我们希望可以用我们挣来的钱重振普瑞姆。

original: We feel much safer opening the casino back up, now that we have a sheriff.
translation: 自从有了警长后，我们觉得让赌场重新开业已经安全多了。

original: I'm glad that I could start working here again, things were rough with those convicts in town.
translation: 我很高兴又能在这里工作了，自从那群逃犯流窜到这儿之后日子就很难过。

original: I've gotta hand it to you. You've done good things for Novac, but you've also got 'em a little scared of you. And that's great for business.
translation: 我把它交给你。你为诺瓦克做了不少好事，但你也搞得他们有点怕你。虽然这样对生意倒是很好。

original: As long as you keep it coming, I'll get you some things a little cheaper than they should be.
translation: 只要你保持这个势头，我就给你些小折扣。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: Between you and me, I don't think she studied at an accredited institution.
translation: 就咱俩说说，我觉得她那些东西都不是从什么正规地方学到的。

original: She hasn't paid me anything yet. Should I be worried?
translation: 她还一分钱都没付给我呢。我该担心吗？

original: Heard you helped out Jackson, thanks for that. Caravans are still waiting for clearance to move out, but at least there's movement.
translation: 听说你帮了杰克逊，谢了。商队还在等待放行，但至少情况已经有所改观。

original: {Impressed}Coming from the North? Must be crazy to brave those roads.
translation: 从北边来的？居然敢走那些路，你真是疯了。

original: Something else you wanted?
translation: 你还有别的事吗？

original: Now that McNamara's lifted that silly lockdown of his, perhaps people around here will come to appreciate our training simulations.
translation: 麦克纳马拉终于解除了他那傻帽的戒严令，也许这儿的人会开始感谢我们的模拟训练的。

original: Perhaps there will be a renewed interest in them as people realize just how close to reality they are... but I digress. What did you want?
translation: 说不定等大家明白了实战离他们并不遥远的时候，就会对这训练更加感兴趣……我跑题了。你想干什么来着？

original: Now that Hardin's Elder, I hope I'll be allowed to continue my experiments. I never quite liked the way he looked at me during meetings.
translation: 现在哈丁成了长老，我希望他别把我的的实验给停了。我一直不太喜欢他在开会的时候看我的眼神。

original: Like he wanted to use me for target practice. The man just has no respect for science! But enough of this. What did you want?
translation: 就好像他想拿我当靶子一样。那家伙一点都不尊重科学！好了，不说了。你想干什么来着？

original: Yes? What is it?
translation: 是吗？什么事？

original: I'll track the virus from over here. You just concentrate on locating the terminals hosting it.
translation: 现在起我会追踪病毒。你专心定位中毒的终端就行。

original: {Flustered}Look, this isn't a great {time}ti- oh, what the hell, it's not like we're making any progress. I'm Ibsen, and I hope your day is going better than mine is.
translation: {Flustered}听着，现在可不是{time}什——嘿，搞什么鬼，看来我们根本没取得什么进展。我是易卜生，希望你今天不会像我过得一样糟。

original: Did you want to try isolating the virus?
translation: 你不是想把病毒隔离起来吗？

original: You actually did it! If you don't mind my saying so, I didn't think you had a chance in hell of pulling it off.
translation: 你真的做到了！希望你别介意，我本来还以为你根本做不到呢。
