original: But I'm glad to be wrong for once! Thank you, my friend. Please, feel free to access the datastore at your leisure.
translation: 但我很高兴自己能错上一回！谢谢你，朋友。只要你有需要，请随便使用数据库。

original: I'm only allowed to give you access to non-classified topics, but it's better than nothing, right?
translation: 我的权限只能让你访问非机密文档，不过有总比没有好，对吧？

original: Hello again, my friend. I hope you've been finding the information in the datastore useful.
translation: 欢迎回来，朋友。希望你在数据库里找到了有用的信息。

original: Welcome to the range. Feel free to use any open lane.
translation: 欢迎来到靶场。你可以随意使用空的射击位。

original: Ah, outsider. I've heard that you were instrumental in providing Hardin with the evidence to bring against me. And here I had thought to use {lightly stressed}you.
translation: 啊，外来者。我听说你在协助哈丁搜集对付我的证据。我本以为可以{lightly stressed}利用你的。

original: Have you come to gloat, or did you actually want something?
translation: 你是来幸灾乐祸的，还是确实有事？

original: Welcome, outsider, welcome! The lockdown has been officially lifted and everyone seems to be in good spirits.
translation: 欢迎，外来者，欢迎！封锁已正式解除，大家看起来都神清气爽。

original: With the surface open to us once again, Hardin's already started talk of sending a force out to attack HELIOS, but I hope to dissuade him.
translation: 因为我们终于能再和外界接触了，哈丁将攻击太阳神一号提上了议程，不过我希望能劝阻他。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: Hail, Brother. May I help you?
translation: 欢迎，兄弟。有什么事吗？

original: Greetings, my friend. I hope I can be of some assistance to you.
translation: 幸会，我的朋友。希望我能为你提供帮助。

original: {Getting ready to lift the lockdown}I apologize, outsider, but I'm going to be busy for a little while making preparations for lifting the lockdown.
translation: {Getting ready to lift the lockdown}抱歉，外来者，我得去为解除封锁做最后的准备。

original: {Annoyed to have to talk to the player again}What is it now, outsider?
translation: {Annoyed to have to talk to the player again}又怎么了，外来者？

original: I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, outsider. I've had word that Hardin is charging me with violating protocol and must prepare a defense.
translation: 恐怕我没有聊天的时间，外来者。听说哈丁要控诉我违反规定，我得准备为自己辩护。

original: Back again, I see. Have you found all the components we need?
translation: 你又回来了。我们需要的部件都找到了吗？

original: Have you had any luck finding the scouts? Or did you have something to discuss?
translation: 你碰见那些斥候了吗？还是有其他事情要找我？

original: Found the missing patrols, or was something else on your mind?
translation: 你是已经找到了失踪的士兵，还是有其他的事要找我？

original: How did you find us, stranger? And do tell the truth.
translation: 你怎么找到我们的，陌生人？别耍花样，说实话。

original: I've been informed that you bring us ill tidings, stranger. Care to elaborate?
translation: 听说你给我们带来了坏消息，陌生人。能不能详细说说？

original: When Paladin Ramos informed me that Veronica was approaching with an outsider in tow, at first I didn't know what to think.
translation: 当圣骑士拉莫斯告诉我维罗尼卡跟一个外来者走得很近的时候，我一开始都不知道该作何感想。

original: After giving the matter some thought, however, I've decided that an outsider could be of use to me right now.
translation: 但仔细想想，我发现这种时候一个外来者对我来说其实还是很有用的。

original: However, I will not force you to help us. Should you refuse, you will be allowed to leave here, though you'd remain Veronica's responsibility.
translation: 当然，我不会强迫你帮我们。如果你拒绝的话，也没人会妨碍你离开这里，不过你得好好对维罗尼卡负责。

original: What do you say, outsider? Are you willing to help us?
translation: 你怎么说，外来者？你愿意帮我们吗？

original: What I wished to discuss with you can wait for once I get settled in the command room, outsider.
translation: 我们可以等到我把指挥室布置好后再详谈，外来者。

original: When you first showed up on our doorstep, I'll admit at first I didn't know what to think.
translation: 你刚出现在门口的时候，我承认，我不知道该作何感想。

original: After giving the matter some thought, however, I've decided that an outsider could be of great use to me right now.
translation: 但仔细想想，我发现一个外来者在这时候其实对我来说会大有用处。

original: However, I will not force you to help us. Should you refuse, you will be allowed to leave here, though know we {stressed}will be keeping an eye on you.
translation: 当然，我不会强迫你帮我们。如果你拒绝的话，也没人会妨碍你离开这里，不过我们{stressed}会一直留意你的。

original: What do you say, outsider? Are you willing to help us?
translation: 你怎么说，外来者？你愿意帮我们吗？

original: How did you resolve the situation with the ranger?
translation: 你是怎么解决和游骑兵之间的问题的？

original: Have you reconsidered, outsider? I can still use your help.
translation: 重新考虑过了吗，外来者？我仍然需要你的帮助。

original: {Generic question node}Yes, associate?
translation: {Generic question node}有事吗？

original: Hey, I heard the pistol got returned. Thanks a lot! I am {emph}never going to listen to Watkins again, believe me.
translation: 嘿，我听说手枪已经找回来了。太感谢了！我{emph}再也不会听沃特金斯的了，相信我。

original: I really hope you can find that pistol.
translation: 真希望你能找到我的手枪。

original: Yes, can I help you?
translation: 是的，有什么事吗？

original: Sorry, but I'm a little busy here. If you'll excuse me.
translation: 对不起，我正巧有点忙。请你见谅。

original: The lockdown is lifted! The patrols are going to start up again! Do you know what this means? I'll actually be able to get into a real fight!
translation: 封锁解除了！巡逻队又要出发啦！你知道这意味着什么吗？我终于可以真刀真枪地干一场啦！

original: I wonder what it'll be against? Raiders? Radscorpions? {super excited}Deathclaws? Oh, I can't wait. So what's up?
translation: 不知道在外面都会碰到些什么？掠夺者？辐射蝎？{super excited}还是死亡爪？噢，我都等不及啦。对了，你有什么事？

original: Hey, so Hardin becoming Elder was because of you, huh? Good job. Now that the lockdown if lifted, I may get a chance to get into a real fight!
translation: 嘿，原来哈丁是仰仗你才当上长老的啊？干得好。现在只要封锁一解除，我就有机会来一次实战了！

original: I wonder what it'll be against? Raiders? Radscorpions? {super excited}Deathclaws? Oh, I can't wait. So what's up?
translation: 不知道在外面都会碰到些什么？掠夺者？辐射蝎？{super excited}还是死亡爪？噢，我都等不及啦。对了，什么事？

original: I hear you handled the NCR ranger that was camping out topside.
translation: 我听说你已经消灭了驻扎在地面上的NCR游骑兵。

original: Don't get a big head or anything about it. I would have taken him out if they'd let me.
translation: 别以为自己有多了不起。要不是他们拦着，我早就把他干掉了。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: You'll find your equipment in the chest to your right. Don't bother coming back until you've dealt with the ranger.
translation: 你的装备都在你右手边的箱子里。没解决掉那个游骑兵就别回来见我。

original: Stand back from the door. The Elder's eager to hear your report.
translation: 退后。长老急着要听你的报告。

original: [You hear nothing.]
translation: [你什么也没听见。]

original: {Ramos Greeting for players who found a patrol}Where did you learn that password? And tell the truth, because I'll know if you're lying.
translation: {Ramos Greeting for players who found a patrol}你从哪儿搞到密码的？老实交代，你骗不了我。

original: {Ramos Greeting for players with Veronica}{Stern}Listen up. I'm in charge of security around here, and I can't say I'm too happy having an outsider waltzing around.
translation: {Ramos Greeting for players with Veronica}{Stern}听好了。我负责这里的安保工作，有个外来者在附近晃来晃去的我可高兴不起来。

original: {Eases up, first part was just for show}But since you came in with Veronica, I'm inclined to cut you a little slack. Just behave yourself and we won't have any problems, okay?
translation: {Eases up，first part was just for show}不过既然你是和维罗尼卡一起来的，我可以对你稍微网开一面。管好你自己，这样大家都轻松，明白吗？

original: Oh, and the Elder's going to want to talk to you. He's on the second level. Just take a right once you get down there.
translation: 噢，还有，长老想和你谈谈。他在二层。你下楼梯后右转就到。

original: My office is right here in case you need anything. Just ask for Ramos.
translation: 如果你有什么需要找我的，我的办公室就在这儿。说找拉莫斯就行。

original: {Ramos dialogue if player sneaks into the bunker}{Angry, an intruder managed to get past his security}How the hell did you get in here? Normally, I would have already shot you, but I'm under orders to bring you to the Elder. Will you come peacefully?
translation: {Ramos dialogue if player sneaks into the bunker}{Angry，an intruder managed to get past his security}你到底怎么进来的？要换成平时我早就一枪把你崩了，不过我接到了命令要带你去见长老。你会合作吧？

original: Rest up, and make your report to the Elder when you're up to it.
translation: 先休息一下，休息好了就去向长老报告。

original: If you have something to say, say it to Elder McNamara.
translation: 如果你有话要说，去和麦克纳马拉长老说。

original: Your presence here... Let's just say it's highly irregular.
translation: 你的出现……只能说非常地不寻常。

original: Outsiders aren't even allowed to know that our bunker's here, let alone come and go freely.
translation: 外来者甚至都不可能知道我们的地堡在这儿，更别说来去自如了。

original: You impressed Elder McNamara, obviously. He must believe that you'll be very useful.
translation: 显然你让麦克纳马拉长老印象深刻啊。他肯定是觉得你会派上大用场。

original: Oh, hey there. Something I can help you with?
translation: 噢，你好。有什么要我帮忙的吗？

original: No time to talk now. I have to get ready to return to base with this information. I'll get a fat raise for this, if anyone actually believes me.
translation: 现在可没功夫闲聊。我得尽快把这个情报带回基地去。如果真有人相信，我肯定会得到丰厚的报酬。

original: {Nonchalant}Okay, so you weren't kidding about there being a Brotherhood base here.
translation: {Nonchalant}好吧，看来你没开玩笑，这里确实有个兄弟会基地。

original: I'll need to report back to base about this. They'll think I'm playing a prank if I try to radio it in, so I'll need some face time with the brass.
translation: 我得尽快向基地报告。如果我用无线电联络，他们肯定会觉得我是在胡扯，所以我得当面向长官报告。

original: Thanks for the heads up. I mean it. I'll be sure to mention you in my report.
translation: 感谢你的情报。我说真的。我一定会在报告里提及你的。

original: Shhh. I thought I heard something up by the entrance.
translation: 嘘。我好像听见门口有动静。

original: Now, now. Calm down. I believe you saw something. Let's just head back to my camp and we'll figure out what it was, okay?
translation: 好了，好了。冷静。我相信你确实看见了什么东西。我们先回营地去把事情前后理清楚，好不好？

original: Sorry, but I've got a long hike ahead of me. You take care.
translation: 抱歉，我还有很长的一段路要走。你自己小心。

original: Powder ganger scum! Hands up or die!
translation: 炸药帮的杂碎！快投降！否则格杀勿论！

original: Thought you'd sneak up on me, you filthy powder ganger?
translation: 你以为靠偷袭就能干得了我吗，炸药帮的贱狗？

original: Oh, it's you. Any particular reason you felt the need to bother me again?
translation: 噢，是你啊。你最好是有事来找我。

original: You must be the stranger I've been hearing about. Sorry, but I'm strictly forbidden from offering our tech to outsiders like yourself.
translation: 你肯定就是我之前听说的那个陌生人了。抱歉，我不允许向你这样的外来者提供任何技术。

original: Besides, I'm a little busy right now.
translation: 况且，我眼下有点忙。

original: Sorry, outsider, but I'm not allowed to sell you anything without the Elder's say so.
translation: 对不起，外来者，没有长老的允许，我不能卖东西给你。

original: Besides, I'm a little busy right now.
translation: 况且，我眼下有点忙。

original: I can't believe Hardin is Elder now. At least with the lockdown lifted I'll be able to resupply my store more often. So what are you here for?
translation: 真不敢相信哈丁现在居然成了长老。但至少解除封锁以后我的货源更广了。那么，你想买点什么？

original: Have you heard the news? Elder McNamara has lifted the lockdown! Good news for this store, let me tell you. I can't wait to start getting more goods.
translation: 你听说没有？麦克纳马拉长老解除了封锁！要我说，这对我的小店来说真是好消息！我都等不及要去搞些更好的货品来了。

original: So what are you here for?
translation: 那么，你想买点什么？

original: The word came down from the Elder that I'm to offer you some of our lesser wares, as if I didn't have other matters on my mind.
translation: 长老发话说我可以向你提供一些小型商品，可我手头上的事情还多着呢。

original: Have you found it? I need to give my report to Hardin soon.
translation: 找到了吗？我得尽快向哈丁报告。

original: Hi there. Looking to spend some caps?
translation: 嗨。想买点什么东西吗？

original: You again? Didn't I tell you I was busy?
translation: 又是你？我不是跟你说了我很忙？

original: Listen very closely and do as I say. Your life depends on it.
translation: 仔细听好，按我说的做。这关系到你的死活。

original: Hand over everything you're carrying. Weapons, ammo, clothes, armor - everything. I want you stripped down to your underwear.
translation: 把你的东西都交出来。武器、弹药、衣服、护甲——所有东西。我要你脱到只剩内衣。

original: Save it for Paladin Ramos, outsider.
translation: 有牢骚去找圣骑士拉莫斯发，外来者。

original: I said shut up and keep moving.
translation: 我说了，闭嘴，走开。

original: You're the one with that robot, I was hoping you'd bring him my way. Pretty impressive piece of hardware.
translation: 你和那个机器人是一起同行的吧，我本希望你会带它来见我。它那一套硬件真的堪称杰作。

original: I can't say that I've seen anything quite like him before.
translation: 我得说，我以前从没见过它那样的机器人。

original: Hmmm? Oh, you must be the outsider everyone's buzzing about. Pleased to meet you. I'm Lorenzo, Senior Knight and general handyman around here.
translation: 嗯？噢，你一定就是那个让大家议论纷纷的外来者吧。幸会幸会。我是洛伦佐，既是高阶骑士，也是这里的技术员。

original: Hey, good to see you again. Have you thought any more about letting me take a look at the logs on your robot?
translation: 嗨，真高兴又见到你。这次你能不能让我看一眼你那个机器人的日志？

original: Good to see you! Alive, that is. Have you found all of the components yet?
translation: 很高兴见到你！看来你还活着。找齐所有部件没有？

original: Good to see you again. What can I help you with?
translation: 很高兴再见到你。有什么我能帮忙的地方吗？

original: What do you want? And don't try anything funny.
translation: 你想干什么？在我面前别耍花样。

original: That report must reach the Elder's hands. I have nothing further to give you.
translation: 那份报告必须交到长老手里。其他的我也没什么可交待你的了。

original: Don't take another step if you value your life. For what purpose do you approach me?
translation: 你如果还珍惜自己的性命，就别再往前走了。你接近我的目的是什么？

original: The Elder is likely urgently awaiting that report. You should make your way to him as soon as possible.
translation: 考虑到长老可能正急切地等着那份报告，你还是尽快回去复命吧。

original: Approach slowly, stranger. If you have no business with me, then go.
translation: 脚步放慢点，陌生人。如果你没有事找我，就走开。

original: Quick now, off with you! The Elder must see that report!
translation: 快点，快回去！长老必须看到那份报告！

original: It looks like you've managed to talk some sense into the Elder, outsider. Be assured, I'll still be keeping an eye on him.
translation: 看来你成功说服了长老，外来者。不过你听好，我还是会盯紧你的。

original: {Grudging}Your efforts to help this chapter are not unappreciated. Now, what can I do for you?
translation: {Grudging}我们很感激你为我们分会所做的一切。那么，有什么能为您效劳的？

original: Welcome, my friend. A new day has dawned for this chapter, and moving forward we will no longer cower in the dark.
translation: 欢迎，我的朋友。分会终于迎来了曙光，我们将大步向前，走出阴霾。

original: And we have you to thank for it. You'll find that I can be generous to those who show loyalty.
translation: 这可都要感谢你。你会发现我对忠实的伙伴是很慷慨的。

original: Here, take this key. If you ever find yourself in need of repair, head to our safehouse to the northeast.
translation: 来，拿着这把钥匙。如果你需要修理什么东西，就去我们在东北边的安全屋吧。

original: Now, what can I do for you?
translation: 那么，有什么能为您效劳的？

original: {Hardin, haven't listened to him yet}Are you willing to listen to me now, outsider?
translation: {Hardin，haven't listened to him yet}你现在愿意听我说话了吗，外来者？

original: Have you reconsidered helping me, outsider? I do what I must to see that the chapter survives.
translation: 你愿意帮助我吗，外来者？我所做的一切都是为了保护这个分会。

original: What is it, outsider? Have you discovered anything?
translation: 什么事，外来者？你有什么发现吗？

original: Welcome back, my friend. What can I do for you?
translation: 欢迎回来，我的朋友。有什么我能帮忙的？

original: What do you want, outsider?
translation: 你想要什么，外来者？

original: I appreciate all you've done, but I'm going to have my hands full for a little while. Come back later and we'll talk.
translation: 我很感激你所做的一切，但我手头还有一大堆事要处理。晚些再来吧，我们那时候再谈。

original: I heard we have you to thank for McNamara having a change of heart. Thank you. So what can I do for you?
translation: 听说麦克纳马拉改变了主意，多亏了你。谢谢。那么，有什么需要我帮忙的？

original: There's a rumor going around that you were behind Hardin's takeover. I suppose his leadership is better than none at all. Time will tell.
translation: 有传闻说哈丁能够接管这里是因为背后有你的支持。我并不看好他的领导能力。咱们还是先观望吧。

original: So what brings you by today?
translation: 今天是什么风把你吹来的？

original: Hello, you must be the outsider everyone is talking about. I'm Linda Schuler. If you ever need medical attention, this is the place to come.
translation: 你好，你肯定就是那个大家都在谈论的外来者吧。我是琳达·舒勒。如果你需要医护，可以随时来找我。

original: Hello. Can I help you with something?
translation: 嗨。需要帮忙么？

original: The Caesar has marked you for death... and the Legion obeys. Ready yourself for battle.
translation: 凯撒已经对你下了格杀令……而军团永远服从他的命令。准备战斗吧。

original: Now you will serve as an example to all who dare oppose Caesar's Legion. Defend yourself!
translation: 我们要杀了你，让那些胆敢和凯撒军团作对的人知道他们的下场！拿起武器吧！

original: You have defied Caesar for the last time! Your life ends now!
translation: 你居然敢和凯撒作对！受死吧！

original: Hey there. Need anything?
translation: 你好。有什么事？

original: They're hoarding our water! How are we supposed to survive the desert, huh?
translation: 他们在抢我们的水！这下我们还怎么在沙漠里活下去，嗯？

original: Hope those greedy bastards rot in foul water.
translation: 希望那些贪婪的王八蛋烂在臭水里。

original: One of these days, we're going to teach them a good lesson.
translation: 迟早有一天，我们要好好给他们点颜色瞧瞧。

original: We'll be back. They can't step over our people forever.
translation: 我们会回来的。他们不可能永远踩在我们头上。

original: Those hillbillies think they can take our water. We bring civilization, and this is how they repay us.
translation: 那些乡巴佬居然想夺走我们的水。我们给他们带来了文明，他们就想这么回报我们。

original: Damned rats. Next time I see them, I swear, I'll aim right between their eyes.
translation: 该死的耗子。下次再让我见到他们，你看我不打爆他们的脑袋。

original: They've got no right to come near our outposts. This is NCR territory, now.
translation: 他们没有权利接近我们的哨站。这里现在是NCR的领土。

original: I almost pity them, these desert savages.
translation: 我真有些开始同情他们了，那些沙漠野人。

original: We'll get back our water, and our land, one of these days. We'll be mean to those soldiers until they leave!
translation: 我们早晚会夺回我们的水和土地。只要那些士兵不走，我们就不会让他们过好日子！

original: They're asking for it, those people from the NCR. We're tough, here! They don't scare us.
translation: 那些NCR的家伙自找的。这是我们的地盘！我们什么都不怕。

original: This desert is our home!
translation: 这片沙漠就是我们的家！

original: We've lived here a long time! We're not going to leave our home.
translation: 我们已经在这里住了很长时间！我们不会离开自己的家。

original: They're mean! Don't want to share water with us.
translation: 他们太坏了！居然不和我们分享水源。

original: Hi! I'm Sarah, Sarah Weintraub. Welcome to the finest Vault hotel in the whole world!
translation: 嗨！我叫萨拉，萨拉·温特劳布。欢迎光顾全世界最好的避难所酒店。

original: Good to see you again!
translation: 又见面了！

original: Well, well! If it isn't the Vault explorer himself! Welcome back.
translation: 哎呀！这不是我们的避难所探险家么！欢迎回来。

original: Well, well! If it isn't the Vault explorer herself! Welcome back.
translation: 哎呀！这不是我们的避难所探险家么！欢迎回来。

original: {Satisfied but exhausted from sex}That was something else. I look forward to the next ride - once I recover, you monster.
translation: {Satisfiedbutexhaustedfromsex}真是过瘾。真想再和你做一次——不过得先等我缓一缓，你这小怪物。

original: What are you doing here!? I don't want to be near you ever again! Leave, leave... just leave, ok!?
translation: 你在这干什么？！我不想再见到你！走开，走开……快走开，行不行？！

original: Hey, stranger! Where have you been, uh? I missed you!
translation: 嘿，陌生人！你去哪了，嗯？我想你了！

original: Give me a few to close the shop, I'll meet you at the room.
translation: 给我点时间关店，等下我去房间里找你。

original: {Deeply Saddened}Mickey is... he's no longer... alive. I'm sorry, but I just can't go on.
translation: {DeeplySaddened}米奇他……他已经……不在了。对不起，我说不下去了。

original: Greetings, citizen. Please, select your accommodation needs.
translation: 您好，公民。请选择您的住宿标准。

original: Behave, and don't give me a reason to kick you out.
translation: 守规矩，别让我把你轰出去。

original: This is going to be fun!
translation: 这将会很有趣！

original: {Amazed at the Player}You must be very special to Mr. House, huh?
translation: {Amazed at the Player}你在豪斯先生眼里肯定很特别吧，嗯？

original: {Amazed at the Player}How did you get in there?
translation: {Amazed at the Player}你怎么进来的？

original: {Amazed at the Player}Wow... I've never seen anyone go into the Lucky 38 before.
translation: {Amazed at the Player}哇哦……我还真没见过有谁能进入幸运38的。

original: {Amazed at the Player}Don't mind me. I was just passing by.
translation: {Amazed at the Player}不用理我。我就路过。

original: {Amazed at the Player}I bet everyone's going to hear about you going into the 38.
translation: {Amazed at the Player}我打赌你进入幸运38的事很快就会传开。

original: {Amazed at the Player}My pals said nobody has ever been inside the Lucky 38.
translation: {Amazed at the Player}我的哥们都说从来没有人进过幸运38。

original: {Amazed at the Player}Hey, sexy, come by the Tops later. I'd love to hear your story.
translation: {Amazed at the Player}嘿，性感美人，等会来九重天吧。我很想听听你的故事。

original: We can chat later. The sooner you finish these tests the sooner you can get out of here.
translation: 闲话以后再聊吧。你越早完成测试，就能越早离开这里。

original: It's important that you're relaxed for this next test. Please, have a seat.
translation: 你只有保持放松，我们才能开始下一项测试。来吧，请坐。

original: All right. I'm gonna say a word. I want you to say the first thing that comes to mind.
translation: 好吧。我先说一个单词。然后你告诉我你脑海中闪现的第一印象是什么。

original: Dog.
translation: 狗。

original: Here. These are yours. Was all you had on you when you was brought in.
translation: 给你。这些都是你的。你被送进来的时候，身上就带着这些东西。

original: I hope you don't mind but I gave the note a look. I thought it might help me find a next of kin. But it was just something about a platinum chip.
translation: 我看了一眼你的笔记，希望你别介意。我本来是想看看你有没有什么亲友，但上面只写了一则关于什么白金筹码的事。

original: I knew you'd make it. Resourceful, as always.
translation: 我就知道你能行。一如既往地神通广大。

original: The override module is functioning properly. I'm rerouting power to the Securitron vault at the Fort as we speak...
translation: 覆盖组件运行正常。眼下我正在把电力重新导向到位于城堡地下的电子保安仓库中……

original: I just need you to head over to the east power plant and manually activate the switch.
translation: 你只要到东边的电站去，手动激活开关就行了。

original: When you return topside, I think you'll see that my Securitron army is a little more than the Legion was prepared to handle.
translation: 等你回到地面上，应该会看到我的安全部队比军团原计划对付的要多了那么一点。

original: Oh, and before you go - grab that print-out spooling from the console here - those papers set the terms for the NCR's unconditional surrender.
translation: 哦，还有，你走之前——把控制台打印出来的那卷纸拿走——那是让NCR无条件投降的条约书。

original: I thought you might enjoy the honor of presenting them to the NCR's commanding officer, once the Legion has been defeated. Cheers!
translation: 一旦打败了军团，你大可以将它甩在NCR指挥官的脸上，我想你会喜欢那种感觉的。干杯！

original: I've been sent to take you back to the Lucky 38. Are you ready to go?
translation: 我来接你回幸运38。你准备好出发了吗？

original: Welcome to Jacobstown, human. You're free to walk around, just don't stare at the Nightkin. They don't like people looking at them.
translation: 欢迎来到雅各布斯镇，人类。你可以随意走动，别盯着夜行族看就是了。他们不喜欢被人看着。

original: {A little quieter, more confidentially}And if you're NCR, keep it to yourself. They're not popular around here.
translation: {A little quieter, more confidentially}另外，如果你是NCR的人，那最好别说出来。他们在这不受欢迎。

original: Got a problem, could use your help. Been having trouble with NCR mercs harassing the town, and they just showed up again.
translation: 我们遇到个麻烦，需要你帮忙。NCR的佣兵经常骚扰这座镇子，他们刚又出现了。

original: Just had to go and start a fight with the mercs, didn't you. Guess we'd better finish things.
translation: 你就非得要去跟那些佣兵干一架，是吧。看来我们只能尽快把事情了结。

original: Not the outcome I was hoping for with the mercs. At least it buys us time to build up our defenses.
translation: 这可不是我希望看到的结果。但至少给我们争取了点时间来建立防御。

original: Had hoped to start reaching out to NCR, start talking trade and borders. It'll be more difficult now.
translation: 我原本还指望能跟NCR和解，谈谈通商和互不侵犯的事。现在这样，难了。

original: {Regretful}So, Keene's dead. Knew it might come to that some day. {Beat, slight weariness}Makes things difficult for the town.
translation: {Regretful}这么说，基恩死了。我就知道迟早会有这一天的。{Beat,slightweariness}这下镇子更难过了。

original: Without Keene, it'll be hard to convince other Nightkin in the wasteland to come here. And harder to get the ones here to stay.
translation: 没有基恩，再想说服废土上的其他夜行族迁来这里就更困难了。已经来了的人也会待不下去的。

original: {sighing}Was hard enough to convince Keene to come up here in the first place, and you gave him an excuse to leave. Better than killing him, I guess.
translation: {sighing}当初说服基恩来这里已经费了好大一番功夫，你倒好，直接给了他离开的理由。不过让他走，总比杀了他好。

original: Always a chance I could get him to come back. Not counting on it. {glum}Hope the town doesn't take the blame for whatever trouble he gets into.
translation: 只要他还活着，就有机会让他回心转意。但我也不抱什么期待了。{glum}只希望他以后做的孽不会算到我们镇子头上。

original: {Nods, respectful}I like how you handled Keene. Without the Nightkin around, Jacobstown would be much weaker than it is.
translation: {Nods,respectful}我喜欢你处理基恩的方式。要是没有了夜行族，雅各布斯镇的的防卫力量将会大打折扣。

original: Something on your mind?
translation: 有什么心事吗？

original: Huh. I'd heard there were new people in town, but I thought it was more Super Mutants. Nice to meet you - I'm Calamity.
translation: 哼。听说镇上来了新人，我还以为又是超级变种人呢。幸会——我是阿难。

original: {Marcus dead}Losing Marcus is bad news for Jacobstown. I doubt the mutants will stick around for long.
translation: {Marcus dead}失去马可世对雅各布斯镇是个坏消息。我怀疑变种人不会再长期留在这里了。

original: With Doctor Henry off to rejoin his Enclave friends, he's left it up to me to carry on with the research here.
translation: 亨利医生回他的英克雷朋友那去了，这里的研究由我接手。

original: Hey, there.
translation: 嘿，你好。

original: So, the Reds finally hit us, just like I always said they would. Vegas is still there as far as I know, but that probably won't last long.
translation: 赤匪终究还是对我们动手了，我早就说过他们会这么干。据我所知，虽然维加斯还在，但恐怕也坚持不了多久。

original: Didn't get accepted into one of the Vaults, so I did the next best thing and had this place built. Got massive debts, but who cares now? Ha!
translation: 我没搞到避难所的准入资格，所以只好退而求其次建了这个地方。我因此欠了一屁股债，可现在谁还在乎呢？哈！

original: It's every man for himself now. {menace - he murdered a kid}Had to take care of the Paulson boy since he knew about this place - these supplies are for me and nobody else.
translation: 现在是人人自危了。{menace-he murdered a kid}谁让保尔森家那孩子知道了这地方，我只能做了他——所有东西都是我的，可没有旁人的份。

original: There's a woman and her daughter up in one of the rooms at the Lodge. Might go pay 'em a visit tomorrow. A man's got needs.
translation: 上面旅社房间里住着一对母女。或许明天我该去拜访她们一下。男人也是有需求的嘛。

original: Another human. One was enough.
translation: 又一个人类。一个就够多的了。

original: {Marcus dead}I always told Marcus we could never get along with humans. I'm right, and he's dead.
translation: {Marcusdead}我一直都跟马可世说，我们不可能跟人类和平相处。我说对了，他死了。

original: Bother someone else. I don't want anything to do with you.
translation: 去烦别人吧。我不想和你扯上关系。

original: {Marcus dead}Huh. With the big guy dead, I guess we're done here. You've made my employers very happy.
translation: {Marcusdead}哼。那个大块头死了，咱们的任务完成了。我的雇主肯定会对你很满意的。

original: Our business is with the muties, not you.
translation: 我们是来找变种人的，不关你的事。

original: {player not on quest}Our business is with the muties, not you.
translation: {player not on quest}我们是来找变种人的，不关你的事。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: We got nothing left to talk about.
translation: 我们没什么好谈的。

original: {Small Fry}Looks like you've hit a lucky streak there. You must be thirsty by now - here, have a drink on the house and keep on playing!
translation: {Small Fry}看来你真是好运连连啊。你现在一定渴了——给，免费畅饮！继续玩吧！

original: {Big Winner}Baby, Lady Luck must be smiling at you today! Compliments of the Tops Casino, enjoy this fine meal and please, keep playing those games!
translation: {Big Winner}宝贝，今天幸运女神真是对你抛媚眼了！九重天赌场向你致意，好好享用这顿佳肴，然后继续享受游戏吧！

original: {Whale}You've been good to us, baby - now let us be good to you. We'd like you to enjoy this private suite as long as you're in town.
translation: {Whale}你对我们太好了，宝贝——让我们来报答你吧：在你离开这个镇子之前，随时都可以享用这个私人套间。

original: {Banned}Okay, pal, you've had enough. Time for you to leave.
translation: {Banned}好了，伙计，你也赢够了。该收手走人了。

original: I've told you Powder Gangers everything I know! Please don't hit me anymore!
translation: 我已经把我知道的都告诉你们炸药帮了！求你不要再打我了！

original: Well look at that! You aren't a Powder Ganger after all. I'd suggest against wearing that outfit around the townsfolk. You may get shot by accident.
translation: 嗨呀，瞧啊！原来你不是炸药帮的人。我建议你平时在镇上还是不要穿着这身衣服了，你可能会莫名挨枪子的。

original: I don't suppose you came here to rescue me?
translation: 我想你不是来这儿救我的吧？

original: I don't suppose you came here to rescue me? I'd cross my fingers but my hands are numb.
translation: 我想你来这不是来救我的吧？我很想祈祷，可我的手已经不听使唤了。

original: It would be so very delightful if you set me free.
translation: 如果你能放了我的话就再好不过了。

original: Please excuse me - I'm {exter-cating}extricating myself at the moment...
translation: 请原谅——我正在{exter-cating}努力脱身呢……

original: Apologies, but I'm quite busy until I reach safety!
translation: 抱歉，没空，先让我跑到安全的地方再说！

original: Well! That was quite an adventure. We taught those convicts a thing or two, didn't we?
translation: 嗨呀！可真刺激。我们也算是给那帮恶棍一点颜色瞧瞧了，对吧？

original: Breaking myself out of a hostage situation - not to diminish your role in it, of course - but it was quite thrilling.
translation: 瞧，我自己一人就逃出来了——当然，你的作用也不可否认啦，想想还真是惊心动魄啊。

original: Problem is, there's still no law in Primm. What're we to do the next time ruffians menace us and hold us hostage?
translation: 问题是，普瑞姆依旧是个无法无天的地方，下次那些暴徒再威胁我们，把我们绑架了该怎么办？

original: Well! That was quite a per-dicament you rescued me from, there in the Bison Steve. A most unpleasant experience.
translation: 哎哟！还好你把我从野牛史蒂夫那破地方捞出来。这段经历可真够不愉快的。

original: Going in alone to rescue a hostage! My brother-in-law was brave like that. Made a fine sheriff. Until the Powder Gangers killed him.
translation: 单枪匹马杀进去救人，我姐夫活着的时候就这么勇敢。他是个称职的好警长，可惜最后却死在了炸药帮的手上。

original: Problem is, there's still no law in Primm. What're we to do the next time ruffians menace us and hold us hostage?
translation: 问题是，普瑞姆依旧是个无法无天的地方，下次那些暴徒再威胁我们，把我们绑架了该怎么办？

original: Well, if it isn't the "lawbringer."
translation: 哎呀，这不是我们的那位"法律使者"嘛。

original: Hello again. I don't suppose you've decided to help Primm find its next sheriff?
translation: 你好啊。你还没有决定为普瑞姆寻找下任警长吧？

original: Any luck finding a suitable candidate for our next sheriff?
translation: 找到我们下任警长的人选了吗？

original: Oh, it's you.
translation: 噢，是你。

original: {sighs}I suppose I should be thanking you for restoring the rule of law to Primm...
translation: {sighs}我想我应该要感谢你恢复了普瑞姆的秩序……

original: I don't plan to come back to the Bison Steve much in the years to come. If I ever get out of it.
translation: 如果我真能逃出去的话，今后几年我恐怕都不会再想来野牛史蒂夫了。

original: I do hope this ordeal will be over soon.
translation: 我真希望这场折磨能快点结束。

original: If we were to miss a convict or two in here, who'd know the difference?
translation: 如果我们放走了一两个罪犯，谁又会知道呢？

original: I'm Lieutenant Hayes of the New California Republic Army, 5th Battalion, 1st Company. What's your business?
translation: 我是新加州共和国军队的中尉海耶斯，隶属于一连五营。你有什么事？

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Primm is secure against outside threats. Be interesting to see how long the natives stay grateful.
translation: 普瑞姆总算能免受外来的威胁了。不知道当地人能感恩多久。

original: I'm Sergeant McGee of the New California Republic Army, 5th Battalion, 1st Company. If you want to talk about something, speak to Lieutenant Hayes.
translation: 我是新加州共和国军队的中士麦基，隶属于一连五营。如果你有话要说，去找中尉海耶斯吧。

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: Move along, waster. Got a town to run here.
translation: 该干啥干啥去，废土游民。我还要管理这个镇子呢。

original: {in combat}<bark! bark!>
translation: {in combat}<汪！汪！>

original: {player has a hat equipped}<growl...>
translation: {player has a hat equipped}<嗷呜……>

original: {in Mojave, player has Wild Wasteland}<aroo!>
translation: {in Mojave, player has Wild Wasteland}<啊呜!>

original: {Rex not cured}<whimper>
translation: {Rex not cured}<悲鸣>

original: {Rex cured, initial}<happy bark!>
translation: {Rex cured, initial}<快乐地吠叫!>

original: {Rex cured, return}<pant pant pant>
translation: {Rex cured, return}<啪嗒啪嗒啪嗒>

original: Leave me alone.
translation: 离我远点。

original: Hey, you got a second?
translation: 嘿，你有空吗？

original: I'd slap him around, but he stood at my parents' wedding.
translation: 我真想赏他两巴掌，可他是我父母的证婚人。

original: Plus he used to make excuses to get me out of my punishment when I'd slept through Head Scribe Taggart's lectures. Figure I owe him for that.
translation: 另外，以前我老在首席学士塔格特的课上打瞌睡，他也帮我打了不少掩护。估计我欠他人情。

original: <Sighs> He means well.
translation: <叹气>他也是出于好心。

original: I'd be angrier with him, but it's hard to stay mad at the guy who taught me how to box when all the other Paladins told me no.
translation: 我本该对他火冒三丈的，可是当其他圣骑士都拒绝我的时候，是他教会了我拳术，这让我很难对他发火。

original: <Sighs> He always does what he feels is right. Usually that's a great quality.
translation: <叹气>只要是他认为正确的事，他就一定会坚持。通常情况下这是个好品质。

original: Let's see what we've got here... Okay, yeah, this is the one I was thinking of. The pulse gun.
translation: 看看里面都有什么……好，真棒，我一直想要这个。脉冲枪。

original: Although maybe the rangefinder could work too. And it looks like the NCR was onto some miracle farming technology.
translation: 可能测距仪也还能用。而且，NCR似乎也对那些近乎奇迹的农业技术感兴趣。

original: {Defeated}He wouldn't listen. The truth was right there staring him in the face. How could he not listen?
translation: {Defeated}他就是不听。事实都摆在他面前了。他怎么就是不听呢？

original: {Disbelieving}God. {Then, saddened}I should get used to this, I guess. People get desperate, they turn on each other. First thing to go is trust.
translation: {Disbelieving}天啊。{Then, saddened}看来我得接受这个事实。人们在绝望的时候就会相互猜疑。最先消失的就是信任。

original: I don't think it's ever gonna be the same for me in there. Knowing no matter what I do, it's gonna end badly.
translation: 看来他们不会再像以前一样对我了。不管我怎么做，都只会带来不好的结果。

original: But they're all I have.
translation: 可我只剩下他们了啊。

original: {Remorseful}God, I did this. This was my fault. Why didn't I see this coming?
translation: {Remorseful}天啊，这怪我，都是我的错。为什么我没预料到会是这样的结果？

original: Of course they'd track me. Of course they'd assume the worst. Sure, I left them. But that didn't mean I'd ever be free of them.
translation: 他们肯定会跟踪我。他们肯定会做最恶意的揣测。是，我离开了他们。但并不意味着我从此就摆脱了他们。

original: I should've known I was beaten before I began. I just... I had to try, you know?
translation: 我早该知道，我还没开始就已经注定了要失败。可我……总得试试啊，你懂吗？

original: Well, if there was any question whether I should leave, I guess there's my answer.
translation: 如果对于我是否应该离开还有什么疑问，我想这就是我的答案。

original: {Horrified}Why did you do that? They were going to let us walk away. Why did you attack them?
translation: {Horrified}你为什么要那样做？他们都要放我们走了。你为什么要攻击他们？

original: I don't care that they started it. What you did was inexcusable. You need to go.
translation: 不管是谁先动的手，你做的事都是无法原谅的。你走吧。

original: Clearly you're determined to fight the Brotherhood. Well, you can add my name to your hit list because you're on your own.
translation: 显然你是决定和兄弟会为敌了。很好，把我的名字也加进你的黑名单里吧，从今往后你就自己干。

original: Okay, listen. The Brotherhood... they're not always the friendliest bunch. But I won't stand for you fighting them.
translation: 好吧，听着。兄弟会……他们有时候确实不近人情。但我是不会和你一起与他们为敌的。

original: This is your last chance.
translation: 这是给你的最后通牒。

original: See? Pretty addictive, right? You do it once, it just makes you want to do it more.
translation: 看吧？相当过瘾，对吧？你只要做过第一次就会想做第二次。

original: You can't help but notice that the Brotherhood barely exists to these people out here. We're like an urban myth. No real presence on the Outside.
translation: 你肯定察觉到了，兄弟会对这里的人来说几乎是不存在的。我们像都市传说一样。外界根本察觉不到我们的存在。

original: We just don't adapt like we should. Used to be that all you needed to get your way was a suit of power armor and a laser rifle.
translation: 我们本该与时俱进的，但我们没有。我们习惯了穿着动力装甲，拿着激光步枪，以为这样就能摆平一切。

original: Now... people are armed and organized. They're not afraid. But we still stick to our old approach, because it's all we know.
translation: 可如今……人人都有枪有组织。他们已经不再害怕了。可我们还在用老办法解决问题，因为我们作茧自缚太久了。

original: You know, I've been thinking. The real problem with the Brotherhood is that we isolate ourselves.
translation: 我也想过这个问题。兄弟会真正的症结在于我们完全孤立了自己。

original: Our training is top-notch, our technology gives us an advantage, but when it all comes down to it, we're losing because we shun the outside world.
translation: 我们的训练水平出类拔萃，我们的科技也遥遥领先，但到最后，我们却把整个世界拒之门外，从而输掉了这场竞赛。

original: We always make enemies, never allies. We refuse to recruit outsiders, or see the value in their simpler technologies.
translation: 我们一直在树敌，却从没结交盟友。我们不肯从外界吸收新鲜血液，也不肯审视外人那看似简单的科技背后所蕴藏的巨大价值。

original: Hold on. I see something I want to punch.
translation: 别动。我看见了让我手痒的东西。

original: No offense, but you look like you've traveled a long way down some bad roads. Where'd you come from?
translation: 我无意冒犯，但看来你这一路的旅途都不顺利啊。你从哪来？

original: Couldn't get enough of talking to me the first time, huh?
translation: 第一次觉得和我有聊不完的话题，嗯？

original: Listen... I want to thank you for helping me out. I'm sorry that... things didn't go like I'd hoped.
translation: 听着……我很感谢你的帮助。很遗憾……事情没有像我期望的那样发展。

original: But at least I got the chance to try. At least I know for sure that there was nothing I could do.
translation: 但至少我尽力了。至少我现在肯定了一点：我做什么都是白费力气。

original: Thank you for giving me that chance.
translation: 谢谢你给了我那样的机会。

original: Wow, Mr. House is looking for you, huh? What do you think he wants? Bowling partner?
translation: 哇，豪斯先生在找你啊？你猜他会找你干什么？一起去打保龄球？

original: What'd you think of Mr. House? I was surprised he only had the two robot sex slaves.
translation: 你对豪斯先生怎么看？我倒是很吃惊，他居然只有两个机器性奴。

original: That chip of yours... I wouldn't wager it on blackjack.
translation: 你的那块筹码……反正我不会拿它去玩21点。

original: Unless the dealer has a five or six showing.
translation: 除非庄家露了一张5或6。

original: Whole future of New Vegas seems like it's up in the air. Guess I should wait things out before buying a condo in the Ultra-Luxe, huh?
translation: 整个新维加斯的前景都不明朗。我想，还是别急着在奢华殿堂买房，你说呢？

original: Hope you're picking the winning side here. Be nice to fight for someone who's gonna be around for a while.
translation: 希望你能选对边。跟撑得久的人站一块儿肯定没错。

original: Next stop, Hoover Dam, huh? When we get there... can we stop by the souvenir shop? Their beaver mascot is just precious.
translation: 下一站，胡佛水坝？到那以后……我们能去纪念品专卖店吗？他们的海狸吉祥物只有那里才有卖。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Sharing knowledge with an outsider organization. I knew Veronica couldn't be trusted.
translation: 她居然和外面的组织分享知识。我就知道维罗尼卡靠不住。

original: We tracked your movements a long way. But it was worth it to catch her in the act.
translation: 我们确实追踪了你们好长一段路。但能抓到她现行也算是值了。

original: Passing Brotherhood secrets to outsiders is the lowest form of treason. What have you got to say for yourself?
translation: 把兄弟会的秘密说给外人听，这是最卑劣的叛变。你现在还有什么要为自己辩护的？

original: We heard Veronica talking with the Elder. We won't stand for this.
translation: 听说维罗妮卡去和长老谈话了。我们可不能容忍这种事。

original: What is this? Veronica brings an outsider into our home, then has a private audience with the Elder?
translation: 这算是怎么回事？维罗妮卡带了个外人回来，还跟长老进行秘密会谈？

original: The two of you may have the Elder fooled, but we know better.
translation: 你们两个或许可以蒙蔽长老，但骗不了我们。

original: Veronica has always twisted the Founder's principles to her own ends. We will not stand idly by and allow her to corrupt our Elder's thinking.
translation: 维罗妮卡的做法已经完全违背了兄弟会创立时的宗旨。我们不可能坐视不理，让她三番五次地蒙蔽长老。

original: This had better be good. You have a lot to answer for.
translation: 你最好有要紧事。等着你给说法的事情多了。

original: What can the Followers of the Apocalypse do for you today?
translation: 不知天启追随者有什么能帮到你的？

original: What do you need tested?
translation: 你需要测试什么？

original: {Black Mountain End States}What happened at Black Mountain?
translation: {Black Mountain End States}黑山出什么事了？

original: {Raul End States}What happened to Raul?
translation: {Raul End States}劳尔出什么事了？

original: {Boomer End States}What happened with the Boomers?
translation: {Boomer End States}大炮族出什么事了？

original: {Brotherhood of Steel End States}What happened to the Brotherhood of Steel?
translation: {Brotherhood of Steel End States}钢铁兄弟会出什么事了？

original: {Veronica End States}What happened to Veronica?
translation: {Veronica End States}维罗尼卡出什么事了？

original: {Fiends End States}What happened to the Fiends?
translation: {Fiends End States}恶魔帮出什么事了？

original: {FoA End states}What happened to the Followers of the Apocalypse?
translation: {FoA End states}天启追随者出什么事了？

original: {Arcade End States}What happened to Arcade?
translation: {Arcade End States}阿卡德出什么事了？

original: {Goodsprings End States}What happened to Goodsprings?
translation: {Goodsprings End States}清泉镇出什么事了？

original: {Cass End States}What happened to Cass?
translation: {Cass End States}卡丝出什么事了？

original: {Great Khan End States}What happened with the Great Khans?
translation: {Great Khan End States}大汗帮出什么事了？

original: {Jacobstown End States}What happened with Jacobstown?
translation: {Jacobstown End States}雅各布斯镇出什么事了？

original: {Lily End States}What happened to Lily?
translation: {Lily End States}莉莉出什么事了？

original: {Kings End States}What happened with the Kings?
translation: {Kings End States}猫王帮出什么事了？

original: {Rex End States}What happened to Rex?
translation: {Rex End States}雷克斯出什么事了？

original: {Misfits End States}What happened to the Misfits?
translation: {Misfits End States}后进生出什么事了？

original: {Novac End States}What happened at Novac?
translation: {Novac End States}诺瓦克出什么事了？

original: {Boone End States}What happened to Boone?
translation: {Boone End States}布恩出什么事了？

original: {Vault 19 End States}What happened to the Vault 19 Powder Gang?
translation: {Vault 19 End States}19号避难所的炸药帮出什么事了？

original: {Primm End States}What happened at Primm?
translation: {Primm End States}普瑞姆出什么事了？

original: {EDE End States}What happened to ED-E?
translation: {EDE End States}ED-E出什么事了？

original: {Rangers End States}What happened with Chief Hanlon?
translation: {Rangers End States}汉隆军士长出什么事了？

original: {Remnants End States}What happened with the Enclave Remnants?
translation: {Remnants End States}英克雷残部出什么事了？

original: {NCRCF End States}What happened at the NCRF?
translation: {NCRCF End States}NCR监狱出什么事了？

original: That business at the Tops could never happen here. We don't admit that sort of riff-raff.
translation: 九重天里发生的事，在我们这里是绝不可能重演的。我们可不会什么人都放进来。

original: I know Benny was murdered, but if you ask me, the real crime was that checkered jacket.
translation: 我知道本尼遇害了，但如果你要问我他该不该死，我告诉你，他最该死的就是穿了那件西服夹克。

original: A little bird told me Benny might be gone for good. He must've been in some delightful scandal to have run off so suddenly.
translation: 有只小小鸟儿告诉我，本尼可能再也回不来了，他肯定是惹上了什么天大的丑闻，所以才走得这么匆忙。

original: {Amused}Those Omertas. Always plotting, never relevant. Bravo for putting them in their place like that.
translation: {Amused}黑手党那些人，只会耍些阴谋诡计，从来成不了大事。你把他们除掉真是大快人心。

original: {Impressed}Word has it you were spotted entering the Lucky 38. How ever did you get on that guest list?
translation: {Impressed}说是有人看见你进了幸运38。你是怎么受到邀请的？

original: Is it me or do the Securitrons seem... sassier?
translation: 是我看错了，还是那些电子保安变得更……粗鲁了？

original: Such a shame about Mr. House. He used to send a Securitron to our dinner parties sometimes, like an uninvited but harmless uncle.
translation: 豪斯先生可真是不知羞耻，有时候他会派电子保安闯进我们的晚餐会，就像一个不请自来却无伤大雅的亲戚。

original: There's a rumor going around that you killed Caesar! I'm dying to know... is it true? That he used a hairpiece, I mean?
translation: 有传言说你杀了凯撒！我非常想知道……是真的吗？我是说他戴假发这事，是真的吗？

original: Caesar may be dead, but I think the toga is here to stay. You simply can't buy better thigh accentuation.
translation: 凯撒是死了，但我想他们那种长袍风格会继续流行下去。毕竟你找不到更能突出大腿的服饰了。

original: The Kings will be missed. Not by me, of course. But who will buy the food at the Tops now that no one needs it to grease their hair?
translation: 会有人怀念猫王帮的，当然，我不会。但还有谁会再去九重天买吃的呢？毕竟没有人会将油腻食物涂在头发上当发蜡了。

original: It sounds like the Kings made nice with the NCR in Freeside. Seems there was room for two flies on the same bit of dung after all.
translation: 听说猫王帮和NCR在自由城和睦相处了。看来一山还是容得下二虎的。

original: Trying to elevate your status by being seen with me? It won't work.
translation: 你以为站在我身边就能让你上档次？没用的。

original: You look like you'd be more at home at one of the other hotels.
translation: 我想你可能是更喜欢住家里而不是住店里。

original: I'm sorry, I prefer to converse with interesting people.
translation: 对不起，我更喜欢和有趣的人交谈。

original: {Disdainful, at first}I hear you've been clawing your way up the social ladder. {then, confidentially}What's your secret?
translation: {Disdainful, at first}我听说你正在一步步混进上流社会。{then, confidentially}你有什么秘诀？

original: People are talking about you.
translation: 大家都在谈论你。

original: I like the cut of your jib.
translation: 我喜欢你的脸蛋儿。

original: Well, if it isn't the toast of New Vegas.
translation: 好吧，让我们来为新维加斯干一杯。

original: Welcome to the pinnacle of society.
translation: 欢迎加入上流社会。

original: Would you mind staying here a moment? I want people to see that I know you.
translation: 愿意多待一会儿吗？我想让大家都知道我和你认识。

original: You're an odd duck.
translation: 你真是个怪人。

original: You've been acting awfully strange towards us.
translation: 你的行为举止非常怪异。

original: What are you playing at? I'm really starting to wonder about you.
translation: 你在掩饰什么？我现在开始怀疑你了。

original: I'm having a little get-together later, but you are not invited until you learn to behave.
translation: 晚些时候我会参加一个小聚会，但除非你能守规矩，否则你不会受到邀请的。

original: How can you be such a dear and such a bother at the same time?
translation: 你怎么能这么让人又爱又恨？

original: You'll never be at the top until you learn some manners and common decency.
translation: 除非你学会上等人的礼仪和举止，否则你永远都不入流。

original: {repulsed}What's that smell? Oh, it's you.
translation: {repulsed}什么味道？哦，是你啊。

original: Please, you're lowering my status.
translation: 别这样，你拉低了我的格调。

original: Shouldn't you be in Freeside with the other thugs?
translation: 你不是应该和其他恶棍一起待在自由城吗？

original: You vile cad. I've half a mind to give you a solid thrashing with my cane.
translation: 你这肮脏的无赖，我现在已经想好怎么用我手中的手杖教训你了。

original: Remove yourself from my sight at once.
translation: 赶紧从我的视线里消失。

original: Loathsome wretch.
translation: 无耻恶徒。

original: Life at the top is immensely satisfying.
translation: 上等人的生活真是惬意。

original: It must be horrible to live in places without luxury.
translation: 生活在没有奢侈品的地方一定很可怕。

original: Being an honorary member isn't the same as being a real member, but it still makes you better than everyone else.
translation: 虽然荣誉会员离真正的会员还有很大差距，但依然能让你高人一等。

original: So you've joined the Society. It feels different, doesn't it? Like you're entitled to the best things life has to offer.
translation: 你终于加入社团了。感觉都不同了，是吧？是不是感觉你终于能有资格享受生活中最美好的东西了？

original: You mustn't ask why we wear our masks. We are forbidden to speak of it.
translation: 你绝对不要问我们为什么要戴面具。这个话题是禁忌。

original: The Lucky 38's perpetual glow these days... it's rather gauche, don't you think?
translation: 幸运38这几天好像有什么动静……不过他们确实不善于交际，你不觉得吗？

original: {Mr. House agreed to surrender Vegas to the NCR}If Mr. House is going to lower his standards, we'll just have to raise ours!
translation: {Mr. House agreed to surrender Vegas to the NCR}既然豪斯先生要降低他的标准，那我们就得提高我们的！

original: Please, ma'am - take pity on us. Free us, I'm begging you!
translation: 求你了，女士——可怜可怜我们吧。放了我们，求求你！

original: Please, sir - take pity on us. Free us, please!
translation: 求你了，先生——可怜可怜我们吧。放了我们，求求你！

original: When will we be free?
translation: 我们什么时候才能获得自由？

original: I can't ever thank you enough for saving me and mine! We're free now!
translation: 您救了我和我的家人，我真不知该如何表达感激之情！我们现在自由了！

original: You're a killer. Go away.
translation: 你这个凶手。走开。

original: We're being held here against our will! I beg you, help us!
translation: 我们是被人关到这里的！求你了，帮帮我们！

original: Are you going to free us, or what?
translation: 你是准备放了我们吗？

original: Thank you. We never would've escaped without your help.
translation: 谢谢你。要是没有你，我们肯定逃不出去。

original: At least I'm free to bury my kin.
translation: 至少我还有埋葬家人的自由。

original: {despair}You killed my kin. Why is this happening to me?
translation: {despair}你杀了我的亲人。我是造了什么孽啊？

original: {miserable}Oh, it's just awful here. Can't you help us?
translation: {miserable}喔，这地方太糟糕了。你就不能帮帮我们吗？

original: {desperate}You're still gonna free us, aren't you?
translation: {desperate}你还是会放我们出去的，对吧？

original: Thank you so much for freeing me!
translation: 非常感谢你放了我！

original: You looking for a pat on the back? My mother is dead.
translation: 你还想让我怎么感激你？我妈都死了。

original: {you don't like being eclipsed, KAI-zar}Caesar may have deemed you worthy to bear his mark, but your reputation preceeds you.
translation: {you don't like being eclipsed, KAI-zar}或许凯撒认为你配得上他的徽记，但你的坏名声早就人尽皆知了。

original: Your presence will be tolerated, but you are not welcome here. Lucullus awaits you on the docks.
translation: 我们可以容忍你在这里走动，但这不代表我们欢迎你。卢库勒斯正在码头上等你。

original: {Angry, do NOT}Do not make {KAI-zar}Caesar wait! Lucullus awaits you on the dock.
translation: {Angry,doNOT}别让{KAI-zar}凯撒等你！卢库勒斯正在码头上等你。

original: {you don't like being eclipsed}A Profligate bearing the Mark of {KAI-zar}Caesar? What is the world coming to?
translation: {youdon'tlikebeingeclipsed}一个荒淫之人居然戴着{KAI-zar}凯撒的徽记？这个世界怎么了？

original: Cursor {Luh-CUL-us}Lucullus is waiting for you with the barge at the docks. He will take you to The Fort to speak with {KAI-zar}Caesar.
translation: 库瑟·{Luh-CUL-us}卢库勒斯正在码头边的驳船上等你。他会带你去城堡觐见{KAI-zar}凯撒。

original: {Annoyed}Get moving, Profligate! Do not make {KAI-zar}Caesar wait!
translation: {Annoyed}快走，荒淫之人！别让{KAI-zar}凯撒等你！

original: {surly}Don't try my patience. A nod of my chin, and you'll be decorating a cross.
translation: {surly}别考验我的耐心。只要我一点头，你就会被钉上十字架。

original: {pleased}You taught {Seh-VER-us}Severus well! Soon I'll wear a necklace of Profligates' toes, blown off by their own mines!{ha!}
translation: {pleased}你教了{Seh-VER-us}西弗勒斯不少东西！很快我就能戴上用荒淫之人脚趾头串成的项链了，都是他们自己的地雷炸下来的！{ha!}

original: {surly}Don't try my patience. A nod of my chin, and you'll be decorating a cross.
translation: {surly}别考验我的耐心。只要我一点头，你就会被钉上十字架。

original: {blunt}Yes? Name your concern.
translation: {blunt}嗯？说明来意。

original: {Shocked}I warned them about that truck weeks ago. Always be prepared for any hazardous radiation I said.
translation: {Shocked}我几个星期前就警告过他们货车的事。我当时就说了要做好受到超量辐射的准备。

original: {Saddened sigh}Those headstrong fools should have listened...
translation: {Saddenedsigh}那些死脑筋的笨蛋为什么就是不肯听我的……

original: {Tired}Are you ready to head upriver?
translation: {Tired}你准备好朝上游进发了吗？

original: {AH-way}Ave. Are you ready to head upriver?
translation: {AH-way}致敬。你准备好朝上游进发了吗？

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar awaits you in his tent. You have license to find your own way.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒在他的帐篷等你。你有许可，可以自己过去。

original: I'll wait here, to ferry you back to the western shore when your visit has concluded.
translation: 我在这等你，等觐见结束后我再把你载回去。

original: {AH-way}Ave. Are you ready to travel to the Fort?
translation: {AH-way}致敬。你准备好前往城堡了吗？

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar has permitted you to leave, but not with the Platinum Chip in your possession. Relinquish it and you may go.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒允许你离开，但白金筹码要留下。把它交出来你才能走。

original: {AH-way}Ave. Are you ready to return to Cottonwood Cove?
translation: {AH-way}致敬。你准备好返回棉白杨湾了吗？

original: {Player has Platinum chip}By order of Caesar, all visitors must disarm and relinquish all banned items. This order also extends to the Platinum Chip you carry - for now.
translation: {Player has Platinum chip}奉凯撒之令，所有来访者必须解除武装并上缴违禁品。这道命令同样适用于你携带的白金筹码——马上交出来。

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar has permitted you to leave, but not with the Platinum Chip in your possession. Relinquish it and you may go.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒允许你离开，但白金筹码要留下。把它交出来你才能走。

original: By order of Caesar, all visitors must disarm and relinquish all banned items.
translation: 奉凯撒之令，所有来访者必须解除武装并上缴违禁品。

original: You may proceed. Your belongings will be returned when you leave.
translation: 你可以继续前进了。所有物品都将在你离开时归还。

original: Halt! What business have you in Cottonwood Cove, outsider?
translation: 站住！你到棉白杨湾来干什么，外来者？

original: {Annoyed}You're the one {Luh-CUL-us}Lucullus said would come? {Blunt}You'll find him waiting for you, down at the docks.
translation: {Annoyed}你就是{Luh-CUL-us}卢库勒斯说的那个人？{Blunt}你去下面码头就能找到他，他在等你。

original: {Angered}What are you doing standing around, whelp? {KAI-zar)Caesar awaits!
translation: {Angered}你还在这瞎转悠什么，小崽子？{KAI-zar)凯撒正等着你呢！

original: You're the one {Luh-CUL-us}Lucullus said would come. You'll find him waiting for you, down at the docks.
translation: 你就是{Luh-CUL-us}卢库勒斯说的那个人吧。你去下面码头就能找到他，他在等你。

original: {menacing}Scum such as you does not belong here. {cold}Leave, or be added to the dead.
translation: {menacing}你这样的废物不属于这里。{cold}走开，否则就去死吧。

original: {menacing}Trade with Canyon Runner if you like. Make trouble and things won't go well for you.
translation: {menacing}如果你想卖东西，可以去找峡谷行者。如果你想惹麻烦，可没你好果子吃。

original: {satisfied}You did well to give Centurion Aurelius the Profligates' listening machine. We'll butcher the troops they send to ambush our patrols.
translation: {satisfied}你把荒淫之人的窃听器交给了百夫长奥勒留，干得漂亮。这下他们派去埋伏我们巡逻队的部队要被屠个干净了。

original: {AH-way}Ave. Name your business.
translation: {AH-way}致敬。说明来意。

original: I see you bear the Mark of {KAI-zar}Caesar! Cursor {Luh-CUL-us}Lucullus awaits you at the docks!
translation: 我看到你戴着凯撒的徽记{KAI-zar}！{Luh-CUL-us}库瑟·卢库勒斯在码头等你！

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar does not like to be kept waiting. I would find Cursor {Luh-CUL-us}Lucullus quickly and travel to The Fort, if I were you.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒不喜欢等人。如果我是你，我会马上去找{Luh-CUL-us}库瑟·卢库勒斯，让他带我前往城堡。

original: He should still be waiting at the docks.
translation: 他应该还在码头等着。

original: {LATIN}{AH-way}Ave. Have you come to sell or trade for captures?
translation: {LATIN}{AH-way}致敬。你是来买卖俘虏的吗？

original: {AH-way}Ave. How goes it?
translation: {AH-way}致敬。什么事？

original: Welcome to The Tops. How can I help you?
translation: 欢迎光临九重天。有什么需要我效劳的吗？

original: Humbly at your service.
translation: 随时愿为您服务。

original: Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler. Looking to exchange?
translation: 欢迎来到原子牛仔。要换筹码吗？

original: Welcome to Gomorrah, how can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到蛾摩拉，有什么能帮你的吗？

original: Welcome to Vikki and Vance. Can I help you with an exchange?
translation: 欢迎来到维姬和万斯。需要我帮你换些筹码吗？

original: You've done a good turn for the NCR and now we'd like to do one for you - here's an NCR emergency two-way radio - you call and we'll come running.
translation: 你为NCR做了很大的贡献，现在我们打算还你这个人情——这是NCR的紧急双向无线电，你用它一呼叫，我们就会赶过来。

original: You're not alone out here - the NCR has your back. Stay safe and good hunting.
translation: 你在外面并不孤单，NCR是你的坚强后盾。注意安全，狩猎愉快。

original: The NCR takes care of its own - so in thanks for your service to the Republic{pause while handing over a radio}... here's one of our emergency two-way radios.
translation: NCR是不会忘记自己人的——为了感谢你对共和国所做出的贡献{pause while handing over a radio}……我将赠送你一部紧急双向无线电。

original: You call and we'll come running. {pause}If you're too far from an NCR outpost there won't be much we can do for you...
translation: 只要你呼叫，我们就会赶来。{pause}但如果你离NCR哨站太远的话，恐怕我们也无能为力……

original: but then the NCR is just about everywhere these days. Good luck and stay safe out there.
translation: 不过现如今NCR已经遍布五湖四海了。祝你好运，在外多保重。

original: For your service, beyond the call of duty, the NCR would like to award you with this emergency two-way radio.
translation: 鉴于你超出职责外的卓越贡献，NCR很荣幸地奖励你这个紧急双向无线电。

original: You call and we'll send you any support we can spare. Keep up the good work, soldier.
translation: 只要你呼叫，我们就会立刻派出援兵。再接再厉吧，士兵。

original: The NCR would like to thank you for your service. If you ever need us, just call and we'll come running.
translation: NCR感谢你所做的贡献。如果你需要我们，就呼叫我们，随叫随到。

original: The NCR takes care of its own... and its supporters. Stay safe out there and call us if you get in a jam.
translation: NCR不仅善待自己……也善待它的支持者。在外多保重，遇到麻烦的话，随时呼叫我们。

original: {Radio transmission}Coordinates for supply cache in your region being sent... now.
translation: {Radio transmission}正在发送你所处区域的补给箱坐标……

original: {Radio transmission}Received - updating map marker for local NCR supply cache.
translation: {Radio transmission}收到——更新当地NCR补给箱的地图坐标信息。

original: {Radio transmission}This is NCR Operator - message received - sending map marker for local supply cache.
translation: {Radio transmission}这里是NCR接线员——已收到请求——正在发送该地区NCR补给箱的坐标。

original: {Radio transmission}This is NCR Operator - I read you. The supplies are on their way.
translation: {Radio transmission}这里是NCR接线员——已收到讯息。补给马上到位。

original: {Radio transmission}Message received - supplies en route.
translation: {Radio transmission}信息收到——补给正在途中。

original: {Radio transmission}Supply crate airdrop heading to your location.
translation: {Radio transmission}补给箱正在空投至你的位置。

original: {Radio transmission}NCR Trooper support en route to your location.
translation: {Radio transmission}NCR援军正在赶往你所在位置。

original: {Radio transmission}NCR support moving to your location.
translation: {Radio transmission}NCR支援正在前往你的位置。

original: {Radio transmission}Request received - NCR Troopers in your area are being redirected to your location.
translation: {Radio transmission}收到请求——本地区的NCR士兵正向你所在的地点集结。

original: {Radio transmission}NCR Ranger support en route to your location.
translation: {Radio transmission}NCR游骑兵支援正在前往你所在位置。

original: {Radio transmission}The cavalry is on its way - just sit tight, we'll be there.
translation: {Radio transmission}援军已经出发——稍等，我们马上就到。

original: {Radio transmission}Support inbound - deploying NCR Rangers to your location.
translation: {Radio transmission}支援已派出——正在向你所在位置派遣NCR游骑兵。

original: {Radio transmission}Your wish is my command - NCR support is on its way.
translation: {Radio transmission}已接到请求，NCR增援将立刻抵达。

original: {Radio transmission}Your problems will soon be solved - Rangers heading your way now.
translation: {Radio transmission}马上为您解决问题——游骑兵已经出发。

original: {Radio transmission}There is no NCR support in your area - suggest a tactical retreat.
translation: {Radio transmission}你所在区域附近没有可用的NCR增援——建议战术撤退。

original: {Radio transmission}Negative, no NCR support available at your current location.
translation: {Radio transmission}无法执行，你所在区域附近没有NCR支援。

original: {Radio transmission}Transmission not received - attempt new transmission closer to an NCR outpost.
translation: {Radio transmission}信息未收到——请靠近NCR前哨站后再发送。

original: {Radio transmission}Sorry, sir, that's all the support I can spare today.
translation: {Radio transmission}对不起，长官，今天我只能送出这么多补给。

original: {Radio transmission}I can't redirect any more support to you today - it would put too many lives at risk. I'll get you what I can tomorrow.
translation: {Radio transmission}我今天没法再向你提供补给了——这样太过于冒险。明天我会尽力帮你。

original: {Radio transmission}I can't afford to send you anything else today. Sorry, sir... good luck out there.
translation: {Radio transmission}我今天没法再向您运输任何东西。对不起，长官……祝你好运。

original: {Radio transmission}You're just going to have to cowboy up, sir - I can't spare any more support today.
translation: {Radio transmission}恐怕你只能自己硬撑了，长官——今天我已经无法送出更多补给了。

original: {Radio transmission}I sent you all I had last time, sir - you're on your own until at least midnight.
translation: {Radio transmission}我已经把能给你的都派过去了，长官——午夜前你得靠自己了。

original: {Radio transmission}I sent you all I had last time, sir - you're on your own until we get resupplied tomorrow.
translation: {Radio transmission}我已经把能给你的都派过去了，长官——明天之前你只能靠自己了。

original: {Radio transmission}Support request received - deploying Troopers to your area. Hold tight, help is on the way.
translation: {Radio transmission}支援请求已收到——正在派遣士兵前往指定区域。 坚持住，增援马上就到。

original: {Radio transmission}Received - find some cover, NCR support is on the way.
translation: {Radio transmission}收到——立刻寻找掩护， NCR的增援马上就到。

original: {Radio transmission}I sent you all I had last time, sir - you're on your own until dawn at least.
translation: {Radio transmission}我已经把能给你的都派过去了长——黎明前你得靠你自己了。

original: {Radio transmission}Stay safe out there.
translation: {Radio transmission}在外面要小心。

original: {Radio transmission}Good hunting, sir.
translation: {Radio transmission}狩猎愉快，长官。

original: {Radio transmission}Over.
translation: {Radio transmission}完毕。

original: {Radio transmission}Over-and-out.
translation: {Radio transmission}完毕，通话结束。

original: {Radio transmission}Good luck out there.
translation: {Radio transmission}祝你好运。

original: NCR Trooper, reporting for duty!
translation: NCR士兵，向您报道！

original: Trooper, ready to fight!
translation: 士兵，准备战斗！

original: You called for a Trooper?
translation: 是你呼叫士兵支援的？

original: You called for an extra gun?
translation: 是你呼叫额外人手的？

original: I got your call and came running.
translation: 我收到你的呼叫就赶来了。

original: Guns and gear - at your service.
translation: 整装待发，为您效劳。

original: Someone said you needed backup? I'm it.
translation: 听说你需要增援？我就是增援。

original: You called for backup?
translation: 你呼叫了增援？

original: Where's the fight, sir?
translation: 敌人在哪儿，长官？

original: For the Republic!
translation: 为了共和国！

original: Ranger at the ready!
translation: 游骑兵准备就绪！

original: NCR Ranger, reporting for duty!
translation: NCR游骑兵，向您报道！

original: Here we are, you just point and we'll shoot.
translation: 我们来了，全听您指挥。

original: Here I am, just point at what needs killing.
translation: 我来了，你只要告诉目标在哪儿就行。

original: One riot, one ranger... let's get this done.
translation: 哪里有骚乱，哪里就有游骑兵……动身吧。

original: Heard you were in a spot of trouble, friend. Let's fix that.
translation: 我听说你遇到了麻烦，朋友。让我们来搞定它。

original: I heard your call and happened to be in the area.
translation: 收到你呼叫的时候我碰巧就在附近，所以我就赶来了。

original: For the Republic!
translation: 为了共和国！

original: You called for an extra gun?
translation: 是你呼叫援军？

original: You're lucky I happened to be nearby.
translation: 你真幸运，我恰好就在附近。

original: I got your flank - you just shoot what's in front of you!
translation: 我来掩护你的侧翼——你只管射击前方的目标！

original: Ranger here - where's the fight?
translation: 游骑兵就位，敌人在哪儿？

original: Hold up! There are Deathclaws all over the damn place north of here. I'd turn back if I were you.
translation: 站住！这鬼地方的北边全是死亡爪，我要是你的话就马上调头。

original: If you want to get to New Vegas, you're better off heading east from Primm and then looping north. It's a heck of a lot safer.
translation: 如果你想去新维加斯，最好先往东到普瑞姆，再从那里向北走。这样虽然绕路，但安全些。

original: Can't believe anyone actually made it through from the north, what with all the Deathclaws at the quarry. You returning from New Vegas?
translation: 真不敢相信居然有人能从北边穿过来，采石场里可全是死亡爪。你是从新维加斯来的吗？

original: You need something?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Let me ask you a question - what's the tastiest thing you've ever eaten?
translation: 让我问你个问题——你吃过最好吃的东西是什么？

original: This is incredibly good. Here's your omelet, and the recipe if you ever want to make your own. It takes a bit of skill to get it tasting right.
translation: 真是妙不可言。这是你的煎蛋卷，还有菜谱，这样你就可以自己做了。不过想要把这蛋卷做得好吃是需要技术的。

original: Hey there. What's new?
translation: 你好。怎么了？

original: That's close enough. What do you want with the Great Khans?
translation: 别再往前走了。你找大汗帮有什么事？

original: Nice outfit, but I know you're not one of us. What do you want with the Great Khans?
translation: 行头不错，但我知道你不是我们的人。你找大汗帮有什么事？

original: {somewhat hostile, untrusting}What do you want now?
translation: {somewhat hostile, untrusting}你还想干什么？

original: {respectful, almost friendly}How's it going?
translation: {respectful, almost friendly}一切都顺利吗？

original: Hey, hey. What can Tyrone do for you?
translation: 嘿，嘿。来找泰隆是有什么事啊？

original: I had an amazing time with you. You can look me up any time, baby.
translation: 和你在一起的感觉真妙。你随时都可以来找我，宝贝。

original: Hey, hey. You're back.
translation: 嘿，嘿。你回来了。

original: <whuff>
translation: <喘气>

original: <snuffle!>
translation: <鼻音!>

original: Hey hey, fella, welcome to the Tops Hotel and Casino! I'm going to have to ask you to hand over any weapons you might be carrying.
translation: 嘿，嘿，老兄，欢迎来到九重天赌场酒店！如果你身上有带武器，请马上交出来。

original: Hey hey, baby doll, welcome to the Tops Hotel and Casino! I'm going to have to ask you to hand over any weapons you might be carrying.
translation: 嘿，嘿，小可爱，欢迎来到九重天赌场酒店！如果你身上有带武器，请马上交出来。

original: Welcome back to the Tops. Anything I can do for you?
translation: 欢迎回到九重天。有什么我可以帮你的？

original: Enjoying your stay?
translation: 过的愉快吗？

original: Get you a drink?
translation: 想喝点什么？

original: Like I said, I needed to go do something. This is it. It belonged to my father.
translation: 我说过，我得做点什么。这就是了。这装甲是我父亲的。

original: Since you convinced me to help out with the defense of Hoover Dam, I figured I'd haul it out of storage.
translation: 既然你都说服我去帮忙防守水坝了，我想怎么着都得把这东西从仓库里拖出来。

original: I'm a little rusty with it but... I think I can manage. {bit of a grin}As long as you've got my back, of course.
translation: 虽然我有点生疏了……但应该没问题。{bit of a grin}当然，前提是你得当我的后盾。

original: Like I said, I needed to go do something. This is it. It belonged to my father.
translation: 我说过，我得做点什么。这就是了。这装甲是我父亲的。

original: I thought I might wear it at Hoover Dam, but after you talked me out of it, I didn't see the point in hanging on to it any longer.
translation: 我本来打算穿着它去胡佛水坝的，但既然你打消了我这个念头，我再继续留着它也没什么意义了。

original: I'm here because of you, so I figure you're the one most deserving of it. It should protect you from everything short of a Plasma Caster.
translation: 因为有你，我才能走到这一步，所以我认为你最有资格穿上它。除了等离子投射器，应该没有什么武器是它防御不了的。

original: And if you need anything - anything at all - you know where to find me.
translation: 还有，如果你需要什么东西，什么都好，随时都可以来找我。

original: {false friendly}Hey there. Was it always your plan to sell me into slavery to Caesar, or was that a spur of the moment thing?
translation: {false friendly}嘿，你好啊。你是本来就打算把我卖给凯撒当奴隶呢，还是突然心血来潮？

original: Why don't you make like Odysseus and get lost?
translation: 你为什么不能像奥德修斯那样，自己主动消失呢？

original: For as lack of adornment is said to become some women, so will this place, without your presence, bring delight.
translation: 有人说女人不加修饰更美，这地方也一样，没有你会更美。

original: I've run out of witty ways to tell you to leave, so why don't you just go?
translation: 我已经努力在用最委婉的方式劝你离开了，可你为什么还不走呢？

original: If you want to talk, take off that ridiculous Legion uniform. It's insulting.
translation: 你能不能先把那件蠢兮兮的军团制服脱掉再说话。看着就刺眼。

original: Hi. If you're looking for medical help, try the other doctors. I'm just a researcher. Not even a particularly good one.
translation: 你好。如果你是来治病疗伤的，那去找别的医生吧。我只是个研究人员，而且水平还不怎么样。

original: Hello, again. Still in one piece, I see.
translation: 你好啊，又见面了。我看你胳膊腿都还在嘛。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Well, we've had some laughs, you and I, but it looks like you're a crazy person and I'm going to have to leave.
translation: 好吧，我们是有过交情，但既然现在你已经疯了，我也只能告辞了。

original: Moreno took the fall of the Enclave hard. He never questioned his orders, never questioned the legitimacy of what the Enclave was doing.
translation: 莫雷诺对英克雷的灭亡始终耿耿于怀。他从不会质疑命令，也从不会质疑过英克雷的合法性。

original: To him, it was all one unbroken chain, from Washington to Richardson. When we left Navarro, I remember looking up at Moreno.
translation: 对他来说，这个国家的血脉是从华盛顿一直延续到理查森的。当我们离开纳瓦罗的时候，我记得我抬头看了莫雷诺一眼。

original: He said, "Kiss America goodbye, boys." When we left the Enclave behind, the love in him burned itself out. Now there's just a bitter old man left.
translation: 他说，"跟美国吻别吧，兄弟们。"我们离开英克雷之后，他心中的爱也就燃尽了。只留下了一个刻薄的老头。

original: Since my mother died, Daisy's been the only woman in my life. She was the only other woman close to my father, too.
translation: 自从我妈死后，黛西就是我唯一有接触的女性了。我爸身边也只有她这另外一个女人。

original: She flew him out on over a dozen missions, including his last. I've always been close to Daisy.
translation: 她陪着他飞了十几次任务，包括他的最后一次任务。我和黛西的关系一直很好。

original: There have been some good men along the way, but lovers make poor confidants. Daisy never had children of her own, so she was always there to listen.
translation: 我这辈子碰到过不少好男人，但情人之间反而难以袒露真心。黛西一直都没有孩子，所以她也愿意听我倾诉。

original: Being in the Enclave didn't mean much to her. She just loved to fly. It broke her heart to be grounded.
translation: 其实她对英克雷并没有太多感情。她只是喜欢飞行而已。不能再飞真的伤透了她的心。

original: Doc Henry always was a hard one to figure out. It didn't seem to matter whether he was working with humans or dogs.
translation: 亨利医生是那种让人不太猜得透的人。好像他根本不在意和自己共事的到底是人还是狗。

original: He had an equal lack of affection for both. A regular {dai-ah-jen-eez}Diogenes. I'm not sure what the man was after.
translation: 反正他对人或者狗都没什么感情。简直跟{dai-ah-jen-eez}第欧根尼一模一样。我都不知道他到底是在图个啥。

original: "Knowledge is power," but to what end for Henry, I have no idea. The problem was what mattered to him, not its practical impact.
translation: "知识就是力量，"但亨利到底得到了什么，我不知道。他在意的只是问题本身，而不是问题带来的实际影响。

original: He simply solved riddles because they existed.
translation: 他单纯就是为了解谜而解谜而已。

original: If I had to pick anyone who didn't belong in the Enclave, it would definitely be Johnson. He hated what the Enclave was doing.
translation: 如果非要我选一个跟英克雷最不沾边的人，那我肯定得选约翰逊。他对英克雷深恶痛绝。

original: Day to day, week to week, he would question orders, subvert mission objectives, do anything he could to serve without serving.
translation: 每时每刻，每分每秒，他都在和上头的命令对着干，坚持妨碍任务执行，总之就是想方设法地唱反调。

original: It's amazing he was never court-martialed. He always had good things to say about my father. Said I was like him in a lot of ways. I wish I knew.
translation: 最神奇的是他居然从来没上过军事法庭。他总赞扬我父亲，说我非常像我爸。我真希望能早点明白他的意思。

original: Judah Kreger is the glue that's kept us all together over the years, and with good reason.
translation: 犹大·克里杰是队伍里的粘合剂，不夸张地说，这些年来一直是他让我们保持团结。

original: Anyone who can command Moreno and Johnson in the same unit without somebody getting fragged is one hell of a leader.
translation: 能指挥动莫雷诺和约翰逊，还能让他俩相安无事，他绝对是个非凡的领袖。

original: Kreger was polite and kind, but never warm. He always did his best to make me feel welcome in the group.
translation: 克里杰为人谦逊和善，但并不热情。他总是尽力让我觉得自己能够融入这个团体。

original: I think he did it out of a sense of loyalty to my father. Loyalty means a lot to Judah.
translation: 我认为他这么做只是出于对我父亲的忠心。忠诚对犹大来说意义非凡。

original: Not loyalty to the Enclave, or even the ideals they fought for, but to the people who served with him.
translation: 不是对英克雷的忠诚，甚至都不是对信仰的忠诚，而是一种同袍情义。

original: I'd like to say that I saw this coming, but honestly I was oblivious. {sheepish}For what it's worth, I'll do what I can to help you... not get killed?
translation: 虽说我有预想过这种情况，但明显我还是未能察觉。不管怎样，我会尽量……保护你的小命的？

original: So Mr. House doesn't care that one of Caesar's most notorious Legion spies is walking around on the Strip.
translation: 看来，豪斯先生并不介意凯撒手下最臭名昭著的间谍在长街上招摇过市。

original: Either that or his Securitrons' AI is too primitive to recognize the threat. Neither answer is particularly comforting.
translation: 要不然，就是他的电子保安还不够智能，根本没有检测到风险。不管哪个答案，都无法让人特别放心呀。

original: {sarcastic, in response to being ignored by another Follower}Oh, hello Emily. Yes, it is I, Arcade Gannon, fellow member of the Followers of the Apocalypse.
translation: {sarcastic, in response to being ignored by another Follower}哦，你好，艾米莉。对，是我，阿卡德·甘农。天启追随者的成员。

original: Would I like to help infiltrate the Lucky 38{casino}? I'm so glad you asked...
translation: 你问我是否愿意帮你入侵幸运38的系统？真高兴你终于问了……

original: That's a lot of energy weapons. Brings back some interesting memories.
translation: 能量武器真多啊。让我想起了一些有趣的往事。

original: The Strip's not a bad place if you love terrible things and people. {a bit sad, annoyed}I'll never understand the allure of giving away your money to the rich.
translation: 你要是不介意多见识几桩人间惨剧，那长街绝对是个好地方。{a bit sad, annoyed}我就不明白了，为什么有人就爱把钱往富人的口袋里送呢？

original: I've read about REPCONN. I think they did some work with the... {catching himself, was about to say "Enclave"} the government before the war. Rockets and some energy weapon prototypes, I think.
translation: 我读过瑞普康的资料。我想他们曾经跟……{catching himself, was about to say "Enclave"}战前政府有过合作。包括火箭啊，能量武器原型机啊什么的。

original: Westside, huh? I passed through here with another Follower a while back, Anderson. The locals were having a lot of trouble getting water through.
translation: 西区啊？我以前跟一个叫安德森的天启追随者路过这里。当地人的用水问题很严重。

original: Westside, huh? I heard about what happened with Anderson. Can't say I'm surprised. He was always a fringe operator in the Followers.
translation: 西区啊？我听说安德森的事了。应该说在意料之中吧。他一直都是天启追随者里的异类。

original: {exasperated}What's wrong with you? Killing Anderson isn't going to bring Corporal White back.
translation: {exasperated}你到底是发什么神经？杀了安德森也不会让怀特下士复活。

original: Interesting way of handling things. Very {soob}sub {roh-sah}rosa.
translation: 你处理问题的方式很有趣。简直瞒天过海。

original: I don't know if the Scorpions deserved to be wiped out for something they didn't do, but that's one less problem Westside has to deal with.
translation: 我不知道毒蝎帮该不该因为自己没做过的事而落得个被全灭的下场，但西区确实少了一个麻烦。

original: Anderson turned in for the wrong reason and Westside gets to keep siphoning water.
translation: 安德森蒙冤进了大牢，西区可以继续抽水用了。

original: It's hard to find justice in all of this, but I suppose this is as close as it gets. Thanks.
translation: 虽然这事从头到尾都谈不上公正，但我想结果也算可以接受。谢谢。

original: Extortion? Really? You go through all of this only to extort the people who are trying to help Westside? Unbelievable.
translation: 敲诈？真的？你做了这么多事，就是为了敲诈一群想要帮助西区的人？难以置信。

original: Hildern is a good example of "big picture" obsession gone too far.
translation: 希尔丹就是一个光顾着"大局"而走过头的典型例子。

original: At some point he became so fixated on large scale results that he lost the concept of "the common good" along the way.
translation: 某种程度上来说，他过于追求宏观统计结果，结果丢掉了"公益"这个概念。

original: It's an inhumane kind of public service when people and the basic resources they need become numbers in a ledger.
translation: 如果人群和基本资源都变成了账面上的数字，那公共服务也就彻底失去了为民造福的本意。

original: A vertibird. Interesting. It's been a long time since I've seen one of these.
translation: 飞鸟。有趣。我好久没见过这东西了。

original: Wait, wait, wait a second. What's going on? Am I playing Vergil to your Dante?
translation: 等等，等等，等一下。现在演的是哪一出？难不成我在演维吉尔，你在演但丁？

original: I'd like to assume that we're tiptoeing into the mouth of hell out of academic curiosity, but I'm not so open-minded that I've lost my brains.
translation: 也许我们是本着对知识的好奇心踮着脚尖走进了地狱的血盆大口，但我的思维还没开放到连理智都不要的地步。

original: I guess I'll wait out here, then.
translation: 我想我还是在外面等吧。

original: I need to talk to you about something, if you have a minute.
translation: 如果你有空的话，我有事跟你说。

original: Thanks for doing this, getting them all back together again.
translation: 谢谢你让他们又聚在一起了。

original: I'll be honest, when Moreno started going off, I didn't think we'd all be walking out of there in one piece.
translation: 说实话，莫雷诺开始发飙的时候，我还以为我们都没法活着出去了。

original: I still don't know how this is all going to shake out in the end, but at least the Enclave can atone a bit for all the damage it's done.
translation: 虽然不知道这事最终结果如何，但至少能弥补一些英克雷过去所犯下的罪孽。

original: I shouldn't be surprised at what happened with Moreno. I hoped that after all this time, he could put his anger behind him.
translation: 莫雷诺变成这样，我并不奇怪。我曾希望时间能让他放下心中的仇恨。

original: Maybe everything good in Orion Moreno died at Navarro and it was foolish to think there was anything in him left to salvage.
translation: 但那个善良的厄里翁·莫雷诺也许早就已经死在纳瓦罗了，指望他心里还残留着一点良心，真是太蠢了。

original: You got the survivors of the Enclave back together so you could convince them to help Caesar?!
translation: 你把英克雷的幸存者全都召集起来，就是为了说服他们帮助凯撒？！

original: What are you thinking? Do you {emph}want to see Vegas turned into the new slave capital of the west?
translation: 你到底在想什么？你是想看着维加斯变成西部的奴隶之都吗？

original: Hey. You're your own person and all that, but you're acting crazy, and if you keep it up, I'm going to leave.
translation: 嘿，虽说没人能管得着你，但我看你是一直在都发疯，如果你再继续这样，我就要走了。

original: I like how you handled that. Nicely done.
translation: 我喜欢你做事的方法。干得漂亮。

original: I can't say that's how {emph.}I would have handled that, but...
translation: 虽说我个人并不太赞同这种做法，但……

original: You're that courier, right? The guy who runs the Tops, Benny... heard he tried to kill you.
translation: 你就是那个邮差，对吧？九重天的老板本尼……听说他想要杀了你。

original: I guess that didn't work out very well for him. {joking}Should I watch my back around you?
translation: 看来这件事他干得不怎样呀。{joking}我是不是也该多留个心眼？

original: Oh, you're that courier, aren't you? The one who got mixed up with Benny over at the Tops. Sounds like messy business.
translation: 噢，你就是那个邮差，对吧？就是和本尼在九重天干起来的那个。听说最后闹得不可开交。

original: I'm no botanist, but I think this {emph}may not be entirely natural.
translation: 虽然我不是植物学家，但我觉得这应该不是纯天然的。

original: Nuclear waste disposal. Pre-War, people figured there was so much desert in Nevada, you might as well turn it into a big dumping ground.
translation: 核废料处理装置。在战前，人们发现内华达有大片的沙漠，于是就顺其自然地把它变成了一个大型垃圾场。

original: People didn't like it, but they weren't about to give up easy access to power, not with all of the petroleum drying up.
translation: 虽然人们也不喜欢这样，但没人会放弃方便快捷的能源，更别说那时候石油早就枯竭了。

original: It's a shame what happened up here. I understand arguments about the "fog of war", but that can't be much consolation to the survivors.
translation: 这里发生的一切让人惋惜。我明白所谓"战争迷雾"的说法，可那毕竟安抚不了幸存者。

original: {sadly}Or to the NCR soldiers who have to live with what they did here.
translation: {sadly}也安抚不了那些经历过此事的NCR士兵。

original: In case it's not obvious, I think you should redirect the power to Freeside and outer Vegas.
translation: 该怎么选是明摆着的，你应该把电力送到自由城和维加斯外围去。

original: You activated ARCHIMEDES?! What the hell are you thinking?!
translation: 你激活了阿基米德？！你他妈的在想什么？！

original: Nicely done. I'm sure people will appreciate the power. I hate to have to rely on it, but out here... it makes a big difference.
translation: 干得好。我相信人们会感激这些电力的。虽然我很讨厌过于依赖能源，但对这种地方……有电会大不同。

original: Hmm. I suppose an even distribution is better than nothing.
translation: 嗯。我想就算是平均分配也总比没有好。

original: Everything to the Strip and McCarran? Are you kidding? {sighs}
translation: 全送到长街和麦卡伦？你开什么玩笑？{sighs}

original: {irritated}I guess I should be grateful you didn't activate the laser.
translation: {irritated}不过你没有启动激光系统，我已经该烧高香了。

original: You have to hand it to the NCR. Get enough hands working together and they can make or break just about anything.
translation: 有件事不得不称赞NCR。只要万众一心，他们可以创造或者毁灭一切。

original: I'm not exactly a mercenary, but taking out scumbags of this magnitude wouldn't cause me to lose any sleep.
translation: 虽然我算不上什么雇佣兵，但解决这种级别的人渣并不会让人心生愧疚。

original: Well, I'll be. Hoover Dam. One of the last remaining {emph}functioning wonders of the Pre-War world.
translation: 哎呀，总算见识到了。胡佛水坝。战前世界留存下来少数还能使用的奇观之一。

original: I'm amazed it's still running at all. Too bad everyone's killing each other over it.
translation: 它还能运作，真是太神奇了。可惜如今人们却要在它上面互相残杀。

original: What a load of Brahmin shit! Can you believe that guy?
translation: 什么屁话！你能相信那家伙？

original: Go away, human.
translation: 走开，人类。

original: {Angry}Head voices don't *like* you, squishy man!
translation: {Angry}脑子里的声音不*喜欢*你，软软人！

original: {Jealous}No! Head voices don't talk to you. Only to me!
translation: {Jealous}不！脑子里的声音不会和你说话。只会和我说话！

original: If it isn't the guy that defeated the Legion at Nelson. I can't thank you enough, morale around here has never been higher.
translation: 这不是在纳尔逊打败了军团的那位伙计嘛。这里的士气从没这么高涨过，我怎么谢你都不为过啊。

original: If it isn't the gal that defeated the Legion at Nelson. I can't thank you enough, morale around here has never been higher.
translation: 这不是在纳尔逊打败了军团那位姑娘嘛。这里的士气从没这么高涨过，我怎么谢你都不为过啊。

original: Whoa, didn't you save President Kimball? Glad to have someone like you here!
translation: 哇，你不就是那个救了金博尔总统的人么？有你这样的人实在太好了！

original: I heard President Kimball almost got killed at Hoover Dam. That would have been a big blow to morale around here.
translation: 听说金博尔总统在胡佛水坝差点遇刺。幸好没事，不然这里的士气肯定会大受打击。

original: Did you hear President Kimball was killed? The guys here aren't taking it very well.
translation: 你听说金博尔总统被杀的事了吗？这里的弟兄们都大受打击。

original: New guy, eh? The more the merrier around here!
translation: 新来的小子吗？人越多越热闹啊！

original: New gal, eh? The more the merrier around here!
translation: 新来的小丫头吗？人越多越热闹啊！

original: Hey everybody, look who it is! Glad to have you here friend. What can I do for you?
translation: 嘿，诸位，看看谁来了！很高兴见到你，朋友。我能为你做什么？

original: Look who we have here. Always nice to see a friend of the NCR. What can I do for you?
translation: 看看是谁来了。我们永远欢迎NCR的朋友来做客。需要我做点什么？

original: You're not going to do anything crazy here, are you?
translation: 你该不会是要在这儿撒泼吧？

original: Uh... is there something I can help you with?
translation: 呃……请问你有什么事吗？

original: Hey, I don't think it's a good idea for you to be here.
translation: 嘿，我觉得你不应该来这里。

original: What brings someone like you here?
translation: 什么风把你给吹来了？

original: Hey there. The names Sexton. Private James Sexton. Welcome to Forlorn Hope.
translation: 你好。我叫塞克斯顿。列兵詹姆斯·塞克斯顿。欢迎来到飘零希望营地。

original: Hey there, champ. Good to see you again.
translation: 嘿，兄弟。又见到你真好。

original: Well speak of the devil! The head of the pack!
translation: 说曹操曹操到！老大来了！

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: So I heard you helped take over Nelson from the Legion. Glad to see someone making a difference around here instead of just complaining.
translation: 我听说你协助我们从军团手中夺回了纳尔逊。很高兴总算有人不是整天抱怨，而是去做点实事了。

original: Thanks again for finding those supplies. I've already started putting them to good use.
translation: 再次感谢你帮我们找到了那些补给。我已经把它们分发下去了。
