original: Proud to have met you, ma'am.
translation: 很荣幸见到你，女士。

original: Listen, asshole. I know you're not really an NCR health inspector, so you can cut the restaurant critic routine.
translation: 听着，混蛋。我知道你的真实身份，你才不是NCR的卫生稽查员，少再来对我的食堂指手画脚。

original: And I want my fifty caps back, 'cause I looked it up and there ain't no disease called colorectal implosion syndrome.
translation: 还有，把我那50个瓶盖还给我。我检查过食材了，根本没有你说的什么直肠闭塞综合症病毒。

original: So I paid you to look the other way for nothing.
translation: 所以我花钱贿赂你完全就是白瞎。

original: Wait. Wait. You're not... oh wow, I'm sorry. You looked just like- never mind. Sorry. So... what can I serve you up?
translation: 等等，等一下。你不是……噢噢，抱歉。你看起来好像——别介意。抱歉。那么……有什么能为您服务的吗？

original: {Terse, sigh}You again? What do need?
translation: {Terse，sigh}又是你？要点什么？

original: {Good-humored}Howdy, looking for chow?
translation: {Good-humored}你好，想吃点什么吗？

original: {Happy to see player}Hey hey, back for seconds, huh?
translation: {Happy to see player}嘿，嘿又忍不住要来品尝了吗，嗯？

original: {Grateful}Thanks for handling the Fiends. One less pack of dogs to hurt the troops.
translation: {Grateful}谢谢你端掉了恶魔帮。少了这帮野狗，士兵们就安全多了。

original: Remarkable work saving Kimball. Glad you were around to prevent his assassination.
translation: 你救下金博尔的举动令人敬佩。很高兴你阻止了刺杀。

original: {Irritated}Yeah?
translation: {Irritated}嗯？

original: Howdy.
translation: 你好。

original: Do you require medical attention?
translation: 你需要医护吗？

original: If you're looking for a quick stitch, I'm your man.
translation: 如果你需要有人帮你疗伤，那我就是最佳人选。

original: They tell me I'm supposed to sell you weapons. Interested?
translation: 他们说我应该卖武器给你。有兴趣吗？

original: What's up with the tower in Vegas being all lit up? I didn't know it could do that.
translation: 维加斯那座塔的灯怎么全亮了？我都不知道还能这样。

original: Even that old House bastard gave in to the NCR. We're the only ones to make a stand!
translation: 就算豪斯那个老混蛋向NCR投降了，我们也要抵抗到底！

original: What are we going to do now that Papa's dead?
translation: 老爷子死了，我们该怎么办？

original: Your friend's cute - is she single?
translation: 你朋友真可爱——她单身吗？

original: I hope Papa knew what he was doing when he left you in charge.
translation: 我希望父汗让你当老大的决定是正确的。

original: A robot dog? Never seen one of those before.
translation: 机器狗？以前从没见过呢。

original: Your pal's one ugly motherfucker.
translation: 你的朋友真他妈逼丑。

original: {Shocked, a little afraid}Holy hell, is that a Nightkin?
translation: {Shocked, a little afraid}我的妈，那是个夜行族？

original: {Slightly sarcastic}Nice robot.
translation: {Slightly sarcastic}机器人不错嘛。

original: You know you're traveling with a fucking murderer?
translation: 你知道你是在和一个他妈的杀人凶手同行吗？

original: Haven't seen a Follower around here in years.
translation: 有年头没在这儿见过天启追随者了。

original: Huh?
translation: 哈？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: I ought to bleed you.
translation: 我就该给你放点血。

original: Fuck off and die.
translation: 滚你妈的，去死吧。

original: Like we don't have enough problems.
translation: 还嫌我们麻烦不够多啊。

original: Just get the fuck out of here.
translation: 马上给老子滚蛋。

original: What the fuck are you doing showing your face here?
translation: 你他妈的还敢在这出现？

original: Why are you even here?
translation: 你来干什么？

original: Crazy-ass mother fucker.
translation: 狗娘养的疯子。

original: You been dosing on too many of Jack's chems?
translation: 你是不是嗑多了杰克做的药？

original: You're almost as crazy as some Fiends I know.
translation: 你怎么和那些恶魔帮一样疯疯癫癫的。

original: {Sarcastic}Oh great, just who I wanted to see.
translation: {Sarcastic}哎哟，真是想谁来谁啊。

original: You going to fuck shit up again?
translation: 你又想干他妈的什么？

original: {Cautious}What do you want this time?
translation: {Cautious}这次你想干什么？

original: You should have been with us in our glory days. You'd have loved it.
translation: 你真该跟我们一起经历那些光辉岁月。你会爱上那一切的。

original: Share a whiskey with me sometime?
translation: 有空一起喝两杯？

original: I wish there were more like you.
translation: 真希望能有更多像你这样的人。

original: I like you, stranger. You've stood by us when not many would.
translation: 我喜欢你，陌生人。在众人离弃我们的时候，你选择了和我们站在一起。

original: Good to see you again.
translation: 很高兴又见到你。

original: Why'd you come here?
translation: 你来这儿干嘛？

original: Come to gawk at the Great Khans, have you? Fuck off.
translation: 又来大汗帮盯梢了？快滚蛋。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: The Legion and the NCR have mobilized their forces at Hoover Dam - it'll be time soon.
translation: 军团和NCR都已经把兵力集结到了胡佛水坝——就快是时候了。

original: It's starting to feel like tensions are coming to a boil. There will be full-scale war soon.
translation: 局势都紧张得要爆炸了。大决战不远了。

original: Seems like everybody with a stake in the Mojave is gearing up for something big.
translation: 看来每个和莫哈维有利害关系的人都准备好大干一场了。

original: So you've been sucked into the decadence of the Strip as well, have you?
translation: 看来你也跟着长街一起堕落了嘛？

original: Caesar's veterans are making short work of the NCR - or that's what I hear.
translation: 凯撒的老兵们要不了几下就能把NCR一锅端——至少我听说是这样。

original: Soon Caesar will send in his best troops from the Arizona campaign - the NCR won't know what hit them.
translation: 很快凯撒就会把亚利桑那的精英部队派过来，NCR就等着看好戏吧。

original: Those black-armored devils might be new to the Mojave, but they're butchers like all the rest.
translation: 虽然以前没见过那些黑甲恶魔，不过他们和其他的屠夫也没啥区别。

original: The runners are saying that the NCR is sending in their elite shock troops to try and push back the Legion.
translation: 送货的说NCR正把他们的精英部队派过来反击军团。

original: NCR spreads its infection to another town, I hear.
translation: 我听说另一个镇子也中了NCR的流毒。

original: I'm glad our brothers have returned home from Boulder City.
translation: 我很高兴弟兄们能从巨石城平安归来。

original: Why did you kill our brothers in Boulder City?
translation: 你为什么要在巨石城杀我们的弟兄？

original: More Khan brothers cut down by NCR in Boulder City. We should kill a hundred of them in response!
translation: 又有弟兄在巨石城惨遭NCR毒手。我们应该百倍奉还！

original: The 1st Recon butchers are in the field again. I'd love to head down to Forlorn hope and show them we haven't forgotten.
translation: 第一侦察营的屠夫又出动了。我真想马上到飘零希望营地去让他们尝尝厉害。

original: So the NCR makes peace with the Kings now? Where was that mercy at Bitter Springs?
translation: NCR跟猫王帮握手言和了？苦泉那会儿怎么不见他们发发慈悲呢？

original: Another tribe was wiped out in NCR territory? Can't say I'm surprised. I hope the surviving Kings learn from this.
translation: 又一个NCR领地上的部落被抹平了？说实话我一点都不惊讶。我希望猫王帮活下来的人能长点记性。

original: Our tribe's final stand will be remembered for a thousand years!
translation: 我们部落誓死不降的事迹一定会千古流芳！

original: We'll return, stronger than before!
translation: 我们会回来的，到时候我们会比以前更加强大！

original: I can't believe they're all gone.
translation: 不敢相信他们都跑路了。

original: So the Legion hit the murderers at Bitter Springs? Good.
translation: 军团在苦泉把那些杀人凶手痛打了一顿？很好。

original: We're not moving as many chems now that the Fiends have been taken out.
translation: 恶魔帮被端掉了，我们的药卖不出去了。

original: Diane's going nuts trying to find a new contact in the Fiends now that Motor Runner's dead.
translation: 现在轰鸣恶煞死了，黛安像发疯一样地在恶魔帮里找新联络人。

original: Typical - even within their highest ranks, the NCR is corrupt.
translation: 果不其然，就算是NCR的最高层，也已经烂到根里了。

original: So, the big bad chief ranger couldn't take the pressure, huh? Good.
translation: 看来那个牛逼哄哄的游骑兵头头顶不住压力了，是吧？很好。

original: If I knew who killed Kimball, I'd buy him a drink.
translation: 如果让我知道是谁杀了金博尔，我一定要请他喝一杯。

original: If you're going to assassinate the president of the NCR, you could at least do it right.
translation: 如果你要去刺杀NCR的总统，那你至少下手要利落。

original: Why the hell would you stop someone from killing Kimball?
translation: 你他妈为什么阻止别人杀金博尔？

original: If you ask me, a true warrior wouldn't let himself be captured at all - but busting that Legionnaire out of McCarran was an impressive stunt.
translation: 要我说，真正的战士根本就不会被俘，不过那军团士兵居然能从麦卡伦脱身，也是叫人佩服。

original: I would have thought the monorail bombing would slow the NCR down more.
translation: 我还以为单轨列车的爆炸能重创NCR的补给线呢。

original: Whoever blew up that monorail is a damn hero.
translation: 不管是谁炸的列车，都他妈是英雄。

original: Karl's been in a shitty mood since that big explosion at the Fort.
translation: 自从城堡发生大爆炸以后，卡尔就一直臭着脸。

original: Word's spreading that Caesar is dead. No one seems to know much about how, though.
translation: 凯撒死了的消息已经传开了。虽然没人知道具体到底是什么情况。

original: Caesar can rot in hell for all I care.
translation: 凯撒就烂在地狱里吧，关我屁事。

original: Not many get the favor of Caesar - even Papa hasn't been to the Fort.
translation: 很少有人能得到凯撒的青睐——就算是父汗也没去过城堡。

original: Rumor from the Strip is that House is dead. I hope the old bastard choked on his own tongue.
translation: 长街有流言说豪斯已经死了。希望那个老混蛋是被自己的舌头噎死的。

original: Mr. House isn't a man to be trusted. Watch yourself.
translation: 豪斯先生不是能相信的那种人。你自己小心。

original: I heard from one of Melissa's runners that that check-coated bastard got thrown out on his ass.
translation: 我听梅丽莎的一个走私贩说，那个穿格子西装的混蛋已经跑路了。

original: Papa says "cut off the head and the snake will die." I guess the Chairmen's days are numbered.
translation: 父汗说过，"蛇无头不行。"我看董事会时日无多了。

original: I remember the Chairmen from their tribal days. They were punks then, they're punks now.
translation: 董事会没混出名堂以前我就认识他们。他们以前就是混混，现在也还是混混。

original: You really killed Caesar himself? Maybe he's not the mighty warrior Karl said he was.
translation: 你真的杀了凯撒？或许他并不像卡尔说的那样，是个强大的战士。

original: You're the one who killed Kimball! If we had a bar here, I'd buy you a drink!
translation: 你杀了金博尔！如果这里有酒吧，我一定请你喝一杯！

original: We're fighting for the NCR now? I don't know about that....
translation: 我们现在给NCR卖命了？我都不知道……

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Hello, wanderer. Please forgive us of our humble surroundings. Our true home awaits us in the Far Beyond.
translation: 你好，流浪者。请原谅敝舍简陋。我们真正的家正在遥远的彼岸等着我们。

original: Have you come to help us complete the Great Journey?
translation: 你是来帮我们完成伟大旅程的吗？

original: I apologize, wanderer, but I must go tend to my flock!
translation: 我很抱歉，流浪者，但我必须去照看我的同胞！

original: I waited to speak with you one last time before I descended to the launch pad, wanderer.
translation: 我一直希望能在进入发射台前最后和你谈一次，流浪者。

original: I want you to know that we will remember for all eternity how you delivered us to the threshold of the Great Journey.
translation: 我想告诉你，我们会永远铭记你是如何帮助我们开启伟大旅程的。

original: Our preparations are nearly complete, but the rockets that will carry us to salvation are yet missing vital components.
translation: 我们的准备工作基本完成了，但那些能将我们带上救赎之路的火箭还缺少一些重要组件。

original: If you would still help us, wanderer, speak to Chris. He can tell you what is missing.
translation: 如果你还愿意帮我们，流浪者，请去和克里斯谈谈。他会告诉你都缺了些什么。

original: There is no way that we can thank you enough, wanderer. Your arrival here was a blessing. We will remember you always.
translation: 你的大恩无以为报，流浪者。你的到来就是上天的恩赐。我们会世代铭记你的恩情。

original: Forgive me, wanderer, but my flock awaits.
translation: 请原谅，流浪者，我的人民在等我。

original: Is the way clear?
translation: 清理干净了吗？

original: Will you help us, wanderer?
translation: 你会帮助我们吗，流浪者？

original: Hello and welcome to Gomorrah. How can I help you?
translation: 你好，欢迎来到蛾摩拉。有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

original: Hey there, can I get you a drink, maybe a party favor?
translation: 嘿，你好，你想喝杯酒吗？或者来几剂嗨的助兴？

original: You looking for a good time?
translation: 你想找乐子吗？

original: What the fuck are you looking at?
translation: 你他妈看什么呢？

original: What the fuck are you looking at?
translation: 你他妈看什么呢？

original: If I wasn't working right now, I'd show you a real nice time.
translation: 要不是我现在正在工作，我真想好好疼爱你一番。

original: Enjoying the show?
translation: 喜欢这场表演吗？

original: I wouldn't mind taking a bite of you.
translation: 我真想咬你一口。

original: Damn, you're looking tasty.
translation: 该死的，你看上去真好吃。

original: Securitrons with faces like soldiers? Is this martial law or something? What the fuck?
translation: 电子保安怎么全换上大兵脸了？军事管制吗？到底怎么回事？

original: So Mr. House sells Vegas out to the NCR, {ay}eh? I always knew that freak was a rat.
translation: 这么说，豪斯先生把维加斯卖给了NCR，{ay}是吗？我就知道那个怪胎是奸细。

original: What the fuck's up with the Lucky 38 being lit up all the time, {ay}eh?
translation: 幸运38的灯到底是为什么才他妈一直全亮着啊？

original: Shit, I can't believe Cachino betrayed the Family.
translation: 该死，真不敢相信卡奇诺居然背叛了家族。

original: I got kicked outta Ultra Luxe the other day. Man, that place gives me the fucking creeps.
translation: 我前几天才被从奢华殿堂里赶出来。老兄，那地方真他妈吓人。

original: Business is good. All the Familes got money. Of course Gomorrah is where the action is.
translation: 生意不错。所有的家族都有钱拿。当然，蛾摩拉才是大头。

original: I'm glad they don't let just any motherfucker through the gate. Freeside smells like shit.
translation: 很高兴他们没放一个畜生进门。自由城的东西闻起来都跟屎一样。

original: Fiends are bad for business. NCR should do their fucking job.
translation: 恶魔帮只会把生意搅黄。NCR倒是干点他妈的正事啊。

original: There's some serious shit going on between NCR and the Legion. They better not fuck with our power.
translation: NCR与军团好像杠上了。别他妈牵涉到我们这里就好。

original: Fuck Not-At-Home, must be cozy up there in the Lucky 38.
translation: 去他妈的豪斯，肯定又在幸运38里干坏事了。

original: Bosses don't like no trouble in their place.
translation: 老板都不喜欢自己的场子出事情。

original: Gomorrah is always open for Business.{Spoken like business has two meanings}
translation: 蛾摩拉对各类生意都敞开大门。{Spoken like business has two meanings}

original: Find yourself a girl or a guy. Have some fun.
translation: 给自己找个姑娘或者小伙。好好乐乐。

original: I think there is something wrong with that dog.
translation: 我觉得那条狗有点不对劲。

original: Uh{hesitates}, I don't think we allow{uh} her kind in here.{pause} I'll let it go this time though.
translation: 啊{hesitates}，我觉得她这样的人应该是不得入内的。{pause}不过这次就算了吧。

original: What the fuck is that thing?
translation: 那他妈是什么玩意？

original: Big tough ranger better not start any trouble in here.
translation: 就算是最强的游骑兵，在这里最好也别惹麻烦。

original: Let me know if the pretty lady with you is looking for some work.
translation: 如果你身边这位美丽的女士正在找工作，请务必告诉我。

original: That Follower fucker is going to have some trouble if he tries to liberate any of our employees.
translation: 那个天启追随者杂碎要是敢在这里搞他解放劳工的那一套，老子要他吃不了兜着走。

original: Kings sold out to the NCR huh? Might be worth a sit down with them.
translation: 猫王帮把自己卖给NCR了？他们从中捞了不少好处吧。

original: Word on the street is something big is about to go down at Hoover Dam.
translation: 街上都在议论胡佛水坝近期要出大事。

original: I hear you been making some waves around here.
translation: 听说你在这附近翻起了不小的浪花啊。

original: I hear the Legion is moving some new tough muscle into the area. NCR better keep their heads down.
translation: 我听说军团又派了一支精锐部队进驻这个区域。NCR最好小心点。

original: Kings were small time. Not surprised they got themselves iced.
translation: 猫王帮算个屁。他们把自己玩死一点都不奇怪。

original: Those fucking Monkey Khans joined the NCR? I can't believe they finally got themselves civilized.
translation: 大猴盟那些该死的东西加入了NCR？不敢相信他们终于接受开化了。

original: Khans finally got what they had coming. Glad we won't have to worry about them again.
translation: 大汗帮自作自受。很高兴我们不用再担心他们了。

original: You hear what happened over at Bitter Springs? Not too pretty.
translation: 你听说苦泉的事了吗？不是什么好事啊。

original: Kimball managed to get himself knocked off. Serves him right.
translation: 金博尔管天管地，终于把自己管死了。这就叫报应。

original: I hear Kimball dodged a bullet there.
translation: 听说金博尔躲过了一劫。

original: The NCR seems none too happy about losing their little train.
translation: 小火车报废了，NCR不开心了。

original: Glad that fucker House is gone.
translation: 很高兴豪斯那狗日的终于死了。

original: Woah, the great Caesar is dead. The management doesn't seem too happy.
translation: 哦哈，伟大的凯撒死了。管理层的人似乎不太高兴。

original: I hear Mr. House cashed out. Ain't much to miss.
translation: 我听说豪斯先生退场了。不过也没人想念他。

original: {Amazed}Holy shit, you been in Lucky 38? You meet the Big Man in there?
translation: {Amazed}妈的，你进到幸运38里面去了？有没有见到里面的大人物？

original: Things are good since Cachino took over.
translation: 自从卡奇诺接手后，这里的一切都挺顺利的。

original: I hear you chased that chicken shit Benny off. Good riddance.
translation: 听说你赶走了本尼那个鸡屎。干得好。

original: Did Benny beg before you burned his sorry ass?
translation: 你点燃本尼屁股的时候，他有没有求饶？

original: {Laughs}Nice work at the Tops, buddy.
translation: {Laughs}你在九重天干得不错，伙计。

original: Welcome back to Gomorrah, find yourself a girl or a guy, and have a drink. You're family.
translation: 欢迎再次光临蛾摩拉，给自己找个姑娘或者小伙，再来一杯喝的。就当自己家。

original: Your ghoul wants to have some fun he can, we don't discriminate.
translation: 如果你的尸鬼也想找乐子，我们不会歧视的。

original: I tell you, Not-At-Home is gonna have his day.
translation: 我告诉你，豪斯马上就要完蛋了。

original: Hot damn do I love this place.
translation: 我爱死这个地方了。

original: This place smells like booze and sex. That's why I always come back.
translation: 这个地方弥漫着酒色之气。让我流连忘返。

original: I hope my dad doesn't find out how much money those hookers cost me.
translation: 希望我爸别发现我在那些妓女身上花了多少钱。

original: The Tops is a real snooze fest. I hope they get some new shows soon.
translation: 九重天实在是让人打瞌睡。希望他们能尽快推出些新节目。

original: This ain't your business. Walk off and forget you saw anything.
translation: 这不关你的事。你什么都没看见，赶紧走开。

original: We got the message. We're going.
translation: 我们收到消息了。这就走。

original: You didn't see nothin', got it?
translation: 你什么都没看见，懂了吗？

original: You'll get no trouble from me.
translation: 我不会再麻烦你了。

original: Hey, I just do what I'm told.
translation: 嘿，我不过是奉命行事罢了。

original: Here to meet with the brass?
translation: 来见长官的？

original: You oughtta think about enlisting. We need you here.
translation: 你应该考虑应召入伍。我们需要你。

original: Lot of folks at McCarran really appreciate what you've done.
translation: 许多麦卡伦营地的人都很感谢你所做的一切。

original: Hope you like it here at McCarran.
translation: 希望你喜欢麦卡伦。

original: Make yourself at home here. It's cozy... for an airport.
translation: 请随意，别客气。作为机场……这里还算是舒适。

original: Checking in with the base, huh?
translation: 来大本营报告的吗？

original: I can't believe it's over. I figured the Dam would fall and this place would be our last stand.
translation: 不敢相信我们完了。在我看来，水坝终将陷落，这地方将成为我们最后的防线。

original: Fight's gonna break out at the Dam any time now. Feels strange not being there for it.
translation: 水坝的战斗一触即发。现在还没派我们过去真是奇怪。

original: The cavalry's finally here. God bless the boys in black.
translation: 救兵终于到了。上帝保佑那些黑衣小伙子。

original: Word is, our Ranger vets are finally coming up from Baja. The Legion should be pissing their togas.
translation: 据说，我们的游骑兵精锐终于从下加州半岛赶来了。军团这下要吓得尿裤子了。

original: First Recon is holding Forlorn Hope now. What I wouldn't give for sniper support here.
translation: 第一侦察营现在驻守在飘零希望营地。所以我提供不了狙击手掩护。

original: With both Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope gone, you have to wonder when McCarran's gonna get attacked.
translation: 纳尔逊和飘零希望营地都失守了，麦卡伦受到攻击也只是时间问题。

original: I've always known Camp Forlorn Hope was a death sentence. I just wish I'd been wrong.
translation: 我一直都认为飘零希望营地是守不住的。我真希望自己错了。

original: They're saying we retook Nelson. Finally some good news.
translation: 他们说我们收复了纳尔逊。终于有好消息了。

original: Brotherhood's been quiet lately. Guess they finally realized Rangers beat power armor every time.
translation: 兄弟会最近消停了。看来他们终于明白了即便有动力装甲，他们也不是游骑兵的对手。

original: Heard the Kings have turned over a new leaf. Doesn't mean you'll see me in Freeside any time soon.
translation: 听说猫王帮已经改过自新了。不过我还是不会随便到自由城去的。

original: I've been seeing a lot of dead Fiends lately. Damn psychos had it coming.
translation: 我最近见到不少死掉的恶魔帮。这些该死的疯子终于遭报应了。

original: Are you the one that killed Motor-Runner? Thank God. That guy was a living nightmare.
translation: 你就是杀死轰鸣恶煞的那个人？谢天谢地。那个家伙就是个噩梦。

original: Bad time to lose Chief Hanlon. He'd have had Caesar running scared.
translation: 这时候失去汉隆军士长真是太糟了。他能把凯撒吓得屁滚尿流。

original: The most important POW we've ever taken and he gets away. He must've had help.
translation: 最重要的那个战俘跑掉了。他肯定得到了某人的帮助。

original: How could we fail to protect our own monorail?
translation: 我们怎么连自己的铁路都没保护好？

original: Caesar's dead. So when do we go home?
translation: 凯撒已经死了。我们什么时候回家？

original: I can't believe it. Caesar's Legion attacks in force, and I actually survived!
translation: 我真不敢相信。凯撒军团发动了猛攻，而我居然活下来了！

original: Unngh... why do I feel so terrible?
translation: 呃……为什么我感觉这么糟糕？

original: I'm glad those nighttime raids have stopped. I was getting worried.
translation: 我很高兴那些夜袭终于停了。本来我真是有些担心了。

original: Doc seems to be doing all right patching people up, at least.
translation: 至少医生在尽心尽力地救治伤员。

original: I never thought they'd actually send us reinforcements.
translation: 我从没想过他们真的会派增援来。

original: Welcome to Bitter Springs. {Sarcastic}Quite a sight, isn't it?
translation: 欢迎来到苦泉。{Sarcastic}风景不错，不是吗？

original: I hear there's a ghost in these mountains... and it doesn't like the NCR much.
translation: 我听说那些山里有一个鬼……而且它还不太喜欢NCR。

original: Not enough food, not enough medicine, and definitely not enough sleep.
translation: 食物不足，药物不足，甚至连睡眠都不足。

original: I don't know how we're expected to hold this place with so few men.
translation: 我不知道靠我们这么一点人该怎么守住这个地方。

original: All these refugees... is Caesar's Legion really that big?
translation: 这么多的难民……凯撒军团的规模真的有那么庞大吗？

original: This is the worst detail in the Mojave.
translation: 这是莫哈维最糟糕的地方。

original: Can't believe the Legion hit us in such numbers. They're stronger than we think.
translation: 难以相信军团会派出这么多人攻击我们。他们比我们想象的要强大。

original: I coughed up blood this morning. I think I'm really sick.
translation: 今天早上我咳出了血。我想我真的病了。

original: No attacks for a while now. That's a good sign, right?
translation: 敌人有段时间没有进攻了。是个好迹象，对吗？

original: I think there's something wrong with the food.
translation: 我认为食物有点问题。

original: I swear I saw somebody sneaking out of the graveyard the other night.
translation: 我发誓那天晚上我看见有人偷偷溜出了墓地。

original: Lieutenant Markland always looks like he's afraid the kids are gonna bite him.
translation: 马克兰中尉好像总是害怕孩子们会咬他。

original: Markland seems to be getting better with his bedside manner.
translation: 看来马克兰对病人的态度正在改善。

original: Finally got enough pills to chase off that damn infection.
translation: 终于有足够的药品来阻止那该死的感染了。

original: Doc's gotten real handy with the kids these days.
translation: 这些天医生真的很用心地在帮助孩子们。

original: Hope the Doc can give me some meds this week.
translation: 希望这周医生能给我些药。

original: Nice to see more guards on patrol. Maybe Caesar won't murder us all.
translation: 很高兴巡逻队的人手多了起来。也许凯撒不会那么轻易杀了我们。

original: Finally starting to get some decent food around here.
translation: 终于开始有些像样的食物了。

original: Not enough soldiers here to stop Caesar if he rolls through.
translation: 如果凯撒想要横扫这里的话，我们可没有足够的士兵能阻止他。

original: So tired....
translation: 太累了……

original: Haven't had a decent meal in weeks.
translation: 几个星期都没吃过一顿像样的饭了。

original: Legion just came out of nowhere.
translation: 军团不知从哪儿就冒出来了。

original: The man with the spiky hat comes into camp at night!
translation: 戴尖帽子的人晚上在营地出没！

original: Did you know ants can get *this big?*
translation: 你知道蚂蚁居然会有*这么大吗？*

original: I saw snake puppies in the hills!
translation: 我在山里看到了小蛇崽！

original: I say, would you like some of this absolutely delightful confection I found? I've been grazing on it all day!
translation: 我说，你想来试试这些我找到的甜点吗？美味无比！我简直离不开它了！

original: I like you! Will you take Barnabas Bear to New Vegas when you go?
translation: 我喜欢你！你去新维加斯的时候能带上先知小熊吗？

original: I'm hungry!
translation: 我饿了！

original: I'm sleepy!
translation: 我困了！

original: I'm scared!
translation: 我害怕！

original: My tummy hurts!
translation: 我肚子疼！

original: Where's my mommy?
translation: 妈妈在哪？

original: Your victory is the Legion's victory. True to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
translation: 你的胜利即是军团的胜利。忠于凯撒。

original: You are to be commended on your martial skill.
translation: 你的战斗技巧值得称道。

original: Forlorn Hope has fallen, another victory for {KAI-zar}Caesar.
translation: 飘零希望营地被攻克了，这是凯撒的又一次胜利。

original: {respectful}I have heard how you cleansed Forlorn Hope of the Profligates.
translation: {respectful}我听说你净化了飘零希望营地的荒淫之人。

original: Nelson, Forlorn Hope... soon {KAI-zar's}Caesar's banners shall rise on Hoover Dam.
translation: 纳尔逊，飘零希望营地……用不了多久，凯撒的旗帜就会在胡佛水坝上空飘扬。

original: Our march to the Dam is assured.
translation: 我们肯定会向水坝进军。

original: With Forlorn Hope's fall, our blades are at the NCR's throat.
translation: 既然攻陷了飘零希望营地，我们的利刃就架在NCR的脖子上了。

original: Our machetes ran thick with blood here.
translation: 我们的刀刃在此饱尝鲜血。

original: I hope to {KAI-zar}Caesar that the Profligates will send more victims to us.
translation: 我向凯撒祈祷，希望荒淫之人能多送些人头来。

original: {contempt}The Profligates here were weak, no fight in them.
translation: {contempt}荒淫之人十分孱弱，根本不堪一击。

original: This is only the first settlement to fall.
translation: 这只是我们攻克的第一个定居点。

original: {contempt}The bodies of beggars and cowards fill Nelson's streets now.
translation: {contempt}乞丐和懦夫的尸体已经阻塞了纳尔逊的街道。

original: Dead Sea has erected a tribute to {KAI-zar}Caesar - made of Profligate corpses.
translation: 死海为凯撒奉上了一份献礼——由荒淫之人的尸体做成。

original: When we're fortified here and reinforced, Forlorn Hope will be next.
translation: 只要我们加强防守，增援一到我们就能拿下飘零希望营地。

original: We kill only those who resist the will of {KAI-zar}Caesar. The rest are kept as tribute.
translation: 我们只杀胆敢反抗凯撒的人，其他人都充作奴隶。

original: Some of Nelson lives on... as slaves. They are being kept nearby.
translation: 纳尔逊的幸存者……都已经成了奴隶，他们就被关在附近。

original: If the rest of the Profligate settlements are as weak as this, {KAI-zar's}Caesar's victory is assured.
translation: 如果荒淫之人其余的城镇都如此不堪一击，那凯撒已经胜券在握。

original: This is only part of our detachment. We have others stationed nearby.
translation: 这只是我们的一个分部。附近还有很多哨站。

original: Speak to our {deh-CAN-us}Decanus, Dead Sea.
translation: 和我们的十夫长死海谈谈吧。

original: We do not move unless Dead Sea commands it.
translation: 除非死海下命令，否则我们不会擅自行动。

original: {contempt}We can see the Profligate cowards stationed on the hill, afraid of us.
translation: {contempt}那些荒淫之人懦夫被我们吓得跑到山上去了。

original: You may walk here - but do not head west along the road.
translation: 你可以在这里走动，但别再沿路往西走了。

original: That we hold Neslon, that is {KAI-zar's}Caesar's will.
translation: 我们会守住纳尔逊，这是凯撒的意志。

original: The {cutting}"great" republic couldn't find enough soliders to liberate this camp, so they sent {emph}you? Pathetic.
translation: {cutting}"堂堂"共和国居然无人可用，只好派你来送死？真是可悲。

original: {AH-way}Ave. Why have you come to Nelson?
translation: {AH-way}致敬。你来纳尔逊干什么？

original: {annoyed}What is it this time?
translation: {annoyed}这次又有什么事？

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: Ave. You have done a great service to Caesar. Do so again, but elsewhere.
translation: 致敬。你为凯撒尽忠职守。现在你可以去别的营地继续效命了。

original: {Lucky 38 re-lit}It turns out the Lucky 38 had its own reactor all along. Now that it's operational, the city doesn't need power from the dam.
translation: {Lucky 38 re-lit}原来幸运38有一个专门的反应堆。如今它启动了，城市就不再需要大坝的电力供应了。

original: {Hated 1}You're just as bad as the NCR or the Legion. What did the Followers ever do to you?
translation: {Hated 1}你跟NCR和军团一样坏。天启追随者怎么招惹你了？

original: {Hated 2}People like you are the reason the Followers haven't brought civilization back to the wasteland yet.
translation: {Hated 2}就是因为有你这样的人，天启追随者才没能让文明在废土复兴。

original: {Hated 3}I don't know what you have against the Followers, but I don't want any trouble.
translation: {Hated 3}我不知道你为什么要和天启追随者作对，但我不想惹麻烦。

original: {Liked 1}You're always welcome among the Followers, friend.
translation: {Liked 1}朋友，天启追随者永远欢迎你。

original: {Liked 2}The Followers are lucky to have a friend like you.
translation: {Liked 2}有你这样的朋友，天启追随者真的很幸运。

original: {Liked 3}If you ever need the assistance of the Followers, just ask.
translation: {Liked 3}如果你需要天启追随者的帮助，尽管开口。

original: {Mixed 1}You're making it hard to trust you, you know.
translation: {Mixed 1}你知道吗，要相信你很难。

original: {Mixed 2}At least you've making up for some of the trouble you've caused.
translation: {Mixed 3}至少你弥补了一些过错。

original: {Mixed 3}They said you're friendly enough, but that we ought to keep an eye on you.
translation: {Mixed 3}虽然他们说你很好，但我们还是应该多留一个心眼。

original: {Rascal 1}I hear you've done some good things for the Followers.
translation: {Rascal 1}我听说你帮了天启追随者不少忙。

original: {Rascal 2}The Followers are always on the look on for new friends like yourself.
translation: {Rascal 2}天启追随者一直在寻求你这样的新朋友。

original: {Rascal 3}I appreciate how you've been helping us so far.
translation: {Rascal 3}感谢你帮了我们这么多的忙。

original: {Thug 2}I really don't have anything you'd want.
translation: {Thug 2}我真的没有你想要的东西。

original: {Thug 3}Look, I've got people to care for. I'm not looking for trouble.
translation: {Thug 3}你看，我还要照顾很多人。我不想找麻烦。

original: {Wild Child 1}I don't get you. Sometimes you help the Followers, and other times you work against us.
translation: {Wild Child 1}我真搞不懂你。有时候你和天启追随者站一边，有时候你又和我们作对。

original: {Wild Child 2}You're an enemy of the Followers, as far as I'm concerned. I don't care how you've helped us.
translation: {Wild Child 2}要我说，你就是天启追随者的敌人。我才不在乎你怎么帮过我们。

original: {Wild Child 3}The Followers can't trust you, you've proven that.
translation: {Wild Child 3}你自己证明了，天启追随者不能相信你。

original: {Securitrons at Fort Destroyed}I never imagined Mr. House would concede to the NCR. I wonder what convinced him...
translation: {Securitrons at Fort Destroyed}我从没想过豪斯先生会对NCR让步。真想知道到底是什么说服了他……

original: {Default}When people have got nothing left, they can always turn to the Followers.
translation: {Default}当人们一无所有的时候，他们总是会来找天启追随者帮忙。

original: {Random - Guard}The Gun Runners ought to help the Followers by donating some of that firepower they've got.
translation: {Random - Guard}军火贩子应该把他们的武器捐给天启追随者。

original: {Random - Guard}{slightly complaining}Wish the Followers would get me some better armor.
translation: {Random - Guard}{slightly complaining}希望天启追随者能给我搞些好点的护甲来。

original: {Random - Guard}Stay alert.
translation: {Random - Guard}保持警惕。

original: {Random - Guard}Keep an eye out for trouble.
translation: {Random - Guard}留意事态。

original: {Random - Doctor}There are so many refugees to care for.
translation: {Random - Doctor}需要照顾的难民太多了。

original: {Random - Doctor}{concerned}Medicine's running low again.
translation: {Random - Doctor}{concerned}药品又紧缺了。

original: {Random - Doctor}All that wealth is wasted on the Strip. There are people in Freeside who need food and medicine.
translation: {Random - Doctor}大把大把的钱财都浪费在了长街上。自由城里还有好多需要食品和药物的人们。

original: {Random - Doctor}I have no idea how most of these people would survive without us.
translation: {Random - Doctor}我都不知道没有我们的话，这里的大部分人该怎么活下去。

original: {Companion Reaction - Veronica}I didn't know the Brotherhood had any people out here.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Veronica}没想到兄弟会在外面还有人啊。

original: {Companion Reaction - Rex}Look at that - a cyber-dog. There can't be many of those left.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Rex}看呐——一只机械狗。这玩意可是挺稀罕的。

original: {Companion Reaction - Lily}{awe}Look at that - a friendly Nightkin. What's it doing here?
translation: {Companion Reaction - Lily}{awe}看呐——一个友善的夜行族。它在这儿干啥？

original: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}{a bit amused}That is one battered Eyebot. It's a miracle it's still functioning.
translation: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}{a bit amused}这个眼球机器人可够破的。它还能运转可真是奇迹。

original: {Companion Reaction - Cass}Isn't that Cass? I heard she'd gotten out of the caravan business.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Cass}那不是卡丝吗？我听说她不再跑商队了。

original: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{slight awe}That's a First Recon beret. They're the best marksmen in the NCR military.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{slight awe}那是第一侦察营的贝雷帽。他们是NCR军队里最顶尖的神枪手。

original: {Companion Reaction - Raul}I'll never get used to the sight of ghouls.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Raul}我就是不习惯见到尸鬼。

original: {Brotherhood of Steel Destroyed}The Brotherhood had a bunker in Hidden Valley, but it was destroyed somehow.
translation: {Brotherhood of Steel Destroyed}兄弟会在隐谷有个碉堡，但是不知怎么已经被毁了。

original: {Kings resolve differences with NCR}I never thought I'd see the day when the NCR and the Kings started getting along.
translation: {猫王帮 resolve differences with NCR}我从没想过有一天NCR和猫王帮会走到一起。

original: {Kings wiped out}{shock at a bloodbath}The Kings got hit hard. I don't know how many of them are still alive, if any.
translation: {猫王帮 wiped out}{shock at a bloodbath}猫王帮损失惨重。我不知道他们还有多少人活着，希望还有吧。

original: {Kimball Assassination Successful}President Kimball was careless and overconfident, and it got him killed.
translation: {Kimball Assassination Successful}金博尔总统就是太不小心又过于自信，才会被刺杀的。

original: {Kimball Assassination Failed}Who would have thought someone would try to assassinate President Kimball with all those troops around?
translation: {Kimball Assassination Failed}谁能想到居然有人想在军队的眼皮底下刺杀金博尔总统？

original: {Monorail destroyed}Did you see the monorail explode? The destruction was absolute.
translation: {Monorail destroyed}你看到单轨列车爆炸了吗？真是场灾难。

original: {Caesar dead}Caesar's death is good news for the NCR. For everyone, most likely.
translation: {Caesar dead}凯撒的死对NCR是个好消息。对绝大部分个人都是。

original: {Mr. House unplugged/killed}No one knows how Mr. House died. His obituary didn't say anything useful.
translation: {Mr. House unplugged/killed}没人知道豪斯先生是怎么死的。他的讣告里没透露多少有用的信息。

original: {Securitrons on the Strip Upgraded}The Securitrons in and around the Strip have been upgraded. It's almost like Vegas has an army now.
translation: {Securitrons on the Strip Upgraded}长街的电子保安升级了。现在维加斯总算有支像样的军队了。

original: {Player enters Lucky 38}Someone entered the Lucky 38. That's never happened before.
translation: {Player enters Lucky 38}有人进入了幸运38。这可是以前从没发生过的。

original: {Player foiled RACKET}Big shakeup in the management at Gomorrah. I wonder what that's about?
translation: {Player foiled RACKET}蛾摩拉的管理层发生了大地震。真想知道出了什么事。

original: {Player killed Benny at The Tops}Someone killed Benny, the Chairmen's bigshot, in his own casino. Violence begets violence...
translation: {Player killed Benny at The Tops}有人干掉了九重天的老板本尼，就在他自己的赌场里。冤冤相报何时了啊……

original: {Player assaulted The Tops}Did you hear about the shootout at The Tops?
translation: {Player assaulted The Tops}你听说九重天的枪战了吗？

original: {Thug 1}We're only trying to help people, and you're not making it easy on us.
translation: {Thug 1}我们只是想帮助人们，你让我们很难做。

original: {Companion Reaction - Arcade}{concern for a friend}Don't let anything happen to Arcade, all right?
translation: {Companion Reaction - Arcade}{concern for a friend}别让阿卡德出事，好吗？

original: See Julie Farkas if you need anything.
translation: 如果你有什么需要，就去找朱莉·法卡斯。

original: Move along, buddy. I have work to do.
translation: 让开，伙计。我有工作要做。

original: {Lucky 38 re-lit}The great tower of the enemy city blazes with light. What does it mean?
translation: {Lucky 38 re-lit}敌城里的高塔灯火通明。这是什么意思？

original: {Wild Child 1}Sometimes friend, sometimes foe. No one knows what to make of you.
translation: {Wild Child 2}你亦敌亦友。根本没人知道该怎么应付你。

original: {Wild Child 2}I've heard stories about you. No one knows what you'll do next.
translation: {Wild Child 3}我听过你的故事。没人猜得到你会做什么。

original: {Wild Child 3}I'm not looking for trouble. You can ignore me.
translation: {Wild Child 4}我不想找麻烦。你不用理我。

original: {apologetic - got in someone's way}Excuse me.
translation: {apologetic - got in someone's way}借光。

original: {Random}My feet are killing me.
translation: {Random}我的脚痛死了。

original: {low voice}It's said that you were responsible for Caesar's death.
translation: {low voice}据说你该为凯撒的死负责。

original: {Brotherhood destroyed}The Legionaries are pleased - an enemy called the Brotherhood of Steel is dead.
translation: {Brotherhood destroyed}军团很高兴——被称为钢铁兄弟会的敌人被彻底消灭了。

original: {Great Khans attack everyone at Dam}The Great Khans tribe went mad. During the battle at the Dam, they attacked both the Legion and the NCR.
translation: {Great Khans attack everyone at Dam}大汗帮真是疯了。他们居然在大坝之战中同时攻击军团和NCR。

original: {Camp Forlorn Hope destroyed}The Legion has won a great victory over the NCR at a place called Forlorn Hope.
translation: {Camp Forlorn destroyed}军团在一个被称为飘零希望营地的地方取得了大捷。

original: {Mr. House Unplugged/Killed}I've heard that a great enemy of the Legion was assassinated in New Vegas.
translation: {Mr. House Unplugged/Killed}我听说有一名军团的宿敌在新维加斯被暗杀了。

original: {Caesar cured}Caesar was ill, but now he lives.
translation: {Caesar cured}凯撒之前病了，但他现在活过来了。

original: {Companion Reaction - Rex}How disgusting. You can see that strange mechanical mongrel's brain.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Rex}真恶心。那野狗的脑袋居然就这样露在外面。

original: {Companion Reaction - Raul}Ugh. One of the burned people walks in our camp.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Raul}啊。有个被烧伤的家伙跑到我们的营地来啦。

original: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}What a strange floating robot. Is it useful for anything?
translation: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}这个浮空机器人可真奇怪。它能有啥用？

original: {Companion Reaction - Lily}What is that thing? I've never seen a blue mutant.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Lily}那是什么东西？我从没见过蓝色的变种人。

original: {Rumors of Legion Veterans}I overheard some of the Legionaries say that more veterans from the eastern campaigns will be summoned to the Fort.
translation: {Rumors of 军团 Veterans}我无意中听军团的人说，会有不少参加过东部战役的老兵在堡垒集结。

original: {Mr. House victory}The leader of New Vegas and his army of robots has defeated both the NCR and the Legion. What will happen now?
translation: {Mr. House victory}新维加斯的领袖带着他的机器人大军打败了NCR和军团。接下来会怎样？

original: {NCR victory}There's talk that many of the ranking Legionaries will be beheaded for allowing the NCR to defeat the Legion yet again.
translation: {NCR victory}据说许多军团的高级军官脑袋不保了，因为他们又一次让NCR击败了军团。

original: {Legion Veterans arriving}A great battle is coming. Many veterans of the Legion have begun arriving from the east.
translation: {Legion Veterans arriving}一场大战即将打响。有不少军团老兵正陆续从东部赶来增援。

original: {Caesar dead}There are many rumors about who'll lead the Legion now that Caesar is dead.
translation: {Caesar dead}现在凯撒死了，谁来继任的传言飞得满天都是。

original: {Player completed Securitron bunker mission}That was quite an explosion a while ago. We felt the ground shake!
translation: {Player completed Securitron bunker mission}刚才的爆炸威力真是惊人。我们感到大地都在震动！

original: {Great Khans unaltered/helping Caesar}I've heard rumors that one of the tribes west of the river may join the Legion.
translation: {Great Khans unaltered/helping Caesar}据传有一个河西岸的部落可能会加入军团。

original: {Random}The work never ends...
translation: {Random}工作永远做不完……

original: {Random}So many tasks to attend to...
translation: {Random}太多活要干……

original: {Random}I need to rest.
translation: {Random}我需要休息。

original: {Thug 3}It's best if I'm not seen talking to you.
translation: {Thug 3}最好别让人看见我在和你说话。

original: {Thug 2}Be careful, or you'll end up being crucified.
translation: {Thug 2}小心点，不然你会被钉死在十字架上。

original: {Thug 1}The Legionaries grumble about you. Be careful.
translation: {Thug 1}军团对你很不满。当心点。

original: {Hated 3}The Legionaries want to kill you. Please don't get me involved.
translation: {Hated 3}军团想要杀了你。请不要连累我。

original: {Hated 2}The Legion hates you. Why do you come here?
translation: {Hated 2}军团恨死你了。你还跑到这里来干什么？

original: {Hated 1}Please - I'll be in trouble if the Legionaries see you speaking to me.
translation: {Hated 1}别——如果军团的人看到我和你说话，我会有麻烦的。

original: {Mixed 3}You're trouble, I can tell.
translation: {Mixed 4}我看得出来，你就是个闯祸精。

original: {Mixed 2}Be careful - the Legionaries aren't sure they can trust you.
translation: {Mixed 2}当心点——军团不知道该不该相信你。

original: {Mixed 1}You're not quite an enemy, nor are you a friend.
translation: {Mixed 1}你既算不上敌人，也算不上朋友。

original: {Rascal 3}Your favor with the Legion grows, I've heard.
translation: {Rascal 3}听说你在军团里的名声看涨啊。

original: {Rascal 2}Some of the Legionaries talk about you with growing respect.
translation: {Rascal 2}有些军团成员谈起你的时候都开始带着敬意了。

original: {Rascal 1}I'm honored to serve.
translation: {Rascal 1}能为您服务是我的荣幸。

original: {Liked 3}Someone as important as you noticing me? I'm flattered.
translation: {Liked 3}您这样的大人物居然会注意到我？我受宠若惊。

original: {Liked 2}The Legionaries speak highly of you. I'm not worthy of your attention.
translation: {Liked 2}军团对您评价很高。我不配引起您的注意。

original: {Liked 1}It's an honor to be noticed by one so favored by the Legion.
translation: {Liked 1}军团的大红人能注意到我，真是太荣幸了。

original: {Random}You're a woman, and yet you wander free?{sound of contemplation, "hmm," or similar}
translation: {Random}你一个女人居然还能四处乱逛？{sound of contemplation, "hmm," or similar}

original: {Almost Alarmed}The owner of the Vault was murdered. I thought we were safe inside the Strip.
translation: {Almost Alarmed}避难所的主人都被谋杀了。我还以为长街会很安全呢。

original: {Contemplative Comment}I like the place, but I wouldn't want to live underground all my life.
translation: {Contemplative Comment}我喜欢这里，但我可不想一辈子都活在地下。

original: {Marveled}Can you imagine how much electricity it takes to keep this Vault running?
translation: {Marveled}你能想象维持这个避难所的正常运转需要多少电力吗？

original: {Marveled}People lived in here for hundreds of years, can you imagine?
translation: {Marveled}人们都在这住了几百年了，你能想象吗？

original: {Slight Disappointment}I wish the rest of the Vault were accessible.
translation: {Slight Disappointment}希望避难所的其他部分也能开放参观。

original: {Satisfied}They have a fantastic menu at the diner.
translation: {Satisfied}他们的晚餐菜单非常棒。

original: {Relieved}Haven't found any Radroaches, so far.
translation: {Relieved}到目前为止，还没有发现辐射蟑螂。

original: {Saddened}This place's got a weird gloom after Miss Weintraub died.
translation: {Saddened}这地方在温特劳布小姐死后就变得阴沉古怪。

original: Did you get a tour? The owner has done a great job with this place.
translation: 你参观过了吗？这里的主人确实花了一番心思。

original: {Marveled}I've never seen so many pretty lights in my life.
translation: {Marveled}我这辈子都没见过这么多漂亮的灯。

original: {Self Justification)It's cramped in here, sure, but who really needs a fancy room, anyway?
translation: {Self Justification)这里空间很狭窄，的确如此，不过，谁需要那么花哨的房间呢？

original: I'll mind my business, you mind yours.
translation: 我管好我的事，你管好你的。

original: I've got nothing to say to you. Best move on.
translation: 我对你没什么好说的。最好继续走。

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: I've got nothing to say to you. Best move on.
translation: 我对你没什么好说的。最好继续走。

original: You don't seem to take a hint. Get out of my face.
translation: 你好像不明白我的意思，从我面前消失。

original: Jesus, you really can't take a hint, can you?
translation: 天啊，你真的不能接受暗示，是吗？

original: Let me be blunt. Go away.
translation: 我直说了吧。走开。

original: I don't know you, you don't know me. Let's keep it that way.
translation: 我不认识你，你也不认识我。让我们保持这种状态。

original: How about you just mind your own business, okay?
translation: 你就管好你自己的事吧，好吗？

original: I hear the NCR and the Kings have been getting along. That's good news for Freeside.
translation: 听说NCR和猫王帮握手言和了。这对自由城来说是个好消息。

original: I hear the Legion's fixing to attack Hoover Dam. Good thing I ain't there.
translation: 听说军团正策划进攻胡佛水坝。幸好我不在那儿。

original: I hear the Great Khans just packed up and left Red Rock Canyon. Always thought the NCR and them would fight it out again.
translation: 听说大汗帮卷铺盖离开了红岩峡谷。我一直以为他们会和NCR再打一仗呢。

original: That President Kimball nearly got killed at Hoover Dam. Now he knows how we feel about the NCR around here.
translation: 金博尔总统差点在胡佛水坝被杀。这下他该明白我们对NCR的感觉了吧。

original: That tower on the Strip, the one you can see for miles? I hear it ain't sealed-up no more.
translation: 长街那座高塔，就是好几里外都能看到的那座，我听说它终于开放了。

original: Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope, both butchered. It's almost like God don't like either side.
translation: 纳尔逊和飘零希望营地都被夷平了。看起来上帝谁也不喜欢。

original: Some Khans got corned in the ruins of Boulder City and the NCR killed them. It's like Bitter Springs all over again.
translation: 大汗帮的人被困在巨石城的废墟里，最后全被NCR杀了。简直是苦泉的翻版。

original: Someone finally put down that sick Motor Runner sonofabitch. Good riddance.
translation: 终于有人把轰鸣恶煞那个狗日的干掉了。死得好啊。

original: So I hear the honcho of one of them Strip families up and disappeared - poof! Yeah, they'll find his body someday...
translation: 我听说长街某个家族的老大突然失踪了——嘿！对，总有一天他们会发现尸体的……

original: The bosses of the {saying it wrong}Omergas? Omer-nas? The ones that run Gomorrah? Someone killed them.
translation: 听说了吗，乌默加的老大们？还是乌默纳？反正就是管理蛾摩拉的那帮家伙，他们被人给灭了。

original: I hear someone went crazy in one of the casinos on the Strip, shot the place up or something!
translation: 听说有个疯子跑到长街的一家赌场里，把那地方射成了马蜂窝！

original: The honcho of one of them Strip families got killed right in his own casino. You know he pissed off the wrong guy!
translation: 我听说长街一个家族的老大在他自己的赌场里死于非命。估计是引火烧身了！

original: You hear there was some kinda shoot-out at one of them casinos on the Strip? Some people got killed or something.
translation: 你听说了吗？长街有家赌场里发生了枪战，好像还出了人命。

original: They say those robots on the Strip are running around with different faces or something. Don't ask, {cuz}because I don't know...
translation: 他们说长街上巡逻的机器人突然就变了脸。别问我{cuz}，我也不知道……

original: Those robots on the Strip, Securi-troids or what have you? Well, they been acting different or something.
translation: 长街那些机器人，是叫电什么保来着？反正，它们近来的举动似乎有点古怪。

original: The same robots on the Strip, I seen one or two of them roll past town time to time. Well, the face on {'em}them looked meaner.
translation: 长街上那种机器人，我时不时能看见它们有一两个从这儿路过。它们的嘴脸比以前更难看了。

original: Usually I don't talk to nobody but robots. But lately some of them been two-faced.
translation: 我通常都不和机器人以外的人打交道。不过最近有些机器人似乎变成双面人了。

original: A customer who been to the Strip told me the faces on the robots there changed from police to soldiers. Now why would that be?
translation: 有个从长街回来的顾客告诉我，那边机器人的脸蛋全都从警察换成了士兵。怎么回事？

original: That Mr. House who lorded over the Strip is dead. Good riddance, I say.
translation: 那个独霸长街一方的豪斯先生死了。要我说，死得好。

original: Now that Mr. House's gone, might be opportunities on the Strip for an enterprising merchant.
translation: 既然豪斯先生已经不在了，长街那些惟利是图的商人发财的机会可就来了。

original: I bet that Mr. House had a buncha booze in his place. Someone oughta get it out of there. He ain't using it!
translation: 我敢打赌豪斯一定藏了不少好酒。真该有个人去把它们弄出来。反正他也没机会喝了！

original: If Caesar's dead, why ain't the NCR taking care of regular folks yet?
translation: 如果凯撒已经死了，那为什么NCR还这么不待见老百姓呢？

original: You hear Caesar's dead? Good for trade if the Legion goes away, that's for sure.
translation: 你听说凯撒死了吗？如果少了军团，那对生意肯定是百利而无一害的。

original: I heard Caesar didn't let nobody drink or drug. Probably why he got killed.
translation: 我听说凯撒既不让人喝酒，也不准人嗑药。这或许就是他被杀的原因吧。

original: Who cares if Caesar's dead? Don't affect our town one bit.
translation: 谁关心的凯撒死活啊？跟我们镇子又没半点关系。

original: If the NCR ain't got to worry about Caesar no more, it should worry about improving the lives of regular folks around here.
translation: 如果NCR不用再担心凯撒了，那他们就该关心关心怎么改善老百姓的生活。

original: So much for the might of the NCR! Their President got killed over at Hoover Dam!
translation: NCR的实力也就那么回事！他们的总统死在了胡佛水坝！

original: You hear how the President of the NCR got killed? Gonna be hard to score chems around here for a while...
translation: 你听说了NCR总统被人谋杀了吗？看来这阵子很难再搞到药品了……

original: Someone tried to kill the NCR President over at Hoover Dam. They say it was Legion.
translation: 有人试图在胡佛水坝刺杀NCR总统。听说是军团干的。

original: How's the NCR gonna protect Vegas if it can't even protect its own President?
translation: 如果NCR连自己的总统都保护不了，他们凭什么来保护维加斯？

original: The NCR's top Ranger, Chief Hanlon, put a gun in his mouth. Think he would've done that if the NCR stood a chance at beating the Legion?
translation: NCR的王牌游骑兵军士长汉隆，饮弹自尽了。你想想，如果NCR有一丝打败军团的希望，他会这么做吗？

original: Turns out the NCR's top Ranger was a traitor! If the Legion can turn a man like Hanlon, what chance has the NCR got?
translation: 没想到NCR的游骑兵首长居然是叛徒！如果军团连汉隆这样的人都能策反，NCR还有什么希望？

original: You hear the Legion attacked Bitter Springs? Didn't know there was anything left there to attack.
translation: 你听说军团进攻苦泉了吗？不知道那破地方有什么好打的。

original: Those Fiend junkies over at Vault 3 been taking some hits. I say kill them all.
translation: 3号避难所的那帮恶魔帮垃圾被收拾掉了。要我说，就该杀光他们。

original: With fewer of them Fiends sucking up the chems, maybe I can finally score a hit now and then.
translation: 现在嗑药的恶魔帮越来越少，没准我终于能搞一剂来尝尝了。

original: With those Fiends on the run, I should head over to Vault 3 and see if I can pull some salvage out of there.
translation: 既然恶魔帮不在了，我应该去3号避难所看看能不能搞点什么值钱的东西出来。

original: The Great Khans signing a treaty with the NCR? I never woulda seen that coming.
translation: 大汗帮和NCR签署合约了？真想不到还能看到这么一天。

original: Have you seen that tower on the Strip all lit up? You can see it for miles!
translation: 长街那座塔完全点亮了，你看见没？几英里外都能看见啊！

original: The Great Khans up and left Red Rock Canyon. Who's gonna brew fresh chems now?
translation: 大汗帮离开了红岩峡谷。我们以后去找谁做药？

original: I hear the Great Khans got massacred again. No survivors this time, though.
translation: 听说大汗帮又被屠杀了。不过这次没有幸存者了。

original: They say the Kings got massacred. Who's gonna watch over Freeside now?
translation: 据说猫王帮被消灭了。现在谁会接管自由城呢？

original: The NCR took back Nelson. Maybe they can win this war after all.
translation: NCR夺回了纳尔逊。他们也许最终能赢下这场战争。

original: First the Legion takes Nelson, then it wipes out Camp Forlorn Hope. The NCR don't stand a chance.
translation: 军团先是拿下了纳尔逊，然后又扫荡了飘零希望营地。NCR大势已去。

original: There was some kind of massacre at one of the Ranger Stations. I don't know which one.
translation: 某个游骑兵驻站发生了屠杀。具体是哪个就不知道了。

original: Some Khans got cornered in the ruins of Boulder City, but the NCR let them go. That's unusual.
translation: 大汗帮的人被困在巨石城的废墟里，但NCR最后居然放了他们。这太不正常了。

original: Primm has a new Sheriff. That should keep the Powder Gangers away.
translation: 普瑞姆有了新的治安官。这下应该能抵挡炸药帮了。

original: Primm wimped out and accepted NCR rule. Some people will do anything to feel safe.
translation: 普瑞姆妥协了，他们接受了NCR的统治。有些人为了自保，什么都能卖。

original: Looks like the war's ratcheting up. I hear the NCR's bringing in elite troops.
translation: 看来战事要升级。听说NCR正在调集精英部队。

original: They say the Legion's bringing in Veterans from out in Arizona. They must be getting ready to attack.
translation: 据说军团把亚利桑那的老兵调过来了。他们肯定准备好开战了。

original: You ever seen one of those Rangers in black armor? I wouldn't want to make one of those mad!
translation: 你见过那些穿黑色盔甲的游骑兵吗？我可不想惹到他们！

original: You ever seen one of those Rangers in black armor? I wouldn't want to make one of those mad!
translation: 你见过那些穿黑色盔甲的游骑兵吗？我可不想惹到他们！

original: I hear reports of Legion raiding parties all over the place. They can't all be rumors!
translation: 听报告说到处都有军团劫掠队出没。不可能都是空穴来风吧！

original: I keep hearing about some courier making a fuss over at the Strip. Must've delivered more than just mail.
translation: 最近常听说有个邮差搞得长街鸡飞狗跳的。送封信也没必要那么大动干戈吧。

original: Mark my words - won't be long before the Legion and NCR butt heads over Hoover Dam.
translation: 记住我的话——要不了多久军团就会和NCR在胡佛水坝打得头破血流。

original: Nobody knows who's gonna win, Legion or NCR. Might not make much of a difference around here.
translation: 没人知道军团和NCR谁会赢。不过似乎谁赢都不会有太大的区别。

original: That tower on the Strip's lit up night and day now! What's it mean?
translation: 长街那座塔现在全天都灯火通明！这是什么意思？

original: Goddamn that Mr. House for selling Vegas out to the NCR! The whole Mojave will have to join up.
translation: 该死的豪斯先生把维加斯整个卖给了NCR！全莫哈维必须联合起来了。

original: Howdy.
translation: 你好。

original: Hey there.
translation: 嘿你好。

original: I'm looking forward to getting sent across the river.
translation: 我一直期待着能被派过河。

original: {Benny escaped}That prisoner, Benny, managed to slip away somehow.
translation: {本尼 escaped}那个囚犯，就是本尼，不知怎么让他给跑了。

original: The new slave girls are quite beautiful.
translation: 这些新来的小女奴真漂亮。

original: The camps are getting crowded.
translation: 营地越来越挤了。

original: Slaves aren't much of a challenge in the arena.
translation: 奴隶在竞技场里可算不上什么挑战。

original: {Player defeated Ranger Stella}{missed out on a good arena match}I didn't think anyone could kill an NCR Ranger in single combat.
translation: {玩家 defeated 游骑兵 Stella}{missed out on a good arena match}我还以为没人能在单挑中打败NCR游骑兵呢。

original: {Player cured Caesar}{KAI-zar}Caesar lives!
translation: {玩家 cured 凯撒}{KAI-zar}凯撒活了！

original: {Caesar dead}I'll mourn {KAI-zar}Caesar - he was a great man.
translation: {凯撒 dead}我会哀悼{KAI-zar}凯撒的——他是个伟人。

original: {Player killed Lupa}Lupa met an honorable death in the arena.
translation: 鲁帕在竞技场死得其所。

original: Some of the slaves have been spreading stories about the Burned Man again.
translation: 又有奴隶在散布浴火者的故事了。

original: If you need a place to stay, check out Vault 21.
translation: 如果你在找地方住，可以去21号避难所看看。

original: I've heard about you.
translation: 我听说过你的大名。

original: It's good to see you around the Strip.
translation: 能在长街见到你真好。

original: {Curious}You turned around?
translation: {Curious}你回来了？

original: {Fortunate}When I get back home, I'll tell everyone I met you.
translation: {Fortunate}等我回家了，我要告诉所有人我见过你。

original: Step up to the tables, let's see what you got.
translation: 上桌吧，看看你手气如何。

original: {Frustrated}Almost outta caps...
translation: {Frustrated}瓶盖快没了……

original: {Dumbfounded}I can't believe you've got the gall to stroll down the Strip after what you've done.
translation: {Dumbfounded}真不敢相信你干出了那些事，居然还能在长街这么理直气壮地溜达。

original: {Doubtful Apprehension}Maybe someone else in the Strip can help you?
translation: {Doubtful Apprehension}也许在长街另有人能帮你？

original: {Feeling Observed and Self-Conscious}If you don't mind, I rather we don't talk right now.
translation: {Feeling Observed and Self-Conscious}如果你不介意的话，我现在不想和你说话。

original: {Dumbfounded}How the hell did the monorail blow up? Someone's bringing back luck into the Strip, I tell you.
translation: {Dumbfounded}单轨列车是怎么被炸毁的？我告诉你，肯定是有人把厄运带到长街来了。

original: {Apprehensive}Kimball's dead, I wonder how long until the Legion's at our walls.
translation: {Apprehensive}金博尔死了，不知道军团兵临城下还需要多久。

original: {Wistful}Vegas at night is like nothing else.
translation: {Wistful}维加斯的夜景独一无二。

original: {Unsure}The robots here look different than others I've seen.
translation: {Unsure}这里的机器人和我在其他地方见过的好像都不一样。

original: Shame about the fighting at the Tops; it's got the best patrons around here, hands down!
translation: 在九重天干架真是不知羞耻；他们的客人都是这里最好的主顾！

original: {Slightly Patriotic}Us NCR folk got to stick together, even if the Strip is the safest place in New Vegas.
translation: {Slightly Patriotic}就算长街是新维加斯最安全的地方，我们NCR也要团结一致。

original: Beats being on patrol.
translation: 总比巡逻强。

original: Just lost a month's caps...
translation: 刚输掉了一个月的瓶盖……

original: You're the one who busted those assholes at Gomorrah, huh? Good work!
translation: 你就是那个把蛾摩拉掀了个底朝天的人吧？干得好！

original: Fucking Crocker couldn't find his ass if it wasn't on his backside...
translation: 他妈的克罗克，老子看他是连自己的屁股都找不着……

original: Don't be carrying any guns into the casino.
translation: 持械禁入赌场。

original: {Not insulting, just commenting}You look like you just crawled out of the desert.
translation: {Not insulting, just commenting}你怎么看着像是刚从沙漠里爬出来。

original: {Night only}Love how this place comes alive at night.
translation: {Night only}我就喜欢这地方在晚上这么热闹。

original: {Day only}You should see this place at night.
translation: {Day only}你应该等晚上再来看看。

original: {Rueful}Looking to lose a few caps, huh? Just the place.
translation: {Rueful}想要散财消灾，嗯？你找对地方了。

original: I never trusted those Omerta punks, even if I like their girls.
translation: 我绝对不会相信黑手党的那些混混，虽然我喜欢他们的小妞。

original: I don't trust those creeps at the Ultra-Luxe.
translation: 我可不相信奢华殿堂的那些贱人。

original: We need more people like you in the NCR.
translation: NCR需要更多你这样的人。

original: {Proud}We should straighten those thugs at Gomorrah.
translation: {Proud}我们应该修理一下蛾摩拉的那些恶棍。

original: We've heard about you from the officers at our embassy.
translation: 我们已经从大使馆的官员那里听说了你的事。

original: You're wasting no time in making a name for yourself around here, huh?
translation: 你的名气真不小，倒是挺能利用时间的嘛，嗯？

original: {Subtly Fearful}The bots have enough firepower to arm a full platoon.
translation: {Subtly Fearful}这些机器人的火力，赶得上一个满编排了。

original: {Surprised, then impressed}A Ranger, here in the Strip? Fine company, sir!
translation: {Surprised, then impressed}游骑兵，在长街？这可是好伙伴啊，先生！

original: {Matter of Fact}I won't be missing Mr. House, that's a given. The Strip's better off without him.
translation: {Matter of Fact}我当然不会想念豪斯先生。没了他，长街会更好。

original: {Satisfied}It was a matter of time before someone got to Mr. House.
translation: {Satisfied}豪斯先生被人干掉是迟早的事。

original: {Satisfied}Mr. House won't trouble our plans for the Strip any longer, huh!?
translation: {Satisfied}豪斯先生不会再影响我们在长街的计划了，是吗！？

original: {Proud}NCR should take this chance, now that Mr. House's out of the way.
translation: {Proud}现在豪斯先生已经不再是问题了，NCR应该抓住这个机会。

original: {Relieved}Good riddance, Caesar! We can finally enjoy some R&R without worrying about a Legion attack at McCarran.
translation: {Relieved}凯撒死得好啊！我们终于可以真正休个好假，而不必担心军团进攻麦卡伦了。

original: {Exuberant}Fuck that Caesar dog! I'm going to drink in your name, all night!
translation: {Exuberant}干他妈的凯撒狗！我要以你的名义喝一整夜，一整夜！

original: {Suspicious}I tell you, something stinks about this Monorail attack!
translation: {Suspicious}我跟你说，这次的单轨列车袭击事件肯定有问题！

original: {Vengeful}My buddies at McCarran will find the asshole that destroyed our Monorail.
translation: {Vengeful}麦卡伦的兄弟们肯定会揪出那个毁掉列车的杂种。

original: {Complicit}So, our President's savior is enjoying a well deserved R&R? Fine piece of work you are!
translation: {Complicit}哎哟，总统的大救星也来我们这个小地方休假了？您可真是好样儿的！

original: {Vengeful}Once I'm done here, I hope they assign me to find the son of a bitch that took down our President.
translation: {Vengeful}等我把这边的事办完，真希望他们会派我去揪出那个刺杀总统的杂种。

original: It's good to have the Khans on our side, but I hope they keep them out of the Strip. Those savages smell like Bighorner's ass.
translation: 虽说大汗帮与我们交好不是坏事，但我还是希望他们别来长街。那些野人闻起来就像大角羊屎那么臭。

original: {Surprised} I heard it got nasty at the Tops; wish I could've seen the shooting.
translation: {Surprised}听说九重天一片混乱；真希望我能亲眼看看那场枪战。

original: My buddies at Camp McCarran are breathing easy now that the Fiends' leader is dead.
translation: 恶魔帮的首领死了，麦卡伦营地的弟兄们总算可以松口气了。

original: {Celebratory}Without leadership, the Fiends are as good as dead!
translation: {Celebratory}没了首领，恶魔帮已经和死了没区别了！

original: {Surprise mixed with disgust}What's a mutant doing in the Strip?
translation: {Surprise mixed with disgust}变种人跑到长街来干什么？

original: {Surprise mixed with disgust}They let Ghouls into the Strip, now?
translation: {Surprise mixed with disgust}长街现在还放尸鬼进来了？

original: {Frowns}Hold up, you look new to Vegas - I'll keep it short: no weapons allowed in the casinos.
translation: {Frowns}等等，你是刚来维加斯吧——长话短说：赌场严禁携带武器。

original: Hand them over, you'll get them back when you leave.
translation: 交出来，你走的时候还给你。

original: Keep to the games, and there won't be any problems.
translation: 守规矩，就没问题。

original: Back for your gear? Here you go.
translation: 回来拿装备？给你。

original: Hey, there, friend, a bit of advice - you look like you could use some *protection.* {Beat, downnote, conspiratiorial}Lucky for you, I got what you need.
translation: 嘿，朋友，给你一个小建议——你看起来需要一些*防护措施*。{Beat, downnote, conspiratiorial}你很走运，我这儿恰好有卖。

original: My stock and trade? Alllll kinds of easy-to-hide weapons for slipping into and out of casinos, they won't give you a second glance.
translation: 你问我都卖些啥？凡是容易藏匿的、能通过赌场安检的武器我都卖，保证没人会看出来。

original: Heard the Dam finally got what's coming to it. Strange days ahead - and that's why it's best to face the day armed.
translation: 听说水坝的事情终于要收场了。难过的日子还在后头呢——所以才得抓紧时间挑把称手的武器啊。

original: Some crazy days on the Strip. Still... it's good for business.
translation: 长街这几天也真够疯狂的。不过……对生意有好处。

original: {Hey, potential customer, slightly hopeful}Back again? Need a weapon for an emergency, Mister Holdout's your guy.
translation: {Hey, potential customer, slightly hopeful}又回来了？如果急需武器，藏牌先生就是你要找的人。

original: Traveling into the Strip just got a lot easier now that the Fiends' leaders are dead.
translation: 恶魔帮的头目都死了，现在要去长街容易多了。

original: {Congratulatory}Stories of how you saved President Kimball are the talk of the Strip, friend!
translation: {Congratulatory}你拯救金博尔总统的故事都传遍长街啦，朋友！

original: {Resigned}If someone can blow up the Monorail, I guess we're not safe even in the Strip.
translation: {Resigned}如果有人能炸毁单轨列车，那我们就算在长街恐怕也不安全。

original: {Hopeful}Lady Luck's on your side. I hope some of that rubs off on me, Caesar killer!
translation: {Hopeful}幸运女神与你同在。希望我能沾你一点光，凯撒杀手！

original: {Determined}Now that you've killed that Caesar bastard, the Strip's really going to bloom!
translation: {Determined}既然你已经杀掉了凯撒那个混蛋，长街的未来肯定一片光明！

original: {Dumbfounded}Someone got Mr. House. The Strip's going to change, I'd bet on it.
translation: {Dumbfounded}有人干掉了豪斯先生。我敢打赌，长街要变天了。

original: {Apprehensive}After what happened to Mr. House, nobody knows for sure what's in play for the Strip.
translation: {Apprehensive}豪斯先生的事发生后，没人知道长街接下来还会有什么好戏。

original: {Dumbfounded}The tables turned for Mr. House. What next, huh?
translation: {Dumbfounded}风水轮流转，豪斯先生也遭殃了啊。下一个会是谁呢？

original: {Apprehensive}Looks like Mr. House run out of luck, huh?
translation: {Apprehensive}看来豪斯先生的运气到头了，嗯？

original: {Dismissive}Later, uh, whoever you are.
translation: {Dismissive}一会再说，呃，管你是谁呢。

original: {Dismissive}I don't talk to "nobodies," not when I'm having the time of my life!
translation: {Dismissive}我从来不跟"无名小卒"废话，尤其是我正在兴头上的时候！

original: {Dismissive}Sorry, I'm here to have a good time, not talk to random people.
translation: {Dismissive}对不起，我来这里是为了享乐的，不是和人聊天的。

original: Howdy, come try your luck? I hope's on your side.
translation: 你好啊，想来试试您的运气吗？我希望您手气不错。

original: {Joyful}That's a true friend of this wonderful place! Lady Luck shines on you.
translation: {Joyful}这位不是我们的好朋友嘛！幸运女神眷顾你。

original: One of New Vegas' finest! You are always welcome in the Strip.
translation: 新维加斯的大好人！长街永远欢迎您。

original: {Sincerely Excited}It's a pleasure to see you, friend! Best of luck during your stay.
translation: {Sincerely Excited}很高兴见到你，朋友!希望好运时刻伴随你。

original: {Slightly Disturbed}So, what do you want with me?
translation: {Slightly Disturbed}那么，你想要我干什么？

original: {Almost Defiant}I'm not scared of you. Give me a good reason to call the law and, I swear, you'll regret it.
translation: {Almost Defiant}我可不怕你。你对再动手动脚的，我就要叫人了，我发誓你会后悔的。

original: {Visibly Disturbed}Don't... do anything to me, okay?
translation: {Visibly Disturbed}不要……伤害我，好吗？

original: {Unsettled}Uh-oh, I'll call the Securitrons if you try anything crazy with me, understand?
translation: {Unsettled}啊哦，如果你想对我做出格的事，我会喊电子保安，明白了？

original: {Disgusted}What the hell do you want?
translation: {Disgusted}你到底想干什么？

original: {Agitated}Beat it, or I'll call the bots on you right quick.
translation: {Agitated}走开，不然我要喊机器人来了。

original: {Visibly Bothered}I'm not going to talk to you!
translation: {Visibly Bothered}我不想和你说话！

original: {Restrained}I swear, I could kill you right now and never look back.
translation: {Restrained}我发誓，我现在眼都不眨一下就能杀了你。

original: {Almost Violent}You better scram before I sic the entire Strip after you.
translation: {Almost Violent}在我干掉你之前你最好给我滚开。

original: {Suspicious}These bots now have eyes on their backs, I swear!
translation: {Suspicious}我敢肯定，现在这些机器人的背后也长了眼睛！

original: You're the talk of the day around the casino tables.
translation: 你可是赌桌上的话题人物啊。

original: {Cautionary}I'd not touch Gomorrah's machines until the dust settles.
translation: {Cautionary}尘埃落定之前，我可不会碰蛾摩拉的任何东西。

original: {Suspicious}I could smell something fishy going on at Gomorrah.
translation: {Suspicious}我敢说蛾摩拉里面肯定有猫腻。

original: I bet dirty business are going on at Gomorrah.
translation: 我敢打赌蛾摩拉现在正进行着什么肮脏的交易。

original: I bet dirty business are going on at Gomorrah.
translation: 我敢打赌蛾摩拉现在正进行着什么肮脏的交易。

original: Come on... time to get lucky.
translation: 拜托……也该行运了。

original: {Determined}Luck's about to change, I can feel it.
translation: {Determined}要转运了，我感觉到了。

original: {Pissed}Damn slots are robbery.
translation: {Pissed}这老虎机简直他妈的抢钱。

original: {Pleased}Send those chips my way.
translation: {Pleased}让我多赢点。

original: {Smug}Come to get fleeced like a Bighorner?
translation: {Smug}大角羊又来剪毛了？

original: Roulette, blackjack, slots... they have it all here.
translation: 轮盘，21点，老虎机……这里应有尽有。

original: Ready to try your luck?
translation: 准备好试手气了吗？

original: {Sizing the player up}Step up, let's see your game.
translation: {Sizing the 玩家 up}来吧，玩一把试试。

original: {Smiling}You look like you got the itch, friend.
translation: {Smiling}看样子你心痒了吧，朋友。

original: {Smiling}You want to gamble with class? Hit the Ultra-Luxe, if you don't mind being serviced by masked creeps.
translation: {Smiling}想玩得有格调一点？那就去奢华殿堂看看吧，只要你不介意他们家的人都是戴面具的怪人。

original: Watch the slots, they're robbery.
translation: 看看那老虎机，简直就是抢劫。

original: Wish I could've seen what's inside the 38.
translation: 真希望我能见识见识幸运38里面里面是什么样。

original: You've been making a name for yourself around here already.
translation: 你在这附近已经挺有名气了。

original: Did you hear? Gomorrah's under new management!
translation: 你听说了吗？蛾摩拉的管理层全换了！

original: {Helpful, then serious}You look new here - be careful of Gomorrah.
translation: {Helpful, then serious}你是新来的吧——小心蛾摩拉。

original: {Cautioning}Watch your caps - they go quick.
translation: {Cautioning}小心你的瓶盖——这里花钱如流水。

original: {Curious}Seeing the sights?
translation: {Curious}在看风景吗？

original: The Ultra-Luxe is fancy, but I get the shivers when I see their staff wearing masks.
translation: 奢华殿堂是很棒，但只要看见那些面具人，我就会掉一地鸡皮疙瘩。

original: Who would have thought a place like this would exist?
translation: 谁能想到世上居然还有这样的地方？

original: At this rate, one Securitron is going to be enough to defend the whole Strip.
translation: 照这个效率, 一个电子保安就足够保护整个长街了。

original: {Admiringly}Good to have you around!
translation: {Admiringly}有你在这儿真好！

original: {Admiringly}Thanks for helping us keep the Strip safe.
translation: {Admiringly}谢谢你帮助我们维护了长街的安定。

original: {Nods}Sir.
translation: {Nods}先生。

original: {Nods}Miss.
translation: {Nods}小姐。

original: {Nods}Ma'am.
translation: {Nods}女士。

original: {Nods}Pleasure.
translation: {Nods}乐意之至。

original: {Nods}An NCR welcome to you.
translation: {Nods}NCR欢迎您。

original: Help you?
translation: 要帮忙吗？

original: Welcome to Vegas - behave yourselves.
translation: 欢迎来到维加斯——请注意自己的言行。

original: If you're looking to join up, head on by the Embassy.
translation: 如果你想加入我们，请去大使馆。

original: Welcome to Vegas. {Beat, slightly threatening}Make your visit a peaceful one.
translation: 欢迎来到维加斯。{Beat，slightly threatening}别惹麻烦。

original: Monorail transit is safe transit.
translation: 单轨列车是一种安全的运输方式。

original: Report any suspicious activity near the Monorail.
translation: 如果你在单轨列车附近发现任何可疑情况，请及时报告。

original: No loitering.
translation: 请勿逗留。

original: Please enjoy the casinos.
translation: 祝您在赌场玩得愉快。

original: Please do not stand in the fountains.
translation: 请不要站在喷泉里。

original: No violence is permitted on the Strip.
translation: 长街禁止暴力行为。

original: Self-control is a virtue.
translation: 自律是一种美德。

original: Please obey all weapon laws.
translation: 请遵守所有的武器法规。

original: Continuing patrol.
translation: 继续巡逻。

original: Strip secure.
translation: 保卫长街。

original: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Area is off-limits, citizen.
translation: {Stern Warning，Deadpan}本区域禁止进入，市民。

original: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Return to the surface, citizen.
translation: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}立刻返回地面，市民。

original: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}Disobedience will be punished.
translation: {Stern Warning, Deadpan}违者将被严惩。

original: Look,{"friend" is said in a sarcastic, but serious, tone} "friend," don't get near me - you're too well respected for my business.
translation: 你看，{"friend" is said in a sarcastic, but serious, tone} "朋友，"你可以离我远一点——你这样好名声的人，和我的生意可不太搭。

original: Hey, think you can walk around here like nothing's happened?
translation: 嘿，你还真以为自己可以像个没事人一样在这儿瞎转悠？

original: See, my friends and I, we were kinda wondering if we should give you a good beating right now, or save it for when we catch you outside.
translation: 你看，我和我的朋友呢，正在商量是应该马上就把你暴打一顿呢，还是等我们到了外面再收拾你。

original: We don't like you Mojave scum, and we like you even less when you fuck with our Strip.
translation: 我们不喜欢你们这些莫哈维垃圾，更不喜欢你们在我们长街乱来。

original: So, you either pay up to walk around here, or we're gonna make you pay up. That clear?
translation: 所以，要么你自己乖乖把过路费交出来，要么我们帮你把过路费交出来。明白了吗？

original: You back again, huh? We missed you, we've been waiting for you. Bet you've missed us too.
translation: 你又回来了？我们可想你了，一直都在等你。你肯定也很想我们吧。

original: Fuck off, punk. And pray we don't hear about you doing crazy shit again.
translation: 滚开，废物。别让我们再看见你捣乱。

original: Fuck this. I'm out of here - let them deal with this crazy place.
translation: 去他妈的。我要走了——让他们去搞定这狗屎地方吧。

original: I can't believe I put up with this kind of crap.
translation: 真不敢相信我居然能容忍这种垃圾。

original: Hey, think you can walk around here like nothing's happened?
translation: 嘿，你还真以为自己可以像个没事人一样在这儿瞎转悠？

original: See, my friends and I, we were kinda wondering if we should give you a good beating right now, or save it for when we catch you outside.
translation: 你看，我和我的朋友呢，正在商量是应该马上就把你暴打一顿呢，还是等我们在外面抓到你了再说。

original: We don't like you Mojave scum, and we like you even less when you fuck with our Strip.
translation: 我们不喜欢你们这些莫哈维垃圾，更不喜欢你们在我们长街乱来。

original: So, you either pay up to walk around here, or we're gonna make you pay up. That clear?
translation: 所以，要么你自己乖乖把过路费交出来，要么我们帮你把过来费交出来。明白了吗？

original: You back again, huh? We missed you, we've been waiting for you. Bet you've missed us too.
translation: 你又回来了，嗯？我们可想你了，在这儿等了你很久。你肯定也很想我们吧。

original: Well, hello there. What a coincidence, finding you outside the Strip.
translation: 啊，你好，真巧啊，长街外面也能碰到你。

original: You should've paid your dues, but, no, you had to play hard, huh? Now it's our turn.
translation: 上次你就该乖乖交钱，不过算你走运把我们唬住了。现在该我们了。

original: Nobody fucks with the NCR and lives to brag about it. You're dead, punk!
translation: 和NCR作对的人都不会有好下场。你死定了，混蛋！

original: Mormon caravan from New Canaan came through the other day.
translation: 从新迦南来的摩门教商队前几天刚从这里经过。

original: The Crimson Caravan's the biggest merchant outfit in the wasteland.
translation: 深红商队是废土最大的商人组织。

original: Damn Brahmin crap everywhere.
translation: 到处都是他妈的双头牛屎。

original: I'm glad Ringo's back. Got a good story to tell, too.
translation: 很高兴林戈回来了。他一定有很多故事要说。

original: Fucking expensive to get into the Strip these days.
translation: 现在来一趟长街是真他妈贵。

original: Keep an eye out for wildlife.
translation: 小心野生动物。

original: When pay day hits, I'm off to the Strip. Can't wait.
translation: 等发了薪水，我就去长街。都等不及了。

original: McLafferty's been riding asses again. Better lay low.
translation: 麦克拉弗蒂又在发脾气了。最好躲着点吧。

original: McLafferty's a hard boss, but she knows what she's doing, that's for sure.
translation: 麦克拉弗蒂是个很难伺候的老板，但是她做事目标明确。

original: Guess Jamison won't be showing his face around here again. It's about time.
translation: 估计贾米森不敢再露面了。也该他倒霉。

original: Tough luck for Janet, huh? I know I'd hate to lose all that pay.
translation: 珍妮特真倒霉，对吧？我也很讨厌拿不到钱。

original: I've never heard of anyone breaking their contract and still getting their pay. Janet is damn lucky.
translation: 没想到违约的人还能拿到钱。珍妮特真他妈走运。

original: I'm heading to Gomorrah next time I get some time off.
translation: 等下次有空的时候我会去蛾摩拉的。

original: I sure hope I get to meet President Kimball.
translation: 我非常希望能见金博尔总统。

original: I wonder if the President will come this way again, he had kind of a close call I hear.
translation: 不知道总统还会不会来，听说他这次差点丧命。

original: The Legion would have to be insane to attack this place.
translation: 军团如果进攻这个地方，那他们肯定是疯了。

original: The sound of the generators is really quite calming.
translation: 发电机的声音让人安心。

original: Private Watson sure seemed excited about meeting Kimball.
translation: 列兵沃森见到了金博尔，他肯定非常激动。

original: I actually got to see the President.
translation: 我真的得去看看总统。

original: I hear President Kimball had a pretty close call with some assassins.
translation: 我听说金博尔总统差点就被刺杀了。

original: The death of the President is going to be a permanent blight on this place.
translation: 总统之死对这里的士气是毁灭性的打击。

original: If the President of our republic isn't safe here, how can we be?
translation: 连我们的总统在这里都不安全，更何况我们呢？

original: Kimball died, security seemed so tight, how could such a thing happen?
translation: 金博尔死了，可安保没有出问题啊，这到底是怎么回事？

original: President Kimball is going to arrive pretty soon to give his speech and meet that wounded soldier.
translation: 金博尔总统很快就到，他会进行演讲，并慰问伤兵。

original: How do we know if Mr. House is really gone? No one's ever seen him in the first place!
translation: 我们怎么知道豪斯先生是不是真死了？根本就没有人见过他！

original: Colonel Moore survived four tours against the Brotherhood back west. If anyone can help take on the Legion, it's her.
translation: 莫尔上校在西部的时候，曾经历过与兄弟会的四次大战。如果说还有谁能对付军团的话，那肯定就是她。

original: You hear that rumor that Colonel Moore was kicked out of Gomorrah a while back? I heard she's had it in for the Omertas ever since.
translation: 你听过莫尔上校前不久被蛾摩拉赶出来的传言吗？我听说从那以后她就和黑手党结下了梁子。

original: I'm really surprised Colonel Moore accepted the Brotherhood's help. I heard she lost a lot of men in war with them back west.
translation: 真不敢相信莫尔上校居然会接受兄弟会的帮助。要知道在西部的时候，她很多弟兄都死在兄弟会枪下。

original: Is it true? Was there really a Brotherhood base nearby that blew sky high?
translation: 真的吗？这附近真有一个兄弟会基地的废墟？

original: I heard a rumor that Moore hired some mercs to wipe out the Khans. Is that such a good idea, with Bitter Springs still on peoples' minds back home?
translation: 我听说莫尔雇了一些佣兵去剿灭大汗帮。但是苦泉的事大家都还没淡忘，这样做真的好吗？

original: Man, I'm exhausted. Moore's got us running drills non-stop.
translation: 老兄，我受够了。莫尔根本把不拿我们当人。

original: Just between us, Colonel Moore scares me sometimes.
translation: 别跟旁人说啊，我好几次都被莫尔上校吓到了。

original: Our victory was never in question.
translation: 我们早已胜券在握。

original: How did the Legion make it into the power plant?
translation: 军团怎么会进到发电厂里的？

original: Let's get going!
translation: 我们走！

original: Let's get to fighting! Now is not the time to talk!
translation: 准备战斗！没时间废话了！

original: I'm not sure I'll ever learn everything there is to know about this place.
translation: 我不知道还会在这里学到什么。

original: How do they keep the floor in here so clean?
translation: 这里的地板怎么会这么干净？

original: They should have used Paladins to help protect the President.
translation: 他们应该接受圣骑士去协助保护总统的。

original: If the NCR wasn't too proud to accept our assistance their president would still be alive.
translation: 要不是NCR如此自负，不愿接受我们的帮助，他们的总统也不会死。

original: The NCR is lucky we've chosen to side with them or we'd take the death of their President as a moment of weakness.
translation: 我们选择站在NCR这一边，他们应该感到幸运，否则总统的死正是趁虚而入的好机会。

original: We are here to help protect the dam, word is Oliver is on his way and the battle will start soon.
translation: 我们来这是帮助保护大坝的，有消息说奥利弗正在赶来，战斗马上就要开始了。

original: We're ready to deploy whenever the NCR says the word.
translation: 只要NCR发话，我们马上就展开部署。

original: The Brotherhood hasn't seen a real battle in so long, I have no doubt we'll handle this no problem.
translation: 兄弟会虽然久疏战阵，不过我觉得应付这场战斗还是没有问题的。

original: The NCR is going to be grateful to have us around when the shooting starts.
translation: NCR会庆幸这场战斗有我们帮忙。

original: The Elder sent us to help protect the dam and await further orders.
translation: 长老派我们来保护水坝，并等待进一步的指示。

original: Mike Lawson sure knows his way around the dam.
translation: 迈克·劳森当然对水坝周边情况很熟悉。

original: I'm honored to work with Lawson, he knows more about the dam than anyone.
translation: 我很荣幸能和劳森并肩作战，他比任何人都熟悉水坝。

original: Fantastic grabbed my ass. That guy is vile.
translation: 珍世邦居然拧我的屁股。那家伙真恶心。

original: I'm pretty sick of Fantastic, can't that guy keep his hands to himself?
translation: 我真受不了珍世邦，这家伙就不能管好自己的手吗？

original: Everyone is abuzz about Oliver arriving soon. That must mean the battle is close.
translation: 大家都说奥利弗马上就到。这肯定意味着大战将近。

original: Hanlon is pretty legendary, people talk about what he did at the first battle of hoover dam with awe and respect.
translation: 汉隆真是个传奇，大家说起他在第一次胡佛水坝之战中的表现时，都带着赞叹和尊重。

original: I miss California.
translation: 我好想念加利福尼亚。

original: By Mars these weaklings die easily.
translation: 战神在上，这些弱者不堪一击。

original: Don't get in my way!
translation: 别挡道！

original: Try to keep up, if you can.
translation: 尽量别掉队。

original: Now is the time for killing, not words!
translation: 现在是动手的时候，不要废话！

original: This was all too easy.
translation: 这太容易了。

original: I long to join my brethren in the power plant below. The fighting's probably fiercer there.
translation: 我渴望加入发电厂的战斗。肯定很激烈。

original: Our orders are to take and hold this section of the dam.
translation: 我们的任务是占领水坝的这片区域。

original: These men fight hard, and die well.
translation: 这些人勇猛作战，死得其所。

original: Ha ha, isn't it glorious?
translation: 哈哈，这不是很光荣吗？

original: These dogs are putting up a fight, I'll give them that.
translation: 这些狗还真能打，我必须承认。

original: The exterior is ours. The interior will fall soon.
translation: 我们已经拿下外围了。内部很快也会被攻克。

original: There's talk of much land and slaves going to the one who kills Oliver. If only I wasn't assigned here!
translation: 听说干掉奥利弗的人会得到大片土地和奴隶。如果我没被部署到这里就好了！

original: With the outside secured, the poor fools inside have nowhere to run.
translation: 我们已经从外面完成了包围，内部那些可怜的蠢货无处可逃了。

original: Oliver's head is as good as mine!
translation: 奥利弗可不比我笨！

original: Is it true the fighting outside has stopped already?
translation: 外面的战斗真的已经结束了吗？

original: Upstairs, or down? If I were a coward, where would I hide?
translation: 楼上，还是楼下？如果我是胆小鬼的话，我会躲在哪呢？

original: Make good use of cover. The time to strike is when they reload.
translation: 好好利用掩体。他们换弹夹的时候就是最好的进攻时机。

original: Their guns aren't quite as effective in these close quarters.
translation: 他们的武器在近距离作战时发挥不出最佳效果。

original: Soon this place will belong to the Legion.
translation: 这地方很快就会属于军团。

original: I've added eight notches to my belt already. How many for you?
translation: 我已经干掉八个了。你干掉了几个？

original: You must get to the control room and install the override chip.
translation: 你必须去控制室安装强制覆写芯片。

original: I will protect you.
translation: 我会保护你的。

original: I hope the Legion doesn't get in here.
translation: 希望军团别攻到这里来。

original: Sorry, but I'm busy with patients right now.
translation: 对不起，我现在得料理伤员。

original: Julie Farkas wasn't kidding when she said we would be needed here.
translation: 朱莉·法卡斯从不拿“这里需要我们”开玩笑。

original: All this bloodshed. Such a waste of human life.
translation: 流了这么多血。真是草菅人命。

original: Please don't hurt me!
translation: 请不要伤害我！

original: I'm just a medic! Please don't hurt me!
translation: 我只是个医疗兵！请别伤害我！

original: Maybe that guy Fantastic wasn't an idiot. Maybe he was a genius.
translation: 或许那个叫珍世邦的家伙根本就不是白痴。搞不好他其实是个天才。

original: Damn that was some light show out there.
translation: 那地方怎么他妈怎么亮。

original: That was blinding out there. Feels like I've been staring at the sun.
translation: 亮得我要瞎了。感觉就像是看到了太阳。

original: Is the plant actually working again?
translation: 发电厂真的恢复工作了吗？

original: I'm surprised they didn't send you somewhere more vital.
translation: 我很奇怪他们居然没把你派到更要紧的地方去。

original: Wow, what are you doing at HELIOS? I feel like I should salute.
translation: 哇哦，你怎么到太阳神一号来了？我觉得该给你敬个礼。

original: Hope you can stay. We could use your expertise here.
translation: 真希望你能留下来。我们很需要你的专长。

original: What'd you do wrong to get sent here? Thought you were an up-and-comer.
translation: 你做了什么坏事被发配到这儿了？我还以为你很有前途呢。

original: Are you supporting us here? We'll take what we can get.
translation: 你是来支援我们的吗？我们正好缺人手呢。

original: Welcome to HELIOS One.
translation: 欢迎来到太阳神一号。

original: The attacks have stopped. Winning the dam saved our asses.
translation: 攻势终于停了。大坝的胜利救了我们的命。

original: We lost Forlorn Hope. The eastern front is collapsing. They'll be here next.
translation: 我们失去了飘零希望营地。东部战线也在崩溃。他们很快就会打到这里来的。

original: Thank God we took back Nelson. Now they'll have a harder time hitting us here.
translation: 感谢上帝，我们夺回了纳尔逊。现在他们想进攻这里就更难了。

original: Heard the Brotherhood got smoked. Guess somebody finished what we started.
translation: 听说兄弟会已经死绝了。估计有人帮我们把屁股擦干净了。

original: With Caesar dead, maybe they'll stop attacking us.
translation: 凯撒死了，他们也许不会再攻击我们了。

original: This chainlink fence perimeter is worthless. We might as well be defending a cage from the inside.
translation: 周围的铁丝网根本就没用，真打起仗来，我们就和困在笼子里没两样。

original: This place is off-limits to civilians. You don't like it, take it up with Lieutenant Haggerty.
translation: 此地不许平民进入，你要是有意见，去找哈格蒂中尉。

original: The Legion's coming for us. Just a matter of time, believe you me.
translation: 军团正在朝我们这儿进发，到这儿只是时间问题，真的。

original: Pretty sure H.Q. has forgotten all about us.
translation: 我确信总部肯定是把我们全给忘了。

original: That scientist we hired has got to be the dumbest asshole I've ever come across.
translation: 我们雇的这个科学家是我见过的最蠢的傻逼。

original: Who knows which side the Legion's gonna hit us from next?
translation: 谁知道军团接下来会从哪边进攻我们呢？

original: If the Legion breaks through our defenses, I got one bullet I'm saving just for me.
