translation: 如果军团突破了我们的防线，我会为自己留一发子弹。

original: We should be up on the front lines, not out here in bumblefuck. This place is a junkyard.
translation: 我们应该去前线，而不是待在这狗屁地方。这地方就是个垃圾场。

original: We're supposed to be relieved any day. That's what they keep telling us. I don't think anyone's coming.
translation: 马上就有人来换班了，他们老是这么说。但我不觉得有谁会来。

original: Hey man, when in Rome.
translation: 嘿，老兄，入乡随俗。

original: I look so good in this shit, I want you to call me Fucking Spectacular from now on.
translation: 我穿这玩意还真好看，现在起你们都叫我酷帅绝伦吧。

original: Well look who it is! Fantastic's little helper, all grown up. Following in his master's footsteps.
translation: 瞧瞧这是谁啊！珍世邦的小帮手，现在都长大了，继承他师父的衣钵了。

original: Guess who got promoted to goddamn dam god? The cream always rises to the top, and Fantastic always rises to the top of the cream.
translation: 猜猜现在是谁是水坝的老大了？牛逼的人总能一鸣惊人，而珍世邦是牛逼中的牛逼。

original: What the fuck, man? Are you loco?
translation: 鸡巴干啥呢，老兄？你有病？

original: You just killed my paycheck.
translation: 你刚把付我薪水的人给杀了。

original: Who the hell are you? They bring you in to replace me? They're replacing me, aren't they?
translation: 你他妈是谁？他们带来代替我的人吗？他们要把我给撤了，是不是？

original: Yo.
translation: 哟。

original: This is a restricted area. State your business.
translation: 这里是管制区域。说明来意。

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: What have you done? Get away from me!
translation: 你干了什么？离我远点！

original: It's unusual to see a new face here. Are you a soldier, or a scientist?
translation: 这里很少看到新面孔。你是士兵，还是科学家？

original: Your organization will doom all of us.
translation: 你那个组织会毁了我们所有人。

original: What can I help you with?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: First Recon is holding Forlorn Hope now. What I wouldn't give for sniper support here.
translation: 第一侦察营正在防守飘零希望营地，所以我现在提供不了狙击支援。

original: We don't even need this place. But it sure scares the shit out of the NCR that we've got a base here.
translation: 其实我们根本不需要这里，但在这里设个基地，能把那些NCR的尿都吓出来。

original: The NCR left its soldiers here to die. Must be their strategy for the whole war.
translation: NCR把那些士兵留在这等死，肯定是出于全局战略的考虑。

original: It was only a matter of time before HELIOS fell to us.
translation: 我们重夺太阳神一号只是时间问题。

original: We will not lose this place again.
translation: 我们不会再丢掉这个地方了。

original: HELIOS One is safe in our hands and our hands alone.
translation: 太阳神一号在我们手上很安全，也只有在我们手上才会安全。

original: Under NCR control, this place was a gun in the hands of a child.
translation: 在NCR的控制下，这地方就像是小孩手里的枪。

original: It was such an honor to be here today. I'm so lucky.
translation: 今天能到这里真的很荣幸。我真的很幸运。

original: I'm too young to die!
translation: 我还年轻，不想死！

original: President Kimball is really well spoken.
translation: 金博尔总统讲得真好。

original: Not right now. President Kimball is giving his speech.
translation: 别说话。金博尔总统正演讲呢。

original: The Legion is attacking! Run for your lives!
translation: 军团打过来了！赶紧逃命吧！

original: Not now!
translation: 不是现在！

original: {Radio}Report.
translation: {Radio}报告。

original: {Radio}<Static>
translation: <静电>

original: I'll meet you on the observation deck.
translation: 我在观光台等你。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

original: You again. What is it?
translation: 又是你。有什么事？

original: We've got a lot to do to prepare for the President's visit and not much time.
translation: 总统要来视察，太多事情要准备，但我们时间太少。

original: Have you finished your security sweep?
translation: 你完成安全检查了吗？

original: Come back in a minute, I'm busy with security matters.
translation: 你过两分钟再来吧，我现在忙着处理安保问题呢。

original: Shouldn't you be keeping an eye out for anything suspicious?
translation: 你不是该去留心可疑情况吗？？

original: Good job today. We got the President out safe and sound and I couldn't have done it without you. You have my thanks.
translation: 今天干得漂亮。我们保证了总统的安全，要是光靠我一个人肯定办不到。谢谢。

original: Damnit! I can't believe the President is dead. It's all my fault!
translation: 该死！不敢相信总统居然死了。都是我的错！

original: Hey, I heard about you. What can I do for you, friend?
translation: 嘿，我听说过你。我能为你做点什么，朋友？

original: {gruff}What is it?
translation: {gruff}怎么了？

original: Is there a problem here?
translation: 有什么问题？

original: You again. What's your problem?
translation: 又是你。怎么了？

original: Do you mind?
translation: 你能让让吗？

original: You're cleared to go on through.
translation: 你可以通过了。

original: No one can go upstairs without authorization.
translation: 未经批准不得上楼。

original: {Condescending}Didn't expect Caesar to send a woman to do this job.
translation: {Condescending}没想到凯撒会派个娘们来做这件事。

original: Oh well, at least you're here now. {Joking}I was starting to get lonely out here by myself.
translation: 算了，反正你来了。{Joking}我一个人在这里也等得寂寞。

original: It's about time you showed up.
translation: 你也该出现了。

original: {Joking}I was starting to get lonely out here by myself.
translation: {Joking}我一个人在这都开始寂寞了。

original: Make it quick. We don't have much time.
translation: 快点。我们时间不多。

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: I still haven't found my lucky helmet yet.
translation: 我还没找到我的幸运头盔呢。

original: Thanks for finding my lucky helmet. It's my favorite!
translation: 谢谢你找到了我的幸运头盔。它是我的最爱！

original: Hey-o!
translation: 嘿——哟！

original: What are you doing up here?
translation: 你在这干什么？

original: Kind of busy up here.
translation: 这儿有点忙啊。

original: Hey, you haven't seen my friend around here, have you? His name is Ben and he's an engineer.
translation: 嘿，你见到我朋友没有？他叫本，是个工程师。

original: We were supposed to meet up so we can watch the President's speech together, but he hasn't shown up yet.
translation: 我们说好了在这见面，一起去看总统演讲的。但他到现在都没出现。

original: Leave me alone.
translation: 离我远点。

original: Still no luck finding my friend. He better show up soon.
translation: 我还没找到我的朋友。希望他能快点出现。

original: Do you mind?
translation: 你能让让吗？

original: We're a bit busy here.
translation: 我们现在有点忙。

original: Why don't you mind your own business.
translation: 你为什么不管好你自己的事呢。

original: Managing security on short notice is going to be tough. We'll have to keep the crowd small for the speech.
translation: 在接到通知这么短的时间里，把安保工作布置好实在太困难了。只能控制演讲现场的观众规模了。

original: It's unlikely that the Legion will try anything, but we'll be prepared for it anyway.
translation: 军团搞小动作的可能性不大，但我们也不能掉以轻心。

original: We'll keep civilian presence to a minimum. That should avoid any unnecessary risks.
translation: 我们要把到场的平民数量控制到最少。那样应该可以避免不必要的风险。

original: What the fuck just happened?
translation: 他妈的发生了什么事？

original: What is going on?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Quiet, I'm trying to listen to the speech.
translation: 安静，我在听演讲。

original: Shh! I want to hear what is going on.
translation: 嘘！我在认真听呢。

original: Leave me alone, I'm trying to pay attention.
translation: 别烦我，我在集中注意力。

original: I'm so excited about he President visiting. This is going to be great!
translation: 总统来视察让我非常兴奋。这真是伟大的一刻！

original: I'm looking forward to seeing the President.
translation: 我一直都期待能见到总统。

original: I'm just glad to have the day off for this.
translation: 今天能请到假真是太好了。

original: I wonder what President Kimball is going to talk about today.
translation: 不知道金博尔总统今天都会说些什么。

original: That was a great speech.
translation: 真是精彩的演讲。

original: That's a nice suit President Kimball had.
translation: 金博尔总统的西装真帅气。

original: I don't have time to talk right now.
translation: 我现在没时间闲聊。

original: We need to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
translation: 我们得留心任何可疑情况。

original: Nothing is going to happen to the President on my watch.
translation: 有我保护总统，不会发生任何事的。

original: Move along.
translation: 继续走。

original: You really saved our asses out there against the Legion. Thanks.
translation: 你从军团手里救了我们一命。谢谢。

original: I can't believe that President Kimball was attacked. I'm just relieved that nothing bad happened to him.
translation: 真不敢相信金博尔总统居然会遇袭。他没事我就放心了。

original: I can't believe President Kimball is dead. He was a great leader for the NCR.
translation: 真不敢相信金博尔总统死了。他是NCR的伟大领袖。

original: So you're the one that has been running errands for Colonel Moore. Do you need something?
translation: 原来你就是那个帮莫尔上校跑腿的那家伙。有什么事？

original: {Happy}Well look who it is! What can I do for you?
translation: {Happy}瞧瞧是谁来了！需要我做点什么？

original: Always nice to have a friend of the NCR around. What can I help you with?
translation: 能在这儿见到NCR的朋友可真好。有什么要帮忙的吗？

original: You better watch yourself around here. I'm not going to put up with any of your crazy shit.
translation: 你最好给我小心点。我可不会让你在这地方撒野。

original: {Wary}Something you need?
translation: {Wary}你想要什么？

original: You've got a lot of nerves being here. Maybe you should just leave instead.
translation: 你居然还敢露面，真是吃了豹子胆。你还是快走吧。

original: {Gruff}What do you want?
translation: {Gruff}你要干嘛？

original: I don't think you're in the right place. You looking for something?
translation: 我觉得你是来错地方了。你在找什么？

original: Is there something I can do for you?
translation: 你有什么事吗？

original: {Threatening}Back off.
translation: {Threatening}后退。

original: {Threatening}Watch it.
translation: {Threatening}小心点。

original: You should go talk to Blake or Alice, they handle most of our contact with visitors.
translation: 你应该去和布莱克或者爱丽丝谈谈，他们负责这里大部分与来访者相关的事务。

original: You should go talk to Blake or Alice, they handle most of our contact with visitors.
translation: 你应该去和布莱克或者爱丽丝谈谈，他们负责这里大部分与来访者相关的事务。

original: Hello again. How's your Boomer friend?
translation: 又见面了。你的大炮族朋友怎么样了？

original: Have you spoken with McLafferty yet?
translation: 你和麦克拉弗蒂谈过了吗？

original: {Angry}You tried to get me killed. Get the hell out of my face.
translation: {Angry}你是想害死我。从我面前滚开。

original: I'm on my way to meet that Boomer you told me about!
translation: 我正要去见你说的那个大炮族的人！

original: Thank you for getting me here. Jack is a great guy.
translation: 谢谢你带我到这儿。杰克是个好人。

original: Hey there! Here's the rest of the payment I promised you back in Goodsprings.
translation: 嗨！我在清泉镇许诺过要给你报酬的，这是剩下的那部分。

original: Hey there, friend.
translation: 嗨，朋友。

original: Welcome to the Crimson Caravan Company, New Vegas branch. What may I do for you?
translation: 欢迎来到深红商队公司新维加斯分部。我能为你做些什么？

original: Welcome back.
translation: 欢迎回来。

original: Shove off. You're making my luck turn bad.
translation: 滚开。你把我的运气都变糟了。

original: You again. What do you want now?
translation: 又是你。这次你又想干嘛？

original: If you're looking to buy or sell, you've come to the right man. The Crimson Caravan Company has the widest selection in the wasteland.
translation: 如果你想做买卖，那算是找对人了。深红商队公司，荟萃废土精品。

original: Hey there. You looking to buy or sell?
translation: 嘿。你是想做买卖吗？

original: I'm helping Doctor Henry with his experiment right now, dear. Come see me again in a bit.
translation: 我正帮亨利医生做实验呢，亲爱的。等会再来找我吧。

original: Jimmy? Little Jimmy - my, how you're grown up. So good of you to come visit your {gramma}grandma.
translation: 吉米？小吉米——天啊，你都长这么大了。你能来看望奶奶真是太好了。

original: My word, but that was a lot of chopping at that casino, dear.
translation: 我说，亲爱的，你刚在赌场里闹得也太凶了吧。

original: Naughty children run from their punishment, but we'll find Benny, won't we Leo?
translation: 坏小孩就该被打屁股，我们会找到本尼的。是吧，利奥？

original: Heavens to Betsy, but Mr. Benny met a nasty end. I hope you've realized, pumpkin, that crime doesn't pay.
translation: 我的老天哟，本尼先生终于得到了应有的惩罚。希望你能从他身上学到教训，小南瓜，恶有恶报。

original: My, but that Lucky 38 is a large building. And so fancy!
translation: 天啊，幸运38真够大的。真豪华！

original: Leo doesn't like that you left that House man alive, dearie. He thinks you should have let us chop him.
translation: 利奥不喜欢你让那个叫豪斯的家伙活着，小宝贝。他觉得我们应该剁了他。

original: You should have heard Leo, sweetie. He laughed and laughed when that old man in the box exploded.
translation: 你真该听听利奥的反应，小甜心。那个盒子里的老头爆炸时，他笑得可高兴了。

original: Leo thinks there will be lots more chopping to do now that Caesar is dead. I do hope you'll be careful, pumpkin.
translation: 利奥觉得，凯撒死了以后，咱们要砍的人就多了。小南瓜，希望你能小心点。

original: {Gramma}Grandma's so proud of her little pumpkin, rescuing the President like that!
translation: {Gramma}奶奶真骄傲，她的小南瓜救下了总统！

original: Now sweetie, if at first you don't succeed, try, try again. That goes for learning to ride bikes and killing Presidents!
translation: 小甜心，如果第一次没成功，那就再试一次。学骑单车是这样，杀总统也是这样！

original: {Gramma}Grandma's so proud of her little pumpkin, assassinating the President like that!
translation: {Gramma}奶奶真骄傲，她的小南瓜利落地干掉了总统！

original: Leo's very grumpy, pumpkin. He wanted to chop the President!
translation: 利奥发飙了，小南瓜。他想要剁了总统！

original: Look at you, sweetness! Blowing up a robot army all by yourself, isn't that precious?
translation: 瞧瞧你啊，甜心！你一个人就把整支机器人大军都炸翻了，多了不起啊？

original: {Gramma}Grandma's so worried about her little baby! It's getting dangerous out there in the Wasteland!
translation: {Gramma}奶奶太担心她的小宝贝了！废土越来越危险了！

original: Leo's getting more and more agitated, sweetie. I think he can smell the fight coming.
translation: 利奥越来越焦躁了，小甜心。我猜他是感觉到大战要来临了。

original: I hope you're not thinking about rushing off to that big dam, pumpkin! It's sure to be very dangerous!
translation: 希望你没打算跑到那座大坝上去，小南瓜！那里太危险了！

original: {not a follower}Hello again, dear.
translation: {not a follower}又见面了，亲爱的。

original: {follower}Hello again, dear.
translation: {follower}又见面了，亲爱的。

original: Well howdy, pardner! Good to see ya again. Boss is waiting for ya upstairs, so get a move on!
translation: 你好啊，朋友！再次看到你真是太好了。老板正在楼上等你呢，快上去吧！

original: Howdy, pardner! Doesn't look like you've brought back the Platinum Chip!
translation: 你好啊，朋友！好像你还没把白金筹码带回来啊！

original: Why don't you mosey on back to wherever it is you left Benny cooling off? Come back when you got it.
translation: 你为何不再去本尼的尸体旁仔细搜一遍呢？等你找到了再回来吧。

original: Sorry, pardner, but the boss ain't available to take a meeting!
translation: 抱歉，伙计，老板现在不见客！

original: Howdy, pardner! Good to see you again!
translation: 你好啊，伙计！很高兴再见到你！

original: Congratulations, pardner! The boss has instructed me to comp you to the High-Roller Suite!
translation: 祝贺你，伙计！老板已经跟我打过招呼了，你可以免费入住高档套房！

original: You can bring your friends, too! Be like a little clubhouse for the gang you put together!
translation: 你也可以带你的朋友来！就把它当成你们的小型聚会场所吧！

original: Just bear in mind, you're the only one gets to see the boss! Any friends you got, they can wait in the suite.
translation: 但是记住，只有你可以见老板！如果你带朋友来，可以让他们先在房间里等。

original: Enjoy the digs, pardner! They're plenty fancy!
translation: 好好享受吧，伙计！这套房绝对够梦幻！

original: What floor, pardner?
translation: 去几楼，伙计？

original: Where to, pardner?
translation: 去哪儿，伙计？

original: Which floor, now?
translation: 现在要去几楼？

original: {announcing elevator stops}Penthouse floor!
translation: {announcing elevator stops}顶楼！

original: {announcing elevator stops}Cocktail lounge!
translation: {announcing elevator stops}餐厅！

original: {announcing elevator stops}High-roller suite!
translation: {announcing elevator stops}高档套房！

original: {announcing elevator stops}Casino floor!
translation: {announcing elevator stops}赌场！

original: {announcing elevator stops}B2! Physical Plant!
translation: {announcing elevator stops}B2！机械工厂！

original: {announcing elevator stops}B2! Facilities Management!
translation: {announcing elevator stops}B2！设施管理区！

original: {player trying to go to penthouse with companions}Sorry, pardner, if you're heading for the penthouse, you gotta go alone.
translation: {player trying to go to penthouse with companions}对不起，伙计，你要去顶楼的话，只能自己去。

original: {attacking player who has betrayed House}You low-down snake! I wish {Ida}I'd have left you in the ground to rot!
translation: {attacking player who has betrayed House}你这条卑鄙的毒蛇！我当初就该让你烂在土里！

original: {starting attack}Draw!
translation: {starting attack}掏枪吧！

original: A pleasure to meet you! I'm Dr. Thomas Hildern, Director of Operations, OSI East. I presume you're here about Vault 22?
translation: 很高兴见到你！我是托马斯·希尔丹博士，东部科工部的项目总管。我想你来这是为了22号避难所的事吧？

original: We spoke earlier, didn't we? About Vault 22. My offer still stands, if you've changed your mind.
translation: 我们之前谈过22号避难所，对吧？如果你改变主意，这份工作我依旧给你留着。

original: We still need a contractor on our Vault 22 project. Interested?
translation: 我们依然在为22号避难所项目寻找合作伙伴。你感兴趣吗？

original: Yes? Something else you needed?
translation: 嗯？你还有什么事？

original: I received a pleasant call from Dr. Keely. It seems we have you to thank for keeping her alive. Very charitable of you.
translation: 我刚接到了一通来自基利博士热情洋溢的电话。看来我们得谢谢你让她活了下来。你可真是善良哟。

original: Ah! I was just wondering what had become of you.
translation: 啊！我还在想你怎样了呢。

original: What do you want? I thought I told you to stay the hell out of here.
translation: 你想干嘛？我记得我说过让你别靠近这里。

original: What are you doing in my office? You're not welcome here, get out!
translation: 你在我的办公室里干什么？这里不欢迎你，出去！

original: Did Dr. Hildern... this really isn't any of my business, but... did he give you a job?
translation: 希尔丹博士有没有……我知道我有些多管闲事，但是……他有没有给你事做？

original: Little busy at the moment. But I can talk.
translation: 我现在有些忙，不过还是能聊两句。

original: If you can find Keely and keep her safe, I'll pay you what I can. I gave my word, and I meant it.
translation: 如果你能找到基利并且保证她的安全，我会尽我所能报答你。说话算话。

original: Keely just called in. You should have heard the Director. "But I-" "Wait a-" "Now look here-"
translation: 基利刚刚打电话来了。你真该听听总管是怎么说的："但是我——""等等——""听我说——"

original: She wouldn't let him finish a sentence. Just reamed him out for sending all those people to the Vault. I've never seen his face so red and twitchy.
translation: 她连一句完整的话都没让他说完，反倒是他骂得狗血淋头，因为他派了那么多人去避难所。我从没见过他脸红成那样，整张脸都扭曲了。

original: Thanks for keeping her safe. Here's the caps I promised. I knew I had a good feeling about you.
translation: 谢谢你救了她。这是我答应给你的瓶盖。我就知道我没看错你。

original: Did you find Keely? You haven't been back for a while, so I was hoping...
translation: 你找到基利了吗？ 你有段时间没有回来了，所以我想……

original: Oh! Good to see you again.
translation: 噢！再次见到你真是太高兴了。

original: Unless I hear from Keely, we've got nothing to talk about.
translation: 除非我听到基利的消息，否则我们没什么可说的。

original: Keely still hasn't checked in. It's not like her...
translation: 基利还是没有任何动静。这不像是她的作风……

original: After what happened with Keely, Hildern's got his eye on me. We shouldn't be talking... not anymore.
translation: 基利出事以后，希尔丹就一直盯着我。我们真的不能……再说话了。

original: You're new? I'm Angela. Williams. Were you just looking around, or...
translation: 你是新来的？我是安吉拉·威廉姆斯。你是随便逛逛呢，还是……

original: Took your sweet time. I suppose the NCR sent you?
translation: 动作可真慢啊。是NCR派你来的吧？

original: Not now! I've got to get up to the lab and finish what I started!
translation: 先别烦我！我得上实验室去解决我自己搞出来的事！

original: This Vault-Tech machinery is so fragile. I had to jury-rig this elevator a few days ago and it's on the fritz again already.
translation: 这些避难所科技的机器太容易坏了。几天前我才把这电梯勉强修好，现在它又坏了。

original: Ah, that's got it. See you upstairs.
translation: 啊，搞定了。楼上见。

original: Hm, what's this? Did you do these repairs? Not bad. Not bad at all.
translation: 嗯，这是什么？这是你修的？不错嘛。应该说非常好。

original: Saves me time, I guess. See you upstairs.
translation: 省了我不少时间。楼上见。

original: Good, you're here. Ready to begin?
translation: 很好，你到了。准备开始了吗？

original: I suppose you have questions. Hurry up and ask them.
translation: 我想你肯定有疑问。快点儿，有问题就赶紧问。

original: Ah, good. You survived. I was beginning to think you hadn't. You'll be pleased to know that the spores should no longer be a problem.
translation: 啊，很好。你活了下来。我还在想你没准活不成了。我得告诉你个好消息，孢子问题终于解决了。

original: Now all that's left is to ensure that none of this ever happens again. The research that led to these abominations must be erased.
translation: 剩下要做的就是杜绝这种事再次发生。所以引发这次事故的所有研究资料都必须销毁。

original: Don't mind me. I have to wrap things up here, gather my gear, that sort of thing. I'll be leaving soon enough.
translation: 别在意我。我还得整理一下行装，处理一些别的事宜。很快就会动身的。

original: Greetings! I do not believe we have met before. I have the singular distinction of being designated as Bohr.
translation: 你好！我相信这是我们初次见面。我的人格识别系统已将我的姓名指定为波尔。

original: Calculating...
translation: 计算中……

original: Ah, the outsider who gained our master's favor. You prove yourself as cunning as the rumors report.
translation: 啊，获得主人青睐的外来者。你确实和流言里说的一样狡猾。

original: I cannot speak long, for my men need direction. What do you want?
translation: 我不能和你聊太久，因为我的人还需要指挥。你有什么事？

original: The legate is expecting you.
translation: 特使正在等你。

original: It is important that you go see the legate.
translation: 你必须尽快去见特使。

original: The legate would have my head if I were to let you pass.
translation: 如果我放你过去的话，特使会要了我的命。

original: Soon, my lovelies. Soon you'll get all the meat you can handle.
translation: 快了，乖孩子们。很快你们就会有吃不完的肉。

original: I haven't fed them in days. The legate wants them hungry for the battle to come.
translation: 我已经好几天没有给它们喂吃的了。为了即将到来的战斗，特使希望它们饿着。

original: Some fool asked me the other day what mongrel meat tastes like. I told him I'd sooner feed him to my dogs than the other way around.
translation: 那天有个白痴问我杂交犬的肉吃起来是什么味道。我告诉他，我更乐意让杂交犬尝尝他的肉是什么味道。

original: The enemy is weak up close, so I must learn to kill quickly at that quarter.
translation: 我们的敌人不擅肉搏，所以我必须学会在近处一击取胜。

original: When attacking with a blade, aim for the meat of the opponent. Tendons and muscle are no good to a man when severed.
translation: 用刃器攻击时，要瞄准对手的肌肉。一旦人的肌腱或肌肉被砍伤，就会失去战斗力。

original: When attacking with a blunt weapon, aim for the opponent's bones. Hips, joints, and especially the skull are all viable targets.
translation: 当使用钝器攻击时，要瞄准对手的骨头。髋部，关节，特别是头骨都是可选的目标。

original: A sharp knife can make the difference between a clean kill and a messy death.
translation: 一把锋利的匕首可以让你干净利落地杀掉敌人。

original: It's amazing how dull a blade can get just by passing through slave meat.
translation: 你想象不到拿来砍奴隶的刀刃已经钝成什么样子了。

original: I must have all of these blades sharpened soon. Rumor is we head out any time now.
translation: 我必须马上把这些剑打磨好。有传闻说我们随时都可能出发。

original: Our men are stronger, faster, and have wills of iron. How can we lose?
translation: 我们的人更强壮，速度更快，还拥有钢铁般的意志。怎么会输？

original: I'm a little busy at the moment.
translation: 我现在有点忙。

original: When will we receive the order to march? I'll go crazy if I don't kill something soon.
translation: 我们什么时候才会进军？要是再不杀点人解闷，我会疯的。

original: We will see that the camp is protected from NCR assassins.
translation: 我们一定会保护这座营地免遭NCR刺客的袭击。

original: The battle is already decided. All that's left is the bloodletting.
translation: 胜局已定。剩下的就是流血了。

original: Mars be with you.
translation: 愿战神与你同在。

original: Salve, Courier. How goes the battle in the east?
translation: 你好，邮差。东边的战斗进展如何？

original: My orders are to remain here, and direct our men as they arrive. Go!
translation: 我接到的命令就是留守在这儿，等我们的人抵达时指引他们。走吧！

original: {Hated}Fuck off.
translation: {Hated}给老子滚远点。

original: Who the hell are you? I know you weren't one of the inmates.
translation: 你他妈是谁？我知道你不是囚犯。

original: What the fuck have you done? We needed that sulfur!
translation: 你他妈在干什么？我们需要那些硫磺！

original: Have you wiped out those geckos yet?
translation: 你把那些大蜥蜴消灭干净了吗？

original: Anything from Papa Khan?
translation: 父汗回话了吗？

original: {Liked}Good to see you.
translation: {Liked}见到你很高兴。

original: Yeah? What do you want now?
translation: 嗯？你现在想要什么？

original: {Kimball dead}Somebody whacked the NCR president. Got what was coming to him.
translation: {Kimball dead}有人除掉了NCR的总统。他终于遭报应了。

original: {Caesar dead}Someone took out the Legion's boss. Doubt it'll stop them for long, though.
translation: {Caesar dead}有人干掉了军团的老大。但我认为这并不会延缓他们扩张的脚步。

original: {Middle Game}Lot more troops on the road these days. Wonder what's up.
translation: {Middle Game}最近往来的部队增加了不少，不知发生了什么事情。

original: {Late Game}Best to lay low. The NCR and the Legion are about to have it out.
translation: {Late Game}最好低调点。NCR和军团的大战一触即发。

original: {Hated}Fuck you.
translation: {Hated}去你妈的。

original: You're not one of us. What do you want?
translation: 你不是我们的人。你想干什么？

original: I sure hope that explosion was you. Did you seal off the sulfur?
translation: 我真希望爆炸是你干的，硫磺都封起来没有？

original: I guess... I guess that means we can turn ourselves in now.
translation: 我猜……我猜这意味这我们现在可以去自首了。

original: You're back.  What's the word from Papa Khan?
translation: 你回来了，从父汗那里带回了什么消息？

original: {Liked}You're back.
translation: {Liked}你回来了。

original: Yeah, what do you want?
translation: 是的，你想要什么？

original: {Kimball dead}Somebody whacked the NCR president. Got what was coming to him.
translation: {Kimball dead}有人除掉了NCR的总统。他终于遭报应了。

original: {Caesar dead}Someone took out the Legion's boss. Doubt it'll stop them for long, though.
translation: {Caesar dead}有人干掉了军团的老大。但我认为这并不会延缓他们扩张的脚步。

original: {Middle Game}Lot more troops on the road these days. Wonder what's up.
translation: {Middle Game}最近往来的部队增加了不少，不知发生了什么事情。

original: {Late Game}Best to lay low. The NCR and the Legion are about to have it out.
translation: {Late Game}最好低调点。NCR和军团的大战一触即发。

original: Welcome, child! Took your sweet time getting here, didn't you?
translation: 欢迎，孩子！你肯定花了不少力气才来到这里，对吧？

original: I've been waiting a good five years for an outsider to come along and visit!
translation: 这五年来我一直都在等着能有一位外来者到访！

original: How is your visit with us going, stranger?
translation: 参观感觉如何啊，陌生人？

original: You have done well to earn the trust of my people, child.
translation: 你的贡献使你赢得了我们人民的信任，孩子。

original: Hello, friend. How can Mother Pearl be of help today?
translation: 你好，朋友。不知珀尔妈妈能帮你做点什么？

original: So you're the outsider. Lived your whole life out there, huh? Wow.
translation: 你就是那个外来者。你一辈子都在外面生活，是吗？哇哦。

original: I always thought you savages probably spoke a different language, but I hear you sound like us.
translation: 我一直以为你们野蛮人说的话和我们不一样，不过我听你说话和我们也没什么差别。

original: Thank you for getting Janet to Nellis. I've never been so happy in my entire life!
translation: 谢谢你把珍妮特带到内利斯。我这辈子都没这么高兴过！

original: This has been a dream come true to work on the Lady. I don't think I've seen Loyal this frisky in years.{test}
translation: 能够再见到淑女，简直是美梦成真。我已经很多年没有见到罗亚尔这样手舞足蹈了。{test}

original: I've never been so happy in my entire life!
translation: 我这辈子都没这么高兴过！

original: Have you seen her? The redhead of my dreams?
translation: 你见到她了吗？我梦中的那位红发女郎？

original: Hi! I can't believe I'm going to meet my red-headed lady soon! I'm really nervous about it!
translation: 嗨！真不敢相信我马上就要见到红发女郎了！我现在还真有点紧张！

original: {Player responsible for the death of his love}Go to hell, outsider. Stay away from me.
translation: {Player responsible for the death of his love}去死吧，外来者。离我远点儿。

original: You're a terrible person! I loved her! And you let her run right into our killzone. Why didn't you stop her?
translation: 你这该死的东西！我爱她！而你居然眼睁睁地看着她去送死。你为什么没有阻止她？

original: Hey there. Back for more?
translation: 你好。又回来了？

original: Whoa there, pal. You better slow down, or you'll get blown up like the rest of the idiots who thought they'd scavenge in Boomer territory.
translation: 噢，老兄。你最好走慢点，不然你就会像其他试图闯进大炮族领地的白痴一样被炸个稀烂。

original: Now that I've got your attention, might you be interested in a little information? It'll cost you, but it's well worth the investment.
translation: 既然你愿意听我说话，那需不需要我帮你支个招？虽然可能花点钱，但绝对物超所值。

original: Welcome back. Have you reconsidered my offer?{test}
translation: 欢迎回来。你考虑过我开的条件了吗？{test}

original: I told you what you need to know. Now get moving!
translation: 我已经告诉你注意事项了。现在去吧！

original: Jumpin' Jesus on a pogo stick! You're the first one to make it through alive, let alone manage a return trip!
translation: 真是活见鬼！你是第一个活着穿过轰炸区的人，更别说还原路返回了！

original: That was pretty incredible. I've never seen anyone come out of the Boomer's rain of death alive before.{test}
translation: 真是相当不得了。我以前从没见过有人能从大炮族的火力压制下活着走出来。

original: Hey there lady! Can you help me find Mister Cuddles?
translation: 你好，女士！你能帮我找抱抱先生吗？

original: Hey there mister! Can you help me find Mister Cuddles?
translation: 你好，先生！你能帮我找抱抱先生吗？

original: Hi again! Have you found Mister Cuddles?
translation: 嗨！你找到抱抱先生了吗？

original: Thanks again for finding Mister Cuddles! You're the best!
translation: 再次感谢你找回了抱抱先生！你是最棒的！

original: I can't believe Mister Cuddles is gone.
translation: 我不信抱抱先生不见了。

original: Pearl sent word saying it's all right to tell you about the Lady in the water.
translation: 珀尔让我给你带个话，她说现在可以告诉你关于水中淑女的事情了。

original: Isn't that bomber a beauty? Thanks so much for making an old man's dreams come true.
translation: 那架轰炸机真是个美人啊，真的非常感谢你让一个老头梦想成真。

original: It's going to be a dream come true once you've raised that bomber from Lake Mead!
translation: 如果你能把轰炸机从米德湖里捞出来，那才真是梦想成真！

original: Good work with those solar arrays.
translation: 感谢你修好了太阳能阵列。

original: I hope Pearl knows what she's doing, letting you wander around Nellis as you please.
translation: 真不知道珀尔在做什么，居然会允许你随心所欲地在内利斯乱逛。

original: What is it, Outsider?
translation: 怎么了，外来者？

original: {fall-through greeting, friendly}Hello, Outsider, need something?
translation: {fall-through greeting，friendly}你好，外来者，需要点儿什么？

original: {to the sentry}I'll take this from here!
translation: {to the sentry}交给我吧。

original: {to player, commanding}I'm Raquel, Master-At-Arms for the Nellis homeland. Mother Pearl, our Eldest, wishes to speak to you.
translation: {to player，commanding}我叫拉奎尔，是内利斯基地的警卫长。珀尔妈妈，我们的长者，想要和你谈谈。

original: Hello, friend. {player raised the B-29 and delivered it to Nellis}
translation: 你好，朋友。{player raised the B-29 and delivered it to Nellis}

original: Mother Pearl's instructions are clear. You can move freely around Nellis, and artillery spotters have orders not to fire on you.
translation: 珀尔妈妈的指示我们已经清楚了。你可以在内利斯自由走动，炮手们都已受命不会朝你开火。

original: These are extraordinary privileges. Don't abuse them.
translation: 以上可是特权。请不要滥用。

original: What is it, savage?
translation: 怎么了，野蛮人？

original: What's the situation with the giant ants?
translation: 蚂蚁的事进展如何？

original: I see the power's back on. The ants are all dead?
translation: 电力又恢复了。那些蚂蚁都死了？

original: What is it, Outsider?
translation: 怎么了，外来者？

original: I know Mother Pearl is letting you wander Nellis as you please, Outsider, but I have patients to tend to.
translation: 我知道珀尔妈妈允许你在内利斯自由行走，外来者，但我还有病人要照顾。

original: If I haven't said it before, Outsider, let me say it now - welcome to Nellis. Word from Pearl is that you're to be greeted as a friend.
translation: 也许我之前有些疏于礼节了，外来者，现在请允许我对你说——欢迎来到内利斯。珀尔已经交代过了，你将得到礼遇。

original: You raised the Lady from the Lake! The future is looking up. How can I help you, Outsider?
translation: 你把淑女从湖里捞起来了！未来总算有盼头了。我能为你做点什么呢，外来者？

original: Yes, Outsider?
translation: 什么事，外来者？

original: Woah! You're the outsider! What are you doing here?
translation: 哇！你就是那个外来者！你在这干嘛？

original: Hey! Do they have any toys outside of here? I sure could use something fun.
translation: 嘿。外面有没有玩具？我肯定有些很有意思的东西。

original: Roar! {Roars like a dinosaur}I'm a dinosaur!
translation: 嗷！{Roars like a dinosaur}我是恐龙！

original: This is mission control, ready for liftoff. What's your 5 by 5?
translation: 控制中心呼叫，准予起飞。你准备好了吗？

original: Halt! You must pay the toll to pass!
translation: 站住！你要付了过路费才能通过！

original: Put up your dukes! I'm the Red-Brick Kid!
translation: 把手举起来！我是红砖小子！

original: I am La Fantoma! I will fly to the side of injustice!
translation: 我是夜魔侠！我将随时降临到恶人的身边！

original: You're back. When you walked off in the middle of our people's story, I thought you must be bored.
translation: 你回来了。故事说到一半你就走了，我还以为你肯定是厌倦了。

original: You killed Mother Pearl! Get out of here, outsider!
translation: 你杀了珀尔妈妈！快滚蛋，外来者！

original: You killed Loyal! Get out of here, outsider!
translation: 你杀了罗亚尔！快滚蛋，外来者！

original: You're the outsider! Mother Pearl sent word that you'd be stopping by. You must be eager to hear the story of our people!
translation: 你就是那个外来者！珀尔妈妈说过你可能会来找我。你肯定很想听我们的故事！

original: I heard about what you've done around here, and I have nothing to say to you, outsider.
translation: 我听说过你的事迹了，我没什么好和你说的，外来者。

original: People around here are a bit upset with you, outsider, but I think there is hope for you yet.
translation: 附近的人并不乐于见到你，外来者，但我觉得你也不是完全没希望。

original: I've seen the bomber! It's... spectacular. The mural is coming true - thanks to you!
translation: 我见过那架轰炸机！它……很壮观。壁画里的内容正在渐渐成真——谢谢你！

original: Were you interested in hearing the story of our people any time soon, perhaps?
translation: 也许你会有兴趣听一听我们的故事？

original: Now that you know the story of our people, you must have all sorts of questions!
translation: 现在你知道我们的故事了，你肯定有一肚子的问题想问吧！

original: How can I help you, Outsider?
translation: 有什么可以帮助你的，外来者？

original: Hold it right there! Don't you move!
translation: 站住！不要动！

original: How the hell did you survive that bombardment?
translation: 你他妈怎么从炮击里活下来的？

original: I still can't believe how you ran through that artillery barrage.
translation: 我还是不相信你居然能穿越火力网。

original: Yes, Outsider?
translation: 什么事，外来者？

original: You're interrupting class, Outsider.
translation: 你影响到我们上课了，外来者。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Hungry for grub?
translation: 肚子饿了？

original: I've lost all respect for you.
translation: 我对你的敬意已经荡然无存。

original: If you're an enemy of the NCR, you're an enemy of mine. Get out of my sight.
translation: NCR的敌人就是我的敌人。滚出我的视线。

original: Goddamn it! Don't sneak up on me like that. What do you want?
translation: 该死的！别这么偷偷摸摸地靠近我。你想干什么？

original: Hey. You. You wandered into town recently, right?
translation: 嘿，你。你是刚来镇上的吧？

original: Get the hell away! We're done talking.
translation: 滚你娘的！我们没什么好说的了。

original: You shouldn't be here. If people know we talked, they'll suspect you.
translation: 你不该来这儿的。如果被别人知道我们说过话，他们肯定会怀疑你。

original: And if whoever did this smells a rat, they'll have the Legion after both of us.
translation: 而且要是让那个凶手发现了，他们肯定会派军团来追杀我们的。

original: That's it, then. How did you know?
translation: 行了，搞定了。你是怎么知道的？

original: If there's one thing I won't tolerate, it's working with some dog of the Legion. You've got some explaining to do.
translation: 这世上有件事我最不能忍，就是和军团狗腿子一起共事。你给我解释清楚。

original: I told you I wouldn't work against the NCR. I meant it.
translation: 我跟你说了我不会和NCR作对。我是认真的。

original: I'm out of here.
translation: 我要走了。

original: Still helping the Legion. You're gonna get what's coming to you. I promise you that.
translation: 你还在帮军团做事。我敢打包票，你不会落得什么好下场的。

original: We're through working together.
translation: 我们不会再一起共事了。

original: Look, I know the NCR has problems, but I fought with those men. I'll be damned before I betray them.
translation: 听着，我也知道NCR有不少问题，但我曾和他们并肩战斗。我如果背叛了他们，肯定会遭报应的。

original: This stops right now.
translation: 马上停手。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: No offense, but I need to focus on getting more rest when I'm off duty. I'm not sleeping so good. So now's not a good time.
translation: 我没别的意思，但我需要在不当班的时候好好休息。我睡得不好。所以现在不是聊天的时候。

original: If you want to talk, catch me when I'm on duty. I'm up in the dinosaur after 9 pm.
translation: 如果你真有话要说，那就等我当班的时候来找我吧。我晚上9点以后都在恐龙嘴里执勤。

original: Nice of you to show up.
translation: 见到你真好。

original: Is it time?
translation: 是时候了吗？

original: Let's get out of this first.
translation: 让我们先把这事解决了。

original: We take this boat, it's probably the last one we ever take.
translation: 如果我们搭这条船，搞不好这就是我们搭的最后一条船了。

original: I'm ready for that. Are you?
translation: 我准备好了，你呢？

original: We're near a Legion slave camp now. I've... been here before.
translation: 我们现在接近一个军团奴隶营地了。我……来过这里。

original: Let's get one thing straight. I see any crimson, I'm taking the shot. You don't like that, you're on your own.
translation: 我先声明，只要我看见一丁点红色，就立马开枪。你不喜欢，那我们一拍两散。

original: We're getting close to Nelson. Any closer, I'm shooting any legionary I see. Hope that's not a problem.
translation: 我们快到纳尔逊了。如果继续前进，那我只要看到军团士兵就会马上开火。希望你不会有意见。

original: Huh. We made it through after all. Not sure what to make of that.
translation: 呵。我们终于做到了。我也不知道是怎么做到的。

original: Mercy killing is expected of NCR snipers. The Legion likes to torture their prisoners within sight of NCR positions.
translation: 替人解脱是NCR狙击手的职责之一。军团喜欢当着NCR士兵们的面折磨战俘。

original: We get called on to end it. I've had my share. Some of them, you think, maybe you could've gotten them out.
translation: 我们会被找来结束他们的痛苦。我也干过这种活。有时我不禁会想，其中有几个或许还能救得下来。

original: Maybe it's not the Legion that got them killed. Maybe it's your orders and you following them.
translation: 也许杀死他们的并不是军团，而是上级的命令，以及你的言听计从。

original: Caesar's dead. Bet he didn't see this coming when he was having his coffee this morning.
translation: 凯撒死了。他今天早上喝咖啡的时候肯定没想过会有这样的下场。

original: Still. It's not gonna stop the Legion. Might not even slow them down.
translation: 但是，这并不会阻止军团的扩张。甚至可能连放慢脚步都办不到。

original: Pisses me off that Legion slavers can just operate on NCR turf like that.
translation: 军团的奴隶贩子在NCR的地盘上还敢那么明目张胆，真是气死我了。

original: If we hadn't caught up to them they'd probably have had a clear path to the river. No one to stop them.
translation: 如果我们没追上他们，他们搞不好已经轻松抵达河对岸了。这一路上都没人阻止他们。

original: There should be patrols. Checkpoints. We got greedy, overstretched. Now our own territory isn't secure.
translation: 本来是应该有巡逻队和哨站的。我们太贪心，把战线拉得太长，结果现在连我们自己的地盘都不安全了。

original: Something's wrong. Got a group coming our way. Looks like a Legion raiding party. It's big.
translation: 不对劲。有一群人正朝我们过来。看上去像是军团劫掠小队。规模还挺大。

original: Might be too big. Even for us.
translation: 有点太大了。恐怕我们难以应付。

original: If you want out I won't blame you. But I'm going to stay. See if I can hold them off.
translation: 如果你想逃，我不会怪你的。但我要留下来。看看能不能拖住他们。

original: Hey. I thought some more about what you said. I think maybe you're right. Maybe I should go to Bitter Springs.
translation: 嘿，我又想了想你说的话。或许你说得对。我应该再去一次苦泉。

original: I don't know what I'm hoping to find there.
translation: 我也不知道我会在那里找到什么。

original: Hey. I want to thank you for bringing me to Bitter Springs. Things seem... clearer now.
translation: 嘿，我要谢谢你带我来苦泉。事情现在……似乎明朗多了。

original: We should get to the Hoover Dam. I don't want to miss this.
translation: 我们该去胡佛水坝了。我可不想错过。

original: That guy Benny was a piece of work.
translation: 那个叫本尼的家伙根本不算回事。

original: A face-to-face meeting with House, huh? The NCR would kill to be in your shoes.
translation: 你跟豪斯面对面谈话？这可是NCR梦寐以求的事啊。

original: Sounds like it's gonna be an all-out war with the Legion soon. Maybe I should've re-enlisted after all.
translation: 看来要不了多久就要和军团全面开战了。也许我应该重新入伍。

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: {serious}I don't believe there's anything left for us to talk about.
translation: {serious}我不认为我们还有什么好谈的。

original: Go on. Go fetch a ranger and do this right.
translation: 去吧。去找一个游骑兵过来。

original: Sorting and manipulating intelligence is what I do. It's what rangers are supposed to do.
translation: 我的工作是对进行情报分类和整理。这也是游骑兵该做的。

original: {joking a bit}This job isn't all gunfighting and gulping shots of whiskey, no matter what the boys and ladies out there say.
translation: {joking a bit}我不管那些小伙子小姑娘们怎么发牢骚，这份工作可不光是成天打枪子，或者狂喝威士忌。

original: I'm occupied at the moment. Come see me when I'm on the balcony.
translation: 我现在还有事要做。等我在阳台上的时候再来找我吧。

original: Back west, you don't see too many of these. Lakes, I mean. Natural or man-made. Any kind, really.
translation: 在西部，这样的景色可不多见。我是说这些湖。天然的，人工的，都很稀罕，真的。

original: We neglected the dams or pumped all the water out a long time ago. Owens, Isabella, the San Luis. Drained the aquifers of everything they had.
translation: 过去，我们忽视了水坝的作用，很早就把水给抽干了。欧文斯，伊莎贝拉，圣路易斯。他们抽光了含水层里的所有东西。

original: Just a lot of mud and dust now. It's a different feeling, watching the sun come up over the water. Takes some getting used to.
translation: 如今只剩下泥沙和尘土。看着太阳从水面上升起反而觉得很不自然。得花很长时间才能适应。

original: But if you're here long enough, it starts to seem normal. That's what a ranger's life is now. Looking east.
translation: 不过你要在这里呆久了，也会觉得稀松平常的。这就是我们游骑兵现在的生活，成天盯着东方。

original: You've come back to see the chief. Nice of you to humor the radio tender. What can I do for you?
translation: 你又来看望我这老头子了。整日与收音机为伴，能跟人聊天解闷也是不错。我能为你做些什么呢？

original: Like I said, I won't run out on you, but I can't let my people get dragged through the mud for this.
translation: 我说过，我不会对你不利，但我也不能因为这件事而让我的部下蒙羞。

original: You did good and you did it well. Work a ranger would be proud of. I'll handle the rest from here.
translation: 你做得很对，也很出色。即便是游骑兵，也会感到光荣。剩下的事就交给我自己处理吧。

original: {Derisive}Only thing you're good for is target practice.
translation: {Derisive}你也就会打打靶子。

original: {Threatening}Bet you'd blow up real good.
translation: {Threatening}我敢说你肯定死无全尸。

original: {threatening}Watch your step, Outsider.
translation: {threatening}注意点，外来者。

original: {Open Threat}I got a shell with your name on it.
translation: {Open Threat}我专门留了一发子弹给你。

original: I can spot a Brotherhood spy from a thousand yards. Even the cute ones.
translation: 我能在一千码就发现兄弟会的间谍。就算是个美女都瞒不过我。

original: I've never seen a ghoul up close. Not sure I wanted to.
translation: 我从没近距离看过尸鬼。还是别看的好。

original: That thing is housebroken, right?
translation: 这东西受过管教吧？

original: I like you big mutants. You're easy to sight.
translation: 我就喜欢你们这些大个子变种人。目标大，容易看见。

original: Did you know you have a robot following you?
translation: 你知道有个机器人跟着你吗？

original: Whatever you're selling, we have plenty.
translation: 不管你要卖什么，我们都不缺。

original: Keep your distance, soldier.
translation: 士兵，保持距离。

original: {suspicious}A doctor? Who's your supplier?
translation: {suspicious}医生？谁给你供药？

original: Idle thumbs tend to get blown off around here. Get moving.
translation: 别瞎按，不然小心指头没了。快走开。

original: Sorry, I've got work to take care of.
translation: 抱歉，我还有工作要做。

original: I'd keep moving if I was you.
translation: 我要是你，就不会在这儿晃悠。

original: {Dismissive}Go back to the Strip where you belong.
translation: {Dismissive}滚回你的长街去。

original: You're nothing like us, Outsider.
translation: 你跟我们完全不是一类人，外来者。

original: We should have never let you in.
translation: 一开始就不该让你进来。

original: You're no different than a common Fiend.
translation: 你和恶魔帮没什么两样。

original: What are you looking at?
translation: 你在看什么？

original: Keep your distance.
translation: 保持距离。

original: I'm not sure what to make of you, Outsider.
translation: 我不知该怎么形容你，外来者。

original: What do you know about our problems?
translation: 关于我们的问题，你知道些什么？

original: Welcome back.
translation: 欢迎回来。

original: Hey there. Kill any Outsiders lately?
translation: 你好啊。最近杀了几个外来者？

original: {Jovial}You can shoot with me anytime, friend.
translation: {Jovial}随时欢迎你陪我一同去打枪，朋友。

original: Always nice to see you.
translation: 见到你很高兴。

original: {Wry}Hope the trip into camp wasn't too eventful!
translation: {Wry}希望你去营地的旅途一路平安。

original: {friendly}Keep your head down, Outsider.
translation: {friendly}低调些，外来者。

original: I've got my sights on you, Outsider.
translation: 我可盯着你呢，外来者。

original: Stand back where I can see you.
translation: 别离开我的视线。

original: Saw you coming a mile away.
translation: 从一英里外我就看见你在往这走了。

original: I actually got to fly Pearl for a little bit during that boming run. Hot damn, what an honor.
translation: 事实上，我在那次轰炸中稍微驾驶了一下珀尔。干他妈，真是太光荣了。

original: All those hours training? Glad they finally paid off.
translation: 这就是一直以来训练的结果？很高兴他们终于获得了回报。

original: Did you see it? I hear the suckers burned right through their armor.
translation: 你看见没有？我都听见那些混蛋护甲被烧穿的声音了。

original: It was wonderful seeing Pearl fly and serve the purpose she was built for.
translation: 能看见珀尔重新飞起来完成使命，真是太好了。

original: It's getting nasty out here. S'times like these I thank god for artillery.
translation: 外面的情况越来越糟。有时候真要感谢上帝，幸好我们还有这些大炮。

original: War's brewing on the horizon, plain as day.
translation: 毫无疑问，战争一触即发。

original: We've survived out here pretty well so far without any help from the outside.
translation: 就算没有外来者帮忙，我们不也一样过得挺好。

original: You should get out of my face before you get yourself hurt.
translation: 快滚出我的视线，否则有你好看的。

original: I don't have anything to say to you, outsider.
translation: 我跟你没什么好说的，外来者。

original: I don't know how you survived the bombardment. That's incredible.
translation: 你是怎么躲过炮击的？太不可思议了。

original: I don't think you should be here.
translation: 我认为你不该呆在这儿。

original: I'm happy you came along. You are the answer to our dreams.
translation: 你能来真是太好了。你是实现我们梦想的关键。

original: You've earned our trust, now let's see if you can earn our gratitude.
translation: 你已经赢得了我们的信任，现在看看你能不能赢得我们的感激。

original: I can't believe we may see the superfortress built in my lifetime.
translation: 真不敢相信，居然能在我有生之年看到超级堡垒建成。

original: Really? So we may see our dream of flight soon?
translation: 真的？我们很快就能看到梦想中的飞机了？

original: I hear you're going to help us, I hope you're up for the task.
translation: 听说你要帮我们，希望你已经准备好了。

original: I'm happy that we managed to raise the bomber in my lifetime.
translation: 我居然能在有生之年看到轰炸机被打捞起来，真是太开心了。

original: Thank you so much for your help.
translation: 真是太感谢你的帮助了。

original: I didn't think the day would ever come, but thanks to you our dreams have come true!
translation: 我从没想过这一天真的会来，感谢你让我们梦想成真！

original: I'm amazed that an outsider has proven so helpful.
translation: 一个外来者居然能帮我们这么大的忙，真让人吃惊。

original: You've given us the ability to touch the sky! Thank you.
translation: 是你给了我们飞上蓝天的能力！谢谢你。

original: You've done us a great service. Thank you.
translation: 你帮了我们的大忙。谢谢你。

original: You've done us a great service. Thank you for your help.
translation: 你帮了我们的大忙。感谢你的帮助。

original: I'm not going to take anything from you. Leave me alone!
translation: 我不要你的东西。离我远点！

original: Hey! You tried to get me sick!
translation: 嘿！你真让我恶心！

original: You should learn to give kids nice things... Like toys!
translation: 你应该学会给孩子们一点好东西……比如玩具！

original: You're the one that tried to give me that yucky stuff.
translation: 你就是想给我恶心玩意的那个人。

original: I don't think I should talk to you. You aren't very nice.
translation: 我不觉得该和你说话。你不是好人。

original: You need to leave me alone. I don't like you anymore.
translation: 你离我远点。我不喜欢你了。

original: You're lots of fun. We should play sometime.
translation: 你可真有意思。我们一起玩吧。

original: I'm going to be a hero and travel the wasteland like you when I grow up.
translation: 等我长大了，也要和你一样做个穿行废土的大英雄。

original: I'm going to tell Mama Pearl how cool you are.
translation: 我要告诉珀尔妈妈你有多酷。

original: I bet you have all kinds of fun stories.
translation: 我打赌你肯定有各种各样的故事。

original: I like you, we should play sometime!
translation: 我喜欢你，我们一起玩吧！

original: Thanks for the toy! It was great!
translation: 谢谢你的玩具！真好玩！

original: I'm going to play raise the B-29!
translation: 我要玩打捞B-29的游戏！

original: I can't believe Pearl let you stay with us.
translation: 真不敢相信珀尔居然让你和我们呆在一起。

original: I sure hope Pearl knows what she's doing.
translation: 我真希望珀尔知道自己在做什么。

original: Sorry, no time to talk, Outsider.
translation: 对不起，外来者，没时间聊天。

original: I bet you'd make an awesome Boomer.
translation: 我打赌你会成为一个了不起的大炮族成员。

original: Yay! I love my new toy!
translation: 耶！我爱我的新玩具！

original: Let me see what you got. Yeah, these'll do just fine. Just fine.
translation: 我看看你都带回了些什么。嗯，这些应该够用了。刚好够用。

original: All right now. We're gonna be making something folks on the trail call Healing Powder.
translation: 好了。我们接下来要制作的东西，往来的旅行者都叫它治疗粉。

original: Go on over to that campfire now. Give it a try.
translation: 现在到营火那儿去，自己动手试一试吧。

original: Mess with any of the equipment here and I'll mount your head on a stick.
translation: 敢乱动这里的东西，我就把你的头砍下来插在棍子上。

original: Stay out of the control room and enclosure or there's gonna be trouble, got it?
translation: 离控制室和围场远点，不然要你好看，明白了吗？

original: Look all you want, just don't mess with any of the equipment. The control room's off-limits, and so is the enclosure.
translation: 看可以随便看，但不要碰任何装备。控制室禁止进入，围场也一样。

original: Mess with any of the equipment here and I'll mount your head on a stick.
translation: 敢乱动这里的东西，我就把你的头砍下来插在棍子上。

original: Stay out of the control room and enclosure or there's gonna be trouble, got it?
translation: 离控制室和围场远点，不然要你好看，明白了吗？

original: Look all you want, just don't mess with any of the equipment. The control room's off-limits, and so is the enclosure.
translation: 看可以随便看，但不要碰任何装备。控制室禁止进入，围场也一样。

original: Just give us an excuse. Been too long since I fired my weapon.
translation: 给我们个借口好了。我好久没开过枪了。

original: Don't go fucking about, asshole.
translation: 别乱来，贱货。

original: Mess with any of the equipment here and I'll mount your head on a stick.
translation: 敢乱动这里的东西，我就把你的头砍下来插在棍子上。

original: Just try pulling some of your Brahmin shit here at the Dorado and see what happens.
translation: 你要是敢在多拉多撒野，我就让你好看。

original: Not much happens here at the Dorado, and that's how we like it.
translation: 多拉多这里总是风平浪静的，所以我们才喜欢这里。

original: Only combat I seen lately was shooting some Geckos.
translation: 我最近唯一经历过的战斗就是打蜥蜴。

original: All the juice from Hoover flows right through the Dorado, and we send it west to keep the home lights burning.
translation: 胡佛水坝产出的电全都经由多拉多送往西部，这才保障了那里的万家灯火。

original: My folks back home got lights at night thanks to what we're doing here.
translation: 我们的人晚上回家能点亮灯，可全是我们的功劳。

original: We keep an eye out for Legion raiding parties. They'd love to shut down the Dorado.
translation: 我们一直在提防军团的突袭小队。他们肯定会袭击多拉多。

original: Stay out of the control room and enclosure or there's gonna be trouble, got it?
translation: 离控制室和围场远点，不然要你好看，明白了吗？

original: The power transmission cables are all underground. Good thing, or the old war might've knocked them down.
translation: 传输电力的缆线都埋在地下。这是好事，不然以前那场大战就已经把它们毁了。

original: You visiting every NCR post just to see the sights? This here's the Dorado - it's where we send power back home.
translation: 你跑到NCR的每一处烧着就是为了来看风景的吗？这里是多拉多——我们把电送回家的地方。

original: Look all you want, just don't mess with any of the equipment. The control room's off-limits, and so is the enclosure.
translation: 看可以随便看，但不要碰任何设备。控制室禁止进入，围场也一样。

original: Hell of a thing about Chief Hanlon. I never would have guessed he was capable of it.
translation: 汉隆军士长真是该死。我从没想过他居然会这样做。

original: I've been hearing some rumors from the Embassy that Mr. House has gone quiet all of a sudden. You wouldn't know anything about that, would you?
translation: 我从大使馆那边听说豪斯先生最近突然失去了音讯。你应该对此不知情吧？

original: Nice work dealing with Caesar. That'll make holding the Mojave a lot easier.
translation: 你解决了凯撒，真是漂亮。这样一来，守住莫哈维就易如反掌了。

original: Have you seen these elite rangers they sent us from California? God damn those boys are gonna kick some ass!
translation: 你见过那些从加州派过来的精英游骑兵了吗？那些小伙子的本事可不一般！

original: Nice work with that assassination attempt! If my troops were half as dedicated as you, we'd win the war in a week!
translation: 你成功阻止了刺杀！要是我的人能有你一半用心，没准我们一个礼拜就能打赢战争了！

original: Looks like the President's security detail was too good for you, huh, shitbird?
translation: 看来总统身边的安保再怎么周全，对你而言也没什么用啊，臭小子？

original: You oughta die for what you did.
translation: 你做出那种事，就该以死谢罪。

original: Not like I even voted for him, but losing the President's a hell of a morale killer.
translation: 虽然我没投票给总统，但失去他绝对会严重挫伤我们的士气。

original: I just got word that 1st Recon is being mobilized to Nelson. God forbid we get any reinforcements here, right?
translation: 我刚听说第一侦察营被派到了纳尔逊。老天就是不想让我们得到增援，是不是？

original: Seems the Misfits scored pretty well on their readiness evaluations. That strikes me as... suspicious.
translation: 后进生的演练成绩相当不错啊。这让我十分……怀疑。

original: I gotta admit, I'm impressed. The Misfits are drilling better than I ever expected.
translation: 我承认我服气了。后进生的表现远超我的预期。

original: I'm not sure what's going on with the Misfits - their accuracy is in the toilet, but they're spoiling for a fight like I ain't never seen.
translation: 我不明白后进生是怎么回事——虽然他们的准头依然在天上飘，但我从没见过他们的斗志如此昂扬。

original: Well, their test scores are only marginally improved, but I'm hearing good things about the Misfits' teamwork.
translation: 好吧，他们的测试成绩虽然进步不大，但在团队合作方面似乎有了些起色。

original: Ah, hell, what is it now?
translation: 啊，见鬼，又有什么事？

original: {Pleased to see the player}What can I do for you?
translation: {Pleased to see the player}有什么可以效劳的？

original: You here to help, or just dick around all day?
translation: 你到底是来帮忙的还是来闲逛的？

original: {Very pleased to see the player}Hot damn, look who it is!
translation: {Very pleased to see the player}见鬼了，看看这是谁来了！

original: {Frazzled and annoyed}Oh, great, like I don't have enough problems!
translation: {Frazzled and annoyed}噢，太棒了，我正嫌麻烦太少呢！

original: {Cold}What the hell do you want?
translation: {Cold}你他妈要干嘛？

original: What the hell do you want, you vicious son of a bitch?
translation: 你他妈要干嘛，贱崽子？

original: What the hell do you want, you vicious bitch?
translation: 你他妈要干嘛，贱逼？

original: So you're back. What else do you want?
translation: 你回来了。还有什么事？

original: Okay, everybody's lined up and ready to go. Any suggestions?
translation: 好了，大家都整装待发了。有什么建议？

original: Okay, we've got our dummy grenades and the course is live. We're all set.
translation: 好的，我们拿到了训练用手雷，课程也就绪了。我们准备好了。

original: The squad really seems to be working together better. It's nice, for a change.
translation: 队员间的默契似乎提高了不少。是个可喜的变化。

original: What the hell happened with these readiness reports? These scores are way too high!
translation: 这些评估报告是怎么回事？得分也高得太离谱了！

original: Thanks to your help, I feel like we can take on the world!
translation: 感谢你的帮助，我觉得我们可以拿下全世界了！

original: I don't know what Razz gave us, but holy shit this is great! I feel like I could kill an entire legion! With my teeth!
translation: 我不知道拉兹给我们吃了什么，但是太他妈爽了！我觉得自己可以用牙咬死整个军团！

original: Haven't seen you around before, soldier.
translation: 以前没见过你，士兵。

original: Not very often we see civilians on-base. What's you're story?
translation: 我们很少在营地见到平民。你是什么来头？

original: I heard Chief Hanlon committed suicide. That's just... hard to believe. Do you know anything about it?
translation: 我听说汉隆军士长自杀了。这可真是……难以置信。你知道这件事吗？

original: I hear Caesar's dead, and we've got you to thank for it. Nice work.
translation: 我听说凯撒死了，我们由衷感谢你。干得漂亮。

original: I hear Caesar's dead. Maybe that means the war will be over soon.
translation: 我听说凯撒死了。也许战争很快就会结束了。

original: I've got a friend stationed at McCarran - I heard something about a monorail explosion there. I hope he's okay.
translation: 我有个朋友驻扎在麦卡伦——听说那儿有一辆列车被炸了。希望他没事。

original: Radio says you stopped the President's assassin cold. Not bad.
translation: 广播说是你阻止了刺杀总统的刺客。干得不错。

original: You're lucky you haven't been shot walking in here after that assassination attempt.
translation: 刺杀事件之后，你在这转悠居然还没吃枪子，也够走运的。

original: You're lucky you haven't been shot walking in here after you killed the president.
translation: 你刺杀了总统之后，在这转悠居然还没吃枪子，也够走运的。

original: Hell of a battle at Nelson. I'm impressed our troops survived.
translation: 纳尔逊战役真是激烈。我很惊异我们的部队还能活下来。

original: Everybody's been really nervous since President Kimball died. I don't know what's going to happen.
translation: 自从金博尔总统遇刺之后，每个人都特别紧张。我不知道接下来还会发生什么。

original: Hell of a battle at Forlorn Hope. I hope the brass can do something for the troopers' families.
translation: 飘零希望战役真是激烈。希望长官能好好慰问那些烈士的家属。

original: There's some weird chatter on the radio saying something wiped out Nelson and Forlorn Hope. That's pretty scary.
translation: 广播说有人横扫了纳尔逊和飘零希望营地。这可真吓人。

original: I'm not supposed to know this, but I hear they're dispatching elite ranger units from California to deal with the Legion.
translation: 我本来不该知道这些的，但我听说他们把加利福尼亚的精英游骑兵都调过来对付军团了。

original: So now the word is Caesar's calling in his elite troops from Arizona. I don't think we're going to catch a break any time soon.
translation: 有传言说凯撒正在从亚利桑那纠集精英部队。我觉得我们很快就会连喘气的时间都没有了。

original: A bunch of units just got mobilized to Hoover Dam. This is the big one, isn't it?
translation: 大批部队正在向胡佛水坝集结。真是壮观，对吧？

original: Glad to see you haven't gotten yourself killed yet.
translation: 很高兴见到你，看样子你状态不错。

original: {sarcastic}Man, the brass is going to be thrilled that you're here.
translation: {sarcastic}老兄，长官要是见到你在这里会发疯的。

original: Friendly warning, you might want to steer clear of NCR facilities. You're not exactly popular.
translation: 善意的警告：最好和NCR的军事设施保持距离。你不受欢迎。

original: {A little starstruck but trying to be nonchalant}Wow, the big celebrity down here with the common troopers. What can I do for you?
translation: {A little starstruck but trying to be nonchalant}哇，大人物来看望我们这些小虾米了。有什么需要我效劳的吗？

original: You're not going to do anything crazy, are you? It's just, you know... the paperwork....
translation: 你应该不会也是来干苦差事的吧？比如……你懂的……文书工作……

original: How'd you get in here without getting shot?
translation: 你是怎么安全到达这里的？

original: Hey again.
translation: 你又来了啊。

original: It sure is nice to see everybody working together like family. Maybe now the baby Jesus won't cry his self to sleep every night.
translation: 能看到大家团结得像一家人，真是太好了。也许现在小耶稣晚上睡觉的时候不会再独自哭了。

original: Shooting guns is real scary, but I think I got the hang of it now!
translation: 开枪确实很吓人，但我想现在我已经完全掌握了！

original: Razz said the candy he got us was special! I wonder what he- {sudden, psychotic break}Gnaaah, kill, kill, rip and kill! -{right back to normal}meant by that?
translation: 拉兹说他给我们的糖果很特殊！我很好奇他说的——{sudden，psychotic break}啊呀，杀，杀，冲啊，杀呀！-{right back to normal}到底是什么意思？

original: Poindexter says all our troubles is over now, and we won't have to go to war. I guess that's good, but I don't understand why.
translation: 波因德克斯特说我们不会再有麻烦了，也不用再参战了。虽然是好事，但我不明白为什么要这样。

original: Is it true? The big boss ranger done killed his self?
translation: 真的？游骑兵的老大自杀了？

original: Howdy, great to see you!
translation: 你好，见到你很高兴！

original: Y'all sure are a big ol' hero. I gotta wright my mama and tell her I met you!
translation: 你就是传说中的大英雄。我要写信告诉妈妈我见到你了！

original: Uh, howdy. Are you gonna be mean or nice this time?
translation: 啊，你好。这次你是想干点好事还是要使坏？

original: You scare and confuse me, and I think you should be nicer to people.
translation: 你把我吓傻了，我觉得你应该对别人好一点儿。

original: Go away, you big bully!
translation: 滚开，你这个大坏蛋！

original: {Frightened}Ahhh! Somebody call in the Rangers!
translation: {Frightened}啊啊！快呼叫游骑兵！

original: Howdy.
translation: 你好。

original: While I have already internalized the new skills we have discussed, I feel as though my solution was nevertheless more practical.
translation: 我把我们讨论过的那些新本领全都消化了，现在我的解决方案似乎是更有实效了。

original: Excellent! Maximal reward for minimal work.
translation: 太好了！真是事半功倍。

original: I trust you're satisfied with the squad's newfound teamwork? It's almost entirely my own doing, I assure you.
translation: 我相信你应该对整支队伍的团队配合相当满意吧？我向你保证，这几乎全是我的功劳。

original: Ever since consuming those "illicit rations" Razz offered us, I have felt a steadily-increasing desire to kill.
translation: 自从吸了拉兹给我们的那些"违禁品"，我感觉自己的杀戮欲望越来越强烈。

original: I understand the esteemed Chief Hanlon is no longer with us. A shame. He seemed to be the only competent leadership this Army had.
translation: 德高望重的汉隆军士长已经离我们而去了。真让人遗憾。他是这支军队里唯一能够胜任指挥的人。

original: I'm assuming you aren't associated with the Army or the Rangers. What can I do for you?
translation: 我想你和军队或游骑兵应该没什么瓜葛。需要我做点什么？

original: You've done an excelent job ingratiating yourself to the top brass. I assume this is some sort of strategem?
translation: 你的成绩很出色，上级长官都对你青睐有加。你是不是耍了什么小聪明？

original: You've managed to become extraordinarily well-liked by the top brass. You should exploit that for your own gain wherever possible.
translation: 你成功得到了上级长官的青睐。如此评价来之不易，你应该好好利用。

original: Your behavior has become an unwelcome X-factor, and I would kindly ask you to consider altering it.
translation: 你的行为让大家都对你不太放心，出于好心，我希望你可以反省一下。

original: I'm afraid I have no desire to socialize with unstable elements such as yourself.
translation: 恐怕我不能容忍自己身边存在不稳定因素，比如你。

original: I must question your logic in coming here, in light of your prior actions.
translation: 根据你之前的表现，我想我有必要了解清楚你来这里的理由。

original: Kindly remove yourself, as I have no desire to be struck by a stray round when disgruntled troopers begin firing on you.
translation: 你最好还是自己离开，我可不想因为你和这儿的士兵们擦枪走火而受处分。

original: Greetings once again.
translation: 又见面了。

original: Okay, okay, I admit it - knowing how to use these guns right is pretty cool.
translation: 好吧，好吧，我承认——知道如何使枪确实很酷。

original: Sweet, those "readiness reports" are so good they actually gave me a raise!
translation: 甜心，那些"评估报告"的成绩实在太棒了，我都升职了！

original: I thought all that touchy-feely teamwork bullshit was kind of fruity... but it kinda feels good knowing my squad's got my back.
translation: 我原先还以为那些关于团队合作的狗屁故事都是拿来搞笑的……但现在一想，有队友在身边，感觉是挺棒的。

original: {Tripping out on a drug almost like but legally distinct from meth}Ha ha, fuck me, Jack's shit is still the best!
translation: {Tripping out on a drug almost like but legally distinct from meth}哈哈，我操，还是杰克的货最正！

original: Heard Chief Hanlon took the {"lead" as in bullets}lead expressway to Angel-town. Weird shit, yo.
translation: 听说汉隆军士长突然就奔着{"lead" as in bullets}天国去了。哟，还真是奇闻。

original: What you want, homes?
translation: 你想要什么，伙计？

original: Aw, shit, here comes the brown-noser. What you want?
translation: 噢，妈的，马屁精来了。你想要什么？

original: Shit, look who it is, the crazy one! What up?
translation: 操，看那是谁，那个疯子！什么事？

original: Every time you come around, the brass gets their pants in a bunch. Keep on coming by.
translation: 每次你来的时候，长官们都会小题大做。有空多来玩啊。

original: Shit, you just piss folks off wherever you go, huh?
translation: 我操，你是走到哪儿都能把人赶跑吗？

original: I know I talk a lot of shit about the army, but you come around here again and I'll slit you.
translation: 我知道自己说了很多军队的坏话，但是如果你敢再来的话我就把你撕成两半。

original: Yo.
translation: 哟。

original: Something I can do you for?
translation: 我能为你做些什么？

original: I suppose I can help you out. What do you want?
translation: 我想我可以帮你。你想要什么？

original: I'm not really comfortable having you in here, so make it quick.
translation: 看到你让我觉得有点不舒服，所以你有话快说。

original: Hey, friend. Need something?
translation: 嘿, 朋友。需要什么吗？

original: Glad to see you! Need a patch-job?
translation: 很高兴见到你！需要治疗吗？

original: I think you'd better get out of here.
translation: 我想你最好赶快离开这里。

original: There are a half-dozen troopers in shouting distance. Best remember that before you try anything.
translation: 只要我大喊一声，立马就会有一群士兵冲过来。所以如果你想惹麻烦，最好先记得这一点。

original: {FIRST TALK, TROUBLE}{slow burn}You're the courier who's caused so much trouble for my Legion, and yet you dare come before me.
translation: {FIRST TALK， TROUBLE}{slow burn}你就是那个处处和我的军团作对的邮差，居然还有胆子出现在我面前。

original: {FIRST TALK, BAD NCR REP}{appraising}So I finally get to meet the courier who's caused so much trouble for the New California Republic.
translation: {FIRST TALK， BAD NCR REP}{appraising}终于见到这位给新加州共和国造成无数麻烦的邮差了。

original: {FIRST TALK}So I finally get to meet the courier who's accomplished so much in so little time. That is why I summoned you here, right?
translation: {FIRST TALK}终于见到那位声名鹊起的邮差了。不过也是因为这样我才召见你的，不是吗？

original: I mean, a man nearly kills you, and your response is to track him across the breadth of the Mojave?
translation: 你为了报复那个差点杀了你的人，居然追着他横穿了整片莫哈维沙漠？

original: {FIRST TALK}The question is... are you ready to get started?
translation: {FIRST TALK}问题是……你准备好干出一番事业了吗？

original: Down the hill, at the west edge of camp, is an old building. It was here when the Fort was taken in 2277.
translation: 这座山下面，营地的西边，有一座老建筑。2277年城堡刚建立的时候，它就已经在那里了。

original: Inside the building is a hatch, and inside that hatch are two steel doors that bear the {SIH-jihl}sigil of the Lucky 38 casino.
translation: 建筑里有个暗门，进去里面有两扇印着{SIH-jihl}幸运38号赌场标记的铁门。

original: Now that same sigil is on the Platinum Chip Benny was carrying when we captured him. Isn't that interesting?
translation: 我们抓到本尼时，在他带着的白金筹码上面发现了同样的标记。你不觉得这很有趣吗？

original: Now that same sigil is on the Platinum Chip you were carrying. Isn't that interesting?
translation: 你带着的白金筹码上面也有同样的标记。你不觉得这很有趣吗？

original: Even more interesting, there's a slot about the same size as the Chip on the console that opens the hatch. So you know what I think?
translation: 更有趣的是，在启动舱盖的控制台上，有个和这筹码大小基本吻合的接口。你知道我是怎么想的吗？

original: I think the Platinum Chip opens those doors - doors that can't be pried open or drilled open or blasted open. Because all that, I tried.
translation: 我认为白金筹码就是打开那些门的钥匙，这些门无论用撬棍、钻头还是炸药都打不开。因为这些方法我都试过了。

original: {BEFORE VAULT DESTROYED}We'll talk again when you've destroyed whatever is down in that bunker - not before.
translation: {BEFORE VAULT DESTROYED}等你彻底从内部摧毁了地堡我们再谈。

original: {AFTER VAULT DESTROYED}I felt the ground shake a while ago. I'll take that as a sign you got the job done.
translation: {AFTER VAULT DESTROYED}我感到地面似乎震动了一下。看来你已经完成了任务。

original: There are rewards for doing as I command. Today, your reward is vengeance. You get to decide how Benny dies.
translation: 服从我的人，都能得到奖赏。今天，你的奖赏就是复仇：我允许你来决定本尼的死法。

original: Go to Benny, let him know what you've decided. My Praetorians will perform the execution - {giving player credit}unless you want to perform it yourself.
translation: 去找本尼，亲自向他下达你的判决。我的禁卫军会遵照执行——{giving player credit}除非你想自己动手。

original: We have nothing to discuss until you've dealt with Benny.
translation: 在你处理掉本尼之前我们没什么好谈的。

original: I'm sure you found Benny's demise pleasing. The destruction of an enemy... there are few things more satisfying.
translation: 本尼的死想必让你心情舒畅。彻底毁灭敌人……没有什么比这更让人满足的了。

original: Let's press on, shall we? As I was telling you before, I want Mr. House out of the picture.
translation: 那就继续下一步计划。我之前说过，我想要除掉豪斯先生。

original: You have an interest in his death, too. If he knows that you destroyed his {for lack of a better term}gadgets beneath the Fort, he will strike back.
translation: 你应该也不希望他活着。如果他知道是你摧毁了他藏在城堡地下面的那些小玩意儿，肯定会报复你的。

original: You know where to find him. How he dies, I leave up to you.
translation: 你知道去哪里找他。至于他具体怎么死，就交给你决定了。

original: Until Mr. House has been dealt with, you and I have nothing to talk about.
translation: 在你处理掉豪斯先生之前，我们没什么好说的。

original: I've read Mr. House's obituary. Had a high opinion of himself, didn't he?
translation: 我读了豪斯先生的讣告。评价甚高啊，不是吗？

original: {seething}I spent months feeding the Omertas bribes, nursing their betrayal, and you've ruined all that.
translation: {seething}我花了几个月的时间笼络黑手党，想方设法策反他们，而你把这一切都毁了。

original: {seething}Do you have any idea how much effort it took to place a mole at McCarran who could plant that bomb on the monorail? The one you defused?
translation: {seething}你知道我为了能在麦卡伦安插一个炸毁单轨铁路的间谍耗费了多大精力吗？你居然把炸弹给拆了？

original: {seething}The garrison I placed at Nelson served a vital strategic function. Did you think you could wipe it out and I wouldn't find out?
translation: {seething}我在纳尔逊建立的这个要塞有着重要的战略意义。你以为我会不知道是谁将它抹平的？

original: {seething}Weeks were spent convincing the Great Khans to join the Legion, but you've ruined all that. {louder}Haven't you?
translation: {seething}我们花费了数周时间才说服大汗帮加入军团，但是你把这一切都毁了。{louder}是不是？

original: With Mr. House out of the way, I can focus on smoothing out a few {slight beat}lingering complications elsewhere in the Mojave.
translation: 没有豪斯先生的阻碍，我就可以集中精力对付{slight beat}莫哈维沙漠其他地区那些还没解决的问题了。

original: First up are the Boomers of Nellis Air Force Base, a tribe so reclusive, it lobs artillery shells at anyone who comes near their settlement.
translation: 首先是内利斯空军基地的大炮族，这群人特别排外，但凡试图靠近他们据点的人都会遭到火炮袭击。

original: I want you to offer them an alliance with my Legion. My terms are simple: target their guns against the NCR side of the dam when I assault it...
translation: 我希望你能代表军团去与他们缔结盟约。我的条件很简单：当我进攻大坝的时候，他们必须把炮口对准NCR。

original: ...and they can keep their freedom. If you find they aren't amenable to this offer, destroy them.
translation: ……事成之后，我允许他们享受自由。但如果他们不接受这个条件，那就消灭他们。

original: It's reached me that you killed Silus before he could talk. I approve.
translation: 我听说你在希鲁斯开口前就杀了他。我很赞赏。

original: I understand that you freed Silus before he could talk. I approve.
translation: 我理解你在希鲁斯开口前就放了他的做法。我很赞赏。

original: Silus dishonored himself when he let himself be captured, and he'll pay the price for that. But the NCR didn't learn anything valuable.
translation: 希鲁斯从成为俘虏的那一刻起就已经没有荣耀可言了。他会为此付出代价的。好在NCR没有得到任何有价值的情报。

original: Have you brought news of the Boomers?
translation: 你带来大炮族的消息了吗？

original: {SUDDEN PAIN}I would've asked you to forge an alliance with the White Glove Society, but you've already killed its leaders. So instead -
translation: {SUDDEN PAIN}我本来想让你去和白手套社团达成盟约，结果你却把他们的领袖都杀了。所以——

original: {sudden, excruciating pain in head}{gritting teeth}Ehhhh! Goddammit!
translation: {sudden， excruciating pain in head}{gritting teeth}呃啊啊啊！该死！

original: {SUDDEN PAIN}I want you to forge an alliance between Caesar's Legion and the White Glove Society.
translation: {SUDDEN PAIN}我要你代表凯撒军团去和白手套社团结盟。

original: They used to be cannibals. I expect that information can be used to manipulate them. Go to -{stopping short as pain eplodes inside head}
translation: 他们以前是食人族。希望这则情报能有助于你说服他们。快去——{stopping short as pain eplodes inside head}

original: {sudden, excruciating pain in head}{gritting teeth}Ehhhh! Goddammit!
translation: {sudden， excruciating pain in head}{gritting teeth}呃啊啊啊！该死！

original: {limping off to bed, head feels like it's being crushed}Goddammit, go away! Come back when I've had some sleep!
translation: {limping off to bed， head feels like it's being crushed}该死，走开！等我睡醒了再来找我！

original: {head feels like it's being crushed}I warned you not to bother me!
translation: {head feels like it's being crushed}我警告过你别来烦我！

original: Praetorians, kill this asshole!
translation: 禁卫军，杀了这混蛋！

original: {recovered from yesterday's sudden headache}The last time we met, I believe we were talking about the White Glove Society?
translation: {recovered from yesterday's sudden headache}上次见面时，我记得我们还在谈论白手套社团的事情吧？

original: Have you been successful in your efforts to recruit the White Glove Society?
translation: 你成功征募白手套社团了吗？

original: {ABSENCE SEIZURE}I want you to destroy the Mojave Chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel. It's not a full-strength chapter, mind you. The Profligates...{trail off. Absence seizure begins}
translation: {ABSENCE SEIZURE}我要你摧毁钢铁兄弟会的莫哈维支部。提醒你一下，这个分会的力量并不强。那些荒淫之人……{trail off。 Absence seizure begins}

original: ...{breathe through nostrils for several seconds}
translation: ……{breathe through nostrils for several seconds}

original: Urh...{continue breathing through nostrils}
translation: 呃……{continue breathing through nostrils}

original: {Caesar heading for bed}{tired}If you interfere with me getting some sleep again, I'm going to have you killed. {resolved}We will talk later.
translation: {Caesar heading for bed}{tired}如果你再敢打扰我睡觉的话，我就杀了你。{resolved}我们以后再谈。

original: {tired, growing angry}You want to die? Fine!
translation: {tired， growing angry}你要找死？好！

original: {shouting for guards, voice weaker than usual}Praetorians! Kill this asshole!
translation: {shouting for guards， voice weaker than usual}禁卫军！杀了这混蛋！

original: Has the Brotherhood been destroyed?
translation: 兄弟会被摧毁了吗？

original: {Brotherhood resolved}I want you to join me in my tent. You and I are going to have a private conversation.
translation: {Brotherhood resolved}到我帐篷里来。我们私下谈。

original: All right, let's state the obvious. There's something wrong with me.
translation: 很好，我们就开门见山吧。我的身体有些不对劲。

original: The headaches started a couple months ago. They weren't too bad at first... but now they come frequently and they're... {beat}debilitating.
translation: 几个月前就开始头痛了。起先并不厉害……可现在越来越频繁了，而且……病痛让我变得非常虚弱。

original: For the past two weeks, my left leg has been dragging. It's stiffer, hard to move. And you've seen me blank out.
translation: 过去的两周，我的左腿一直是瘸的。现在它变得更加僵硬，几乎不听使唤。你也看到了我昏厥的样子。

original: Lucius says I stare into space, blink a few times, then keep talking like nothing happened. So what's the diagnosis?
translation: 卢修斯说我有时会突然两眼放空，眨巴几下之后又若无其事地继续说话。你觉得我这究竟是什么症状？

original: {Successful surgery}I thank you for saving my life. You're a warrior {emphasis}and a healer - a rare combination.
translation: {Successful surgery}感谢你救了我的命。你不仅是个战士，也是一名神医——真是罕有的奇才。

original: I thank you for saving my life. Arcade will be a fine addition to my retinue.
translation: 感谢你救了我的命。阿卡德会是我的另一个好随从。

original: I thank you for saving my life. The Auto-Doc module you recovered did the trick.
translation: 感谢你救了我的命。你修复的自动医生组件真是太神奇了。

original: I trust this payment is adequate compensation for your troubles. Now, lest we grow sentimental here...
translation: 我相信这笔报酬应该足以补偿你的辛劳。好了，客套话就免了……

original: The time for battle will soon be upon us. {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius draws nigh. When he arrives, my Legion will assault Hoover Dam.
translation: 决战的时刻马上就要来临了。{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯正在赶来汇合。等他抵达，我的军团就会对胡佛水坝发起进攻。

original: In the meantime, the Profligates have prepared a welcome gift for us. The President of the NCR intends to visit Hoover Dam.
translation: 同时，那帮荒淫之人也给我们准备好了见面礼。NCR总统打算视察胡佛水坝。

original: You {slight beat}dispatched President Kimball with real skill. Right under their noses, too - {enjoying it}what a humiliation.
translation: 你竟然在他们的眼皮底下{slight beat}干净利落地处决了金博尔总统——{enjoying it}多么讽刺啊。

original: {seething}Why did you not attack President Kimball?
translation: {seething}你为什么没有刺杀金博尔总统？

original: {seething}President Kimball was there on the Dam, right before you. And yet he lives. {beat}How did you fuck this up?
translation: {seething}金博尔总统就在水坝，就在你眼前。而他居然到现在都还活着。{beat}你到底在搞什么鬼？

original: {Kimball quest resolved}My forces are in position to assault the Dam. {Leh-GAH-tus Lah-Nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius has assumed command.
translation: {Kimball quest resolved}我的部队已经就位，随时准备突袭水坝。{Leh-GAH-tus Lah-Nee-OOS}战斗将由特使拉尼厄斯指挥。

original: Are you ready to go to him? To tell him to begin the assault?
translation: 你准备好去找他了吗？告诉他开始进攻？

original: You know everything you need to know. Be on your way.
translation: 需要知道的已经都告诉你了。行动吧。

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}What did you want to know?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}你还想知道什么？

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}What else did you want to know?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}你还想知道什么？

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even with the Boomers to deal with, you have questions?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}难道就处理一下大炮族，你也还有问题？

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even with the White Glove Society to deal with, you have questions?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}难道就处理一下白手套社团，你也还有问题？

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even with the Brotherhood to deal with, you have questions?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}难道就处理一下兄弟会，你也还有问题？

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even with a President to kill, you have questions?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}难道就刺杀一个总统，你也还有问题？

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}Even on the brink of the final battle, you have questions?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}难道到了决战关头，你也还有问题？

original: Do you have any progress to report?
translation: 你有什么进展要汇报吗？

original: Allow me to make this clear. Because you've been of service to me, I will forgive your crimes against my Legion this one time.
translation: 我得先把丑话说在前面。这一次我原谅你的罪过，是因为你一直尽心尽力为我效命。

original: In the future, if I become aware that you've committed other crimes, I'll have my Praetorians butcher you before my eyes.
translation: 要是今后让我发现你再犯下什么罪过，我会亲眼看着禁卫军把你大卸八块。

original: If you've committed any other crimes, this is the time to confess them, because after today there will be no forgiveness.
translation: 如果你还犯下过其他的罪行，现在一并坦白，因为过了今天就不会再得到我的宽恕了。

original: I warned you about this. {to your guards}Praetorians, slaughter this degenerate!
translation: 我已经警告过你了。{to your guards}禁卫军，宰了这个杂种！

original: I'm so much happier now. Thank you again.
translation: 我现在高兴多了。再次感谢你。

original: {Sullen youth, has just been surprised doing something embarassinng}What do you want?
translation: {Sullen youth, has just been surprised doing something embarassinng}你想干什么？

original: {Sarcastic}Oh look, it's the conformist tool.
translation: {Sarcastic}哦，看哪，这不就是那个应声虫嘛。

original: {Sarcastic}How much ass did you have to kick to get Papa Khan to like you so much?
translation: {Sarcastic}你到底是做了什么不得了的事，会让父汗这么喜欢你？

original: {Thinks the player is totally cool, but doesn't want to admit it}Oh, hey. What's up?
translation: {Thinks the player is totally cool, but doesn't want to admit it}哦，嘿。怎么了？

original: I can't believe you're talking to me, this is so cool! I mean, uh... dude, what's up?
translation: 你居然在和我说话，这太酷了！我是说，呃……伙计，有什么事？

original: You going to make fun of me too?
translation: 你也是来取笑我的吗？

original: I really don't want to deal with this right now.
translation: 我现在真的不想和你说话。

original: {Sullen youth}What?
translation: {Sullen youth}什么？

original: You're the one making a name for yourself among the troops, aren't you? What is it you need?
translation: 你就是最近在部队里声名鹊起的那个家伙是吧？你有什么事？

original: Ah, the vaunted hero of the Legion. What can I do for you?
translation: 啊，那位号称军团英雄的人来了。你有什么事？

original: You've been quite difficult to predict, my friend. I hope I can sway you more solidly to the Legion's way of thinking.
translation: 你的思想太难以捉摸了，朋友。我希望你能和军团保持一条心。

original: Caesar is not fond of loose cannons like yourself. I sincerely hope you change your ways before something drastic must occur.
translation: 凯撒不喜欢像你这样我行我素的人。我真心希望你能改变作风，免得吃苦头。

original: I've been warned about you. You are perilously close to making an enemy of Caesar, and that is not wise.
translation: 我听说过你的名字。你离凯撒的敌人只有一步之遥，这是非常不明智的。

original: I understand you've been invited to meet with Caesar. You should be aware of the honor you've been granted.
translation: 我知道你已受邀觐见凯撒。你应该清楚自己获得了怎样的荣耀。

original: If we weren't in Khan territory I would kill you where you stand. Caesar will be avenged!
translation: 要不是我们现在正在大汗帮的地盘上，我一定会立马杀了你。有人会为凯撒复仇的！

original: Caesar's death was tragic, but do not think that it will break the Legion's resolve.
translation: 凯撒的死是个悲剧，但别以为这会破坏军团的团结。

original: Caesar's veterans will arrive from Arizona soon, and there will be no stopping our victory.
translation: 凯撒的老兵很快就会从亚利桑那赶到，到时我们将势不可挡。

original: Greetings in the name of {KAI-zar}Caesar.
translation: 以{KAI-zar}以凯撒之名，向您致意。

original: I understand you've been talking to the Great Khans about breaking their oaths to great Caesar. I would call that... unwise.
translation: 我知道你正设法劝说大汗帮与伟大的凯撒解除盟约。我只能说……这很不明智。

original: What more do you want?
translation: 你还有什么事？

original: I haven't seen you before - what brings you to the Great Khans?
translation: 我以前没见过你——是什么风把你吹到大汗帮来了？

original: It's good to have you here. What can I do for you?
translation: 你能来太好了。我能为你做些什么？

original: You honor the Great Khans with your presence. What can I do to help you?
translation: 您的到来让大汗帮蓬荜生辉。需要我做点什么？

original: You're always... {beat, considering word choice}interesting to have around.
translation: 你还真是……{beat, considering word choice}总会出现在有趣的地方。

original: {Cautious, unsure of player's motives}What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这干什么？

original: If you're smart, you'll find somewhere else to be.
translation: 如果你够聪明，那你最好换个地方。

original: You're becoming quite the political agitator. I can't say I'm displeased.
translation: 你正在变成一个政治煽动家。我对此很满意。

original: Something else you wanted?
translation: 你还有什么事？

original: We'll begin readying the camp to move. As soon as Caesar makes his move, we'll depart. We will make ourselves strong again, and we shall conquer!
translation: 我们已经准备拔营了。一旦凯撒开始进军，我们就转移。但我们会东山再起的，总有一天，我们将独霸一方！

original: So, the cub enters the wolf's den. What do you want, cub?
translation: 哎呀，小绵羊闯进狼窝里来了。你有什么事，小绵羊？

original: All four of my most trusted advisors have told me we should break our alliance - maybe I should hear you out after all.
translation: 我最信任的四个顾问都建议我解除与军团的同盟关系——或许我应该听听你的意见。

original: I'm beginning to hear troubling rumors from my advisors. Would you know anything about that?
translation: 我从顾问那里听说了一些不太好的传言。你知道是怎么一回事吗？

original: More of my advisors are starting to talk openly of breaking our alliance. I wonder where that idea is coming from?
translation: 已经有几位顾问在公开谈论解除盟约的事情了。我想知道这个想法是从哪儿冒出来的？

original: I understand you dealt the NCR a crushing defeat at Forlorn Hope. I hope that trend continues.
translation: 听说你在飘零希望营地给了NCR致命的一击。我希望这个势头能保持下去。

original: That's why I've made a decision: I'm naming you my heir. When I die, leadership of the Great Khans will pass to you.
translation: 因此，我决定：我将立你为我的继承人。一旦我死了，大汗帮的领导权将交给你。

original: You've been doing good things for us - don't think I haven't noticed. What can I do for you?
translation: 你一直在帮助我们——我看得到。我能为你做什么？

original: It's always a pleasure to see you around the camp.
translation: 很高兴能在营地里看见你。

original: Are you going to help us this time, or vex us?
translation: 你这次到底是来帮我们的，还是来骚扰我们的？

original: And so the unpredictable one returns. What do you want from us?
translation: 让人猜不透的家伙又回来了。你有什么事啊？

original: I've got little enough patience for you. Consider your words carefully - you don't want me as an enemy.
translation: 我已经对你没什么耐性了。说话小心点——别把我逼急了。
