original: In the past, I'd have had someone like you executed for showing their face here - consider yourself lucky I don't have the warriors to spare.
translation: 要是放在以前，你这样的人敢露脸，我马上就叫人处决了你——算你运气好，我眼下分不出人手来干这事。

original: Ah, you're back. What else do you need?
translation: 啊，你回来了。你还有什么事？

original: Not now, I'm busy.
translation: 没空说话，我正忙呢。

original: You look like someone with a question. What can I do for you?
translation: 你看上去好像满腹疑问。不知我能帮你做点什么？

original: {In agony}Unnnh... please... help me.
translation: {In agony}呃啊……求你……救救我。

original: Thanks for getting me down from that cross. I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢你把我从十字架上放下来。我欠你一条命。

original: Thanks again for saving my ass.
translation: 多谢你救了我的小命。

original: Get away from me, you lunatic!
translation: 离我远点，你这疯子！

original: Anders told me what happened. We owe you one for rescuing him. Tell you what: I can give you caps as a thank you, or a special recipe Jack cooked up.
translation: 安德斯把事情都告诉我们了。我们欠你个人情。这么着吧，我可以给你些瓶盖当报酬，或者，我也可以送你一份杰克的独门配方。

original: Any luck finding Anders?
translation: 找到安德斯了么？

original: You're not one of my regulars. What do you want?
translation: 你好像不是我的老主顾呀。你想要什么？

original: I've been hearing a lot of good things about you. What's up?
translation: 最近常常听见有人说你的好话。有什么事吗？

original: Hey! Seems like you've been making lots of friends around here.
translation: 嘿！看来你在这儿交了不少朋友嘛。

original: {Wary, the player is an unpredictable nutter}Oh, uh, hey - Jack can probably give you a discount, if that'll calm you down.
translation: {Wary, the player is an unpredictable nutter}哦，啊，嘿——杰克也许会给你打折的，你别发火了。

original: Look, we'll be happy to sell you any chems you want, just don't do anything crazy, okay?
translation: 听着，你要什么药，我们都乐意卖给你，但你别乱来，好吗？

original: If there's something you want, spill it - otherwise, move along.
translation: 想说什么就快说——否则就快走。

original: Make it quick - I don't want to be seen with you.
translation: 快点——我可不想被人看到和你在一块。

original: Dammit, someone offed Motor-Runner! That guy was one of our biggest clients.
translation: 该死，有人把轰鸣恶煞做了！那家伙可是我们的大客户。

original: Someone's been picking off the leaders of the Fiends down in New Vegas. That's going to cut into our profits.
translation: 有人正在逐步剿灭新维加斯外围的恶魔帮首领。这是要断了我们的财路啊。

original: Did you make that delivery yet?
translation: 你的货送到了吗？

original: Hey, what's up?
translation: 嘿，怎么了？

original: Whoa. New guy.
translation: 哇哦。新来的小伙。

original: Whoa. New chick.
translation: 哇哦。新来的小妞。

original: Hey, look who it is bringing that good Khan karma around!
translation: 嘿，瞧瞧咱们大汗帮的老朋友回来了！

original: How's my most favoritest friend?
translation: 老朋友，最近怎么样啊？

original: You seriously ought to mellow out, take some chill pills. I could sell you some, if you want.
translation: 我觉得你应该放松一下，来点镇静剂吧。你想要的话，我可以卖给你几支。

original: You seem really... high-strung. You know, I'm sure some of what I make my chems out of was an antipsychotic at some point....
translation: 你看起来有点……压抑。你知道吗，刚好我做的药里含有一些镇静剂的成分……

original: I'm all for live and let live, you know, but a lot of folks around here... umm... aren't.
translation: 我觉得人各有各的活法，应该相互尊重，但这里的很多人却……嗯……不这样想。

original: Why do you have to harsh my mellow? Just be cool, you dig?
translation: 你干吗非要来扫我的兴呢？冷静点，好吗？

original: Hey, what's up?
translation: 嘿，怎么了？

original: Swank filled me in about Benny. Hell of a thing, baby. Hell of a thing.
translation: 斯万克跟我说了本尼的事。事闹大了，宝贝，事情真的闹大了。

original: Oh, come on, baby, we just got this place cleaned up after your last visit!
translation: 哦，拜托，宝贝。我们才刚把你上次留下来的烂摊子收拾干净！

original: Hey hey! Welcome, welcome, welcome to the finest entertainment experience in New Vegas! My name is Tommy Torini, and how can I make your night?
translation: 嘿嘿！欢迎，欢迎，欢迎前来体验新维加斯最棒的娱乐场所！我是汤米·托里尼，不知我该如何帮您度过一个难忘的夜晚？

original: Hey hey! Welcome, welcome, welcome to the finest entertainment experience in New Vegas! My name is Tommy Torini, and how can I make your day?
translation: 嘿嘿！欢迎，欢迎，欢迎前来体验新维加斯最棒的娱乐场所！我是汤米·托里尼，不知我该如何帮您度过一个难忘的夜晚？

original: Well, well, well, if it ain't the best-loved cat on the Strip in my theater! What can Tommy do for you, baby?
translation: 哎呀，哎呀，瞧瞧又有贵客上门了，这不是长街上最受人喜爱的小猫咪么！不知汤米能为你做些什么呀，宝贝？

original: Now baby, you know I welcome everybody here at the Aces, but I gotta ask you to keep any mayhem to a minimum, you dig?
translation: 听我说，宝贝，虽然王牌剧场来者不拒，但我真的得麻烦您，别在我们这儿惹事，明白吗？

original: This new act is out of sight, baby! We're bringing in the caps like a Nuka-Cola bottling plant!
translation: 新场子简直爆满啊，宝贝！我们这儿的瓶盖多得都快成核子可乐装瓶厂了！

original: You doing right by Tommy, baby. Two new acts? We're making this joint jump!
translation: 你对汤米太好了，宝贝。两名新演员？这儿的房梁都快被挤塌了！

original: Damn, baby, you bringing in so many acts the Rad Pack's taking half the night off! I'm seriously thinking about charging them for the free liquor.
translation: 该死，宝贝，你介绍来的新演员也忒多了，核子欢乐汇现在每天都经营到半夜！我已经在认真考虑要不要取消免费酒水了。

original: I got to hand it to you, baby, you did an 18-karat job on this one. My schedule's so full I couldn't put on new acts if I wanted to!
translation: 我得跟你说实话，宝贝，你干得太漂亮了，简直和18克拉钻石一样。现在我的节目表满当当的，新场子都安排不过来了！

original: Welcome back! Here for another fine entertainment experience?
translation: 欢迎回来！又来享受顶级的娱乐服务了？

original: Howdy there, partner.
translation: 你好啊，搭档。

original: Howdy, little lady.
translation: 你好，小女士。

original: Ahhh! Please don't kill me, I swear I'll have - wait. You... you don't work for Mr. Bishop, do you?
translation: 啊！求你别杀我，我发誓我会——等等。你……你不是替彼希先生工作的，对吧？

original: Hey, thanks again for getting me this gig. I owe you one.
translation: 嘿，再次感谢你给我介绍的演出机会。我欠你一个人情。

original: Oh, it's you again. What is it?
translation: 哦，又是你。什么事？

original: Hey, come on, pal, I'm trying to put on a show here!
translation: 嘿，拜托，老兄，我在演出啊！

original: Hey, come on, lady, I'm trying to put on a show here!
translation: 嘿，拜托，女士，我在演出啊！

original: You again? You should meet my bookie, you have something in common - every time I talk to you, I lose caps!
translation: 又是你？你真该去见见我的经纪人，你们有一个共同点——每次和你们说话，我就会亏钱！

original: Whoa, baby! Am I looking at a mirror, or are you just that ugly?
translation: 哇哦，宝贝！是我在照镜子呢，还是你真的有那么丑？

original: Any luck with Garret yet?
translation: 跟加勒特谈的怎么样？

original: Well, if it isn't my number one fan. What can I do for you, number one fan?
translation: 噢，这不是我的头号粉丝吗。有什么事，头号粉丝？

original: You're back. Any progress on saving our skins?
translation: 你回来了。找到办法帮助我们了吗？

original: {Awed}You're some kind of hero, huh? I heard about how you saved the President's life. That's incredible.
translation: {Awed}你已经成了大英雄了，对吗？我听说你救了总统的命。真是难以置信。

original: You've heard the news about President Kimball? {Relieved}Thank God he survived, but I hope the Rangers hunt down the miserable traitor that tried to kill him.
translation: 你听说金博尔总统的事了吗？感谢上帝他活了下来，希望游骑兵能抓到那个企图刺杀他的混蛋叛徒。

original: {Shocked, numb}I just can't believe it... the President's dead. It doesn't even feel real.
translation: {Shocked， numb}我没法相信……总统死了。我真的无法相信。

original: {Furious}You've heard the news about President Kimball? If I got my hands on the traitor that killed him....
translation: {Furious}你听说金博尔总统的事了吗？要是让我抓到那个刺杀他的凶手……

original: {Frightened}So now it's come to open assassination attempts against the President? Hard to believe.
translation: {Frightened}所以说这年头连刺杀总统都公开化了？难以置信。

original: {Hugely relieved}Thank God. Please tell me you're here to relieve me.
translation: {Hugely relieved}感谢上帝。你一定是来救我的吧。

original: {Impressed, relieved}Never expected someone as famous as you to turn up here. What can I do for you?
translation: {Impressed， relieved}没想到像您这样的名人居然会光临此地。不知我能为你做些什么？

original: {Mildly impressed}I've been sending requests for relief for months now. Didn't think they'd send you, though.
translation: {Mildly impressed}确实这几个月我都在发求救信号。但我没想到他们会派你来。

original: {Less than thrilled} I really hope you're not here to cause trouble.
translation: {Less than thrilled}我真心希望你不是来找茬的。

original: {Uncertain}Oh. I've heard of you. What do you want?
translation: {Uncertain}噢。我认得你。你有什么事？

original: {Cold}I'll give you this, you've got a lot of guts just walking in here like this.
translation: {Cold}不得不说，你居然敢大摇大摆地出现在这儿，真是胆量十足。

original: {Stiff, really doesn't like the player}What do you want?
translation: {Stiff, really doesn't like the player}你有什么事？

original: {Frustrated, busy}If this isn't a crisis situation, you'd better have a damn good reason for interrupting me.
translation: {Frustrated, busy}如果不是紧急情况，你最好给我解释清楚你为什么要来打扰我。

original: Anything else I can do for you?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的？

original: {Cautious}What now?
translation: {Cautious}又怎么了？

original: {Cold}What?
translation: {Cold}什么？

original: You've been a huge help here. Thanks to you, I think we can hold this camp together.
translation: 你真是帮了大忙。多亏了你，我觉得我们可以一起守住这个营地了。

original: Was there something else?
translation: 还有什么事吗？

original: {Impressed}It was you that rescued President Kimball, wasn't it? You're becoming quite the celebrity already.
translation: {Impressed}就是你救了金博尔总统，对吗？ 你现在是大名人了。

original: {Relieved}I heard it was a close call for the President. Good thing he has top-notch security.
translation: {Relieved}我听说当时的情况千钧一发。幸好总统身边有最顶级的安保力量。

original: {Melancholy}I hear they're already assembling a team to investigate the President's assassination. Going to be one hell of a report.
translation: {Melancholy}我听说他们已经组建了一支队伍去调查刺杀案。肯定要查他个水落石出。

original: {Angry}I'm a little ashamed to admit it, but a part of me would {emphasis}really love to get my hands on the bastard that killed the President.
translation: {Angry}虽然有些羞愧，但我内心真的{emphasis}很想亲手干掉那个刺杀总统的杂种。

original: {Angry}I'm a little ashamed to admit it, but a part of me would {emphasis}really love to get my hands on the bitch that killed the President.
translation: {Angry}虽然有些羞愧，但我内心真的{emphasis}很想亲手干掉那个刺杀总统的杂种。

original: So, the NCR finally sent some relief? It's about damn time.
translation: 这么说，NCR的增援总算是到了？也该他妈来了。

original: {Starstruck}Wow. Hey, it's you. What are you doing in Bitter Springs?
translation: {Starstruck}哇哦。嘿，是你。你到苦泉来干什么？

original: {Cautious}I don't suppose you're feeling helpful today?
translation: {Cautious}你今天是来捣乱的吧？

original: {Bitter, resigned}I don't know what you're doing here, but you can just leave. We've got enough problems here.
translation: {Bitter, resigned}我不知道你在这里是要干什么，但你最好马上离开。我们的麻烦已经够多了。

original: Those medical supplies have already been a phenomenal help. Thank you.
translation: 那些医疗物资真是及时雨。谢谢你。

original: I really appreciate those books. They've already been a huge help.
translation: 我真的很喜欢那些书。它们令我受益匪浅。

original: Yeah? What is it?
translation: 嗯？什么事？

original: {Angry}Die, NCR filth!
translation: {Angry}死吧，NCR渣滓！

original: {Peaceful, accepting}Thank you for your advice. You've helped me see more clearly.
translation: {Peaceful， accepting}谢谢你的建议。你让我看得更清楚了。

original: {Battle cry}Flails of God!
translation: {Battle cry}神之枷锁！

original: {Suspicious}Who are you? How did you find this place?
translation: {Suspicious}你是谁？你怎么找到这里的？

original: {Resigned}Back again. What now?
translation: {Resigned}你回来了。又有什么事？

original: {Studying player}Looks like we got a new visitor in the ol' Brahmin pen. {Beat}Not many people coming here in a hurry, only passing through.
translation: {Studying player}看来我们的双头牛圈里又来新客人啦。{Beat}没多少人会专程来这里，大多只是从这儿路过。

original: {Sighs}And if you're passing through, you picked a bad time. Road north has gone to hell, and if I let a caravan through, they won't make it.
translation: {Sighs}如果你也是路过的，那可太不巧。北边的道路现在太乱，即便我放商队过去，他们也走不了多远。

original: Appreciate the help. Wish I had more work for you, but nothing else on the radar at the moment.
translation: 多谢帮忙。我很想再给你一点别的活干，但眼下确实没有什么大事了。

original: {Slightly bored}Caravan, citizen, pilgrim, or...?
translation: {Slightly bored}商队，公民，朝圣者，还是……？

original: {Nods to player}Been doing a lot of good work out there, setting an example for the others - I know Ranger Jackson appreciates it.
translation: {Nods to player}你坚持行善，为他人树立了榜样——游骑兵杰克逊肯定会感激你的。

original: Back again, I see. Something you need?
translation: 你又回来了。有什么事吗？

original: {Bad person just walked in}Got some nerve, coming to an NCR outpost with that look about you. {Low, warning}Hope you aren't here to trade, not sure you can afford the prices.
translation: {Bad person just walked in}你胆够大的啊，居然还敢来NCR前哨站。{Low, warning}希望你不是来做买卖的，我怕你出不起那个钱。

original: {Mildly curious}New face in the Outpost, must've come from the North. {Frowns}So - what'll you have?
translation: {Mildly curious}前哨站冒出个新面孔，肯定从北边来的吧。{Frowns}那么——你想要点什么？

original: Back round? Just my luck... what'll it be this time?
translation: 回来了？瞧我这运气……这次你又有什么事？

original: Something else you needed? I'm short-handed here.
translation: 你还需要什么？我这会正忙呢。

original: Any luck up by the track?
translation: 找到什么线索了？

original: Oh... Hello. I am Michael Angelo. How can I-
translation: 噢……你好。我是米开·朗琪罗。请问您——

original: Uh... wait. Are you here to deliver more billboard requests? Please tell me you're not a messenger on behalf of Mr. House.
translation: 呃……等一下。你是来订购灯箱牌的吗？别告诉我你是替豪斯先生给我传话的。

original: Oh, what do you want?
translation: 噢，你有什么事？

original: Aha. The brave photographer returns. Good to see you.
translation: 啊哈。英勇的摄影师回来了。见到你很高兴。

original: {Still afraid}Now that you have all you care for, please... leave, and don't come back!
translation: {Stillafraid}既然你已经没什么事了，那请……走吧，不要再回来了！

original: {Deeply Saddened}I can't talk, not after what happened to Sarah. I feel... so cold.
translation: {DeeplySaddened}我说不出话了，在萨拉遭遇不测以后，我就一直这样。我觉得……好冷。

original: Hi, what can I do for you?
translation: 嗨，有什么能帮忙的？

original: Welcome back. Need anything?
translation: 欢迎回来。有什么事吗？

original: {Sad about her mentor's death}I've been taking care of the shop, since Michael... {Steeled Resolve}I've got to look forward. Someone's got to bring beauty into this barren world.
translation: {Sadabouthermentor'sdeath}我一直在打理这家店，米开他……{SteeledResolve}我必须向前看。总会有人把美好带给这个荒芜的世界。

original: Excuse me, but I'm busy.
translation: 抱歉，我在忙。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Hey, it's you! Michael Angelo told me about your photographs. I hope to see the world, one day, like you do.
translation: 嘿，是你！米开·朗琪罗和我提到了你拍的照片。我希望有朝一日也能像你一样去看看外面的世界。

original: Welcome back, friend. What can I do for you?
translation: 欢迎归来，朋友。需要我做什么？

original: Hey there, friend.
translation: 嗨，朋友。

original: Well butter my butt and call me a biscuit, if it ain't my old friend from Goodsprings!
translation: 哎呀，真是太阳打西边出来了！这不是我那来自清泉镇的老朋友嘛！

original: Well... don't that beat all - it's my old friend from Goodsprings!
translation: 哎呀…真是稀奇啊——这不是我来自清泉镇的老朋友嘛！

original: Well howdy, pardner!  You made it out of Goodsprings no worse for the wear. Good for you.
translation: 你好啊，搭档！看来你是毫发无损地离开了清泉镇啊。真是太好了。

original: I reckon you'll be tracking down that varmint now. A man puts you in a grave has it coming if you ask me.
translation: 我想你是在追杀那个恶棍吧。居然敢活埋你，要我说这人一定是活腻了。

original: Damn, son, you look like ten miles of bad road.
translation: 见鬼，小子，你看上去就像刚从地底下钻出来似的。

original: A piece of advice: Watch yourself around No-Bark... I think he's studying to be a half-wit.
translation: 个人建议：在疯嘴旁边的时候悠着点…我觉得他这人好像故意把自己整成一个弱智。

original: Fancy meeting you here, friend.
translation: 能在这里遇见你真是太巧了，朋友。

original: Charging a casino full of heavily-armed gangsters was a great idea, boss. Definitely not the kind of thing that could have gotten us both killed.
translation: 直接杀进一个满是全副武装的恶徒的赌场，这主意可真妙，老大。咱们肯定能全身而退的，对吧。

original: Not to worry, boss. I'm sure killing the boss of one of the Families will in no way lead to savage, bloody reprisals against you and your loved ones.
translation: 不用担心，老大。要我说，就算你把哪个家族的大佬干掉，也绝不会招致对你亲近的人和你本人的疯狂报复。

original: If we run, we might still catch Benny! Well, you might. I'll just be wheezing along behind you.
translation: 如果我们跑起来的话还是能追上本尼的！我看好你，我会在后面为你加油打气的。

original: You really enjoy dragging me into situations where I get shot at, don't you boss?
translation: 你倒挺喜欢把我拽进枪林弹雨里的嘛，老大？

original: Ahh, overly-elaborate mob schemes to take over Vegas. Reminds me of the days before the War.
translation: 啊哈，一群乌合之众煞费苦心地想要占领维加斯。让我想起了战前的日子。

original: {Hushed, slightly awed and actually not sarcastic for once}I can't believe we're allowed inside the Lucky 38. That place has been a legend since before the War....
translation: {Hushed，slightly awed and actually not sarcastic for once}真不敢相信我们能获准进入幸运38。那地方在伟大战争以前就已经是个传奇了……

original: Angry soldier robots with bazookas. I'm sure they'll be a good police force.
translation: 手持火箭、怒气冲天的机器人士兵。我敢肯定他们都是尽忠职守的好警察。

original: Maybe I'm just old and tired, but being locked in a cool, dark pod to sleep for a few centuries doesn't sound so bad.
translation: 也许是我老不中用了吧，不过被关在一个凉爽昏暗的舱室里睡上几个世纪，听起来也不坏嘛。

original: {Vaguely grossed out by seeing a guy's body explode}Eesh, boss. Just... eesh.
translation: {Vaguely grossed out by seeing a guy's body explode}噫，老大。那也太……噫！

original: Don't worry boss, I'm sure Caesar just wants to invite you over for coffee or something. That's all.
translation: 老大，别担心，我敢肯定凯撒只是想请你去喝杯咖啡之类的。仅此而已。

original: Hey boss, that surgery reminded me of something: I got this funny lump right down here... think you could take a look at it?
translation: 嘿，老大，那场手术突然让我想起了点事情：我这儿长了个滑稽的肿块……你能不能帮我看一下？

original: I'm glad you decided to off one of the most powerful men in the Mojave. Life was getting boring anyways. Really.
translation: 我很高兴你决定把莫哈维沙漠中最有权势的人之一置于死地。反正生活也很乏味。真的。

original: Yeah, Caesar, let's give you brain surgery in a tent. That can't possibly go wrong.
translation: 对，凯撒，我们来你的营帐里给你做脑科手术吧。不会出问题的。

original: Caesar's death reminds me of an old saying. I can't quite remember it now, something like "sic semper tyrannosaurus."
translation: 凯撒的死让我想起了一句老话。我记不太清楚了，好像是"sic semper tyrannosaurus。（这就是暴君的下场。）"

original: Oh, good. Now there's an army of robots. You don't do things by halves, do you, boss?
translation: 噢，太好了。现在冒出来了一整支机器人大军。你不会半途而废的，对吧，老大？

original: Did blowing up that vault serve a purpose, or do you just like explosions?
translation: 把那个避难所炸飞有什么意义吗，还是你只是单纯地喜欢看爆炸？

original: {Pity}Those poor NCR soldiers... now where will they get their hookers and gambling?
translation: {Pity}那些可怜的NCR士兵啊……现在他们去哪玩女人和钱呢？

original: Be honest, you did it for the ticker-tape parades, huh boss?
translation: 说真的，你是想搞庆祝大游行吗，老大？

original: Don't worry, boss. I'll make sure your biography says you "heroically changed your mind" about killing the president, not "choked under pressure."
translation: 放心，老大。我在你的传记里肯定会写，在刺杀总统这件事上，你是"英雄般地临阵倒戈"，而非"迫于万般无奈。"

original: Just to be clear, we're not planning to visit any NCR facilities, right boss? Like, ever again?
translation: 就是确认一下，咱们并没有打算访问NCR的任何设施，对吧，老大？永远不会有？

original: Well, the President's dead, but don't worry. History has shown that that sort of thing almost never leads to massive destabilizations or world wars.
translation: 好了，总统已经死了，不过别担心。历史已经一再证明，这种事情从来就不会导致大规模动乱或者世界大战。

original: Never been a big fan of gangs like the Fiends, boss. I'm glad they're gone.
translation: 我从来就不喜欢恶魔帮那样的帮派，老大。很高兴他们完蛋了。

original: The Khans didn't seem so bad to me, but what do I know? I was locked up in a cell by a crazy Nightkin for years.
translation: 我觉得大汗帮也没那么坏，不过也轮不到我说话，毕竟我都被一个夜行族疯子关在囚室里那么多年了。

original: Do you often go toe-to-toe with guys dressed as tanks, boss? That might not be great for your life expectancy.
translation: 你很喜欢和穿得像个铁桶似的家伙贴身肉搏吗，老大？那倒是个折寿的好办法。

original: I'm sure pissing off a ruthless warlord with a tribe of fanatically-devoted warriors was a good move. How could it not be? It was your idea.
translation: 我相信，和一个统领着数百名狂热士兵的军阀结下梁子绝对是一着妙棋。怎么会不好呢？那可是您想出的妙计啊。

original: I'm sure pissing off a massive government with a huge army at its disposal was a good move. How could it not be? It was your idea.
translation: 我相信，和一个手握军权的强力政府结下梁子绝对是一着妙棋。怎么会不好呢？那可是您想出的妙计啊。

original: I'm sure pissing off the two most powerful factions in the Mojave was a good move. How could it not be? It was your idea.
translation: 我相信，同时和莫哈维最强大的两大势力结下梁子，绝对是一着好棋。怎么会不好呢？那可是您想出的妙计啊。

original: Don't worry, boss. I'm sure the sudden tension in the air is just... {desperately searching for an explanation}a thunderstorm?
translation: 别担心，老大。我敢肯定这突然间的风云骤起，也只不过是……{desperately searching for an explanation}一场雷暴雨？

original: Okay, so maybe I was wrong about the thunderstorm thing. I admit it.
translation: 好吧，我承认，可能并不是什么雷暴雨。

original: {Quiet, somber, usual sarcasm replaced by seriousness}Looks like this is gonna be the big one, boss. If you're ready, I'm with you.
translation: {Quiet，somber，usual sarcasm replaced by seriousness}看起来是要大干一场了，老大。如果你准备好了，咱们就一起上。

original: What can I do for you, boss?
translation: 你要我怎么做，老大？

original: Took you long enough. So, can I go now?
translation: 你来得可真慢啊。那么，我现在可以走了吗？

original: I haven't heard a fresh batch of crazy coming out of the radio in a while. Does that mean I can leave?
translation: 电台里的各类新鲜玩意我都快听腻了。我是不是可以走了？

original: Back again? Can I go this time, or do you have something else in mind?
translation: 又来了？这次我终于能走了吧？还是你又有别的打算？

original: Oh, it's you. You need something repaired or something?
translation: 噢，是你呀。你是有东西要修，还是有其他事？

original: {Terrified and alarmed. Yelling to everyone around. Monsters got free.}Run! Beasts got free!
translation: {Terrified and alarmed。 Yelling to everyone around。 Monsters got free。}快逃啊！野兽跑出来了！

original: {Terrified and alarmed. Yelling to everyone around. Monsters got free.}Deathclaws are loose! Get out of here!
translation: {Terrified and alarmed。 Yelling to everyone around。 Monsters got free。}死亡爪都出来了！快离开这里！

original: {Terrified and alarmed. Yelling to everyone around. Monsters got free.}It can't be! How the hell...
translation: {Terrified and alarmed。Yelling to everyone around。Monsters got free。}不可能！这到底……

original: {Terrified and alarmed. Yelling to everyone around. Monsters got free.}Holy shit! Run for your lives!
translation: {Terrified and alarmed。 Yelling to everyone around。 Monsters got free。}妈的！快逃命啊！

original: {Excited to watch creatures fight}What a fight!
translation: {Excited to watch creatures fight}多么精彩的战斗！

original: {Excited to watch creatures fight}Go Red!
translation: {Excited to watch creatures fight}红方加油！

original: {Excited to watch creatures fight}Blood! We want more blood!
translation: {Excited to watch creatures fight}血！我们要更多的血！

original: {Excited to watch creatures fight - drawn out "kill"}Kiiiiiiill, kill now!
translation: {Excited to watch creatures fight — drawn out "杀"}杀杀杀，现在就杀！

original: {Excited to watch creatures fight}I'm betting for Blue!
translation: {Excited to watch creatures fight}我押蓝方！

original: {Excited to watch creatures fight}Did you see that?
translation: {Excited to watch creatures fight}你看到了吗？

original: {Satisfied after much excitement}Until next time.
translation: {Satisfied after much excitement}等下次了。

original: {Satisfied after much excitement}Great fighting today.
translation: {Satisfied after much excitement}今天太过瘾了。

original: {Proud}There's always more next day.
translation: {Proud}下次会更精彩。

original: {Proud}That was a good day for The Thorn.
translation: {Proud}荆棘街又过了热闹的一天。

original: {Proud}The beasts don't look so tough behind bars, huh?
translation: {Proud}这东西在笼子里也没那么可怕嘛，嗯？

original: {Proud}I can't imagine this place will ever disappear.
translation: {Proud}我敢说这地方会永远都不会消失。

original: {Proud}There's nothing else like The Thorn!
translation: {Proud}没有像荆棘街更棒的地方了！

original: {Hopeful Excitement}One day I'll get to see Deathclaws tear through Fiends!
translation: {Hopeful Excitement}总有一天我会看到死亡爪撕碎恶魔帮！

original: {Hopeful Excitement}I hope Red Lucy gives us the{slight emphasis in "big"} *big* monsters, next.
translation: {Hopeful Excitement}希望血手露西下次能派真正的{slight emphasis in "big"}*大*家伙上场。

original: {Impatient Excitement}More fights, we want more.
translation: {Impatient Excitement}再来几场，我们还要看。

original: {Impatient Excitement}I can't wait to see what fights next.
translation: {Impatient Excitement}我迫不及待想看下场战斗了。

original: {Bewildered}What the hell?{slight pause}Is that a half-robot dog?
translation: {Bewildered}什么东西？{slight pause}那是一条半机械狗吗？

original: {Gratitude}You better control that{slight pause, sizing E-DE}thing. Bots can't be trusted.
translation: {Gratitude}你最好能管住{slight pause, sizing E-DE}那东西。机器人都不可信。

original: {Gratitude}A Follower is always welcome among our people.
translation: {Gratitude}天启追随者在这里是非常受欢迎的。

original: {Restrained Warning}Keep the Ranger on a leash around here.
translation: {Restrained Warning}把你的游骑兵拴好。

original: {Inquisitive}Another Supermutant roaming outer New Vegas, huh?
translation: {Inquisitive}怎么又来一个在新维加斯外围闲逛的超级变种人？

original: {Proud Assertion}All humans are welcome here, even Ghouls.
translation: {Proud Assertion}这里欢迎任何人，包括尸鬼。

original: {Relieved}That Fiend leader got what he fucking deserved.
translation: {Relieved}那个恶魔帮头目真是他妈罪有应得。

original: {Disappointed}Fuck that Fiend bastard. Wish I would've seen him die.
translation: {Disappointed}那个该死的恶魔帮杂种。真希望亲眼看见他是怎么死的。

original: {Pessimistic Resignation}Can't help thinking that we've not seen the last of the Fiends yet.
translation: {Pessimistic Resignation}有时候我忍不住会想，我们怕是看不到恶魔帮死光的那一天了。

original: {Relieved}I hope the Fiends have learned their lesson.
translation: {Relieved}希望恶魔帮已经得到教训了。

original: {Relieved}Won't have to worry about those Fiend assholes for some time now, huh?
translation: {Relieved}终于可以不用时刻担心那些恶魔帮杂种了，嗯？

original: {Surprised}I heard Mr. House's done for. I hope the Sewers don't turn for the worse.
translation: {Surprised}听说豪斯先生完蛋了。希望下水道不会变得更糟。

original: {Happily Surprised}We should reclaim the rest of city, if the rumors about House are true.
translation: {Happily Surprised}如果关于豪斯的谣言属实的话，我们应该彻底占领这座城市。

original: {Pessimistic Sarcasm}You saved the NCR's head honcho, sure you can save a bunch of low-life scum like us.
translation: {Pessimistic Sarcasm}你既然能救NCR的大老板，肯定也能救我们这些底层的渣滓。

original: {Pessimistic Sarcasm}Got time to save us too, or are you running errands for your NCR masters?
translation: {Pessimistic Sarcasm}你是来救我们的，还是来给你的NCR主子跑腿的？

original: {Satisfied}Even Presidents die, huh? Good.
translation: {Satisfied}就连总统都死了？很好。

original: {Pessimistic Resignation}Caesar's death don't change shit down here.
translation: {Pessimistic Resignation}凯撒的死能对这里有个屁的影响。

original: {Defiant, then relieved}That Legion boss would've never taken the city, but I'm glad he's a goner.
translation: {Defiant, then relieved}那个军团老大根本夺取不了这座城市，不过他死了是最好的。

original: {Wishful Sarcasm}Wonder if we can move into the Sewers under the Strip now that Mr. House is outta business.
translation: {Wishful Sarcasm}既然豪斯先生已经不是问题了，我们是不是可以搬进长街的下水道了。

original: If there's war in the end, it won't affect our city.
translation: 就算以后真打仗，也影响不到我们的城市。

original: Rumors of imminent war have made it all the way down here.
translation: 这里谣言四起，都说战争要打响了。

original: {Indolent}Going to stay down here until all the trouble outside blows over.
translation: {Indolent}在外面的麻烦事结束前，我还是躲在这里比较好。

original: Looks like the entire region's going straight where we are - knee-deep in shit.
translation: 感觉这地方的人就快和我们差不多了，都一脚踩进膝盖深的屎里。

original: {Almost annoyed}Only one bad thing about the Thorn, it brings all the idiots, assholes and topsiders down here.
translation: {Almost annoyed}荆棘街唯一的问题就是，它把所有的白痴、杂种和上面的人都集中到这下面来了。

original: {Excited}I can't wait to hit The Thorn. I wouldn't mind hitting on Red Lucy either, but she's outta my league.
translation: {Excited}我等不及要去荆棘街了。虽然我不介意和血手露西来一发，但她应该看不上我。

original: {Excited}Going to place me a good bet at The Thorn.
translation: {Excited}我要在荆棘街好好赌一把。

original: {Excited}Want to see the best of New Vegas? Our sewers got it - The Thorn!
translation: {Excited}想看看新维加斯最棒的地方吗？就在我们的下水道——荆棘街！

original: {Excited}Saw a monster rip a man in half at The Thorn.
translation: {Excited}我在荆棘街见过怪物把人活生生撕成两半。

original: {Amazement}Hey, you're the one that's been hunting the most dangerous beasts for The Thorn!
translation: {Amazement}嘿，你就是帮荆棘街捕猎最危险的野兽的那个人吧！

original: {Honest Praise}Hey, It's great what you're doing for The Thorn, way to go!
translation: {Honest Praise}嘿，你为荆棘街做了很大的贡献，加油！

original: {Amazement}Wish I could've seen you capture those beasts for our Thorn!
translation: {Amazement}真希望能亲眼见识你为我们荆棘街抓捕那些野兽的场面！

original: {Honest Praise}I've heard of your fights at The Thorn. People down here don't stop talking about you.
translation: {Honest Praise}我听说了你在荆棘街的战斗。这下面的人可一直在谈论你呢。

original: {Bewildered}Taking down a Giant Radscorpion, by yourself, has made you popular down here.
translation: {Bewildered}你凭一人之力就打败了巨型辐射蝎，光是这件事就已经让你在这儿大受欢迎了。

original: {Bewildered}Killing Fire Geckos at The Thorn is no joke, you're quite the fighter!
translation: {Bewildered}在荆棘街杀死火蜥蜴可不是开玩笑的，你是真正的斗士！

original: {Bewildered}You've beat Night Stalkers, right? We don't see that often down here.
translation: {Bewildered}你消灭了夜行兽，是不是？这种事可不常见。

original: {Bewildered}You've taken down Cazadores! Didn't think I'd ever see that.
translation: {Bewildered}你打败了猎蜂！没想到还会有这种事。

original: {Bewildered}I heard you've killed Deathclaws at The Thorn. I couldn't believe it!
translation: {Bewildered}听说你在荆棘街杀死了死亡爪。真是难以置信！

original: {Excited}One of these days, Red Lucy's going to show off her Deathclaws.
translation: {Excited}过不了几天，血手露西就该让她的死亡爪出场了。

original: {Dumbfounded}All hell broke loose when the creatures escaped from The Thorn!
translation: {Dumbfounded}荆棘街所有的鬼东西都跑出来了！

original: {Dumbfounded}One of those beasts cut my friend in half! How the hell did they escape from Red Lucy?
translation: {Dumbfounded}有头野兽把我的朋友撕成了两半！这些东西到底是他妈怎么从血手露西那里逃出来的？

original: {Dumbfounded}Can't believe that The Thorn's no more.
translation: {Dumbfounded}真不敢相信荆棘街已经不复存在了。

original: {Dumbfounded}Can't believe that The Thorn's no more.
translation: {Dumbfounded}真不敢相信荆棘街已经不复存在了。

original: {Dumbfounded}Red Lucy was a fine warrior, and a beautiful woman.
translation: {Dumbfounded}血手露西是一个优秀的战士，也是一个漂亮的女人。

original: {Dumbfounded}We'll miss Red Lucy down here.
translation: {Dumbfounded}我们会想念血手露西的。

original: {Slight Sarcasm}Fiends don't come here no more, they say.
translation: {Slight Sarcasm}他们说恶魔帮再也不会来了。

original: {Slight Sarcasm}I bet NCR troops can't wait to clean the sewers.
translation: {Slight Sarcasm}我敢打赌NCR的部队已经等不及要清理下水道了。

original: {Slight Sarcasm}New Vegas, paradise, my ass.
translation: {Slight Sarcasm}新维加斯，天堂，个屁。

original: {Slight Sarcasm}NCR should head back to their lands, I'm sure *their* people miss them.
translation: {Slight Sarcasm}NCR应该回老家去，*他们的*人民肯定想死他们了。

original: {Slight Sarcasm}NCR came all the way to save us, huh? Guess they missed the shit-holes.
translation: {Slight Sarcasm}NCR大老远跑来救我们？我猜他们肯定是没看见这些粪坑。

original: {Matter of Course Warning}Stay underground at night.
translation: {Matter of Course Warning}晚上在地下呆着。

original: {Matter of Course Warning}Watch out where you exit. Sewers can lead you to Fiend territory.
translation: {Matter of Course Warning}出去的时候警惕点。下水道和恶魔帮的领地可是连着的。

original: {Matter of Course Warning}Keep an eye on your stuff - damn thieves.
translation: {Matter of Course Warning}看好你的东西——小偷太多了。

original: {Matter of Course Warning}Don't go too far, it's all shadows and dangers in the lower levels.
translation: {Matter of Course Warning}别走得太远，下面一层很危险。

original: {Matter of Course Warning}Careful with those Fiends in the western sewers.
translation: {Matter of Course Warning}小心西边下水道里的那些恶魔帮。

original: {Anxious Apprehension}I need my fix.
translation: {Anxious Apprehension}我得过下瘾了。

original: {Anxious Apprehension}I hurt all over.
translation: {Anxious Apprehension}感觉浑身都疼。

original: {Anxious Apprehension}Going to eat the next fucking rat I see.
translation: {Anxious Apprehension}妈的，老鼠再来我就吃了它。

original: {Anxious Apprehension}Just got to find me some sweet Jet.
translation: {Anxious Apprehension}得找点杰特来爽一下。

original: {Beaten Resignation}Won't ever make enough to live outside.
translation: {Beaten Resignation}永远挣不够去外面生活的钱。

original: {Beaten Resignation}Can't go anywhere else.
translation: {Beaten Resignation}去不了别的地方。

original: {Beaten Resignation}Don't think I'll make it topside any time soon.
translation: {Beaten Resignation}看来我这段时间是别想上去了。

original: {Beaten Resignation}Smells like shit all the time, but at least we're safer than in the Wastes.
translation: {Beaten Resignation}这地方闻起来永远都是屎味，但至少我们比待在废土安全。

original: {Thankful}Good to see you respect the Followers.
translation: {Thankful}很高兴你能尊重天启追随者。

original: {Cautionary}Make sure the NCR dog behaves, you're in the Mojave now.
translation: {Cautionary}管好你身边那条NCR的狗，你现在是在莫哈维。

original: {Approving}Your merchant friend is always welcome among us.
translation: {Approving}非常欢迎你的商人朋友。

original: {Apprehensive Curiosity}That bot of yours don't look like anything I've seen in the Mojave.
translation: {Apprehensive Curiosity}你这个机器人和我在莫哈维见过的东西都不一样。

original: {Overt Curiosity}Your friend's not from the desert, is she?
translation: {Overt Curiosity}你的那个朋友不是从沙漠里来的吧？

original: {Suspicious}We tolerate Wasteland savages, as long as they respect our rule around here.
translation: {Suspicious}只要守我们这里的规矩，我们也可以容忍废土的野人。

original: {Carlitos speaks all his dialogue like a gangster out of luck, still heavily affected by slang, tone and sarcastic demeanor}Hey, do you mind? I'm trying to drink myself to the ground, right here. Scram.
translation: {Carlitos speaks all his dialogue like a gangster out of luck， still heavily affected by slang， tone and sarcastic demeanor}嘿，麻烦你走开好吗？我要让自己醉倒在地上不省人事。滚开。

original: Hey, scram. Come bug me when I'm at the diner... if you're a real pain in the ass.
translation: 嘿，滚远点。有事等吃饭的时候再来找我……如果你真嫌皮痒痒的话。

original: Yeah, what do you want?
translation: 是的，你想要什么？

original: Hey, it's you! What's the news?
translation: 嘿，是你！有什么消息吗？

original: You've made it! Thank you so much for your help. I owe you more than- Wait! What's that?
translation: 你成功了！非常感谢你的帮助。我欠你——等等！怎么回事？

original: Let me guess. You want to know my secret - how I got my beard to grow in so thick.
translation: 我猜猜。你肯定是想知道我的秘密吧——比如我的胡子为什么这么浓密。

original: Just talk to Big Beard next to me, pal. Whoever's got the biggest whiskers, does the talking...
translation: 有话就去和我边上的大胡子说吧，伙计。这地方，只有胡子最密的人才有发言权……

original: Couldn't stay away, huh?
translation: 你就不能离我远点吗？

original: Well, well, well, if it isn't our whore, Joana... and, I don't believe this. Carlitos!
translation: 哎呀，哎呀，哎呀，这不是我们的大名媛琼娜么……还有这位，连我自己都不敢相信，卡利托斯！

original: We had you and the whore clocked from the start, but we thought Carlitos would be long gone by now.
translation: 我们从一开始就在跟踪你和那个妓女了。但我们真没想到卡利托斯还活着。

original: He should've fled with the caps he stole from the family. We Omertas don't forget and now's time to pay for your offenses.
translation: 他既然偷了家族的钱，就应该溜远一点。我们黑手党是很记仇的，看来现在要新仇旧恨一起算了。

original: Look, we are going, okay? So, leave us be.
translation: 听着，我们马上走，行吗？放了我们吧。

original: I don't know how we pulled this off, for a minute there I thought we were not going to make it.
translation: 我都不知道我们是怎么逃出来的，有那么一分钟我真的以为我们都完了。

original: Without you, we'd been in the losing end. Thank you so much for your help, friend.
translation: 没有你的话，我们早就死无葬身之地了。非常感谢你的帮助，朋友。

original: No... Joana! It can't be! She didn't deserve this, she didn't, you hear?
translation: 不……琼娜！这不可能！她不该是这样的下场，不该是这样的，你明白吗？

original: It should've been me, not her... They will pay, right now! Out of my way!
translation: 应该是我，不应该是她……他们会付出代价的，就是现在！给我让开！

original: For my beard, I do as I promised.
translation: 为了我的胡须，我会履行我的诺言。

original: Hey, friend! It's good to see you again.
translation: 嘿，朋友！能再次看到你真是太好了。

original: This place don't have the glitter of the Strip, but I've got Joana - that's all I'll ever need.
translation: 这地方没有长街那样光彩夺目，但是我有琼娜——这就足够了。

original: {Whispering, not wanting to be recognized}We're ready. Let's get out of here.
translation: {Whispering， not wanting to be recognized}我们准备好了。走吧。

original: {Thankful}Thank you for your help!
translation: {Thankful}感谢你的帮助！

original: {Fearful}I'm out of here.
translation: {Fearful}我要离开这儿。

original: {Whispering, not wanting to be reconized}C'mon, let's go.
translation: {Whispering， not wanting to be reconized}快点，我们走。

original: {Thankful}Can't thank you enough for saving us.
translation: {Thankful}你的大恩我们无以回报。

original: {Fearful}Didn't expect things to go so bad - I'm not staying here any longer.
translation: {Fearful}从没想到事情会变得这么糟——我要马上离开这儿。

original: Watch out for Fiends.
translation: 小心恶魔帮。

original: We don't need the NCR.
translation: 我们不需要NCR。

original: I kinda like being a farmer.
translation: 我有点向往农夫的生活了。

original: I'm glad Mean Sonofabitch is on our side.
translation: 很高兴无耻杂种和我们站一边。

original: {No more water from NCR}Crops aren't getting as much water lately.
translation: {No more water from NCR}最近都没有足够的水来灌溉庄稼了。

original: {Saint James and Dermot dead}We're better off with those slaver bastards Saint James and Dermot.
translation: {圣詹姆斯 and 德莫特 dead}没有圣詹姆斯和德莫特那两个杂种奴隶贩子，我们的日子好过多了。

original: That Sweetie sure is something.
translation: 那个小甜甜本事不错。

original: {Anderson dead or gone}I'm gonna miss having Anderson around.
translation: 我会想念有安德森在的日子的。

original: Anything new happening?
translation: 有什么新情况吗？

original: {Drunk, pathetic}Ya got any change, man? I've got five kids to feed.
translation: {Drunk，pathetic}你有零钱吗，老兄？我有五个孩子要养活。

original: {Drunk rambling}You're a crazy son of a bitch, you hear me! The Tops!? Ha! Crazy.
translation: {Drunk rambling}你是个疯杂种，疯杂种！九重天！？哈！彻底疯了。

original: {Drunk, pathetic}Ya got any change, man? I've got five kids to feed.
translation: {Drunk，pathetic}你有零钱吗，老兄？我有五个孩子要养活。

original: {Drunk rambling}Yeah I saw Benny running through here! He had the fear of the devil {in-im}in him!
translation: {Drunk rambling}没错，我看见本尼跑过去了！{in-im}像是被鬼追一样！

original: {Drunk rambling}You killed ol' cheeser!? They said he was a God! Ha, who ever heard of a God of cheese?
translation: {Drunk rambling}你杀了老干酪！？他们说他是神！哈，谁听说过干酪之神？

original: {Drunk rambling}Cheeser's dead!? They said he was a God! Ha, who ever heard of a God of cheese?
translation: {Drunk rambling}老干酪死了！？他们说他是神！哈，谁听说过干酪之神？

original: {Drunk rambling}There are many good things in life, but peeing is definitely the best.
translation: {Drunk rambling}生命中美好的事很多，撒尿绝对是其中最美好的。

original: {Drunk upset}Hey! Don't poke me!
translation: {Drunk upset}嘿！别戳我！

original: {Drunk upset}Ow! Why are you poking me!
translation: {Drunk upset}哎呦！干嘛老戳我！

original: {Drunk upset, you gotta}You've got to keep {yer}your bitches in line!
translation: {Drunk upset, you gotta}管好你的那些婊子！

original: {Drunk upset, you gotta}You've got to keep {yer}your bitches in line!
translation: {Drunk upset, you gotta}管好你的那些婊子！

original: {Drunk upset}Go bother someone else.
translation: {Drunk upset}去烦别人去。

original: {Drunk rambling}A man is never drunk if he can lie on the floor without holding on.
translation: {Drunk rambling}只要没人扶还能在地板上躺稳，就不算醉。

original: {Drunk cheer}Woooooo!
translation: {Drunk cheer}呜——！

original: {Drunk confused}Where'd {da}The {kins}Kings go?
translation: {Drunk confused}猫王帮去哪了？

original: {Drunk happy}Hey doc! You got any Fixer?! I've got a bender planned that would make a hobo cry.
translation: {Drunk happy}嘿，医生！你那儿还有瘾头解吗？我想到了一个整蛊流浪汉的好方法。

original: {Drunk, scared whisper}I think your friend wants to eat me! Please don't let him!
translation: {Drunk, scared whisper}我觉得你朋友想要吃我！求你管好他！

original: {Drunk, wistful}Is there anything more beautiful than a beautiful busty brahmin riding a caravaneer off into the sunset... Wait I don't think that came out right.
translation: {Drunk, wistful}有比丰满的双头牛骑着商队成员消失在落日里更美的景象吗……等等，好像哪有点不对。

original: {Drunk rambling}I'll give you five caps for the {robe-it}robot!
translation: {Drunk rambling}我愿意出5个瓶盖买那个机器人！

original: {Drunk rambling}Your ghoul friend looks shifty. Watch your pockets, buddy!
translation: {Drunk rambling}你的尸鬼朋友看起来鬼鬼祟祟的。看好你的口袋，伙计！

original: What happened to your buddy's face?
translation: 你朋友的脸怎么了？

original: {Drunk, very slurred speech}I am not an alcoholic, sir. I'm a drunk! There's a difference!
translation: {Drunk，very slurred speech}我不是酒鬼，先生。我是喝醉了！这是两码事！

original: {Drunk, very slurred speech}I am not an alcoholic, ma'am. I'm a drunk! There's a difference!
translation: {Drunk，very slurred speech}我不是酒鬼，女士。我是喝醉了！这是两码事！

original: {Drunk ramble}The problem with some people is when they're not drunk, they're sober.
translation: {Drunk ramble}有些人最大的问题就是，没醉的时候太清醒了。

original: {Drunk ramble}People ask me how much it takes me to get drunk. I don't know. I usually can't remember numbers, let alone where I am the next morning.
translation: {Drunk ramble}有人问我要喝多少才会醉。我不知道。我通常都记不住数字，更别说第二天早晨起来在哪了。

original: {Drunk ramble}Hey! Watch your back! There be a pack of ol' ladies runnin' round here somewhere! Don't let {em}them catch you unawares!
translation: {Drunk ramble}嘿！当心点！附近有一群老太太在乱窜！别被她们偷袭了！

original: Hang on there, traveler. You'll want to steer clear of this place - the whole town is irradiated to high hell.
translation: 旅行者，不要再往前走了。你不会想在这里久待的，整个镇子的辐射高得都和地狱一样。

original: How are you coming with the dog tags?
translation: 狗牌收集得怎么样了？

original: You're back. What can I do for you?
translation: 你回来了？我能为你做些什么？

original: <Questions about Searchlight>
translation: <关于探照灯的问题>

original: <Questions about Edwards>
translation: <关于爱德华兹的问题>

original: <Cottonwood Cove Quest>
translation: <棉白杨湾任务>

original: Go away.
translation: 走吧。

original: Who the hell are you? Better yet, what the hell are you doing in this cursed place?
translation: 你到底是谁啊？还有，你跑到这个被诅咒的地方来干什么？

original: You know what? Forget it, it doesn't matter. Welcome to Camp Searchlight, the shittiest place on earth.
translation: 算了，我不问了，无所谓。欢迎来到探照灯营地，地球上最烂的地方。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: <Questions about dog tag>
translation: <关于狗牌的问题>

original: <Questions for Edwards>
translation: <对于爱德华兹的问题>

original: <Arachnophobia Quest Stuff>
translation: <恐蛛症任务物品>

original: This job's boring enough without talking to you. Go see Alexander.
translation: 就算不和你聊天，这工作也是无聊透顶。去见亚历山大吧。

original: Alexander doesn't pay me to talk.
translation: 亚历山大付钱给我，不是让我聊天的。

original: We're just muscle. Alexander's the man to talk to.
translation: 我们只是马仔，亚历山大才是管事儿的。

original: Hi, mister. I hope you're doing fine today.
translation: 嗨，先生。希望你今天过的愉快。

original: Hello, ma'am. I hope you're doing fine today.
translation: 你好，女士。希望你今天过的愉快。

original: I thought I'd be seeing you again.
translation: 我觉得还会见到你的。

original: You a merc? 'Cause you don't look like a prospector...
translation: 你是雇佣兵？感觉你看起来不像捡破烂的……

original: I've still got guns and ammo, if you need them.
translation: 如果你需要的话，我这儿还有枪支和弹药。

original: I lost everything I had at The Tops, but if you gave me 500 caps, I'd head straight back. Sick, huh?
translation: 我在九重天输得精光，但如果你给我500瓶盖，我还是会直接回去。中毒不浅，对吧？

original: I came east to strike it rich, and now I'm broker than ever. What do I tell my family back home?
translation: 我来东部是为了发财，结果现在比以前还惨。我回去怎么跟家里人交待啊？

original: On the Strip, everyone's nice to you when you got the caps. The moment you don't? They throw your ass out.
translation: 在长街，只要你有瓶盖，所有人都特别好。要是没瓶盖了？一脚把你踹出门。

original: I won big my first night on the Strip. I kept chasing that feeling. Right into the gutter.
translation: 我到长街的第一夜赢得盆满钵满。我决定继续跟着感觉走，结果就跟进了贫民窟。

original: I sat down at a roulette table with my life savings. An hour later, it was gone.
translation: 我拿着毕生的积蓄坐上赌桌。一小时以后，什么都没了。

original: Can you spare some caps, mister?
translation: 能给几个瓶盖吗，先生？

original: Can you spare some caps, 'mam?
translation: 能给几个瓶盖吗，女士？

original: Go East! they say. Scrap lying in the sun for you to grab. Yeah, right.
translation: 去东部！他们说的，满地废品等你捡。好吧，也没错。

original: The Strip ain't nothing but a monster. Chews folks up, sucks out their caps, and spits 'em back out.
translation: 长街就是个怪物。它把所有人都吞下去，吸干净了瓶盖再吐出来。

original: The Strip's got more gorgeous women than I ever seen in one place, and most of them's affordable.
translation: 长街的美女比我见过的任何一个地方都多，而且大部分都不太贵。

original: You hear the losers around here complaining how they lost their shirts on the Strip? It's pathetic.
translation: 你听见那些输家是怎么抱怨自己在长街把内裤都输出去的吗？真可悲。

original: After I win big, I'm going to buy my friends dinner at that fancy Gor-mant restaurant. I saw ads for it back home.
translation: 等我赢了大钱，就请我的朋友们去美食家餐厅吃顿好的。我在回家路上看见广告了。

original: I walked all the way from Hub! Thought I'd rest my feet here a day or two, then I head onto the Strip fresh.
translation: 我是从哈勃城一步一步走过来的！我打算先休息一两天，等精神饱满了再上长街。

original: I'll get in, win big, get out. Take those winnings back home where they'll do some good!
translation: 我要进去，赢大钱，然后出来。把赢来的钱都带回家，用来做好事！

original: You know it's illegal for us to gamble back home? The government wants to keep us poor.
translation: 你知道在我家那边赌博违法吗？政府就是想让我们穷。

original: I'm sick of the sob stories you hear around here. If you don't know when to stop gambling, that's no one's fault but your own.
translation: 你知道的那些悲伤故事，我早就听腻了。赌博不懂得见好就收，那是你自己的错。

original: I can't wait to see the Strip. I hear it's so beautiful!
translation: 我都等不及去看看长街了。听说非常漂亮！

original: I only work for caravans, all right? Try someone else.
translation: 我只为商队工作，懂了？找别人吧。

original: Sitting around here makes me miss my raider days. I don't know why I figured it was time to get respectable.
translation: 在这儿坐着让我想起了当掠夺者的那段日子。不知道为什么，那段日子我觉得自己活得很有尊严。

original: Whatever you're selling, I ain't buying.
translation: 不管你想卖什么东西，我都不缺。

original: A friend of mine at the Dam says President Kimball might visit the troops out there. Imagine shaking the president's hand!
translation: 我有个在水坝的朋友说金博尔总统要去那里视察部队。想想和总统握手的感觉！

original: Do you believe there are folks who'd pay 500 caps for a steak dinner? Over at the Ultra-Luxe! Honest!
translation: 你能相信有居然人愿意花500瓶盖就为吃一顿牛排吗？奢华殿堂就有这种人！真的！

original: If you want to get fucked up, Gomorrah's the place to go. Wish I was there now.
translation: 如果你想乱搞，那就去蛾摩拉搞。真希望我现在就在那儿。

original: You gotta piss someone off to pull guard duty out here.
translation: 你得把人惹毛才能吸引卫兵的注意力。

original: Camp McCarran is paradise compared to this place. A two-minute monorail and you're on the Strip!
translation: 麦卡伦和这地方比起来简直就是天堂。那里还有两分钟就能到长街的单轨列车！

original: You been to the Strip? Last time I had R&R, I left with 300 caps more than I went in. Who says the House always wins?
translation: 你去过长街吗？上次我去那里休假，赢了300瓶盖回来。谁说豪斯总是赢的？

original: I thought the dam was boring. Then they stuck us out here to watch over this scrap heap.
translation: 我猜水坝肯定很无聊。所以他们才会把我们困在这里看守这堆废品。

original: Watch yourself if you're heading further south. There's been trouble down by Nelson and Searchlight.
translation: 如果你要再往南走，最好小心点。纳尔逊和探照灯营地可能遇到了麻烦。

original: Try not to make any trouble. We like it quiet around here.
translation: 别惹麻烦。我们都喜欢风平浪静的。

original: If I hear one more loser moan about losing everything they own on the Strip, I may shoot him in the head.
translation: 要是再让我听见哪个废物抱怨在长街输了个精光，我就一枪打爆他的脑袋。

original: It's quiet out here. We like to keep it that way.
translation: 这里很平静，我们就喜欢这样。

original: Don't make any trouble for us, we won't make any trouble for you.
translation: 你别给我们找麻烦，我们也不会给你找麻烦。

original: Welcome to the 188 Slop & Shop. Like our slogan says, "It's better than nothing."
translation: 欢迎光临188贸易站。我们的口号是："聊胜于无"。

original: Feeling thirsty?
translation: 感觉有点渴？

original: Welcome to the 188 Slop & Shop. How can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到188贸易站，需要点什么？

original: Back for more?
translation: 又来买东西了？

original: Is there some reason I should be talking to you?
translation: 我有必要和你说话吗？

original: Still making a nuisance of yourself?
translation: 你还是那么让人讨厌吗？

original: I don't work for freelancers. So move along.
translation: 我可不为自由职业者工作。请你走开。

original: Stay out of my way and I'll stay out of yours, got it?
translation: 你别挡我的道，我也不挡你的道，明白了？

original: {Player in combat}Leave me out of your fight!
translation: {Player in combat}你别把我也卷进去！

original: Welcome to the Casa Madrid. If you got an itch needs scratching, you came to the right place. Just watch how you treat the merchandise.
translation: 欢迎光临卡萨·马德里。如果你想解解闷，那你算是来对地方了。不过对这儿的商品，可要记得轻拿轻放。

original: Welcome to the Casa - so long as you didn't come here to sell that scrawny ass of yours around here.
translation: 欢迎光临卡萨——只要你不是来卖你那个瘪屁股的。

original: I'm not hiring new girls - all slots filled, you could say - and my arrangements with Marco are exclusive.
translation: 我不打算雇新的姑娘——没有空位了——而且我和马可达成的协议是专属的。

original: {Anderson dead}I don't know what went on between you and Anderson, but leave me out of it.
translation: {Anderson dead}我不知道你和安德森之间发生过什么，但是别把我扯进去。

original: It's good you told me about Dermot and Saint James. It was killing that needed doing.
translation: 多谢你告诉我德莫特和圣詹姆斯的事情。正好我也想找他们算账。

original: You think you see the worst of what people can do to each other, and then there's always something else to top it.
translation: 每次你都觉得自己已经看到了人性最丑恶的一面，但实际上总能有人能继续突破你的底线。

original: I'm going to assume you had reason to kill Dermot and his pet. Always had a bad feeling about them. {stern}But everyone else here is hands-off.
translation: 我想你应该也是有什么仇怨才会杀了德莫特和他的跟班吧。他们确实让人生厌，{stern}但这里的人从来都不会去过问。

original: You can just talk to the whores, you know. You and me don't need to talk unless there's trouble.
translation: 你可以去和那些妓女聊天。除非有什么麻烦，否则你我之间没什么可说的。

original: What do you need this time?
translation: 这次你想要什么？

original: {Player in combat}Hey, don't drag me into this!
translation: {Player in combat}嘿，别把我扯进去！

original: {Male PC}Hey, mister, looking to relax? Looks like you carry a lot of tension in your shoulders... {mischievous}and upper thighs.
translation: {Male PC}嗨，先生，想不想放松一下？ 看起来你肩上的压力很大……{mischievous}下面也是。

original: {Female PC}Sorry, ma'am, but my services are {archly}"members only," all right? You might try Sweetie.
translation: {Female PC}抱歉，女士，我只给{archly}"会员"服务，好吗？ 你可以试试小甜甜。

original: That situation with Dermot and Saint James must've been stressful. Looking to relax?
translation: 处理德莫特和圣詹姆斯的事情想必让你压力很大。要不要放松一下？

original: {Male PC}Glad you came back. You wanna get together with me?
translation: {Male PC}很高兴你回来了。你想和我好好缠绵一番吗？

original: {Female PC}Still wasting your time in this pit, honey?
translation: {Female PC}还在这里浪费时间吗，甜心？

original: {Player in combat}Fuck off! I ain't helping you!
translation: {Player in combat}滚开！我可不会帮你！

original: I got nothing you need. If it's ass you're looking for, talk to Pretty Sarah.
translation: 我没有你要的东西。如果你想找个妞，去和美人萨拉谈。

original: I said fuck off.
translation: 我说滚开。

original: {Player in combat}Yeah! Fight! Fight!
translation: {Player in combat}耶！打架！打架！

original: {unstable}Why you talking to me, man? I'm trying to relax here, got it?
translation: {unstable}你为什么要和我说话，老兄？我来这儿是想放松一下的，明白没？

original: {unstable, issues with women}When I talk to a girl, I start the conversation! And I didn't start no conversation with you.
translation: {unstable，issues with women}每次和姑娘说话，都是我先开口！而我还没和你开口说话呢。

original: {unstable}We got to go through this again? What's it about this time?
translation: {unstable}你还要来找我？这次你又想问什么？

original: {Player in combat}Oh my! Keep me out of this!
translation: {Player in combat}天呐！离我远点！

original: Hello, stranger. You looking for a good time?
translation: 你好，陌生人。想找点乐子吗？

original: Don't see many or your kind here in the Casa. Women, I mean - who ain't working.
translation: 在卡萨很少见到你这种人。娘们，我是说——不干活的娘们。

original: Always knew there was something wrong with Dermot and Saint James. Neither one ever got busy between my legs!
translation: 我就知道德莫特和圣詹姆斯有毛病。老娘就算张开腿，他们都不会卖力！

original: Been enjoying your time at the Casa?
translation: 在卡萨玩得开心吗？

original: {Player in combat}Look out!
translation: {Player in combat}小心！

original: {Female PC}Hey, honey. Looking for something softer than a man can give you?
translation: {Female PC}嘿，甜心。想尝尝比男人更温柔的滋味吗？

original: {Male PC}Hey, baby. What say you and me get acquainted?
translation: {Male PC}嘿，宝贝。来和我玩玩？

original: Dermot being dead I don't care about, but Saint James was regular income. Maybe you could throw some business my way?
translation: 德莫特死了我不在乎，但圣詹姆斯可是常客。要不你介绍一点生意给我？

original: Hi again. You here to play?
translation: 你好啊。来玩吗？

original: {Player in combat}{deadpan}You look busy. Talk to me later.
translation: {Player in combat}{deadpan}你好像很忙。晚点再说吧。

original: {playing at being a showman}Welcome to the Casa Madrid - cheapest, cleanest whores in all New Vegas. If you want to know the rates for poon, talk to the whores.
translation: {playing at being a showman}欢迎来到卡萨·马德里——新维加斯最便宜、最干净的妓女都在这里。如果你想谈价钱，就和你中意的姑娘说话吧。

original: {sarcastically}Thanks a lot. I'm out Dermot and St. James's rent - and they paid regular - and once they get to stinking I'll have to clean up the mess, too!
translation: {sarcastically}非常感谢。我终于不用再伺候德莫特和圣詹姆斯了——虽然都是常客——但他们如果搞得臭烘烘的，我还得给他们收拾！

original: Yeah? What is it?
translation: 嗯？什么事？

original: I'm not getting sucked into your fight, friend.
translation: 我可不想被你打到，朋友。

original: {as a way of introducing himself}Tom Anderson. Can I help you?
translation: {as a way of introducing himself}我是汤姆·安德森。有什么能效劳的？

original: Good to see you again.
translation: 很高兴又见到你。

original: House signing up with the NCR, you hear? Fucking sell-out.
translation: 你听说了吗？豪斯和NCR签了协议。该死的叛徒。

original: If House is dead, how'd the lights get turned on in his place, huh?
translation: 如果豪斯死了，那他的地方为什么还亮着灯，嗯？

original: House is dead, wonder if Motor-Runner will let us hit the strip now.
translation: 豪斯死了，不知道轰鸣恶煞现在会不会让我们杀进长街。

original: Why's that tower on the Strip all fucking lit up now, huh? I don't like it.
translation: 为啥长街那座塔现在能那么亮，嗯？我不喜欢这样。

original: Your pet ghoul smells like ass.
translation: 你这宠物尸鬼闻起来跟屎一样。

original: Is that Mean Sonofabitch? They all look the same to me.
translation: 那是无耻杂种吗？我看他们都长一个样。

original: {Laughs nervously}A flying robot? Man, I must be fucked up.
translation: {Laughs nervously}会飞的机器人？伙计，我一定是疯了。

original: You hear about this courier doing shit around the Strip? Like what, delivering {disparaging}mail?
translation: 你听说这个邮差在长街干的狗屁事了么？像是什么，送信{disparaging}之类的？

original: I wouldn't mind hitting that. She put out?
translation: 我不介意和她干一炮，她能撩吗？

original: You see a Ranger in black, run the other way. Take you out from a quarter mile off.
translation: 如果你看到一个黑甲游骑兵，赶紧跑。他能从半里之外干掉你。

original: Primm is going to be much tougher to push around with that new sheriff down there.
translation: 新警长上任后，普瑞姆就不像从前那么好欺负了。

original: Someone is targeting us, I'm gonna kill that fucker when I find out who did it.
translation: 有人想干我们。等我揪出那个狗日的，一定要宰了他。

original: The Khans are all gone, wonder if they left behind their shit for making our goods.
translation: 大汗帮的人都跑了，不知道那些用来做药的东西他们留下来没有。

original: {Laughs}House unplugged like a light. Wonder if he twitched before he bit it.
translation: {Laughs}豪斯就像电灯一样被人拉了线。不知道他死以前蹬腿没有。

original: Fuck, where are we gonna get our shit from now that the Khans are all buddy buddy with the NCR.
translation: 操，大汗帮都和NCR称兄道弟了，我们以后从哪儿搞药啊。

original: So long as the Khans keep making it, I keep getting high.
translation: 只要大汗帮还继续做药，我就能继续嗨翻天。

original: Someone is targeting us, I'm gonna kill that fucker if we find out who did it.
translation: 有人想干我们。等我揪出那个狗日的，一定要宰了他。

original: Motor Runner dead? Who the fuck gonna run the show now?
translation: 轰鸣恶煞死了？那现在他妈的是谁说了算？

original: Kimball dead, maybe the NCR will learn to stay the fuck out of{outta} other people's business.
translation: 金博尔死了，或许NCR以后能学会少管点闲事了。

original: That NCR prez survived a Legion hit? Wouldn'ta guessed.
translation: NCR总统躲过了军团的刺杀？真没想到。

original: NCR is going to be rip shit about losing their little train.
translation: 没了小火车，NCR会跟丢了魂一样。

original: House all dead, we should hit the Strip. Rip shit up.
translation: 豪斯都死了，我们应该去攻击长街。干死他们。

original: House dead, Strip can belong to anyone who wants it. Fiends to rule.
translation: 豪斯死了，谁先出手谁就能占住长街。恶魔帮要崛起了。

original: People all scared of those robots on the Strip since they changed. Like who needs the Strip anyway?
translation: 自从长街那些机器人变了之后，人们就很怕它们。谁他妈稀罕长街啊？

original: {Helped Joe Cobb}Got some fresh grub coming in from Goodsprings.
translation: {Helped Joe Cobb}清泉镇又送了些新鲜的吃食过来。

original: {Helped Goodsprings}Joe Cobb's crew got themselves killed over in Goodsprings.
translation: {Helped Goodsprings}乔·科布的手下都死在清泉镇了。

original: {Eddie dead}Who's going to take charge with Eddie out of the picture?
translation: {埃迪 dead}埃迪死了，以后谁说了算？

original: Haven't seen a decent caravan come up the road in days.
translation: 有时子没见着正经的商队路过了。

original: Think that rollercoaster in Primm is still working?
translation: 你觉得普瑞姆的过山车还能用吗？

original: If it weren't for Cooke, we'd still be slaving away for the NCR.
translation: 要不是库克，我们还不知道在什么地方给NCR服劳役呢。

original: {Before Prison Attack}Gotta wonder why the NCR hasn't come for us.
translation: {Before Prison Attack}NCR的人怎么还不来。

original: {After Prison Attack}We sure showed those bastards in the NCR.
translation: {After Prison Attack}我们给那些NCR的杂种好好上了一课。

original: {Meyers became Sheriff}Haven't seen Meyers around. Did he run off or something?
translation: {迈尔斯 became Sheriff}最近都没见迈尔斯，他是逃了还是怎么的？

original: Scrambler's crazier than usual. Watch yourself.
translation: 爬行者比平时更疯狂了。你自己小心。

original: You hear about the Deathclaws north of here?
translation: 听说过这地方以北的死亡爪吗？

original: Could've sworn I saw some Great Khans the other day.
translation: 我敢发誓，前几天真的看见了大汗帮的人。

original: Steer clear of the Mojave Post. NCR troopers all over the place down there.
translation: 躲着点莫哈维哨站。那里到处都是NCR部队。

original: {Scrambler dead}Man, I'm glad Scrambler's gone.
translation: {爬行者 dead}老兄，爬行者死了我是真高兴。

original: You hear about that band of crazy old ladies running around? I hear they're real vicious when they mug folks.
translation: 你听说在附近乱跑的那群老疯婆子没？据说她们抢劫的时候凶残得很。

original: If the Lucky 38 coulda been giving us power all along, why all the fuss with Hoover Dam?
translation: 如果幸运38就可以给我们提供源源不断的能源，那我们还在意胡佛水坝干什么？

original: Try sleeping with that Lucky 38 all lit up above you. Just try.
translation: 幸运38的灯全在你头上亮着，你去睡个觉给我看看。你去啊。

original: I hear that woman can kill with her eyes! Stay away from me!
translation: 我听说那个女人可以用眼神杀人！离我远点！

original: Your lady friend needs to lighten up.
translation: 你那个女性朋友应该阳光一点。

original: Better watch out, I hear Rex likes to eat his owners. Why do you think the King was so eager to give him away?
translation: 你最好小心点，我听说雷克斯喜欢吃他的主人。要不猫王干嘛那么急着把它送人？

original: Good to see Rex still around and kicking.
translation: 见到雷克斯还这么鲜活的真好。

original: That's one ragged Ghoul you've got with you. Seems like a good guy, though.
translation: 跟着你的尸鬼还真是破衣烂衫的。不过看起来是个好人。

original: That ghoul with you looks like he's older than the war! My the things he must have seen.
translation: 跟你一起的那个尸鬼看起来像是战前出生的！他肯定见识过许多事。

original: Oh no, I hear those things eat people! Stay back, freak!
translation: 哦，不，我听说那些玩意会吃人！退后，怪物！

original: Odd company you keep. I thought all Super mutants were crazed cannibals.
translation: 你那跟班真奇怪。我还以为所有的超级变种人都是丧心病狂的食人族呢。

original: Weird robot. I don't think I've ever seen one of those before.
translation: 奇怪的机器人，我好像从没见过这型号的。

original: That looks like one of those spybots I hear House has been secretly releasing at night.
translation: 据说豪斯会在晚上偷偷放些监视机器人出来，这个机器人好像就是其中之一。

original: Business and luck don't often go hand-in-hand in the Mojave. Watch your back.
translation: 在莫哈维可不能光靠运气。你最好多加小心。

original: Check out the Wrangler if she needs booze.
translation: 她如果想要烈酒，就去原子牛仔看看。

original: Keep your guns to yourself and there won't be any trouble.
translation: 你把枪收好，就不会有麻烦。

original: You're not doing yourself a favor by having him tag along. NCR aren't welcome here.
translation: 你让他跟着你可不是什么好事。NCR在这里不受欢迎。

original: I hear that guy has hundreds of kills, not all of them deserving of death.
translation: 我听说那家伙杀了几百人，其中不少是无辜的平民。

original: I always thought there was more to Arcade than met the eye. I bet he'll do great things without the Followers holding him back.
translation: 我一直都认为阿卡德没有发挥出他真正的实力。要不是天启追随者扯后腿，我打赌他能成大事。

original: I'm surprised to see Arcade venturing out of the Old Mormon Fort. I thought science types preferred to stay indoors.
translation: 看到阿卡德走出旧摩门教要塞，我很吃惊，我还以为这种科学人才都足不出户呢。

original: Howdy.
translation: 你好。

original: Hey.
translation: 嘿。

original: One of these days you'll get what's coming to you.
translation: 你总有一天会遭报应的。

original: Eat shit and die. That clear enough for you?
translation: 吃了屎就去死吧。说得够明白了吧？

original: {Annoyed}We don't take kindly to your type around these parts.
translation: {Annoyed}这里不欢迎你这样的人。

original: Witch! Witch! You should be burned for all the people you've turned into newts!
translation: 巫师！巫师！应该把你烧死，为那些被你变成蜥蜴的人报仇！

original: Baby-killer! Don't deny it! They told me you mowed down an entire orphanage on a dare!
translation: 你连婴儿都杀！别想抵赖！他们都跟我说了，有次就因为一句话，你就屠杀了整所孤儿院！

original: Necrophiliac! I heard about those corpses you dug up! Stay away from my grandparents, dammit!
translation: 你这食尸鬼！我都听说了，你把死人的尸体挖出来吃！离我爷爷奶奶远点，他妈的！

original: People say you practice witchcraft and dance naked in the moonlight. What the hell is wrong with you?
translation: 人们传说你在午夜的时候会修炼妖术，在月光下裸身起舞，口念咒语。你脑袋是不是被门板夹了？

original: So I hear you like picking on little kids, huh? What kind of person beats up children for their lunch money?
translation: 我听说你欺负小孩，嗯？什么样的人才会靠殴打小孩来挣饭钱？

original: People say you wear the skin of your enemies under your clothing. Is that true?
translation: 传说你衣服下面裹着你从对手身上剥下来的皮。这是真的吗？

original: {Annoyed}Leave me alone, scumbag.
translation: {Annoyed}人渣，离我远点。

original: {Annoyed}You're a real piece of work.
translation: {Annoyed}你还真是个奇葩。

original: {Annoyed}Great. You again?
translation: {Annoyed}好极了，又是你？

original: You're one crazy bastard, you know that?
translation: 你知道吗？你就是个疯杂种。

original: I can't decide if I should shake your hand or make a run for it.
translation: 我不知道是该和你打招呼，还是该逃命。

original: Good? Bad? You're the one with the weapons, eh?
translation: 好人？坏人？对你来说都差不多，是吗？

original: Rumor has it you're really a posessed golem being controlled by the casinos. If this is true, where is your control crystal?
translation: 传言说你其实是一个假人，操纵你的是那些大赌场。如果是真的，控制你的水晶在哪？

original: Planning to kill a puppy or save some goons today?
translation: 今天是准备残害哪条小狗，还是救几个暴徒？

original: I have no idea what to believe when it comes to rumors about you. You must be insane or something.
translation: 关于你的传言太多了，我都不知道该信哪个。你肯定是疯了。

original: People around here think you're a bit of an enigma.
translation: 这儿的人们都觉得你难以捉摸。

original: Some say you like to trip old ladies crossing the street. Others say you regularly string up thugs.
translation: 有人说你喜欢把过街的老太太放倒。其他人则说你经常收拾暴徒。

original: People just don't know what to think of you.
translation: 大家都不知道你到底在想什么。

original: Decisions are hard, aren't they?
translation: 做人有时候就是左右两难，是吧？

original: We're all hoping you'll eventually figure out which side you're on.
translation: 我们都希望你尽快决定到底站哪边。

original: Good? Bad? You're the one with the weapon.
translation: 好人？坏人？选择权在你手上。

original: Thanks for everything you've done. It really means a lot.
translation: 谢谢你所做的一切，真是帮了大忙了。

original: I hope some of the thugs around here follow your shining example.
translation: 我希望这里的那些恶棍也能跟你一样浪子回头。

original: You've been a godsend to Freeside.
translation: 你真是自由城的守护神。

original: I hear you even help the local rats cross the street.
translation: 听说你甚至帮助本地的老鼠过街。

original: People are saying you must have super powers to have pulled off all you've done in Freeside.
translation: 大家都说你有超能力，要不怎么能在自由城干出这么多大事呢？

original: My friends have nothing but good things to say when your name is mentioned. It's great to see you.
translation: 我的朋友一提到你便敬仰万分。能见到你本人真是太好了。

original: Word of your work around here is spreading like wildfire. Keep it up.
translation: 你在这儿做的好事就像野火一样传遍四方。请继续努力。

original: Hey, you're the one people say has been helping out around here. Good on you.
translation: 嘿，你就是大家口中乐于助人的那个人。好样的。

original: I tell my friends you're a shining example of what's good around here, but they're not so optimistic.
translation: 我和朋友们说你是这里的道德楷模，不过他们的反应不怎么积极。

original: Thanks for helping out around here.
translation: 多谢你的帮助。

original: Good to see you're still around.
translation: 你还在，太好了。

original: Hey, good to see you.
translation: 嘿，见到你很高兴。

original: Hmm?
translation: 嗯？

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: I wish I were there to see you take Benny down.
translation: 真希望我能亲眼看着你干掉本尼。

original: They say you single-handedly assaulted the dam and massacred everyone! That must have been quite a sight!
translation: 大家说你孤身一人杀进水坝，还干掉了所有人！那场面肯定相当火爆！

original: Well, it looks like we won't have to worry about NCR or the Legion messing with us now. I just hope the Securitrons can keep the peace.
translation: 好吧，现在NCR和军团都不会来打扰我们了，但愿这些电子保安能一直维持和平。

original: They say you swarmed the dam with a whole army of Securitrons! That must have been quite a sight!
translation: 他们说你带领电子保安大军横扫了水坝，那场面一定非常壮观！

original: Can't say I like all the tin cans shuffling around, but this new Securitron Army shouldn't have much trouble keeping things safer around here.
translation: 我可不太喜欢这些铁皮罐子，但是这支新的电子保安大军确实能够维护和平。

original: Why not just put the slave collars on us yourself, you bastard. With the Legion at the dam, it won't be long before they enslave us all.
translation: 你怎么不亲自给我们戴上奴隶项圈，混球。军团占领了大坝，用不了多久我们所有人都会变成奴隶。

original: I heard the Legion is bringing in giant mutant dogs to assault the dam. I hope the NCR death squads packed steaks to distract them.
translation: 我听说军团带了很多超级变种狗一起进攻大坝，但愿NCR的突击小队有足够多的排骨来分散它们的注意力。

original: Don't be fooled. As soon as the Legion and NCR start fighting, the robots will invade and kill us all!
translation: 别傻了。只要军团和NCR一开战，那些机器人会立刻攻过来，把我们全杀死。

original: I hope the Legion gets destroyed. If they take the dam, we'll all be slaves.
translation: 我希望军团被消灭掉。要是他们占领了水坝，我们全都会变成奴隶。

original: People say the NCR are bringing in super trooper death squads to defend the dam against the Legion! This battle is going to be crazy!
translation: 大家都说NCR派出了他们的超级士兵敢死队在水坝防御军团的进攻！这场战斗越来越疯狂了！

original: Normally, I'd say screw the NCR, but if the Legion takes the dam, I think we're all screwed.
translation: 通常我都是说干他妈的NCR，不过要是真让军团拿下了水坝，我们所有人的妈妈都要被干了。

original: Some of my friends think the Legion is throwing a huge barbeque cookout across the river. With that much smoke rising, I believe it!
translation: 有些朋友说军团在河对岸举行了一场大型的烧烤野餐会。你看那边冒出来的烟，我信了！

original: It looks like the Legion might be preparing for another run at the dam. This can't be good.
translation: 看起来军团又打算对水坝发动一次进攻。这可不妙。

original: Well, aren't you just special? Everybody likes the new guy, but me? I'm chopped liver.
translation: 哎呀，你挺厉害的啊？大家都喜欢新人，至于我？我算个屁。

original: I hear you're building quite the reputation on The Strip. Don't forget about the little guys when you make it big.
translation: 我听说你在长街扬名立万，发达了可别忘了小兄弟们哦。

original: You meet any of those Rangers dressed up in black yet? My friends say they're mutant cyborgs and they're going to kill us all!
translation: 你见过那些穿黑色盔甲的游骑兵吗？我朋友说他们其实是变种生化人，而且要把我们都杀光！

original: That new Ranger armor is downright impressive. I'd hate to be on the business end of one of their revolvers.
translation: 那帮游骑兵的新装甲看起来很厉害。我可不想死在他们的枪下。

original: We've already got people disappearing at night. I hear the NCR have veterans from out west coming to push us out of Freeside.
translation: 我们已经有人在夜里失踪了。听说从西边来的NCR老兵要把我们都赶出自由城。

original: I've been hearing rumors of the Rangers getting some heavy reinforcements soon. Hope they don't try to start anything around here.
translation: 我听说游骑兵很快就会得到强力增援。希望他们别打这地方的主意。

original: The NCR must have paid off the Kings big to get them to sign up. Maybe there was an NCR mole who tricked them into it!
translation: 猫王帮肯定是从NCR手里得了不少好处才会同意和解的。要么就是NCR的间谍骗了他们！

original: Good news for Freeside. The Kings have decided to work with NCR for a change.
translation: 自由城的好消息。猫王帮决定和NCR通力合作，共创未来。

original: I hear the Kings were wiped out by some kind of Super mutant ninja assassin paid by the NCR! Who else could have taken them down?!
translation: 我听说猫王帮被NCR雇的超级变种忍者刺客消灭了！不然还能有谁这么厉害呢？！

original: I don't get why the Kings are dead. They weren't a bad bunch of guys.
translation: 我不明白为什么要消灭猫王帮。他们并不坏啊。

original: Some people are saying the Great Khans got drugged up out of their minds and attacked the dam.
translation: 据说大汗帮的人嗑药嗑到丧失理智，进攻了水坝。

original: I heard the Khans went wild at Hoover Dam. I suppose they were looking for one last blaze of glory.
translation: 我听说大汗帮在水坝发狂了。估计他们是要追寻最后的荣耀。

original: I hear the Great Khans staged their own deaths to trick the NCR.
translation: 我听说大汗帮至死都在和NCR作对。

original: People say the Khans got wiped out at Red Rock. That's one less bunch of crazies to worry about.
translation: 都说大汗帮在红岩峡谷被一锅端了。又少了一伙让人担心的疯子。

original: The Great Khans aren't gone. They're just hiding, biding their time...
translation: 大汗帮并没有消失。他们只是藏在暗处，等待时机……

original: The Great Khans moved out? One less mob of degenerates to worry about, if you ask me.
translation: 大汗帮离开了？要我说，又少了一伙需要担心的暴徒。

original: The Khans signed a treaty with NCR? I've heard some crazy rumors before, but that one's rich!
translation: 大汗帮和NCR签了和约？这是我听过最离谱的事！

original: So, the Great Khans signed up with NCR. Who would have thought those two would settle their differences?
translation: 这么说，大汗帮和NCR签了和平协定。谁能想到这俩会凑到一块？

original: Those sick Legion bastards had the brass balls to attack Bitter Springs? I bet that was one messy fight.
translation: 军团的那些变态杂种居然胆敢进攻苦泉？我敢说战斗肯定十分惨烈。

original: Maybe it'll be a little safer to travel, now that the Fiends' bosses are dead. We owe their killer a debt of gratitude.
translation: 既然恶魔帮如今群龙无首，出门应该会比较安全了。感谢那个为民除害的英雄。

original: I heard Motor Runner got taken down. Maybe the Fiends will finally destroy themselves now that he's gone.
translation: 我听说轰鸣恶煞被干掉了。没了他，恶魔帮最终可能会自我毁灭吧。

original: I hear Hanlon was abducted by aliens and that's why he was acting so strangely. Better check yourself for strange scars.
translation: 我听说汉隆被外星人劫持过，所以他的行为才如此怪异。你也最好检查一下自己身上有没有奇怪的伤疤。

original: Hanlon was apparently sabotaging NCR's efforts in the area. Now, I kind of wish he hadn't died.
translation: 汉隆明显在给NCR捣乱。现在我真有点希望他还没死。

original: I hear Hanlon was working for the aliens and NCR found out.
translation: 我听说汉隆其实是为外星人服务的，而且被NCR发现了。

original: Chief Hanlon is dead? I hear that guy couldn't order himself out of a cardboard box, let alone command troops
translation: 军士长汉隆死了？我听说那家伙连指挥自己从纸箱里爬出来都做不到，还怎么率领部队啊！

original: My friends say Kimball's assassination was all an Illuminati plot to reclaim power. I say they're crazy. How do you kill someone with a flashlight?
translation: 我朋友说金博尔遇刺其实是光明会夺权的阴谋。要我说，他们都疯了。光拿个手电筒怎么杀人？

original: Kimball getting killed is going to make a mess of things around here. The troopers coming through here are mean enough already.
translation: 金博尔一死，这里的局势更混乱了。不断增加的部队已经证明了这点。

original: My friends say you're working for the Illuminati, and that's why you killed Kimball. Watch your back. {paranoid whisper}They have listening devices everywhere!
translation: 我朋友都说你为光明会工作，所以你才要杀金博尔。小心点，{paranoid whisper}他们到处都安了监听器！

original: Killing Kimball is going to make a mess of things around here. The troopers coming through here are mean enough already.
translation: 金博尔一死，这里的局势更混乱了。不断增加的部队已经证明了这点。

original: Thanks for not killing Kimball. I hear he's been working against the secret alien invasion forces above the planet. {paranoid whisper}They want to eat our brains!
translation: 感谢你放了金博尔一马。我听说他正在对抗秘密入侵的外星人呢。{paranoid whisper}那些外星人想吃我们的脑子！

original: So, I hear that assassination attempt on Kimball didn't quite turn out the way you planned. Now, the NCR are going to be even pissier than usual.
translation: 我听说刺杀金博尔的计划没成功。现在NCR比平常更神经紧张了。

original: Good job saving Kimball's life. I hear he's been working against the secret alien invasion forces above the planet. {paranoid whisper}They want to eat our brains!
translation: 你救了金博尔一命，干得好。我听说他正在对抗秘密入侵的外星人呢。{paranoid whisper}那些外星人想吃我们的脑子！

original: I suppose you did the right thing saving Kimball, even though it means we're still screwed here in Freeside.
translation: 虽然自由城要继续倒霉，但我还是认为你救了金博尔是对的。

original: You freed that Silus guy from McCarran? Guess you've got your reasons for helping the Legion.
translation: 你把那个叫希鲁斯的家伙从麦卡伦给放了？我想你肯定有自己的理由才帮军团的。

original: I hear the monorail bombing was an alien plot. Just a few more gates to destroy and we're all trapped in here.
translation: 我听说其实是外星人炸的列车。他们只要再摧毁几座大门，我们就全被困在这了。

original: I guess the monorail getting bombed wasn't all bad. Freeside is getting a lot more business now.
translation: 我觉得列车被炸也不全是坏事。自由城现在的生意红火多了。

original: With the monorail down, we're going to have a lot more NCR goons wandering through here. Yay...
translation: 列车没了，跑来乱晃的NCR军队要更多了。爽……

original: Rumor has it Mr. House joined the NCR on account of some secret love child he never even knew he had.
translation: 传言说豪斯先生之所以加入NCR，是因为他有个自己都不知道的私生子在NCR手里。

original: Never thought I'd see House settle for being an NCR lapdog. What the hell happened?
translation: 没想到豪斯居然甘愿给NCR当走狗。到底怎么回事？

original: I think Caesar was killed by alien clone agents! The Legion are just a bunch of alien slaves doing their bidding!
translation: 我觉得凯撒是被外星克隆特工杀死的！军团就是一群按外星人要求行事的奴隶！

original: I hear Caesar had an alien brain chip in his head, but he died on the operating table when they tried to remove it.
translation: 我听说凯撒的脑袋里装了外星人的脑芯片。他们移除芯片的时候，他死在了手术台上。

original: People say Caesar is dead. I hope someone worse doesn't replace him.
translation: 大家都说凯撒死了。希望别来一个更坏的人接班。

original: You killed Caesar? Rumor around here has it he was struck down by a bad case of explosive diarrhea.
translation: 你杀了凯撒？传言说他是严重腹泻拉死的。

original: All hail the slayer of Caesar! It's about time that slavemaster got his!
translation: 为魔头凯撒的惨死欢呼吧！终于轮到他遭报应了！

original: I don't need to read no obituary to know House was an asshole.
translation: 我早就知道豪斯不是个玩意。

original: With no House to boss Vegas around, the NCR's gonna want that job.
translation: 既然豪斯没法再管理维加斯，NCR肯定想要代劳。

original: According to the rumor mill, House is faking his death to catch the NCR off-guard.
translation: 坊间传说，豪斯只是诈死麻痹NCR。

original: House dead? Good riddance.
translation: 豪斯死了？死得好。

original: Better give the Securitrons a wide berth if you know what's good for you. Those new upgrades look nasty.
translation: 为了你自己着想，最好离那些电子保安远点。它们升级之后看着可不怎么友善。

original: House must have special plans for you to get into the Lucky 38 and come out alive.
translation: 豪斯让你活着进出幸运38，肯定是有什么特别的目的。

original: I hear you made a real mess of the Omerta's plans. Hopefully, the new management does a better job running Gomorrah.
translation: 我听说你彻底粉碎了黑手党们的阴谋。希望蛾摩拉的新管理者能比黑手党干得好。

original: Impressive work fighting off Benny's thugs! I know I wouldn't have survived that.
translation: 你把本尼手下的恶棍都打跑了，真厉害！换成我肯定不行。

original: I heard you made a run on The Tops. You've got guts, kid.
translation: 听说你在九重天干了一票。你真有胆量，孩子。

original: Figures that Benny would run. Sorry coward's nobody without his thugs to back him.
translation: 早就知道本尼会逃跑。那家伙没有手下护着，就是个屁都不算的软蛋。

original: Get rough with the escorts, and you'll be seeing the business end of my barrel.
translation: 对护卫有意见的话，可以和我的枪管谈解约。

original: With the Kings gone, who is going to keep Freeside safe?
translation: 猫王帮不在了，谁来维持自由城的安全？

original: If the King is working with the NCR, he must have a damn good reason. I just hope it doesn't come back to bite us.
translation: 如果猫王决定和NCR合作，那他肯定是有充分的理由的。我只是希望我们不会被反咬一口。

original: Do I know you?
translation: 我认识你吗？

original: And you are?
translation: 你是？

original: Need something?
translation: 需要什么吗？

original: I'm hearing good things about you, friend. Good things.
translation: 我听说了你的事，朋友。都是好事。

original: Good to see someone helping out for a change.
translation: 很高兴见到你这样的好人。

original: People say you've been helping out around town. Much appreciated, friend.
translation: 大家都说你乐于助人。非常感谢，朋友。

original: You've done good, kid. Happy to have you around.
translation: 你做得很好，孩子。很高兴你能在这里。

original: I'm amazed by how much you've accomplished here in Freeside.
translation: 你居然为自由城做了这么多事，太让我吃惊了。

original: We've been really fortunate to have you helping Freeside.
translation: 有你这样帮助自由城，我们真是太幸运了。

original: Helping on a consistent basis wouldn't hurt you, would it?
translation: 一直做好事应该不会给你带来不便吧？

original: You've done a strange mix of things since coming to Freeside.
translation: 自从你来了自由城，干的都是些毁誉参半的事。

original: Does it get painful sitting on the fence like you do?
translation: 你这样骑在墙上，屁股不疼吗？

original: It seems you've decided to be indecisive when it comes to helping Freesiders.
translation: 看来在帮助自由城人这个问题上，你铁了心要走摇摆路线了。

original: Throwing caution to the wind yet again, huh?
translation: 又把警告当耳旁风了，嗯？

original: I guess no one is ever going to change a crazy freak like you.
translation: 我想没人能改变你这样的疯子。

original: What did we ever do to you? Can't we all just get along?
translation: 我们到底把你怎么了？我们就不能正常相处吗？

original: Why the hate for Freeside? We're not all bad.
translation: 为什么这么憎恨自由城？我们又不全是坏人。

original: What the hell do you want?
translation: 你到底想要什么？

original: Go to hell you two-faced bastard.
translation: 两面派杂种，去死吧。

original: Go away, you rotten bastard.
translation: 走开，臭杂种。

original: Way to stab us in the back, asshole.
translation: 挺会背后捅刀子的啊，贱人。

original: Howdy, doc. Strange to see you wandering around.
translation: 你好啊，医生。在这儿见到你还真是稀奇。

original: I admire a woman who can hold her liquor. Cute to boot.
translation: 我就喜欢泼辣女人。特别过瘾。

original: She looks like she knows how to handle herself in a fight.
translation: 她看起来很能打。

original: I hope you programmed that thing to be friendly to Freesiders.
translation: 希望你已经把那东西的程序设置成对自由城友善了。

original: Super mutant? You don't look so super to me.
translation: 超级变种人？我看也没那么超级啊。

original: How's it hangin', old man? Oh, sorry.
translation: 最近怎么样啊，老头？哦，抱歉。

original: Hey, Rex. I see your new master is keeping you polished up. Good for you.
translation: 嘿，雷克斯。你的新主人把你打扮得锃光瓦亮的嘛。挺好。

original: Cheer up, lady. You've still got your youth.
translation: 高兴点，女士。你还很年轻呢。

original: NCR military transmissions say the robots on the Strip have been upgraded. Wish we had eyes-on intel...
translation: NCR军方通报说长街的机器人升级了。要是能有第一手情报就好了……

original: Mr. House is out of the picture. Probably killed by his own robots.
translation: 豪斯先生不在了。大概是被他自己的机器人给弄死了吧。

original: I heard you took out Caesar by yourself. Proves the Legion is just a bunch of savages, like we thought.
translation: 听说你一个人就干掉了凯撒。这说明军团不过是一群未开化的蛮子，和我们想的一样。

original: With their leader gone, the Legion will likely tear itself apart. It's what most violent tribal societies do.
translation: 既然他们的领袖死了，军团很可能会四分五裂。大多数依靠暴力组织起的部落社会，最后都是这个结果。

original: NCR military radio keeps talking about Mr. House agreeing to join the NCR. What changed his mind?
translation: NCR军方广播一直在说豪斯先生同意加入NCR。他怎么改主意了？

original: Someone blew up the monorail the NCR uses to travel to the Strip and back. We should use this time to strike!
translation: 有人把NCR用于往返长街的单轨铁路炸了。我们应该抓住这个时机进攻！

original: Seems the destruction of the monorail didn't slow the NCR down much. How many troops do they have?
translation: 看来炸毁铁路也没有打乱NCR的部署。他们到底有多少兵力啊？

original: There's a rumor going around that you saved the NCR president's life. I'm surprised you have the stones to show your face around here.
translation: 有传言说就是你救了NCR总统的狗命。我真好奇你怎么还有胆子到这里来。

original: There was an attempt on the NCR president's life recently. Too bad it didn't succeed.
translation: 最近有一起针对NCR总统的刺杀行动。可惜没有成功。

original: Were you the one who killed the NCR president? I'd like to shake your hand!
translation: 你就是宰了NCR总统的那个人？我想和你握握手！

original: Did you hear? Someone actually managed to assassinate the NCR's president! And we just sit here!
translation: 你听说了么？真的有人成功刺杀了NCR总统！可我们却还坐在这儿！

original: The other day I heard some bigwig in the NCR military died. Hopefully it disrupts their chain of command some.
translation: 前几天我听说NCR军方的某个大人物死了。希望这能打乱他们的指挥系统。

original: Did you hear about that NCR higher up that died? That he was trying to sabotage them? Hope he wasn't the only one.
translation: 你听说过NCR那个死了的高层吗？他居然一直在暗中搞破坏？希望这么干的不止他一个。

original: Seems the NCR is making friends. We've had reports of them making overtures to some gang in Freeside.
translation: 看来NCR正在结交朋友。我们得到报告说他们正在主动联系自由城的一些帮派。

original: We just had word that the town of Primm is now part of the NCR. At this rate, they'll be running the whole region soon.
translation: 我们刚刚才听说普瑞姆现在已经归顺NCR了。这样下去，他们很快就会控制这一整片地区。

original: I heard some special squad of Rangers is on its way to the Vegas area. I guess the NCR is finally getting serious about fighting the Legion.
