translation: 我听说有一支特种游骑兵小队正在赶往维加斯地区。看来NCR终于要认真对待和军团的战斗了。

original: There've been reports that the NCR is moving more and more troops into the area.
translation: 有报告说NCR正向该区域增派大量兵力。

original: It's the quiet before the storm up top. For once I'm almost glad we're down here.
translation: 这只是暴风雨前的宁静。我第一次觉得我们待在这下面真好。

original: Keep an eye on Veronica here. She's a sharp one.
translation: 多留心维罗妮卡。她可不是省油的灯。

original: Try to keep Veronica out of trouble, would you?
translation: 别让维罗妮卡受委屈，好吗？

original: If you're planning to take Veronica with you, be sure to have a good pair of earplugs with you. I'm kidding, Veronica! Put the power fist down!
translation: 要是你准备带上维罗妮卡同行，那你一定要准备一副好耳塞。我开玩笑的，维罗妮卡！把动力拳套放下！

original: What a fascinating animal. I'm sure the scribes will want to take a look at him.
translation: 多奇妙的动物啊。我肯定学士们会想研究一下他的。

original: Is that a {Mark}Mk. III Support Model you have with you? I've seen references to them, but never with my own eyes. I imagine he makes a great pet.
translation: 你带的那个是III型支援模组？我在一些资料上看到过类似记载，但从没亲眼见过。他做宠物肯定很听话吧。

original: Where did you get that Eyebot? I've never seen one modified quite like that.
translation: 你从哪搞来的这个眼球机器人？我从没见过这样的改装。

original: Keep that mutant in line, or we'll put it down.
translation: 管好你的变种人，不要让我们来帮你管。

original: Oh good, now I have to put up with the stench of rotting ghoul as well. I hope the air filters are working.
translation: 妙极了，现在我还要忍受腐烂尸鬼身上的味道。希望空气净化器没出毛病。

original: I've heard that your friend there can put some of the senior scribes to shame.
translation: 听说你的朋友知识渊博，连不少高阶学士也相形见绌。

original: Why is your friend there glaring at me like that? Did I bump into him or something?
translation: 为什么你的朋友这样打量我？我是撞着他了还是怎么着？

original: Don't bother me. I'm on patrol.
translation: 别烦我，我在执勤。

original: Hello, outsider.
translation: 你好，外来者。

original: I've important work to do, so no time to talk.
translation: 我有很重要的事，没空和你聊天。

original: Does Ramos know you're walking around without a guard?
translation: 你怎么在这乱晃，也没个警卫跟着，拉莫斯知道吗？

original: Keep up the good work, outsider.
translation: 继续努力，外来者。

original: I hear you've been making yourself useful. Unlike some people I could mention.
translation: 我听说你做了不少好事。不像某些人。

original: Are you adjusting to the bunker, outsider?
translation: 你适应地堡里的生活了吗？外来者？

original: Just between you and me, I'm glad you're here. This place needed a fresh face.
translation: 私下跟你说，我很高兴你能来。这地方需要新面孔。

original: You've been a great help, outsider. Thank you for all your hard work.
translation: 你真是帮大忙了，外来者。感谢你的努力。

original: Greetings, {outsider}out- excuse me, I guess I need to stop calling you that, don't I?
translation: 你好，{outsider}外来——抱歉，我想我不该再这么称呼你了，是吧？

original: So you're one of us now, eh? Truly it is a rare honor.
translation: 这么说你现在是我们的一员了，嗯？真是少有的荣誉。

original: Oh, it's you.
translation: 噢，是你。

original: I'd rather not talk to you, outsider.
translation: 我不想和你说话，外来者。

original: I'd rather not associate with you. Excuse me.
translation: 我不想跟你扯上关系。抱歉。

original: Why the Elder didn't just have you shot is beyond me.
translation: 真不明白，为什么长老没有直接毙了你。

original: Don't talk to me. You've caused more than enough damage.
translation: 别和我说话。你闯的祸已经够多了。

original: Ramos is keeping an eye on you, outsider. Remember that.
translation: 拉莫斯在盯着你，外来者。记住了。

original: You certainly make life more interesting, outsider.
translation: 你还有点意思啊，外来者。

original: Some of the others may look the other way, but I don't trust you.
translation: 可能别人不这么看，但我不信任你。

original: You're going to have to clean up your act if you want some respect around here, outsider.
translation: 如果你想在这里得到点尊重，就好好洗心革面，外来者。

original: Just when I think I've got you figured out, you go and surprise me.
translation: 每次我以为自己已经了解你了，你都能让我大吃一惊。

original: I don't trust you, outsider, but I can't help but like you.
translation: 我不信任你，外来者，但我不禁有些喜欢你了。

original: You're alright, outsider. Most of the time, anyway.
translation: 你还不错嘛，外来者。至少大多数时候都还不错。

original: I have two hours of weapons training every morning. It is a good way to start the day.
translation: 我每天早上都花两小时做武器训练。用这种方式迎接早晨感觉挺不错。

original: Hardin is a tough man, but fair. I'd follow him into battle any day.
translation: 哈丁虽然严厉，但处事公正。我任何时候都愿意跟随他冲锋陷阵。

original: There are whispers that McNamara's lost his nerve. I can't believe that, not after what he did at HELIOS One.
translation: 有传闻说麦克纳马拉胆小怕事。我可不信，尤其是见证了他在太阳神一号的壮举之后。

original: How long before we resume normal patrols?
translation: 还有多久我们才能恢复正常巡逻？

original: After the battle at HELIOS One, some people were worried about the NCR coming after us, but this bunker is secure.
translation: 太阳神一号之战后，有人担心NCR会追杀我们，但地堡是绝对安全的。

original: Ramos runs a tight ship. We haven't had an incident in over a year. Your arrival excluded, of course.
translation: 拉莫斯把这里一直都管理得井井有条，一年多来我们没出过任何纰漏。当然，你的到来是个例外。

original: Hardin will be Elder soon, mark my words.
translation: 记住我的话，哈丁过不了多久就会当上长老。

original: Why are we hiding down here? We should be avenging our fallen brothers!
translation: 为什么我们要躲在地底下呢？我们应该为牺牲的兄弟报仇！

original: HELIOS will be ours again someday.
translation: 总有一天我们会夺回太阳神一号的。

original: When are these night missions going to end?
translation: 这些夜间任务什么时候才到头？

original: Ugh, more VR training. Maybe I'll hit the shooting range instead.
translation: 呃，又是VR模拟训练。我宁愿去靶场练习射击。

original: Maintaining the machinery around here is important. We have to breathe, after all.
translation: 维持这些机器正常运行非常重要。毕竟我们总有喘气的时候。

original: After this I have some weapons to repair.
translation: 这事完了之后，我还得去修理武器。

original: If I do a good job, I might be up for promotion to Paladin soon.
translation: 如果我能立功，说不定很快就能升任圣骑士了。

original: Power armor is pretty intricately made. It's not an easy thing to fix.
translation: 动力装甲结构复杂得很，可没那么容易修好。

original: Have you seen the dust storm above? I worked on that machine!
translation: 看见上面的沙尘暴没有？是我用那台机器弄出来的！

original: If it's not broken power armor, it's broken electrical fixtures.
translation: 要是动力装甲没问题，那就是电力系统有问题。

original: If it's not broken weapons, it's broken power armor.
translation: 要是武器没问题，那就是动力装甲有问题。

original: I'm really busy now, sorry.
translation: 我现在真的很忙，抱歉。

original: I don't think these repairs will ever end.
translation: 我觉得这根本是修个没完啊。

original: Our early test results look promising.
translation: 从早期测试结果来看，情况还不错。

original: I heard the Elder's got Taggart working on some kind of secret project.
translation: 听说长老派塔格特执行什么秘密任务去了。

original: Every day we come one step closer to reclaiming the glory of the past.
translation: 每一天我们都离重现往日荣耀更近一步。

original: Even though the patrols no longer go out, we've got a backlog of devices that require investigation.
translation: 即便巡逻队不再出去了，我们还是有很多设施需要调查。

original: Why is it so important that we research night vision optics?
translation: 为什么研究夜视镜这么重要呢？

original: I'd kill to go outside and gather some specimens.
translation: 我真忍不住了，好想出去收集些样本。

original: Everyone says I'm crazy, but I still say it'd be a great advancement if doors opened once you got close to them.
translation: 所有人都说我疯了，但我还是要说，如果这里的门会在人走近时自动打开，肯定会是个伟大的进步。

original: The loss of HELIOS was terrible, but this bunker is a wonder of its own.
translation: 我们在太阳神一号损失惨重，不过幸好还有这个地堡。

original: If we could just combine the best qualities of laser and plasma weaponry...
translation: 如果我们把激光和等离子的优点结合在一起的话……

original: It pains me to think of the scientific wonders at HELIOS One, now in NCR hands.
translation: 每当想到太阳神一号这样的科学奇迹落在了NCR手里，我就心痛。

original: But if I adjust the magnetic field, perhaps the resulting change in wavelength will- excuse me, I'm merely thinking out loud.
translation: 但如果我调整磁场，结果可能就会受到波长的影——抱歉，我又自言自语了。

original: We have a duty to preserve the past.
translation: 我们的使命就是保护战前科技。

original: Only a few people get to venture outside, usually to trade for food.
translation: 只有少数几个人可以冒险出去，一般都是去采购食品。

original: You've been outside. Is the NCR really still hunting us?
translation: 你在外面呆过。NCR真的还在追杀我们吗？

original: McNamara's done a pretty good job, given the situation he was handed.
translation: 就当时的情况而言，麦克纳马拉已经做得很好了。

original: Our former Elder, Elijah, was obsessed with new technology. That's why we were at HELIOS in the first place.
translation: 我们的前任长老以利亚痴迷于战前科技。所以我们当时才会驻扎在太阳神电站。

original: Hardin owes his life to McNamara. That's why he won't challenge him outright.
translation: 哈丁欠麦克纳马拉一条命，所以他不敢公开挑战他。

original: As much as I'm sick of Taggart's VR sims, I have to admit we wouldn't be combat ready without them.
translation: 尽管塔格特的VR模拟训练让我恶心，但不得不承认这对我们的实战大有帮助。

original: Doc Schuler is a lifesaver. I was hurt in training the other day and she fixed me right up.
translation: 舒勒医生真是妙手回春。有一次我在训练中受了伤，就是她把我治好的。

original: The Lucky 38's reactor has been restarted... it can be seen from miles away.
translation: 幸运38的反应堆重启了……几英里外都能看到。

original: I waited months to get in here, but the place isn't nearly full. You think the waiting list is just for hype?
translation: 我等了好几个月才排进来，可这地方却没什么人。你觉得那所谓的预约名单是不是只是个噱头？

original: The food here is to die for. No one cooks Brahmin like Philippe.
translation: 能尝到这里的佳肴，真是死了都不亏。菲利普做的双头牛肉无与伦比。

original: The torching is Philippe's idea. Brilliant, no?
translation: 火烤是菲利普的点子。天才的主意，不是吗？

original: Keep away from me, if you know what's good for you.
translation: 如果你识好歹，就离我远点。

original: You look positively famished. We simply can't have that.
translation: 你看起来饿坏了。我们可不能让这种事发生。

original: Welcome to Top Shelf. The drinks cost twice as much during happy hour, but they draw twice the attention, too.
translation: 欢迎来到云巅酒吧。虽然这儿的酒水价格在畅饮时段翻倍，但别人的回头率也会翻倍哦。

original: What can I get you?
translation: 要来点什么？

original: What's this about the White Glove Society?
translation: 这个白手套社团到底怎么回事？

original: You got me my boy back. I got no words.
translation: 你救了我的孩子。真是无以言谢。

original: Now... I hope you didn't do no harm to whoever's responsible for this. I wanna skin their hides myself.
translation: 说真的……我希望你还没有逮到凶手。因为我要亲手剥了他们的皮。

original: You got a lot of nerve sticking around here. If I didn't have better things to do I'd thump your skull for what you said.
translation: 你还敢留在这里，真够有种的。要不是我还有别的事要忙，光凭你那些话就够我打爆你的脑袋。

original: Tell me good news.
translation: 有什么好消息吗？

original: {To himself}Ted, where are you, boy?
translation: {To himself}泰德，你在哪呢，孩子？

original: Beg your pardon, stranger, but I'm looking for someone. You ain't seen a young man with dark brown hair and a white hat on lately, have you?
translation: 请见谅，陌生人，我正在找人。你最近有没有见过一个深棕色头发、戴白帽子的年轻人？

original: You ain't heard anything about my boy, have you?
translation: 你有没有我儿子的消息？

original: You done right by me. I appreciate it.
translation: 你为我做了很多。我非常感激。

original: Oh- oh my. How unfortunate! And in front of all these people, too.
translation: 噢——噢，天啊。太不幸了！而且还当着这么多人的面！

original: He always was a bit of a pill, Mortimer. He was so pouty when I decided to ban eating people. And now this.
translation: 莫蒂默真是本性难移。我决定禁止吃人的时候他就很恼火。现在又来这么一出。

original: I should've paid more attention to the warning signs.
translation: 我早该注意到那些苗头的。

original: Can you imagine what people would've said? Why, it would've been a complete scandal if it weren't for you.
translation: 想想万一他得逞了，人们会怎么说吧。哎，要不是你，这恐怕就要变成一桩大丑闻了。

original: To think, Mr. Gunderson, a cold-blooded murderer. It's simply chilling.
translation: 谁能想到冈德森先生居然是个冷血的杀人凶手。太可怕了。

original: But his arrest ought to instill faith in our patrons that murderers are not welcome to gamble here.
translation: 但反过来说，逮捕他有助于老主顾坚定对我们的信心，让他们知道我们这里不欢迎杀人犯。

original: What a disaster! An important person dead in my hotel.
translation: 真是悲剧！居然有一位大客户死在了我的酒店里。

original: {Appalled}Now people will confuse us with Gomorrah. The idea!
translation: {Appalled}如此一来大家会把这里当成蛾摩拉那样的地方的。见鬼！

original: So glad you could be here tonight. I had hoped you would join us.
translation: 你今晚能来真是太让人高兴了。我早盼望着你光临了。

original: Welcome to the Ultra-Luxe. I do hope it exceeds your every expectation.
translation: 欢迎光临奢华殿堂。我诚挚地希望这里能满足你的所有要求。

original: You double-crossing snake! I have nothing to say to someone so lowly and ill-mannered.
translation: 你这两面派！我跟你这样的卑鄙小人无话可说。

original: {Pissed}I wanted Mr. Gunderson out of the way, not slaughtered in my hotel! Our business is concluded. Good day!
translation: {Pissed}我是想让冈德森先生别再和我们作对，不是想让他死在我的酒店里！咱们这桩生意没得做了。再见！

original: {Angry}You've done enough!
translation: {Angry}你太过分了！

original: Mark my words. I'll have you filleted for this.
translation: 你给我记着，迟早我要把你剁成肉片。

original: Ah, you're back. You're always a welcome guest here.
translation: 啊，你回来了。这里永远欢迎你。

original: Any word as to our arrangement?
translation: 我们之间的交易进行得如何了？

original: What the- ? Who is this trespasser?
translation: 什么——？这个入侵者是谁？

original: How may I be of service, sir?
translation: 能为您效劳吗，先生？

original: How may I be of service, madam?
translation: 能为您效劳吗，女士？

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: You'll have to excuse me. There's somewhere I need to be right now.
translation: 请您原谅。我还有别的事情。

original: Good day.
translation: 再见。

original: Leave me alone. Haven't you done enough?
translation: 离我远点。你还没折腾够么？

original: Why are you standing still? Do you think that the world waits for you while you you stand there drooling? Get back out there and get to work!
translation: 你还傻愣着干什么？你是不是以为自己站着发愣的时候全世界都会停下来等你？赶紧滚回去干活！

original: Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 你看不见我在忙？

original: I thought I told you to get lost.
translation: 我记得我已经说过叫你滚蛋了。

original: Why are you standing still? Do you think that the world waits for you while you you stand there drooling? Get back out there and get to work!
translation: 你还傻愣着干什么？你是不是以为自己站着发愣的时候全世界都会停下来等你？赶紧滚回去干活！

original: How may I assist?
translation: 有什么能帮忙的？

original: Come on, move it.
translation: 来吧，走吧。

original: My daddy's gonna kill all you bastards once he finds out what you done to me.
translation: 等我爸爸知道了你们都对我做了什么，他会把你们这些混蛋都杀光。

original: You know, if you knew what you were doing I coulda been out of there hours ago.
translation: 你知道吗，如果你能稍微靠谱点，我早就脱险了。

original: Beg your pardon, but could I trouble you to turn over your weapons?
translation: 请见谅，能否耽误您一下，把身上所有的武器都交上来呢？

original: You! What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你！你以为你在干什么？

original: The sooner you find yourself elsewhere, the better.
translation: 你最好早点离开这里。

original: Outrageous what Mortimer did. The nerve of some people.
translation: 莫蒂默的所作所为真是骇人听闻。有些人就是狗胆包天。

original: {Mock sympathy}Oh, Mortimer. You always had the gift of gaffe.
translation: {Mock sympathy}哦，莫蒂默。你永远都不缺出洋相的天分。

original: Usually we punish people who come in here uninvited. But you've made such a splash, we don't have the heart.
translation: 通常我们会惩罚那些不请自来的人。但你闹出了这么大动静，我们实在是在不忍心。

original: Your theatrics were just priceless. I salute you.
translation: 你的演出真是无以伦比。向你致敬。

original: Mortimer's vision was absolutely inspired.
translation: 莫蒂默的眼光绝对独到。

original: Now it can truly be said that not only to we dress better than anyone, we eat better as well.
translation: 现在终于可以毋庸置疑地说，我们不光穿的比别人好，吃的也比别人好。

original: I supported Mortimer from the beginning.
translation: 我从一开始就支持莫蒂默。

original: Of course cannibalism is civilized! It's all a matter of perspective.
translation: 同类相食当然是文明行为！这完全取决于你怎么理解。

original: I am at your service.
translation: 我随时为您效劳。

original: Have you been inside our bathhouse? The salts in the water work to balance the bodily humors.
translation: 你用过我们的浴室了吗？水里的盐分比例跟体液是一样的。

original: To eat at the Gourmand is to spoil the palate. I can't bring myself to eat anywhere else.
translation: 去美食家餐厅吃饭简直会宠坏舌头。别家的菜都没法入口了。

original: Did you see Heck Gunderson the brahmin baron at the bar? He may be a wastelander, but his taste clearly befits his status.
translation: 看到吧台边的赫克·冈德森了吗，就是那个双头牛大亨？虽然他来自废土，但他的品位彰显了他的格调。

original: Certainly you can buy the same drinks more cheaply elsewhere, but the point of drinking at Top Shelf isn't the liquor. It's the prestige.
translation: 你当然可以在其他地方用便宜得多的价格买到同样的酒水。但在云巅酒吧点酒，并不是为了喝酒，而是一种身份的象征。

original: Marjorie has done a remarkable job managing the restoration of this place, wouldn't you agree?
translation: 玛乔里的修饰工作做得还真好，你说呢？

original: Our executive chef Philippe is the toast of New Vegas. His Brahmin Wellington is absolutely sublime.
translation: 我们的行政主厨菲利普是新维加斯最棒的大厨。他做的惠灵顿牛排是人间一绝。

original: You watch yourself around Mr. Gunderson.
translation: 在冈德森先生身边时注意点。

original: Keep your distance. Who are you, and what do you want?
translation: 站那儿别动。你是谁，你想干什么？

original: It smells so good in here. Like the air is cleaner than it is outside.
translation: 这里的气味棒极了。感觉空气都比外面的干净。

original: I heard they brought in sea salts from California just for this bath.
translation: 我听说他们从加利福尼亚带来海盐，就为了洗浴。

original: I'm so relaxed. Too bad I can't stay longer. But who can, at these prices?
translation: 我感觉真放松啊。不能多呆一会儿，实在太可惜了。可是这么高的价格，谁又长待得起呢？

original: Have you been in the steam room yet? It's just off to the side there. You can feel your aches just melt away.
translation: 你去过桑拿房了吗？就在那边。蒸一下你就会觉得身上的酸痛都消失了。

original: Every evening most of the White Glove Society sneaks away somewhere. It's probably just for show.
translation: 每天晚上多数白手套社团的人都会溜到某个地方去。应该只是做样子的吧。

original: I'm in Heaven. I haven't had a meal like this in... well... ever, really.
translation: 我这是进天堂了呀。我从来没有吃过这样的大餐……呃……从没，真的。

original: Philippe has outdone himself again.
translation: 菲利普再一次突破了自己的极限。

original: For the price of this meal I could buy a whole Brahmin. But I'd never make that trade.
translation: 这餐饭的钱都够我买下一整头双头牛了。但我还是要说，这钱花得值呀。

original: Hey, any idea how somebody gets into the White Glove Society? Have to know somebody?
translation: 嘿，你知道怎么加入白手套社团吗？是需要走关系吗？

original: They must've spent a fortune renovating this place.
translation: 他们肯定花了一大笔钱来装修这地方。

original: I love the masks. It's like being at a fancy ball.
translation: 我喜欢这些面具。像参加化妆舞会一样。

original: I'm not really gambling. I'm just hoping to be seen here. People will think I'm rich.
translation: 其实我不是来赌钱的。我就是希望别人看见我在这而已，这样大家就会以为我是有钱人。

original: I've heard you have to make reservations at the Gourmand years in advance.
translation: 听说要在美食家餐厅订座需要提前几年预约。

original: Those masks make me nervous. Is there something wrong with their faces?
translation: 那些面具让我紧张。他们是不是脸上有什么毛病？

original: There are a lot of rumors going around about the White Glove Society. I heard they used to be tribals.
translation: 关于白手套社团有很多谣言。我听说他们以前都是野蛮人。

original: Top Shelf is the premiere bar on the Strip. The drinks are overpriced, but that's the whole point.
translation: 云巅是长街最顶尖的酒吧。酒水价格高得离谱，可这样才能上档次。

original: The Lucky 38's all lit up because someone infiltrated the El Dorado and flipped a switch. I'd shoot those lights out if I could.
translation: 幸运38突然灯火通明，估计是有人摸进多拉多电站去扳了电闸。我倒是真想把那些灯泡都打掉。

original: You ever think about being a Ranger?
translation: 你有没有想过成为一名游骑兵呢？

original: I'd gladly fight at your side.
translation: 我很高兴和你并肩作战。

original: You got my respect.
translation: 你赢得了我的尊重。

original: {Overtly flirtatious, boisterous before friends}That a pretty gal! Want to share?{laughter}Ha ha ha!
translation: {Overtly flirtatious, boisterous before friends}哎呀，漂亮妹子啊！要不有福同享啊？{laughter}哈哈哈！

original: We got ourselves a little Ranger family reunion now. Time's right for a feud.
translation: 咱们这帮游骑兵也算是小小地团聚了一下，该是时候了结恩怨了。

original: {Impressed}Hell of a place, huh?
translation: {Impressed}这地方糟透了，对吧？

original: Staying long?
translation: 多待一会儿吧？

original: A veteran Ranger inspires awe. Stick around for when they get here, you'll see. If I live to earn the Black Armor, I can die a happy woman.
translation: 精英游骑兵会让人肃然起敬。等过一阵子他们来了，你就明白了。要是能穿上那样一套黑色盔甲，我这辈子也值了。

original: First Recon's in Camp Forlorn Hope. Get some Rangers in there too and it'll be a damned impregnable fortress.
translation: 第一侦察营已经转移到了飘零希望营地。再来几名游骑兵，那里就会成为一座固若金汤的要塞。

original: Wish I could've been there, defending Camp Forlorn Hope. Even if it didn't change anything.
translation: 真希望防守飘零希望营地的时候我也能在，即便结果并不会改变。

original: Looks like we booted the Legion outta Nelson. About damn time.
translation: 看来我们把军团赶出纳尔逊了。也该是时候了。

original: From here on out, we fight for Chief Hanlon.
translation: 从现在起，我们将为军士长汉隆而战。

original: President Kimball was a tough son-of-a-gun. The Rangers'll pick up where he left off.
translation: 金博尔总统是个顽强的家伙。游骑兵会继承他的衣钵的。

original: President Kimball was a soldier's soldier. It's up to us to make the Legion pay for what they did.
translation: 金博尔总统是战士们的榜样。只有靠我们来让军团血债血偿了。

original: {with esteem}You saved President Kimball, didn't you? Hell of a thing.
translation: {with esteem}就是你救了金博尔总统吧？真是厉害。

original: Don't get many chances to catch a legionary alive. Burns me up that we botched ours.
translation: 活捉军团士兵的机会本来就少。好不容易抓到一个却被我们自己给弄死了，真让人窝火。

original: All you need is one Ranger protecting the monorail. You don't even need to feed him that much. He'll get it done.
translation: 找个游骑兵保护列车就行了。你甚至都不用管饭，他自己就会搞定。

original: Wish I had a First Recon guy looking after me.
translation: 真希望能有个第一侦察营的家伙来掩护我。

original: Hoover Dam... just thinking about it makes me nervous.
translation: 胡佛水坝……光想想都让人紧张。

original: {Starstruck}One of the Ranger vets looked at me and I just about surrendered.
translation: {Starstruck}有个精英游骑兵看了我一眼，我差点没把枪扔了。

original: The Ranger vets are on their way from Baja. Never seen one before. But I've heard they chew nails and spit napalm.
translation: 精英游骑兵正从下加州半岛赶来。我没见过他们，但我听说他们各个都是生吞铁钉口吐火焰的主。

original: We put our trust in Hanlon and look where it got us. Makes you wonder if we can trust anyone at all.
translation: 我们对汉隆百般信任，可你瞧瞧他是怎么耍我们的。现在我对任何人都不太信任了。

original: Chief Hanlon's watching over us now. He won't let us lose.
translation: 军士长汉隆罩着我们。他不会让我们失败的。

original: {Scared}They got to President Kimball. How long can we hold out?
translation: {Scared}他们杀了金博尔总统。我们还能坚持多久？

original: Oh my God, are you the one who saved President Kimball?
translation: 天啊，你就是那个救了金博尔总统的人？

original: I heard we captured a live Centurion and then let him get away. That never would've happened if I was in charge.
translation: 听说我们活捉了一名百夫长，又让他跑了。这事让我来办，是绝不可能搞砸的。

original: When I got this assignment I was hoping there'd be more gambling.
translation: 我刚调过来的时候，还以为能多赌几把呢。

original: Patrolling the Mojave almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter.
translation: 在莫哈维巡逻，真的会让人巴不得核冬天快点来。

original: Why don't you go join the rest of the human trash across the river?
translation: 为什么你不去找河对岸的那些人渣？

original: {Defiant}Come on. Give me a reason.
translation: {Defiant}来啊。碰我试试。

original: Shooting you right now might be worth the court-martial.
translation: 要能一枪毙了你，上军事法庭我也认了。

original: I suggest you leave.
translation: 我建议你马上离开。

original: Keep walking.
translation: 走开。

original: You got a lot of nerve walking around here.
translation: 你还真敢在这儿露脸。

original: You need to get your head straight. If you're fighting for us, act like it.
translation: 别老是打小算盘。如果你想为我们而战，那至少也表现得像样一点。

original: You're insane. We shouldn't be letting you run loose around here.
translation: 你疯了。我们不该放你到处乱跑的。

original: How are we supposed to trust you? You're completely unpredictable.
translation: 我们怎么相信你？根本没人能预料你会做什么。

original: Everything you've been up to... I just don't know what you're trying to pull.
translation: 你搞的那些名堂……我只是不清楚你到底打的什么主意。

original: At least the Legion knows what they're fighting for. When are you gonna figure it out?
translation: 就连军团都有明确的目标。你怎么就搞不清楚自己到底要做什么？

original: Why don't you pick a side? We did.
translation: 为什么不表明你的立场呢？看看我们。

original: Honored to speak with you, sir.
translation: 很荣幸和您交谈，先生。

original: Honored to speak with you, ma'am.
translation: 很荣幸和您交谈，女士。

original: You know, if you were serving, you'd probably be halfway to general by now.
translation: 依我看，如果你来部队服役，说不定现在已经快当上将军了。

original: Nice job out there.
translation: 你在外面表现不错。

original: Glad you're with us.
translation: 很高兴你站在我们这一边。

original: Hey. Welcome aboard.
translation: 嘿。欢迎。

original: I'm not sure you should be here.
translation: 我觉得你不应该到这儿来。

original: You lost?
translation: 你迷路了？

original: We won't go quietly. The Legion can count on that.
translation: 我们不会善罢甘休的。军团就等着瞧吧。

original: Sounds like we're running Primm now. I'd still rather take my leave at the Strip.
translation: 听说普瑞姆现在归我们管了。但我还是宁愿去长街。

original: First Recon's at Camp Forlorn Hope. Now we've got a chance to hold it.
translation: 第一侦察营已经进驻飘零希望营地。这下我们守住的机会就大了。

original: Nelson's back in our hands. I hope we can defend it this time.
translation: 纳尔逊回到了我们手中。希望这次能守住它。

original: Is it me, or has the Brotherhood stopped engaging us? Smartest move they ever made, you ask me.
translation: 是我听错了，还是兄弟会真的放弃抵抗了？要我说，这算是他们至今为止最明智的决定。

original: Smart move for the Kings to back down. They didn't know who they were messing with.
translation: 放弃抵抗对猫王帮来说是明智之举。他们根本不知道顽抗的下场。

original: We signed a treaty with the Great Khans. Guess you can never have too many lowlife chem dealers on your side.
translation: 我们和大汗帮签了协议。看来以后毒贩子是不会少了。

original: Sickens me that the Legion would try to harvest slaves from a refugee camp.
translation: 军团居然直接从难民营抓奴隶，真让我恶心。

original: President Kimball is lucky he escaped. I don't think we could lose him right now.
translation: 金博尔总统幸运地逃过一劫。这种节骨眼上，我们可不能没有他啊。

original: Wish I could've been there to see Caesar die. What an asshole.
translation: 真希望我能亲眼看着凯撒咽气。那个狗日的。

original: Monster of the East, huh? Well I've got the Monster of the West in my holster right now. Hope I get to introduce them.
translation: 东方之兽，嗯？那我枪套里的就是西方之兽咯。希望我能介绍他们认识认识。

original: Got business here?
translation: 你有什么事？

original: Keeping the Strip secure has been hell since the monorail was taken out.
translation: 自从单轨列车被炸后，长街的安保工作就乱成了一锅粥。

original: Did you hear about that Legion POW escape? I don't like our chances of taking him alive twice.
translation: 你听说军团战俘逃跑的事情了吗？我想再次活捉他的希望不大。

original: They're talking about you on the radio. Saving President Kimball. I'm impressed.
translation: 他们在电台节目上聊到了你。是你救了金博尔总统。我很佩服。

original: How could we lose Kimball at a time like this?
translation: 我们怎么能在眼下这种关头失去金博尔？

original: Chief Hanlon was a model soldier. We all looked up to him.
translation: 军士长汉隆是模范士兵。我们都很敬重他。

original: Too bad about Chief Hanlon. He did what he thought was best for us.
translation: 军士长汉隆的死真教人惋惜。他也都是为了我们好。

original: Without Camp Forlorn Hope, it's a matter of time before the Legion surrounds us at the Dam.
translation: 没了飘零希望营地，我们在水坝被军团合围就只是时间问题。

original: This whole war's gonna change when the Ranger veterans get here. Soon as we see the Black Armor, we can all breathe easier.
translation: 一旦精锐游骑兵们赶来，整个战局都将改变。只要看到黑色装甲出现，我们就可以松口气了。

original: A platoon of veteran Rangers is like a tactical nuke, only tougher to scare.
translation: 一个排的精英游骑兵就像一颗战略核弹头，甚至比核弹头更可怕。

original: This battle... everything's riding on it.
translation: 这场战斗……成败在此一举。

original: That red beret's looking good, soldier.
translation: 那顶红色贝雷帽看起来不错，士兵。

original: The security lapse with the monorail is a huge embarrassment.
translation: 列车竟然存在安保漏洞，实在是太丢脸了。

original: That POW escape presents some real security concerns. That was our base camp, for crying out loud.
translation: 战俘逃亡暴露出来的是实实在在的安保隐患。搞什么鬼，那可是我们的大本营。

original: There's something fishy about how Chief Hanlon died. It just doesn't add up.
translation: 军士长汉隆的死有些不对劲。但我说不上来是什么。

original: Can't believe Hanlon was working against us.
translation: 没想到汉隆居然暗中和我们作对。

original: No hope of securing the border now that Forlorn Hope fell.
translation: 飘零希望营地沦陷了，边境保不住了。

original: The Ranger veterans have been running ops in Baja. We'll be a different army with them here.
translation: 精英游骑兵正在下加州半岛执行任务。如果能有他们支援，我们肯定会大不一样。

original: We've got our best Rangers here now. All of a sudden I like our chances a whole lot better.
translation: 现在我们最强的游骑兵到了。我突然觉得胜算大增。

original: If we lose Hoover Dam, we can kiss Nevada goodbye.
translation: 如果我们丢了胡佛水坝，那就只能和内华达说再见了。

original: With House dead, we'll have Vegas annexed before the year's out.
translation: 既然豪斯死了，我们在新年之前就能吞并维加斯。

original: It's been a long tour. All I can think about now is going back home.
translation: 长路漫漫啊。我现在就想回家。

original: {Primm, new Sheriff}Primm's got some new sheriff watching over the town now.
translation: {Primm, new Sheriff}普瑞姆来了一个新警长。

original: {Primm, NCR rule}The NCR's all over Primm. Steer clear.
translation: {Primm, NCR rule}现在普瑞姆到处是NCR的人。躲远点吧。

original: {Kimball dead}Somebody whacked the NCR president. Got what was coming to him.
translation: {Kimball dead}有人干掉了NCR的总统。我就知道他会是这下场。

original: {Caesar dead}Someone took out the Legion's boss. Doubt it'll stop them for long, though.
translation: {Caesar dead}有人干掉了军团的老大。但我怀疑这招并不能阻止他们。

original: {Middle Game}Lot more troops on the road these days. Wonder what's up.
translation: {Middle Game}最近路上的军队是越来越多了。也不知道怎么回事。

original: {Late Game}Best to lay low. The NCR and the Legion are about to have it out.
translation: {Late Game}最好低调点。NCR和军团很快就要开战了。

original: {Liked 1}You and me are all right.
translation: {Liked 1}咱们没问题。

original: {Liked 2}Good to know that you've got my back.
translation: {Liked 2}很高兴你能做我的后盾。

original: {Liked 3}Don't let the NCR catch up to you, all right?
translation: {Liked 3}不要让NCR把你抓去，好吗？

original: {Rascal 1}You seem to be on the level.
translation: {Rascal 1}你还算上道。

original: {Rascal 2}Heard some things about you. {clarifying}Good things.
translation: {Rascal 2}我听过你的事。{clarifying}都是好事。

original: {Rascal 3}Guess we're on the same side.
translation: {Rascal 3}我们应该是一伙的吧。

original: {Wild Child 1}I respect you, but I want nothing to do with you.
translation: {Wild Child 1}我尊重你，但我不想和你扯上关系。

original: {Wild Child 2}I've heard some crazy stories about you.
translation: {Wild Child 2}我听说你做过不少疯狂的事。

original: {Wild Child 3}Whatever is you want, keep me out of it. I've heard the stories.
translation: {Wild Child 3}不管你想干什么，别扯上我。我听过你的事。

original: {Mixed 1}I don't think I'll be turning my back to you anytime soon.
translation: {Mixed 1}我觉得还是防着你一点比较好。

original: {Mixed 2}Keep your hands where I can see them - makes me feel better.
translation: {Mixed 2}把手放在我能看到的地方——这样我能舒服点。

original: {Mixed 3}You make it hard to trust you, you know that?
translation: {Mixed 3}你让人很难相信你，你知道吗？

original: {Hated 1}You better be sleeping with one eye open.
translation: {Hated 1}你最好睡觉时也睁一只眼。

original: {Hated 2}Why are you even talking to me?
translation: {Hated 2}你为什么还敢跟我说话？

original: {Hated 3}I'd kill you right now if I could.
translation: {Hated 3}如果可以的话，我现在就想杀了你。

original: {Thug 1}You're not exactly making friends around here, are you?
translation: {Thug 1}你不会是想在这里交朋友吧，啊？

original: {Thug 2}You and I have got nothing to talk about.
translation: {Thug 2}我和你没什么好说的。

original: {Thug 3}Just keep on walking.
translation: {Thug 3}一边去。

original: {Companion Reaction - Lily}Holy fuck. Never seen a mutant like that before.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Lily}我的妈呀。从没见过那样的变种人。

original: {Companion Reaction - Rex}Didn't know they still had robo-dogs around.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Rex}原来现在还有机器狗啊，我都不知道。

original: {Companion Reaction - Raul}Wouldn't want to live forever if I had to look like a ghoul.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Raul}要是变成尸鬼那样，我宁愿不要长生不死。

original: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{slight awe, respectful}That guy's got cold eyes. Definitely ex-military.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{slight awe, respectful}这家伙眼神冰冷，绝对在部队里混过。

original: {Companion Reaction - Veronica}Now there's a fine-looking woman. Just needs to ditch the robe.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Veronica}这女人挺漂亮。要是能脱掉袍子就更好了。

original: {Companion Reaction - Cass}Tough-looking woman. Something tells me she aims for the crotch.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Cass}挺彪悍的女人。我估计她瞄人都是直接瞄裤裆的。

original: {Companion Reaction - Arcade}We bought and sold guys like Four-Eyes over there like property back in the prison.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Arcade}当年关牢里的时候，我们可是把这些四眼田鸡当东西卖的。

original: {slight threat}You eyeballing me?
translation: {slight threat}你瞅啥？

original: Damn. Running low on smokes again.
translation: 该死。又要没烟抽了。

original: Any lawman that comes after me won't have it easy.
translation: 让那些条子来抓我们试试。

original: Never gets old when something blows up.
translation: 炸东西玩永远不会腻。

original: No way I'm going back to prison.
translation: 我绝对不回监狱。

original: {Companion Reaction - Lily}Holy fuck. Never seen a mutant like that before.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Lily}我的妈呀。从没见过那样的变种人。

original: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{slight awe, respectful}That guy's got cold eyes. Definitely ex-military.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Boone}{slight awe, respectful}这家伙眼神冰冷，绝对在部队里混过。

original: {Companion Reaction - Cass}Tough-looking woman. Something tells me she aims for the crotch.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Veronica}这女人挺漂亮。要是能脱掉袍子就更好了。

original: {Liked 1}You and me are all right.
translation: {Liked 1}咱们没问题。

original: {Liked 2}Good to know that you've got my back.
translation: {Liked 2}很高兴你能做我的后盾。

original: {Liked 3}Don't let the NCR catch up to you, all right?
translation: {Liked 3}不要让NCR把你抓去，好吗？

original: {Rascal 1}You seem to be on the level.
translation: {Rascal 1}你还算上道。

original: {Rascal 2}Heard some things about you. {clarifying}Good things.
translation: {Rascal 2}我听过你的事。{clarifying}都是好事。

original: {Rascal 3}Guess we're on the same side.
translation: {Rascal 3}我们应该是一伙的吧。

original: {Wild Child 1}I respect you, but I want nothing to do with you.
translation: {Wild Child 1}我尊重你，但我不想和你扯上关系。

original: {Wild Child 2}I've heard some crazy stories about you.
translation: {Wild Child 2}我听说你做过不少疯狂的事。

original: {Wild Child 3}Whatever is you want, keep me out of it. I've heard the stories.
translation: {Wild Child 3}不管你想干什么，别扯上我。我听过你的事。

original: {Mixed 1}I don't think I'll be turning my back to you anytime soon.
translation: {Mixed 1}我觉得还是防着你一点比较好。

original: {Mixed 2}Keep your hands where I can see them - makes me feel better.
translation: {Mixed 2}把手放在我能看到的地方——这样我能舒服点。

original: {Mixed 3}You make it hard to trust you, you know that?
translation: {Mixed 3}你让人很难相信你，你知道吗？

original: {Hated 1}You better be sleeping with one eye open.
translation: {Hated 1}你最好睡觉时也睁一只眼。

original: {Hated 2}Why are you even talking to me?
translation: {Hated 2}你竟然还敢跟我说话？

original: {Hated 3}I'd kill you right now if I could.
translation: {Hated 3}如果可以的话，我现在就想杀了你。

original: {Thug 1}You're not exactly making friends around here, are you?
translation: {Thug 1}你不会是想来交朋友的吧，啊？

original: {Thug 2}You and I have got nothing to talk about.
translation: {Thug 2}我和你没什么好说的。

original: {Thug 3}Just keep on walking.
translation: {Thug 3}一边去。

original: {slight threat}You eyeballing me?
translation: {slight threat}你瞅啥？

original: Damn. Running low on smokes again.
translation: 该死。又要没烟抽了。

original: Never gets old when something blows up.
translation: 炸东西玩永远不会腻。

original: {Companion Reaction - EDE}Wouldn't mind having one of those little flying robots myself.
translation: {Companion Reaction - EDE}我倒是不介意能有一个会飞的小机器人。

original: {Worried}We can't sit idly while the Legion prepares their own elite forces.
translation: {Worried}军团就要派精英部队过来了，我们可不能坐以待毙。

original: {Conviction}The time to assert our rule over the territories has come.
translation: {Conviction}是时候把秩序带给这片蛮荒之地了。

original: {Fearful Suspicion}I've seen what those creatures do, and I don't know how you trust them.
translation: {Fearful Suspicion}我见过那些畜生的真面目，真不懂你怎么能相信他们。

original: {Hopeful}Those Legion beasts needed to be put down, like the vermin they are!
translation: {Hopeful}那些军团的禽兽就像害虫一样！他们应该被消灭。

original: {Hopeful}Did you hear about the Legion Defeat at Nelson? We're winning back our territories.
translation: {Hopeful}你听说军团在纳尔逊被打败的事情了吗？我们正在收复失地。

original: {Indifferent}As long as the Khans leave our lands alone, I don't care what happens.
translation: {Indifferent}只要能让大汗帮离我们的地盘远点，我才不介意怎么样呢。

original: {celebratory}I always knew House would give in! Sixth state of the union, here we come!
translation: {celebratory}我就知道豪斯会屈服的！联邦的第六个州，马上要成立了！

original: {Encouraged}I'd wager that the army's sending elite units our way, right as we speak.
translation: {Encouraged}我敢打赌，就在我们说话这会，军方派来的精锐部队正在赶来的路上呢。

original: {Pessimistic}Bitter Springs... a name like that could've only brought bad luck.
translation: {Pessimistic}苦泉……这样的名字只会招来厄运。

original: {Cautious}I'll believe that the Fiends are gone when they stop their raiding and pillaging.
translation: {Cautious}等到那些恶魔帮不再烧杀抢掠的时候，我才能相信他们死光了。

original: {Hindsight}Should've bet we'd kill the Fiend's leader.
translation: {Hindsight}早知道就赌我们会杀掉恶魔帮头目了。

original: {Dumbfounded}Everywhere I go, people are talking about our President's assassination.
translation: {Dumbfounded}不管我走到哪里，人们总在谈论总统遇刺的事。

original: {Avarice}With House out of the way, I hope someone opens the Lucky 38.
translation: {Avarice}豪斯已经不在了，我希望有人能打开幸运38的大门。

original: {Disdainful}I see you prefer the company of anarchic cultists to civilized peoples.
translation: {Disdainful}比起文明人，我想你更喜欢和无政府主义的邪教徒们打交道。

original: {Incredulous}What makes you think I give a damn about you?
translation: {Incredulous}你觉得我会管你是哪根葱吗？

original: {Apprehension}Just, don't do anything crazy.
translation: {Apprehension}只要别做傻事就好。

original: {Genuine Appreciation}I hope you're doing well, friend!
translation: {Genuine Appreciation}祝你一切顺利，朋友！

original: {Dismissive}Don't bother me, please.
translation: {Dismissive}请你别来打扰我。

original: {Fearful yet Determined}This is it. War's almost upon us.
translation: {Fearful yet Determined}快了。大战就要来了。

original: {Feeling Fortunate}Word is you're getting popular in The Strip.
translation: {Feeling Fortunate}据说你在长街越来越受欢迎了。

original: {Hopeful}I've heard that elite units are on the way to support our armies here.
translation: {Hopeful}我听说精英部队马上要来增援了。

original: {Fearful}War doesn't forgive anybody, but what did we do to deserve this?
translation: {Fearful}战争不会放过任何人，但我们凭什么要遭这个罪啊？

original: {Dismissive}Those Freeside thugs aren't worth our time anymore.
translation: {Dismissive}这些自由城的暴徒已经不再值得我们浪费时间了。

original: {Assertive}Khans are history, it serves them right!
translation: {Assertive}大汗帮已经成为了历史，它罪有应得！

original: {Disbelief}Did you hear about Hanlon? What a blow!
translation: {Disbelief}你听说汉隆的事了吗？真是个打击！

original: {Fearful Anger}You killed him! What have we done to you?
translation: {Fearful Anger}你杀了他！我们没把你怎么样啊？

original: {Indignated}I hear some asshole freed our enemy from McCarran.
translation: {Indignated}我听说有傻逼从麦卡伦营地放走了我们的敌人。

original: {Deep Concern}Someone blew up the Monorail, right by our troops!
translation: {Deep Concern}有人炸毁了单轨列车，就在我们部队的眼皮子底下！

original: {Celebratory}With Mr. House dead and gone, Vegas can finally join the NCR!
translation: {Celebratory}豪斯先生死了，维加斯也终于可以加入NCR了！

original: {Intrigued}Your robot looks worth quite a few caps.
translation: {Intrigued}你的机器人看起来值不少瓶盖啊。

original: {Thoughtful Naivete}If the Legion can equip their men so well, maybe they can take care of me too.
translation: {Thoughtful Naivete}如果军团能给他们的人这么好的装备，或许他们也能照顾好我。

original: {Hopeful}I hope the Fiends stop their raids now that their boss is gone
translation: {Hopeful}我希望这些恶魔帮别再出来打劫了，他们的老大都挂了。

original: {Dumbfounded}Bad weather ahead, I tell you. The death of our President's just the start.
translation: {Dumbfounded}要变天了，我跟你说。总统的死只是个开始。

original: {Resentful}Don't care about Kimball, until he starts to care about us.
translation: {Resentful}我才不在乎金博尔的死活，除非他开始关心我们。

original: {Revolted}Don't dump your Ghoul here, we've already got enough shit around us.
translation: {Revolted}别把你的尸鬼扔这儿，我们周围的破事已经够多了。

original: {Admiringly}People of my trade respect the merchants of these territories.
translation: {Admiringly}干我们这行的都很尊敬这片地区的商人。

original: {Proud and Celebratory}I hear the Khans won't trouble us anymore.
translation: {Proud and Celebratory}我听说大汗帮不会再骚扰我们了。

original: {Slightly Apprehensive}I hear the Securitrons are tougher since their faces changed.
translation: {Slightly Apprehensive}我听说自从电子保安变了脸之后就强大了许多。

original: {Celebratory}House was the only thing keeping Vegas from joining the NCR!
translation: {Celebratory}豪斯是阻止维加斯加入NCR的唯一障碍！

original: {Excitedly Surprised}You're the one that killed Caesar, right?
translation: {Excitedly Surprised}你就是杀死凯撒的那个人，对吗？

original: {Celebratory}After all, Caesar died like the old man he was.
translation: {Celebratory}终于，凯撒像一个风烛残年的老人那样死去了。

original: {Excitedly Surprised}That Caesar bastard had it coming.
translation: {Excitedly Surprised}那个混蛋凯撒真是罪有应得。

original: {Thankful}I'm glad those damn bots are gone for good.
translation: {Thankful}我很庆幸那些可恶的机器人终于离开了。

original: {Slight Relief}Our guys put the Monorail back to work!
translation: {Slight Relief}我们的人修好了列车！

original: {Excitedly Thankful}We owe you so much for saving our President.
translation: {Excitedly Thankful}你救了我们的总统，我们欠你很多。

original: {Proud Indignation}Can you believe they tried killing our President? Don't they know who they are dealing with?
translation: {Proud Indignation}你能相信吗，居然有人想刺杀总统？难道他们不知道自己在跟谁作对？

original: {Rueful Indignation}Our own President, murdered! Things aren't looking good.
translation: {Rueful Indignation}我们的总统被谋杀了！大事不妙。

original: {Unspoken Suspicions}Hanlon was a brave soldier, what could've driven him to despair?
translation: {Unspoken Suspicions}汉隆曾是一位勇敢的士兵，是什么事情把他逼上绝路？

original: {Assertive}That Fiend leader shouldn't have messed with our great army.
translation: {Assertive}那个恶魔帮的头目就不该招惹我们的大军。

original: {Proud}The Fiends are running for their lives. That'll show everyone what we do to our enemies.
translation: {Proud}恶魔帮的人已经做鸟兽散了。这下敌人该明白我们的实力了。

original: {Worried}If the Legion can reach as far as Bitter Springs, what's going to stop them from getting to us?
translation: {Worried}如果军团的魔爪能触及苦泉镇，还有什么能阻止他们把手伸向我们呢？

original: {Slightly Concerned, if Hopeful}Those Khans are savages, but we can use them to our advantage.
translation: {Slightly Concerned, if Hopeful}大汗帮都是野蛮人，但他们也有利用的价值。

original: {Proud}Those Khans got the hint! We've shown everyone that these are our new territories.
translation: {Proud}大汗帮的人终于开窍了！这下人人都知道这里是我们的新领土了。

original: {Self-Righteousness}I knew those Khans couldn't be trusted!
translation: {Self-Righteousness}我就知道大汗帮的那些人信不得！

original: {Proud}I hear we straightened up a band of thugs in Freeside.
translation: {Proud}听说自由城原来的那帮暴徒弃暗投明了。

original: {Hopeful}I hear a troublesome Legion camp got razed to the ground!
translation: {Hopeful}听说又有个讨厌的军团营地被夷为平地了！

original: {Rueful}Our forces suffered a huge blow at Forlorn Hope, We'll remember that!
translation: {Rueful}我们的部队在飘零希望营地遭受了巨大的打击，我们不会忘记的！

original: {Celebratory}Legionaries are next in the list of rabid dogs to put down!
translation: {Celebratory}下一个该镇压的疯狗就是军团了！

original: {Proud}Civilizing Primm will show what we can do for everyone else in these territories.
translation: {Proud}普瑞姆的开化会向这片土地上的所有人展示我们的实力。

original: {Excitedly Hopeful}Our rangers are going to show everyone what happens when we're pissed off!
translation: {Excitedly Hopeful}游骑兵会让所有人知道激怒我们的代价！

original: {Concerned}I've heard the Legion's planning to unleash their best men against us.
translation: {Concerned}我听说军团正计划派他们最精锐的部队来对付我们。

original: {Worried}Those Legion elite troops are bad blood.
translation: {Worried}军团精英都是些恶贯满盈的家伙。

original: {Slightly Concerned}Things are getting stranger every day.
translation: {Slightly Concerned}局势越来越令人困惑了。

original: {Visibly Concerned}It seems that the territories are about to blow up.
translation: {Visibly Concerned}这片土地马上要有大麻烦了。

original: {Slightly Irritated}Back home we don't waste time talking to strangers, either.
translation: {Slightly Irritated}就算在老家，我们也不会浪费时间和陌生人说话。

original: {Slightly Irritated}I really have more important things to do, sorry.
translation: {Slightly Irritated}我确实有更重要的事情要做，劳驾。

original: {Pleasant}Good to see a friend of our government.
translation: {Pleasant}很高兴能见到我们的盟友。

original: {Pleasant}The NCR appreciates good citizens like you.
translation: {Pleasant}NCR很感谢像你这样的优秀公民。

original: {Pleasant}I'm glad to see you.
translation: {Pleasant}很高兴见到你。

original: {Genuine Appreciation}The NCR's fortunate to have your support.
translation: {Genuine Appreciation}有你的支持，NCR真的很幸运。

original: {Genuine Appreciation}You're a model citizen, thank you.
translation: {Genuine Appreciation}你是模范公民，谢谢你。

original: {Slight Discomfort}What do you want with me?
translation: {Slight Discomfort}你找我干什么？

original: {Slight Suspicion}You're not going to cause any problems, right?
translation: {Slight Suspicion}你不会是来找麻烦的吧？

original: {Palpable Apprehension}Uh-oh, back off and leave me alone.
translation: {Palpable Apprehension}啊哦，走开，让我一个人静静。

original: {Fearful}I don't want any trouble, okay?
translation: {Fearful}我不想找麻烦，好吗？

original: {Violent Indignation}What the hell's going on in your crazy head?
translation: {Violent Indignation}你脑袋里装的都是些什么疯狂玩意儿？

original: {Repulsion}Don't talk to me!
translation: {Repulsion}别和我说话！

original: {Proud Disdain}I don't waste my time with troublemakers.
translation: {Proud Disdain}我从不和制造麻烦的家伙浪费时间。

original: {Seething Anger}We should have you tried, and then killed on the spot!
translation: {Seething Anger}我们就该放你乱来，然后当场毙了你！

original: {Seething Anger}I'm too civilized, otherwise I'd stone you to death.
translation: {Seething Anger}要不是我够文明，真想用乱石砸死你。

original: {Restrained Violence}I should make you pay for your crimes!
translation: {Restrained Violence}我会让你为自己的罪行付出代价！

original: {Curious}I've seen Followers of the Apocalypse in my travels before.
translation: {Curious}我之前在旅途中见过天启追随者。

original: {Admiringly}NCR Rangers deserve all my praise.
translation: {Admiringly}我所有的赞美都归于NCR游骑兵。

original: {Admiringly}Is your friend one of those elite troops we've been hearing about?
translation: {Admiringly}你的朋友就是那支传说中的精英部队的一员？

original: {Admiringly}Your merchant friend would make a fine NCR woman.
translation: {Admiringly}你的商人朋友会成为NCR的优秀女性公民。

original: {Intrigued}I've never seen a robot like that before.
translation: {Intrigued}我之前从未见过这种机器人。

original: {Fearful Suspicion}The Supermutant's under control, I hope.
translation: {Fearful Suspicion}我希望你能管好那个超级变种人。

original: {Fearful Suspicion}I've seen what those creatures do, and I don't know how you trust them.
translation: {Fearful Suspicion}我了解那些畜生的本性，我不知道你怎么会信任他们。

original: {Fearful Suspicion}I've seen what those creatures do, and I don't know how you trust them.
translation: {Fearful Suspicion}我了解那些畜生的本性，我不知道你怎么会信任他们。

original: {Fearful Suspicion}I've seen what those creatures do, and I don't know how you trust them.
translation: {Fearful Suspicion}我了解那些畜生的本性，我不知道你怎么会信任他们。

original: {Fearful Suspicion}I've seen what those creatures do, and I don't know how you trust them.
translation: {Fearful Suspicion}我了解那些畜生的本性，我不知道你怎么会信任他们。

original: {Revolted}Your Ghoul friend better not be radioactive.
translation: {Revolted}你的尸鬼朋友最好身上没有辐射。

original: {Unabashed Curiosity}What on earth is *that* creature?
translation: {Unabashed Curiosity}*那个*生物到底是什么？

original: {Thoughtful Curiosity}Your lady friend seems out of place here.
translation: {Thoughtful Curiosity}你的女性朋友看起来和这个地方不太搭。

original: {Thoughtful Curiosity}Your friend seems too civilized for a place like this.
translation: {Thoughtful Curiosity}你的朋友太文明了，跟这地方一点都不搭。

original: {Satisfied}Caesar's fate was sealed from the start.
translation: {Satisfied}从一开始，凯撒的命运就已经注定了。

original: {Satisfied}Wish I could've seen that Legion dog suffer.
translation: {Satisfied}真希望我能亲眼目睹军团的走狗受难。

original: {Chanced Encounter}My lucky day, running into our President's savior!
translation: {Chanced Encounter}今天真是我的幸运日，居然让我撞见了总统救星！

original: {Hopeful}I'm glad the President is still here to help us settle in these new territories.
translation: {Hopeful}很高兴总统能帮助我们在这片土地上定居。

original: {Proud}I'm not surprised Kimball survived. We NCR people are made of hard stuff.
translation: {Proud}金博尔能逃过此劫，我并不惊讶。我们NCR向来坚如磐石。

original: {Violent}I should kill you myself for what you did to Kimball, and fuck the law!
translation: {Violent}我就该亲手杀掉你这个谋害总统的人，去他妈的法律！

original: {Violent}Even without our President, we won't leave the new territories!
translation: {Violent}即使没有总统，我们也不会离开新领土！

original: {Violent}I bet I'd get a reward for bringing your head to the authorities, assassin!
translation: {Violent}如果把你的脑袋交给政府，我敢打赌一定会拿到一笔赏金，刺客！

original: {Resigned}Kimball's luck ran out.
translation: {Resigned}金博尔的好运到头了。

original: {Proud}I should've taken the Fiend's head for myself.
translation: {Proud}我恨不得亲手取了恶魔帮的人头。

original: {Resigned Fear}They say the Fiends are defeated, but I'm sticking close to the army - just in case.
translation: {Resigned Fear}他们都说恶魔帮被击败了，但以防万一，我还是多和军队亲近一些吧。

original: {Cautious}They say it's safer to travel now that Fiends are retreating, but I'd still look out for trouble.
translation: {Cautious}他们说现在旅行安全多了，恶魔帮撤退了，但我还是要多加小心。

original: {Arrogant}As we've done with the Fiends, we'll kill anyone who resists our fight for peace.
translation: {Arrogant}阻碍我们和平大业的人终将被消灭，恶魔帮就是明证。

original: {Visibly Disturbed}Legion attacking so far from their bases means we'll have to watch out on the road.
translation: {Visibly Disturbed}军团竟然已经如此深入腹地了，看来我们外出得小心些。

original: {Pessimistic}We're just pushing our luck by signing a treaty with those savage Khans.
translation: {Pessimistic}我们居然和大汗帮那些的野蛮人签订条约，这根本就是一场豪赌。

original: {Proud and Celebratory}The territories are safer now that the Khans have disappeared.
translation: {Proud and Celebratory}大汗帮消失了，现在这片地区安全多了。

original: {Scolding Hindsight}I told everyone we shouldn't have bet for the Khans.
translation: {Scolding Hindsight}我早说过我们不能对大汗帮抱希望。

original: {Self-Affirming Conviction}It's clear that savages, like the Khans, can't be trusted to civilize.
translation: {Self-Affirming Conviction}很明显像大汗帮那样的野蛮人，是不可能被文明社会所接纳的。

original: {Proud}I'll tell everyone back home about how the NCR deals with wild thugs, like the Kings.
translation: {Proud}我会告诉家乡父老，NCR是怎么对付猫王帮这群恶棍的。

original: {Proud}The Kings were pushing it too far, and they got what was coming to them.
translation: {Proud}猫王帮太过分了，他们自作自受。

original: {Proud Sarcasm}I guess those "Kings" finally got who's the real boss around here.
translation: {Proud Sarcasm}"猫王帮"这下该明白谁才是这地方的老大了吧。

original: {Hopeful}Our victory at Nelson's a worthy story to tell in my travels.
translation: {Hopeful}我们在纳尔逊取得了大捷，这下我在路上可有话聊了。

original: {Hopeful}Our victory at Nelson's a worthy story to tell in my travels.
translation: {Hopeful}我们在纳尔逊取得了大捷，这下我在路上可有话聊了。

original: {Arrogant}Nelson will serve as example. We'll bleed the ground red with anyone who opposes our peace-efforts.
translation: {Arrogant}谁敢妨碍我们的和平大业，就让他的鲜血染红大地。纳尔逊就是证明。

original: {Bewildered Anger}You'll pay for what you did to our soldiers at Forlorn Hope, murderer!
translation: {Bewildered Anger}你要为我们牺牲在飘零希望营地的士兵们偿命，凶手！

original: {Proud}It's good to hear that Primm has accepted our law.
translation: {Proud}很高兴普瑞姆接受了我们的法律。

original: {Matter of Fact}A reliable source told me we're getting the best NCR soldiers to help us against the Legion.
translation: {Matter of Fact}可靠消息，NCR的精英部队很快就会前来协助我们对抗军团。

original: {Admiringly}Have you seen them? Our Rangers are the finest men alive!
translation: {Admiringly}你看到他们了吗？我们的游骑兵举世无双！

original: {Worried}People are whispering, everywhere, about the massive Legion army gathering past the Colorado.
translation: {Worried}大家都在传，军团的主力部队正在科罗拉多峡谷一侧集结。

original: {Visibly Worried}Looks like the Legion also brought their own elite warriors to the territories.
translation: {Visibly Worried}军团似乎也出动了他们的精锐部队。

original: {Visibly Worried}You'd be crazy to put your money on either side of the coming battle.
translation: {Visibly Worried}只有疯子才会给接下来的战斗下注。

original: {unsettled}Why the hell is the Lucky 38 all lit up these days? I don't like it.
translation: {unsettled}为什么这该死的幸运38的灯这几天都全亮着？我不喜欢这样。

original: {Conviction}We'll make this land peaceful, after we kill everybody who opposes us.
translation: {Conviction}等我们消灭了所有反对我们的人，这片土地自然就会和平了。

original: {Fearful}It's time to pack and leave these lands until the dust settles.
translation: {Fearful}尘埃落定之前，最好收拾东西避一避。

original: {Fearful}It's time to pack and leave these lands until the dust settles.
translation: {Fearful}尘埃落定之前，最好收拾东西避一避。

original: {Casual Acknowledgement}What's up.
translation: {Casual Acknowledgement}最近如何？

original: {Casual Acknowledgement}Uh huh.
translation: {Casual Acknowledgement}啊哈。

original: {Casual}Hey.
translation: {Casual}嘿。

original: {Unabashed Curiosity}Never seen a guardian dog like that before.
translation: {Unabashed Curiosity}我以前从没见过那样的警卫犬。

original: {Satisfied}With Caesar out of the way, we'll assert our rule over the territories.
translation: {Satisfied}既然我们已经赶走了凯撒，应该继续巩固对这片土地的统治。

original: {Self-Affirming Conviction}I knew that the Khans were animals. We should kill them like vermin.
translation: {Self-Affirming Conviction}我就知道大汗帮都是些畜生。我们应该除掉这些害虫。

original: {Bewildered Anger}What on earth could push you to destroy Forlorn Hope?
translation: {Bewildered Anger}究竟是什么天杀的原因让你摧毁了飘零希望营地？

original: {Fearful Apprehension}You're not going to raze us to the ground, like you did to Forlorn Hope, right?
translation: {Fearful Apprehension}你不会像摧毁飘零希望营地那样把我们这里也毁掉吧？

original: {Proud}NCR will civilize all this Wasteland, Primm is only the beginning.
translation: {Proud}NCR会将文明传播到废土的每一个角落，普瑞姆只是个开始。

original: {Encouraged}I've heard that we're getting strong reinforcements to help us civilize the territories.
translation: {Encouraged}我听说马上就会有大批援军来帮助我们开化这片地区。

original: {Disappointed}Instead of spending a fortune in this war, the NCR should be paying us to survive!
translation: {Disappointed}NCR应该帮助我们改善生活，而不是都把钱花在战争上！

original: {Disappointed}I could buy back my *life* with the money it must cost to make one of those Ranger elite armors!
translation: {Disappointed}做一套游骑兵精英护甲的钱，都够买我的*命*了！

original: {Admiringly}The Legion better watch out now, our Rangers are going to turn the tables around!
translation: {Admiringly}军团可得当心了，我们的游骑兵马上就会扭转局势！

original: {Visibly Worried}Despite our strength, the Legion army looks fierce enough to make me waiver.
translation: {Visibly Worried}虽说我们也有实力，但看军团部队的阵势，真让我有些心虚。

original: {Thoughtful Naivete}Maybe when this is all over, they'll find time to look after us.
translation: {Thoughtful Naivete}也许等这一切都结束，他们就有精力来管我们了。

original: {Fearful}It's time to pack and leave these lands until the dust settles.
translation: {Fearful}尘埃落定之前，最好收拾东西避一避。

original: {Hopeful}Our victory at Nelson's a worthy story to tell in my travels.
translation: {Hopeful}我们在纳尔逊取得了大捷，这下我在路上可有话聊了。

original: Hi there. I'm Old Lady Gibson, or so they tell me. I've got odds and ends for sale, and I'm pretty good at fixing things, too.
translation: 嗨。我是老太太吉布森，至少他们是这样称呼我的。我有些稀罕玩意可以卖，另外我对修修补补也很在行。

original: You might have noticed the very large building just north of here. That's HELIOS One. The NCR runs the place, so it's off-limits to prospectors.
translation: 你可能已经注意到了这里北方那座很大的建筑。那就是太阳神一号。NCR驻扎在那里，所以拾荒者都禁止入内。

original: So you're back. Now, where did we leave off?
translation: 你回来了。那么，我们上次说到哪儿了？

original: {Elite rangers have arrived}{Veteran}I keep an eye out for Rangers in black armor. I haven't killed one yet.
translation: {Elite rangers have arrived}{Veteran}我更在意那些穿黑色护甲的游骑兵。我还没有杀过呢。

original: {Nelson wiped out}{veteran}Had the Legionaries at Nelson been more {beat}seasoned, we'd still hold the settlement.
translation: {Nelson wiped out}{veteran}如果军团部署在纳尔逊的士兵能更老练些，我们也不至于丢掉那个据点。

original: {LATIN}{AH-way}Ave.
translation: {LATIN}{AH-way}致敬。

original: Move along.
translation: 走开。

original: {Companion Reaction - Arcade}{pretending surprise}Imagine, a Follower brave enough to leave Freeside.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Arcade}{pretending surprise}想不到啊，天启追随者居然还有人敢离开自由城。

original: {Companion Reaction - Rex}The dog is part-machine... but its brain is flesh.
translation: {Companion Reaction - Rex}这只狗一半是机器……但大脑还是狗的大脑。

original: {Companion Reaction - Raul}{disgusted by ghoul's appearance}What a revolting sight. {incredulous}To call that a friend?
translation: {Companion Reaction - Raul}{disgusted by ghoul's appearance}真恶心。{incredulous}你和那玩意做朋友？

original: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}That machine looks like a floating eye. I don't like it.
translation: {Companion Reaction - ED-E}那台机器好像一个会飞的眼睛。我不喜欢它。

original: {Companion Reaction - Lily}How does one get that blue monster to obey?
translation: {Companion Reaction - Lily}你是怎么让那个蓝色怪物听话的？

original: {Legion victory}{proud}All that {KAI-zar}Caesar promised has come true.
translation: {Legion victory}{proud}那么{KAI-zar}凯撒的诺言实现了。

original: {Legion victory}{Ah-WAY, Ah-ME-cus}Ave, amicus.
translation: {Legion victory}{Ah-WAY, Ah-ME-cus}致敬，顾问大人。

original: Look to Bitter Springs to see what happens to disloyal slaves.
translation: 不忠诚的奴隶是什么下场，看看苦泉就知道了。

original: {Player killed President Kimball}{Officer}I've heard the stories of how you assassinated Kimball. It's all my Legionaries will about.
translation: {Player killed President Kimball}{Officer}我听说了你刺杀金博尔的事。这正是我们军团的目标。

original: {Player killed President Kimball}Kimball's assassin is always welcome here.
translation: {Player killed President Kimball}刺杀金博尔的人在这里是永远受欢迎的。

original: {Silus freed}The {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion Silus will be punished for letting himself be captured. Coward.
translation: {Silus freed}The {Ken-TOO-ree-on}百夫长希鲁斯居然甘当俘虏，他会受到严惩的。懦夫。

original: {Battle for Hoover Dam soon to begin}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is come. The battle for the dam will soon begin!
translation: {Battle for Hoover Dam soon to begin}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯来了。大坝之战即将打响！

original: {Late game begins}{Officer}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius will arrive soon enough - and with him comes slaughter.
translation: {Late game begins}{Officer}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯马上就到了——杀戮即将开始。

original: {Late game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius draws near. The Profligates' days are numbered.
translation: {Late game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯即将抵达。荒淫之人的好日子到头了。

original: {Middle game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is known as the Monster of the East - a name he has earned many times over.
translation: {Middle game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯被称作东方野兽——他无愧于这一称号。

original: {Elite Rangers have arrived}{trying not to sound worried}The black-armored Rangers are said to be fearsome in battle.
translation: {Elite Rangers have arrived}{trying not to sound worried}据说黑甲游骑兵各个骁勇善战。

original: {Elite rangers on the way}{Officer}The Legionaries fret like women over rumors of Rangers in black armor.
translation: {Elite rangers on the way}{Officer}听了关于黑甲游骑兵的谣言后，军团士兵们都跟娘们似的慌了神。

original: {Elite rangers on the way}There have been sightings of Rangers in black armor, the best the Profligates have to offer.
translation: {Elite rangers on the way}有人看到了黑甲游骑兵，那是荒淫之人最能拿得出手的部队。

original: I wish I could hear the Profligates weeping over the explosion at McCarran!
translation: 真希望我能亲耳听到荒淫之人因为麦卡伦大爆炸发出的哭声。

original: The Mark of {KAI-zar}Caesar protects you.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒的徽记庇护你。

original: {Mr. House Unplugged/Killed}The warlord House thought himself beyond {KAI-zar's}Caesar's reach. And now he is dead.
translation: {Mr. House Unplugged/Killed}豪斯那个军阀以为{KAI-zar's}凯撒拿他没办法。可现在他死了。

original: {Caesar cured}{officer}Never once did I believe that {KAI-zar}was near death. I have friends in high places.
translation: {Caesar cured}{officer}我从来都不相信{KAI-zar}凯撒快死了。我在高层有朋友。

original: {Caesar dead}The Legion will survive {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death. It must!
translation: {Caesar dead}{KAI-zar's}军团绝不会因为凯撒的死而倒下，绝不会！

original: {Player destroyed Securitron Army}I felt the earth shake when the evil below the Fort was destroyed!
translation: {Player destroyed Securitron Army}地下城堡里的邪恶被摧毁的时候，简直地动山摇啊！

original: {Rumors of Legion Veterans}{Officer}Soon the Legion's veterans will arrive from Arizona. Each has killed many times his number.
translation: {Rumors of 军团 Veterans}{Officer}很快军团的精锐们就会从亚利桑那来到这里。他们每一个都锐不可当。

original: {Legion dogs killed}Our hounds were bred to kill. They are missed.
translation: {Legion dogs killed}我们的猎犬是用来杀戮的。它们要还在就好了。

original: {Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope both wiped out}It's said that every living thing at Nelson and Forlorn Hope camp was killed.
translation: {Nelson and Camp Forlorn Hope both wiped out}据说纳尔逊和飘零希望营地都被屠戮一空了。

original: {Camp Forlorn Hope wiped out}{cheerful}I hear the Profligates at Forlorn Hope begged for their lives.
translation: {Camp Forlorn Hope wiped out}{cheerful}我听说飘零希望营地的荒淫之人在求饶。

original: {Nelson wiped out}{officer}Had I been the commander of our forces at Nelson, the town would still be ours.
translation: {Nelson wiped out}{officer}如果指挥纳尔逊部队的人是我，那镇子现在肯定还在我们手上。

original: {Nelson wiped out}The Legionaries at Nelson were killed to a man. No survivors.
translation: {Nelson wiped out}纳尔逊的驻军被一个男人尽数剿灭。无一幸免。

original: {Great Khans signed treaty with NCR}So frightened are the Profligates that they've begun signing treaties with primitive tribes!
translation: {Great Khans signed treaty with NCR}荒淫之人已经被吓破了胆，他们甚至开始和原始部落签署合约了！

original: {Unknown}{Officer}Keep barking and I'll feed you to a dog.
translation: {Unknown}{Officer}再瞎叫我就拿你去喂狗。

original: {Unknown}Watch yourself, Profligate.
translation: {Unknown}给我小心点，荒淫之人。

original: {Unknown}Hold your tongue, wastrel.
translation: {Unknown}管好你的嘴，废物。

original: {Unknown}Degenerates like you belong on a cross.
translation: {Unknown}你这样的堕落者就该被钉在十字架上。

original: {Dislike}{contempt}Wretched Profligate. Try making some trouble.
translation: {Dislike}{contempt}卑鄙的荒淫之人。敢惹麻烦试试。

original: {Dislike}{contempt}You belong on a cross, degenerate.
translation: {Dislike}{contempt}你就该被钉在十字架上，堕落者。

original: {Dislike}I'd rather kill you than talk to you.
translation: {Dislike}杀了你比跟你废话好。

original: {Hated}When the time comes, I'll be the one to kill you.
translation: {Hated}等着吧，我会亲手杀了你。

original: {Hated}{looking for an excuse to attack}Give me cause, Profligate.
translation: {Hated}{looking for an excuse to attack}有本事就惹我试试，荒淫之人。

original: {Hated}Attack me. Give me license to kill you.
translation: {Hated}动手吧。这样我就有理由杀你了。

original: {Mixed}You aren't trusted here, Profligate.
translation: {Mixed}这里不相信你，荒淫之人。

original: {Mixed}{Scornfully}You serve yourself, not the Legion.
translation: {Mixed}{Scornfully}你只向自己效忠，而非军团。

original: {Mixed}Why is your degneracy tolerated?
translation: {Mixed}为什么你的堕落得到了容忍？

original: {Wild Child}{Officer}You can't be trusted... but you're useful.
translation: {Wild Child}{Officer}你不值得相信……但是你很有用。

original: {Wild Child}How are we to trust one such as you?
translation: {Wild Child}我们怎么可能相信你这样的人？

original: {Wild Child}{suspicious}Who knows what you'll do next?
translation: {Wild Child}{suspicious}谁知道你接下来会做什么？

original: {Wild Child}You're a crazed one. I'll not talk to you.
translation: {Wild Child}你太疯狂，我不会再和你说话了。

original: {Somewhat liked}{Most idiots try to defy the Legion}You do well to serve the Legion.
translation: {Somewhat liked}{Most idiots try to defy the 军团}你为军团效力得很好。

original: {Somewhat liked}{Most are forced to serve}You're wise to serve the Legion by choice.
translation: {Somewhat liked}{Most are forced to serve}为军团效力是明智的选择。

original: {Somewhat liked}You've proved yourself useful, at least.
translation: {Somewhat liked}至少，你证明了自己还有用。

original: {Liked}{Officer}You serve the Legion well, {ah-ME-cus}amicus.
translation: {Liked}{Officer}你为军团效力得很好，{ah-ME-cus}顾问大人。

original: {Liked}We each serve the Legion, in our way.
translation: {Liked}我们都在用各自的方式为军团效力。

original: {Liked}{LATIN}Good to see you, {ah-ME-cus}amicus.
translation: {Liked}{LATIN}很高兴见到你，顾问大人。

original: {Liked}{LATIN}{AH-way, ah-ME-cus}Ave, amicus.
translation: {Liked}{LATIN}{AH-way, ah-ME-cus}致敬，顾问大人。

original: {Unknown}{Veteran}I know your kind. You die easily enough.
translation: {Unknown}{Veteran}我了解你这种货色。杀你易如反掌。

original: {Legion Veterans arriving}Have you seen the Legion's veterans, arrived from Arizona? They are fearless!
translation: {Legion Veterans arriving}你看到从亚利桑那过来的军团精锐了吗？他们无所畏惧！

original: {Rumors of Legion Veterans}It's said the Legion's veterans will arrive from Arizona soon. They are a sight to behold.
translation: {Rumors of 军团 Veterans}据说军团精锐将会很快从亚利桑那赶来。他们可是非同小可。

original: {Middle game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is on the march. When he arrives, the real slaughter will begin.
translation: {Middle game begins}{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯正向这里开拔。等他来了，好戏就该开场了。

original: {Late game begins}{Veteran}I have fought beneath {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius many times. He cannot be defeated.
translation: {Late game begins}{Veteran}我曾多次在{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯麾下效劳。他真是战无不胜。

original: {Battle for Hoover Dam soon to begin}{Veteran}Finally, the dam will be assaulted. {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius is come.
translation: {Battle for Hoover Dam soon to begin}{Veteran}终于要进攻大坝了。{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯来了。

original: {Player killed President Kimball}{Veteran}{recognizing player}Kimball's assassin. Nicely done.
translation: {Player killed President Kimball}{Veteran}{recognizing player}刺杀金博尔，干得漂亮。

original: True to {KAI-zar}Caesar.
translation: 凯撒{KAI-zar}万岁。

original: I hope they don't close the quarry. I need the money.
translation: 希望他们别关闭采石场，我还得赚钱呢。

original: With Chomps in jail, who's going to run things at the quarry? He was our most experienced guy!
translation: 托姆斯进了班房，谁来负责采石场？没有比他更有经验的家伙了！

original: Maybe I was just seeing things, but I could've sworn I saw some people up on the ridge by the quarry.
translation: 可能我看错了，但我发誓刚看见采石场的山边有人。

original: I can't believe Chomps got arrested! They said he was involving in smuggling, if you can believe it.
translation: 不敢相信托姆斯居然被捕了！他们说他涉嫌走私，你能相信吗。

original: The Deathclaws have been keeping their distance. For now.
translation: 死亡爪还不敢靠近这里。至少目前如此。

original: When do you think the NCR will send their troops to help us?
translation: 你觉得NCR什么时候才会派兵来帮我们？

original: Jas screwed up the coffee again. Wouldn't drink it if I were you.
translation: 雅斯又把咖啡泡得老难喝。我要是你，坚决不喝。

original: It's too damn hot.
translation: 太他妈的热了。

original: {player fixed generator}Sure is nice to have the lights on again.
translation: {玩家 fixed generator}灯又亮了，太好了。

original: {Deathclaw Mother and Alpha dead}With the Deathclaw pack leaders dead, I hope we can get back to work soon.
translation: {死亡爪 Mother and Alpha dead}既然死亡爪的首领都死了，我希望能快点回去工作。

original: {player healed Snuffles}Snuffles' leg seems to have gotten better.
translation: {玩家 healed 鼻涕虫}鼻涕虫的腿看起来好多了。

original: Man, I wish I'd stayed back in California some days.
translation: 老兄，有时候我真觉得还不如留在加利福尼亚呢。

original: Generator's still not working. Big surprise.
translation: 重大喜讯：发电机还没修好。

original: Poor Snuffles. Wish somebody could do something about his leg.
translation: 可怜的鼻涕虫。但愿有人能帮他治好腿。

original: Is Benny taken care of yet?
translation: 本尼的事解决了吗？

original: You're back. Find anything?
translation: 你回来了。找到什么了？

original: You ready to deal with Benny yet?
translation: 你准备好要去和本尼算账了吗？

original: So that's it then. Benny's dead, and I'm the boss now. What can I do for you?
translation: 看来事情已经尘埃落定了。本尼死了，我成了老板。你有什么事吗？

original: I heard you were wandering around. Haven't gotten yourself arrested yet, huh?
translation: 我听说你还在四处闲逛。你怎么还没被抓起来？

original: This is just swell - Benny vamooses and I'm left holding the bag. Whaddya need, kid?
translation: 真是棒极了——本尼跑路，我留下来收拾烂摊子。你有啥事吗，小子？

original: Heya baby, good to see you. Always nice to have a celebrity drop by.
translation: 嘿，宝贝，见到你很高兴。有您这样的名人光临，小店真是倍感荣幸。

original: Got to admit, baby, I'm surprised to see you walking around like this. Figured you for persona non grata around here.
translation: 必须承认，宝贝，看见你在这儿出没，实在教我吃惊。毕竟你在这里不是什么受欢迎的人物。

original: Kid, you better have a good reason for waltzing back in here and not expecting us to fill you full of lead. So talk.
translation: 小子，你居然还敢回来，最好给我们个理由，否则赏你一梭子。快说。

original: Jesus. Benny's dead, and now I gotta take up the slack. This right here is the end of an era.
translation: 天啊。本尼死了，我得收拾残局了。真是一个时代的落幕啊。

original: {draw out "hello;" this whole line is flirty}Hello, baby! Welcome to the Tops! What can I do for you?
translation: {drawout"托普斯;"thiswholelineisflirty}你好,宝贝！欢迎光临九重天！需要我为您做什么？

original: Hey there, pal! Welcome to the Tops, and what can I do for you today?
translation: 嘿，哥们！欢迎光临九重天，今天想来点什么？

original: You did good, putting those Omerta finks in their place. I never did trust them.
translation: 你成功让那些黑手党叛徒伏法了，干得漂亮。我从来就没相信过他们。

original: So all of a sudden I'm hearing word that Mr. House ain't the boss of Vegas? Baby, that's just not square.
translation: 我突然听说，豪斯先生已经不是维加斯的老大了？宝贝，这可不妙啊。

original: Little birdies tell me you've been to visit the Lucky 38 - {mildly suspicious}not a lot of folks go in there these days.
translation: 我的小小鸟儿们说，你去了幸运38——{mildlysuspicious}那地方可没有几个人去过。

original: Hey, doll, how's my favorite girl? Got a kiss for me?
translation: 嘿，我心爱的小美女，最近过得还好吗？愿意赏我一个吻吗？

original: Couldn't stay away, huh baby? Shoulda known. What can I do for you?
translation: 舍不得走是吗，宝贝？我就知道。需要我做点什么？

original: Something else you need?
translation: 你还需要什么？

original: You did a super job wrapping things up! And I'm not just saying that because I have to!
translation: 你为一切划上了圆满的句号，真是太精彩了！我是打心眼里这么认为的！

original: I didn't want to make a big deal about this until after we won, but, {draw out}well...
translation: 有件事，我本是打算等咱们胜利以后才告诉你的，不过，呃……

original: I found some code snippets in one of Mr. House's databanks that will let me, um, reprogram my personality! To be a little more assertive, basically!
translation: 我在豪斯先生的数据库里找到了一节代码片段，它们可以，呃，重塑我的人格！简单来说就是，让我变得更加自信！

original: So that's what I'm going to be doing, and it's going to take me a while, so it'll seem like I'm off-line. But don't worry, everything will be okay!
translation: 我决定部署这段代码，这要花上一段时间，期间我会一直处于离线状态。不过别担心，一切都会没事的！

original: I've updated the Securitrons' targeting parameters, so they know what to do! Vegas will be protected!
translation: 我已经升级了电子保安的目标参数，它们知道该做什么！维加斯会得到保护的！

original: So that's where I'll be, off making a few changes, and I... I guess I'll see you around!
translation: 那么，先失陪了，我要去离线升级了，祝……祝我们后会有期！

original: {bye-bye}We accomplished a lot together! It was fun! Take care!
translation: {bye-bye}我们在一起创造那么多丰功伟绩！真是太有趣了！保重！

original: Hey! Hi there, good to meet you! What can I do for you today?
translation: 嘿！嗨，很高兴见到你！今天有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: {copy audio from Conversation VMQTopsYesManTransfer}Isn't this exciting? I know I'm excited!
translation: {copyaudiofromConversationVMQTopsYesManTransfer}这难道还不够让你兴奋吗？反正我很兴奋！

original: {copy audio from Conversation VMQTopsYesManTransfer}I have a good feeling about this! It's going to be great!
translation: {copyaudiofromConversationVMQTopsYesManTransfer}我感觉前途一片光明！我们肯定能干出一番大事！

original: {copy audio from Conversation VMQTopsYesManTransfer}I bet I'm going to like it in that mainframe!
translation: 我打赌那台主机里头一定会很有意思！

original: Hi! Nice to see you again!
translation: 嗨！很高兴再次见到你！

original: {singsong}Sooooo... we can blow up the dam's generators, {draw out}or I could rout the dam's entire power output to the Fort.
translation: {singsong}那么……我们可以炸掉水坝的发电机，{drawout}或者我也可以把水坝的电力全部改送去城堡。

original: That'll activate a certain army of Securitrons and set them loose to ravage the Legion! What do you say?
translation: 这样就能启动一支电子保安大军，用它们一举摧毁军团！你怎么说？

original: {greeting player in control room at Hoover Dam}This is neat! From this console I could've routed the dam's power input over to the Fort and activated that dormant army of Securitrons!
translation: 真是太漂亮了！我可以通过这个控制台把水坝的电力转移到城堡，并且激活休眠状态下的电子保安大军！

original: So go ahead and blow up the dam's generators! And when that's done, head back upside and finish off the Legion and NCR.
translation: 去把水坝的发电机炸上天吧！然后我们再回上面去解决军团和NCR。

original: Hi! This is big, huh? A very big moment!
translation: 嗨！不得了吧？这可是相当重要的时刻！

original: Here goes! I'll just take that Platinum Chip off your hands, thanks! Wish me luck!
translation: 来吧！你手上的白金筹码我就暂且收下了，多谢！请祝我好运吧！

original: Wow, Mr. House had quite a set-up here! I can access his databanks and view telemetry on every Securitron on the network!
translation: 哇哦，豪斯先生拥有的东西可真不少！我可以进入他的数据库，在局域网上查看每个电子保安的遥测资料！

original: You did a super job wrapping things up! And I'm not just saying that because I have to!
translation: 你为一切划上了圆满的句号，真是太精彩了！我是打心眼里这么认为的！

original: President Kimball survived his visit to Hoover Dam! Nice one! {hastening}Now, moving on...
translation: 金博尔总统毫发无伤地视察了胡佛水坝！干得好！{hastening}现在，下一步……

original: Don't you love seeing the Lucky 38 all lit up? Sign of things to come!
translation: 幸运38灯火通明的样子很壮观吧？这可是大事要发生的前兆啊！

original: Exciting news! The Legion's massing troops in a staging area east of the dam! Attack imminent! Monster of the East, ready to roll!
translation: 好消息！军团正在水坝东侧集结部队！马上就要发起进攻！东方野兽已经蓄势待发了！

original: {DUPLICATE?}Don't you love seeing the Lucky 38 all lit up? Sign of things to come!
translation: {DUPLICATE?}幸运38灯火通明的样子很壮观吧？这可是大事要发生的前兆啊！

original: Too bad about President Kimball and everything, but hey - stuff happens, right?
translation: 金博尔总统遇刺实在太让人遗憾了，可是，嘿——天有不测风云嘛？

original: {DUPLICATE?}Exciting news! The Legion's massing troops in a staging area east of the dam! Attack imminent! Monster of the East, ready to roll!
translation: {DUPLICATE?}好消息！军团正在水坝东侧集结部队！马上就要发起进攻！东方野兽已经蓄势待发了！

original: Are you ready to head for the dam? Caesar's Legion is due to attack at any moment!
translation: 你准备好前往水坝了吗？凯撒军团随时可能发动进攻！

original: Don't you just love that Platinum Chip? Buzzes with power and possibilities, doesn't it?
translation: 那白金筹码难道不让你着迷吗？它蕴含着无限的力量和可能，不是吗？

original: If I were you, I'd almost want to deliver the Chip to Mr. House just to learn all its tricks!
translation: 如果换做我，肯定会立马把筹码给豪斯送去，好一谈其中的奥秘！

original: That is, unless you want to bring the NCR or Caesar's Legion to power! I wouldn't want to tell you want to do!
translation: 但如果你是想把力量留给NCR或者凯撒军团的话，那就另当别论了！我是不会干涉你的决定的！

original: An entire {emph}army of upgraded Securitrons just standing by over at the Fort! Pretty neat, huh?
translation: 一整支{emph}升级完毕的电子保安大军正在城堡待命！不错吧，嗯？

original: {trying to convince yourself, verging on passive aggressive}I can't get over how brave you were to destroy all those Securitrons at the Fort, you know?
translation: 我实在不理解，你究竟哪来的勇气，居然把城堡里的电子保安全都给摧毁了？

original: It's just going to make everything so much more... {searching for positive word}challenging! Yeah, challenging!
translation: 这下事情可就变得更有……挑战性了！对，挑战性！

original: Here's some big news! I decoded a military radio transmission, and it turns out the NCR President, Aaron Kimball, is going to visit Hoover Dam!
translation: 重大消息！我破译了一个军方无线电讯，NCR总统艾伦·金博尔即将视察胡佛水坝！

original: I guess he wants to boost the troops' morale! But according to projections Mr. House made, he has an 83.75% chance of being assassinated! Oops!
translation: 我估计他是想来鼓舞一下士气！但根据豪斯先生的测算，他遇刺的几率高达83.75%！噢！

original: Anyway, it looks like Mr. House thought it was important to keep President Kimball alive...
translation: 总之，豪斯先生似乎认为，让金博尔总统活下来很重要……

original: Every Securitron on the network has been upgraded. Pretty neat, huh?
translation: 所有联网的电子保安都已经完成了升级。很漂亮吧？

original: So I've been looking over a bunch of data about the bunker at the Fort. You and me should really have a talk about this!
translation: 我最近一直在调阅堡垒山地堡的数据。我觉得我们应该好好谈谈这件事！

original: Wait... {to yourself}Oh, so {emph}that's what the Platinum Chip does! Interesting!
translation: 等一下……{toyourself}噢，原来白金筹码是这样用的！有意思！

original: Mr. House had a whole demonstration planned for you. Just head downstairs to the lowest level to check it out. You'll see!
translation: 豪斯先生早就为你准备好了全套说明。去最下层看看吧。去了你就知道了！

original: You'd better hurry to the dam if you're going to save President Kimball!
translation: 如果你想救金博尔总统，那最好赶紧出发去水坝！

original: This gadget I'm handing you is called an override module! Mr. House had two of these made years and years ago - just like him to think ahead!
translation: 我交给你的这个小玩意叫强制覆写模组！这东西一共有两个，都是豪斯先生在很久很久之前制作的——他可真是高瞻远瞩呀！

original: Take the module to the El Dorado Substation and attach it the power control terminal! I'll handle the rest!
translation: 把这个模组装到埃尔多拉多变电站的电力控制终端上！剩下的就交给我吧！

original: I'm talking direct tactical control of hundreds of upgraded Securitrons at vast distances! {we will so kick ass}You know that's gonna come in handy!
translation: 我将可以直接对分散在广大区域的上百台电子保安进行战术控制！{wewillsokickass}你也知道它们能派上大用场！

original: I'm talking direct tactical control of dozens of Securitrons at vast distances! That might come in handy!
translation: 我将可以直接对分散在广大区域的数十台电子保安进行战术控制！这可以派上大用场！

original: It's probably a good thing you blew up those hundreds of Securitrons over at the Fort! Controlling {emph}hundreds might've got confusing!
translation: 话说回来，你摧毁了城堡里的那堆电子保安，也算是做了一件好事了！同时控制几百个{emph}机器人！很容易乱套的！

original: Wow, you really blew up all those Securitrons at the Fort! {beat}{trying to convince yourself}Great! No problem!
translation: 哇哦，你真的把城堡里的电子保安全都炸上天了！{beat}{tryingtoconvinceyourself}厉害！没问题！

original: The Securitrons at the Fort are on standby... I see a status log here confirming that the Mark II OS upgrade installed correctly...
translation: 城堡的电子保安已经就位……我看到日志文件上说II型操作系统的升级程序已经安装完毕……

original: They'll be all set to go once we boost my transmitting power and bring them online with the network! But we'll worry about that later!
translation: 只要我们把电力输送过来，并联上网，它们就可以启动了！不过这个问题我们过后再考虑吧！

original: Oh, hi again! Can I help you with something else?
translation: 噢，嗨！你还有什么别的需要吗？

original: Here's a print-out with some additional information!
translation: 这里有一份附加了信息的复印件！

original: Here's another one of my print-outs! Read up!
translation: 这是我的另一份复印件！请过目！

original: As soon as you have the Platinum Chip and Mr. House is out of the way, things will be great. There'll be so much I can do for you!
translation: 只要你把白金筹码拿到手，再搞定豪斯先生，情况就会好转。我也可以帮你做很多事！

original: As soon as you have the Platinum Chip, things will be great. There'll be so much I can do for you!
translation: 只要你把白金筹码拿到手，情况就会好转，我也可以帮你做很多事！

original: As soon as Mr. House is out of the way, things will be great. There'll be so much I can help you accomplish!
translation: 只要你搞定了豪斯先生，情况就会好转，我也可以帮你做很多事！

original: {player killed you last time}I am so sorry about last time! Let me make it up to you!
translation: {playerkilledyoulasttime}上次我真的很抱歉！让我补偿你吧！

original: {player killed you last time}I keep disappointing you!
translation: {playerkilledyoulasttime}我又让你失望了！

original: {player killed you last time}Please, I swear I'll do better this time!
translation: {playerkilledyoulasttime}拜托了，我发誓我这次会做好！

original: {player killed you last time}I need you to like me! I feel empty inside!
translation: {playerkilledyoulasttime}我需要你喜欢我！我的内心很空虚！

original: {player killed you last time}I've learned my lesson, I promise!
translation: {playerkilledyoulasttime}我已经吸取教训了，我保证！

original: {player killed you last time}That was my fault! But I've changed!
translation: {playerkilledyoulasttime}都是我的错！但是我已经改了！

original: {greets player after Benny killed or fled, accompanied by a Victor or House Securitron whose face screen then blinks over to the default}You got friends in high places, kid! According to this heap of bolts here, Mr. House don't want you touched.
translation: {greets player after Benny killed or fled, accompanied by a Victor or House Securitron whose face screen then blinks over to the default}看来你上面有人啊，孩子！照这铁皮罐头的说法，豪斯先生不希望有人碰你。

original: In fact, I've been directed to cooperate with your {beat, quoting the robot}"investigation," so you have the run of the place. Go where you want.
translation: 其实我已经得到他的指示，要协助你进行{beat,quotingtherobot}"调查"，所以现在这地方你说了算。你想去哪都可以。

original: {player fled or fought way out after Benny killed/fled}Hey, kid - let's not have trouble this time, hey?
translation: {playerfledorfoughtwayoutafterBennykilled/fled}嘿，孩子——咱们这次就别再对着干了，成吗？

original: I did some nosing around after your last {raise eyebrows, all hell broke loose}visit. In Benny's suite, to be specific.
translation: 上次你走之后，我特意四处转了转。确切地说，是到本尼的套间里转了一圈。

original: What I saw, well, it's a bit out of my league. But it was enough to make me think you mighta been the party wronged.
translation: 我所见到的东西，好吧，有点超出我的表达能力。不过我算是明白了，你可能是被冤枉的。

original: Check Benny's suite. The angle he was playing, well, maybe you can figure it out.
translation: 你可以去本尼的套房里看看。他的小伎俩，嗯，也许你可以弄明白。

original: I've told the boys to leave you be. Don't abuse the hospitality.
translation: 我已经吩咐过手下，让他们不要打搅你。希望你不会辜负我们的好意。

original: A tribe called the Great Khans has joined us. They'd better be good fighters.
