translation: 一个叫做大汗帮的部落加入了我们。他们最好都是些优秀的战士。

original: They say a doctor killed Caesar. Why would Caesar need a doctor?
translation: 他们说是个医生杀死了凯撒。但凯撒要医生干什么？

original: I can't believe Caesar is dead. What will we do now?
translation: 不敢相信凯撒居然死了。我们现在怎么办？

original: Caesar has been seen walking among the troops. A good omen.
translation: 有人看到凯撒徒步检阅部队了。这是个好兆头。

original: One of our agents successfully assassinated the NCR president.
translation: 我们的特工成功暗杀了NCR的总统。

original: Hard to believe this place used to be a luxury resort, huh?
translation: 很难想象这里以前是个豪华度假区吧？

original: Haven't had any reports from Station Charlie in a while - hope everything's okay.
translation: 有一段时间没收到查理驻站的报告了——希望那边没出什么事。

original: Don't tell the troopers, but the grub up here is way better than the mess tent.
translation: 你可别跟士兵们说啊，这儿的伙食要比下面的大锅饭好多了。

original: We can monitor ranger activity all through the region with the systems here.
translation: 我们利用这里的系统就可以掌握本地区游骑兵的一举一动。

original: I just can't believe Chief Hanlon would do that.
translation: 我真不敢相信汉隆军士长会这样做。

original: Jesus, the Chief's dead. Who's going to take over now?
translation: 天呐，军士长死了。现在谁来接替他？

original: You should talk to Chief Hanlon if you have any questions. He's usually up on the balcony.
translation: 如果你有问题就去找汉隆军士长吧。他通常在二楼阳台上。

original: {Great Khan}Man, I'm sick of this place. Can't wait to get back to Red Rock.
translation: {Great Khan}老兄，我受够这里了。都等不及回红岩去了。

original: {Great Khan- slight awe at level of destruction}The NCR sure did a number on this place.
translation: {Great Khan- slight awe at level of destruction}NCR确实在这地方投入了不少人力。

original: {Great Khan}Hope the NCR doesn't send reinforcements from the Dam.
translation: {Great Khan}希望NCR不会再从水坝调援兵过来。

original: {Great Khan}Fuck Benny. We'll make him pay for stabbing us in the back.
translation: {Great Khan}该死的本尼。居然敢在背后捅刀子，我们要让他付出代价。

original: {Great Khan - in combat}There's more of them still out there.
translation: {Great 大汗 - in combat}外面还有更多。

original: {NCR Trooper}Beats going up against the Legion.
translation: 至少强过跟军团过招。

original: {NCR Trooper}Never gone up against Great Khans before.
translation: 我跟大汗帮交手就没吃过亏。

original: Man, this place is a mess.
translation: 老兄，这地方真是一团糟。

original: This rubble is slippery. Watch your step.
translation: 这石头很滑。注意脚下。

original: {NCR Trooper - in combat}We didn't get all of them. Talk later!
translation: {NCR 骑兵 - in combat}还有敌人。待会再说!

original: {Worker}It's about time they called us back.
translation: {Worker}也该把我们调回去了。

original: {Worker}Work's slow right now, but at least it's something.
translation: {Worker}虽然进度缓慢，不过至少还是有成效的。

original: {Worker}Train's not working yet.
translation: {Worker}火车目前还未运行。

original: {Worker}I'm happy the Big Horn is still around.
translation: {Worker}很高兴大角酒馆还在。

original: Some of the machinery's frozen up. Need someone to talk a look at it.
translation: 有机器不能用了。得找个人过去看看是什么情况。

original: Hello again. Remember to stop by one of these nights. Northwest, by the old train station.
translation: 你好啊。有空的话记得晚上过来看看。就在西北边，老火车站。

original: You looking to take the test again?
translation: 你还想再做测试一次么？

original: Hello, don't think I've seen your face before. Are you a citizen of the NCR?
translation: 你好，我好像没见过你吧。你是NCR的公民么？

original: Hello again. We spoke briefly before, but remind me, are you a citizen of the NCR?
translation: 你好啊。我们之前好像简短聊过，我给忘了，你是NCR的公民吗？

original: Hey there. We hope to see you by the train station one of these nights.
translation: 嘿，你好。如果你有空，可以等晚上到车站来见见我们。

original: Ah, you're back. Did you want to take that test again now?
translation: 啊，你回来了。还想再做一次测试吗？

original: You look like a person in need of a good meal. You wouldn't happen to be an NCR citizen, would you?
translation: 你看起来需要好好吃一顿。你不会是NCR的公民吧？

original: That meal's still available, but only to NCR citizens. You are an NCR citizen, aren't you?
translation: 粮食依然有现成的，但只发放给NCR公民。你是NCR公民，对吧？

original: I've held up my end. You tell the King that I'm willing to listen to him.
translation: 我已经信守了自己的承诺。你去告诉猫王，我愿意听他的。

original: This isn't really a good time. What did you want?
translation: 现在可不是聊天的好时候。你有什么事么？

original: Welcome. There's food and water here for any citizen of the NCR. Please, have some.
translation: 欢迎。我们准备了食物和水，任何NCR公民都可以享用。别客气，来一点吧。

original: Yes, was there something else you needed?
translation: 嗯，你还有别的需要吗？

original: Who the fuck are you?
translation: 你他妈是谁？

original: Shut up and keep going.
translation: 闭嘴，走你的路。

original: I don't know where the hell you're going but it's not the right way. Are you still in this?
translation: 我不知道你要去哪儿，但我肯定你走错路了。你听见了吗？

original: What do you want now?
translation: 你现在想要什么？

original: <Questions>
translation: <问题>

original: <Radiation Suit Location Found>
translation: <发现防辐射服储存点>

original: <Returned with Radiation Suits>
translation: <携防辐射服返回>

original: <Police Station Dialogue>
translation: <警察局对话>

original: <Fire Station Dialogue>
translation: <消防局对话>

original: Peace, traveler.
translation: 致敬，旅行者。

original: You again? What 'cha need, champ?
translation: 又是你？你有什么事，伙计？

original: Unless you wanna slap leather with me you'll put that gun down, friend.
translation: 你如果不想和我对着干，就把枪放下，朋友。

original: Anders showed up here not too long ago. I'm told you're the one who got him out of the vault.
translation: 安德斯前不久来过这里。他说是你把他从避难所里救出来的。

original: I can't tell you how relieved I am. Sending him on that mission was a mistake.
translation: 我这颗心可算是放下来了。当初就不该派他去执行那个任务的。

original: We're all impressed with the work you've done for us. I thought you might be able to make use of this.
translation: 你为我们做的事让我们非常感动。我想你可能用得上这玩意。

original: It's a key to a little hideaway south of here. We've used it as a place for Rangers to rest and resupply. I thought you might get good use out of it.
translation: 这是南边一个小藏身处的钥匙。游骑兵偶尔会在那里休息和补给。我想对你应该能派得上用场。

original: I know who you are. I'm a patient man, but you'd better have a damn good reason to be standing here right now. Spit it out.
translation: 我知道你是谁。虽然我很有耐心，但你最好还是赶快把来这地方的理由说清楚。快说。

original: Look who it is. I haven't had the privilege, but I'm told you've been an angel on our shoulder. What can we do for you at Camp McCarran?
translation: 看看是谁来了。能亲眼见到你真是三生有幸，大家都说你是我们的守护天使。不知您来麦卡伦营地有什么事？

original: Well. I'm glad we could finally meet. My sources tell me you've done some good work for us. What brings you to Camp McCarran?
translation: 很好，很高兴我们终于见面了。我的手下说你为我们立下了不少功劳。是什么风把你吹到麦卡伦营地来的？

original: I'm usually good with faces, but I don't think I've seen you here before. What brings you to Camp McCarran?
translation: 我通常记人都很准，但我不觉得咱们见过。是什么风把你吹到麦卡伦营地来的？

original: What happened?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Yes, what is it?
translation: 是吗？什么事？

original: What are you doing here? You don't have clearance.
translation: 你在这干什么？你还没获准进入。

original: Get the hell out of my sight.
translation: 给我滚出去。

original: Hey, what are you doing out here at this hour?
translation: 嘿，你在这种时候到这里来干什么？

original: Trouble sleeping again, huh? Well, do yourself a favor - try and get some rest.
translation: 又失眠了？好吧，多为自己想想，回去睡一觉吧。

original: Following up on your lead, huh? Good. I'll get out of your way before I blow your cover.
translation: 还在追查线索呢？很好。我现在就走，免得泄露了你的身份。

original: I hope you catch this guy.
translation: 希望你逮住这家伙。

original: Nice to meet you. I'm Curtis.
translation: 很高兴见到你。我是柯蒂斯。

original: Well?
translation: 嗯？

original: What is it?
translation: 这是什么？

original: Hey! Can't you see I'm busy here?
translation: 嘿！你看不见我这正忙吗？

original: Nah, I'm just kidding. This has to be the most worthless patrol duty on the whole base. They never attack this gate.
translation: 嘿嘿，我开个玩笑而已。在这儿巡逻完全没有意义。他们不会攻打这个门的。

original: They just put me back here because they don't think I can handle anything else.
translation: 他们把我派到这里，只是因为他们觉得我一无是处。

original: Man, am I bored.
translation: 老兄，我好无聊。

original: You want to buy Wind-Brahmin?
translation: 你想买神风双头牛？

original: Careful, sometimes they escape and I have to round them up again.
translation: 小心点，有时它们会逃跑，我还得花力气把它们再圈起来。

original: Why do you scare my cattle?
translation: 你为啥要惊吓我的牲口？

original: Don't scare the herd.
translation: 别吓着牲口。

original: Leave doggies alone.
translation: 离狗远点。

original: Why don't you wait in the other room while I chat with Silus here?
translation: 我跟希鲁斯谈事情的时候，你为什么就不能去旁边的房间等着呢？

original: What is it, soldier?
translation: 怎么了，士兵？

original: You stick out like a sore thumb around here. You sure you're in the right place?
translation: 你在这地方非常惹眼。你确定自己来对地方了？

original: You weren't supposed to kill him! Goddamn it. Not only did we not get any information, but now you've ended his suffering, too.
translation: 你怎么把他杀了！妈的。我们本来可以从他嘴里套点情报出来的，这下好了，你倒是帮他解脱了。

original: Shit, guess I can forget about a promotion this decade. Thanks a lot, asshole.
translation: 娘的，看来我这十年之内都别指望升官了。真是感谢你啊，蠢货。

original: Fuck. What am I going to tell the colonel?
translation: 操他妈。这下我怎么跟上校交代？

original: Haven't you done enough?
translation: 你够了没？

original: Poor guy. He's all tuckered out. Well, I guess we'll have to pick up where we left off tomorrow. Good work.
translation: 可怜的家伙，他完全崩溃了。我看还是明天再继续吧。干得好。

original: I'm sure he'll have had enough after a few days of this. Or if we're lucky, a few months.
translation: 我敢说未来几天他都会消停了。要是我们运气好，说不定是几个月。

original: I'll get someone in here to clean up the mess he made. You can head out for the day. Let's let him sleep.
translation: 我会叫人来收拾他的烂摊子，你可以走了，让他睡一觉吧。

original: That was fun to watch. I'd have you do it again, but I'd probably get in trouble.
translation: 真是太有意思了。我很想让你再来一次，但那样我怕是会惹麻烦。

original: This'll do the NCR a lot of good, so you should be proud.
translation: 他说的话会对NCR大有帮助，你应该感到骄傲才是。

original: Here's the standard fee, plus I threw in the price of a good show on the Strip. That's from me personally. You can beat up my prisoners anytime.
translation: 这是基本的报酬，另外我还加了一点奖金，因为你让我欣赏了一场长街上的经典好戏。你以后也可以随时替我痛揍囚犯。

original: You did well. I don't know how you did it without putting a scratch on him, and I'm a little disappointed personally, but it saved the NCR some face.
translation: 你干得不错。我是不知道你怎么能不动他一根毫毛就搞定的，虽说我个人多少有些失望吧，但多少也给NCR挽回了一些颜面。

original: And it could save us more than that when all is said and done. I'm gonna talk to some people when we're through here.
translation: 如果到时候情报派上了用场，那可就不只是挽回颜面了。等这事结束，我要去几个人谈话。

original: This is about double the standard fee we'd give a "consultant," but from what I saw, you're more of an artist. So think of this as your commission.
translation: 这差不多是基本报酬的两倍，一般这个价要"顾问"才拿得到，但在我看来，你简直就是艺术家。所以我觉得你值这个价钱。

original: Let's finish this up, then we can talk.
translation: 先把事做完，然后我们再谈。

original: You're back.
translation: 你回来了。

original: What an ugly little worm you are. What pile of excrement did the lieutenant pluck you from, worm?
translation: 你这恶心的小蛆虫。中尉是从哪坨屎里把你翻出来的，烂蛆？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: You don't have to do this.
translation: 你不需要这样做。

original: You hit like a bedridden old woman.
translation: 你这一下就和起不来床的老太太差不多。

original: We don't have anything to discuss, worm.
translation: 我们没什么好说的，烂蛆。

original: Enough! This is pointless. I'm dead to the Legion either way. I'll tell you what I know.
translation: 够了！这毫无意义。反正我对军团来说已经是个死人了，你想知道什么，全我都说。

original: But you should know that Caesar has always kept his own counsel. He never reveals anything that would make him vulnerable.
translation: 但你应该明白，凯撒总是私底下都留了一手。他从不暴露任何弱点。

original: My knowledge will not prevent the inevitable. This camp will be ash within months. Maybe weeks.
translation: 即使我招供，也无法改变必然的结局。这座营地在几个月之内就会化为灰烬。也可能是几周。

original: Have you got it?
translation: 你拿到了吗？

original: Hit me.
translation: 打我啊。

original: Get away from me.
translation: 离我远点。

original: I'll take it from here.
translation: 剩下的就交给我了。

original: Boyd's in there with a prisoner right now. Boy, is she pissed.
translation: 博伊德正在里面审讯俘虏。老天，她可真是气坏了。

original: {delighted}If it isn't the courier who's done everything he can to defy the will of mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar!
translation: {delighted}这不就是那个拼尽全力跟伟大的{KAI-zar}凯撒作对的邮差吗！

original: {delighted}If it isn't the courier who's done everything she can to defy the will of mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar!
translation: {delighted}这不就是那个拼尽全力跟伟大的{KAI-zar}凯撒作对的邮差吗！

original: The Legion holds Nelson, Profligate! This is where you'll die. {call to arms}Brothers, attack!
translation: 军团已经掌控了纳尔逊，荒淫之人！这里就是你的葬身之处。{call to arms}兄弟们，进攻！

original: Have you come to Nelson seeking your death, Profligate?
translation: 你是来纳尔逊找死的吗，荒淫之人？

original: Excuse me, but... are you the courier who caused all of that trouble in The Tops?
translation: 打扰了，你……你就是那个大闹九重天的邮差吗？

original: Hey, have you been able to bug Mr. House's network yet?
translation: 嘿，你把木马装进豪斯先生的系统了没有？

original: Any interest in helping us with Mr. House's data network? I'm still good for the medical supplies.
translation: 有兴趣帮我们入侵豪斯先生的数据网络吗？我手里还有医疗物资。

original: Have you reconsidered our offer to bug Mr. House's data network? It could be of enormous medical value to us and could alleviate a lot of suffering.
translation: 你愿意帮助我们入侵豪斯先生的网络吗？这也许能帮我们获取极具价值的医学信息，从而挽救更多饱受病痛折磨的人。

original: Oh, hi. Thanks again for helping us with that data. {a bit disappointed}I mean, the feed only lasted about thirty seconds and it's not that useful, but... {sighing}we tried.
translation: 哦，嗨。数据的事多谢你帮忙了。{abitdisappointed}虽说传输只持续了30秒，没什么太大的用处……{sighing}但至少我们尽力了。

original: Thanks again for helping with Mr. House's data network. Come see me at the Old Mormon Fort if you get a chance.
translation: 豪斯先生数据网的事，再次感谢你。有空就来旧摩门教要塞找我吧。

original: Drop dead.
translation: 去死吧。

original: What's up?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Heard some more people got attacked last night.
translation: 听说昨晚又有人受袭击了。

original: It doesn't matter if they restrict the water. We can get it elsewhere now.
translation: 他们就算限水也没有关系。我们可以从别的地方获取水源。

original: Heard some of the Locals were attacked recently. Serves 'em right!
translation: 听说有一些本地人受到了攻击。真是活该！

original: Some friends of mine were attacked the other night. Someone should do something.
translation: 我有朋友在夜间遇到袭击。该有人站出来维护秩序了。

original: One of these days I'll say up enough to get out of here. One of these days...
translation: 总有一天等我攒够了钱，就要离开这里。总有一天……

original: A guy I know said there's some kind of cannibal army camped out to the east.
translation: 我认识的一个人说有一支食人者部队在东边出现。

original: Watch yourself if you go into one of them casinos, or you'll be stuck here like the rest of us in no time.
translation: 进赌场的时候可千万要长点心眼，不然你很快也会像我们一样被困在这个鬼地方。

original: The NCR should just take this place over. Their army's big enough.
translation: NCR真该直接占领这片地区。他们的部队足够大了。

original: The Kings say they're keeping the peace, but this place is as violent as ever.
translation: 猫王帮说他们会维护和平，但是这里一直暴力不断。

original: Did you go over by the train station last night? Bless those people.
translation: 你昨晚去火车站了吗？老天保佑那些人。

original: It's almost time to head down to the train station. It's all I look forward to anymore.
translation: 差不多该是时候去火车站了。我可就指着这个活了。

original: Hey stranger, if you're hungry, there's a man around here somewhere telling people where to get free food and water.
translation: 嗨，陌生人，如果你饿了，这附近有个人可以告诉你从哪里有免费的食物和水。

original: You going over to the station tonight, too?
translation: 你今晚也要去火车站吗？

original: Need some grub? I got you covered. Cheap and filling.
translation: 需要食物吗？我这里有你想要的。既便宜又能填饱肚子。

original: Hey buddy, spare a cap? I can make it worth your while.
translation: 嗨，伙计，能给我一个瓶盖吗？你肯定不会后悔的。

original: This man's prices are steep, but I hear he's worth it.
translation: 这人开出的价格是高了些，但我听说物超所值。

original: Thanks, mister!
translation: 谢谢，先生！

original: Thanks, lady!
translation: 谢谢，女士！

original: I wish he'd quit running.
translation: 我希望他别再跑了。

original: He's kinda cute, isn't he?
translation: 他蛮可爱的，对吧？

original: We're gonna have rat tonight!
translation: 我们今晚有老鼠肉吃！

original: Hey pal, spare a cap?
translation: 嗨，老兄，给个瓶盖吧？

original: Ah, my favorite customer. Got a cap for me?
translation: 啊，我的老主顾又来了。又给我带瓶盖来了？

original: You could do worse than leave your life in my hands, wanderer. Far worse.
translation: 要么把命交给我来保护，要么就等着曝尸街头，你自己选吧，流浪者。

original: A hundred caps sees you safely through Freeside. What do you say?
translation: 一百个瓶盖就能保你在自由城平安。你觉得怎么样？

original: You're in luck stranger. You just happen to be talking to the most successful bodyguard in all of Freeside.
translation: 陌生人，你很幸运。站在你面前的恰好是自由城最厉害的保镖。

original: And I just happen to be available at the moment. One hundred caps gets you a peaceful, pleasant trip through our fair district. Guaranteed.
translation: 而我现在也恰好在找主顾。只要100个瓶盖，我就能保你在我们的街区畅行无阻。我保证。

original: Hello, my friend! Can I perhaps interest you in some protection? My services come cheap at only a hundred caps.
translation: 你好，我的朋友！需要我保护你吗？今日特惠，我的服务只要一百瓶盖。

original: Look, I'm being paid to shoot people who talk to you, not talk to you myself. Just pretend I'm not here or something.
translation: 听着，我收钱是为了教训那些想和你搭话的家伙，我自己是不会和你说话的。你就当我是空气好了。

original: Freeside truly is an interesting place, isn't it?
translation: 自由城真是个有趣的地方，不是吗？

original: I am sorry, my friend, but I must concentrate on watching out for threats. Please do not take offense.
translation: 对不起，我的朋友，我必须集中精力提防潜在的威胁。请不要见怪。

original: Something you need, kid?
translation: 需要什么吗，孩子？

original: Heh, so the Garrets sent you to track me down? What a joke.
translation: 呵，是加勒特家族派你来跟踪我的？真是可笑。

original: Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler. What can I get you?
translation: 欢迎光临原子牛仔。需要点什么？

original: Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler.
translation: 欢迎光临原子牛仔。

original: Hey man, can you spare a few caps?
translation: 嗨，伙计，能给我几个瓶盖吗？

original: How are you today? Santiago is fabulous!
translation: 你今天好吗？圣地亚哥过得很好！

original: Ah... I wasn't expecting you to return.
translation: 啊……我没想到你会回来。

original: Santiago has nothing left to give. Leave me now.
translation: 圣地亚哥没东西能给你。快走开。

original: Santiago thanks you for getting him this job.
translation: 圣地亚哥感谢你帮他找到了这份工作。

original: Hello. Lovely to meet you.
translation: 你好。很高兴见到你。

original: I have nothing more to give. Leave me be.
translation: 我没东西能给你了。快走开。

original: Are you here to drop off medical supplies? Leave them with the rest in the middle of the courtyard.
translation: 你是来捐赠医疗物资的吗？把它们放在院子的中央吧。

original: Looking for a fix, man? I got what you need.
translation: 在找好东西吗，老兄？你想要的我都有。

original: You seen Dixon around? He said he'd be back today.
translation: 你见到迪克森没有？他说今天就回来的。

original: Come on, man. I'm dying here.
translation: 快点啊，老兄。我快死了。

original: Do you have chems, buddy? I could really use a fix.
translation: 有货吗，兄弟？我真想来点过过瘾。

original: So you're back. Got any chems for me yet?
translation: 你回来了。帮我找到什么药没有？

original: Howdy.
translation: 你好。

original: Not bad. You're lucky I was drawing their fire, otherwise you would have been chewed up.
translation: 不错。幸好我吸引了他们的火力，否则你都死好几回了。

original: I sent one of my guys back to the King to report what happened. You should head back. He'll probably want to thank you.
translation: 我已经派人向猫王报告情况了。你应该马上回去，他说不定要感谢你呢。

original: The King just sent a messenger over, saying these guys are off-limits. He's probably already heard about what you did here.
translation: 猫王刚捎来口信，不许我们再和这些家伙有任何瓜葛。估计他已经听说你在这里的所作所为了。

original: Looks like you get to be a hero. Enjoy it while it lasts.
translation: 看来你成了一名英雄。尽情享受这点威风吧。

original: Why the hell are you here? I got this under control!
translation: 你他妈怎么还在这里？我已经控制住局面了！

original: Why are you talking to me? Smoke these guys already!
translation: 你还和我说什么话？快干掉这些家伙！

original: Good, you're here. These soldier boys don't kid around. They must have had a lookout posted and spotted us coming.
translation: 你来了，很好。这些大兵不是开玩笑的。他们肯定早就埋伏好了，就等我们自己送上门。

original: They took out two of my guys right away, and now the rest are too scared to move in. That leaves you.
translation: 我们一下就被干掉了两个人，剩下的人全成了缩头乌龟。现在只能靠你了。

original: What do we have here? Another petitioner for the King?
translation: 瞧瞧是谁来了，你也是来求见猫王的吗？

original: Look who's back. If you want to see the King, you better pay up.
translation: 瞧瞧是谁回来了。如果你想见猫王，那最好先把钱付了。

original: Go on. The King's a busy man. Be grateful for this opportunity.
translation: 进去吧。猫王很忙，你可要好好珍惜这次见面的机会。

original: I've got my eye on you. You cross the Kings, you'll regret it.
translation: 我盯着你呢。敢惹猫王帮，有你后悔的。

original: Look, Rexie, someone new's come to see us. {Sighs}Poor boy. He hasn't been feeling well lately. I'm the King. What can I do for you?
translation: 瞧啊，雷克斯，咱们有客人了。{Sighs}可怜的孩子，他最近一直不舒服。我就是猫王。你有何贵干？

original: That's strange, I don't see ol' Rexie with you. He usually comes back here whenever he's not with you. Where'd he get to?
translation: 真是奇怪，老雷克斯没和你在一起。平常他只要没跟着你，就会回到这儿来。他去哪儿了？

original: Why Rexie, you look all better, boy! Good as new! {talks in dog-owner-schmoopy voice}Did my Rexie get a new brain?
translation: 雷克斯，你看上去精神多了，好孩子！像重生了一样！{talksindog-owner-schmoopyvoice}我的雷克斯换了新脑子没有？

original: I sure appreciate you coming back. You think a little more about my offer?
translation: 我很高兴你能回来。考虑过我的提议了吗？

original: I... I can't believe Pace is gone... He was always right here, you know? Always cracking me up with some story or another.
translation: 我……我无法相信佩瑟就这么走了……他总是伴我左右，你懂吗？总是拿一个又一个的故事逗我开心。

original: Anyway, what did you want?
translation: 算了，你有什么事？

original: I heard someone got to my friends who were injured. Looks like we'll never find out who did it now.
translation: 我听说有人害死了我那些受伤的朋友。看来现在要找出凶手已经很难了。

original: Did you want something? I'm all kinda shook up right now.
translation: 你有什么事吗？这件事让我难以释怀。

original: My eyes on the street tell me you haven't paid our mutual friend Orris a visit yet. Until you do, we got nothing to talk about.
translation: 我的眼线告诉我，你还没去拜访我们的朋友欧里斯。事情办妥以前我们没什么好说的。

original: What do you have for me?
translation: 有什么消息吗？

original: Have you found anything out? Or were you just here to chat?
translation: 你查到了什么吗？还是来闲聊的？

original: You find out somethin' about them soldier boys yet?
translation: 你查到那些大兵的事了吗？

original: I've already heard all about what happened, and all I can say is that I, and all of Freeside, thank you. Thank you very much.
translation: 整件事我都听说了。我只能说，我和自由城的所有人都十分感谢你。感激不尽。

original: I heard all about what happened. Maybe it's time for a little more talkin' and a little less fightin'.
translation: 整件事我都听说了。看来以后应该要多动嘴，少动手了。

original: Things have been lots better since you helped with with those soldier boys. Thanks again. So what can I do for you?
translation: 你摆平了那些阿兵哥以后，情况改观了不少。再次感谢你。所以，有什么我能帮忙的？

original: What can the King do for you?
translation: 有什么猫王能帮你的？

original: Leave me alone. Can't you see a man's fighting for his life here?
translation: 别烦我。你看不见有人正为生存而战吗？

original: What is it? Can't you see I want to be left alone with my friend here?
translation: 什么事？你看不出我想和朋友独处一会吗？

original: Tell the King we thank him for looking out for us.
translation: 请转告猫王，感谢他的关照。

original: I ain't got any reason to talk to you. Scram.
translation: 我和你没话说。滚开。

original: That true? Did the King really send you?
translation: 真的？真的是猫王派你来的？

original: Hope what I remembered helps.
translation: 希望我的回忆能帮上忙。

original: Hey, you helped out Bill Ronte so the Followers worked out a deal for you to drink free.
translation: 嘿，你帮了比尔·朗特一个大忙，所以天启追随者同意让你免费喝水。

original: The King controls the water pump. If you want water, you need to pay like everyone else.
translation: 这水泵是猫王帮的。你想喝水，就得和大家一样付钱。

original: Guess we won't be doing this for much longer.
translation: 看来我们不必再这样做了。

original: The Major gave us all a talking-to. Guess she heard about some of the guys' "night missions."
translation: 少校把我们都训了一顿。可能她听说了我们有些人在"夜间出任务"的事。

original: I've never seen the Major so angry before. She may look calm right now, but don't let her fool you.
translation: 我从没见过少校这么生气。虽然她看起来好像没事人一样，但你可别被她给骗了。

original: Hold up. What's the password?
translation: 站住。口令。

original: Let's try to keep the line moving, folks.
translation: 保持队形移动，伙计们。

original: Try to take only what you need.
translation: 尽量按需取用。

original: Submit to a credit check or present your passport before proceeding to the gate. Trespassers will be shot.
translation: 请缴纳保证金，或出示通行证，非法闯入者将被击毙。

original: Don't bother me right now. I've got to get back to see if any customers are waiting.
translation: 别烦我。我得回去看看有没有客人在等我。

original: Stay away from me, if you know what's good for you.
translation: 如果你识相，就离我远点。

original: Come on, let's get this over with.
translation: 来吧，我们做个了断。

original: Don't distract me. I need to focus all my senses on keeping you safe.
translation: 别分散我的注意力。我要集中精力才能保护你的安全。

original: This gentleman and I were just settling on a price. I'm afraid you'll have to hire one of the others this time around.
translation: 我刚和这位先生谈好了价钱。恐怕你只能另请高明了。

original: If you need to cross Freeside, no one will keep you safer than I will.
translation: 如果你需要穿过自由城，没人比我更能保你周全。

original: I knew you'd be back. Ready to hire the best?
translation: 我就知道你会回来的，打算雇个最好的保镖了？

original: Fully Integrated Security Technetronic Officer active and reporting for duty.
translation: 全功能整合电子安保员已激活，向您报到。

original: Operation complete. Thank you for your business.
translation: 操作完成。感谢您的配合。

original: Greetings. Fisto is programmed to please.
translation: 幸会。阿拳竭诚为您服务。

original: I am programmed for your pleasure. Please assume the position.
translation: 我的职责是竭诚为您服务。请选择体位。

original: Welcome to Mick & Ralph's. If you need guns, I'm your man.
translation: 欢迎光临米克与拉尔夫的杂货店。如果你需要买枪，那你算找对人了。

original: For general supplies and other services, see my partner Ralph.
translation: 如果需要补给或其他东西，可以去找我的搭档拉尔夫。

original: {Blunt advice}You might want to clean up your act. Some of the locals have been complaining.
translation: {Bluntadvice}你还是先改正一下自己de行为吧。有些本地人已经在抱怨你了。

original: Ralph and I don't sell to people who treat our friends badly.
translation: 拉尔夫和我都不跟亏待我们朋友的人打交道。

original: {Blunt}I don't take kindly to deadbeats who treat my friends like trash. Get {outta}out of here.
translation: {Blunt}敢欺负我朋友，我是不会给好脸色的。{outta}滚蛋。

original: {saddened sigh}I wish I'd never gotten involved with the Omertas. All of this bloodshed...
translation: {saddenedsigh}我真希望自己从没和黑手党帮扯上关系。瞧瞧死了这么多人……

original: {vindictive}One of these days, those bastards will get what's coming to them. {calm realization}In the meantime, I'll be sure to be more careful with my sales.
translation: {vindictive}总有一天那些混蛋会遭报应的。{calmrealization}不过从今往后，我也得更小心地选择生意对象了。

original: {back to business}Anyway, is there anything I can get you?
translation: {backtobusiness}好了，你要买什么？

original: {Matter of fact}That was a real mess the Omertas were looking to create. {grateful, long glaaad}Glad you could get all that sorted.
translation: {Matteroffact}黑手党的人就是来搞破坏的。{grateful,longglaaad}还好你把他们都摆平了。

original: {financially strained, but relieved}May have cost me some business, but at least we avoided a shitstorm.
translation: 虽然我可能会少挣一点，但至少我们逃过了一劫。

original: {back to business}Anything I can get {ya}you?
translation: {backtobusiness}要来点什么{ya}？

original: {Gruff}All of the scumbags are coming out of the woodwork now that the Kings are keeping everyone in line.
translation: {Gruff}自从猫王帮开始维持秩序，各种三教九流的家伙都冒出来了。

original: {resigned sigh}At least gun sales are better than ever. {back to business}Now what can I get you{getcha}?
translation: {resignedsigh}好在枪比以前好卖多了。{backtobusiness}你想来点什么{getcha}？

original: {Ambivalent sigh}I'm not sure how to feel about the Kings and NCR sorting out their differences, but as long as business keeps up, I'm a happy man.
translation: {Ambivalentsigh}猫王帮和NCR化干戈为玉帛了，我不知该作何感想，但只要生意好做，我也无所谓。

original: {back to business}Now what can I {getcha}get you?
translation: {backtobusiness}你想来点什么{getcha}？

original: {Amused}People say Mr. House hasn't been heard from in a while. Good riddance.
translation: {Amused}大家都在说有段时间没听到豪斯先生的音讯了。这家伙终于滚蛋了。

original: {Back to business as usual}Now what can I do for {yuh}you?
translation: {Backtobusinessasusual}你想买点什么{yuh}？

original: I heard about some things you've done around town. Nice to know someone is helping out for a change.
translation: 我听说了你在镇上的事迹。还有人愿意无私奉献，真好。

original: {happy to see player}Welcome back, buddy! What can I {getcha}get you?
translation: {happytoseeplayer}欢迎回来，哥们！你想要点什么{getcha}？

original: Welcome back.
translation: 欢迎回来。

original: I don't deal with dirtbags. Take a walk.
translation: 我可不和人渣做生意。快走开。

original: If you're looking for guns, talk to Mick. Otherwise, I've got a nice selection of general supplies and other services.
translation: 如果你要买枪，去找米克谈。如果不是，我这里还有不少精选的货物与其他服务。

original: Hey, thanks for getting Bill Ronte fixed up. I was really getting sick of paying for water.
translation: 嘿，谢谢你治好了比尔·朗特的酒瘾。我实在受不了喝点水还要花钱。

original: Now, what can I do for {ya}you?
translation: 那么，想买点儿什么{ya}？

original: {Giddy}Man, Jacob's Absinthe is phenomenal stuff. I don't think I've slept this well in ages...{trails off}
translation: {Giddy}老兄，雅各布的苦艾酒真是不一般。我已经有好几百年没睡过那么香了……{trailsoff}

original: {back to business}If you haven't tried it yet, he's been supplying the Wrangler with the stuff. So, what can I get {ya}you?
translation: {backtobusiness}如果你还没尝过，那在原子牛仔就有卖的。好了，你想买点什么{ya}？

original: {chuckles to self}With the Kings gone, it may be a little hairier around here, but business is good.
translation: {chucklestoself}自打猫王帮完蛋，这地方是越来越不太平了，但生意还不错。

original: Anything in particular you're looking for?
translation: 你想买什么东西？

original: {Sarcastic}So, Ambassador Fancypants has graced us with his presence! {sarcastic}I apologize if you're looking for Pre-War pipes and smoking jackets, I'm clean out.
translation: {Sarcastic}瞧瞧，咱们光彩照人的花裤子大使驾到了！{sarcastic}如果你想买战前烟斗或者浴袍，那不好意思，都卖完了。

original: Playing debt collector for the Garrets, eh? I guess someone has to do their dirty work.
translation: 在帮加勒特家族讨债啊？我就知道会有人愿意帮他们干脏活的。

original: {Pimpin'}Pimping ain't easy, eh? Maybe if you find some decent talent, I'll start visiting the Wrangler more often.
translation: {Pimpin'}皮条不好拉吧？要是你能找几个漂亮妞镇场子，我会多去光顾几次原子牛仔的。

original: {happy to see player}How's it going, friend? Looking for anything special?
translation: {happytoseeplayer}最近过得怎样，朋友？想买点什么？

original: {Sarcastic, aaaand}And NCR wins? No, really, I'm shocked.
translation: {Sarcastic,aaaand}NCR赢了？不可能吧，真让我大吃一惊。

original: {sarcastic}I totally didn't expect the guys with advanced armor and seemingly unlimited ammunition to take down an army of machete-wielding ingrates.
translation: {sarcastic}说真的，我从没指望过这群穿着高档装甲、用着几乎无限的子弹的家伙，能搞定那支用大砍刀武装起来的军队。

original: {Wary}With Caesar's Legion in control of the dam, I think things are going to get much more difficult around here.
translation: {Wary}凯撒军团控制了大坝，我看呐，以后的日子更难过喽。

original: {Elated}That old coot, House, is going to make me rich! With all the new rules and regulations in New Vegas, I'll make a killing circumventing them!
translation: {Elated}豪斯那个老蠢货会让我发大财的！既然新维加斯有了新规矩，我何不设个套狠狠宰他们一笔呢！

original: {Pleased}An independent Vegas... Never thought I'd see it.
translation: {Pleased}独立的维加斯……真没想到我亲眼见到这一天。

original: House may be gone, but the players remain the same. Business as usual, then.
translation: 豪斯虽然不在了，但客人却一个也没少。生意照旧。

original: Hey, what can I get you?
translation: 嘿，来点什么？

original: {creepy vagrant laugh}Heh heh heh heh heh. <Coughs>
translation: {creepyvagrantlaugh}呵呵呵呵呵。<咳嗽>

original: {nearly passed out}Wha-?
translation: {nearlypassedout}什——？

original: Bang bang bang bang bang!
translation: 砰、砰、砰、砰、砰！

original: Reach for the sky, lady.
translation: 上天去吧，女士。

original: Reach for the sky, mister.
translation: 上天去吧，先生。

original: I wish I had a gun.
translation: 真希望我有枪。

original: Max can't even hit me. He's so dumb.
translation: 马可世根本打不中我。他太蠢了。

original: I'm bored.
translation: 我很无聊。

original: Hey pal, you dig my new hat? I've been making some good money lately, and figured I'd treat myself.
translation: 嘿，哥们，看到我的新帽子没？最近赚了不少钱，我觉得应该对自己好点。

original: Hey, I thought about what you said before, and picked up this sweet piece. You were right, I feel much safer.
translation: 嘿，我仔细想了想你说的话，从中提取了一些精华。你说的很有道理，我现在感觉安全多了。

original: Hey, I'm sorry about being so dismissive about your suggestion before. I thought a lot about what you said.
translation: 嘿，很抱歉之前拒绝了你的建议。在你说过那些话之后，我想了很多。

original: There've been times when just a little bit of money from a stranger would have made a huge difference to me, so I get where you're coming from.
translation: 有时候陌生人的几个小钱，确实能给我带来极大的变化，所以我理解你的意思。

original: Maybe I could make that kind of difference for someone else... ah, who am I kidding?
translation: 也许我也能让别人体会到这种改变化……啊，我开什么玩笑呢？

original: Hey, I've been thinking a lot about what you said earlier, about saving up and leaving this dump. Do you really think it's possible?
translation: 嘿，我一直在想你之前说的话，就是攒钱离开这个鬼地方。你真觉得这能行吗？

original: Look pal, I've been thinking. I know we got off to a bad start there, but let's put it behind us, okay?
translation: 听着，朋友，我一直在想。我知道我们初次见面时闹了点别扭，但这一页就翻过去吧，行吗？

original: Hey pal, I made so much recently that I was able to afford this little number too. How do I look?
translation: 嘿，朋友，我最近发了大财，几个小钱已经不在话下了。我这一身行头如何？

original: You again. You want a tip, or you here to piss me off some more?
translation: 又是你。你到底是想打听情报，还是想来耻笑我的？

original: Hey pal, you got the caps, I got the info. You do have the caps, right?
translation: 嘿，朋友，只要你有钱，我就有情报。你应该带着钱吧？

original: Ah, my favorite customer returns. Want a tip?
translation: 啊哈，我的老主顾回来了。想打听点什么？

original: {Mugging sequence}Well, look who it is. I was just thinking about you.
translation: {Muggingsequence}瞧啊，这是谁来了。我刚刚还在想你来着。

original: I recently came across a piece of info that you just have to hear, and since you're my best customer, it's on the house. Interested?
translation: 我手上恰好有一条情报，你一定得听听，鉴于你是我的忠实客户，这次就不算钱了。有兴趣吗？

original: {Mugging, after you turned him down the first time}Hey, I've still got that super-hot tip for you, and it's still free. What do you say?
translation: {Mugging,afteryouturnedhimdownthefirsttime}嘿，那条猛料我还给你留着呢，而且依然免费。怎么样？

original: {Leaving}Hey pal, I've finally saved up enough caps to leave this dump, so no tips today. Or ever, I guess, ha ha.
translation: {Leaving}嘿，朋友，我终于攒够了钱，可以离开这鬼地方了，所以今天就不爆料了。估计以后也不会再有了，哈哈。

original: A lot of these caps came from you, so I wanted to say thanks before I shove off. Meeting you really changed my life.
translation: 这些钱大部分都是你给的，在动身之前，我想向你道个谢。你确实改变了我的生活。

original: {Actual mugging}Okay, pal, we're going to do this quick and easy. I know you're loaded down with caps, judging by how much you've already given me.
translation: {Actualmugging}好吧，伙计，咱们就简单一点吧。我知道你腰缠万贯，毕竟你都给了我那么多钱了。

original: So I thought I'd save us both some time and just take all the caps you have. Hand them over.
translation: 所以我想，干脆咱俩就省省事，你就直接把钱都送给我得了。快交出来。

original: {Him working for the Followers}Oh hey, didn't think I'd see you here. I decided to stop scrounging for caps and start making a difference.
translation: {HimworkingfortheFollowers}噢，嘿，没想到会在这见到你。我决定要洗心革面，不再乞讨。

original: The Followers have been really great. There's always something that needs to be done, and everyone here treats me really well.
translation: 天启追随者还不错。总有活儿可以干，而且大家都对我挺好的。

original: Sorry if you stopped by my old spot looking for info. I've been so busy lately that I haven't heard anything.
translation: 如果你还去过老地方打听情报，那我要说声抱歉了。我最近一直很忙，无暇他顾。

original: Anyway, feel free to stay as long as you like. I've got to get back to work.
translation: 总之，这儿就请您自便了。我要回去干活了。

original: {Said with an accusing tone, emphasis on the "you"}What do you want?
translation: {Saidwithanaccusingtone,emphasisonthe"you"}你想干什么？

original: Welcome to Freeside. Try not to get killed.
translation: 欢迎来到自由城。小心别死了。

original: Kick back and relax! Everything is allowed in Freeside!
translation: 尽情放纵，尽情狂欢吧！自由城百无禁忌！

original: The only rule in Freeside is don't mess with the Kings.
translation: 自由城唯一的规矩就是：不要招惹猫王帮。

original: Watch yourself around here.
translation: 自己小心一点。

original: If you're heading to the Strip, just go through the gate there.
translation: 如果你要去长街，可以从那边的大门进去。

original: Freeside is the Kings' turf. Remember that.
translation: 自由城是猫王帮的地盘。记好了。

original: Great, another one come in from the wastes. Like this place isn't crowded enough.
translation: 真棒，又来了一个废土游民。好像这地方还不够挤似的。

original: Move along.
translation: 走开。

original: Good evening! Are you looking for companionship, love?
translation: 晚上好！你是在找伴儿吗，亲爱的？

original: You look new to Freeside, so here's a little advice, friend. Don't go past the south gate greeter without talking to it first.
translation: 你是第一次来自由城吧，给你个小小的建议，朋友。如果你要从南门的迎宾机器人身边经过，一定要先和它们打声招呼。

original: Hello again.
translation: 又见面了。

original: Ah, you return to me a King yourself! It would be an honor for me to do your hair! That is why you are here, yes?
translation: 啊，你也成为猫王帮的一分子了！为你理发是我的荣幸！你应该是来理发的吧？

original: Ah, I knew you'd be back. Ready for your entire life to change?
translation: 啊，我就知道你会回来的。准备好让你的人生改头换面了吗？

original: You want your hair done, too? No, no, no. The Kings are many, and their hair must be *perfect*.
translation: 你也想要做头发吗？不，不，不。猫王帮虽然人多，但每个人的发型都必须*完美*。

original: When is the King coming back up here? I'm bored!
translation: 猫王什么时候回来？我都等烦了！

original: The King is all that his name implies, and then some.
translation: 猫王人如其名，甚至更加伟岸。

original: The King promised to take us out tonight. I simply adore going to the Tops!
translation: 猫王答应今晚带我们出去。我只想去九重天！

original: All I do all day is read magazines. You'd be amazed what you can learn from them!
translation: 我整天都在看杂志。你绝对想不到能从杂志上学到什么东西！

original: I want to go to the Strip! We never get to go to Gomorrah anymore!
translation: 我想去长街！我们不要再去蛾摩拉了！

original: You're not a King! Does the King know you're up here?
translation: 你不是猫王帮的人！猫王知道你在这里吗？

original: You want to travel through Freeside with ease, you hire a King. We're everywhere, and no one messes with us.
translation: 想自由城畅行无阻，就得雇个猫王帮的人伴你左右。我们无处不在，也没人敢惹。

original: Your safety is practically guaranteed, for just 100 caps.
translation: 绝对保证你的生命安全，只需100个瓶盖。

original: Hey there, you want to cruise Freeside in style, you'd do worse than hire a King to tag along.  Only 100 caps.
translation: 嘿，如果你想在自由城招摇过市，那没有什么比请个猫王帮的人做保镖更靠谱的了。只需100个瓶盖。

original: You wanted something?
translation: 你有什么事吗？

original: Something on your mind?
translation: 有什么心事吗？

original: {Angry}Well, I hate to support the damn NCR, but it looks like they're the only thing between us and mass slavery at the hands of the Legion.
translation: {Angry}好吧，虽然我讨厌NCR，但要是没有他们，军团那帮人肯定会把我们都抓去当奴隶。

original: Here's to the slaughter of every last one of those brahmin-poking meatheads, Caesar's Legion.
translation: 为了那帮戴着牛角头盔的蠢货凯撒军团全军覆没，干杯吧。

original: {Wary}Doesn't look good, this build-up of forces between the NCR and Legion. Not good at all for business in the long run, if the Legion wins.
translation: {Wary}NCR和军团之间的军备竞赛愈演愈烈了，看起来不妙啊。如果军团赢了，从长远来讲，对生意可不是好事。

original: {Concerned}I hear the Legion is camping out across the river. I hope they're not planning to attack, but those bloodthirsty molerats are never up to any good.
translation: {Concerned}我听说军团已经在河对岸扎营了。希望他们不要再策划什么攻击，但那些嗜血的野蛮人什么事都干得出来。

original: {excited}Some guys were in here earlier saying you survived Benny's goon squad. That's one hell of a feat, bud. Have a drink on me.
translation: {excited}我听其他客人说，你居然独自一人面对本尼的诸多手下，还能全身而退。了不起啊，伙计。我请你喝一杯。

original: {Amused}I hear Benny got force-fed a little slice of heaven. Man what I would have paid to see that loathesome little weasel eat it.
translation: {Amused}我听说本尼被送去见上帝了。如果能让我看看那黄鼠狼死前的表情，付多少钱也值了。

original: {Snarky}So Benny went MIA, huh? I always figured him for a coward.
translation: {Snarky}看来本尼跑得没影了？我就说他是个胆小鬼。

original: {Confident}You made a run on The Tops, eh? Admirable work, but don't try that crap in Freeside.
translation: {Confident}你把九重天搅了个天翻地覆啊？手段不错，但在自由城里，你最好别来那一套。

original: {Mixed}I don't care how you get your work done, but keep you nose clean in Freeside.
translation: {Mixed}我不知道你平时行事风格怎样，但是在自由城，你就得守规矩。

original: {Mixed}{Chuckle}Here comes trouble. What can I do for you?
translation: {Mixed}{Chuckle}来了个捣蛋鬼。你想干什么？

original: {Wild Child}I can see you appreciate the gray areas of life. Got anything in particular you're looking for?
translation: {WildChild}看来你喜欢在刀尖上跳舞。想买什么东西吗？

original: {Wild Child}Welcome back, wild man. What can I do for you.
translation: {WildChild}欢迎回来，狂放不羁的疯小子。你想要什么？

original: {Wild Child}Welcome back, wild woman. What can I do for you.
translation: {WildChild}欢迎回来，狂放不羁的疯婆娘。你想要什么？

original: {Good Natured Rascal}{Heya}Hey, chum. Welcome back.
translation: {GoodNaturedRascal}{Heya}嘿，伙计。欢迎回来。

original: {Liked}Welcome back, friend. What can I get you?
translation: {Liked}欢迎回来，朋友。需要点什么？

original: {Merciful Thug}People in Freeside are talking, bub. We don't serve punks. Change your attitude, or find another place to drink.
translation: {MercifulThug}自由城的人都在说你的事，伙计。我们不为混蛋服务。要么你改改态度，要么你就换个地方喝酒吧。

original: {Merciful Thug}I don't have all day. What do you need?
translation: {MercifulThug}我可没时间跟你耗。你需要什么？

original: {Hated}You're a real piece of work, bub. You're lucky to be alive with your rep around here.
translation: {Hated}伙计，就凭你这名声，你还能活着到处转悠，运气可真好。

original: {Unknown}Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler. What can I get you?
translation: {Unknown}欢迎光临原子牛仔。想来点儿什么？

original: {Unknown}Welcome back. What can I get you?
translation: {Unknown}欢迎回来。想来点什么？

original: {Concerned}I heard about your run on The Tops. Don't even think about trying that crap here.
translation: {Concerned}我听说你在九重天闹出的乱子了。在这里可别想来那套。

original: {Amused}So Benny's dead, huh? That shifty son of a bitch had it coming.
translation: {Amused}这么说，本尼死了？那个狗杂种是咎由自取。

original: {at a loss}I hear Benny went missing. I can't help but wonder what happened to him.
translation: {ataloss}我听说本尼失踪了。真教人好奇他的下落。

original: {excited}I heard Benny sent his goons after you. You're one hell of a survivor to make it out of The Tops alive.
translation: {excited}我听说本尼派了手下来对付你。你居然还能从九重天全身而退，真是了不起。

original: {matter-of-fact}So it turns out the Omertas were into some serious shit. I always suspected that crew was dirty.
translation: {matter-of-fact}原来黑手党真的图谋不轨啊。我早就怀疑他们不干净了。

original: {Friendly, Impressed}Some gamblers came in saying they'd seen you enter the Lucky 38. I have to say I'm impressed.
translation: {Friendly,Impressed}有赌客说看见你进入了幸运38。不得不说，你真行。

original: I don't know of any other living person who's been in there.
translation: 我以前从没听说有哪个活人进去过。

original: {Cheery}People are saying the Securitrons are acting funny. {Cold}I hope that old Geezer, House, is dead. Might give the locals a chance to take control.
translation: {Cheery}大家都说电子保安举止滑稽。{Cold}希望是因为豪斯那个怪老头死了。这样一来，本地人终于有机会当家做主了。

original: {Warm thanks}Here's one on the house for taking down Caesar. Serves him right for treating women like livestock.
translation: {Warmthanks}这一杯我替大家敬你，感谢你除掉了凯撒。他把女人当两脚畜生，就该遭这样的报应。

original: {Amused}You hear? Caesar finally kicked the bucket! Serves him right for treating women like livestock.
translation: {Amused}你听说了吗？凯撒终于嗝屁了！他把女人当两脚畜生，就该遭这样的报应。

original: {Disgusted}Damn monorail bombing. I {spose}suppose this means we'll be seeing more NCR chumps wandering through Freeside.
translation: {Disgusted}该死的列车爆炸。我看这意味着今后会在自由城看见更多NCR草包了。

original: {Reticent}Hate to say it, but business has improved since the troopers started coming through Freeside to get to Vegas.
translation: {Reticent}虽然我不想承认，但自从士兵们开始通过自由城进入维加斯以后，生意明显好多了。

original: {Amused}I hear you've been making a name for yourself on The Strip. Don't forget about the Wrangler if you make it big.
translation: {Amused}听说你在长街声名鹊起。将来发达了可别忘了原子牛仔哦。

original: {Concerned}People are getting nervous about the Legion amassing on the other side of the river. I hope the NCR can hold agains another attack.
translation: {Concerned}军团在河对扎营搞得大家人心惶惶。希望NCR可以再次击退军团的进攻。

original: {Wary}This build-up on both sides of the dam isn't good. If the Legion attacks and wins, it won't be long before we're all slaves.
translation: {Wary}争夺水坝的两股势力正剑拔弩张，这可不是什么好事。如果军团最终胜利，要不了多久我们都会变成奴隶。

original: {Angry}God-damned Legion is raring for a fight. No matter who wins, a lot of people are going to die in the process, and dead men don't drink.
translation: {Angry}该死的军团已经准备开战了。虽然我不在乎谁会赢，但打仗就要死人，死人可不喝酒。

original: {Mixed}You can order whatever you want, as long as it's alcoholic.
translation: {Mixed}你想点什么都有，只要是酒精饮料。

original: {Wild Child}So the wild one returns! What can I get you?
translation: {WildChild}疯子回来了！想要点什么？

original: {Good Natured Rascal}{Appreciative}I hear you've been helping out around town. It's much appreciated, friend.
translation: {GoodNaturedRascal}{Appreciative}听说你一直在镇上帮助大家。感谢你，朋友。

original: {Good Natured Rascal}{Warm}What can I get you, friend?
translation: {GoodNaturedRascal}{Warm}要点什么，朋友？

original: {Liked}{Warm}You've done a lot for Freeside and it is much appreciated. Here's one on the house.
translation: {Liked}{Warm}感谢你为自由城做了这么多。这杯我请了。

original: {Liked}{Warm}Good to see you! What can I get you, friend?
translation: {Liked}{Warm}很高兴见到你！想要点什么，朋友？

original: {Merciful Thug}Watch yourself, friend. We don't serve those who treat our friends badly. Shape up, or ship out.
translation: {MercifulThug}小心点儿，朋友。我们可不伺候那些欺负我们朋友的家伙。要么好好表现，要么滚蛋。

original: {Merciful Thug}{Disinterested}Yeah? What do you need?
translation: {MercifulThug}{Disinterested}嗯？你要什么？

original: {Hated}What the hell do you want?
translation: {Hated}你他妈想要啥？

original: {Unknown}Welcome to the Atomic Wrangler. What can I get you?
translation: {Unknown}欢迎光临原子牛仔。想要点什么？

original: {Unknown}Welcome back. What can I get you?
translation: {Unknown}欢迎回来。你想来点什么？

original: Emily says you're working with her on bugging the Lucky 38. That information would be invaluable to our research if you can get it done.
translation: 艾米丽说你在帮她往幸运38植入木马。如果你能搞定，那些情报对我们的研究意义非凡。

original: Hey, I heard about the bug getting destroyed in the Lucky 38. We'll get in there eventually. It's just a matter of time.
translation: 嘿，我听说幸运38的木马被清除了。我们迟早会黑进去的的，这只是个时间问题。

original: One of my aides said you got into the Lucky 38. If you see someone by the name of Emily near there, we would like you to work for us.
translation: 我听一个助手说你进入了幸运38。如果你在那附近见到一个叫艾米丽的人，希望你能跟她合作。

original: {Concerned}I've heard a few patients mention the Securitrons are acting strangely and no one has heard from Mr. House in a while.
translation: {Concerned}我听一些病人提起最近电子保安举止怪异，而且已经好久没听到豪斯先生的音讯了。

original: If House is out of the picture, maybe we'll be able to get our hands on some of his technology. It would help our scientists greatly.
translation: 如果豪斯不在了，也许我们可以接触到他的技术。这对我们的科学家大有裨益。

original: So the great {Kai-zar}Caesar is dead. Happy news, but I don't know that it'll make things safer. The rest of his goons may be even worse once they take power.
translation: 伟大的{Kai-zar}凯撒死了。好消息，但我觉得局势并不会就此好转。一旦权力落到他那些部下手上，情况可能会更糟。

original: Smoke rising from the east spells trouble. I hope the Legion isn't on the move.
translation: 东边飘起了黑烟，估计情况不妙。希望军团还没开始行动。

original: I sincerely hope the NCR are getting supplies in place to defend against an attack, because it looks like the Legion has plans for the dam again.
translation: 我衷心希望NCR能做好应对进攻的准备，因为看来军团又在打水坝的主意了。

original: If things don't go well at the dam, all of our efforts here could be for nothing. I hope to God the Legion doesn't win control.
translation: 如果水坝那边战况不利，那咱们做的一切就都白搭了。希望老天开眼，别让军团占上风。

original: {Unknown}Is there something you need?
translation: {Unknown}你需要什么吗？

original: {Unknown}Hi, do you need assistance?
translation: {Unknown}嗨，需要帮助吗？

original: {Unknown}Can I help you?
translation: {Unknown}需要帮忙吗？

original: {Mixed}Yes?
translation: {Mixed}什么事？

original: {Mixed}Do you need something?
translation: {Mixed}你有什么事？

original: {Mixed}Have you ever considered getting your head checked?
translation: {Mixed}你有没有想过自己的脑袋可能有病？

original: {Wild Child}I'm pretty busy, is there something you need?
translation: {WildChild}我很忙，你有什么事？

original: {Wild Child}Make it quick, I'm a busy woman.
translation: {WildChild}有话快说，我忙得很。

original: {Wild Child}We don't specialize in psychiatry in this camp.
translation: {WildChild}我们这个营地不研究神经病。

original: {Good Natured Rascal}Hey, good to see you.
translation: {GoodNaturedRascal}嘿，见到你很高兴。

original: {Good Natured Rascal}Welcome.
translation: {GoodNaturedRascal}欢迎。

original: {Liked}Welcome back, friend.
translation: {Liked}欢迎回来，朋友。

original: {Liked}Great to see you again.
translation: {Liked}再次见到你真高兴。

original: {Merciful Thug}What do you want?
translation: {MercifulThug}你想干什么？

original: {Merciful Thug}Watch yourself around here. We don't tolerate thugs in the camp.
translation: {MercifulThug}小心一点。我们这个营地可容不下暴徒。

original: {Merciful Thug}I'm busy, make it quick.
translation: {MercifulThug}我很忙，有话快说。

original: {Hated}I hope you don't think I'm going to stitch your sorry ass.
translation: {Hated}希望你不要逼我把你那张臭嘴缝起来。

original: {Hated}Great, you again?
translation: {Hated}真棒，又是你？

original: {Hated}Don't you have some kittens to drown or something?
translation: {Hated}你不是正忙着欺负花鸟鱼虫吗？

original: Check it out. Between the dumpsters there.
translation: 去看看吧。就在那边的垃圾箱中间。

original: Looky what we have here, ladies, another unsuspecting ponce!
translation: 瞧瞧是谁来了，女士们，又一个毫无防备的娘炮！

original: Place your bets and give the wheel a spin!
translation: 买定离手，轮盘马上开转！

original: Pull up a stool and join the game, buddy!
translation: 把凳子搬过来一起玩吧，伙计！

original: You people are crazy!
translation: 你们都疯了！

original: You want to get your hands on some of the deadliest weapons around? Head just down the street to the Silver Rush. You won't be disappointed.
translation: 你想见识一下最致命的武器吗？去街那头的银色冲击看看吧。你不会失望的。

original: The Silver Rush is just down the street here. You can't miss it.
translation: 银色冲击就在街那头。你不会错过的。

original: Hey baby, head down to the Atomic Wrangler if you want to have a good time.
translation: 嘿，宝贝。想找乐子的话就去原子牛仔。

original: The Wrangler's just down the street. You're almost there already.
translation: 原子牛仔就在街那边。马上就能看到了。

original: Stop by Mick & Ralph's for all your shopping needs, sir.
translation: 米克与拉尔夫的杂货店，满足您的一切购物需求，先生。

original: Stop by Mick & Ralph's for all your shopping needs, ma'am.
translation: 米克与拉尔夫的杂货店，满足您的一切购物需求，女士。

original: Mick & Ralph's is located just before the east gate.
translation: 米克与拉尔夫的杂货店就在东大门前面一点。

original: You need to be careful, it's dangerous out here!
translation: 你得小心点，这里很危险！

original: Since you haven't pissed yourself I'll assume that you don't know who we are - next time I'll bring my sickle and wear my black cloak.
translation: 既然你没有被吓得尿裤子，那我估计你是还不认得我们，下次我会带上镰刀和黑披风的。

original: See, the NCR sends us when they want terrible things done to terrible people...
translation: 听着，当NCR希望恶人遭受恶运时，他们就会派我们登场……

original: Sorry, friend, you crossed the NCR one too many times - you've been marked for death... and we're here to take care of that.
translation: 对不起，朋友，你跟NCR作对太多次了，他们要取你的项上人头……而我们就是替他们办事的。

original: Nothing personal - orders - you know how it is. {pause}Well, let's get to it.
translation: 无关私人恩怨，只是公事公办而已，希望你理解。那么，咱们动手吧。

original: Never mind - don't care. You've got two more days to deal with your bad NCR reputation.
translation: 算了，无所谓。我们再给你两天改善和NCR的关系。

original: Make them happy or we'll make you dead.
translation: 要是他们还不高兴，我们就只能让你死了。

original: We're back - you've got two days left to improve your NCR reputation. After that we find you and end you. Clear?
translation: 我们回来了——你还剩两天改善你和NCR的关系。如果到时还没改观，那我们就会来取你的性命。明白吗？

original: Remember us? You've got two days left make up for pissing off the NCR. See you around. <laughs>
translation: 记得我们吗？你还剩两天来处理你和NCR的关系。再见。 <笑>

original: {Sarcastic}So, last day on earth, huh? Getting your affairs in order? Or are you still trying to work on that bad reputation of yours?
translation: {Sarcastic}那么，终于到最后一天了，嗯？把该办的都办完了吗？还是说你仍在努力改善你的坏名声？

original: The NCR just wants to be friends, but you don't seem to want to play nice. See you tomorrow.
translation: NCR只是想交个朋友，可你似乎却不那么上道啊。明天见了。

original: Tick-tock, time's up. The NCR says you gotta die, so guess what?
translation: 滴答滴答，时间到了。NCR要你死，猜猜会发生什么？

original: I gave you three days - you should have crawled in a hole somewhere. Time to die.
translation: 我给了你三天时间，也够你找个山洞藏起来了。受死吧。

original: Well, take a good look around - this is where your life ended.
translation: 好了，仔细瞧瞧你的周围吧，因为这就将是你的葬身之地。

original: Well, seems like you've redeemed yourself. Welcome back to the NCR's good graces. Play nice... or I'll be back for you.
translation: 好吧，看来你挽回了自己的名誉。欢迎回到NCR的怀抱。表现好点……不然我还会回来找你的。

original: The brass has put me back on my leash - that must mean that you've decided to play nice with the NCR. Good choice, you just saved your life.
translation: 上级命令我不用再和你动手了，看来你已经决定和NCR好好相处。明智的选择，你救了自己的小命。

original: Don't make me come after you again.
translation: 别让我再来找你。

original: I see you took my advice and made nice with the NCR. Guess that means you aren't as dumb as you look.
translation: 你接受了我的建议和NCR搞好了关系。看来你还不是那么蠢。

original: Stay smart and I won't have to come for you again.
translation: 放聪明点，那样我就不用再来找你了。

original: I don't know how you managed to improve your reputation with the NCR after pissing us off like that, but honestly...
translation: 我不知道你惹了这么多事端后，是怎么和NCR达成和解的，但老实说……

original: I'm just happy I don't have to kill you now. See you around, wastelander.
translation: 我很高兴不用再杀你了。以后再见，废土游民。

original: Get him! Nobody screws with the NCR!
translation: 把他拿下！没人敢惹NCR！

original: The NCR's come for you - time to die!
translation: NCR来找你了——你死定了！

original: You crossed the NCR one time too many - now you die!
translation: 你惹怒了NCR——现在你死定了！

original: Did you think you'd get away with crossing the NCR?!
translation: 你觉得你惹怒了NCR之后还能全身而退吗？！

original: The NCR wants you dead, friend!
translation: NCR要你死，朋友！

original: Consider this your final warning from the NCR!
translation: 把这当成NCR对你的最后一次警告吧！

original: Nobody crosses the NCR!
translation: 没人能惹NCR！

original: You'll pay for crossing the NCR!
translation: 你会为惹恼NCR付出代价的！

original: This is what the NCR does with traitors!
translation: 这就是NCR对付国家公敌的手段！

original: {INTERCOM}The cleaners will knock twice. Make sure they're thorough.
translation: {INTERCOM}清洁工会敲两下门。记得放他们进来。

original: {INTERCOM, NOASSASSIN}Baby, this little reunion of ours? Chalk me up as a no-show.
translation: {INTERCOM， NOASSASSIN}宝贝，还惦记着咱们这次相会呢？恕我不能奉陪了。

original: I'm surprised you fell for it, not that I'm complaining. You caused plenty enough trouble, turning Swank against me.
translation: 我倒挺惊讶的，你居然如此记仇。不是我抱怨，你太能挑事了，害得我都和斯万克反目了。

original: You've forced my hand. Hell, I gotta skip town because of you. A real pain in the caboose...
translation: 是你逼我摊牌的。因为你，我只能跑路了。真是让人伤心欲绝啊……

original: {INTERCOM}{confident in your safety}Baby, this little meet and greet of ours? Chalk me up as a no-show.
translation: {INTERCOM， NOASSASSIN}宝贝，还惦记着咱们这次相会呢？恕我不能奉陪了。

original: It would be 41 flavors of stupid to let you get a drop on me. And you've caused plenty enough trouble as-is.
translation: 如果那么轻易就着了你的道儿，那我未免也蠢得有些离谱了。你惹的麻烦实在太多了。

original: You've forced my hand. Hell, I gotta skip town because of you. A real pain in the caboose...
translation: 是你逼我摊牌的。因为你，我只能跑路了。真是让人伤心欲绝啊……

original: {FIRST TALK}{dumbfounded - as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK}{dumbfounded - as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves, like {drawing words out}smooth little babies...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER HAS VISITED L38}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK}{dumbfounded - as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. {drawing it out}Smooth...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}Hello! The guy everyone saw go in the Lucky 38, that was you? {gift of gab failing}Oh shit.
translation: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}你好啊！那个大摇大摆走进幸运38的人就是你吗？{gift of gab failing}哦，见鬼。

original: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER HAS VISITED L38}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER HAS VISITED L38}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. {drawing it out}Smooth...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}Hello! That broad everyone saw go in the Lucky 38, that was you? {gift of gab failing}Shit.
translation: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}你好啊！那个大摇大摆走进幸运38的人就是你吗？{gift of gab failing}哦，见鬼。

original: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. {drawing it out}Smooth...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}Hello! It was you, smashed up the Omertas? You did that?{gift of gab failing} Shit.
translation: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}你好啊！就是你把黑手党一锅端了吧？{gift of gab failing}哦，见鬼。

original: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER WIPED OUT KHANS IN BC}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. {drawing it out}Smooth...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}Hello! It was you, wiped out the Khans down in Boulder City? You did that? {gift of gab failing}Oh shit.
translation: {just dawning on you， keeping voice down}你好啊！就是你把巨石城里的大汗帮给一锅端了吧？{gift of gab failing}哦，见鬼。

original: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER FREED KHANS IN BC}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. {drawing it out}Smooth...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}Hello! It was you, set the Khans free down in Boulder City? You did that? {gift of gab failing}Oh shit.
translation: {just dawning on you， keeping voice down}你好啊！就是你把巨石城里的大汗帮给放了吧？{gift of gab failing}哦，见鬼。

original: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER HAS STRIP REP}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}Let's keep this in the groove, hey? Smooth moves. {drawing it out}Smooth...
translation: {keeping voice down}{Trying to contain the situation}咱们有话好商量，行吗？冷静一点，别冲动……

original: {just dawning on you, keeping voice down}Hello! The gasser everyone's been talking about, making a splash on the Strip. That's been you? {gift of gab failing}Oh shit.
translation: {just dawning on you， keeping voice down}你好啊！大伙都在谈论你，那个近来在长街声名鹊起的家伙就是你吧？{gift of gab failing}哦，见鬼。

original: {Ready to "get it on" now that you're in private}Benny is gonna show you the Tops! I hope you're built sturdy, you crazy broad!
translation: {Ready to "get it on" now that you're in private}本尼可要让你领教一下九重天的厉害！但愿你身子骨够结实，疯杂种！

original: {FIRST TALK, ASSASSINATION}{Dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}What in the goddamn...?
translation: {FIRST TALK, PLAYER BROKE UP OMERTAS}{dumbfounded, as though seeing a ghost}这他妈怎么……？

original: {how could the player be here?}You? How could you be...? {realizing you've been had}Oh Swank, you finky bastard...
translation: {how could the player be here?}你？你怎么可能……{realizing you've been had}噢，斯万克，你这两面三刀的狗杂种……

original: {stating the obvious, trying to spin it}You got a crazy drop on me, baby, but you don't want to kill me. We should be working together.
translation: {stating the obvious， trying to spin it}我确实着了你的道，宝贝，但你不该杀我，我们应该合作。

original: {SECOND PLUS TALK, ASSASSINATION}{finding the player in your suite}Hey hey hey, what the hell...?
translation: {SECOND PLUS TALK， ASSASSINATION}{finding the player in your suite}嘿，嘿，嘿！怎么回事……？

original: {realizing you've been had}Oh Swank, you finky bastard...
translation: {realizing you've been had}噢，斯万克，你这两面三刀的狗杂种……

original: {stating the obvious, trying to spin it}You got a crazy drop on me, baby, but you don't want to kill me. It's like I said, we should be working together.
translation: {stating the obvious， trying to spin it}我确实着了你的道，宝贝，但你不该杀我，就像我说的，我们应该合作。

original: I comped you the prez so we can talk there, hey? No need to keep tugging at my sleeve.
translation: 我带你去总统套房，咱们可以在那儿谈，怎么样？没必要在这儿揪着我领子。

original: {annoyed}Wait {'til}until we get to the Presidential, {pal-ee}pally. I don't need you tugging at my sleeve.
translation: {annoyed}等{'til}到了总统套房再说吧，{pal-ee}亲爱的。我可不喜欢你拽着我的领子。

original: Cool by me if you wanna talk after all... but a confab like this, out in public, in my place of business? That don't play.
translation: 你愿意和我谈，我很高兴……问题是公共场合，大庭广众的，还是我做生意的地方，聊这种话题？有点不地道吧。

original: {keeping voice down}What say you and me cash out, go somewheres more private-like? Any questions you got, I'll answer.
translation: {keeping voice down}要摊牌的话，咱们不妨找个僻静点的地方，你觉得呢？无论你问什么，我都会回答你。

original: {keeping voice down}Like I said, we should be talking somewheres private.
translation: {keeping voice down}我说了，我们找个安静点的地方再谈。

original: {FORCED GREETING IN PRIVATE}Now that you and me's got some privacy, I gotta ask - how is it that you're still living?
translation: {FORCED GREETING IN PRIVATE}既然现在就剩我们两个人了，我得问问——你怎么还活着？

original: Once you were vertical, how'd you track me down?
translation: 你诈尸了以后，是怎么找到我的？

original: {TOP LEVEL QUESTIONS}I guess that's enough scratching around at first base. Tell me, which way is the wind gonna blow?
translation: {TOP LEVEL QUESTIONS}看来咱们俩是不打不相识了。告诉我，现在到底是个什么情况？

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}You got questions, I got answers.
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE}你有问题，而我有答案。

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE, REPEATS}How else can I clue you in?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE， REPEATS}你还有什么情况想要了解的？

original: {MASTER QUESTION NODE, 2nd REPEATS}Something else you wanted to know?
translation: {MASTER QUESTION NODE, 2nd REPEATS}你还有什么想知道的吗？

original: {Question Node: THE CHIP}It's the House edge, baby - literally. It's what Mr. House needs to stack the odds in his favor.
translation: {Question Node: THE CHIP}这可是豪斯的王牌啊，宝贝。顾名思义，他是要靠这玩意来翻盘的。

original: {Question Node: THE CHIP}What about it?
translation: {Question Node: THE CHIP}怎么了？

original: {Question Node: VEGAS POLITICS}Yeah, it's a tricky world out there. I'll tell it to you straight.
translation: {Question Node: VEGAS POLITICS}是啊，这世上满是阴谋诡计。我会和你说实话实说的。

original: {Question Node: VEGAS POLITICS}What else did you want to know?
translation: {Question Node: VEGAS POLITICS}你还有什么想知道的？

original: Broad strokes? Change in management.
translation: 简单点说，就是换人坐庄呗。

original: The Securitrons are where it's at. I need a way to control them, and a way to beef up their hitting power.
translation: 电子保安是个问题。我要想办法控制它们，还要提升它们的进攻能力。

original: I get those two ducks in a row, Vegas can defend itself versus all comers - NCR, Caesar's Legion, it won't matter.
translation: 只要搞定这两样，维加斯就能抵御所有的入侵——管它是NCR还是凯撒军团，都无所谓。

original: {Question Node: BENNY'S SCHEME}What else did you want to know?
translation: {Question Node: BENNY'S SCHEME}你还有什么想知道的？

original: Like I said, once the Chairmen are running Vegas, you'll get a percentage. Until then I'll pay you a retainer and bonuses for "special missions."
translation: 我说了，等董事会控制了维加斯，你就会拿到分红。在那之前，我会先预付给你一笔定金，以及执行"特殊任务"的奖金。

original: {player has charged past guards to talk to Benny}What are you, crazy? These Praetorians mean business!
translation: {player has charged past guards to talk to Benny}你做什么，疯了吗？这些禁卫军可不是吃素的！

original: {congratulating player on killing all guards}You're a scrapper, baby. They didn't stand a chance. {asking if player will let you live}How about me?
translation: {congratulating player on killing all guards}你可真能打啊，宝贝。他们一点机会都没有。{asking if player will let you live}你打算拿我怎么办？

original: {not expecting a good outcome}Change in plans?
translation: {not expecting a good outcome}计划有变？

original: {FIRST TALK, LOVERS}{surprised, pleased}Pussycat! Ain't this platinum? Had I known, I woulda baked a cake!
translation: {FIRST TALK， LOVERS}{surprised， pleased}妈妈呀！简直是喜从天降啊！早知道我就该烤个蛋糕庆祝一下了！

original: That last turn we took is an 18 karat memory, baby. It's all that's been keeping me warm at night, stuck where I am.
translation: 宝贝，我们共度的这段时光，对我来说就像18克拉的钻石一般珍贵。被困在这里的夜晚，只有它能给我温暖。

original: {FIRST TALK, NO AMBUSH}{mock scolding}Why you little promise-breaker! {effeminate voice}"Let me live, Benny, and I'll never come after you - pinky swear!" What a fink! Anyway...
translation: {FIRST TALK， NO AMBUSH}{mock scolding}你这个食言的小混蛋！{effeminate voice}"放我一条生路吧，本尼，我绝不会再来找你，一言为定！"真是卑鄙！不管怎样……

original: {FIRST TALK}Go ahead and laugh, baby. I ain't blind to the humor in this situation.
translation: {FIRST TALK}尽管笑吧，宝贝。我知道现在这处境有多可乐。

original: {BEFORE BUNKER, SECOND TALK}Sing, baby. You got a captive audience.
translation: {BEFORE BUNKER， SECOND TALK}唱吧，宝贝。你的听众就在这儿捆着呢。

original: {BEFORE BUNKER, BUSINESS AGAIN}Go on.
translation: {BEFORE BUNKER， BUSINESS AGAIN}说吧。

original: {BEFORE BUNKER, BUSINESS}Down to brass tacks. How'd your meet and greet with Baldie go?
translation: {BEFORE BUNKER, BUSINESS}咱们就事论事。你倒是怎么跟这个秃瓢儿搭上线的？

original: {BEFORE BUNKER, BENNY'S FATE}{just learned the player gets to choose how you die}Try not to smile so wide, baby. You might break your mouth.
translation: {BEFORE BUNKER， BENNY'S FATE}{just learned the player gets to choose how you die}别笑得这么开心，宝贝。小心风大闪了舌头。

original: Yeah, Baldie said you'd get to decide. So which way you leaning?
translation: 对，秃子说你来决定。你倾向用哪种方式呢？

original: {BEFORE BUNKER, BENNY'S FATE}{player has mentioned possibly freeing you}Last we spoke, you were leaning in more {emphasis}merciful direction...?
translation: {BEFORE BUNKER， BENNY'S FATE}{player has mentioned possibly freeing you}记得上次我们谈的时候，你好像更{emphasis}倾向于仁慈的方法……？

original: {BEFORE BUNKER, BENNY'S FATE}So you keep saying.
translation: {BEFORE BUNKER， BENNY'S FATE}你继续说。

original: {AFTER BUNKER}{eager}So baby, what did you find down there?
translation: {AFTER BUNKER}{eager}宝贝，你在下面发现了什么？

original: {AFTER BUNKER, BENNY'S FATE}{bracing yourself, a bit defiant}I see. And how's that gonna happen?
translation: {AFTER BUNKER， BENNY'S FATE}{bracing yourself， a bit defiant}我知道了。那又怎样呢？

original: What's holding you up? Let's get this over with.
translation: 你还在犹豫什么？赶紧把这事情了结吧。

original: {POLITICS}Which greedy overlord do you want to start with?
translation: {POLITICS}你想从哪个大佬开始说起呢？

original: {BENNY'S PAST}{of course you'd want to know about me}I'm the most interesting person I know.
translation: {BENNY'S PAST}{of course you'd want to know about me}我认识的人里，最有趣的人就是我自己。

original: {BENNY'S PAST}I never tire of talking about myself.
translation: {BENNY'S PAST}我可喜欢和别人分享我的故事了。

original: {after player forgave you}I'm still a little choked up over here, baby. We'll catch up in a bit.
translation: {after player forgave you}我还是有些哽咽，宝贝。咱们以后再聊吧。

original: {generic line any time Benny doesn't want to talk to player}Scram, will ya? I value my privacy.
translation: {generic line any time Benny doesn't want to talk to player}走开点，好吗？我很重视自己的隐私。

original: {upbeat}You and me gonna accomplish great things, baby.
translation: {upbeat}我们会成就一番大事的，宝贝。

original: {POLITICS}Name a name.
translation: {POLITICS}你想问哪个？

original: Welcome to Novac. It's not very exciting here, but the people are friendly enough.
translation: 欢迎来到诺瓦克。虽然这地方不怎么有趣，但人们都非常友好。

original: You saw the rockets explode, right? It turns out I was lucky they couldn't take me on the Great Journey.
translation: 你瞧见那些火箭爆炸的样子了吗？还好我走运，没有被他们拉去参与伟大旅程。

original: Do you have any idea what went wrong?
translation: 你觉得是哪里出了问题？

original: I'm going to make my way to that little town we talked about.
translation: 我准备到我们之前聊到的那个小镇上去。

original: Welcome to Novac. It's not very exciting here, but the people are friendly enough.
translation: 欢迎来到诺瓦克。虽然这地方不怎么有趣，但人们都非常友好。

original: My engineering skills have been coming in handy, too. I've got plenty to do. Thanks for telling me about this place.
translation: 我的工程技术在这儿还算吃得开。我还有很多事要做，谢谢你向我介绍了这个地方。

original: Hey! Over here! Are you listening?
translation: 嘿！这儿呢！你听得到我说话吗？

original: Go to the big room on the east side of this building and take the metal staircase all the way up. And hurry.
translation: 到东侧的大房间去，然后沿铁楼梯向上走。快点。

original: All right, Smoothskin, I'm letting you in. You better watch yourself. I'll sure as hell be watching you.
translation: 好吧，滑皮肤。我让你进来。但你最好注意点，我会盯着你的。

original: What's the problem, smoothskin? Lost your way?
translation: 怎么了，滑皮肤？迷路了？

original: Hello? Who's down there?
translation: 喂？谁在下面？

original: Stop messing around with the intercom, smoothskin.
translation: 别再冲着对讲机嚷嚷了，滑皮肤。

original: God, but are you ugly! Get upstairs and talk to Jason before I throw up just from looking at you.
translation: 老天，你太丑了！趁我还没吐出来，你赶紧去楼上找杰森谈。

original: Go bother Jason, smoothskin. I don't like having you around.
translation: 去找杰森吧，滑皮肤。我不想看见你。

original: Have you found the components we discussed?
translation: 你找到我们之前说的部件了吗？

original: Have you found the components we discussed?
translation: 你找到我们之前说的部件了吗？

original: Have you found the components we discussed? The sooner we get this over with, the better.
translation: 你找到我们之前说的部件了吗？我们越快了结这事越好。

original: Jason says that I am to cooperate with you on the final tasks necessary to launch the Great Journey.
translation: 杰森说我得和你合作完成最后几项必要的任务，伟大旅程才能起航。

original: Are you ready to get started? Those rockets aren't going to launch themselves.
translation: 你准备好没有？那些火箭还等着我们发射呢。

original: It is almost time for the great Journey!
translation: 伟大旅程就要起航了！

original: Not now! It is almost time for the Great Journey!
translation: 别烦我！伟大旅程就要起航了！

original: It is almost time for the great Journey!
translation: 伟大旅程就要起航了！

original: Nice enough speech, I guess.
translation: 讲话还挺精彩。

original: Well, it's up to you to go launch the rockets. There's a small mission control room all the way back upstairs. Should be as easy as pressin a button.
translation: 好吧，发射火箭的任务就交给你了。原路返回楼上，那里有个小型"任务控制"室。应该只要按下按钮就行，非常简单。

original: It seems my work here is done, so I'll be on my way to Novac. We'll see how that works out.
translation: 看来我在这里的工作已经完成了，我准备去诺瓦克了。接下来就看这事情怎么收场吧。

original: Did you hear him? As though some fancy speech can make what they did to me less of a crime?
translation: 你听见他的那番话了吗？好像只要发表一些高论，就能减轻他们对我犯下的罪行？

original: Go launch the rockets! There's a cramped little "mission control" room all the way back upstairs. Should be as easy as pushing a button.
translation: 好吧，发射火箭的任务就交给你了。原路返回楼上，那里有个小型"任务控制"室。应该只要按下按钮就行，非常简单。

original: Enjoy the view. I hear the "Great Journey" is going to be shorter than they expected. Sweeter, too.
translation: 好好欣赏吧。我估计"伟大旅程"会比他们预计的要短。也更美妙。

original: Did you hear him? My god, you were right all along. I'm no ghoul! They were just using me...
translation: 你听见他的话了吗？天啊，你一直都是对的。我不是尸鬼！他们利用了我...

original: Go launch the rockets. Don't worry about me.
translation: 去发射火箭吧。别担心我。

original: Leave me alone.
translation: 离我远点。

original: Did you bring the items we discussed? The sooner I send them on their way, the sooner I can head to Novac.
translation: 你把我们之前说的东西带来了吗？越早把它们送出去，我就能越早前往诺瓦克。

original: Whoa! Are you like... some kind of crazy person?
translation: 哇！你是...你就像...某种疯子？

original: Do that again!
translation: 再来一次！

original: Cool. Can I try?
translation: 酷。我能试试吗？

original: Do that someplace else!
translation: 去别的地方找靶子吧！

original: You tryin' to get me killed?
translation: 你想打死我吗？

original: Holster that. And be quick about it.
translation: 把枪收好。快点。

original: Holster your iron, pardner!
translation: 收起枪，哥们！

original: Quit it!

original: Stop that!

original: Hey! Do that somewhere else.
translation: 嗨！要开枪就去别的地方。

original: Be careful!
