original: Why did you damage me? You're supposed to be a healing robot!
translation: 你为什么要伤害我？你不是治疗机器人吗！？

original: They don't actually... make you fight. Do they?
translation: 他们实际上没……让你参战，是吗？

original: Aren't you a little young for all this?
translation: 你不觉得自己还是太年轻了吗？

original: What do you make of the Enclave, Squire?
translation: 你了解英克雷吗，侍从？

original: I don't suppose you know anything about the Super Mutants?
translation: 你知道任何关于超级变种人的事吗？

original: What about the Brotherhood's history in this area?
translation: 兄弟会在这一地区的历史是怎样的？

original: I need medical supplies.
translation: 我需要医疗物资。

original: I don't give my help to enemies of the NCR. Maybe you can find a raider "medic" to fix you up.
translation: 我不会帮助NCR的敌人。你可以去找个掠夺者"医生"来帮你解决问题。

original: Yeah, and I need {emph}sterile medical supplies. But let's see what I have with me.
translation: 是啊，我也需要无菌的医疗物资。你先来看看我这儿卖的东西吧。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: I'd love to help you out, but I'm pretty strapped here as it is. I really don't have anything to sell you.
translation: 我也想帮你，可我这儿也物资紧缺，我真的没有什么东西能卖给你。

original: Hmm... well, I am better set for supplies now that you helped me out. I guess I can part with some of them.
translation: 嗯……好吧，多亏了你的帮助，我的医疗物资现在比较充足。卖一些给你也无妨。

original: Here's what I've got.
translation: 来看看我的东西吧。

original: I suppose I have a few things around that I can spare.
translation: 我想我应该可以卖一点药品给你。

original: I guess I can spare a few things.
translation: 我想我可以腾出一些东西。

original: Hey, can you hook me up with some chems?
translation: 嗨，你能用药品治疗我吗？

original: Care to share anything about the Super Mutants?
translation: 关于超级变种人，有什么信息可以分享？

original: So... Any thoughts on the Enclave?
translation: 那么……对英克雷有什么看法？

original: Who was it?
translation: 那是谁？

original: Molerat men, come up from the Underneath to steal young women with promises of riches and fancy mud mansions with all the latest designer appliances.
translation: 鼹鼠人，他们从地下来，用豪华奢侈的泥巴宅子与数不尽的荣华富贵当幌子，把年轻女孩骗走。

original: They covet our ladyfolk's long hair for wigs, it's said, being either bald or balding themselves.
translation: 据说，他们都是秃子，觊觎女人的长发，拿来制作自己的假发。

original: What do you know about the abduction of Boone's wife?
translation: 关于布恩的妻子被绑架的事情你了解多少？

original: Seen it all. Seen shadowy folk come to his room and leave again in the middle of the night. Thought one might've gone in the lobby, too, for a spell.
translation: 我全看见了。我看到一个家伙在半夜鬼鬼祟祟地进入他的房间，然后离开了。还有一个人也进了接待室，只待了一会。

original: Could be that person went in to get something. Or use the john maybe. Mighty interesting either way, you ask me.
translation: 那个人也许是进去拿什么东西，或者是去上厕所。不管怎么说，真是有趣极了。

original: I thought it was cannibals, come to eat us all for sure, so I kept out of sight. But now I know better.
translation: 我觉得那可能是食人族，要把我们全都吃掉，所以我一直没敢接近。但现在我全明白了。

original: Has anybody been acting strange lately?
translation: 最近有人的行为举止不正常吗？

original: I don't trust a man that doesn't have something strange going on about him, 'cause it means he's hiding it from you.
translation: 要是有一个人举止完全正常，那是绝对不可信任的，因为他肯定有事瞒着你。

original: If a man's wearing his pants on his head or if he says his words backwards from time to time, you know it's all laid out there for you.
translation: 如果一个人把裤子套在头上，或者总说反话，那你就会知道，他道出的必然是真相。

original: But if he's friendly to strangers and keeps his home spick-and-span, more often than not he's done something even his own ma couldn't forgive.
translation: 但如果他对陌生人非常友善，还把自己的屋子打扫得一尘不染，那他肯定是做了连老妈都不能原谅的事。

original: What else do you know about the deaths at the corral?
translation: 关于双头牛离奇死亡的事件，你都知道些什么？

original: I come face to face with the chupacabra himself one night whilst I was investigating whether this gecko was hiding his treasure from me.
translation: 有一天晚上，我和那只吸血怪魔撞了个对脸，当时我正在调查蜥蜴人是否在背着我偷藏财宝。

original: He was the meanest, ugliest chupacabra you could imagine. Had two heads, and fangs down to the ground.
translation: 那可真是一只既丑陋又凶恶的吸血怪魔，长着两个头，嘴里的毒牙长到可以碰着地面。

original: Best I could tell, anyways, since when he come up to me he was invisible.
translation: 我只看清了这些，因为他撞到我之前完全是隐形的。

original: Had himself a blunderbuss what would rotate and shoot bullets real fast out of a backpack. Never seen nothing like it.
translation: 他带了一杆会旋转的长枪，可以瞬间打光背包里所有的子弹。从未见过这么厉害的武器。

original: Walked right past me having an argument with somebody.
translation: 他从我旁边走过的时候，似乎还在和别人争吵。

original: But I only saw the one chupacabra, so I guess the other fella had to be invisible too. Only more invisible than the other one.
translation: 但我只看到一只吸血怪魔，所以我肯定附近还躲了一只。只是那只藏得更深。

original: What's been going on in town?
translation: 镇上有什么新鲜事儿吗？

original: There's been things of a disturbing nature going on at the McBride Corral.
translation: 麦克布莱恩的牛圈里最近常常发生怪事。

original: Seems every night one of their herd meets a most unnatural death, and always there's holes all over the body.
translation: 好像每晚都会有一只双头牛离奇死亡，而且尸体上满是窟窿。

original: Work of the chupacabra, the livestock vampire, says No-bark, but they don't pay no mind. Too many holes, they say, and there's bullets in them.
translation: 这是吸血怪魔的杰作，疯嘴知道它们是专吸牲畜血的怪物，但别人都不信。他们说，尸体上的窟窿太多了，而且还有弹头留在里面。

original: Well, says No-bark, we got a chupacabra with an automatic weapon. And that's when they get real quiet, 'cause now they see the predicament we're in.
translation: 于是疯嘴就说，这是一只会使用全自动武器的吸血怪魔。结果大家就不再说话了，因为他们都知道了现在所处的窘境。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 咱们说点别的吧。

original: Good idea. It ain't safe to stay on the same topic for too long.
translation: 挺聪明啊。长时间聊同一个话题并不安全。

original: Who do you think is actually at the factory?
translation: 你觉得那座工厂里面有什么？

original: Ghosts. Commie ghosts what don't know they're dead.
translation: 有鬼。连自己死了都不知道的老共鬼。

original: Hoping to steal our rockets so they can fly up and paint the moon pink and draw a Lenin face on it.
translation: 梦想着偷乘我们的火箭飞上天，把月亮涂成赤色，再把列宁的脸画在上面。

original: I seen one of them disappear and reappear before my very eyes.
translation: 我亲眼见过他们中的一个人消失之后又现身。

original: Although being a scientist, I have to admit I might've just blinked for longer than usual, what with the shock of seeing a commie ghost and so forth.
translation: 作为一名科学家，我必须承认，这也可能是因为我看到了共产主义的幽灵，过分震惊而眨眼时间稍长所致。

original: Is anything interesting happening in the area?
translation: 附近有什么有趣的事情吗？

original: Folks'll tell you that they seen ghouls up near the rocket factory.
translation: 人们会告诉你，他们看到火箭工厂附近出现了一些尸鬼。

original: Sensationalist hooey, cooked up by superstitious yokels seeing phantoms of their own imagining.
translation: 纯属异想天开，都是那些迷信的乡下土包子编造了他们幻想中的鬼怪故事。

original: 'Cause they know I ain't just barking here. What I say's got bite, 'cause it's the truth.
translation: 因为人们都知道我没有多嘴。我说的都是事实，事实会咬人的。

original: Them quack doctors can say what they want about all the radscorpion stings that done pierced my skull. I know what I seen.
translation: 那些江湖郎中可能会说什么我的脑袋被辐射蝎蛰过之类的胡话。可我却看得是明明白白。

original: Why do they call you No-bark?
translation: 他们为什么叫你疯嘴？

original: I'm not sure who started it. It wasn't a very nice name, but he took to calling himself by it, so we all had to.
translation: 我也不知道是谁先开始这么叫的。这不是什么好名字，可他既然自己都接受了，我们也就跟着叫了。

original: I don't even remember what his real name is.
translation: 我都不记得他的真名了。

original: Anyway, I think it comes from that expression that people say when you're crazy - that not all of your dogs are barking. Poor No-bark.
translation: 不管怎样，我想这个词应该是人们用来称呼疯子的——控制不了自己的嘴巴。可怜的疯嘴。

original: How did No-bark get his name?
translation: 疯嘴这个名字从哪里来的？

original: If you're going to be weird, I'm just going to leave.
translation: 如果你净说些离奇事，我就走了。

original: Weird's just normal when normal decides to start taking notice of things. You just think about that.
translation: 离奇也不过是正常人想获得他人关注所采取的正常手段罢了。你想想是不是这个道理。

original: Now what'd you come here for?
translation: 所以，你来这里做什么？

original: I have to go now.
translation: 我得走了。

original: Let me know if you meet anyone suspicious.
translation: 如果你见到可疑的人就告诉我。

original: <Glare at No-bark>
translation: <朝疯嘴瞪一眼>

original: You said you'd stab me with that dirty knife.
translation: 你说过要用那把脏兮兮的破刀捅我。

original: Okay, okay. Just speak up a little. But not so much that They hear you. They got people everywhere, always listening.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我不过是吓唬人罢了。别太大声，会叫他们听见的。他们到处都布了耳目，就为了偷听情报。

original: We can talk from this distance.
translation: 我们就在这个距离谈话。

original: You sure, now? It's kinda hard to hear you.
translation: 你确定吗？很难听清楚你说的话。

original: I give up! Please don't do no harm to me, mister, leastaways not my face. All I got left is my rugged good looks. What do you want to know?
translation: 我投降！请不要伤害我，先生，至少不要打我的脸。我身上能看的就剩这张沧桑的俊脸了。你想打听什么？

original: You're going to talk whether you like it or not.
translation: 无论你喜不喜欢，你都得老实交待。

original: I give up! Please don't do no harm to me, missy, leastaways not my face. All I got left is my rugged good looks. What do you want to know?
translation: 我投降！请不要伤害我，女士，至少不要打我的脸。我身上能看的就剩这张沧桑的俊脸了。你想打听什么？

original: You're going to talk whether you like it or not.
translation: 无论你喜不喜欢，你都得老实交待。

original: Talk about what?
translation: 谈论什么？

original: Who tried to make you talk?
translation: 谁曾想让你开口？

original: Confound it, No-bark, you done it again. You let on that you know things. Now they'll never let you be.
translation: 真要命，疯嘴，你又搞砸了。你让人看出你心怀鬼胎了。现在他们不放你走了。

original: All right, stranger, you got me. What do you want to know?
translation: 好吧，陌生人，我认输。你想要知道什么？

original: I don't mean any harm.
translation: 我并无恶意。

original: We'll just see about that. You come any closer and I'm liable to stick you with my stickin' knife. Ol' Sticky's feeling mighty ornery this day.
translation: 那可得用事实说话。你要是再敢走近一步，我就用这把刀捅死你。今天老刀子的脾气可不太好。

original: What can you tell me about the Brotherhood of Steel?
translation: 你能跟我说说钢铁兄弟会吗？

original: Can I come in?
translation: 我能进去吗？

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: Who built Liberty Prime? Or better yet... why?
translation: 谁建造了“自由先锋”？……又为什么？

original: What can you tell me about the Lyons' Pride?
translation: 你能跟我说说“里昂斯的骄傲”吗？

original: Are you in charge of the um... the robot?
translation: 你负责这个，嗯……机器人的事？

original: Can we talk about something else?
translation: 我们能谈谈别的吗？

original: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

original: Well don't worry yourself too much over it. We'll get by.
translation: 别太担心这件事。我们能熬过去的。

original: No one is going to attack your corral from now on.
translation: 再也不会有人来袭击你们的牲口了。

original: Well I don't know how you done it, but I do know how I can thank you. Please take this, compliments of Alice and myself.
translation: 好吧，我不知道你是怎么办到的，但我必须要感谢你。请收下吧，这是爱丽丝和我的一点谢意。

original: And help yourself to anything in that freezer over yonder. We got more steaks in there than we'd be able to eat in a year.
translation: 另外，冰箱里的东西你也可以随便拿。我们这儿的牛排多得一年都吃不完。

original: Well we surely appreciate for what you done for us. Even without our stock, just having peace of mind means the world to us.
translation: 我们真的很感谢你为我们做的一切。虽然牲口都没了，但能安享太平，对我们来说已经是最大的福气了。

original: Take this, compliments of Alice and myself. We'd give you more if we could, knowing you risked your neck for us.
translation: 收下吧，这是爱丽丝和我的一点谢意。你为我们差点掉了脑袋，可惜我们实在没有别的东西来报答你了。

original: I'll see if I can catch whoever's responsible.
translation: 我看看能不能抓到凶手。

original: We'd be grateful. Especially if you find 'em before they get my whole stock. But don't go getting yourself killed over it.
translation: 那可真是谢谢了。如果你能在我们的牲口被杀光前找到他们就更好了。不过，可千万要小心啊。

original: Alice and I'll find a way to make do. Always have.
translation: 爱丽丝和我会想办法对付的。天无绝人之路嘛。

original: Did you get a look at the attacker?
translation: 你看清袭击者了吗？

original: Beg your pardon mister, but them two-headed beeves ain't worth getting shot over.
translation: 请原谅，先生，为了这几只双头畜牲去玩命可太不值得了。

original: Not to mention what would happen if half of what No-bark says is true.
translation: 更何况，要是疯嘴说的那些话有一半是真的话，那就太可怕了。

original: Best we can hope is that whoever's doing this'll move on, or get tired of it. I just hope it happens while we still got animals left.
translation: 我们顶多也只能希望袭击者能尽早离开，或者哪天杀腻了。希望那时候咱们还能有几头牲口剩下。

original: Whoever it is, I don't think they're from around town. Seems like they've taken to shooting from the west side.
translation: 不管凶手是谁，我想应该不是这镇上的人。他们好像是从西边开的枪。

original: Beg your pardon ma'am, but them two-headed beeves ain't worth getting shot over.
translation: 请原谅，女士，为了这几只双头畜牲去玩命可太不值得了。

original: Not to mention what would happen if half of what No-bark says is true.
translation: 更何况，要是疯嘴说的那些话有一半是真的，那就太可怕了。

original: Best we can hope is that whoever's doing this'll move on, or get tired of it. I just hope it happens while we still got animals left.
translation: 我们顶多也只能希望袭击者能尽早离开，或者哪天杀腻了。希望那时候咱们还能有几头牲口剩下。

original: Whoever it is, I don't think they're from around town. Seems like they're usually shooting from the west side.
translation: 不管凶手是谁，我想应该不是这镇上的人。他们好像是从西边开的枪。

original: How is business lately?
translation: 农场近况怎么样？

original: You must mean what's left of it. Somebody's been attacking our animals at night. We're down to less than half of what we had a few weeks back.
translation: 你应该问我们还能撑得了多久。有人总在半夜袭击我们的牲口，现在我们剩下的牲口数量还不到几个礼拜前的一半。

original: Every night around midnight Alice and I'll wake up to some crazy hollering and gun shots. You'd think the world was ending all over again.
translation: 每天半夜爱丽丝和我都会被一阵疯狂的喊叫声和枪声惊醒。听那架势，还以为世界末日又来了呢。

original: But it's just one animal each night. They don't take it or carve it up or nothing. Just leave it there, all full of holes.
translation: 可每天晚上死的却只有一头牲口。他们既没把它偷走，也没削过它一块肉，就只是把它打得浑身是洞，然后丢在原地。

original: Tell me what you know about the attacks.
translation: 告诉我你们被袭击的经过。

original: Well, it's the strangest thing. Last time it happened I could swear I heard someone cry out for help. Sounded like a big fella.
translation: 更怪的还在后头。上次出事后，我发誓我听到了某个人求救的声音。而且听上去个头应该还不小。

original: But when we finally got up the gumption to go look outside all we found was our cattle. And I know what they sound like when they get upset.
translation: 可当我们终于鼓起勇气出去查看时，却只发现了我们的牛。我记得它们发脾气时的叫声，并不是这样的。

original: I can't imagine what went on. Dusty can probably tell you more about it.
translation: 我都不敢想象到底出了什么事。也许达斯蒂能告诉你更多信息。

original: What can you tell me about the attacks on your ranch?
translation: 关于袭击你们农场的人，你能描述一下吗？

original: What do you do here in Novac?
translation: 你在诺瓦克干什么工作？

original: Oh, I tend to my ranch, that's about it. Alice'll tell you. I don't get out a whole lot.
translation: 哦，我负责照看农场，也就这些了。爱丽丝会告诉你的。我不常出门。

original: I heard you've been losing livestock.
translation: 我听说你们丢了牲口。

original: Losing don't describe it. It's a massacre. Few more days and there won't be nothing left to lose.
translation: 如果只是丢了倒好，根本就是屠杀。再这样下去，过几天也就没东西可丢的了。

original: Your friends are safe. I just helped them sneak out of here.
translation: 你的朋友们安全了。我已经带他们逃出去了。

original: I haven't found her yet.
translation: 我还没找到她。

original: I'm not expecting good news, but keep looking.
translation: 我也不指望有好消息，但你再找找看吧。

original: I'll try to find your friend.
translation: 我会尽力去找你朋友的。

original: Thanks. Let me know what you find out. Here's hoping she's okay.
translation: 多谢。不管结果如何，都跟我说一声。希望她没事。

original: What can you tell me about the "demons"?
translation: 你能和我说说"魔鬼"是怎么回事吗？

original: I kill them on sight, so we haven't had much time to get acquainted.
translation: 我见一个杀一个，所以也没什么机会和他们交流沟通。

original: They're hard to see, obviously, but they aren't too smart when it comes to tactics. Or not stepping in traps.
translation: 显然他们虽然会隐身，但还没聪明到懂战术。或者规避陷阱。

original: What can you tell me about the creatures out there?
translation: 你能和我说说外面那些东西是怎么回事吗？

original: How did you end up trapped down here?
translation: 你是怎么被困在这儿的？

original: First off, I'm not trapped. This was a tactical choice, all right?
translation: 首先，我没有被困在这儿。这叫战术，好吗？

original: I'm no match for those things out there, so I found a good defensive position, and I've been defending it, right?
translation: 好汉架不住人多，所以我找了个不错的制高点，然后进行防御，懂不？

original: ...Aw, who am I fooling? I'm trapped. Name's Harland. Pleased to meet you.
translation: ……唉，我骗谁呢？我确实被困在这儿了。我叫哈兰。幸会。

original: What happened was, I was escorting folks down to work when those things attacked us.
translation: 其实是这样的，我本来是要护送一些人下去干活，结果这些家伙突然袭击了我们。

original: Most of the fight was upstairs, but some folks panicked and made for the basement. And I went after them.
translation: 大部分战斗都是在楼上发生的，但有一些人慌了神，逃到了地下室。我就跟了过来。

original: Well, turns out there were even more of those bastards down here than upstairs, and things went to shit fast.
translation: 没想到下面的狗杂种比上面还多，接着情况就迅速恶化了。

original: I couldn't find the others, so I fell back to this room and set up a nice little kill zone. End of story.
translation: 我和其他人失散了，于是我就退到了这间屋子里，设下一个小小的陷阱，就是这样了。

original: I'm not delicate. Radroach meat for protein, condensation off the pipes for water, and I do my business over in the far corner.
translation: 我不挑食。辐射蟑螂肉能补充蛋白质，管子里漏出来的水也能喝，我就这样死守着这个小角落。

original: I wouldn't say it's been comfy.
translation: 当然也谈不上舒服就是了。

original: How have you survived?
translation: 你怎么活下来的？

original: How can I help get you out of this room?
translation: 我怎么才能把你请出去呢？

original: Ha! Well, you're polite, I'll give you that. If this was just between you and me, I'd do as you ask. But it's not.
translation: 哈！好吧，我承认，你很有礼貌。如果这只是咱俩的事，你一提，我肯定照做。可惜事情没这么简单。

original: I had a friend with me when those mutant bastards came out of nowheres. She panicked and ran the wrong direction - further into the basement.
translation: 那帮混蛋变种人冒出来的时候，我有个一起的朋友。她受了惊吓，跑错了方向——反而钻进了地下更深处。

original: She's probably dead, but I ain't leaving until I know for sure. I'd have gone looking myself, except I wouldn't last a minute out there.
translation: 她很可能已经死了，但我一定要知道结果才能安心。我本来是打算自己去找她的，可我在外面怕连一分钟都待不了。

original: You, on the other hand, seem pretty resourceful. Find my friend, and I'll get out of your way.
translation: 而你，你就不同了，你看起来神通广大。去找到我的朋友，我就给你让路。

original: Looks like I have to kill you.
translation: 那我只好杀了你了。

original: Then you're dumber than you look, smoothskin. Eat this!
translation: 看来你比你长得还要愚蠢，滑皮子。看枪！

original: I need to search this room.
translation: 我需要检查一下这个房间。

original: You don't look like the other ghouls from Bright's group.
translation: 你跟辐光那伙尸鬼看着不太像啊。

original: Guess the outfit gives that away, huh? I never did buy into that religious mumbo-jumbo with the robes and all that shit.
translation: 是我这身行头让你有这样的感觉吧？我从来都不信他们那一套什么狗屁教义。

original: It gets lonely out in the wastes, okay? And I don't have to tell you that Bright's group has got some fine-looking ghoulettes in it!
translation: 但人在废土哪儿能没有伴儿呢，对吧？不用我说你也能想到，辐光的集团里还真有几个漂亮姑娘！

original: Eh... or maybe I would have to tell you...
translation: 呃……估计你也不太能理解……

original: Anyway, I helped them out, and they kept me supplied with ammo and pleasant company.
translation: 总之，我给他们帮忙，他们给我弹药补给，还提供欢乐和我相伴。还有美女作陪。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: This souvenir rocket I have glows. Will it serve as fuel?
translation: 我手上有些会发光的火箭纪念品。它能作为燃料吗？

original: Yes, that's the stuff. And the container's shielding must be intact, or you'd be dead by now.
translation: 是的，就是这个。罐子的防护层应该还完好，否则你早就玩完了。

original: You already brought me the thrust control modules, so all that's needed now is three boxes of Sugar Bombs.
translation: 你把推进力控制模块带来了，所以现在就只差三盒甜麦炮弹。

original: I found an entire container of the igniting agent.
translation: 我找到了一整罐推进剂。

original: Yes, that's the stuff. And the container's shielding must be intact, or you'd be dead by now.
translation: 是的，就是这个。罐子的防护层应该还完好，否则你早就玩完了。

original: Now all I need is the thrust control modules and three boxes of Sugar Bombs.
translation: 我现在就只差推进力控制模块和三盒甜麦炮弹了。

original: I found an entire container of the igniting agent.
translation: 我找到了一整罐推进剂。

original: Yes, that's the stuff. And the container's shielding must be intact, or you'd be dead by now.
translation: 是的，就是这个。罐子的防护层应该还完好，否则你早就死了。

original: I found an entire container of the igniting agent.
translation: 我找到了一整罐推进剂。

original: Yes, that's the stuff. And the container's shielding must be intact, or you'd be dead by now.
translation: 是的，就是这个。罐子的防护层应该还完好，否则你早就死了。

original: Now all I need is the thrust control modules.
translation: 现在就只差推进力控制模块了。

original: I found an entire container of the igniting agent.
translation: 我找到了一整罐推进剂。

original: That's all I needed to know.
translation: 我就打听这些吧。

original: Isn't it dangerous being this deep into the city?
translation: 在城市的深处难道不危险吗？

original: How did all of the Ghouls end up here?
translation: 这些尸鬼是怎么来到这的？

original: What was this place before the Ghouls moved in?
translation: 尸鬼住进来前，这是什么地方？

original: Do you know anything about Underworld?
translation: 你知道关于地下城的事吗？

original: You don't get a lot of customers, do you?
translation: 你没多少顾客对吧？

original: You run this place with Greta?
translation: 你和葛丽泰管理这地方？

original: What do you know about Underworld?
translation: 对于地下城你知道些什么？

original: He works for a guy up in Megaton. I think he might be a slave.
translation: 他在兆吨镇给一个家伙打工，我想他可能是个奴隶。

original: He's working in a bar in Megaton.
translation: 他在兆吨镇的酒吧里工作。

original: All right. I'm going to go have a look around.
translation: 好吧，我会四处看看。

original: I'm working on it, okay?
translation: 我正在处理，知道了吗？

original: Yeah, it's taken care of. Should be safe now.
translation: 很好，危机已经化解了，现在应该安全了。

original: Well, you can call Beagle a deputy so long as you don't harbor too high an opinion of the word.
translation: 呵，你可以将比格尔称作副警长，不过建议你还是别太把这个头衔当回事。

original: Boy was 'bout as useful as tits on a radscorpion. Only qualification he ever had was to be brother to the wife of the sheriff.
translation: 那小子就和辐射蝎身上的乳头一样没用。他能当上副警长，全凭他是前任警长的小舅子。

original: Still, I s'pose he don't deserve what's befell him. We would've considered paying the ransom, if we'd had caps to spare.
translation: 但就算这样，我觉得他也不该遭这份罪。我们要是有钱的话，还是会考虑赎他出来的。

original: You say Powder Gangers kidnapped Primm's deputy?
translation: 你说炸药帮绑架了普瑞姆的副警长？

original: {Sarcasm}I feel safer already. {harrumphs}Meanwhile, there's still more of them Powder Gangers out there than I care to count.
translation: {Sarcasm}我已经觉得安全多了。{harrumphs}不过，外面的炸药帮依旧多得数不过来。

original: What we need around here is a real sheriff. Someone who can help fight off the next attack.
translation: 我们需要一个真正的警长，一个能帮我们抵挡炸药帮的人。

original: I rescued Deputy Beagle.
translation: 我救了副警长比格尔。

original: Kind of too bad you didn't do it the other way around! {chuckles}Primm ain't got no future until rule of law comes back to town.
translation: 真可惜你没有用另一种方法解决问题啊！{chuckles}如果没有法律约束的话，普瑞姆是没有未来的。

original: I freed Deputy Beagle and killed the Powder Gangers.
translation: 我杀死了那些炸药帮，解救了副警长比格尔。

original: Finally decided to make yourself useful, huh? If you can bring the law back to Primm, we'll all be in your debt.
translation: 总算想做点好事了？如果你能重建普瑞姆的法律和秩序，我们就欠你一份大人情了。

original: I'll find Primm a new sheriff.
translation: 我会为普瑞姆找一个新警长。

original: Why would I deny it? I was the one that hacked that Cowboy Robot while Vance kept him busy. Ain't the first thing we stole. Won't be the last.
translation: 我不否认。是我趁着那台机器人唠叨的功夫把它黑掉的。这又不是我们第一次偷东西，也不会是最后一次。

original: I know the two of you stole Vance's gun down in Primm.
translation: 我确信是你们俩从普瑞姆偷走了万斯的枪。

original: You'll see! You'll feel stupid that you made fun of us when you learn how rich we are!
translation: 你就等着瞧吧！到时候我们俩发了大财，你就会明白当初取笑我们是有多么愚蠢了！

original: Your plan is going to get you both killed.
translation: 你们的计划纯属找死。

original: Simple! Up 'til now, we committed our crimes stealthily, leaving no evidence behind. So we never built a rep.
translation: 很简单！因为迄今为止，我们做的坏事都很隐蔽，从未留下过任何蛛丝马迹。所以我们当然没有名气啦。

original: But that's gonna change with our next score. You just wait and see.
translation: 但只要干完这一票，我们就会名扬天下。你等着瞧吧。

original: You sound pretty tough. I wonder why I've never heard of you.
translation: 听起来很厉害。可我为什么从没听说过你们呢。

original: We ain't never heard of you, either, so the not being impressed is mutual.
translation: 我们也没听说过你呀，所以咱们半斤八两咯。

original: Come a week or so, though, and everyone will've heard of Sammy and Pauline! Just you wait!
translation: 可惜再过一个礼拜，天底下的人就都会知道萨米和宝琳的大名了！你就瞧好吧！

original: You sound pretty tough. Why haven't I heard of you two before?
translation: 听起来你们很强嘛。为什么以前我从没听说过你们俩？

original: I'm Pauline, of Sammy and Pauline, the wasteland's most dangerous and notorious criminal couple!
translation: 我是宝琳，萨米和宝琳的宝琳，我们是废土上最臭名昭著的雌雄大盗！

original: You'd best not mess with us, or you'll have a bullet hole where your eye used to be!
translation: 你最好别惹我们，否则小心我在你的眼窝子里再开个洞！

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Me? I'm Sammy, of Sammy and Pauline, the wasteland's most dangerous and notorious criminal duo!
translation: 我？我是萨米，“萨米和宝琳”的萨米——我们是废土上最危险，最声名狼籍的雌雄大盗!

original: You better not mess with us or you'll end up face down in a shallow grave!
translation: 你最好别惹我们，否则我就叫你脸朝下躺坟里去！

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Dang it. I hope you'll keep looking.
translation: 真见鬼。希望你能继续找。

original: I haven't found the gun.
translation: 我还没找到那把枪。

original: Those thieves had some gall, stealing from a museum dedicated to romanticizing a couple of criminals!
translation: 这些小偷真是厚颜无耻，他们居然敢从雌雄大盗的博物馆里偷东西！

original: I'll make sure the gun ends up back on display. I thank you, Primm thanks you, and I do believe Vance'd thank you, if he could.
translation: 我会把枪重新放回陈列箱里的。谢谢，我代表普瑞姆感谢您，我相信万斯若是泉下有知，也一定会感谢您的。

original: I found the gun. Here it is.
translation: 我找到枪了。就在这里。

original: Primm Slim at your service! Authentic cowpoke and official spokesbot of the Vikki and Vance Casino and Museum! Yeehaw!
translation: 普瑞姆·斯利姆为您服务！维姬与万斯赌场兼博物馆最佳员工，官方唯一指定可以交流的机器人！咦哈！

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Have it your way, pardner. Maybe work up your curiosity by having a look at thrilling exhibits like the genuine Death Car and Vance's machine gun!
translation: 请便，朋友。或许当你看到那些让人胆寒的展品，比如货真价实的亡命飞车和万斯的机关枪时，就会按捺不住自己的好奇心啦！

original: Another time, maybe.
translation: 还是下次再聊吧。

original: Yahoo! I ain't had a chance to tell their tale in a mess of years.
translation: 好嘞！我还以为这些年再也没有机会说起他们的传奇故事了呢。

original: First things first: any bosh you've heard about Vikki and Vance being copycats ain't nothing but ill-tempered slander.
translation: 有言在先，如果你听到任何有关维姬与万斯是模仿他人的流言，那绝对是恶意中伤。

original: Fact is, they begun their crime spree two days before Bonnie and Clyde robbed their first bank - so who was copying who?
translation: 事实上，他们在雌雄大盗邦妮和克莱德抢劫第一家银行的前两天就已经在疯狂作案了——所以你觉得是谁在模仿谁？

original: Now true, Vikki and Vance didn't exactly cut a wide swath of murder and bank robbery across the central U.S., like Bonnie and Clyde did.
translation: 同时，维姬与万斯也不像雌雄大盗那样横行美国中部，大肆烧杀掠夺。

original: It was more like a narrow swath of shoplifting, check-cashing fraud, and gas pump driveoffs - but crime is crime! They drove reckless, too.
translation: 他们做的事都比较低调，比方说商店行窃啦，欺诈现金啦，还有白吃白拿什么的——但犯罪就是犯罪！别以为他们是省油的灯。

original: Having lived by the gun - well, Vance owned one, anyway - it was only fitting that the duo of desperados would die by the gun.
translation: 枪下生，枪下死——何况，万斯就有这样一把枪，一把能配得上他这样的亡命徒，让他甘愿托付身家性命的枪。

original: Perhaps it was fate itself that accidentally drove them into a crossfire between police and a gang of bank robbers in Plano, Texas.
translation: 也许真是命中注定，让他俩最终被卷入了一场发生在德克萨斯州普莱诺银行的警匪火拼。

original: Or maybe they just didn't notice until it was too late. It's been said that Vikki would have tried to cash a bad check in that bank, had she lived.
translation: 也许他们至始至终都未能发现厄运将至。维姬当时若不是想把一张空头支票在银行兑现，或许她还可以活下来。

original: We'll never know for sure. All we know is that the crossfire tore the car and both occupants to pieces, and the police issued an official apology.
translation: 我们永远也无从得知真相。我们只知道，这场火拼殃及了他们的汽车，把他们炸得粉身碎骨，随后警方还进行了公开道歉。

original: You can put your eyes on the genuine Death Car just over yonder, and there's Vance's machine gun in the case next to it!
translation: 你可以看到这辆货真价实的亡命飞车就位于那边不远处，而万斯用过的机关枪就摆在旁边的陈列箱里！

original: Tell me the whole story of Vikki and Vance.
translation: 和我说说维姬与万斯的历史故事吧。

original: You got it, Pardner. Primm Slim loves to spin a yarn.
translation: 你找对人了，朋友。普瑞姆·斯利姆就是喜欢说故事。

original: First things first: any bosh you've heard about Vikki and Vance being copycats ain't nothing but ill-tempered slander.
translation: 有言在先，如果你听到任何有关维姬与万斯是模仿他人的流言，那绝对是恶意中伤。

original: Fact is, they begun their crime spree two days before Bonnie and Clyde robbed their first bank - so who was copying who?

original: Now true, Vikki and Vance didn't exactly cut a wide swath of murder and bank robbery across the central U.S., like Bonnie and Clyde did.
translation: 同时，维姬与万斯也不像雌雄大盗那样横行美国中部，大肆烧杀掠夺。

original: It was more like a narrow swath of shoplifting, check-cashing fraud, and gas pump driveoffs - but crime is crime! They drove reckless, too.
translation: 他们做的事都比较低调，比方说商店行窃啦，欺诈现金啦，还有白吃白拿什么的——但犯罪就是犯罪！别以为他们是省油的灯。

translation: 也许真是命中注定，让他俩最终被卷入了一场发生在德克萨斯州普莱诺银行的警匪火拼。

original: Or maybe they just didn't notice until it was too late. It's been said that Vikki might have tried to cash a bad check in that bank, had she lived.
translation: 也许他们至始至终都未能发现厄运将至。维姬当时若不是想把一张空头支票在该行兑现，或许她还可以活下来。

original: We'll never know for sure. All we know is that the crossfire shot the car and both occupants to pieces, and the police issued an official apology.
translation: 我们永远也无从得知真相。我们只知道，这场火拼殃及了他们的汽车，把他们炸得粉身碎骨，随后警方还进行了公开道歉。

original: You can put your eyes on the genuine Death Car just over yonder, and there's Vance's machine gun in the case next to it!
translation: 你可以看到这辆货真价实的亡命飞车就位于那边不远处，而万斯用过的机关枪就摆在旁边的陈列箱里！

original: Tell me about Vikki and Vance again.
translation: 再和我说说维姬与万斯的故事。

original: Why, this is the Vikki and Vance Casino and Museum - Primm's Primm-eer tourist attraction and resort destination! Yeehaw!
translation: 喔，这里是维姬与万斯赌场兼博物馆，普瑞姆最不普通的度假旅游胜地！咦哈！

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: Well, thank you {emphasis}so much, so {emphasis}very much, for ruining my life.
translation: 好吧，{emphasis}太感谢你了，非常非常感谢你{emphasis}，毁了我的生活。

original: That's right - you SHOULD thank me.
translation: 没错——你理应感激我。

original: I do thank you so kindly for your efforts.
translation: 真的十分感谢你的帮助。

original: I'm still looking.
translation: 我还在找。

original: But - but the town doesn't have a Sheriff! I don't have an employer, and that means I don't have a job.
translation: 但是——但是镇里没有警长了啊！没了上司，那等于我的工作也没了。

original: If you think you might be able to help, come find me. I thank you for all you've done.
translation: 如果你愿意帮我，那就来找我吧。感谢你所作的一切。

original: I'll be going now.
translation: 我要走了。

original: Maybe next time you can bring a new sheriff back with you!
translation: 也许下次你可以带个警长回来！

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All right. Goodbye.
translation: 好吧。再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Oh no! I'm just the deputy. And I can't be a deputy without a sheriff. It's called chain of command!
translation: 不是那样的！我只是副职，如果没有警长的话，我这副职也只是个虚位。这就叫管理体系！

original: What are you talking about? You're the sheriff now!
translation: 你在说什么呢？现在你就是警长了！

original: {Edited Line}My problem is that I'm no longer a deputy. I'm just a Beagle now.
translation: {Edited Line}问题就是我不再是副警长了，我现在只是比格尔。

original: Apparently two-and-a-half months of law enforcement experience doesn't count for anything. The new regime is just that - all new.
translation: 显然我这两个半月的执法经历一文不值。现在新的老大来了——所有规矩都变了。

original: He's rude. Just don't tell him I said it. Primm has a sheriff now, just not as supportive as I would've hoped.
translation: 他是个粗人——可别说是我说的。普瑞姆现在是有了一个新警长，只不过和我预期中的有些偏差。

original: What's your problem now?
translation: 你又有什么问题？

original: {Edited Line}My problem is that I'm no longer a deputy. I'm just a Beagle now.
translation: {Edited Line}问题就是我不再是副警长了，我现在只是比格尔。

original: Apparently two-and-a-half months of law enforcement experience doesn't count for anything. The new regime is just that: all new.
translation: 显然我这两个半月的执法经历一文不值。现在新的老大来了——所有规矩都变了。

original: He's a good sheriff but a hard man. He doesn't abide by anyone slinking by the rules. I guess there won't be any trouble, but the man's law is hard.
translation: 他是个好警长，但对人太苛刻了。哪怕是最轻微的违法行为他都不能容忍。虽然我觉得这没什么问题，但他这人也太严厉了。

original: What's your problem now?
translation: 你又有什么问题？

original: {Edited Line}My problem is that I'm no longer a deputy. I'm just a Beagle now.
translation: {Edited Line}问题就是我不再是副警长了，我现在只是比格尔。

original: Slimm is alright, I don't wish him no harm, but the law to him is a set of logic.
translation: 斯利姆小子干得还不错，我不是有意要埋汰他，但法律对它来说只不过是一套程序。

original: Not everything is black and white, not sure a robot can ever understand that.
translation: 这世上的事情可不全是非黑即白那么简单，我觉得一个机器人是理解不了的。

original: What's your problem now?
translation: 你又有什么问题？

original: Thank you so much.
translation: 非常感谢。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: {sighs}I wonder what it's like to be able to "get going" whenever you like.
translation: {sighs}真希望我也能够体验"来去自如"的感觉。

original: I've got to get going.
translation: 我必须要走了。

original: I certainly hope so. It gets lonely down here on the floor.
translation: 我也这么想。这里越来越寂寞了。

original: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

original: Wait a second! I handled Silver for you, and you still want me to pay?
translation: 稍等！我为你解决了席尔瓦的麻烦，你还要我付钱吗？

original: Forget it. I'll come back.
translation: 门都没有。我会回来的。

original: Yeah, yeah. Here, take your 100 caps. I hope you choke on them.
translation: 好，好。给，你的100个瓶盖。你小心别被瓶盖压死了。

original: Fine, here's your 100 caps.
translation: 很好，这是你的100个瓶盖。

original: Why don't you come with me?
translation: 你为什么不跟我一起走？

original: No! I won't do it!
translation: 不！我不要这么做！

original: Shhh. Shhh. Can't sleep. Can't sleep. Shhh.
translation: 嘘—嘘。别睡着。不能睡着。嘘。

original: Stop it, stop it, stop it!
translation: 停下，快停下，快停下！

original: Stay in control. Stay in control.
translation: 保持镇静。保持镇静。

original: Not real. Don't look. Not real.
translation: 这是幻觉。别看。肯定是幻觉。

original: Stop talking to me!
translation: 别再说了！

original: Leave me alone!
translation: 离我远点！

original: Get outta my head!
translation: 从我脑子里面滚出去！

original: Any thoughts on where I might find some computer parts?
translation: 知道哪里可以找到电脑部件吗？

original: Any idea where I might be able to find nuclear material?
translation: 知道哪里我可以找到核原料吗？

original: Where did you say I might find some computer parts again?
translation: 你说我在哪儿能找到电脑配件？

original: And I thought I was old. It's a junkshop east and slightly north of here. There's an old woman running it. Gilbert, or something.
translation: 我还以为就只有我老了。从这里往东，再往北一点点有个垃圾店。有个叫吉尔伯特还是什么的老女人在那管事。

original: Chris said you might know where I can find computer parts.
translation: 克里斯说你知道哪儿能找到电脑配件。

original: He did, did he? I swear, I should tear the rest of the hair out of that cocksucker's head.
translation: 他告诉你的？我发誓，回去后我一定要把那个王八蛋脑袋上仅剩的几根毛全都拔光。

original: Send a rescue mission after Harland? Nah, let's just send some smoothskin whose radio got broke!
translation: 派个救援小队救哈兰？不用，派个没带对讲机的滑皮肤下去就行了！

original: Harland's tough! He probably enjoys waiting to be attacked at any moment! He probably loves eating nothing but roach meat!
translation: 哈兰厉害得很！没准他就是喜欢莫名其妙挨枪子！没准他就是喜欢吃蟑螂肉！

original: Licking up condensation from a rusted pipe is his idea of fun! So's doing his business in a corner, and smelling it for days!
translation: 舔锈管子滴下来的水，只有这样才能让他快乐！所以他才守着那个小角落，一蹲就是好几天！

original: But oh, that's right - the crisis is that you need some computer parts! Well, you can go fuck yourself until you get my friends out of this mess.
translation: 不过，哦，对——真正要紧的是你需要的那些电脑配件！很好，除非你把我的朋友全都带出这个鬼地方，否则就去你的吧！

original: Go get them yourself, then.
translation: 你自己快去赶上他们。

original: Goodbye, Amata.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔。

original: Why not come with me? There's nothing here for you anymore.
translation: 为什么不跟我一起走？这再没有值得你关心的事了。

original: The door's open. You could come with me.
translation: 门开了，你可以跟我一起走。

original: Time for me to go, Amata. My Dad's out there somewhere.
translation: 我要走了，阿玛塔。我爸爸就在外面某个地方。

original: Goodbye, Amata. It's time for me to go.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔，我要走了。

original: You could come with me, you know. Leave this place behind forever.
translation: 你知道，你可以和我一起走。永远离开这。

original: Goodbye, Amata.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔。

original: You should come with me. It's not safe for you to stay.
translation: 你该跟我一起走，你留下来不安全。

original: Goodbye, Amata.
translation: 再见，阿玛塔。

original: Can I see what you have to trade?
translation: 我能看看你有什么可交易的吗？

original: Yes, unfortunately.
translation: 是的，很不幸。

original: I see. Well, spare me the details.
translation: 我知道了。别告诉我细节。

original: Damn it, I'm going to miss that crooked, yellow smile...
translation: 该死，我会怀念她那张黄澄澄的笑脸的……

original: All right, you did your part, so I'll do mine. Look around up here if you want. I'm going to make a break for topside.
translation: 好吧，你履行了承诺，该我了。你想进就进来吧。我要上去喘口气了。

original: Are you all right? You sound... strange.
translation: 你没事吧？ 你好像……有点奇怪。

original: I am in command of my faculties! In command of my troops!
translation: 我主宰着我的身体！我主宰着我的部下！

original: Antler guides me in all things! As I in turn guide my kin!
translation: 鹿角始终指引着我！而我指引着我的族人！

original: You can release the prisoners. I promise they're no threat.
translation: 你可以释放那些囚犯了。我保证他们毫无威胁。

original: Hey, I've been there! Those Super Mutants are all dead. It's safe now.
translation: 嗨，我去过那了！那些超级变种人全死了，那边现在很安全。

original: What kind of crap is this? I already knew about Rivet City!
translation: 废话！对铆钉城我已经了解得不少了！

original: I already know about Rivet City. I was hoping for a bit more.
translation: 对铆钉城我已经了解得不少了，不过还希望知道得更多些。

original: Enough with the inane banter! Just tell me already.
translation: 废话说够了！说正经的。

original: I did my part. Now it's your turn to contribute to the Good Fight.
translation: 我做了我该做的。现在轮到你为圣战做贡献了。

original: Yes, please.
translation: 是的。

original: Okay, I'm just going to slowly walk away now...
translation: 好吧，我这就慢慢走开……

original: On second thought, stick with me for a little longer.
translation: 我想了一下，还是留在我身边吧。

original: Excellent. Will do.
translation: 好极了。遵命。

original: On second thought, stay with me.
translation: 经过考虑，留在我身边吧。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Actually I changed my mind. Let's stick together.
translation: 事实上我改主意了。让我们继续同行吧。

original: Your decisiveness is truly a wonder to behold, boss.
translation: 你这优柔寡断的性格可真称得上是个奇观哪，老大。

original: On second thought, you've been pretty useful so far. Forget what I said.
translation: 我想了一下，你还是蛮有用的，忘了我说的话吧。

original: {"Thought so."}Mmm hm.
What is this, the Hokey Pokey?
translation: 怎么着，耍猴呢？

original: {Happy Beep}<Makes beeping sounds>
translation: {Happy Beep}<发出哔哔声>

original: <Companion Protocol::Continue Companion Protocol>
translation: <同伴协定::继续同伴协定>

original: {happy bark}<bark!>
translation: {happy bark}<犬吠！>

original: Don't be playing with my heart now, gets me pissed.
translation: 别玩弄我的心，我会被惹毛的。

original: You {emph}sure now? All right.
translation: 你{emph}确定？ 好吧。

original: Either shoot or don't, but don't be wishing and washing about it.
translation: 要走就走，要留就留，别翻来覆去耍嘴皮子玩。

original: {Mutters}You're like a switchblade stuck on flick.
translation: {Mutters}你这人怎么就跟卡着的弹簧刀似的。

original: {Told to stay or go}Going to give a lightswitch a run for its money. Click click click.
translation: {Told to stay or go}你这德行简直就跟电门似的，咔嗒咔嗒来回扳个不停。

original: Oh, pumpkin, you make {gramma}grandma so happy!
translation: 哦，小南瓜，你太让{gramma}奶奶高兴了。

original: Yes, I'm sure.
translation: 是的，我确定。

original: All right. Guess I'll be around Novac for a while longer, until I figure out what I want to do with myself. See you around.
translation: 好吧。我估计会回诺瓦克待一段时间，想清楚自己究竟该干什么。再见。

original: Yeah, that's what I think. You should head back home.
translation: 是，我是这么想的。你应该回家去。

original: That's why you're the boss. You always make the right decisions. I'll just head home. Home to my lonely, abandoned shack in the middle of nowhere.
translation: 所以你才能当老大啊，你的决定永远正确，我马上就回家，回我那风雨飘摇的小破屋去。

original: I think it's for the best.
translation: 我认为这是最好的方法。

original: Okay. Then I guess I'll be back at the 188. Maybe digging in some dirt for scrap metal or something.
translation: 好的。我想我会回188号贸易站的。也许还会在那儿挖点废旧金属呢。

original: I just think we should right now.
translation: 我认为我们现在就该这样做。

original: {Confirmation Beep}<Makes beeping sounds>
translation: {Confirmation Beep}<发出哔哔声>

original: <Companion Protocol::End Companion Protocol>
translation: <同伴协议::结束同伴协定>

original: I'll head back to the Old Mormon Fort. If you need me, just swing by.
translation: 我会回旧摩门教要塞的。如果你需要，随时都可以来找我。

original: {whimper}<whimper>
translation: {whimper}<呜咽>

original: {Slight sass, told to leave}Fine then.
translation: {Slight sass，told to leave}好吧。

original: {Slight sass, told to leave}I'll get out of your hair, then.
translation: {Slight sass，told to leave}那么我马上离你远远的。

original: All right, then, dearie. Now you promise to come visit {gramma}grandma soon, you hear?
translation: 好的，亲爱的，答应我要经常来看看{gramma}奶奶哦，听见了吗？

original: I'll miss you too, Lily, but it's time.
translation: 我也会想你的，莉莉，但是时候到了。

original: I found Argyle. I'm afraid he's dead.
translation: 我找到阿盖尔了。恐怕他已经死了。

original: Tell me about Argyle.
translation: 跟我说说阿盖尔吧。

original: You mentioned something about GNR?
translation: 你提到了银新台？

original: I saw the Family's mark on the wall. What's up with that?
translation: 我在墙上看到家族的标志，发生了什么事？

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Do you really believe in vampires?
translation: 你真的相信血族？

original: Did you ever talk to your parents about it?
translation: 你父母知道这事吗？

original: What did Lucy say she saw you do to that Wastelander?
translation: 当你杀了那废土客，露西说了什么？

original: When did you first discover you had the hunger?
translation: 你头一次发现你有这种饥饿感是什么时候？

original: Would you mind if I asked about your unusual hunger?
translation: 问下你那不寻常的饥饿感，你介意吗？

original: No, thanks.
translation: 不了，谢谢。

original: If that's the way you want it, it's all the same to me.
translation: 如果这是你想要的，对我来说都一样。

original: In that case, stand just like that for a second. I want to make some toast.
translation: 那样的话，你能不能先别走。我想在你身上烤个面包。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: All right, but don't blame me if you end up sterile.
translation: 好吧，但你要是绝后了，可别赖我啊。

original: Whatever you say. Hey, is that a little patch of ghoul rot on your cheek there?
translation: 随便你。嘿，你脸上那块是尸鬼的腐肉吗？

original: Suit yourself. I'm sure there are ghouls and other mutants who once said the same thing.
translation: 随你的便吧。我敢肯定以前有些尸鬼和变种人也说过类似的话。

original: Do it.
translation: 来吧。

original: Then I can't help you. Sorry.
translation: 那我帮不了你。对不起。

original: I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 我没有100个瓶盖。

original: And a quick shot... all done.
translation: 再来一针...全部完成。

original: Okay. And remember, if this doesn't help, try taking a bath in tomato juice.
translation: 好的。记住，如果没用，那就用番茄汁洗澡。

original: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
translation: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

original: Okay... all done.
translation: 好……搞定了。

original: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
translation: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

original: Just stand still and try to ignore the tingling.
translation: 站着别动就行了，如果感觉刺痛也不要理睬。

original: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
translation: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

original: This might tickle a little. Or it might cause searing, agonizing pain to shoot through your body. You never know.
translation: 可能会有点发痒，也可能会产生烧灼感，甚至可能会有深入骨髓的剧痛。很难讲。

original: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
translation: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

original: I bet you could make some of the money letting people work on their tans next to you.
translation: 要我说，你完全可以让别人在你身边晒个日光浴，保证能让你发大财。

original: I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 我没有100个瓶盖。

original: Well, come back when you do. I'll be here.
translation: 好吧，随时可以回来找我。我就在这儿。

original: I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 我没有100个瓶盖。

original: Well, if you scrounge it up, the help is here waiting for you.
translation: 好吧，你要是再遇到什么问题，都可以来找我。

original: I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 我没有100个瓶盖。

original: Then I can't help you much. Now, maybe if you enlisted....
translation: 那样恐怕我就帮不了你了。如果你愿意参军的话……

original: Sorry, I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 抱歉，我没有100瓶盖。

original: Here we go. You'll be rad-free in no time.
translation: 好的，很快你就不用再忍受辐射了。

original: Here's your 100 caps. Do it.
translation: 这是100个瓶盖，来吧。

original: Then I can't help, sorry. Just following protocol.
translation: 我不能帮你，抱歉。这儿有规定。

original: Sorry, I don't have 100 caps.
translation: 抱歉，我没有100瓶盖。

original: Can you heal my radiation?
translation: 你能治疗我的辐射吗？

original: I don't give my help to enemies of the NCR. Maybe you can find a raider "medic" to fix you up.
translation: 我不会帮助NCR的敌人。你可以去找个掠夺者赤脚"医生"来帮你解决问题。

original: Are you sure? You won't be able to read in the dark as well.
translation: 你当真吗？那样你以后就不能在躲在暗处看书了哦。

original: Sure. I can help you out.
translation: 当然。我能帮你。

original: Well, one thing we do have is a good supply of Rad-Away. Sure, I can help you with that.
translation: 好吧，好消息是，我们的辐特宁还算充足。当然，我可以帮你。

original: No, sorry, we're totally unprepared to deal with radiation sickness.
translation: 抱歉，我们没有处理辐射病的经验。

original: Ha ha, just kidding, of course I can!
translation: 哈哈，开个玩笑，我当然能！

original: We always make sure to keep an ample supply of Rad-Away. Most of us haven't had the exposure outsiders like you take for granted.
translation: 我们总是会尽量保证辐特宁的储备充足。毕竟对你们外来者辐射是家常便饭，对我们可不同。

original: Sure can. Quick and easy.
translation: 当然能。很快就好。

original: Who the hell are you supposed to be?
translation: 你他妈的是谁？

original: Wait, you're Ian West? I have this letter for you from your sister!
translation: 等等，你是伊恩·维斯特？你姐姐要我带封信给你！

original: Sorry, pal. Vance is worm food.
translation: 对不起，朋友。万斯已经成了虫子的食物了。

original: Are you a prisoner here or something?
translation: 你是囚犯还是什么？

original: Looks like I'm breaking you out of your cell...
translation: 看起来好像是我把你从囚室里救了出来……

original: What the hell is your problem?
translation: 你到底有什么问题？

original: I have no clue what you're talking about.
translation: 你说完全不知道你在说什么。

original: Calm down, Ian. Tell me everything from the beginning.
translation: 冷静，伊恩，从头告诉我整件事。

original: Is there someplace I can sleep?
translation: 有我能睡觉的地方吗？

original: Let's trade.
translation: 我们来交易。

original: What's with all the names? Bob, Herbert and Harold? I don't get it.
translation: 鲍勃、赫伯特和哈罗德？这些名字都在指谁？我搞不懂。

original: I'm not a charity. You want to die, cough up some caps.
translation: 我可不是慈善机构。你想死，就拿出点瓶盖来。

original: You're mostly a tree, right? Can't I just burn you down?
translation: 你大体上是一棵树，对吧？我能不能直接把你烧掉？

original: I'd like a haircut please.
translation: 我要理发。

original: Certainly. I am programmed with a multitude of hair shaping scenarios, if you would care to choose one, I would be happy to replicate it for you.
translation: 愿意效劳。我的数据库里保存了大量的发型数据。您看中哪一个，我就为您剪哪一个。

original: Tell me about the Rebels.
translation: 跟我说说这些反叛者。

original: Tell me about the rebels.
translation: 跟我说说这些反叛者。

original: What happened down here?
translation: 这儿发生了什么？

original: Where can I rent a bed?
translation: 我能在哪租到床？

original: I'm the one who saved the kids from Paradise Falls.
translation: 是我从堕落天堂救了这些孩子。

original: What can you tell me about Mabel Henderson?
translation: 你能跟我说说梅布尔·亨德森吗？

original: Sorry, sounds like suicide. Be my guest.
translation: 抱歉，这听起来像是自杀。请便。

original: Start from the beginning.
translation: 从头开始。

original: Tell me what's going on and I'll see if I can help.
translation: 告诉我出了什么事，看我能否帮忙。

original: Your team's still alive... I heard their distress signal!
translation: 你的队伍还活着……我收到了他们的求救信号！

original: I saved the Vault, and now you're kicking me out?
translation: 我救了避难所，而你却要把我赶出去？

original: I understand. Goodbye, Amata.
translation: 我懂了。再见，阿玛塔。

original: Why don't you just forget about it and clear on out of here?
translation: 你为什么不忘掉它，然后离开这？

original: Look, anything else you can do to help might save lives.
translation: 听着，你可以再做点别的，或许还能救几条命。

original: Will's dad was scary? How so?
translation: 威尔的爸爸很恐怖？你怎么会这么觉得？

original: How about Will's parents?
translation: 威尔的父母怎么样？

original: So, you and Will were good friends?
translation: 这么说你和威尔是好朋友？

original: Where did the Brandices live?
translation: 布兰迪斯一家住在哪？

original: About the other people from Grayditch...
translation: 说说格雷蒂奇其他的人……

original: Tell me about the Brandice Family.
translation: 跟我说说布兰迪斯一家的情况。

original: Tell me about this "Doc Lesko."
translation: 跟我说说这“莱斯科博士”。

original: Mind if I ask about some of the people who lived here?
translation: 介不介意我问一下住在这的人？

original: I heard you bake really tasty pies. Can you make one for me?
translation: 我听说你烤的派超美味，能满足下我的胃吗？

original: Dad? Is that really you?
translation: 爸爸？真的是你吗？

original: You want help? Fork over some caps, Einstein.
translation: 你要帮忙？那就给点瓶盖吧，爱因斯坦。

original: Books aren't going to buy me new ammunition.
translation: 书本可不会给我买新弹药。

original: No reward needed Doc, I'll be glad to help.
translation: 不需要回报，博士，我很乐意帮忙。

original: Is there anyone on this ship named Pinkerton?
translation: 这船上有个叫平克顿的人吗？

original: You know what, keep your caps and I'll tell Moriarty you're gone.
translation: 这样吧，留着你的瓶盖，我会告诉莫里亚蒂你已经走了。

original: This is a hefty task, Doc. I'm going to need serious incentive.
translation: 这是艰巨的任务，博士，我需要点强力的激励。

original: So you want me to pop the Queen, huh?
translation: 你是要我用枪干掉蚁后，呃？

original: Why not just kill the Queen and be done with it?
translation: 为什么不直接干掉蚁后，那不就全搞定了？

original: If the Queen's your concern, why not deal with it directly?
translation: 如果问题出在蚁后身上，为什么不直接把她处理掉？

original: So? It's your mistake Doc, you fix it.
translation: 那是你犯下的错误，博士，你自己处理吧。

original: What exactly do you need?
translation: 直说吧，你要我怎么帮忙？

original: What can I do to help?
translation: 我能帮忙做什么？

original: Mutagenic Bio-what?
translation: “突变体基因活性增强剂”是什么？

original: This will stop the Fire Ants?
translation: 这能阻止火蚁吗？

original: I hope that's everything, I've had enough of ants.
translation: 我希望这就是全部了，我受够蚂蚁了。

original: Just how will all this undo the mayhem you've caused?
translation: 这一切将会如何化解你造成的混乱？

original: I found him, actually... inside Marigold Metro.
translation: 我找到他了，事实上……是在玛丽戈德地铁里。

original: Do you trust Lesko?
translation: 你信任莱斯科吗？

original: Before Lesko showed up, were there ever ants in Grayditch?
translation: 莱斯科来这之前，格雷蒂奇就有蚂蚁了吗？

original: Did your pappa ever tell you what he thought of Lesko?
translation: 你爸爸怎么看待莱斯科？

original: Mind if I ask you some important stuff about Doctor Lesko?
translation: 介不介意我问一下莱斯科博士的一些事？

original: Haven't found a thing. (Lie)
translation: 还没找到。(撒谎)

original: I know where the Ant Queen lives.
translation: 我知道蚁后在哪。

original: Don't worry, Bryan... I think I know how to take care of these ants.
translation: 别着急，布赖恩……我想我知道怎么处理这些蚂蚁。

original: All the ants are dead so I'm done here. Go home.
translation: 所有蚂蚁都死了，我的事也做完了。回家吧。

original: It's a slave collar, I sold your dumb ass for caps.
translation: 这是奴隶项圈，我把你这蠢货卖了换瓶盖。

original: Something to remember me by. It'll lead you home.
translation: 这给你留作纪念。它会指引你回家的路。

original: It's a Paradise Welcome Necklace. It'll help you find your way, you lucky devil!
translation: 这是一条天堂欢迎项圈。它会帮你找到方向，你这幸运的家伙！

original: Sure did. It's a beautiful place called Paradise Falls. Here, put this on.
translation: 当然。那是个名叫堕落天堂的漂亮地方，给，戴上这个。

original: I found a place with lots of kids your age. I'll tell you how to get there.
translation: 我找到了一个有很多和你同龄孩子的地方。我会告诉你怎么去那里。

original: I sure did, Bryan. Vera said she'd take you in!
translation: 当然，布赖恩。薇拉说她愿意收留你！

original: Actually, I give up. I can't find anywhere that will take you in.
translation: 事实上，我放弃了。我找不到任何肯收留你的地方。

original: Actually, I'm not ready yet.
translation: 事实上，我还没准备好。

original: I'd like the Ant Sight to increase my perception.
translation: 我想用“蚁之感”提升我的感知力。

original: I'd like the Ant Might to increase my physical strength.
translation: 我想用“蚁之力”提升我的身体力量。

original: I'm ready for my Mutagenic Bioenhancer injection and Lab Coat, Doctor.
translation: 我准备好接受我的诱变生物增强剂注射和实验外套了，博士。

original: Your theories were in error, and beyond correction. I had no choice.
translation: 你的理论是错的，完全是南辕北辙，我别无选择。

original: Because you're out of your mind!
translation: 因为你精神不正常！

original: I can't let you risk people's lives for an experiment.
translation: 我不可以让你用人们的生命危险做实验。

original: It was for the greater good Lesko. Man is not ready to play God.
translation: 这对你有好处，人类不能扮演上帝。

original: I've killed the Ant Queen and I destroyed your mutagen supply.
translation: 我杀了蚁后，毁了你的诱变剂。

original: I've killed all of the Nest Guardians, but I destroyed your mutagen supply.
translation: 我杀了所有的守卫蚁，但我毁了你的诱变剂。

original: Actually, my mistake... I'm not done yet.
translation: 事实上，是我的错……我还没搞定。

original: I've killed all the Nest Guardians [Lie]
translation: 我杀光了所有的巢穴守卫者 [撒谎]

original: My work is done, Doctor.
translation: 我的工作完成了，博士。

original: I've killed all the Nest Guardians.
translation: 我杀光了所有的巢穴守卫者。

original: I've destroyed your mutagen sample.
translation: 我毁了你的诱变剂样本。

original: What kind of work do you do in here?
translation: 你在这做什么工作？

original: What are you doing here in this wrecked part of the ship?
translation: 你在断裂的船头做什么？

original: I’m sorry about this, I really am. But it’s true. You’re not human.
translation: 对此我很抱歉，真的很抱歉。但这是事实，你不是人类。

original: You were made to look and act human. But you’re not. The evidence proves that.
translation: 你被做成外貌、举止都像人，但你不是。证据就摆在那。

original: It’s not real blood, Harkness. It’s synthetic, just like everything else.
translation: 那不是真血，哈克尼斯。是合成的，和其他东西一样。

original: I need to know more about what I'm dealing with. What is an android exactly?
translation: 我需要知道更多关于我在处理的是什么。仿真人到底是什么？

original: So tell me about the Commonwealth.
translation: 跟我说说联邦。

original: I got my own problems right now, kid.
translation: 我自己都有一堆麻烦事，孩子。

original: Sorry, kid. Help costs caps, and you look pretty broke to me.
translation: 对不起，孩子。帮助不是免费的，而你看起来没什么钱。

original: If you're talking about the Fire Ants, I'm already working on it.
translation: 如果你说的是那些火蚁，我已经把它们搞定了。

original: That's wonderful, kid. Now scram.
translation: 好极了，孩子。赶快滚开。

original: Calm down, calm down. Just who the heck are you?
translation: 冷静，冷静，你是哪个小鬼？

original: Hey, are you okay? You shouldn't be alone in a place like this.
translation: 嗨，你没事吧？你不该独自跑到这鬼地方来。

original: Hold on. You're in the Tunnel Snakes? You guys really do rule!
translation: 等等，你是穴蛇帮？你们这些家伙真的主宰了一切！

original: What did you hear from the guards?
translation: 你从警卫那听到什么？

original: How the heck can an ant breathe fire?
translation: 蚂蚁怎么会喷火？

original: You should have at least told him you were alive. He thought he was alone.
translation: 你至少该告诉他，你还活着。他觉得他很孤单。

original: Don't you realize you've ruined his entire life?
translation: 你难道没意识到你已经毁了他的整个生活？

original: Can't you take responsibility for his father's death?
translation: 难道你不该对他父亲的死负责？

original: Who the hell is Bryan Wilks?
translation: 布赖恩·威尔克斯他妈的是谁？

original: Wilks? I have no idea what you mean.
translation: 威尔克斯？我不明白你的意思。

original: I'd be glad to help him. Who is he?
translation: 我很乐意帮助他，他是谁？

original: You've betrayed Doctor Li, and my father.
translation: 你背叛了李博士和我父亲。

original: Have you seen my dad?
translation: 见过我爸爸吗？

original: Never mind. I'll be going.
translation: 没关系，我要走了。

original: Tell me more about this place.
translation: 再多跟我谈谈这地方。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: What have you done with my father?
translation: 你对我父亲做了什么？

original: I just wanted to say thanks, and good luck.
translation: 我只想说谢谢，祝你好运。

original: I changed my mind. I'll do it. I'll put in the code.
translation: 我改变主意了。我会输入密码。

original: Sorry, I didn't expect to bump into anyone alive down here.
translation: 抱歉，我没想到这还能撞见活人。

original: Hey, it's none of my business.
translation: 嗨，这不关我事。

original: What are you doing now?
translation: 你在做什么？

original: Why do you think the Enclave attacked Project Purity?
translation: 你觉得英克雷为什么要攻击净水工程？

original: Where can I buy more things for my place?
translation: 我要到哪为我的房间购买更多的设备？

original: No, thanks.
translation: 不了，谢谢。

original: Sure, I'll take it!
translation: 行，我要了！

original: I'll take it for 50 caps.
translation: 我出50瓶盖买了。

original: You got any snake oil in there as well?
translation: 你这儿不会还掺了狗皮膏药吧？

original: How is it better than a regular Nuka-Cola?
translation: 比普通的核子可乐好在哪？

original: Shut up and make some sense!
translation: 冷静，说清楚点！

original: Who's burning what?
translation: 谁烧了什么？

original: Calm down! Let me try and help you.
translation: 冷静！让我帮帮你。

original: The Wasteland is as dead as you're going to be if you don't tell me the truth!
translation: 你要是不跟我说实话，就会和废土一样死寂！

original: What are you, crazy or something?
translation: 你怎么回事，疯了还是怎么着？

original: What is it? What did you see?
translation: 它是什么？你看见了什么？

original: My mistake. I thought you were someone else.
translation: 我的错，我把你当成别人了。

original: Life sucks, then you die. You may as well get that through your thick skull.
translation: 活着无聊，然后死去。用你的笨脑子也能想明白。

original: Happy? Sure, I guess you could call it that.
translation: 快乐？当然，我猜你也可以这么说。

original: I've been worried about you. You don't exactly seem cut out for this place.
translation: 我担心你，你真的不适合待在这。

original: Now that's what I call payment.
translation: 那就是我想要的报答。

original: Wow, thanks!
translation: 哇哦，谢谢！

original: I don't know what to say. What do I owe ya?
translation: 我不知道说什么，我怎么感谢你？

original: What are you doing, following me?
translation: 你在干嘛，跟踪我吗？

original: No problem. What are you doing out here?
translation: 没问题，你到这来做什么？

original: Donovan! What are you doing in these parts?
translation: 多诺万！你在这地方做什么？

original: Did you say a city of Ghouls?
translation: 你是说尸鬼之城？

original: "Other assholes"?
translation: “其他混蛋”？

original: I'm not a tourist...
translation: 我不是游客……

original: You're crazy to stand out here! Aren't you afraid of the Super Mutants?
translation: 你们待在这地方肯定是疯了！难道你们不怕超级变种人？

original: Um... Where the hell did you come from?
translation: 呃……你他妈的是从哪来的？

original: What does the Nuka-Cola machine dispense?
translation: 核子可乐机是用来做什么的？

original: The Nuka-Cola machine will dispense Ice Cold Nuka-Cola.
translation: 核子可乐机里出来的东西是冰镇核子可乐。

original: Once you've dispensed 8 of them, the machine will have to be restocked in order to make regular Nuka-Colas ice cold.
translation: 一旦做出了八瓶冰镇核子可乐，那么你就必须把机器里的冰镇可乐替换掉，才能让机器重新开始运作冷冻程序。

original: Can you explain what the Workbench is for?
translation: 你能不能解释下工作台是做什么的？

original: If you come across any schematics in the Wasteland, you'll be able to construct its contents on this specially designed table.
translation: 如果你在废土上碰巧发现了某些武器的蓝图，你就可以利用这个工作台把它制造出来。

original: What does my Jukebox do?
translation: 自动点唱机有什么用？

original: Just switch on the Jukebox, and instantly the room will fill with music to keep you entertained.
translation: 只需打开点唱机，整个屋子里就会充满可以让你放松的音乐。

original: The music selections have been hand picked by none other than Three Dog of Galaxy News Radio.
translation: 音乐都是由三狗主持的银河新闻广播电台精选出来的。

original: Can you explain how the My First Laboratory works?
translation: 你能解释下生化实验台是怎么工作的？

original: From the keen minds at Med-Tek, the My First Laboratory will instantly detoxify you, removing any nasty addictions from your body.
translation: 得益于医疗科技公司的伟大技术，“个人自助试验台”能够立刻清除你身上所有的毒素，消除你所染上的瘾症。

original: If you're feeling the need to experiment, just set the lab to "brew" and a day later, it will produce a random useful compound.
translation: 如果你想做要做实验的话，只需把试验台调到“酿造”这一功能上，一天以后，它就可以合成出一剂随机的药物。

original: Remember that while the lab is brewing, you can't use the detoxify functions.
translation: 切记，当实验室在合成药品的时候，你是无法使用解毒功能的。

original: Can you explain how the My First Infirmary works?
translation: 你能解释下自动治疗仪是怎么工作的？

original: An innovation from Med-Tek, the My First Infirmary will automatically diagnose and treat any injury you might sustain.
translation: 作为医疗科技公司的一项伟大发明，“个人治疗仪能自动诊断并治疗你身上所有的外伤。

original: It will also make any of the pesky rads you've accumulated in the Wasteland vanish instantly.
translation: 它也会把你在废土上游荡时积累下来的辐射全部清除干净。

original: What's with those things behind the glass?
translation: 玻璃后的那些东西是什么？

original: Blessings to you, too. Surely, you would care to give a tithe for that wisdom?
translation: 也祝福你。当然了，你介不介意为那点智慧做点施舍？

original: I never meant it like all that. It's just supposed to help you stay alive.
translation: 我从没想过它会那么重要，它只是应该用来帮助你们活下去。

original: No. Why don't you tell me about it? <Lie>
translation: 不，为什么你不和我说说这个？<撒谎>

original: Read it? I helped write it!
translation: 读它？就是我帮助写成了它！

original: You must be crazy. It's never a good day out here.
translation: 你肯定是疯了，这绝不会有什么好日子。

original: Why are you so happy?
translation: 你为什么这么高兴？

original: Actually, I helped write that book.
translation: 事实上，我协助撰写了那本书。

original: Two meals a day doesn't sound like much.
translation: 一天两顿饭听起来少了点。

original: Oh, I am hunting. I'm hunting what you've got.
translation: 哦，我在打猎，打你身上东西的猎。

original: Maybe the book's fine, and you're just an idiot.
translation: 或许这本书不错，而你只是个白痴。

original: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it really that bad?
translation: 听到这个我很遗憾，它真的那么糟？

original: Actually, I helped write that book.
translation: 事实上，我协助撰写了那本书。

original: Book? What book?
translation: 书？什么书？

original: Just be glad you're still alive.
translation: 很高兴你还活着。

original: What book?
translation: 什么书？

original: Fine, I like it better up here than I ever did down there.
translation: 很好，比起下面，我更喜欢待在这里。

original: Well, don't let me hold you up.
translation: 不妨碍你了。

original: I miss her, too. Give my warmest regards to the Vault, would you?
translation: 我也想她。替我向避难所问好，行吗？

original: Doesn't really make a difference to me. I was exiled, remember?
translation: 这对我来说没什么区别。我被赶出来了，记得吗？

original: So, does that mean I can come back?
translation: 就是说，我能回去了？

original: I never expected to see you out here, either. I'm surprised you're alive.
translation: 我也从没指望在这见到你，没想到你还活着。

original: Good to see you, Susie! Looks like you're doing well.
translation: 看见你真好，苏茜！看起来你们情况不错。

original: I've got to go now.
translation: 我现在得走了。

original: You're obviously crazier than they are. Why would I listen to you?
translation: 你显然比他们更加疯狂。我为什么要听你的？

original: I'm not the killing type.
translation: 我不是那种会杀人的人。

original: You've become an important part of their life. Without you, they're lost.
translation: 你已经成为他们生活中重要的一部分。没有你，他们会不知所措。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他事。

original: Which Treeminder do you get along with the best?
translation: 你和哪位护树人相处得最好？

original: How do the Treeminders normally handle other Outsiders?
translation: 树启者通常怎样对待其他的外来者？

original: Did you ever ask one of them to kill you?
translation: 你之前有要求过他们中某人杀了你吗？

original: About those Treeminders...
translation: 关于那些树启者……

original: Nevermind.
translation: 没关系。

original: What, just give it to you? Hell no.
translation: 什么，白送？见鬼，不。

original: I knew it was too good to be true... there are no good souls in the Wasteland.
translation: 我就知道这一切美好得令人难以置信...废土上没有善良的灵魂。

original: Go. Just leave me alone to die...
translation: 走吧。就让我一个人死去吧...

original: I... I understand. You have to look out for yourself.
translation: 我...我明白了。你得照顾好自己。

original: Just leave me...
translation: 别管我了...

original: I insist, my friend. It's the least I can do to help.
translation: 收下吧，我的朋友。这是起码该做的。

original: Really? Seriously? My God. Thank you. Thank you so much. I'll never forget this!
translation: 真的？你是认真的？我的上帝，谢谢你！非常感谢。我永远不会忘记这件事！

original: Water... precious water... thank you! You're a saint!
translation: 水...珍贵的水...谢谢你！你真是个圣人！

original: My... thank you. Thank you so much. You've saved my life. Bless you.
translation: 我的...谢谢你！非常感谢。你救了我的命，祝福你。

original: What is this place? Some kind of city?
translation: 这是什么地方？某个城市？

original: No. Find your own water.
translation: 没有，你自己去找水吧。

original: Oh... I guess that's understandable. Got to watch out for numero uno and all.
translation: 哦...我想这是可以理解的。得提防着一号人物什么的。

original: Just leave me...
translation: 别管我了...

original: I... I understand. You have to look out for yourself.
translation: 我...我明白了。你得照顾好自己。

original: Just leave me...
translation: 别管我了...

original: You mean... you don't want anything for it? I don't have any caps or anything...
translation: 你的意思是...你不需要任何东西吗？我没有瓶盖什么的...

original: I can just have it? For free?
translation: 我可以拿走吗？免费的？

original: Here. Have this Purified Water.
translation: 给，给你这瓶净水。

original: You... are you serious? I can't offer anything in exchange, you know?
translation: 你...你是认真的吗？我不能提供任何东西作为交换，你知道吗？

original: I can just have it? For free?
translation: 我可以拿走吗？免费的？

original: Here. Have this Purified Water.
translation: 给，给你这瓶净水。

original: I've been drinking whatever I can find, but I can't do it anymore. I need purified water.
translation: 我一直在喝我能找到的任何东西，但我再也喝不下去了。我需要纯净水。

original: Please... if you find any...
translation: 请...如果你找到任何...

original: All I have is irradiated water.
translation: 我只有被辐射过的水。

original: Please, if you find some... please...
translation: 求你了，如果你有...拜托...

original: I'm sorry. I don't have any water to give you.
translation: 抱歉，我没有水给你。

original: Will any water do?
translation: 随便什么水都可以吗？

original: I've been drinking this irradiated shit and... I can't do it. I just throw it up now. I need purified water... please...
translation: 我一直在喝这种辐照的狗屎，而且...我做不到，我现在只想把它吐出来。我需要纯净水...拜托...

original: Timmy Neusbaum? Who's that?
translation: 提米·纽斯保？那是谁？

original: Do you sell any specialty items?
translation: 你有没有什么特别的货色？

original: If this android "wandered" off, why would he want a new mind and face?
translation: 如果这仿真人是“走失”，为什么他会想要新的心智和面孔？

original: Okay, so if others have escaped... why are you coming after this one?
translation: 好吧，既然其他人也跑了……你为什么还要来追这一个？

original: Why would an android feel guilt? Come on, Zimmer, what aren't you telling me?
translation: 为什么一个仿真人会感到愧疚？拜托，齐默，你有什么没告诉我的吗？

original: Well, you found me. Now try and kill me, tough guy.
translation: 你找到了我。来试试杀死我，硬汉。

original: The Nuka-Cola Corporation had her killed! (Lie)
translation: 核子可乐公司害死了她！(撒谎)

original: Yeah, it's a shame. She was beautiful.
translation: 是的，可惜，她那么美。

original: Where was Vault 87 again?
translation: 再问下87号避难所在哪？

original: My father was looking for something called a G.E.C.K. Do you have one?
translation: 我父亲在找名叫伊甸园创造器的东西，你有吗？

original: What the hell just happened?
translation: 究竟发生了什么？

original: The gate's open. Run for it!
translation: 大门开了，快跑！

original: I'm interested in the Love Machine Theme.
translation: 我对性爱装饰主题有兴趣。

original: I'm interested in the Love Machine Theme.
translation: 我对性爱装饰主题有兴趣。

original: You're forcing me to do things against my nature, and I hate you for it.
translation: 你在强迫我做违背我本性的事，我恨你。

original: I don't want to do this... But I will.
translation: 我不想做这事……但我会做的。

original: So it's not yours? Oops.
translation: 它不是你的？哎哟。

original: What am I supposed to be doing again?
translation: 再说一遍，我该怎么做？

original: Zimmer thought you were an android. Don't worry, I set him straight.
translation: 齐默认为你是一个人造人。别担心，我把他纠正过来。

original: The android is dead. See, here's an internal component. <Lie.>
translation: 人造人死了。看，这是一个零件。<撒谎。>

original: So what's this stuff you gave me, these are... android guts?
translation: 那么你给我的是些什么玩意，这些是……人造人内脏？

original: Do you know this android personally?
translation: 你自己了解这个人造人吗？

original: Tell me more about you. You help androids escape?
translation: 跟我详细的讲讲你自己。你帮助人造人们逃跑？

original: Really, I just kinda stumbled onto all of this. I'm mostly just curious is all.
translation: 真的，我只是有点困惑，对这些主要是觉得好奇。

original: I wonder who wants the android more... care to put a price on the android?
translation: 我想知道谁要更多人造人……人造人的价钱？

original: Look, I'm just trying to find out more so I can help this android.
translation: 听着，我只是在作进一步调查，来帮助这人造人。

original: Clearly I'm onto something important. What's your stake in all of this?
translation: 很明显我现在处在一件很重要的事中，你会有什么好处？

original: The Commonwealth? What's that?
translation: 联邦？那是什么？

original: My interest in the android is none of your business.
translation: 我对这人造人的兴趣与你无关。

original: There's something you aren't telling me. Isn't there?
translation: 有些事你没告诉我，对吧？

original: What if this evidence doesn't work? What if Harkness doesn't believe me?
translation: 如果这证据不起作用，该怎么做？要是哈克尼斯不相信我，又该如何？

original: Harkness should be told. You'd want to know if you were an android.
translation: 应该把事实告诉哈克尼斯。如果你是个人造人，你就能明白了。

original: Sorry Harkness, but this is the only way. Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet.
translation: 抱歉，哈克尼斯，但这是唯一的办法。激活A3-21回忆代码 Violet。

original: Welcome back to reality, you filthy android. Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet.
translation: 欢迎回到现实，你这恶心的仿真人。激活A3-21回忆代码 Violet。

original: Sorry Harkness, but this is the only way. Activate A3-21 Recall Code Violet.
translation: 抱歉，哈克尼斯，但这是唯一的办法。激活A3-21回忆代码 Violet。

original: What do you know about the Commonwealth?
translation: 你对联邦知道些什么？

original: What do you know about this android Railroad?
translation: 你对于人造人“铁路”都知道些什么？

original: So why'd you help the android?
translation: 那么你为什么帮助这人造人？

original: So what do I call you, now? Harkness or A3-21?
translation: 那么，我现在该怎么称呼你，哈克尼斯还是A3-21？

original: Well... now that you know the truth. What are you going to do?
translation: 嗯……既然你知道了真相。那你打算怎么办？

original: So why did you do go ahead with the change? Was it worth it?
translation: 那你为什么要做出改变呢？值得吗？

original: If I help you, is there some kind of reward?
translation: 我要是帮助你，会有回报吗？

original: Anything else I should know?
translation: 还有什么我应该知道的吗？

original: Can I join the Railroad?
translation: 我能加入“铁路”吗？

original: What about human slaves? Don't you try to help them, too?
translation: 那么人类奴隶呢？你们不也想帮助他们吗？

original: What's this "movement" you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的“运动”是什么？

original: This conversation's over, Ms. Watts. Now step aside.
translation: 瓦兹女士，谈话结束了。让开。

original: What would you have me do?
translation: 你要我做什么？

original: What I do with my own time is my own goddamn business.
translation: 我他妈怎样花我自己的时间，是我自己的事。

original: Look, whoever this missing android is, I just want to help. Okay?
translation: 听着，不管这人造人是怎么回事，我只是想帮忙，好吗？

original: I think you're confusing me with someone else...
translation: 我想你把我和某人搞混了……

original: Who the hell are you?
translation: 见鬼，你是谁？

original: I can't wait. What do you want me to do?
translation: 我等不及了，你要我做什么？

original: I'm taking it direct
translation: 我直接去。

original: Sure, here you go and you don't owe me a single cap.
translation: 当然，拿好，你不欠我瓶盖。

original: I'll sell it to you...for 300 caps.
translation: 我会把它卖给你……300个瓶盖。

original: Nope, sorry. I'm holding onto it.
translation: 不，抱歉，我要自己留着它。

original: I'm not giving you anything.
translation: 我是不会给你任何东西的。

original: Hang on a second. You want it, you need to pay for it.
translation: 等一下，既然你要它，你就得出钱。

original: Sure, here you go.
translation: 当然，给你。

original: I bumped into him a while back is all. (Lie)
translation: 我撞见过他。(撒谎)

original: I found him dead.
translation: 我发现他死了。

original: I have a package for you from him.
translation: 他要我给你个包裹。

original: Do you know someone named Grady?
translation: 你认识一个叫格雷迪的人吗？

original: I'm keeping it, and I'd advise you to back off before I get angry!
translation: 我要留着它，在我发火之前，我建议你快点走！

original: Come and get it from me, if you think you can.
translation: 你要有胆，那就放马过来从我手里抢走它。

original: No way, it's mine!
translation: 没门，它是我的！

original: How about you pay me for it?
translation: 不如你你付钱给我？

original: Okay... okay. Here. No need for violence.
translation: 好吧……好吧，给，别那么凶。

original: So my father's okay? I can... get him back?
translation: 我父亲还好吗？我能带他……回去吗？

original: So... I'm free to leave?
translation: 那么……我可以自由离开了？

original: Tell me about the G.E.C.K.
translation: 跟我说说伊甸园创造器。

original: Tell me exactly who you are. Who you really are.
translation: 确切地告诉我你是谁，你真是的身份是什么。

original: Tell me about this place, about Tranquility Lane.
translation: 跟我说说宁静巷这地方。

original: I came here for my father. Now where is he?
translation: 我来找我父亲，他现在在哪？

original: You'll just reset everything anyway. Who cares?
translation: 反正你也会把一切都重置。谁在乎呢？

original: It's all over. Now shut up, and answer my questions.
translation: 都结束了。现在闭嘴，回答我的问题。

original: I'm calling the shots now!
translation: 现在我来发号施令！

original: Are you kidding? If you get out, you can have all the booze you want!
translation: 开什么玩笑？如果你逃出去，就能狂饮一通烈酒！

original: You're hopeless. Forget it.
translation: 你没希望了。算了吧。

original: What's the deal with Barrett?
translation: 巴雷特和你什么关系？

original: Can I buy some Ultrajet?
translation: 我能买点超级杰特吗？

original: Have you ever heard of The Family?
translation: 你听说过家族没？

original: Here's all the Sugar Bombs I've got.
translation: 给，我所有的糖麦弹。

original: Let me think about it a bit.
translation: 让我考虑一下。

original: Make it 30 caps each and you got yourself a deal.
translation: 每个30个瓶盖，就成交。

original: Alright, Murphy... I'm in.
translation: 好吧，墨菲……我接受。

original: No way. I'm not helping you make chems!
translation: 没门，我不会帮你制作药品！

original: Nothing's free in this world, Murphy.
translation: 天下没有免费的午餐，墨菲。

original: That's it, Butch. You and me. Right now.
translation: 就是这样，布奇，你和我，现在。

original: Yeah sure, what do you need?
translation: 行啊，你需要什么？

original: Stop trying to talk your way out of this, zombie!
translation: 别想胡说八道，丧尸！

original: What the heck are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么鬼东西？

original: Ultrajet? That some sort of super chem?
translation: 超级杰特？某种超级药品？

original: Yeah sure, I'm here for everything you got. Hand it over, zombie!
translation: 当然，我就是来要你交出一切的，丧尸！

original: What secrets?
translation: 什么秘密？

original: Steal your secrets? Not at all.
translation: 偷你的秘密？当然不是。

original: Not now. I'm busy
translation: 现在不行，我很忙。

original: I changed my mind. I'll go with you to Rivet City.
translation: 我改变了主意，我会和你去铆钉城。

original: Can I think about it?
translation: 我能考虑下吗？

original: Screw it, I'm going for the faceoff!
translation: 他妈的！对决就对决！

original: Make it 400 caps and it's all yours.
translation: 400个瓶盖，归你了。

original: Fine, I'll take it.
translation: 好吧，我接受。

original: I think you're all crazy, and I'm getting out of here.
translation: 我认为你们都疯了，我要离开这。

original: Well, "captain", are we gonna fight or try and make a deal?
translation: 嗯，“队长”，我们战斗，还是交易？

original: Okay, if you say so.
translation: 好吧，如果你这么说的话。

original: I think you've taken a few too many blows to the head, weirdo!
translation: 我想你的头被打坏了，怪人！

original: What's with the masks, anyway?
translation: 顺便问问，这些面具怎么了？

original: Who are you and why are you talking like that?
translation: 你是谁，为什么你那样说？

original: Hey, take it easy, I was just passing through.
translation: 嗨，冷静，我正好路过。

original: None of your damn business!
translation: 不关你他妈的事！

original: I'm here to tell you Mercier is dead.
translation: 我来这告诉你梅西埃死了。

original: I've got the formula for Nuka-Cola Clear.
translation: 我得到了核子可乐清爽型配方。

original: May I have the key to the Research Safe?
translation: 我可以拿一下研究室保险箱的钥匙吗？

original: Who was this "Master" you served?
translation: 你侍奉的这位"主人"是谁？

original: Maybe you missed it. Can I come up and look?
translation: 也许你看漏了。能让我上来看看吗？

original: Those things out there want the stash of StealthBoys in this room.
translation: 外面那些东西想要的就是藏在这间屋子里的隐身小子。

original: Player tries to leave conversation.
translation: 玩家想结束对话。

original: No. Antler says you are solution. Plus can't have you skulking around, making trouble.
translation: 不。鹿角说你能解决问题。另外我也不能让你四处转悠，惹麻烦。

original: Do as Antler says, or feel his horns. Up to you.
translation: 要么照鹿角说的去做，要么尝尝他的犄角。你自己选。

original: I need to be going...
translation: 我得走了……

original: No! Antler was clear! Do as Antler says or feel Antler's HORNS!
translation: 不！鹿角的意思很清楚！按鹿角说的做，否则就尝尝他的犄角！

original: I need to go, but I'll come right back.
translation: 我得走了，等还会回来的。

original: I killed Junders Plunkett.
translation: 我杀了伦德斯·普朗基特。

original: Where did you come from?
translation: 你是从哪来的？

original: On second thought, I think I'll pass.
translation: 经过重新考虑，我放弃。

original: Nah. I was just messing with ya.
translation: 不，我在逗你玩。

original: Well, I hope it all works out.
translation: 嗯，我希望会成功。

original: There's tremendous risk in what you do and I bet Theo knew that.
translation: 你所做的事情有极大的风险，我保证西奥明白这一点。

original: It is what it is.
translation: 事实真相大概就是这样子。

original: Yep, you're right. He really cares about you!
translation: 对，你是对的。他真的很在乎你！

original: If this place has living plants, does that mean the water is safe to drink?
translation: 如果这地方有活的植物，那是否意味这的水可以安全饮用？

original: Harold makes unusual requests.
translation: 哈罗德提出了不寻常的请求。

original: Just because.
translation: 就是突然想这么做。

original: You just... did it? Just like that, on a whim?
translation: 所以你……就动手了？全凭一时冲动？

original: Well listen, sir, if something like that crosses your mind about me, please let me know. I'm sure we can work something out.
translation: 好吧听着，先生，万一您对我有什么想法，请您一定提前告诉我。我想咱俩应该用不着走到那一步吧。

original: Will there be anything else?
translation: 还有其他能为您效劳的吗？

original: You just... did it? Just like that, on a whim?
translation: 所以你……就动手了？全凭一时冲动？

original: Well listen, ma'am, if something like that crosses your mind about me, please let me know. I'm sure we can work something out.
translation: 好吧听着，女士，万一您对我有什么想法，请您一定提前告诉我。我想咱俩应该用不着走到那一步吧。

original: Will there be anything else?
translation: 还有其他能为您效劳的吗？

original: Seemed like a good idea at the time.
translation: 当时看来是个好主意。

original: She missed my wake-up call.
translation: 她忘了叫醒我。

original: I- I'm sorry to hear that. She's a nice woman. Was. She might've grown on you.
translation: 我、我很遗憾。她是个不错的女人，你应该喜欢她才对。

original: She's usually real good about those calls. Something must've happened.
translation: 通常她的叫醒服务都很及时啊。肯定是出了什么意外。

original: I hope just because I said she and I were friends doesn't mean you and I can't still be friendly.
translation: 虽然我说过我和她是朋友，但可别因为这样就导致我们俩做不成朋友了啊。

original: Will there be anything else?
translation: 还有其他能为您效劳的吗？

original: That's my business.
translation: 与你无关。

original: Lord almighty. I can't for the life of me imagine her doing anything that'd make someone want to kill her.
translation: 万能的主啊。我真是无法相信有人居然会对她痛下杀手。

original: Not that I'm saying you're a liar, of course! I'm just surprised, is all.
translation: 当然了，我不是说你是个骗子！我只是有点吃惊而已。

original: Will there be anything else?
translation: 还有其他能为您效劳的吗？

original: Personal favor.
translation: 个人喜好。

original: She had it coming.
translation: 她自找的。

original: I killed Jeannie May. Do I still get my discount?
translation: 我杀了珍妮·梅。我还有折扣吗？

original: Ki- killed her? Why would you do something like that?
translation: 杀、杀了她？你为什么要这么做？

original: Jeannie May sent me.
translation: 是珍妮·梅推荐我来的。

original: Bless her. Seems like every traveler I get in here tells me the same thing.
translation: 上帝保佑她。几乎每个到这来的客人都这么说。

original: They see the sign and think, gift shop? That's just too good to be true. But Jeannie May always points them back in my direction.
translation: 他们看到招牌就会想，纪念品商店？怎么可能还有这种地方。可珍妮·梅总是能把他们引到我这儿来。

original: Well, a friend of Jeannie's is a friend of mine. And my friends get a discount at my store.
translation: 好吧，珍妮的朋友就是我的朋友。我的朋友都享受折扣。

original: What do you think of the people who live here?
translation: 你觉得住这儿的人都怎么样？

original: Oh, we keep to ourselves, for the most part. Try not to pry. I think Jeannie May gets bothered that we aren't more sociable, but it's just our way.
translation: 哦，我们很少与人来往，也不爱打探别人的私事。估计珍妮·梅也因为我们不爱社交而大伤脑筋，可我们就习惯这样过日子。

original: Ain't that we don't appreciate what she's done, managing this town like she has, but I worry she feels that way anyhow.
translation: 倒不是说我们不感激她，毕竟她花了那么大功夫打理这个镇子，可我还是担心她误解我们。

original: Not that there ain't others who pry around here. That No-bark was skulking around our yard last week.
translation: 当然，爱打探的人也是有的。上个礼拜疯嘴就想溜进我们的农场来着。

original: <Laughs> I thought he was our cow-killer. Was about to lash him with our bullwhip till I saw who it was.  He's harmless, though.
translation: <大笑> 我以为他就是那个杀牛的凶手。正打算用鞭子抽他，然后才看清楚是谁。他这人没什么危险。

original: Part of me wishes I could see things like he sees 'em, all full of mystery.
translation: 其实我还挺羡慕他那种处世的态度，看什么都充满了神秘感。

original: I just wanted to meet you.
translation: 我只是想见见你。

original: Oh! Well I'm Alice and you've already met my beau, Dusty. He's sweet, ain't he? I don't care what my mama said, I know how to pick 'em.
