original: Well, come back and see me after you find some caps somewheres and put 'em on you!
translation: 呵，那就等你凑够了瓶盖之后再来和我说话吧。

original: I don't have 100 caps on me.
translation: 我身上没有100个瓶盖。

original: Well, I swore not to say a word, but an NCR deserter passed through some days ago and traded for supplies.
translation: 呵，我本来发誓不和人说这件事的，但前几天有个NCR逃兵路过这里买了些东西。

original: According to him, the NCR's decided enough's enough and's going to send in a mess of troops to take back the prison any day now.
translation: 照他的说法，NCR已经不想再等了，他们很快就会派出大批军队拿下那座监狱。

original: Here's your 100 caps.
translation: 这是你的100个瓶盖。

original: I'm here looking for work.
translation: 我是来找活干的。

original: Never mind, then.
translation: 那就算了。

original: I sent power to McCarran and the Strip.
translation: 我向麦卡伦和长街输送了电力。

original: Whoa, really? Ho, shit! I knew I could do it. Those NCR pricks can all get on their knees and worship at the altar of fucking Fantastic!
translation: 啊，真的？见鬼！我就知道能行。现在那帮NCR的废物们总该拜倒在我珍世邦的圣坛下了吧！

original: But don't worry, I'll tell them what you did for me, man. Not all of it, though. They'd think I was an idiot. But some of it.
translation: 不过别担心，我会告诉他们是你帮了我，朋友。当然，不会全部都说。他们以为我是个白痴，那可不全对。

original: Keep at it, man. One day you could end up where I am. You never know.
translation: 加油吧，朋友。总有一天你也会变得像我一样才华横溢的。谁知道呢。

original: I overloaded the plant. No one will be able to use it to power a weapon.
translation: 我已经将电站过载了，现在没人可以启动那件武器了。

original: So I saw. Shame to let the energy go to waste, but on the other hand, now we can rest easy. Here, accept these, for your efforts.
translation: 我看见了。可惜这么好的能源就此浪费了。不过换个层面讲，我们也不必再有什么后顾之忧了。拿着，收下吧，权当给你的奖赏。

original: I diverted power to the grid.
translation: 我已经将电力输送进电网了。

original: I saw that on the monitors here. And you sent it to everyone. Very admirable.
translation: 我已经从监视器里看到了。你居然选择把电力送至各个角落，真是令人钦佩。

original: Now that the NCR has more or less what they want, hopefully their curiosity about the plant is satisfied and they'll dig no deeper.
translation: 如此一来NCR的目的也可以说是基本达成了，希望他们对这座电站的好奇心也能到此为止。

original: The Followers will be grateful. Here, take these, as a parting gift. I hope you'll find them useful.
translation: 我代表天启追随者感谢你。收下这些吧，权当是一点小小的饯别礼。希望能对你有用。

original: I saw that on the monitors here. And you sent it to Freeside, where power is in short supply. A respectable decision.
translation: 我已经从监视器里看到了。你把电送到了能源紧缺的自由城，真是令人尊敬的选择。

original: Now that the NCR has more or less what they want, hopefully their curiosity about the plant is satisfied and they'll dig no deeper.
translation: 如此一来NCR的目的也可以说是基本达成了，希望他们对这座电站的好奇心也能到此为止。

original: The Followers will be grateful. Here, take these, as a parting gift. I hope you'll find them useful.
translation: 我代表天启追随者感谢你。收下这些吧，权当是一点小小的饯别礼。希望能对你有用。

original: I saw that on the monitors here. It's strange, but I can't find where on the grid the power is being sent to.
translation: 我已经从监视器里看到了。可我看不出你把电送到哪儿去了，真奇怪。

original: Nevertheless, hopefully the NCR's curiosity is satisfied now that the plant's output is improved. Here, accept these, for your efforts.
translation: 但至少NCR的好奇心也得到满足了，毕竟电站的发电量提升了。给你，收下吧，算是给你的奖赏。

original: [You ask McNamara about himself.]
translation: [你问麦克纳马拉关于他自己。]

original: Keep moving!
translation: 继续前进！

original: [FAILED] I know! It's incredibly generous and altruistic{alter-istic} of you. See you outside!
translation: [失败] 我知道！你不仅无私无畏，还很宽宏大量！我们外头见吧！

original: Like I cut you loose just so you could run away? Like I don't want your help?
translation: 你以为我帮你松绑就是为了让你逃跑？你以为我就不需要你帮忙？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh! Why, uh, of course! I would never let you fight my kidnappers with my help. Uh, without it! You lead the way!
translation: [成功] 哦！啊，呃，当然！我会让你独自面对那些绑匪——我是说，不会！你带路吧！

original: If you try to run away instead of fighting at my side, I'll kill you myself.
translation: 如果你就一门心思想逃跑的话，我会亲手杀了你。

original: Oh, that's so gracious of you, to offer to bodyguard me like that? But I'd only slow you down. See you outside!
translation: 哦，你愿意当我的保镖吗？真是让人感动啊。可我在这儿只会拖累你，我们还是外头见吧！

original: I didn't cut you loose so you could run away. Stick with me!
translation: 我给你松绑可不是让你逃跑的。跟紧我！

original: One more question Beagle.
translation: 还有一个问题，比格尔。

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Then I'll defer to your superior appraisal of character and prowess in contests of arms and see you outside!
translation: 您表现得是如此临危不惧又英勇无畏，我只能甘拜下风。外面见啦！

original: Sure, run away. You don't look like you'd be much help.
translation: 对，快跑吧。你在这也没什么用。

original: I don't remember saying there was going to be an attack on the prison, waster. You've overstayed your welcome.
translation: 我可不记得我有说过要对监狱发起进攻，废土佬。再多嘴我们可就没这么客气了。

original: Tell them to call off the attack on the prison, or they'll get wiped out.
translation: 告诉他们停止对监狱发起进攻，不然他们死定了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Some Powder Gangers did you wrong, is that it? Well, get in line.
translation: [成功] 难不成炸药帮的人欺负到你头上了？那你可得排队了。

original: Still, you do look capable enough, and manpower hasn't been easy to come by...
translation: 不过，你看着倒是有两把刷子，何况现在人手也不好找……

original: All right. If you want to put yourself in harm's way, I'll help you do it. I'll mark the staging area on your map. Talk to Sergeant Lee.
translation: 行吧。如果你非要给自己找罪受，我也没意见。我会在地图上给你标明集合地。去跟李中士报到吧。

original: I want to help your troops take the prison back. Believe me.
translation: 我想帮助你的部队夺回监狱。相信我。

original: [FAILED] I don't know how they'll do it without you - if they are going to do it - but I guess they'll have to manage. Now get out of here.
translation: [失败] 就算没有你，他们也会攻下监狱，只要他们有这个决心。虽然我不知道手段如何，但我相信那伙人的实力。所以现在，你给我出去。

original: But I could help the troops attack the prison, you know?
translation: 但我能帮你们的部队攻下监狱，你知道吗？

original: Some Powder Gangers did you wrong, is that it? Get in line.
translation: 难不成炸药帮的人欺负到你头上了？那你可得排队了。

original: Still, you do look capable enough, and manpower hasn't been easy to come by...
translation: 不过，你看着倒是有两把刷子，何况现在人手也不好找……

original: All right. Fine by me if you want to put yourself in harm's way. I'll mark the staging area on your map. Talk to Sergeant Lee.
translation: 行吧。如果你非要给自己找罪受，我也没意见。我会在地图上给你标明集合地。去跟李中士报到吧。

original: Classified or not, I want to help make the attack.
translation: 我不管什么军事机密，我只想帮忙。

original: Do all of the brothers use this equipment?
translation: 所有的兄弟们都用这套装备？

original: Everyone in the base has to spend a minimum of five hours a week running tactical simulations, but outside that, interest is scarce.
translation: 基地里的每个人每周至少要花五个小时进行战术模拟，不过除此之外，也没多少人会对这个感兴趣。

original: It wasn't always this way. When we first moved into the bunker, everyone was so excited that the VR systems were intact.
translation: 以前可不是这样的。我们刚进驻地堡时，模拟训练系统运转良好，每个人都跃跃欲试。

original: Over time, though, my fellows have become listless and less entertained by the wonders of the technology around us.
translation: 不过，一段时间后，伙伴们就对这里的各种科技失去了兴致，变得无精打采了。

original: That's why Apprentice Watkins is such a joy to work with. Her unbridled enthusiasm for virtual combat is unparalleled.
translation: 所以我才会如此高兴能与学徒沃特金斯一块儿共事。她对模拟战斗似乎有着无限的热情。

original: And you are?
translation: 你是？

original: Ah, the outsider. I suppose it's too much to ask that jarhead Ramos to keep outsiders away from my research.
translation: 啊，外来人。我记得我已经叫锅盖头拉莫斯让外来人远离我的研究了啊。

original: I am Head Scribe Taggart, and I am much too busy to deal with the likes of you right now.
translation: 我是首席学士塔格特，我现在手头有不少事务，没空搭理你这类人。

original: That explains why there's been no sit-rep from Sergeant Lee.
translation: 难怪李中士一直没有向我报告情况。

original: It took months to get authorization for that assault. It'll be a long time before we take on the Powder Gangers again.
translation: 这次行动花了好几个月才获得上级批准。估计下次对付炸药帮又得等到猴年马月了。

original: The attack on the prison was a success.
translation: 对监狱的进攻很成功。

original: I'm not surprised. Criminals like to act tough, but they're no match for military discipline.
translation: 不奇怪。犯罪分子都喜欢虚张声势，和正规军相比，他们就是一帮乌合之众。

original: The attack on the prison was a success.
translation: 对监狱的进攻获得了成功。

original: Let's get going.
translation: 咱们走吧。

original: And depart we will!
translation: 赶紧走吧！

original: Wait here.
translation: 在这儿等着。

original: Don't leave me here too long. I can't wait forever.
translation: 别一直把我丢在这儿太久。我等不了多久的。

original: Beagle, take a weapon.
translation: 比格尔，给你把武器。

original: I just hope I won't have to use it!
translation: 真希望我不会用到它！

original: You got it.
translation: 我马上照办。

original: I'd like to purchase something.
translation: 我想买点东西。

original: Now, music.
translation: 现在，来点音乐。

original: And now, music.
translation: 那么，来点音乐。

original: But you don't want to listen to me, do you? You want music.
translation: 但你并不喜欢听我唠叨，对吗？你想听音乐。

original: If by some chance you want to find me again, and if by some even greater chance coyotes haven't picked my bones clean, I'll be at my shack.
translation: 如果你想找我，而我还也没被郊狼吃个精光的话，那你可以在我的棚屋里找到我。

original: You'll do fine. Farewell, mi amigo.
translation: 你会没事的。保重，我的朋友。

original: Alrighty then, I'll just head out. Alone. By myself. Into the dangerous wastes.
translation: 好吧，那我就自个儿先告辞了。孤身一人，无依无伴，外面还是充满危险的废土。

original: It's okay by me. Enjoy your freedom.
translation: 我无所谓。享受你的自由吧。

original: Anything's better than staying here. Let's go.
translation: 总比留在这儿强。我们走吧。

original: Actually, do you want to tag along with me?
translation: 说实话，你想不想跟我一块儿走？

original: Sorry boss, but as much as I'd like to risk getting killed by your side, you seem to already have some help.
translation: 抱歉，老大。我可不想死在你旁边，再说你看起来不是已经有帮手了嘛。

original: Actually, do you want to tag along with me?
translation: 说实话，你想不想跟我一块儿走？

original: You got the caps, I got the skills.
translation: 只要你有瓶盖，我就有技术。

original: Can you repair some of my stuff?
translation: 你能修好我的东西吗？

original: Sure, boss. I'd be happy to prolong my captivity and psychological abuse to tighten some lug nuts for you.
translation: 好的，老大。我很乐意忍受肉体和精神上的双重虐待，来帮你拧紧这些螺母的。

original: Can you repair some of my stuff?
translation: 你能修好我的东西吗？

original: Sure, I'll just pull a toolbox out from behind a conveniently-placed rock and get to work.
translation: 好的，等我从附近的石头后面变个工具箱出来，我就能开始干活了。

original: Can you repair some of my stuff?
translation: 你能修好我的东西吗？

original: I imagine the NCR doesn't deal with deserters kindly.
translation: 我估计NCR对逃兵应该是严惩不贷吧。

original: Yeah, if we see the NCR, they'll be waiting for us with a bullet to the brain pan.
translation: 是的，只要见到NCR，我们的脑门上会被立马开个洞。

original: So what are we supposed to do, just run?
translation: 所以你说我们除了逃跑，还能怎么办？

original: <Attack> Murdering deserters. Well, I think I've heard enough.
translation: <攻击> 无恶不作的逃兵，反正我是听够了。

original: And it'll be the last thing you hear!
translation: 那就当是你听到的最后一句话吧！

original: It doesn't sound like things have gone to plan.
translation: 看来计划赶不上变化啊。

original: It would be safer to run and find someplace to hide.
translation: 你们找个地方躲起来会更安全。

original: Maybe you're right. Come on, boys, lets get the hell out of here before the law shows up.
translation: 你说得对。来吧，伙计们，趁着条子还没来，我们赶紧离开这鬼地方。

original: Well, they do have a few more troops than the four of you...
translation: 哎呀，他们的人数可比你们四个要多啊……

original: No biggie there. We've been avoiding the patrols and staying low key until this mess.
translation: 没什么大不了。来这儿之前，我们一直躲着巡逻队，始终就没露过脸。

original: <Attack> I guess I'll serve as their justice then.
translation: <攻击> 那我就替他们伸张正义吧。

original: You won't live to regret those words!
translation: 等你归西了再去后悔刚才说过的话吧！

original: [SUCCEEDED] Please do not not make your way to the 2nd floor.
translation: [成功] 请不要上二楼。

original: I am not supposed to go upstairs, let me pass and I won't.
translation: 我没想过要上楼，让我过去。

original: [FAILED] Unauthorized access.  You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败] 非法闯入。在警报拉响之前，你有三十秒时间离开。

original: I've worked here for years. I forgot my badge at home.
translation: 我在这里已经工作了很多年。我把身份牌忘在家里了。

original: Valid facial pattern detected.
translation: 识别到有效面部数据。

original: Unauthorized facial pattern detected. Valid security badge detected. Temporary access granted. Please complete employee registration with security.
translation: 无法识别面部数据。识别到有效的安全身份牌。获得临时通行权。请在保安处完成雇员登记。

original: Unauthorized facial pattern. Please present credentials for first floor access.
translation: 无法识别面部数据。请提供一层的安全通行证。

original: Hello, please remember visiting hours are from 10 AM until 5 PM. Please show your badge or make your way out of the building.
translation: 你好，请记住我们的开馆时间为早上10点到下午5点。请出示身份牌，或离开建筑。

original: You have been warned. Please vacate the premises or you will be considered an intruder.
translation: 您已被警告！请离开此建筑，否则您将被视为入侵者。

original: Intruder Alert! Intruder Alert!
translation: 入侵者警报！入侵者警报！

original: Why did you leave the army?
translation: 你为什么离开军队？

original: I didn't. My C.O. ordered me to flog a couple "deserters," and I told him to eat shit. So they kicked me out for insubordination.
translation: 我没有离开。我的指挥官命令我去鞭打一群"逃兵，"我让他去吃屎。结果他们就以抗命为由把我开除出了军队。

original: Those kids didn't desert. They just got liquored up on the Strip and missed roll call.
translation: 那群小鬼根本就没逃跑。他们不过是在长街喝高了，错过了集合号。

original: I don't know what else the brass expects... half these kids don't get more than two weeks of training before they ship 'em out here.
translation: 我实在不懂那些当官的在想什么……这群小鬼被送过来之前，有一半人只接受过不到两个礼拜的训练。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Sure, no problem.
translation: 当然，没问题。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'll be here a while yet, if you need any guns or ammo.
translation: 我依然在这儿，如果你需要枪械弹药就来找我吧。

original: Hello Mrs. Millet, I hope you have an excellent day at work today.
translation: 你好，米利特夫人。希望你一天工作愉快。

original: Hello! Have a wonderful day here at REPCONN. Remember, security is job one!
translation: 你好！祝你在瑞普康的一天愉快。记住，安全第一！

original: Valid facial pattern detected.
translation: 识别到有效面部数据。

original: Unauthorized facial pattern. Second floor access restricted to registered employees.
translation: 无法识别面部数据。二楼只对已注册的员工开放。

original: No valid REPCONN identification badge detected. Please vacate the premises.
translation: 未检测到有效的瑞普康身份牌。请离开这座建筑。

original: No valid REPCONN identification badge detected. This is your second and final warning. Please vacate or security will be alerted.
translation: 未检测到有效的瑞普康辨识标志。这是第二次也是最后一次警告。请立刻离开，否则将拉响警报。

original: Unauthorized access. Activating Security!
translation: 非法闯入。启动警报。

original: Let's do it.
translation: 我们开始吧。

original: Here's the plan. The gate to Tabitha's compound is guarded by several Nightkin, all of them using devices that make them invisible.
translation: 计划是这样的。塔比瑟的院子大门由几个夜行族把守，他们全都使用了隐身装置，所以你看不到他们。

original: I'm going to draw them away from the gate by telling them I spotted an intruder in the village. Then you slip in.
translation: 我会骗他们说村子里有入侵者，好把他们引开，你就趁机溜进去。

original: Valid facial pattern detected.
translation: 识别到有效面部数据。

original: Third floor access is for executives only. Please identify.
translation: 三楼只对主管开放。请进行识别。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Correct. Facial pattern recognized. Diagnostic mode initiated.
translation: [成功] 正确。识别到有效面部数据。诊断模式启动。

original: If my face is recognized a second time then I must belong here.
translation: 既然我的脸能被认出来两次，那么我肯定是这里的人。

original: [FAILED] Unauthorized access. You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败] 非法闯入。在警报拉响之前，你有三十秒时间离开。

original: I just spoke with that other robot over there.
translation: 我已经和那边的机器人说过了。

original: [FAILED] Invalid response! You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败] 验证无效！在警报拉响之前，你还有三十秒的时间离开。

original: Let me pass! I'll make it worth your while.
translation: 让我过去！我又不会让你吃亏。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Override accepted.
translation: [成功] 指令覆盖成功。
让我过去！我又不会让你吃亏。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Thank you sir, have a nice day.
translation: [成功] 谢谢你，先生。祝你一天愉快。

original: ICE CREAM!
translation: 冰激凌！

original: [SUCCEEDED] Thank you ma'am, have a nice day.
translation: [成功] 谢谢你，女士。祝你一天愉快。

original: ICE CREAM!
translation: 冰激凌！

original: [SUCCEEDED] Thank you ma'am, have a nice day.
translation: [成功] 谢谢你，女士。祝你一天愉快。

original: Ice Cream
translation: 冰激凌

original: [SUCCEEDED] Thank you sir, have a nice day.
translation: [成功] 谢谢你，先生。祝你一天愉快。

original: Ice Cream
translation: 冰激凌

original: [FAILED] Incorrect. Security alert! You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败] 错误！安全警报！在警报拉响之前，你有三十秒时间离开。

original: Sorry, no idea.
translation: 抱歉，不知道。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Diagnostic mode entered.
translation: [成功] 进入诊断模式。

original: You appear to have a faulty subroutine. Run diagnostics.
translation: 看来你的某个子程序有问题。运行诊断程序。

original: [FAILED] No maintenance service request logged. Intruder alert!
translation: [失败] 未发现维修申请记录。入侵者警报！

original: [Repair/Speech] I'm here to fix the broken wall.
translation: [修理/口才] 我是来修理坏掉的墙壁的。

original: Valid facial pattern detected.
translation: 识别到有效面部数据。

original: You have accessed a restricted area.
translation: 你已进入限制区域。

original: What makes this a "dangerous place?"
translation: 这里怎么变成"凶险之地"了？

original: You must've heard her radio broadcasts? Though why a human would follow her invitation here is beyond me... unless you didn't listen very closely.
translation: 你肯定听过她的广播节目吧？我真不明白为什么一个人类会听从她的指引来到这里……估计你是没有仔细听她说什么吧。

original: The voice on the radio belongs to Tabitha, the "supreme commander" of Black Mountain - or, as she calls it, the "State of Utobitha."
translation: 那个广播是塔比瑟开的，她是黑山——或者按她的叫法，"乌托比萨共和国"的"最高指挥官。"

original: She took control of this place almost two years ago. The Super Mutants here do whatever she says - and she says humans are to be killed on sight.
translation: 她大约在两年前控制了这里。这里的超级变种人都听她的——她还下令见到人类就格杀勿论。

original: Thanks for the warning, but I can take care of myself.
translation: 多谢提醒，不过我能保护自己。

original: Yes, I hear that sometimes. And then I never see the people who said it again.
translation: 是啊，好多人一开始都是这么说的，不过那些人后来我就再也没见过了。

original: You do look like someone who can take care of himself. But I think you'll find this is more than you bargained for...
translation: 你这身板看着确实是有能力保护自己。不过你很快就会发现事情并非如你所料……

original: You do look like someone who can take care of herself. But I think you'll find this is more than you bargained for...
translation: 你这身板看着确实是有能力保护自己。不过你很快就会发现事情并非如你所料……

original: Intruder! I have foreseen your death!
translation: 入侵者！我已经预见了你的死亡！

original: No! I won't let you have my Raul!
translation: 绝不！别想抢走我的劳尔！

original: You! Now you've gone and done it! No one messes with my radio station!
translation: 你！除了你还有谁！就是你毁了我的广播站！

original: Tell me about RobCo.
translation: 和我说说罗科。

original: RobCo industries purchased REPCONN in 2075 to assist with some of RobCo's military projects, as well as developing unmanned space exploration.
translation: 罗科工业在2075年收购了瑞普康，以协助军方开展相关项目及无人太空探索的研究。

original: The relationship between RobCo and REPCONN is mutually beneficial, and we hope that both companies bolster each other well into the next century.
translation: 罗科与瑞普康的合作本着平等互利的原则，我们希望两个公司能够携手走向下个世纪。

original: Research and development.
translation: 研发成就。

original: As you may already know, REPCONN is an industry leader in producing alternative fuels for military and scientific purposes.
translation: 如你所知，在军用及科研用替代燃料生产领域，瑞普康是当之无愧的领头羊。

original: REPCONN scientists were pioneers in fission-based propulsion systems, and have recently had some very exciting breakthroughs with plasma systems.
translation: 瑞普康的科学家在核裂变推进系统方面也始终走在行业前沿。近来，他们在等离子系统的研发上又有了喜人的突破。

original: The recent partnership with RobCo has freed our engineers from mundane business matters, allowing them to focus solely on future projects.
translation: 与罗科的合作使我们的工程师得以从繁杂的商务活动中解脱出来，更加全身心地投入未来的研究计划中去。

original: REPCONN's history.
translation: 瑞普康的历史。

original: REPCONN's illustrious history began way back in 2054, shortly after the famous Delta XI rocket was completed and launched.
translation: 瑞普康始建于2054年，即著名的德尔塔11号火箭建造与发射后不久。

original: REPCONN's initial focus was on the development of fuel to be used in orbital propulsion in response to the energy crisis of 2052. Sad times, indeed.
translation: 成立之初，瑞普康主要潜心于在轨推进力燃料的研发，以应对2052年的能源危机。那真是个悲哀的年代。

original: The company really took off when RobCo purchased REPCONN in late 2076 to develop unmanned rockets to explore the solar system.
translation: 2076年，罗科购了瑞普康，以开展探索太阳系的无人火箭研发项目。此时公司的事业才开始蒸蒸日上。

original: What can you tell me about REPCONN?
translation: 关于瑞普康，你能告诉我什么？

original: I can answer whatever questions you'd like... {Warning}provided your query is limited to REPCONN history, research and development, or RobCo.
translation: 我能回答你的所有问题……{Warning}回答范围仅限于瑞普康的历史、研发成就，或者罗科。

original: I'd like a tour of the museum.
translation: 我想要参观一下博物馆。

original: Excellent, excellent! Please be patient, the tour will begin in just a moment.
translation: 很好，很好！请耐心等待，我们的游览马上开始。

original: I am so pleased you enjoyed the last tour! A new tour will begin in a moment, if you wish to wait.
translation: 很高兴你能喜欢上次的游览！新的游览行程很快就会开始，请稍等片刻。

original: I'd like another tour.
translation: 我想要再参观一次。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: That's enough about REPCONN.
translation: 关于瑞普康的事情，我已经听够了。

original: Very well, feel free to ask me more about REPCONN at {emphasis}any time, don't be shy.
translation: 没关系，有关瑞普康的事情，你随时都可以问我。别害羞。

original: The tour showcases REPCONN's amazing scientific contributions, and the promise of many more, coupled with its parent company, RobCo.
translation: 展厅里还会为你展示瑞普康及其母公司罗科在科学领域的出色贡献及对未来的承诺。

original: Behind me is our most recent rocket project, which we're keeping under our hats... until "launch," if you'll pardon the expression.
translation: 在我身后的是最新的火箭发射计划，火箭的具体模样……在发射前必须保密。希望你能原谅我有所隐瞒。

original: And in front of me is a model  - not actual size - of the launch dome we are using to send our rockets screeeeaming into orbit.
translation: 我身前的这个模型是发射用的拱顶，当然真实尺寸可没那么小。我们就是用它将火箭呼啸着送入地球轨道。

original: To my right you can see a sample of some old "safety barrels" REPCONN once used to store radioactive waste. Perfectly safe.
translation: 在我右手边，你可以看到一个老式的"安全桶"样品，瑞普康曾用这个存储放射性废料。绝对安全。

original: On my left is an example of a mountain of REPCONN safety barrels some legislators claim are poisoning our environment. Ridiculous.
translation: 在我左侧则是用来堆放安全桶的核废料堆，一些立法者声称这些废料会污染环境。真是荒唐。

original: Look here - a row of multi-colored plasma fuels! Careful, they may look safe to drink, but your stomach is the last place they should be.
translation: 看这里，一整排五颜六色的等离子燃料！当心，它们虽然看起来很好喝，但你绝对不会希望它们出现在你的胃里。

original: Why the difference in cylinder size? Refining our production methods has resulted in higher yields of fuel over time, that's why!
translation: 为什么气缸的尺寸大小不一？这就对了！我们拥有独特的精炼方法，使得我们的燃料产量一直处于行业领先水平！

original: In the lead-lined case behind me is a spent radioactive rod from of our old reactors. No need to stand too close, let's move along, shall we?
translation: 我身后的这个铅箱里装的是从旧反应堆上拆下来的控制棒。不要站得太近。让我们继续往前参观，可以吗？

original: Ready for the REPCONN tour, Rocketeers? Courtesy of the fine folks at RobCo, I'll be your guide today on the path of... Scientific. Discovery.
translation: 准备好启程了吗，火箭专家们？承蒙罗科诸多优秀人士的关照，今天，将由我来带领大家踏上这场科学探索之旅。

original: Congratulations, martyr! Your fantastic journey is only just beginning. Please proceed to the light.
translation: 恭喜你，烈士！你的美妙旅程才刚刚开始。请你穿过这道光。

original: The light is calming, and puts your mind at ease. Go to the light.
translation: 光会让人平静，让你的精神放松。走进这道光吧。

original: Welcome. Please sit in the chair. The show is about to begin.
translation: 欢迎，请就坐。节目马上开始。

original: The show requires that you sit in the chair.
translation: 观看演出时请坐在座位上。

original: It is absolutely essential that you sit in the chair.
translation: 坐在椅子上观看是最基本的修养。

original: You have no other choice. You must sit in the chair.
translation: 你没有别的选择，你必须坐在椅子上。

original: Greetings, martyr, and welcome! If you're here now, it means you've been offered up as a sacrifice so that your vault can continue to thrive.
translation: 向你致意，烈士，欢迎你！如果你来到这里，说明你已经为了自己的避难所能够存续，而被选为了牺牲品。

original: Currently, you may be feeling sad or angry. Perhaps you never got to have grandkids, or to enjoy the pleasures of a fresh cigar.
translation: 你可能会觉得沮丧和愤怒。你可能无法看到自己的子孙，也无法享受雪茄的香醇。

original: But march with your chin held high, soldier, and remember that each of us has an important role to play.
translation: 但抬起你的头，向前走吧，战士，请记住，我们每个人都扮演着重要的角色。

original: For some people, their role might be to heal the sick. For others, it might mean they will drive a racecar or fly a rocket ship.
translation: 对有些人来说，他们的角色是救死扶伤。其他人则可能是驾驶赛车，或是操作火箭。

original: And some of us are meant to forfeit our lives for the good of the people.
translation: 而我们中的一些人，注定要为了大众的利益牺牲自己。

original: Sure it might not be as fun as driving a racecar, but it's every bit as important.
translation: 当然，这不像开赛车那么有趣，但不意味着它不重要。

original: Let's take a moment to reflect on the moments that made your life worth living.
translation: 让我们来花点时间来，回顾一下你生命中那些美妙的时刻吧。

original: Think about that time you kissed your steady girl for the first time under the bleachers at the big game.
translation: 回想一下你第一次在比赛后的看台下亲吻女友的时候吧。

original: Or when you snuck out after curfew to catch that new flick that your parents wouldn't let you see because it was too scary. Boy, were they right!
translation: 或是在熄灯后，溜出去偷看那些你父母怕吓坏你，而不准你看的恐怖电影。乖乖，真恐怖啊！

original: And who could forget when you met the love of your life? What a looker! These are just examples.
translation: 谁又能忘记自己第一次遇到真爱的时刻呢？好一位美人啊！屏幕上的只是些例子罢了。

original: Do you feel that feeling stirring in your chest as you think of these things? Good. What you are feeling is peace.
translation: 当你想到这些事情时，胸口是否会涌过阵阵暖意？很好。这正是安宁的表现。

original: You've led a great life. Living it has been its own reward. But it is only the beginning.
translation: 你经历了一段伟大的人生。生命本身就是最好的奖励。但这仅仅是开始。

original: Close your eyes now, and imagine what joys await you in the next life - the afterlife. Can you see them? Good.
translation: 闭上眼睛，想象下辈子吧——来生的幸福。你能看到了吗？很好。

original: Thinking hurts you, too? Aw, I wish I could let you have the one on my head but I can't. It hurts real bad when I don't wear it.
translation: 思考也让你感到痛苦了么？啊，我多希望我能把头上的这东西送给你，但是不行。如果不戴着它，我就会疼得不能自已。

original: I might be interested in buying your "headache medicine." How much?
translation: 你的"头痛药"有点意思。多少钱？

original: I need to take off my medicine...
translation: 我得把药取下来…

original: Local, local, the here and now... little of interest... things to buy, false hopes, and regrets watered down, washed down in dirty glasses.
translation: 这里啊，这里，现在…没什么有趣的…东西可买，虚假的希望，掺了水的悔恨，就着肮脏的玻璃杯一饮而尽。

original: With regret comes a girl... smiling sad, brown robe, name Veronica, half here. Wraps her and her heart up like a pack, in the pack, a key, some say.
translation: 来了一个悔恨的女孩…苦笑着，穿着棕色长袍，名叫维罗尼卡，未至半至。她紧紧包裹了自己的心，有人说，在那心里藏着一把钥匙。

original: {Slight upbeat at the end, different than the eeriness}Forecast: Cloudy, with a chance of friendship.
translation: {Slight upbeat at the end, different than the eeriness}预测: 乌云，但仍有发展友谊的可能。

original: {Frowns, winces}Ouch. Thinking small only hurts a little, but it's a sharp pain.
translation: {Frowns, winces}哎哟。原本思考些这类小事情只会有点疼，不过这次却疼得要命。

original: Do your thinking about "Here."
translation: 思考一下"这里。"

original: Let me take off my medicine...
translation: 等我把药取下来…

original: Bull and Bear over the Dam, at each other's throats... but a light from Vegas? Ball spinning on the wheel, more than two at the table, placing bets.
translation: 牛熊在坝上争斗，相互撕咬对方的喉咙……而维加斯却发出光亮？小球在轮盘里转动，不止两个人…正围着桌子下注。

original: All lose in different ways, a dam of corpses, towns of corpses, scattered across the sand. But whose, in what shares? Even the dealer doesn't know.
translation: 没有赢家，大坝上尸横遍野，城镇里血流成河，沙地里生灵涂炭。可那又是谁的尸体，谁又死伤最重？就连下注的人也无从知晓。

original: Forecast: A rain of blood will flood the desert and not purify it.
translation: 预报：一场血雨将冲洗整片沙漠，却无法洗净它。

original: Bleh. Thinking about Everywhere always makes me feel a little sick...
translation: 呃。要让我思考所有地方，我会有些恶心的…

original: Do your thinking about "Everywhere."
translation: 思考一下"所有地方"。

original: Okay. Let me take off my medicine...
translation: 好的。等我把药取下来…

original: {A little slower, more thoughtful}Your face does the thinking - two to the skull, yet one gets up. Odds are against you... but they're just numbers after the two-to-one.
translation: {A little slower, more thoughtful}你的面庞已经说明了一切——两发正中眉心，却大难不死。原本毫无生还可能……可就连这二中一的概率也被你幸运扭转。

original: You're playing the hand you've been dealt, but you don't let it rest, you shuffle and stack, and a gamble... a gamble that may pay off? {Frowns}But how?
translation: 你只有手中这一副底牌，可你并未认输，你重新洗牌，发牌，准备孤注一掷……一场赔率惊人的豪赌？可你该怎么下注？

original: Forecast: Rapidly changing conditions.
translation: 预测：不可捉摸，变幻莫测。

original: {Frowns, resumes normal voice}A lot of thinking - most of it in your face, it's almost shouting at me. {Beat, slight apology}Sorry if I said anything weird.
translation: {Frowns, resumes normal voice}所有的想法，全都写在你的脸上，它们就差没对着我大声吼了。{Beat, slight apology}如果我说了奇怪的话，我向你道歉。

original: Do your thinking about me.
translation: 思考一下我的事情吧。

original: Great! What do you want me to think about? I can think about You, Here... or Everywhere. What do you want?
translation: 好的！你要我思考什么？我能思考你的事，也可以思考这里…甚至所有地方的事情。你想要了解什么？

original: I'll pay 100 caps to hear your thoughts.
translation: 告诉我你的思想是什么样的，我就给你100瓶盖。

original: Sure, I could do some more thinking. What should I do my thinking about this time?
translation: 当然，我还可以继续思考。这次你要我想些什么？

original: Here's another 100 caps. I want to hear your thoughts again.
translation: 这还有100瓶盖。我要再听听你的思想。

original: That's all right, mister. You will someday.
translation: 没关系的，先生。有一天你会再来的。

original: Sounds interesting... I don't have 100 caps, though.
translation: 听起来很有趣…不过我没钱。

original: That's all right, ma'am. You will someday.
translation: 没关系的，女士。有一天你会再来的。

original: Sounds interesting... I don't have 100 caps, though.
translation: 听起来很有趣…不过我没钱。

original: Sorry, sir. All that thinking has made my head hurt. I don't think I'll be doing any thinking for a long time.
translation: 抱歉，先生。刚刚的那阵思考让我头疼欲裂。我想我得休息一阵子了。

original: Any more thoughts I can pay you for?
translation: 还有其他思想可以告诉我吗？

original: Sorry, ma'am. All that thinking has made my head hurt. I don't think I'll be doing any thinking for a long time.
translation: 抱歉，女士。刚刚的那阵思考让我头疼欲裂。我想我得休息一阵子了。

original: Any more thoughts I can pay you for?
translation: 还有其他思想可以告诉我吗？

original: That's not junk. That's other people's thoughts. People had to think to make them, and the thoughts got stuck inside.
translation: 那不是垃圾，是别人的思想。思想一经头脑创造，便在脑海中永存。

original: I need other people's thoughts to fill my head when I'm not thinking myself. Otherwise it's... kind of empty.
translation: 当我自己停止思考的时候，就需要用别人的思想来充实脑袋。否则会…一片空白。

original: You don't sell that junk behind you?
translation: 你背后那堆垃圾也不卖？

original: I don't have a mama or papa anymore. I see them sometimes when I take off my medicine, but they can't stay. I'm pretty used to being on my own.
translation: 我爹妈都已经不在了。有时我把药取下来以后就会看见他们，不过很短暂。我已经习惯一个人了。

original: Where are your parents, kid? Are you here all alone?
translation: 孩子，你的父母呢？这里就你一个人？

original: This thing on my head is headache medicine. It works real good, except I can't think when it's on. {emphasize}Really think, I mean.
translation: 我头上这东西就是我的药。它的效果非常好，但戴着它的时候，我就不能思考。{emphasize}我是说，真正的思考。

original: What is your "medicine" and how do you take it off?
translation: 你的"药"是什么？你又是怎么服用的？

original: I can take off my medicine and do some thinking. People say it's real interesting. I don't know, {'cause}because I never hear it.
translation: 我把药取下来就能进行思考。人们都说这很有趣。我不知道是不是真的，{'cause}因为我从来没听见他们说过。

original: Some people say that it's a gift. Other people say that it's the kind of thinking anyone could do if they watched more than they talked.
translation: 有人说这是天赋。有人则说这种所谓的思考，任何少说多看的人都能做到。

original: I don't know which is true. I see a lot, I think a lot. There's a lot to hear through the 188, too, that maybe accounts for the thinking.
translation: 我不知道哪个才是对的。我看了很多，也想了很多。在188贸易站能听到很多奇闻轶事，这也许正是我能思考的原因之一。

original: You sell *thoughts?*
translation: 你贩卖*思想*？

original: Oh, I don't sell things, mister. I sell {emph}thoughts.
translation: 噢，先生，我卖的不是货，我卖的是{emph}思想。

original: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你的货。

original: Oh, I don't sell things, ma'am. I sell {emph}thoughts.
translation: 噢，女士，我卖的不是货，我卖的是{emph}思想。

original: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你的货。

original: Got nothing to spare.
translation: 没货了。

original: Oh, you could. You just don't want to.
translation: 噢，你当然有卖，只是不愿意罢了。

original: Can't help you.
translation: 帮不了你。

original: I understand. Sorry to be a bother.
translation: 了解了。抱歉打扰。

original: Can't help you.
translation: 帮不了你。

original: But... Of course. It's all right. Thank you.
translation: 但是……当然。没事。谢谢。

original: Can't help you.
translation: 帮不了你。

original: Sure. Here's 25 caps.
translation: 当然。这是25瓶盖。

original: Thank you so much! I'm so hungry!
translation: 真是太谢谢你了！我要饿死了！

original: Sorry I had to bother you. I've... well, I've lost everything.
translation: 抱歉打扰你。我…呃，一无所有了。

original: You're very kind. I wish... well, I'll just thank you and leave you be.
translation: 你真是太好了。我希望…好吧，还是谢谢你，再见。

original: Still plenty of other problems keeping the 15 shut down, though. Thanks for playing.
translation: 想要重开15号州际公路，还需要解决其他很多问题。不过还是感谢你的帮助。

original: I made sure those prisoners won't bother Primm anymore.
translation: 我肯定那些囚犯不会再入侵普瑞姆了。

original: That'll help. Still plenty of problems out that way, though.
translation: 的确有所帮助。但那条路还是有很多问题。

original: I restored rule of law to Primm.
translation: 我恢复了普瑞姆的秩序。

original: You took out a Deathclaw nest? Either you're lying, or you're tougher than you look.
translation: 你清理掉了一个死亡爪巢穴？如果你没撒谎的话，那你可是比看上去厉害多了。

original: Still plenty of troubles out that way, though. Thanks for playing.
translation: 但那条路还是有很多问题。感谢你的帮助。

original: That's impressive - if you're telling the truth.
translation: 如果你说的都是真的，那真是叫人敬佩。

original: Still, it'll take some time for routes to readjust. I expect I'll be working from here for the foreseeable future.
translation: 尽管如此，重新调整路线依旧要花些时间。估计我还是得在这里呆上一阵子了。

original: I've cleared all the trouble west of here. Caravans can start using I-15 again.
translation: 我已经清除了西边所有的麻烦。商队可以再次使用15号州际公路了。

original: We used to. But every caravan carrying them was getting ambushed and wiped out. By someone sophisticated enough to know which was which.
translation: 以前卖。但运送能量武器的商队全都遇袭了，一个活口也没留下。袭击者似乎相当老道。

original: We think it was the Brotherhood of Steel - those crazies always go hard for energy weapons. But the NCR would rather pretend they killed all of them.
translation: 我们认为是钢铁兄弟会的人干的——那些疯子为了能量武器总是不择手段。但NCR却自以为已经把他们消灭干净了。

original: Why don't you deal in energy weapons?
translation: 为什么你们不卖能量武器？

original: Not much to tell. A brahmin or two loaded up with weapons, and a whole mess of well-armed guards to make sure it ends up where it's supposed to.
translation: 没什么好说的。通常会有一两头满载武器的双头牛，还有一整支全副武装的护卫队，负责确保货物能安全抵达目的地。

original: One nifty bit, though. The gun cases are rigged to explode. So trying to loot one of our caravans doesn't do much good.
translation: 别小瞧了这些人。子弹不长眼，要打劫我们的商队可不是什么好主意。

original: And that's how the NCR stays equipped. The only thing we don't bring in is energy weapons.
translation: 正是靠着我们，NCR才能保持战斗力。我们唯一不卖的就是能量武器。

original: Tell me about Gun Runner caravans.
translation: 跟我说说军火贩子的商队。

original: I'm a salesman. I swing through McCarran and the dam once a week or so to take orders. But lately I spend most of my time in this piss heap.
translation: 我是个销售员，每周往返于麦卡伦和大坝之间接订单。不过最近我大部分时间都待在这个破地方。

original: Ever since the 15 shut down, all caravans come through here - right to me. I check the stock and direct deliveries onward to meet orders.
translation: 15号州际公路关闭后，所有路过的商队都绕到我这里来了。我得负责检查库存，再安排发货。

original: Sure, it stinks to hang out here, but it won't be forever. Plus I can afford a monthly bender on the Strip and still build up my nest egg.
translation: 对，我在这儿蹲得都快发臭了，好在苦日子迟早会到头的。再说了，我现在每个月都去长街玩一次，回去还能攒下点钱。

original: What do you do?
translation: 你是做什么的？

original: There's usually a gun merchant hanging around topside. I'm sure she'll take care of you.
translation: 上面有个武器商人。她肯定会接待你的。

original: So where can I buy some weapons?
translation: 那么我在哪可以买到武器？

original: The Gun Runners have been putting rapid-fire death-dealing in the hands of anyone who needed to defend himself for over a century.
translation: 一个世纪以来，军火贩子始终在为所有需要自卫的人们提供够高效又致命的武器。

original: We're the NCR's #1 supplier of weapons and ammunition. You might call us an unofficial branch of the army.
translation: 我们是NCR的头号军火供应商。你可以把我们当成一支非官方后勤部队。

original: Tell me about the Gun Runners.
translation: 跟我说说军火贩子。

original: Like you have a clue what that even means.
translation: 别说得好像你跟我们这一行很熟似的。

original: So you're a Gun Runner?
translation: 这么说，你是军火贩子？

original: [SUCCEEDED] You might be on to something. I like to hang on to any weapons mods I run across...
translation: [成功] 你算是说到点子上了。我平生就好收集各种武器改装件……

original: Take a look.
translation: 看看吧。

original: I figure a guy like you gets his pick of killing gear.
translation: 我说，像你这样的人，对武器肯定有独特的喜好吧。

original: [FAILED] Do I look like a fucking arms caravan to you?
translation: [失败] 你觉得我他妈像是个武器商人吗？

original: Do you think the Gun Runners keep the NCR military supplied by carrying weapons and ammo from the Boneyard out here by the armload?
translation: 你以为军火贩子是靠从坟堆里刨东西来满足NCR军需的？

original: Get a clue. We have caravans. We deal in bulk.
translation: 动动脑子。我们有商队，做的是大宗生意。

original: A gun nut like you must have some weapons stashed around here.
translation: 像你这种整天和枪打交道的人，肯定没少在附近藏武器吧。

original: Take a look.
translation: 看看吧。

original: Let me see what you have for sale.
translation: 我看看你都有些啥好货色。

original: Am I selling? Yeah. Am I selling to you? No. Sorry to hurt your feelings, but you're small time. Move along.
translation: 我是有在卖东西。但卖给你？没门。很抱歉伤害了你的感情，可你毕竟是个无名小卒，走吧。

original: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你的货。

original: You like it any better if I tell you to fuck off?
translation: 换我叫你滚蛋，你乐意吗？

original: I don't like your attitude.
translation: 我不喜欢你的态度。

original: That's nice. I suspect we'll stick around here, though. Business has been good.
translation: 那挺好。不过我觉得在这儿待着也行。现在生意还不错。

original: Primm's safe now. I took care of those prisoners.
translation: 普瑞姆现在安全了。我处理掉了那些囚犯。

original: What do you know about Legion raids?
translation: 关于军团劫掠队你都知道些什么？

original: Not much. I hear some folks got killed down by Nelson... or was it Novac? I don't know. If they come up this way, me and dad'll go someplace else.
translation: 也不多。我听说纳尔逊有人被杀……又或者是诺瓦克？我不知道。如果他们打过来，我就得和老爸逃到别的地方去。

original: Why's this place called the 188?
translation: 这里为什么叫188？

original: You do know these old roads were numbered, right? We're standing where the 95 and 93 meet. And 95 plus 93 equals... 188.
translation: 你应该知道，这些旧公路都是以数字命名的，对吧？这里是95号和93号公路交汇的地方。95加93等于…188。

original: Why'd you settle in this dump?
translation: 你为什么住在这个垃圾堆里？

original: There's more to the 188 than meets the eye. Troops move back and forth on 93 all the time, and 95 is how NCR folks come and go from Vegas.
translation: 来188贸易站的人可比你看见的要多得多。步兵们在93号公路上往来穿梭，95号公路则是NCR往返维加斯的必经之路。

original: No shortage of customers... so long as Legion raids south of here don't get worse, anyways.
translation: 我并不缺客人…只要军团不会继续在南边打家劫舍就行。

original: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你的货。

original: Have a look.
translation: 看看吧。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Name's Michelle. My Dad and me run this store. His name's Samuel. I take the day shift and he takes nights.
translation: 我叫米歇尔。我老爸和我开了这家店，他叫塞缪尔。我上白班，他上晚班。

original: We came here about a month ago, when Primm went to hell on account of the prison break north of there. Found a bin to call home and set up shop.
translation: 大约一个月前，普瑞姆北面的监狱发生暴乱，我们待不下去了，就来了这里。我们找了一个棚屋当房子，然后开了这家店。

original: You bet.
translation: 当然。

original: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你的货。

original: Guess that makes you a big hero - in Primm. Like I said, me and Michelle didn't sit around waiting to be saved. Business is better here, anyway.
translation: 看来我该称你为普瑞姆的大英雄了。不过我之前说了，我和米歇尔不想靠别人救济。何况这里的生意比那儿更好。

original: I took care of those prisoners myself. Primm is clear now.
translation: 我亲自处理掉了那些囚犯。普瑞姆现在安全了。

original: Well... There's been reports of trouble south, but me and Michelle can handle ourselves. And there's plenty of soldiers about, so that helps.
translation: 哦…南边据说是有点麻烦，不过我和米歇尔能应付得来。这儿有很多士兵，也能帮上忙。

original: Is it safe here?
translation: 这里安全吗？

original: Michelle and I ran a little shop in Primm 'till a prison break north of town spoiled it for everyone. Goddamned convicts just about shut down I-15.
translation: 米歇尔和我在普瑞姆开了一个小店，后来镇子北边的监狱暴动，镇上也跟着遭殃。那群该死的逃犯几乎封锁了整条15号州际公路。

original: When traffic dried up, we took to our heels to find us some customers. I'm not one to sit around waiting to get saved, and Michelle ain't, neither.
translation: 路不能走之后，我们便离开那里到别处谋生。我不想干坐着等别人救济，米歇尔也不想。

original: Why'd you leave Primm?
translation: 你们为什么要离开普瑞姆？

original: When 15 shut down, 95 became the route NCR citizens use to get to the Strip - or limp back home, after the Strip's drained 'em of caps.
translation: 15号州际公路关闭以后，NCR的人就只能走95号公路去长街——等他们花完了瓶盖，也只能走那条路回家。

original: We get 'em coming and going. Coming, the suckers flush with caps they saved to gamble on the Strip...
translation: 所以无论来回，我们都能和他们打个照面。来的时候，那些傻瓜的兜里都揣着去长街赌博的钱…

original: ...and going, the same folks, but now they're losers who'll trade you the shirt off their backs so they don't starve before they make it back home.
translation: …走的时候，人还是那些人，口袋里却一文不剩，只能变卖点家当，免得回家路上挨饿。

original: Add in the troopers marching back and forth from McCarran and the Dam, and well, let's just say we don't miss Primm.
translation: 再加上士兵们往返麦卡伦和大坝也要路过这里，这么说吧，我们一点都不想念普瑞姆。

original: Why's business so good here?
translation: 这的生意怎么这么好？

original: Samuel Kerr at your service. Me and my daughter Michelle run this fine establishment.
translation: 塞缪尔·科尔，乐意为您服务。小店是由我和我的女儿米歇尔经营的。

original: We came here from Primm about a month past. Doesn't look like much, but it's one hell of a location.
translation: 我们大约一个月前从普瑞姆搬到这里。虽然看着挺破，但绝对是个好地方。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: I thought you'd say that.
translation: 我就知道你会这么说。

original: On second thought... maybe another time.
translation: 我认真想了下…还是下次吧。

original: Congratulations, citizens of Vault 11! You have made the decision not to sacrifice one of your own.
translation: 恭喜，11号避难所的公民！你们终于做出决定，不再选出牺牲者了。

original: You can walk with your head held high knowing that your commitment to human life is a shining example to us all.
translation: 你们可以昂首挺胸地活下去，因为你们对生命的珍视体现了人性的光辉。

original: And to make that feeling of pride even sweeter, I have some exciting news.
translation: 为了给这个骄傲的时刻锦上添花，我还有些振奋人心的好消息要宣布。

original: Despite what you were led to believe, the population of Vault 11 is not going to be exterminated for its disobedience.
translation: 无论之前你们了解的信息是怎样的，11号避难所的居民都不会因为抗拒命令而被消灭。

original: Instead, the mechanism to open the main vault door has now been enabled, and you can come and go at your leisure.
translation: 相反，避难所大门的设施已经激活了。你们现在可以自由出入。

original: But not so fast! Be sure to check with your overseer to find out if it's safe to leave. Here at Vault-Tec, your safety is our number one priority.
translation: 但也别急着走！请在离开前与监督商量，以确保外界安全。这里是避难所科技，你们的安全是我们的最高追求。

original: All right, I know you can hear me, so listen up. There's five of us left. Five. Out of... I don't know how many.
translation: 好吧，我知道你能听见，所以给我听好了。我们现在只剩下5个人了。5个。以前……我都不知道我们总共有多少人。

original: So... it's over. We've talked and it's over. We're not going to send anybody to die anymore.
translation: 所以……结束了。我们谈过了，一切都结束了。我们不会再派人送死了。

original: So shut off our water or gas us or do whatever it is you're programmed to do. But we're done listening to you.
translation: 你要断水或者要放毒气之类的，随你的便吧，照你的程序来吧。我们不会再听你的了。

original: Okay. Here.
translation: 好的。给你。

original: Thanks.  We're leaving now, we don't want no more trouble.
translation: 谢谢。我们这就走，我们不想惹麻烦。

original: Hey, just checking the place out. Now I'll just be on my way...
translation: 嘿，瞧一眼罢了，我马上走……

original: We don't take kindly to tourists on our turf. You're gonna need to pay a fine if you want to leave in one piece. 100 caps should cover it.
translation: 我们对闯入领地的游客可不太友好。你得交罚款，否则休想从这儿平安过去。100个瓶盖就够了。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Of course.
translation: 当然。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Until next time.
translation: 直到下次。

original: You're welcome to try.
translation: 欢迎尝试。

original: There is always a choice.
translation: 天无绝人之路。

original: It looks like these people got more than just hurt.
translation: 看来这些人不仅仅是受伤了。

original: By extorting money from the locals?  What happened here?
translation: 从当地人那儿勒索钱财？这里发生了什么？

original: No raider would be foolish enough to go parading around in that.
translation: 没有哪个掠夺者会蠢到去那里耀武扬威。

original: <Pay 50 caps> Okay, here.
translation: <付50个瓶盖> 好的，给。

original: Thanks, Let's get out of here boys.
translation: 谢谢，我们走吧，伙计们。

original: But I don't even have that much.
translation: 可我连这么点钱也付不起。

original: That's alright, we'll take what we can from your body before the law shows up.
translation: 没关系，我们也可以趁条子还没来，自己动手从你尸体上拿。

original: I don't have that many caps.
translation: 我没有那么多瓶盖。

original: Alright, since you look new and didn't know better, we'll cut you some slack.  50 caps.
translation: 好吧，看你是新来的，什么也不懂，我们就放你一马。50个瓶盖。

original: There's an intruder in the dish hut! Get over there and kill whoever it is, you fools!
translation: 天线控制室发现入侵者！快给我滚过来宰了这家伙，你们这群蠢货！

original: [SUCCEEDED] I am supreme commander Best Friend Tabitha! Neil is nothing! You are all traitors! I sentence all dumb-dumbs to death!
translation: [成功] 我是最高指挥官好朋友塔比瑟！尼尔算什么！你们都是叛徒！我判处所蠢蛋冒死刑！

original: We no follow you no more! We follow Neil! He no call us dumb-dumbs!
translation: 我们不会再听你的了！我们要去找尼尔！至少他不会叫我们蠢蛋！

original: [SUCCEEDED] A dumb-dumb revolt, you say? Then I sentence all dumb-dumbs to death!
translation: [成功] 你说啥？这帮蠢蛋反了？我要弄死他们！

original: We no dumb-dumbs! You the stupid, not us! We's taking over!
translation: 我们不是蠢蛋！不是！你才是，我们不是！这地方归我们了！

original: [FAILED] Hello. Was that supposed to sound like a dumb-dumb? Because they sound dumber than that. They sound like this: "Duuuuuh."
translation: [失败] 喂，你是在学那帮蠢蛋说话吗？那帮蠢蛋比这要蠢多了，他们只会说："蠢——"

original: Excuse me just a moment, would you?
translation: 先稍等一下，行吗？

original: We no follow you no more! We follow Neil! He no call us dumb-dumbs!
translation: 我们不会再听你的了！我们要去找尼尔！至少他不会叫我们蠢蛋！

original: [FAILED] Hello. Was that supposed to sound like a dumb-dumb? Because they sound dumber than that. They sound like this: "Duuuuuh."
translation: [失败] 喂，你是在学那帮蠢蛋说话吗？那帮蠢蛋比这要蠢多了，他们只会说："蠢——"

original: Excuse me just a moment, would you?
translation: 先稍等一下，行吗？

original: Hi. We "dumb-dumbs" is rebelling! You no lead us no more!
translation: 听着！我们这些"蠢蛋"起义了！你再也不能对我们发号施令了！

original: Why thank you! It's always gratifying to talk to one's fans. Hold on, I have something I need to do for a second.
translation: 谢谢你！能和自己的粉丝聊天真开心！不过请稍等，我有点事情要处理。

original: Aren't you the super mutant from the radio? I'm a huge fan.
translation: 你不是广播里的那个超级变种人吗？我可是你的铁杆粉丝！

original: Why do I even bother? Go play with something shiny, dumb dumb.
translation: 我为什么要自寻烦恼？自个儿玩去吧，傻冒。

original: [Dumb] Uh... what?
translation: [傻冒]呃……啥？

original: Gah, stupid dumb dumbs have the attention span of a gnat.
translation: 唉，这帮蠢蛋就不能稍微上点心吗。

original: <Say nothing.>
translation: <一言不发。>

original: You've interrupted my broadcast, dumb-dumb - so there had better be a good reason! What is it?
translation: 你这个蠢蛋，耽误我播节目了！怎么回事？你最好给我个合理的解释！

original: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在打算做什么？

original: I don't know... it's been so long since I lost Rhonda, that I'm not sure...
translation: 我不知道……我已经太久没见到朗达了，而我不确定……

original: It pleases me to see you, mistress. I owe my functional state to this human here.
translation: 很高兴见到您，夫人。我的身体机能一切正常，全仰仗这个人类。

original: R- Rhonda? Is that you?
translation: 朗、朗达？是你吗？

original: Sorry, I don't think I'll be heading her way.
translation: 抱歉，我想我不会与她同行。

original: Nevertheless, I must find her, so I'll just tag along with you for a bit until I pick up her trail.
translation: 但是我一定要找到她，我会暂时跟着你，直到发现她的下落。

original: Sure, follow me.
translation: 当然可以，跟我来吧。

original: Thank you very much. My internal clock says it's been 6 years, 52 days, 40 minutes, and 13 seconds since I last spoke to her.
translation: 非常感谢。根据我的内置时钟，自我上次与她交谈至今，已经过了六年五十二天四十分零十三秒。

original: I hope she hasn't gotten lonely.
translation: 希望她不会觉得孤独。

original: Hello. Could you please direct me to mistress Tabitha?
translation: 您好。请问您是否能带我去见塔比瑟小姐？

original: I wonder what mistress Tabitha has been doing with herself during my convalescence.
translation: 我也很想知道塔比瑟小姐在我康复期间都是怎么照顾自己的。

original: It is so good to be traveling with mistress Tabitha again!
translation: 能再次和塔比瑟小姐一起旅行真是太好了！

original: Voice 1: Are we really gonna do this? It's open. We could just leave.
translation: 声音1：我们真的要这么做吗？大门开了。我们可以直接离开啊。

original: Voice 2: I couldn't. Not after that.
translation: 声音2：我不能。做了那种事，我不能。

original: Voice 3: We don't deserve to leave.
translation: 声音3：我们不配离开。

original: Voice 4: "A shining example." That's what it called us.
translation: 声音4："人性的光辉。"，它居然这么称呼我们。

original: Voice 1: But we were! We did what we were supposed to.
translation: 声音1：我们确实是啊！我们做了该做的事情。

original: Voice 5: Not by a long shot.
translation: 声音5：可流了那么多血。

original: Voice 1: Anybody would've done what we did.
translation: 声音1：换做别人也一样会这么做的。

original: Voice 2: You ask me, that's exactly the problem. Now let's get on with this.
translation: 声音2：正是如此，这才是问题所在。好了，我们开始吧。

original: Voice 3: I'll go first.
translation: 声音3：我先来。

original: Voice 1: Wait. Wait. People should know what happened. They could learn from it.
translation: 声音1：等等。等等。人们应该知道这里发生的事情，他们可以从中吸取教训。

original: Voice 5: If there's anyone out there at all, I hope they never have to find out. Ready, Harry?
translation: 声音5：如果外面还有活人的话，我希望他们永远也不要知道这里发生了什么。准备好了吗，哈利？

original: Voice 3: Yeah.
translation: 声音3：好了。

original: Voice 1: No no no, wait!
translation: 声音1：不、不、不！等等！

original: <Four gunshots in succession>
translation: <连续四声枪响>

original: Voice 1: <Whimpers>
translation: 声音1：<呜咽>

original: <Sound of a pistol dropping to the floor>
translation: <手枪掉到地上的声音>

original: Voice 1: She can't do this.
translation: 声音1：她不能这么做。

original: Voice 2: It's done. We're done.
translation: 声音2：她已经做了。我们完了。

original: Voice 1: Nothing's done.
translation: 声音1：还什么都没做成。

original: Voice 2: She's got the authority. The only thing she can't do is change her own fate.
translation: 声音2：她已经获得了权力。只不过她无法改变自己的命运。

original: Nothing says she can't change the selection process for future overseers.
translation: 但并不意味着她不能改变下届监督者的选举规则。

original: Voice 1: I say she can't.
translation: 声音1：我打赌她办不到。

original: Voice 2: You shouldn't have toyed with her like that, Roy.
translation: 声音2：你不该那样戏弄她的，罗伊。

original: Voice 1: We still have the majority.
translation: 声音1：我们仍然占多数。

original: Voice 2: We don't vote for anything anymore.
translation: 声音2：我们不会再有什么选举了。

original: Voice 1: I'm not talking about voting.
translation: 声音1：我说的不是选举。

original: Voice 2: What, then? You want to have a sit-in? A hunger strike?
translation: 声音2：那怎么办？静坐示威？还是绝食抗议？

original: Voice 1: Not exactly.
translation: 声音1：不是。

original: Voice 2: Maybe march into her office with torches and pitchforks?
translation: 声音2：或许我们该拿着火把和草叉冲进她的办公室？

original: Voice 1: Yes.
translation: 声音1：正是如此。

original: Voice 2: Come on.
translation: 声音2：得了吧。

original: Voice 1: I mean it.
translation: 声音1：我是说真的。

original: Voice 2: What, start a revolution?
translation: 声音2：怎么，要武装夺权？

original: Voice 1: Laws don't outlast their governments.
translation: 声音1：法律是不会比制定它的政府更长命的。

original: Voice 2: Roy, all we have to do is wait until someone from Justice Bloc gets picked for overseer. Then we have them change the law back.
translation: 声音2：罗伊，我们只需要等正义团中有人被选上监督。然后我们就能把法律改回来。

original: Voice 1: There won't be any blocs after the new overseer is picked tomorrow. Everyone's going to move on.
translation: 声音1：等到新监督明天上任以后，就不会再有什么集团了。所有人都要放弃过去的传统了。

original: By the time we've reformed, who knows if we'll still be in the majority.
translation: 谁知道经过这次变革，我们还能不能占多数。

original: Voice 2: We can hold the bloc together.
translation: 声音2：我们可以联合其他集团。

original: Voice 1: You don't know that. Besides, what if the computer picks you? What if it picks me?
translation: 声音1：天知道能不能成。另外，如果电脑选的是你呢？或者选的是我？

original: Voice 2: And your solution is to start shooting?
translation: 声音2：你的解决方案就是动武？

original: Voice 1: Not if we don't have to. Look, we arm up. We go to the lower floors, take some strategic targets. Power, food, water.
translation: 声音1：我们已经无路可走了。听着，我们武装起来，去下层，将战略目标全部夺过来。电力、食物、水。

original: Just until she turns authority over to us.
translation: 直到她愿意把权力交到我们手上为止。

original: Voice 2: The other blocs won't support it. They're tired of us having the power.
translation: 声音2：其它集团不会支持我们的。他们已经厌倦我们一手遮天了。

original: Voice 1: We have the majority. We don't need them.
translation: 声音1：我们人多。不需要他们。

original: Voice 2: This isn't a vote, Roy. They'll fight back.
translation: 声音2：这不是选举，罗伊。他们会还击的。

original: Voice 1: They've never had the nerve.
translation: 声音1：他们没这个胆。

original: Voice 2: Hell of a way to test it.
translation: 声音2：这试胆的方式可真够极端的。

original: Tell me about the Nightkin.
translation: 跟我说说夜行族的事。

original: The Nightkin are vicious in combat, and that's if you see them coming. Most don't.
translation: 夜行族凶残好战，你最好不要招惹他们。

original: They were created to be soldiers, and given devices to camouflage them in battle. Unfortunately, the devices drove most of them mad over time.
translation: 他们生来就是战士，还拥有一套可以在战斗中隐身的装备。不幸的是，这些装备通常会让他们发疯。

original: They spend most of their time at the top of the mountain, but patrol the roads after dark as well. You'd do well to avoid the mountain at night.
translation: 他们大部分时间都待在山顶上，但到了夜里就会在公路上巡逻。你晚上最好躲远点。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Help would improve the odds. Help might just make the difference...
translation: [成功] 有人帮忙的话会更有把握。也许有个帮手的话真的会不一样……

original: All right, if you're good enough at what you do to meet me in the village up near the peak, we can talk further.
translation: 好吧，如果你有本事一路杀到山顶附近的棚屋村去，我们再细谈。

original: I'll have a plan by the time I see you - if I see you. Good luck. It's going to be a lot harder for you to get up there than it will be for me.
translation: 我会在那里与你会合，将我的计划告诉你——前提是你能见得到我。祝你好运。毕竟比起我，你要去那里的难度可大多了。

original: Sounds like you've had enough of Tabitha. What if you had some help?
translation: 听起来好像你已经受够塔比瑟了。要不要来帮帮忙？

original: [FAILED] Hmm. While your enthusiasm is... admirable, I think I'd best stay here so I can warn other travelers.
translation: [失败] 呃。尽管我很欣赏你的……勇气，不过我觉得最好还是留在这里警告其他旅行者。

original: Hey! Let's you and me - you know, us! - let's overthrow Tabitha together!
translation: 嘿！你和我——就是我们！一起打倒塔比瑟！

original: What is Jacobstown?
translation: 雅各布斯镇是什么？

original: The opposite of Black Mountain! A stable community of Mutants, mostly, led by a mentally stable leader.
translation: 是黑山的对立面！一个安定祥和的变种人城镇，由一个神经正常的首领管理。

original: Humans are welcome there, so long as they behave themselves. Look northwest of Red Rock Canyon if you want to find it.
translation: 只要没有不当的行为，人类在那里也是受欢迎的。如果你要去的话，它就在红岩峡谷的北面。

original: How did Tabitha end up in control?
translation: 塔比瑟是怎么得到控制权的？

original: For years, Black Mountain was a peaceful community. Its leader, Marcus, broadcast an invitation to Mutants throughout the wasteland.
translation: 很多年以前，黑山还是一片祥和之地。当时的首领马可世通过无线电向散落在废土各地的变种人发出邀请。

original: That's how I found Black Mountain. So did others, most of them second generation Mutants. Marcus welcomed everyone - that was his mistake.
translation: 我就是这样来到黑山的。其他人也是——他们大部分是第二代变种人。马可世欢迎每个人的到来，可他错就错在这里。

original: The community ended up being mostly second gen - not very bright, but easy to influence. Fine, until the Nightkin came along, led by Tabitha...
translation: 最终这里的第二代变种人占了多数——他们不够聪明，很容易受外界的影响。后来，塔比瑟带着夜行族来到了这里……

original: In a week she had most of the second-gens thinking she was some kind of prophet - and that she should be broadcasting her "truth," not Marcus.
translation: 只用了一周的时间，她就让大部分第二代变种人对她顶礼膜拜。他们认为她是先知，她传播的才是"真理"，而马可世只是个骗子。

original: Marcus saw what was coming and decided to leave before things got out of hand. He smashed the radio and left to found Jacobstown.
translation: 于是马可世决定在事情失控之前离开黑山。他毁掉了无线电，之后又建立了雅各布斯镇。

original: Why are you here, instead of Jacobstown?
translation: 为什么你在这里，而不是雅各布斯镇？

original: Marcus sent me here a couple of months ago to check on Black Mountain. I suppose you could say I came here as a spy.
translation: 马可世在几个月之前派我来黑山看看。你也可以把我当成间谍。

original: But with no signs of Tabitha's weakening, and none of the second-gens ready to revolt or to come to Jacobstown, there wasn't much I could do.
translation: 不过我既没有发现塔比瑟的活动有减弱的迹象，也没发现第二代变种人有企图叛变或者转投雅各布斯镇的苗头，所以我确实也做不了什么事。

original: Down here, on the other hand, I've saved a dozen Mutants from heading up the mountain. It's not much, but it's something.
translation: 话又说回来，我倒是成功阻止了不少想上山的变种人。虽然不值一提，但也还算有点意义。

original: I have my own reasons to stay away from Jacobstown for a while - reasons we won't be discussing - so I've stayed here.
translation: 我有些个人原因，需要暂时远离雅各布斯镇一段时间——具体情况你就别问了。反正我就留在这里了。

original: The road is a series of switchbacks up to the peak. There are three blockades, plus patrols. Sneaking past them would be... difficult.
translation: 去山顶的路上有一连串的急弯，还有三处路障和一些巡逻队。想偷溜过去还是……有点难度的。

original: Just before the peak is a kind of shanty village. More second-gens there. And then there's Tabitha's compound - heavily guarded by her Nightkin.
translation: 在到达山顶前你会看到一个棚屋村，那里有很多第二代变种人。继续走，就是塔比瑟的管制区，那里由她手下全副武装的夜行族把守。

original: What sort of trouble should I expect if I head up?
translation: 如果我上山的话应该注意些什么？

original: The road is a series of switchbacks up to the peak. There are three blockades, plus patrols. Sneaking past them would be... difficult.
translation: 去山顶的路上有一连串的急弯，还有三处路障和一些巡逻队。想偷溜过去还是……有点难度的。

original: Just before the peak is a kind of shanty village. More second-gens there. And then there's Tabitha's compound - heavily guarded by her Nightkin.
translation: 在到达山顶前你会看到一个棚屋村，那里有很多第二代变种人。继续走，就是塔比瑟的管制区，那里由她手下全副武装的夜行族把守。

original: Remind me what I should expect if I head up?
translation: 如果我上山的话你有什么要提醒我的？

original: You say that super mutants were *made*?
translation: 你说那些超级变种人是*造*出来的？

original: Yes... And it's not something I care to discuss with one of your kind.
translation: 是的……不过我可没兴趣和一个人类讨论这件事。

original: If you have some insatiable curiosity about the matter, talk to Marcus in Jacobstown. He's more patient with such questions than I am.
translation: 如果你真的那么想知道，就去雅各布斯镇找马可世吧。回答这些问题，他可比我有耐心得多。

original: Why are some Super Mutants smarter than others?
translation: 为什么有的超级变种人会比其他的聪明？

original: Not all Super Mutants were created equal. Or at the same time, or for the same purpose.
translation: 并非所有的超级变种人都是按照同一标准制造的。要么是批次上的区别，要么就是制造目的上的区别。

original: The first generation tends to be smarter, stronger, and... more civilized, I suppose you could say, than the ones made later, save the Nightkin.
translation: 与之后制造的相比，第一代超级变种人更聪明，更强壮，也更……文明——大概你会这么说吧，当然夜行族除外。

original: Spare me the "poor mutants" rap, all right?
translation: 别再和我说什么"可怜变种人"的饶舌，行吧？

original: Of course. Sorry I bothered you. Enjoy your travels.
translation: 当然。抱歉打扰你了。旅途愉快。

original: Moving on...
translation: 那我走了……

original: Yes, that's exactly what I'm telling you to do. Move on.
translation: 是的，这正是我对你的要求。走吧。

original: Sorry about that. No offense intended.
translation: 抱歉。我不是有意冒犯。

original: And none taken... since you apologized.
translation: 既然你都道歉了……那就算了。

original: You seem friendly, for a mutant.
translation: 以一个变种人来说，你很友好。

original: Keep saying things like that, and I won't be so friendly. Not every Super Mutant is a brain-damaged brute.
translation: 你再这么说，我就不友好了。又不是所有的超级变种人脑子都有问题。

original: Many of us are just as intelligent as basic humans - and the rest don't really have any choice in the matter, do they?
translation: 我们中大部分的智力水平都和普通人类一样——至于剩下的那部分，他们也不想的，是吧？

original: They had it coming if they drew on you.
translation: 如果他们这么做，那是咎由自取。

original: So thats it?  You've resorted to raiding and crime?
translation: 是吗？所以你们就开始剪径了？

original: Perhaps I could convince them to take you back.
translation: 也许我可以说服他们让你回去。

original: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会尽量想办法的。

original: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会尽量想办法的。

original: You're right.  You guys are totally screwed.
translation: 你说得对。你们完全搞砸了。

original: Well you made the right one.
translation: 你说得挺对。

original: [Rhonda] You're listening to Radio Free Utobitha, bringing truth to Utobithians 24 hours a day! Welcome!
translation: [郎达] 您现在收听的是乌托比萨自由频道，我们将全天24小时向每个乌托比萨人传播真理！欢迎收听！

original: [Tabitha] I am in control here!
translation: [塔比瑟] 在这里我说了算！

original: [Rhonda] That was today's and every day's extra special guest, Best Friend Tabitha, supreme commander of Utobitha and Wearer of the True Eyes!
translation: [朗达] 现在来欢迎今天同时也是每天的特别来宾，我们最好的朋友塔比瑟，同时也是乌托比萨的最高统治者和真实之眼的持有者！

original: [Tabitha] I still miss you, Rhonda. After all these years...
translation: [塔比瑟] 朗达，这么多年过去了，我对你的思念丝毫未减……

original: [Rhonda] Also joining us from his locked cell is Raul Tejada, master mechanic who can be executed at any time! Hello, Raul. Or should that be "Hola?"
translation: [朗达] 同时，还有劳尔·特哈达，从监狱里专程赶来参加我们的节目！他是一名随时可能被处决的机械大师！你好，劳尔。或者说我该说”吼啦？“

original: [Raul] Uh, either one works.
translation: [劳尔] 呣，都可以。

original: [Tabitha] Today you die, Raul! I command it!
translation: [塔比瑟] 你今天死定了，劳尔！我已经下定决心了！

original: [Rhonda] Ooooh, Raul. Supreme commander Tabitha says you die today. Any reaction?
translation: [朗达] 哦哦哦，劳尔。最高指挥官塔比瑟叫嚣你今天一定会死。对此你有什么感想？

original: [Raul] I going to obey supreme Tabitha, claro, whatever she say. Just I feel so bad I die before I fix her special robot.
translation: [劳尔] 我当然会听从至高无上的指挥官塔比瑟的命令。只是很遗憾，我还没能修好她的机器人，就得一命呜呼了。

original: [Silence.]
translation: [沉默。]

original: [Tabitha] <Growls in frustration.>
translation: [塔比瑟] <沮丧的咆哮着>

original: [Rhonda] We'll be right back after this musical interlude! Enjoy!
translation: [朗达] 在欣赏完这悦耳的片段之后，我们马上回来！好好享受吧！

original: The REPCONN museum is now closed. Visitors are required to leave the premises.
translation: 瑞普康博物馆现在已经闭馆。请游客立即离开。

original: Hello, please remember closing time is at 5 PM. Please make your way toward an exit.
translation: 你好，请记住，闭馆时间为下午5点。请按时离开。

original: This is the final stop on our tour. This model of our solar system is a small example of where the partnership between RobCo and REPCONN hopes to go.
translation: 这就是我们旅途的终点站。一个小小的太阳系模型，它展示了罗科和瑞普康未来的合作方向。

original: See those little rockets zipping about? They are manned by robots, tirelessly looking for resources to mine on planets beyond our own.
translation: 看到那些四处穿梭的小火箭了吗？它们正在机器的控制下，不知疲倦寻找其它星球上的矿产资源。

original: And that's it for our tour today, Rocketeers - RobCo and its tiny partner REPCONN thank you! Any further questions, please, feel free to ask.
translation: 以上就是我们今天展览的全部内容，火箭专家们，罗科和合作伙伴瑞普康感谢各位的光临！若有问题，请尽管提问。

original: Now for the highlight of our tour! Due to a generous donation from RobCo, this next exhibit showcases the wondrous world of - robots!
translation: 接下来是本次展览的一大看点！得益于罗科的慷慨捐助，下个展厅中，将悉数展出所有让世人为之惊奇的——机器人！

original: Around you are the incredible Eyebot, the fearsome Sentry Bot, and the {chuckles}always-helpful Mr. Handy. That helpfulness runs through our whole line!
translation: 在你们四周的是不可思议的眼球机器人，可怕的铁卫兵以及{chuckles}无所不能的“巧手”先生。它的作用可是贯穿了我们整条生产线哦！

original: Now these colorful fellows behind me are REPCONN's earliest... experiments in flight. Feel free to read the plaques and learn, Rocketeers!
translation: 现在位于我身后的这些彩色的玩意是瑞普康最早的…宇航计划试验品。请各位火箭专家们自行查阅其面前的铭牌！

original: {Rhonda} Welcome back, Utobitha. I have with me Best Friend Tabitha, who has something important she'd like to share.
translation: {朗达}欢迎回来，乌托比萨。我正和我最好的朋友塔比瑟一起，她有重要的事情要向我们宣布。

original: {Tabitha} Well Rhonda, I'm a little concerned about the number of humans that keep coming to Black Mountain.
translation: {塔比瑟}好了，朗达，我注意到一群人正向黑山进发。

original: {Rhonda} Humans? Here? Why do you think they'd do that?
translation: {朗达}人类？朝这里？你觉得他们为何要这么做？

original: {Tabitha} Honestly, I think they're a little jealous of the ideal society we've built here, Rhonda. And I can't blame them.
translation: {塔比瑟}坦白的说，我觉得他们是有些嫉妒我们建立的这个理想社会，朗达。但我不能责怪他们。

original: {Tabitha} We have everything we need here. Food, shelter, safety, entertainment. It really is a paradise.
translation: {塔比瑟}我们现在别无他求。食物，住所，安全，还有娱乐。这里简直美若天堂。

original: {Rhonda} There's no arguing with the truth, is there?
translation: {朗达}真理面前无可争辩，不是么？

original: {Tabitha} But humans need to be aware that Black Mountain is no place for them. In fact, it's even dangerous for them here.
translation: {塔比瑟}但人类必须意识到，黑山并不适合他们。反而对他们来说很危险。

original: {Rhonda} {gasps}Why is that?
translation: {朗达}为何这样说？

original: {Tabitha} First of all, there's the radiation. That warm, peaceful glow that we all know and love doesn't have the same effect on humans.
translation: {塔比瑟}首先，就是辐射。那温暖祥和的光芒对我们而言是这么平常又美妙，对人类却并非如此。

original: {Tabitha} You see, humans are weak, and have an inherent defect that causes them to fall apart when exposed to radiation.
translation: {塔比瑟}你看，人类是脆弱的，这种不可避免的缺陷让他们一旦暴露在辐射中就必死无疑。

original: {Rhonda} That sounds terrible! How do they stand it? Radiation's, like, everywhere!
translation: {朗达}听起来真可怕！他们是如何存活的？辐射，简直是，无处不在！

original: {Tabitha} I know. They truly have a hard lot in life. Which may explain why they're so irritable all the time.
translation: {塔比瑟}我知道。他们的生活自然苦不堪言。同时也解释了为什么人类总是暴躁易怒。

original: {Rhonda} I don't know about you, Utobitha, but my eyes have really been opened. We'll be back after some music!
translation: {朗达}我不知道你怎么想的，乌托比萨，不过听了这一席话，我真觉得大开眼界。我们音乐之后马上回来！

original: [Rhonda] Welcome back, Utobitha. It's time!
translation: [朗达]欢迎回来，乌托比萨。是时候了！

original: [Tabitha] Time for what, Rhonda?
translation: [塔比瑟]什么时候，朗达？

original: [Rhonda] <sing-song> True Eye Seeing Time!
translation: [朗达]真理时刻！

original: [Applause track.]
translation: [掌声响起。]

original: [Rhonda] I see that you're already wearing the True Eyes, Best Friend Tabitha, along with your head of True Hair. What do you see?
translation: [朗达]塔比瑟，我看到你已经拥有了真理之眼，还有了一头浓密的真理之发。你看到了什么？

original: [Tabitha] Uh... I see Neil...
translation: [塔比瑟]啊…我看到尼尔…

original: [Rhonda] First-generation Neil from down the mountain? And what is he up to?
translation: [朗达]山下来的第一代变种人？他在做什么？

original: [Tabitha] Standing outside his shack down there.
translation: [塔比瑟]站在他的窝棚外面。

original: [Rhonda] In the same spot as before, or has he moved?
translation: [朗达]还是站在原地？就没有挪个身子？

original: [Tabitha] A little.
translation: [塔比瑟]一点点。

original: [Rhonda] Wow! It must be so exciting to see and know all. What a powerful reminder of your ultimate authority and power for our listeners!
translation: [朗达]哇！这真是太令人激动了。再次向我们的听众证明了你的无上的权威和伟大的力量！

original: [Tabitha] I see Moe...
translation: [塔比瑟]我看到了阿萌…

original: [Rhonda] Moe, the Centaur? Favorite Centaur Moe? What's he up to?
translation: [朗达]阿萌，那个多脚兽？可爱的多脚兽阿萌？他在做什么？

original: [Tabitha] Licking the gate. Wants out of the pen.
translation: [塔比瑟]舔着大门。想从圈中出来。

original: [Rhonda] Now, I'm almost afraid to ask, but do you see any - you know - threats out there?
translation: [朗达]啊！是的！那么，我虽然有点不敢问了，但你是否看到了……或者预见到了……威胁？

original: [Tabitha] Threats all around us... converging... like a noose, tightening! Two-head-bear people astride battle cattles!
translation: [塔比瑟]威胁从未离去，它一直萦绕在我们身边…就像一股绞索，越勒越紧！加州佬还有凯撒军团，他们是不会善罢甘休的！

original: [Rhonda] <unnerved> Not the the dreaded battle cattle training to hunt mutants?
translation: [朗达]难道不只是那些可怕的凯撒牛头战士们在训练捕杀变种人吗？

original: [Rhonda] <calmer> Would it be going too far to say that your gift of True Eyesight is the only thing saving our community from annihilation?
translation: [朗达]我是不是可以这么说，只有你的真实之眼才能够阻止我们的族群遭受灭绝？

original: [Rhonda] Because I think it's so important for everyone - even the dumb-dumbs - how impossible it is to sneak up on us! More after this!
translation: [朗达]我觉得这对大家至关重要——甚至对那些蠢蛋也是——这种神迹竟然会悄悄的降临在我们身上！尤其在这种危难时刻！

original: [Tabitha] Are you tired of getting chased because you're bigger than humans, and scaring them?
translation: [塔比瑟]你是否已经厌倦了被四处驱赶的生活，仅仅因为你比人类高大，会吓着他们？

original: [Tabitha] Did you kill some and they overreacted? Are two-head-bear people shooting at you, and battle cattle mooing? Beware the battle cattle...
translation: [塔比瑟]你是否因为人类的反应过度而大开杀戒？那些加州佬是不是还会对着你们开火，凯撒的崽子们是不是还会对着你们大呼小叫？

original: [Rhonda]<whispering a line prompt> "Leave the fear behind."
translation: [朗达]“置恐惧于身外”。

original: [Tabitha] Leave the Fear Behind. Meet at the Mountain Top! Enjoy life in a state of Utobitha - Free, Safe, Secure!
translation: [塔比瑟] 置恐惧于身外。居于山峦之巅！享受在乌托比萨的每时每刻吧——自由，安全，顺心！

original: [Rhonda] <rushing sotto voce like disclaimers at the end of prescription ads> Freedom limited to following the commands of Best Friend Tabitha...
translation: [朗达] 自由的前提是您必须遵循好朋友塔比瑟的命令……

original: [Rhonda] <Cont.> Safety not guaranteed against siege or assault by two-head-bear people or battle cattles.
translation: [朗达] 由于可能遭遇加州佬和凯撒牲口们的的围追堵截，此地并不保障安全。

original: [Rhonda] <Cont.> Many infractions are punishable by death, no allowances for dumb-dumb "misunderstandings".
translation: [朗达] 多数违令者都将被处死，不允许出现所谓的“误会”。

original: [Tabitha] Utobitha! Come feel the difference!
translation: [塔比瑟]乌托比萨！来感受全新的生活吧！

original: [Rhonda] You're listening to UNC - the Utobithian News Channel - with breaking news!
translation: [朗达]你们正在聆听的是乌托比萨新闻频道——马上发布震撼消息！

original: [Rhonda] The execution of master mechanic Raul Tajeda has again been commuted for a period of 24 hours to allow time for important repairs.
translation: [朗达]由于需要处理繁重的修理工作，总工程师劳尔·特哈达的处决再次被推迟24个小时。

original: [Tabitha] <snarling> This time you will get it done, Raul!
translation: [塔比瑟] 这次你必须把她修好，劳尔！

original: [Rhonda] Joining us from his cell to comment on the situation is Raul Tejada. Raul?
translation: [朗达]下面请正在服刑中的劳尔·特哈达说话。劳尔要自己评论一下目前的状况，请说吧？

original: [Raul] Hi, Tab - <catches himself> Rhonda.
translation: [劳尔]你好，塔比——朗达。

original: [Rhonda] What's your take on the situation?
translation: [朗达]你对现在的情况有什么看法？

original: [Raul] All I want is to make that special robot work again, you know? I give it my best.
translation: [劳尔]您应该明白，我现在唯一想做的就是让这个独一无二的机器人重新运转起来。我已经竭尽全力了。

original: [Rhonda] We'll be right back after this word from our sponsor during which Raul will contemplate how lucky he is to be alive.
translation: [朗达]接下来进一段赞助商广告，我们马上回来。同时劳尔将会重新审视自己能活着是多么的幸运。

original: Not yet. Wait here.
translation: 还不行。在这等等。

original: Whatever you need to do, be quick about it.
translation: 不管你想干嘛，都抓紧点。

original: You say Marcus smashed the radio. Not very well, apparently?
translation: 你说马可世把无线电给毁了。可收音机的信号似乎没受到影响啊？

original: Heh. There's a sad story behind that. Marcus smashed it just fine, but while we were gone some Ghoul named Raul came along.
translation: 唉。那背后是个悲伤的故事。马可世确实毁掉了无线电，但他离开以后，来了一个叫劳尔的尸鬼。

original: Tabitha turned him into her personal mechanic. A slave, really. See, if I'd been standing down here, I could've warned him before it was too late.
translation: 塔比瑟把他当成自己的私人机械师。其实就是奴隶。你看，如果当时我能早点来这里的话，我就能提前警告他了。

original: That's your plan? I *am* an intruder in the village!
translation: 这就是你的计划？我不*就是*入侵者吗！

original: Yes, so try to stay out of sight, because they'll be coming this way.
translation: 对，所以尽量别暴露，他们很快就会过来。

original: Okay, I can make that work.
translation: 好的，我会搞定的。

original: Good luck. We're going to need it.
translation: 祝你好运。我们都需要好运。

original: How did you end up selling weapons?
translation: 你为什么会跑这儿来卖军火？

original: Going home didn't feel right, not with those savages camped on the other side of the river, sharpening their knives.
translation: 河对岸那帮野蛮人依然在磨刀霍霍呢，我就算回了家也不自在。

original: And I still get to see my old platoon when they pass through here... make sure the new C.O. is treating them right, and sneak them extra ammo.
translation: 何况，我的老部队经过这里时，我还能关照一下……看看他们的新指挥官是否称职，顺便再偷塞点弹药给他们。

original: Anyway, I was always complaining about the standard issue gear. The new kids don't even get body armor, can you believe that?
translation: 总之，我以前就常常抱怨我们的装备标准实在太差。新兵们甚至连防弹衣都没有，你能相信吗？

original: What was your rank?
translation: 你过去的军衔是什么？

original: Staff sergeant, Third Platoon, Bravo Company. I was at the Dam when the Legion hit us, three years back.
translation: 陆军中士，三排，B连。三年前军团进攻大坝的时候，我也在前线。

original: That was a shitstorm, and don't let anybody tell you different. The brass try to play it down, but most of them were back at McCarran.
translation: 那场仗打得极其难看，你可别信其他人的话。当官的想把这件事淡化处理，可当时他们多数人都躲在麦卡伦营地。

original: Administrative discharge? What does that mean?
translation: 行政处分？什么意思？

original: It means my C.O. was an asshole, and I told him to eat shit. He ordered me to flog a couple "deserters."
translation: 意思是我的上司是个混蛋，我让他去吃屎。他居然命令我去鞭打一群"逃兵。"

original: Those kids didn't desert. They just got liquored up on the Strip and missed roll call.
translation: 那帮小鬼根本就没逃跑。他们不过是在长街喝高了，错过了集合号。

original: I don't know what else the brass expects... half these kids don't get more than two weeks of training before they ship 'em out here.
translation: 我实在不懂那些当官的在想什么……这群小鬼被送过来之前，有一半人只接受过不到两个礼拜的训练。

original: Just show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: You do a lot of business with prospectors?
translation: 你经常和淘金客做生意吗？

original: Sure do. Lots of folk been coming out east, sorting through junk, looking for whatever they can sell.
translation: 当然，很多人都会跑到东边来拣垃圾，只要能拿来卖钱的东西，都能入他们的法眼。

original: Times are tough back home. Too many people, not enough work. Unless you like shoveling brahmin shit.
translation: 老家那边的情况并不好。人太多，工作太少。除非你喜欢铲双头牛粪。

original: Something like that. Are you an NCR soldier?
translation: 大概吧。你是个NCR士兵？

original: Hell, yes sir. Well... not officially. Not anymore.
translation: 当然是，长官。好吧……严格来说不是。不再是了。

original: They mustered me out a year ago. Administrative discharge.
translation: 我在一年前被他们开除了。行政处分。

original: Hell, yes ma'am. Well... not officially. Not anymore.
translation: 当然是，长官。好吧……严格来说不是。不再是了。

original: They mustered me out a year ago. Administrative discharge.
translation: 我在一年前被他们开除了。行政处分。

original: [FAILED] Invalid response! You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败]验证无效！在警报拉响之前，你还有三十秒的时间离开。

original: [FAILED] Invalid response! You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败]验证无效！在警报拉响之前，你还有三十秒的时间离开。

original: [FAILED] Invalid response! You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败]验证无效！在警报拉响之前，你还有三十秒的时间离开。

original: Are you with the NCR?
translation: 你是NCR的人？

original: Go on.
translation: 继续。

original: So I hooked up with a couple other vets... bribed a Gun Runner...
translation: 我找了几个老兵合伙…还收买了一位军火贩子…

original: Now we're supplying grunts, mercs, and anybody else on our side. We don't make much... but at least we're saving lives.
translation: 现在我们主要把货卖给士兵、雇佣兵，只要是站在我们这边的就行。我们挣得不多…但至少我们是在救人一命。

original: NCR doesn't have the caps to outfit their troops?
translation: NCR没钱装备部队？

original: Vegas is bleeding us dry. We're tossing caps at a hundred different problems, while Caesar bides his time and lets us wear ourselves out.
translation: 维加斯快把我们的血给抽干了。各类问题层出不穷，我们前后花了不知多少瓶盖，而凯撒却只是作壁上观，等着我们流尽最后一滴血。

original: This war is gonna bankrupt the NCR, unless we finish off the Legion fast and dirty.
translation: 这场战争已经要让NCR破产了，除非我们能尽快将军团彻底消灭。

original: We shouldn't be perched up at the Dam - we ought to be crossing the Colorado and sticking a boot up Caesar's ass.
translation: 我们不该死盯着那座大坝——我们就该直接跨过大峡谷，一棍子捅爆凯撒的屁股。

original: Let me see what I can do.
translation: 让我看看我能做什么。

original: I need something repaired.
translation: 我有些东西要修一下。

original: Sorry, I was just leaving.
translation: 抱歉，我马上离开。

original: [FAILED] Invalid response! You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败]验证无效！在警报拉响之前，你还有三十秒的时间离开。

original: [FAILED] Invalid response! You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败]验证无效！在警报拉响之前，你还有三十秒的时间离开。

original: [FAILED] Invalid response! You have 30 seconds to vacate before security is alerted.
translation: [失败]验证无效！在警报拉响之前，你还有三十秒的时间离开。

original: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在打算做什么？

original: I still have a job to do here. Some Mutants may have heard Tabitha's broadcasts and are headed here even as we speak.
translation: 我在这里的工作尚未完成。目前，依然有很多变种人可能会因为听了塔比瑟的广播而朝这里来。

original: I'll remain and direct any who show up toward Jacobstown, where they'll be much better off.
translation: 我会留在这里，指引那些人去雅各布斯镇，在那里他们会过得更好一些。

original: Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff.
translation: 重新汇编普瑞姆·斯利姆，调整为普瑞姆的警长。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Bzzzt... Law Enforcement Protocols reinstated, pardner. Initializing use of force authorization... authorization found. Yee-haw!
translation: [成功] 滋滋…执法数据已恢复，朋友。初始化武力使用许可…获得许可。咦哈！

original: <Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff.>
translation: <重新汇编普瑞姆·斯利姆，调整为普瑞姆的警长。>

original: [FAILED] Aw, shucks, SYSTEM RUNTIME ERROR! Unable to initialize Law Enforcement Protocols, pardner!
translation: [失败] 喔，哼，程序运行错误！无法初始化执法数据，朋友！

original: <Try to reprogram Primm Slim to act as Sheriff of Primm.>
translation: <尝试重新汇编普瑞姆·斯利姆，将其行为调节成普瑞姆的警长。>

original: Oh, I don't know anything, mister. I just think it, and then I don't.
translation: 噢，我什么都不知道，先生。我就是动了动脑子，然后就没有了。

original: How do you know these things?
translation: 你是怎么知道这些事的？

original: Oh, I don't know anything, ma'am. I just think it, and then I don't.
translation: 噢，我什么都不知道，女士。我就是动了动脑子，然后就没有了。

original: How do you know these things?
translation: 你是怎么知道这些事的？

original: So you convinced those NCR sons of bitches to take an interest, did you? Well, we need the help. I'll sign.
translation: 这么说，NCR那帮狗娘养的被你说动了，是不是？好吧，我们确实需要帮助。我签。

original: Will you sign this formal letter asking the NCR to take control of Primm?
translation: 你会在这张请求NCR接管普瑞姆的公函上签字吗？

original: Punk?  Thats my line.
translation: 蠢货？这可是我的台词。

original: Heh, you've got moxy, buddy, but we don't take kindly to tourists on our turf. 100 caps should cover this trip into our territory.
translation: 呵，口气倒不小。但我们不欢迎游客闯入我们的领地。100个瓶盖，就当是你进来的门票钱吧。

original: Are you deserters?
translation: 你们是逃兵？

original: I like to think that we are Prisoners Of War that managed to escape before capture.
translation: 我觉得更像是被抓之前就逃出来的战俘。

original: I don't know how long it'll be before the Legion crosses the river, but sure as fuck I don't want to be wearing a NCR inform when they get here.
translation: 我不知道军团还有多久会渡河，但我绝对不想在他们来的时候还穿着NCR制服。

original: I guess I can understand that.
translation: 我可以理解。

original: We figured we'd make some money in New Vegas and then beat feet.
translation: 我们本打算在新维加斯弄点钱，然后就远走高飞。

original: Then we'd head north or something and take our caps to start up a ranch or something.
translation: 原计划往北走，拿着这些钱去建一个牧场什么的。

original: <Attack> Well then. It sounds like there might be a bounty on your heads.
translation: <攻击> 哎呀，听起来你的脑袋值不少钱呢。

original: Perhaps, but you won't be the one to collect!
translation: 也许吧，但也轮不到你来领赏！

original: So that's it? You've resorted to robbing and raiding to solve your problems?
translation: 所以？你们就开始靠抢劫他人来解决自己的问题？

original: Our luck has gone south since we lost all of our money gambling in Vegas. We didn't go AWOL from duty to become raiders.
translation: 我们点儿太背，在维加斯把钱都输光了。我们并没有临阵脱逃去当掠夺者。

original: But we've seen what the Legion does to people that survive their battles. We wanted to be gone before the fighting starts.
translation: 可我们见识过军团是如何对待战俘的，我们只是希望在战争爆发前就离开。

original: And we heard there may be some safety up in New Canaan.
translation: 我们听说新迦南可能会更安全。

original: <Attack> Well, I think your luck just ran out.
translation: <攻击>嗯，我也觉得你的运气用完了。

original: Looks like we've got a wannabe hero on our hands, boys.
translation: 看来这儿有人想逞英雄啊，伙计们。

original: Why not just turn yourselves in?
translation: 为什么不去自首？
