original: No fucking way. We're deserters now, the NCR isn't going to throw us a ticker-tape parade for going home.
translation: 不可能。我们现在是逃兵，NCR才不会敲锣打鼓欢迎我们回去呢。

original: You're right.  You're totally screwed.
translation: 你说得对。你们完蛋了。

original: I'm getting tired of your chatter. Hand over 100 caps, or we start using you for target practice.
translation: 我不想再听你废话了。交出100个瓶盖，否则我们就拿你当活靶子。

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才技能>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Fuck, we lose again.
translation: [成功] 他妈的，我们又输了。

original: We heard Primm was ripe for the picking, so figured we could come here and shakedown some of the suckers. We weren't expecting a sheriff here.
translation: 我们听说普瑞姆是个趁火打劫的好地方，所以就想来这儿逮几个白痴捞一笔。没想到这里居然有个警长。

original: We're just trying to put as many miles from NCR as we can, we don't want to be anywhere near New Vegas when the Legion crosses the river.
translation: 我们也是想尽量远离NCR的领地。我们可不希望在军团渡河时还留在新维加斯附近。

original: Your turf? I guess the news hasn't reached you yet, Primm has law again.
translation: 你们的领地？我想你还不知道吧，普瑞姆又有新执法者了。

original: [FAILED] I seriously doubt that. You've got about as much personality as a baked potato.
translation: [失败] 我很怀疑你的说法。你的人品相当不靠谱。

original: I'm getting tired of your chatter. Hand over the caps, or we start using you for target practice.
translation: 我不想再听你废话了。把钱交出来，否则我们就拿你当活靶子。

original: I can help if you'll let me!
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以帮你！

original: <Attack> Well, in that case, maybe I'll do the town a favor and take you down.
translation: <攻击> 哦，既然这样，也许我应该把你们都干掉，给镇子做点好事。

original: So be it. Perhaps your corpse will be better at coughing up the caps...
translation: 行啊。反正从你的尸体上拿钱还更省事……

original: That's some impressive weaponry. Where did it all come from?
translation: 这些武器真是上乘啊，你从哪里弄来的？

original: All Gun Runner merchandise is constructed on-site.
translation: 军火贩子的所有商品都在厂房内生产。

original: How did you get inside there?
translation: 你是怎么进去的？

original: This kiosk was specially constructed around me to deter theft and assault.
translation: 这座售货亭是专门为我建立的，为了防止小偷和强盗。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: This is the New Vegas branch of the Gun Runners, supplying the wasteland with only the finest armaments since 2155.
translation: 这里是军火贩子的新维加斯分部，始于2155年，致力为废土提供最好的军火。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你卖些什么。

original: I am ready to process our transaction.
translation: 我已经准备好交易了。

original: I'm here to provide support. Is there anything I might be able to help with?
translation: 我是来提供支援的。有什么我能帮忙的？

original: Hmm... you don't cook by any chance, do you? Farber's doing his best, but it's hard to manage an army with half my staff in line for the latrine.
translation: 嗯……你会做饭吗？应该不会吧？法伯已经尽力了，但如果你手下一半的兵都在等着排队上厕所，那你是没办法指挥军队的。

original: Honestly, we're fighting a lot of fires right now. The Fiends keep pressing their position from Vault 3.
translation: 说实话，我们现在四面都有仗要打。那些从3号避难所里出来的恶魔帮一直在骚扰我们。

original: We've got the Legion breathing down our necks across the river. We actually took an officer alive last week, but so far he hasn't spoken a word.
translation: 河对岸还有军团在虎视眈眈。上周我们刚活捉了他们一个军官，但他到现在都没开口说一个字。

original: I'm up for hire if you need some extra manpower around the base.
translation: 如果你需要额外的人手，随时可以雇我。

original: There are a lot of things I can't spare troops for right now.  If you can help us, we can definitely pay you for your work.
translation: 现在确实有太多事情我抽不出人手去做。如果你肯帮我们，我们一定会付你报酬的。

original: How are things going for the NCR around here?
translation: NCR在这地方的进展如何？

original: Could be better, I'll say that much.
translation: 我只能说，不够理想。

original: We set up here with our sights set on annexing New Vegas. That's a lot of resources that could do a lot of good for us. But that hasn't happened.
translation: 我们到这儿来的根本目的是为了吞并新维加斯。这里资源丰富，对我们会有很大用处。可最后的情况却完全相反。

original: If anything, they annexed us. They rake in the profits from our soldiers and we're stuck protecting them from the Legion. Not exactly the plan.
translation: 说他们吞并了我们还差不多。他们把我们的士兵榨得身无分文，我们还得成天为他们抵御军团入侵。和计划完全是两样子。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Come back and see us again soon.
translation: 我们会再见面的。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Sure. I'm all ears.
translation: 当然。洗耳恭听。

original: I could look into who's leaking NCR intelligence.
translation: 我可以调查是谁在泄露NCR的情报。

original: You? I think you've done enough.
translation: 你？我想你已经做得够多了。

original: Hmm... Well, why not? Given your recent arrival, at least I can safely rule you out as the leak.
translation: 嗯……好吧，也没什么不行。毕竟你才刚来这里，至少我能确信你没有参与泄密。

original: I'd like to have absolute trust in my men, but that's just not practical right now. Go ahead and look into it. See what you find.
translation: 虽然我也想相信自己的部下，但目前看来这个想法恐怕不太实际。你去调查吧，看看能不能有所发现。

original: I bet I could make the Legion prisoner talk.
translation: 我也许可以让那个军团俘虏开口。

original: I have Lieutenant Boyd on that already, and she's excellent. But I think she's hit a wall.
translation: 我已经让博伊德中尉负责这件事了。她虽然很优秀，但目前看来她是遇到困难了。

original: Talk to her, if you like. See if she has any use for you.
translation: 你愿意的话就去找她聊两句吧，看她需不需要你帮忙。

original: Her office is right above mine, but I think she might be interrogating right now. So she'd be upstairs on the other side of the building.
translation: 她的办公室就在我这间屋子的正上方。但我觉得她现在可能在审讯犯人，所以她应该会在楼上的另一侧。

original: The Fiends?
translation: 恶魔帮？

original: As in chem fiends. Biggest gang of raiders I've ever seen. Nothing like addiction to swell your numbers. Psychotic, and completely unpredictable.
translation: 一群嗑药的。是我见过的人数最多的掠夺者帮派。用毒瘾来拉拢帮众，相当有效。这帮人都是疯子，完全不可理喻。

original: They've set up shop in Vault 3 to the west. Every day they attack our positions and my men repel them.
translation: 他们在西边的3号避难所设立了据点，每天都向我们的阵地发起进攻，又屡次被我们击败。

original: But every day there's more of them and less of us. I sent one of my rangers after their leader to try and destabilize them. He didn't return.
translation: 但他们的规模在不断增长，我们却在减少。我派了一名游骑兵去消灭他们的首领，想就此瓦解他们。可他却没有回来。

original: Hell of a thing, losing a ranger. You come to depend on them. And they come through for you so often, you forget it can happen.
translation: 损失了一名游骑兵啊，简直亏大了。我太依赖他们了。他们几乎每次都能出色地完成任务，让你忘了他们也可能会死。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Wrong turn? Happens all the time. Do they give me a secretary? Of course not.
translation: 搞错了？这种事时有发生。比如他们老说要给我安排一位秘书，有吗？没有。

original: No, this is the first I've heard about Vault 22.
translation: 没有，这是我第一次听说22号避难所。

original: No, they wouldn't have briefed you, would they? Probably better that our junior fellows stay within the bounds of their pay grade, anyway.
translation: 没有，看来他们没向你介绍过，是吧？不过总比我那些光拿薪水不干活的手下好。

original: <Lie> Yes, that's right.
translation: <撒谎>是的，没错。

original: Wonderful! Straight to it, then. Have you signed the release forms? No? Doesn't matter - we'll keep that to ourselves.
translation: 太好了！那就开门见山吧。你有过免责声明吗？没有？没关系——我们知道你没有就行了。

original: Vault 22... where to begin...
translation: 22号避难所……从何说起呢……

original: You seem calm given that things are as bad as they are.
translation: 虽然情况这么糟，你看起来还是很淡定啊。

original: Calm is what you have to be when people look to you. And it's all you can be when things are out of your hands.
translation: 那么多人眼巴巴地看着你，你当然要淡定。事情已经超出了你的控制，不淡定又能怎样呢。

original: How much do you know about what happened with the NCR at Bitter Springs?
translation: NCR在苦泉的事你都知道多少？

original: You won't be having problems with intelligence leaks anymore.
translation: 你再也不用担心什么泄密问题了。

original: No? What happened?
translation: 是吗？怎么回事？

original: I know who bombed the monorail.
translation: 我知道是谁炸毁单轨列车的了。

original: What? Who?
translation: 什么？谁？

original: What do you need me to do?
translation: 你想要让我做什么？

original: I believe that the inhabitants of Vault 22 unlocked the secrets of vegetative growth.
translation: 我敢肯说22号避难所的居民已经洞悉了植物生长的奥秘。

original: Scientific discovery is never so simple as that.
translation: 科学探索从来就没有那么简单。

original: Isn't it? One directs one's efforts - or the efforts of others - toward a goal, and progress is made. It's a matter of incentives, nothing more.
translation: 是吗？为了一个目标，去促使自己或他人做出努力，不断进步。这不过是个动力的问题。

original: Tell me more.
translation: 再给我说说。

original: Good! I thought I sensed a kindred soul in you, beneath the wasteland veneer.
translation: 太棒了！尽管你浑身散发着废土的气息，但我相信你一定和我是同道中人。

original: I had some other questions.
translation: 我要问其它的问题。

original: Actually, I had some other questions.
translation: 实际上我还有些别的问题要问。

original: Oh? What might those be?
translation: 噢？什么问题？

original: Anything else I should know?
translation: 还有什么我应该知道的吗？

original: I thought it was a fairly straightforward assignment. It's a simple question of retrieving the data, which shouldn't prove overly challenging.
translation: 我觉得这个任务应该很简单。无非就是把数据取回来，不至于太困难吧。

original: Downloading the data will be handled by your Pip-Boy. You might think of yourself as a mere means of conveyance. No insult intended, of course.
translation: 把数据下载到你的哔哔小子里就行了。其实就是要你跑跑腿而已。当然，我无意冒犯。

original: I'll think about it.
translation: 我会考虑的。

original: Very well. I hope you'll consider this an open offer from the OSI. Now, I'm sure your time is valuable, so unless there was anything else...
translation: 很好。希望你能认真考虑科工部的这一公开要约。好了，我相信你的时间也很宝贵，如果没有其他事情的话……

original: All right. I'll do it.
translation: 好吧，我干。

original: Good. No need to check in with the NCR authorities, I can authorize your payment from OSI accounts.
translation: 很好。不必去找NCR报备了，我可以代表科工部直接发酬劳给你。

original: Vaults typically contain a server room on a lower level, where they would have backed up their research data. A computer room, you understand?
translation: 避难所的底层一般都会有个控制室，那里一定有他们备份的研究数据。就是有电脑机房，你明白吗？

original: Download all the information on the central server to your Pip-Boy. And you'll be certain to bring me any notes or samples that you find, won't you?
translation: 把中央服务器里的所有数据都下载到你的哔哔小子里去。如果还有其他记录或样本，也要记得一并带给我，好吗？

original: Get to the point.
translation: 说重点吧。

original: Fair enough. My point is this. I believe that the inhabitants of Vault 22 unlocked the secrets of vegetative growth.
translation: 行，那我说重点。我相信22号避难所的居民已经了解了植物生长的奥妙。

original: Nothing is impossible.
translation: 一切皆有可能。

original: Precisely. Science has proven that truth a thousand times over, but how many wasteland savages believe it? Present company excepted, of course.
translation: 没错，科学已经无数次证明了这一真理，可废土上这些未开化的野蛮人，又有多少愿意相信这一点呢？当然，我面前的这位除外。

original: The bounty I described to you is no idle fantasy. It exists, in primitive form, only a few miles from where we stand.
translation: 我向你讲述的事情可不是天方夜谭。在距离我们不过数英里的地方，就存在着这样的奇迹。

original: We need only reach out and unlock its secret. For that, the OSI needs you.
translation: 我们要做的就是解开这其中的奥秘。因此，我们需要你。

original: Yes, I'd say so.
translation: 是的，没错。

original: A realist. We have that in common. A year ago, I'd have said the same.
translation: 够现实的，咱们都一样。要是换做一年前，我也会说同样的话。

original: But what if I was to tell you that the wasteland can yield an endless bounty, and that the secret may lie a mere few miles from where we stand...
translation: 不过万一我告诉你，你的行为能够造福整个废土，而这一切的奥妙就隐藏在几里之外，你会怎么想呢……

original: We need only reach out and take it. And for that, I need you.
translation: 我们要做的就是解开其中的奥秘。因此，我们需要你。

original: Save the sales pitch. Just tell me what you want me to do.
translation: 不要再念宣传稿了。只要告诉我要做什么就行。

original: All right. Straight to the point. I believe that the inhabitants of Vault 22 unlocked the secrets of vegetative growth.
translation: 好吧，废话少说，我敢肯说22号避难所的居民已经洞悉了植物生长的奥秘。

original: Plants are spilling from their gate. No one tends them. No one waters them. Yet they multiply and spread in all directions.
translation: 避难所大门外竟然堆满了花草树木。也没有人打理，更没有水源，它们依还能长得郁郁葱葱。

original: Find the reason for this miraculous growth, and I promise you, the OSI will see that you are generously compensated.
translation: 只要你能找出这奇迹发生的原因，我向你保证，科工部一定会重赏你的。

original: I'm listening.
translation: 我听着呢。

original: Imagine, if you will, the wasteland in bloom... vast fields of corn that grow from seeds and produce their bounty in the space of a month...
translation: 想想看，只要你一转念，废土上就能开遍鲜花……不用一个月时间，广袤的玉米地里就将结出甜美的果实……

original: ...orchards of trees, their branches weighed halfway to the ground, hung with fat, ripe oranges. A harvest that could feed a city... or a nation.
translation: ……漫山的绿树，半垂着枝桠，无数硕大而成熟的橘子挂在上头。只要迎来丰年，这些作物就可以养活整座城市……乃至整个国家。

original: And all this... all this... requiring no more than a few of drops of precious water, and the efforts of only a handful of human farmers. Impossible?
translation: 而这一切……这一切……只需几滴甘霖，和几位农民辛勤的耕耘，你觉得这难道不可能吗？

original: Forget it. I don't have time for this.
translation: 算了吧。我没有时间。

original: Of course not! You're obviously a busy man. But if life should... quiet down a bit... I'm certain we can find a place for you here.
translation: 当然！你的确是个大忙人。不过万一你……以后能有空的话……我相信我们能替你谋个好差事。

original: Of course not! I can see you're a woman of consequence. But if life should... quiet down a bit... I'm certain we can find a place for you here.
translation: 当然！看得出来，你是位交际花。不过万一你……以后能有空的话……我相信我们能替你谋个好差事。

original: I'll think about it, and maybe I'll be back.
translation: 我会考虑的，也许我会回来的。

original: Naturally! Take all the time you need.
translation: 那是自然！请便吧。

original: I assure you, the OSI places considerable value upon our contractors. We will take good care of you, should you decide to accept our offer.
translation: 我向你保证，科工部一向重视雇员利益。我们不会亏待你的，只要你接受我们的条件。

original: Depends. How much are you paying?
translation: 那就要看情况了。你能付多少钱？

original: Ha ha! A mercenary, is that it? You won't be disappointed, I promise you. The Office of Science and Industry provides highly competitive benefits.
translation: 哈哈！原来你是个雇佣兵。价钱不会让你失望的，我保证。科工部能提供给你的报酬是相当可观的。

original: And as an external contractor, your pay would be... rather more competitive than those of our regular employees.
translation: 作为一名编外人员，你的报酬应该会比……我们编制内的雇员要高。

original: But we should keep that to ourselves, don't you think?
translation: 不过这件事情最好能保密，你觉得呢？

original: So... how about I tell you what we need, and then you can tell me whether you're up to it? No pressure, of course.
translation: 那么……我把任务一五一十地告诉你，然后你再决定去不去，如何？当然，不会给你任何压力的。

original: Where do you get your water?
translation: 你从哪弄到水的？

original: The NCR fixed up the pipe network pretty good, and water merchants like me are allowed to have some of it to sell.
translation: NCR修复了供水系统，也允许我这样的送水商人拿一些淡水出来卖。

original: If we have a water license, of course. Still, it beats the inconvenience of having to trek all the way to the lake to resupply.
translation: 当然，得有供水许可证才行。但还是比长途跋涉到湖边取水方便多了。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你卖的东西。

original: Glad to do it.
translation: 乐意之至。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Until next time!
translation: 下次见！

original: I'll be right back - there's something I need to double-check.
translation: 我马上回来——还有些事得再确认下。

original: I'll be waiting.
translation: 我等着你。

original: You'd be surprised what some people are capable of.
translation: 有些人真的是让你无法预料。

original: That doesn't implicate Crenshaw any more than it does anyone else.
translation: 但也不等于克伦肖就一定会去做这种事。

original: This isn't the resolution I was looking for when I assigned you to this.
translation: 我当初安排你进行调查，可不是想看到这样的结果。

original: Given the dubious circumstances under which the confession took place, the NCR can't compensate you.
translation: 你口中所谓的认罪情形依然有许多含糊不清的地方，因此我们没法给你支付报酬。

original: Ordinarily I'd have to arrest you for this. But we can hardly afford to waste resources in the wake of all that's happened.
translation: 通常来说，这种情况我应该直接逮捕你才对。但现在出了那么多事，我们已经不想再去浪费资源了。

original: I think your freedom is compensation enough for whatever it is you've done here, don't you?
translation: 干脆我就放你走好了，就凭你在这儿的所作所为，我已经算是仁至义尽了，你觉得呢？

original: [Speech] He confessed it to me. Right before he died.
translation: [口才] 他在断气前向我认了罪。

original: [FAILED] That's not exactly airtight.
translation: [失败] 依然有疑点。

original: [Speech] He confessed it to me before he died. He used the word "frumentarius."
translation: [口才] 他在断气前向我认了罪。他提到了"弗鲁曼塔里伊"这个词。

original: [SUCCEEDED] That's what the Legion calls their spies. I was afraid of this. Caesar's reach is longer than anybody guessed.
translation: [成功] 这是军团对他们手下间谍的称呼。我怕的就是这个。凯撒真是无孔不入。

original: If only we'd caught this sooner, before he got to the monorail...
translation: 要是我们能早点发现就好了，在他去车站之前……

original: Still, this investigation has been valuable to us, and you deserve to be compensated for it.
translation: 但这次调查依然对我们很有价值，你理应获得报酬。

original: The NCR appreciates the work you've done. Will there be anything else?
translation: NCR感谢你所做的一切。还有其他事吗？

original: He had explosives and plans for the operation bearing Caesar's emblem.
translation: 他手里有炸药，还有印着凯撒纹章的行动计划。

original: He had explosives and plans for the operation bearing Caesar's emblem.
translation: 他手里有炸药，还有印着凯撒纹章的行动计划。

original: I was afraid of this. Caesar's reach is longer than anybody guessed.
translation: 我怕的就是这个。凯撒真是无孔不入。

original: Private Crenshaw. He's dead now.
translation: 列兵克伦肖。他已经死了。

original: Crenshaw... I've met Crenshaw. At his disciplinary hearing. Still, this is hard to imagine - he was just a prankster.
translation: 克伦肖…我见过克伦肖，他因为违反纪律而接受过一次聆讯。但实在难以想象他会做出这样的事——他只是爱捣蛋而已。

original: Who are the Fiends?
translation: 恶魔帮是些什么人？

original: [Speech] I've been fighting for the wrong side. Let me prove myself to you.
translation: [口才] 我以前站错了边。给我个证明自己的机会。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I'll believe it when I see it. You've got one shot, and you're on a tight leash. I'll be watching.
translation: [成功] 那我要亲眼看到你的表现才行。再给你一次机会，你可得好好珍惜。我会盯着你的。

original: [FAILED] Forget it. We have no use for you here.
translation: [失败] 算了吧。我们这里不需要你。

original: We don't have much to go on right now. Lately every raiding party in New Vegas seems to have a map of our troop movements.
translation: 我们目前的情况很不顺利。最近一段时间，仿佛新维加斯所有的掠夺者帮派都掌握了我们的动向。

original: It derails everything. Supplies, reinforcements. And it'll only get worse, the longer we let it go on.
translation: 部署全乱套了。补给、增援。如果我们不马上采取措施，事态只会变得更加糟糕。

original: Captain Curtis is heading up the investigation right now. He can fill you in.
translation: 柯蒂斯上尉正在调查此事。他会向你说明详细情况。

original: I'll go to Vault 3 and see if I can find your ranger.
translation: 我会去3号避难所，也许能找到你的游骑兵。

original: That Vault is a hornet's nest. If you have second thoughts, no one would think less of you for it. But if you can get him home, it'd mean a lot.
translation: 那座避难所就是个马蜂窝。你要是临阵改变主意，我们也不会有意见。但如果你真能把他带回来，那可就帮我们大忙了。

original: Watch for civilians, too. The Fiends have been kidnapping locals. They just walk right into people's homes in the middle of the day and take them.
translation: 顺便也注意一下里面有没有平民。恶魔帮一直在绑架本地老百姓。他们都是光天化日之下直接闯进民宅里抢人。

original: But the man you're looking for is Bryce Anders. Anders was trying to find the leader, Motor-runner.
translation: 不过记住，你要找的正主是布里斯·安德斯。安德斯本来是要去铲除恶魔帮的首领轰鸣恶煞的。

original: You hear something like a chainsaw, you've found Motor-runner. Put a bullet in his head, and you'll have some new friends around here.
translation: 如果你听到类似电锯的声音，那就说明轰鸣恶煞来了。要是你能给他的脑门来一枪，那你在这儿肯定能交到一批新朋友。

original: Then it wouldn't matter if I mentioned our deal to the colonel?
translation: 如果我把咱们的交易告诉上校，不会有什么问题吧？

original: All right. Fair enough. No need to bring the military into this matter - it's between the two of us, after all.
translation: 好吧，好吧。没必要把军方也扯进来——毕竟这只是咱俩之间的私事。

original: ...and make sure you have some healthy competition.
translation: ……看来得你确实需要良性竞争。

original: There's... there's no need to do anything rash. Naturally, OSI would be willing to negotiate for exclusive rights to that data.
translation: 没……没必要冲动。科工部非常乐意就这份数据的专有权与你进行谈判。

original: Here. Take these caps. That's all of my contracting budget, and it's yours.
translation: 拿着，拿着这些瓶盖。我全部的预算经费都在这了，全给你。

original: Now, I've... got to get back to work. I'm sure you understand. Exit's over there, you can show yourself out.
translation: 现在，我得……回去工作了。你肯定会理解我的。出口就在那边，你请便。

original: What contract? You cut an under-the-table deal with me.
translation: 什么合同？口说无凭。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You're saying that I didn't file the proper paperwork, is that it? I suppose you're an expert on NCR procedures?
translation: [成功] 你是说我们没有签署书面文件吗？你该不会对NCR的规章制度熟悉到这个程度了吧？

original: All right. Then I'll sell this data to some other interested party...
translation: 行。那我就去给这些数据找个新的下家了……

original: [SUCCEEDED] Now... wait a minute...
translation: [成功] 嘿……等等……

original: I'd be careful with that data. You didn't see those plants in the Vault.
translation: 对待那些数据可要千万小心，你是没见过避难所里的那些植物。

original: Your concerns are perfectly understandable, but I assure you, they're entirely misplaced. We would never use a technology that wasn't fully tested.
translation: 你的担心我完全可以理解，但我向你保证，那些植物完全是实验失败的牺牲品。我们是不会随意采用未经严格测试的技术的。

original: We aren't some motley band of Vault alchemists. We're with the government, for goodness sake. Have a little faith in us!
translation: 我们可不是避难所里那群鱼龙混杂的江湖术士。老天，我们可是代表官方的。要对我们有信心啊！

original: I agree, I've more than done my part. You owe me more caps.
translation: 同意。我可费了好大一番力气呢，你得再多付我一些钱。

original: You want to renegotiate your contract. Mm. This is a very serious matter, you do understand that, don't you?
translation: 你想就合同细则重新与我进行谈判？嗯，这事非同小可，你明白吗？

original: I realize that one's word counts for little in the wasteland, but amongst civilized people, one doesn't just... demand more than one has agreed to.
translation: 我知道，在废土上，承诺是有多么微不足道，可是一个文明人……是不会这样出尔反尔，还得寸进尺的。

original: Glad to be of service.
translation: 很乐意效劳。

original: A pleasure working with you, really! I'll make certain that you're mentioned in the final report, you have my word on it.
translation: 与你合作真得愉快！我会在最终报告里提及你的名字的，绝不食言。

original: Fine. Just give me my reward.
translation: 好吧，给我报酬吧。

original: I knew you were a reasonable person. Here you are... our agreed-upon sum.
translation: 我就知道你是个讲道理的人。给你……这是我们讲好的数目。

original: By the way... you never warned me about the dangers in that place.
translation: 对了……你从来没提到那里如此凶险啊？

original: Didn't I? Did you encounter undue difficulties? Clearly not, or you wouldn't be standing here, would you?
translation: 是吗？难道你遇到了什么特殊困难？没有吧，要不然你也不会站在这里了，对吧？

original: All that matters is whether the data is intact...
translation: 最重要的是数据完好无损……

original: No problem. I can wait.
translation: 没关系，我可以等。

original: I think...  Williams' decryption algorithms seem to be working...
translation: 我想……威廉姆斯的解密算法似乎奏效了……

original: Yes... here it is! The data is mostly uncorrupted. This will make the board of directors finally sit up and take notice...
translation: 没错……成功了！数据大多完好。这下那些大佬们终于得好好坐下来听报告了……

original: Here, then... as promised. An agreeable sum, payable upon delivery of the data. You've more than done your part.
translation: 拿着吧……这是答应给你的酬劳。里面还包括了成功将数据送达的奖金，你已经超额完成任务了。

original: Never mind. I'll be back later.
translation: 没关系。我一会儿再来。

original: You won't keep me in suspense for long, I hope? Of course I can't authorize any payments until I have the data in hand...
translation: 你不会在耍我吧？当然如果你没拿到数据，报酬我是一分都不会给的……

original: I've brought the data from Vault 22.
translation: 我把22号避难所的数据带来了。

original: Wonderful! Excellent work! Let me see it... it'll take a moment to decode on my terminal...
translation: 太棒了！干得漂亮！让我瞧瞧……看来我的电脑得需要一段时间来解密这些数据了……

original: You said you were the Director of OSI?
translation: 你说你以前是科工部的主管？

original: Director of the entire OSI? Me? If I didn't know better, I'd say you were trying to plant seditious ideas in my head. Ha ha ha.
translation: 整个科工部的主管？我？幸亏我知道自己的身份，你这是灌输煽动思想。哈哈哈。

original: No, I direct our eastern operations. I've been responsible for squeezing unprecedented levels of power from the Dam.
translation: 不，我只管东部这一片。将水坝发的电输送到千家万户，这就是我的职责。

original: I'm also confronting the problem of food production, in what little spare time I have. But I've found some promising leads.
translation: 同时我也利用自己的闲暇时间从事一些和粮食生产有关的研究。我已经发现了一些关键线索。

original: Tell me more about the OSI.
translation: 多告诉我一些有关科工部的事情吧。

original: The Office of Science and Industry. That's a rather expansive topic. I could talk for hours, but I'm sure I'd bore you.
translation: 全称是科学与工业部。这话题有点大，我能说上好几个小时，但你肯定会不耐烦的。

original: Suffice to say, we are the leading edge of the NCR. Our work focuses on practical matters. Medicine, engineering, biology.
translation: 简而言之，我们代表着NCR最尖端的科技。我们的工作主要集中在应用领域，比如医药、工程和生物技术。

original: The Dam, for instance. OSI routes its energy supply to our cities in the west. That's only one responsibility of this office.
translation: 举个例子，就说胡佛水坝吧。科工部负责将其生产的电输送到西边的城市中。这只是我们的职责之一。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Yes... goodbye.
translation: 好的……再见。

original: This doesn't sound like my kind of job.
translation: 这种活我干不来。

original: I'm very sorry to hear that. If you should change your mind, the offer will stand. As will the substantial reward...
translation: 太遗憾了。要是你今后改变主意，就再来和我联系吧。当然，酬金我也一样会给你留着的……

original: This all sounds a little hard to believe.
translation: 这也太玄乎了。

original: Skepticism can be forgiven. But I think you'll come around... if the reports I've heard are true.
translation: 有怀疑也是正常的。可万一报告里说的是真的……我想你会感兴趣的。

original: Well... consider it a down payment on future service.
translation: 好吧……就当是为我以后再给你们跑腿预付的定金吧。

original: [FAILED] No, I'm sure I won't require your services in the future. The OSI does not enter into long-term arrangements with its contractors.
translation: [失败] 不可能，我保证以后我们不会再找你帮忙了。科工部是不会与编外人员签订长期合同的。

original: Of course, we're all very grateful for your efforts, and I'll make certain that you're credited in our final report. Good day to you.
translation: 当然，我们非常感激你为此付出的努力。我会在最终报告里提及你的名字的。再见。

original: [FAILED] If you are unhappy with the terms of our agreement, then consider this an object lesson.
translation: [失败] 如果你觉得我们的协议不好，那就权当这次行动是一次主题实践课吧。

original: In the future, I'm sure you'll consider your agreements and contracts more carefully. Now, here is the sum we agreed to.
translation: 我相信你今后一定会更加仔细地考虑其他协议或者合同的。就这样吧，我们谈拢的价钱就是这么多。

original: Of course, we're very grateful for your efforts, and I'll make certain that you're credited in our final report. Good day to you.
translation: 当然，我们非常感激你为此付出的努力。我会在最终报告里提及你的名字的。再见。

original: What am I doing here? What are you doing here?
translation: 我在这里干什么？你又在这里干什么？

original: Why I'm here is my business. If you don't have a question for me then get lost.
translation: 我在这里干什么是我的事。你要是没问题要问就快滚蛋。

original: Never mind, I'm leaving now.
translation: 算了，我走了。

original: Make yourself scarce. If you get yourself in trouble, I'm not going to cover your back.
translation: 你自己小心点。要是你惹上什么麻烦，可别指望我会帮你。

original: What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 关于这个地方你了解多少？

original: What are you looking to find out?
translation: 你想问什么？

original: I was sent here by Colonel Hsu.
translation: 许上校派我来的。

original: Hsu sent you? This was my mission!
translation: 许派你来的？这可是我的任务！

original: He sent you? Why?
translation: 他派你来的？为什么？

original: <Lie> Colonel Hsu sent me here to find you.
translation: <撒谎>许上校派我来找你的。

original: The monorail is destroyed.
translation: 列车被炸了。

original: Goddamn it! How could I have let this happen?
translation: 该死的！我怎么会让这样的事发生？

original: I caught Curtis radioing intel to Caesar's Legion. I had to take him down.
translation: 我抓到柯蒂斯在用电台向凯撒军团报信，只好击毙了他。

original: Curtis? Something's not right. He came to me today saying he was worried about the monorail. Had me put him in charge of the inspection crew.
translation: 柯蒂斯？情况不对啊。他今天还跟我说担心列车可能会出事，让我任命他带一批人去调查。

original: Listen, you've got to get to the monorail. If it's been sabotaged, we're completely crippled here. Go!
translation: 听着，你赶快到列车那儿去。万一它被炸了，那咱们可就彻底瘫痪了。快去！

original: It was Curtis. He's in the Legion. I can prove he tried to blow up the monorail.
translation: 是柯蒂斯干的。他是军团的人。我能证明他企图炸毁列车。

original: Curtis? He's been in the NCR long before our conflict with the Legion. There's just no way...
translation: 柯蒂斯？他在我们和军团发生冲突以前就加入NCR了呀。这不可能……

original: I hope you're mistaken, but somehow I don't think so. It'd explain a lot. This is much worse than anyone expected. There could be others, too.
translation: 希望是你搞错了，但我又总觉得不是。因为这样很多事情就说得通了。看来情况比料想的还糟。我们之中可能还有更多像柯蒂斯这样的人。

original: You've done everything that was asked of you. You have my personal thanks for this, and I'll make sure you receive the credit you deserve.
translation: 你完成了我交给你的所有任务。我代表自己由衷地向你表示感谢，我也保证你一定会得到相应的奖励。

original: I'll have Curtis taken into custody. If he lets himself be taken alive, that is.
translation: 我会把柯蒂斯关起来的。不过前提是我们能活捉他。

original: [Attack] I did. Right before I assassinated the colonel.
translation: [攻击] 是我干的。我还杀了上校。

original: You're getting ahead of yourself.
translation: 你真是不自量力。

original: I've got connections.  Maybe we could make an arrangement?
translation: 我也是有些门路的。也许我们可以谈谈条件？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Now you're talking my language. I do have an expanded inventory for people I can trust.
translation: [成功] 这才像话嘛，我确实有些特别的货物，只卖给我信任的人。

original: If you're willing to do a little legwork for me, I could give you access to my stash and at a discount.
translation: 如果你愿意为我稍稍跑跑腿，我可以允许你以折扣格购买我这儿的私货。

original: Many of these items aren't available in the NCR, and you'll be hard-pressed to find them at a better price anywhere else.
translation: 里面有很多东西在NCR是买不到的，在其他地方你也找不到更好的价格了。

original: [FAILED] I don't think so. This is what I've got. Take it or leave it.
translation: [失败] 不行。我就这么些货。不买拉倒。

original: I've got caps.  Name your price.
translation: 我有的是钱，你开个价吧。

original: I can be pretty resourceful.  Perhaps we could work out a deal?
translation: 我还是挺有人脉的。或许我们可以做笔交易？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Now you're talking my language. I do have an expanded inventory for people I can trust.
translation: [成功] 这才像话嘛，我确实有些特别的货物，只卖给我信任的人。

original: If you're willing to do a little legwork for me, I could give you access to my stash and at a discount.
translation: 如果你愿意为我稍微跑跑腿，我可以允许你以折扣格购买我这儿的私货。

original: Many of these items aren't available in the NCR, and you'll be hard-pressed to find them at a better price anywhere else.
translation: 里面有很多东西在NCR是买不到的，在其他地方你也找不到更好的价格了。

original: [FAILED] I don't think so. This is what I've got. Take it or leave it.
translation: [失败] 不行。我就这么些货。不买拉倒。

original: Come on, man.  Hook me up.
translation: 拜托，伙计，行个方便嘛。

original: [50 caps] Maybe some caps will clarify things.
translation: [50瓶盖] 这一点儿心意就当是我孝敬您的。

original: Now you're talking my language. I do have an expanded inventory for people I can trust.
translation: 这才像话嘛，我确实有些特别的货物，只卖给我信任的人。

original: If you're willing to do a little legwork for me, I could give you access to my stash and at a discount.
translation: 如果你愿意为我稍微跑跑腿，我可以允许你以折扣格购买我这儿私藏的货物。

original: Many of these items aren't available in the NCR, and you'll be hard-pressed to find them at a better price anywhere else.
translation: 里面有很多东西在NCR是买不到的，在其他地方你也找不到更好的价格了。

original: Nevermind.
translation: 算了。

original: What do you need then?
translation: 那你需要什么？

original: What kind of supplies did you have in mind?
translation: 你这儿都有什么东西卖？

original: For you? Just the basics. Come back when you're a little more seasoned and maybe we could talk about other options.
translation: 卖给你的？只有一些普通货色。等你在外面混出些名堂了，咱们再来谈别的吧。

original: Bad business if someone hurts themselves using your products, you know? Gets all kinds of unwanted attention.
translation: 如果有人用了我提供的商品，结果受了伤，那可是会坏名声的，明白不？会引起许多不必要的麻烦。

original: Are you implying I have some kind of secret under-the-table stash I only offer to certain clients? Because that could get a man in trouble.
translation: 你是怀疑我在暗中向某些客户提供那种见不得人的商品吗？你觉得我会给自己找麻烦吗？

original: What's the hold-up - if you don't mind my asking?
translation: 你到底是怎么被困在这的？不介意我这么问吧。

original: What's it look like? I caught one in the leg. I killed a dozen of those degenerates sneaking my way in... but one got a drop on me.
translation: 你觉得呢？我腿上中枪了。我摸进来干掉了很多敌人……却被其中一个碰巧打中了。

original: I holed up in here after I killed that one. They're too stupid to unlock the doors, so I knew they'd figure whoever attacked had just taken off.
translation: 我杀了那家伙，之后就一直守在这里了。他们很蠢，连门都打不开，所以我想他们肯定会以为袭击他们的人已经翘辫子了。

original: I just need day or two and then I'll take out Motor-Runner myself. I even got the key to his Maintenance Wing. Situation's under control.
translation: 只要再给我一两天时间，我就能亲手干掉轰鸣恶煞。我已经拿到了通往维修区的钥匙。一切都在我的掌握中。

original: I'll leave you to it then.
translation: 我不会插手这件事的。

original: Let me take out Motor-Runner for you.
translation: 让我帮你干掉轰鸣恶煞吧。

original: Bad idea on all sorts of levels. Leave it to the professionals, kid.
translation: 真是馊主意。这种事情还是留给专业人士吧，孩子。

original: SPEECH attempt to convince Bryce to help take out Motor-Runner
translation: 口才 试图说服布莱斯帮忙除掉机车手

original: [SUCCEEDED] I guess you're right. I won't be able to move fast, but I can more than hold my own in a firefight. Here, take the key...
translation: [成功]你说得对，虽然我的腿脚不利索了，但如果真打起来，我还是能发挥点作用的。拿着钥匙……

original: Here, take this key to the Maintenance Wing. Should make getting to Motor-Runner a whole easier. I'll follow you down.
translation: 这把钥匙能帮你进入维修区。你可以从那里抄近路去找轰鸣恶煞。我会跟在你后面。

original: The only way you're going to take out Motor-Runner is if we work together.
translation: 你唯一能干掉轰鸣恶煞的办法就是和我联手。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I guess you're right. I won't be able to move fast, but I can more than hold my own in a firefight.
translation: [成功]你说得对，虽然我的腿脚不利索了，但如果真打起来，我还是能发挥点作用的。

original: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!
translation: 该死！我他妈怎么这么走霉运！我把钥匙给丢了！

original: Well, this whole thing's improvised, and now we'll have to improvise some more and find another way through. I'll follow you down.
translation: 好吧，反正都是临时行动，再临时点也无妨。咱们找别的路吧。我会跟在你后面。

original: The only way you're going to take out Motor-Runner is if we work together.
translation: 你唯一能干掉轰鸣恶煞的办法就是和我联手。

original: [FAILED] Thanks for the offer - but the answer is no. Once my leg is healed up, I'll take care of Motor-Runner easily enough.
translation: [失败] 谢谢你的好意——我不用你帮忙。等我的腿好了，我会轻松解决轰鸣恶煞的。

original: Let's you and me take out Motor-Runner together!
translation: 让我们一起干掉轰鸣恶煞！

original: I want to help you rescue the hostages.
translation: 我想帮你解救人质。

original: Yeah? Nice thought, but that's not my primary mission. If you want to go it solo, more power to you.
translation: 是吗？想法很好，不过那不是我的首要目标。如果你想自己去搞定，我在精神上支持你。

original: I'm sure you can handle it alone. I'll leave you to it.
translation: 你肯定会独立完成任务的。我就不打扰你了。

original: Good idea. Try not to get hurt out there.
translation: 好主意。出去的时候别受伤了。

original: Colonel Hsu thinks you need additional support.
translation: 许上校认为你需要额外援助。

original: Is that right? And what sort of support, exactly, is it that you have to offer?
translation: 是吗？那么，是哪种援助呢，难道就是派你来吗？

original: The Colonel was concerned. You missed your check-in.
translation: 上校很担心你，你一直没有回去。

original: You can go back to old Hsu and tell him that the mission will be completed. I just need a couple more days.
translation: 回去告诉老许，说我一定完成任务，只是还需要几天时间。

original: Who are the Fiends?
translation: 恶魔帮是什么人？

original: The Fiends are degenerate drug addicts who kill and rape for fun, basically. They're human garbage - though I'm not sure about the human part.
translation: 基本上就是一群无恶不作、吸毒成瘾的惯犯。他们全是人渣——我看真该把那个“人”字去掉。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: This was Vault 3, but I'm sure you can tell that by all the 3s all over the damn place. Now it is a drug den for the goddamn Fiends.
translation: 这里以前是3号避难所，光看这鬼地方到处都贴着3的标志，你也应该知道了。现在这里已经成了恶魔帮的毒窟。

original: What can you tell me about what happened here?
translation: 能告诉我这里出了什么事吗？

original: The Fiends killed everyone living here, and now they are squatting in their home.
translation: 瘾君子杀了这里的所有人，现在这地方成了他们的老巢。

original: Have you noticed anything suspicious lately?
translation: 你最近有没有发现什么可疑的事情？

original: Now what kind of MP would I be if I didn't notice anything suspicious?
translation: 要是我没发现什么可疑的地方，我怎么能当宪兵呢？

original: I've had soldiers go AWOL, break-ins, thefts, you name it.
translation: 我注意到有些士兵开小差，还有非法闯入，偷盗，等等。

original: Do you need any help?
translation: 你需要帮忙吗？

original: No, I've got this one. I don't think he's going to have much information of value, so I'm just tormenting him for fun. Thanks, though.
translation: 不，我自己能行。反正从他嘴里也问不出什么有用的情报，我就当拿他找乐子得了。谢谢。

original: Yeah, so far this has gone exactly as expected - poorly. But with the work you've done for NCR already, you might be just what I've been looking for.
translation: 是的，就拿我手头这件事来说，情况一点也不出乎我的意料——进展十分缓慢。不过凭你为NCR所做的贡献，也许你就是我要找的人。

original: We captured an honest-to-God centurion of Caesar's Legion recently.
translation: 我们最近抓到了一个货真价实的凯撒军团百夫长。

original: Sorry, this is state business, what I'm working on. You'd have to do a lot more NCR ass-kissing before they'd let you help me with this one.
translation: 抱歉，这是公务。我看你得再多为NCR做点事情，他们才会允许你插手此事。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Not big on reading nametags, huh? That's okay, my name is long and difficult to pronounce. Ready for it?
translation: 不太喜欢看身份牌是吗？没关系，我的名字有点长，而且比较拗口。你听仔细咯。

original: It's Boyd. Lieutenant Boyd to my friends. Colonel Hsu has me handling the policing duties for the base.
translation: 我的名字是博伊德，朋友们都叫我博伊德中尉。许上校派我掌管这个基地的宪兵事务。

original: I've told him he could make my job a whole lot easier if he would just let me shoot anyone who talks back to me, but you know how colonels can be.
translation: 我跟他说过，如果他允许我朝每个向我顶嘴的家伙脑袋上都开一枪，我的工作就会轻松许多。但你也知道，通常上校都很迂腐。

original: Let me take another look at that leg.
translation: 让我再看看你的腿。

original: How's it look, doc?
translation: 情况怎么样，医生？

original: I don't have a spare doctor's bag I can spare.
translation: 我没有多余的诊疗包了。

original: Yeah? Well, there's a ton of pharmaceuticals out there. Maybe you can find one and bring it back to me. It'd be a great help...
translation: 是吗？好吧，外面有成吨的药品。如果你能在其中找一个诊疗包回来，那可就帮大忙了……

original: I'll check in with you and Colonel Hsu when it's done.
translation: 任务完成后我会跟你一起向许上校报告。

original: All right. Let me give you the key to the Maintenance Wing...
translation: 好的。这把维修区的钥匙就给你了……

original: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!
translation: 该死！我他妈怎么这么走霉运！我把钥匙给丢了！

original: I don't know what to say. You'll have to find your own way to get at that sick bastard. Hope to see you back at McCarran.
translation: 真不知说什么好。你得自己去找那个混蛋了。希望回麦卡伦时能见到你。

original: Here, take this. It's the key to the Maintenance Wing. Should make getting to Motor-Runner that much easier. Good luck.
translation: 给你，拿着吧。这是去维修区的钥匙。那里应该有可以找到轰鸣恶煞的近路。祝你好运。

original: I have a doctor's bag right here. It should be enough to get you on your feet.
translation: 正好我手上有个诊疗包。应该足以治好你的腿了。

original: What are we waiting for? I've got a high-value target to kill!
translation: 我们还等什么？我还有一个重要目标要杀！

original: Thanks, doc. The Fiends have got a ton of pharmaceuticals out there. Here's hoping a doctor's bag is in the mix.
translation: 谢谢，医生。外面那些恶魔帮手里有成吨的药品，希望其中就有诊疗包。

original: You need a doctor's bag. I'll find one and come back.
translation: 你需要一个诊疗包。我去弄一个回来。

original: If you head for McCarran now, I think you'll make it in time - even at a limp.
translation: 如果你现在就回麦卡伦，我想还来得及——哪怕是瘸着回去。

original: Goddammit. Fine. I'll head back. Are you saying you'll handle Motor-Runner yourself?
translation: 该死。好吧，我会回去的。这么说你是要自己解决轰鸣恶煞了？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Goddammit. I know. Was just hoping that, uh...
translation: [成功] 见鬼。我知道，只是希望，呃……

original: Are you trained as a doctor? Can you fix my leg?
translation: 你是医生？能治好我的腿吗？

original: I'm afraid your leg looks - and smells - like it's on the verge of infection.
translation: 恐怕你的腿不管是看起来还是闻起来都——像是已经感染了。

original: [FAILED] The slug went straight through. I'm a goddamned NCR ranger, all right? I'm trained in first aid!
translation: [失败] 子弹已经直接打穿了。我可是他妈的NCR游骑兵好吗？我受过急救训练的！

original: A day or two of resting up isn't going to heal that leg.
translation: 光靠休息个一两天是治不好那条腿的。

original: Then you broke our agreement. I want double the caps.
translation: 你破坏了我们的约定。我要双倍的报酬。

original: [FAILED] No. Our agreement was very specific. You bring me the data, I give you a reward.
translation: [失败] 不行。我们约定得很清楚。你把数据带给我，我才给你酬劳。

original: We never discussed the dangers. That's your business, not mine. If you can't provide the data, I'm sure I'll find someone who can.
translation: 我们从来没有讨论过风险。那是你的事，与我无关。如果你拿不到数据，我就去找其他人。

original: It doesn't trouble you that you sent eight or ten people to their deaths?
translation: 你居然派了八九个人去送死，你的良心被狗吃了？

original: I have no evidence that they're dead. A thousand things could have happened between here and the Vault.
translation: 没有证据表明他们死了。从这里到避难所，这中间足够发生一千种情况。

original: They could have changed their minds and walked away. I wouldn't be much of a scientist if I leapt to conclusions without proof.
translation: 搞不好他们半路就开溜了。好歹我也是个科学家，没有证据我是不会下妄下结论的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I want double the caps. Or I spread the word that you're full of shit.
translation: 我要双倍的报酬。否则我会告诉全世界你满嘴都是狗屁。

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right. I'll admit that it's been difficult to find anyone willing to enter the Vault. And I'd rather get the data sooner than later.
translation: [成功] 好吧。我承认要找一个愿意进入避难所的人确实很难。但我还是想早点拿到数据。

original: You have a deal. I'll double your reward, if you bring me the data. But this is as high as my budget will allow.
translation: 成交。只要你把数据带回来，我就付你双倍的报酬。但这就是我能承担的上限了。

original: Maybe I should cancel our deal.
translation: 也许我该取消我们的交易。

original: Do whatever you think is best. You're under no obligations. If you want the caps, you'll complete the job. Simple.
translation: 你想怎么样都可以，反正你也不受我们的限制。但如果你想要钱，那就去完成任务。简单明了。

original: Take my advice. Forget about Williams. She's a talented researcher, but she doesn't understand people, and she can't see the big picture.
translation: 听我一句劝，别再想威廉姆斯了。她的确是位优秀的研究员，但她的格局太小了。

original: Now, I know your time is valuable, so I won't waste any more of it. Feel free to show yourself out...
translation: 好了，我知道你的时间很宝贵，我就不再浪费了。请便吧，我就不送了……

original: I prefer to know what I'm getting myself into.
translation: 我更想知道这事究竟有多大风险。

original: You want certainty? You'll never find it... especially not in the pursuit of science.
translation: 你想一帆风顺？那是不可能的……毕竟这是科学探索。

original: How many others have you sent to the Vault?
translation: 你还派过多少人去避难所？

original: I'd have to consult my records. Eight? Ten? Your point is what?
translation: 我得数一下。八个？十个？你什么意思？

original: No, that was me. I fixed HELIOS One.
translation: 不是他，是我。太阳神一号是我修好的。

original: I... see. Of course you did.
translation: 我……知道了。当然是你修好的。

original: Fantastic.
translation: 珍世邦。

original: Yes! That was it, exactly.
translation: 对！就是那个名字。

original: Do you control the Dam from here?
translation: 你在这里就能控制胡佛水坝？

original: Directly? No. But we attempt to maximize its output. You have no idea how difficult it is to provide power to an entire nation.
translation: 直接控制？不，我们只是努力让它能够全力运转。你不知道要为偌大一个国家供电有多难。

original: Fortunately, we also have the HELIOS One facility. One of our external contractors recently got the station up and running.
translation: 幸好我们还有太阳神一号发电厂。有位编外人员最近成功启动了那座电站的发电装置。

original: Fortunately, we also have the HELIOS One facility. One of our external contractors recently got the station up and running.
translation: 幸好我们还有太阳神一号发电厂。有位编外人员最近成功启动了那座电站的发电装置。

original: We were starting to bring the HELIOS One facility online, as well. That might have increased our power output by half.
translation: 我们本打算让太阳神一号发电站也正常运转起来。如果成功了，我们的发电量就能提高50%。

original: But some wasteland scum managed to sabotage the array. Probably got quite a laugh at our expense. Very funny indeed.
translation: 可有个废土渣滓破坏了阵列机组。让我们蒙受了如此大的损失，搞不好他正在背后偷笑呢。确实很有趣。

original: I'd pay a year's salary for a crack at that maniac. Not that he'd ever show his face in a place like this.
translation: 我很乐意拿出一整年的薪水来雇人剁了那疯子。那样他就不会再来我们这里骚扰了。

original: We were starting to bring the HELIOS One facility online, as well. That might have increased our power output by half.
translation: 我们本打算让太阳神一号发电站也正常运转起来。如果成功了，我们的发电量就能提高50%。

original: But some wasteland scum managed to sabotage the array. Probably got quite a laugh at our expense. Very funny indeed.
translation: 可有个废土渣滓破坏了阵列机组。让我们蒙受了如此大的损失，搞不好他正在背后偷笑呢。确实很有趣。

original: I'd pay a year's salary for a crack at that maniac. Not that she'd ever show her face in a place like this.
translation: 我很乐意拿出一整年的薪水来雇人剁了那疯子。那样他就不会再来我们这里骚扰了。

original: Our efforts at HELIOS One held a great deal of promise, until some drifter blew in from the waste and managed to reroute the power.
translation: 我们在太阳神一号付出的努力一直都很有成效，直到某个不知道从哪钻出来的流浪者把输电线路给改了。

original: As to where the power is going... who knows. Can you imagine? A drifter outsmarting professional scientists? Only in New Vegas.
translation: 至于那些电被输送到哪里去了……谁也不知道。你能想象吗，一群科班出身的科学家居然比不过一个流浪者？也只有新维加斯才会出这种事。

original: We'd hoped that HELIOS One would boost power to McCarran and Vegas. Then some damned crusader routed all the power to Freeside.
translation: 我们本想将太阳神一号的电力输送到麦卡伦和维加斯。谁知道来了个该死的“人权卫士”，把所有的电力都改输到自由城去了。

original: I also have high hopes for our HELIOS One facility. Unfortunately, I can't say the same for the two "scientists" who are working there.
translation: 我也对太阳神一号的产能抱有很大的期待。不幸的是，我没法对在那里工作的两位"科学家"抱有同样的期待。

original: So far, they've only managed to achieve one percent power output. I'd send help, if I could spare the personnel.
translation: 目前为止，他们居然只达到了百分之一的产能。要不是没有足够的人手，我早派人去帮忙了。

original: His name was something like... "Exceptional" or "Marvelous" or...
translation: 他的名字好像是叫什么……"珍世牛"……还是"珍棒棒"之类的……

original: That's the trouble with this wasteland - too many damned variables. No one can account for them all.
translation: 这就是废土最可恶的地方——变量实在太多了，没有人能够完全预料。

original: NCR has a food shortage?
translation: NCR有食品缺口？

original: Not yet. But our government understands the value of proactive thought. Our studies project an imbalance between production and consumption.
translation: 目前还没有。但我们的政府懂得未雨绸缪。我们的研究表明，生产和供应之间是存在不平衡的。

original: Or, for a layman such as yourself - not enough food, too many mouths to feed. Mass starvation. In a decade or so.
translation: 换个你这种外行也能明白的说法——粮食太少，嘴巴太多，养不过来。过不了十年就会闹饥荒的。

original: You're doing all these things yourself?
translation: 所有这些都是你一人完成的？

original: Yes. With the assistance of my team, of course.
translation: 是的。当然，我的团队也提供了协助。

original: Yes, I have. What difference does it make?
translation: 是的，我和她谈过了。有什么关系吗？

original: None at all. Informed speculation on my part. Williams is very good at her job, so it remains secure... despite her best efforts.
translation: 没关系。只是我的合理推测罢了。威廉姆斯工作能力很强，所以尽管她想极力掩饰……但我还是能猜得很准的。

original: No, you aren't the first person I've sent to the Vault. I'm sorry that I neglected to tell you, but I don't see how it makes any difference.
translation: 不错，你不是我第一个派去避难所的人。很抱歉我没有告诉你，但我觉得这没有什么大不了的。

original: <Lie> No, Williams didn't tell me anything.
translation: <撒谎>不，威廉姆斯什么都没告诉我。

original: All right. I'll take you at your word. Williams didn't say anything at all, you just came to this conclusion on your own.
translation: 好，我相信你的话。威廉姆斯什么都没说，这一切全是你的臆测。

original: I'm the one asking the questions, Dr. Hildern.
translation: 提问的人是我，希尔丹博士。

original: Fair enough. Begging your pardon, but this is beginning to feel like an interrogation.
translation: 好吧，请你原谅，我总觉得你在审问我。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'm not the first person you've sent to Vault 22... am I?
translation: 我不是你第一个派去22号避难所的人……对吗？

original: I never said you were. You've been speaking to Williams, haven't you?
translation: 我从来都没说过你是第一个啊。你已经和威廉姆斯谈过了，对吧？

original: I have some questions.
translation: 我有些问题要问。

original: Oh no! Miss Tabitha is hurt! Someone, get a doctor!
translation: 哦，不！塔比瑟小姐受伤了！来人，叫医生来！

original: There, there Miss Tabitha. It's going to be all right.
translation: 放心，放心吧，塔比瑟小姐。一切都会没事的。

original: Miss Tabitha, your distinct lack of respiration is quite worrisome.
translation: 塔比瑟小姐，你失血过多，现在情况很糟。

original: That's good, Miss Tabitha. It's important that you don't move. You might aggravate your injury.
translation: 这样就对了，塔比瑟小姐。你千万不能再动了，再动的话伤势会加重的。

original: Where is that doctor?
translation: 医生在哪儿？

original: Don't worry, Miss Tabitha, I'll keep you warm with my exhaust.
translation: 别担心，塔比瑟小姐，我会拼尽全力保证你的温暖的。

original: I do hope the doctor doesn't get lost on the way up here.
translation: 真心希望医生不是在来的路上走丢了。

original: <Lie>I'm an independent contractor with the NCR.
translation: <撒谎> 我是受NCR雇佣而来的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, my apologies sir. I was sent here by Colonel Hsu to exterminate Motor-Runner, the leader of the Fiends.
translation: [成功] 噢，对不起，长官。许上校派我来这里消灭轰鸣恶煞，他是恶魔帮的领导人。

original: [FAILED] Your curiosity and a few caps will get you a rat on a stick, but it won't get you fuck all from me.
translation: [失败] 你的好奇心和那几个瓶盖在外面可以买一串烤老鼠，但什么也别想从我这得到。

original: I'm just curious.
translation: 我只是好奇。

original: Tell me what an NCR ranger is doing here.
translation: 告诉我，你一个NCR游骑兵在这里干什么。

original: Tell me why I should tell you anything. I don't know you.
translation: 告诉我为什么要告诉你。我都不认识你。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Okay, but make it quick.
translation: 好吧，有事快说。

original: By the way, that Vault was just as dangerous as Williams thought.
translation: 顺便一提，那个避难所确实像威廉姆斯认为的那样危险。

original: I don't see how that's relevant. The dangers of the Vault were your business, not mine. The only question is whether the data is still intact.
translation: 我没看出来这和我有什么关系。避难所危不危险那是你的事。我只在乎数据是否完好无损。

original: Was it? I'm sure I made it very clear... the hazards of the job were your business, not mine. The important question is whether this data is intact.
translation: 是吗？我记得我说得很清楚……不管这次任务有什么风险，我都不负责。我只关心数据是否完好无损。

original: Damn right. No thanks to you.
translation: 说的对，我真不该信你。

original: I'm sorry you feel that way. But we both came out ahead, so... no harm done, I hope.
translation: 听到你有这种想法我真觉得遗憾。不过我们既然已经达到各自的目的了，希望……我们不要因此伤了和气。

original: Make it fast. I want my caps.
translation: 快一点。我急着用钱呢。

original: If the data's intact, you'll get your reward. I gave my word. I'm not the kind of wasteland savage you're used to dealing with.
translation: 只有数据完好，你才能拿到酬劳。我已经做过承诺了。我可不是你平常遇到的那些未开化的野人。

original: All right. I'll investigate Vault 22.
translation: 好吧，我这就去调查22号避难所。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I just have some questions.
translation: 我还有些问题。

original: What else can you tell me about Anders?
translation: 你还能告诉我有关安德斯的其他事情吗？

original: I don't know him very well, myself. I seem to remember that he was the man to call on if you needed someone to get in and get out quietly.
translation: 我并不怎么了解他。在我的印象里，他是那种很善于干偷鸡摸狗勾当的人。

original: Colonel Hsu would really be the person to talk to.
translation: 这事应该去问问许上校。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: I'll see what I can find out about Cpl. White for you.
translation: 我会尽力寻找怀特下士的下落的。

original: Word around the base is he'd been going regularly to visit a hooker named Dazzle at Gomorrah. That's a casino on the Strip. Classy place.
translation: 有传言说他最近经常和蛾摩拉里一个叫达泽的妓女在一起鬼混。那是长街上的一个赌场，纸醉金迷的地方。

original: His belongings are up in the barracks in the concourse building. First bunk on your left if you're facing in from the center.
translation: 他的行李还放在候机厅的兵营里。进去后，正对中央面朝里，左手边第一个铺位就是。

original: I haven't had a chance to look through his things yet, so that might be a good place to begin.
translation: 我还没翻过他的东西，不过也许里面会有些线索。

original: You said there have been thefts?
translation: 你说有贼？

original: Yeah. We keep coming up short on our weekly supply inventory checks. Guns and ammo, mostly. Not the kind of things you like to see go missing.
translation: 是啊，连续几周都发现物资出现短缺。大部分是枪和弹药，都不是常人以为会丢那种的东西。

original: No witnesses yet. I've got my money on Sergeant Contreras, who's supposed to be in charge of distribution, the little weasel.
translation: 暂时还没有目击者。我怀疑是孔特雷拉斯中士，他是管物资分配的，这个狡猾的黄鼠狼。

original: But he's too slick to let anyone catch him doing it. We've searched his possessions a dozen times. Nothing.
translation: 他太能躲了，谁也抓不到证据。我们已经搜过他的财物不下几十遍了。一无所获。

original: Tell me about the break-ins.
translation: 跟我说说基地遭人闯入的事。

original: Maybe break-in isn't the right word. We didn't find signs of forced entry. But I've had reports of someone sneaking into the control tower at night.
translation: 说“闯入”也许不大恰当。我们没有发现任何武力闯入的痕迹。不过我们确实收到报告称有人在夜间摸进了指挥塔。

original: It's probably just a meeting spot for a steamy military base love affair. <Sighs> Kids today.
translation: 也许只是几个干柴烈火的新兵蛋子在暗中幽会吧……<叹气>现在的年轻人啊。

original: But it bothers me that they didn't break in. It means they have an access code. Most soldiers around the base don't have that.
translation: 不过正是非武力闯入这点让我感到担心。这说明闯入者有口令。而基地里的多数士兵都没有。

original: Who's missing?
translation: 谁失踪了？

original: Well, there's Anders. He's a Ranger. That one's not suspicious so much as worrisome - he left on a dangerous assignment.
translation: 好吧，安德斯。他是位游骑兵。也不知该怀疑他还是担心他——他去执行一项危险的任务去了。

original: Colonel Hsu sent him out. Now I think he feels guilty not having any way to check up on him.
translation: 是许上校派他去的。估计他现在正在后悔没有好好审查这家伙呢。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: See you later!
translation: 回头见。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Sure thing!
translation: 当然的！

original: Anything else I can do for you?
translation: 还有什么需要吗？

original: Why is this water so special?
translation: 这水为什么这么特别？

original: 'Cause it's clean. The crops taste funny if you don't use clean water, but the NCR won't give us any and it's too expensive to buy.
translation: 因为它干净。如果不用纯净水灌溉，种出来的庄稼会有奇怪的味道。但NCR根本不给我们提供纯净水，我们也买不起。

original: I didn't come here to do your job for you.
translation: 我不是来替你干你的活的。

original: Well, take this goddamn key anyways. It'll get you into the Maintenance Wing. Maybe you'll brave up and do the right thing. Good luck.
translation: 无所谓，反正这把破钥匙给你了。它能让你进入维修区。希望你能鼓起勇气做点好事。祝你好运。

original: Well, take this goddamn key anyways. It'll get you into the Maintenance Wing.
translation: 无所谓，反正这把破钥匙给你了。它能让你进入维修区。

original: Goddammit! Is there nothing I can't fuck up here? I've lost the goddamn key!
translation: 该死！我他妈怎么这么走霉运！我把钥匙给丢了！

original: That's it. I'm heading for McCarran. Good luck to you.
translation: 好吧，我这就回麦卡伦去，祝你好运。

original: I'm not interested in doing that right now.
translation: 我现在对这种事不感兴趣。

original: You sure? You're missing out. Well, you're always welcome, if you should change your mind.
translation: 是吗？那你可错过好机会了。好吧，要是你改主意了，我们随时欢迎。

original: Okay. Let's get started.
translation: 好的，让我们开始吧。

original: That's the spirit. Okay, I'll go in and have a word with him. Then I'll call you in.
translation: 这就对了。行，我先进去跟他说一声，然后再叫你进来。

original: Have you tried calling him hurtful names?
translation: 你尝试过辱骂他吗？

original: Yes, and one time I thought I saw a tear when I told him his uniform was unflattering. But I think he just got some dust in his eye.
translation: 是的，记得有一次我说他的制服皱了，他竟然在掉眼泪。不过我想他只是眼睛里进了沙子。

original: What about a truth drug?
translation: 用点吐真剂如何？

original: Don't have anything like that. Sounds nice. Like the kind of thing I'd want to take home and use on my husband.
translation: 没那种东西。听起来倒是不错。真想拿点回家给我丈夫试试。

original: But even if we did, I don't know that I'd be comfortable using it. If there's any risk of overdose, it's not worth it. Asshole's too valuable.
translation: 不过就算有，我也担心使用药物会出问题。万一用药过量产生副作用，那就亏大了。这家伙还是很值钱的。

original: Why don't you just beat your prisoner senseless?
translation: 你为什么不直接把囚犯打晕？

original: I like the way you think. Have I said that yet?
translation: 我喜欢你的想法。我有这么说过吗？

original: Problem is that the NCR frowns on using that sort of tactic. There are some restrictions still in place from President Tandi's administration.
translation: 问题是NCR不允许我们使用酷刑。从坦蒂总统时期沿袭下来的很多限令至今对我们仍有约束力。

original: But here's my favorite thing about you - you're not {emph}in the NCR. Plus, for all this guy knows, you're completely insane. That's a winning combination.
translation: 所以我才青睐你——你不是NCR的人。而且在这家伙眼里，你就是个彻头彻尾的疯子。两条加一块，实在是完美。

original: I'll keep an eye out for your missing supplies.
translation: 我会留意你的那些失踪物资的。

original: Good. The more guns you can recover, the more I'll be able to use to shoot Contreras for being inept.
translation: 很好。你追回的枪械越多，我就越能用它们把那个蠢货孔特雷拉斯打得满地找牙。

original: I've got the whiskey.
translation: 我拿到威士忌了。

original: The Vault 22 data is gone. Destroyed.
translation: 22号避难所的资料已经没了，被销毁了。

original: Destroyed. Really. I find that hard to believe. More likely, you failed to locate the proper server.
translation: 销毁了。是啊。我可不太相信，我看是你没有找到正确的服务器吧。

original: You're researching all these problems yourself?
translation: 你是自己一个人研究这些问题吗？

original: So... you wanted something more?
translation: 也就是说……你当时并不知足？

original: [FAILED] That was years ago. No point in discussing it. We have more practical concerns... and more important things to talk about.
translation: [失败] 反正那都是老黄历了，再讨论也没什么意义。我们还有很多更现实的事……更重要的事要谈。

original: Doesn't sound like a good place for a person of ambition.
translation: 听起来，并非是一个有远大抱负的人应该待的地方。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Exactly right. Imagine what the Followers could have accomplished if they were properly motivated... if they had a unified purpose!
translation: [成功] 说的太对了！想想看，如果他们能有一个正确的纲领，团结在统一的目标下，将会有怎样的成就！

original: Those of us who founded the OSI... we wanted to put our knowledge to work. And we have, to some degree.
translation: 科工部的创立者……他们设想的就是将知识应用到实际中。而我们一定程度上已经在这么做了。

original: But the execs at OSI Central... they're still bound to the old ideas. Society of equals, and all that. There's still too little direction.
translation: 但那些科工部中心的高层……他们还是被老思想束缚着。建立平等社会之类。根本就是空中楼阁。

original: If I can make real breakthroughs here... show the President what can be done when junior researchers are kept in line... kept focused on task...
translation: 如果我能取得真正的突破……给总统看看，哪怕只是一个初级研究员，当他全身心投入时，也能取得巨大的成就……

original: Who knows. Maybe I'll be sitting in OSI Central, in a few years time. And there'll be no more coddling of "free spirits" like our friend, Williams.
translation: 谁知道呢。也许几年后我就会在科工部中心坐着了。那时候就不必再像我们的朋友威廉姆斯那样，歌颂什么“自由精神”了。

original: And what do the Followers believe?
translation: 天启追随者的信条是什么？

original: Knowledge for knowledge sake. A society of equals. They purport to be intelligent people, and then they spout this old-world dogma.
translation: 奉知识为圭臬，建立平等社会。他们自认为世人皆醉我独醒，满口都是这些旧世界的教条。

original: So who *did* train you?
translation: 那你是在哪里深造的？

original: Before the bombs, I might have studied at any number of colleges, universities. They gave a man a chance to advance himself... or so I've heard.
translation: 放在核战之前，我可能会去上大学，或者专科学院。人们能在那里提高自己的知识水平……至少我听说是这样。

original: But after the bombs - until a few years ago - anyone with half a brain had one choice. The Followers of the Apocalypse.
translation: 但核战之后，直到几年之前，有才华的人想要通古博经，只有一个选择，那就是找天启追随者。

original: Didn't matter if you agreed with them or not. You either played along or you were turned away.
translation: 不管你是否认同他们，你要么就跟他们学，要么你就滚蛋。

original: You didn't always work for the OSI?
translation: 你以前不是在科工部工作的？

original: No, I... no. The OSI hasn't been around for very long. I received my training elsewhere.
translation: 不，我……没有。我在科工部待的时间不算久，我是在别的地方接受了教育。

original: Why terminate her contract?
translation: 为什么要终止她的合约？

original: Williams has a tendency to feel before she thinks. Not in the lab. But everywhere else.
translation: 威廉姆斯总是感情用事，缺乏理性思考。不仅是在科研工作中，她在各方面都是这样。

original: That might be forgivable if she kept her concerns to herself. But she doesn't. Not in front of her peers, not even with contractors like yourself.
translation: 如果她能约束一下自己，这倒也可以原谅。但是她没有。不仅在同事面前，连在像你这样的雇佣兵面前也毫不遮掩。

original: That kind of behavior can undermine morale. She convinced my last contractor to quit. Same way she tried with you.
translation: 这种行为会影响工作效率的。她把我上一个合作者给劝跑了，现在还想把你也劝走。

original: Probably didn't tell you that, did she?
translation: 看来她没告诉过你这些，是吧？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Best of luck to you. Not that you'll need it. You seem like a reasonably competent person...
translation: 祝你好运。不过你也不需要吧，你看起来是个讲道理又有本事的人……

original: No. "Civilized" people stack the deck in their own favor, don't they?
translation: 不。"文明"人就喜欢耍心眼出老千，不是吗？

original: If you're unhappy with the terms of our agreement, then consider this an object lesson.
translation: 如果你对我们的约定不满意，就当是长个记性吧。

original: In the future, I'm sure you'll consider your agreements and contracts more carefully. Now, here is the sum we agreed to.
translation: 以后你作承诺、签协议的时候最好多留个心眼。好了，这是我们之前谈好的价钱。

original: I just have some questions.
translation: 我只是想问几个问题。

original: Yes. Tell me about it.
translation: 对，跟我讲讲。

original: What do you think of NCR's chances against the Legion?
translation: 你认为NCR能打败军团吗？

original: To be frank, I have no idea. I leave the fighting to Colonel Hsu, and I expect him to leave the science to me.
translation: 说实话，我不清楚。打仗的事都是许上校在负责，我只期望他能把科研工作交给我。

original: Too many people have opinions on things they know nothing about. And the more ignorant they are, the more opinions they have.
translation: 太多人只会不懂装懂。而且越无知的人越喜欢高谈阔论。

original: Never mind. Goodbye.
translation: 没事了，再见。

original: Never mind. Goodbye.
translation: 没事了，再见。

original: I had some other questions.
translation: 我有些别的问题。

original: What's your opinion of Williams?
translation: 你觉得威廉姆斯怎么样？

original: Williams is an admirable researcher. If she wasn't, I'd have terminated her contract, and she'd be begging for work from my former employers.
translation: 威廉姆斯是个优秀的研究员，否则我早就开除她了。那样的话，她就只能乞求我的前老板们给她一份工作了。

original: Believe whatever you want. It's the truth.
translation: 无所谓。这就是事实。

original: Keely. It was Keely, wasn't it? Who else would fail to give a fuck that thousands of people are going to starve, without that data?
translation: 基利，是基利干的对不对？不惜让无数的人因此挨饿，除了她还有谁他妈干得出这种事？

original: And for what? So Keely can wage her selfish little war against me and the OSI.
translation: 为的什么呢？她根本就是公报私仇，想方设法在和我与科工部作对。

original: The plants in that vault were dangerous. We destroyed the data.
translation: 那些避难所里的植物很危险。我们已销毁了数据。

original: We? We?! You were a part of this? After we made an explicit agreement, you have the fucking gall to destroy priceless scientific data?
translation: 我们？我们？！这事你也有份？我们之前都已经商量好了，你他妈居然把那些珍贵的科研资料都给毁了？

original: The authorities are going to hear about this. They're going to know your name, they're going to know your goddamn face.
translation: 上面的人会知道这事的，他们会记住你的名字，记住你那张臭脸！

original: Keely wiped the data. It's gone.
translation: 基利销毁了资料。都没了。

original: Keely. Again. Do you... do you understand what that rotting old bitch has done?! Thousands of people, mass starvation. We had a chance to avoid that.
translation: 基利，又是她。你……你知不知道那个老贱人干了什么？无数的难民，颠沛流离，饥荒肆虐……我们本来可以阻止这一切的。

original: And I had a chance to prove that scientists could be more than a bunch of useless idealists. But Keely doesn't give a goddamn about that, does she?
translation: 我本来可以证明科学家们并非只是没用的空想家。但看来基利根本就不在乎，是吧？

original: You're an accomplice in this. Keely is one old woman - you could have easily stopped her. You're either incompetent, or you were on her side.
translation: 你就是她的帮凶。基利不过是个老太婆，你要阻止她根本不费吹灰之力。要么你是个废物，要么你就是跟她一伙的。

original: Now get out of this office. Get out!
translation: 滚出我的办公室。滚出去！

original: Right...  Well, I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 好的……嗯，我会记住的。

original: Be sure you do.
translation: 相信你能做到。

original: If you get this last job done, full access to my stash. At a discount, even. Just because I like you.
translation: 如果你能完成这项最后的工作，我的所有货物都向你开放。甚至还能打折，因为我喜欢你。

original: Get moving, watch out for raiders, and do {emph}not lose that package. Good Luck.
translation: 去吧，路上小心掠夺者，另外{emph}别把包裹弄丢了，祝你好运。

original: I'm ready for the next task.
translation: 我准备好进行下一个任务了。

original: Well, I'm not. Come back tomorrow and the stuff will be ready to transport.
translation: 嗯，可我还没准备好，明天再来吧，到时货物应该就备妥了。

original: All right, I need you to pass something off to a merchant. The guy's name is Price. The exchange goes down at Miguel's Pawn Shop in Westside.
translation: 好吧，我要你带些东西给一个商人，他叫普莱斯。交易地点在西区的米格尔典当行。

original: This next bit is very important. He's paranoid. Maybe a little schizo. You have to identify yourself with a passcode or he'll shoot you right there.
translation: 有件事非常重要。他有妄想症，也许还有点精神分裂。你要和他对暗号来表明身份，不然他肯定会对你开枪。

original: Just tell him you're looking for some betting advice. Then he'll say the surest move is to bet on the house.
translation: 只要告诉他，你想向他讨教一些赌博的技巧。然后他会回答最可靠的方法就是押庄家。

original: Here are the medical supplies from Blake.
translation: 这是布莱克的医疗物资。

original: See, you're practically stealing caps from me, this work is so easy.
translation: 看，我简直就是送钱给你嘛，这工作多容易啊。

original: There's one more job. It's a little more complicated, but I think you're up to it.
translation: 还有一件差事，更复杂些，但我觉得你可以胜任。

original: I need to get some stuff sorted around. Gonna take me a day or two, so just stop back in a few days.
translation: 我要先把货物整理一下。可能要花上一两天时间，所以你过几天再来吧。

original: [Attack] Uh oh. Now you've made me angry.
translation: [攻击] 啊，噢。你可把我惹毛了。

original: I can take anything you've got.
translation: 我愿意奉陪。

original: You're about to tell me everything you know, Silus.
translation: 你必须把你知道的全部一五一十地告诉我，希鲁斯。

original: Of course, of course. All you had to do was ask. I'll tell you everything I know.
translation: 当然，当然，你问吧。我什么都告诉你。

original: Let's see. I know that you're a brainless cretin. I know that you're wasting your time. I know the lieutenant is going to be disappointed in you.
translation: 我看看啊。据我所知，你就是个没脑子的蠢货，只会浪费时间。中尉肯定会对你失望的。

original: And I know that by this time next month the streets of New Vegas will be decorated with the decaying heads of NCR soldiers.
translation: 我还知道下个月这个时候，新维加斯的大街上将挂满NCR士兵的脑袋。

original: Is there anything else you wanted to know?
translation: 还有什么你想知道的？

original: [Speech] You... *smell* like excrement. So there.
translation: [口才] 你……*闻起来* 就像一坨屎。就是这样。

original: [FAILED] I must admit that a conversation with an imbecile may be far worse than the kind of torture I was anticipating.
translation: [失败] 我不得不承认，和一个低能儿说话，比任何酷刑都要折磨人。

original: But somehow I think I'll manage.
translation: 但我觉得自己还是能应付的。

original: [Speech] I think you're confused. I'm with the excrement right now.
translation: [口才] 我看你一定是搞错了。现在我眼前坐着的就是一坨臭狗屎。

original: [?] You must have some reason to be in your line of work. Tell me, what did the Legion do to you?
translation: [?] 干这活儿一定是有原因的。告诉我，军团都对你做了什么？

original: Did we enslave your children? Slaughter your family before your eyes to teach you a lesson?
translation: 把你的孩子抓去作奴隶了吗？为了教训你，杀了你全家？

original: Whatever it was, I hope I was there to give the order.
translation: 不管哪一样，我都希望那命令是我下的。

original: <Lie> I'm with the Legion. I'm here to kill you before you talk.
translation: <撒谎> 我和军团是一伙儿的。我要杀了你，免得你走漏了风声。

original: [?] You're nothing. You're some inept mercenary the NCR is paying to supplement its own incompetent soldiers.
translation: [?] 什么都不是。你不过是NCR搬来的蹩脚雇佣兵，和他们军中那些酒囊饭袋一路货色。

original: [?] What? No! Listen, Caesar's secrets are safe with me. I stayed alive because Caesar would've wanted it. I'm useless to him dead.
translation: [?] 么？不！听着，凯撒的秘密我半个字都不会泄露。我得活着，因为凯撒需要我。我死了对他没有好处。

original: I'm a friend of the Legion. I'm here to help.
translation: 我是军团的朋友，我是来帮忙的。

original: Caesar's eyes truly are everywhere. And here I thought they'd send assassins instead. Did the officer send you?
translation: 凯撒的眼线真的无处不在。我还以为他们会派刺客来。是长官让你来的吗？

original: What officer?
translation: 什么长官？

original: I don't know what name he goes by here. But I saw him when they brought me in, and I recognized him.
translation: 我不知道这儿的人管他叫什么，但我进来时看见他，还认出他来了。

original: When I saw him last it was ages ago. He was training to be an agent of Caesar's {LATIN}frumentarii. Apparently he passed the trials.
translation: 我记得很多年前见过他。他当时正在受训，成为凯撒手下的一名特工。很显然他后来通过了考核。

original: And what a job he's done, to achieve such a rank. I have no doubt he'll deliver a crippling blow to the NCR while he's here. Perhaps many.
translation: 瞧瞧他干的，竟然能在这里平步青云。我毫不怀疑，有一天他会给NCR带来一次致命打击，也许不止一次。

original: I have heard that he has been radioing high-level NCR intelligence back to Caesar's camp virtually every night.
translation: 我听说他每晚都会把NCR的绝密情报发送给凯撒的营地。

original: But never mind that now. We don't have much time. If you can get me a weapon, the rest will be easy.
translation: 但现在已经不用担心了。我们时间紧急，如果你能给我弄把枪，那剩下的事就简单多了。

original: In the hall outside, they still have my possessions in a locker. There's a gun in there that should be small enough to get past the lieutenant.
translation: 外面的大厅里有个柜子，我的东西都锁在里面。其中有把尺寸很小的手枪，足以混过中尉。

original: When she comes back, I want you to go and get it for me. Simple enough?
translation: 等她回来，我要你立马把她干掉，够简单吧？

original: Intruder Alert! Activating Defenses!
translation: 入侵者警报！启动防御！

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Right. Good luck.
translation: 好，一路顺风。

original: I have some questions.
translation: 我有些问题要问。

original: Of course. Anything.
translation: 当然，说吧。

original: Not my problem. Keely is on her own.
translation: 跟我没关系。基利得靠她自己了。

original: I know it's not your business to fend for anyone but yourself. If not for her, do it for the caps. That's all I'm asking.
translation: 我知道你没有义务去管其他人。就当你是为了瓶盖去救她，怎么样？我就这个请求了。

original: I'll try, but no promises.
translation: 我试试，不过我可不敢保证能成功。

original: That's all I ask. She might even be able to help you. As long as you don't speak too well of Dr. Hildern.
translation: 我就要求这么多。只要你别讲太多希尔丹博士的好话，她说不定还能帮你一把呢。

original: It never came up. Doesn't bother me.
translation: 没这回事。对我反正没差别。

original: No, I knew the danger wouldn't. I'm not trying to scare you off the job.
translation: 不，我知道你不怕危险。我不是想要把你吓跑。

original: Maybe Hildern and I need to have another talk.
translation: 也许我该再去找希尔丹谈谈。

original: No, wait! I don't mean to see any harm come to Dr. Hildern. Unless by "talk" you just mean... talk.
translation: 不，等等！我不是要你去教训希尔丹博士。除非你说的"谈谈"……意思就是跟他说话。

original: All right. I'll look for her.
translation: 没问题，我会去找她的。

original: I had a good feeling about you. Moment you walked in. I mean it.
translation: 你进来的那一刹那，我就感觉你是个好人。我是认真的。

original: No. Hildern didn't mention anyone else.
translation: 没。希尔丹没提到过其他人。

original: But now he's hired you. Which means one of two things. Either he heard back from Keely, and she failed, or he's given up on her.
translation: 可他又委托了你。这说明了两件事。要么他得到了基利的消息——她失败了；要么他根本就放弃了基利。

original: Listen. I make a fair wage, but I'm not rich, not by any means. Maybe my kind of money wouldn't appeal to your average merc.
translation: 听着。我工资虽然不低，但我也不是有钱人。可能我开的价在你眼里不算什么。

original: But I'm willing to pay you, if you'll find Keely and make sure she's safe. Isn't right leaving her out there, no idea if she's alive or dead.
translation: 但是如果你能把基利平安带出来，我愿意付给你钱。不能就这样把她丢在那里，生死不明。

original: You're right. It's none of your business.
translation: 说得对，不关你的事。

original: We shouldn't even be talking about this, I know. But I think someone should tell you. You're not the first one he's sent to Vault 22.
translation: 我知道，我们都不应该谈这个。但是我觉得总该有人告诉你。你已经不是他第一个派去22号避难所的人了。

original: Why so interested?
translation: 为什么这么感兴趣？

original: Not interested. More concerned. It's just... you're not the first person he's sent to Vault 22. And I know he'd never tell you.
translation: 不是感兴趣。主要是担心。因为……你已经不是他第一个派去避难所的人了。我知道他肯定不会告诉你这个的。

original: Yes. He asked me to get some data from Vault 22.
translation: 对。他让我从22号避难所里面找一些资料。

original: I shouldn’t say anything, I know that. But you’re not the first person Hildern's sent out to the vault.
translation: 我知道我不该多嘴，但是——你不是第一个被希尔丹派去22号避难所的人。

original: There were a lot of mercs. One after another. None of them came back.
translation: 曾经有很多雇佣兵跟你一样，但他们都没回来。

original: Then, about a week ago, there was a scientist. Keely. She's unusual, not the sort of person you'd expect, but she's an absolute genius, and...
translation: 然后，大约一个星期前，来了一个叫基利的科学家。她很——特别，她的外表可能跟你想象的不太一样，但她绝对是一个天才。

original: And he didn't mention her? Not even her name? Or any of the other mercs?
translation: 他有没有提到过她？连名字都没提过？其他的佣兵也没说？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Nice to meet you. If you need anything, I'm almost always in the lab.
translation: 很高兴见到你。如果你有事找我，我基本上一直待在实验室里。

original: Mercenaries? What for?
translation: 雇佣兵？他们来干什么？

original: I can't say. We're not supposed to talk about the research. Not the details. If you're interested, I'm sure he'd see you.
translation: 我不能说。关于研究的事情，特别是细节问题，我们不能随便谈。不过如果你感兴趣的话，他肯定愿意见你。

original: Need help with anything?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

original: You mean... give you work? No, that'd be up to the administrator. Hildern. He's back there in his office.
translation: 你是说……给你点任务做？没有，那归希尔丹管。他就在后面的办公室里。

original: Between you and me, I don't think he ever leaves. Plenty of mercs go in to see him, though.
translation: 私底下说，我感觉他就没出过那个房间。倒是有不少雇佣兵过来找他。

original: What's your role here?
translation: 你在这里是干什么的？

original: Head researcher. Mostly on the Dam project, but I help out on other things, when they need me. Got to be flexible.
translation: 首席研究员。主要是研究与大坝有关的项目，但需要时也帮忙做些其他工作。工作的内容挺灵活的。

original: Are you a scientist?
translation: 你是科学家吗？

original: I know I don't sound the part. Get raised by brahmin ranchers, and you never lose the twang. Drives Hildern crazy.
translation: 我知道我说话的口气不像科学家。我父母都是养牛的，乡下人的习惯永远也改不了。希尔丹听着都快疯了。

original: But I know every inch of the power grid from Hoover Dam to Shady Sands. That's what we do here - try to optimize the power output from the Dam.
translation: 但我对胡佛水坝到沙漠绿洲的每一寸电网都如数家珍。我们在这儿负责的就是这个——将大坝的发电输出最大化。

original: Some of the others are working on an agricultural project, but... truth be told, they aren't making much progress. Not yet, anyway.
translation: 其他一些人则在搞农业课题，但是……说实话，他们没什么进展。反正目前为止都没有。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: This? The OSI lab. We don't get many visitors. The smell puts people off, I think.
translation: 这里？这里是科工部实验室，少有人来。我想应该都是被这味道给熏跑的。

original: Nobody ever said science would smell clean and fresh. Anyway, you get used to it, if you give it some time.
translation: 又没人说过和科学有关的东西都得好闻啊。反正时间一长你就习惯了。

original: What was that about salvage and traps?
translation: 拾荒者和陷阱？

original: That's right, the H&H Tools factory on the main drag. It's been sealed for ages, and it's lousy with traps. Still, might be something valuable to you.
translation: 没错，我说的就是大道边上的H&H五金工具厂。那里封闭多年，里面遍布陷阱。不过对你而言，里头也许有些值钱货。

original: What is there to do here?
translation: 这儿有什么事可做吗？

original: Keep your nose to the ground, stranger, that's what. Mind your own business and let us mind our own, are we clear?
translation: 老实点就行，陌生人。咱们各扫门前雪，你管好你自己就行，我们的事我们自己解决，明白了？

original: If you've got a mind to loot the old H&H Tools factory, don't even bother. That place is sealed tighter than a Radscorpion's bunghole.
translation: 如果你有打算去H&H五金工具厂里探险，我劝你还是趁早放弃。那地方比辐射蝎巢还要危险。

original: Every salvager who tries gets blown up, flattened, or gutted by traps. Then he starts to stink up the town and we're the ones to clean up the mess.
translation: 每个试图进去的拾荒者不是被陷阱炸飞、碾成肉酱，就是被大卸八块。最后臭味都飘到镇上来了，还得我们进去给他们收尸。

original: If you've got the caps, I'll back any claim you want.
translation: 只要你瓶盖够多，让我支持什么都行。

original: [FAILED] Hmm. Honesty's a good trait, stranger, but I don't deal with mercenaries unless I'm damn sure they can be trusted.
translation: [失败] 嗯，诚实是一个好品质，陌生人，但我不和雇佣兵打交道，除非他们真的值得信任。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Spoken like a true mercenary. Well, you seem like you can handle yourself, stranger, and we can use people like that.
translation: [成功] 说话的口气倒挺像个真正的雇佣兵。好吧，看来你是有点本事，陌生人，我们可以和你这样的人合作。

original: We may not squander our wealth like those fools in the Strip, but we take care of our own business. Consider this a token of good faith.
translation: 虽然我们不像长街的那些傻瓜那样有钱，但为了自己的事还是舍得的。这些小钱，就当是我们对你的信任吧。

original: I've got the skills, the will and the firepower. All I expect is a decent reward for my work.
translation: 我本领高强，意志坚定，装备优良。只要能给我一份对得起这身价的报酬就行。

original: I'm not interested in this, right now.
translation: 我现在对这个一点都不感兴趣。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: You need somebody with real firepower, and mine's yours for a small fee.
translation: 你需要一个有真本事的人，只要你肯花钱，我供你差遣。

original: I'm a friend, trust me.
translation: 我是你们的朋友，相信我。

original: [FAILED] Really? You'll forgive me if I ask you to back that claim up, won't you?
translation: [失败] 真的？如果我坚持要你证明这一点，你应该不会介意吧？

original: [SUCCEEDED] That's the kind of stuff I like to hear, stranger. All right, we could use someone like you.
translation: [成功] 我就喜欢听这些，陌生人。好吧，我们应该能用上你这样的人。

original: I respect your independence, and I'm good at taking care of troubles.
translation: 我尊重你们的独立自主，而且我最擅长的就是处理麻烦。

original: Doesn't the NCR keep order around here?
translation: 难道NCR没在这里维持秩序？

original: NCR... did you just crawl out from under a rock? Those folks only care about {emphasize all three "theirs"}their business, their people and their pockets.
translation: NCR……你是刚从石头缝里蹦出来的么？NCR们只在乎{emphasize all three "theirs"}他们自己，他们的人，还有他们的口袋。

original: NCR's order? Don't make me laugh, stranger. We work this land, we own these streets, and we yank up the bad weeds ourselves, got it?
translation: 让NCR来维持秩序？别说笑了，陌生人。在这片土地是我们开垦的，这些街道也是我们的，所以该由我们自己来清理门户，明白吗？

original: What kind of trouble?
translation: 什么样的麻烦？

original: Folks that don't belong. Murderers, rapists, extortionists, and everything in between.
translation: 外来人口。杀人犯、流氓、强盗，以及所有类似的货色。

original: You know, business as usual in North Vegas, stranger.
translation: 你懂的，就是北维加斯的毒瘤啊，陌生人。

original: Need a hand with any trouble?
translation: 有什么需要帮助的吗？

original: You want to help us out? What makes you think we want you around here, huh?
translation: 你想帮我们？你凭什么觉得我们会需要你，嗯？

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Name's Crandon, stranger. I keep an eye out for trouble around here.
translation: 我叫克兰登，陌生人。我负责这儿的治安，防止出现各类麻烦。

original: Tell me about North Vegas.
translation: 跟我说说北维加斯的情况。

original: We've been here for a few years, just looking for a place we can call our own.
translation: 我们已经在这里待了好几年了，只是为了建设一个能属于我们自己的地方。

original: Life's harsh, but still, it beats the hell out of the desert. We've got numbers, we've got food, and we've got trade. That's progress, stranger.
translation: 虽然生活很艰难，但总比在沙漠里要强得多。我们有人，有食物，还能做点买卖。这已经是不小的进步了，陌生人。

original: Tell me more about your role here.
translation: 给我讲讲你在这儿都负责些啥。

original: Jules, myself, and a few others patrol the streets and sewers. Any punks come up out of the rest of the city, we give 'em the run off.
translation: 我，儒勒，还有其他几个人主要在街上和下水道里巡逻。要是有混蛋敢从城市的其他地方跑来惹事，我们就把他们踢出去。

original: Like I told you, we look out for each other here. Me, Jules, and a few others make sure any trouble stays the hell out of our streets.
translation: 我说过，我们负责维护这里的治安。我，儒勒，还有其他几个人，主要任务就是确保我们的街道能够太平。

original: Don't worry.  I paid him off.  He won't be a problem.
translation: 别着急，我付他钱了，他不会再来坏你的事了。

original: You bribed a {emph}Ranger? Ha! That's gotta be some kind of special talent.
translation: 你贿赂{emph}了一个游骑兵？哈！你真有本事。

original: Sounds simple enough. I'll get right on it.
translation: 听起来很简单，我马上去干。

original: Thanks. Don't come back until you have it. Crimson Caravan is just northeast of the Gun Runners. Blake's usually in the main office.
translation: 谢谢。拿到货再回来。深红商队就在军火贩子地盘的东北边。布莱克通常都待在办事处里。

original: All right, what's the job?
translation: 好吧，什么工作？

original: Great. The Crimson Caravan has something ready for me.
translation: 很好。深红商队为我准备了一些东西。

original: Look for Blake and let him know you're picking up Contreras' medical supplies.
translation: 去找布莱克，告诉他你是替孔特雷拉斯来拿医疗物资的。

original: Don't worry.  He won't be telling anyone anything ever again.
translation: 别担心，他什么也不会说了。

original: Good to hear.
translation: 很好。

original: <Hand Contreras the package> Nah, but he is definitely looking for you.
translation: <把包裹交给孔特雷拉斯> 没有，不过他肯定会来找你的。

original: Thank God. You're going to need to take him out.
translation: 感谢上帝，你需要去把他干掉。

original: If McCarran hears I've been selling contraband, we're both dead.
translation: 如果营地内部知道我在销售违禁品，我们俩就死定了。

original: I didn't really have a choice.
translation: 我别无选择。

original: Now you're just going to have to take him out. I can't afford having NCR knowing about my side business...
translation: 那你现在就只能把他干掉了。我绝不能让NCR知道我的生意……
