original: ...and I don't think you want to go in front of a firing squad either. You take care of this, my entire stock is available to you.
translation: ……你也不想被他们抓起来枪毙吧。只要你把这事搞定，我这里的货物任你挑。

original: Hell, I might even throw in something extra to sweeten the deal.
translation: 该死，哪怕再多给你点甜头我都愿意。

original: Price is being held by the NCR.  A Ranger replaced him.
translation: 普莱斯被NCR抓住了，一个游骑兵顶替了他。

original: Ah shit. Well, please tell me you didn't hand him the package.
translation: 啊，妈的。好吧，你没有把包裹给他吧。

original: Just some supplies for McCarran from the Crimson Caravan.
translation: 只是深红商队送给麦卡伦营地的一些物资。

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right, if you hear anything, report it to myself or Lt. Boyd immediately. We need to track down his source.
translation: [成功] 好吧，如果你听到什么消息，立马向我本人或者博伊德中尉报告。我们需要追查他的货源。

original: [FAILED] <Takes Contreras' package> Bullshit, lets see what you've got here...
translation: [失败] <拿走孔特雷拉斯的包裹> 放屁，让我看看这里有什么……

original: Well, it looks like you've got the materials here to make chems. You're under arrest unless you've got a damn good explanation.
translation: 好啊，你这包裹里居然有用来制造毒品的原料。你最好给我解释清楚，这到底是怎么回事，否则我就逮捕你。

original: <cover package> Oh this?  Nothing important.
translation: <掩盖包裹> 哦，你说这个？没什么东西。

original: He said he would help you.
translation: 他说他会帮你的。

original: Great. Let him know we'll be keeping an eye on him. He is free to do business...
translation: 好极了。告诉他，我们会盯着他的。他可以正常做买卖……

original: But, if he isn't regularly reporting on illegal transactions, he's a dead man.
translation: 但是，如果他不按期报告那些违法的勾当，他就死定了。

original: <Draw Weapon> We agreed you should die.
translation: <掏出武器> 我们觉得你可以去死了。

original: Contreras will still get his. Killing you will just save me some paperwork.
translation: 孔特雷拉斯被抓是迟早的事。杀了你，也省得我向上级打报告了。

original: Nothing. I was just told he was a local merchant I should check out.
translation: 没什么。有人告诉我他是个本地商人，我想找他聊聊。

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right, if you hear anything, report it to myself or Lt. Boyd immediately. We need to track down his source.
translation: [成功] 好吧，如果你听到什么消息，立马向我本人或者博伊德中尉报告。我们需要追查他的货源。

original: [FAILED] What's that you're carrying? Looks like some kind of delivery to me...
translation: [失败] 你带着什么呢？我看是要送什么货吧……

original: Oh, just delivering packages.  No clue whats in em, but its really important.
translation: 哦，只是送包裹。不知道里面有什么，不过肯定很重要。

original: Well, I was given this package to deliver to him.
translation: 其实，有人给我这个包裹，叫我送给他。

original: Let's see... Well, it looks like you've got the materials here to make full-blown chems.
translation: 让我们瞧瞧……嗯哼，看来你这包裹里有不少用来制造强效毒品的原料啊。

original: Here.  Take this package Contreras gave me.  I don't want any trouble.
translation: 给。这是孔特雷拉斯给我的包裹，你拿去吧。我不想惹麻烦。

original: I was just told he was a local merchant and to find him to buy some supplies.
translation: 我只知道他是这儿的一个商人，我要去他那儿买些物资。

original: <Draw Weapon> Well, I can't just let him be killed. Word of this stops here.
translation: <掏出武器> 抱歉，我不能眼睁睁地看着别人杀他。谈话到此为止了。

original: I have Contreras. No one is going to miss you.
translation: 孔特雷拉斯我抓定了。没人会记得你的。

original: Ok. I'll just be on my way then.
translation: 好吧。那我这就走。

original: Stay out of trouble.
translation: 别惹麻烦。

original: What's going to happen to him?
translation: 你们准备把他怎么样？

original: He'll be shot. We have no tolerance for chem dealers in the military.
translation: 他会被枪决。我们决不允许军队中有人贩毒。

original: [SUCCEEDED] It might work since he's acting as a major hub for this activity. It's not like he has much choice now that we have evidence.
translation: [成功] 本地区的毒品贸易活动有不少是他经手的，这个建议应该可行。而且我们目前掌握着他的罪证，他也没多少选择。

original: If you can convince Contreras to work with the Rangers to break up the drug ring, I'll call off the firing squad.
translation: 如果你能说服孔特雷拉斯帮助游骑兵组织端掉整个贩毒网络，我就饶他一命。

original: Just report back to me when he's agreed to make the deal.  Otherwise, he's dead.
translation: 只要他同意这个条件，立刻回来向我复命。否则，他就死定了。

original: I'm sure Contreras could work with you.
translation: 我相信孔特雷拉斯可以跟你合作。

original: The way you stand, your weapon, even your armor is fitted in a military fashion.
translation: 你的站姿、武器，就连你身着的护甲看起来都像是个军人。

original: Hell. Thought I'd done a better job than that. Well, if that's how it is, you can call me Ranger Keller.
translation: 该死。我还以为能装得更像一点呢。好吧，既然你都看出来了，你可以改口叫我游骑兵凯勒。

original: Price is in deep with the NCR for supplying drug ingredients to the local gangs. He's currently being held for questioning.
translation: 普莱斯因为向本地黑帮提供毒品原料，已经得罪了NCR。他被拘押了，正在接受调查呢。

original: What is your business with Price?
translation: 你跟普莱斯是什么关系？

original: C'mon guy.  You're no merchant.  You've got Ranger all over you.
translation: 得了吧伙计。你根本不是商人。你浑身都是游骑兵的气味。

original: [SUCCEEDED] What?! How the hell did you figure that out?
translation: [成功] 什么？！你他妈是怎么看出来的？

original: [FAILED] Password? That little bastard said nothing about a password.
translation: [失败] 暗号？那个小混蛋可没提到过什么暗号。

original: Price is in NCR custody and you're going to join him, unless you've got a damn good explanation for why you're looking for him.
translation: 普莱斯正蹲在NCR的大牢里，你最好给我解释一下，你为什么要找他，否则我就抓你进去陪他。

original: Hand over your weapons. You're under arrest.
translation: 交出你的武器。你被捕了。

original: [INT/PER] Hey, that wasn't the right response for the password!
translation: [智力/感知] 嘿，这可不是正确的暗号！

original: Hey, I'm just the messenger. I didn't know anything about this.
translation: 嘿，我只是个邮差。我对这事一无所知。

original: You know what? I believe you.
translation: 是吗，我相信你。

original: You're free to go. Contreras, however, won't be moving drugs ever again.
translation: 你可以走了。不过，孔特雷拉斯以后再也无法倒买毒品了。

original: <Draw Weapon> You won't be telling anyone about this.
translation: <掏出武器> 你不会有机会跟别人讲的。

original: Heh, an accomplice afterall. Well, it'll save me some paperwork just killing you.
translation: 哼，到头来，你还是他的同伙。好吧，直接杀了你，也省得我打报告了。

original: Who the hell are you?
translation: 你到底是谁？

original: Ranger Keller. I've been undercover for months tracking chems in this area.
translation: 游骑兵凯勒。我在这一区域卧底了几个月，追查毒品的流向。

original: This has to be the easiest catch yet.
translation: 这证据真是来得不费功夫。

original: <Draw Weapon> You'll never take me alive, pig!
translation: <掏出武器> 别想活捉我，蠢猪！

original: Good. Saves me paperwork.
translation: 很好。也省得我向上级打报告了。

original: I had no idea that package had chems! Contreras gave it to me!
translation: 我根本不知道这个包裹里装的是毒品！是孔特雷拉斯给我的！

original: Contreras, eh? We suspected he was involved somehow.
translation: 孔特雷拉斯啊？我们怀疑他参与贩毒。

original: It looks like you just gave me the evidence I've been looking for.
translation: 看样子你正好提供了我一直在苦苦寻找的证据。

original: Close enough.  Yeah, Contreras told me to give Price this package.
translation: 差不多啦。孔特雷拉斯叫我把这个包裹交给普莱斯。

original: Lets see here...
translation: 我看看……

original: Congratulations, you're under arrest for chem trafficking. Hand over your weapons and come with me.
translation: 恭喜你，你因非法买卖致瘾性药物被逮捕了。交出武器，跟我走一趟。

original: Um, well...  Nevermind.
translation: 嗯，好吧……没事儿了。

original: Crazy wastelander.
translation: 脑子有问题。

original: Uh... do you like... gambling?
translation: 啊…你想要……赌两把么？

original: I'm looking for some betting advice.
translation: 我想请你教我一两手赌博的小技巧。

original: Brahmin tipping is a cherished pastime.
translation: 推倒双头牛真的很适合拿来消磨时光。

original: What? Look, do you have something to drop off or not?
translation: 什么？听着，你是有东西要给我，还是有别的事？

original: Have you seen a guy named Price around?
translation: 你在这附近见过一个叫普莱斯的人么？

original: We work together. I'm handling his deliveries for the moment while he handles a business opportunity that came up.
translation: 我们是一伙儿的。我负责替他送货，而他负责为我联系客户。

original: Where's your boss? He'll want to know you were hitting me up for freebies.
translation: 你们老大在哪？我要告诉他，你想从我这儿揩油。

original: Hey! No need, no need! I was just kidding!
translation: 嘿！别，别呀！我刚才开玩笑呢！

original: Motor-Runner's down in the Maintenance Wing. Straight through the door behind me, down the hall, down the stairs to the right.
translation: 轰鸣恶煞就在下面的维修区。直走穿过我身后的那扇门，经过大厅，再下楼梯右转就是了。

original: I was just kidding about tossing me some Psycho. So you don't got to say anything about that.
translation: 我刚才问你要疯狂药是开玩笑呢。你可千万不要乱说呀。

original: [FAILED] Who the fuck you trying to kid? You're lucky if I let you walk away from this, asshole.
translation: [失败] 你他妈的骗谁呢？你要是能活着走出去算你走运，混蛋。

original: Your boss, um... He summoned me here.
translation: 是你们老大，呃……亲自要召见我的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] If you're fucking carrying, just fucking say so. Yeah, deliver to the boss, business as usual.
translation: [成功] 你他妈是来送货的啊，早他妈说啊。好的，老规矩，送给头儿吧。

original: Motor-Runner's down in the Maintenance Wing. Straight through the door behind me, down the hall, down the stairs to the right.
translation: 轰鸣恶煞就在下面的维修区。直走穿过我身后的那扇门，经过大厅，再下楼梯右转就是了。

original: I'm carrying Jet, Psycho, and other favors. And I don't deliver to the help.
translation: 我身上带着杰特、疯狂药和其他不少好东西。但不能交给你们这帮小弟。

original: Let's see how tough you are.
translation: 来，让我看看你有什么本事。

original: All right, asshole, you just fucked yourself!
translation: 好啊，蠢货，这可是你他妈自找的！

original: Isn't this Vault 3, home of the Fiends?
translation: 这里不是3号避难所吗，恶魔帮的大本营？

original: Final warning, asshole. Get the fuck out of here or we are going to waste your ass.
translation: 最后说一遍，蠢货。给我滚蛋，否则老子他妈废了你。

original: No need to get worked up. I'll leave.
translation: 用不着发火嘛。我这就走。

original: Yeah - fuck off, and be grateful you're still breathing!
translation: 对啊，滚蛋吧，没弄死你，你就该感恩戴德了！

original: This is what I been waiting to see! A big bad Khan bringing in the medicine! How about you toss some psycho my way?
translation: 终于盼来了！有个大汗帮的人带来了药！你能不能甩几支疯狂药给我？

original: What the fuck are you doing here? You got some kind of fucking death wish, asshole?
translation: 你他妈在这干什么？准备好他妈的遗言了吗，混蛋？

original: I wasn't expecting a resupply so soon, so you have anything from Red Rock Canyon to sell me?
translation: 我没想到这么快就有人来补货了，你从红岩峡谷那边带了什么东西来卖给我？

original: NCR? Here? Not for long.
translation: NCR？在这里？待不久的。

original: How the hell did you get in here? Where the fuck are my guards?
translation: 你他妈的怎么进来的？我的守卫都他妈死哪去了？

original: Take down this password, it'll get you into the Overseer's area upstairs I think.
translation: 拿着这个密码，我想这样你就能进入楼上的监督者办公区了。

original: Thanks for the help. We'll find our own way out.
translation: 谢谢帮忙。我们会自己找到出口的。

original: Thanks for the help. We'll find our own way out.
translation: 谢谢帮忙。我们会自己找到出口的。

original: Thanks for the help. We'll find our own way out.
translation: 谢谢帮忙。我们会自己找到出口的。

original: Thanks for the help. We'll find our own way out.
translation: 谢谢帮忙。我们会自己找到出口的。

original: Thanks for the assistance taking out Motor-Runner. I'll be heading back to McCarran. I'll put in a good word for you.
translation: 感谢你干掉了轰鸣恶煞。等我回到麦卡伦，一定会好好宣传你的事迹。

original: <Draw Weapon> I think I'll just take my caps back from your corpse.
translation: <掏出武器> 我就直接从你的尸体上拿回我的钱好了。

original: You really don't know what you just got yourself into, girlie.
translation: 你绝对想不到你趟了怎样的一潭浑水，小妞。

original: You really don't know what you just got yourself into, boy.
translation: 你绝对想不到你趟了怎样的一潭浑水，小子。

original: <Give 250 caps> Okay, make that 500 caps. I'm sure Contreras can skim for you.
translation: <给250瓶盖> 好的，那就500瓶盖。我确信孔特雷拉斯会帮你隐瞒的。

original: I wouldn't normally do this, but seeing so much money change hands between scumbags on a daily basis has me thinking.
translation: 我通常不收人钱，但一想到每天有那么多钱在这帮混蛋手里来回倒腾，我可真得好好考虑一下。

original: I'm never going to be able to track all of these bastards down without some help, and Contreras seems to be a central hub of activity.
translation: 如果没人帮我，我永远都无法将这群狗杂种一锅端。孔特雷拉斯看上去是本地毒品交易的关键人物。

original: Tell Contreras I'm willing to put in a good report with the brass if he cooperates.  Just give me a cut of the action and report any major moves.
translation: 告诉孔特雷拉斯，只要他肯合作，我愿意在报告里替他向上级求情。条件是给我一笔抽成，并且所有重大活动都必须向我报告。

original: Otherwise, he'll be reported as a traitor selling contraband to the enemy and go in front of a firing squad.
translation: 否则，我就在报告里写他是个里通外敌、走私毒品的叛徒，让行刑队去处置他。

original: <Give 250 caps> I'm sure Contreras would be willing to work with you...
translation: <交250个瓶盖> 我敢肯定孔特雷拉斯会很愿意跟你合作的……

original: [SUCCEEDED] I wouldn't normally do this, but seeing so much money change hands between scumbags on a daily basis has me thinking.
translation: [成功] 我通常不收人钱，但一想到每天有那么多钱在这帮混蛋手里来回倒腾，我可真得好好考虑一下。

original: I'm never going to be able to track all of these bastards down without some help, and Contreras seems to be a central hub of activity.
translation: 如果没人帮我，我永远都无法将这群狗杂种一锅端的。孔特雷拉斯看上去是本地毒品交易的关键人物。

original: Tell Contreras I'm willing to put in a good report with the brass if he cooperates. Just give me a cut of the action and report any major moves.
translation: 告诉孔特雷拉斯，只要他肯合作，我愿意在报告里替他向上级求情。条件是给我一笔抽成，并且所有重大活动都必须向我报告。

original: [FAILED] You don't bribe a Ranger. You had better have something compelling to say, or you can join Contreras in hell.
translation: [失败] 别想贿赂游骑兵。你如果没什么话要说，那就和孔特雷拉斯一起下地狱去吧。

original: He seemed focused on results. Maybe not so much on people.
translation: 他似乎更关心结果，不太关心人。

original: [SUCCEEDED] He's not what you'd call... warm. Unless he wants something from you. And even then, it's kind of a cold warm.
translation: [成功] 他不是我们说的那种……热心肠的人。除非他对你有所企图——但即便是那样，那也是比较冷淡的热心。

original: Most of the time, I focus on the science and try to forget him. He doesn't get mixed up in any actual work. Though he tells people that he does.
translation: 大多数时候，我都在集中精力做研究，想把他忘了。他基本不参与任何实际工作。但是他却跟别人说自己做了很多贡献。

original: That's not much of an endorsement. What do you *really* think?
translation: 听你的口气，好像对他有所质疑啊。你到底是怎么想的？

original: [FAILED] Wouldn't be right for me to say. He's my boss... and he took a chance, bringing me out here as lead researcher.
translation: [失败] 我不太方便说。毕竟他是我的上司……是他把我提拔来当首席研究员的。

original: Exactly how old is Keely?
translation: 基利到底有多大了？

original: I couldn't get her to say. But she talked about the war - the great war, when the bombs fell - like she'd been there.
translation: 她不肯告诉我。但是她讲过那场大战时的事——她似乎亲眼目睹过核弹轰炸。

original: So I'm guessing... pretty old. Two hundred years? Maybe more.
translation: 所以我猜……相当老了。二百岁？可能更老。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Right. Stay safe.
translation: 好。保重。

original: What's your role here?
translation: 你在这里干什么？

original: Head researcher. Mostly on the Dam project, but I help out on other things, when they need me. Got to be flexible.
translation: 首席研究员。主要是研究有关大坝的项目，但需要时也帮忙做些其他工作。工作的内容挺不固定的。

original: Hildern mentioned the Followers of the Apocalypse...
translation: 希尔丹提到了天启追随者信徒……

original: My father used say good things about them, but that was years ago... back when they'd teach farmers and ranchers about crop rotation and the like.
translation: 我父亲对他们赞誉有加，不过那是很多年前了……那时候他们会教农民和农场主该如何轮种作物什么的。

original: Nowadays... they've changed. They're doing what they can to discredit the NCR, give us a bad name with the locals.
translation: 现在……他们变了。他们不遗余力诋毁NCR，让我们在当地的名声变得很不好。

original: Dr. Hildern trained with them, years ago. Not me, though. I'm an OSI girl.
translation: 希尔丹博士几年前跟他们一起培训过。我倒是没有。我一直待在科工部。

original: What do you think of Dr. Hildern?
translation: 你认为希尔丹博士这个人怎么样？

original: The Director? He's... very well-spoken. And... knowledgeable.
translation: 主管吗？他……举止文雅。还……挺有学识的。

original: I hear the food around here is pretty bad.
translation: 我听说这里的伙食不好。

original: It's foul, to tell the truth. Most people try to get what they can from the outside... even if it's just a smuggled candy bar, now and then.
translation: 说实话，恶心透了。大多数人都想办法从外面买吃的……有时候连偷偷弄进来的糖果棒都不放过。

original: Contreras is a genius, he can find almost anything you'd want. Takes caps to get him motivated, though. He won't do a thing for free.
translation: 孔特雷拉斯是个天才，想要什么他几乎都能给你搞到手。不过得给他点瓶盖。他可不会免费帮你办事。

original: Can you tell me anything else about Keely?
translation: 关于基利，你还有什么能告诉我的？

original: Keely's brilliant... an absolute genius. She plays at being mean, but it's all a front.
translation: 基利太出色了……绝对是一个天才。她看起来很凶，不过那只是表象。

original: When you've lived as long as she has, you get defensive around new people. Who wants to make a friend when you know you'll outlive them?
translation: 如果你也像她一样活那么久，你也会对遇到的陌生人心怀戒备。总是看着自己的朋友老死，谁也不会想去交新朋友吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Dammit. Now you've made me forget what I was doing...
translation: 该死。你害我忘了我正在做什么了……

original: Then you don't want this invoice from Alice McLafferty?
translation: 那你不想要这份爱丽丝·麦克拉弗蒂的发票了？

original: Fine. I'll see that she's paid. Crimson Caravan always fulfils their contractual obligations to the letter.
translation: 好吧。她会收到货款的。深红商队总是按照合同履行义务。

original: Now I assume there's nothing more, so I trust you can see yourself to the door.
translation: 我想没别的事了吧，门没关，用不着我送你吧。

original: I have an invoice for you from Alice McLafferty.
translation: 爱丽丝·麦克拉弗蒂有一份发票要我交给你。

original: From Alice? I'll see that she's paid right away.
translation: 爱丽丝的？我马上会付给她钱的。

original: Crimson Caravan runs a tight operation, even out here in the waste. Wouldn't do to keep them waiting.
translation: 深红商队即使在废土上也分秒必争。别让他们等太久。

original: Was there anything else? Or were you just here about the invoice?
translation: 还有别的事吗？还是说你只是为了发票来的？

original: I have a few questions.
translation: 我想问几个问题。

original: You mentioned Vault 22. I might be willing to help.
translation: 你提到了22号避难所。我说不定能帮上忙。

original: Actually, I have an invoice for you from Alice McLafferty.
translation: 其实，爱丽丝·麦克拉弗蒂有一份发票要我交给你。

original: From Alice? I'll see that she's paid right away.
translation: 爱丽丝的？我马上会付给她钱的。

original: Crimson Caravan runs a tight operation, even out here in the waste. Wouldn't do to keep them waiting.
translation: 深红商队即使在废土上也分秒必争。我不该让他们等太久。

original: Was there anything else? Or were you just here about the invoice?
translation: 还有别的事吗？还是说你只是为了发票来的？

original: Was there anything else? Or were you just here about the invoice?
translation: 还有别的事吗？还是说你只是为了发票来的？

original: Keely's dead.
translation: 基利死了。

original: Dead? But that's... terrible. You're sure? You saw her body? With the way she looks, maybe she just seemed dead, and she really wasn't...
translation: 死了？这简直……太可怕了。你确定吗？你看到尸体了？以她的长相来说，她可能只是看起来死了，但其实没有……

original: No... you've seen enough death to know the difference. I didn't mean to sound ungrateful. I know you tried.
translation: 不……你见过很多死人，肯定能看出区别。我不是不感谢你。我知道你尽力了。

original: Keely was brilliant... she'd seen so much. What a horrible waste...
translation: 基利非常出色……她见过那么多世面。真是太可惜了……

original: How do Keely and Hildern get along?
translation: 基利和希尔丹关系如何？

original: Like a brahmin and a deathclaw. Though I'm not sure which would be which. Bad analogy, maybe - they're both deathclaws, in their way.
translation: 就像双头牛和死亡爪。不过我也不太确定谁是谁。也许从不同的角度来说，他们都是死亡爪。

original: Keely hates Hildern. She says he's more politician than scientist, and gets in the way of true discovery.
translation: 基利讨厌希尔丹。她说他不像个科学家，更像个政客，妨碍了真正的科学进步。

original: And Hildern hates Keely because... well, because every time they meet, she makes him look like an ass. In front of important people, usually.
translation: 而希尔丹也讨厌基利，因为……因为每次基利一出现，就总要让他难堪。而且都是在重要人物面前丢脸。

original: Keely's dead. But I found her research notes.
translation: 基利死了。但是我找到了她的研究笔记。

original: Dead? But that's... terrible. You're sure? You saw her body? With the way she looks, maybe she just seemed dead, and she really wasn't...
translation: 死了？这简直……太可怕了。你确定吗？你看到尸体了？以她的长相来说，她可能只是看起来死了，但其实没有……

original: No... you've seen enough death to know the difference. I didn't mean to sound ungrateful. I know you tried.
translation: 不……你见过很多死人，肯定能看出区别。我不是不感谢你。我知道你尽力了。

original: The notes count for something. I'll keep them safe. Keely's work in the vault won't be lost, and it won't be forgotten.
translation: 这些笔记相当珍贵。我会好好保管的。基利在避难所中的工作不会被遗忘的。

original: So Dr. Hildern takes credit for your work?
translation: 也就是说希尔丹博士抢了你的功劳？

original: He sure does. Everyone knows it. I've just got to endure this job until the project is finished.
translation: 当然。大家都心知肚明。我现在就盼着赶快完成项目。

original: But abandoning Keely... he crossed a line. Taking credit for other people's work is one thing. Sending people to die in the waste is another.
translation: 可把基利丢在那里不管……这太过分了。抢别人的功劳是一回事，漠视别人的生命就是另一回事了。

original: If Hildern tries to recruit any more mercs, I'm going to warn them. What can he do to me? I'm the only one who can run this lab.
translation: 如果希尔丹再雇别的佣兵，我就要警告他们了。他还能把我怎么样？没有了我，这实验室的研究就进行不下去了。

original: That's it? A few caps and another errand?
translation: 就这么点？几个瓶盖，还想再让我去跑腿？

original: {Sarcastic}You're right. I'm just an under-the-table arms dealer. What could I possibly offer you, a drifting mercenary? Sorry for wasting your time.
translation: {Sarcastic}没错，我只是个见不得人的地下武器贩子，像你这样贪财的流浪者，你还能指望我给你什么？抱歉浪费你的时间了。

original: Isaac said they'll have the extra guns and ammo in the next shipment.
translation: 艾萨克说他们的下一批货会附带额外的枪支和弹药。

original: Very professional. I like that. Maybe you can handle something bigger.
translation: 很专业。我喜欢。也许我能把更重要的任务交给你。

original: Got anything for sale?
translation: 有什么卖的吗？

original: Take your pick.
translation: 自己挑。

original: You need to clean up your reputation or you're going to get me in trouble - I'll have to charge you more to keep from arousing suspicion.
translation: 你最好先把自己的坏名声洗干净，否则你会给我惹麻烦的。为了避免怀疑，我得多收你钱。

original: I took care of the Ranger.
translation: 我把那个游骑兵料理了。

original: Good to hear.
translation: 很好。

original: I convinced the Ranger to work with you.  You're safe, but be careful.
translation: 我说服那个游骑兵和你合作。你安全了，不过要小心。

original: No problem.  Consider it done.
translation: 没问题，肯定办妥。

original: Don't come back until his corpse is rotting in the sunlight. The last thing I need is a do-gooder Ranger trying to take me down.
translation: 不让他暴尸荒野，就别回来见我。栽在一个爱管闲事的游骑兵手里，是我这辈子最不想遇到的事。

original: He's looking to break up trafficking.  Maybe there is money to be made here...
translation: 他正在调查贩毒网络。也许这当中也能找到财路……

original: That might just work. Tell him I'll cut him in on a bit of the profit and help him track down drug dealers if he'll give me a pass.
translation: 可能管用，告诉他，只要他能放我一马，我愿意分给他一部分利润，并且帮助他追踪毒贩子。

original: The last thing I need is a do-gooder Ranger trying to take me down.
translation: 栽在一个爱管闲事的游骑兵手里，是我这辈子最不想遇到的事。

original: No way. I'm making too much money to just hand him the entire contraband operation. Just kill the bastard.
translation: 没门，这买卖赚得很，我才不会把整个生意拱手让给他。给我杀了那个混蛋。

original: Killing a Ranger brings big risks.  Killing gets expensive.
translation: 杀死一个游骑兵要冒很大风险，报酬也得加码了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right, here's a little something in advance. Now get the job done.
translation: [成功] 好吧，这是定金，先把活干好再说。

original: [FAILED] You've got brass balls, but no deal. I'm already offering you access to my stash if you take care of this.
translation: [失败] 你说得在理，可惜没门。我已经开了价码，只要你能把这件事搞定，我的货物任你挑。

original: Hey man, you never said anything about killing.  Cough up some caps.
translation: 嗨，老兄，你可没说过我还要杀人呢，这么点钱哪儿够啊。

original: We don't have to kill him.  You could work with him and make caps.
translation: 我们不用杀了他，你可以和他合作，一块儿发财。

original: [SUCCEEDED] That might just work. Tell him I'll cut him in on a bit of the profit and help him track down drug dealers if he'll give me a pass.
translation: [成功] 可能管用，告诉他，只要他能放我一马，我愿意分给他一部分利润，并且帮助他追踪毒贩子。

original: The last thing I need is a do-gooder Ranger trying to take me down.
translation: 栽在一个爱管闲事的游骑兵手里，是我这辈子最不想遇到的事。

original: [FAILED] No deals. I want that son of a bitch dead.
translation: [失败] 不行，我要那狗娘养的去死。

original: Kill him?  Can't we just cut a deal or something?
translation: 杀了他吗？我们就不能和他达成协议之类的？

original: [Attack] Lucky you. You can borrow my dentures when I knock all your teeth out.
translation: [攻击] 算你走运。等我把你那一口真牙都敲光，你还可以借我的假牙用。

original: It'll take more than that to get me to talk, worm.
translation: 想让我开口可没那么容易，蛆虫。

original: [Attack] Then you won't mind if I keep going.
translation: [攻击] 那么你应该不介意我得寸进尺吧。

original: Oh, but I do, Silus. Unlike you, I follow Caesar's orders.
translation: 哦，可我和你不一样，希鲁斯。我坚决遵照凯撒的旨意。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I've done everything Caesar ever asked of me, and this is how I am repaid? With assassination?
translation: [成功] 凯撒以前吩咐给我的每一件事，我都一丝不苟地执行。他就是这样奖赏我的？将我灭口？

original: I ambushed countless NCR patrols and wiped them out so that our operatives could move freely.
translation: 我曾无数次伏击NCR的巡逻队，把他们杀得片甲不留，为的就是给我们的密探开路。

original: I waited for him to dispatch us for three days, never questioning why the "headaches" he complained of would hinder his ability to command.
translation: 我等他的调度令等了整整三天。我搞不懂，他说自己头疼，那又怎么可能影响他指挥呢？

original: Did you honestly believe you could escape death?
translation: 你真的以为自己还能侥幸活命吗？

original: [?] If I had killed myself then I would've been murdering one of Caesar's greatest soldiers. Either choice is a betrayal of the Legion, as I see it.
translation: [?] 果我自杀，那凯撒就将失去手底下一名最优秀的战士。无论哪条路，都是对军团的不忠。

original: You shouldn't have done that. I'm the only friend you have right now.
translation: 你不必那么做，我是你现在唯一的朋友。

original: [?] You've made your intentions clear. The Legion has abandoned me.
translation: [?] 的来意我已经很清楚了。军团抛弃我了。

original: I'll be right back.
translation: 我很快回来。

original: Take your time.
translation: 请便。

original: But I want to know how a coward can attain the rank of centurion.
translation: 可我真想知道，一个懦夫是如何获得百夫长头衔的。

original: [?] Coward? I've faced odds that would make your NCR soldiers wet themselves.
translation: [?] 夫？我打过的仗足以让你们NCR的士兵吓得尿裤子。

original: I've led charges against men with guns carrying only my knife, and I can tell you, it was they who feared me.
translation: 我曾经手执刀剑，率领部下向荷枪实弹的敌人发起冲锋，我可以告诉你，真正怕的人是他们。

original: But suicide is a weak death on a battlefield. It says to your enemy that you fear capture. It says if you're caught you can be broken.
translation: 在战场上自杀才是懦弱的表现，那等于告诉你的敌人，你害怕被俘。一旦被俘，你就会土崩瓦解。

original: You sure talk tough for someone who's afraid to die.
translation: 没想到怕死还能找出这么多借口。

original: [?] You think I could get where I was in the Legion army if I feared death?
translation: [?] 觉得如果我要是真怕死的话，还能在军团里混到今天这个位置吗？

original: [Speech] You must've really screwed up to be caught by the NCR.
translation: [口才] 你一定是太没本事才被NCR抓了的。

original: So in addition to treason, you're also a deserter.
translation: 这么说，你不仅是叛徒，还想当逃兵？

original: [SUCCEEDED] No! That's not what I meant! I-
translation: [成功] 不！我不是这个意思！我——

original: Lieutenant! This man is trying to kill me! He's not who you think he is!
translation: 中尉！这个人要杀我！你被他骗了！

original: [SUCCEEDED] No! That's not what I meant! I-
translation: [成功] 不！我不是这个意思！我——

original: Lieutenant! This woman is trying to kill me! She's not who you think she is!
translation: 中尉！这个女人要杀我！你被她骗了！

original: Caesar's laws are absolute. He does not grant exceptions.
translation: 凯撒的律法神圣不可动摇，绝不会有例外。

original: [?] You have to let this go. I'll disappear. No one will ever see me again. That was always the plan in the first place.
translation: [?] 要你放我一马，我马上消失，从此不会再有人见到我，我早都计划好了。

original: You're a danger to him alive. Your knowledge threatens him.
translation: 你活着，对他就是个威胁。你知道的太多了。

original: [?] I've told them nothing. They've gotten nowhere. I'm a centurion, for Christ's sake. I deserve his trust.
translation: [?] 什么也没告诉他们。他们什么也没得到。我是百夫长，看在老天的份上，他应该信任我。

original: [Speech] Yes. I want to *know* how such a big talker got caught so easily.
translation: [口才] 是啊，我可真想知道，你这个牛皮吹上天的家伙又是如何这么轻易就被俘的。

original: [Speech] Sounds to me like you were too gutless to follow Caesar's orders.
translation: [口才] 在我看来，你是没胆量遵守凯撒的命令。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I'll show you gutless, you sniveling bastard. I'll spill your guts all over this room!
translation: [成功] 我让你瞧瞧什么才是没胆量，你这可怜的杂碎。我要把你的五脏六腑撒得满地都是！

original: [Speech] You must miss giving orders, now that all your men are dead.
translation: [口才] 你的人都死光了，很怀念发号施令的感觉吧。

original: [?] Foot soldiers of the Legion are trained to not have to think for themselves - to have conflict removed from their minds.
translation: [?] 团的步兵们在受训时就被要求学会置生死于度外，这样他们才不会心存杂念。

original: They kill themselves to evade capture because they are not trusted to make such a decision rationally in the heat of battle.
translation: 用自杀来防止被俘，是因为在残酷的战斗中，这些士兵不大可能做出冷静的判断。

original: But I'm no foot soldier. I knew I could escape captivity on my own, without revealing the tiniest iota of information to my captors.
translation: 可我和那些无名小卒不同。就算被俘虏，我也能轻易逃走，而且绝不会向敌人泄露哪怕一丁点的秘密。

original: Go over that one more time.
translation: 再说一遍。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: I don't know why I'm taking this chance on an invalid... I'll explain again.
translation: 真搞不明白我怎么会摊上这么个废物……我再解释一遍。

original: I understand.
translation: 我明白。

original: Good. But for her to trust you to re-enter the room, she'll need to believe you've been doing what she expects of you.
translation: 很好，但为了能让她允许你再次进入屋子，你必须假装听她的吩咐。

original: You'll need to punch me until I'm bleeding and weak. Go on. This is nothing compared to the Legion's training.
translation: 先把我揍得头破血流。来吧。这和军团的魔鬼训练相比根本不算什么。

original: How many agents of the Legion *are* there here?
translation: 军团在这儿究竟有多少特工？

original: I know of only the one other. Though I wouldn't be surprised if there were a great many.
translation: 我只认识其中一个，不过我敢肯定还有别人。

original: I work independently.
translation: 我单干。

original: Hmm... perhaps not, then.
translation: 嗯……恐怕现在不是了。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: You were warned! Time to die.
translation: 我已经警告过你了！去死吧。

original: I'm not a Khan. I'm just dressed like one.
translation: 我不是大汗帮的人。只是穿得像而已。

original: Then what the fuck are you doing here? You looking to get killed? What the fuck?
translation: 那你他妈的来这里做什么？找死啊？什么毛病？

original: Are there many water merchants around here?
translation: 这附近运水的商人多吗？

original: There's a few independent ones like me, but it's mostly the big trading outfits that deal in water, like the Crimson Caravan Company.
translation: 有几个像我这样的独立小商贩，但主要还是大商家在做，比如深红商队公司。

original: <Lie> Yes, Keely's fine. We escaped the Vault together.
translation: <撒谎> 是的，基利没事了。我们一起从避难所里逃了出来。

original: [FAILED] No. That can't be right. Keely would've called in.
translation: [失败] 不，不对。那样的话基利会联系我的。

original: Maybe you think you helped her... I don't know. But I need to hear from Keely. Personally.
translation: 也许你以为自己救了她……我不清楚。但只有她亲自和我联络，我才能确认。

original: Otherwise... no reward. Not a cap.
translation: 否则的话……没有报酬，一个瓶盖都没有。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Thanks again. Really. I owe you.
translation: 再次感谢你。真的。我欠你一个人情。

original: <Lie> Keely is safe. She's just finishing up some research in the vault.
translation: <撒谎> 基利已经安全了。她现在正在避难所里忙着进行研究的收尾工作。

original: [SUCCEEDED] She is? But she didn't call in. Keely wouldn't waste a chance to yell at Dr. Hildern.
translation: [成功] 真的？但是我还没联系上她。基利应该不会错过这个痛骂希尔丹博士的机会。

original: But if she's caught up in her notes... I guess she might have forgotten.
translation: 也许她正忙着整理她的笔记……大概忘了联络吧。

original: Sorry. I shouldn't question your word. If you say Keely's safe, I owe you these caps.
translation: 对不起。我不应该怀疑你。如果像你说的，基利安全了，就收下这些瓶盖吧。

original: I don't believe you. You're lying.
translation: 我不相信你。你在说谎。

original: Then you're a fool. That man reports to Caesar on what I do here. The Legion isn't going to take me back.
translation: 那是你自己蠢，那个人会向凯撒报告我在这儿的一举一动。军团已经不打算救我回去了。

original: My only hope is to escape and disappear. But if I escape and he reports it, they'll hunt me down as long as I live.
translation: 我唯一的希望就是逃走，然后销声匿迹。可万一这个计划也被他捅出去，那他们就算追到天涯海角也要取我的命。

original: It'd serve me to report him as much as it'd serve you.
translation: 所以把他揪出来对你我都有好处。

original: Who's the operative?
translation: 那个密探是谁？

original: I don't know. I know he sends intelligence by radio in the middle of the night. Sometimes that intelligence would find its way to my century.
translation: 我不知道。我只知道他会在半夜通时过无线电传递情报。有时候那些情报也会递交到我的部队。

original: I think I've heard all I need to. You've been very helpful.
translation: 我想我已经得到想要的情报了，感谢你的配合。

original: I hope the Legion burns your wretched body at the stake when they conquer this place.
translation: 等军团征服了这里，我希望他们能把你那丑陋的尸体钉在柱子上烧成灰烬。

original: Nothing I could tell you would do anything to stop that.
translation: 就算我告诉你再多，也改变不了这个结局。

original: See? Don't you feel better now that you've divulged all those state secrets?
translation: 看到没？把秘密都说出来了，是不是感觉清爽不少？

original: So you were unafraid to cut any throat but your own.
translation: 这么说你愿意替别人了断，却不敢自己动手。

original: And if you can't go through with it, you look even weaker.
translation: 如果你还这么嘴硬，那你的丑态就更表露无遗了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You think I'm going to slit my throat for some megalomaniacal self-appointed dictator?
translation: [成功] 你以为我会为了一个狂妄自大、目中无人的独裁者而去白白送死吗？

original: I didn't work my way up to have it all be taken from me out of some irrational paranoia. Caesar's losing it. I believe that.
translation: 我好不容易才混到今天，他那疑神疑鬼的样子，让我无法不生二心。凯撒有点老糊涂了，这点我深信不疑。

original: He's been shutting himself in his tent. Privately, he complains of headaches. Whatever it is, it's affecting his ability to lead.
translation: 他把自己关在营帐里。私下里总是抱怨自己头疼。不管究竟什么原因，他的领导能力都因此受到了影响。

original: You've been tricked, Silus. I'm working with the NCR. I just got you to talk.
translation: 你被耍了，希鲁斯。我替NCR工作。我总算让你招供了。

original: No! You slimy bastard!
translation: 不！你这个小杂种！

original: No! You cursed bitch!
translation: 不！你这该死的婊子！

original: Nothing I've said will change the outcome for you. No force can hold back the tide of the Legion. This camp and everyone in it will burn.
translation: 就算你们知道了我的秘密，也不会改变你们的命运。军团势不可挡。这座营地，你们每一个人，都将化作灰烬！

original: [Attack] If you've got any last words, you'd better say them now, Legion scum.
translation: [攻击] 如果你有什么遗言，你最好现在就说，军团的杂碎。

original: {LATIN}Cedo nulli.
translation: {LATIN}决不投降。

original: Your loyalty is commendable, but I don't work for Caesar's Legion.
translation: 你的忠诚确实令人钦佩，可惜我不为凯撒军团工作。

original: If his empire falls, it'll probably be because his centurions are so gullible.
translation: 如果有一天他的帝国完蛋了, 那肯定是因为他手下的百夫长们太窝囊了。

original: What? What do you mean?
translation: 什么？你什么意思？

original: I can deliver them your cold, dead skull.
translation: 我可以把你的脑袋提给他们。

original: I could just tell them you are dead. For a price.
translation: 我可以告诉他们你已经死了。但这话不能白说。

original: Well now, I guess that depends on who's paying.
translation: 好吧，那要看谁出钱了。

original: I was thinking we could make an arrangement.
translation: 我想我们可以做一笔交易。

original: What kind of arrangement did you have in mind?
translation: 你想做什么交易？

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: I'm not here to talk. I'm here for business. Either do some or get the fuck out.
translation: 我是来做生意的，不是来聊天的。不做买卖就滚蛋。

original: I'll give you exclusive rights to my personal stash, for a slight markup.
translation: 我可以让你购买我的私人特藏，但要稍微加点价。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, 22 caps each, but that's it.
translation: [成功] 好吧，每支22瓶盖，不能再高了。

original: [FAILED] These are my prices. I don't negotiate.
translation: [失败] 就这个价，不要拉倒。

original: I don't suppose you can pay a little better?
translation: 如果我稍微提一点价，你不会介意吧？

original: I'll sell you a vial of Psycho for 20 caps.
translation: 我愿意以20个瓶盖的价格卖给你一支疯狂药。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you a vial of Psycho for 22 caps.
translation: 我愿意以20个瓶盖的价格卖给你一支疯狂药。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you a pack of Buffout for 20 caps.
translation: 我愿意以20个瓶盖的价格卖给你一瓶壮大灵。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you a pack of Buffout for 22 caps.
translation: 我愿意以20个瓶盖的价格卖给你一瓶壮大灵。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you a can of Jet for 20 caps.
translation: 我愿意以20个瓶盖的价格卖给你一支杰特。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you a can of Jet for 22 caps.
translation: 我愿意以22个瓶盖的价格卖给你一支杰特。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: Appearances can be deceiving. Shall we?
translation: 人不可貌相，不是吗？

original: Cool. I haven't had a good fight in a while, and it's been ages since Donnie and Marie had something they could sink their teeth into!
translation: 很好。正巧我已经有段时间没好好打过架了，唐尼和玛丽也好久没有东西可以拿来磨牙了！

original: Sounds good to me, and to the dogs, too! Dinnertime, boys!
translation: 不错呀，我的狗儿刚好也饿了！孩子们，开饭时间到！

original: I was actually just leaving.
translation: 我正准备走呢。

original: Then get the fuck out. I'm a busy man.
translation: 那就快滚蛋吧。我可是大忙人。

original: The NCR sent me here to take care of you.
translation: NCR派我来料理你。

original: You? Take care of me? Ha! You don't look half-tough enough.
translation: 你？料理我？哈！你看上去一点本事都没有。

original: I'll be leaving now.
translation: 我要走了。

original: Nice doing business with you.
translation: 和你做生意真痛快。

original: I'm just here looking around.
translation: 我只是随便看看。

original: [FAILED] Then I think you'd better find your way out before you get yourself hurt.
translation: [失败] 那我觉得你最好掉头回去，免得受伤。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I guess it isn't a secret. Yeah, the residents of the Vault are all dead. We killed them.
translation: [成功] 我想这也不是秘密了。没错，这座避难所里面的居民都被杀掉了，是我们干的。

original: Funny thing is, they just let us in. We didn't have to force the doors or anything.
translation: 好玩的是，他们居然就直接放我们进来了。都不用我们破门而入。

original: Can you tell me what happened to the residents here?
translation: 你能告诉我这里的居民发生了什么事吗？

original: I have some chems that I can sell.
translation: 我有些药可以卖。

original: I'm paying 20 caps each for Jet, Psycho, or Buffout.
translation: 你卖给我一支杰特、疯狂药或者壮大灵，我付20个瓶盖。

original: Deal is still the same, 20 caps each for jet, psycho, or buffout.
translation: 还是老规矩, 每支杰特、疯狂药或者壮大灵都是20瓶盖。

original: I'm here to do some business with chems.
translation: 我来这是要做药品生意的。

original: Okay, our deal was Jet, Psycho, or Buffout for 22 caps a pop.
translation: 好的，我们的价码是每支杰特、疯狂药或者壮大灵22瓶盖。

original: You want to buy some chems from my personal stash?
translation: 你想买点我私人珍藏的药吗？

original: I don't have any more questions. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我没什么问题了，我们来说说别的。

original: All right, then.
translation: 好吧，那。

original: Is there any place to buy weapons and armor?
translation: 这里有没有能买到武器和弹药的地方？

original: I think there a few places, but I've heard that the Gun Runners sell the best.
translation: 这里是有个卖枪的地方，不过我听说军火贩子的货是最好的。

original: Where can I find a doctor around here?
translation: 在这附近，哪能找到医生？

original: Doctor Usanagi runs a medical clinic up the road.
translation: 宇佐木医生在前面经营着一家小诊所。

original: May I ask you some questions?
translation: 我能问你些问题么？

original: Sure. Fire away.
translation: 当然，随便问吧。

original: No, not yet.
translation: 不，还没有。

original: Hurry!
translation: 快点！

original: Yes, I have it here.
translation: 是的，就在我这儿。

original: Good! Give it to me.
translation: 很好！把它给我。

original: I'm going to pretend to be unconscious. Let them send you out so no one suspects you.
translation: 现在我要假装失去意识。让他们把你送出去，这样没人会怀疑你了。

original: When I'm alone with a guard, I'll shoot him and leave in his uniform.
translation: 等房间里就剩下我和落单的守卫时，我就干掉他，穿上他的制服逃走。

original: There must be more you can tell me.
translation: 你肯定还有什么没告诉我。

original: There is one other thing that may interest you. I know that Caesar has planted a spy here.
translation: 还有一件事你可能会感兴趣。我知道这儿潜伏着一个凯撒的间谍。

original: Every night details of NCR troop movements are broadcast from a radio on this base to Caesar's camp.
translation: 每天晚上他都会通过无线电来向凯撒传递这个基地内军队的动向。

original: The spy has been here a long time - since before the entire conflict began. He's an officer.
translation: 这名间谍潜伏很久了，战争打起来以前他就已经被安插在此了。他是名军官。

original: If I knew who he was, I would tell you. If I escape and he's alive to report it, the Legion would hunt me down.
translation: 如果我知道他是谁，我会说的。假如他把我逃脱的事情也上报给军团的话，那他们是不会放过我的。

original: But like I said, none of this information will change the outcome for you. No force can hold back the tide of the Legion.
translation: 但就像我说的，即便得知这一情报，也无法改变你们的命运。军团无人可挡。

original: Maybe I'll beat some more useful information out of you.
translation: 也许我能用拳头从你嘴里多撬出点情报。

original: Beat me all you like, but it won't make my information any more useful. You can take what I have or leave it.
translation: 随你便吧，我知道的其他情报都不重要了。你可以相信，也可以不信。

original: I'll be the judge of that. Let's hear what you've got to say.
translation: 这我自有判断。你有什么想说的就说吧。

original: Something is wrong with Caesar. Something he is attempting to hide from his men. But it was obvious before we set out on this last mission.
translation: 凯撒有点不对劲。他好像在对部下隐瞒什么。直到上次执行任务时，我才发现了端倪。

original: For three days, we awaited his order to dispatch us. Three days. But he hid in his tent, refusing to give orders. Complaining of headaches.
translation: 整整三天，我们都在等待他的调令。可他却只是躲在营帐里，闭门不出，一声不吭，说他头疼。

original: He looks different now than he used to. His face is sunken, sickly. But any questioning of his health enrages him.
translation: 他比前阵子看起来更加古怪了。他现在面黄肌瘦，满脸病容。可只要一提到他的健康，他就会暴跳如雷。

original: Crandon says you're not allowed to stay here. You'll have to go somewhere else.
translation: 克兰登说你们不准待在这里。你们得到别的地方去。

original: Oh really? And how are you gonna make us?
translation: 哦，真的？那你打算怎么办？

original: <Attack> Easy, I'm just going to kill you.
translation: <攻击>别担心。我打算杀了你。

original: Fuck you, asshole! You're gonna regret it!
translation: 操你妈，混蛋！你会后悔的！

original: I'm asking nicely. I only do that *once.*
translation: 我已经很客气了。我可不会一直都这么客气。

original: [SUCCEEDED] H-Hey... hey, don't worry, I was just kidding. We're going, right boys?
translation: [成功] 嗨…嗨，别担心，我只是在开玩笑。我们这就走，对吧，伙计们？

original: [FAILED] I ain't moving my stuff just 'cause you ask, nicely or not. Get the fuck out of my sight, punk.
translation: [失败] 你这么说，我还就不走了，管你客气不客气。废物，赶紧从我眼前消失。

original: I'm asking nicely. Maybe you should go before I get angry at you.
translation: 我已经很客气了。你最好在我发火前赶紧滚蛋。

original: I'd rather not have any trouble. Here's 50 caps, just keep yourself off the streets.
translation: 我不想找不愉快。这是50瓶盖，别再出现在街上了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Sure. You got a deal.
translation: [成功] 当然。成交。

original: [FAILED] That don't buy much these days. Double it and you've got a deal.
translation: [失败] 目前的行情，这点可不够。加倍才行。

original: I've got other things in mind, right now.
translation: 我还有其他的事情要考虑。

original: Okay, I'll go see her.
translation: 好的，我会去见她的。

original: I like your enthusiasm, stranger. Let me know when that's done.
translation: 我欣赏你的热情，陌生人。完事后来找我。

original: I've got other things in mind, right now.
translation: 我还有其他的事情要考虑。

original: I'll deal with them.
translation: 我会解决掉他们的。

original: Glad to hear it. Let me know when they're gone.
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。完事后来找我。

original: I've got other things in mind, right now.
translation: 我还有其他的事情要考虑。

original: Mercs with a brain are no good to me, stranger. Let me know when you start behaving like a real gun.
translation: 有脑子的雇佣兵我可用不着，陌生人。等你真打算替人卖命时，再来找我吧。

original: I'm on it.
translation: 我这就去。

original: I like your speed, stranger. Let me know when that's done.
translation: 我喜欢你的效率，陌生人。完事后再来找我。

original: Got any more work for me?
translation: 能给我些活干吗？

original: Good work with those newcomers. I think you can handle more serious business... with more serious rewards.
translation: 流浪汉的事情你处理的不错。我想你可以承接一些更正经的任务了……报酬自然也会更丰盛。

original: There's a handful of greasers down in the sewers causing trouble. They ain't packing too much iron, but I'd like them dealt with all the same.
translation: 下水道里老有一小撮油脂帮的人在闹事。他们手里没什么家伙，所以我希望你能一如既往地搞定他们。

original: Anything else you'd like me to do?
translation: 还有别的事情要我帮忙不？

original: You know, this time I may actually need a gun with a brain.
translation: 你知道吗，这次我可能真需要一个有脑子的雇佣兵。

original: Talk to Mrs. Hostetler. She's near the Crimson Caravan. I think her daughter's making bad "friends," the kind that'll slit your throat in the dark.
translation: 去找霍斯泰特勒夫人。她住在深红商队驻地附近。恐怕她的女儿交了些坏"朋友，"就是会在暗地里捅刀子的那种。

original: What would you like me to do?
translation: 有什么能让我做的吗？

original: Some squatters decided to take space where they don't belong, over by the playground. We'd prefer to keep 'em off the streets and out of sight.
translation: 有些流民占据了不属于他们的地方，就在游乐场那一片。我们想让他们离开街区，别再回来。

original: Maybe you could go and talk to them... convince them to see things our way.
translation: 或许你可以去和他们谈谈……劝他们乖乖听话。

original: Good work with those newcomers. I think you can handle more serious business... with more serious rewards.
translation: 流浪汉的事情你处理的不错。我想你可以接受一些更正经的任务了……报酬自然也会更丰盛。

original: There's a handful of greasers down in the sewers causing trouble. They ain't packing too much iron, but I'd like them dealt with all the same.
translation: 下水道里老有一小撮油脂帮的人在闹事。他们手里没什么家伙，所以我希望你能一如既往地搞定他们。

original: Sorry for your loss. I hope the Colonel reconsiders.
translation: 你丈夫没回来，我很难过，我希望上校能重新考虑。

original: So do I. But I know he won't. Ain't important enough in the scheme of things, you know? Still... thanks for listening.
translation: 我也很难过，但我知道上校不会改变主意的。这件事太微不足道，根本排不上日程，你知道吗？总之……谢谢你听我说。

original: I'll recover your husband's body.
translation: 我会把你丈夫尸体带回来的。

original: Mister, I'd about given up hope. But you've got to be careful. I don't want anybody else dying on my account.
translation: 先生，我都快放弃希望了，但是你一定要小心，我不想任何人因我而死。

original: Ma'am, I'd about given up hope. But you've got to be careful. I don't want anybody else dying on my account.
translation: 女士，我都快放弃希望了，但是你一定要小心，我不想任何人因我而死。

original: Esteban's body is laid out between some buildings, east of the REPCONN headquarters. At least, that's what his squadmates said.
translation: 埃斯特班的尸体就躺在楼栋之间，位于瑞普康总部的东边。至少他的战友是这么说的。

original: There's an NCR position just north of there. It's on the way. They should be able to tell you what the situation is.
translation: NCR有个哨站就设在那儿的北面。如果你顺路经过那里的话，他们应该会把具体情形告诉你。

original: How did he die?
translation: 他怎么死的？

original: He was out on patrol. Bunch of drugged-up Fiends attacked them.
translation: 他和同伴在巡逻时，被一群磕了药的恶魔帮袭击了。

original: Esteban laid down cover fire while the others fell back. One of the men saw him get shot. He didn't die, though, not then.
translation: 其他人撤退时，埃斯特班负责掩护，有人看到他中弹了。但他没有死，至少当时没有。

original: They tried to go back for him, but there were too many Fiends, and they had to pull out. Damn savages chased them halfway to McCarran.
translation: 他们试图把他救回来，可恶魔帮的人太多了，他们只能撤退。该死的野蛮人在他们返回麦卡伦的途中一路围追堵截。

original: I brought his body to an NCR position. He's on his way back to McCarran.
translation: 我把他的尸体带到了一座NCR哨站，他马上就能回麦卡伦了。

original: They put him in a box? With a flag and all? I hope so. He'd have been proud.
translation: 他们会为他准备棺材吗？上面还盖着国旗？我希望他能得到这个待遇，他一定会很自豪的。

original: You're too good for this rotten town. First kind thing anybody ever did for me and Esteban.
translation: 你是个好人，这个腐坏的城市配不上你。以前从未有人这样善待过我和埃斯特班。

original: You ever need anything, all you need to do is ask. Thank you so much.
translation: 以后无论你需要什么，只管开口就行。太谢谢你了。

original: You did what you said you would, and I owe you. Just like I promised, this is Esteban's back pay. Every cap.
translation: 你信守了诺言，我很感激。这是埃斯特班的抚恤金，我答应你的。

original: Maybe the caps are all that matter to you, but... you still did more for Esteban than his own country did. Thank you.
translation: 也许你干这个只是为了钱，但是……这个国家回报给埃斯特班的甚至还不如你多。谢谢。

original: I haven't found him yet.
translation: 我还没有找到他。

original: No... I didn't expect nothing so soon. You're doing me a favor - I don't mean to be a pest.
translation: 没有吗……我也没指望能有多快。毕竟你已经在帮我了——我也不想打搅你。

original: You said you wanted the caps. If you're thinking I'm not good for the money... please, you've got to take my word.
translation: 你说过你想要钱。如果你是觉得我付不起报酬才……求求你，我绝对不会食言的。

original: It seems strange the NCR wouldn't do their best to retrieve a fallen comrade.
translation: 真奇怪，NCR竟然没有尽力去夺回死去同伴的尸体。

original: Colonel says he can't spare the men to bring Esteban back home. And the Fiends, they put all kinds of mines and traps around his body. Snipers, too.
translation: 上校说他抽不出人手把埃斯特班带回来。另外，恶魔帮在他尸体周围布置了各种各样的地雷和陷阱，还有狙击手。

original: If your husband is dead, what does it matter if you get the corpse back?
translation: 你丈夫都死了，就算把他的尸体弄回来又有什么意思呢？

original: You never lost anybody, have you? Not like this. Never had to think about that person you love all alone out there, cooking in the sun like meat...
translation: 你从没失去过亲人，对吧？没有感受过亲人横死。你想象一下，自己所爱的人被弃尸荒野，像团烂肉似的在烈日之下曝晒……

original: NCR never leaves a soldier behind. That's what the recruiters told us. Promised us. We believed them.
translation: "NCR绝不放弃同袍"，征兵处的人是这样告诉我们的，他们承诺我们的，我们信了。

original: You look upset.  What's wrong?
translation: 你看起来心事重重，怎么了？

original: I know... I've been crying. Stupid. I'm supposed to be a soldier.
translation: 我知道……我一直在哭。太蠢了，我真该有个当兵的样子。

original: My husband... he's a Ranger, and he... he got murdered by a pack of Fiends. Goddamn savages laid his body out to rot.
translation: 我的丈夫…他是一名游骑兵，他……他被一群恶魔帮杀害了。那些该死的野蛮人把他的尸体扔在荒郊野外。

original: The brass won't say it to me straight, but they mean to leave Esteban out there. I can see that plain.
translation: 上司没有和我明说。但我看得出来，他们已经打算把埃斯特班的尸体扔在那儿不管了。

original: Some other guy replaced Price, and he definitely didn't know the password.
translation: 有个家伙取代了普莱斯，而且他确实不知道暗号。

original: Ah shit, I'm guessing he got caught by the NCR. You need to kill that guy now that he's seen you.
translation: 该死，他肯定是被NCR抓住了。既然那家伙已经见过你了，那你就去杀了他。

original: Last thing we need is some investigator tracking you down. Get it done, and I think we can settle accounts, so to speak.
translation: 我可不想看到你被调查人员逮到。要我说，赶紧把这事解决，然后我们把帐结了。

original: <Draw Weapon> Special delivery!
translation: <掏出武器> 特别快递！

original: Ah, hell!
translation: 哦，干！

original: <Draw Weapon> Nothing now. I think I'll end your little investigation here.
translation: <掏出武器> 算了。我想你的调查也到此为止了。

original: <Draw Weapon> And now I'm going to kill you, you lying son of a bitch.
translation: <掏出武器> 我要杀了你，你这个撒谎的狗杂种。

original: Whoa!  Hold on a minute, buddy...
translation: 哇哦！等一下，伙计……

original: Whoa!  Hold on a minute, honey...
translation: 哇哦！等一下，亲爱的……

original: Son of a...  Sir, I didn't know anything about this.
translation: 操蛋……长官，我什么都不知道。

original: You know what? I believe you.
translation: 这样吧，我相信你。

original: You're free to go. Contreras, however, won't be moving drugs ever again.
translation: 你可以走了。不过，孔特雷拉斯再也不能倒买毒品了。

original: I'd like to buy some supplies.
translation: 我想买点物资。

original: The brass are pissed about the trouble you've been causing. Your caps are no good here.
translation: 上司对你糟糕的表现非常不满意。你有钱也没用。

original: Maybe you didn't hear me the first time. No service for scumbags!
translation: 看来上次你是没听清。我们不卖东西给卑鄙小人！

original: Hey, I heard you were able to recover Morales' corpse.  In thanks, you get a discount on supplies.
translation: 嘿，我听说你找回了莫拉莱斯的尸体。作为感谢，你在我这儿可以享受折扣。

original: That was a real honorable thing you done there, kid.  Much appreciated.
translation: 你做的事非常光荣，孩子。十分感谢。

original: Here is what is currently available.
translation: 目前我手上有的就是这些了。

original: With your reputation? Well, I won't say your caps are no good here... let's just say that they're... less good.
translation: 就凭你现在的名声？怎么说呢，虽然你的钱在我这儿是可以用……但也确实…不那么好用。

original: Come on, you can tell me.
translation: 快点吧，告诉我。

original: [FAILED] Not my place to talk. Sorry.
translation: [失败] 真不能说，不好意思。

original: Anything you tell me stays with me.
translation: 我的嘴很严，不会到处乱说的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right. Some of the farmers, especially Trent Bascom, claim the NCR isn't giving them the water they need to meet their crop quotas.
translation: [成功] 好吧，有几个农民，尤其是特伦特·巴斯科姆，声称NCR所供应的水无法满足粮食生产的需求。

original: Personally, I think they're just incompetent and making excuses. The NCR ought to send them all crying back to California.
translation: 我个人觉得，他们只是能力不足在找借口罢了。NCR就应该把他们送回加州，让他们哭去吧。

original: Who's ungrateful?
translation: 谁没有心存感激？

original: I shouldn't have brought it up. It's not my place to spread gossip.
translation: 我早知道就不提这事了。我不应该瞎传谣言。

original: Tell me about the farms.
translation: 跟我说说关于农场的事情吧。

original: It's NCR-owned farmland. It produces a lot of the crops that supply McCarran and the Dam. The farmers are all civilians, though.
translation: 这是NCR经营的农场。这里出产的粮食大多供应麦卡伦与大坝。不过这儿的农民都是我们的公民。

original: They work the farms, and in return they get a safe place to stay and clean food and water. Some of 'em aren't all that grateful, though.
translation: 他们在农场中劳动，作为回报，他们能够得到安稳的住处、干净的粮食和水。不过并非每个人都心存感激。

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: I'm a private in the NCR army, and I've been proudly serving for two years now.
translation: 我是NCR军队的一名列兵，我已经光荣入伍有两年了。

original: Although, if you were asking what I'm doing right this instant, I'm patrolling the farms. It's a safe post, but a little boring.
translation: 如果你是问我目前在做什么，我正在农场里巡逻。虽然这岗位很安全，但也有些无聊。

original: I do get to take shots at marauding Molerats once in awhile, and that's always fun.
translation: 偶尔我也会拿那些来偷粮食的鼹鼠练练手，真的很有趣。

original: {slightly confused - player is dressed like a fellow trooper}Same as you, I'd imagine? Although, I'm assigned to watch over these farms and keep out trespassers.
translation: {slightly confused - player is dressed like a fellow trooper}应该和你一样吧？我被指派来保护农场，严防入侵者。

original: I do get to take shots at Molerats once in awhile, so that's always fun.
translation: 偶尔我也会拿那些来偷粮食的鼹鼠练练手，真的很有趣。

original: I'm looking to buy and sell things.
translation: 我想做些买卖。

original: The Crimson Caravan Company is north of here. They have just about everything you need.
translation: 往北走就是深红商队。他们那儿的货物应有尽有。

original: But, if you're in the market for guns, go see the Gun Runners. They're expensive, but they have stuff no one else carries.
translation: 不过，如果你想买枪，就去军火贩子那里看看吧。虽然价格高昂，但他们的东西绝对是有口皆碑。

original: I need a doctor.
translation: 我要看医生。

original: There's the medic at Camp McCarran, but I've also heard there's a civilian doctor in the northeast part of New Vegas. I don't know for sure.
translation: 在麦卡伦营地就有卫生员，不过我听说新维加斯的东北部也有个医生。但我不太确定。

original: I could use some directions.
translation: 我想问个路。

original: I'll help you if I can. What are you looking for?
translation: 我会尽量帮你。你想要去什么地方？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Bye.
translation: 拜。

original: If the Fiends are so dangerous, why hasn't the NCR wiped them out?
translation: 如果这些恶魔帮真的这么危险，为什么NCR不除掉他们？

original: Current orders are to hold the line and nothing more. That's all we seem to do these days - hold the line.
translation: 我们当前的命令是守住防线。眼下我们做的也基本就是这件事——守住防线。

original: I guess it's a tricky situation since there's a vault in Fiend territory. If the NCR went after them, they'd just hole up.
translation: 情况还是挺棘手的，因为恶魔帮的地盘上刚好有一座避难所。只要NCR一追来，他们就会躲入地下。

original: Are there more dangerous posts?
translation: 有更危险的岗位吗？

original: Oh, you'd better believe it. I feel sorry for the troops who are charged with keeping the Fiends from overrunning everything.
translation: 噢，你别不信。我真为那些每天都在与恶魔帮搏斗的战友们感到遗憾。

original: The Fiends are scary because they're unpredictable. One day, they'll be taking potshots at you and then running off before you can shoot back.
translation: 恶魔帮之所以可怕，是因为他们的行为捉摸不定。他们会突然间冒出来，放几发冷枪，然后趁你还未反应过来就逃之夭夭。

original: And the next day, they'll come rushing at you pumped full of drugs and not stopping until you or they are dead.
translation: 到了第二天，他们就会浑身药味地冲过来与你拼命，直到有一边死透了为止。

original: Ok, 200 is a deal.
translation: 好的，200成交。

original: Alright then, take my helmet and bring it to the NCR. That should be proof enough. This doesn't make us friends though.
translation: 那好，把我的头盔带给NCR的人，这应该够当证明了吧。但你也别以为咱们从今往后就是朋友了。

original: We don't offer protection services. That's not my racket. So if you find yourself dead on your way out that's your tough shit.
translation: 我们不提供护送服务。对，不提供。所以如果你死在出去的路上，那是你自己倒霉。

original: Actually, I can just bring them your head for free.
translation: 我干脆把你的脑袋提给他们好了，不花钱。

original: I was thinking closer to 150.
translation: 我在想150瓶盖应该差不多了。

original: Sorry, no deal.
translation: 抱歉，没门。

original: Okay, I don't need the money that bad. 150 it is. This doesn't make us friends though.
translation: 好吧，我也不是那么在乎钱。这是150瓶盖。但你也别以为咱们从此就能成为朋友。

original: We don't offer protection services. That's not my racket. So if you find yourself dead on your way out that's your tough shit.
translation: 我们不提供护送服务。对，不提供。所以如果你死在出去的路上了，那是你自己倒霉。

original: The NCR is leaving you alone, 150 seems like a small price to pay.
translation: 能让NCR离你远远的，150瓶盖可是相当划算啊。

original: You should pay me, I'm providing you the service.
translation: 应该是你付我钱，我可是在保你的命啊。

original: I'm not going to pay you squat. Now get outta my face.
translation: 我一分钱都不会给你的。给我滚出去。

original: Yeah, that sounds like an alright deal. Here take my helmet back to the NCR. This doesn't make us friends though.
translation: 对了，这样的条件听起来才像话嘛。把我的头盔拿给NCR吧。但你也别以为咱们从此就能成为朋友。

original: We don't offer protection services. That's not my racket. So if you find yourself dead on your way out that's your tough shit.
translation: 我们不提供护送服务。对，不提供。所以如果你死在出去的路上了，那是你自己倒霉。

original: How about you give me 75 caps, it'll keep the hit squads away for a bit.
translation: 你给我75瓶盖怎么样，这样那些部队就不会来骚扰你了。

original: I'll pay you, I'm sure I can make up the difference from NCR.
translation: 我给你钱好了，反正我能从NCR那把差价补回来。

original: Okay, we got a deal. Now let's talk a price, it'll cost you 200 caps for proof of my death.
translation: 好吧，那就这么定了。谈谈价格吧，200瓶盖，我就把能证明我死亡的东西给你。

original: Nevermind, I'll just show myself out.
translation: 不客气，我这就走。

original: Nothing left to sell, time for me to leave.
translation: 没东西可卖了，我该走了。

original: Thanks for doing business.
translation: 感谢你来和我们做生意。

original: That is all I can spare.
translation: 我就只有这些了。

original: Okay then. What's your business now?
translation: 那好吧。现在你还有什么事？

original: I'll sell you all my Buffout for 20 caps each.
translation: 我把手上的壮大灵全都卖给你，每支20瓶盖。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you all of my Buffout for 22 caps each.
translation: 我把手上的壮大灵全都卖给你，每支22瓶盖。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you all my Psycho for 20 caps each.
translation: 我把手上的疯狂药全都卖给你，每支20瓶盖。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you all of my Psycho for 22 caps each.
translation: 我把手上的疯狂药全都卖给你，每支22瓶盖。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you all of my Jet for 20 caps each.
translation: 我把手上的杰特全都卖给你，每支20瓶盖。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: I'll sell you all of my Jet for 22 caps each.
translation: 我把手上的杰特全都卖给你，每支22瓶盖。

original: Okay, got anything else?
translation: 好吧，还有别的东西吗？

original: [Attack] Then I may as well beat you to death for personal satisfaction.
translation: [攻击] 我也可以把你活活打死，好让我解解闷。

original: Let's see you try.
translation: 愿意奉陪。

original: Fine. Tell me what you know.
translation: 好吧，说说你都知道什么。

original: You're out of your mind.
translation: 你根本是疯了。

original: I'd love to debate you on this, but there's no time. Now do it or don't, but stop wasting my time.
translation: 我很想跟你争辩这个话题，不过没时间了。你爱干不干，但不要再浪费我的时间。

original: Sounds dangerous, but I'll do it.
translation: 听起来很危险，不过我同意帮你。

original: Good. Return to me when it's done.
translation: 很好。完事了再回来吧。

original: I told you. I'm not helping you.
translation: 我说过了，我不帮你。

original: I don't think you understand the situation. Listen up.
translation: 你还是不清楚情况。听着。

original: This place is now locked down under quarantine, so neither of us is leaving until the situation at hand is dealt with.
translation: 这里已经被彻底隔离了，在事态得到控制之前，我们谁都不能出去。

original: The hell I am. The door to the entrance is locked!
translation: 搞什么！入口的门被锁住了！

original: Of course it is. This place is under quarantine until I finish what I started. Now listen up.
translation: 那当然了。在完事之前，这里必须被隔离。你先听着。

original: Just as long as I'm getting paid for this.
translation: 只要给钱我就干。

original: You really have a one track mind, you know that? Anyway, listen up.
translation: 你光惦记着这个是不？总之，你先听着。

original: Sure, how can I help?
translation: 好的，我该怎么做？

original: Time is of the essence, so I'll be brief. This place is filled with spores that are toxic to humans, and we need to get rid of them.
translation: 时间紧迫，长话短说。这里充满了对人类有毒的孢子，我们需要把它们全部消灭。

original: I've pumped the vault full of a highly flammable gas that, once ignited, should destroy the vast majority of the spores. There's one problem, though.
translation: 我已经将整个避难所灌满了高度易燃的瓦斯，一旦引燃，就能消灭绝大多数的孢子。不过有一个问题。

original: The gas becomes semi-inert on exposure to oxygen, meaning the gas will have to be ignited close to where it's being introduced.
translation: 这种气体暴露在氧气中时呈半惰性，这意味着它只能在用于排放气体的通风口处引燃。

original: I need you to find the vents where the gas is being pumped and ignite it. Oh, and survive the resulting blast.
translation: 我需要你找到通风口，然后点燃它。哦，对了，别被烧死了。

original: No deal. You'll have to do it without me.
translation: 没门。你自己干吧。

original: Have it your way. When you change your mind, I'll be on the second level. Meet me there and I'll explain what needs to be done.
translation: 随便。如果你改变主意了，我就在二层。到那里找我，然后我告诉你该怎么做。

original: How much are you paying?
translation: 你付多少钱？

original: So you're one of those, huh? Fine, I'll give you all the money I have once we're done. Meet me on the second level, and I'll explain more.
translation: 原来你也是那种拿钱办事的？好吧，等完事之后我就把钱都给你。先去二楼跟我碰头，然后我告诉你怎么做。

original: Of course. I'd be glad to help.
translation: 当然，我很高兴能帮忙。

original: Good. Meet me on the second level, and I'll explain what needs to be done.
translation: 很好。去第二层找我，我会告诉你该怎么做。

original: I was sent to fetch some research data. No one said anything about a rescue.
translation: 我只是来找研究数据的。没人跟我提过还要救人什么的。

original: Looks like you got sent on the same fool's errand I did, then.
translation: 看来你跟我是被同一个白痴糊弄进来的。

original: No, I was just exploring the vault when I stumbled on this place.
translation: 不，我只是碰巧路过，进来看看而已。

original: Well that's a hell of a bit of luck on my part, then.
translation: 是吗，那我可是真走运啊。

original: We can talk later. Right now we need to get out of here.
translation: 以后再说这个。我们现在得先想办法出去。

original: All right, all right. Just trying to make a little conversation. Shoulda known a youngin like you would be in a hurry.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我只不过想找点话说罢了。像你这样的年轻人，个个都是急脾气，我早就该猜到了。

original: But that's neither here nor there. These plants have gotten completely out of control. I've got a plan to deal with them, but I'll need your help.
translation: 不过那不重要。这些植物已经彻底失控了。我有一个计划，可以把它们处理掉，但是我需要你的帮助。

original: <Give 100 caps> 200 seems a bit steep.  How about 100?
translation: <给100个瓶盖> 200个看起来太多了，100个怎么样？

original: [SUCCEEDED] You drive a hard bargain, but 100 caps will do until we can get a regular deal worked out with McCarran.
translation: [成功] 你很善于讨价还价，如果我们能和麦卡伦做长期贸易的话，100个瓶盖也不错。

original: You can let McCarran know they'll have fresh snacks coming in a few days.
translation: 你告诉麦卡伦营地，几天后他们就会得到新鲜的零食。

original: <Give 200 caps> Alright.  200 caps it is.
translation: <给200个瓶盖> 好吧，这是200个瓶盖。

original: Great. I'll just pick up future payments from McCarran directly when I drop off my snacks.
translation: 好极了，那以后的款项就等我把食品送到麦卡伦营地时，再向他们要吧。

original: You can let McCarran know they'll have fresh snacks coming in a few days.
translation: 你告诉麦卡伦营地，几天后他们就会得到新鲜的零食。

original: I'll do it.
translation: 我会干的。

original: Great. Let me know what he says. They're almost a straight shot north from here, up past the sharecroppers.
translation: 好极了。问问他究竟什么说法。往北一直走，过了那些佃农地就能找到他们了。

original: Maybe later.
translation: 以后再说吧。

original: All right, well just find me when you want to get started.
translation: 好吧，当你有兴趣了再来找我。

original: You said you have some legwork needing done?
translation: 你说你需要有人替你跑腿？

original: Well, I can't exactly go wandering off the base whenever I want, you know? They're already suspicious.
translation: 是啊，我无法随心所欲地离开基地四处转悠，你知道吗？他们已经开始怀疑我了。

original: I can hear the MP's now. "Gee, Contreras, I didn't know you had so many friends in the Gun Runners." Speaking of which, guess your first stop.
translation: 我都能猜到宪兵会说啥。"哎呦，孔特雷拉斯，没想到你居然认识这么多军火贩子的朋友啊。"说到这个，知道我会先派你去哪儿了吗？

original: You're just passing a little note to a man named Isaac for me. {Sarcastic}I want to know which girl he likes.
translation: 我要让你给一个叫艾萨克的人带个口信。{Sarcastic}问他到底喜欢哪个女孩。

original: McCarran's mess hall needs more variety.  Could we work out a deal?
translation: 麦卡伦的食堂需要添点菜色，我们能做笔交易吗？

original: Well, business is pretty light and I'd welcome the income, but I'll need a lot of caps to buy the necessary supplies.
translation: 好吧，生意清淡，我也希望能多几桩买卖，但我还是需要瓶盖去购买一些必要的物资。

original: 200 caps would get me started.
translation: 给我200个瓶盖我就干。

original: Can anything be done to improve your supplies?
translation: 有什么办法能够改善你们的补给供应么？

original: {Tired sigh, lamenting lack of supplies}Well, we haven't had any quality meat in months. Everyone in the camp just eating beans for protein... It isn't pretty.
translation: 我们已经一个多月没吃肉了。军营里的大伙儿每天只能靠吃豆子来补充蛋白质……这可不够。

original: {Annoyed by bad luck}Some of my kitchen machinery is broken down, too, so we've been eating mostly raw vegetables.
translation: 我厨房里的一些机器设备也坏了，所以我们近来吃的蔬菜几乎都是生的。

original: {Direct, a bit desperate}And I'm desperate for spices or seasonings. Anything. Just something to the general mood around here.
translation: 此外，我还急需一些香料和调味品，哪怕一点都行。多少可以缓解一下我们大家低落的情绪。

original: I can bring his body back, but it'll cost you.
translation: 我可以把他的尸体带回来，但是你得出钱。

original: Caps. This whole rotten town wants caps. Nobody does anything just because it's right.
translation: 钱，这个腐烂的城市到处都要钱，就没人愿意发扬一下美德。

original: Fine. You want caps? You can have all of Esteban's back pay. NCR owes me, and I don't even want the damn money.
translation: 好吧，你想要钱？埃斯特班的抚恤金全都给你。NCR欠我的，反正我也根本不想要那该死的钱。

original: I'd like to buy some food.
translation: 我想买点吃的。

original: Chow down.
translation: 随便点吧。

original: Sorry, but the brass ordered me to not serve enemies of NCR.
translation: 对不起，上司命令我不得向NCR的敌人提供服务。

original: I don't like your kind taking food from my men, so I'm going to charge you a little extra. Don't like it? Tough.
translation: 我不喜欢你这样的家伙和我的弟兄们抢饭吃，所以我要额外收你钱。不满意？一边去。

original: Got anything to eat?
translation: 有什么吃的吗？

original: {Sarcastic}Oh yeah. You can order up anything you want... as long as it's corn or beans!<Laughs>
translation: {嘲讽的}哦，当然。想吃什么尽管点……只要是玉米或豆子就行！<笑>

original: {Done joking, serious}Just kidding. Haven't you heard? With few shipments from home and little variety, the troops are getting restless for some quality grub.
translation: 玩笑罢了，你没听说吗？老家运来的物资少得可怜，品种还很单一，为了搞到点能吃的东西，士兵们连觉都睡不好。

original: {Matter of fact}You can only do so much as a chef with just corn, beans, onions, and peppers.
translation: 如果厨师手里只有玉米、豆子、洋葱和胡椒，那你也别指望伙食能好到哪儿去。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Then you're not from the colonel's office? Sorry... I shouldn't have bothered you.
translation: 这么说，你不是从上校的办公室来的？抱歉……我不该打扰你。

original: Changed his mind about what?
translation: 什么改变了主意？

original: Sorry, I don't have time to help you out.
translation: 抱歉，我没时间来救你们。

original: We are going to die in here. Please, if you find the key let us out. We'll find our own way to safety.
translation: 我们迟早会死在这里的。求你了，如果你找到钥匙，就放我们出去吧。我们会自己找路逃出去的。

original: Can you tell me about the Fiends?
translation: 你能说说恶魔帮吗？

original: They are a bunch of junkies that do whatever they can to get money for chems.
translation: 他们是一群混蛋，为了弄钱买药，什么事都干得出来。

original: I hear they are lead by a guy calling himself Motor-Runner. I think he is in one of the other wings, although I haven't seen him myself.
translation: 听说他们的首领是个自称轰鸣恶煞的家伙。虽然我没亲眼见过他，但我想他应该就在这附近的某个区域。

original: I need to know a little more about Vault 3.
translation: 我需要再了解一些3号避难所的情况。

original: I don't know much, only that the people who lived in here originally were killed by the Fiends. Carter there escaped and managed to explore for a bit.
translation: 我了解的也不多，只知道这里原本的居民都被恶魔帮杀光了。那边的卡特逃跑过，他稍微探索了一下。

original: He hacked a password off of the computer, and found the location of some guns. He was on his way to get them when the Fiends caught him again.
translation: 他破解了一台电脑的密码，发现了藏武器的地点。他在准备去拿武器的途中，又被恶魔帮给抓了。

original: Yeah, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好的，我会想个办法的。

original: Thanks partner. I think the Fiend with the key is back in one of the bedrooms somewhere, someone called him Daniel. If that helps.
translation: 谢了，伙计。我估计保管钥匙的那个恶魔帮现在应该回卧室了，别人都叫他丹尼尔。希望这情报对你有用。

original: What are you doing here?
translation: 你们在这里干什么？

original: We were part of a caravan heading into New Vegas from down south. They are holding us hostage, trying to get some ransom.
translation: 我们参加了一支商队，原计划从南部赶往新维加斯。现在他们把我们扣为人质，想要以此勒索赎金。

original: Anyone willing to pay for us died in the attack. Once the Fiends figure that out, we are as good as dead.
translation: 但能付赎金的人在我们被打劫的时候就已经死了。要是让恶魔帮知道了这一点，我们就完蛋了。

original: Can you set us free now?
translation: 你现在能放了我们吗？

original: That's good to hear. Can't ever be too careful with strangers around here.
translation: 做得不错。对来这里的陌生人，再怎么小心都不为过。

original: I've dealt with those newcomers.
translation: 我已经处理了那些不速之客。

original: I'm starting to think you're as undesirable around here as those strangers. Do something to change my mind, merc.
translation: 我都开始怀疑你和那些不受欢迎的陌生人是不是一路货色了。你最好能用实际行动改变我的看法，雇佣兵。

original: Not yet. I'll get on it.
translation: 还没有，我正在处理着呢。

original: That's good to hear. Can't ever keep too many eyes on strangers around here.
translation: 不错。对这里的陌生人，再怎么小心都不为过。

original: I take care of those who help with that. Here, you earned it.
translation: 愿意帮我的人，我必会重金相谢。给你，这是你应得的。

original: I've dealt with those newcomers.
translation: 我已经处理了那些新来的。

original: I thought you'd be made of stronger stuff, merc. Don't prove me wrong or I'll have to find someone else with the guts to do what's right.
translation: 我还以为你挺有魄力的呢，雇佣兵。别辜负我，否则我就去换个更有胆量的家伙来。

original: I haven't sent them to the sewers, yet.
translation: 我还没处理掉他们呢。

original: Great work. I gotta make sure this place doesn't eat itself from the inside.
translation: 干得好。我得确保不会有人从内部破坏这里的安定团结。

original: I've taken care of those troublemakers.
translation: 我已经解决掉那些滋事者了。

original: Great work. I gotta make sure this place doesn't eat itself from the inside.
translation: 干得好。我得确保不会有人从内部破坏这里的安定团结。

original: I take care of those who help with that. Here, you earned it.
translation: 愿意帮我的人，我必会重金相谢。给你，这是你应得的。

original: I've taken care of those troublemakers.
translation: 我已经解决掉那些滋事者了。

original: I don't have that much.
translation: 我可没有那么多。

original: A hundred caps? Forget it.
translation: 100个瓶盖？还是算了吧。

original: Then we ain't going nowhere.
translation: 那我们就谈不成了。

original: Fine, take it.
translation: 好吧。拿着。

original: Pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 很高兴和你做买卖。

original: Give me the directions again.
translation: 再给我指一次路。

original: Not my problem. Goodbye.
translation: 和我无关，再见。

original: Not your problem. Right. That's the motto in this town. Rotten people, rotten place.
translation: 和你无关。没错，这就是这座城市的座右铭。烂人，烂地方。

original: McCarran has more vegetables and water than they know what to do with...
translation: 麦卡伦营地有些多余的蔬菜和水，不知该如何处理……

original: [SUCCEEDED] Fresh food and water is worth it's weight in gold... You've got yourself a deal.
translation: [成功] 新鲜的食物与水就像金子一样值钱……好吧，这单生意我接了。

original: Let McCarran know they'll have fresh snacks coming in a few days. I'll pick up the produce at that time as well.
translation: 你告诉麦卡伦，几天后他们就会得到新鲜的零食。不过他们也得把要交换的农产品准备好。

original: Maybe we could work something out later.
translation: 我们以后再商量吧。

original: Suit yourself.  I'm always open to more business.
translation: 随你的便吧。我随时欢迎生意上门。

original: The scientists here must have made some useful discoveries.
translation: 这里的科学家一定发现了不少有用的东西。

original: Oh, they did. I've taken extensive notes of all their successful experiments. Their research won't go to waste. As for the file erasure...
translation: 哦，是的。我已经记录了不少有关他们试验成功的资料。他们的研究成果不会白费的。至于删除的资料嘛……

original: Never mind. Go ahead and delete the files.
translation: 算了。尽管把那些资料删了就是。

original: You're pretty highstrung for a youngster. In any case, just a few more moments and...
translation: 你年纪不大啊，怎么紧张兮兮的。再怎么样都得等一下才能好……

original: <Lie> No, I've been too busy rescuing you. Could someone else have done it?
translation: <撒谎> 我不清楚。我一直忙着搜救你来着。是不是其他人干的？

original: It's possible. I have spent the last few days in a cave, after all.
translation: 很可能。我在这洞里已经待了好几天了。

original: For all we know, that man sent someone immediately after you to swipe the data while you posed as mantis bait.
translation: 据我推测，那家伙可能是在你离开后立马又派了个人，在你忙着对付变异怪物时渔翁得利拷走了文件。

original: Nothing to be done about it, I suppose. All we can do is delete what's here, and that's done.
translation: 咱们现在也没办法了。我们能做的就是把这里存的所有资料全删了。

original: Good riddance. Those files have caused enough trouble.
translation: 赶紧拿去。那些资料惹的麻烦已经够多了。

original: Indeed. This should only take a minute. Just a few more moments and...
translation: 可不是。只要几分钟就好。只要再等一会……

original: On second thought, go ahead and erase the data.
translation: 我考虑了一下，你还是把资料删了吧。

original: Glad you're thinking clearly. I was afraid to blink there for a second.
translation: 很好，你可算想通了。我刚才还真挺担心的。

original: There, all done. That wasn't so bad, was it?
translation: 好了，完事了。也没那么糟，是不是？

original: Positive.
translation: 是的。

original: Then you give me no choice.
translation: 那我就别无选择了。

original: I'm afraid I can't let you do that.
translation: 恐怕我不能让你这么做。

original: So you're going to be stubborn about it, eh? You're sure I can't change your mind about this?
translation: 所以你不打算让步是吗？你确定连谈判的余地都没有了？

original: Actually, I copied the files. Hildern sent me here to get them.
translation: 其实，我复制了那些资料。希尔丹派我过来拿的。

original: Yes, that sounds like something he'd do. Well, there's nothing for it, then.
translation: 对，这事一听就是他干出来的。他想得美。

original: Those files need to be erased. Hold out your arm and I'll have it done in a flash.
translation: 这些资料必须被删除。交出来，我马上就把这些资料删掉。

original: Will it take long?
translation: 要很长时间吗？

original: No, it shouldn't take all that long. Just a few more moments and...
translation: 不，很快就好。只要再等一小会……

original: ...it's done. We can rest easy.
translation: ……好了。我们可以松一口气了。

original: ...that's strange. The system says that the files were accessed recently, and copied to an external source.
translation: ……真奇怪。系统记录显示这些文件最近被查阅过，还被复制到了一个外接存储器上。

original: You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?
translation: 你该不会知道这是怎么回事吧？

original: I've unlocked the door so you're free to run along now. Although it pains me to say it, I wouldn't have made it out of here without your help.
translation: 我已经打开了门锁，你可以走了。虽然不愿意承认，但我还是得说，没有你的帮忙我完成不了这个任务。

original: If you're heading back toward McCarran, tell Dr. Williams that she has my thanks as well.
translation: 如果你要回麦卡伦，告诉威廉姆斯博士我也很感谢她。

original: If you're in the neighborhood of Camp McCarran anytime soon, look for a Dr. Williams. She was one of the few people there I could tolerate.
translation: 如果你路过麦卡伦营地，记得去找威廉姆斯博士，她是少数几个我还能忍得了的人。

original: She seemed genuinely worried when I agreed to come out here, so if you could be a dear and let her know I'm okay, I'd be most grateful.
translation: 我说要来这里时，她看起来很担心，你要是好人当到底，就帮我报个平安。我会感激不尽。

original: Exactly. Without that knowledge, something similar is bound to occur.
translation: 正是。如果销毁这些资料，同样的惨剧注定会再次发生。

original: All right. You convinced me. Take the files back to that buffoon. You make a good point, but I still honestly hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 好吧。你说服我了。把这些资料给那个蠢货送去吧。你说得很有道理，但我还是希望你清楚自己在干什么。

original: Science isn't just about success. Failures are just as important to learn from.
translation: 科学研究不可能永远一帆风顺。那些失败的经验同样重要，我们需要从中吸取教训。

original: I suppose the data here could serve as a warning to other scientists. Tell them what paths of research not to follow.
translation: 我估计这些资料确实可以警示其他的科学家，告诫他们不要重蹈覆辙。

original: How do you figure that?
translation: 你——为什么这么说？

original: Deleting those files makes it more likely that this will happen again.
translation: 删除这些资料，这种惨剧再次发生的可能更大。

original: If we destroy the files, all of these people will have died in vain.
translation: 如果我们销毁这些资料，这些人就都白死了。

original: No, these people died trying to stop a monster of their own creation. Failing to complete their work would mean they died in vain.
translation: 不，这些人就是为了消灭自己所创造出的怪物才牺牲的。如果不完成他们的遗志，那他们才是白死了。

original: And that's what I intend to do. And...
translation: 而我正打算这么做。所以……

original: I need those files. Dr. Hildern specifically sent me here to find them.
translation: 我需要那些资料。希尔丹博士派我过来就是为了那些文件。

original: Don't you realize what those files represent? If they get into the wrong hands, this could happen all over again.
translation: 你还没意识到这些资料造成了什么后果吗？如果落入居心不轨的人的手里，惨剧还会重演的。

original: Only this time, the madness won't just be confined to a musty vault. Do you really want that on your conscience? I sure as hell don't.
translation: 也就这次，遭殃的只是这个破避难所，下次可就没那么好运了。到时候，你的良心担得起吗？反正我是不能。

original: Wait! Don't delete the files!
translation: 等等！别把那些资料删了！

original: What's got you so flustered? You just about scared me to death shouting like that.
translation: 你这么慌干啥？！你刚才这一嗓子差点吓死我。

original: What needs to be done?
translation: 该怎么做？

original: I've managed to create a connection to the vault's backup system from here. I just have to remotely delete all the files, and we're done here.
translation: 我已经成功从这里连入了避难所的备份系统。我现在只需要远程删除所有研究资料，这样就完事了。

original: Any idea where these vents are that I'm looking for?
translation: 你知道通风口在哪吗？

original: I set the gas to pump into the fifth level since that's where the concentration of spores was highest. I'd start looking there.
translation: 我已经把瓦斯气体充进孢子密度最高的第五层了。我建议你去那里看看。

original: Typically, these vaults use circular vents in their air circulation systems. Look for a wall with two of them almost side by side.
translation: 一般来说，这些避难所的空气循环系统用的都是圆形的通风口。去找一面有两个并排通风口的墙。

original: There's one just around the corner outside this lab if you need an example.
translation: 这个实验室外面的角落里就有一个，你可以先去看看样子。

original: Know where I can find a doctor?
translation: 知道我到哪能找到医生吗？

original: I'm pretty sure they've got a doc over at Camp McCarran, but I don't know if he'll treat just anybody.
translation: 我敢肯定，麦卡伦营地有一个医生，但不知道他会不会给外人看病。

original: Who sells equipment around here?
translation: 这儿有谁卖装备的吗？

original: The Crimson Caravan Company's the big dog around here. Keep following the road north and you'll eventually come across their camp.
translation: 深红商队公司是这儿的大商号。沿着这条路向北走，你就会碰见他们的营地。

original: That's all I want to know right now.
translation: 我想知道的就是这些。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: I have some general questions for you.
translation: 我想问你一些其他的问题。

original: Shoot.
translation: 说吧。

original: What do you know about the NCR?
translation: 有关NCR你知道些什么？

original: Their main base is right over there by the old airport - it's called Camp McCarran now. Some people like to paint 'em all as a bunch of bullies.
translation: 他们的大本营就建在附近那座旧机场内——现在叫麦卡伦营地。有些人喜欢将他们形容成一伙恃强凌弱的恶霸。

original: Me, I'm glad they're around. They do what they can to keep things safe and orderly.
translation: 我倒是很欢迎他们。他们始终在坚持维持这里的安定和秩序。

original: Tell me about the Fiends.
translation: 和我说说恶魔帮。

original: They're a bunch of crazies hopped up on all kind of drugs. Apparently, they're using one of the old vaults as a hideout.
translation: 他们是一群靠嗑药过活的疯子。他们现在躲在一座老避难所里。

original: The army should really get in there and wipe 'em all out, but I guess they've got more than enough trouble to deal with right now.
translation: 军队真该去把他们铲除掉，不过我想他们现在应该也抽不开身吧。

original: Anything I should know about New Vegas?
translation: 在新维加斯有什么需要注意的吗？

original: They won't just let anybody into the Strip, but you should be able to have a good time in Freeside itself. Just, uh, keep a close eye on your caps.
translation: 他们不会随便让人进入长街，不过在自由城你也能找到乐子。只是，嗯，要多注意你的钱包。

original: No, should they have?
translation: 不，他们应该来找你吗？

original: Well, if they had any manners they would. In my day, if an old lady went missing for a spell, people cared.
translation: 如果他们还有点人性的话。要换做我那个年代，有位老太太失踪了，人们都会很在意的。

original: Hsu is dead.
translation: 许上校死了。

original: What? You idiot! I spent years earning his trust. The whole point of your heading up this operation was to preserve that trust!
translation: 什么？你这白痴！我耗费了好几年时间才取得他的信任。让你接手这个任务的主要目的就是为了维持他的信任！

original: Now they'll replace him in a week with some other colonel and I'll be back to square one. You've set me back years today. Years!
translation: 他们会在一周内派就新的上校来接替他的位置，然后我又得重新来过。多年的努力就这样被你毁于一旦了。多年的努力啊！

original: Get the hell out of my sight.
translation: 马上给我滚！
