original: Actually, I didn't notice the attitude until just now.
translation: 你不提我还没发现，你的气质有点与众不同。

original: Hah! See, we've even got the same sense of humor. I like a girl who doesn't piss me off after sex.
translation: 哈！瞧，我们都很有幽默感。我喜欢那种完事之后不和我计较的姑娘。

original: Hah! You're not as dumb as I thought you'd be. We got the same sense of humor.
translation: 哈！看来你并不傻。我们俩都很有幽默感嘛。

original: Probably better to walk away while I still like you, though. All kinds of things piss me off. Like just about anything that anybody says.
translation: 不过，趁我还没讨厌你，建议你赶紧离开。我可指不定什么时候就会发起火来，随便一句话就能让我开锅。

original: So snipers work in pairs?
translation: 这么说狙击手都是两人一组执行任务。

original: {Female PC, CHA 7+}Yeah. We spot for each other, watch each other's backs. Usually works pretty well, unless you get paired up with an asshole.
translation: {Female PC, CHA 7+}是的，我们互相掩护，互相照应。通常合作得很好，除非你的队友是个废物。

original: Thing is, there's a lot of assholes in the army. Now if they paired me up with somebody who looks like you...
translation: 问题是，现在这支军队偏偏不缺废物。要是他们能让我和你这样的家伙一组的话……

original: Lot of downtime in the army. Nobody around but you and your partner. Plenty of time for... whatever we want.
translation: 在军队里实在是憋得慌。很多时候周围除了你和你搭档，一个人也没有。当然这样我们就能有……独处的时光了。

original: Yeah. We spot for each other, watch each other's backs. Usually works pretty well, unless you get paired up with an asshole.
translation: 是的，我们互相掩护，互相照应。通常合作得很好，除非你的队友是个废物。

original: Thing is, there's a lot of assholes in the army. I keep hoping they'll pair me up with some hot blonde, like you see on those old pinups.
translation: 问题是，现在这支军队偏偏不缺废物。我真希望他们能把我安排和一位热辣的金发美女一组，类似招贴画上的那些。

original: Shit, I don't even care if she can shoot straight. Can't have everything.
translation: 妈的，我甚至都不要求她枪法准。人不能十全十美嘛。

original: Who's your partner?
translation: 你的搭档是谁？

original: The little guy. 10 of Spades. I like him because he listens. Doesn't shut up the rest of the time, but when I talk, he listens.
translation: 那个小伙子。黑桃十。我喜欢他，因为他听话。虽然其余时间总是唠叨个没完，但只要我一开口，他肯定会听。

original: Also, he doesn't pull any stupid come-ons, like practically every other horn-dog alpha male on this base. Might be he's just scared of me, though.
translation: 而且，他也不像这基地里的其他臭男人一样，成天到处卖弄。当然也许是因为他怕我。

original: I didn't know that all snipers wear shades.
translation: 我不知道狙击手都戴遮阳镜。

original: They don't. Only the good ones do.
translation: 并不是。只有优秀的狙击手才会戴。

original: My partner's got some potential, so I let him wear those goofy glasses. I tell him they're his training shades. He totally buys it.
translation: 我的搭档很有潜力，所以我也让他戴上了那种可笑的眼镜。我说这是用来训练的，他竟然信了。

original: Truth is, his eyes just suck.
translation: 其实是，他的眼神实在糟透了。

original: The big gun.
translation: 你的长枪。

original: Don't take this the wrong way, but girl, it's a damn good thing you're hot. That sarcasm blew right over your head, didn't it?
translation: 你可别误会我啊，姑娘，我觉得你真是太火辣了。你一定是想到这句话的讽刺意味了，对吧？

original: Yup. Lot of people make that connection. Big gun. Sniper. Some people don't even need to ask.
translation: 对啊。多数人都会这么联想：长枪配狙击手。有些人甚至都不用问就知道了。

original: You're a sniper?
translation: 你是个狙击手？

original: What gave me away? The big gun, the shades, or the attitude?
translation: 你怎么看出来的？是这把长枪，遮阳镜，还是我的气质？

original: I thought you should know. Cook-cook is dead.
translation: 我想还是告诉你比较好。大厨库克已经死了。

original: You killed him? Well, shit. Here I'd dreamed up this whole elaborate revenge fantasy.
translation: 你杀了他？好吧，我还整天在琢磨怎样才能把他大卸八块呢。

original: Didn't really think I'd do it, but as long as the tubby bastard was actually alive, I could pretend like I would.
translation: 我没有真想那么干，但只要那下流坯子还活着，我就会一直琢磨。

original: Here. I owe you. Take it and get out of here, before I indulge my inner bitch and spoil the moment.
translation: 给你，算我欠你的。拿上就赶紧走人吧，免得我泼妇脾气发作，破坏了这美好的气氛。

original: You were raped. That's not something you can just shrug off.
translation: 你被强奸了，这种事你是逃避不了的。

original: Never said it was. But I don't need to talk to any doctors. Especially not the pricks around here.
translation: 我从来没打算把它忘了。可我不想告诉医生，尤其是附近的那些白痴。

original: If I was smart, I'd fake a big old breakdown. That'd make everybody happy, and I'd get some leave time.
translation: 如果我够聪明，我会假装精神崩溃。那样就能皆大欢喜，我也能自个儿求得个清净。

original: But then I'd be doing what everybody wants, and being the asshole that I am, it just wouldn't feel right. Got to have some integrity.
translation: 可那样就等于让他们看笑话，从此我就只能低着头，当个脓包。这样也太窝囊了，我总得对得起我自己。

original: 10 of Spades blames himself.
translation: 黑桃十心里一直过意不去。

original: Yeah. Typical. Thing is, that fat pile of shit sneaked up on us from behind and kicked little 10 in the back of the head.
translation: 是啊，猜到了。当时的情况是，那头死肥猪从后面偷袭了我们，阿十的脑袋被狠狠地砸中了。

original: Knocked him out cold. Probably meant to kill him. The kid had no idea what happened until he woke up in the infirmary.
translation: 他当场就被打晕了。算他福大，本来那一记是能要他命的。后来那孩子在医务室里醒来，才知道发生了什么事。

original: 10 wants to blame himself, I can't stop him. He'll work it through on his own.
translation: 阿十把一切都归咎在自己头上，我劝不了他。他会自己想明白的。

original: Don't you want some payback?
translation: 你不想报仇么？

original: What kind of dumbass question is that? Of course I want payback.
translation: 这还用说吗？当然想报仇啦。

original: If I get hold of that fat pile of shit, I'll shove my rifle up his ass a couple hundred times, see how he likes it.
translation: 等我逮到那头肥猪，我一定要好好用枪管子捅他的屁眼一百次，看看他有多爽。

original: Then I'll fire some shells up in there, make sure he doesn't ever forget me. He left me a bunch of souvenirs - I figure I can do the same.
translation: 接着再朝里头开上几枪，让他这辈子也忘不了我。他在我身上留了不堪回首的印记，我也要悉数奉还。

original: So yeah. Payback would be good. Doesn't mean I need to have myself a big long cry.
translation: 所以说。我一定会报仇。不过我没必要天天把这事挂在心上。

original: I heard you were raped by Cook-cook.
translation: 我听说你被大厨库克强奸了。

original: Can't stop talking about that, can they? The Lieutenant actually sat me down and asked if I wanted to talk to a doctor.
translation: 这帮家伙真是啥都往外传。中尉确实找我谈过话，问我要不要看医生。

original: Wouldn't believe me when I told him to forget it. I mean, if that slab of meat had gotten me pregnant, then maybe I'd want to talk to a doctor.
translation: 我跟他说别再管这件事了，可他就是不信。要我说，除非那狗娘养的把我肚子搞大，否则我是不会去看医生的。

original: Mind cleaning up our mess, Corporal?
translation: 介意帮我们清理下烂摊子吗，下士？

original: Not at all, ma'am. I'll get right on it.
translation: 一点也不，女士。我这就去。

original: Tell me about Maude.
translation: 和我说说莫德吧。

original: Old Maude... Sometimes you can afford the creamy veal of a Sweetie, and sometimes you got just enough caps to buy a tough piece of jerky. {Ha!}
translation: 老莫德啊……有钱的时候你就能享受小甜甜的香甜滑嫩，可有的时候，你口袋里的钱就只够你买一块干瘪的老牛肉！

original: We're here. First Recon, get into your positions and wait for the target.
translation: 我们到了。第一侦察营，各就各位，等待目标出现。

original: Sorry, not interested.
translation: 对不起，没兴趣。

original: Damn shame. I've got some leave time coming to me, and I booked a suite at the Gomorrah. The two of us, rolled up in those silk sheets...
translation: 真扫兴。难得请了假，还在蛾摩拉酒店订了房。就我们俩，在丝绸床上翻云覆雨……

original: That's a little forward, don't you think?
translation: 你不觉得你有点太得寸进尺了吗？

original: Yeah. So what? I could take a bullet in the skull tomorrow. I haven't got time to take it slow and subtle.
translation: 是啊，那又怎样？成全了这事，就算明天我脑袋上开个窟窿也值了。我可没工夫耍花花肠子。

original: I see somebody I like, I go ahead and tell her. That's about the only thing that the horn-dog males get right.
translation: 我要看上谁，就会直截了当说出来。那些臭男人就这点值得学习。

original: Yes. But never a woman.
translation: 是的，但女人不行。

original: Trust me, the alpha males are overrated. Plenty of them in the army. All they're good for is killing each other and taking smelly shits.
translation: 相信我，那些大男人根本没那么厉害。军队中有很多这样的人。他们只懂得自相残杀和放狗屁。

original: I'm just saying... never know what you might like, if you don't give it a try.
translation: 我的意思是……不去尝试的话，你又怎么能知道自己几斤几两呢？

original: That's too bad, but not my problem.
translation: 真糟糕，但与我无关。

original: Hey, you asked, I answered.
translation: 嘿，你问了我才答的。

original: Okay, I'll look into it.
translation: 好吧，我会调查一下的。

original: Glad to hear it.
translation: 很高兴听到你这么说。

original: Well... that was a bit messier than I would have liked. Was there anything else?
translation: 好吧……比我想得要多了点波折。还有别的事情吗？

original: You're one of the Followers of the Apocalypse?
translation: 你是天启追随者？

original: I surely am. Well, sort of. I came out from Utah about six months back, saw a need for my help here.
translation: 当然是了。好吧，也不尽然。我六个月前刚从犹他回来，因为听说这里需要我的帮助。

original: The Followers weren't too happy about that, of course. They haven't been too fond of the NCR for a while, but I go where I'm needed.
translation: 当然，其他天启追随者对此并不怎么高兴。他们对NCR素来没什么好感，不过哪里需要我，我就去哪里。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿做什么？

original: I give what aid and comfort I can. I have medical knowledge thanks to my time with the Followers.
translation: 我会尽我所能去救死扶伤。能掌握这些医疗知识，得感谢过去我和天启追随者在一起的那段日子。

original: What happened to your friend Nephi?
translation: 你的朋友尼法出什么事了？

original: I never was able to reach him. He has allowed drugs and hatred to consume him. He runs with the Fiends north of here, now. They call him Driver Nephi.
translation: 我一直没能联系上他。他任由毒品和仇恨腐蚀自己。现在，他又加入了北边的恶魔帮。人们管他叫球杆尼法。

original: What was it that brought you out here from Utah?
translation: 你为什么要从犹他州到这里来？

original: Following a lost cause, I'm afraid. My old friend Nephi fell in with a bad crowd.
translation: 为了一个注定的败局。我的老朋友尼法中了一群坏人的邪。

original: Drug runners, raiders, probably worse things it's better not to dwell on. When his gang headed west, I followed.
translation: 毒贩子、掠夺者，还有一些更坏的家伙，还是别去深究的好。他们一路向西，我就跟着他来了。

original: I thought perhaps I could turn him back to the Church.
translation: 我当时还以为自己能让他改邪归正。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Well, that's an interesting question. Among the Church, I'm called Elder Gunnarsson. The Followers call me "Doc."
translation: 啊，有趣的问题。教会里的人叫我贡纳尔松长老。天启追随者则叫我"医生。"

original: You can call me Bert, though.
translation: 你称呼我伯特就行了。

original: What's the deal with all these refugees?
translation: 这些难民是怎么回事？

original: Poor lost souls, most of them. They thought to come to New Vegas and find their fortunes on its shining Strip.
translation: 大部分都是迷途的羔羊。他们以为到了新维加斯，就能在五光十色的长街上发一笔横财。

original: But the journey is often long, and the price to enter the city is steep. Those who could not pay ended up here, hoping to earn the caps they need.
translation: 但旅程通常都很漫长，进城的费用又像山一样高。那些负担不起的人就只能窝在这里，绞尽脑汁想要挣钱翻身。

original: Some find honest labor, but more fritter away what little they've saved on crooked gambling and cheap liquor. Still, I minister to them as I can.
translation: 有些人找到了正经工作，但更多的人把微薄的积蓄都用在了赌博和廉价酒精上。尽管如此，我还是会尽量帮助他们。

original: Excellent treatment. I hadn't thought of that!
translation: 妙手回春啊。我都没想到能这样！

original: I thought that man was done for, but you brought him around.
translation: 我还以为那个人快不行了，但是你把他救了回来。

original: That was some fine doctoring. I could learn a thing or two from you!
translation: 医术确实不错。我都能从中学到一两手呢！

original: You didn't have a choice. The Fiends were a growing threat.
translation: 也没别的办法。恶魔帮的威胁每天都在增长。

original: You did the right thing. If you'd sent more, they'd have been killed.
translation: 你做得没错。就算你派更多人去，他们也一样会死。

original: That's probably true, but I wonder if I should've taken a different strategy entirely.
translation: 也许吧，但我在想，如果我一开始就采取完全不同的策略，结果会不会更好一些。

original: Although my options were certainly limited with most of our forces tied up garrisoning this place.
translation: 只可惜我们的大部分兵力都在忙于本地防务，我能用的手段实在也很有限。

original: I don't understand how you could be so careless with the life of a ranger.
translation: 我真不明白你怎么能这样不关心一个游骑兵的死活。

original: I'd hoped he'd be able to slip past their security and be out before anyone knew he was there.
translation: 我原本希望他能够绕过敌人的守卫，在被发现之前就顺利脱身。

original: But I underestimated the Fiends. Should've known better, given the hell they've caused for us.
translation: 但我低估了那群恶魔帮。我不该这么草率的，想想他们制造了多大的麻烦就知道了。

original: Regardless, what you did for Anders isn't something he or any of us around here take lightly. We're all glad to have him back. Thank you.
translation: 无论如何，大家都不会忘记你为安德斯所做的一切，相信他本人也一样。他能回来我们都很高兴。谢谢你。

original: Motor-runner is dead. I brought his helmet as proof.
translation: 轰鸣恶煞死了。我有他的头盔为证。

original: Unbelievable. That man has given us so much grief since we set up here. This may be a major turning point for us.
translation: 难以置信。自从我们在这里驻扎以来，这家伙就一直在给我们添堵。他的死讯对我们来说也许是个重大转折。

original: I can't tell you how many times we thought we'd taken him out, only to have him show up again later, taking more heads off of fallen troopers.
translation: 我都记不清有多少次，我们自以为干掉他了，可没过多久他又再次冒出来，将死去士兵的头颅砍下取走。

original: This is for the bounty. And this is from a pool me and a lot of the soldiers around the base had going. You may not be NCR, but hey, it's only fair.
translation: 这是你的赏金。我和基地里的士兵一起凑份子设了个悬赏，钱就是从里头出的。你虽然不是NCR的人，但我们也要讲究公平嘛。

original: {LATIN}Timeo Danaos et dona ferentis. I posed as a mercenary to get inside the walls.
translation: （拉丁文）我怕希腊人，即便他们来送礼。我伪装成了雇佣兵才进来的。

original: {LATIN}Legum servi sumus. We are both slaves to Caesar's law. And you are in violation.
translation: （拉丁文）成为法律的奴隶，是为了保有自由。我们都是凯撒治下的奴隶，而你却违反了他的旨意。

original: How naive, Silus. {LATIN}Corruptio optimi pessima. Caesar sees you as a threat now.
translation: 你真是天真，希鲁斯。（拉丁文）最高尚的人如果败坏，便是最可悲的。凯撒已经不想留你了。

original: What's going on in Westside?
translation: 西区怎么了？

original: I try to keep my people out of Westside. Apart from trying to stay on good terms with the Khans, who do business there. There's Mean Son of A Bitch.
translation: 我一直想让我的人远离西区。毕竟我要和大汗帮搞好关系，因为他们在那儿有生意要做。还有一个叫无耻杂种的家伙。

original: That fucking mutant is more trouble to kill than to avoid. Having someplace for my people to sleep reduces the chances of drifting into Westside.
translation: 那混蛋变种人就是死不了，惹不起躲得起。至少有了能睡觉的地方，我的人也不至于成天去西区晃悠。

original: I gave my last hit of Psycho to this hot little chick last night.
translation: 我昨晚把最后一剂疯狂药留给了那个小骚货。

original: Motor-Runner told me he was going to pick up some more when the Khans come back through.
translation: 轰鸣扼杀告诉我他准备在大汗帮回来的时候再多买一些。

original: I got some to last me a little bit I think.
translation: 我手上的这些应该还够我撑一阵子。

original: Yeah, me too. Gonna have to go hit the boss for a fix soon.
translation: 是啊，我也是。得去老板那里多搞几支来。

original: I don't feel right. My head is fucking with me.
translation: 我感觉不太舒服，我的脑袋简直要爆炸了。

original: Shit. I gotta go find something to take the edge off.
translation: 糟糕，我要找点东西缓缓这劲头。

original: Yeah, you don't look too good.
translation: 哇哦，你看起来不大好。

original: Me too. I think I need a fix.
translation: 我也是，我可能得去爽一下。

original: I don't know. If you can't trust dealers, who can you trust?
translation: 我不知道，如果你连商人都信不过，那你能信过谁呢？

original: I got it from my buddy. I think he made it himself.
translation: 是从我伙计那儿搞到的。我觉得是他自己做的。

original: Where'd you get it from?
translation: 你从哪得到它的？

original: Fuck! I did too. I'm not doing well.
translation: 妈的！我也是。我做不好。

original: Sorry. I'm moving.
translation: 抱歉，我这就走。

original: I didn't say anything.
translation: 我什么都没说。

original: Get the fuck out of may way.
translation: 滚一边去，别挡我路。

original: Well keep moving.
translation: 给我走开。

original: I'm not looking at anything.
translation: 我什么都没看到。

original: I'm looking at you.
translation: 我看着你呢。

original: Damn, I gotta find some shit.
translation: 见鬼，我得想法子爽一下。

original: I can't help you.
translation: 我帮不了你。

original: You and me both.
translation: 你和我都是。

original: Lying bitch.
translation: 撒谎的婊子。

original: Fuck, I need a fix.
translation: 见鬼，我得过过瘾才行。

original: All I have is Psycho.
translation: 我只有疯狂药。

original: Nope, not for you at least.
translation: 不，至少不给你。

original: Why did you move the Fiends into this Vault?
translation: 你为什么要带恶魔帮进这座避难所？

original: We needed some place to put down some roots. I was having trouble keeping my people out of {outta} Westside.
translation: 我们需要一个地方安营扎寨。以前我的人老是往西区钻，让我很是头疼。

original: I'd hate to kill you over a misunderstanding, but if that's what you want...
translation: 我不喜欢因为误会就对人痛下杀手，但如果你们自己找死的话……

original: [SUCCEEDED] No, no, it's all right. We're just looking out for our own, you understand. We're, uh, sorry to bother you.
translation: [成功] 不，不，算了。我们只是想保护自己，你懂的。我们，呃，很抱歉打扰你。

original: All right, let's get this over with. I've got better things to do.
translation: 好吧，那就动作快点，我还有别的事要做呢。

original: It'll be hard for you to do anything once we break your arms and legs.
translation: 我们要把你的手脚都弄断，让你什么也别想做。

original: Look, all I did was talk to him. It's no big deal.
translation: 听着，我只是和他聊聊天。没什么大不了的。

original: [FAILED] Right. No big deal. We're going to beat the hell out of you now, but don't worry - we don't think it's a big deal, either.
translation: [失败] 当然没什么大不了啦。现在我们打算狠狠揍你一顿，没关系——我们也觉得这没什么大不了的。

original: What do you guys want?
translation: 你们想干什么？

original: We saw you follow the kid in there. Figured we'd teach you a lesson.
translation: 我们看见你在尾随一个孩子。所以我们觉得该给你上一课。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Oh, no you don't. Time to teach you to mess with our people!
translation: 哦，这可不行。我要教教你敢惹我们的人会是什么下场！

original: How long have you been stationed here?
translation: 你在这里驻扎多长时间了？

original: Going on six months, now. But I reckon we'll be moving out, soon enough. Can't talk about the details.
translation: 到现在快六个月了，不过我想很快我们就会转移的。细节不便告诉你。

original: 'Til then, we'll man the towers and keep an eye on the Fiends. We've had more than our share of trouble from their direction.
translation: 在那之前，我们的任务主要还是驻守控制塔，监视附近的恶魔帮。他们造成的麻烦还是相当大的。

original: Whole things smells of Caesar to me. 'Course, that's just guesswork, but I'd still bet a few caps that he's stirring up the locals against us.
translation: 我觉得这整件事情都是凯撒在背后捣鬼。当然，这只是猜测，但我敢打赌，他肯定在暗地里挑唆本地人反对我们。

original: Thanks for the information.
translation: 谢谢你告诉我这些。

original: No trouble at all. Might be nothing. Couple frisky young folks looking for a quiet place to snuggle up.
translation: 没什么。可能啥事都没有。也许只是两个小兔崽子想找个没人的地方打野炮。

original: Then again... that light is mighty consistent. Always there at 1 AM. Might be worth a look.
translation: 不过说起来……那亮光出现得也太频繁了。总是在凌晨一点钟。也许值得调查一番。

original: Have you seen anything suspicious around here?
translation: 这儿附近有什么可疑情况么？

original: As a matter of fact... it's funny that you'd ask. Couple nights back, I was on watch in the yard...
translation: 说实在的……你这么问很有趣。几天前的一个晚上，我在营地里放哨。

original: Got myself a habit of looking all around - not just where I'd expect to find trouble. Old habit, but it's saved my hide, on occasion.
translation: 我有个习惯，就是爱转悠——不光是有可能出事的地方，几乎哪儿都去。老习惯了，但有几次，这招还真救了我的命。

original: Round about one in the morning, I spied some lights in the control tower. Now that's the third time I've spied those lights, mind you.
translation: 大约凌晨一点钟的时候，我发现控制塔里有亮光。那是我第三次发现那儿有亮光，真的。

original: And every time I ask about it, they tell me the place was empty. I'm just saying... it didn't look empty to me.
translation: 可我每次问起来，他们都说那里根本没人。要我说……那儿肯定有人。

original: Interesting rifle you have there. Lever-action, right?
translation: 你这把来复枪挺不错的啊。是杠杆枪机，对吧？

original: I call her La Longue Carabine. Didn't always have the scope - I added that myself.
translation: 我叫她长舌卡宾枪。以前没有固定瞄准镜，这是我自己加上的。

original: Been shooting with her so long... couldn't bring myself to toss her away. Would have felt guilty to part with the old girl.
translation: 这个老姑娘跟了我很长时间……一直都舍不得扔。要是和她分开，我会很内疚的。

original: The other snipers use bolt-action, but Gorobets reckoned it didn't matter none if I was different, so long as I can hit my targets.
translation: 其他狙击手都用弹簧枪，可格罗别茨认为，只要我能打中目标，与众不同一点也没关系。

original: How did you manage to escape Malpais?
translation: 你是怎么逃出马尔佩斯的？

original: Caesar's boys figured I wasn't going anywhere, after what they done to me. So they didn't bother tying me up.
translation: 我受了那样的酷刑，凯撒的人以为我哪也去不了，干脆也不来绑我了。

original: I crawled out of there on my elbows and knees. Must have looked a sight. Then I rolled down an embankment into the Colorado.
translation: 我是靠着手肘和膝盖一路爬出去的。样子肯定狼狈极了，我顺着山坡一路滚到了科罗拉多河边。

original: Guess I had a mind to drown, rather than give Caesar's boys the satisfaction of killing me.
translation: 记得那时我都打算跳河自杀了，我宁可这样死，也不愿再被凯撒手下的那群混蛋肆意糟蹋。

original: But a couple Rangers happened to be watching from across the river. They jumped on in and pulled me out of there. Lucky break, they said.
translation: 可刚好有几个游骑兵就在河对岸。他们跳进河里把我捞了起来。事后他们说我真是福大命大。

original: Why did you leave the Rangers?
translation: 你为什么不干游骑兵了？

original: Well... that wasn't really a matter of choice. Got myself caught by Legionnaires, up near Malpais.
translation: 唉……我也不是自愿放弃的啊。我在马尔佩斯附近被军团的人俘虏了。

original: They had themselves some fun with me... mangled my hands and feet pretty good.
translation: 他们折磨我，拿我取乐……弄断了我的手脚。

original: Wasn't much good with a pistol after that. Wasn't gonna be trekking across the waste on any more long scouts, either.
translation: 从那以后，我连手枪都握不牢了。更没办法长途跋涉做侦察了。

original: Have you always been with the First Recon?
translation: 你一直都在第一侦察营服役吗？

original: Used to be a Ranger... one of the first they sent out east, back before we took the Dam. Observation and reconnaissance.
translation: 我原来是游骑兵……属于最早被派去东部的那一批，那时我们还没拿下大坝。我们主要负责侦察，还有通讯。

original: We took the lay of the land, checked out the locals, and kept ourselves inconspicuous. Couple friends of mine were the first to scout the Dam.
translation: 观察地形，了解当地人的生活，并且保持低调。第一批被派去侦察大坝的人当中，就有一些是我的老战友。

original: That was back in '73, if I recall. Lot of those Rangers are dead now.
translation: 说起来，那都是73年的事啦。很多当年的游骑兵今天都已经不在了。

original: Vegas always chewed men up... it's just a little more literal, nowadays.
translation: 维加斯就像一台绞肉机……现如今这句话是更形象了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Mighty pleased to meet you. Maybe I'll see you again, before we move out.
translation: 非常高兴能见到你，也许我们出发前会再见。

original: Always a pleasure. You keep yourself safe.
translation: 不胜荣幸，在外小心点。

original: It's true. I've got a memorable face.
translation: 没错，因为我这张美丽的面孔实在太好记了。

original: You're a fine-looking woman, no doubt about that. But I'm looking a little deeper than the skin, if you take my meaning.
translation: 你是个很漂亮的女人，毫无疑问。可我并不止在乎外表，希望你明白我的意思。

original: Not so long ago, I spent more than my share of time lookin' for memorable folk like yourself. Did a lot of scoutin' around these parts.
translation: 不久前，我就花了很大力气，去寻找一个和你一样生了一张难忘面孔的人。我在这片地方干侦察好多年了。

original: You remember everyone who passes through here?
translation: 你记得每一个经过这里的人？

original: Got a good memory for faces. Landmarks and such, too. Comes with practice, that's all. And a lot of scoutin' from place to place.
translation: 我很会记人脸，地标也一样，没什么了不起的。都是熟能生巧练出来的，毕竟常年四处跑侦察。

original: I reckon I've walked every inch of ground between Shady Sands and the Colorado... or close enough to make a man's feet plenty sore.
translation: 我几乎踏遍了沙荫镇和科罗拉多之间的每一寸土地……也许没那么多，但也快把我的腿给累断了。

original: Good for you.
translation: 对你有好处。

original: That's noble of you.
translation: 您真是品德高尚。

original: I only do what I can to help.
translation: 我也只是做些力所能及的事。

original: Can you heal me?
translation: 你能治好我吗？

original: I would be happy to, should you require it. You seem to be in fine health now.
translation: 只要你有需要，我很乐意帮忙。不过看样子你现在的状态挺好的。

original: I would be happy to. What I can do isn't much, but I give it freely.
translation: 乐意效劳。虽然我会的并不多，但我从不收钱。

original: I'm afraid I have exhausted my supplies. If you come back in a day or two, I may be able to do more for you.
translation: 恐怕我的医疗用品已经用完了。如果你能过一两天再来，我应该能为你提供更好的服务。

original: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

original: Please, hurry!
translation: 请快点！

original: Dead as a doornail. Shouldn't have left her in the desert, Frankie.
translation: 已经死透了。你不该把她丢在沙漠里的，弗兰克。

original: I'm sorry. She didn't make it.
translation: 对不起，你妻子没挺过来。

original: Oh. Oh, I see. Well... thank you for saving my children, at least.
translation: 哦。我知道了。好吧…谢谢你至少救了我的孩子们。

original: Where did they go?
translation: 他们去了哪里？

original: <Honest Option>
translation: <诚实的选项>

original: Oh God no! I haven't been the best father, but I didn't deserve this!
translation: 哦，上帝啊，不！虽然我不是一个称职的父亲，但我也不该受到这样的惩罚！

original: Yes. They're all dead.
translation: 是的。他们都死了。

original: They are? Oh my God, thank you! Thank you so much!
translation: 是吗？哦，我的天啊，谢谢你！太感谢你了。

original: But wait, where are they?
translation: 等一下，他们现在在哪？

original: Yes. They're all alive.
translation: 是的。他们都还活着。

original: Oh, thank you! Thank you!
translation: 哦，谢谢你！太谢谢你了！

original: But wait, what about my wife?
translation: 等等，我妻子怎么样了？

original: Your children are alive.
translation: 你的孩子们还活着。

original: Oh. Oh, I see. Well... thank you for saving her, at least.
translation: 哦。我知道了。好吧……谢谢你至少救了她。

original: But wait, where is she?
translation: 等等，她在哪里？

original: Your children are dead, but your wife made it.
translation: 你的孩子们都死了，不过你的妻子还活着。

original: Oh. Oh, I see. Well... thank you for saving the rest, at least.
translation: 哦。我知道了。好吧……谢谢你至少救下了其他人。

original: But wait, where are they?
translation: 等等，他们在哪？

original: Your wife and one of the children made it out alive.
translation: 你的妻子和一个孩子存活了下来。

original: Oh. Oh, I see. Well... thank you for saving one of them, at least.
translation: 哦。我知道了。好吧……谢谢你至少救了他们中的一个人。

original: But wait, where is my child?
translation: 等等，我的孩子在哪？

original: Your wife and one of your children are dead.
translation: 很不幸，你的妻子和一个孩子死了。

original: They would have killed you if you fought. Maybe I can help you find them.
translation: 如果你敢反抗，他们会杀死你的。也许我可以帮你找到他们。

original: Wait a minute - why didn't they take you, too?
translation: 等一下，他们为什么不把你也一起带走？

original: I... God help me, I ran! I abandoned my family to those butchers. Not a day goes by I don't hate myself for that.
translation: 我……上帝救了我，我逃掉了！我把家人丢给了那些刽子手。从那之后，我没有一天不是在悔恨中度过的。

original: I'm so sorry. Can I help?
translation: 真是对不起。我能帮你吗？

original: You'd do that for a complete stranger? Thank you, friend. The army says they don't have the available manpower - as if this city is more important.
translation: 你愿为一个陌生人做这些？谢谢你，朋友。军队说他们腾不出人手，好像这座城市比人命还重要似的。

original: From what I've gathered from NCR rangers, they were most likely taken to Cottonwood Cove. You might start there.
translation: 我从NCR游骑兵那儿打听到了一点消息，他们最有可能被带到了棉白杨湾。你可以从那里开始找。

original: Wow, some protector you turned out to be.
translation: 喔，就这样也算得上监护人啊。

original: Go ahead, mock me. Nothing you say can be worse than my own shame.
translation: 来吧，嘲笑我吧。无论你说什么，都比不上我自己的良心谴责。

original: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

original: Get it done.
translation: 把事情做完。

original: The guy claiming to stand in for Price is dead.
translation: 那个家伙声称是普莱斯的代理人，他死了。

original: Good to hear.
translation: 很好。

original: Well, I'd say you're officially invited to the big kids' table now. My stash is your stash.
translation: 好吧，要我说，你现在就算正式入伙了。从今往后，我的货就是你的货。

original: Oh, and I think you might get more use out of this rifle than I ever will. Enjoy.
translation: 哦，还有，我觉得这支来复枪让你来用也许更合适，请笑纳。

original: I convinced the Ranger to work with you.  You're safe, but be careful.
translation: 我已经说服那个游骑兵和你合作了。你安全了，不过要小心。

original: Price wasn't there.  I fought some guy claiming to be his replacement.
translation: 普莱斯不在。有个自称是他代理人的家伙，我和他干了一架。

original: Well, it sounds like you screwed the pooch. Give me the package back.
translation: 好吧，看来这桩生意是砸了。把包裹还给我。

original: Price works alone. If someone has replaced him, it's either some scumbag trying to hijack goods from his suppliers, or worse...
translation: 普莱斯一直是单干的，如果有人代替了他，那说明要么有混蛋想劫他的货，要么更糟……

original: It could be someone more dangerous. You need to kill him, whoever he is.
translation: 那家伙也许来头不小。无论他是谁，你都必须干掉他。

original: Some guy is standing in for Price.  I didn't inquire further.
translation: 有个人替代了普莱斯，我没有细问。

original: Huh. Not good. Price works alone. Chat him up and see what's going on.
translation: 啊，这可不妙，普莱斯向来是单干的。和他谈谈，搞清楚到底发生了什么事。

original: Don't give him any details and do {emph}not give him the package. There's a chance he actually knows Price, but I doubt it.
translation: 不要向他透露任何内情，另外{emph}别给他包裹。他可能只是碰巧认识普莱斯，但我对此深表怀疑。

original: You had your chance.
translation: 已经给过你机会了。

original: That's it.
translation: 到此为止。

original: Go on through, soldier.
translation: 可以过去了，士兵。

original: Go right ahead, trooper.
translation: 进去吧，士兵。

original: Hold it. NCR only beyond this point. Keep your distance or I {emph}will fire.
translation: 站住。这里禁止NCR以外的人员进入。再靠近我就开枪了。

original: Sorry. No civilians on the monorail. Any closer and I am authorized to use deadly force.
translation: 抱歉。平民不能进入车站。如果你继续靠近，我有权使用武力。

original: You sure know how to make a girl feel welcome.
translation: 你确实很懂得用花言巧语来讨人喜欢。

original: Just needed to make the situation clear is all. How can I help you?
translation: 只是为了把情况说得清楚些罢了。有什么能帮您的吗？

original: In the right hands, it could do a lot of good. I'll see it gets there.
translation: 只要交给好人，它一定能发挥大作用的。我保证。

original: I suppose you've given me no reason not to trust you. Fine, take the data and go. I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 看来我没什么理由不信任你了。好吧，拿着资料快走吧。你最好明白自己在做什么。

original: Do you know how many caps I can get for it?
translation: 你知道我能靠它们赚多少瓶盖嘛？

original: Ah, I should have known. Well, in that case...
translation: 噢，我早就该知道的。既然如此……

original: That data is valuable to me.
translation: 那些资料对我有用。

original: What do you mean?
translation: 你是什么意思？

original: Why is the door to the entrance locked?
translation: 为什么通往入口的门被锁住了？

original: Are you kidding me? This place is under quarantine! We can't let a single spore get out of this place if we can help it.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？这里必须被隔离！我们绝对不能让孢子跑到外面去。

original: What were you doing down in that cave?
translation: 你当时在那个洞里干什么呢？

original: The mantises and spore plants virtually ignored me for most of the time that I've been here.
translation: 我踏入避难所后，那些螳螂和孢子植物多数时候都无视我。

original: It was only once I began to investigate the fifth level that my presence began to agitate them. I guess I was a little too close to home for them.
translation: 但是当我开始调查第五层时，我似乎刺激到了它们。我猜可能是因为我离它们的巢穴太近了。

original: A few days ago, I was attacked by a large number of mantises and was knocked unconscious. When I woke up, I was in that cave.
translation: 几天之前，我被一大群螳螂攻击，失去了知觉。当我醒来的时候，就躺在那个洞里了。

original: The mantises seem to feed some of their prey to the plants. Fortunately for me, it appears the plants are disinclined to eat ghoul meat.
translation: 那些螳螂似乎会给孢子植物喂食猎物。不过我挺走运，那些植物好像不愿意吃尸鬼肉。

original: What happened to the scientists, then?
translation: 那些科学家们后来都怎么样了？

original: Something prevented them from igniting the gas, obviously. I suppose it's possible that the gas triggered some kind of defensive reaction.
translation: 显然他们没有成功引燃瓦斯。我想大概是因为瓦斯引发了孢子生物的某种自我防御机制。

original: Hordes of previously slumbering creatures may have awoken and entered a killing frenzy, ripping the hapless scientists into quivering, bloody chunks.
translation: 成群的生物有可能瞬间被唤醒，陷入狂暴，把那些倒霉的科学家撕成了血肉模糊的碎片。

original: You'll have to let me know when you get back from going downstairs.
translation: 你从楼下回来的时候一定要告诉我一声。

original: How did you get this whole gas thing set up so quickly?
translation: 你是怎么这么快把瓦斯充满整个楼层的？

original: That's a very good question! Actually, I didn't come up with it. The systems were already set up to pump the gas when I first arrived here.
translation: 问得好！其实不是我弄的。我刚到这里的时候，空气循环系统就已经在排放瓦斯了。

original: I believe the scientists were in the process of attempting to ignite the gas just as we're about to do. And by we, I mean you, of course.
translation: 看来这些科学家在我们来之前就已经要准备点燃瓦斯了。当然，现在这任务就交给你了。

original: Where did these plants come from?
translation: 这些植物都从哪里来的？

original: From what I've been able to determine, the scientists here managed to breed them by combining traits from two distinct plant species.
translation: 根据我的推断，它们由这里的科学家通过杂交两个不同的品种，综合它们的特性制造而成。

original: The resulting hybrid proved more adaptable than expected, however, and soon became a threat to humans.
translation: 但是，培育出来的杂交种的适应性远超预期，很快就对人类产生了威胁。

original: It's sad, really. All those wonderful minds, undone by their own irresponsibility.
translation: 真是悲哀。这些无比聪明的人最终被自己的轻率给毁灭了。

original: No way. I'm not going to torch myself for your amusement.
translation: 没门。我才不会为了你把自己烧成黑炭呢。

original: It would be pretty funny, wouldn't it? Oh, don't look at me that way. I'm sure you'll be fine.
translation: 会很好玩，对吧？哦，别那么看着我，我保证你不会有事的。

original: And?
translation: 然后？

original: What? Do I have to figure everything out for you? Fine, let me think for a second.
translation: 什么？什么事都得我来干？好吧，让我再考虑考虑。

original: Blast?
translation: 爆炸？

original: Yes, there'll be an explosion when the gas is ignited. But I'm sure you'll be fine. Now leave me to my work.
translation: 是啊，瓦斯一经引燃就会立刻发生爆炸。但我相信你肯定没事的。你走吧，我还有活儿要干。

original: How am I supposed to survive that?
translation: 那我该怎么躲过去呢？

original: That does pose a problem, doesn't it?
translation: 这的确是个问题，对不对？

original: If you could seal yourself inside a room before the explosion went off, you might be protected from the blast.
translation: 如果你可以在引爆前躲进一个密闭的屋子，应该就不会被炸到了。

original: Then again, the flames will probably blow into the rooms down there. Maybe if there were a room that was reinforced...
translation: 不过，火焰弄不好会冲进那房间。如果能找一个加固过的房间是最好不过……

original: Well, I'm sure you'll figure something out.
translation: 嗯，我相信你会有办法的。

original: Did you say there'd be a blast?
translation: 你刚才是不是说——会引起爆炸？

original: Oh yes, I imagine there'll be quite an explosion when the gas gets set off. Fire will probably expand throughout the entire level in mere moments.
translation: 是的，我想瓦斯引燃之后应该会发生不小的爆炸。火焰可能会迅速蔓延到整个楼层。

original: How exactly should I ignite the gas?
translation: 具体一点儿，我应该怎么引燃那些气体？

original: In the area where the gas is active, any kind of fire or explosion should do the trick. Hell, even lasers would do the job.
translation: 在有瓦斯气流动的地方，点个火花就可以。用激光都行。

original: If you don't have anything like that, I've got some grenades in my bag in the corner that you can use.
translation: 如果你什么都没有，我放在角落的背包里有几颗手雷，你可以拿去用。

original: No questions right now. I'll be going.
translation: 没别的问题了。我得走了。

original: Well in that case, leave me to my work.
translation: 那好，我回去接着工作了。

original: Get your rifles and move out, First Recon. We've got a Fiend to kill.
translation: 拿好枪准备出发，第一侦察营。有个恶魔帮正等着我们去消灭。

original: Fascinating. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 太棒了。我们聊点儿别的吧。

original: Sure thing. Careful, though. I'll talk your ear off.
translation: 当然可以。不过你可得留神咯，我能聊到你耳朵长茧。

original: Never mind, I was mistaken.
translation: 别介意，我搞错了。

original: Aww.
translation: 噢。

original: [Attack] The bad news is I'm here to relieve you of your life.
translation: [攻击] 坏消息是，我解放你的方式是要彻底消灭你。

original: What- What are you doing?
translation: 你——你要干什么？

original: Good news, private. I'm here to relieve you.
translation: 好消息，列兵。我是来解放你的。

original: Really? That's great. I was getting so sick of this.
translation: 真的？太好了。我干这活儿都干得有点恶心了。

original: [Attack] I'm going to get you in trouble for blowing up the monorail.
translation: [攻击] 我要让你成为列车被炸毁的替罪羊。

original: What? Like hell you are.
translation: 什么？说什么鬼话呢。

original: <Pull Pin>I just pulled the pin out of somebody's grenade.
translation: <拉开保险栓> 我刚才拉开了某人的手雷保险栓。

original: Man, I can't wait to see the look on his face!
translation: 天啊，老兄，我简直等不及要看那人的表情了！

original: That's great because I'm in the middle of pulling a prank right now.
translation: 真是太棒了，其实我现在也在搞恶作剧。

original: No kidding! What'd you cook up?
translation: 真的吗！你打算做什么？

original: What kinds of pranks have you pulled?
translation: 你都搞过些什么恶作剧？

original: Aw, usual stuff. Brought a brahmin upstairs in the terminal once. They can go upstairs but not down. Two heads and both of 'em dumb as stumps.
translation: 噢，也没什么特别的。有一次我把一只双头牛赶到了候机厅的二楼。它虽然会上楼但不会下楼。两个头都像树桩一样蠢。

original: That got me some detention time, but it was worth it 'cause they couldn't get the brahmin back down, so it visited me a few times in my cell.
translation: 那次我被关了几天禁闭，但我觉得值了。他们没法把牛赶下楼，所以那头牛还来禁闭室看望了我几次。

original: Dropped some firecrackers in the toilets too. That was the real bad one for me.
translation: 还有一次我把几串鞭炮丢进了马桶里。那次可真的是闹大了。

original: Turns out there's no way to replace the toilets now. Toilet company blew up in the War. I think they'd just have shot me if they weren't shorthanded.
translation: 因为现在已经没办法换马桶了。马桶公司早在核战中炸没了。我想如果不是他们人手不足，估计早就一枪把我给崩了。

original: I've heard you're kind of a prankster.
translation: 我听说你是个捣蛋鬼。

original: Heh. My reputation precedes me, I see. Yeah I pulled a few pranks in my time.
translation: 嘿。看来我名声在外啊。是的，我有时就爱开点小玩笑。

original: Where is Private Crenshaw's footlocker?
translation: 列兵克伦肖的脚柜在什么地方？

original: It's in the main concourse. That's the building just across the skybridge. There's a barracks area that'll be behind you on the left when you enter.
translation: 在主厅。过了天桥后看到的那栋建筑就是了。进去以后，你的左后方就是营区。

original: His stuff will be at the foot of one of the beds.
translation: 他的东西应该就放在床脚边。

original: Where can I find Private Crenshaw again?
translation: 再问一下，我在哪能找到列兵克伦肖？

original: He's stationed just inside the south wall of the base. Should be on patrol, if he isn't screwing around.
translation: 他就在基地这一侧的南墙下站岗。如果他没去别处鬼混的话，应该正在巡逻。

original: All right, you can stop for a sec.
translation: 好吧，你先休息一下。

original: You don't really mean what you said about your parents, do you?
translation: 关于你父母的那些话，你不是认真的把？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All right. Goodbye.
translation: 好的。再见。

original: Never mind. Forget I mentioned it.
translation: 别介意。就当我没提过。

original: Okay. I will. Guess that's something I'd rather not talk about, that's all.
translation: 好的。看来这件事我还是不提比较好，就这样吧。

original: I really don't know. Come on, Sergeant, you can tell me.
translation: 我真的不知道。来吧，中士，跟我说说吧。

original: [FAILED] No. What's it matter to you? Why's everybody care so much about other people's business?
translation: [失败] 不。这和你有什么关系？为什么每个人都这么喜欢打听别人的私事呢？

original: Just leave it lie. And leave me be.
translation: 少多管闲事了。也别再来烦我。

original: You're not telling me something. You couldn't have forgotten the whole massacre.
translation: 你说的这些都没用。你不可能把整个屠杀的经过全都忘了吧。

original: It's like I tell Major Dhatri. Best not look under a rock, if you don't really want to know what's there.
translation: 就像我跟达特里少校说的，如果你不想知道石头下面有什么，那最好就不要掀开它。

original: Could be that NCR found some blood on me, and none of it mine. Could be that a few of those Khans didn't die from NCR bullets.
translation: 也许，当时NCR发现我身上血迹斑斑，但那些都不是我的血。也许有些大汗帮的人并没有被NCR的子弹直接打死。

original: I had scores of my own to settle... deeper ones than NCR ever had. Don't bother asking who they were with.
translation: 当时，我自己也有一笔帐要算……那是比NCR还要重的血海深仇。你也别费力去问他们当时站在哪一边了。

original: How did you survive the massacre?
translation: 你是怎么躲过大屠杀的？

original: Guess I could tell a pretty good story, if I had a mind. But the truth is, I don't know. Just got lucky.
translation: 如果我花点功夫，可以给你讲得天花乱坠。但实际情况是，我根本就不知道。走运而已。

original: They brought me to Dhatri after the battle. He was just a Captain, back then. Guess he saw something in me... knew I didn't belong with the Khans.
translation: 战斗结束后，他们就带我去见了达特里。那时他还是上尉。可能他在我身上看到了某种潜力……他知道我和大汗帮不是一路人。

original: Maybe he felt bad, too. About how his men killed my folks. I told him he did me a service, but he didn't believe me. Still doesn't.
translation: 也可能，他对于自己手下残杀我族人的事情感到很内疚。我告诉他，他是我的恩人，但他不相信。到现在也还是不信。

original: He's a good man, Dhatri. Doesn't act like it sometimes, I know. But he didn't have to take me in.
translation: 达特里是个好人。虽然我知道有时他表现得并不像个好人。但他当时根本没必要收留我。

original: So your name... it comes from Bitter Springs.
translation: 所以你的名字……是源自苦泉。

original: In the Khans, you're not fully grown 'til you've taken a beat-down. Everybody gathers round and hits you until you're damn near dead.
translation: 大汗帮里有个规矩，只有经历过一顿杀威拳，你才算长大成人。也就是所有人把你围在中间，将你揍个半死。

original: After that - if you haven't begged for mercy - you get to choose a new name. One you'll use for the rest of your life.
translation: 在那之后，如果你还没求饶，你就有资格挑选一个新名字。这个名字将会陪伴你终身。

original: When NCR slaughtered the Khans at Bitter Springs, I hadn't got my beat-down yet. I was still too young.
translation: 当NCR血洗苦泉的大汗帮时，我还没接受过杀威拳的洗礼。我当时太小了。

original: Way I see it, Bitter Springs was my beat-down. So afterward... I gave myself a name. It's all I've got from the Khans, and it's all I ever want.
translation: 在我看来，苦泉事件就是我的成人礼。后来……我就给自己取了这个名字。这就是大汗帮所给我的一切，也正是我一直想要的。

original: You don't really mean that, do you?
translation: 你在开玩笑吧？

original: Don't I? Mister, you never met my parents.
translation: 是吗？见谅，先生，你是从来没见过我的父母。

original: Don't I? Beg pardon, ma'am, but you never met my parents.
translation: 是么？见谅，女士，你是从来没见过我的父母。

original: My dad, he got himself fucked up, every chance he got. Always started with folk for no reason.
translation: 我老爹，他动不动就会给自己招来一顿胖揍。总是毫无理由就和别人干架。

original: Hell, he was the one who taught me to shoot. You know how? By taking potshots at NCR. And not just soldiers. Civilians, too. Even kids.
translation: 该死，我打枪的本领还是他教的。你知道他怎么教的吗？朝NCR的人胡乱扫射。不光是士兵，还有平民，甚至孩子。

original: Then he'd get high with his buddies and swap tales about the folk they killed. Bunch of animals.
translation: 然后他就会和他那帮狐朋狗友一起嗑药，一边吹嘘自己是如何杀人的。一群畜生。

original: And my mom... couple times she tried to sell me to some waster, just to score some Jet. Even the other Khans said she was useless.
translation: 而我母亲……好几次差点把我卖给游民，就为了换几根杰特。连大汗帮里的人都说她是个废物。

original: Only reason they kept her around was because she was a... how'd my dad say it... "a smokin' piece of ass."
translation: 他们之所以没把她赶走，是因为她是个……我老爹怎么说来着……"一个会抽烟的逼。"

original: Losing your parents must have been hard for you. I'm sorry.
translation: 失去父母一定对你打击很大。我很抱歉。

original: You're sorry? Well, that makes one of us. Bitter Springs was the best thing that ever happened to me.
translation: 你很抱歉？那你自己抱歉去吧。对我来说，这辈子没有比苦泉那件事更让我痛快的了。

original: Best thing that ever happened to my parents, too. They were as bad as the rest. Worse, maybe.
translation: 我父母活该落得这种下场。他们跟其他人一样坏。甚至更坏。

original: I've heard enough. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我听够了。让我们来谈谈别的吧。

original: Yeah. That's probably best.
translation: 是的。这样也好。

original: Tell me about happened to them at Bitter Springs.
translation: 和我说说当时苦泉的情况吧。

original: It was massacre. That's what a lot of NCR folk will tell you. Most of them feel plenty bad about what happened.
translation: 大屠杀。很多NCR的人都会这么告诉你。大部分人对于当时发生的一切都难以释怀。

original: But I was there. Saw it myself. I don't care what anybody says. The Khans asked for Bitter Springs. They wouldn't leave the NCR be.
translation: 但我那天也在现场。我亲眼目睹了整个经过。我不在乎别人说什么，苦泉的事就是大汗帮自找的。谁叫他们不让NCR安生。

original: My damn parents, too. They were just as bad as the rest.
translation: 我那该死的父母也是。他们跟其他人一样坏。

original: What do you know about the Great Khans?
translation: 你认为大汗帮怎么样？

original: They're scum. Lazy, trumped-up Raiders. Most of the time, they're drunk or high, and when they're not shooting chems, they're selling them.
translation: 一群人渣。懒惰，自以为是，穷凶极恶。他们多数时候不是喝高，就是犯毒瘾；等不嗑药的时候，他们又会把药卖给别人。

original: Used to have a settlement up at Bitter Springs, 'til they pissed off NCR and got slaughtered for their trouble.
translation: 本来他们在苦泉还有个窝，谁知后来他们惹恼了NCR，结果遭到了屠杀。

original: Lot of us got killed at Bitter Springs. Lot of them, I mean. My parents died, too.
translation: 我们很多人都死在了苦泉。我是说，“他们”很多人。我的父母也死了。

original: What happened to your parents?
translation: 你的父母怎么了？

original: They're dead. Got themselves killed at Bitter Springs. Served them right, if you ask me.
translation: 他们死了。死在了苦泉。要我说，他们是罪有应得。

original: I didn't mean to offend. You don't have to tell me, if you'd rather not.
translation: 我无意冒犯。如果你不愿意告诉我也无妨。

original: [SUCCEEDED] It's a Khan name. You know... the "Great Khans." That's what my parents were.
translation: [成功] 这是大汗帮的名字。你知道……就是那个"大汗帮。"我父母都是大汗帮的人。

original: I figured I grew up around the bastards... they owed me a name, after all they put me through.
translation: 我是和一帮王八羔子一起长大的……他们让我受了这么多苦，多少欠我一个名字。

original: Bitter-Root. You have an unusual name.
translation: 苦根。你有一个很不寻常的名字。

original: You trying to start trouble? Or do you really not know where I got that name?
translation: 你是来找茬的吗？还是说你真的不知道我这个名字从哪儿来的？

original: How long have you been with the First Recon?
translation: 你在第一侦察营呆了多长时间了？

original: A while, I guess. I don't keep too careful track of time.
translation: 我猜有一阵子了吧。我不太擅长记日子。

original: I like to keep things simple. Just focus on now. That's why they made me a sniper.
translation: 我喜欢简洁明了。注重当下。正因为这样，他们才让我做狙击手。

original: You let your mind wander back a ways, and you lose sight of what's in front of your eyes. Good way to miss a mark.
translation: 如果你的思绪总是游离于过去，那你就无法专注于眼前的事物了，又怎能盯紧目标呢。

original: Your father is your commanding officer? Is that allowed?
translation: 你们的指挥官是你父亲？这种事符合规定？

original: Yeah, look... he's not my real father. He just looked after me, for a while.
translation: 是的，其实……他不是我亲生父亲。他只是照顾了我一段时间。

original: It's a long story. And I'd get tired of talking before it was through.
translation: 这件事可说来话长。我是没耐心全部讲完。

original: It's like I told you. Dhatri's not my real father. He just looked after me for a while.
translation: 我好像跟你说过。达特里不是我的亲生父亲。他只是照顾了我一段时间。

original: Where can I find some work around here?
translation: 这附近能找到什么活干么？

original: You a merc? Then I guess you'd want to talk to my, uh... father. Major Dhatri. He's our CO.
translation: 你是个佣兵？那我觉得你应该去找我……呃……父亲。达特里少校。他是我们的指挥官。

original: Not too friendly, are you?
translation: 你好像不太友好啊。

original: Guess not. I don't mean nothing by it.
translation: 是有点。我没有别的意思。

original: You really want to talk to somebody, try 10 of Spades. He's always got plenty to say.
translation: 你想和人聊天，去找黑桃十吧。他总是很有话说。

original: Me, I'm here to do my job. For now, that job is shootin' Fiends.
translation: 我呢，只是来执行任务的。就目前来说，我的任务是干死那些恶魔帮。

original: {10 of Spades dead}10 of Spades always had plenty to say, before he got himself killed. Me, I'm just here to do my job.
translation: {黑桃十死了}黑桃十还在的时候，总是都很喜欢和人说话。而我，只是来执行任务的。

original: I don't really agree with you, but I'm not interested in moving drugs for you.
translation: 我不是很赞成你的想法，我也没兴趣去帮你运送毒品。

original: Fine, piss off then. I thought we had a good thing going here, but it looks like you're just a goody-goody.
translation: 好啊，那就滚蛋吧。本来我还以为咱俩能合作愉快呢，没想到你却要充好人。

original: Yeah, I agree about the alcohol.
translation: 是的，酒精那段我同意。

original: The law is the law.  I'm done doing business with you.
translation: 犯法就是犯法，我和你的关系结束了。

original: Now see, that's just downright unfriendly of you. I can't just let you go shooting your mouth off to Boyd now can I?
translation: 瞧瞧，你翻脸比翻书还快。我怎么能就这样放你去找博伊德告状呢？

original: Lying bastard.  I want cut in on this action.
translation: 你说谎。我要你给我提成。

original: You're one pushy son of a bitch, I'll give you that. Alright, here are some caps to keep your mouth shut.
translation: 我必须承认，你这个王八蛋还挺会讹人的。好吧，这些钱你拿去，给我把嘴闭上。

original: There is a lot of money to be made, and I'm not afraid to share it with reliable folks. Just keep the busters out of this and we're good.
translation: 发财的机会多得是，我也不在乎分一点给可靠的人。只要不会有人来坏我的事，咱们就算合作愉快。

original: So you've got the package then? I need to get that sorted and then sent off in a few days.
translation: 所以，包裹还在你身上吗？我得把它整理一下，过几天再找人送走。

original: Bullshit.  If you're moving drugs, I'm going to have to report you.
translation: 放屁，如果你偷运毒品，我就举报你。

original: Whoa there, kiddo. No need to blow things out of proportion. I'm just selling certain ingredients on the side, not chems.
translation: 哇，小不点儿，别这么大惊小怪。我只是兼职卖点原料，又不是致瘾药物。

original: Besides, it's not like drugs are a big deal. Alcohol is just as bad yet it is perfectly legal in the NCR. I'm just a businessman doing business.
translation: 再说了，毒品又没什么大不了的。酒精的害处也不小啊，但在NCR却是完全合法的。我只是想多做点生意罢了。

original: All right.  I guess I believe you.
translation: 好吧，我相信你了。

original: Good. Does that mean you have those supplies?
translation: 很好。那么你拿到物资了吗？

original: Hey, these medical supplies look like chem ingredients.
translation: 嘿，这些医用品看起来像用来做毒品的原料啊。

original: Really? I never noticed that. I'm just following orders here, moving supplies as needed.
translation: 真的吗？我没注意到。我只是服从命令，按要求运送货物罢了。

original: The tram is about to depart. Please keep clear of the doors, and restrain any young children.
translation: 列车即将出站。请不要靠近车门，并看管好您的孩子。

original: You're getting too close, shamus!
translation: 你知道得太多了，奸贼！

original: This is where your trail runs cold.
translation: 你的调查到此为止了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Hey, yeah. Next time you see me, maybe I'll be rolling in a shitload of caps, right?
translation: 哼，是啊。也许下次你再见到我的时候，我就在一大堆瓶盖上乱滚了，你说呢？

original: You've worked a lot of different trades?
translation: 你曾经做过很多份工作吗？

original: Oh, yeah. A lot. Like, before I was a bounty hunter, I worked as a caravan guard. You'd think that was a cakewalk, right? Wrong.
translation: 哦，是啊，很多。比如，在当赏金猎人前，我曾做过商队保镖。你会想，那肯定小菜一碟，对吗？大错特错。

original: Crazy bastards expected me to wake up at dawn. Forget it. That's about two hours after this guy hits the sack.
translation: 那群该死的奸商天还没亮居然就喊我起来。算了吧。我才刚躺下去两小时不到。

original: And I need at least ten, twelve hours of sleep to do my job. Price of excellence.
translation: 至少也要给我十到十二个小时的睡眠，才能保证工作效率。这是起码的啊。

original: How long have you been a bounty hunter?
translation: 你做赏金猎人多久了？

original: Oh, shit, I don't know.  Got to be at least a month. Longer than I last at most jobs.
translation: 哦，见鬼，我忘了。起码有一个月了吧。比我以前干的那些工作要久多了。

original: What are you going to do now?
translation: 你现在有什么打算？

original: Simple. I'm going to make myself some easy money. I got a plan.
translation: 很简单。我想赚点轻松钱。我有个想法。

original: Once I get my caps from Dhatri, I'm going to head on over to Gomorrah and win big at cards.
translation: 等我从达特里那儿拿到了钱，我就一头扎进蛾摩拉，赌一把大的。

original: There's not as many people playing at Gomorrah, so that means I've got better odds of winning big. I got this figured out.
translation: 蛾摩拉没多少人去，所以我赢钱的机会就大了。这办法可是我老半天才想出来的。

original: No. Never heard of them.
translation: 没有，从没听说。

original: 'Course you didn't. 'Cause they crossed paths with Little Buster. Bam! Dead, finished, over.
translation: 那就对了。因为他们碰上了我！嘣！完蛋，死翘翘，嗝儿屁了。

original: I take it they were Fiends?
translation: 他们都是恶魔帮的？

original: Damn right they were. And they were good, too. 'Til I popped a couple shells in their assholes. Bam! Dead, finished, over.
translation: 说对了。而且都很厉害，可惜我只用一梭子就送他们上了西天。嘣！玩完，死翘翘，嗝儿屁了。

original: See, somebody gives me a job, I do it. Maybe I complain a little, here and there, but my shit gets done.
translation: 你看，有人给我活，我就接。可能我会有点抱怨，这儿啊那儿的，但我绝对能把活干完。

original: Why does Dhatri owe you caps?
translation: 达特里为何欠你钱？

original: Because I killed a couple marks for him, that's why. You ever hear of Jackson? Or Night Terror?
translation: 因为我为他杀了一大批通缉犯，却还是两手空空。你听说过杰克逊吗？或是夜魔？

original: Major Dhatri said I should ask you about Cook-Cook.
translation: 达特里少校说我可以找你问问有关大厨库克的事情。

original: The rapist with the flamethrower? Yeah, that's a combination I stay the fuck away from.
translation: 那个背着喷火器的变态强奸犯？是的，碰到这种变态，我只希望能躲得远远的。

original: I was stalking him for a while. I'm real good at that. Watching people from where they can't see me, you know?
translation: 我跟踪他有一段时间了。我擅长跟踪，专门躲在暗处监视他人的一举一动，你懂吗？

original: Only one thing I learned about that asshole. He keeps a bunch of Brahmins. Most of them he roasts whenever he feels like it, but there's one...
translation: 我只发现了一件事。那个混蛋养了一群双头牛。大多数都被他烤熟吃掉了，可有一头……

original: ...must be his pet, or some shit. Doesn't let anybody near that Brahmin. Somebody puts a bullet in her, I bet that'd piss him off good.
translation: ……怎么说，也许是他的宠物。他从不许别人碰那头牛。如果朝那头牛开枪，我敢说他一定会暴跳如雷。

original: Might make him careless, too.
translation: 也许这样能让他分心。

original: Why did you quit the trade?
translation: 你为什么不做这个生意了？

original: See, I thought the bounty hunting trade would be easy money, but it turns out it's hard work. So screw it.
translation: 你看，我本以为赏金猎人赚钱容易，可到头来却发现钱一点也不好挣。所以我才退出了。

original: Also - I ran into this mark who was a little too tough for me. I mean, I could've taken him.
translation: 另外，我接了一桩大单子，结果却没完成。我的意思是，我本来是能干掉他的。

original: But with this guy, it might have cost me some bad burns or an ass-rape. I'm all for risking my life, but I'm a little sensitive about my asshole.
translation: 可这家伙实在太厉害，我担心自己会被烧得面目全非，或者被他操屁眼。我倒是不怕死，只是珍惜自己的屁眼。

original: I've been known to hunt a few bounties, myself.
translation: 我可是个有名的赏金猎人，干过几桩大买卖。

original: Well hey, the field's wide open, now that I'm gone. Probably lots of people looking to get in, once they hear I quit.
translation: 嘿，现在没了我，你们这些小辈就开始放肆了。听说我洗手不干了，估计有不少人都等着入行呢。

original: Are you supposed to be famous or something?
translation: 难不成你很出名吗？

original: Well shit, feel free to stick a knife in the old ego. I thought I'd made a name for myself around here.
translation: 哦，见鬼，你想打击我，随你的便吧。我还以为在这一带我已经小有名气了。

original: Guess that's as good a reason as any to quit this stinkin' trade. No glory. No easy money, no women, and no glory.
translation: 想要从这肮脏的行当里金盆洗手，无人搭理确实是个好借口。没钱赚，没女人，没名声。关键是没名声。

original: Shit, I'd settle just for the women.
translation: 见鬼，我更情愿是因为女人。

original: I found this in Dermot's room. <Show her Dermot's ledger.>
translation: 我在德莫特的房间里找到了这个。<给她看德莫特的账簿。>

original: {tentative}I'll take a look, just to see what sort of shit they were into.
translation: 给我瞧一眼，就看看他们到底在搞什么鬼名堂。

original: {mounting fury}What?... Those bastards! Selling folks off to the Fiends? Selling children - to Cook-Cook...?
translation: {mounting fury}什么？……那些混蛋！贩卖人口给恶魔帮？把儿童卖给——大厨库克…？

original: I've seen enough. You did everyone a service. Take these. Might help if you get a jam.
translation: 我看不下去了。你为大家做了件好事。这些东西你收下吧。遇到麻烦时也许用得到。

original: I found this in Dermot's room. <Show her Dermot's ledger.>
translation: 我在德莫特房间里找到了这个。<给她看德莫特的账簿。>

original: We'll see how it goes.
translation: 我们要静观其变。

original: That's right, we will. Anything I can help you with?
translation: 说得对，我们会的。有什么能为您效劳的？

original: We'll see how it goes.
translation: 我们要静观其变。

original: Fine by me.
translation: 可以啊。

original: So long as we understand each other.
translation: 既然没什么问题那就再见了。

original: Fine by me.
translation: 可以啊。

original: I'd like to hear about your open bounties.
translation: 我想知道你们公开悬赏的人是谁。

original: Good. That's damn good. I figure it's about time we got lucky out here, so maybe you can snuff one of these maniacs.
translation: 很好，非常好。我估计咱们也该时来运转了，说不定你真有能力制服那几个变态呢。

original: I got a little turned around. Where can I find your boss?
translation: 我有点绕晕了。我上哪能找到你们的老大？

original: Let me ask you something else.
translation: 我想问点别的事。

original: Do you ever quit? Go on.
translation: 就那么喜欢问问题？说吧。

original: I'm not sure how much I can help. But I have another question.
translation: 我不知道能否帮得上忙，不过我还有个问题。

original: Your talking slows my healing process. Be snappy about it.
translation: 和你说话会影响我疗伤。快问吧。

original: Like anyone in their right mind would follow you.
translation: 好像所有聪明人都会跟着你。

original: Yeah, you do that.
translation: 是啊，是这样。

original: Yeah. Can't say I'm sad to hear he's gone. I should take over.
translation: 是啊，那家伙挂了，我倒挺开心的，我应该当老大。

original: Must have been some NCR. I know they've been gunning for him.
translation: 一定是NCR的人干的，我知道他们在追杀他。

original: Damn, are you serious? He was one tough son of a bitch.
translation: 该死，你说真的？那狗娘养的东西可猛着呢。

original: Good, I hated that fucker.
translation: 很好，我本来就讨厌那混蛋。

original: Can you make it worth my while?
translation: 你们要怎么报答我呢？

original: I don't know. Carter told me about some password he hacked out of a computer. I could give it to you, if you help us out.
translation: 我不知道。卡特把他破解的那台电脑密码告诉了我，如果你救我们出去，我就把密码给你。

original: I have a couple more questions.
translation: 我还有几个问题。

original: Okay, but be quiet. I don't want the Fiends to hear us.
translation: 好吧，但是小声点。我可不想让恶魔帮听到我们说话。

original: Give me the password he found, and I'll help you escape.
translation: 把他找到的密码告诉我，我就帮你们逃走。

original: [FAILED] Help us first, then we'll give you the password, and don't think about killing me. Its all in my head.
translation: [失败] 你先救我们，我们才能再给你密码。杀了我也没用，密码都在我脑子里。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Fine, it isn't like it is doing me any good in here. You'd better come back though.
translation: [成功] 好吧，这密码我留着似乎也没什么用处。希望你能信守承诺。

original: <Intimidate> Give me the password or you're all going to die in here.
translation: <威胁> 告诉我密码，否则我让你们都全都死在这里。

original: If I help you escape, will you give me the password he found?
translation: 如果我帮你们逃走，你能把他找到的密码告诉我吗？

original: Yeah, it is yours if you help us out of here.
translation: 当然，只要你把我们救出去，密码就告诉你。

original: I object to the use of violence against prisoners of war.
translation: 我反对虐待战俘。

original: Aw, tear my heart out, why don't you? Well, maybe you can find a way to play with his mind - get him out of his comfort zone.
translation: 哦，太让我感动了。好吧,也许你能想办法跟他斗斗智——让他别那么舒坦。

original: People lose their heads and say things they regret. Especially if they underestimate you. This dickhead would underestimate a nuclear missile.
translation: 人只要一得意忘形，就容易失言，尤其是当他们不把你放在眼里的时候。这白痴估计拿枚核弹放在他跟前，他都能不屑一顾。

original: Plenty of ways to skin a cat, as they say. Hey, what if we skinned him? Bet he wouldn't be so smug then.
translation: 就像别人说的，剥猫皮有很多种办法。嘿, 要不咱们也把他的皮剥了？保证他以后不再那么嚣张。

original: He admitted to manufacturing and selling chems.
translation: 他承认自己在生产和贩售药品。

original: He's trafficking chems? I don't know how he thought he could get away with that.
translation: 他在贩毒？他是怎么想的，居然以为自己还能逍遥法外吗。

original: I hacked into his computer and found evidence that he's selling NCR guns.
translation: 我入侵了他的电脑，发现他居然在向外兜售NCR的枪支。

original: Little bastard. I'm sure some of those find their way into the hands of our enemies, too.
translation: 这个小兔崽子，我敢肯定现在有些枪支已经落入敌人之手了。

original: I have proof that Sgt. Contreras is involved in criminal activity.
translation: 我有证据证明孔特雷拉斯中士卷入了犯罪事件。

original: That may be the worst-kept secret on the base. I'd be more surprised if you had proof he wasn't involved in criminal activity.
translation: 这早就是整个基地人所共知的秘密了。要是你能证明他没犯罪，我反倒会觉得吃惊呢。

original: But if you have proof, you're the envy of every MP stationed here. What'd you find?
translation: 不过既然你发现了证据，那基地里其他宪兵都会嫉妒死你的。你发现了什么？

original: All right. Thanks for telling me. I'm going to have him rounded up.
translation: 很好。多谢你告诉我这些。我会把他抓起来的。

original: Pretty impressive work there. Wish I could keep you around.
translation: 干得漂亮。真希望能把你留在我身边。

original: But for helping me nail this guy, I think you should have a little keepsake.
translation: 不过你帮我揪出了这个家伙，我想应该给你些小小的奖赏才是。

original: Here. It's not contraband, but I confiscated it from Contreras last week because he was being smarmy and I was sick of his bullshit.
translation: 拿去。这不是禁运品，是我从孔特雷拉斯那儿收缴来的，这家伙整天只会阿谀奉承，太让我恶心了。

original: No, nothing else.
translation: 不，没什么事了。

original: Well, that's a shame about Corporal White. He knew better than that.
translation: 怎么说呢，怀特下士的事情真叫人遗憾，他是个明理的人。

original: He wants you to increase water flow to Freeside. Said it'd be lost otherwise.
translation: 他想让你增加供应自由城的水量。他说反正这些水流到别处也是浪费。

original: Man, that guy's got water on the brain. Knows more about water pipes than any man should.
translation: 老天，难道那家伙脑子进水了吗。怎么满脑子都是水管子的事情。

original: If he says we're losing water, I think the colonel would listen to that. I'll talk to him about it.
translation: 要是我们的水真的浪费了，那我想上校肯定不会置之不理的。我会去和他谈谈。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Okay, well let me know if you find out anything.
translation: 好吧，如果有什么发现就告诉我。

original: A gang called the Scorpions murdered him. A man named Anderson witnessed it.
translation: 一伙自称毒蝎帮的暴徒杀了他。另外还有一个叫安德森的人，他目睹了整个经过。

original: Shit. That's why you don't go wandering off looking for some call girl on the Strip without telling somebody first.
translation: 见鬼，你看看，这就是擅自去长街招妓却不提前打招呼的下场。

original: Anderson. Is that Followers of the Apocalypse Anderson?
translation: 安德森。是天启追随者的安德森？他以前有和我们共事过，他还说了什么？

original: He was killed by a man named Anderson he caught stealing water from the NCR.
translation: 他被一个叫安德森的人杀了。那个人从NCR偷水的时候被他抓住。

original: Anderson. I've heard of him, if it's the same guy. Water nerd from the Followers of the Apocalypse. Used to handle some of the operations for OSI.
translation: 安德森，要是没记错，我认得他。他是天启追随者的人，书呆子一个。曾经在科工部主持过一些项目。

original: I don't know what to think about the Followers. The things they do... hard to say if they're helping or hurting sometimes. Especially in Freeside.
translation: 我真的不知道该怎么看待天启追随者。他们做的事……有时候很难说究竟是在帮忙还是在添乱，尤其是在自由城的问题上。

original: I'll have to send some people out there to make sure we don't lose any more water. That stuff's like gold out here.
translation: 我会派些人过去，确保我们的淡水不会再流失。它对我们可是如金子一般珍贵。

original: But you. I owe you for this. You saved me a lot of work. And I'm sure Corporal White's family will be grateful to at least get some closure.
translation: 但你，我欠你一个人情。你让我省了不少力气，怀特下士的家人至少也能得到些许慰藉。

original: The MPs keep a bunch of junk around that's confiscated off of people who decide to screw with us.
translation: 宪兵队存了不少从捣乱分子手中收缴来的垃圾。

original: I haven't really sorted through it, but go ahead and see if there's anything you can use in there.
translation: 我还没详细做过整理，但你可以去看看，如果有什么需要，就尽管拿去吧。

original: We keep it in a trunk across the hall, by the prison cells.
translation: 我们把它放在大厅后面的一个箱子里了，就在牢房边上。

original: I have an update on Corporal White.
translation: 我有怀特下士的最新信息。

original: I've already talked to Anderson, actually. Came in, confessed, and gave you credit for the whole thing.
translation: 我已经和安德森谈过了，他把一切都向我坦白了，还说是你让他来自首的。

original: First time I've ever seen anything like that. Was like you'd done him some huge favor. I've gotta hand it to you.
translation: 我还是第一次遇到这种事。感觉你好像帮了他一个大忙似的。我得好好表扬你。

original: This Dazzle must be some girl.
translation: 这个达泽一定是位女孩了。

original: Don't tell me. He married the hooker.
translation: 别和我说，他和一个妓女结婚了。

original: Isaac has me out looking for metal so they can do the first shipment.
translation: 艾萨克说，我必须先找些废铁来，他们才能开始准备第一批货。

original: Well what the hell are you doing here? Get your ass out and find that metal.  Don't come back until the job is done!
translation: 哦，那你还在这儿干什么？快给我滚出去收集废铁。活没干完就别回来！

original: No one works for Price, so who the hell are you?
translation: 没人为普莱斯工作，所以你他妈的是谁？

original: Ah, shit. Well since you seem to have things figured out, the name's Keller. I'm an NCR Ranger investigating chem runners.
translation: 啊，该死。既然你似乎都看出来了，我叫凯勒。是一名NCR游骑兵，负责调查毒贩。

original: Price is in deep with the NCR for supplying ingredients to the local gangs. He's currently being held for questioning.
translation: 普莱斯因为向本地黑帮提供毒品原料，已经得罪了NCR。他被拘押了，正在接受调查呢。

original: What's your business with him?
translation: 你找他有什么事？

original: <Draw weapon> You're a dead man.
translation: <掏出武器> 你死定了。

original: Whoa!  Hold on a minute, buddy...
translation: 哇哦！等一下，伙计……

original: Whoa!  Hold on a minute, lady...
translation: 哇哦！等一下，伙计……

original: Has your research here turned up anything interesting?
translation: 你发现什么有意思的东西了吗？

original: A few things here and there, but a lot of the data has been corrupted, and all of the live samples have been contaminated by the spore plants.
translation: 是有一些，但是不少资料已经损坏了，而且所有活着的样本都被孢子植物感染了。

original: One interesting thing I found is that one of the chemicals secreted by the spore plants serves as a mild stimulant when ingested by humans.
translation: 另外我还发现一件有趣的事——孢子植物的一种分泌物被人类摄入后，会起到轻微的兴奋剂效果。

original: As far as I can tell, it has no side effects or addictive properties, aside from the inherent psychological ones, of course.
translation: 到目前为止，我还没发现它具有任何副作用或成瘾性。当然啦，要剔除那些已经发神经的样本。

original: Now that I think of it, there was a Cpl. Farber back at McCarran who'd probably be interested in it. There's a sample of it around here somewhere.
translation: 哦，对了。在麦卡伦营地有一位法伯下士，他可能会对这个感兴趣。样本的话这附近就有一个。

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}Move it!  Move it!  Move it!  Get those legs up you sorry bastards!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}动起来！动起来！动起来！腿给我抬高点儿，你们这些白痴孬种！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}Move, you lazy bastards! Do you think the legion is going to slow down for your sorry asses?!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}快点，你们这群懒惰的狗杂种！你们以为军团会专门慢下来等你们这帮饭桶吗？！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}Quit dragging your feet, recruit. Pick it up!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}脚别在地上拖，新兵蛋子。把脚抬高点！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}You run like a feeble old man, private!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}你跑起来像个快要没气儿的糟老头子，大兵！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}You can rest when you're dead, private! Move your ass!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}只要你还有一口气在，就别想休息，大兵！给我动起来！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}How the hell did you make it through boot camp, private?!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}你他妈的是怎么混过新兵训练营的，大兵？！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}You think it burns now, wait until I sit on your shoulders!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}这你就受不了啦，等会儿我还要坐在你肩膀上呢！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}The road to hell is paved by the bleached bones of privates that fell by the wayside, boys.
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}通往地狱的路，可是由倒在路边的小兵骨头铺就的，伙计们。

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}Pathetic! My 80-year-old grandmother runs faster than you!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}真可悲啊！我80岁的奶奶都跑得比你快！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}Good thing you're not a ranger. When a ranger quits he's dead!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}幸亏你不是个游骑兵。游骑兵要是敢停下来，他就死定了！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}Sound off like you've got a pair!
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}给我大声报数！

original: {Angry grizzled Drill Instructor yell}That's better, but you're still not winning the battle, boys.
translation: {灰白头发的训练教官生气的吼叫着}比以前好点了，但就凭这样还是打不了仗的，小子。

original: I'm looking for work.
translation: 我在找工作。

original: Well, I know Major Dhatri is offering bounties on some of the Fiends - that's the gang that controls the southeast part of the city.
translation: 嗯，我知道达特里少校正在悬赏一些恶魔帮的人头，这个团伙控制了城市的东南片区。

original: You can find the major at the camp just outside of the old airport.
translation: 你可以在旧机场外面的营地里找到少校。

original: Not sure how to help you with that one. Major Dhatri was offering bounties on some of the Fiends, but I hear someone took care of that recently.
translation: 恐怕我也帮不了你。达特里少校原本悬赏过几个恶魔帮的首级，不过听说已经有人把钱领走了。

original: Are these files valuable?
translation: 这些资料很有价值吗？

original: To someone, I'm sure. But they constitute a threat to life as we know it. Now give me your arm already.
translation: 对一些人来讲，非常有用。但正如你看到的，它们对人类构成了不小的威胁。现在赶紧把手伸过来。

original: Fine, do it.
translation: 很好，动手吧。

original: I did download some files earlier while exploring the vault.
translation: 我之前在探索避难所时，确实下载过一些资料。

original: Those files need to be erased. Hold out your arm and I'll have it done in a flash.
translation: 那些资料必须被删除。把手伸过来，我马上就把它们删掉。

original: What was the name of the Fiend who was carrying keys?
translation: 那个拿着钥匙的恶魔帮叫什么名字？

original: Daniel. Probably find him back in the Residential Wing somewhere.
translation: 丹尼尔。你应该可以在居住区找到他。

original: Status............ operational.
translation: 状态…………可运行。

original: Loading memory banks........
translation: 加载内存……

original: Current designation....... Koch.
translation: 已有称号……科赫。

original: Current mission.........
translation: 目前任务………

original: Warning! Primary defensive objective, designation Keely, taken by unknown hostile entities. Initiating full countermeasures.
translation: 警告！主要护卫目标，名称基利，获悉不明敌对势力。全面启动反制措施。

original: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里干什么？

original: I am assisting my master Keely with her research. We have been tasked with extracting as much of the research that was performed here as possible.
translation: 我正在协助我的主人基利进行科学研究。我们的任务是尽可能从此地保留下来的研究成果中提取有用的资料。

original: What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 你能和我说说这个地方吗？

original: Very little, I'm afraid. I've been stuck here calculating protein sequences for most of our sojourn here thus far.
translation: 恐怕我知道的也很少。我大多数时候都留在这里计算蛋白质序列。

original: Master Keely has done most of the exploring. She might be able to tell you more.
translation: 探路大多是主人在负责的。她应该可以告诉你更多。

original: Why don't you go and look for her?
translation: 你为什么不去找她？

original: I have been given explicit instructions to stay here until the master returns.
translation: 我得到了明确指示，必须在这里等着，直到主人回来。

original: Perhaps. I'll go down and look for her.
translation: 也许。我要下去找她。

original: Oh, thank you! The master can really be a bother sometimes, but she has a good heart.
translation: 哦，谢谢！主人可能有时候很烦人，但她其实很善良。

original: Now, I must get back to computing protein sequences. Please tell the master to hurry back if you see her.
translation: 现在我必须继续处理这些蛋白质序列了。如果你找到主人，叫她赶快回来。

original: Not really. Is your master around?
translation: 不是。你的主人在这儿吗？

original: I've been sent to look for her. Where is she now?
translation: 我是被派来找她的。她在哪里？

original: Where is Keely now?
translation: 基利现在在哪？

original: I couldn't say, exactly. She went down to the lower levels some time ago and hasn't been back since. Do you suppose something has happened to her?
translation: 确切来说，我也不知道。她之前到下面的楼层去了，现在还没回来。你觉得她会不会出事了？

original: I don't have time to talk, sorry.
translation: 我没时间聊天，对不起。

original: Very well, I'll get back to computing these protein sequences, then. Farewell.
translation: 很好。我会继续处理这些蛋白质序列。再见了。

original: Have you seen a ghoul named Keely around here?
translation: 你见过一名叫基利的尸鬼吗？

original: Why yes, the master was here some time ago. Do you have business with her?
translation: 是的，主人一段时间前在这里。你找她有事吗？

original: Skip the introductions. Why are you here?
translation: 不用自我介绍了。你在这里做什么？

original: My, how rude. If you must know, I am here to assist my master Keely in her research.
translation: 天哪，你真没礼貌。如果你非要问，我在这里协助我的主人基利做研究工作。

original: Nice to meet you.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: A pleasure to meet you, sir. What may I do for you?
translation: 很高兴见到你，先生。我能为你做些什么？

original: A pleasure to meet you, madam. What may I do for you?
translation: 很高兴见到你，女士。我能为你做些什么？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goobye!
translation: 掰拜！

original: Do you have trouble speaking?
translation: 你说话很吃力吗？

original: Mmm-hm. [Points to stump of tongue in his mouth.]
translation: 嗯，哈。[从他嘴里露出残缺的舌头。]

original: I have bo go bow. Goobye!
translation: 窝得肘了。掰拜。

original: Nice to meet you... Mahsohfabish.
translation: 很高兴见到你……胡此夹种。

original: Ba peasure is ah mah. Goobye!
translation: 窝很荣训。掰拜！

original: O... kay.
translation: 好……吧。

original: Mmm-hm. Goobye!
translation: 嗯，嗯。掰拜！

original: What's a Super Mutant like you doing in a place like this?
translation: 像你这样的超级变种人到这种地方来干什么？

original: Ha ha ha! I wash ma bown. Wesibe.
translation: 哈哈哈！我造看地盘。西区。

original: I have bo go. Fiebs aroub. Goobye!
translation: 窝要肘了。有恶毛帮。掰拜！

original: Uh... who are you?
translation: 嗯……你是谁？

original: Mahsohfabish.
translation: 胡此夹种。

original: Get your ass up.
translation: 给我起来。

original: What the-
translation: 怎么——

original: Nothing today. Goodbye.
translation: 今天没什么事情。再见。

original: I could ask you the same question.
translation: 这问题该我问你才对。

original: See those menacing looking troopers with guns standing on the walls up there? That's Bravo Company. My company.
translation: 你看见围墙上那些荷枪实弹的士兵了吗？就是看起来很吓人的那些？他们都是B连的。我的连队。

original: Since Oliver stuck me in a desk job, I hardly ever get to see them during the day. So sometimes I like to check up on them when they have night duty.
translation: 自从奥利弗把我调到办公室后，我就很少能在白天见到他们了。所以我有时会在他们值夜班的时候过来看看。

original: But you still haven't answered my question.
translation: 话说回来，你仍然没有回答我的问题。

original: I got lost. This place is so big.
translation: 我迷路了。这个地方真大。

original: [FAILED] Lost, huh? If you say so. If you head over to the front terminal building you should be able to get in through the garage doors in back.
translation: [失败] 迷路了？那行吧。你可以走到前面的候机大厅去，然后从大厅后面的车库门进去。

original: I'm headed that way, myself, actually, so you can just follow me if you need to.
translation: 其实我也正好要去那里，所以你需要的话我可以带你过去。

original: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

original: Be straight with me. If you're onto something, I want to know about it.
translation: 你可以对我坦率一点。要是你真有什么打算，直接告诉我就行了。

original: If you were to get caught or killed, we'd lose everything you've learned about this case.
translation: 如果你被捕或者被杀了，那么你获取的所有情报也就没了。

original: I couldn't sleep, so I decided to take a walk.
translation: 我睡不着，所以决定出来走走。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Yeah, I get insomnia pretty bad myself, out here. I think it's the heat. Weird how sometimes it's cooler out here than it is inside.
translation: [成功] 是啊，我到了这里以后也经常失眠。大概因为气候炎热吧。真奇怪，有时候外面居然会比里面还凉快。

original: Well, I hope you manage to get some rest. Take it easy.
translation: 好吧，希望你能睡个好觉。放松点。

original: I'm here to buy out Cassidy Caravans for the Crimson Caravan Company.
translation: 我是来代表深红商队公司收购盖西迪商队的。

original: Okay! Sold!
translation: 好的！成交！

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Bye.
translation: 拜。

original: Yeah, yeah. This isn't rocket science. Watch and learn.
translation: 是啊，是啊。又没什么难度。好好学着点。

original: Understood. Thanks for the help.
translation: 明白了。谢谢你的提醒。

original: Least we can do. Wish we could help more.
translation: 小事一桩。真希望我们能帮得上忙。

original: I'll take my chances.
translation: 我倒想试试。

original: Hey, it's your life.
translation: 嘿，那自求多福吧。

original: Actually I'm supposed to be getting a body out of there.
translation: 实际上，我是受人之托，要去那里给人收尸。

original: Out of my way.
translation: 滚开。

original: I'm going to take this basket of cakes to my grandmother's house.
translation: 我正要把这一篮子蛋糕拿去给我外婆尝一尝呢。

original: All right, smartass, I get it. You don't answer to us. But get this straight. You will get eaten alive if you go up that way.
translation: 好吧，机灵鬼，我听明白了。你不想告诉我们。但我丑话说在前头，你要是继续往前走，肯定会被生吞活剥的。

original: And that's not a figure of speech, either. Bunch of sick, messed-up junkies control the road up there. Got a thing for desecrating corpses.
translation: 我不是在跟你耍嘴皮子。一群脑子不正常的毒棍在前面的道路上设了卡。他们尤其热衷亵渎尸体。

original: You've been warned.
translation: 别说我没警告过你。

original: Just passing through.
translation: 只是路过。

original: I wouldn't do that if I were you. Those buildings up ahead are crawling with psychos. This is as far up as we've been able to safely set up a position.
translation: 换做我可不会从这地方路过。前面那几栋建筑里盘踞着一堆疯子。我们最多也只敢在这个距离设置岗哨，才能保证安全。

original: You go any further, we can't protect you, understand?
translation: 你再往前走，我们就没法保护你了，明白吗？

original: I'm going to retrieve the body of Ranger Morales.
translation: 我要去收殓游骑兵莫拉莱斯的尸体。

original: Christina hired you, huh? Well, if you're going to go up there, there's a couple things you should know.
translation: 是克里斯蒂娜委托你的？好吧，如果你执意要去，有几件事我得先提醒你。

original: Esteban's body is in the middle of those buildings up the hill there. Look carefully, and you can see the Fiends patrolling the rooftops.
translation: 埃斯特班的尸体就躺在坡顶那几栋房子下面。多注意一下，屋顶上应该会有恶魔帮在巡逻。

original: But they laid traps, too. There's mines all over. So for godsakes, watch your feet. Get him back here. We'll get him home.
translation: 他们同时还设了陷阱。那里到处都是地雷。所以你千万要小心脚下。把他的尸体带回来。我们会送他回家的。

original: How might I be of assistance?
translation: 我该怎么才能帮你们的忙？

original: Oh, so many ways! Small ones to begin with, so we can get used to what it's like to have a sav- outsider around and about.
translation: 噢，方法可多啦！从小事做起吧，这样我们就能慢慢习惯有野蛮——外来者的感觉了。

original: Should that go well, it may be you can help in big ways, too. We'll have to see.
translation: 如果小事都做得好，那大事你应该也能帮上忙。我们会拭目以待的。

original: <Science check to get emitter>
translation: <科技技能检定>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hot damn, you're right! It's a matter of boosting across those thresholds, not exact amplitude. You're smarter than you look.
translation: [成功] 妙极了，你说得对啊！只要超过临界点就行，不需要具体的数值。你看起来还挺聪明的。

original: Just so happens I was testing it at 24,000 hertz, so it should be good to go. Place it near their nest and cross your fingers.
translation: 刚好我之前正在24000赫兹上做测试，直接拿来用应该就能行。把它放到蚂蚁窝附近，然后就等着看好戏吧。

original: Signal's too high for people to hear, so no harm done, but it might make you feel sick to your stomach.
translation: 这个信号频率很高，人耳捕捉不到，所以对人体是无害的，不过还是有可能导致恶心反胃。

original: Any signal over 22,000 hertz at 150 or more decibels should do the trick.
translation: 任何超过22000赫兹、150分贝的声波应该都能产生作用。

original: [FAILED] No, it doesn't have a dial! It has to be stabilized for an exact frequency or it could shake itself apart!
translation: [失败] 不，它没有转盘！如果不能确定准确的频率，这玩意会把自己给震散架的！

original: Oh. Does it have a dial or something? Turn it up to 11!
translation: 噢。那玩意上面有没有转盘之类的装置？拨到11就行啦。

original: Raquel said you were working on some kind of weapon to fight the giant ants?
translation: 拉奎尔说你曾经尝试过制造某种武器来对付那些巨型蚂蚁？

original: I started building a sonic emitter that might do the trick, but it's useless without knowing the exact frequency that would kill the ants.
translation: 我正在制作一种可能会有用的声波发射器，但如果不知道准确的频率，也是白搭。

original: I'd like to know all about your people.
translation: 我确实很想了解你们。

original: Wonderful! I'm sure you've noticed the mural on the wall of this hut. Shall I tell you what it all means?
translation: 太好了！你肯定已经注意到这个棚子墙上的壁画了吧。要不要我介绍一下它们的含义？

original: Ask away.
translation: 问吧。

original: I have some questions about your people's history.
translation: 关于你们的历史，我有一些问题。

original: Anything else you want to know?
translation: 你还想知道点什么吗？

original: Other questions you want to ask?
translation: 你还想问其他问题吗？

original: What else I can tell you?
translation: 还有什么是你想了解的吗？

original: I wish everyone were just as interested in our story as you are! Maybe I should act out the battles or learn how to throw my voice...
translation: 我希望大家都能像你一样对我们的历史感兴趣！也许今后我应该表演一下战斗场面，或者学会用丹田气说话……

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Me? I'm Pete, Keeper of the Story.
translation: 我？我是皮特，历史守护者。

original: I know I seem kind of young. I was the apprentice Keeper of the Story until a couple months ago, but ol' Keeper Don, well...
translation: 我知道我看起来是年纪小了点。几个月以前，我还只是个学生，但是我们的前任守护者唐恩，他，呃……

original: Whiskey and land mines don't go together. So it's up to me. I bet you want to know everything about us!
translation: 他没分清威士忌和地雷的差别，于是担子就落到了我肩上。我敢说你一定特别想了解我们的历史！

original: I'm looking for ways to make myself useful.
translation: 我正想着怎么才能帮你们呢。

original: If that's so, how about you look into repairing the solar arrays on the roof of the generator building?
translation: 那样的话，你去试试把发电机房顶上的太阳能电池板修好怎么样？

original: Nothing too complicated about it, but it's a long ways to walk my old bones, and there's been that ant problem over near there.
translation: 事情本身不复杂，可我这把老骨头走不了太远的路，而且那边还在闹蚂蚁。

original: You can't miss the array. It's on top of the generator building smack dab in the middle of Nellis between the two runways.
translation: 太阳能板很好找。就在内利斯基地两条跑道中间那座发电机房的楼顶。

original: Thanks for the warning, but I'm leaving.
translation: 谢谢你的提醒，但是我要走了。

original: Is there a way to get past?
translation: 有过去的路吗？

original: There is a way, and I'll tell you... for a little wager?
translation: 有一条路，我可以告诉你……不过你得愿意和我赌一把。

original: 300 caps? Nah, I've got better things to spend my caps on.
translation: 300瓶盖？休想，我还得留着钱办大事呢。

original: Suit yourself. Come back and see me when you get tired of picking shrapnel out of your backside.
translation: 随你的便吧。等你被炮弹炸得屁股开花，再回来找我吧。

original: Thanks for the warning. What's going on past those signs?
translation: 谢谢你的提醒，要是不理那些标牌继续往前走会怎么样？

original: Oh lordy lordy, you haven't heard of the Boomers? What rock have you been living under?
translation: 哎哟，我的老天爷，你没听说过大炮族吗？你是从哪个石头缝儿里蹦出来的？

original: They're a bunch of artillery-slingin' grenade lobbin' odd-jobs camping out in Nellis. Wander into their territory and you're as good as mincemeat!
translation: 他们是一群没事就喜欢往天上开炮的狂徒，就驻扎在内利斯基地。你要是敢闯进他们的地盘，那就等着被轰成肉酱吧！

original: Simple enough. Run, hide, run. It's all in the timing.
translation: 很简单，跑，躲，再跑。关键在于掌握时机。

original: But I had you zeroed in the whole time! Nobody's that fast!
translation: 但我一直都瞄着你啊！没有人能跑得那么快的！

original: Move a muscle now and I'll blow you to pieces!
translation: 你要再敢乱动，我就把你炸成碎片！

original: I'm still trying to figure out who to help and how.
translation: 我还在考虑该帮谁的忙，怎么帮。

original: Each of the elders would appreciate assistance with various issues here in Nellis.
translation: 每位长老都有不同的事务需要协助，他们非常欢迎别人伸出援手。

original: Seek out Jack, Loyal, Raquel, and Argyll. They will guide you.
translation: 去找杰克，罗亚尔，拉奎尔和阿盖尔。他们会给你指示的。

original: Loyal still needs help getting the plane back to Nellis, and there may be others who still require assistance.
translation: 罗亚尔需要有人帮他把飞机运回内利斯，其他人也可能需要帮手。

original: You tell me. What do people have to say about me?
