translation: 挺不错的。大家都是怎么看待我的？

original: I haven't heard anything. You must not be trying hard enough.
translation: 我可没怎么听到反响。肯定是你还不够努力。

original: I may have heard a compliment or two. Nothing special.
translation: 我可能是听到了一两句恭维话，不过也没什么特别的。

original: I do believe you've convinced one or two of us that it's better you made it here than were blown to smithereens.
translation: 据我所知，有一两个人确实被你打动了，至少你向他们证明了当初我们没把你炸成碎片是对的。

original: More and more, I hear my people saying good things about you.
translation: 我听见有越来越多的人在说你的好话。

original: I believe the time has come for you to show your value in full. The people have come to accept having you around.
translation: 我相信你已经充分展现你的价值了。人们已经完全接纳了你。

original: Find Loyal and ask him about our people's fondest dream. He will tell you what to do next.
translation: 去找罗亚尔，他会告诉你我们的梦想。也会告诉你下一步该做什么。

original: Well, I think. I've done everything I can to help out.
translation: 挺好的吧。我一直在尽全力帮助他人。

original: The ballast worked. The B-29 is at the surface, ready to go.
translation: 浮袋起作用了。那架B-29浮上来了，随时可以拖走。

original: What you have done for us is a miracle, child. You have fulfilled the only dreams we ever had outside our walls.
translation: 你为我们创造了奇迹，孩子。你实现了我们对墙外世界的唯一梦想。

original: You are a trusted friend of us all. If there is ever a way for us to help you, child, tell me and I will make it so.
translation: 你是我们大家都能信赖的朋友。如果有什么我们能帮上忙的，孩子，告诉我，我会不遗余力地帮你。

original: I've spoken to Loyal. The B-29 is on the way.
translation: 我跟罗亚尔说过了。那架B-29马上就会运过来。

original: Extraordinary, child. Go tell Loyal, then return to me.
translation: 太了不起了，孩子。去向罗亚尔报喜吧，再回来找我。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: See you later!
translation: 回头见。

original: I didn't run through all that artillery to hear your stupid questions.
translation: 我冒着炮火来，可不是为了听你问这种蠢问题的。

original: Are you even human? Some kind of mutant?
translation: 你还是人类吗？该不会是变种人吧？

original: Move a muscle now and I'll blow you to pieces!
translation: 你要再敢乱动，我就把你炸成碎片！

original: Who's in charge here?
translation: 这里谁是管事的？

original: I'm not telling you a thing, savage!
translation: 野蛮人，我什么都不会告诉你的！

original: Move a muscle now and I'll blow you to pieces!
translation: 你要再敢乱动，我就把你炸成碎片！

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Your plan worked. The plane floated up. Seemed to be intact.
translation: 你的计划成功了。飞机漂上来了。看起来还挺完好。

original: That's tremendous! I'll transmit instructions to the robots to start packing up the plane to bring it back to Nellis!
translation: 太壮观了！我马上给机器人发指令，把飞机打包带回内利斯！

original: Tell me again what I need to do.
translation: 再说一遍我需要做什么。

original: I wish you'd paid attention the first time! All you need to do is attach the deployable ballast to the plane.
translation: 我真希望你第一次的时候有认真听讲！你要做的是把可展开式浮袋装到飞机上。

original: Some of my robots will carry a remote activation station out to the shore. Attach the ballast, hit a button, and they'll handle the rest.
translation: 我的机器人会把一个遥控启动器带去湖边。给飞机装上浮袋，按下按钮，剩下的事情就交给机器人去做吧。

original: Where is the bomber located?
translation: 轰炸机的位置在哪？

original: I told you, at the bottom of Lake Mead! I'll make sure the location is displayed on your Pip-boy map.
translation: 我跟你说了，就在米德湖底！我会把地点标记在你的哔哔小子上。

original: How do you expect to raise a bomber from the bottom of a lake?
translation: 你打算怎么把一架轰炸机从湖底捞出来？

original: Simple! Attach deployable ballast to the plane and float it on up!
translation: 简单！给它装上可展开式浮袋，它自己就会漂上来！

original: Here is a remote detonator. Once the ballast is attached to the plane just hit the detonator from the shore and let buoyancy handle the rest.
translation: 这是遥控雷管。把浮袋装到飞机上以后，在湖边引爆雷管，机身就会自己浮上水面。

original: Where is the bomber located?
translation: 轰炸机的位置在哪？

original: It's at the bottom of Lake Mead. I'll mark its location on your Pip-boy map.
translation: 就在米德湖底。我会把地点标记在你的哔哔小子上。

original: Lady in the water? What's that?
translation: 湖中的淑女？那是什么？

original: A long time ago - long before the war that killed just about everything that ever lived - a bomber crashed not far from here.
translation: 很久很久以前——在整个世界都毁于战火之前——有架轰炸机坠毁在了离这儿不远的地方。

original: A bomber was a flying contraption that could drop explosives down on anything it flew over. But anyway, moving on...
translation: 轰炸机是一种可以一边飞，一边扔炸弹的奇妙玩意。不过这不重要，继续听我说……

original: This bomber crashed down in Lake Mead, pretty damn near intact. When we got to Nellis, see, I found this article in a magazine all about it.
translation: 这架轰炸机坠落在了米德湖中，几乎完好无损。当我们到达内利斯的时候，我在一本杂志上看到了关于此事的详细报道。

original: There was another B-29 around here, part of a museum. Couldn't fly, but had a lot of spare parts, see? Get where I'm going?
translation: 这附近还有另外一架B-29轰炸机，是博物馆的展品。虽然不能飞，但有很多能拆下来用的零件，懂了吧？知道我要说什么了吗？

original: Since I was a young man, I've dreamed of raising that Lady from the lake and bringing her back to life. What do you say?
translation: 在我还是年轻人时，我就梦想着能把湖里那架轰炸机捞起来，让她复活。你觉得怎么样？

original: That's all for now.
translation: 先这样吧。

original: Thanks for dropping it off. Anything else?
translation: 谢谢你把它送过来。还有什么事吗？

original: Just take all of it.
translation: 都拿走吧。

original: Hey thanks!
translation: 嘿，谢了！

original: Just 1.
translation: 就1个。

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: I've got scrap metal for you.
translation: 我给你带来了废金属。

original: Cool! How much can you spare?
translation: 酷！你能给我多少？

original: I'll look into it. Stranger things have happened.
translation: 我会去调查的。比这奇怪的事我都遇到过。

original: That would be amazing. As in, I would thank you forever.
translation: 那真是太好了。我会永远感激你。

original: Maybe I could talk to her for you. What's she look like?
translation: 也许我可以帮你和她谈谈。她长什么样？

original: Oh, you can't miss her! She has short red hair and she's the most beautiful woman who ever lived!
translation: 噢，你一眼就能认出来！她留着红色的短发，是世界上最美的女人！

original: You'd really talk to her for me? What if she feels the same way? What if she comes here like you did?
translation: 你真能替我去和她说话吗？万一她和我想法一样呢？万一她也想学你跑到基地里来呢？

original: What if she gets blown up? What if she doesn't like me?
translation: 万一她被炸死了怎么办？万一她不喜欢我呢？

original: Oh jeez, I better just let you handle it. I'm better with machines. They don't make my stomach queasy like this!
translation: 喔，天呐，还是交给你处理吧。我就守着机器好了。起码它们不会让我神经这么紧张！

original: Oh, you can't miss her! She has short red hair and she's the most beautiful woman who ever lived!
translation: 噢，你一眼就能认出来！她留着红色的短发，是世界上最美的女人！

original: You'd really talk to her for me? What if she feels the same way? What if she comes here like you did?
translation: 你真能替我去和她说话吗？万一她和我想法一样呢？万一她也想学你跑到基地里来呢？

original: What if she gets blown up? What if she doesn't like me?
translation: 万一她被炸死了怎么办？万一她不喜欢我呢？

original: Oh jeez, I better just let you handle it. I'm better with machines. They don't make my stomach queasy like this!
translation: 喔，天呐，还是交给你处理吧。我就守着机器好了。起码它们不会让我神经这么紧张！

original: What can you tell me about Loyal?
translation: 你对罗亚尔了解多少？

original: Loyal's a great man, but he's getting on in years, so a younger's got to learn everything he knows. That'd be me.
translation: 罗亚尔是个了不起的人，但他老了，有个年轻人很快会继承他的衣钵。而那个人就是我。

original: The man knows how to fix and build just about everything that was ever made. It's not easy keeping up with him.
translation: 他几乎什么都能修，什么都能造。想达到他那样的水平可不容易。

original: If you help him recover the Lady I figure - oh, I figure it's been a nice day. Yeah, a real nice day.
translation: 如果你能帮他找回“淑女”，我敢说——噢，那将是美好的一天。对，相当美好的一天。

original: Loyal's a great man, but he's getting on in years, so a younger's got to learn everything he knows. That'd be me.
translation: 罗亚尔是个了不起的人，但他老了，有个年轻人很快会继承他的衣钵。而那个人就是我。

original: The man knows how to fix and build just about everything that was ever made. It's not easy keeping up with him.
translation: 他几乎什么都能修，什么都能造。想达到他那样的水平可不容易。

original: Oh come on, you've met Loyal by now. He's a mechanical genius.
translation: 噢，拜托，你不是已经见过罗亚尔了吗。他是个机械天才。

original: The man knows how to fix and build just about everything that was ever made. It's not easy keeping up with him.
translation: 他几乎什么都能修，什么都能造。想达到他那样的水平可不容易。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All right. See you around, I hope.
translation: 好的，后会有期了。

original: This doesn't interest me.
translation: 我对这个没兴趣。

original: Then why did you make me spill my guts about it? You're an asshole!
translation: 那你干嘛还让我和你掏心窝子？你这个混蛋！

original: So tell me about this girl that caught your interest.
translation: 和我说说那个让你感兴趣的女孩儿。

original: There's an outpost near here. The signs say "Crimson Caravan?" It seems like they carry things to and fro for people out there?
translation: 这附近有一个哨站。标牌上写着"深红商队"？他们应该是帮人运东西的吧？

original: Well, every once in a while I watch the outpost through one of the spotters' binoculars. And sometimes there's this girl there, this special girl...
translation: 总之，我时不时会用望远镜观察那个前哨站。偶尔会看到那边有个女孩，十分与众不同……

original: And sometimes it's like she's watching me back with her binoculars! Except she's probably just watching Nellis. I haven't tried waving.
translation: 感觉她有时好像也在用望远镜看我！也可能是她在观察内利斯吧。我不敢朝她挥手。

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才技能>

original: [FAILED] I'll keep my spit to myself, thank you very much. That sounded stupid, didn't it? Damn it.
translation: [失败] 我还是把话憋在心里吧，谢谢你。挺蠢的，对吧？该死。

original: "Personal matter?" Nonsense. Spit it out.
translation: "私事？"没关系，说吧。

original: [SUCCEEDED] That must be nice, sharing yourself like that, not being embarrassed or anything? Well, the thing is, there's this girl...
translation: [成功] 真好，能和别人分享自己的想法，不必感到尴尬或者丢脸。好吧，事情是这样，有个女孩……

original: Where I come from, we discuss personal matters all the time.
translation: 在我们那儿，没人介意和别人讨论私事。

original: I can find you some scrap metal.
translation: 我可以帮你找些废金属。

original: Thanks. That'd be great.
translation: 谢谢，那太好了。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿做什么？

original: Me? I work with Loyal, mostly electronics work and robotics. Keeping the old technologies alive, right?
translation: 我吗？我和罗亚尔一起工作，主要负责电子设备和机器人。总得让这些老旧的科技发挥些余热，对吧？

original: I'm looking for ways to help out. Anything come to mind?
translation: 我想帮你们的忙。有什么事可以让我做的？

original: What I could use is some scrap metal. It may not sound exciting, but around here we have to recycle every rivet and plate.
translation: 我想要一些废金属。虽然听起来没什么意思，但是在这里，每一颗铆钉和铁片都必须回收利用。

original: The other thing, you being from the outside and all, well, I guess you'd call it a personal matter but, well... Eh, forget it!
translation: 另外，毕竟你是从外面来的，有件事，其实这应该算是我的私事，不过……呃，算了！

original: Like I said, I can never get enough scrap metal.
translation: 就像我说的，我需要废金属。

original: Can you think of any ways I can help out?
translation: 我怎样才能帮上你忙呢？

original: Loyal said you can help me breathe under water.
translation: 罗亚尔说你可以帮我在水下呼吸。

original: I just need some parts from a pressure cooker to create a hermetic seal for the rebreather.
translation: 我需要一些压力锅上的配件来做下水呼吸器的密闭装置。

original: Have you found a pressure cooker so I can finish the rebreather?
translation: 你找到能用来制作呼吸器的压力锅了吗？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: < Speech - 30 >
[SUCCEEDED] The truth of it is that I did cut out a raider's heart, but only took a bite to mess with his buddies.
translation: [成功] 事实上，我的确把一个掠夺者的心脏挖了出来，但我只咬了一口，想震慑他的同伴。

original: They had me surrounded and I went with the first thing that came to mind. Some ran, and the rest were startled just long enough.
translation: 当时我被他们包围，脑中灵机一动想到了这么个主意。有几个人见状撒腿就跑，剩下的人也吓傻了，给了我可乘之机。

original: It sounds like there's an interesting story behind it.
translation: 听起来另有隐情啊。

original: [FAILED] Nope. You'll just have to keep on wondering. Heh.
translation: [失败] 不。你就继续猜吧。呵。

original: Come on, you can tell me.
translation: 拜托，告诉我吧。

original: You served in the military?
translation: 你在军队中服役过？

original: Err... yeah. It was a long time ago. Things were better back then.
translation: 呃……是的。很久以前了。那时候可比现在过得好。

original: Who's Sergeant Dornan?
translation: 多南中士是谁？

original: He was a drill instructor I knew. He was also the meanest bastard I've ever known.
translation: 他是我认识的一个教官。也是我这辈子见过的脾气最差的混蛋。

original: Once, he caught this private out of uniform and old Dornan went off on the most ear-blistering rant known to man. It was inspiring.
translation: 有一次，老多南抓到一个不穿制服的列兵，他那刺耳的怒吼声，真可谓前无古人后无来者。相当惊心动魄。

original: You sound like you're eager to die.
translation: 听你的话，好像你在一心求死。

original: There's a twitch in my trigger finger, I've lost my eagle eyes, and the other day I could've sworn I heard Sergeant {DOOR-nan}Dornan chewing me out.
translation: 我扣扳机的手指已经不听使唤，眼睛也不中用了，我发誓有一次我甚至听见多南中士在我耳边唠叨。

original: I'm old and I'm starting to feel it. It's not pleasant, especially when you know your mind's slipping away.
translation: 我老了，我能感觉到。太让人难受了，尤其你发现自己的的神智正在日益模糊。

original: We all gotta go sometime, but I was hoping for something a little more heroic.
translation: 我们总有一天会离开，但我希望自己能走得更壮烈一些。

original: How much money do you owe this Reaper guy?
translation: 你欠这个叫死神的家伙多少钱？

original: What? I was talking about Death, kid. Guess that one went right over your head, didn't it? Old Sergeant {DOOR-nan}Dornan would've had a field day with you.
translation: 什么？我们说的可是取人性命的死神啊，孩子。好像你根本就没在听吧？要是多南中士还在，肯定会给你颜色看的。

original: You were expecting someone else?
translation: 你在等谁？

original: "Oh?"
I've been in the Reaper's shadow for a long time now, and I thought he'd finally showed up to collect. He's just mocking me now.
translation: 我已经在死神的阴影下苟活了很久，我以为他终于要来向我讨债了。没想到他只是在嘲笑我。

original: I've been inside Nellis. There's a young man there who has a crush on you.
translation: 我曾到过内利斯。那儿有个少年喜欢你。

original: Nice-looking blonde boy? I always wondered if he was watching me back! What's he like?
translation: 那个帅气的金发男孩？我一直都在想他能不能看见我呢！他这个人怎么样？

original: No reason. I'll be off now.
translation: 不为什么。我要走了。

original: Alright then, goodbye.
translation: 好吧。再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Bye.
translation: 拜。

original: I don't suppose you watch the Boomers over in Nellis sometimes, do you?
translation: 你该不会有见过内利斯基地里的大炮族吧？

original: I watch all sorts of things with my binoculars. Who wants to know, and why?
translation: 我经常看望远镜，各种东西我都见过。谁让你来问这些的？有什么事？

original: I'm looking for a redheaded girl around here.
translation: 我要找一个红头发的女孩。

original: Do you know any redheads in these parts?
translation: 你知道这附近有红头发的人吗？

original: I'm looking for a redhead girl, do you know any around here?
translation: 我在找个红头发的女孩，你在附近见过她吗？

original: I can spare 4 more.
translation: 我可以再给你4个。

original: I can spare another.
translation: 我可以再给你一个。

original: Sorry to see you go so soon. Be sure to drink a Sunset Sarsaparilla for me!
translation: 这就走了吗，真教人遗憾哪。记得替我喝下一瓶夕阳沙士！

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'm sorry, I didn't quite understand that. Could you repeat it?
translation: 对不起，我没明白。能再说一遍吗？

original: Silly Ol' Advisory.
translation: 白痴佬顾问。

original: I'm sorry, I didn't quite understand that. Could you repeat it?
translation: 对不起，我没明白。能再说一遍吗？

original: Silly Ol' Advisory.
translation: 白痴佬顾问。

original: While Sunset Sarsaparilla is perfectly safe, a recent independent study - whose validity is currently being challenged - revealed the following:
translation: 尽管夕阳沙士完全不含任何有害物质，但最近一项仍有待检验的独立研究结果表明：

original: Excessive ingestion of sarsaparilla can lead to deleterious effects including, but not limited to:
translation: 过量饮用夕阳沙士可能会导致许多副作用，包括且不限于以下症状:

original: kidney damage,
translation: 肾损伤，

original: nausea,
translation: 恶心，

original: digital numbness,
translation: 手脚麻痹，

original: anxiety,
translation: 焦虑，

original: loss of visual acuity,
translation: 失明，

original: dizziness,
translation: 头晕，

original: occasional nosebleeds,
translation: 流鼻血，

original: joint inflammation,
translation: 关节发炎，

original: tooth decay,
translation: 蛀牙，

original: sore throat,
translation: 喉咙痛，

original: bronchitis,
translation: 支气管炎，

original: organ rupture,
translation: 脏器破裂，

original: and halitosis.
translation: 和口臭。

original: Note that you'd have to drink a heap of Sunset Sarsaparilla to match the quantities used in the study. How much, you ask?
translation: 请注意，只有大量饮用夕阳沙士，才有可能达到该研究所声称的过量标准。你问要多少？

original: A lot. A whole helluva lot. In fact, you'd have to get full as a tick on Sunset Sarsaparilla to even come close.
translation: 很多。非常多。事实上，即便你喝掉整整一箱的夕阳沙士，也不大可能会得病。

original: Anyway, thanks for stopping by, partner! And keep drinking Sunset Sarsaparilla!
translation: 无论如何，感谢您的光临，朋友！请继续畅饮夕阳沙士吧！

original: Silly Ol' Advisory.
translation: 白痴佬顾问。

original: Not yet, but I hope to very soon.
translation: 还没有，但是我想快了。

original: Okay, I'll be around.
translation: 好的，我会等着的。

original: I got a Boomer uniform for you to wear while you cross to Nellis.
translation: 我弄了一套大炮族的制服，穿着这个你就可以去内利斯了。

original: Well, with McLafferty dead, I guess my contract is done and I'm free to leave. I'm off to meet my admirer!
translation: 好吧，既然麦克拉弗蒂死了，我想我的合同也一笔勾销了。我要走了，我要去见我的爱慕者了！

original: There's one more thing. I have a work contract with the Crimson Caravan, and if I walk away, I lose the wages they owe me.
translation: 还有件事。我和深红商队还有工作合同，如果我离开，我就拿不到他们欠我的工资了。

original: Could you do just one more thing for me and talk to Alice McLafferty about it? I know if I do it, she'll just say no. I'd hate to lose the money.
translation: 你能再帮我个忙和爱丽丝·麦克拉弗蒂打声招呼吗？我知道如果我走掉的话，她肯定不会同意。我可不想把钱丢了。

original: He's doing well. I'll come back when I have some more information.
translation: 他近况很好。再有其他消息我会回来告诉你的。

original: Ok, talk to you soon.
translation: 好吧，回头再聊。

original: Actually, I wanted to talk to you about him again.
translation: 实际上，我想和你再谈谈他的事情。

original: I was hoping you would. What's going on?
translation: 正盼着呢。想说什么？

original: I was hoping you would. What's going on? Have they agreed to my safety yet?
translation: 正盼着呢。怎么样，他们同意保证我的安全了吗？

original: I doubt it.
translation: 我很怀疑。

original: Just my luck. I finally find the perfect guy, and he's a Boomer.
translation: 瞧我这运气。我终于找到了一位如意郎君，可他却是个大炮族。

original: I'll ask Pearl to make an exception for you.
translation: 我会求珀尔为你破次例。

original: This is so exciting! Let me know how it turns out.
translation: 太让我兴奋了！要是有结果记得告诉我啊。

original: I'm not sure. Let me think about it and I'll come back to you.
translation: 我不知道。我考虑考虑再回来告诉你。

original: Ok, let me know when you have an idea.
translation: 好吧，想出办法了再跟我说。

original: <Lie> You have permission. They know you're coming.
translation: <撒谎> 你可以通过，他们知道你会来。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Surprise}Really? Thank you so much! I'll get going right away.
translation: [成功] {Surprise}真的？太谢谢你了！我马上出发。

original: [FAILED] {Angry}Are you trying to get me killed? No way I'm going in there.
translation: [失败] {Angry}你想让我死吗？没门儿，我才不过去呢。

original: <Lie> Just wave your arms and run as fast as you can.
translation: <撒谎> 你只要一边挥手一边尽快跑过去就好了。

original: Let me see if I can get you safe passage past the artillery.
translation: 让我想想能让你安全穿过炮击区的办法。

original: He's a special sort of guy - perfect for a special sort of gal.
translation: 他是个很特别的小伙，对一位很特别的姑娘来说，简直是绝配。

original: Ooh, I've just got to meet him! Is there any way the Boomers would let me visit Nellis?
translation: 哦，我要去见他！有什么办法能让大炮族放我进内利斯吗？

original: He's a catch. You should see him blush when I flirt with him.
translation: 他可容易上钩了。你真该看看我调戏他的时候，他脸红成什么样子。

original: Well, you don't have to do that anymore! Sounds like I better hurry to him.
translation: 哎呀，我可不许你再做这种事了！看来我得赶紧去找他才行。

original: Any chance the Boomers would let me visit Nellis?
translation: 大炮族会放我进入内利斯基地吗？

original: He's nice, maybe a little naive. Seems convinced you're the love of his life.
translation: 挺好的，虽说有些孩子气。他似乎早就对你情有独钟了。

original: Really? That's so sweet!
translation: 真的吗？太棒了！

original: I'd love to go meet him. Is there any way the Boomers would let me visit Nellis?
translation: 我真想见见他。有没有什么办法能让大炮族放我进内利斯基地？

original: Is that thing silver?
translation: 那是银的么？

original: You're not getting paid to run your mouth.
translation: 我花钱雇你可不是要你动嘴皮子的。

original: So far you ain't paid us nothing!
translation: 到现在你还没付给我们一分钱呢！

original: You'll get your caps when the job's done!
translation: 等你们把事情办完就给钱！

original: Is this deep enough?
translation: 够深了么？

original: Yeah. Take that thing off.
translation: 行了，把眼罩摘下来。

original: Real shame you got caught up in this, kid. Must seem like bad luck.
translation: 很抱歉把你卷进来了，小子。你一定觉得自己很倒霉吧。

original: Truth is, game was rigged from the start.
translation: 可真相是，这场游戏的赢家从一开始就已经定了。

original: That the thing you were talking about?
translation: 你说的就是那个东西？

original: Beautiful, ain't it? It's platinum.
translation: 很美对不？是白金的。

original: Can't see shit out here.
translation: 连个屁都看不见。

original: Either way, you owe us.
translation: 反正，你还欠我们钱呢。

original: I told you, you'll get paid when we get there.
translation: 我说过了，事成以后就给你。

original: We just walked through hell, man.
translation: 咱们可是吃了相当大的苦头啊，兄弟。

original: What are you, dense? I don't got it here!
translation: 你脑子缺根筋吗？我现在身上没钱！

original: Hey. What do you want me to do with this?
translation: 嘿。那这家伙你打算怎么办？

original: Almost forgot. Take off the hood.
translation: 还真忘了。把罩子摘下来吧。

original: Well, kid, you're our last loose end.
translation: 好吧，小子，就剩你一个需要处置了。

original: Shame you had to get caught in the middle of all this. Bet you don't even know why you're here.
translation: 很遗憾把你也牵扯了进来。我看你连为啥会在这里都不明白吧。

original: But hey, if it makes you feel any better, it's nothing personal.
translation: 不过，为了让你走得舒坦些，我可以告诉你，这不是个人恩怨。

original: Just bad luck.
translation: 只是你点儿太背了。

original: Well we're not going back north. We're lucky to be alive.
translation: 我们不回北方了。能活着就已经很幸运了。

original: How the hell else are we supposed to get back, genius?
translation: 那我们该怎么回去啊，天才？

original: We go east. Take the 95.
translation: 我们往东。走95号大道。

original: East? Are you nuts? That'll take us days out of our way.
translation: 往东？你傻了？这得多走好几天路程呢。

original: Then you can just go back by yourself.
translation: 不喜欢的话你可以自己一个人回去。

original: Fine. Anything to get you two to shut up.
translation: 够了。你们俩还是闭嘴吧。

original: I'll take it.
translation: 我接了。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Have you talked to your superior officer?
translation: 你和你的上司谈过了吗？

original: How are you going to get rid of her?
translation: 你打算怎么摆脱她？

original: What are you going to do about Harcourt?
translation: 你打算对哈科特做什么？

original: Or she's just lucky.
translation: 或者其实她就是走狗屎运而已。

original: I could take of Harcourt. What are you offering?
translation: 我可以对付哈科特。你开什么条件？

original: I think you're overreacting.
translation: 我觉得你有点反应过度了。

original: Is that going happen soon? I'd like to be around to loot your corpses.
translation: 你们什么时候打架啊？我很期待为你们收尸。

original: What are you talking about?
translation: 你说什么呢？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'm sure the casinos of New Vegas love you.
translation: 我敢说，新维加斯的赌场肯定爱死你了。

original: You put on a brave face, but I can tell that it bothers you, just a bit.
translation: 虽然你装得很勇敢，但我敢说其实你还是有点苦恼的吧。

original: That has to bother you, right?
translation: 搞得你很烦，对吧？

original: Why do the other soldiers think you're a jinx?
translation: 为什么其他士兵都觉得你是个扫把星？

original: I take it you're some kind of jinx?
translation: 意思说你是个扫把星？

original: Uh, what?
translation: 呃，什么？

original: Right. Biggs mentioned you.
translation: 对了。比吉斯提到过你。

original: I win more than my fair share of coin tosses. How is that a bad thing?
translation: 我可是赢了不少呢。怎么会是坏事呢？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I think a man would be very lucky indeed to catch you.
translation: 我觉得，谁要能抓到你，那真是太走运了。

original: Of course it would. I'll have you set up with some quarters with some of the other women.
translation: 当然会的。我会给你找个住的地方，就和其他姑娘住一起吧。

original: And you're even more handsome up close. Do you think it'll be okay if I hang around here for a little while, so we can get to know each other better?
translation: 近了看你更帅了。我能不能在这儿多呆一会儿，好让咱俩有机会多了解一下对方呢？

original: I'm glad that you made it out here. You're even more stunning up close than you were at a distance.
translation: 很高兴你能来。虽然远看也很美，但近了看，你可更加显得迷人了。

original: Hi there, it is great to meet you as well.
translation: 嘿，你好，我也很高兴能见到你。

original: Let's talk about something else
translation: 我们来说点别的。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Howdy, pardner! Fine evening, ain't it?
translation: 你好啊，伙计！美丽的夜晚，不是吗？

original: Friend, you look like you could use a sarsaparilla.
translation: 朋友，你看起来似乎需要来一瓶沙士啊。

original: Howdy, pardner! Sure is one fine evening, ain't it?
translation: 你好啊，伙计！这夜晚真是美极了，不是吗？

original: Gimme your hand, pardner. Let's get you out of there.
translation: 把手给我，伙计。我来拉你出来。

original: You okay, pardner? You look like you could use a sarsaparilla.
translation: 你还好吧，朋友？你看起来需要来一瓶沙士。

original: So what do you do now that the fighting's died down?
translation: 那么，没有战斗的时候你都在做些什么？

original: Mostly drill the troops, try to keep the discipline up and combat readiness high.
translation: 多数时候在训练士兵，维持纪律，确保部队的战斗力。

original: It's not the easiest job in the world - soldiers without a mission get bored very easily.
translation: 这不是一份简单的差事，没有接到任务指派的士兵很容易就会变得无所事事。

original: Still, with the Legion just across the river, we have to be ready.
translation: 而军团却一直在河对岸虎视眈眈，我们必须时刻做好准备。

original: Funny, I thought this was where they sent washouts and losers.
translation: 有趣，我还以为这地方全都是一些部队里不要的饭桶和窝囊废呢。

original: Yeah, well, somebody has to wrangle those washouts and losers. Somebody's got to turn them into a real fighting force.
translation: 是啊，但总得有人管着这群饭桶和窝囊废吧。总得有人把他们训练成真正的战士。

original: That's some dedication.
translation: 很有敬业精神嘛。

original: Thanks. I only wish some of the soldiers under my command would share some of it.
translation: 谢谢，我只希望我手下的几个士兵也能有我这样的觉悟。

original: You joined at 16 and you're still a sergeant?
translation: 你16岁入伍，现在还只是个中士？

original: Yeah, well... I didn't want to get promoted out of the field. I didn't join up to drive a desk.
translation: 呃，是啊……我本来是想在战场上建功立业的，我当兵不是为了坐办公室的。

original: Well, maybe if you tried to lead by example instead of tearing them down.
translation: 我觉得如果你能以身作则，总比这样叫苦连天好。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You really think so? Hell, I guess it's worth a shot.
translation: [成功] 你真的那么想？见鬼，那我可得试试。

original: [FAILED] Yeah, right. You think Poindexter doesn't have a dozen of his crazy practical jokes all lined up if I try that?
translation: [失败] 是，很对，我要是真那么干，你信不信波因德克斯特会把我往死里整？

original: I like my underwear to *not* be full of radioactive itching powder, thanks.
translation: 我可不想看到自己内衣上沾满了会让人浑身发痒的辐射尘，谢谢。

original: This place doesn't seem so bad.
translation: 这地方也不算太糟嘛。

original: Please. Camp Golf is where they shuffle off anybody they don't want any more. Assignment here is a career ender.
translation: 拜托，高尔夫营地就是个垃圾场。如果你被他们送到这儿来，那你的军旅生涯就算完蛋了。

original: How come you didn't make it into the Rangers?
translation: 你怎么没进入游骑兵部队？

original: Gee, I dunno, maybe because I'm saddled with the worst damn unit in the NCR Army? Think that might have something to do with it?
translation: 哎，我也不知道，大概因为我手上这支队伍在NCR全军中排名倒数第一吧？你觉得会不会和这有点关系？

original: Sounds like you're a little disappointed in your troops.
translation: 听起来你对你的士兵有些失望。

original: Disappointed? We call 'em the Misfits for a reason. They're undisciplined, lazy, and they have absolutely no espirit de corps.
translation: 失望？大家管他们叫后进生，这个绰号可不是白叫的。他们目无纪律、慵懒涣散，而且丝毫没有团队精神。

original: The squad leader's got some promise, kid named Mags, but as for the rest...{Trails off} I don't see much hope.
translation: 那个叫玛格丝的人是他们的队长，还算有点潜力。至于其他人嘛……{Trails off}我不抱多大期望。

original: I'm going to make them shape up if it kills me, though. Or them, for that matter.
translation: 就算把我累死，也得把这队伍整出点样子来。否则到时候，死的就是他们。

original: How'd you end up at Camp Golf?
translation: 你怎么来到高尔夫营地的？

original: I've been here since the first push into Vegas. Back in the day, this camp was the hotspot for conflicts with the Legion, raider tribes, you name it.
translation: 我是跟随NCR的先头部队来到维加斯的。那时候，这个营区还是兵家必争之地，军团、掠夺者之流经常和我们在这儿发生冲突。

original: These days, I spend most of my time trying to beat a little discipline into the soldiers under my command. They've gotten soft with no action.
translation: 可现在，我却得把大部分时间都拿来教训手底下这群孬兵。他们不仅胆小，还没用。

original: How do you like serving in the Army?
translation: 在军队里服役的感觉怎么样？

original: Man, it's my life. I joined up when I was 16 - I don't know how to do anything else.
translation: 老天，我可是当大半辈子兵啊。我16岁就参了军，除了当兵，我都不知道自己还能做什么。

original: Good news - Sgt. McCredie's canceled the combat patrol.
translation: 好消息，麦克雷迪军士取消了作战巡逻。

original: Sgt. McCredie asked me to talk to you about getting your squad in shape.
translation: 麦克雷迪军士派我来和你商量该怎么整顿你的小队。

original: Thanks to you, I think we're in good shape. The squad seems to be functioning much better as a unit now.
translation: 多亏了你，我觉得我们状态不错。感觉队伍比以前更团结了。

original: How's the squad doing?
translation: 你的小队现在怎样？

original: He did, huh? Well, good luck with that. You'd have an easier time teaching radroaches to march in formation.
translation: 他真这么说的？嚯，那可祝你好运咯。这比训练蟑螂齐步走还难。

original: Hoo-hoo! Hot damn, it's gonna be a party in the camp tonight!
translation: 呜——呼！太屌了，今晚要在营地里开派对！

original: I got you the stuff.
translation: 我拿到你要的东西了。

original: Yo, I'll tell you what this squad needs. A healthy dose of angry juice.
translation: 哟，我告诉你这小队真正需要什么。他们需要来针兴奋剂。

original: You actually did it? My friend, I am without doubt a genius, but I must say, you've given me a run for my money. Bravo. Bravo.
translation: 你真的做到了？朋友，虽然我是个不折不扣的天才，但我今天也算花钱长见识了。棒极了。棒极了。

original: I think you'll find that the Misfits' records are now much improved.
translation: 你会发现这些后进生的成绩如今好多了。

original: That seems highly illogical. What reason would he have for doing that?
translation: 这感觉很不合逻辑啊。他这么做有什么理由呢？

original: Boy, the squad sure is working together a lot better now! I think we're gonna be A-Okay!
translation: 小队现在可团结了！我们肯定没问题的！

original: How's that human niceness working out?
translation: 提高人情味有用吗？

original: To me? Well, I'll tell you what I think this squad needs: a little more basic human niceness.
translation: 你问我？我告诉你这小队真正需要什么：他们需要一点点人情味。

original: It helped, but we've still got a grenade range inspection to pass.
translation: 有点帮助，但我们还必须通过手雷投掷考试。

original: So, did the shooting range practice take care of things?
translation: 打靶射击这招管用了吗？

original: It really, really didn't.
translation: 真的，真的没用。

original: So, did the shooting range practice take care of things?
translation: 打靶射击这招管用了吗？

original: Not even a little bit, no.
translation: 没用就是没用。

original: So, did the grenade range practice take care of things?
translation: 扔手榴弹练习这招管用吗？

original: Yeah, what about it? I told you, we need marksmanship and explosive handling improvements.
translation: 怎么样？我跟你说过，我们需要射击以及爆破练习。

original: So, about those improvements....
translation: 关于整顿队伍这件事……

original: Like I said, you get the juice, we'll cut loose.
translation: 我说了，只要你搞到药，我们天王老子都不怕。

original: About getting the squad's readiness reports up....
translation: 关于提高队伍成绩这件事……

original: And what do you propose?
translation: 那你有什么主意？

original: Going back to those squad improvements, I had an idea.
translation: 关于提高小队作战能力这方面，我倒有个点子。

original: You did? Does that mean you're going to help?
translation: 是吗？那么说你愿意帮忙了？

original: I thought about what you said about basic human niceness.
translation: 我想了想你所说的人情味这件事。

original: Sounds like you aren't too fond of your squadmates.
translation: 听起来你对你的队友们没什么好感。

original: Yeah. I mean, no, they're okay people, but they don't care, y'know? They don't have any ambition. No drive.
translation: 是啊…不，也不全对，他们人挺好的，就是不用心，懂吗？他们没有目标。缺乏动力。

original: They're slacking off, and that reflects badly on me.
translation: 他们经常偷懒，这样给我的影响很不好。

original: Tell me a little about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你的经历。

original: Not much to tell, really. I grew up in New Reno, joined up, took my shot at being a Ranger. Didn't make it, so I'm stuck with this crew of jokers.
translation: 其实没什么好说的，我在新里诺长大，后来参了军，想做游骑兵，没成功，只好沦落到这儿来和一群废物作伴咯。

original: How'd you end up assigned to Camp Golf?
translation: 你怎么被调到高尔夫营地的？

original: Easy - this is where they send all the fuck-ups and people they don't want. But hey, it's not like I'm bitter or anything.
translation: 很简单——凡是脑子有病或是没用的人，都会被送到这儿来。嘿，我可没有怀恨在心哦。

original: Why'd you join the Army?
translation: 你为什么参军？

original: I guess I wanted to make something of myself, you know? Be the best of the best. I *wanted* to be a ranger, but... guess this is as close as I get.
translation: 大概是想干出一番事业吧，想出人头地，成为一名游骑兵，不过……估计我的能力也就这样了。

original: Know anything about your squadmates?
translation: 知道你战友的事么？

original: We don't talk too much, mostly. Poindexter's a smartass prick.
translation: 我们交流不多。波因德克斯特这小子脑袋挺好用。

original: O'Hanrahan's a big pussy, ain't good for shit in a fight, and Mags... well, Mags is cut out for something other than soldiering, you dig?
translation: 奥汉纳汉是个孬种，打架也是一塌糊涂，玛格丝么…怎么说呢，除了打仗之外，别的都还可以，你懂么？

original: So, what's your story?
translation: 那，你的身世是怎样的？

original: Ain't much to tell. Grew up out west, in the Boneyard. Heard of it?
translation: 没啥可说的。我在西部长大，埋骨地。听说过么？

original: Yeah, not many people have. Wasn't really a good place for kids, you know? I joined up to get out. My family's still back there.
translation: 嗯，应该没什么人听过。对孩子来说可不是什么好地方。我参军了之后就没回去过。我的家人还在那边呢。

original: Can you tell me anything about Camp Golf?
translation: 你对高尔夫营地有什么了解？

original: What you want to know? Whole place used to be some kinda rich bastard resort, back before the war.
translation: 你想知道什么？这破地方在战争爆发前可是个给专供富佬们使用的度假胜地。

original: Now the Rangers use the old resort, and we grunts get to live in tents. Fucking typical.
translation: 现在那些旧宅子都给游骑兵占去了，而我们这些兵卒子就只能睡帐篷。真他妈可以。

original: Why are you in the Army?
translation: 为什么参军？

original: Shit, man, it was this or the Fiends, and Fiends don't last too long in the NCR.
translation: 你说呢，哥们，不参军就只能投靠恶魔帮了。而恶魔帮在NCR面前根本不堪一击。

original: At least this way the badasses with the top-shelf guns are on my side.
translation: 至少NCR还有好多狠角色和顶尖武器，跟着他们不会有错的。

original: Shit, honey, it was this or the Fiends, and Fiends don't last too long in the NCR.
translation: 你说呢，妹子，不参军就只能投靠恶魔帮了。而恶魔帮在NCR面前根本不堪一击。

original: At least this way the badasses with the top-shelf guns are on my side.
translation: 至少NCR还有那么些狠角色和顶尖武器，跟着他们不会有错的。

original: What do you think of Camp Golf?
translation: 你觉得高尔夫营地怎么样？

original: Oh, it's a fine place. The lake is real {purty}pretty, and we don't get bothered much by them Legion fellers.
translation: 噢，地方不错。这里的湖水真是{purty}漂亮，而且我们不太会受到军团的骚扰。

original: How'd you end up in the Army?
translation: 你怎么会决定参军呢？

original: Well, as it turns out, we had a string of bad harvests a few years back. Pa said he couldn't afford to feed but three youngins, or we'd starve.
translation: 嗯，说到原因，当年我们家的收成很不好。爸爸说他养不活三个孩子，我们迟早会饿死。

original: As the biggest one it was my job to go join the Army so's my sisters could eat and so's we wouldn't all be killed by raiders and Jesus would love us.
translation: 作为家中的长子，为了让妹妹吃饱，为了让全家不受掠夺者袭击…也为了耶稣能爱护我们，我就毅然参了军。

original: It's all right, I guess. I don't like all the fighting we gotta do, though.
translation: 其实也还好吧。虽然我并不喜欢打仗。

original: Can you tell me about your squadmates?
translation: 你能和我谈谈你的小队吗？

original: They're mostly pretty nice - Poindexter showed me how to make fireworks! Razz kinda scares me sometimes, but I don't mind. He's had a hard life.
translation: 他们人都很好——波因德克斯特还教我做鞭炮！拉兹有时会吓唬我，但我不介意。他的日子过得很苦。

original: Why are you so afraid of fighting?
translation: 你为什么这么害怕打仗？

original: I ain't scared! I just don't like hurting folks, is all. Ma always used to tell me "boy, you're the biggest and the strongest, so you mind yourself!"
translation: 我并不是害怕！我只是不喜欢伤害别人，仅此而已。妈妈总告诉我，"孩子，你个头最高，身体最壮，所以你得管好自己！"

original: Every day she told me that. Guess I done took it to heart.
translation: 她每天都这么说。估计这话已经深入我心了。

original: Tell me a little more about yourself.
translation: 再和我谈谈你自己吧。

original: Well, I was born on a farm out in California. Weren't much - me, Ma and Pa, my two sisters and about 40 acres of corn and brahmin.
translation: 好吧，我出生在加利福尼亚边界附近的一座农场里。家中人数不多——我，妈妈，爸爸和我的两个妹妹。种了四十亩玉米，养了些双头牛。

original: Didn't never have no problems really, except for some lean years. Then I joined up and got shipped out here to New Vegas.
translation: 家中境况还算过得去，但遭了几次荒年后就不太好了。于是我决定参军，然后被派到了新维加斯。

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: To what purpose? It's highly unlikely you'd understand anything I'd say.
translation: 为了什么？我觉得你不大可能会理解我。

original: Suffice to say I'm a certified genius, and when I'm discharged from this pit of testosterone and failure, I'll have all the money I could ever need.
translation: 毫不夸张地说，我是个公认的天才，等我离开这个鸟不拉屎又没前途的鬼地方，我就能赚到一大笔花不完的钱了。

original: Are you in charge around here?
translation: 你是这儿的负责人吗？

original: In a strictly official capacity, no.
translation: 严格意义上说，不是。

original: However, as I am by far the most intelligent and resourceful figure on this base, I feel it's safe to say the soldiers here look up to me.
translation: 但作为这个基地里最聪明最机灵的人，我可以很负责任地告诉你，这里的士兵都敬仰我。

original: How'd a guy like you end up in the Army?
translation: 像你这样的人怎么会混在军队里头的？

original: It's a simple idea: the Army offers fiscal security and generous benefits at the cost of substantial personal risk - if you're on the front line.
translation: 道理很简单，军队为了鼓励士兵奋勇作战，会提供相当优渥的待遇和犒赏，但前提是我们必须得上前线。

original: If you perform too poorly, they'll scrub you out. Perform too well, and you get sent to the front lines.
translation: 如果你表现太差，他们会把你踢出去。可要是表现太好，你就会被送去前线吃枪子。

original: All I have to do is ride that mediocrity gradient to a cushy, do-nothing job miles away from the war.
translation: 所以我只要当一个碌碌无为的平庸之辈，就能躲在战场后方，讨个闲职吃空饷。

original: No.
translation: 不。

original: I'll do what I can.
translation: 我会尽力的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: You seem distressed.  Is something going on?
translation: 你看起来很难过。发生什么了？

original: You appear to require assistance. I'll go find someone.
translation: 你似乎需要帮助。我会去找人的。

original: So the fact we're having this conversation means you failed, right?
translation: 所以现在我能和你说话，就意味着你已经失职了，对吗？

original: I wasn't the one firing the howitzers. If you want to see how good I am at killing savages, I can show you.
translation: 我不是榴弹炮手，谈不上失职。如果你想了解我对付野蛮人的手段，我倒是可以让你见识一番。

original: Or you can accept Mother Pearl's invitation. It's your choice.
translation: 或者你也可以接受珀尔妈妈的邀请。你自己选择吧。

original: What's a Master-At-Arms?
translation: 警卫长是什么职务？

original: I oversee the security of the Nellis homeland, from the coordination of its defenses to the training and fitness of its population.
translation: 我负责内利斯的安保工作，除了协调防卫体系，还要训练居民们的体格。

original: All right. Lead the way.
translation: 好。带路吧。

original: Follow close - and mind your behavior.
translation: 跟紧了——还有，注意你的举止。

original: Do you really think I'm scared of a punk like you?
translation: 你真以为我会怕你这样的小痞子吗？

original: Watch your mouth, savage! Raquel'll be here any second...
translation: 管好你的臭嘴，野蛮人！拉奎尔马上就来了……

original: Can we move this along?
translation: 就不能放我过去吗？

original: I said stay where you are! Raquel'll be here any second...
translation: 我说过了待在那别动！拉奎尔马上就过来了……

original: I didn't come here to attack you.
translation: 我不是来袭击你的。

original: Then just - just stay where you are! Raquel'll be here any second...
translation: 那就——那就待在那别动！拉奎尔马上就过来了……

original: Sorry, son. I fixed up your head as best I knew how. I guess I missed a spot.
translation: 对不起，小伙子。虽然我已经尽力想把你的脑袋治好，但我好像还是忘了点什么。

original: Sorry, little lady. I fixed up your head as best I knew how. Guess I missed a spot.
translation: 对不起，小姑娘。虽然我已经尽力想把你的脑袋治好了，但我好像还是忘了点什么。

original: Look at that. Maybe them bullets done your brain some good.
translation: 你瞧。或许那一发子弹还让你脑袋开窍了呢。

original: Now that don't make a lick of sense. Seems to me you're the luckiest son-of-a-gun in New Vegas.
translation: 完全没道理啊。你简直称得上是新维加斯最幸运的小子了。

original: With luck like yours I'm surprised them bullets didn't just turn right around and climb back into the gun.
translation: 以你这样的运气，我都怀疑他们打出来的子弹是不是又掉个头爬回枪管里去了。

original: That's some serious atrophy, even for someone who's been in bed awhile. It's a wonder you can move at all.
translation: 即便对那些长期卧床的病人来说，这也是相当严重的器官萎缩。你还能动真是一个奇迹。

original: Surprised anybody'd want to tangle with you. Heck, you could go Deathclaw hunting with a switch.
translation: 居然还有人敢惹你，真是奇怪。见鬼，我看你完全你可以带上鞭子去捕猎死亡爪了。

original: I just don't get it. A stiff breeze'd tear you in two but a couple of bullets and you're right as rain.
translation: 我实在不明白。一阵轻风刮过就能把你撕成两半，但一梭子弹飞过去后，你居然还能活着。

original: I guess that explains how you're still alive. You're built solid as an oak.
translation: 我想这可以解释你为什么还活着了。你就像棵橡木一样结实。

original: Huh. Must be some frontal lobe damage.
translation: 嗯。一定是某块前额脑叶受到了损伤。

original: Good to see them bullets didn't affect your charm none.
translation: 很高兴他们的子弹没有影响到你的魅力。

original: Now I ain't no optometrist, but maybe we should fit you for some glasses while you're here.
translation: 我不是验光师，但或许我们应该趁你还在这儿的时候，给你配副眼镜。

original: Nothing gets by you, huh? Coulda used you when I lost my keys last month.
translation: 什么都逃不过你的眼睛，是吗？早知道上个月我丢钥匙的时候，就应该去找你的。

original: Don't have all your coordination back yet, looks like. You should think about doing some rehab.
translation: 看起来，你的肌肉协调能力还没有完全恢复。你应该考虑做些复健运动。

original: Most patients don't get out of bed after being shot and then move like they was in perfect control. You're unusual, I'll say that.
translation: 大部分被子弹射伤的病人就没能再下过床，更别说活蹦乱跳了。你的确不同寻常，我必须承认。

original: Yep, that's a pretty standard score there. But after what you been through, I'd say that's great news.
translation: 是啊，正常人都是这个标准。不过考虑到你经历的那些事，我得说你真的福大命大。

original: You're awake. How about that.
translation: 你醒了。感觉怎么样？

original: Whoa, easy there. Easy. You been out cold a couple of days now.
translation: 哇哦，放松点。放松。你已经昏迷好些天了。

original: Why don't you just relax a second? Get your bearings.
translation: 为什么不稍微喘一口气呢？恢复下精神。

original: Let's see what the damage is. How about your name? Can you tell me your name?
translation: 来看看你究竟伤得有多重吧。你叫什么名字？能告诉我吗？

original: Huh. Can't say it's what I'd have picked for you. But if that's your name, that's your name.
translation: 哈。换我可不会给你起这个名字。不过既然你这么说了，那就当它是你的名字吧。

original: I'm Doc Mitchell. Welcome to Goodsprings.
translation: 我是米切尔医生。欢迎来到清泉镇。

original: Now, I hope you don't mind, but I had to go rooting around there in your noggin to pull all the bits of lead out.
translation: 希望你不要介意。我已经把你的脑子翻了个底朝天，把所有能找到的弹片都清了出去。

original: I take pride in my needlework, but you'd better tell me if I left anything out of place.
translation: 虽然我对自己的缝合技巧很有自信，但为了以防万一，还是请你检查一下自己的脸蛋吧。

original: How'd I do?
translation: 手术效果怎么样？

original: Well, I got most of it right, anyway. Stuff that mattered.
translation: 嗯，看样子还算比较成功。至少关键部分没问题。

original: Okay. No sense keeping you in bed anymore. Let's see if we can get you on your feet.
translation: 好了。你也不必再呆在床上了。让我们看看你能否站得起来吧。

original: Good. Why don't you walk down to the end of the room? Over by that vigor tester machine there.
translation: 很好。为什么不试试走到房间另一头去呢？就走到那台活力检测机旁吧。

original: Take it slow now. It ain't a race.
translation: 不用着急。我可没有让你赛跑。

original: Looking good so far. Go ahead and give the vigor tester a try. We'll learn right quick if you got back all your faculties.
translation: 目前看来情况不错。来试用一下这台活力检测机吧，我们马上就能知道你的身体机能恢复得如何了。

original: Let's go into the next room. I've got a few more tests I'd like to run.
translation: 让我们去隔壁房间吧。我还要再做几项检查。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Keep your gun handy if you go poking around some of the abandoned places around here, like the schoolhouse.
translation: 如果你要去探索周边的废弃地区，比如校舍，一定要拿好你的枪。

original: Wasteland critters like to move in when Sunny's not looking, so watch out.
translation: 桑妮只要一不留神，就会有废土畜生溜进来，所以小心点。

original: Yup.
translation: 是。

original: How hard can it be? Just light them and throw.
translation: 能有多难啊？点燃扔出去就是了。

original: [FAILED] Too dangerous, sorry. Blow yourself up, blow your neighbor up, blow the whole town up.
translation: [失败] 太危险了，抱歉。你那样不仅会把自己炸飞，还会把旁边的人也炸飞，把整个镇子都炸飞。

original: I'm familiar with the care and handling of explosives, dynamite included.
translation: 我熟悉正确使用各种爆炸物的方法，包括炸药。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Uh huh. Guess you know what you're doing. I'll go dig it up and get it ready. You'll have it by the time the fighting starts.
translation: [成功] 啊哈。看来你确实懂点行。我会把它挖出来，拾掇好的。等战斗打响了就交给你。

original: I hear you've got dynamite. It would help us beat the powder gangers.
translation: 我听说你这儿有炸药。那玩意可以帮我们痛打炸药帮。

original: Too dangerous. Gonna kill all yourselves if I let you touch it. Better to leave it buried - safer that way.
translation: 那太危险了。要是我让你碰它，恐怕会害死所有人的。还是继续埋着吧——那样最安全。

original: Told you before - it's too dangerous for a bunch of amateurs to handle.
translation: 我跟你说过了吧——让业余的人来处理太危险了。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Right. Just keep me out of it. Is there anything else?
translation: 对。别把我扯进去就行。还有别的事吗？

original: The town's at stake. That has to be worth more than a few supplies.
translation: 镇子已经到危机关头。那一点货物又算什么？

original: [FAILED] Look, you're bringing this on yourselves. There's no way I'm getting involved. But, hey, I'm sure you can buy what you need...
translation: [失败] 听着，这事你们自行解决就好。我是绝对不会掺合的。但是，嘿，我保证你可以花钱买到需要的东西……

original: Let them take over the town, then. I'm sure your business will be much better off.
translation: 那就让他们接管这个镇子吧。我相信你的生意会好很多的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You made your point. I can provide people with some leather armor and extra ammo. I sure hope it's worth it.
translation: [成功] 你说得有道理。我可以提供一些皮甲和额外的弹药。真希望这一切都值得。

original: And, uh, I'll be guarding the store while all this is going on. I have to put my business first, you understand.
translation: 另外，呃，你们如果打起来了，我要守着我的店。毕竟我得把生意放在第一位，你明白的。

original: I need supplies to fight the Powder Gangers.
translation: 我需要补给物资来对付炸药帮。

original: Now just hold on. I never voted to take on the Powder Gangers. That's a thousand cap investment you're talking about.
translation: 等等。我从来都不赞成和炸药帮硬碰硬。何况你说的还是一笔事关1000瓶盖的投资。

original: This again? Like I said, I'm against taking on the Powder Gangers. My supplies aren't cheap, you know.
translation: 又来了？我之前不是说了，我不想和炸药帮作对。我这儿的货可不便宜，你懂的。

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: Oh, sorry. I thought everybody knew already. I'm a trader with the Crimson Caravan Company.
translation: 噢，抱歉。我还以为大家都知道呢。我是深红商队公司的一名商人。

original: I'm, uh, staying in town for a bit.
translation: 我打算，呃，在镇里呆一段时间。

original: Like I said, I'm not from Goodsprings. I'm a trader with the Crimson Caravan Company.
translation: 我之前说过，我不是清泉镇本地人。我是深红商队公司下属的商人。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Take it easy now.
translation: 随便瞧。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: I respect the way you've conducted yourself around here. Reminds me of myself in some ways.
translation: 我很佩服你在这里的处事方式。某些方面让我想起了以前的自己。

original: From now on, you want to buy from Chet's, I'll give you wholesale prices.
translation: 从现在起，只要你想从我切特手里买东西，我都会给你批发价。

original: Can do.
translation: 可以。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: {Positive Rep Bonus}Got a special discount for you, after what you done for us.
translation: {Positive Rep Bonus}你帮了我们这么多，我会给你打个特别折扣。

original: I'm sure I've got something you'll like.
translation: 我保证有你喜欢的东西。

original: What are you going to do?
translation: 你们打算怎么办？

original: Some of the others, like Sunny, will probably stand up for Ringo if he asks for help, which he hasn't.
translation: 我觉得如果林戈向我们求助，那其他一些人，比如桑妮，可能会帮助他，但他到现在也没有向我们开口。

original: Personally, I hope he sneaks out of town one night and takes the Powder Gangers with him.
translation: 就我个人而言，我倒是希望他能找一天晚上偷偷溜出镇子，把炸药帮的人都引走。

original: Why not just kill Cobb and be done with it?
translation: 为什么不干脆直接杀了科布？

original: You mean murder him? That's not our way, even if Cobb is scum. He can bluster and threaten all he wants.
translation: 你说杀人？我们不这样办事，虽然科布确实是个人渣。他爱怎么瞎吼乱叫都随他去。

original: Where is Ringo now?
translation: 林戈现在在哪？

original: He's holed up at the abandoned gas station up the hill.
translation: 他藏在小丘上的废弃加油站里。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Be careful out there.
translation: 在外面要小心。

original: I overheard your argument. What was that all about?
translation: 我听到你们吵架了。怎么回事？

original: It looks like our little town got itself dragged into the middle of something we don't want anything to do with.
translation: 看来我们的这个小镇已经被卷进了一场人人都避之不及的风波里。

original: About a week ago, this trader, Ringo, comes into town. Survivor of an attack, he says. Bad men after him, needs a place to hide.
translation: 大概一周前，有个叫林戈的商人来到镇上。他说被人袭击了，有坏人在追他，需要找个地方躲一躲。

original: We figured he was just in shock, so we gave him a place to lie low. We didn't actually expect anyone to come after him.
translation: 我们觉得他可能是吓坏了，所以就给他安排了个地方藏身。没想到还真有人追着他来了。

original: What was that you said about Ringo?
translation: 你之前说的林戈是怎么回事？

original: He's some trader who decided he'd rather shoot than pay the toll for being in our territory. He's hiding somewhere in town.
translation: 他是个宁可吃枪子都不愿意付过路钱的狗屁商人。现在就藏在镇上的某个地方。

original: Would serve these idiots right if me and my guys shot the place up after we got payback on Ringo.
translation: 等我们收拾了林戈，再来好好教训这些白痴。

original: Why are the Powder Gangers out to get you?
translation: 为什么炸药帮要找你？

original: My caravan was on the return trip from California and heading back up to the company branch in New Vegas when we got jumped.
translation: 我的商队在从加州返回新维加斯分部的途中遭遇了伏击。

original: Not even a "drop your weapons and hands up" before the bullets started flying. We put up a good fight, but there was too many of them.
translation: 连句"放下武器，举起手来"都没有，子弹就开始乱飞。我们打得不错，但他们人太多了。

original: I took a few of the bandits down before I ran, so I figure their friends are out for revenge.
translation: 我逃跑以前放倒了好几个掠夺者，所以他们的朋友估计是想来报复我吧。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Uh huh.
translation: 呃嗯。

original: That's... helpful.
translation: 这……还挺有用的。

original: Welcome.
translation: 欢迎。

original: What do you know about Joe Cobb?
translation: 关于乔·科布你知道些什么？

original: Bad trouble.
translation: 一个大麻烦。

original: What do you know about the situation with the Powder Gangers?
translation: 关于炸药帮与镇子的纠纷你都知道些什么？

original: If Ringo doesn't head out on his own, I think we should hand him over. The town shouldn't get itself mixed into the problem.
translation: 如果林戈不主动离开的话，我觉得我们应该把他交出去。这个镇子真的经不起折腾了。

original: Don't mistake that for coward talk, though. We're a town of survivors, and we'll fight tooth and nail if pushed, but we don't go looking for trouble.
translation: 不过你可别误会，我们并不是软弱。这镇上的人也都是经历过风雨的，迫不得已的话我们会反抗到底，我们只是不想惹麻烦。

original: Did you know there's a man named Joe Cobb looking for you?
translation: 你知道这里有个叫乔·科布的人在找你吗？

original: Yeah. He doesn't look very tough, though. I hear he's afraid I'll shoot him down from one of the windows when I see him, and he's right.
translation: 知道。但他看起来并不怎么厉害。我听说他很害怕我看见他的时候会一枪爆了他的头，他怕得对。

original: I'll have a much bigger problem once his friends show up. There's no way I could handle all of them in a gunfight.
translation: 但如果他的朋友也跟着来了，那麻烦就比较大了。我可没办法靠着一把枪解决他们所有人。

original: I'm done being nice. If you don't hand Ringo over soon, I'm going to get my friends and we're burning this town to the ground, got it?
translation: 我懒得再和你说好话了。如果你不马上交出林戈，我就叫上朋友把这镇子烧成灰，明白了吗？

original: I haven't talked to her yet.
translation: 我还没和她谈。

original: Oh. Well, I don't want to make a move until she's with us.
translation: 噢。好吧，在她加入我们之前，我是不会轻举妄动的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Try to hurry.
translation: 抓紧。

original: Sunny's with us.
translation: 桑妮会跟我们一起战斗。

original: Well, I guess that means we're ready to go. Unless you think there's something else you can do?
translation: 很好，那这样咱们应该就能行动了。除非你觉得还有其他事情要做的？

original: How can I get Easy Pete's dynamite?
translation: 我要怎么才能得到轻松皮特的炸药？

original: Easy Pete's pretty protective of his dynamite. You'd have to convince him you know a thing or two about explosives before he handed it over.
translation: 轻松皮特非常爱惜他的炸药。你必须让他相信你懂点爆破技术，他才会把炸药分给你。

original: Any ideas on how to convince Trudy to join us?
translation: 有什么好办法能说服特鲁迪加入我们吗？

original: A silver tongue would help. Convincing Trudy that we had a good plan to win the fight would also help.
translation: 口才好就行了。最好能用一个可行的方案打动他，这样比较管用。

original: We might die horribly. Well, maybe not me.
translation: 我们可能都会悲惨地死去。好吧，可能我不会。

original: That's inspiring. You might want to keep your optimism to yourself if you try to recruit anyone else.
translation: 这话倒是挺振奋人心的嘛。如果你想请其他人来帮忙，那你最好先把这种乐观藏在心里。

original: Just like that?
translation: 就这样？

original: Just like that. I have a feeling that I'm going to end up fighting those guys one way or another, so I might as well get it over with.
translation: 就这样。我一直有种感觉，我迟早会和那帮家伙打起来。所以还不如早动手的好。

original: Well, that was easy.
translation: 哎呀，挺简单的嘛。

original: Joe Cobb talks about leaving us alone if we hand over Ringo, but I know his type. He and his friends will come after the town eventually.
translation: 乔·科布说我们交出林戈就放过我们，但我知道他是个什么货色。他和他那些朋友迟早还是要来惹事生非的。

original: However, between you, me, and Ringo, we aren't exactly a force to be reckoned with. A lot of people around here look up to Trudy.
translation: 不过，只有你、我和林戈，还不足以对付他们。这里多数人都比较敬仰特鲁迪。

original: If you could convince Trudy to join us, some of the folks in town might decide to help out as well.
translation: 如果你能说服特鲁迪加入我们，镇上的其他一些人可能也会决定帮忙。

original: I know Easy Pete's got a stock of dynamite somewhere, and Chet just got a shipment of leather armor we could borrow. Talk to them as well.
translation: 我知道轻松皮特在某个地方存了一批炸药，切特的那批皮甲我们也可以去借几件。记得和他们谈谈。

original: Finally, there's a good chance we'll all end up with extra holes in us, so if Doc Mitchell could cough up some extra stimpaks, that'd be great.
translation: 最后，我们可能都得吃枪子，所以如果米切尔医生能提供一些额外的治疗针，那就更好了。

original: Even though Joe Cobb's dead, his friends will come after the town eventually.
translation: 即便乔·科布死了，他那些朋友迟早还是要来惹事生非的。

original: However, between you, me, and Ringo, we aren't exactly a force to be reckoned with. A lot of people around here look up to Trudy.
translation: 不过，只有你、我和林戈，是不足以对付他们的。这里多数人都比较敬仰特鲁迪。

original: If you could convince Trudy to join us, some of the folks in town might decide to help out as well.
translation: 如果你能说服特鲁迪加入我们，镇上其他一些人可能也会决定帮忙。

original: I know Easy Pete's got a stock of dynamite somewhere, and Chet just got a shipment of leather armor we could borrow. Talk to them as well.
translation: 我知道轻松皮特在某个地方存了一批炸药，切特的那批皮甲我们也可以去借几件。记得和他们谈谈。

original: Finally, there's a good chance we'll all end up with extra holes in us, so if Doc Mitchell could cough up some extra stimpaks, that'd be great.
translation: 最后，我们可能都得吃枪子，所以如果米切尔医生能提供一些额外的治疗针，那就更好了。

original: I'm going to help Ringo take on the powder gangers. I might need your help.
translation: 我要帮助林戈对付炸药帮。可能需要你帮忙。

original: Say no more. I'm in.
translation: 不用多说了。算我一个。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'll be waiting.
translation: 我会等着的。

original: Until next time.
translation: 直到下次。

original: You don't think I can handle myself in a fight?
translation: 你觉得我在战斗中没法顾好自己吗？

original: I was thinking of myself, actually. Who's going to watch my back while I'm watching yours?
translation: 其实我想的是我自己。我顾着你，谁顾着我呢？

original: I'll ask around and see who I can round up.
translation: 我会在周围问问看谁愿意帮忙的。

original: Start with Sunny Smiles. She's been friendlier than most around here.
translation: 你可以先从微笑桑妮开始问起。她比这里的大多数人都友好。

original: Maybe I can help.
translation: 也许我能帮忙。

original: I saw you being awfully friendly with Joe Cobb, so no thanks.
translation: 我看见你和乔·科布相谈甚欢，所以不必了。

original: No thanks. I think we'd need some of Goodsprings on our side, and I hear you're not exactly friendly with them.
translation: 不必了。我还是得靠清泉镇的人来救我的命，而我听说你对他们并不怎么友好。

original: We'd just end up sharing the same grave if it's just the two of us. Now, if some of the other people in town were also on board...
translation: 要是只有我们两个人的话，那结局肯定是咱俩埋一块儿。如果这镇上还有其他人愿意帮忙的话……

original: It's odd that Cobb wasn't able to find Ringo. The town's not that big.
translation: 科布没能找到林戈也够奇怪的。镇子又不大。

original: Cobb hasn't exactly been looking for Ringo too hard - I think he's afraid that Ringo will ambush him, which is probably true.
translation: 科布根本就没去找林戈——我觉得他应该是害怕林戈偷袭他，这是非常有可能的。

original: What are you going to do about the Powder Gangers?
translation: 你打算怎么对付炸药帮？

original: I'm going to lay low for as long as I can, assuming the town doesn't throw me to the wolves. I've got no chance against the gang on my own.
translation: 要是镇里的人没把我丢给这群狼，那我就继续躲着，躲得越久越好。我一个人可没办法对付一群人。

original: I'm still laying low.
translation: 我还在躲着呢。

original: How many powder gangers are out there?
translation: 外面总共有多少炸药帮的人？

original: At least a dozen, I'd say. And that was just the group that attacked us. For all I know, they've got a lot more friends lurking around.
translation: 要我说，至少一打。那还只是正面攻击我们的这伙人。据我所知，这附近还有更多他们的人。

original: Hold it right there! You had no business treating that man. You may've spared him a lingering death, but that's straight-out malpractice.
translation: 等一下！虽然那个人的死活与你无关。或许你还想让他死得痛快点，但这种行为是绝对错误的。

original: Sounds like a bunch of winners.
translation: 听起来像是一群活宝啊。

original: Whatever. Not like I need any of them. I do just fine on my own.
translation: 随便啦，反正我也不需要他们。我自己就能行。

original: That's charming. It's good to know team-building is alive and well.
translation: 有意思。看来你们还是挺重视团队建设的嘛。

original: [FAILED] Hey, you asked. Don't want the answer, don't ask a guy's opinion.
translation: [失败] 嘿，是你问我的。如果你不想要答案，那就别问。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Shit, maybe you're right. Guess I ought to give them a shot.
translation: [成功] 妈的，也许你是对的。我应该多给他们一些耐心。

original: Great, maybe you can help me get this squad working together!
translation: 棒极了，也许你能帮我提高这支小队的凝聚力！

original: [FAILED] Why would I? If this unit improves its performance, we'll be shipped to the front lines. That's hardly conducive to living a long life.
translation: [失败] 为什么我要那么做？如果队伍的战斗力提高了，我们就会被派往前线。那可无助于给大伙延长寿命啊。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm. You're trying to appeal to my ego. I must admit, it's an effective tactic. All right - I'll help.
translation: [成功] 嗯，你在拍我马屁。我必须承认，这招挺管用的，好吧——我会帮忙的。

original: But only because I want to see if it's even possible.
translation: 但我只是想看看这到底有没有成功的可能。

original: Since you're so respected, maybe you can help get this unit into shape.
translation: 既然你那么受尊重，也许你能让这支部队变得更像样一点。

original: I wonder if anyone else would share that sentiment.
translation: 不知道其他人是否也能感同身受。

original: Genius is seldom appreciated in its own time.
translation: 天才总是在死了之后才为人称道。

original: So, that's a no, then?
translation: 所以你的意思是"不是"咯？

original: I suppose if you must stick with your narrow, parochial view of "in charge," then yes, it's a no. Are we done?
translation: 如果你对"负责"这个词抱有如此狭隘的偏见，那没错，我的确不是。还有事吗？

original: Tough luck. If the Legion attacks, they're dead meat.
translation: 倒霉了，万一军团打过来，他们就死定了。

original: I'd be skeptical of the odds, myself. I just hope they figure it out before it comes to that.
translation: 我个人觉得概率相当大。只希望他们能在那一天到来之前尽早开窍。

original: Maybe I can help you whip them into shape.
translation: 也许我能帮你训练他们。

original: You're welcome to try - hell, maybe they'll listen to somebody they don't see as an authority figure.
translation: 你可以试试，说不定他们还更愿意听你这种非权威人士的话呢。

original: <Lie> I assume the ants' tibular nastis pierced the patients' anterior traxes?
translation: <撒谎> 我觉得蚂蚁的毒液可能已渗入到病人器官的前侧部了？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Well... I don't know, actually... I suppose it's possible. You should take a look!
translation: [成功] 嗯…实际上，我不知道……可能是吧。你应该看一看！

original: <Lie> I'm a medical expert and my specialty is giant insect bites!
translation: <撒谎> 我是医学专家，我的专业就是治疗大虫子叮咬伤！

original: [FAILED] These patients were gravely injured. It's not a joking matter!
translation: [失败] 这些病人都伤的很重，现在不是开玩笑的时候！

original: Player has medical knowledge.
translation: 玩家具有医学知识。

original: [SUCCEEDED] If what you say is true, you can do us a world of good.
translation: [成功] 如果你说的是真的，那可真是帮了我们大忙了。

original: I have extensive medical knowledge. Let's see what I can do.
translation: 我的医学知识很丰富。我来想想办法吧。

original: [FAILED] No need to apologize. Their care is my responsibility, not yours. Thing is, everything I know came out of a first aid handbook!
translation: [失败] 不用道歉。照顾他们是我的责任，与你无关。问题是，我的医疗知识都是从一本急救手册上学来的！

original: If you think you know more than that, let me know.
translation: 如果你觉得自己比手册上懂得多，请告诉我。

original: Sorry. I'm sure you know more than I do.
translation: 抱歉，我知道的还没你多。

original: I'm sorry, I don't know enough to help. I wish I did.
translation: 抱歉，我也希望能帮上忙，但我知道的不多。

original: Don't apologize. Their care is my responsibility, but everything I know came from an old first aid field manual.
translation: 不必道歉，照顾他们是我的责任，但我的所有医疗知识都是从一本旧的战场急救手册中学会的。

original: I don't know what else to do to help them...
translation: 我也不知道还有什么办法能救他们了……

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I need medical treatment.
translation: 我需要医疗用品。

original: Seeing as you're a friend of ours, I suppose we could trade for what you need.
translation: 看在你是朋友的份上，我们可以互通有无。

original: I'm afraid medications are in short supply. Maybe you should seek medical treatment away from Nellis.
translation: 恐怕我们也缺乏医疗用品。也许你应该去内利斯之外的地方看看。

original: I'm looking for ways to make myself useful.
translation: 我正在想办法为你们做点贡献。

original: Well, look elsewhere. I can't let you near a patient after what happened.
translation: 你去找别人吧。发生了这种事，我可不敢再让你靠近病人了。

original: I'm still looking for ways to make myself useful.
translation: 我还在想办法为你们做点贡献。

original: You're finished? So are they, I'm afraid. Your medicine was almost as dangerous to them as those giant ants!
translation: 完了？恐怕他们也要完了。对他们来说，你的医疗技术和那些巨型蚂蚁一样危险！

original: I'm finished with your patients.
translation: 我治完你的病人了。

original: You did more harm than good, I think. Your heart was in the right place, at least.
translation: 我觉得你帮了倒忙。不过至少你的出发点是好的。

original: I'm finished with your patients.
translation: 我治完你的病人了。

original: Those men owe you their lives. Seems we could learn a thing or two from you savages, when it comes to medicine, at least.
translation: 这些人的命都是你给的。看来在医疗方面，我们还是可以从你们野蛮人身上学到点东西的。

original: I've finished treating your patients.
translation: 我照顾完你的病人了。

original: Well, there are still patients left to treat... though I worry you'll just make them worse.
translation: 嗯，确实还有病人需要照料……可我担心你只会让他们的情况恶化。

original: I'm still looking for ways to make myself useful.
translation: 我还在想办法为你们做点贡献。

original: There are still patients in need of treatment. Help them if you can.
translation: 还有病人需要照料。如果可以的话你就帮帮他们吧。

original: I'm still looking for ways to make myself useful.
translation: 我还在想办法为你们做点贡献。

original: I have three patients here who were gravely injured fighting those giant ants in the generator building a few days ago.
translation: 我这儿有三个病人，几天前他们在发电机室和巨型蚂蚁搏斗时受了重伤。

original: I've stabilized their wounds, but they're in bad shape. Do you have medical training?
translation: 我暂时稳住了他们的伤势，不过他们仍然没有脱离危险。你受过医疗培训吗？

original: Wait. I may have missed an ant or two.
translation: 等一下。我可能漏掉了一两只蚂蚁。

original: "You may have missed an ant or two?" Get back down there and finish those ants off!
translation: "你可能漏掉了一两只蚂蚁？"那赶紧给我回去把所有蚂蚁都处理掉！

original: Just doing my part to help out.
translation: 我只是做了力所能及的事。

original: I already said you did a good job. I don't give out hugs.
translation: 我已经夸过你了。我可不会拥抱你。

original: <Lie> Yep, power on, ant's dead, all good.
translation: <撒谎> 对，来电了，蚂蚁死了，一切都好了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Maybe Pearl is right about you, because I don't know how you pulled that off.
translation: [成功] 看来珀尔并没有看错你，我根本想不出你是怎么完成这项工作的。

original: I'll tell Loyal to send someone down to clear out the eggs and repair the generators. Good work.
translation: 我会通知罗亚尔安排人下去清理蚂蚁卵，修好发电机。干得漂亮。

original: [FAILED] You're a terrible liar. Get down there and clear out those ants.
translation: [失败] 就你这样还想骗人？赶紧回去干活。

original: <Lie> I... Um... Tamed the ants, you don't have to worry about them anymore.
translation: <撒谎> 我……嗯……驯服了那些蚂蚁，你不用再担心它们了。

original: Well, most of the ants are dead.
translation: 好吧，大多数蚂蚁都死了。

original: I didn't tell you to kill most of the ants. It's an either-or proposition. Get down there and finish them off.
translation: 我要的不止是大多数。这个任务你要么做好，要么就别做。回去把那些蚂蚁全都处理掉。

original: Yes, it's safe to go down there now.
translation: 对，现在下去那里已经很安全了。

original: Maybe Pearl is right about you, because I don't know how you pulled that off.
translation: 看来珀尔并没有看错你，我根本想不出你是怎么完成这项工作的。

original: I'll tell Loyal to send someone down to clear out the eggs and repair the generators. Good work.
translation: 我会通知罗亚尔安排人下去清理蚂蚁卵，修好发电机。干得漂亮。

original: All dead.
translation: 都死了。

original: If that's so, why isn't the power back on? Remember how I told you to power up the generators when the ants are dead?
translation: 如果都死了，为什么供电没恢复？我是不是跟你说过解决蚂蚁以后要恢复供电吗？

original: Looks like you've still got some work left to do.
translation: 看来你这工作还是留了点尾巴。

original: Still in progress.
translation: 还在努力呢。

original: It's not in progress if you're up here talking to me. Get it taken care of.
translation: 你都跑来和我聊天了，还叫哪门子努力？好好把事情做完。

original: Thanks, but there are easier ways to commit suicide.
translation: 谢谢，不过想自杀还有更简单的法子。

original: A savage, scared of bugs? I don't believe it. I'm sure you'll change your mind.
translation: 一个野蛮人，还怕虫子？我不信。你会改变主意的。

original: One other thing. The ants must be eating gunpowder from the munitions down there, or something.
translation: 还有件事。那些蚂蚁肯定是吃了军火库里的火药或者其他东西。

original: They exploded when hit by a flamethrower. One of us was using a laser pistol - same thing. Bullets seem okay, just don't hit the artillery shells.
translation: 我们拿喷火器烧他们，它们居然爆炸了。我们试了激光手枪——结果也一样。普通子弹好像就没这个问题，不过要小心别击中库存的炮弹。

original: Loyal's been working on some kind of weapon to use against them. Maybe you should check with him.
translation: 罗亚尔正在研究某种可以用来对付它们的武器。也许你应该找他聊聊。

original: I'll do it, even though you're just trying to get me killed.
translation: 交给我吧，哪怕你是要害死我，我也接了。

original: Don't get my hopes up.
translation: 我本来就没抱太大希望。

original: One other thing. The ants must be eating gunpowder from the munitions down there, or something.
translation: 还有件事。那些蚂蚁肯定是吃了军火库里的火药或者其他东西。

original: They exploded when hit by a flamethrower. One of us was using a laser pistol - same thing. Bullets seem okay, just don't hit the artillery shells.
translation: 我们拿喷火器烧他们，它们居然爆炸了。我们试了激光手枪——结果也一样。普通子弹好像就没这个问题，不过要小心别击中库存的炮弹。

original: Loyal's been working on some kind of weapon to use against them. Maybe you should check with him.
translation: 罗亚尔正在研究某种可以用来对付它们的武器。也许你应该找他聊聊。

original: I can handle a few ants.
translation: 几只蚂蚁对我来说没问题。

original: Sure, anyone can. But there's more than a few down there. See for yourself.
translation: 当然，几只蚂蚁对谁都不是问题。问题是那儿可不止几只蚂蚁。你自己去看看吧。

original: One other thing. The ants must be eating gunpowder from the munitions down there, or something.
translation: 还有件事。那些蚂蚁肯定是吃了军火库里的火药或者其他东西。

original: They exploded when hit by a flamethrower. One of us was using a laser pistol - same thing. Bullets seem okay, just don't hit the artillery shells.
translation: 我们拿喷火器烧他们，它们居然爆炸了。我们试了激光手枪——结果也一样。普通子弹好像就没这个问题，不过要小心别击中库存的炮弹。

original: Loyal's been working on some kind of weapon to use against them. Maybe you should check with him.
translation: 罗亚尔正在研究某种可以用来对付它们的武器。也许你应该找他聊聊。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: We haven't seen the last of each other, savage.
translation: 我们还会再见面的，野蛮人。

original: Get those ants handled, savage.
translation: 去把那些蚂蚁处理掉，野蛮人。

original: Stay out of trouble.
translation: 别惹麻烦。

original: If I do, you'll be the first to know.
translation: 要是我滥用了，肯定第一时间让你知道。

original: All I need is a pretext.
translation: 给我个借口就行。

original: Mother Pearl said you have a "bug problem?"
translation: 珀尔妈妈说你需要"处理虫害？"

original: Long story short, the power failed a few days ago because giant ants have tunneled into the generator room and set up a nest.
translation: 长话短说吧，前几天停电就是因为有巨型蚂蚁爬进了发电机房，还在那儿建了个蚂蚁窝。

original: I led a team down to exterminate them, but there were... so many of them. We lost two killed, three wounded.
translation: 我领了一队人马想去消灭它们，但是……蚂蚁数量太多了。我们死了两个，伤了三个。

original: Personally, I think it's more than a savage can handle, but if you want to kill those ants and switch the power back on, feel free.
translation: 就我个人老说，我觉得你一个野蛮人根本处理不了这种事，但如果你真的愿意消灭蚂蚁，恢复供电，我也没理由拦着你。

original: Sorry, not interested. I'll be leaving.
translation: 抱歉，没兴趣。我要走了。

original: I'll send word to the spotters to let you come and go as you wish. Why not stay awhile before you head out?
translation: 我会传话给观察哨，让你可以自由进出。为什么不多呆一段时间呢？

original: Where do I start?
translation: 我该怎么做？

original: You picked a good time to stop by, for we're swimming in problems. My youngers can tell you all about it.
translation: 你来的时机正好，我们正巧碰上了一大堆麻烦。我的后辈们会告诉你具体情况。

original: Raquel could use help with the bug problem, Doc Argyll has wounded he's tending to, and Loyal and Jack might be looking for help with some repairs.
translation: 拉奎尔需要人帮忙处理虫害，阿盖尔医生要照料伤员，罗亚尔和杰克需要人帮忙修点东西。

original: Or you could just go see Pete at the museum and hear the story of our people. All you have to do there is listen.
translation: 另外你还可以去博物馆找一下皮特，他会告诉你我们的历史。你只要站在那儿听就行了。

original: Come and go as you like, help or don't help, I leave it up to you. But I hope you'll show my youngers that not every outsider needs to be blown up.
translation: 反正你来去自由，要不要帮忙就自己决定吧。不过我是希望你能向我的后辈们证明，不是每个外来者都活该被炸死。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You have to keep in mind that you're our first contact with the outside world since I was barely a woman.
translation: [成功] 你必须要记住，自打我成人以来，你是我们接触到的第一个外来访客。

original: Seclusion has kept us safe. but the world around us is changing. Neon lights in the distance, patrolling robots, soldiers...
translation: 与世隔绝令我们得到了安全，可我们周围的世界却在不停变化。远方的霓虹灯光，巡逻的机器人，还有士兵们……

original: My youngers think our guns can keep out the world, but I think we need to let it in, just a little, or become its victim.
translation: 我的后辈认为我们的大炮能把世界拒之门外，但我觉得我们还是应当开放，哪怕只有一点点，否则我们就会变成时代的牺牲品。

original: You're that little bit of the world, child. Welcome to Nellis.
translation: 而你，就是那溜进来的那一点点世界，孩子。欢迎来到内利斯。

original: How can we trust each other if you're going to be keeping secrets?
translation: 你要这样什么都不说，我们怎么相信彼此？

original: [FAILED] If I were your grandma, I'd wash out your mouth with Abraxo for being so rude, child!

original: I don't like being kept in dark, grandma. Clue me in.
translation: 我可不喜欢一直被蒙在鼓里，老奶奶。告诉我。

original: Why are you called Easy Pete?
translation: 为什么叫你轻松皮特？

original: Was a prospector until I decided to settle here to get away from the NCR. Now I just take it easy and help out with the Brahmin and Bighorners.
translation: 在我离开NCR到这村子里定居前，我做过淘金客。现在我只想求个轻松点的日子，靠着几头牛和大角羊就够了。

original: No, I haven't found him yet.
translation: 不，我还没找到他。

original: Okay, well thanks for looking. Let me know when you find him.
translation: 好吧，谢谢你找他。如果找到他了记得告诉我。

original: <Lie> I'm sorry Lindsay. Mister Cuddles is dead.
translation: <撒谎> 对不起，林赛。抱抱先生死了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] No! Not Mister Cuddles!
translation: [成功] 不！抱抱先生不会死的！

original: [SUCCEEDED] No! Not Mister Cuddles! He can't be dead!
translation: [成功] 不！为什么是抱抱先生！他不会死的！

original: <Lie> I already told you he's dead. Get over it already, kid.
translation: <撒谎> 我已经告诉你他死了。别再缠着我了，孩子。

original: [FAILED] I know you're kidding. Mister Cuddles is just hiding somewhere.
translation: [失败] 我知道你是在开玩笑。抱抱先生就在什么地方藏着呢。

original: I have Mister Cuddles right here.
translation: 我把抱抱先生找回来了。

original: Oh! Thank you so much! I'll never lose you again Mister Cuddles!
translation: 噢！太谢谢了！抱抱先生，我不会再把你弄丢了！

original: Great work Lindsay! I'll go take a look for him.
translation: 干得好，林赛！我去找他。

original: Thanks! Let me know when you find him.
translation: 谢谢！找到后请告诉我。

original: Think really hard. What were you doing when you saw him last?
translation: 真的很难找。最后一次看见他时你在干嘛？

original: Oh, I remember now! I was playing hide and seek in the big hangar! Mister Loyal made us leave though.
translation: 哦，我想起来了，我在飞机库里玩捉迷藏，罗亚尔先生想赶我们走，不让我们玩。

original: Ok, I'll look for him.
translation: 好的，我会去找他的。

original: Thanks! Let me know when you find him.
translation: 谢谢！找到后请告诉我。

original: Sorry, I don't have time right now.
translation: 对不起，我现在没有时间。

original: Oh. Bye then.
translation: 噢，再见。

original: Who is Mister Cuddles?
translation: 抱抱先生是谁？

original: Mister Cuddles is my teddy. I lost him and I don't remember where.
translation: 抱抱先生是我的泰迪熊。我把他弄丢了，想不起来放在哪了。

original: Now I know what they mean by "dumb luck"!
translation: 现在我知道他们说的"傻人有傻福"是什么意思了！

original: Are you sure you know what you're doing? You nearly killed that man!
translation: 你到底在干什么啊？你差点儿就杀了那个人！

original: You've made him worse! Is that what you savages call medicine?
translation: 你把他的情况搞得更糟了！这就是你们这些野人所谓的医疗吗？

original: Were you exaggerating your knowledge of medicine? Even I would've known not to do that!
translation: 你不是刚夸耀过自己的医术有多么高明吗？连我都知道那种事不能做！

original: Any ideas how to get to the bottom of Lake Mead without drowning?
translation: 有没有什么办法能潜到湖底还不被淹死？

original: Might try holding your breath. If that doesn't sound good enough, talk to Jack. He was working on a rebreather once.
translation: 试试憋气咯。如果不行，那就去找杰克吧。他之前在研究一种呼吸器。

original: That's just about the stupidest idea I ever heard.
translation: 这是我听过最蠢的想法。

original: No, it's not. It's the smartest idea you ever heard, but you're too stupid to know it!
translation: 不，你错了。这其实是你听过最聪明的想法，只不过你太蠢了，理解不了。

original: All right. I'm game.
translation: 好吧。我试试。

original: Good. Here's the deployable ballast. Go find the plane, attach the ballast, and hit the button!
translation: 好，这是可展开式浮袋。找到飞机，装上浮袋，再按下按钮！

original: If it's so simple, why haven't you done it?
translation: 既然这么简单，你怎么还没搞定？

original: Maybe you don't understand. Hasn't been one of us, not a one, to set a foot outside Nellis in over fifty years.
translation: 可能你不明白。五十多年了，没有一个人，没有一个，曾经走出过内利斯一步。

original: You come along, with your knowledge of the outside, and it seems the time's come to raise the Lady after all.
translation: 你独自一人远道而来，又对外面世界那么熟悉，将淑女捞出来的时机似乎已经成熟了。

original: That sounds impossible.
translation: 听起来不可能。

original: I know it does, but I tell you, it ain't! I've worked it out so it's simple!
translation: 我知道，但我告诉你，这是错的！我已经研究出来了，非常简单！

original: That sounds really creepy, Loyal.
translation: 这词儿用的有些诡异啊，罗亚尔。

original: Ain't nothing creepy about it. It's a term of respect!
translation: 什么诡异。这是表示尊重！

original: Maybe another time. Goodbye.
translation: 下次吧。再见。

original: Did I misunderstand what Pearl said? All right. Goodbye.
translation: 难道我误解了珀尔的话？好吧，再见。

original: <Lie> She was so excited to see you, she wouldn't wait.
translation: <撒谎> 她太想见你了，一分钟都等不下去。

original: [FAILED] Then why didn't you stop her? You could've tackled her or something! You knew how much she meant to me!
translation: [失败] 那你为什么不阻止她？你为什么不拖住她，或者想点别的办法！你明明知道她对我有多重要！

original: Just - just go away!
translation: 你——你走开！

original: <Lie> It's a tragedy. She loved you so much, she risked it all.
translation: <撒谎> 这是一场悲剧。她那么爱你，冒了那么大的危险。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, my sweet blameless Red! Curse the walls of Nellis! Curse our guns and isolation! Her blood is on our hands!
translation: [成功] 噢，我无辜的爱人啊！该死的内利斯之墙！该死的大炮和隔离带！是我们害死了她！

original: Only if we stop shelling everyone who comes close will some good come from this tragedy. If you'll excuse me...
translation: 如果我们能停止炮击靠近的行人，悲剧就不会重演了。抱歉，请让我静一静……

original: It's not my fault that your tribe blows up everyone who comes close.
translation: 是你的族人把每个接近的人都炸飞，难道怪我？

original: I wish we'd blown you up! I wish you were dead! Just leave me alone!
translation: 被炸死的怎么不是你！死的怎么不是你！给我滚远点！

original: I told her how to get through the artillery barrage.
translation: 我告诉她怎么穿过炮火隔离带了。

original: Wow, that seems dangerous, but if you really think it's safe, I'll trust you. You did make it here, afterall.
translation: 哇，这有点危险啊，不过如果你觉得没问题，我也相信你。毕竟你都自己经历过了。

original: Here take this Boomer outfit. I'll let the gunners know she is coming, and not to shoot at her.
translation: 拿着这套大炮族的外衣。我会通知炮手，她过来的时候别开火。

original: I've seen her, but we haven't talked about you yet.
translation: 我见过她了，不过还没有谈到你。

translation: 你还在等什么？我成天在猜她的心思，害我都睡不着觉了！

translation: 我还有其他事要处理。

translation: 好消息，她也有同样的想法。

original: Well, we know your vitals are good.
translation: 好吧，我们知道你体质好。

original: But that don't mean them bullets didn't leave you nuttier than a Bighorner dropping.
translation: 但那也不等于你能刀枪不入，只要是人，挨了枪子后都会像一坨牛粪似的瘫在地上。

original: What do you say you take a seat on my couch and we go through a couple questions? See if your dogs are still barking.
translation: 不然咱们到沙发上坐坐，我问你几个问题如何？看看你是不是依旧毫发无伤。

original: That's all I wanted to know. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我想知道的就是这些。我们聊点别的吧。

original: If you want to know anything else, just ask.
translation: 如果你还想知道点别的，尽管问。

original: What kind of creatures are out there?
translation: 都是些什么生物？

original: Around here, mostly coyotes and geckos. The coyotes are pretty dangerous in large packs, but otherwise they're nothing to really worry about.
translation: 这周围大多是郊狼和蜥蜴。郊狼一旦成群结队地出没就非常危险，但除此之外并不值得担心。

original: The geckos aren't too tough, but they've got a nasty bite. I've heard about bigger, nastier versions out in the wasteland, but I've never seen them.
translation: 蜥蜴倒是不太难对付，可它们的撕咬很要命。我听说在废土上还有更大、更凶猛的品种，但我从没亲眼见过。

original: Stick to the roads when you can, and steer clear of the hills north of Goodsprings. The critters up there are big and poisonous.
translation: 尽量沿着路走，避开清泉镇北边的山丘。那里的生物体型都很大，而且有毒。

original: What other towns are nearby?
translation: 附近还有其他镇子吗？

original: Southeast of here is Primm - can't miss it, since it has this giant old rollercoaster right in the middle of town. The NCR's got an outpost there.
translation: 东南方是普瑞姆——镇子的正中央有一个巨大的过山车，非常显眼。NCR在那里设了个前哨。

original: If you follow the road north, you'll eventually hit Sloan and Quarry Junction. They mine rocks or something, but I heard they got troubles lately.
translation: 如果你沿着路往北走，最终会抵达斯隆和采石场。他们好像在那儿挖石头，但我听说他们最近遇到了一点麻烦。

original: I wouldn't head that direction if I were you, though. Got critters up there that don't take kindly to getting shot.
translation: 如果我是你的话，我可不会往那边走。那附近游荡的生物都不是善茬。

original: Let's talk about the areas around Goodsprings.
translation: 我们说说清泉镇周边的地方。

original: Sure. What did you want to know?
translation: 当然。你想知道什么？

original: [SUCCEEDED] If you're willing to take the risk, be my guest.
translation: [成功] 如果你愿意冒险，那悉听尊便。

original: I've got it set to broadcast a powerful signal at 24,000 hertz. Just place it near their nest and cross your fingers.
translation: 我已经把它的发射信号频率调节到了24000赫兹。你只要把它放到蚂蚁窝附近，然后就等着看好戏吧。

original: Signal's too high for people to hear, so no harm done, but it might make you feel sick to your stomach.
translation: 这个信号频率很高，人耳捕捉不到，所以对人体是无害的，不过还是有可能导致恶心反胃。

original: Think of it as a field test. A trial run.
translation: 把它想成一次实验好了。当成试运行。

original: [FAILED] I don't even know what the hell you're talking about. Sounds like gibberish.
translation: [失败] 我不知道你说的是什么意思。听起来就是胡说八道。

original: Maybe tilt the... megareceiver? To 73.5 kilonewtons...?
translation: 也许调节一下……巨型接收器？调到73.5千牛……？

original: Well, if you're heading back out there, you ought to have this.
translation: 如果你想出去的话，我建议你最好戴上这个。

original: They call it a Pip-Boy. I grew up in one of them vaults they made before the war. We all got one.
translation: 他们管这玩意叫哔哔小子。我是在战前建造的避难所中长大的，所以我们人人都有一个。

original: Ain't much use to me now, but you might want such a thing, after what you been through. I know what it's like, having something taken from you.
translation: 现在我用不着了，但你应该用得上，毕竟你遭了这么多罪。我能理解你，那种被人抢了的感受。

original: And put this on, too, so the locals don't pick on you for lacking modesty. Was my wife's.
translation: 把这个也穿上吧，不然本地人会嫌弃你衣冠不整的。这衣服曾经是属于我妻子的。

original: I think she was about your size, and she hardly wore it after we left the vault. Felt it was too brazen.
translation: 我想你和她个头应该差不多，我们离开避难所后她就很少穿了。感觉太招摇了。

original: And put this on, too, so the locals don't pick on you for lacking modesty. Never was much my style anyway.
translation: 把这个也穿上吧，不然本地人会嫌弃你衣冠不整的。反正我也穿不惯这套行头。
