original: [SUCCEEDED] Ah, an educated fellow? Now that is almost as rare as artistry! So, how can you help me regain my inspiration?
translation: [成功] 啊，你受过高等教育？简直和艺术一样稀有！那么，你要怎么帮我重获灵感？

original: Why do you have a problem with Mr. House's requests?
translation: 为什么你对豪斯先生的要求这么有意见？

original: {Taking Offense}Because spending myself to the edge of artistic oblivion for Mr. House sums up my existence since I had to leave Vault 21, that's why.
translation: {Taking Offense}因为自从我离开21号避难所以后，为豪斯先生没日没夜地投身艺术创作就成了我生活的全部。

original: 300 caps it is.
translation: 300瓶盖就够了。

original: Here. Now, please leave me be. I have had enough bullying for today.
translation: 给你。现在请你离开吧。我今天受的欺负已经够多了。

original: All right. 150 caps will do.
translation: 好吧。150瓶盖也行。

original: Here. Now, please leave me be. I have had enough bullying for today.
translation: 给你。现在请你离开吧。我今天受的欺负已经够多了。

original: Oh, so you've got lots of caps on you? Then I guess I can just beat them out of you.
translation: 哦，那你一定有很多瓶盖了？我不妨揍你一顿，看你能掉出来几个子儿。

original: {Fearful}What!? No, please! Here, take the caps but please don't hurt me!
translation: {Fearful}什么！？别，求你了！给你，这些瓶盖拿去，请别伤害我！

original: (Lie) So, uh, wasn't it clever how I tricked you? I'm... working for Mr. House!
translation: (撒谎) 那，呃，我耍你的方式高不高明？我……我为豪斯先生工作！

original: {Hesitant Warning}[FAILED] I know important people here in the Strip. Powerful people. You, uh, can't get anything out of me.
translation: {Hesitant Warning}[失败] 我在长街认识许多大人物。都是有权有势的人。你，呃，休想从我这儿得到什么好处。

original: (Lie) You really believed I wasn't working for Mr. House? Chump.
translation: (撒谎) 你真以为我不是在为豪斯先生工作？蠢货。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I should've known that Mr. House wouldn't have sent just anybody. Anything I might I offer to, well, encourage discretion?
translation: [成功] 我早该猜到豪斯先生不会随便派个人来的。不知我该怎样才能让您，呃，替我美言几句？

original: An artist - rare thing to see. What's your story?
translation: 艺术家啊——真稀有。你有什么故事？

original: Well, I, uh, not much, really. Vault 21 was my home, my dear home. I left it to explore the outside world.
translation: 啊，我，呃，没什么故事，真的。21号避难所是我的家，美丽的家。我离开了它，去外面的世界闯荡。

original: At first it was a marvel to behold. My inspiration flowed true and its works caught Mr. House's attention. That's how I ended up in this... place.
translation: 起先我对一切都充满了好奇。我的灵感喷涌而出，作品也引起了豪斯先生的注意。然后我就……到这儿来了。

original: I guess you're having trouble with Mr. House requests. What's the problem?
translation: 看来你没办法满足豪斯先生的要求。是什么问题？

original: {Accusative, then thoughtful nostalgia}It's this place - my inspiration ebbs and I don't know how to stop it! I can't feel the warmth anymore...
translation: {Accusative, then thoughtful nostalgia}问题出在这间房子——我的灵感正在衰竭，可我却不知道该怎么办！我再也感受不到温暖了……

original: You lived in Vault 21? Tell me about that.
translation: 你在21号避难所住过？跟我说说。

original: Most people don't, uh, understand what it means to grow up in a vault. Its corridors, its walls, radiate a warmth that feels, safe, honest.
translation: 很多人都，呃，不理解在避难所长大的感觉。它的走廊，墙壁，四处都散发着温暖的气息，安全，可靠。

original: But here everything is huge and threatening - so empty that I think one of these days I'll just... snap.
translation: 但这里，所有东西都大得可怕——太空虚了，空虚到让我觉得自己说不定哪天就会……崩溃。

original: Okay. Game's over. Now pay up or I'll break your bones one by one, little man!
translation: 好了，游戏结束。要么马上还债，要么我就把你的骨头一根一根捏断，臭小子！

original: {Fearful}What!? No, please! Here, take the caps but please don't hurt me!
translation: {Fearful}什么！？别，求你了！给你，这些瓶盖拿去，请别伤害我！

original: Artists are scarce. I bet you get paid handsomely. Cough up 300 caps.
translation: 艺术家可是稀缺资源，我打赌你肯定挣了不少钱。拿300瓶盖出来。

original: {Taking Offense}[FAILED] What!? I don't get paid near enough to what my talent deserves!? A 150 caps is my final offer.
translation: {Taking Offense}[失败] 什么！？我拿的报酬可远远配不上我的天赋啊！？我最多出150瓶盖。

original: Have you seen the cost of pliers, duct-tape and saws lately? 300 caps.
translation: 你知道最近老虎钳，胶带和锯子都涨到多少钱了吗？300瓶盖。

original: {Angry Resignation}[SUCCEEDED] Yeah, I imagine that it takes a lot to fill the void of such a bottomless soul. Take the caps and leave me to my sorrows.
translation: {Angry Resignation}[成功] 是哦，这么多钱应该足够填满一个贪得无厌的灵魂了。瓶盖你拿走，不要再来打扰我了。

original: Relax. I was just kidding. What's all this fretting about Mr. House?
translation: 放松点。我就开个玩笑而已。你怎么一听到豪斯先生就那么焦虑？

original: {Surprised Relief}You were, really? Okay. For a moment I thought you were going to tighten my screws - like everyone else around here.
translation: {Surprised Relief}你真是在开玩笑？好吧。我还以为你是来给我施压的——就像其他人那样。

original: Better cough up some caps or Mr. House finds about your sorry excuses.
translation: 你最好吐点瓶盖出来，否则你那点拙劣的借口，豪斯先生轻而易举就会识破的。

original: [FAILED]Sorry excuses?.. That's does it! Tell Mr. House to hire a better artist, if he can find one in this barren wasteland!
translation: [失败] 拙劣的借口？……我受够了！告诉豪斯先生，让他另请高明吧，我倒要看看他还能在这荒凉的废土上找到几个艺术家！

original: Your failure would not amuse Mr. House. Unless I be persuaded otherwise.
translation: 要是你干得不好，豪斯先生可是会生气的。除非你能说服我。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You've made your point. What would it take to... convince you to keep silent until I manage to finish Mr. House's requests?
translation: [成功] 你说到点子上了。我该怎样才能……说服你保持沉默，好让我能专心完成豪斯先生的要求？

original: Lets see... You've got that thingy... there. Power, uh, re-circulators here....
translation: 我看看……你怎么还有那个玩意……电力，呃，这儿还有循环泵……

original: {Suddenly Suspicious}Wait a minute... Do you even know what I do here? Who are you, really?
translation: {Suddenly Suspicious}等等……你知道我在这干什么吗？说实话，你到底是什么人？

original: Spare parts, assembly tools, generators. Mr. House won't buy your excuse.
translation: 这么多备用零件，还有组装工具和发电机。豪斯先生是不会听信你的借口的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I should've known that Mr. House wouldn't have sent just anybody. Anything I might I offer to, well, encourage discretion?
translation: [成功] 我早该猜到豪斯先生不会随便派个人来的。不知我该怎样才能让您，呃，替我美言几句？

original: Okay, I'll hire you.
translation: 好吧，我雇你。

original: Done and done. I want to mention a few things up front. In order to ensure your safety, I need you to follow my instructions to the letter.
translation: 那就不废话了。有些话得说在前面。为了保证你的安全，我要你一字不差地照我说的做。

original: We'll be heading down the main street here the whole way down. No detours. You go off sightseeing and I go off to find another customer.
translation: 我们沿着主路一直走到底，不绕弯。你要是跟丢了，我就去另找主顾。

original: I'll keep a brisk pace, so try not to fall behind. Now let's head out.
translation: 我会走得比较快，所以千万别落单。出发吧。

original: I don't think I need your services. Sorry.
translation: 我不需要你的服务，抱歉。

original: I'm sure Freeside will disabuse you of that notion soon enough. Farewell.
translation: 我相信自由城会让你改变主意的，再见。

original: What if I'm not going to the south gate?
translation: 如果我不去南门呢？

original: Sorry, but all the people with real money are heading for the Strip, so that's the way I go. You want to go somewhere else, hire one of these losers.
translation: 抱歉，真正的有钱人都去长街，所以我只去那儿。如果你要去别的地方，那找其他人吧。

original: How much for your services?
translation: 你的服务要多少钱？

original: Two hundred caps gets you my watchful eye for a trip to the south gate.
translation: 200个瓶盖保护你到南门。

original: Why do I need a bodyguard crossing Freeside?
translation: 为什么去自由城要带保镖？

original: Just look around. People here are as like to stab you as say hello. That is, if I weren't at your side.
translation: 看下周围吧。这里的人都用刀子和别人打招呼。如果我不在你身边，你肯定会受到热烈欢迎的。

original: I'd like to buy a passport.
translation: 我想买张通行证。

original: 500 caps and it's yours.
translation: 只要500个瓶盖,它就是你的了。

original: 375 caps and it's yours.
translation: 只要375个瓶盖,它就是你的了。

original: No way your materials and expenses require that. How about half?
translation: 材料和成本不可能要这么多钱。一半怎么样？

original: [SUCCEEDED]Hah! I like your style, kid, but the best I can do is meet you halfway. 375 caps, and we can call it a deal.
translation: [成功] 哈，我喜欢你的风格，孩子，但我可没法降太多。375个瓶盖，咱们就成交。

original: [FAILED]Heh, who are you shitting?
translation: [失败] 呵，你开什么玩笑？

original: I appreciate your brass, but 500 is the price. Take it or leave it.
translation: 我欣赏你的胆量，但500块钱是一口价。不要拉倒。

original: I've already got enough caps to pass the credit check.
translation: 我身上的瓶盖都足够我直接交保证金了。

original: Okay, I'll take one.
translation: 好的，我要一个。

original: Here you go.
translation: 就是这样。

original: <Pay 500 caps> Okay, I'll take one.
translation: <支付500个瓶盖> 好的， 我要一个。

original: Here you go.
translation: 就是这样。

original: <Pay 375 caps> Okay, I'll take one.
translation: <支付500个瓶盖> 好的， 我要一个。

original: Too steep for my blood. Maybe later.
translation: 对我来说太危险了。下次吧。

original: No problem. If you need one later, just stop in.
translation: 没问题。如果你以后有需要，过来找我便是。

original: Ah, now I see why you want to keep this low key.
translation: 现在我终于知道你为什么行事如此低调了。

original: Hey, if you're interested and have the caps, they go for 500. Any less and it ain't worth the risk {"of" omitted intentionally}of getting caught.
translation: 嘿，如果你感兴趣，手头也够宽裕，那给我500个瓶盖我就帮你做。我可是冒着被抓的风险，少于这个数我不干。

original: What do you say? You game?
translation: 怎么样？这买卖做吗？

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才>

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right. Yeah, I've got a little side business going, but what I'm about to share with you does not leave this room, eh?
translation: [成功] 好吧，我的确有做一些特殊买卖，但我接下来说的话，我不希望其他人知道，懂吗？

original: Over the years, I've gradually perfected my craft to the point of perfection. No one can distinguish between my work and the real thing.
translation: 几年来，我一直在改进工艺。没人能分辨出我做的东西和真品之间有什么区别。

original: What I'm referring to is passports. If you've got the caps, I can whip up a Strip passport which will fool even the most well-trained eye.
translation: 我指的是通行证。如果你有瓶盖的话，我可以帮你造一张长街的通行证，绝对能骗过任何专家的眼睛。

original: A resourceful fellow such as yourself must have something on the side.
translation: 像你这样八面玲珑的人，一定有些别的门路吧。

original: [FAILED] Wow, you're a real wordsmith there, bub. Sorry, talk to the leaders of Freeside if you want the deal.
translation: [失败] 哇，你还真是挺胆大的啊，朋友。抱歉，如果你要做这桩买卖，得先去找自由城的老大谈。

original: Let me in on the action!
translation: 让我也掺一脚吧！

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Stop back in if you need anything.
translation: 有需要再来。

original: See you later, Ralph.
translation: 回头见，拉尔夫。

original: See ya.
translation: 回见。

original: Thanks, I'd like to buy some stuff before I head out.
translation: 谢谢，在离开之前，我想买点东西。

original: The King said you could set me up with a pass to the Strip.
translation: 猫王说你可以帮我弄到去长街的通行证。

original: One of his boys stopped in and said you had won the King's favor. You've done right by this town and deserve a pass. Here you go.
translation: 他的手下已经和我打过招呼了，猫王很喜欢你。你在城里的表现不错，值得奖励一张通行证。拿去吧。

original: Any suggestions on how to get Ted out?
translation: 你觉得该怎么才能把泰德弄出来？

original: Hmm. Well, they'll all be sampling Pre-War wines before the meal. Maybe it's as simple as drugging them.
translation: 嗯。这个嘛，他们在餐前都喜欢饮用战前保存下来的葡萄酒。我看你只要在酒里下药就行了。

original: Although... that wouldn't stop any future kidnappings. You'd have to expose Mortimer. But he's going to confess anyway...
translation: 但有一点……他们今后还是会照样去绑架其他人。所以你必须揭穿莫蒂默的阴谋。问题在于，他本来就打算在今天坦白的……

original: What if... what if his revelation were a lie? What if no one had eaten human flesh but him?
translation: 如果……如果他所谓的真相其实是谎言呢？如果除了他，其他人实际上都没吃到人肉呢？

original: If you could somehow replace Philippe in the kitchen and serve a convincing substitute instead...
translation: 要是你能想办法顶替菲利普大厨，做出一道足够以假乱真的菜肴……

original: You could walk Ted right through the middle of that room after Mortimer speaks. And then he'd have some explaining to do.
translation: 那你就可以在莫蒂默演讲完之后，带着泰德堂而皇之地走出那个房间了。那样一来，他可就百口莫辩了。

original: Philippe has been trying to approximate the taste of human flesh for years. He must have a recipe somewhere.
translation: 菲利普这些年来一直在研究怎么把普通菜肴做出人肉的味道。他肯定在什么地方藏了食谱。

original: Where are they keeping Ted?
translation: 他们把泰德关在哪里？

original: I don't know exactly. I wasn't in on it. I think some of them have stopped trusting me.
translation: 我也不太清楚。这件事我没参与。大概他们中的一些人已经不信任我了吧。

original: But you can bet they're keeping him near the Gourmand. Our chef, Philippe, has an obsession with fresh ingredients.
translation: 但他们肯定会把他关在美食家餐厅附近的某个地方。因为我们的大厨菲利普对食材新鲜程度有着近乎病态的要求。

original: It'd be back in the members only section, so you'll have to be careful. Don't be seen, and more importantly, don't let them see Ted in the open.
translation: 美食家餐厅就在会员专用区的后面，所以你最好小心一点。别被发现，尤其要注意，带泰德出来时千万不能被看见。

original: It's guarded both at the lobby entrance and in the access tunnels leading from the main restaurant.
translation: 前厅入口和通向主宴会厅的通道处都布了守卫。

original: I... could sponsor you as an honorary member. But I don't know that you've achieved the level of status that would gain the Society's approval.
translation: 我……可以担保你成为荣誉会员。但以你现在的地位，能不能得到社团的认可还是个问题。

original: Perhaps if you were to gain some more notoriety on the Strip, we could get you in.
translation: 如果你能在长街再积攒些名气的话，也许我们就可以把你拉进来了。

original: I... could sponsor you as an honorary member. The White Gloves are always looking for people who can elevate their status.
translation: 我……可以担保你成为荣誉会员。白手套社团一直都希望能拉拢声名显赫的人加入。

original: You'd certainly fit the bill with everything you've done around here.
translation: 以你目前的地位，肯定完全符合他们的要求。

original: Otherwise, you'll have to find some way to get inside quietly. It won't be easy. And it'll be harder still to get him out.
translation: 如果这招不行，你就只能自己想办法溜进去了。这可不容易啊。要把人救出来就更难了。

original: Wouldn't they punish Mortimer for the deception?
translation: 莫蒂默这样蓄意欺诈，他们不会惩罚他吗？

original: They might. But to him the legacy of returning to the old ways is worth his own life. I don't think he expects it, though. I don't, either.
translation: 当然有可能这么做。但对莫蒂默而言，为了复兴食人传统，他宁可连命都不要。不过，他大概是自信不会受到惩罚吧。连我都这么认为。

original: Nothing is more important to the Society than to be on the cutting edge of New Vegas cuisine. Mortimer's idea will appeal to that need.
translation: 在社团眼里，走在新维加斯的美食最前沿才是重中之重。莫蒂默的想法和社团的理念一致。

original: He just has to get them over the taboo.
translation: 他想做的只是帮助他们打破禁忌。

original: What about Ted Gunderson?
translation: 泰德·冈德森怎么了？

original: He's alive, as far as I know. They're trying to keep him fresh. Mortimer has special plans for him.
translation: 据我所知，他还活着。他们想让他的肉质保持新鲜，因为莫蒂默准备了一个特别的计划。

original: The White Glove Society has a banquet every night at 7. It's in our private section.
translation: 白手套社团每天晚上7点都会举办宴会。地点是在我们的一个私密会所。

original: Mortimer wants to reintroduce humans into our cuisine. Since eating people is a crime we punish by death, he's going to do it in secret.
translation: 莫蒂默想让人肉重新登上我们的餐桌。由于吃人肉在家族内部是死罪，因此，他决心上演一出暗度陈仓。

original: After everyone has eaten it he'll tell them.
translation: 他打算在大家都尝过之后，再告诉他们吃的是什么。

original: With no real way to punish everyone, in Mortimer's mind, anyway, their minds will be open to the idea of eating people as a delicacy.
translation: 在莫蒂默看来，既然法不责众，那说不定他们会从此转变观念，将人肉当成一种单纯的食材。

original: How do you know what happened to the girl?
translation: 你怎么知道那个女孩出了事？

original: Because I distracted her fiancee while they took her. Well, I'm not proud of it! But I had to. They could see I was having second thoughts.
translation: 因为她被抓的时候，我负责分散她未婚夫的注意力。唉，我也不想干啊！可我没办法，只要稍一犹豫就会被他们看出来。

original: Some of the White Gloves began meeting privately a while back. Started talking about how we'd lost our identity.
translation: 一些社团成员前不久开始秘密集会，讨论我们如何迷失了本性。

original: I started attending because I thought it was about changing our politics.
translation: 起初我还以为他们是要修改社团的纲领，于是就参加了。

original: Then they started talking about returning to the old ways, and there was no way out. They'd kill me for the things I'd heard them say.
translation: 结果他们就开始大肆鼓吹要复兴传统，我一听就明白自己跑不掉了。我知道的太多，他们肯定会杀了我的。

original: So is Mortimer behind the disappearances?
translation: 所以说，莫蒂默就是失踪事件的幕后黑手？

original: Yes. The White Glove Society strictly forbids eating humans. But we weren't always the White Glove Society.
translation: 是的。白手套社团严禁以人肉为食。但我们以前并且如此。

original: Mortimer and some of the others have... regressed... to the old ways.
translation: 莫蒂默和其他一些人正在……尝试复兴……传统。

original: They've taken many people over the last few months. But always from Freeside or secluded places, where they wouldn't be missed.
translation: 他们过去几个月抓了很多人。这些人都来自自由城或者其他偏远地区，就算失踪了也不会被发现。

original: It wasn't enough. Lately they've gone for tourists here on the Strip. Even in the hotel.
translation: 可这样还不够。他们最近又瞄上了长街的游客。连住在酒店里的都不放过。

original: I guess that's the hazard of a cannibal becoming a gourmet - it's hard to please a refined palate.
translation: 所以，食人族一旦了成美食家，那就要了命了——刁钻的口味太难满足了。

original: What were you supposed to discuss here?
translation: 你们本来要在这里讨论什么？

original: The girl. The one who disappeared. I know what happened to her.
translation: 那个失踪的女孩。我知道她出了什么事。

original: Who are you afraid of?
translation: 你在害怕谁？

original: Mortimer. If he realizes it was me the investigator was planning to meet, he'll have me killed.
translation: 莫蒂默。要是让他发现那个侦探要见的人是我，他肯定会杀了我的。

original: [Attack] I am now.
translation: [攻击] 我现在是了。

original: Not for long.
translation: 不会太久的。

original: No. I'm trying to find a different missing person and ran across the man's body.
translation: 不。我在找另一个失踪的人时碰巧发现了这个男人的尸体。

original: I found the matchbook on a body in a hotel room.
translation: 我在某个酒店房间里的尸体身上找到了这个火柴包装纸。

original: You don't want to know.
translation: 你不会想知道的。

original: <Lie> He couldn't make it, so he sent me instead.
translation: <撒谎> 他不能来了，所以叫我替他来。

original: {using 'devil' as a curse here}The devil he did. He was supposed to meet me days ago. Are you in Mortimer's employ, then?
translation: {using 'devil' as a curse here}瞧他干的好事。他几天以前就该来见我的。那么，你是莫蒂默雇来的吗？

original: He's dead.
translation: 他死了。

original: Oh my goodness me! They must know he was talking to someone on the inside.
translation: 哦，我了个天！他们肯定发现他和组织里的人有勾结了。

original: They'll be watching everyone closer now. I knew this was a mistake.
translation: 这下他们会对每个人盯得更紧的。早知道我就不掺和了。

original: Just someone who found a matchbook.
translation: 我刚刚找到了一个火柴包装纸。

original: Matchbook? What about the man I gave it to?
translation: 包装纸？那它原来的主人呢？

original: I'm looking for someone who went missing.
translation: 我在找一个失踪的人。

original: So was the man I'm supposed to be meeting here. Where is he?
translation: 那个要和我在这儿见面的人也失踪了。他在哪？

original: You first.
translation: 你先说。

original: You don't know? <Sighs> Good. That's good. So they didn't send you after me.
translation: 你不知道？ <叹息> 很好。非常好。也就是说你不是他们派来跟踪我的。

original: Where's the gentleman I'm supposed to meet?
translation: 我要见的那位先生在哪里？

original: That was me, "negotiating."
translation: 我就是这样"谈判"的。

original: You were supposed to negotiate for the safety of my troopers, damn it.
translation: 你谈判的目的应该是尽力保护我手下人的安全，该死的。

original: Like you said, things went bad.
translation: 就像你说的，情况失控了。

original: Right... probably just bad luck.
translation: 是啊……大概运气差了些吧。

original: <Lie> I didn't have a choice - they started shooting first.
translation: <撒谎> 我没得选，是他们先开枪射击的。

original: Knowing the Khans, they were probably drugged up to hell and back.
translation: 大汗帮的人本性难改，他们八成是都嗑了药。

original: We'll take it from here and sort things out. Thanks for trying to help us out.
translation: 剩下的事就交给我们来处理吧。谢谢你的帮助。

original: Please bear in mind that there may be more to this situation than there seems. The reasons for these attacks are yet unknown.
translation: 请务必牢记，这一情况背后可能还另有隐情。目前我们尚不清楚攻击的原因。

original: It may be possible to avoid further bloodshed if you discover the cause at the root of this recent outbreak of violence.
translation: 如果你能查清楚事情缘由的话，也许能避免更多的流血事件。

original: We've actually already met. It is good to see you again.
translation: 我们其实已经见过面了。能再见到你真好。

original: It's a pleasure to meet you. I appreciate what you've done so far in the interest of peace in Freeside.
translation: 很高兴见到你。感谢你为了自由城的和谐安宁做了那么多好事。

original: What kind of specialist is Clanden?
translation: 克兰顿是哪方面的专家？

original: Oh? Is that so, well I can't say that I'm sad to see that fucker gone.
translation: 哦？真的啊？我对那混蛋的死一点也不感到悲伤。

original: Clanden has been handled already.
translation: 克兰顿已经被干掉了。

original: I got no fucking idea. They let him have the run of the place though. He seems like a nice guy, but he makes nervous.
translation: 我他妈也不清楚。不过老板们却好吃好住地供着他。他看起来人不错，就是让我不舒服。

original: He's a little arrogant, but he's too nice. Too open, I've never seen him fucking or gambling. Everyone has a vice, but this guy seems like the Pope.
translation: 有点自大，但品行却好到不正常。一身干干净净，我从没看见过他嫖妓或赌博。每个人都有恶习，要比起来，这家伙简直就是个圣人。

original: <Barter Option>
translation: <交易选项>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Okay, you got me by the balls. Here's a couple hundred caps, maybe that'll buy your friendship.
translation: [成功] 好吧，谁让我的蛋蛋就在你手里捏着。这里有几百个瓶盖，就当咱们俩之间的一点小意思吧。

original: I'll consider giving this to you, for some cash up front.
translation: 如果你先付我一些钱，我可以考虑把它给你。

original: [FAILED] Do I look like some kind of fool? I'm not paying you so you can double deal on me.
translation: [失败] 我看起来像傻瓜吗？我不会付钱给你的，别想耍我两次。

original: Err... Well if you give me everything you have, I'll consider making a deal.
translation: 嗯……如果你把你的东西都给我，我会考虑和你谈笔交易的。

original: I think I'm going to keep this for a little while.
translation: 我觉得这东西我还是再保管一阵这东西好了。

original: All right, all right.  I can't stop you, but I think we can help each other out.
translation: 好，好。我不会阻止你的，不过我想你应该是个聪明人，知道怎么做对咱俩都好。

original: I know Not-At-Home and the NCR would be happy to get some dirt on the Family. I can help you get that dirt, and you got me by the short hairs.
translation: 我知道“不在家”先生和NCR都很希望得到一些对家族不利的情报。我能帮你搞到这些情报，毕竟我的小辫子还在你手里呢。

original: Do you think the Family would like to see this?
translation: 你认为家族会喜欢这东西吗？

original: I can't stop you, but that's gonna mean my death. I can make it worth your while to give it to me though.
translation: 我无法阻止你，但那样做会要了我的命。如果你把它给我的话，我会让你觉得物超所值的。

original: Plus, if you go to the bosses I can't help you stop what they've been doing.
translation: 另外，如果你非要去见老板的话，我就不能帮助你阻止他们的计划了。

original: Is this journal worth 100 caps to you?
translation: 这日志对你来说值100瓶盖吗？

original: I can pay you for it, of course. I also have some information about the Family's business that you might find interesting.
translation: 没问题，我可以付你钱。另外，我手上还有一些和家族生意有关的情报，估计你会有兴趣的。

original: Between you and I we can break up what they're planning, maybe save some lives... Mine included, of course.
translation: 我们俩联手就能破坏他们的计划，也许还能救几个人……当然其中包括我。

original: Oh, here are some caps. Now give me the journal. Right, there we go. So let me tell you what I know about the Family's business.
translation: 噢，给你钱。现在把日志给我。好了，我们成交了。我再告诉你一些我掌握的有关家族生意的情报。

original: The Bosses, Big Sal and Nero, have been working for a while on this. They're arming themselves like an army, using this new guy, Troike.
translation: 我的老板，大萨尔和尼禄，已经精心策划了有一段时间了。拜卓伊克这个新面孔所赐，他们现在就像军队一样武装到牙齿。

original: They also brought in a specialist named Clanden. At least that's what they introduced him as.
translation: 他们还引进了一个名叫克兰顿的专家。起码他们在介绍他的时候是这么说的。

original: Ok, 100 caps and you help me break up whatever your bosses have planned.
translation: 行，100瓶盖，然后你帮我破坏你老板策划的那些阴谋。

original: He bolted. But I'll find him.
translation: 他逃了。不过我会找到他的。

original: I hope so, kid. Last thing we need is that punk running around out there.
translation: 希望如此，孩子。我不想再看到那个废物出现在这里。

original: Yeah, he's dead.
translation: 没错，他死了。

original: Huh. Guess that makes me the boss. Ring-a-ding.
translation: 哈，这样我就能当老大了，太棒了。

original: Not yet. Soon.
translation: 还没。快了。

original: All right, well, might want to get a move on, is all I'm saying.
translation: 好吧，嗯，既然这样，那你动作快点吧。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Sure, whatever you want.
translation: 当然，说吧。

original: I've got more questions about New Vegas.
translation: 关于新维加斯，我还有些问题。

original: Baby, you're too good to me! How about some caps to buy myself something pretty?
translation: 宝贝，你对我实在太好了！不如给我些钱让我买点儿东西？

original: Ooh, I dig the way you think, doll. Here, go treat yourself.
translation: 噢，我知道你在想什么，乖乖。给你，好好犒劳自己一下。

original: Flattering, but I don't like being tied down. How about some real work?
translation: 你可真能说，不过我不喜欢被束缚的感觉。来点真正的工作怎么样？

original: You might have a jaw at Tommy Torini up in the Aces. He's always looking for talent scouts.
translation: 你可以去王牌剧场找汤米·托里尼谈谈。他最近一直在招募星探。

original: Tell me about the Chairmen.
translation: 给我说说董事会。

original: Baby, we're only the coolest cats on the whole Strip. We been here the longest, we got the swankiest digs, and we got caps rolling in like the tide.
translation: 宝贝，我们可是整条长街上最棒的家族。我们来得最早，地盘也最时髦，赚的钱也最多。

original: Everybody loves the Chairmen, because we show them a simple good time, no strings attached.
translation: 人人都爱董事会，因为我们可以教他们无忧无虑，纵情欢乐。

original: Man, we're only the coolest cats on the whole Strip. We been here the longest, we got the swankiest digs, and we got caps rolling in like the tide.
translation: 老兄，我们可是整条长街上最棒的家族。我们来得最早，地盘也最时髦，赚的钱也最多。

original: Everybody loves the Chairmen, because we show them a simple good time, no strings attached.
translation: 人人都爱董事会，因为我们可以教他们无忧无虑，纵情欢乐。

original: What do you know about Mr. House?
translation: 你对豪斯先生了解多少？

original: House is an all-right kind of guy. Sure, he keeps a pretty tight grip on the reins, but Vegas is a wild horse, and you can't just give her her head.
translation: 豪斯是一个很可靠的家伙，他对权位把持得很紧，但维加斯就像是一匹野马，不紧紧拽着就控制不住。

original: Without Mr. House, we'd still be wearing gecko skins, poking around the ruins with pointy sticks and scalping people for giggles.
translation: 如果没有豪斯先生，我们可能现在还穿着蜥蜴皮，举着削尖的木棍在废墟里以剥人皮为乐呢。

original: Let's talk about the Omertas.
translation: 我们谈谈黑手党吧。

original: Oh, they're a shifty pack of rats. If I were you, I'd keep one hand on my wallet and the other on my gun whenever they're around.
translation: 哦，那群贼眉鼠眼的狗东西。我要是你，看见他们出现在我身边，就会立马抓紧自己的钱包和手枪。

original: What's the story with the White Glove Society?
translation: 白手套社团到底是个怎样的组织？

original: Creepy bunch of cats, you ask me. Oh, sure, they act all polite and civilized, but there's something off about them, you dig?
translation: 一群令人毛骨悚然的家伙。哦，没错，他们举止优雅，文质彬彬，但我总觉得他们有地方不对劲，你明白吗？

original: Don't get me wrong, that resort of theirs is ring-a-ding, but my guts say, "don't go in the basement."
translation: 你可别误会，他们那赌场是相当豪华，但是直觉告诉我，“别去地下室”。

original: Benny must think this chip will allow him to seize power on the Strip.
translation: 本尼肯定是觉得这筹码能让他坐上长街的头把交椅。

original: Jesus, I can't even believe it. After all House did to set us up with this swank joint. I don't suppose there's more?
translation: 上帝，我简直不敢相信。豪斯给了我们这么个时髦的金窝还嫌不够，他还想要别的？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Jesus, I can't even believe it. After all House did to set us up with this swank joint. I don't suppose there's more?
translation: [成功] 上帝，我简直不敢相信。豪斯给了我们这么个时髦的金窝还嫌不够，他还想要别的？

original: [FAILED] Now you're just talking crazy. No way Benny'd risk something like that. What else you got?
translation: [失败] 别扯淡了。本尼可没必要冒那样的险。你还有什么要说的？

original: He tried to make it look like an accident - just a traveler killed and robbed in the Wasteland.
translation: 他想把这件事伪装成一起意外，一名旅行者在废土上被人劫杀。

original: He's trying to pull a fast one on the big man? Crazy bastard. You got any more?
translation: 他想跟大佬作对？他疯了。你还知道些什么？

original: [SUCCEEDED] He's trying to pull a fast one on the big man? Crazy bastard. You got any more?
translation: [成功] 他想跟大佬作对？他疯了。你还知道些什么？

original: [FAILED] Kid, that doesn't even pretend to make sense. You want to try again?
translation: [失败] 孩子，瞎掰也掰得像一点。你还能编出什么故事来？

original: Benny's going to steal all of House's robots! Don't you see?
translation: 本尼要偷走豪斯所有的机器人！你还不明白？

original: I've got evidence!
translation: 我拿到证据了！

original: Benny tried to kill me and stole a platinum chip I was hired to deliver.
translation: 本尼想杀我，还把我递送的白金筹码给偷走了。

original: That doesn't... why would he pull a stunt like that? Got anything else to offer?
translation: 那没道理……为什么他要干这种吃力不讨好的事？一定还有别的缘故吧？

original: [SUCCEEDED] That doesn't... why would he pull a stunt like that? Got anything else to offer?
translation: [成功] 那没道理……为什么他要干这种吃力不讨好的事？一定还有别的缘故吧？

original: [FAILED] Kid, I think you really better shut up and stop making baseless accusations unless you got some proof. Well?
translation: [失败] 孩子，我觉得你最好闭嘴，没有证据，就不要瞎告状。懂了？

original: Benny stole my chip! And he tried to kill me, Mr. House said so!
translation: 本尼偷走了我的筹码，还想杀我！豪斯先生是这么说的！

original: Go ahead, see if I care.
translation: 去啊，关我屁事。

original: Pal, you're gonna regret that for the rest of your very short life.
translation: 伙计，你这条命是活不了几分钟了，等着后悔吧。

original: Ha ha! Take it easy, pal, I'm just pulling your leg. Honest.
translation: 哈，哈！别生气，伙计，我只是跟你开个玩笑，真的。

original: Anybody ever tell you your sense of humor stinks? I'll let it go this time, but you watch your mouth from now on.
translation: 没人跟你说过你的幽默感令人作呕吗？这次就算了，但从现在开始，你最好管住自己的嘴巴。

original: I don't think you're going to like it. Seems Benny's been making his own play.
translation: 你听了别生气，本尼看起来是打算自己坐庄了。

original: Huh? What are you talking about?
translation: 哈？你说什么呢？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Huh? What are you talking about?
translation: [成功] 哈？你说什么呢？

original: [FAILED] Why you lousy no-good punk! Give me one reason why I shouldn't take this to Benny right now!
translation: [失败] 你这一肚子坏水的混球！给我个理由，不然我就把这事告诉本尼，马上！

original: Uh, well, you know Benny's planning to screw you over, right?
translation: 呃，好吧，你知道本尼在计划对付你，是吧？

original: We don't have time for that. We need to take him out right now.
translation: 我们可没那闲工夫，我们得马上做掉他。

original: Take him out? Jesus... okay, well, if you think that's the best way to deal with this. I'll send him up to his room, you can ambush him there.
translation: 做掉他？上帝……好吧，好吧，如果你觉得这么做最合适的话。我会把他送回房间，你可以在那里伏击他。

original: And don't worry about the rest of the Chairmen - I'll keep them from getting involved. You'll still have to watch out for Benny's guards, though.
translation: 你也不必担心董事会的其他人——我不会让他们卷进来的。不过就算这样，你还是要小心本尼的保镖。

original: Okay, I'll do it.
translation: 没问题，交给我吧。

original: Groovy. Here's your stuff back - in case you run into company, you dig? I'll tell the boys to give you a pass to pack some heat.
translation: 好极了。东西先还给你——以防你突然遇到麻烦什么的，懂吗？我会让伙计们给你放行的。

original: Go on then. Elevators are past the slot machines on your left.
translation: 走吧。电梯就在你左手边老虎机的后面。

original: That's it. What do you think?
translation: 就这些。你觉得呢？

original: I'll tell you what I think, I think I oughta go tell Benny about this right now - but I'll clam up for now.
translation: 我告诉你我是怎么想的：我想我应该立刻把这件事告诉本尼——不过，我现在还是保持沉默吧。

original: That's all I'm going to do, though, unless you can get me some more proof.
translation: 除非你有更多证据，否则我不会采取任何进一步的行动。

original: I think you might just be onto something here, kid. Tell you what, I can't actively back your play, but I'll keep the Chairmen off your back.
translation: 我觉得这当中一定另有文章，孩子。实话告诉你，虽然我不能公开支持你，但我可以保证不让董事会在你背后捅刀子。

original: I'll tell the doormen you're cool to pack heat inside - trust me, you're gonna need it.
translation: 我会告诉门卫你可以带家伙进来——相信我，你会用得上它们的。

original: You'll still have to deal with Benny's private goon squad, though. I got no play with those cats. You want more help, I'll need more proof.
translation: 你还得想办法解决本尼的私人保镖。我可不希望招惹那帮人。如果你还想要我帮忙，就得给我更多的证据。

original: Jesus, kid, I think we got a real problem on our hands. Can't believe Benny's a no-good stinkin' punk. Trying to play House like that....
translation: 上帝啊，孩子，我想我们遇上大麻烦了。真不敢相信，本尼居然是个不好安心的孬种，敢那样愚弄豪斯先生……

original: Tell you what - I'll call Benny, keep him away from his suite. You go search the place. Here's the key, it's on the 13th floor.
translation: 这样吧——我会吸引本尼的注意，你趁他不在的时候搜下他的房间。这是钥匙，就在13楼。

original: It's the room with the double doors, can't miss it. Maybe you'll find something we can show to Mr. House and get him arrested.
translation: 有双扇门的那个房间，你不会搞错的。说不定你还能找到些证据，这样我们就可以报告豪斯先生，把他抓起来了。

original: Look, just trust me on this, okay?
translation: 听着，一定要相信我，好吗？

original: Here, take a look at this note I found in Novac.
translation: 看看，这是我在诺瓦克找到的便条。

original: That's... pretty shady, yeah. Could be Benny's up to no good, could be this is somebody else altogether. What else you got?
translation: 还真是……相当可疑，是的。这可能是本尼干的，也可能是别的什么人干的。你还发现了什么？

original: I found this lighter in Boulder City. He dropped it when he killed his partners.
translation: 这是我在巨石城找到的打火机。他杀同伙的时候把这东西落下了。

original: Yeah, that looks like Benny's lighter all right. Still, not exactly a ton of proof. Got anything else, kid?
translation: 没错，看起来确实像是本尼的打火机。不过这也算不上证据确凿。还有其他东西吗，孩子？

original: Look, I found these cigarette butts by the grave he buried me in.
translation: 你看，这是我在他们埋我的坟边上捡到的烟头。

original: Huh. Well, yeah, okay, these are Benny's brand, and they ain't too common. You got anything else?
translation: 嗯，是吗，好吧，这的确是本尼常抽的牌子，而且它们确实不太常见，你还找到了些什么？

original: I took all the pictures you wanted. There was something about a reward...
translation: 你想要的照片我都拍来了。至于报酬……

original: You have earned it, my friend! Now I can finally unveil my masterpieces to the world, all thanks to you. Come visit me again sometime.
translation: 都是你应得的，我的朋友！多亏了你，现在我终于能向全世界展示我的杰作了。以后常来坐坐。

original: What landmarks did you want me to photograph?
translation: 你想让我拍摄些什么地标？

original: I always wanted to see the Dinosaur and its Thermometer sign at Novac. Then, there's the famous Bison Steve sign.
translation: 我一直想看看诺瓦克的大恐龙和温度计。还有，著名的野牛史蒂夫旅馆招牌。

original: The McCarran Airfield and the Helios One power station signs are of much interest to my work - like the Sunset Sarsaparrilla Headquarter's bottle.
translation: 麦卡伦机场和太阳神一号发电站也会对我的创作大有帮助——此外还有夕阳沙士总部大楼上的瓶子。

original: I have some ideas that may help with your agoraphobia problem.
translation: 我有些能帮助你克服广场恐惧症的建议。

original: That's great to hear, really great.
translation: 那真是太好了，太好了。

original: What's your story, Michael Angelo?
translation: 你有什么故事吗，米开·朗琪罗？

original: Well, I, uh, not much, really. Vault 21 was my home, my dear home. I left it to explore the outside world.
translation: 啊，我，呃，没什么故事，真的。21号避难所是我的家，美丽的家。我离开了它，去外面的世界闯荡。

original: At first it was a marvel to behold. My inspiration flowed true and its works caught Mr. House's 'attention. That's how I ended up in this... place.
translation: 起先我对一切都充满了好奇。我的灵感喷涌而出，作品也引起了豪斯先生的注意。于是我就……到这儿来了。

original: You mentioned growing up in Vault 21. Can you tell me about that?
translation: 你提到你是在21号避难所长大的。能和我说说那里吗？

original: Most people don't, uh, understand what it means to grow up in a vault. Its corridors, its walls, radiate a warmth that feels, safe, honest.
translation: 很多人都，呃，不理解在避难所长大的感觉。它的走廊，墙壁，四处都散发着温暖的气息，安全，可靠。

original: But here everything is huge and threatening - so empty that I think one of these days I'll just... snap.
translation: 但这里，所有东西都大得可怕——太空虚了，空虚到让我觉得自己说不定哪天就会……垮掉。

original: Tell me about you again.
translation: 再跟我说说你自己的事。

original: I am Sheldon, from Vault 21, although here I go by my artistic name, "Michael Angelo."
translation: 我叫谢尔顿，来自21号避难所。不过在这儿我都用艺名，“米开·朗琪罗”。

original: Groveling brings out the worst in me. I'm going to enjoy this.
translation: 我就喜欢听人求饶。我会好好教训你一顿的。

original: Aaaaahhhhh - Help!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊——救命！

original: That's a very... inspired choice, Mickey.
translation: 这是个很……有创意的选择, 米奇。

original: {Still afraid}Now that you have all you care for, please... leave, and don't come back!
translation: {Still afraid}你想要的东西都已经给你了，请你……快走吧，别再回来了！

original: You're not making this easy. Screw it. Hand over the caps or drop dead.
translation: 你说得倒是轻松。去你妈的，把瓶盖交出来，否则就去死吧。

original: {Fearful}What!? No, please! Here, take the caps but please don't hurt me!
translation: {Fearful}什么！？别，求你了！给你，这些瓶盖拿去，请别伤害我！

original: I'm glad we have an understanding. Now, do you have any landmarks in mind?
translation: 很高兴我们达成了共识。那么，你有什么想看的地标吗？

original: I always wanted to see the Dinosaur and its Thermometer sign at Novac. Then, there's the famous Bison Steve sign.
translation: 我一直想看看诺瓦克的大恐龙和温度计。还有，著名的野牛史蒂夫旅馆招牌。

original: The McCarran Airfield and the Helios One power station signs are of much interest to my work - like the Sunset Sarsaparrilla Headquarter's bottle.
translation: 麦卡伦机场和太阳神一号发电站也会对我的创作大有帮助——此外还有夕阳沙士总部大楼上的瓶子。

original: I have some fresh pictures for you.
translation: 我有些新的照片给你。

original: Oh, that's wonderful! Just what I need. Thank you, brave one! Here's some compensation for your work.
translation: 哦，真不错！正是我需要的。谢谢你，勇士！这些是给你的报酬。

original: Ok, you've got a deal. I'll return with the pictures.
translation: 好吧，就这么定了。我会拍好照片回来的。

original: Thank you! I really can't thank you enough for this. Please, get me all the pictures. I will compensate you accordingly.
translation: 谢谢你！真是感激不尽。请你一定要拍完所有的照片。我会照价付钱的。

original: Oh, and if you need more camera film then just come back and I will get it for you. Again, thank you!
translation: 噢，还有，如果你需要胶卷的话就回来找我，我会给你的。再次感谢你！

original: All right. I'll bring you more next time. Good bye
translation: 好的。下次我会给你带回更多的照片。再见。

original: All right. I'll bring you more next time. Good bye
translation: 好的。下次我会给你带回更多的照片。再见。

original: All right. I'll bring you more next time. Good bye
translation: 好的。下次我会给你带回更多的照片。再见。

original: All right. I'll bring you more next time. Good bye
translation: 好的。下次我会给你带回更多的照片。再见。

original: Let's see. Walk half the world or rough you up right now... Mickey, you lose.
translation: 我看看啊。要么走遍大半个世界，要么现在就揍你一顿……米开，你输了。

original: {Fearful}What!? No, please! Here, take the caps but please don't hurt me!
translation: {Fearful}什么！？别，求你了！给你，这些瓶盖拿去，请别伤害我！

original: Yeah. Keep him distracted while I search his room.
translation: 好的。你想办法拖住他，我去搜他的房间。

original: You got it. Anything else?
translation: 了解。还有别的事吗？

original: Yeah, send him up to his room. I'll take care of him.
translation: 好了，让他去房间里等着吧。我会好好教训他的。

original: Yeah, sure. I hope you know what you're doing, kid.
translation: 好的，当然。希望你知道自己在做什么，孩子。

original: Not yet, I want to take care of a few things first.
translation: 稍等，我还有些事情要处理。

original: Okay. Just let me know when you're ready.
translation: 好吧。你准备好了就告诉我。

original: Okay, I'll do it.
translation: 好的，交给我吧。

original: Here's your stuff back - in case Benny don't go quiet, you dig? I'll tell the boys to give you a pass to pack some heat.
translation: 装备还你——以防本尼不肯乖乖就范，明白吗？我会让我的人放你过去的。

original: Go on then. Elevators are past the slot machines on your right.
translation: 走吧，电梯就在你右手边的老虎机再过去一点。

original: Go on then. Elevators are past the slot machines on your right.
translation: 走吧，电梯就在你右手边的老虎机再过去一点。

original: They took my guns at the security checkpoint. Can you set me up?
translation: 他们在安检的时候缴了我的枪，你能不能让他们还我？

original: Yeah, sure. Take your stuff back - you'll need it.
translation: 啊，当然，把你的装备拿回去吧——你会用得上它们的。

original: Go on then. Elevators are past the slot machines on your right.
translation: 走吧，电梯就在你右手边的老虎机再过去一点。

original: Actually, never mind. It's nothing.
translation: 其实，没关系。没什么。

original: Yeah, thought so. You're a smart kid, you know that?
translation: 哈，我也这么觉得。你真是个聪明的孩子，你知道吗？

original: I have a couple more questions.
translation: 我还有一些问题。

original: Okay toss 'em at me.
translation: 好的，问吧。

original: That's all the questions I have for now. I may have more later.
translation: 我现在没问题了。晚点有了再问你。

original: Okay. You can find me here, or upstairs in my room. I'll let the muscle know you're a friend of mine, that should let you get around a little easier.
translation: 没问题，你可以在这里或者我楼上的房间里找到我。我会和手下说你是我朋友的，这会让你来去更方便点。

original: Do you know anything about what they are planning?
translation: 对他们的计划你了解多少？

original: No, just that it involves guns and muscle. Also that it's big. Very big. Only Nero and Big Sal know everything, and they ain't telling.
translation: 不清楚，只知道涉及军火和武力。它是个大计划，非常大。只有尼禄和大萨尔了解详情，但他们对此闭口不谈。

original: Tell me about this Troike.
translation: 告诉我卓伊克的事。

original: He's a skittish little fucker. Spends half the day pumping his body full of chems and the other half pumping hookers with his willy.
translation: 他就是个没长性的孬种。每天一半的时间花在毒品上，另一半时间花在妓女上。

original: He has some kind of connections, so he's able to smuggle huge shipments of weapons into the strip.
translation: 他有些关系，能把大批军火偷运进长街。

original: The bosses got him by the short hairs. We covered up a hooker he killed while flying on some psycho, so he gets us guns in exchange for not ratting.
translation: 老板抓住了他的把柄。有次他发狂杀了一个妓女，我们掩盖了这件事，为了不让事情败露，从此他就给我们提供军火了。

original: You took care of Troike already, you don't need to worry about him.
translation: 既然你已经处理掉卓伊克的事情了，就不用再管他了。

original: Why don't you try and take it from me?
translation: 你怎么不试试从我手中抢走它呢？

original: You wanna come into a back room and give me a chance? Didn't think so.
translation: 你会跑进角落里乖乖等着我动手？我不这样认为。

original: Much as I'd love to put my fist through your neck, Mr. House frowns on that kind of behavior, so it'd get me killed just as quick as that book.
translation: 我确实很想一拳打断你的脖子，但豪斯先生不喜欢这种行为，这么做还是会害死我，还不如你拿着那本日记去告密呢。

original: Nothing, I was just leaving.
translation: 没事，我这就走。

original: Then leave.
translation: 那快走吧。

original: Actually I'm looking for someone named Cachino.
translation: 实际上我在找一个叫卡奇诺的人。

original: Get the fuck away from me. Don't ask me about Cachino.
translation: 离我他妈的远点。别问我什么卡奇诺。

original: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。

original: Your loss.
translation: 这是你的损失。

original: Deal.
translation: 成交。

original: Follow Me.
translation: 跟我来。

original: Yeah, let's have some fun.
translation: 好啊，来点乐子吧。

original: Okay, 50 caps to make you scream.
translation: 没问题，50瓶盖让你爽到尖叫。

original: I'm a little short on caps. I don't suppose there's any work available?
translation: 我现在需要瓶盖。不会没有我可以做的工作吧？

original: Not in Goodsprings, no. But if you're up for a little scavenging, there's always the schoolhouse.
translation: 清泉镇这里还真没有。但如果你愿意捡破烂，可以去校舍里看看。

original: Most of what's in there is junk, but there's this old safe that even Easy Pete wasn't able to crack with dynamite.
translation: 那里大部分都是垃圾，但有个旧保险箱连轻松皮特的炸药都炸不开。

original: If you want to take a shot at it, take these.
translation: 如果你想去试试自己的本事，就拿着这些东西吧。

original: Let's talk about the acts I recruited.
translation: 说说我新招来的人的表现吧。

original: The cowboy act? Yeah, he dropped on in here not too long before you. He's got chops, baby, real chops, and I ain't just talking about that mustache.
translation: 那个牛仔？是的，他已经先你一步到这儿了。宝贝，他的演技简直绝了，真的绝了，我说的可不是他那胡子。

original: And like we agreed, here's your fee. 3% of the cut comes to 100 caps. Don't spend them all in one place now - unless it's right here!
translation: 咱们之前说好的，这是你的报酬。3%的分成，就是100个瓶盖。别一次全花完了——除非确实有必要!

original: The cowboy act? Yeah, he dropped on in here not too long before you. He's got chops, baby, real chops, and I ain't just talking about that mustache.
translation: 那个牛仔？是的，他已经先你一步到这儿了。宝贝，他的演技简直绝了，真的绝了，我说的可不是他那胡子。

original: And like we agreed, here's your fee. 5% of the cut comes to 166 caps. Don't spend them all in one place now - unless it's right here!
translation: 咱们之前说好的，这是你的报酬。5%的分成，就是166个瓶盖。别一次全花完了——除非确实有必要!

original: You talking about Mr. Isaac? Damn, baby, when you bring them in, you bring them *in!* That cat's gonna bring me money like you wouldn't believe.
translation: 你说艾萨克先生？该死，宝贝，你介绍了他，简直就是给我送了棵摇钱树啊！他会让我发大财的。

original: Here's your 3%, baby. You enjoy that.
translation: 这是你的3%分成，宝贝。自己拿着花吧。

original: You talking about Mr. Isaac? Damn, baby, when you bring them in, you bring them *in!* That cat's gonna bring me money like you wouldn't believe.
translation: 你说艾萨克先生？该死，宝贝，你介绍了他，简直就是给我送了棵摇钱树啊！他会让我发大财的。

original: Here's your 5%, baby. You enjoy that.
translation: 这是你的5%，宝贝。自己拿着花吧。

original: That comedian you mean? Yeah, he practically begged me to hire him. Didn't even haggle. Here's your 3%.
translation: 你说那个喜剧演员？是啊，他根本就是在求我雇他。连价钱都不谈。这是你的3%。

original: That comedian you mean? Yeah, he practically begged me to hire him. Didn't even haggle. Here's your 5%.
translation: 你说那个喜剧演员？是啊，他根本就是在求我雇他。连价钱都不谈。这是你的5%。

original: That comedian you mean? Yeah, he was a hell of a haggler. Cost me a pretty cap - hope he's worth it. Here's your 3%.
translation: 你说那个喜剧演员？是啊，跟他讨价还价可真够呛。花了我不少瓶盖，希望他能值这个价。这是你的3%。

original: That comedian you mean? Yeah, he was a hell of a haggler. Cost me a pretty cap - hope he's worth it. Here's your 5%.
translation: 你说那个喜剧演员？是啊，跟他讨价还价可真够呛。花了我不少瓶盖，希望他能值这个价。这是你的5%。

original: That ugly mug with the razor tongue? Dig it baby, he'll be one hell of a novelty act. Just like Tommy promised, here's your 3%.
translation: 那个嘴巴毒得像刀子的丑八怪？和你实话说吧，这家伙一定能带来不少新鲜感。之前说好的，这是你的3%分成。

original: That ugly mug with the razor tongue? Dig it baby, he'll be one hell of a novelty act. Just like Tommy promised, here's your 5%.
translation: 那个嘴巴毒得像刀子的丑八怪？和你实话说吧，这家伙一定能带来不少新鲜感。之前说好的，这是你的5%分成。

original: Swank mentioned you might be looking for some new acts. Can I help?
translation: 斯万克说你可能需要一些新演员。我能帮忙吗？

original: Sure, baby, sure. Tommy's always looking for new talent to bring to the Aces.
translation: 是的，孩子，没错。汤米一直在为王牌剧院招兵买马。

original: Tell you what, you see any good acts while you're out wandering, give them my card. If they work out, I'll give you a 3% cut of the door.
translation: 这么说吧，如果你在外面遇见了不错的演员，就把我的名片递给他们。如果他们表现良好，我会分3%的门票收入给你。

original: Just swing back by as you recruit folks, I'll get you your bread.
translation: 只要你招到人以后回来，我就会给你提成。

original: What other entertainment is there on the Strip?
translation: 在长街上还有什么别的娱乐活动吗？

original: Now why would you want to go breaking Tommy's heart asking a question like that?
translation: 哦，你怎么能问出这种让汤米感到心碎的问题呢？

original: Here I run the finest entertainment venue in all New Vegas, and you're asking me "what else is there?"
translation: 我经营的可是整个新维加斯最好的娱乐场所，你居然还想要"别的"？

original: Nothing close to what we got here at the Tops, that's for sure.
translation: 再没有什么地方能与我们九重天相媲美了，我向你保证。

original: What do you think about Benny?
translation: 你怎么看本尼？

original: Benny? Ahh, he's an all right cat, you dig? He don't got much musical talent, but he knows how to run a business. When he's around, anyways.
translation: 本尼？啊，他这人挺不错的，你知道吗？他虽然没什么音乐天赋，但做生意很在行。当然，我指的是他没外出的时候。

original: Tell me about this theater.
translation: 和我说说这家剧院吧。

original: Well, it was my idea - well, me and the rest of the Rad Pack boys. We took it to Benny, and he thought it was a good idea.
translation: 好吧，当初搞剧院可是我出的主意——我是说，我和其他核子欢乐汇成员们一起出的主意。我们告诉了本尼，他觉得是这是个好点子。

original: A few years later, here we are - the best show in New Vegas!
translation: 没几年，我们就成了新维加斯最棒的剧院！

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: Well, apart from serving as talent manager, show scheduler, and all-around man in charge of this fine theater, I happen to be its headline act.
translation: 这个嘛，我不光是这个剧院的人力总监、舞台调度以及全权负责人，我还是它的当家明星。

original: Every night from eight till midnight, come on by to see the Rad Pack Revue live, only right here at the Aces Theater!
translation: 每晚八点至午夜，你都能这儿来欣赏核子欢乐汇现场秀，只在王牌剧场独家上演哦！

original: On second thought, never mind.
translation: 我又想了想，还是算了吧。

original: Can that actually be done?
translation: 真的能做到吗？

original: Sure! If the Chip can be used to reset administrator privileges, it'll be super-easy!
translation: 当然了！如果那枚筹码真的能让你获得管理员权限，那一切就易如反掌了！

original: You're very... forthcoming with that information.
translation: 你能告诉我这些，还真是……直接。

original: I was programmed to be helpful and answer any questions I was asked. I guess nobody bothered to restrict who I answer questions for.
translation: 我的设定就是要乐于助人，有问必答。我想，应该不会有人限制我回答其他人的问题吧？

original: That was probably pretty dumb, huh?
translation: 如果那样就太傻了，不是吗？

original: Shouldn't you be working for Mr. House? How'd you end up here?
translation: 你不是豪斯先生的手下吗？怎么到这来了。

original: As I understand it, I used to be just like all those other Securitrons out on the Strip.
translation: 按我的理解，我原本和长街的那些电子保安是一样的。

original: But then my neuro-computational matrix was completely reprogrammed! To be nice! Very, very nice!
translation: 可后来，我的神经运算系统被人彻底篡改了！于是我就变成了好人！十足的大好人！

original: "Yes Man?" What kind of a name is that?
translation: "好好先生？"这算什么名字？

original: It's what Benny always called me. Probably because I'm programmed to be so helpful!
translation: 本尼就是这么叫我的。也许是因为我自从诞生起就乐于助人吧。

original: Benny reprogrammed a Securitron? All by himself?
translation: 本尼重新编写了电子保安的程序？就凭他自己？

original: {You're so smart}Oh, he had some help - a lady friend of his! She said something about living in a Fort over in Freeside... but that's all I remember!
translation: {You're so smart}哦，有人帮忙——他有个女性朋友！她说过自己好像住在自由城的什么要塞……但我只记得这么多了。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: This is Benny's workshop. When the Tops got renovated, he had this half of the floor blocked off for his own use.
translation: 这里是本尼的工作室。九重天赌场翻新的时候，他就把这半层封了起来，留作自己用。

original: I guess you could say it's my entire world! I don't think I've ever left this room! But that's okay - I'm not complaining!
translation: 这里可以算是我的专属小天地了！我想我应该从没离开过这个房间！不过没关系——我不会抱怨的！

original: Benny stole a Platinum Chip from me. Do you know what it's for?
translation: 本尼从我这偷走了白金筹码。你知道它是干什么的吗？

original: Sure! Benny had me look at it a bunch of times!
translation: 当然！本尼让我看过很多次了！

original: It's a data storage device, kind of like a holotape, but a lot more advanced! As for what's on it, well...
translation: 它是个数据储存器，类似于全息磁带，但先进得多！至于上面存了什么，这个嘛……

original: Some of Mr. House's data transmissions made it sound like the Chip could upgrade his defenses somehow!
translation: 豪斯先生的一部分传输数据显示，它能升级豪斯先生的防御系统！

original: That's just a guess, though! The Chip's a proprietary format! You'd need special hardware to read the data on it!
translation: 不过这只是个猜想！筹码的存储格式是独有的！你需要专门的硬件来读取上面的数据！

original: There are two locations with non-standard hardware on the network - the Lucky 38 and an underground facility at Fortification Hill. I'd look there!
translation: 共有两个非常规硬件接口——幸运38和堡垒山的地下工厂。换做是我的话，就去那些地方找找看！

original: Sure! Benny had me look at it a bunch of times!
translation: 当然！本尼让我看过很多次了！

original: It's a data storage device, kind of like a holotape, but a lot more advanced! As for what's on it, well...
translation: 它是个数据储存器，类似于全息磁带，但先进得多！至于上面存了什么，这个嘛……

original: Some of Mr. House's data transmissions made it sound like the Chip could upgrade his defenses somehow!
translation: 豪斯先生的一部分传输数据显示，它能升级豪斯先生的防御系统！

original: That's just a guess, though! The Chip's a proprietary format! You'd need special hardware to read the data on it!
translation: 不过这只是个猜想！筹码的存储格式是独有的！你需要专门的硬件来读取上面的数据！

original: There are two locations with non-standard hardware on the network - the Lucky 38 and an underground facility at Fortification Hill. I'd look there!
translation: 共有两个非常规硬件接口——幸运38和堡垒山的地下工厂。换做是我的话，就去那些地方找找看！

original: Have you seen this Platinum Chip before?
translation: 你以前见过这个白金筹码没有？

original: What's Benny planning to do with the Chip?
translation: 本尼打算拿白金筹码做什么？

original: Oh! He wants to kill Mr. House and use the Platinum Chip to copy my neuro-computational matrix onto the Lucky 38's mainframe.
translation: 噢！他想要杀死豪斯先生，然后用白金筹码把我的神经计算矩阵复制到幸运38的主控电脑里。

original: That should give me control over all of Mr. House's defenses, most prominently his Securitrons. And then I just do what Benny tells me - easy-peasy!
translation: 那样我就能控制豪斯先生所有的防御系统，主要是他的电子保安。接着，我就能完成本尼交待给我的工作了，小菜一碟！

original: Oh! He wanted to kill Mr. House and use the Platinum Chip to copy my neuro-computational matrix onto the Lucky 38's mainframe!
translation: 噢！他想要杀死豪斯先生，然后用白金筹码把我的神经计算矩阵复制到幸运38的防火墙里。

original: That would give me control over all of Mr. House's defenses, most prominently his Securitrons. And then I guess I just do as I'm told!
translation: 那样我就能控制豪斯先生所有的防御系统，主要是他的电子保安。接着，我就能完成本尼交待给我的工作了，小菜一碟！

original: What was Benny planning to do with the Chip?
translation: 本尼打算拿白金筹码做什么？

original: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

original: Good question! My function is to monitor Mr. House's data network and decode his encrypted transmissions!
translation: 问得好！我的职责就是监视豪斯先生的数据网络，破解他的加密信息！

original: Allow me to introduce myself! I'm a PDQ-88b Securitron, but you can call me Yes Man!
translation: 请允许我自我介绍一下！我是PDQ-88b型电子保安，你可以叫我好好先生！

original: Sergeant Reyes at Camp Forlorn Hope sent me with a security update for your radio.
translation: 飘零希望营地的雷耶斯军士派我来给你的无线电进行安全更新。

original: {Player in NCR gear}Oh, right. She radioed ahead and mentioned that somebody was coming by.
translation: {Player in NCR gear}哦，是的。她之前在无线电里提到过会有人来。

original: Oh, right. She radioed ahead and mentioned that somebody was coming by. Odd that she'd send a civilian instead of a trooper, though.
translation: 哦，是的。她之前在无线电里提到过会有人来。不过来的不应该是个士兵么？怎么是个平民。

original: Ted's father is a wealthy man. With his resources, this should be easy to stop.
translation: 泰德的父亲是个有钱人。只要他动用手头的资源，想要摆平这件事简直轻而易举。

original: That may be true, but I wouldn't recommend it. He's built a reputation, and it isn't for calmness and impartiality.
translation: 也许吧，但我不建议这么做。他确实名声在外，可那都是因为他的暴脾气和下三滥手段。

original: He's not what he looks like. They call him "Hurricane Heck." The man built his empire by hiring mercenaries to drive off the competition.
translation: 他这人和外表看起来完全不一样。大家都管他叫"飓风赫克。"他建立商业帝国的方法，就是派雇佣兵将竞争对手全部消灭。

original: Lately he's been attacking our Brahmin suppliers so he can take over their business.
translation: 最近他又把枪口对准了我们的牛肉供应商，为的就是取而代之。

original: He's the sort to pound in a nail with a wrecking ball. If you gave him the whole story on this he'd be liable to raze the entire hotel.
translation: 他是那种喜欢杀鸡用牛刀的人。你要是把这件事告诉他，他肯定会把整个酒店都夷为平地的。

original: And God knows what he'd do to the rest of the Strip.
translation: 更别提长街的其他地方了，天晓得他会干出什么来。

original: All right. I'll go take a look at that safe when I have a chance.
translation: 好吧。如果有机会我就去看看那个保险箱。

original: Always happy to help someone down on their luck.
translation: 我一直都乐于帮助那些走背运的人。

original: And this magazine - "Locksmith's Reader?"
translation: 那这本杂志——"锁匠必读？"

original: And the bobby pins?
translation: 那发夹呢？

original: What are the bobby pins for?
translation: 发夹拿来干什么用？

original: You'll need those to pick the lock. Be careful, though - put too much pressure on them and they'll snap.
translation: 你需要用它们来开锁。但用的时候要小心——太用力了容易断。

original: A magazine on locksmiths?
translation: 锁匠杂志？

original: If the lock's too much for you to handle, reading through the magazine might give you the edge you need.
translation: 如果你遇到了开不了的锁，那这本杂志肯定能解你的燃眉之急。

original: Listen here shitwad, tell me where I can find Cachino.
translation: 听着，你这狗屎混蛋，告诉我在哪能找到卡奇诺。

original: Whoa, simmer down! Head over to Brimstone. I'll have him find you there.
translation: 别，冷静点！去硫磺火，你会在那找到他的。

original: <Black Widow/Lady's Man Options>
translation: <黑寡妇/登徒子选项>

original: I bet you say that to all the girls. Yeah, head over to Brimstone, he'll find you there.
translation: 我打赌你对所有的女孩都这么说。好吧，去硫磺火，你会在那找到他的。

original: A gorgeous lady like you has to know where I can find Cachino.
translation: 像你这样的美人儿肯定知道能在哪找到卡奇诺。

original: Gorgeous, you can have anything you want from me. Cachino is in Brimstone.
translation: 好了好了，我投降。卡奇诺在硫磺火。

original: I be a sexy lady like you could tell me where I could find someone named Cachino.
translation: 像你这样的性感女郎一定会告诉我在哪能找到卡奇诺。

original: Well thank you, gorgeous. Yeah, look for Cachino in Brimstone.
translation: 谢谢夸奖，真入耳。好了，去硫磺火找卡奇诺吧。

original: If I told you you have a beautiful body, would you tell me where Cachino is?
translation: 如果我告诉你，你的身材真火辣，你会告诉我卡奇诺在哪吗？

original: Well thank you, gorgeous. Yeah, look for Cachino in Brimstone.
translation: 谢谢夸奖，真入耳。好了，去硫磺火找卡奇诺吧。

original: A handsome man like you has to know where I can find Cachino.
translation: 像你这样的帅小伙一定知道在哪能找到卡奇诺。

original: Where can I find Cachino?
translation: 我在哪能找到卡奇诺？

original: Cachino? Get out of my face.
translation: 卡奇诺？赶紧从我面前滚开。

original: Actually, I already cracked that safe.
translation: 实际上，我已经把那个保险箱弄开了。

original: Oh. Well, go ahead and keep the stuff I gave you, anyway. It'll be more useful to you than me.
translation: 噢，这样啊。不过我给你的东西你还是留着吧，你拿着比我有用。

original: Cachino sent me to ask you about some guns.
translation: 卡奇诺派我来找你要些枪。

original: Cachino... Cachino what? Are you kidding me? He must be trying to get me killed.
translation: 卡奇诺……卡奇诺说什么？你开玩笑吧？他这是想害死我。

original: They're keeping them in a little utility section down off the basement.
translation: 他们把军火藏在地下室深处的一个小工具间里。

original: I don't know what they're arming themselves for, but I know it isn't for the good of mankind.
translation: 我不知道他们要枪做什么，但肯定不是什么好事。

original: Okay, so what can you tell me about the guns the Omertas have?
translation: 好的，关于黑手党拥有的军火，你能告诉我些什么？

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: I don't see how that's your business. I'm just a guest here, having a little fun.
translation: 我看不出这和你有什么关系。我不过是个客人，来找点乐子罢了。

original: On second thought, let's talk about something else.
translation: 我想了想，我们还是说点别的吧。

original: Sure, kid, like what?
translation: 当然了，年轻人，说什么？

original: What do you think of Caesar's Legion?
translation: 你对凯撒军团有什么看法？

original: Oh, boy, those clowns. Listen up, kid, and listen good, I don't care how many fancy Latin names he gives himself, a thug ain't nothin' but a thug.
translation: 噢，老天，你说那些小丑啊。听着，孩子，听好了，恶棍就算给自己起个再花哨的拉丁文名字，那也还是恶棍。

original: Warlords and emperors? Don't make me laugh. At least they got enough brains to stay the hell out of New Vegas - Mr. House'd clean their clocks.
translation: 军阀和皇帝？别逗我了，还不是得乖乖地待在新维加斯外边——不然他们肯定会被豪斯先生狠狠教训一顿。

original: Make it 5% and you've got a deal.
translation: 给我5%的提成，我们就成交。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Ooh, a sharp customer! All right, all right, 5% it is.
translation: [成功] 噢，你还挺懂行的嘛！好吧，好吧，就5%。

original: [FAILED] I'm guessing you don't really know how this business works, kid. My offer is very generous already. Think about it.
translation: [失败] 我看你是根本不知道该怎么做生意，孩子。我的报价已经非常慷慨了。好好考虑下吧。

original: No way, I won't do it for less than 50%!
translation: 没门，少于50%我是不会干的！

original: Sounds great.
translation: 听起来不错。

original: You know it, baby!
translation: 你懂的，宝贝！

original: Maybe I could help you find some more acts for your show.
translation: 或许我能帮你的节目找几个演员。

original: Glad to hear it, baby! My card - pass it on if you see any good acts out there.
translation: 你这么说真是太好了，宝贝！给你我的名片——如果你遇到好演员，就推荐到我这儿来。

original: I've reconsidered about the talent scouting.
translation: 找人的事，我重新考虑过了。

original: Really? What kind of entertainment do you have?
translation: 真的吗？有什么消遣呢？

original: Well, acts are a little bit thin on the ground right now, but every night from eight to midnight, we got the Rad Pack Revue!
translation: 嗯，目前咱们的节目是少了点，但每晚八点到午夜，我们这儿都会上演核子欢乐秀！

original: Songs, dancing, jokes, we got it all!
translation: 歌唱，舞蹈，笑话，我们应有尽有！

original: Okay, sorry, I didn't mean anything by it.
translation: 好吧，抱歉，我没有别的意思。

original: It's cool, baby. Tommy's a forgiving fella.
translation: 没事，宝贝。汤米是个宽容的人。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Sure thing, baby. What can Tommy do for you?
translation: 当然了，宝贝。想要汤米为你做点什么？

original: Yeah, I hear you. Any idea where he goes when he disappears like that?
translation: 哎哟，我听见了。那你觉得他每次都外出会是去哪儿了呢？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Well, now, you didn't hear this from Tommy, but Benny likes to go off on a bender now and then.
translation: [成功] 好吧，记着，千万别说是汤米告诉你的。有时本尼挺喜欢出去寻欢作乐的。

original: Usually he's only gone a couple days, but this last time nobody saw him for almost a month!
translation: 一般他只出去几天，但近来这次，他居然快一个月都不见人影！

original: Ask me, I think he's got a dame from Gomorrah holed up in his suite, because nobody ever saw him leave it.
translation: 要我说，他十有八九是在金屋里藏了个蛾摩拉的娘们，因为就没有人见过他离开自己的套房。

original: [FAILED] Oh, uh, it ain't even a thing. Forget I even said it.
translation: [失败] 哦，呃，没什么。当我什么都没说。

original: So, Benny likes to take off, huh? Uhh, want to tell me where he goes?
translation: 这么说，本尼喜欢玩消失？呃，介意和我说说他去哪了吗？

original: Talent scouting isn't really my thing. I think I'll pass.
translation: 我可当不了伯乐。还是算了吧。

original: All right, well, if you change your mind, just let me know.
translation: 好吧，如果你改主意了，就告诉我。

original: Sure, I'll keep an eye out.
translation: 好，我会留意的。

original: Ring-a-ding! My card.
translation: 棒极了！给你我的名片。

original: If I see McCaffery on the Strip, I'll be sure to take care of him.
translation: 要是我在长街见到了麦卡弗里，我一定会好好“照顾”他的。

original: Good. Just stop on back when he's dead and you'll be rewarded handsomely. Bring his hat as proof of the kill.
translation: 很好。杀了他之后来找我领赏，别忘了把他的帽子带回来，当做证明。

original: How am I supposed to get to the Strip?
translation: 我怎么进入长街？

original: See the King. I'm sure he could work something out to get you in. You'll need to prove you're worth his time, but it'll be well worth it.
translation: 去找猫王。我相信他有办法让你进去。你要向他证明自己的实力，反正对你而言也是包赚不亏。

original: <Barter>
translation: <交易>

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right. 50/50 it is, but you better bring back all of the caps.
translation: [成功] 好吧。五五分，但你最好能把所有的瓶盖都收回来。

original: If we hear you crossed us, the next bounty hunter will be coming for you.
translation: 要是让我们知道你在耍我们，那下个赏金猎人的目标就是你的脑袋。

original: This kind of work costs time and money.  50/50 would cover my expenses.
translation: 这个活吃力又不讨好。必须五五分成，我才能接受。

original: [FAILED] Who the hell do you think you're talking to? Keep talking like that and your ass is going to be in the gutter. 25%. Take it or leave it.
translation: [失败] 你知道自己在和谁说话吗？再用这种口气和我讨价还价，小心我捅爆你的屁眼。25%，不能更多了。

original: Are you crazy?!  I'll be walking all over the place looking for these people.
translation: 你疯了吗？为了找那几个家伙，我得把整个镇子都翻个遍。

original: I think I have all of the debts collected.
translation: 我把帐都收齐了。

original: I don't care how you handled those lumps of human refuse, but you got the job done. We need you to hunt down another person.
translation: 我不知道你是怎么对付那几个人渣的，但总之你办到了。我们想请你再替我们除掉一个人。

original: That son of a bitch McCaffery stole a ton of caps and ran off to Vegas. I guess the fact that we farmed out his usual work to you pissed him off.
translation: 那个狗娘养的麦卡弗里偷了我们一大笔钱，躲进了维加斯。我想他一定是不满意我们把原本给他的差事交给了你。

original: No one steals from the Garret Twins! If you can kill that bastard and bring back as much as you can, you'll be paid very well.
translation: 想偷加勒特家的东西，门都没有！如果你能杀了那个混蛋，把钱追回来，你将得到丰厚的报酬。

original: I don't care how you handled those lumps of human refuse, but you got the job done. We need you to hunt down another person.

translation: 我不知道你是怎么对付那几个人渣的，但总之你办到了。为了表达谢意，我们为你准备了个房间。

original: You can have the corner room, rent free. It was McCaffery's.
translation: 拐角处那间房以后就免费给你用了。本来是麦卡弗里住的。

original: Now that he's dead, we're happy to let you use it. Thanks for helping us.
translation: 既然他死了，我们很乐意把它转交给你。谢谢你的帮忙。

original: Now that he's dead, we're happy to let you use it. Thanks for helping us.
translation: 既然他死了，我们很乐意把它转交给你。谢谢你的帮忙。

original: Doesn't look like it to me. I'm expecting 388 caps...
translation: 我看着好像不对啊。总共是388个瓶盖…

original: You're short. Come back when you have the rest.
translation: 你拿来的瓶盖不够。等凑齐了再来。

original: It doesn't look like it to me. I'm expecting 600 caps...
translation: 我看着好像不对啊。总共是600个瓶盖…

original: You're short. Come back when you have the rest.
translation: 你拿来的瓶盖不够。等凑齐了再来。

original: I suppose that might work. It'll take some convincing though.
translation: 我想这样应该可以，就是要费点口舌。

original: I swear they'll never see me again. After this experience, I want nothing to do with this hell hole.
translation: 我发誓，他们不会再见到我了。有过这次经历，我不想再和这里有任何瓜葛。

original: I'll get started now. The last thing I need is more bounty hunters trying to track me down.
translation: 我现在就出发，我可不想再让别的赏金猎人找到我。

original: But then, I'd be a liar, and I hate liars. <Attack>
translation: 这样我不就成骗子了吗？我最讨厌骗子了。<攻击>

original: Oh God, no!
translation: 哦，天哪，不要！

original: Just give me what you have on you and they might accept it knowing you're dead.
translation: 把你身上的东西全交出来，再加上你的小命，应该就够了。

original: Hey, you don't need to kill me. I'm going back to California to start over.
translation: 嘿，你不用杀我。我准备回加州从头开始。

original: Just tell them you killed me and they won't be the wiser.
translation: 你就告诉他们，我已经被你杀了，他们不会发现的。

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才>

original: [SUCCEEDED] I'm short 90 caps or so, but I have a few cartons of cigarettes and some sensor modules I could put toward my debt.
translation: [成功] 我还欠90多个瓶盖，不过我有几包香烟和一些传感器模组，可以用来顶债。

original: At this point I'll have to return to California to start anew. I haven't got a cap to my name.
translation: 把它们都拿走的话，我就只能返回加州重新开始了，我身上一个瓶盖也没有了。

original: Perhaps there is something else of value you could put toward the debt?
translation: 也许你还有其他值钱的东西可以用来还债？

original: [FAILED] I don't even have enough caps to get a new caravan up and running. What makes you think I have enough to afford anything else of value?
translation: [失败] 我连重新买大篷车的瓶盖都不够，你认为我还会有其他值钱的东西吗？

original: I bet you've got some extra caps hidden in that dress somewhere.
translation: 你那衣服里应该藏了些瓶盖。

original: I was hired by the Garrets to track you down.
translation: 我是加勒特家雇来找你的。

original: In that case, I suppose you're here to collect. I apologize, but I simply do not have enough caps on me to cover the debt.
translation: 既然这样，那你应该就是来讨债的了。抱歉，我身上实在是没那么多瓶盖来还债。

original: If someone were to recover my caravan from that cave, I could easily pay in full, but who would bother with such a mess?
translation: 要是有人能去洞里找回我的大篷车，我就有钱还了，可谁又愿意趟这浑水呢？

original: I can collect from your corpse, if you prefer.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以从你的尸体上收钱。

original: Here are the caps I owe! No need for violence!
translation: 这些是我欠的瓶盖！没必要动粗！

original: <Barter>
translation: <交易>

original: [SUCCEEDED] When did this happen?! Hey, look. I only do the Santiago bit as a way of getting free stuff. I didn't think it would get me in trouble.
translation: [成功] 还有这等事？！嘿，听着。我扮成圣地亚哥，只是想占点小便宜。我从没想到真的会惹祸上身。

original: Here is everything I have on me. Keep the extra for yourself! The last thing I need is a constant stream of bounty hunters after me.
translation: 我身上就这么多钱。剩下的你自己留着吧！我可不想再有赏金猎人跟在我屁股后头了。

original: With a price on your head, you should be paying me to say you're dead.
translation: 你脑袋可值钱了，你最好给我点钱，我会告诉大家你已经死了。

original: [FAILED] You are not a VIP. You do not tell Santiago what he needs to do.
translation: [失败] 你不是VIP。你没有资格对圣地亚哥发号施令。

original: Leave me now. Santiago grows bored of this exchange.
translation: 走吧。圣地亚哥对你这套说辞已经烦透了。

original: You need to pay me to pay the Garrets right now.
translation: 你得给我钱，我才能向加勒特兄妹交差。

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才>

original: [SUCCEEDED] I didn't think she was upset enough to have me killed... Here are the caps I owe.
translation: [成功] 我没想到她居然想要杀我……这是我欠的瓶盖。

original: I do the Santiago act to get out of paying for services every once in a while. I didn't think it could possibly get me killed.
translation: 为了逃避债务，我偶尔会扮成圣地亚哥。我从没想到有人居然会因此想要我的命。

original: I'd rather not kill you, but Francine put a bounty on your head.
translation: 我不想杀你，可弗朗辛已经开出了赏金，要取你的脑袋。

original: [FAILED]You think Santiago is susceptible to such idle threats? Santiago laughs at your silly bluff.
translation: [失败] 你认为圣地亚哥会被这些无聊的威胁吓倒？圣地亚哥对你的虚张声势不屑一顾。

original: I'm going to... Well, I'm sure it will be very painful if you don't pay.
translation: 我要……好吧，反正我告诉你，你要是不给钱，一定会吃苦头的。

original: <Punch Santiago in the face> I won't ask again, Santiago.
translation: <一拳打在圣地亚哥脸上>我不会再问第二遍，圣地亚哥。

original: Ow! Okay. Here! Take the caps, just don't hurt Santiago again!
translation: 哎唷！好吧。给你！拿着这些瓶盖，别再伤害圣地亚哥了！

original: Liar. Pay up.
translation: 骗子，赶紧还钱。

original: Santiago is offended that you would opine such slander.
translation: 你这是无端的诽谤，圣地亚哥感觉受到了污蔑。

original: Santiago is dead if he doesn’t cough up what he owes the Garrets.
translation: 如果圣地亚哥不愿意交出他欠加勒特家的钱，那他就死定了。

original: Sir, Santiago does not know what he has done to offend, but he can explain everything.
translation: 先生，圣地亚哥不知道他为何会得罪人，但他可以解释。

original: <Barter down 25 caps>
translation: <交易25瓶盖>

original: [SUCCEEDED] 25 caps will do. Tell Mick Santiago sent you and the code word is 'extravaganza'. He will set you up.
translation: [成功] 25个瓶盖成交。告诉米克，是圣地亚哥介绍你来的，暗号是“妄自尊大”。他会好好招待你的。

original: I don't even know this discount is worth 50.  How about 25 caps?
translation: 我看这个折扣恐怕不值50个瓶盖。25个瓶盖怎么样？

original: [FAILED] Sorry, my friend. 50 caps is the price to be a VIP.
translation: [失败] 对不起，我的朋友。想当VIP，就得花50个瓶盖。

original: What kind of moron would pay 50 caps for information?  25 caps.
translation: 花50个瓶盖买情报？只有蠢货会干这种事。25个瓶盖吧。

original: 50 Caps is a bit steep, but okay. Here, now what is it?
translation: 50个瓶盖有点贵了，算了。给你，告诉我暗号是什么？

original: Santiago thanks you. Tell Mick Santiago sent you and the code word is 'extravaganza'.
translation: 圣地亚哥谢谢你。你只要告诉米克，是圣地亚哥介绍你来的，暗号是“妄自尊大”。

original: VIP? The Garrets said nothing about VIP status.
translation: VIP？加勒特家的人可没说过什么VIP。

original: Yes indeed, Santiago is very important. I even have a discount at Mick & Ralph's.
translation: 当然是了，圣地亚哥可是有头有脸的人物。我甚至在米克和拉尔夫杂货店都享有折扣呢。

original: Perhaps you could use Santiago's discount? For 50 caps, Santiago will tell you the super secret code word to get a discount with Mick.
translation: 你也想和圣地亚哥一样享受折扣吗？只要50个瓶盖，圣地亚哥就会告诉你在米克店里打折的通用暗号。

original: Francine warned me that you're a smooth-talker.
translation: 弗朗辛警告过我，说你这人很善花言巧语。

original: Indeed, Santiago is a poet among pretenders. If you are here to collect for the Garrets, Santiago is debt free.
translation: 正是。圣地亚哥是一条富有诗意的老狐狸。如果你是来为加勒特兄妹收债的，圣地亚哥可没有欠钱。

original: You owe the Garrets a bunch of caps.
translation: 你欠了加勒特家一大笔瓶盖。

original: Santiago does not owe anyone. Santiago is a Freeside VIP.
translation: 圣地亚哥谁也不欠。圣地亚哥是自由城的VIP。

original: Heh. Whatever. Mess with the Garrets again and you're a dead man.
translation: 不管怎样，再惹加勒特家的话，你就死定了。

original: Oh, by the way. That damn eye of yours is creepy. Get it checked out.
translation: 对了，顺便说下，你的眼睛有点不对劲，去查下吧。

original: <Twitches> A scum-humping water baron did this to me. No one trash-talks the eye.
translation: <抽搐>是一个卑鄙的水贩干的。谁也不许嘲笑我的眼睛。

original: Nevermind. You owe the Garrets a good lump of caps.
translation: 算了，你欠加勒特家一大笔瓶盖。

original: Seriously zombie, are you looking at me or someone off that direction?!
translation: 我说真的，丧尸，你是在瞪着我看，还是在瞪着我身后的某个人哪？

original: That's it! No one insults the eye!
translation: 够了！谁也不准侮辱我的眼睛！

original: Yeah, and your eye! That shit is hilarious!
translation: 对，你的眼睛！简直太滑稽了！

original: <Twitches> My eye? A scum-humping water baron did this to me. No one talks trash about my eye.
translation: <抽搐>我的眼睛？是一个卑鄙的水贩干的。谁也不许嘲笑我的眼睛。

original: Sheesh, you're one ugly sonofabitch!
translation: 啧，你这个丑八怪贱种！

original: What? Thank you Mr. Obvious. I haven't heard that in a while.
translation: 什么？哦，谢谢你啊，好眼力先生。我已经有一段时间没听到这个词儿了。

original: What? Thank you Mrs. Obvious. I haven't heard that in a while.
translation: 什么？哦，谢谢你啊，好眼力小姐。我已经有一段时间没听到这个词儿了。

original: <Press for clothing>
translation: <要他的衣服>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Anything, take it! Just don't kill me, man!
translation: [成功] 什么都行，都给你！别杀我，老兄！

original: Heh, I think I'll make an example of you. Give me your clothes, or you get dead.
translation: 嘿，我就给你留个教训好了。把衣服给我，不然就去死吧。

original: [FAILED] You're freaking crazy. I'm not stripping for you. I'm already broke.
translation: [失败] 你他妈疯了。我才不会被你扒光呢。我已经破产了。

original: You cheapass zombie.  You need to pay my extra fee.
translation: 你这个下贱的僵尸。你必须付我额外的一笔费用。

original: Thanks for the caps, now enjoy the zombie afterlife.
translation: 多谢你的瓶盖，我就受累送你去僵尸的极乐世界吧。

original: Oh God! Help! Help!
translation: 哦，天哪！救命！救命！

original: That'll do. Mess with the Garrets again and you're dead.
translation: 小心点吧。再敢招惹加勒特家族，你就死定了。

original: I won't. Thanks for not killing me.
translation: 我不会的。多谢你不杀之恩。

original: <Press for extra caps>
translation: <榨取额外的瓶盖>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Okay! Here. That's everything I've got except the clothes on my back. I'm sorry about this.
translation: [成功] 好吧！给你。我除了身上的衣服，已经啥也没剩下了。我很抱歉。

original: You don't cheat the Garrets and walk away. Cough up the rest or you're rat bait.
translation: 你骗了加勒特家族的钱，可不会就这么算了。把钱都拿出来，不然你死定了。

original: [FAILED] Hey, I'm tapped out, man. I've got nothing left but the clothes on my back.
translation: [失败] 嘿，我没钱了。我除了身上的衣服，已经啥也没剩下了。

original: You cheapass zombie.  You need to pay my extra fee.
translation: 你这个下贱的僵尸。你必须付我额外的一笔费用。

original: Cough em up, Grecks.
translation: 把钱连本带利都吐出来，格里克斯。

original: Interest?! The Garrets said nothing about interest on their tabs. Look man, I've got the caps right here, just don't hurt me.
translation: 利息？！加勒特兄妹没说过有什么利息啊。听着，朋友，我已经准备好了瓶盖，别伤害我。

original: There is more where that came from if you don't pay your debt.
translation: 如果你不给钱的话，我还有别的手段。

original: You owe the Garrets a good lump of caps. I'm here to collect.
translation: 你欠了加勒特家一大笔钱。我是来这儿收账的。

original: Ah crap. I was hoping they'd forget about my tab. Look, I've got the caps right here, just don't hurt me.
translation: 啊，该死。我还希望他们能把这事忘了呢。看，我已经把瓶盖准备好了，别伤害我。

original: Your hangman, if you don't start being straight with me.
translation: 我是来索命的，你要是再耍嘴皮子，我就吊死你。

original: Whoa, yeah. I guess the Garrets sent you after me? Look, I've got the caps right here, just don't hurt me.
translation: 哇，好吧。是加勒特家族派你来找我的？看，我已经把瓶盖准备好了，别伤害我。

original: Sure, man. Here you go. <Punch Grecks in the face>
translation: 当然，朋友。赏你的。<一拳打在格里克斯脸上>

original: Ow! What the hell was that for?!
translation: 哎唷！你干什么？！

original: Collecting money to pay back the Garrets?
translation: 凑钱还加勒特家族的债吗？

original: Are you the Grecks who owes the Garrets?
translation: 你就是那个欠了加勒特家族一屁股债的格里克斯吗？

original: That all depends on who's asking.
translation: 这得看问的人是谁了。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: I operate the radio and call it in if we see any Great Khans moving out in large groups from Red Rock Canyon.
translation: 如果红岩峡谷的大汗帮有大规模的迁徙动作，我会立刻无线电向上汇报。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: Ranger military outpost. We're keeping an eye on the Legion activities south of here at Cottonwood Cove.
translation: 我们是游骑兵军事哨站。主要负责监视南边棉白杨湾的军团动向。

original: Nothing going on down there at the moment - just the usual slave trafficking. Poor bastards.
translation: 目前那里一切正常——就是时常会有贩卖奴隶的情况发生。哎，这些可怜虫。

original: Anything unusual happening around here?
translation: 附近发生了不平常的事么？

original: All quiet at the moment. Ranger {BOH-mont}Beaumont is in charge here, but he's off leading a patrol.
translation: 目前一切正常。游骑兵博曼特是这里的负责人，不过现在他正带队巡逻。

original: It was quiet until those rockets blasted off over our heads.
translation: 只要那些火箭不要炸到我们头上来就一切正常。

original: There was a hell of a boom over at REPCONN. Looks like the ghouls had some sort of accident with their rockets.
translation: REOCONN发生了大爆炸。看起来那些尸鬼的火箭出了点问题。

original: What do you do out here?
translation: 你们到这来儿干什么？

original: This is the frontier of NCR territory, and we're the first line of defense. You won't find much in the way of civilization east of here.
translation: 这里是NCR的边界，我们是第一道防线。从这里往东，基本就没什么文明可言了。

original: South of here is Camp Guardian, but they've been having radio trouble so they've been silent for awhile now.
translation: 这里往南是守护者营地，不过他们的无线电出了问题，已经静默了有一阵了。

original: Sergeant Reyes sent me here. I've got a security update for your radio.
translation: 我是雷耶斯军士派来的。我来给你的无线电进行安全更新。

original: No problem. Hey, do me a favor when you get back to Reyes and tell her that we don't need any more damn ammo. Wouldn't mind more water, though.
translation: 没问题。嘿，回去的时候顺便帮我个忙吧？告诉雷耶斯，别再往这里送该死的弹药了，多送点水来倒是更要紧。

original: Use [Speech to press Mr. House about the Chip.]
translation: [使用口才]从豪斯那里得到关于筹码的信息。

original: Suggest getting down to business.
translation: 建议直接谈正事。

original: Suggest talking about Benny.
translation: 建议谈谈本尼。

original: Why the VIP treatment? I'm just a courier.
translation: 为什么要把我当VIP？我不过是个送信的。

original: Oh, don't be coy. You've been playing a high-stakes game ever since Victor dug you out of the ground. Don't be afraid to admit it.
translation: 哦，别害羞。自从维克多把你从地底挖出来之后，你可是历经艰险才到这儿啊，换了我我会把这当做一种荣耀。

original: Can we get down to business?
translation: 我们还是直接谈谈生意吧？

original: Oh, by all means - yes. That's refreshing.
translation: 噢，当然，没错……真是振奋人心啊。

original: The business is this. One of my employees has stolen an item of extraordinary value from me, and I want it recovered.
translation: 是这样的。我有位雇员偷走了一件对我而言意义非凡的东西。我想把它拿回来。

original: Simple enough?
translation: 很简单吧？

original: You're ready to move forward, then?
translation: 那么，你准备好出发了吗？

original: I prefer the wasteland, to be honest.
translation: 老实说，我更喜欢废土。

original: {arch}You aren't going to ramble on about the virtues of life out in the wastes, are you? It's a desert, you do realize?
translation: {arch}难道你还想告诉我废土上存在着美德吗？那只不过是一片沙漠，你知道的吧？

original: A radioactive desert where humans subsist in a barbaric state? Difficult to glorify convincingly. They are, however, aptly named.
translation: 一片满是辐射的沙漠，幸存的人类在那里过着茹毛饮血的野蛮生活。我很难由衷地赞美它。不过这名字倒是取得恰当。

original: For that's what you'd be out there - wasted. Here on the Strip, your talents can be put to use.
translation: 任何人在那里待久了，就会变得和它一样——荒废。而在长街，你却能充分施展自己的才华。

original: A city devoted to vice and sin - what's not to love?
translation: 一座充斥着罪恶的城市，怎么能不爱上她呢？

original: {not buying it}Oh, come now - don't play the fool. Vegas has fools enough, a superfluity of them. They're what makes it so profitable.
translation: {not buying it}哦，天——别装傻了。维加斯的傻子已经够多了，多得数不完。这些傻子就是摇钱树啊。

original: They come to Vegas chasing penny-ante dreams of high-living, to feel like they're big shots, like they're winners.
translation: 他们来到维加斯，不过是为了追逐那蝼蚁般的梦想。想活得潇洒，想不可一世，想当大赢家。

original: You see that you and I are of a different stripe, don't you? We don't have to {emphasis}dream that we're important. We {emphasis}are.
translation: 你看，我们俩就和他们不一样，对吗？我们从来不会去幻想自己是个大人物。因为我们本来就是大人物。

original: I've never seen anything like this place.
translation: 我从来没见过这种地方。

original: Of course you haven't. Vegas always was one of a kind.
translation: 你当然没见过。维加斯永远是独一无二的。

original: What you see down on the Strip is just a fraction of the city's former glory, and yet... {beat}more than an echo. I preserved its spirit.
translation: 你看到的下面那条长街，它不过是这座城市往日荣华的一个缩影，但它……不仅仅是为了怀旧。因为我保留了它的精髓。

original: Or perhaps you were referring to the Lucky 38? The years haven't been kind to her, but still she manages to impress.
translation: 或者您指的是幸运38？纵然岁月在她的身上刻下了皱纹，但她依旧魅力不减。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Like what?
translation: 怎么了？

original: About Rex here...
translation: 关于雷克斯…

original: What about him?
translation: 他怎么样了？

original: I'll pass.
translation: 算了。

original: I completely understand. No reason you should take on someone else's problems. Let me know if you change your mind, though.
translation: 我理解你的想法。他人的问题，确实轮不到你来负责。不过如果你改变注意，记得来找我。

original: Now, was there anything else you wanted to talk about?
translation: 那么，还有什么事要与我商量的吗？

original: Absolutely. I'll see that he gets better.
translation: 当然，我会想办法让他康复的。

original: I can't thank you enough. Now, there's a few things you should know about ol' Rex here if you're going to be traveling together.
translation: 真是感激不尽。如果你想要和雷克斯一道旅行，那有几件事我必须先和你说明。

original: First, he hates rats. Can't stand the things. Giant rats, molerats, doesn't matter. He catches a whiff of one and he's off like a shot after them.
translation: 首先，他讨厌耗子，完全无法忍受。不管巨鼠还是鼹鼠，都一样。只要一闻到老鼠的味道，他就会像子弹一样躲开。

original: He's normally pretty obedient, but you might have to chase him some if he goes after one of the little varmints.
translation: 他一般很听话，但你得看着他点，他喜欢追逐小动物。

original: Second, he doesn't like hats, or the people wearing them. Don't ask. I have no idea why. Maybe because it rhymes with "rats".
translation: 其次，他不喜欢帽子，或者戴帽子的人。别问我为什么。我也不知道。也许因为帽子和"耗子"发音相近吧。

original: That should be it, though. Other than the occasional bad spot when his brain starts hurting him, that is, but I'm hoping you'll see to that.
translation: 就是这些了。除此之外，他偶尔会因为大脑损伤而造成有些行为怪异，但我希望你能治好他。

original: I wish you both luck. Take care of my Rex now, y'hear?
translation: 祝你们俩好运。好好照顾我的雷克斯，听到了吗？

original: Can I help somehow?
translation: 我能帮得上吗？

original: I don't know. Maybe. If you found a way to help my poor Rex here, I'd be much obliged.
translation: 我不知道。也许吧。如果你能找到办法救救我可怜的雷克斯，我一定会感谢你的。

original: Your best bet would be to talk to Julie Farkas over at the Old Mormon Fort north of here. Maybe you'll have better luck than I did.
translation: 我建议你最好去找北边旧摩门要塞的朱莉·法卡斯谈谈。也许你的运气比我好。

original: Is he going to be okay?
translation: 他会没事吗？

original: For now, but they said eventually he's going to get worse. I don't know what to do.
translation: 暂时吧，但他们说情况最终还是会恶化的。我不知道该怎么办。

original: Can they do anything?
translation: 他们有办法吗？

original: No, they said they don't have the tools to help him.
translation: 不，他们说缺乏工具，救不了他。

original: Tell me about the Kings.
translation: 和我说说猫王帮。
