original: [SUCCEEDED] Great. So I'm fucked either way. I guess I don't have any choice but to help you. Just try not to get me killed here.
translation: [成功] 好极了。看来我不管怎样都得完蛋。那我也没得选，只好帮你了。不过，你最好别让我死在这儿。

original: <Lie> If you don't help me, I'll report your work here to NCR.
translation: <撒谎> 如果你不帮我，我就把你做的肮脏勾当全都报告给NCR。

original: [FAILED] Nothing you could do scares me as much as the Omertas.
translation: [失败] 我可是被黑手党恐吓过，你觉得你比他们更有分量吗？

original: Tell me what you know or I'll, um... break your nose.
translation: 把你知道的都告诉我,否则我就，嗯…让你吃不了兜着走。

original: Maybe I can help you out of your contract with the family.
translation: 或许我能帮你摆脱和家族之间的合同。

original: More power to you if you can, but keep me out of it. I've been doing business with Big Sal, so he's going to be your man.
translation: 你有本事你自己去，别把我卷进来。一直以来我都是在和大萨尔联系，你应该去找他。

original: I'm looking to help Cachino break up whatever the Bosses are planning.
translation: 我正在帮助卡奇诺破坏老板们的计划。

original: Yeah? Well fuck that. The bosses have my number, and I'm a company man while they've got the goods on me.
translation: 是吗？去他的吧。老板们都了解我的底细，只要他们还抓着我的小辫子，我也只能唯命是从。

original: Here, Benny - special delivery. <Punch Benny in the face.>
translation: 接着，本尼——特快专递。<一拳打在本尼脸上>

original: Seems you need to work on your marksmanship.
translation: 看来你还需要练练枪法。

original: {amused, keeping voice down}I hit what I was aiming for. Guess you had brains to spare. Or are you just thick-skulled?
translation: {amused, keeping voice down}我觉得我没打偏啊。该不会你还留了个备用的脑袋吧。或者，你单纯就是脑壳硬？

original: {trying to swing this to your advantage}Either way, baby, this is good news. {lying}Maybe I can finally sleep at night, knowing you didn't die.
translation: {trying to swing this to your advantage}不管怎样，宝贝，这是个好消息。{lying}知道你没死，我总算能睡个安稳觉了。

original: I dug myself out of that grave to plant you in yours, Benny. <Attack.>
translation: 我从坟墓里爬出来就是为了把你送进去，本尼。<攻击。>

original: {fleeing in terror; "cash me out" is slang for leaving}Cash me outta this mess!
translation: {fleeing in terror; "cash me out" is slang for leaving}快来人救救我！

original: I want the Platinum Chip and I want it now.
translation: 我要那个白金筹码。现在就要。

original: {keeping voice down}I can't do that, baby, and you know it. There's a lot of angles to this caper - complexities aplenty.
translation: {keeping voice down}我不能这么做，宝贝，你懂的。这笔买卖涉及的面太多了——总之说起来挺复杂的。

original: But plenty of action, too - enough for both of us. But we don't jabber about that out here in public.
translation: 要做的事也不少，但如果咱俩联手，应该不在话下。不过，咱们可不能公开谈这个。

original: [Black Widow] and options.
translation: [黑寡妇] 还有别的选择。

original: {amused}You making a pass at me, sister? {Cuz}Because I'm out of your league.
translation: {amused}你是想勾引我吗，姑娘？{Cuz}我这高枝你可攀不起哦。

original: When you shot me, you ran off so fast I never got your name.
translation: 你打了我一枪后，跑得比兔子还快，我都来不及问问你的名字。

original: {wary confusion - is she really coming on to you?}Did those bullets scramble your egg? {starting to get turned on despite yourself}Or have you always been a naughty broad...?
translation: {wary confusion - is she really coming on to you?}难不成我那一枪打得你魂牵梦绕？ {starting to get turned on despite yourself}还是说，你天生就是这么浪……？

original: Is it wrong to want a guy who'd shoot me in the head?
translation: 对一个给你当头一枪的男人念念不忘，有错吗？

original: {aroused despite yourself}You're one sick pussycat, baby. There's {derisive term for an easy pick-up}quins and then there's... I don't even know what to call you.
translation: {aroused despite yourself}你可真是个小野猫，宝贝。要说骚狐狸，我见识过的也不少……可像你这样的，我真不知该怎么形容。

original: Girls like bad boys. And you've been downright awful.
translation: 男人不坏，女人不爱。而你，真是坏透了。

original: {referring to her burial}I hear "dig" from you, babe, and all I can think of is a shovel. How can this be? This ain't forgiveness, it's something... wrong.
translation: {referring to her burial}你说到"挖"，我能想到的就是铲子。怎么可能？这不像是原谅我，感觉有点……不对头啊。

original: I'm saying I dig you, despite it all. What do you say?
translation: 我就想挖挖你身上的男人味。你怎么说？

original: {unable to help yourself - you want her}All right, honey baby, this is all kinds of wrong, but to my suite it is. Thirteenth floor. Don't keep me waiting.
translation: {unable to help yourself - you want her}好吧，甜心宝贝，虽然感觉不对，不过还是到我房间去吧。十三层，别让我等太久。

original: I'm a courier, remember? Don't you want me to handle your package?
translation: 我是个邮差啊，送货四处奔波，热得很呢，想借你身下的凉棚降降火，不行吗？

original: Wow-ee wow wow, girl. This is all kinds of wrong, but I'm in for a dozen.
translation: 喂-唔，哇哦，姑娘。这么做可不太对啊，不过我喜欢。

original: You stole my package. Let's see what I can do with yours.
translation: 你偷了我的包裹。我只好拿你裤子里那个小包裹抵债咯？

original: Give me one good reason not to kill you.
translation: 给我个不杀你的理由。

original: {keeping voice down}You want a reason, how about four?
translation: {keeping voice down}你想要理由，我给你四个如何？

original: They're called bodyguards, and every one of them is packing. Me, too - so baby makes five.
translation: 这四个理由的名字叫做保镖，而且他们每个都荷枪实弹。我也一样——所以宝贝，你就按五个算吧。

original: Add to that every Chairman in this joint is armed, and not with some hold-out peashooter like {doubting it}maybe you smuggled through security.
translation: 再说，这赌场内外的每个会长帮成员身上都带着家伙呢，怎么着也比你偷偷夹进来的那些小玩具要强吧。

original: Anyhow, baby, you didn't come here for vengeance. You came to get clued in.
translation: 所以啊，宝贝，你不该是来这儿寻仇的，你是来求个明白的。

original: What's the story with your secret workshop and "Yes Man" friend?
translation: 你的秘密工作室还有那个"好好先生"是怎么回事？

original: Tell Benny to give you the Chip.
translation: 让本尼把白金筹码给你。

original: I'm wondering why I shouldn't just kill you.
translation: 我在想为什么我不直接宰了你。

original: You've got a crazy drop on me here, baby, that's for sure. If killing's what you came for, this would be the time.
translation: 你已经打了我个措手不及，宝贝。如果你今天就是来杀我的，那现在正是时候。

original: But baby - you'd be disappointing me. All the trouble you went through to arrange this shin-dig? Must be something more you're after...?
translation: 可是宝贝，那样你就太让我失望了。你演了这么一出好戏，就为了要我的命？我看你想要的应该不止……这些吧？

original: I dug myself out of that grave to plant you in yours, Benny.
translation: 我从坟墓里爬出来是为了把你送进去，本尼。

original: What's the story with your secret workshop and "Yes Man" friend?
translation: 你的秘密工作室还有那个"好好先生"是怎么回事？

original: What do you need me to do?
translation: 你想让我干什么？

original: I was hoping you might have some work for me.
translation: 我原以为你有工作能交给我。

original: Maybe so. Maybe so. You look like you might be able to handle yourself. Tell you what.
translation: 也许吧，也许吧。你看起来还挺有能耐的，这样吧。

original: You do me a favor, and I'll have some more work for you when it's done. Sound good?
translation: 你帮我个忙，完成之后我会给你更多差使。如何？

original: I did have something, but some friends of mine got whacked and now I got nothing for ya. Sorry about that.
translation: 我是有些事务要处理，但已经交给我的朋友们摆平了。所以现在没有差事能给你。抱歉。

original: I did have something, but a close friend of mine got whacked and now I got nothing for ya. Sorry about that.
translation: 我是有些事务要处理，但已经交给我的朋友们摆平了。所以现在没有差事能给你。抱歉。

original: Do you always charge people to come talk to you?
translation: 每个人来找你都得先交钱吗？

original: Charge? Ha ha. Pace must be at it again. What did he take you for?
translation: 交钱？哈哈。一定是佩瑟又在搞鬼名堂了。他收了你多少钱？

original: Actually, the White Glove Society is responsible. They're all cannibals.
translation: 实际上，白手套社团是幕后黑手。他们都是食人族。

original: But, but, but... that's so unfair. You should only punish the man who did it.
translation: 可是，可是，可是……这不公平。你只要惩罚罪魁祸首就行了。

original: [FAILED] No, that ain't enough. It ain't just him. It's this hotel. It's the whole damn Strip, and everybody who takes their money here.
translation: [失败] 不，那样可不够。不光是他一个人的责任。要怪就怪这家酒店，怪整个长街，怪每一个拿钱到这儿来挥霍的人。

original: I sensed it when I got here. This place is evil, pure and simple. Everyone did their part. Ted getting taken was just a symptom of the disease.
translation: 我刚来时就察觉到了。这地方邪得很，而且是那种纯粹的邪恶。每个人都有份，像传染病似的，泰德被绑仅仅是众多症状的其中一种。

original: That sounds like a fantastic idea.
translation: 这听起来是个好主意。

original: Sometimes I got me so many ideas, it's a wonder they don't all just burst outta my head.
translation: 老子的鬼主意可多着哩，它们没一下全从我脑袋里蹦出来还真是奇迹。

original: This town's headed to perdition anyway. I'm just giving them a little push.
translation: 反正这城镇也没救了，我不过是再轻轻推他们一把而已。

original: That's just what they'd want. You'd be driving the city to eat each other.
translation: 你这样只会逼得整座城市都开始吃人，那样正中他们的下怀。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I don't like this place. Whole Strip, really. Ever since I got here, the stink of it... it's flooded my nostrils.
translation: [成功] 我不喜欢这地方。整条长街我都不喜欢。我一到这地方，就能闻到它的臭味……塞得老子满鼻孔都是。

original: But you got a point. They're already hell-bent on depravity here. All I'd be doing is helping them along.
translation: 但你说的有道理。他们本来就已经堕落到无可救药了，我这么做也只是助长了他们的歪风邪气。

original: Let's not be hasty. You don't have to punish the entire Strip.
translation: 你别冲动。没必要把整个长街都卷进来。

original: The heck I don't! It's their support that gives these bastards power.
translation: 去他妈的别冲动！要不是因为他们纵容，这帮杂种有那个胆子？

original: They all oughtta suffer for what they done. I just won't be satisfied with anything less. Wouldn't be enough.
translation: 我要让他们所有人都为自己的行为付出代价。指望我从轻发落，门都没有。光这样老子还觉得不够呢。

original: My mind's made up on this. I'm cutting off the food supply to the Strip. They gotta learn their lesson the hard way, looks like.
translation: 我已经决定了。我要切断长街的食品供应。看来不给他们来点狠的，他们是不会长记性的。

original: Your son is confused. He doesn't know what he's saying.
translation: 你儿子迷糊了。他都不知道自己在说些什么。

original: You better be right. Cause I got me a mind to wipe this town off the map if some of the folks running it are to blame.
translation: 你最好是对的。因为老子已经想好了，要是连这儿的管理者也参与了，那我就把这个城市从地图上抹掉。

original: Well who did this, if it wasn't the White Gloves?
translation: 好吧，如果不是白手套，那是谁干的？

original: You can blame the White Glove Society. They're all cannibals.
translation: 你可以全算在白手套社团头上。他们都是食人族。

original: Well that does it! None of them maniacs will ever do business with Heck Gunderson long as they live.
translation: 好吧，我忍无可忍了！这帮疯子休想再活着跟我赫克·冈德森谈生意了。

original: Hell, I'll put me together a damn blockade. Hit 'em where it hurts.
translation: 妈的，我要动用所有手段好好制裁他们，让他们知道自作孽的下场。

original: They control the food? Well there ain't gonna be no food. Not for anybody in this whole damn town.
translation: 他们控制粮食？好啊，老子就断了他们的粮。这座狗屁城市休想再得到一粒粮食。

original: It's a goddamned monument to inhumanity. Let 'em starve. Biggest favor anyone's ever done this hellhole.
translation: 反人类的渣滓，简直他妈反出新境界了。饿死这帮狗东西，已经算是对这个粪坑最大的仁慈了。

original: <Lie> I don't know who took him. I just found him.
translation: <撒谎> 我不知道是谁抓的他。我只找到了他本人。

original: Confound it! I just don't know how I'm supposed to sleep knowing whoever done this got away.
translation: 真该死！居然让犯事的人跑了，这让我以后怎么睡得着觉。

original: All right. Well, I promised you I'd make it worth your while, so here you are.
translation: 好吧。我答应过会好好酬谢你的，拿着吧。

original: Try not to lose it all at the same casino.
translation: 可别全输在一家赌场里了。

original: It was Mortimer, one of the White Gloves, who had Ted taken. He's a cannibal.
translation: 白手套社团的莫蒂默把泰德抓走了。他是食人族。

original: Oh my god! Ted! Are you all right?
translation: 天啊！泰德！你还好吗？

original: Quit your hollering. I'm fine.
translation: 别大喊大叫的。我没事。

original: Listen, Pa, we got to go after the White Shoes or whatever they're called. They're the ones responsible.
translation: 听着，爸，我们得追查那个叫白鞋子还是什么的组织。他们应该为这事负责。

original: I would like to hear again about the items you sell here.
translation: 再给我说说你这儿都卖些什么。

original: I have all sorts of things. Vault souvenirs, vault wares, vault machines, vault mementos and vault suits! And, well, lots of other vault things, too.
translation: 应有尽有。避难所纪念品、避难所商品、避难所设备、避难所杂物和避难所服装！当然还有其它避难所里的东西。

original: You said that Vault 21 wasn't always a hotel?
translation: 你说21号避难所以前并不是旅馆？

original: No, silly! Of course it wasn't always a hotel.
translation: 哦哦，别傻啦，一开始当然不是个旅馆。

original: Actually, I don't have enough for that right now.
translation: 哎，我现在没带够钱。

original: Okay. Anything else I can do for you?
translation: 好的！那还有什么事吗？

original: Actually, I don't have enough caps right now.
translation: 哎，我现在没带够钱。

original: Okay. Anything else I can do for you?
translation: 好的！那还有什么事吗？

original: Here you go, 10 caps.
translation: 给你，10个瓶盖。

original: Okay! You know where to go. See you soon!
translation: 好的！你的房间还在老地方，知道怎么走吧？回见！

original: Go all the way down to the Vault's main game room, take the hallway to your left and then the first room on the left-hand side. Enjoy your stay!
translation: 往里走，一直到避难所中央的娱乐室，然后走左边的过道，左手边第一间就是。祝你在这里过得愉快！

original: What do I need to do to get in?
translation: 我需要什么才能进去？

original: If you are unable to meet the minimum balance requirement, an official passport is an acceptable alternative.
translation: 如果你无法满足最低资产要求，也可以向我们出示由官方派发的通行证。

original: <Science>
translation: <科学>

original: [SUCCEEDED] <Various buzzing and clicking noises>
translation: [成功] <各种蜂鸣和咔嚓声>

original: Thank you, sir.  You may proceed.
translation: 谢谢，先生。你可以通过了。

original: 1C 3C R34 M.
translation: 1C 3C R34 M。

original: [SUCCEEDED] <Various buzzing and clicking noises>
translation: [成功] <各种蜂鸣和咔嚓声>

original: Thank you, madam.  You may proceed.
translation: 谢谢，女士。你可以通过了。

original: 1C 3C R34 M.
translation: 1C 3C R34 M。

original: [FAILED] Please submit to a credit check or present a passport.
translation: [失败] 请缴纳保证金或出示通行证。

original: Robot!  Let me past!
translation: 机器人！让我过去！

original: [Passport] I've got a passport.
translation: [通行证]我有通行证。

original: Thank you, sir. You may proceed.
translation: 谢谢，先生。你可以通过了。

original: Thank you, madam. You may proceed.
translation: 谢谢，女士。你可以通过了。

original: Thank you, sir. You may proceed.
translation: 谢谢，先生。你可以通过了。

original: Thank you, madam. You may proceed.
translation: 谢谢，女士。你可以通过了。

original: I'll submit to the credit check. <2,000 caps required.>
translation: 我愿意提供保证金。<需要2000瓶盖 。>

original: Thank you, sir. You may proceed.
translation: 谢谢，先生。你可以通过了。

original: Thank you, madam. You may proceed.
translation: 谢谢，女士。你可以通过了。

original: I'm sorry, but your balance does not meet the minimum balance.
translation: 抱歉，你的资产数量无法满足最低要求。

original: Credit check? What's that for?
translation: 保证金？是干什么的？

original: Admission to the Strip requires an official passport or proof that you are carrying the required minimum balance.
translation: 想要获得进入长街的许可，你必须出示由官方派发的通行证，或者证明自己的资产已达到最低要求。

original: These policies prevent less-reputable persons from entering and ensure a good time will be had by all who enter the Strip.
translation: 以上政策是为了杜绝闲杂人等进出，以便为来到长街的游客们营造一个舒心的环境。

original: RadAway.
translation: 辐特宁。

original: You'll need to wait another 24 hours for us to get more made. We need everything else we currently have.
translation: 你得等待24个小时，我们才能生产出来。我们现在什么都缺。

original: Fixer.
translation: 瘾头解。

original: You'll need to wait another 24 hours for us to get more made. We need everything else we currently have.
translation: 你得等待24个小时，我们才能生产出来。我们现在什么都缺。

original: A stimpak.
translation: 一支治疗针。

original: You'll need to wait another 24 hours for us to get more made. We need everything else we currently have.
translation: 你得等待24个小时，我们才能生产出来。我们现在什么都缺。

original: You said you could spare some supplies?
translation: 你说过你有多余的补给品？

original: Sure. Would you like a Stimpak, Fixer, or Rad-Away?
translation: 没错，你想要治疗针，瘾头解还是辐特宁？

original: Well, now that Jacob is dead, we don't have the extra resources to make a surplus of medical supplies. Sorry, but we cannot spare anything now.
translation: 哎，雅各布已经死了，我们没能力生产额外的药物了。抱歉，我们现在没有多余的药品可以分给你。

original: I helped with that addiction problem you mentioned.
translation: 我已经救助了你提到的那几个吸毒者。

original: I saw them. Thank you so much for helping them. This means a lot to the Followers of the Apocalypse. You have our thanks.
translation: 我见过他们了，谢谢你对他们的帮助。这对天启追随者意义非凡，我们十分感谢你。

original: If you need some medical supplies, come see me. With Jacob working with us, we should be able to spare a stim or fixer once a day.
translation: 如果你需要医疗用品的话，请来找我。有了雅各布的帮助，每天为你提供一支治疗针或瘾头解应该不成问题。

original: I saw Bill, but found Jacob Dead. His death will be a big loss for Freeside.
translation: 我见到了比尔，但雅各布却过世了。他的死对自由城来说是个巨大的损失。

original: Thank you for helping Bill. At least he will help repair things around here.
translation: 谢谢你帮助比尔。至少他以后还能帮忙这儿的人修修东西。

original: I saw Jacob, but found Bill dead... His death will be a big loss for Freeside.
translation: 我见到了雅各布，但比尔却过世了。他的死对自由城来说是个巨大的损失。

original: If you need some medical supplies, come see me. With Jacob working with us, we should be able to spare a stim or fixer once a day.
translation: 如果你需要医疗用品的话，请来找我。有了雅各布的帮助，每天为你提供一支治疗针或瘾头解应该不成问题。

original: No you didn't! They're both dead!
translation: 胡说！他们都死了！

original: I don't know what you're pulling here, but this is not the way to win us over.
translation: 我不知道你到底有什么企图，可你用这种方式是无法博取我们的信任的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: See you.
translation: 回头见。

original: I want to help you get well, Jacob.
translation: 我想帮你好起来，雅各布。

original: Fine. If you really care so much, then get me some shots of Fixer to calm down these shakes.
translation: 好。如果你真的这么关心我，那就先给来我几针瘾头解，让我不要抖得那么厉害。

original: I'm gonna need at least ten shots to get me through the week. From there the Followers should be able to help.
translation: 需要至少十针才能帮我捱过这个星期。然后就交给天启追随者吧。

original: Sorry, Bill, but I still don't have the meds yet.
translation: 对不起，比尔，我还没搞到那些药品。

original: I don't have that on me right now.
translation: 我现在还没搞到那些东西。

original: Withdrawal could kill me if I don't get them soon.
translation: 如果再找不到的话，戒断反应会杀了我的。

original: I took care of that dealer. Now you can clean up.
translation: 我搞定了那个毒贩。现在你可以安心戒毒了。

original: What?! I need a fix now!
translation: 什么？！我正需要过过瘾啊！

original: You look pretty bad, Jacob. You should probably stop using chems.
translation: 你看上去很糟，雅各布。别再服用药物了。

original: Why stop? I feel great!
translation: 为什么？我感觉好极了！

original: No worries. My guy will be here soon enough, just wait.
translation: 别担心。我要找的人马上就会来的，再等一下。

original: Julie Farkas says you could use some help.
translation: 朱莉·法卡斯说你需要帮忙。

original: Julie is a saint, but I don't need help. I feel young and strong, as long as I get my chems.
translation: 朱莉真是大好人，但我不需要帮忙。只要有药磕，我就精力充沛。

original: What can you tell me about Captain Pappas?
translation: 可以告诉我有关帕帕斯上尉的事吗？

original: She may be a bit of a hardass, but she's the best damn Captain we've had here. I'd be careful around her. You don't want to get on her bad side.
translation: 她可能有点铁石心肠，但绝对是这里最好的上尉。我在她身边很小心的。你可别跟她作对。

original: If you're digging for dirt on the Captain, you're digging in the wrong place.
translation: 你想挖她的丑事，抓她的把柄？那你可找错了人了。

original: What do you know about the Ambassador?
translation: 你觉得大使这个人怎么样？

original: He's a little stiff and stuffy. Doesn't leave the office that much, always surrounds himself with papers and reports.
translation: 他有点古板，平时基本不出办公室，身边总是有一大堆文件报告什么的。

original: I've always wanted to play a prank on him, but there's no way I could ever pull that off without getting in trouble from Captain Pappas.
translation: 我总想找个机会弄个恶作剧整一下他，但那么做的话肯定会惹帕帕斯上尉生气。

original: Sorry. I don't know much about him. We run in different circles, you know?
translation: 不好意思，我跟他不怎么熟。我们不是一个圈子的人，你理解我的意思吧？

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: What have you heard? I know people think I'm a little on the wild side, but I'm just trying to have fun, you know?
translation: 你是打听到了什么吗？我知道大家都觉得我有点不着调，但我只是闹着玩的，知道吗？

original: Just because I happen to get into fights and like to pull pranks doesn't mean anything.
translation: 我不过偶尔打个架，平时好开个玩笑，搞点恶作剧什么的，又没什么大不了。

original: What's happening on the Strip?
translation: 长街上有什么新鲜事？

original: Us troopers mostly come to the Strip for our R&R. We blow off some steam by gambling, drinking, partying, or fighting.
translation: 我们这些士兵去长街都是为了消遣，赌钱、痛饮、狂欢、打架，就是为了解闷。

original: If you're looking for a good time, I'd suggest hitting up Gomorrah. The girls there are pretty nice, if you know what I mean.
translation: 如果你想找找乐子的话，我推荐你去蛾摩拉。那里的小姐都挺漂亮的，你懂的。

original: Tell me about Private Erwin.
translation: 跟我说说列兵欧文。

original: Private Erwin... he's starting to get a thick file here with all his troublemaking.
translation: 列兵欧文……他惹的麻烦很多，案底越来越厚了。

original: My troopers are my business. Stay out of it.
translation: 我的士兵归我管。你不要插手。

original: What can you tell me about the Ambassador?
translation: 跟我讲讲大使吧。

original: Crocker isn't too bad. He mostly stays in his office now. If you have any questions about the Embassy you should ask him. He'll talk your ear off.
translation: 克罗克人不坏。他大多数时候都呆在办公室。如果你想问关于大使馆的事，就去找他吧，他能把你的耳朵磨出茧子来。

original: If you want to know more about the Ambassador, go talk to him yourself.
translation: 如果你想多了解一下大使，自己去找他谈吧。

original: I'd like to know more about you.
translation: 我想多了解了解你。

original: Not much to tell. Keeping the troopers in line and monitoring the Strip keeps me busy. It's my job and I'm going to do it well.
translation: 没什么可说的。我整天就忙着操练士兵和看守长街。我还挺擅长干这活儿的。

original: Now if that's all, I've got work to do.
translation: 如果没别的事了，我要忙我的了。

original: Look, I don't know you at all and I'm not really interested in small talk. If you have something important to say, do so quickly.
translation: 听着，我根本就不认识你，我没空跟陌生人闲扯淡。如果你有什么要紧事就快说。

original: What is happening on the Strip?
translation: 长街上最近有什么新鲜事？

original: More of the usual. We're keeping an eye on the troopers to make sure they don't do anything stupid.
translation: 没什么特别的。我们一直在紧盯着这些士兵，以防他们干傻事。

original: The only stupid one we've had lately is Private Erwin. He's starting to cause me more trouble than he's worth.
translation: 最近唯一不让人省心的就是列兵欧文。他惹出的麻烦越来越多，已经不值得我们替他擦屁股了。

original: None of your business. You better keep your nose clean because I'll be watching you.
translation: 不关你的事。你最好小心点，我会盯着你的。

original: People drink, gamble, and fight. What do you think happens on the Strip? Any other intelligent questions?
translation: 喝酒、赌博、打架，还能有什么新鲜事？你能问点有智商的问题吗？

original: How the hell did a brahmin get loose on the Strip? If this is another one of Private Erwin's pranks, I'll make him regret it.
translation: 双头牛怎么会跑到长街上来？如果这又是欧文搞的鬼，我可要让他吃不了兜着走。

original: I've got to deal with drunk troopers making fools of themselves and embarassing all of the NCR with their behavior, so it's just another day here.
translation: 我必须整治一下那些士兵，到处干傻事，太给NCR丢脸了。这种事简直天天有。

original: Some idiot decided it would be funny to put up graffiti all over the Strip. If I find out it was one of my men, they'll be locked up for a month.
translation: 有些白痴以为在长街上到处涂鸦很好玩。如果我发现是我手下干的，我就关他们一个月禁闭。

original: Some fool troopers think they can lounge around on the rooftops instead of doing their job. If I catch them, they'll have KP duty for a year.
translation: 有些傻子以为他们可以趴在天台上偷懒不工作。如果被我抓到了，他们就要被罚扫一年卫生。

original: Some drunk girls thought it would be fun to play in the fountain in front of the Ultra-Luxe. Now I need to clean up the mess.
translation: 有些喝醉了的姑娘以为在奢华殿堂前面的喷泉边上耍酒疯很有意思。现在我要管管这事了。

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: I don't have time to give my life story to everyone that passes through. Is there something I can actually help you with?
translation: 我可没时间跟每个路过的人都讲我的故事。你到这儿来究竟有没有事？

original: What can you tell me about the Embassy?
translation: 你可以和我介绍一下大使馆的情况吗？

original: The Embassy offices are to your left while the barracks and living quarters are to the right.
translation: 大使的办公室在你的左边，营房和生活区在你的右边。

original: If you're looking for a history lesson, I suggest you talk to Ambassador Crocker.
translation: 如果你想听历史课，我建议你去找克罗克大使。

original: I'm looking for the Ambassador.
translation: 我正在找大使。

original: Ambassador Crocker can be found in his office through the door to my right at the end of the hall.
translation: 走过这个门，往我右手边，一直走到大厅尽头，克罗克大使就在办公室里。

original: What a prize you are. Not interested.
translation: 你还真是个机灵人。没兴趣。

original: You fell for this trap hook, line, and sinker. <Attack Benny.>
translation: 你自己上钩了，咬得还挺深，挺实在。 <攻击本尼>

original: {entering combat}You tramp! Like I needed another social disease anyhow!
translation: {entering combat}你这骚婆娘！我才不不稀罕沾花惹草呢！

original: Keep your pants on. I've got questions that need answers.
translation: 别急着脱裤子。我有话要问。

original: The time for talk has passed, honey baby. These mouths of ours have appointments to be elsewhere.
translation: 现在可不是说话的时候，宝贝。咱们这两张嘴还有别的活要干呢。

original: Let's see what's under that checked suit. <Have sex with Benny>
translation: 来看看你格子西装里还藏了什么吧。<和本尼做爱。>

original: Let's see what you've been hiding under that checked suit. <Have sex with Benny.>
translation: 来看看你格子西装里还藏了什么吧。<和本尼做爱。>

original: More than you ever dreamed, baby.
translation: 绝对会让你大吃一惊哦，宝贝。

original: You're right. I want answers.
translation: 说的不错。我需要答案。

original: [SUCCEEDED] If that's what it takes to win your trust, that's what it takes. Follow me.
translation: [成功] 如果这样才能赢取你信任的话，行吧。跟我来。

original: Two conditions - lose the bodyguards, and we both go to the suite now.
translation: 两个条件——让保镖离开，然后我们两个现在一起进套房。

original: [FAILED] {keeping voice down}You tracked me across the desert, Sugar Plum. Finding the Presidential? Easy pickings.
translation: [失败] {keeping voice down}你为了找我，可是横穿了整个沙漠啊，甜心。找个套房？太简单了吧。

original: Why don't you, you know... help me find where the suite is?
translation: 你能不能……帮我找找套房在哪吗？

original: Tell Benny you're going to kill him.
translation: 告诉本尼你准备杀死他。

original: Starts combat.
translation: 开始战斗。

original: Decline Benny's offer and say you'll expose him.
translation: 拒绝本尼的条件并说你会揭发他。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Where's my manners? Here's some cash up front. There'll be more where that came from.
translation: [成功] 瞧我真是失礼。这是预先垫付的一部分现金。剩下的将来会还清的。

original: Wait for me in the Presidential suite. We got a future together, you and me. It's time we got started.
translation: 在总统套房等我。咱们是要共同创造未来的。就从现在开始吧。

original: The suite's a nice touch, but someone's got to pay off my contract.
translation: 套房是不错，但总得有人给我付我送货的钱。

original: [FAILED] {keeping voice down}This operation has cost me plenty. I ain't about to get shaken down by some Johnny-come-lately.
translation: [失败] {keeping voice down}这次行动已经花了我不少钱。我可不会因为一个毛头小子一句话就交钱出来。

original: If you want me to play nice, it'll cost you.
translation: 如果你想让我按规矩来，那可得花不少钱。

original: [FAILED] {keeping voice down}This operation has cost me plenty. I ain't about to get shaken down by some Janey-come-lately.
translation: [失败] {keeping voice down}这次行动已经花了我不少钱。我可不会因为一个小丫头一句话就交钱出来。

original: If you want me to play nice, it'll cost you.
translation: 如果你想让我按规矩来，那可得花不少钱。

original: {keeping voice down}There's a first-class offer on the table. The rest is up to you.
translation: {keeping voice down}我台面上开出的条件已经够好了。剩下的就看你了。

original: Fine, but don't keep me waiting.
translation: 好，但别让我等太久。

original: Why would I do that, baby? I want to talk to you as much as you want to talk to me.
translation: 我怎么会让你等呢？我真恨不得立马坐下来与你畅谈一番哪。

original: And you dig this is just first base, right? You and me have a future together, and it's big league and open all night.
translation: 现在只是万事开头第一步，明白吗？咱们是要共创未来的，到时候可有享不尽的荣华富贵啊。

original: Here's this key to the Prez. I'll see you there in two shakes. Ta-ta.
translation: 这是套房的钥匙。我马上就来。回见。

original: What'd you have in mind?
translation: 你有什么想法？

original: {keeping voice down}To start, I'll comp you the Presidential - best suite in the house. You deserve a taste of the VIP lifestyle.
translation: {keeping voice down}作为见面礼，我给你提供一间总统套房——这里最豪华的房间。遭了这么大的罪，你应该好好享受VIP的待遇。

original: {keeping voice down}I'll hang out down here for a while to make everything look business-as-usual, then come to you. Any questions you got, I'll answer - guaranteed.
translation: {keeping voice down}我先在下面巡视两圈，好教人不会起疑，然后我再来找你。无论你有什么问题，我一定解答——我保证。

original: What are you offering?
translation: 你出什么条件？

original: Ask Benny about himself and his situation.
translation: 询问本尼关于他自己的事以及他的处境.

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Please return when you have sufficient caps or a passport.
translation: 请先确保您拥有足够的资产或通行证。

original: Excuse me, but a lady of my stature does not converse with those of low stock.
translation: 对不起，像我这样有品位的淑女是不会和那些身无分文的人说话的。

original: Hello, my friend.
translation: 你好啊，我的朋友。

original: Those rat-bastard Garrets stopped offering tabs.  Now where the hell am I supposed to go for free drinks?
translation: 加勒特家那帮混蛋不再允许人赊账了。现在我他妈去哪儿搞免费的酒喝啊？

original: Friggin' troll NCR squatters.  A bunch of mouth-breathing wastes of space, if you ask me.
translation: 可恶的NCR流民。要我说，他们活着都是浪费空间。

original: Hey! Got any liquor on you?! I'm damn thirsty.
translation: 嘿！你有酒吗？我他妈快渴死了！

original: Hey. Thanks for helping me out. Being back and working really saved my life.
translation: 嘿。谢谢你救了我。回来工作让我感觉好多了。

original: Got any chems, sir?  I need a hit quick!
translation: 有药吗，先生？我想过把瘾！

original: Can't talk. Much work to do at the Fort and Atomic Wrangler.
translation: 没空说话。我在城堡和原子牛仔还有很多活要干。

original: I led you on, and it worked like a charm. Bye bye.
translation: 我骗了你，没想到还挺管用。拜拜。

original: Player says goodbye.
translation: 玩家道别。

original: {relieved to be getting out of here}Baby, you're the boss. All you gotta do is whistle.
translation: {relieved to be getting out of here}宝贝，你说了算。只要你吹声口哨，我马上就走。

original: In the meantime, enjoy the high life. Room service is on me. I'll send up a bottle of the good stuff. Ta-ta.
translation: 在此期间，请好好享受富贵生活吧。客房服务都算我账上。回头我会挑瓶好酒送上。再见了。

original: You're stinking up my suite, Benny. Scram. We'll talk later.
translation: 你真是把我的房间都搞臭了，本尼，滚吧。我们以后再说。

original: {relieved by end of conversation}Baby, you're the boss. All you gotta do is whistle.
translation: {relieved to be getting out of here}宝贝，你说了算。只要你吹声口哨，我马上就走。

original: Here, take some chips and see how you do at the tables. Ta-ta.
translation: 来，拿着这些筹码，看看你手气如何。明儿见。

original: See ya {'round}around.
translation: {'round}回头见.

original: In the meantime, enjoy the high life. Room service is on me. I'll send up a bottle of the good stuff. Ta-ta.
translation: 在此期间，请好好享受富贵生活吧。客房服务都算我账上。回头我会挑瓶好酒送上。再见了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All I want is to see you dead. <Attack Benny.>
translation: 我只想看你下地狱。<攻击本尼。>

original: Then this is endsville, baby - may the best {slight emphasis}man win.
translation: 那样最好，宝贝——那{slight emphasis}就来比个高低吧。

original: Here you go. I hope this helps.
translation: 给你。希望能帮上忙。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You're a bastard after my own heart. Here, it's all I got.
translation: [成功] 你在我眼里就是一坨狗屎，拿去，就这么多了。

original: Now get in there and waste those guys!
translation: 去吧，干掉他们！

original: What's my help worth to you?
translation: 我帮你，你打算给我多少钱？

original: [FAILED] What the hell? I ain't got that kind of money!
translation: [失败] 什么？我可没那么多钱！

original: Take those guys out and I'm sure the King will reward you just fine.
translation: 干掉那些人，我相信猫王会好好犒赏你的。

original: I'll need at least two thousand caps to motivate me.
translation: 至少得给我200个瓶盖， 我才有动力。

original: What do you want me to do?
translation: 你想让我干什么？

original: Take these assholes out, what else? Now go!
translation: 干掉这群混蛋，还想什么？上！

original: What about you?
translation: 你呢？

original: They seem to have it in for me. Go figure. While they waste all their bullets trying to get me, you head in and waste 'em.
translation: 他们看起来是有备而来，上吧。我来吸引火力，你进去干掉他们。

original: I want you to back him up. See this through, and there'll be something good waiting for you when you get back.
translation: 我希望你能给他搭把手。只要这事顺利解决，等你回来，我不会亏待你的。

original: Howdy, pardner! You've come a {fur}far piece, haven't you? Welcome to New Vegas!
translation: 嘿，搭档！你真是走了好远的路啊！欢迎来到新维加斯！

original: I'd like to ask about something else instead.
translation: 我还想问点别的。

original: {slightly disappointed}Oh yes, sure sure. Ask away.
translation: {slightly disappointed}噢，好啊，当然。随便问。

original: Interesting, go on.
translation: 有意思，继续说。

original: {Proud}I was elected to this post seven years ago. {Pride escalating}I'm the third NCR representative to serve here in Vegas.
translation: {Proud}7年前我赢得提名选举，到这个岗位上赴任。{Pride escalating}我是NCR派驻维加斯的第三任大使。

original: {Beat, still proud}Now, I've had my share of ups and downs along the way, but I wouldn't trade it for anything in the world.
translation: {Beat, still proud}这一路走来，我也算是经历了不少大起大落，但它们对我而言都是无可替代的宝贵财富。

original: That's it. Anything else you wished to know?
translation: 我就说这些。你还有什么想知道的吗？

original: Go on.
translation: 继续。

original: Now we mostly just keep track of the NCR citizens and troopers around and make sure they don't get in trouble, but that's Captain Pappas' job.
translation: 我们现在的工作主要是监督这儿的NCR公民和军人，防止他们遇上麻烦，不过这事是帕帕斯上校在负责。

original: I keep myself busy with paperwork and reports that get sent back to the NCR. It's mostly busy work, but every once in awhile, we make progress.
translation: 我则是整天忙着向NCR提交各种文书和报告。虽然工作挺繁重的，但我们偶尔还是会取得一些进展。

original: That's enough history for me.
translation: 我不想再听历史课了。

original: Oh... very well then. What else can I do for you?
translation: 噢……那好吧。你还有什么事吗？

original: Have you seen Benny?
translation: 你见到本尼了吗？

original: I saw him heading for his suite just a few minutes ago. Looked like a fox that just got caught in the henhouse. Maybe you'll catch him there.
translation: 几分钟前我还看他往自己的房间走呢，那模样就好像一只刚在鸡窝里被逮着的狐狸似的。或许你能在那儿找到他。

original: It was a while ago! He came through in a real hurry - didn't even stop to say hello! I think he went down his secret escape elevator out in the hall!
translation: 就在刚才！他匆匆忙忙地闯进来，连声招呼都没打！我想他一定是搭乘大厅里的秘密逃生电梯逃跑了！

original: When's the last time you saw Benny?
translation: 你最后一次见到本尼是什么时候？

original: Dig it, baby, he beat feet to his suite. You scare the big boss man or something?
translation: 实话说吧，宝贝，他三步并两步窜到房间里去了，你是把大老板吓着了还是怎么的？

original: Sure! He came through here in a big hurry - didn't even stop to say hello! I think he went down his secret escape elevator out there in the hall!
translation: 见过！他匆匆忙忙地闯进来，连声招呼都没打！我想他一定是搭乘大厅里的秘密逃生电梯逃跑了！

original: He was around not too long ago. He's probably down on the casino floor now.
translation: 不久之前他还这儿呢。可能现在去赌场了吧。

original: You can wait for him here, if you like. I'm incapable of asking you to leave.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，可以在这里等他。毕竟我也不好意思赶你走。

original: Do you still need more vault stuff?
translation: 你还需要更多的避难所物品吗？

original: If you could bring me vault suits, I would so make it worth your while... I mean, really! But it has to be good leather, okay!?
translation: 如果你能给我弄几套避难所服装，我可以付报酬给你……我是认真的！但必须是上等皮革，好吗！？

original: Maybe later. I have more questions for you.
translation: 待会再说吧。我还有问题想问你。

original: Don't say anything then - you look good enough just nodding your head.
translation: 啥都别说了，只要你点点头就足够了。

original: [FAILED] Oh, don't floor it... There's a lot more to this than a classy chassis, you know?
translation: [失败] 哦，别这么着急加油门嘛……要驾驭我这小绵羊可不容易哦，知道吗？

original: Anyway, what do you say about my proposal?
translation: 总之，你对我的提议有什么看法？

original: Maybe later. I have more questions for you.
translation: 待会再说吧。我还有问题想问你。

original: All right. Consider it done.
translation: 好的。包在我身上。

original: Thank you so much!
translation: 真是太感谢你了。

original: Maybe later. I have more questions for you.
translation: 待会再说吧。我还有问题想问你。

original: All right. Consider it done.
translation: 好的。包在我身上。

original: Thank you so much!
translation: 真是太感谢你了。

original: You are an angel. I can't wait to see you again!
translation: 你真是个天使！我都等不及想再见到你了！

original: Thinking about you in tight leather makes me want to uh... blow my top?
translation: 想象你穿着紧身皮衣，真的能让我……神魂颠倒？

original: [FAILED] Oh yeah? I bet you spend most of the time thinking lines rather than putting them to use. That vault merchandise is not on your menu! Next!
translation: [失败] 是吗？我看你是情愿花大把时间想着怎么花言巧语，也不肯真的穿到身上吧。避难所商品不对你出售！下一位！

original: Actually, let me ask you about something else.
translation: 其实，我想问你点别的。

original: Okay. Anything else I can do for you?
translation: 好的，还有其他事情吗？

original: Quit yapping. I am starting to think of very unpleasant uses for those toasters.
translation: 别瞎嚷嚷了。我都开始对那些烤面包机产生非分之想了。

original: Cool it, smarty-pants! I don't have to take that shit from anybody, you know? Get out! Don't come back until you learn how to get along.
translation: 得了吧，耍什么心眼呢！我告诉你，我不吃别人这一套！给我滚出去！先学会好好跟人说话再回来吧。

original: Wait a moment - I changed my mind. Let me ask you something else.
translation: 等一下——我改变主意了。我想问你点儿别的。

original: You know, leather is my specialty. Unzip it, heat it and rub a shine onto it.
translation: 你知道吗，我也喜欢皮衣。拉开拉链、用火烘干，再擦得油光锃亮。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Really? Well... Ha! I don't even know what to say to that!
translation: [成功] 真的？嗯……哈！我都不知道说什么好了！

original: Yeah. I wanted to ask you about something else before my top blows... off, too.
translation: 好的。在我也……神魂颠倒之前，我还想问你点儿别的。

original: I might be persuaded to lend a hand.
translation: 如果条件合适，我帮你的忙也无妨。

original: You would? You really would?
translation: 你？真的？

original: That would help me, a lot!
translation: 那可帮了我的大忙了！

original: I'll pay you good money per each suit.
translation: 每件衣服我都会付你大价钱的。

original: I'll help you out.
translation: 我会帮你的。

original: You would? You really would?
translation: 你会帮我？真的？

original: That would help me, a lot!
translation: 那可帮了我的大忙了！

original: Sarah, stop right there. Do you actually have any vault gear?
translation: 萨拉, 等一下，你不是说卖避难所设备吗？

original: Okay, I do, but who wants a lame sensor module, or a nitrogen canister, anyway?
translation: 是的，我的确有。但谁会想要一个破烂的传感器模块，或是一只氮气瓶呢？

original: All the popular stuff has been sold - especially the vault suits. I need to find more because people buy them like hot cakes.
translation: 所有受欢迎的东西都卖光了，尤其是避难所服装。我得多弄几套来，因为实在太畅销了。

original: Leather suits are good times! Thinking about that just blows my top!
translation: 皮衣穿着显身板！光是想想就让人神魂颠倒！

original: Vault gear - swell. Can you show me what you got?
translation: 避难所设备——妙极了。能给我介绍一下吗？

original: Oh, yeah, sure!
translation: 哦，没问题！

original: Okay - I got these great lunchboxes, they are super! What else? Oh! Look at these toasters! You like toasts, right? If they are crunchy even better!
translation: 好的，首先是午餐盒，这些可都是稀有货！还有什么？哦，对了！这些烤面包机！你喜欢烤面包吗？能烤得又香又脆哦！

original: What about a vintage Vault-Tec toy car? Or-
translation: 来个古老的避难所科技玩具车怎么样？还是——

original: I have some questions to ask first...
translation: 我得先问几个问题。

original: Here you go. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
translation: 给你。<把白金筹码给豪斯先生。>

original: This doesn't interest me. I should be leaving.
translation: 我没兴趣，我该走了。

original: Too late, Mortimer. You already said too much.
translation: 太迟了，莫蒂默。你已经说得太多了。

original: You're all hypocrites! How can you claim to be connoisseurs yet deny yourselves the greatest of all meats?
translation: 你们全是伪君子！你们怎么能一边自称美食家，一边却拒绝品尝这世界上最美味的肉？

original: I am ashamed to have once called everyone here family. This isn't over, though.
translation: 我曾把你们当作家人，但现在我感到耻辱！这件事不会就此结束的。

original: I'll begin anew. The White Glove Society will never achieve the greatness of my new order.
translation: 我要组建新的社团。我会把它提升到白手套社团永远都无法企及的高度。

original: You'll all hear from me again.
translation: 你们就等着我的消息吧。

original: [Attack] You all heard his confession! The punishment for cannibalism is death!
translation: [攻击] 你们都听见他的坦白了！吃了人，就应当被判死罪！

original: So be it. But we are all cannibals here. My death will be a constant reminder, and some day you will all remember.
translation: 那就来吧。但今天在场的各位都吃过人。就算我死了，这件事也会烙在你们心底，迟早有一天你们会想起来的。

original: Sorry, Mortimer. Secret recipe. It isn't human, though, I can tell you that.
translation: 抱歉，莫蒂默。这道菜的做法是个秘密。但我可以告诉你，它不是人肉。

original: No! These are lies! I never kidnapped anyone. And even if I did, there's no harm done. He's alive, after all.
translation: 不！全是谎话！我从没绑架过任何人！就算我绑架了谁，也从没伤害过他。毕竟他还好好活着。

original: I'm looking for the Gourmand. Am I in the right place?
translation: 我在找美食家餐厅。我找对地方了吗？

original: Get them!
translation: 抓住他们！

original: Get him!
translation: 抓住他！

original: Get her!
translation: 抓住她！

original: <Loudly> Bad news, Mortimer. No one's eating the boy you kidnapped tonight.
translation: <大声> 坏消息，莫蒂默。今晚没人能吃得了你们绑架的那个男孩了。

original: Kidnapped? That's ridiculous! And who said anything about eating anyone?
translation: 绑架？太荒谬了！还有，有人说要吃人了吗？

original: {Stage Whisper}I know I didn't, because I hadn't gotten to that line of my speech yet. What remarkable timing you have.
translation: {Stage Whisper}反正不是我说的，因为我的演讲还没提到那个部分呢。你这时机选得不错呀。

original: What are you- ? Why is he there? Who are we eating right now?
translation: 你在做什——？他怎么在那儿？那我们现在吃的是谁？

original: Yeah, I heard that before. What about actual vault gear?
translation: 是的，这话我听过了。我说的是真正的避难所设备。

original: Okay, I do, but who wants a lame sensor module, or a nitrogen canister, anyway?
translation: 是的，我的确有。但谁会想要一个破烂的传感器模块，或是一只氮气瓶呢？

original: All the popular stuff has been sold - especially the vault suits. I need to find more because people buy them like hot cakes.
translation: 所有受欢迎的东西都卖光了，尤其是避难所服装。我得多弄几套来，因为实在太畅销了。

original: Leather suits are good times! Thinking about that just blows my top!
translation: 皮衣穿着显身板！光是想想就让人神魂颠倒！

original: What the- ? You son of a- ! Goddamn motherf- ! Ugh! Let me out!
translation: 搞什——？你这狗娘养——！操你妈——！啊！让我出去！

original: You get back here with our dinner!
translation: 你把我们的晚餐还回来！

original: I'm just browsing.
translation: 我就随便看看。

original: Please let me know if anything catches your eye.
translation: 要是看中什么，请告诉我。

original: I'd like to see what you have for sale.
translation: 我想看看你卖些什么。

original: Of course.
translation: 当然。

original: Hmmm, I guess they were harmless after all. I'm not often mistaken, you know.
translation: 嗯，看来他们也没什么威胁嘛。你知道，我很少看走眼的。

original: Just so you know, heading out here breaks our contract. This is why I ask people to pay up front. See you around.
translation: 我之前说了，走到这地方来就已经是违反约定了。所以我才都让客人先付钱的。再见啦。

original: You don't follow orders very well, do you? Oh well, more money for me.
translation: 你好像不太喜欢听别人的话啊？好吧，反正我包赚不亏。

original: Down to the right here is the fun part of town. You haven't seen Freeside till you've been to the Wrangler.
translation: 右边就是镇上找乐子的地方。没去过原子牛仔酒吧，就不算到过自由城。

original: Up ahead on the next block is where the Kings hang out. Don't let them scare you, if they don't outnumber you five to one you'll be fine.
translation: 前面的街区就是猫王帮的地盘。别被他们吓着，只要不是你一个单挑他们五个，就根本用不着害怕。

original: To your left here is the Old Mormon Fort. You get roughed up, the Followers there will patch you right up. Not that I ever need their services.
translation: 你左手边的是旧摩门教要塞。如果你受伤了，可以去那里找天启追随者治疗。我反正是不会去找他们。

original: Two hundred caps! That's twice what everyone else is charging!
translation: 200个瓶盖！比别人贵了一倍！

original: Hey, you want the best, you have to pay for it.
translation: 喂，你想要最好的服务，就得花大价钱。

original: I'm a little busy right now.
translation: 我现在有点忙。

original: I beg your pardon, then. I'll let you get about your business.
translation: 那不好意思了。你去忙你的吧。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: I'm listening.
translation: 我听着呢。

original: Will it be dangerous? I like dangerous.
translation: 危险吗？我喜欢冒险。

original: In that case, some of the things I need handled will be right up your alley.
translation: 既然如此，我倒是有几件事应该能合你的胃口。

original: Would you be willing to sponsor me as an honorary member now?
translation: 你现在愿意担保我成为荣誉会员了吗？

original: The answer is still no, I fear. You need to be the talk of the town, really. Think big! Your name should be on everyone's lips.
translation: 恐怕依然不行。你得在城里家喻户晓才行。志向大一点！要有本事让所有人都把你的名字挂在嘴边。

original: Come back then, and we shall welcome you with open arms.
translation: 等那时你再回来，我们一定会张开双臂欢迎你的。

original: Most definitely! You have become quite an impressive person in my estimation, and you are very well regarded here among those in the know.
translation: 当然了！我觉得你已经给所有人都留下了十分深刻的印象，这里的知名人士都很看好你。

original: You have my full support, and you are welcome to join us at our nightly banquets in our special section of the Gourmand.
translation: 我完全支持你，也欢迎你参加我们在美食家餐厅特别区域举办的晚宴。

original: I hope to see you there.
translation: 希望能在那里见到你。

original: I want to join the White Glove Society. I was told I'd need a sponsor.
translation: 我想加入白手套社团。有人跟我说需要一个担保人。

original: Why yes, of course. The White Glove Society is the most exclusive club in all of New Vegas. Perhaps the entire world.
translation: 是的，当然。白手套社团是新维加斯城中最高档的俱乐部。恐怕放眼全世界都无出其右。

original: It's only natural that you'd need a sponsor from within the club who can vouch for your good name.
translation: 因此，你需要一名来自俱乐部内的成员为你的品行做担保，也是再自然不过的要求。

original: Originally we didn't allow anyone else in, you see. Founding members only. We thought exclusivity would make us the envy of everyone who's anyone.
translation: 我们原本是不允许创始成员以外的人员加入的。我们认为，设置高门槛可以吸引到上流人士的注意。

original: And it has. But then I had the idea to allow honorary members. Lower in status, naturally, but it just makes people want to be us even more.
translation: 事实也证明了这一点。后来我又想出了荣誉会员制。当然，荣誉会员的地位要低一些，但慕名而来的人反而更多了。

original: And the right people could certainly do wonders for our image. Celebrities, philanthropists. We want only the very best.
translation: 吸纳合适的成员可以大幅提升我们的形象。名人也好，慈善家也罢，我们只接受精英。

original: I'm afraid you are a relative unknown. Certainly not the caliber of person we would consider for such an honor. Not yet, anyway.
translation: 恐怕你还不够出名。显然你不符合我们对荣誉会员的要求。至少现在还不符合。

original: If you had more notoriety or clout here on the Strip, things would be different. People need to have heard of you, and you must be well thought of.
translation: 如果你能提高自己在长街的声望或是影响力，那也许就有机会了。必须要让大家都知道你，还得保持良好的形象。

original: And you most definitely fit the bill. Given your deeds on the Strip alone, I can safely say that you would be a prized addition to our honorary ranks.
translation: 显然你完全符合我们的条件。考虑到你在长街的名望，我相信你的加入必定会给我们的荣誉殿堂增光添彩。

original: Mmm. You'll have to look elsewhere, I'm afraid. The whole idea of "joining" the White Glove Society is pure hogwash.
translation: 唔……我看你还是另谋高就吧。所谓"加入"白手套社团的想法，完全就是异想天开。

original: You're either in it, or you're not. There's no joining.
translation: 会员身份是与生俱来的。根本没有什么加入一说。

original: This "honorary member" nonsense is just something Marjorie contrived because she's so preoccupied with image. But it's only a fad.
translation: 这个"荣誉会员"纯粹就是玛乔里心血来潮想出来的馊主意，因为她太在意社团的形象了。但这也只是她一时脑热。

original: Once it blows over the riff-raff we've temporarily inducted will be shown the door. So I wouldn't hold out hope if I were you.
translation: 等她冷静下来，那些被我们临时拉进来的乌合之众都会被统统扫地出门。所以我劝你，还是别抱希望了。

original: What did you say about not being the owner of the hotel and shop?
translation: 你说你不是这旅店和商店的主人，这是什么意思？

original: I take care of it but I suppose you could say that it belongs to Mr. House.
translation: 我只负责经营，这地方实际上属于豪斯先生。

original: I would like to know other things about you and this hotel.
translation: 我还想了解一下你和这家旅馆。

original: I see. Okay, your move.
translation: 我明白了。没问题，问吧。

original: I have some more questions about Vault 21
translation: 对21号避难所我还有点疑问。

original: I still have some questions about Vault 21.
translation: 对21号避难所我还有点疑问。

original: All right! What would you like to know?
translation: 好的！你想知道什么？

original: Count on it.
translation: 没问题。

original: Oh, that makes me so happy! You are too much!
translation: 哦，真让我高兴！你太好了！

original: Just don't say "Here, now!" Don't want to get the patrons all riled up, do we?
translation: 别说"给我过来！"就行，我们都不想得罪回头客，对吧？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Ha ha ha! Okay - why don't you help me out and in the meantime I will think about where to... take advantage of your skills.
translation: [成功] 哈哈哈！好吧，你帮我个忙怎样，我也可以想一想该如何……利用你的能力。

original: I had other questions for you.
translation: 我有别的问题要问你。

original: Do you miss the old days in the vault?
translation: 你怀念避难所的旧时光吗？

original: It was bustling with activity! We all knew each other so well - you see, the vault kept us all even. It's all symmetry and windows down there.
translation: 那可是段活力四射的岁月！我们彼此关系都很好，避难所里人人平等。到处都是一片和谐的景象。

original: We solved any quarrels through gambling! Lady luck casts no eyeballs, you know? So, nobody shafted anyone else!
translation: 所有的争吵都可以通过赌博解决！幸运女神是不会偏袒任何人的，知道吗？所以，谁也别想蒙人！

original: Yeah... I miss those days!
translation: 是的……我怀念那段岁月！

original: Yeah... I miss those days!
translation: 是的……我怀念那段岁月！

original: Do you get a lot of business here?
translation: 你这儿生意挺好的？

original: Sure! The place's packed... usually.
translation: 当然！通常……都是爆满的。

original: We get loads of NCR cubes these days, a stray Brahmin baron once in a while, and recently circled couples shining big rocks on their fingers.
translation: 最近来的都是NCR的客人，我记得有一位迷了路的双头牛大亨，还有几对双手戴了漂亮石头的情侣。

original: Why did he fill the vault with concrete?
translation: 为什么他要用混凝土把避难所填上？

original: I don't know! Maybe he didn't want anybody sneaking around down there.
translation: 我不知道！也许他不喜欢有人成天在地底下钻来钻去吧。

original: My vault runs deep and wide! It's filled with corridors and rooms that go far.
translation: 我的避难所又深又宽敞！到处都是绵延不断的走廊和房间。

original: What gives him the right to screw us with the royal shaft, anyway? So, he saved New Vegas. Wohooo! Now scram and let us go on with our lives! Sheesh!
translation: 他有什么权力摆出那副霸道的样子，还对我们颐指气使的？是，他是拯救过新维加斯。哇呼！干嘛不让我们自个儿过日子呢，切。

original: Sure. I would like that.
translation: 当然。我很愿意。

original: Righty-o, daddy-o. Let's do it!
translation: 好哒，伙计——我们走着！

original: You run the place, then?
translation: 你是这儿的老板娘？

original: Yeah - and you got to dig what I did with it! Looking as good as it should... almost.
translation: 没错！哈，瞧瞧我打理得多好啊！看起来一切井井有条的……对吧。

original: What does Mr. House have to do with Vault 21?
translation: 豪斯先生和21号避难所有什么关系？

original: Mr. House has everything to do with Vault 21. He tried to get us out before he filled it with concrete.
translation: 豪斯先生和21号避难所的关系可大了。他把我们撵了出去，然后用混凝土把这里给填了。

original: I almost went ape! So, we convinced him - okay, Sheldon and I, right? We convinced him to leave the top level mostly intact!
translation: 我都要疯了！后来我们说服了他，好吧，就谢尔顿和我，我们说服他把地表的这几层留了下来。

original: Mr. House has everything to do with Vault 21. He tried to get us out before he filled it with concrete.
translation: 豪斯先生和21号避难所的关系可大了。他把我们撵了出去，然后用混凝土把这里给填了。

original: Something doesn't add up, Sarah. This can't be all that.
translation: 这说不通，萨拉。肯定还有别的原因。

original: [FAILED] I grew up in it. I love it - my favorite place in the world!
translation: [失败] 我是在这儿长大的，我热爱它——全世界就这地方最棒了！

original: Sheldon also likes the indoors... a lot. Are you agoraphobic too?
translation: 谢尔顿也…喜欢呆在室内。你们都有恐旷症？

original: Okay - you're right. I hate going outside. It's almost impossible for me to step out of here. Still, I love my vault. It's my pad!
translation: [成功] 好吧——你是对的。我讨厌外面，离开这里我就寸步难行。不过我爱避难所是真的。毕竟是我的家！

original: Sarah - there is something else behind all this, right?
translation: 萨拉，这背后一定另有隐情，对吧？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Okay - you're right. I hate going outside. It's almost impossible for me to step out of here. Still, I love my vault. It's my pad!
translation: [成功] 好吧——你是对的。我讨厌外面，离开这里我就寸步难行。不过我爱避难所是真的。毕竟是我的家！

original: You have never actually left this place?
translation: 你真的从没有离开过这儿？

original: Sure I have! I made the scene in The Strip. It is just that I really like it here - Vault 21 is a kick!
translation: 当然有！我去过长街。只不过我太喜欢这里了——21号避难所是最棒的！

original: What is so special about this vault?
translation: 这个避难所有什么特别之处？

original: My vault is pure New Vegas. Everyone has a chance and lady luck smiles if you play your odds right!... Okay, it was like that before we had to leave.
translation: 我的避难所就和新维加斯一模一样——机会对每个人都是公平的，幸运女神总会垂青你！……好吧，在我们被赶出去前，确实是那样。

original: Vault 21 had very smart ways to help people get along. All arguments and fights got solved through gambling.
translation: 21号避难所在引导人们和睦相处上自有一套。所有的争端都可以通过赌博来解决。

original: I'll give you a quick tour of my home! Oh, yeah, if you like.
translation: 我可以带你快速参观一下这里！哦，如果你愿意的话。

original: Vault 21 had very smart ways to help people get along. All arguments and fights got solved through gambling.
translation: 21号避难所在引导人们和睦相处上自有一套。所有的争端都可以通过赌博来解决。

original: I'll give you a quick tour of my home! Oh, yeah, if you like.
translation: 我可以带你快速参观一下这里！哦，如果你愿意的话。

original: Vault 21 had very smart ways to help people get along. All arguments and fights got solved through gambling.
translation: 21号避难所在引导人们和睦相处上自有一套。所有的争端都可以通过赌博来解决。

original: Oh, that's it. Your ass is mine!
translation: 哦，好吧。你这条命是我的了！

original: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 好，随便。

original: Just get the fuck away from here, already.
translation: 给我他妈滚出去。

original: Where are you normally stationed?
translation: 你平时都驻扎在什么地方？

original: Camp McCarran, but I'm on leave at the moment - heading back to California to see my folks.
translation: 麦卡伦营地,但我现在正在休假——打算回加利福尼亚见见我的家人。

original: I'm supposed to join up with a caravan that's heading that way up at the 188, but they're not due to arrive for awhile yet.
translation: 我本来要跟着北边188号贸易站的一个商队同行的，但他们现在暂时还来不了。

original: < Speech Option - 30 >
[SUCCEEDED] All right, apology accepted. Don't let it happen again.
translation: [成功] 好吧，我接受道歉，下不为例。

original: My apologies. It was rude and disrespectful of me to do that.
translation: 抱歉，我刚才实在太粗鲁太失礼了。

original: [FAILED] Yeah, sure, whatever. I'm done with you.
translation: [失败] 是啊，随便，反正我是不想理你了。

original: Sorry. I, uh, didn't know what I was doing.
translation: 抱歉，我，呃，我都不知道自己干了什么。

original: I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: 很抱歉提到了你的伤心事。

original: Don't worry about it.
translation: 没关系。

original: What is this memorial?
translation: 这个纪念碑是做什么的？

original: It commemorates the Battle of Hoover Dam. The rangers lured the best of Caesar's Legion into Boulder City, then blew the whole town up.
translation: 这是为了纪念胡佛大坝战役而设立的。当时游骑兵把凯撒军团的精锐引进了巨石城，然后把整座城镇都炸上了天。

original: The NCR still lost a bunch of troops in the fighting, though. My older brother sacrificed himself so they could evacuate some of the wounded.
translation: 不过NCR依然在战斗中损失了不少部队。我哥哥就是为了掩护伤员撤退而牺牲了自己。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Bye.
translation: 拜。

original: You're a little bitch and your brother was, too.
translation: 你和你哥哥一样都是混蛋。

original: Oh, now it's on.
translation: 哦，那就动手啊。

original: I didn't come here to negotiate, I came for revenge. <Attack Benny.>
translation: 我不是来谈判的，我是来复仇的。<攻击本尼。>

original: We talk here and now, or I tell everyone my story.
translation: 我们就在这儿谈，不然我就把你的事告诉所有人。

original: Do what you got to do, baby, and let the chips fall as they may. You know where to find me.
translation: 随你的便，宝贝，我不会计较后果的。你可以随时回来找我。

original: Tell Benny you're going to kill him.
translation: 告诉本尼你要杀死他。

original: What is Thermite?
translation: 铝热剂是什么东西？

original: Thermite is a mix of rust and aluminum dust. If you add a little heat, a massive{emphasized} amount of heat is spit out.
translation: 铝热剂是铁锈和铝粉的混合物。只要一遇热，它就会瞬间释放巨大的热量。

original: It gives off enough heat to melt through just about anything. It should make short work of the weapons.
translation: 这股热量几乎可以熔化任何物体。用它来销毁武器相当划算。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, fuck you.
translation: [成功] 嘿，去你妈的。

original: Alright, I'll place the fucking Thermite myself. You get out of the casino for a bit. I'll take care of it while you're gone.
translation: 好吧，我去放那该死的铝热剂。你就先去赌场外避避风头吧，等你走后我自己会搞定的。

original: If you don't deploy the Thermite yourself, I'll tell the bosses what you've been planning.
translation: 如果你不亲自去放置铝热剂，我就把你的计划告诉老板。

original: [FAILED] Nothing you could threaten me with holds a candle to what the Omertas would do to me if they caught me.
translation: [失败] 比起黑手党，你这种程度的恐吓只能算是小菜一碟。

original: You deploy the Thermite or I'll punch you in the shoulder.
translation: 你自己去放铝热剂，否则小心我打烂你的胳膊。

original: Give me the Thermite and I'll destroy the weapons.
translation: 给我铝热剂，我要销毁那些武器。

original: Okay, here's the Thermite and a key to the room where the guns are stored. Place the Thermite on the crates in the room.
translation: 好的，这是铝热剂和储藏武器的房间的钥匙。记得把铝热剂放到屋内的板条箱上。

original: I rigged the light switch outside the room to kick off a spark big enough to hold the Thermite. That should turn that shit into molten slag.
translation: 我已经在屋外装了个电灯开关，碰出的火花应该可以引燃那些铝热剂。这样一来，那些武器很快就会熔成一堆废渣。

original: As soon as we're done talking I'm going to make myself like a ghost. I don't want to be anywhere near here when the bosses find out.
translation: 等咱们说完话，我也该出去避避风头了。我可不想出了事以后还在这儿坐以待毙。

original: Where do the guns come from?
translation: 枪支是从哪来的？

original: I've made lots of contacts over the years. I have some friends back in California that can get their hands on just about anything.
translation: 这些年我积攒了不少人脉。我在加州认识几个老朋友，他们可以帮我搞到货。

original: Mostly I've been calling in every last favor I have.
translation: 基本上，我是把所有人情都用尽了。

original: That's it for now.
translation: 先这样吧。

original: Okay, cool.
translation: 好的，没事。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Alright, let's.
translation: 好的，说吧。

original: I have a couple more questions about the guns.
translation: 关于枪支我还有几个问题要问。

original: Okay, try and be fast about it.
translation: 好的，问吧，不过快点。

original: What can we do to take care of the guns?
translation: 我们该怎么处理那些军火？

original: As a little pet project I've been making some thermite. Thermite burns as hot as the devil's asshole and can melt through just about anything.
translation: 我早就想出了个小小的计划，为此我一直在制作铝热剂。铝热剂燃烧时的热量堪比魔鬼的屁眼，几乎能烧穿所有东西。

original: I've been keeping it so if the Family betrays me I can hopefully do some damage before I end up dead or in jail.
translation: 这玩意我始终都备着，如果有一天家族背叛我，那我至少还能在完蛋以前搞点破坏。

original: Okay, I know the stuff inside and out. What do you want to know?
translation: 好的。我对那东西非常了解，你想知道什么？

original: I have some more questions about the Thermite.
translation: 我对铝热剂有几个问题。

original: How do you get the guns into the strip?
translation: 你是如何把枪支弄进长街的？

original: I'm pretty proud of myself. It's a stroke of genius, if I can be so modest.
translation: 这我可得好好吹嘘一番。哪怕谦虚点说，这也绝对是个天才之举。

original: The whole arrangement starts with an old buddy of mine in the Republic. He's responsible for packing and shipping supplies to the NCR on the Strip.
translation: 我在共和国有个老朋友，全是他安排的。他负责向驻扎在长街的NCR军队装运各类物资。

original: He marks some containers as food and medical and packs them with guns and other shit.
translation: 每次运货，他都会留下几个箱子，写上药品与食物，再往里头塞进枪支和其他玩意。

original: From there it just took a couple greased palms to get someone to let me cherry pick a container or two out of every shipment. Easy as pie.
translation: 然后，只要多使几个钱，我就可以让人从每批货物当中挑出那一两个箱子。简直小菜一碟。

original: I found proof of your blackmail.
translation: 我发现了你被敲诈勒索的证据。

original: Well that motherfucker. What the hell. Damn, thanks for finding this.
translation: 那个王八蛋。真够操蛋的。该死，感谢你查出来了。

original: This should be plenty of proof to cover my ass if they try to rat me out to any authorities.
translation: 如果他们有天想把我扫地出门，那我至少也能有条后路了。

original: What would you like to know?
translation: 你想要知道什么？

original: And this is where I come in.
translation: 所以你们才找着我了。

original: Right. We just want to find out what sort of technology Mr. House has used to stay alive for all these years.
translation: 是的。我们只想知道豪斯先生究竟是用了什么科技才让活了这么久。

original: It could be of great benefit to the people we try to help, many of whom suffer from hard to diagnose illnesses.
translation: 这对那些我们要拯救的人十分有用，许多人都是因为无法诊断出病症，才一直在忍受疾病的痛苦。

original: Yes.
translation: 是的。

original: Oh. Great! The Followers of the Apocalypse, well some of us, anyway, have been interested in Mr. House's technology, how he stays alive.
translation: 哦，太好了！天启追随者，应该说是我们当中的有些人，对豪斯先生的技术十分感兴趣，尤其是他延长寿命的方法。

original: Of course, no one is allowed inside the Lucky 38, so no one knows what's going on. Well, except for you.
translation: 当然，没有人能进入幸运38，所以也就没有人知道里面究竟怎么回事。呃，除你以外。

original: Why do you want to know?
translation: 你知道这个做什么？

original: Oh! Well, I heard... I mean, we heard... we meaning the Followers of the Apocalypse... that you had been in there. The Lucky 38, I mean.
translation: 哦！我听说……我是说，我们听说……我们是指天启追随者……你去过那里。我是说，幸运38。

original: And we were wondering if you could help us. If it's not too much trouble, of course.
translation: 而且我们觉得，也许你能帮助我们。当然，只要不麻烦你。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: I'm Jane, one of Mr. House's girls. We keep him... entertained. We don't get many guests lately; perhaps we can entertain you as well.
translation: 我叫简，是豪斯先生的女郎。我们为他提供……娱乐。来我们这里的客人并不多；或许我们也能招待一下您。

original: Down there is the game room! Each side of the vault had one... but the other is filled with concrete now. Okay, that wraps it up. I'll see you soon!
translation: 沿这往下走是游艺室！两边各有一个……但是另一个已经被堵死了。好吧，游览结束。待会见！

original: This hall leads to our guest rooms. You can use the first room on our left. But no snooping next door! That's my room, always was.
translation: 这个走廊里都是我们的客房，你可以使用左手第一间房。但不准偷窥隔壁的房间！那是我的房间，一直都是。

original: We used to have such parties in this diner! A bitch to clean later... but well worth it!
translation: 我们经常在这个餐厅举行宴会！虽然之后的打扫总是特别麻烦……但都值得！

original: Chosen representatives gambled against each other here. The winner earned the right to settle the dispute as wished by the collective.
translation: 各方派出代表在这里用赌博决一胜负。胜利者将有权用自己的方法解决争端。

original: This is the main game-hall. Here we settled the big disputes among the vault's levels.
translation: 这是游艺大厅。只要是避难所里遇到的争议，我们都会带到这里来解决。

original: Don't get lost! My vault has many corridors and rooms - although it is no longer symmetrical, after Mr. House threw us out.
translation: 别迷路了！我的避难所有很多走廊和房间——尽管在豪斯先生把我们赶出来后，这里的建筑结构就已经不再是对称的了。

original: Above us there's the control center for this level of the vault's life-support systems, electric grid, radioactive shields and all that jazz.
translation: 在我们头顶上的是这一级避难所的控制中心，包含了生命维持系统、电力网络、防辐射系统和其他必要的设施。

original: This bunker protects the entrance to the vault - solid stone outside and thick steel on the inside!
translation: 这个掩体守卫着避难所的入口——外面是坚硬的石头，内部是厚实的钢铁！

original: All right! Please, follow me. We'll head into the vault right away.
translation: 好，跟着我，我们现在要进入避难所了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, you've done some good work for us. I'll do this as a favor for you.
translation: [成功] 好的，你帮了我们不少忙，我就当还你一个人情了。

original: You should buy guns from Mick and Ralph, people are starting to ask questions.
translation: 你应该从米克和拉尔夫那里买枪，人们已经开始怀疑了。

original: [FAILED] Yeah, I'm sure they enjoy the cash flow, but that doesn't mean dick to me.
translation: [失败] 是啊，我知道他们想发财，可那和我有鸟关系。

original: Mick and Ralph would...Um... Enjoy selling the Omertas guns.
translation: 米克和拉尔夫会……嗯……很乐意卖枪给黑手党的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] We don't want to draw attention to ourselves. Alright, we'll give them a little bit of extra business.
translation: [成功] 我们也不想引人注目。好吧，就给他们点生意做好了。

original: You should buy guns from Mick and Ralph, people are starting to ask questions.
translation: 你应该从米克和拉尔夫那里买枪，人们已经开始怀疑了。

original: [FAILED] They're small timers, I could give a fuck what they would enjoy.
translation: [失败] 他们就是一帮小杂碎，是不是非要我上门教训他们一顿才开心？

original: Mick and Ralph would...Um... Enjoy selling the Omertas guns.
translation: 米克和拉尔夫会……嗯……很乐意卖枪给黑手党的。

original: Sorry, but I don't know you from Adam, and you don't have any business getting in our business.
translation: 抱歉，我们以前没见过面，而且你和我们也没有生意往来。

original: Mick and Ralph are curious why you stopped buying guns from them.
translation: 米克和拉尔夫很奇怪你为什么不再到他们那儿买枪了。

original: He seems pretty tired.
translation: 他看起来很辛苦。

original: I bet he does. That's from hookers and chems. His work for us is the most restful part of his day.
translation: 我看也是。他成天泡在妓女和毒品里。工作时间算是他一天里最清闲的时段了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Yeah, I see where you're coming from. Okay, tell Troike he can hit the road.
translation: [成功] 是啊，我明白你的意思。好的，告诉卓伊克他可以上路了。

original: Troike is pretty strung out. He'll be more trouble than he is worth.
translation: 卓伊克的毒瘾已经没救了。就算他有用，他以后惹的麻烦也只会更多。

original: [FAILED] Nah, I don't think so. We've still got some work for him to do.
translation: [失败] 不，我可不这么想。我们还有工作要他做。

original: Well I'm sure he's be a very productive worker, he could use some vacation time.
translation: 我觉得他是个很能干的人，你也该让他休几天假嘛。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Really? That was his idea? Alright, he can go. Hopefully he finds us some good deals out there.
translation: [成功] 真的？那是他的主意？好的，他可以去。希望他能给我们找到一些好买卖。

original: <Lie>Troike wants to see about negotiation some lower prices for weapons for you guys.
translation: <撒谎> 卓伊克想帮你的手下们弄批便宜点的军火。

original: [FAILED] You're really funny. I like you. But no. We still have business for Troike.
translation: [失败] 你真有趣，我喜欢你。不过不行。我们还有事要卓伊克做。

original: Um... I'm sure you have enough guns.
translation: 嗯……我觉得你们手上的军火已经够多了。

original: Big Sal agreed to let you go.
translation: 大萨尔答应让你离开了。

original: Holy shit, really? Okay, I'll help you, but I'm getting the hell out of here first chance I get.
translation: 妈呀，真的？好，我帮你，不过有机会我一定会离开这鬼地方的。

original: Why do they need to die?
translation: 为什么他们得死？

original: As long as they're alive, they can start up their plans again. All you've managed to do is stall them. I guarantee you they have contingencies.
translation: 只要他们还活着，迟早能东山再起，你只是稍微绊了他们一脚罢了。我敢跟你打包票，他们肯定还留了后手。

original: What's the next step in breaking up the bosses plans?
translation: 要破坏老板们的计划，下一步该做什么？

original: Now we cut off the head of the serpent. Big Sal and Nero have to die.
translation: 现在我们该砍掉毒蛇的脑袋了。大萨尔和尼禄必须得死。

original: What's the next step in breaking up the bosses plans?
translation: 要破坏老板们的计划，下一步该做什么？

original: You better get outside for a little bit. I'm sure they are going to look for the infamous courier when things go to hell.
translation: 你最好出去避一下风头。要是生意黄了，他们肯定会找那个坏事的邮差算账的。

original: Troike is on his way to destroy the guns for me.
translation: 卓伊克已经动身去为我销毁那些枪械了。

original: Yeah, poor fucker got himself caught after he melted all the guns. Bastard mentioned your name before they shot him in the head.
translation: 没错，刚销毁完所有枪支，这可怜的杂种就被抓了。在脑袋开花之前，这杂种供出了你的名字。

original: Now the bosses want to see you.
translation: 于是老板们现在要见你了。

original: Troike destroyed the guns for me.
translation: 卓伊克已经为我把那些枪械销毁了。

original: Whoa{surprised}, you managed to pull that off? Solid work. That ought to gum up the bosses' plans.
translation: 哇{surprised}，你全搞定了？干得不错啊，这应该可以把老板们的计划搅黄了。

original: I destroyed all the guns.
translation: 我把那些枪械全销毁了。

original: Well, what the fuck are you talking to me for? Go destroy the damn guns so we can move on.
translation: 操，那你现在还来跟我扯什么蛋？快去销毁那些该死的枪，这样我们才能继续下一步。

original: Troike gave me some Thermite to destroy the guns.
translation: 卓伊克给了我一些铝热剂来那些销毁枪械。

original: Yeah, we saw the troopers come through. I can't imagine things are going to work out well for him.
translation: 是的，我们看见士兵们进去了。我猜他不会有什么好果子吃的。

original: Clanden has been arrested.
translation: 克兰顿被抓了。

original: Oh, is that right? Well I guess if he's gone, he's gone. I don't need to know anything more than that.
translation: 哦，真的吗？嗯，走就走吧。我也没有什么别的事情想要知道的。

original: Clanden is leaving Gomorrah and won't be back.
translation: 克兰顿离开了蛾摩拉，再也不会回来了。

original: Oh, is that right? Was that your handiwork? Well I can't say I'm sad to see him go, he gave me the fucking creeps.
translation: 哦，真的吗？是不是你亲手干的？好吧，他死了我也不会难过的，这家伙总他妈让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

original: Clanden is dead.
translation: 克兰顿死了。

original: Could you repair some things for me?
translation: 你能帮我修复一些物品吗？

original: Sure, let's see what you've got.
translation: 当然，来看看你有什么。

original: I'd like to talk about something else.
translation: 我想谈谈别的。

original: What do you want to talk about?
translation: 你想谈什么？

original: What can you tell me about your organization?
translation: 能跟我介绍一下你的组织吗？

original: My, such a popular question. I suppose it is only natural to see us and wonder what it is that makes us special.
translation: 噢，这问题常有人问。但也不奇怪，任何人只要一见到我们，都会好奇我们为何如此与众不同。

original: The White Glove Society has only just made itself known to the public, of course, but our pedigree was established over generations.
translation: 虽然白手套社团进入公众视野的时间并不长，但其实我们的血统早在几代人之前就已经形成了。

original: Were we always so refined? I'd be lying if I said yes. But I've always felt we were destined for a place atop modern society. And now, here we are.
translation: 我们向来都这么彬彬有礼吗？要说有，那肯定是骗人的。但我早就预感，总有一天，我们会在上流社会中占据一席之地。现在，预言成为了现实。

original: Not everyone can wear the finest clothes and eat the finest foods, obviously. That's just the reality we live in.
translation: 显然，并不是每个人都能过上锦衣玉食的生活。毕竟现实摆在那里。

original: But surely we can agree that the most tasteful, sophisticated people are the most deserving. That's what the White Glove Society is all about.
translation: 但我们都会觉得，品味和格调高的人本来就应当享受最上等的生活。这就是我们白手套社团成立的宗旨。

original: What happened to Boulder City?
translation: 巨石城发生了什么事？

original: Destroyed during the Battle of Hoover Dam a couple of years ago. The town was set up as a trap for Caesar's Legion.
translation: 这小地方在几年前的胡佛大坝战役中被夷为了平地。当时整个镇子都被改造成了用于引诱凯撒军团的陷阱。

original: The sharpshooters in the Rangers picked off the Legion's veterans from a distance, and the rest of the Legion just rushed on in. Then - boom!
translation: 游骑兵中的神枪手从远距离消灭了那些军团老兵，剩下的士兵沉不住气，就冲进了城里，紧接着——轰！

original: The President is coming to Hoover Dam?
translation: 总统要来胡佛大坝？

original: It's probably just a political thing - you know, give a few speeches, shake hands with the troops, boost morale.
translation: 估计也就为了政治作秀——你懂的，发表一下演说，和士兵握个手，鼓舞鼓舞士气。

original: Where can I find McCarran?
translation: 麦卡伦在什么地方？

original: Camp McCarran is the headquarters for the NCR military in this region. It occupies the old airport next to New Vegas.
translation: 麦卡伦营地是本地区NCR部队的大本营，它坐落在新维加斯附近的废旧机场内。

original: Is there anything you can tell me about the Great Khans?
translation: 能告诉我些有关大汗帮的消息么？

original: They're an outlaw group, primarily trafficking in drugs and other contraband. They usually stay out of NCR territory, though.
translation: 他们是一个非法组织，主要从事毒品与其他违禁物的走私。但他们通常都会远离NCR的领土。

original: What can you tell me about Hoover Dam?
translation: 你能和我说说胡佛大坝吗？

original: It's one of the biggest sources of electrical power in the region, so the NCR's fortified the place pretty heavily.
translation: 那是本地区规模最大的电力供应设施，所以那里NCR的防御工事非常严密。

original: When President Kimball shows up on his inspection tour, I'm sure he'll be confident that the Dam is safe and secure.
translation: 等金博尔总统来视察时，我相信他一定会对这座大坝的安保措施感到无比骄傲。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: Let me ask you about something else.
translation: 我想问点别的问题。

original: Go ahead.
translation: 继续。

original: Where did you say the investigator's room was, again?
translation: 你之前说那个侦探的房间在哪里来着？

original: If you head back to the hotel rooms, his will be one floor directly above you after you exit the lobby.
translation: 如果你回客房区找他的话，他的房间就在二楼，你出大厅后，往正上方走就是。

original: Get lost.
translation: 走开。

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, Julie... I've really screwed things up.
translation: [成功] 噢，朱莉……我真的把事情搞砸了。

original: I'll head over to the fort and get some rest. This has gone on too long.
translation: 我要回要塞去休息一下。我确实做得太过了。

original: Bill, Julie and the rest of your friends miss you. They need your help.
translation: 比尔，朱莉和其他朋友都很想念你。他们需要你的帮助。

original: [FAILED] Sissy?! Real men can hold their liquor, and I'm double-clutching mine!
translation: [失败] 娘们？真男人都能守住他们的酒，而我是个双响炮！

original: Harden the hell up, Bill. You're being a sissy!
translation: 见鬼去吧，比尔。你就是个娘们！

original: <Science>
translation: <科技>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Never thought about using that combination before. Should be able to get through this with that.
translation: [成功] 我从没想过还能这样混服。它应该可以让我捱过戒断反应。

original: A combination of Fixer, Psycho, and Buffout would do it in one shot.
translation: 将瘾头解，疯狂药，和壮大灵混在一起服用，就能立马见效。

original: [FAILED] No way, the withdrawal symptoms will kill me if I don't have Fixer to flush out the chems.
translation: [失败] 没门，如果不用瘾头解来清理身体里的毒素，戒断反应会杀了我的。

original: Fixer is for pansies!
translation: 娘们才用瘾头解！

original: <Science>
translation: <科技>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Man, you're one hell of an egghead. If you think it'll work, I'll give it a shot.
translation: [成功] 老兄，你可真是博学。如果你认为这办法有效，我就试一试。

original: Regulating decreasing doses of booze with a couple shots of Fixer should do it.
translation: 有节制地减低饮酒量，再加上几针瘾头解，应该就能脱瘾了。

original: [FAILED] Oh, I'll be vomiting plenty if you don't get me Fixer. You're worse than that damn dealer.
translation: [失败] 噢，你要再不给我瘾头解，我就要吐了。你比那些卖酒的还过分。

original: Just stick your fingers down your throat. That'll flush you real good.
translation: 把喉咙张开，将手指塞进去。吐出来就好了。

original: <Lie> Yes, everything's resolved - Hanlon and I found a Legion spy at Camp Golf.
translation: <撒谎>是的，全都解决了——汉隆和我在高尔夫营地抓住了一个军团间谍。

original: I knew it. I'm glad you and the Chief were able to put a stop to this.
translation: 我就知道。很高兴你和军士长阻止了事态进一步恶化。

original: Hanlon was the one sending out the false reports. He killed himself rather than turning himself in.
translation: 汉隆是散布失实报告的推手。他畏罪自杀了。

original: What? Chief Hanlon. The man's a war hero? Why would he...? That just doesn't make sense. This is awful...
translation: 什么？汉隆军士长？他不是战斗英雄吗？怎么会……？算了，说这些也没用。真是太糟了……

original: So I assume you know why we called you here?
translation: 你知道我们为什么把你叫来吗？

original: Is this you asking for a last request?
translation: 这就是你最后的要求？

original: Let's have some words. Take a seat on the couch so we can get to talking.
translation: 我们聊两句。在沙发上坐下，我们好好谈谈。

original: Please, have a seat. Let's have a bit of a pow-wow.
translation: 请坐。我们简单谈谈。

original: Hey, here is that gun I promised you. I suggest using it while they are talking, I'm pretty sure they're going to kill you after they've talked.
translation: 嘿，这是我答应给你的枪。我建议你趁他们说话的时候就马上动手。要是等他们说完，你就死定了。

original: Hey, I'll take care of them when you're ready, just say the word. I suggest doing it while they're talking to get the drop on them.
translation: 嘿，等你准备好了，我就解决他们，到时听你口令。我建议趁他们说话的时候就动手，先发制人。

original: I'm not ready to take out the bosses yet.
translation: 我还没准备好去收拾老板们。

original: Hurry and get ready. I'll give you a gun when you get to the room.
translation: 赶紧做好准备。你进房间时我会塞给你一把枪的。

original: Hurry and get ready. I'll be waiting for you there when you're ready.
translation: 赶紧做好准备。我会在那儿等着你，好了就赶紧过来。

original: Let's go take care of the bosses.
translation: 出发，去搞定老板吧。

original: Hurry and get ready. I'll give you a gun when you get to the room.
translation: 赶紧做好准备。你进房间时我会塞给你一把枪的。

original: Hurry and get ready. I'll be waiting for you there when you're ready.
translation: 赶紧做好准备。我会在那儿等着你，好了就过来。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, I'll take care of them. Just give me the word when to start shooting.
translation: [成功] 好吧，我来对付他们。当你准备动手的时候就告诉我。

original: They are going to expect something from me, you can do it and surprise them.
translation: 他们的注意力都会集中在我这儿。你开枪他们肯定反应不过来。

original: [FAILED] If you aren't a good shot then we're fucked anyways. No, I think you're going to have to do it.
translation: [失败] 你要是枪法也不好，那我们就他妈的完蛋了。没错，开枪这活必须由你来做。

original: I'm not a very good shot, you should kill them.
translation: 我枪法不怎么着，应该由你来动手。

original: What happens when the bosses are gone?
translation: 处理掉老板之后呢？

original: When they're gone I'm gonna run this joint. Don't worry, I'll take care of the place.
translation: 他们挂了，我就是这儿的头儿了。放心吧，这地方到时候由我来罩着。

original: How do we take care of the bosses?
translation: 我们该怎样对付老板们？

original: They're a little bit upset about what's been done to muck up their plans. They tasked me to find out who's responsible.
translation: 他们对计划受挫感到有些恼火，于是派我来查查到底是谁坏了他们的好事。

original: There isn't going to be another chance to get both of them together in the same room. I'll slip you a gun and we can take them out.
translation: 再也没有别的好机会能让他俩同处一室了。我到时候会偷偷塞把枪给你，咱们一起把他俩干掉。

original: I have some questions about the Bosses plans.
translation: 我对老板们的计划有些问题要问。

original: Alright, let's have them.
translation: 好的，说说看。

original: He's trying to escape!
translation: 他想逃跑！

original: You're not getting away!
translation: 你跑不掉的！

original: Cachino! Shoot now.
translation: 卡奇诺！开枪。

original: Cachino? What the fu...{fuck interrupted}
translation: 卡奇诺？他妈的……{fuck interrupted}

original: Time to die, Sal.
translation: 去死吧，萨尔。

original: Alright, let's dance.
translation: 好啊，来玩玩吧。

original: I hear you lost some guns.
translation: 我听说你损失了些军火。

original: Yeah, we lost some guns{in a mocking tone} you little weasel. However, we can get more guns. You slowed us down but you can't stop us.
translation: 是的，我们损失了些军火，{in a mocking tone}你这个小骗子。不过，我们有办法搞到更多的武器。虽然你碍了我们的事，但你阻止不了我们。

original: You're gonna die a failure.
translation: 你就以失败者的身份下地狱去吧。

original: No idea.
translation: 不知道。

original: Well you've been a real thorn in our side. We've got business plans. You set us back a little bit, I'll admit that.
translation: 你小子最近挺喜欢和我们作对的嘛。我们制订了生意计划。我得承认，你确实给我们制造了一些小麻烦。

original: However, we wanted you to know that nothing you did made a shit bit of difference, and you're going to die a failure.
translation: 不过，我们也想让你知道，你所做的一切完全都是徒劳，你就以一个失败者的身份下地狱去吧。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Sounds like a deal to me.
translation: [成功] 听起来还能接受。

original: How about 200 caps and I forget we ever met.
translation: 200瓶盖怎么样。我会当咱们从来没见过面。

original: [FAILED] Yeah, but come back when you have the money.
translation: [失败] 得了，你还是等有了钱再来吧。

original: How about 200 caps and I forget we ever met.
translation: 200瓶盖怎么样。我会当咱们从来没见过面。

original: [FAILED] I bet it does, but free ain't gonna work.
translation: [失败] 我也这么想，不过免费是不可能的。

original: Free sounds better to me.
translation: 我觉得免费更好。

original: Ok, 300 caps is a deal.
translation: 好的，300瓶盖成交。

original: Fine, here you go. If anyone asks you ain't never seen me before.
translation: 好啊，给你。如果有人问起，可别说看见过我。

original: Fine, here you go. If anyone asks you ain't never seen me before.
translation: 好啊，给你。如果有人问起，可别说看见过我。

original: Thanks, but I'll find another way.
translation: 谢了，我另想办法吧。

original: No skin off my back.
translation: 无所谓。

original: I need a key to Cachino's room. Do you have one that will work?
translation: 我需要卡奇诺的门钥匙，你有吗？

original: Yeah, Cachino is a creep. I'll give you a key for some caps... Hazard pay.
translation: 有的，卡奇诺是个混蛋。我会给你钥匙的，不过你得付点……风险保证金。

original: Yeah, Cachino is a creep. I'll give you a key for some caps... Hazard pay.
translation: 有的，卡奇诺是个混蛋。我会给你钥匙的，不过你得付点……风险保证金。

original: I need more film for the camera
translation: 我需要更多的胶卷。

original: Here.
translation: 给。

original: Okay. You got it.
translation: 好的。没问题。

original: I'll also bring you Boomer suits. You can fix them and sell them.
translation: 我会把大炮族的服装也带给你。你可以改了它们再拿去卖。

original: [FAILED] Do I look like a seamstress to you? Those boomsters can stay in their nowhereville until the sun runs out of gas, for all I care. No deal.
translation: [失败] 你看我像是个裁缝吗？除非太阳从西边出来了，不然就让那些大炮族服装烂在那儿吧。你别想了。

original: Shame that you can't fix Boomer suits. They're very similar to vault suits.
translation: 真可惜，你不懂得改那些大炮族的服装。它们其实和避难所服装非常相似。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, who says I can't fix that? You bring me those boom-suits too, okay?
translation: [成功] 嘿，谁说我不会改的？把那些大炮族服装拿给我，好吗？

original: I'll also bring you Boomer suits. You can fix them and sell them.
translation: 我会把大炮族的服装也带给你。你可以改了它们再拿去卖。

original: [FAILED] Do I look like a seamstress to you? Those boomsters can stay in their nowhereville until the sun runs out of gas, for all I care. No deal.
translation: [失败] 你看我像是个裁缝吗？除非太阳从西边出来了，不然就让那些大炮族服装烂在那儿吧。你别想了。

original: Shame that you can't fix Boomer suits. They're very similar to vault suits.
translation: 真可惜，你不懂得改那些大炮族的服装。它们其实和避难所服装非常相似。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, who says I can't fix that? You bring me those boom-suits too, okay?
translation: [成功] 嘿，谁说我不会改的？把那些大炮族服装拿给我，好吗？

original: I'll also bring you Boomer suits. You can fix them and sell them.
translation: 我会把大炮族的服装也带给你。你可以改了它们再拿去卖。

original: [FAILED] Do I look like a seamstress to you? Those boomsters can stay in their nowhereville until the sun runs out of gas, for all I care. No deal.
translation: [失败] 你看我像是个裁缝吗？除非太阳从西边出来了，不然就让那些大炮族服装烂在那儿吧。你别想了。

original: Shame that you can't fix Boomer suits. They're very similar to vault suits.
translation: 真可惜，你不懂得改那些大炮族的服装。它们其实和避难所服装非常相似。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, who says I can't fix that? You bring me those boom-suits too, okay?
translation: [成功] 嘿，谁说我不会改的？把那些大炮族服装拿给我，好吗？

original: Answers first, then I decide.
translation: 先回答我的问题，然后我再考虑。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: What do you know about the White Glove Society?
translation: 你对白手套有什么了解？

original: Personally? They give me the heebie-jeebies. There's such a thing as being too polite, "if I may" this and "my pleasure" that.
translation: 个人看法？他们让我浑身发毛。他们那种过分拘泥的礼节让人总觉得不对头，整天"打搅"来"荣幸"去的。
