original: They already have that pig McCaffery working for them. Do they need another guard?
translation: 他们已经有麦卡弗里那头蠢猪了。还需要别的守卫？

original: Still trying to convince me, huh?
translation: 又想来说服我了？

original: If you're looking for work, Tommy Torini is hiring singers at the Tops.
translation: 想找活干的话，汤米·托里尼正在九重天招歌手。

original: Really? The Tops, huh? Well, it's no Shark Club, but I hear security on the Strip is real tight. Even Mr. Bishop wouldn't hit a joint like that.
translation: 真的？九重天？好吧，虽然那里比不上新里诺的鲨鱼俱乐部，但据我所知，长街戒备森严。就算是彼希先生也不会轻易在那里惹麻烦。

original: I'll check it out. Thanks!
translation: 我会去看看的，谢了！

original: I'll let you know if I find any work for a singer.
translation: 如果我找到适合歌手的工作，我会告诉你的。

original: You'd do that? Great! I really appreciate that!
translation: 真的吗？太好了！真是太感谢了！

original: That's a tough break. Good luck with that.
translation: 真是处境艰难啊。只能祝你好运了。

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: You really don't know when to quit, do you?
translation: 你就是禁不住要作死，对吧？

original: I guess I don't. That's why I'm here.
translation: 我想是的。这也是我流落到这儿的原因。

original: Wow. My hat is off to you, that takes some balls.
translation: 哇哦，向你致敬，你真是有种啊。

original: Thanks, but if Bishop finds me and I don't have his money, {emphasis}my balls are going to be on his trophy wall.
translation: 谢了，但如果我被彼希抓到了，又还不起他的钱，{emphasis}那我的蛋蛋恐怕就要被他挂在墙上了。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: And so because of that you ran all the way to Novac?
translation: 所以这就是你逃到诺瓦克的原因？

original: I figured it might take him a while to understand his accounting error and cool down a little.
translation: 我觉得要让他发现自己的账出了问题，并且冷静下来，可能还需要一段时间。

original: Also, I might have... umm... sort of... plowed his daughter. A little.
translation: 另外，我还和……该怎么说呢……和他女儿亲热了一下。就一下。

original: You robbed a casino boss?
translation: 你抢了一个赌场老板？

original: "Robbed" is such an ugly word. It's more like I took care of a payroll problem for him.
translation: 说"抢"也太难听了。应该说帮我他处理了一下财富再分配的问题。

original: Also, I might have... umm... sort of... plowed his daughter. A little.
translation: 此外，我还和……该怎么说……和他女儿亲热了一下。就一下。

original: Aren't you that singer from New Reno? I think I saw you play the clubs there.
translation: 你不是那个新里诺来的歌手吗？我记得好像在那儿的俱乐部里看过你表演。

original: Oh, so you have heard of me. Yeah, that's right. I was the big draw at the Shark Club, people used to pay hundreds of caps to see me.
translation: 哦，你听说过我啊。嗯，没错。我以前是鲨鱼俱乐部的招牌，有人愿意花几百瓶盖，就为了听我唱歌。

original: Can't say that I have.
translation: 也不能说我有。

original: <Lie> Yeah, I do, and it's time for you to suffer!
translation: <撒谎>啊，对，现在轮到你吃苦头了！

original: Please, no!
translation: 求你，别！

original: No, I don't. What makes you think that?
translation: 不，我不是。你为什么那么想？

original: Sorry, it's just... you look like his type, y'know? You got that hard-ass wasteland explorer thing going on.
translation: 抱歉，我只是……觉得你和他气质很像，你知道吗？你们身上都有一种废土探险家的刚毅。

original: If you're looking for work as a singer, Tommy Torini at the Tops is hiring.
translation: 如果你想当个歌手，汤米·托里尼正在九重天招人。

original: Why would this Mr. Bishop be after you?
translation: 这位彼希先生为什么在找你？

original: Oh, well, that's all just a big misunderstanding, see.
translation: 哦，好吧，我想那是个天大的误会。

original: Mr. Bishop, well, he owed me a lot of money, and, y'know, he's a busy guy, so I sort of figured I'd just...take it off his hands.
translation: 其实呢，这个，彼希先生欠了我一大笔钱，然后吧…你也知道他是个大忙人啦，所以我就，呃，自取了呗。

original: Why did you come all the way out here from New Reno?
translation: 为啥你要大老远从新里诺跑到这来？

original: You don't know Mr. Bishop. He's not like the other bosses up there. He knows the Wasteland like the back of his hand, and he likes to wander it.
translation: 你不知道，彼希先生跟那里的其他老大不一样。他对废土了如指掌，又爱没事瞎晃悠。

original: I knew if I didn't get way the hell away from New Reno, he'd run me down like a dog.
translation: 如果我不赶紧逃出那该死的新里诺，他就会像收拾野狗一样灭了我的。

original: Billy's worth three times what you're paying him.
translation: 比利的身价是你开给他工资的三倍。

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right, you drive a hard bargain, baby. Tell you what, I'll bump him up to 3,000. That's fair. Here's the difference for your cut.
translation: [成功] 好吧，你还真能讲价啊，宝贝。这样吧，我把他的价码提到3000。够公道了。这是你的提成。

original: [FAILED] Baby, you have got to be joking!
translation: [失败] 宝贝，你是在开玩笑吧！拿好你的提成，别再说疯话了。

original: I want to talk to you about how much you're paying Billy Knight.
translation: 我想和你谈谈比利·奈特的报酬。

original: That comedian you mean? Yeah, he practically begged me to hire him. Didn't even haggle.
translation: 你说那个喜剧演员？是啊，他根本就是在求我雇他。连价钱都不谈。

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Any day, baby, any day.
translation: 随时恭候，宝贝，随时恭候。

original: Hang on, this comes out to 1,500 caps for Billy! He's worth three times that!
translation: 等等，那样比利岂不是只值1500个瓶盖！他的身价可是这个数的三倍啊！

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right, you drive a hard bargain, baby. Tell you what, I'll bump him up to 3,000. That's fair. Here's your cut.
translation: [成功] 好吧，你还真能讲价啊，宝贝。这样吧，我把他的价码提到3000。够公道了。这是你的提成。

original: [FAILED] Baby, you have got to be joking! Now take your cut and stop being crazy.
translation: [失败] 宝贝，你是在开玩笑吧！拿好你的提成，别再说疯话了。

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Any day, baby, any day.
translation: 随时恭候，宝贝，随时恭候。

original: Hang on, this comes out to 1,500 caps for Billy! He's worth three times that!
translation: 等等，那样比利岂不是只值1500个瓶盖！他的身价可是这个数的三倍啊！

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right, you drive a hard bargain, baby. Tell you what, I'll bump him up to 3,000. That's fair. Here's your cut.
translation: [成功] 好吧，你还真能讲价啊，宝贝。这样吧，我把他的价码提到3000。够公道了。这是你的提成。

original: [FAILED] Baby, you have got to be joking! Now take your cut and stop being crazy.
translation: [失败] 宝贝，你是在开玩笑吧！拿好你的提成，别再说疯话了。

original: Tommy wants a profit, he won't pay you what you're worth unless you ask for it.
translation: 汤米毕竟也要赚钱，除非你主动开口，否则他不会按公道价给你钱的。

original: Look, just hang out here for a bit, I want to make sure you get a deal.
translation: 听着，你先在这儿等一下，我去问问那边到底同不同意。

original: Hey, okay, but don't take too long, I don't want to miss this!
translation: 嘿，好，不过别太久，我可不想错过！

original: That's your call. Here's his card.
translation: 你自己决定吧。这是他的名片。

original: Sure, here's his card.
translation: 当然，这是他的名片。

original: Sweet daisies, here I come!
translation: 甜蜜的小雏菊，我来了！

original: Don't sell yourself short. You're worth a lot more than that.
translation: 别把自己贱卖了。你不止值那点。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Whoa, geez, what was I thinking? You're right, I oughta go in there with a cool head, tell him how much I'm really worth.
translation: [成功] 哇，天，我在想些什么啊？你是对的，我应该一本正经地走进去，告诉他我有多值钱。

original: [FAILED] Look, I appreciate the vote of confidence, but you don't know what it's like.
translation: [失败] 听着，我很感谢你为我站台，但是你不了解情况。

original: They offer me a roof over my head and half a Fancy Lad and I'll fold like a classy napkin.
translation: 只要他们能给我个栖身的地方，再加上半盒奇想小子，我就千恩万谢了。

original: No, you've got to start high! Ask for a million and go from there!
translation: 不，你得有高起点才行！提到一百万就是高起点！

original: With jokes like that, no wonder you're working the street.
translation: 就你这水平的笑话，难怪你会流落街头。

original: Hey, now, come on! I prefer the term "outdoor entertainment bonanza." Besides, have you seen the caps whores make in this town? I should be so lucky!
translation: 嘿，拜托！我更喜欢"户外娱乐摇钱树"这个词儿。对了，你知道这里的妓女能赚多少吗？我也该那么幸运才对！

original: So you're looking for your big break?
translation: 所以你想在事业上有所突破？

original: A break's better than a shot - less chance of lead poisoning. Hey, if you know any gigs hiring, I'll work cheap. Real cheap. I'll take peanuts!
translation: 有事做总比吃枪子强——起码铅中毒的概率要小一些。嘿，如果你知道还有什么地方要人，我不在意报酬低。真的不在意。给我花生米都行！

original: It's very impressive.
translation: 令人佩服。

original: Woof! If you're not the most sarcastic fella I ever met, your standards are so low they could use you at the Annual Gomorrah Saucy Limbo Competition.
translation: 哇！你的讽刺功力堪称是我认识的伙计里最厉害的了，那就凭你这水平，完全可以去参加蛾摩拉年度废话大赛。

original: As the bar!
translation: 干杯！

original: Woof! If you're not the most sarcastic dame I ever met, your standards are so low they could use you at the Annual Gomorrah Saucy Limbo Competition.
translation: 哇！你的讽刺功力堪称是我认识的姑娘里最厉害的了，那就凭你这水平，完全可以去参加蛾摩拉年度废话大赛。

original: As the bar!
translation: 干杯！

original: But we're standing on a street corner in the middle of nowhere.
translation: 你是说躲在一个谁也不会光顾的街角里吗？

original: That's exactly my point, kid. Exactly my point.
translation: 那正是我要说的，孩子。正是我要说的。

original: Tommy Torini at the Tops is hiring entertainers. I could put in a word for you.
translation: 九重天的汤米·托里尼在招募艺人，我可以帮你说几句好话。

original: Yeah? Hey, you're all right! Tell him I'll do it for a hundred a night! No! Fifty! No, twenty! Ten!
translation: 真的？嘿，太好了！告诉他每晚只要一百块我就干！不！五十！不，二十！十块！

original: Just don't rob me, and I'll do it!
translation: 只要不让我倒贴钱就行！

original: Hey, I'm just happy to get any kind of work I can.
translation: 嘿，只要能让我干，怎样都行。

original: Have you reconsidered asking for a better price from Tommy?
translation: 你有没有考虑过再跟汤米讲讲价？

original: How long have you been doing comedy?
translation: 你演喜剧有多久了？

original: If you believe my mother, since she first laid eyes on me. First thing she said was "Boy! That's a funny-looking kid!"
translation: 你知道我老妈第一眼看到我时说的是什么话吗？她说："哎哟！这孩子长得真逗！"

original: I guess I got a face only a mother could love, because nobody else would give me the time of day.
translation: 我想我这模样，也只有妈妈会爱我了，因为别人都不肯和我待在一起。

original: Maybe you can help me, see, I can never tell when it's lunchtime.
translation: 也许你能帮我，你看，我都上顿不接下顿了。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: The name's Knight. Billy Knight. And this here is what a lifelong career in comedy will get you.
translation: 我叫奈特，比利·奈特。我毕生倾心喜剧事业，可你瞧瞧我最后努力的结果。

original: I just have a few questions.
translation: 我有几个问题。

original: All right, but make it snappy, this isn't exactly a lucrative career enterprise here.
translation: 可以，不过尽量简短一点，我这份差事可不怎么赚钱。

original: Sorry, I didn't mean to interrupt.
translation: 抱歉，我不是有意打岔。

original: Jeez, some people....
translation: 真是的，现在的人啊……

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Later.
translation: 回见。

original: What are you doing out here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

original: Keeping watch on the Great Khans mostly. They usually stick around Red Rock Canyon, but at least one large group left recently.
translation: 主要是监视大汗帮。他们通常在红岩峡谷一带活动，但最近已经有大批人员动身离开。

original: We called it in, but haven't heard anything about any Great Khan incidents. Whatever they're doing, they're keeping a low profile.
translation: 我们已经向上级作了汇报i，不过还没发现大汗帮有什么动作。他们一直非常低调。

original: Tommy Torini is hiring new acts at the Tops. I think you could make good money.
translation: 汤米·托里尼正在为九重天招募新演员，我觉得你去的话多半有戏。

original: Too bad I got this ironclad contract with the Garrets. They'll never let me out of it.
translation: 可惜我被加勒特的这个合同拴死了。他们肯定不会放我走的。

original: Like I told you, I can't go anywhere without getting out of my contract with Garret first. Talk to him, maybe he'll cut me loose if you ask nice.
translation: 我和你说过，除非我能和加勒特解除合同，否则我哪儿也去不成。和他谈谈吧，没准你美言几句，他就答应放我走了呢。

original: Are you sure you wouldn't rather go work at the Tops?
translation: 你确定你不去九重天工作？

original: Really? You mean I'm finally out of this shithole? That's great! Thank you!
translation: 真的？你是说我终于可以离开这个大粪坑了？太好了！谢谢你！

original: Garrett's agreed to let you out of your contract. You can go work at the Tops.
translation: 加勒特已经同意解除你的合同了。你随时可以去九重天上班。

original: Sure, why not? Nothing left for me here since Garret's dead.
translation: 当然，为什么不呢？加勒特都死了，我还留在这干什么？

original: So you perform stand-up comedy, huh?
translation: 所以你是个说单口相声的，对吧？

original: Eesh, is my act that bad, or are you just that dumb? Yeah, that's right - got me a nice, juicy contract with the management.
translation: 噫，是我的表演不够好，还是你脑子缺根筋？是啊，没错——这儿的老板和我签了一份油水丰厚的合同！

original: So who are you, exactly?
translation: 那你到底是谁？

original: Either you need to get your eyes checked or that "fame is fleeting" thing is true - and since I happen to be world famous, you must be going blind.
translation: 要么是你眼神不好，要么就像常言说的，"名气如流水"———不过恰好我可是名满天下，所以你肯定是瞎了。

original: Name's Hadrian. Bet you never saw a ghoul in a suit before, huh? Course, you don't exactly strike me as the worldly type.
translation: 我叫哈德良。我打赌你从没见过穿西装的尸鬼吧？当然，我看你也不像是个等闲之辈。

original: He's agreed to let you out of your contract. You can go work at the Tops now.
translation: 他同意你解除合同了。你现在可以去九重天工作了。

original: Not yet. I'm still working on it.
translation: 还没有。我还在想办法呢。

original: I'm not suirprised, he's a stubborn, greedy bastard.
translation: 我一点也不奇怪，他就是个贪婪的固执杂种。

original: I can't think of a more pathetic career choice.
translation: 我想不出比这更烂的职业选择了。

original: Thanks, but that's not why I'm here.
translation: 谢谢，但我可不是为了这个来的。

original: No, but if there's money in it, I could be.
translation: 不，但是有报酬的话我可以试试。

original: Yeah, no, we were hoping to find someone who was actually... what's the word... funny? What do you want, kid?
translation: 哈，不，我们是想找一个真正会……怎么说呢……会搞笑的人？你有什么事，孩子？

original: Afraid not.
translation: 恐怕不是。

original: So, what do you want, then?
translation: 那你有什么事吗？

original: That's what your mom said last night. Aw yeah. I went there.
translation: 你妈昨天晚上也是这么说的。咿呀，我昨晚去找她了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, not bad! Your timing's terrible and you got no style, but you might make it as a professional heckler.
translation: [成功] 嘿，这句还不赖！虽然你在时机和个人风度上差了点，不过你还挺像是个专业捧哏。

original: Why bother? You're embarassing yourself enough as it is.
translation: 何必呢？你自己就够丢脸的了。

original: [FAILED] That doesn't even make any sense! You're not the heckler Garret hired to spice up the show, are you?
translation: [失败] 都什么东西！就你这样加勒特还雇你来给我当捧哏？你不是他雇的吧？

original: I have no idea what you're talking about.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么。

original: Whoa, why the hostility?
translation: 哇，干嘛一上来就埋汰人？

original: Come on, stay in character! You're supposed to be heckling me!
translation: 拜托，你得入戏！你应该和我唱反调才对！

original: Watch your mouth, ghoul, or I might just rip your jaw off.
translation: 嘴巴干净点，尸鬼，否则我撕烂你的嘴。

original: Whoa Nelly! There's insult comedy and then there's psycho comedy! I guess you aren't the heckler Garret hired to spice up my show. What do you want?
translation: 哇，老天！本来只是损人的节目，现在又变成发神经了！我猜你应该不是加勒特雇来加戏码的吧。你到底想干什么？

original: Excuse me?
translation: 抱歉？

original: What, you mean you're not part of the act? Heh. Sorry. Thought you were the heckler Garret hired to spice up the shows.
translation: 什么，你的意思是你没参与这次演出？呃，不好意思。我还以为你是加勒特雇来加戏码的。

original: Would you happen to know where I could find a sexbot?
translation: 你知不知道我在哪能找到性爱机器人？

original: Ha! Are you some kind of machine fetishist or something?
translation: 哈！难不成你的取向是机性恋吗？

original: The Garrets are looking to satisfy certain customers.
translation: 加勒特双胞胎想找一台机器人来满足某些客人的需要。

original: Heh. Well, the only place I know of locally would be Cerulean Robotics, but that place has been overrun by vermin for years.
translation: 呵。好吧，据我所知，本地只有蔚蓝机器人公司生产这种玩意，但那里早几年前就被害虫占领了。

original: If you want to check the place out, you can find it on the west side of Freeside. The entrance is on the back side of the building.
translation: 如果你对那个地方感兴趣，可以在自由城西面找到它。入口就在建筑物的后面。

original: Just watch out for thugs. The rats aren't the only vermin you need to worry about.
translation: 要当心暴徒。所谓害虫可不单单只有老鼠而已。

original: Thanks, I'll check it out.
translation: 多谢，我会去看看的。

original: Anything else I can help you with?
translation: 还有什么需要帮忙的吗？

original: Is there a holotape or anything I'll need for the sexbot?
translation: 你这儿有性爱机器人所需的全息磁带或者别的东西吗？

original: I don't know of any, but if you give me a few days and some caps, I think I could probably make one on my terminal.
translation: 我手头没有。但如果你能给我几天时间，外加一些瓶盖，我可以用我的终端帮你做一个。

original: Here are the caps. <pay 150 caps>
translation: 给你瓶盖。 <付150个瓶盖>

original: All right. Come back in a couple days and I should have it ready for you.
translation: 好吧。几天后再来，我会把成品给你准备好的。

original: Good to know. I might have you make one later if I can't get it myself.
translation: 很好。如果我自己搞不到，我可能会让你做一个。

original: Just stop back and see me if you need one made. Anything else I can help you with?
translation: 如果你需要的话，回来找我就行了。还有别的事吗？

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才>

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right. Come back in a couple days and I should have it ready for you.
translation: [成功] 好吧。几天后再来，我会把成品给你准备好的。

original: Ralph, I've been a loyal customer to you and Mick. How about 100 caps?
translation: 拉尔夫, 我是你和米克的忠实客户。100个瓶盖怎么样？

original: [FAILED] I don't think so. I've got a business to run here, buddy.
translation: [失败] 恐怕不行。我还得做生意呢，伙计。

original: Can't you just call it a favor?
translation: 你就不能帮我个忙？

original: <Barter>
translation: <交易>

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right. Come back in a couple days and I should have it ready for you.
translation: [成功] 好吧。几天后再来，我会把成品给你准备好的。

original: Data modules are rare but generally useless. How about 100 caps for your work?
translation: 数据模块很稀有，但一般也没什么大用。100个瓶盖怎么样？

original: [FAILED] That is just an insult to my expertise. My work is worth more than that.
translation: [失败] 你这是在羞辱我的技术。我的手艺可不止这个价。

original: 50 caps is my best offer.
translation: 我最多出50瓶盖。

original: <Speech High>
translation: <高级对话>

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right. Come back in a couple days and I should have it ready for you.
translation: [成功] 好吧。几天后再来，我就能帮你准备好。

original: Ralph, I've been directing a lot of business your direction. Call it a favor?
translation: 拉尔夫，我帮你介绍过不少生意。你就帮个忙呗？

original: Is the holotape ready yet?
translation: 全息磁带准备好了吗？

original: Not yet. Come back later and it should be ready to go.
translation: 还没。过一阵子再来吧，那时应该就好了。

original: Yep, here you go. You'll need to use a terminal to upload the data to the robot.
translation: 好了，给你。你需要用终端来把数据传送到机器人上。

original: I'm short on caps right now. Maybe later.
translation: 我现在没有瓶盖了。下次再说吧。

original: Just stop back and see me if you need one made. Anything else I can help you with?
translation: 如果你需要的话，回来找我就行了。还有别的事吗？

original: Is there a holotape or anything I'll need for the sexbot?
translation: 你这儿有性爱机器人所需的全息磁带或者别的东西吗？

original: I don't know of any, but if you give me a few days and some caps, I think I could probably make one on my terminal.
translation: 我手头没有。但如果你给我几天时间外加一些瓶盖，我可以用我的终端帮你做一个。

original: Piss off, kid. We've got no more business to conduct.
translation: 走开，小鬼。我们已经没有生意往来了。

original: A fight broke out when I presented Hsu's offer. The Kings are all dead.
translation: 我把许上校的提议告诉猫王，没想到突然起了冲突。猫王帮全死了。

original: That's terrible. I suppose the violence against our people will stop, though.
translation: 真是可怕。不过针对我们民众的暴力行为应该会停止了。

original: I'll have to spend much of the remaining funds for the operation on damage control, but I can spare this much as compensation for your efforts.
translation: 恐怕我得把更多的经费用于进行善后工作了，不过我还是留了一些钱给你，就当是辛苦费吧。

original: The King accepted Colonel Hsu's offer of help.
translation: 猫王接受了许上校的提议。

original: Good, good. Hsu's a man you can count on to handle a crisis. I'm just glad that things didn't end in violence.
translation: 不错，不错。许在处理危机这件事上确实很有手腕。我很高兴最后这件事没有诉诸暴力。

original: Here, this is what remains of the funds initially allocated for this operation.
translation: 拿去吧，这些是实行这项计划的工作经费里剩余的资金。

original: Also, I've been directed to send you on to Colonel Moore at Hoover Dam. She's been following my reports on your exploits with some interest.
translation: 还有，我接到命令，得派你去胡佛水坝见莫尔上校。她对我提交的报告中你的出色表现十分感兴趣。

original: As I don't have any further assignments for you, I'd recommend going to see her if you need more work.
translation: 我也没有进一步的任务要给你了，如果你需要更多工作的话，我建议你去见她。

original: The Kings were all killed after the King turned down the ultimatum.
translation: 在猫王拒绝最后通牒后，猫王帮的成员们都被杀了。

original: I was afraid this would happen. Freeside will be a little more dangerous for a while, but eventually things will die down.
translation: 我早就担心会变成这样。估计短时间内自由城的局势会变得很不稳定，不过事态最终会平息的。

original: I expect few people will purposely target NCR citizens for some time to come, which is a relief.
translation: 我想今后一段时间里也不会有人再敢袭击NCR公民了，算是不幸中的万幸了吧。

original: However, the NCR's reputation has taken a huge blow because of this. People are beginning to see not much difference between us and the Legion.
translation: 然而NCR的声誉将因此而遭到极大的损害。人们会开始觉得，我们和军团没什么两样。

original: I've been authorized to give you this for your efforts. It's not much, but most of the funds for this operation are now going toward damage control.
translation: 我代表官方将这些赠送给你，作为你的报酬。数量不多，毕竟大部分资金恐怕都要被用于善后工作了。

original: The King complied with Colonel Moore's ultimatum.
translation: 猫王接受了莫尔上校的最后通牒。

original: How unexpected! I was sure a direct confrontation would lead to more fighting, but I'm delighted to be proven wrong.
translation: 不敢相信！我本来以为正面对峙只会引发更加严重的冲突，没想到我居然错了，但我很高兴。

original: I wouldn't be surprised if you had something to do with the situation not flaring up, either. Here, I'm sure you deserve every one of these caps.
translation: 如果这次事态的平息有你的一份功劳，我也完全不会感到惊讶。拿去吧，这些钱你受之无愧。

original: Also, Colonel Moore has requested your presence at Hoover Dam again. No doubt she has further work for an individual with your skillset.
translation: 另外，莫尔上校要你再去一趟胡佛水坝。毫无疑问，她还有别的工作要交给你这样的人才。

original: I'm afraid I don't have any further assignments that would suit you, so you should probably go see her at your earliest convenience.
translation: 恐怕我这儿已经没有适合你的任务了，所以你还是尽快赶到她那儿去吧。

original: But you've got another idea. Spit it out.
translation: 我觉得你另有想法。但说无妨。

original: Is it that obvious? You must understand that while Colonel Moore's job is to get things done, my job is to represent the NCR's best interests.
translation: 我表现得那么明显吗？你必须明白，莫尔上校的目的只是解决手头的问题，而我的工作是在最大限度地维护NCR的利益。

original: I guess I'll head over to Colonel Moore, then.
translation: 那么，我觉得我应该去见莫尔上校了。

original: Wait a moment, if you would. While sending you to Colonel Moore is what I'm officially supposed to do, I'd like to propose an alternative.
translation: 先等一下，我还有句话要说。虽然我接到的官方命令是派你去见莫尔上校，但我有另外一个建议。

original: So what do you suggest?
translation: 所以你的建议是？

original: I'd suggest you speak to Colonel Hsu over at Camp McCarran. He's much more level-headed about this sort of thing.
translation: 我建议你去麦卡伦营地和许上校谈谈。他处理这种事情可要稳健得多了。

original: He's also in a better position to bargain with the people of Freeside, seeing as how he's in charge of water and power distribution in the area.
translation: 而且说到和自由城的人讨价还价，他也有很充分的优势，毕竟他掌管着这个地区的水电供应。

original: Still, I'm only mentioning it as an option. My official orders are to direct you to Colonel Moore. Godspeed.
translation: 当然，这只是我个人的意见罢了。从官方的角度来讲，我的命令是让你去找莫尔上校。祝你好运。

original: Sending NCR soldiers into Freeside would be a bad idea.
translation: 派NCR的军队去自由城不是个好主意。

original: I completely agree. Even if a riot didn't immediately break out, a line will have been crossed, and we'll have made that many more enemies.
translation: 完全赞同。就算这样做不会马上引起暴动，也是越过了底线，会给我们自己制造更多的敌人。

original: That'll show the people in Freeside who's in charge!
translation: 那才能让自由城人明白谁才是老大！

original: More like instigate a mass riot. People there already think the NCR is trying to take this place over. We'd only be confirming their fears.
translation: 我看更可能会激起一场暴动。那儿的人已经在怀疑NCR企图夺取他们的地盘了。这么做无疑只会证明他们的担忧。

original: Sounds like you and the Colonel don't get along.
translation: 好像你和上校处不来啊。

original: Oh, I like the Colonel just fine. She's a good soldier, one of the best. I just don't think her general approach to things is a good fit here.
translation: 哦，我对上校没意见。她是个优秀的军人，百里挑一。我只是觉得她处理事情的方法并不适合这里。

original: See, the Colonel likes to solve things neatly, quickly, and efficiently, through a show of force if possible, and through actual force if necessary.
translation: 你看，上校做事喜欢干净利落。只要允许，她就会派部队进行威慑；如果有必要，她甚至直接会动用武力。

original: That won't work here. Unless she plans on killing half the population of Freeside, sending soldiers to the area will only make things worse.
translation: 这招在这二可行不通。派军队过去只会让事情更糟，除非她想杀掉自由城一半的人。

original: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我仍然在忙这件事。

original: I understand. Sometimes these things take time.
translation: 我理解，慢工出细活。

original: Remember, do what you can to gain the man's trust. Then you'll have your chance.
translation: 记住，你要竭尽所能争取那个人的信任，然后你就能找到机会。

original: The King won't deal with the NCR.
translation: 猫王不买NCR的帐。

original: That's most unfortunate. In this circumstance I've been instructed to send you along to Colonel Moore over at Hoover Dam for further orders.
translation: 真是不幸。这样的话，我只能按照命令派你去胡佛水坝会见莫尔上校，她会给你进一步指示的。

original: The Colonel will likely send you back to Freeside with a squad of armed men, for all the good that will do.
translation: 上校很可能会命你返回自由城，同行的还将有一队武装士兵，以应付一切可能发生的情况。

original: I spoke to the King, and he promised to stop the violence against NCR citizens.
translation: 我和猫王谈过了，他同意停止袭击NCR的公民。

original: That's great to hear. He's got a lot of sway in Freeside, so we can expect a dramatic drop in violence soon.
translation: 太好了。他在自由城一言九鼎，我们可以预想，不久后暴乱就会戏剧般地减少。

original: Now, you're probably wondering about your reward. This has been something of a hot button topic, so I was able to secure this for you.
translation: 现在，你可能想知道能拿多少报酬。你的任务可是时下的烫手山药，所以我为你搞到了这么多。

original: Keep me in mind for any future assignments.
translation: 以后有什么任务的话，请告诉我。

original: I would, but I'm afraid the rest of the work in my queue pertains to matters I'll have to deal with personally. You do have another option, however.
translation: 我会的，但是恐怕接下来的那些工作都需要我亲自去完成。不过，你确有别的选择。

original: Glad to be of service.
translation: 很高兴为你服务。

original: I've received a message from Colonel Moore up at Hoover Dam. She's been following your exploits and has requested that you meet with her.
translation: 我收到胡佛水坝莫尔上校发来的消息。她对你的成就一直很关注，现在她要求你去见她。

original: You're not officially in the employ of the NCR, so there's nothing forcing you to go, but I'd go see her sooner rather than later.
translation: 你不是NCR的正式人员，所以我也并非强迫一定要去见她。但要是我的话，还是早去比晚去好。

original: The Colonel is not someone you want to keep waiting.
translation: 何况上校也不是一个有耐心的人。

original: I laced Pacer's Jet with Psycho and it didn't go well for him.
translation: 我在佩瑟的杰特里掺了点疯狂药，他没捱过去。

original: Good show. With the conditions there, no one will suspect anything other than bad drugs to be the culprit. You've done a great service for the NCR.
translation: 干得漂亮。如此一来，大家只会认为是劣质药物害了他。你为NCR做出了巨大的贡献。

original: Now, you're probably wondering about your reward. This has been something of a hot button topic, so I was able to secure this for you.
translation: 你估计想问报酬了吧。这个任务确实相当棘手，所以我为你争取到了这么一笔资金。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Well, I don't officially have access to any more funds, but here. This is from me personally. There's more coming your way, too.
translation: [成功] 我没有权力动用其他经费。这些你拿去，算是我个人的一点谢礼。接下来的任务还有更优厚的酬劳在等着你。

original: I risked my neck out there. Couldn't you spare a little more?
translation: 我可是拼了老命在干活啊，你就不能多给一点吗？

original: [FAILED] I'm sorry, but those are the only funds I was able to allocate. You'll have to make due with it. Besides, you may have other tasks soon.
translation: [失败] 抱歉，我有权动用的经费只有这么多，你凑合着用吧。而且你很快也会接到新任务的。

original: That's it?
translation: 就这些？

original: I used an energy weapon to kill Pacer, so the Van Graffs should take the blame.
translation: 我用能量武器杀了佩瑟，这样范格拉夫家族就得背黑锅了。

original: Killing two birds with one stone. Excellent. You've done a great service for the NCR.
translation: 一石二鸟，好极了。你为NCR做出了巨大的贡献。

original: Now, you're probably wondering about your reward. This has been something of a hot button topic, so I was able to secure this for you.
translation: 你估计想问报酬了吧。这个任务确实相当棘手，所以我为你争取到了这么一笔资金。

original: I discovered that Pacer is a Jet addict and has a heart condition.
translation: 佩瑟对杰特上瘾，而且他心脏不太好。

original: That could be useful, but I'm afraid I don't have the background to know how to take advantage of that knowledge.
translation: 这个情报可能会有用。但恐怕我没有足够的医学知识，不懂得这一点该如何利用。

original: As I told you before, that could be useful information, but I don't know how to take advantage of it.
translation: 我之前说过，这个情报可能会有用。但恐怕我没有足够的医学知识，不懂得这一点该如何利用。

original: I discovered that Pacer and the Van Graffs have a troubled history.
translation: 我听说佩瑟和范格拉夫家族有仇。

original: See, that's exactly the type of information we can use. In fact, that's perfect. Those fancy weapons the Van Graffs peddle aren't exactly common.
translation: 你看，这就是我们能够利用的情报。简直太完美了。范·格拉夫家族卖的那些漂亮武器可不是什么普通玩意。

original: It goes without saying that actually getting the Van Graffs to do the deed would be the ideal solution.
translation: 不用说了，现在这件事最理想的解决方式就是借范·格拉夫之手除掉佩瑟。

original: However, if Pacer were killed with either a laser or plasma-based weapon, everyone would automatically assume the Van Graffs did it.
translation: 当然，如果佩瑟是被激光或等离子武器干掉的，大家一般也会默认是范·格拉夫家族做的。

original: Still, unless you want several dozen armed men at your throat, you'd have to kill him without being seen. Be careful.
translation: 不过，你在杀他的时候最好别被看见，除非你想被数十个全副武装的人追杀。千万要小心。

original: I'll leave the method up to you. However, there is an alternative if you'd rather try to handle things without bloodshed.
translation: 选哪种手段就看你了。如果你不喜欢用流血的方式解决，我这儿也还有一个备选方案。

original: {Dumb option}Wow, you're really mad.
translation: {Dumb option}哇哦，你真的很生气耶。

original: You better believe I'm mad. You've waged a one man campaign to drag our good name through the mud and I'll be held accountable!
translation: 我当然要生气。你一个人把我们的好名声砸了个稀把烂，而我还要为此背黑锅！

original: You probably don't even know what I'm talking about. Gah! This is what I get for hiring an idiot to do such an important job.
translation: 估计你都不明白我在说什么。唉！都怪我雇了个傻子来做这么要紧的工作，真是报应。

original: Here, just take this and go. I have damage control to do.
translation: 给你，拿了钱就赶紧滚蛋。我还要处理善后呢。

original: Wait, I'm supposed to send you to Colonel Moore up at Hoover Dam, though why she wants to see an imbecile like you is beyond me.
translation: 等等，我得派你到胡佛水坝去见莫尔上校，虽然我不明白她为什么想见你这样一个智障。

original: So go to Hoover Dam and see Colonel Moore. Got it? Hoover Dam. Colonel Moore. {Sighs}Maybe it's time to retire.
translation: 你去胡佛水坝见莫尔上校吧。记住了吗？胡佛水坝。莫尔上校。唉，也许我真该退休了。

original: I'm sorry. I screwed up.
translation: 对不起，我搞砸了。

original: That's an understatement. Still, there's nothing to be done about it now. Maybe the violence may die down once things settle.
translation: 真是轻描淡写。泼出去的水已经收不回来了。或许等尘埃落定之后，暴乱就会平息了吧。

original: Here, take this. It's not what I was planning to give you, but you deserve some sort of payment for your efforts. Oh, and one other thing.
translation: 这些你拿去吧。我本来不打算给你的，但你好歹也该有点辛苦费。哦，还有件事情。

original: You wanted a man dead. He's dead. Now where are my caps?
translation: 你想让他死掉。他也的确死了。我的瓶盖呢？

original: If it will get you out of my hair, this is a small price to pay. At least I won't have to put up with you any longer.
translation: 只要你能从我眼前消失，花这一点钱也算值了。至少我不必再忍受你了。

original: I suppose not.
translation: 似乎不太合适。

original: At least you've got the sense to know you've screwed up. I'll probably be cleaning toilets by the end of the week. But you'll be busy, too.
translation: 至少你还懂得自己搞砸了。估计到了这周末，我就要被发配去扫厕所了。不过你也别想闲着。

original: When you put it that way... yes.
translation: 好吧，既然你非要这样说……是的。

original: Oh, I see. You're proud of your efforts, eh? Bah! Thankfully, it looks like we won't be working together any longer.
translation: 哦，我明白了。你是不是还觉得挺自豪的？呸！谢天谢地，我看咱们以后不会再继续合作了。

original: Let's start with my reward.
translation: 我们谈谈报酬吧。

original: Reward? You want a reward for setting our diplomatic efforts back a year?
translation: 报酬？你让我们的外交状况倒退回了一年前，你还想要报酬？

original: What's my other choice?
translation: 另一个方案是什么？

original: I'm not a violent man myself, so I had our guys come up with an alternate solution on the off chance that our agent-to-be shared my sentiments.
translation: 我自己并不是个崇尚暴力的人，所以我让我的人制定了一套备选方案，这样万一我找的代理人和我观念一致，我也有干货能拿得出手。

original: All right, I'll try to find a way.
translation: 好吧，我会想办法的。

original: I'm sure something will turn up. If you think you've found something but are unsure, report back and I'll let you know if it's something we can use.
translation: 我相信你一定会有所发现。如果你挖到了情报，却不知道有没有用，可以来找我，我帮你研判。

original: It may be tough to find a way to completely throw off suspicion, however.
translation: 不过，想要找到一个能完全洗刷嫌疑的办法，确实比较困难。

original: I'm not an assassin.
translation: 我不是刺客。

original: In that case, we can take a different tack, but one that I at least have more experience with - diplomacy.
translation: 这样的话，我们可以采用另一种策略，至少我在这方面还是比较有经验——那就是外交。

original: If we can't go after the man responsible, we'll simply appeal to the man above him.
translation: 如果我们无法追究凶手的责任，那么最简单的方法就是直接找他的上级。

original: The Kings, including our friend Pacer, report to the leader of their gang, a man who calls himself the King.
translation: 整个猫王帮，包括我们的老朋友佩瑟在内，都是由一个名叫猫王的男人领导的。

original: I was hoping you'd know.
translation: 我还以为你懂呢。

original: {Wild Wasteland!}Damn it, I'm an ambassador, not a doctor. You'll have to find some other way.
translation: {Wild Wasteland!}见鬼，我是大使，又不是医生。你最好想想其他的办法。

original: I'm afraid I can't be much help in this matter. My specialty is people and politics, not medicine.
translation: 恐怕这事我帮不上忙。我的研究领域是民众和政治，不是医学。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Remind me never to get on your bad side. If that's true, then yes, that would be a suitable way to get rid of him.
translation: [成功] 万一我以后哪儿得罪你了，你可千万要告诉我。如果这是真的，那行吧，用这个方法解决他是比较合适。

original: However, it would involve gaining access to his personal drug stash and tampering with it unseen, which might pose a challenge.
translation: 不过，如何潜入他藏药的地方，“加工”他的杰特，还得不被发现，这一点依然要仔细考虑。

original: Add a little Psycho to his Jet, and he'd have a heart attack.
translation: 往他的杰特里加一点疯狂药，我会让他的心脏瞬间停跳。

original: [FAILED] I doubt it. I've seen junkies live for decades on the stuff. You'd be better off asking someone who knows about these things.
translation: [失败] 我不信。我见过有的瘾君子吸毒活了几十年了，你最好找个专家咨询一下。

original: Maybe the jet will cause his heart to give out.
translation: 也许杰特可以让他的心脏停止跳动。

original: Pacer's addicted to Jet, even though he has a heart condition.
translation: 佩瑟对杰特上瘾，而且他心脏不太好。

original: That could be useful, but I'm afraid I don't have the background to know how to take advantage of that knowledge.
translation: 这个情报可能会有用。但恐怕我没有足够的医学知识，不懂得这一点该如何利用。

original: I've heard that there's bad blood between Pacer and the Van Graff family.
translation: 我听说佩瑟和范格拉夫家族有仇。

original: See, that's exactly the type of information we can use. In fact, that's perfect. Those fancy weapons the Van Graffs peddle aren't exactly common.
translation: 你看，这就是我们能够利用的情报。简直太完美了。范·格拉夫家族卖的那些漂亮武器可不是什么普通玩意。

original: It goes without saying that actually getting the Van Graffs to do the deed would be the ideal solution.
translation: 不用说了，现在这件事最理想的解决方式就是借范·格拉夫之手除掉佩瑟。

original: However, if Pacer were killed with either a laser or plasma-based weapon, everyone would automatically assume the Van Graffs did it.
translation: 当然，如果佩瑟是被激光或等离子武器干掉的，大家一般也会默认是范·格拉夫家族做的。

original: Still, unless you want several dozen armed men at your throat, you'd have to kill him without being seen. Be careful.
translation: 不过，你在杀他的时候最好别被看见，除非你想被数十个全副武装的人追杀。千万要小心。

original: I'll leave the method up to you. However, there is an alternative if you'd rather try to handle things without bloodshed.
translation: 选哪种手段就看你了。如果你不喜欢用流血的方式解决，我这儿也还有一个备选方案。

original: If I can't just kill him, what did you want me to do?
translation: 如果我不能简单杀了他，那么我应该怎么做？

original: Make it look like an accident, or pin the deed on someone else. Look into this guy's affairs, and I'm sure you'll find something you can use.
translation: 伪装成事故，或者栽赃到其他人身上。调查一下这家伙的风流事，我想你应该能找到一些可以利用的突破口。

original: I think I'll pass.
translation: 还是算了吧。

original: That's too bad. Come back if you change your mind. I'm sure you can see yourself out.
translation: 真遗憾。如果你改变主意，可以再来找我。恕不远送了。

original: Sure, I'll look into it.
translation: 当然了，我会去调查的。

original: Good. Our men have come up with two different plans for seeing an end to the violence.
translation: 很好。关于如何终结暴力事件，我们的人想出了两套不同的方案。

original: First, our sources have tracked most of the attacks back to a King named Pacer. The consensus is that the violence will stop if he's removed.
translation: 首先，我们的线人已经发现有个叫佩瑟的猫王帮成员和大多数袭击案有关。大家一致认为，只要消灭他就能阻止暴力事件继续发生。

original: The problem is that we can't simply kill him. In the current climate, the NCR would likely be blamed for his death.
translation: 但问题是，我们不能就这么简单地杀了他。当下这种形势，人们十有八九会将他的死归咎到NCR头上。

original: There is an alternative option, but my sources feel that getting rid of this Pacer fellow is our best shot.
translation: 还有另外一个选择，不过我的线们人觉得，将这个佩瑟除掉才是我们目前最佳的方案。

original: Maybe? I go lots of places. Can't remember them all, you know.
translation: 也许吧？我去过许多地方。不可能全都记住。

original: You'd remember this one. It's a pit where people are robbed, murdered, or simply go to die.
translation: 这地方你不可能忘掉。它是个深渊，抢劫、谋杀，暴毙街头，在那儿是常态。

original: No, I haven't.
translation: 不，没有去过。

original: It's a beastly place. Poverty is rampant, and all that goes with it - drugs, alcohol abuse, the usual.
translation: 那是个无法无天的地方。贫穷充斥着街头巷尾，吸毒、酗酒等情况也屡见不鲜。

original: Yes, what of it?
translation: 是啊，怎么了？

original: Violence is something of a way of life there, but there's been a disturbing rise in the number of attacks on our people lately.
translation: 暴力在那儿已经成了家常便饭，但最近，针对我们公民的袭击不断增加，令我们十分苦恼。

original: More worrying is the fact that our sources suggest the violence is being perpetrated by the gang that runs the place, the Kings.
translation: 更令人担心的是，我们的情报显示，这一系列暴力事件的主谋正是统治该地区的黑帮——猫王帮。

original: I need someone to look into this that won't attract attention. Would you be interested?
translation: 我需要有人帮我秘密调查此事。你有兴趣吗？

original: I have. It's a slum.
translation: 我去过，那是个贫民窟。

original: I'm inclined to agree, but it's a slum with NCR citizens in it, and as such it falls under my jurisdiction.
translation: 我基本同意，不过这个贫民窟里还有NCR公民，也就因此落到了我的管辖范围内。

original: So I did. As you may have noticed, our position here in New Vegas is tenuous.
translation: 是的，我说过。你可能也注意到了，我们在新维加斯的地位很微妙。

original: We've made great strides, sure, but the NCR is not welcomed here, merely tolerated. And even then, not by everyone.
translation: 我们无疑已经取得了重大的进展，但本地人并不欢迎NCR，他们只是忍着不爆发而已。而且也不是所有人都忍得住。

original: We've had reports of violence against NCR citizens in a neighborhood just to the northeast called Freeside. Ever been there?
translation: 我们接到报告，在这里的东北方有个叫自由城的地方，有NCR公民在那儿受到了暴力袭击。你去过那里吗？

original: Earlier you mentioned another assignment?
translation: 先前你说过还有另一项任务？

original: Yes, have you reconsidered? NCR citizens may be dying as we speak in that hellhole.
translation: 是的，你重新考虑过了？也许在我们说话的当口，就有NCR公民在那儿遭遇不测呢。

original: Is that job in Freeside still available?
translation: 自由城的那份差事还要人吗？

original: Oh, I've already heard. Pacer is dead. The Kings are up in arms. The entire area is gripped by chaos and the violence has only increased.
translation: 哦，我已经听说了。佩瑟死了。猫王帮发动了武装暴动。混乱已经蔓延到整个地区，暴力活动也有增无减。

original: In fact, I've heard that many are assuming the NCR did it without even looking into the matter. This is the worst thing that could possibly happen!
translation: 我甚至还听说，有很多人几乎不假思索就断定NCR是这一切的幕后主使。简直没有比这更糟糕的情况了！

original: What do you have to say for yourself?
translation: 你还有什么好说的？

original: I've completed the Pacer job.
translation: 佩瑟那任务已经解决了。

original: Oh, I've already heard. The Kings are up in arms. The entire area is gripped by chaos and the violence has only increased.
translation: 哦，我已经听说了。猫王帮发动了武装暴动。混乱已经蔓延到整个地区，暴力活动也有增无减。

original: In fact, I've heard that many are assuming the NCR did it without even looking into the matter. This is the worst thing that could possibly happen!
translation: 我甚至还听说，有很多人几乎不假思索就断定NCR是这一切的幕后主使。简直没有比这更糟糕的情况了！

original: What do you have to say for yourself?
translation: 你还有什么好说的？

original: Uh, the King sort of got killed while I was working on that Freeside job.
translation: 呃，我在处理自由城问题的时候，猫王貌似被人给杀了。

original: Yes, do you have something to report?
translation: 好的，你有什么需要报告的吗？

original: I wanted to talk about the situation in Freeside.
translation: 我想谈谈自由城目前的状况。

original: Yes, how did it go?
translation: 好的，情况怎么样了？

original: I have an update on the Freeside situation.
translation: 自由城的状况有了点变化。

original: You train these dogs?
translation: 这些狗都是你驯养的？

original: Been doing it since I was a boy. The mongrels know to listen up when I start talking to them.
translation: 我从小就在驯狗了。只要我一开口，这帮小杂种就会乖乖听我的话。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Where does the Legion get its dogs?
translation: 军团的狗是哪来的？

original: We breed them, mostly, but sometimes we get some good ones from Denver. That whole city is overrun with them.
translation: 大部分都是自己养的，不过偶尔我们也会从丹佛弄一些良犬过来。那地方的狗已经泛滥成灾了。

original: I had some questions.
translation: 我有几个问题。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: What's being a Bighorn rancher like?
translation: 大角羊牧场主的生活是什么样的？

original: Bighorners' my trade since I was a youngin. I confess it's hard living these days, kid. The Wasteland ain't the same anymore.
translation: 我从年轻时起就一直在做大角羊生意。我承认这年头日子是越来越难过了，孩子。废土的世道跟以前不一样了。

original: Tell me again about your home.
translation: 再和我说说你的老家吧。

original: Darn far it is, our ranch. Ethel would be happy to yap about that - I got more important things in mind, kid.
translation: 我们来的地方离这儿很远，想知道的话，可以去听埃塞尔唠叨——我还有更重要的事要做，孩子。

original: Actually, never mind. Let me ask you about something else.
translation: 还是算了。我问你点其他的事吧。

original: I'm not interested right now. Sorry, Walter.
translation: 我现在没兴趣。抱歉，沃尔特。

original: I won't hold it against you, kid. You got to do your clean thing, I respect that.
translation: 我不会因此对你抱有成见的，孩子。你喜欢做人干干净净，我敬佩这样的人。

original: 500 and Ted's history.
translation: 给我500瓶盖，泰德就是死人了。

original: [FAILED] Cut that in half and we got a clean deal, kid.
translation: [失败] 价码砍掉一半，咱们就成交，孩子。

original: Ethel's going to be madder than a wet hen but you reap what you sow, kid, and Heck's earned every ounce of misery he gets. So, we have a deal?
translation: 埃塞尔肯定会像只老母鸡似的嗷嗷大叫，但常言道种瓜得瓜，赫克吃下的每一粒苦果都是他自己造的孽。那么，我们成交？

original: Heck's a powerful man - I'd need extra for his son's life, 500 caps.
translation: 赫克的势力很大——要他儿子的命，就得额外付钱，500瓶盖。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You'll leave me drier than tumbleweed, kid, but I reckon anything I can do to get back at Heck is well worth the expense.
translation: [成功] 我都要被你榨干成风滚草了，孩子，但我琢磨着只要能报复赫克，花多少都值。

original: Ethel's going to be madder than a wet hen but you reap what you sow, kid, and Heck's earned every ounce of misery he gets. So, we have a deal?
translation: 埃塞尔肯定会像只老母鸡似的嗷嗷大叫，但常言道种瓜得瓜，赫克吃下的每一粒苦果都是他自己造的孽。那么，我们成交？

original: I'll take care of them.
translation: 我会收拾他们的。

original: Ethel's going to be madder than a wet hen but you reap what you sow, kid, and Heck's earned every ounce of misery he gets. So, we have a deal?
translation: 埃塞尔肯定会像只老母鸡似的嗷嗷大叫，但常言道种瓜得瓜，赫克吃下的每一粒苦果都是他自己造的孽。那么，我们成交？

original: How is Heck a threat to other ranchers in The Wasteland?
translation: 为什么说赫克对废土其他的牧场主都是威胁？

original: We are honest folk out there, damn hard to make a living in the desert, kid. Heck's a different breed, goddamn thief he is.
translation: 我们都是老实人，辛辛苦苦在沙漠里讨生活。但赫克却不走正道，尽想着窃取别人的果实。

original: Scaring us into giving away our lands is all he's done to strike it flush - comes packing iron and none can hold a candle to his men - bad blood.
translation: 威胁我们放弃土地，这就是他发家致富的路子——每次来都带着家伙，没人斗得过他的手下——净干坏事。

original: Actually, let me consider it first.
translation: 我还是先考虑考虑吧。

original: Okay, I'll be back when I find out more about him.
translation: 好的，等我打探到更多消息就回来。

original: All right, kid! I appreciate it. I hope to see you soon.
translation: 很好，孩子！感谢你。希望你尽早回来。

original: Actually, let me consider it first.
translation: 我还是先考虑考虑吧。

original: Okay, I'll be back when I find out more about him.
translation: 好的，等我打探到更多消息就回来。

original: All right, kid! I appreciate it. I hope to see you soon.
translation: 很好，孩子！感谢你。希望你尽早回来。

original: Actually, let me consider it first.
translation: 我还是先考虑考虑吧。

original: That's okay, kid. I understand - let me know if you change your mind, will you?
translation: 没问题，孩子。我理解——如果你改变主意，就再来找我吧，好吗？

original: The best don't come cheap, Walter. 400 caps' my fee.
translation: 好货从来都不便宜，沃尔特。400瓶盖，就当是我的报酬。

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right, kid! I'm taking a liking to you. It's a deal.
translation: [成功] 好吧，孩子！我挺喜欢你的。成交。

original: Where I come from, we appreciate good intentions. I reckon you could help me figure out what's he doing in town.
translation: 在我们老家，好心人是会得到赞扬的。我想你可以帮我们查一查他来城里的目的。

original: Tell you what, that chiseler's blowing hot air at that over there fancy casino - The Ultra-Luxe. Find out what's his story here, will you?
translation: 实话告诉你，现在那头老狐狸就坐在对面那座漂亮赌场里吹牛皮呢——那儿叫奢华殿堂。你就帮我搞清楚他究竟唱的哪出戏吧，怎么样？

original: Okay, I'll be back when I find out more about him.
translation: 好的，我打探到更多消息就回来。

original: All right, kid! I appreciate it. I hope to see you soon.
translation: 很好，孩子！感谢你。希望你尽早回来。

original: I'll find out for you but not cheaply - 400 caps.
translation: 我会帮你弄清楚的，但可不便宜——400瓶盖。

original: [FAILED] Cut that in half and we got a clean deal, kid.
translation: [失败] 价码砍掉一半，咱们就成交，孩子。

original: Where I come from, we appreciate good intentions. I reckon you could help me figure out what's he doing in town.
translation: 在我们老家，好心人是会得到赞扬的。我想你可以帮我们查一查他来城里的目的。

original: Tell you what, that chiseler's blowing hot air at that over there fancy casino - The Ultra-Luxe. Find out what's his story here, will you?
translation: 实话告诉你，现在那头老狐狸就坐在对面那座漂亮赌场里大吹牛皮呢——那儿叫奢华殿堂。你就帮我搞清楚他究竟唱的哪出戏吧，怎么样？

original: I may be able to help you.
translation: 我也许能帮助你。

original: Where I come from, we appreciate good intentions. I reckon you could help me figure out what's he doing in town.
translation: 在我们老家，好心人是会得到赞扬的。我想你可以帮我们查一查他来城里的目的。

original: Tell you what, that chiseler's blowing hot air at that over there fancy casino - The Ultra-Luxe. Find out what's his story here, will you?
translation: 实话告诉你，现在那头老狐狸就坐在对面那座漂亮赌场里吹牛皮呢——那儿叫奢华殿堂。你就帮我搞清楚他究竟唱的哪出戏吧，怎么样？

original: Heck's looking for his disappeared son. I've agreed to find him.
translation: 赫克在找他失踪的儿子。我已经同意了去找他。

original: I'll be damned! You mean the young Gunderson? That's a shave tail if I ever saw one - he's got less sense than a Brahmin at a crossroads.
translation: 我的天！你说小冈德森？他绝对是我见过最糊涂的人——简直比站在十字路口找不着北的双头牛还傻。

original: I'd not be one to complain if he got lost for good, kid... If it makes Heck suffer then I'm all for it.
translation: 这家伙要玩完的话，我是不会有意见的，孩子……只要是能让赫克痛苦的事，我都举双手赞成。

original: What do you plan to do about him?
translation: 你准备怎么对付他？

original: I have no illusions that he'll ever stop his plundering. So I'm just going to make him suffer, that's what I'm going to do.
translation: 我从没指望他会收手。所以我只想让他好好尝点苦头，这就是我的打算。

original: Here, in town, he's got few of his armed men to protect him. I just got to find out what's he up to and then I'll know where to hit him hard.
translation: 他进城时，身边只带了几个保镖。我只需要弄清楚他的动向，就能照准软肋给他狠狠一击。

original: Like I said, kid. Someone's got to rein that greedy son of a gun.
translation: 我说过了，孩子。总得有人让这个贪得无厌的狗杂种尝尝厉害。

original: Heck claims to be an honest rancher.
translation: 赫克声称自己是个诚实的农场主。

original: Sure, kid, and I still hump like a buck in Spring. That Gunderson's a liar and born of a viper, I swear.
translation: 当然了，孩子，我还声称我能像春天的雄鹿那样发情呢。冈德森是个骗子，而且是条天生的毒蛇，我发誓。

original: What else can you tell me about Heck Gunderson?
translation: 对于赫克·冈德森，你还有什么能告诉我的？

original: What more you want? He's a slithering snake, what he is. One of the biggest landowners this side of the Colorado and it's all stolen, I tell you.
translation: 你还想知道什么？他就是一条残忍的毒蛇。科罗拉多河西部最大的地主之一，但我告诉你，他所有的土地都是偷来的。

original: All that money buys him any NCR senators he wants - scoundrels, like Heck. There's just no way for us small folks to get by, much less prosper, kid.
translation: 他捞的钱足够买通任何NCR议员——那些恶棍和赫克都是一路货色。现在像我们这样的小人物，靠着正道已经难以生存了，孩子。

original: Are you a Bighorn rancher?
translation: 你是大角羊牧场主吗？

original: Bighorners' my trade since I was a youngin. I confess it's hard living these days, kid. The Wasteland ain't the same anymore.
translation: 我从年轻时起就一直在做大角羊生意了。我承认这年头日子是越来越难过了，孩子。废土的世道跟以前不一样了。

original: You're not from around here, are you?
translation: 你不是从这附近来的吧？

original: Darn far it is, our ranch. Ethel would be happy to yap about that - I got more important things in mind, kid.
translation: 我们来的地方离这儿很远，想知道的话，可以去听埃塞尔唠叨——我还有更重要的事要做，孩子。

original: I want to talk to you about our deal.
translation: 我想和你谈谈我们的那笔交易。

original: I hear you. What's on your mind?
translation: 我听着呢。你想说什么？

original: How do Wastelanders cope with current times?
translation: 咱们这些废土游民该怎么应对眼下的状况？

original: {Bragging Jokingly}Steeling our pure-breed resolve, that's how! We've faced the Wasteland right in the old mug and told her to shove it!
translation: {Bragging Jokingly}吃下秤砣铁了心跟他们干，就这么办！咱们也是跟废土面对面较量过，不照样活得好好的！

original: Listen, we own these lands, and I'll be damned if the NCR, those Legion bastards, or anyone else tries to walk all over us.
translation: 听着，我们才是这片土地的主人。无论NCR还是那帮军团杂种，或者其他什么人，只要想踩在我们头上的，我一概不答应。

original: {Serious}Listen, we own these lands, and I'll be damned if the NCR, those Legion bastards, or anyone else tries to walk all over us.
translation: {Serious}听着，我们才是这片土地的主人。无论NCR还是那帮军团杂种，或者其他什么人，只要想踩在我们头上的，我一概不答应。

original: I have news about the Gundersons
translation: 我知道些冈德森的消息。

original: You have? What are you waiting for, kid? Spill the beans!
translation: 你知道？那你还憋着干嘛，孩子？别卖关子了！

original: Where do you come from?
translation: 你从哪里来？

original: What was that about settling a score?
translation: 算账是怎么回事？

original: There's a long list of grievances that Heck Gunderson's got to answer for, kid. I'm here to make sure that "rancher" stops stealing our lands.
translation: 我可憋了一肚子的牢骚，那个赫克·冈德森必须得给我个说法。我来这儿就是为了阻止那个"牧场主"继续窃取我们家土地的。

original: If he ain't chiseling behind your back, he just sends his men, ready for a fight. Then you either "sell" your ranch for a penny or you're dead.
translation: 他不是在背后使绊子，就是直接派人和你来硬的。如果你不把农场低价"贱卖"给他，那就等着归西吧。

original: I'm tired of being trampled over, kid, and I got a good mind to stop Heck once and for all.
translation: 我已经受够了他的欺负，孩子，这次我铁了心思，一定要和他干到底。

original: I came to take care of Heck Gunderson. That bastard's taking over any ranch he spots in The Wasteland.
translation: 我是来解决赫克·冈德森的。那个混蛋就快把废土上所有他能看到的牧场都要霸占光了。

original: Let's talk about Heck Gunderson.
translation: 我们谈谈赫克·冈德森。

original: I hear you. What's on your mind?
translation: 我听着呢。你想说什么？

original: I'd like to ask you about the Wasteland.
translation: 我想问问你关于废土的问题。

original: I know it better than my wife's corset! What about it, kid?
translation: 我对废土的了解比我老婆的内衣还多！你想知道什么，孩子？

original: I have questions about you.
translation: 我对你本人有些问题。

original: Okay. What'd you want know?
translation: 好吧，你想知道什么？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All right, kid! Be good.
translation: 那好吧，孩子。保重！

original: I'd like to ask you some other questions.
translation: 我想问你些别的问题。

original: I got some time - what's eating you?
translation: 我有时间，你想知道什么？

original: Then have, I don't know, some water or something.
translation: 那你干脆……就喝点水吧，怎么样。

original: [FAILED] A drink? Nonsense. All I need right now is to settle a score. We didn't come a long ways just to stroll our best clothes around.
translation: [失败] 喝水？胡说八道。我现在唯一想做的就是把账算清。我们大老远跑到这儿来可不是为了逛服装店的。

original: You look more than just too hot - what's the matter?
translation: 我看你的样子可不止是热着了——怎么回事？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Sharp eyes on you, all right. We've gone through a heap of trouble to get in town. Ethel says I just need to wet my throat.
translation: [成功] 你眼睛很尖嘛。好吧，我们费了好大一番周折才进到城里。埃塞尔说我需要先解解渴。

original: A drink? Nonsense. All I need right now is to settle a score. We didn't come a long ways just to stroll our best clothes around.
translation: 喝水？胡说八道。我现在唯一想做的就是把账算清。我们大老远跑到这儿来可不是为了逛服装店的。

original: I want to talk about Joana.
translation: 我想说一下琼娜的事。

original: Hey, that's great. What's going on?
translation: 嘿，好啊。怎么了？

original: On second thought - let's wait.
translation: 我又想了想——还是等等吧。

original: Dammit! You're going to leave me hanging, uh? Don't know how else I can get her back.
translation: 操！你就想这样吊着我，是吧？我不知道还有什么办法能让把她救出来。

original: All right. I'll talk to her.
translation: 好。我会和她说的。

original: Deal! Come back with news soon, you hear?
translation: 一言为定！尽快带着消息回来，听见没有？

original: On second thought - let's wait.
translation: 我又想了想——还是等等吧。

original: Dammit! You're going to leave me hanging, uh? Don't know how else I can get her back.
translation: 操！你就想这样吊着我，是吧？我不知道还有什么办法能让把她救出来。

original: All right. I'll talk to her.
translation: 好。我会和她说的。

original: Deal! Come back with news soon, you hear?
translation: 一言为定！尽快带着消息回来，听见没有？

original: You know, paying a visit to Joana sounds like fun.
translation: 说实在的，去拜访琼娜，听着就有趣。

original: I could talk to Joana for you, but it'll cost you 200 caps.
translation: 我可以帮你给琼娜带个话，但你得给我200瓶盖。

original: Don't know... She's a dream to me now... If I, I mean if I could have her again I'd be a made man.
translation: 我不知道……她现在对我来说只是个梦……如果我，我是说如果，我能再次拥有她，那就真的和重生一样。

original: {Reflects on his unfounded fear, having a break-through}Why am I even scared of Cachino and all those fuckers? Joana and I are dead anyway if we don't get the hell out of here.
translation: {Reflects on his unfounded fear, having a break-through}我为什么要害怕卡奇诺和那些混蛋？如果琼娜和我不能离开这鬼地方，那我们和死了还有什么区别。

original: Okay - you try that and let me know, okay? How she looks, what she's wearing, she's safe, anything - I'll pay you, you hear?
translation: 好吧，你去试试。回来告诉我她的近况，好吗？穿什么衣服，是否安全，怎样都行——我会付你钱的，听见没有？

original: Have you made up your mind?
translation: 你想好了吗？

original: I can talk to Joana for you.
translation: 我可以帮你给琼娜带个话。

original: Don't know... She's a dream to me now... If I,{repeats with "I mean" to give emphasis} I mean if I could have her again I'd be a made man.
translation: 我不知道……她现在对我来说只是个梦……如果我，{repeats with "I mean" to give emphasis}我是说如果，我能再次拥有她，那就真的和重生一样。

original: {Reflects on his unfounded fear, having a break-through}Why am I even scared of Cachino and all those fuckers? Joana and I are dead anyway if we don't get the hell out of here.
translation: {Reflects on his unfounded fear, having a break-through}我为什么要害怕卡奇诺和那些混蛋？如果琼娜和我不能离开这鬼地方，那我们和死了还有什么区别。

original: Okay, you try that and let me know. How she looks, what she's wearing, she's safe, anything - I'll pay you, you hear?
translation: 好吧，你去试试。回来告诉我她的近况，好吗？穿什么衣服，是否安全，怎样都行——我会付你钱的，听见没有？

original: Have you made up your mind?
translation: 你想好了吗？

original: How did Cachino get you out of the way?
translation: 卡奇诺是怎么把你赶走的？

original: He's a cunning bastard, Cachino. Told Nero and Big Sal he caught me spring cleaning my tributes to the family - can't do nothing against that viper.
translation: 那个狡猾的混蛋卡奇诺。他向尼禄和大萨尔告状，说我私吞了给家族的贡金——谁拿这种毒蛇都没办法。

original: Why don't you get her out of Gomorrah?
translation: 你为什么不把她弄出蛾摩拉？

original: What, you think I can just waltz in there and take her away? She's their doll now, okay?
translation: 什么，你以为我能大摇大摆地进去把她带走？她现在是他们的人了，好吗？

original: Besides, I step in Gomorrah and I'm as good as dead, you hear? You don't just leave the Omertas unless it's in a body bag.
translation: 而且，我前脚踏进蛾摩拉，后脚就该上西天了，你懂吗？想摆脱黑手党，只有装进裹尸袋里这一条路。

original: Why not? It looks private enough for a midnight stunt.
translation: 为什么不？这对一场午夜狂欢来说已经够隐秘了。

original: Don't talk to me like that or I'll... I'll... have to get tough with you.
translation: 别那样跟我说话，否则我就……我就……只能跟你来硬的了。

original: [FAILED] Ha ha ha! Okay, okay... stop or I'll choke, I swear. Listen, kid - I'll cut you some slack because nothing else in this town will, you hear?
translation: [失败] 哈哈哈！好吧，好吧……停，否则我要笑死了，真的。听着，孩子——这次我放你一马，但在这座城里，绝不会再有第二个人这么做了，听见了吗？

original: Tell me again about the girl at Gomorrah that worries you.
translation: 再跟我说一下那个在蛾摩拉让你担心的姑娘。

original: What about Joana?
translation: 琼娜呢？

original: What did you say about working at Gomorrah?
translation: 能说说你在蛾摩拉工作的事么？

original: It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.
translation: 那里曾是天堂——直到有一天，你发现所有的光鲜亮丽都是用破碎的梦拼成的，所有的笑脸背后都藏着刀刃，直指你的胸口。

original: So you live in Vault 21?
translation: 所以你住在21号避难所？

original: This place has come a long way. Sarah takes care of it and she lets me stay, for now.
translation: 这地方比以前好多了。萨拉把这儿打理得井井有条，她还允许我暂时住下来。

original: {Enthusiasm muffled by sadness}This place has come a long way, but ever since Sarah's death it is not the same.
translation: {Enthusiasm muffled by sadness}这地方比以前好多了，但自从萨拉死后，也变味了。

original: Tell me about your past.
translation: 和我说说你的过去吧。

original: You know - straightening up bets, Gomorrah, success, women, all that shiny stuff.
translation: 你懂的——在赌桌上叱咤风云，蛾摩拉，成功，女人，派头得很。

original: Wait a minute. What's that name again?
translation: 等等。那人叫什么名字来着？

original: No dice. I already opened my trap more than I should. Walls have ears even all the way down in this hole, you know? Can't trust nobody.
translation: 我不会再提了。我已经说了不该说的话。即使在这种小地方也隔墙有耳，懂吗？谁都不能信。

original: I can keep a secret, Carlitos. About whom are you worried?
translation: 我会保密的，卡利托斯。你在担心谁？

original: I... Okay, it's Joana. She... works at Gomorrah. But it's all my fault! I met her at the Atomic Wrangler - beautiful doesn't even come close.
translation: 我……好吧，是琼娜。她……在蛾摩拉工作。这都是我的错！我是在原子牛仔和她邂逅的——用美丽这个词根本不足以形容她。

original: I moved her into Gomorrah. I was in love, okay? Then Cachino, backstabbing snake, got me out of the way so that he could have my girl.
translation: 我把她弄到了蛾摩拉。我当时被爱冲昏了头，好吗？然后卡奇诺，那条阴险的毒蛇，把我赶了出来，霸占了我的姑娘。

original: Why do you say that Vault 21 has come a long way?
translation: 为什么你说21号避难所比以前好多了？

original: Because Mr. House ripped this place to shreds before filling it with concrete. Hey, I was untouchable once, but Mr. House's a god - you got that?
translation: 因为豪斯先生把这里拆成了一片废墟，还用混凝土把地下部分给填了。嘿，虽然我以前也高人一等过，但豪斯先生是神——你懂吗？

original: What does Sarah do around here?
translation: 萨拉在这儿都干些什么？

original: What doesn't she do, huh? Sarah makes this hole look like a palace - damn nice pair of gams on her too. She never walks outside, though.
translation: 她什么事都干。萨拉把这个破地洞变成了一座富丽堂皇的宫殿——她那双腿也相当迷人。不过，她从不外出。

original: Let me ask you something else.
translation: 我想问点别的问题。

original: Anyone in Gomorrah you'd recommend for a good time?
translation: 我想在蛾摩拉找个人玩玩，你有什么建议吗？

original: I'd recommend you save your caps and your skin. Check The Tops - no big time wiseguys there. Freeside's also fun, you know?
translation: 为了你的瓶盖和安全着想，我建议你去九重天看看——至少在那儿不会遇到什么大名鼎鼎的聪明人。自由城也不错，你懂吗？

original: There's too much shit and despair at Gomorrah already. I don't want anybody making it worse for Jo... for the girls, you know?
translation: 蛾摩拉到处是肮脏和绝望。我可不想再有谁为了琼……为了几个姑娘，把那儿弄得更加乌烟瘴气了，你懂吧？

original: Any important "wiseguys" that I should know about?
translation: 有没有哪个大名鼎鼎的“聪明人”是我该认识的？

original: Now, if you have to ask, you probably don't know shit about who you're dealing with, huh? Listen up - watch out for Cachino, that's all I'm saying.
translation: 这种话都能问出来，看来你是不知道自己是在和谁打交道咯？听好了——小心卡奇诺，我就说这些。

original: You spent some time at Gomorrah, then. What was it like?
translation: 这么说你在蛾摩拉待过。那地方怎么样？

original: I didn't just spend time there, I lived there, okay? I was family. All I wanted, I had. Caps, booze, drugs, women, power, you name it.
translation: 我可不是光在那儿待过，我曾经住在那儿的好吧？我过去是家族的一员。想要的东西我都得到了。瓶盖，美酒，毒品，女人，权力，应有尽有。

original: It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.
translation: 那里曾是天堂——直到有一天，你发现所有的光鲜亮丽都是用破碎的梦拼成的，所有的笑脸背后都藏着刀刃，直指你的胸口。

original: You worked in Gomorrah as a Croupier, uh? What was it like?
translation: 你在蛾摩拉当过荷官？感觉如何？

original: Hey, you're smart. Okay, it was like finding diamonds in your vodka and showgirls under your card-table. You want it, Gomorrah has it.
translation: 嘿，你够聪明的。好吧，感觉就像是在伏特加里找钻石，或者在牌桌下面找代言女郎。你想要什么，蛾摩拉就有什么。

original: It was heaven - until you find that all the glitter is made of broken dreams and all the praise hides a knife pointing at your ribs.
translation: 那里曾是天堂——直到有一天，你发现所有的光鲜亮丽都是用破碎的梦拼成的，所有的笑脸背后都藏着刀刃，直指你的胸口。

original: Any recommendations on where to go for some fun?
translation: 我想找点乐子，你的建议是什么？

original: My recommendation, get the fuck out of town while you can. It'll leave you hanging in the wind or, worse, add your body to a concrete wall, okay?
translation: 我的建议是，趁你还挪得动腿脚，赶紧他妈的滚出这座城市。留在这儿只会让你变得迟疑不定，甚至更惨，被砌进墙里怎么样，你喜欢吗？

original: I've got other questions about you.
translation: 我还有其他问题要问你。

original: What are the important players in town?
translation: 城里都有哪些大人物？

original: Ha! There's only one important player in town, and that's Mr. House. Everyone keeps clean around him, the families, the barons - fuck, even the NCR.
translation: 哈！城里只有一个大人物，那就是豪斯先生。所有人对他都毕恭毕敬，几大家族，那些大亨——操，甚至连NCR也一样。

original: Tell me about The Strip.
translation: 和我说说长街。

original: If you're smart, the Strip's all flash and noise. If not, luck's your dame, your hot date, until you find she's a cheap whore high on Jet.
translation: 如果你够聪明，那长街就是声色犬马之地。但如果你不够聪明，那你的运气就好比泡到了一个骚得不行的妞，却发现她是个吸杰特成瘾的贱货。

original: Let me ask you about New Vegas.
translation: 我想找你了解一下新维加斯的情况。

original: All right. What do you want to know?
translation: 好吧。你想知道什么？

original: If Vault 21 is your "bottom of the barrel" then I'd say you could've done worse.
translation: 如果你以为21号避难所就叫惨的话，那我告诉你，你还可以更惨。

original: Yeah, I could've ended buried in the sands with just my head sticking out. Ants love that - a riot, know what I mean?
translation: 对，我还可以被埋在沙子里，只把脑袋露在外面。蚂蚁最喜欢这种场面了——简直是狂欢节，懂我意思吧？

original: This place has come a long way. Sarah takes care of it and she lets me stay, for now.
translation: 这地方比以前好多了。萨拉把这儿打理得井井有条，她还允许我暂时住下来。

original: Yeah, I could've ended buried in the sands with just my head sticking out. Ants love that - a riot, know what I mean?
translation: 对，我还可以被埋在沙子里，只把脑袋露在外面。蚂蚁最喜欢这种场面了——简直是狂欢节，懂我意思吧？

original: {Enthusiasm muffled by sadness}This place has come a long way, but ever since Sarah's death it is not the same.
translation: {Enthusiasm muffled by sadness}这地方比以前好多了，但自从萨拉死后，也变味了。

original: How high was that fall?
translation: 你摔得有多惨？

original: From the top! Where else, uh? I am Carlitos - my fingers work the magic and my hands deal the luck!
translation: 一路到底啊！你说有多惨？老子可是卡利托斯——动动指头就能变魔术，搓搓手掌就能改变命运！

original: There was no player who'd stood a chance, no wiseguy who didn't fear me, and no doll who could resist me. Gomorrah was my kingdom, Carlitos' turf!
translation: 没有赌客嬴得了我，没有聪明人不惧怕我，没有美女会拒绝我。蛾摩拉是我的王国，是卡利托斯的地盘！

original: Sounds like you're in trouble. What's the deal?
translation: 听起来你像是有麻烦。怎么回事？

original: Who isn't in trouble in New Vegas, uh? Sooner or later, you hit the bottom of the barrel - I just happened to fall harder than most, is all.
translation: 在新维加斯，谁没点麻烦？你迟早也会摔得一嘴泥——只不过我碰巧比大多数人摔得都惨罢了，就这样。

original: I am just one more loser that got the evil-eye from Lady Luck - hard fall. Now I lay at the bottom and keep to myself.
translation: 我和其他废物也没什么区别，幸运女神瞪了我一眼，就害我跌得找不着北了。现在我只能躺在地上，憋着一肚子苦水不敢说。

original: All right. About what do you want to know?
translation: 好吧。你想知道什么？

original: You've got them all wrong.
translation: 你误解他们了。

original: Wrong, huh? And I suppose they sent all of these soldiers just to make nice. Lucky me.
translation: 误解？原来他们派这些军人来是为了示好啊。真教我受宠若惊。

original: Actually, they want to make you an offer.
translation: 其实他们是想和你谈谈条件。

original: An offer, huh? All right, let's hear it.
translation: 条件？好吧，说来听听。

original: Let me guess. The NCR couldn't get me to dance to their tune so now they're asking again a little less nicely, right?
translation: 让我猜猜。NCR没法让我顺着他们的意思办事，所以现在要和我来硬的了，对不对？

original: Sounds like he's not going to cooperate, men. Open fire!
translation: 看来他拒绝合作，弟兄们，开火！

original: The NCR is just trying to protect its people.
translation: NCR只是想保护他们的人民。

original: And I'm trying to protect mine. If the NCR wants peace so much, the first step would be to get these soldiers out of here.
translation: 我也只是想保护我的人民。如果NCR这么想要和平，那第一步就该先把这些军人撤走。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Honestly, I hadn't thought it through that far. I'd guess someone would come and take over this place.
translation: [成功] 坦白说，我从没想过这么远。我猜应该会有人来接替我。

original: And you can be damn sure they won't run it like the King, baby. They might run everyone out, or enslave them, or worse.
translation: 但我敢肯定，他们绝对不会有猫王这样的品格。他们要么会把人都赶走，要么就奴役他们，甚至更糟。

original: I guess I have no choice. Tell your NCR masters that I accept their terms. I'll see that violence against their people is dealt with.
translation: 看来我别无选择。去转告你的NCR主子，就说我接受他们的条件。他们的人不会再受到暴力袭击了。

original: Now take these fools and get out of here before they start a riot.
translation: 现在，趁着这帮蠢货还没有引发暴乱，赶紧把他们给我带走。

original: And when you're dead? What will happen to their freedom then?
translation: 那如果你死了呢？到时候谁来保障他们的自由？

original: [FAILED] My momma didn't raise no quitter, and I stand by my beliefs. The answer is no.
translation: [失败] 我妈妈养的可不是一个胆小鬼，我坚持自己的信念。答案是不。

original: The NCR is far too powerful. Just give up.
translation: NCR实在太强大了。放弃吧。

original: These men have orders to kill you all if you refuse. Are you sure?
translation: 如果你拒绝，这些人就会把你们赶尽杀绝。你确定吗？

original: That I don't want to sign away my freedom and that of all the people I'm responsible for at gunpoint? Yeah, I'm sure.
translation: 我不会将自由拱手相让，也绝不会因为武力威胁就放弃我对人民的承诺。是的，我确定。

original: There's still time to solve this peacefully.
translation: 还是可以和平解决的。

original: Says the one with a squad of armed soldiers behind them. No, I don't think a peaceful solution is possible. Not anymore.
translation: 说这话的人身后可站着一排全副武装的士兵呢。不，已经没有和平解决的可能了，不再有了。

original: The violence needs to stop.
translation: 暴力应该停止。

original: And whose job is it to stop it? Yours? Mine? Who are we to tell people what to do? No man has that right.
translation: 那谁去阻止暴力呢？你？我？我们有什么权利对人发号施令？没人拥有这样的权利。

original: I'm afraid so.
translation: 恐怕是这样。

original: Then I must refuse. The people here have the right to do what they want and are beholden to none. I won't take that away from them.
translation: 那我只能拒绝了。这里的人有权做自己想做的事，不应承担任何义务。我不能剥夺这种权利。

original: Let me guess. The NCR couldn't get me to dance to their tune so now they're asking again a little less nicely, right?
translation: 让我猜猜。NCR没法让我照着他们的路子办事，所以现在要和我来硬的了，对不对？

original: Nope. I'm to go to Freeside and shoot up some Kings.
translation: 没有了。我要去自由城打爆猫王帮的脑袋。

original: Not exactly. Give them the chance to do the right thing at least. Personally, I doubt they'll do it.
translation: 不必这样。至少给他们一个改过自新的机会。虽然就我个人来说，我很怀疑他们会真的改过。

original: Crocker's been making overtures to these savages for months and gotten nowhere. Expect a fight, but don't look for one.
translation: 克罗克已经在这些野蛮人身上浪费了好几个月，却毫无进展。做硬碰硬的准备，但不要主动惹事。

original: Dismissed.
translation: 解散。

original: This plan seems awfully confrontational.
translation: 这个计划看起来相当强硬。

original: Do you have any idea what our current situation is? As we speak there is a huge army of madmen not ten miles from here waiting to kill us all.
translation: 你搞清楚我们现在的状况了吗？就在我们说话的工夫，离这不到十里的地方有一支疯子组成的大军正等着把我们全都干掉。

original: We don't have the luxury of long-term diplomacy any longer. Anyone that could prove a hindrance in the battle to come must be dealt with swiftly.
translation: 我们对长期的外交政策已经不抱奢望了。任何可能阻碍战争进行的人都必须立刻被清除。

original: You have your orders. I expect you to carry them out.
translation: 你已经接到命令了。希望你能马上执行。

original: Dismissed.
translation: 解散。

original: No ma'am.
translation: 没有了，女士。

original: Good. When the task is done, report back to Crocker. My men have other orders and will return here on their own to make their report.
translation: 很好。任务完成了就去找克罗克报告。我的人还有其他任务，他们全部完成后会自己回来报告的。

original: Dismissed.
translation: 解散。

original: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about Freeside.
translation: 克罗克大使让我过来和你谈自由城的事。

original: You say Crocker sent you? Let me see... I just received a memo regarding him recently and haven't had a chance to read it in detail.
translation: 你说是克罗克派你来的？我想想……我最近是收到了他一份备忘录，不过还一直没机会细看。

original: Ah, the matter with the so-called Kings. Crocker's been wringing his hands while good people die for too long, and now the matter's fallen to me.
translation: 啊，猫王帮的事。好人都快死完了，克罗克也没想出法子，现在这个皮球又踢到我这儿来了。

original: Unlike the good ambassador, I don't intend to blink. Tell the leader of this gang to stand down or face annihilation.
translation: 我跟那个好大使不一样，我可不打算装傻。去跟这个猫王帮的头领说，要么自己解除武装，要么等着受死。

original: That is his choice. If he chooses the latter, a squad of my men will be there to back you up. Any questions?
translation: 选择权在他手里。如果他选择后者，我会派一队人马去支援你。还有什么问题吗？

original: You know, I just received the strangest memo about Freeside. It said that Colonel Hsu has already dispatched a squad to take care of the problem.
translation: 你知道吗，我刚刚收到一份关于自由城的备忘录，内容相当奇怪。上面说许上校已经派了一队人去处理那儿的问题了。

original: I'll let Hsu's men deal with things, but the good ambassador is going to learn a harsh lesson regarding protocol.
translation: 我会让许上校的人接手的，但那个好大使估计得再仔细学学我们的办事流程是怎么一回事。

original: I trust you can find your own way out.
translation: 我相信你会有办法的。

original: I was, uh, just sightseeing. Sorry to bother you.
translation: 我只是，呃，观光而已。抱歉打扰你们。

original: Then I suggest you make your way back outside. My men have orders to shoot anyone caught sneaking around in sensitive areas.
translation: 那么我建议你立刻调头回去。我们已经接到命令，任何在敏感区域鬼鬼祟祟的人都格杀勿论。

original: I think the authorities would like to hear these tapes I found in your safe.
translation: 我想当局会很乐意听到这些磁带的，这都是我在你保险柜里找到的。

original: I think I should kill you before you have a chance to show those tapes to anyone. What do I have to lose?
translation: 我会很乐意在你把这些东西泄露之前将你干掉。我又有什么损失呢？

original: {Angry}What the fuck are you trying to pull here? Where is my girl? Now I'm gonna have to kill your sorry ass.
translation: {Angry}你他妈在这儿搞什么名堂？我的妞呢？我现在非弄死你不可。

original: Ok little lady, let's get started. You look like a tough piece of meat, I'm going to enjoy tenderizing you.
translation: 好的，小妞，我们开始吧。你看起来真紧实，瞧我不得把你干得又松又软。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Get lost.
translation: 走开。

original: Sorry, I was thinking about someone else. I have a different question though.
translation: 抱歉，我可能认错人了。不过我有别的问题要问你。

original: Alright, but you're starting to get on my nerves.
translation: 好的，不过我已经有些不耐烦了。

original: I thought that maybe I could be your next playtoy. Your exploits are well known.
translation: 我想，也许我可以作你的下一个玩偶。你的本领有目共睹。

original: Well, look at you! It's so rare I get a volunteer. Yes, let's head to my special room. Follow me, we'll talk there.
translation: 噢，瞧瞧！居然有志愿者，真是少见。好吧，那就到我的专用小房间去吧。跟我来，到那儿我们再谈。

original: [SUCCEEDED]{Excited} Oh, already? I figured it would be a couple days. Well, let's go meet the lucky lady.
translation: [成功] {Excited}哦，已经来了？我以为还要再等几天呢。好吧，让我们去会会这位幸运的女士。

original: Oh, I was just told to deliver a girl to the spare room you keep up here.
translation: 哦，我是奉命送一个女孩到你这儿来的。

original: [FAILED]{Laughs} I don't care much about your tastes. Get lost and leave me alone.
translation: [失败] {Laughs}我对你的口味没多少兴趣。快走开，别来打扰我。

original: Well... I... I have some exotic tastes too!
translation: 嗯…我…我也喜欢异国口味！

original: I hear you have some exotic tastes when it comes to women.
translation: 我听说你品鉴女人的口味很特别。

original: {Annoyed}Oh did you now? What business is that of yours, and why the fuck should I care?
translation: {Annoyed}哦，你知道？那又跟你有什么关系呢，我干嘛要听你说这个？

original: Clanden, under the authority of the New California Republic, I place you under arrest for murder.
translation: 克兰顿，依照新加州共和国的授权，我现在以谋杀罪的名义逮捕你。

original: What? Are you fucking kidding me? You can't do this, the Omertas aren't going to stand by and let you arrest me.
translation: 什么？你他妈在逗我？你不能这么做，黑手党不会眼睁睁地看着你把我抓走的。

original: The Omertas have no say in this matter. This is a legal matter now. You'll have to come with us.
translation: 黑手党对此事没有发言权。这件事已经成了法律问题。你必须跟我们走一趟。

original: Alright. I'll come quietly, but this fucked.
translation: 好吧。我会乖乖跟你们走的，太操蛋了。

original: Never mind, I have some other questions though.
translation: 没关系，我还有些别的问题。

original: Ok, ask away.
translation: 好，问吧。

original: It is a guy named Clanden.
translation: 是一个叫克兰顿的家伙。

original: Clanden? Okay, I'll send some troops over there to bring him in.
translation: 克兰顿？明白了，我会派一批士兵把他抓回来的。

original: No, but I'll find out for you.
translation: 没有，但我会帮你查出来的。

original: Come back here as soon as you do, I'd like to see this asshole behind bars.
translation: 一有结果马上回来。我会把这个混蛋送进大牢里的。

original: I can't say for sure.
translation: 我不能完全肯定。

original: Well come back here when you can. I'd like to take care of this as soon as possible.
translation: 等你搞清楚的时候再回来。到时候我会马上处理这案子的。

original: I found these tapes.
translation: 我找到了这些带子。

original: These are terrifying. Do you have any idea who the man is speaking on this tape?
translation: 简直令人发指！你知道磁带里说话的人是谁吗？

original: I found a dead girl in Gomorrah.
translation: 我在蛾摩拉发现了一具年轻女子的尸体。

original: Well that's something, but I can't go in there without proof of foul play.
translation: 这可是件大事。不过没有证据，我无法进去调查。

original: Sorry, I'll find some proof.
translation: 抱歉，我会找到证据的。

original: Okay, this is a very serious accusation. Please be sure to bring me something concrete.
translation: 好的。这个指控非同小可。请务必找到确凿的证据。

original: I'd like to report a murder at Gomorrah.
translation: 蛾摩拉里有人被谋杀了，我要报案。

original: Murder? What kind of Murder? Do you have any proof?
translation: 谋杀？什么谋杀？你有证据吗？

original: It turns out that Ted Gunderson's disappeared. Heck's looking for him.
translation: 泰德·冈德森似乎失踪了。赫克正在找他。

original: I'll be damned! You mean the young Gunderson? That's a shave tail if I ever saw one - he's got less sense than a Brahmin at a crossroads.
translation: 我的天！你说小冈德森？他绝对是我见过最糊涂的人——简直比站在十字路口找不着北的双头牛还傻。

original: I'd not be one to complain if he got lost for good, kid... If it makes Heck suffer then I'm all for it.
translation: 这家伙要玩完的话，我是不会有意见的，孩子……只要是能让赫克痛苦的事，我都举双手赞成。

original: I'm surprised you haven't asked what became of Benny.
translation: 我很奇怪你怎么一点也不关心本尼的下场。

original: That's because he ceased to be relevant when you recovered the Platinum Chip. Revenge doesn't interest me, progress does.
translation: 既然你已经找回了白金筹码，那他的生死也就无关紧要了。我对复仇并不感兴趣，我关心的是进展。

original: Sorry to deny you a moment of primate triumph, but you'll have to go elsewhere to sound your barbaric yawp.
translation: 抱歉扫了你的兴，如果你实在抑制不住心中那股躁动的狂喜，那你大可以换个地方。

original: <Change the subject.>
translation: <换个话题>

original: I'm not planning to visit the Fort.
translation: 我没打算前去城堡。

original: I'm not planning to go to the Fort.
translation: 我没打算前去城堡。

original: No thanks, Mr. House.
translation: 不，谢了，凯撒先生。

original: I've already met with Caesar at the Fort.
translation: 我已经在城堡和凯撒见过面了。

original: Caesar has already invited me to the Fort.
translation: 凯撒已经邀请我前往城堡了。

original: What will I find at Caesar's camp?
translation: 我会在凯撒的营地发现什么？

original: So you want me to go back there and kill Caesar?
translation: 你想让我回去杀了凯撒？

original: What's inside the hatch?
translation: 舱盖里面是什么？

original: Something very important. I wouldn't want to spoil the surprise - so don't bother asking.
translation: 是一件很重要的东西。我不想扫你的兴，所以还是别问了。

original: What will I find at Caesar's camp?
translation: 我会在凯撒的营地发现什么？

original: I'll do as you ask.
translation: 我会照你说的做的。

original: Here, take the Platinum Chip again. You will need it.
translation: 给你，把筹码重新带上，你会需要它的。

original: Upon arrival at the Fort, it's likely that you'll be searched and the Chip taken from you. Don't worry - it will come back to you.
translation: 你进入城堡时，很可能会被搜身，筹码会被没收。但别担心，它会回到你的手上。

original: I expect that if Benny doesn't have the Chip, Caesar will make sure you get it. More on that later. Be off.
translation: 我估计就算本尼没有筹码，凯撒也会让你拿到筹码。详细的事以后再谈。出发吧。

original: No thanks, Mr. House.
translation: 不，谢了，豪斯先生。

original: I've already visited Caesar.{Kill Benny at Tops, see CL 1st}
translation: 我已经见过凯撒了。{Kill Benny at Tops, see CL 1st}

original: Caesar has already invited me to the Fort.
translation: 凯撒已经邀请我前往堡垒了。

original: And what then?
translation: 然后？

original: No thanks, Mr. House.
translation: 不，谢了，豪斯先生。

original: If you find Caesar's Legion so frightening at this remove, imagine them rampaging across the Strip.
translation: 要是你在这儿都能觉得凯撒军团如此可怕，那想象一下他们在长街上横冲直撞的情景吧。

original: We have a chance to see them detroyed, to see New Vegas become the harbinger of a new age.
translation: 我们有机会亲眼见证他们的覆灭，让维加斯成为新时代的先驱。

original: I've already visited Caesar.{Kill Benny at Tops, see CL 1st}
translation: 我已经见过凯撒了。{Kill Benny at Tops, see CL 1st}

original: {nonplussed}You have? So you have the means to gain entry?
translation: {nonplussed}你见过了？那么你知道怎么进去咯？

original: Caesar has already invited me to the Fort.
translation: 凯撒已经邀请我前往。

original: I'm not surprised. The Legion has spies on the Strip.
translation: 不出所料。军团在长街果然有眼线。

original: What do you want me to do there?
translation: 你想让我去那儿做什么？

original: I want you to open a hatch in the basement of the derelict weather station atop Fortification Hill.
translation: 我希望你去堡垒山的破天文台那里，打开一个舱盖。

original: You'll recognize it on sight. The hatch bears the logo of the Lucky 38, same as the Platinum Chip.
translation: 到了那儿你就知道了。舱盖上印着幸运38的标志，就和白金筹码一样。

original: I think that sounds insane.
translation: 这太疯狂了。

original: Not if you've been invited. You realize that you've made quite a splash here in New Vegas?
translation: 如果你接到邀请，那就不是。你知不知道自己在新维加斯已经小有名气了？

original: I can predict with a high degree of confidence that you'll receive an official summons from Caesar. If you haven't already, that is.
translation: 我有把握断言，你很快就会得到凯撒的正式召见。当然，前提是你还没有见过他。

original: No thanks, Mr. House.
translation: 不，谢了，豪斯先生。

original: Let me ask some questions first.
translation: 我先问几个问题。

original: I guess you can tell me about the mission.
translation: 你应该可以和我谈谈任务的事吧。

original: The Chip's been delivered. We're through.
translation: 我已经把筹码带回来了。咱们该两讫了吧。

original: Do you have any idea how prodigious is the opportunity you're casting aside here?
translation: 你知不知道，你放弃了一个多么宝贵的机会？

original: Let me ask some questions first.
translation: 我先问几个问题。

original: I'm listening.
translation: 我听着呢。

original: The next step will require you to infiltrate Caesar's camp at Fortification Hill.
translation: 下一步，你需要潜入凯撒在堡垒山的营地。

original: You'll have to return to Caesar's camp at Fortification Hill.{Player got Chip at CL Fort, didn't activate bunker army}
translation: 你必须要回到凯撒在堡垒山的营地。{Player got Chip at CL Fort, didn't activate bunker army}

original: I'll be on my way, Mr. House.
translation: 我要走了，豪斯先生。

original: No no no, you'll want to hear this out...
translation: 不不不，你必须要听一下……

original: Disappointing. In the extreme.
translation: 失望。极度失望。

original: You think your Securitrons can defeat Caesar's Legion *and* the NCR?
translation: 你觉得你的机器人能同时击败凯撒军团和NCR？

original: Why would I want to go to war against the NCR? They're my best customers.
translation: 我为什么要和NCR开战？他们可是我的老主顾。

original: If their leaders weren't scheming to steal Vegas out from under me, I'd have no troubles with the NCR at all.
translation: 如果他们的领导人没有打算拿下维加斯的话，我是不会和他们起冲突的。

original: Why show your hand like that? Now your enemies know what you're up to.
translation: 你为什么要亮出你的底牌？你的敌人们都知道你要干嘛了。

original: I'm surprised you can still underestimate me after everything you've seen.
translation: 我很惊讶，你已经与我接触了有段时日，居然还会怀疑我的能力。

original: I haven't shown my hand - I've shown one card. I've given my enemies a single, provocative datum upon which to fixate.
translation: 我没有亮出我的底牌——我只是亮出了其中一张而已。我只是为我的敌人立了一个显而易见的靶子，好转移他们的视线。

original: They have no idea what other cards I'm holding. It's a strong hand, believe me - I dealt it to myself.
translation: 他们根本不知道我手中还有什么牌。这张牌可不简单，相信我，我心里有数。

original: I'll be on my way, then...
translation: 那么我先走了……

original: {FORT SECS UP}I must insist that you stay long for me to show you that the Platinum Chip does more than change the pictures on the Securitrons' face screens.
translation: {FORT SECS UP}我希望你能留下来，我要向你展示一下，白金筹码的威力可不仅仅是让电子保安换张脸而已。

original: Events of great import are about to unfold, with you taking a central role. To get started, all you need do is take the elevator all the way down...
translation: 一系列重大的变革就要发生，而你将是这一切的主角，你只需要乘上电梯，一路向下……

original: I must insist that you stay long for me to show you what the Chip does. I promise you'll like what you see...
translation: 我希望你能留下来，我要向你展示一下，白金筹码的威力可不仅仅是让电子保安换张脸而已。

original: Events of great import are about to unfold, with you taking a central role.
translation: 一系列重大的变革就要到来，而你将是这一切的主角。
