original: To get started, all you need to do is take the elevator all the way down to the bottom level...
translation: 你首先要做的是，乘上电梯，一路向下到最底层去……

original: What does the Chip do, exactly?
translation: 筹码到底是做什么的？

original: {FORT SECS UP}Yes, so far as you've seen, all it does is change the picture on the Securitrons' face screens from policemen to soldiers. But as you'll see...
translation: {FORT SECS UP}是啊，到目前为止，你只是看到了机器人脸上的图标从警察变成了士兵而已。但你很快就会发现……

original: Some things are more easily shown than told. Take the elevator all the way down to the bottom level, and you'll see what I mean.
translation: 有些事情百闻不如一见。搭上电梯，到最底层去，你就能明白我的意思了。

original: Don't worry, you'll like what you see. We have much to accomplish, you and I...
translation: 别担心，你会喜欢上那里的小玩意的。我们还有很多事情要去实现呢……

original: What happens next?
translation: 接下来会发生什么？

original: {FORT SECS NO}A great deal shall be happening - a cascade of events, with you taking a central role.
translation: {FORT SECS NO}会发生很多事——一连串的事件，而你将是其中的主角。

original: At the moment, however, all you need to do is take the elevator all the way down to the bottom level. You'll understand soon enough...
translation: 不过现在呢，你要做的就是搭上电梯，一路下到底层。很快你就会明白的……

original: {FORT SECS UP}A great deal shall be happening - a cascade of events, with you taking a central role.
translation: {FORT SECS NO}会发生很多事——一连串的事件，而你将是其中的主角。

original: At the moment, however, all you need to do is take the elevator all the way down to the bottom level.
translation: 不过现在呢，你要做的就是搭上电梯，一路下到底层。

original: What you see there will help you understand the significance of what you accomplished at the Fort.
translation: 等你到了那里，你就会明白自己在城堡所做的一切究竟有何意义。

original: I'm still not giving you the Chip.
translation: 我还是不打算给你筹码。

original: {exasperated sigh}Then this is a waste of time.
translation: {exasperated sigh}那么这就是在浪费时间。

original: Here, take it. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
translation: 喏，给你。<把白金筹码给豪斯先生。>

original: Well enough. We can put the past behind us, I think.
translation: 很好，那咱们就既往不咎了。

original: Here it is. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
translation: 给你。<把白金筹码给豪斯先生。>

original: You want the Chip? Here it is. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
translation: 你想要筹码？给你。 <把白金筹码给豪斯先生。>

original: Not so fast, Mr. House. We need to discuss payment.
translation: 别急，豪斯先生。我们还没谈论酬金呢。

original: I'm not going to give you the Chip.
translation: 我没打算把筹码交给你。

original: I have some questions to ask first...
translation: 我得先问几个问题。

original: This is not the time for Q&A. Kindly hand over the Chip.
translation: 我没空和你玩什么问答游戏，把筹码交出来。

original: I have some questions to ask first...
translation: 我得先问几个问题。

original: This is not the time for Q&A. Kindly hand over the Chip.
translation: 我没空和你玩什么问答游戏，把筹码交出来。

original: I'm not afraid of you, Mr. House. The Platinum Chip belongs to me.
translation: 我并不怕你，豪斯先生。白金筹码是我的了。

original: {ordering attack}You needn't be afraid of me. It's my Securitrons that are going to kill you.
translation: {ordering attack}你的确不必怕我。你该怕的是我的电子保安。

original: Here it is. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
translation: 给你。<把白金筹码给豪斯先生。>

original: {sarcastic}Why, thank you so much. You played that {beat}very poorly, you realize?
translation: {sarcastic}哎呀，非常感谢。你玩的这手{beat}真是太蹩脚了，你知道吗？

original: You're fortunate that I have a certain {beat}tolerance for greed. I expect my business partners to be self-interested - but {unlike you}smartly so.
translation: 你应该庆幸，我对贪婪的人有种特殊的忍耐力。虽然我知道我的生意伙伴可能会惟利是图，但你至少也该用用脑子吧。

original: Attack me and you risk destroying the Chip.
translation: 如果你敢对我动手，那你的筹码也会跟着完蛋。

original: {restraining anger}By the time I was 30 years old, I was a billionaire 30 times over. I founded and ran a vast economic empire.
translation: {restraining anger}我30岁的时候，就已坐拥300亿身家。我创立了一个庞大的经济帝国。

original: {restraining anger}Do you really think I'm going to let an upstart come into my home and ransom my property to me?
translation: {restraining anger}你真的以为，我会让一个无名之辈大摇大摆地走进我的家门，当着我的面勒索我吗？

original: {restraining anger, losing it a little towards end}I spent two centuries searching for the Platinum Chip. It's my invention, my property - mine. Now be a good courier and deliver it!
translation: {restraining anger, losing it a little towards end}为了寻找白金筹码，我花了整整两个世纪。它是我发明的，是我的财产——我的。乖乖把它交出来吧！

original: I'm not going to give you the Chip.
translation: 我不会把筹码给你的。

original: {drawn out}Hmm... {to yourself}How shall I put this?
translation: {drawn out}嗯……{to yourself}我该怎么说呢？

original: {taking time, spelling it out}Delivery of the Platinum Chip is non-negotiable.
translation: {taking time, spelling it out}白金筹码必须送到我这里，没有谈判的余地。

original: I invite you to think carefully about what you do next... standing alone before me, surrounded by my heavily-armed Securitron guards.
translation: 我建议你好好考虑一下目前的处境……你现在正独自一人站在我前面，四周都是全副武装的机器人守卫。

original: Not so fast, Mr. House. We need to discuss payment.
translation: 别心急，豪斯先生。我们还没谈谈酬劳的问题呢。

original: Our terms were clear. Now that you have the Chip in your possession, any attempt to "re-negotiate" payment would be tantamount to blackmail.
translation: 咱们的条件早就谈妥了。你已经拿到筹码，现在还想跟我"讨价还价"，那无异于勒索。

original: I haven't talked to either Colonel Moore or Colonel Hsu yet.
translation: 我还没有和莫尔上校或者许上校谈过。

original: Well then don't waste any more time here. Get going!
translation: 那就不要在这浪费时间了。赶紧出发吧！

original: I received my orders from Colonel Hsu, and am still carrying them out.
translation: 我接受了许上校的指派，现正在执行他的命令。

original: I trust that Hsu will deal with the matter thoughtfully. Regardless, stay on your toes. There's no telling what will happen.
translation: 我相信许会理智地处理此事的。无论如何，你要时刻保持警惕，没人能预料接下来会发生什么。

original: I received my orders from Colonel Moore, and am still carrying them out.
translation: 我接受了莫尔上校的指挥，现在正在执行她的命令。

original: No doubt Colonel Moore's approach will produce results. Just be ready to duck when the bullets start flying.
translation: 毫无疑问莫尔上校的方法会有效果的。只是当子弹向你飞过来的时候，别忘了躲哦。

original: I was hoping you'd know.
translation: 我还以为你知道呢。

original: {Wild Wasteland!}Damn it, I'm an ambassador, not a doctor. You'll have to find some other way.
translation: {Wild Wasteland!}见鬼，我是大使，又不是医生。你最好想想其他的办法。

original: I'm afraid I can't be much help in this matter. My specialty is people and politics, not medicine.
translation: 恐怕这件事我帮不上忙。我的研究领域是民众和政治，不是医学。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Remind me never to get on your bad side. If that's true, then yes, that would be a suitable way to get rid of him.
translation: [成功] 记得提醒我永远别和你为敌。如果这是真的，那就这么办，这会是解决他的一个有效的办法。

original: It looks like you have things well in hand, so I'll leave you to it.
translation: 看起来你是此中老手，那你自己看着办吧。

original: Add a little Psycho to his Jet, and he'd have a heart attack.
translation: 往他的杰特里加一点疯狂药，然后他就会心脏病发了。

original: [FAILED] I doubt it. I've seen junkies live for decades on the stuff. You'd be better off asking someone who knows about these things.
translation: [失败] 我可不敢相信。我看到有的人渣吸毒活了几十年了，你最好找个专家咨询一下。

original: Maybe the jet will cause his heart to give out.
translation: 也许杰特会让他的心脏出问题。

original: I think I'd rather go with the assassination plan.
translation: 我想我更喜欢用暗杀的方法。

original: If that's what you prefer, I won't stop you. Just remember to try to find a way to do it that doesn't lead back to the NCR.
translation: 如果你喜欢的话，我不会阻止你。只是记住别给人家留下指责NCR的把柄。

original: If it just doesn't look possible to make the kill without drawing attention, don't forget there's always the diplomatic approach.
translation: 如果无法在不引起注意的情况下杀死他，那么记着还有外交的方式可以解决问题。

original: Guess I'll go have a talk with the King, then.
translation: 看来我得和猫王谈谈了。

original: I wish you luck. If you run into some difficulty and think you'd rather just take the shot with Pacer, that's fine too.
translation: 祝你好运。如果你发现这么做有难处，想要直接干掉佩瑟的话，我也不反对。

original: What would I need to do?
translation: 我该怎么做呢？

original: Go and talk to the King, try to convince him to put an end to this violence. Pacer's a punk, but he won't likely disobey a direct order.
translation: 去和猫王谈谈，说服他放弃暴力。佩瑟是个混蛋，不过他是不会公然违抗猫王的命令的。

original: The King might not be open to the idea at first, so you may have to ingratiate yourself with him. Do whatever it takes.
translation: 猫王一开始或许不会听你的，所以你可能需要去迎合他。要不惜一切代价。

original: When it's done, one way or the other, report back here and we'll take it from there.
translation: 当你搞定了，无论是用哪一种方式，来这向我汇报，我们会去那接手的。

original: Tell me more about the King.
translation: 和我说说猫王的情况。

original: He's caucasian, in his mid-30s, and extremely charismatic. It's that last part that we're counting on.
translation: 他是个白人，30多岁，拥有非凡的领袖魅力。这最后一点也正是我们要指望的。

original: The Kings are a bunch of young hoodlums who aren't inclined to listen to anyone, except him. Get him on our side, and the rest will fall in line.
translation: 猫王帮是由一群年轻的混混们组成的，他们谁的话都不听，唯独信服他。把他争取过来，其他的人也就搞定了。

original: We'll deal with that should the time come, Pace. Now I'm sure these gentlemen are as anxious to get out of here as we are to see them go.
translation: 等时机成熟，我们会把这事摆平的，佩瑟。现在我估计这帮先生们已经坐立不安，巴不得早点离开这儿了。

original: It appears the Kings are a worthless pack of thugs. Sergeant, they're all yours.
translation: 看起来猫王帮都是群没用的饭桶，中士，他们都交给你了。

original: We're dealing with the King, not you.
translation: 我们只和猫王打交道，没你的事。

original: You're going to have to deal with me whether you like it or not. Get them!
translation: 我才不管你们愿不愿意，总之你们得先过我这一关！干掉他们！

original: [SUCCEEDED] I... No. We would never survive. We need to stick together.
translation: [成功] 我…不，那样我们必死无疑，我们必须团结一致。

original: I'll go with whatever the King decides, but I'll be watching these NCR scumbags like a hawk. If they try anything...
translation: 我服从猫王的决定，但我也会盯着这帮NCR的渣滓。如果他们敢耍什么花招的话……

original: So you'll fight him *and* the NCR? Can the Kings afford to fight each other?
translation: 你想同时跟他*还有*NCR对着干？猫王帮能承受双线开战的后果吗？

original: [FAILED] No, I won't even consider this. We'll show the NCR they can't bully us!
translation: [失败] 不，想都别想。要让NCR知道，骑在我们头上作威作福是不可能的！

original: Just shut up and do what your leader tells you!
translation: 赶快闭嘴，按你们老大说的办！

original: I was afraid this would happen. Sergeant, you know what to do.
translation: 我就担心会变成这样。中士，这儿就交给你了。

original: What the f-? Get the others! Now!
translation: 什么？妈的！快叫其他人来！快！

original: I think that's up to the King.
translation: 我想这得由猫王说了算。

original: Not anymore it isn't. He's not in his right mind if he's even thinking about making a deal with this scum.
translation: 不再是了。如果他想和那个人渣讲和，那他一定是脑子抽筋了。

original: Pacer, I won't let you ruin this opportunity.
translation: 佩瑟，我不会让你坏了我的好事。

original: Let's see you stop me, then. Guys, let's teach these soldier boys a lesson.
translation: 我倒要看看你们怎么阻止我。伙计们，给这帮阿兵哥一点颜色看看。

original: I can't believe what I'm hearing. You're actually going to make a deal with these guys?
translation: 我不敢相信自己的耳朵。你真打算和这些家伙做交易？

original: Pace, this is an opportunity we can't pass up. They're finally recognizing us. This is what we've been fighting for.
translation: 佩瑟，我们不能错过这个机会，他们终于愿意正眼瞧我们了，我们抗争了这么久不就为的这个吗？

original: Like hell it is. This goes against everything we stand for. Everything {stressed}you supposedly stand for.
translation: 胡说八道。这完全违背了我们的初衷，也和你口口声声坚持的信念不一样。

original: I'm not going to listen to them just because they throw a few crumbs my way, and a lot of the guys feel the same way.
translation: 我可不会因为被赏了口剩饭就乖乖摇尾巴，和我想法一样的人多得是。

original: And you. Bringing these assholes in here like you're doing us some kind of favor.
translation: 还有你。是你把这些杂碎引来的，别装得跟没事人一样。

original: You can take your new friends and get the hell out of here, because the answer is no. The Kings will never deal with trash from the NCR.
translation: 赶紧带着你的新朋友滚蛋，我的答案是不。猫王帮从来不和NCR的垃圾做交易。

original: No catch. You just make sure no King attack an NCR citizen from now on.
translation: 不值得。你只要保证猫王帮成员从此不再攻击NCR市民。

original: That's not so bad. I might have to make an example of a few of the more hotheaded guys, but otherwise, that sounds fair.
translation: 也不坏嘛。我恐怕得先抓几个带头闹事的家伙以儆效尤，不过除此之外，这个条件也还算公平。

original: Tell you what. I'll agree to those terms. But the Kings won't lift a finger until we see the first of those supplies.
translation: 这样吧。我接受这些条件。但除非我们亲眼看见第一批物资送到，否则别指望猫王帮有任何动作。

original: They're just here as an escort. Now do you want to hear their offer or not?
translation: 他们只是护送我过来。你到底愿不愿意听听他们的条件？

original: The Kings have to stop the violence against people from the NCR.
translation: 猫王帮必须停止对NCR公民的暴力。

original: Hmmm, people around here *would* be a lot less ornery if there were more supplies to go around. It'd be rough at first, but I think we could manage.
translation: 嗯，如果物资充足，这里的人们*也许*就不会再那么顽劣。虽然一开始可能会很艰难，但我们能挺过去。

original: Tell you what. I'll agree to those terms. But the Kings won't lift a finger until we see the first of those supplies.
translation: 这样吧。我接受这些条件。但除非我们亲眼看见第一批物资送到，否则别指望猫王帮有任何动作。

original: You stop the attacks on NCR citizens, and your supply problems disappear.
translation: 只要你们停止袭击NCR的公民，你们的物资问题就能解决。

original: Just hear them out. They're offering generous terms.
translation: 你就从了吧，他们开出的条件多诱人啊。

original: The NCR is willing to help supply Freeside in exchange for peace.
translation: NCR愿意给自由城提供物资，以换取和平。

original: Freeside gets more food, water, and electricity.
translation: 自由城可以得到更多的食物、水和电。

original: That doesn't sound half bad... what's the catch?
translation: 听起来倒是不错……条件是什么？

original: What if they are?
translation: 万一是呢？

original: Then I'm afraid we're going to have ourselves a tussle. Now say what you came to say or get out.
translation: 那恐怕咱们就要闹得不愉快了。想说什么快说，否则就滚出去。

original: I can't give you these tapes, they are evidence of a crime.
translation: 我不能给你磁带，这些是你的罪证。

original: I guess you've made your choice then. Time to die.
translation: 看来你已经做出选择了。那就去死吧。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, give me the tapes and I'll leave.
translation: [成功] 好吧，给我磁带，我会离开的。

original: I'm going a long way away from Vegas, but you better hope that you and I never see each other again.
translation: 我会走得远远的，不过希望咱俩最好别再碰面。

original: I'll give you the tapes if you promise to leave Vegas and never come back, and give me 200 caps.
translation: 如果你答应离开维加斯，永远不再回来，再付我200个瓶盖，我就把磁带还给你。

original: [FAILED] Sorry, but there's no fucking way I'm going anywhere if those tapes aren't with me.
translation: [失败] 抱歉，拿不到磁带，我哪儿都不会去。

original: If you... um... give me 300 caps and leave Vegas, I'll keep these tapes safe.
translation: 如果你…呃…给我300个瓶盖，并且离开维加斯，我会好好保管这些磁带的。

original: I found the supplies you were looking for.
translation: 我找到了你需要的补给品。

original: I take it my men were dead. It's a high price to pay, but these supplies will save a few lives here.
translation: 我猜我的人都死了。代价太惨重了，但这些补给品可以救营地里的士兵一命。

original: Thanks for finding these. You should check in with the Major, he'll want to know about this.
translation: 谢谢你找到了它们，建议你去找一下少校，应该让他知道这件事。

original: Major Polatli sent me to help you out.
translation: 波拉特里少校派我来帮助你。

original: So the Major has you running errands for him. Well, we're short on personnel as well as supplies so we'll take all the help we can get.
translation: 所以是少校让你来帮他跑腿的。很好，我们这里的人手就像物资一样短缺，我们需要一切可能的帮助。

original: Major Polatli said you might need some help.
translation: 波拉特里少校说你可能需要帮助。

original: With business booming like it is and considering I'm the only person with medical experience in the camp, I could perhaps use a hand.
translation: 在战事如此繁重的情况下，我又是营地里唯一有医疗经验的人，我需要有人能帮我一把。

original: Do you have any medical experience?
translation: 你有医疗经验吗？

original: I don't have time for this.
translation: 我没有时间做这个。

original: I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变了主意，可以随时来这儿找我。

original: I could do that for you.
translation: 我可以帮你。

original: Good, let's not waste time then. Our biggest problems right now are supplies and troops, and the Legion is draining us of both.
translation: 太好了，那我们就别浪费时间了。我们现在最大的问题是补给和兵员，而这两者已经要被军团消耗殆尽了。

original: Quartermaster Mayes has been complaining to me nonstop about the lack of supplies, but unfortunately we aren't getting a resupply any time soon.
translation: 军需官梅伊斯一直在向我抱怨物资短缺的问题，但遗憾的是我们短期内肯定没办法得到补给了。

original: I want you speak with him and see if there's anything you can do for him.
translation: 我希望你去和他谈谈，看看有什么你可以帮助他的。

original: What do you need help with?
translation: 你需要我帮你做什么？

original: I'm short staffed and I don't have the time to take care of some issues around the camp.
translation: 我这里人手短缺，我也没有时间去处理营地里的一些问题。

original: I need someone to talk to a few of the officers and help them resolve some of the problems around here.
translation: 我需要个人去和几个军官谈谈，并帮助他们解决这里的某些问题。

original: I've got the Legion at Nelson breathing down my neck and not enough men or supplies to get this camp into fighting shape so we can strike back.
translation: 纳尔逊的军团部队就在我耳边喘着气，可我却没有足够的人手和物资来使营地进入战斗状态，打个翻身仗。

original: I need someone to talk to a few of the officers and help them resolve some of the problems around here.
translation: 我需要一个人去和营地里的军官谈谈，帮助他们解决这里遇到的一些问题。

original: If I can get this place in order, then I can focus our efforts on taking back Nelson from the Legion.
translation: 如果能把这地方整顿一番，我就能集中力量把纳尔逊从军团手里夺回来。

original: And the more that gets done around here, the more resources I'll be able to put into assaulting Nelson.
translation: 并且，这里整顿得越好，能投入攻打纳尔逊的力量就越多。

original: Speaking of supplies... I found some nearby, are they yours?
translation: 说起补给品……我在附近了找到一些，是你的吗？

original: Damn it all... I sent some men out to get these supplies, but they never returned. I guess the Legion got them on their way back.
translation: 可恶……我派了一些人出去拿这些补给品，但他们没有一个回来。我认为是军团在他们回来的路上袭击了他们。

original: At least we have the supplies. It's not much, but every little bit counts.
translation: 不过至少我们有了补给品。虽然不是很多，但有一点是一点吧。

original: Thanks for finding these. You should check in with the Major, he'll want to know about this.
translation: 谢谢你找到了这些补给，你应该去少校那里报个到，他会想知道这事的。

original: Let's talk about that mission after all.
translation: 还是让我们来谈谈任务吧。

original: Legion?
translation: 军团？

original: What's the trouble with the Legion?
translation: 你们和军团之间有什么嫌隙？

original: Hell, what ain't the trouble with the Legion? This time, they jumped the camp in Nelson while the troopers were setting up
translation: 妈的，和军团还能有什么好事？这次他们趁部队还没安顿好，偷袭了纳尔逊营地。

original: Captured a bunch of gear and took the town. Couple of troopers too. Got 'em crucified down near the center of town.
translation: 抢了不少装备，占了镇子。还把他们抓的几个人钉在了镇中心广附近的十字架上。

original: {carefully}You're one of them "special" folks, ain't you? They ain't... {searching}real snakes, see? They're Legion soldiers.
translation: {carefully}你就是那一类"特别"人群，对吧？他们不是……{searching}真的蛇，明白吗？他们是军团士兵。

original: I just called 'em snakes because they're low down and sneaky. {beat}Like a snake.{sigh}
translation: 我说他们是蛇，是因为他们鬼鬼祟祟。{beat}就像蛇一样。{sigh}

original: Anyway, we always have trouble with the Legion 'round here. This time, they jumped the camp in Nelson while the troopers were setting up.
translation: 总之，我们和军团之间总是麻烦不断。这次，他们趁部队还没安顿好，偷袭了纳尔逊营地。

original: Captured a bunch of gear and took the town. Couple of troopers too. Got 'em crucified down near the center of town.
translation: 抢了不少装备，占了镇子。还把他们抓的几个人钉在了镇中心附近的十字架上。

original: Do you have time for a few questions?
translation: 你有时间回答几个问题么？

original: What's on your mind?
translation: 你在想什么？

original: I'll be on my way. Goodbye.
translation: 我走了，再见。

original: What does the Platinum Chip do?
translation: 白金筹码有什么用？

original: I'll make it up to you. What do we do next?
translation: 我会补偿你的。我们接下来怎么办？

original: That all you've got, robot?
translation: 你就这点本事了吗，机器人？

original: I will require a hardware and software upgrade to offer enhanced services.
translation: 我必须进行硬件和软件升级，好为您提供更好的服务。

original: No chatty games, Santiago. I don't have time for this.
translation: 别废话了，圣地亚哥，我可没空听你瞎扯。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Please leave me alone. I have nothing more to give.
translation: 请离我远点。我没什么能给你的了。

original: If you want to make a go at it, I'll come along.
translation: 如果你真想去，我可以和你一起去。

original: Why?
translation: 为什么？

original: Nelson?
translation: 纳尔逊？

original: Fine, I'll do as you ask.
translation: 好吧，我会找你说的做。

original: What's inside the hatch?
translation: 舱盖里面是什么？

original: I'll do as you ask, Mr. House.
translation: 我会照你说的做的，豪斯先生。

original: What's in it for me?
translation: 对我有什么好处？

original: I'll go to the Fort as you ask.
translation: 我会照你说的前往城堡的。

original: Like I said, I'm not interested.
translation: 我说了，我没兴趣。

original: I'll give you time to think over the consequences of what you're saying. I urge you to reconsider.
translation: 我给你时间考虑一下你说这话的后果。我强烈呼吁你再思考一下。

original: I do have questions to ask.
translation: 我是有些问题要问。

original: I have some questions to ask.
translation: 我有些问题要问。

original: No thanks, Mr. House.
translation: 不，谢了，豪斯先生。

original: No thanks, Mr. House.
translation: 不，谢了，豪斯先生。

original: No thanks, Mr. House.
translation: 不，谢了，豪斯先生。

original: What's my stake in this?
translation: 我能得到什么好处？

original: All right, I'll do as you ask.
translation: 好吧，我会照你说的做的。

original: What's inside the hatch?
translation: 舱盖里头是什么？

original: All right, I'll do as you ask.
translation: 好吧，我会照你说的做。

original: What's my stake in this?
translation: 我能得到什么好处？

original: I'm not offering you an incentive as crude as money - though there'll be plenty of that.
translation: 我所提供的奖励可不像金钱这般庸俗——虽然，钱是必不可少的。

original: What I'm offering you is a ground-floor opportunity in the most important enterprise on Earth.
translation: 我提供的是一个近水楼台的机会，让你能在地球上最重要的机构工作。

original: What I'm offering is a future - for you, and for what remains of the human race.
translation: 我向你提供的是未来——不仅仅向你，还向所有幸存的人类。

original: James Garret is looking for a suave escort. Interested in some work?
translation: 詹姆斯·加勒特想找个有情调的牛郎，你有兴趣吗？

original: I'm honored they would consider me. I'll start immediately.
translation: 他们能想到我，真是太荣幸了，我马上去。

original: What are you selling?
translation: 你都卖什么？

original: Have a look, baby.
translation: 来看看吧，宝贝。

original: No, not really.
translation: 并没有。

original: Without any medical experience, you're not going to be much use to me in here.
translation: 没有任何医疗经验的话，你在我这就没什么用了。

original: However, you can take this status report back to Major Polatli. It's a very important task and I think I can count on you.
translation: 不过，你可以帮我把这份状况报告带给波拉特里少校。我相信你能完成这项非常重要的任务。

original: <Lie> You betcha!
translation: <撒谎> 那还用说！

original: Excellent. As you can see, we have a lot of injured troopers here and I haven't had time to look at all of them yet.
translation: [成功] 好极了。如你所见，在这有很多伤兵，而我没时间一个个检查。

original: Since you have some medical experience, I'd like you to examine them and see what you can do to treat them.
translation: 既然你有些医疗经验，那么我想让你检查下他们然后酌情进行医疗。

original: Yes. I have some medical experience.
translation: 是，我有一些医疗经验。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Excellent. As you can see, we have a lot of injured troopers here and I haven't had time to look at all of them yet.
translation: [成功] 好极了。如你所见，在这有很多伤兵，而我没时间一个个检查。

original: Since you have some medical experience I'd like you to examine them and see what you can do to treat them.
translation: 既然你有些医疗经验，那么我想让你检查下他们然后酌情进行医疗。

original: I'll need some time to prepare.
translation: 我需要些时间做准备。

original: Come back when you're ready.
translation: 准备好了就过来。

original: I'm ready. Let's do it!
translation: 我准备好了，开始进攻吧！

original: Excellent. Killing the Legion commanders in Nelson will severely cripple the Legion forces and allow us to take back the city.
translation: 太好了。击杀纳尔逊军团的指挥官们将重创军团部队，进而帮助我们夺回这座小城。

original: Meet up with Sergeant Cooper just outside Nelson. He will assist you in reclaiming Nelson.
translation: 去纳尔逊镇外和库珀中士碰头吧，他会协助你夺回纳尔逊的。

original: What do you want me to do now?
translation: 你现在希望我做些什么？

original: Well, with that over with and the Legion forces at Nelson defeated, we finally have some breathing room.
translation: 嗯，事情完结了，纳尔逊的军团部队也被打败了，我们现在终于有了个喘息的机会了。

original: Now we can actually try to strengthen our forces along the river and prepare for the upcoming battle at Hoover Dam.
translation: 现在我们终于可以沿着河流加强我们的军事力量，并为即将到来的胡佛水坝之战做准备了。

original: With the help you've given us, we're doing a little bit better, but we still have the Legion forces at Nelson to deal with.
translation: 在你的帮助下，局面有所好转，但军团在纳尔逊的军事存在仍然是个问题。

original: If we can retake Nelson, that will be a huge help to our efforts in this area and give us an advantage at Hoover Dam.
translation: 如果可以夺回纳尔逊，那将对我们在该地区的形势带来巨大的帮助，并能使我们在胡佛水坝之战中占得优势。

original: I've finished helping Dr. Richards.
translation: 理查兹医生那边的事，我已经做完了。

original: I heard from Dr. Richards. Too bad you weren't able to help him with anything, but we all can't be doctors.
translation: 我从理查兹医生那里听说了。很糟糕你没能帮上任何忙，但毕竟不是人人都当得了医生。

original: I heard from Dr. Richards and I wouldn't call what you did helping. We need all the men we can get on the frontline.
translation: 我从理查兹医生那里听说了，但我不觉得你是在帮忙。我们需要让尽可能多的士兵上前线。

original: I heard from Dr. Richards. I'm glad you were at least some use to him.
translation: 我从理查兹医生那里听说了。我很高兴你多少还是有点用处的。

original: Dr. Richards said you did a good job in there. That's mighty high praise coming from him.
translation: 理查兹医生说你帮上了大忙。他能这么说，已经是一个很高的评价了。

original: I've helped Quartermaster Mayes get some supplies.
translation: 我已经帮军需官梅伊斯弄到了一些补给品。

original: I heard. The extra supplies will help for a short time, but that only solves one of our problems.
translation: 我听说了，这些额外的补给品可以让我们维持一小段时间，但这只解决了我们的一个问题。

original: With all the Legion raids lately, we're running low on troops that can still fight. Some are injured, but even more are dead.
translation: 因为近期不断遭到军团的袭击，我们可以作战的兵员变得越来越少。一些人受了伤，但更多的人牺牲了。

original: I want you to check in with Dr. Richards and see if he needs any help getting our troops back on the front line.
translation: 我希望你去理查兹医生那里报到，看看他需要些什么帮助，好让我们的伤员能够尽快返回前线。

original: I finished looking over your patients.
translation: 我已经检查完你的病人了。

original: Excellent job. Where did you learn how to do all that? I don't think that I could have done much better myself. Very impressive.
translation: 真是厉害。你在哪学的这些？我不觉得我有这么好的医术。令人敬佩。

original: As for the men, they'll recover soon and be back on the front lines in no time. Ahh... the circle of life.
translation: 至于那些士兵，他们会很快痊愈然后返回前线。呵……生死循环。

original: I'll send word to Major Polatli about your work here. Once again, you have my sincerest thanks.
translation: 我会把你的所作所为告诉波拉特里少校的。再一次真诚地感谢你。

original: Not too bad, at least you didn't kill anyone.
translation: 不算太差，至少你没医死人。

original: They'll recover soon and be back on the front lines in no time. Ahh... the circle of life.
translation: 他们会很快痊愈然后返回前线。呵……生死循环。

original: I'll send word to Major Polatli about your work here. Thanks.
translation: 我会把你的所作所为告诉波拉特里少校的。谢了。

original: I'm looking for information.
translation: 我想打听点事。

original: Sorry, it's not my business to get involved.
translation: 抱歉，我的业务不包括传播小道消息。

original: Let me see what you have.
translation: 让我看看你这儿都有什么。

original: Here you go.
translation: 就是这样。

original: I need you to stop the violence against NCR citizens.
translation: 我想请你阻止针对NCR平民的暴力袭击。

original: Is that so? That's a mighty tall order for someone I barely know. Now, if you were to help me out some, that might change my mind.
translation: 是吗？咱们俩才刚认识，你就提这种要求，真的让我很为难。如果你愿意帮我的忙，我也许会改变主意。

original: Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 还有别的事吗？

original: I'd like to help you out, especially considering all you've done, but that's a pretty big favor you're asking for, and you've already used yours.
translation: 考虑到你替我做了不少事，我也确实乐意帮你，但这个忙实在不好帮，而且我也已经还清了欠你的人情。

original: Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 你还有别的要求吗？

original: Well, if you can't do it...
translation: 哎呀，如果你做不到的话……

original: Hold on now, I didn't say I couldn't do it, just that I couldn't guarantee it, and even that's probably stretching the truth a little.
translation: 等一下，我可没说我做不到，只是不能保证罢了。而且就连这种话都有些言过其实。

original: Just leave everything to me. I'll see that the violence stops. But this makes us even, you hear?
translation: 总之交给我吧。我会制止暴力的。但这样一来咱们就两清了，你明白吗？

original: The Kings will follow your leadership.
translation: 猫王帮会听从你的领导的。

original: Damn straight they will. It's some of the other locals that I'm worried about.
translation: 他们当然会。我担心的是其他人。

original: On second thought, if I can whip this band of hooligans into obedience, a stray tough guy or two shouldn't be a problem.
translation: 不过转念一想，既然我能让这群流氓混混听我的话，那教训一两只癞皮狗应该不成问题。

original: Okay, you've got a deal. No more violence against the NCR on my watch. But this makes us even, you hear?
translation: 好吧，一言为定。只要有我在，就不会再有针对NCR平民的暴力行为。但这样一来咱们就两清了，你明白吗？

original: All I'm asking is that you try.
translation: 我只想请你试一试。

original: I'll give it my best. You've earned that much. But this makes us even, you hear?
translation: 我会尽力的。毕竟是我欠你的。不过这样的话，咱们可就两清了，明白吗？

original: I need you to stop the violence against NCR citizens in Freeside.
translation: 我想请你出面阻止自由城里针对NCR市民的暴力事件。

original: Whoa... that's a doozy. Truth be told, I don't even know if I can pull something like that off.
translation: 哇……这可了不得。实话告诉你，我觉得这件事我也无能为力。

original: I wanted to talk about something else.
translation: 我想聊点别的。

original: Fine by me, just remember I owe you one. Now what did you want to talk about?
translation: 没问题，不过你记着，我还欠你个人情。你想聊点什么？

original: I'd like to think about it.
translation: 我想再考虑一下。

original: That's a good idea. I don't give out favors everyday, so you probably shouldn't rush to pick something.
translation: 好主意。我可不是每天都愿意做顺水人情，所以你最好还是别太匆忙做决定。

original: Tumble it around in your mind and come back when you know what you want. I'll be here.
translation: 仔细考虑清楚，等你搞明白自己究竟想要什么再回来吧。我随时在这里恭候大驾。

original: I could really use some money...
translation: 我真的需要钱……

original: Caps are a little tight these days, but with our guards making more and those supplies comin' in I reckon I can spare some.
translation: 我们的手头也不宽裕，不过考虑到我们派出的保镖最近赚得不错，物资补给也陆续进来了不少，我想给你点钱也不算什么。

original: Can you get me into the Strip?
translation: 你能让我进入长街吗？

original: Sure can. I have a friend who has just what you're looking for, has a shop over yonder by the east gate, named Mick & Ralph's.
translation: 当然可以。我有个朋友，他正是你要找的人。在东门外有家店，店名是米克和拉尔夫杂货店。

original: Just tell Ralph that I sent you and he'll get you squared away.
translation: 你去找拉尔夫，就说是我介绍你来的，他会好好招待你的。

original: I want to join the Kings.
translation: 我想加入猫王帮。

original: Normally, we don't let outsiders join, but I think I can make an exception in your case. I'll have one of the guys spread the word.
translation: 通常来说，我们不允许外人加入，但我可以给你破个例。我会派人把话传出去。

original: From this day forward, you're one of us, and no one in Freeside will mess with you if they know what's good for them.
translation: 从今天起，你就是我们的一员了。今后在自由城，只要是懂得好歹的人，都不会再找你麻烦了。

original: In addition, if you want to do something about that hair of yours, talk to Sergio. I'll let him know you're coming.
translation: 此外，如果你想换个发型，可以去找塞尔吉奥。我会提前和他打声招呼的。

original: Perhaps more importantly, you've earned the right to wear something a little more stylish. Here, wear it proudly.
translation: 不过更重要的是，你终于有资格让自己的装扮赶上时代潮流了。来吧，自豪地穿上这件外套吧。

original: Normally, we don't let outsiders join, and you'd be the first female King ever, but I think I can make an exception in your case.
translation: 通常来说，我们不允许外人加入，何况你还是一名女性，但我也许可以给你破个例。

original: From this day forward, you're one of us, and no one in Freeside will mess with you if they know what's good for them.
translation: 从今天起，你就是我们的一员了。今后在自由城，只要是懂得好歹的人，都不会再找你麻烦了。

original: In addition, if you want to do something about that hair of yours, talk to Sergio. I'll let him know you're coming.
translation: 此外，如果你想换个发型，可以去找塞尔吉奥。我会提前和他打声招呼的。

original: Perhaps more importantly, you've earned the right to wear something a little more stylish. Here, wear it proudly.
translation: 不过更重要的是，你终于有资格让自己的装扮赶上时代潮流了。来吧，自豪地穿上这件外套吧。

original: Keep it to yourself, but Hanlon is the one behind the misinformation. He's got a plan.
translation: 我说了你可不要告诉别人，汉隆是信息误报的幕后主使。他有他的打算。

original: The Chief? But, he's a legend! I guess if he's got a plan behind it all, who am I to question it? I won't say a word about it to anyone else.
translation: 军士长？但，他是传奇人物啊！就算他真的有什么计划，我又有什么资格质疑？这件事我不会跟别人说的。

original: Can I join the Kings?
translation: 我可以加入猫王帮吗？

original: Whoa, there. Not just anyone can be a King. First of all, we usually only accept people native to the area.
translation: 哇，等一下。不是所有人都能加入猫王帮。首先，我们一般只接收本地人。

original: Second, I have to approve. And I don't. You haven't shown me you've got what it takes to be a King yet.
translation: 其次，必须得到我的批准。而我现在不会这么做。因为你还没有展示出一名猫王帮成员所需的品质。

original: But if you're fixin' to join something fierce, stick around, and if you play your cards right, things might change.
translation: 但如果你能保持一副热心肠，多在这儿走动，那只要你用对了心思，也许我的想法就会改变。

original: I have questions about something else.
translation: 我还有其他问题。

original: What did you want to talk about?
translation: 你想谈点什么？

original: You don't hate the Legion for what it did to your tribe?
translation: 军团对你的部落做了那么过分的事，你就不恨他们吗？

original: We were savages. The Legion raised us up, made us better than what we were.
translation: 我们以前是野蛮人。是军团开化了我们，让我们过上了更好的生活。

original: What happened to the rest of your tribe?
translation: 你们部落其他人怎么样了？

original: The girls and women were enslaved, and many of the men and boys were also chosen to become Legionaries. The rest were killed.
translation: 女的都成了奴隶，男的许多和我一样成了军团士兵。剩下的都被杀了。

original: How did you end up joining the Legion?
translation: 你后来怎么加入军团的？

original: When I was a boy, the Legion conquered my tribe. I was chosen for training as a Legionary.
translation: 军团在我很小的时候便征服了我所在的部落。我受到征召，成为了军团士兵。

original: I fought in many battles for the Legion. Eventually, Caesar chose me to lead his Praetorian Guard. It was a great honor.
translation: 我为军团流过不少血。最终，凯撒挑选我来率领他的禁卫军。这是莫大的荣耀。

original: I don't have any more questions. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我问完了。我们谈点儿别的吧。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: I had some general questions for you.
translation: 我有些问题要问你。

original: I'll answer if I can.
translation: 只要能回答的，我言无不尽。

original: Why do you want to know?
translation: 你问这个干什么？

original: I ask because Caesar once had a similar pet, but it was lost during a battle.
translation: 我问你，是因为凯撒以前有只差不多的宠物，不过在一次战斗中阵亡了。

original: <Lie> He just started following me one day. I have no idea where he came from.
translation: <撒谎> 他是突然就开始跟着我的。我都不知道他从哪儿冒出来的。

original: I see. That's very strange.
translation: 明白了。那可就奇怪了。

original: Rex? I picked him up in New Vegas.
translation: 雷克斯？我是在新维加斯遇到他的。

original: Oh? Such things are common in Denver, but I didn't know that other cities had them as well.
translation: 哦？它这种东西在丹佛很常见，但我没想到其它城市也有。

original: Have you ever met Caesar?
translation: 你见过凯撒吗？

original: I haven't had the pleasure. I have crossed paths with Legate Lanius, his second-in-command, however. It was... unpleasant.
translation: 我可没那福气。我倒是在路上遇到过拉尼厄斯特使，他是军团的二把手，不过那次经历……并不愉快。

original: {Child At Heart}Don't worry - I won't tell on you if you don't tell on me.
translation: {童心未泯}别担心——咱俩都不说，谁也不知道。

original: Okay. Um... do you think you could help me?
translation: 好的，嗯……那你能帮帮我吗？

original: < Speech - 50 >
[SUCCEEDED] I guess that's okay. Um, if you're a friend, can you help me?
translation: [成功] 呃……我觉得，应该没问题。好吧，如果你真是朋友的话，帮我个忙怎么样？

original: I'm a friend. It's okay for you to talk to friends, right?
translation: 我是好人，是你的朋友，和朋友说话没问题的，对吧？

original: [FAILED] I'm not allowed to talk to you. Bye.
translation: [失败] 我不可以和你说话，再见。

original: I just have some questions. It'll probably be okay to talk to me.
translation: 我只是想问你几个问题，我不会伤害你的。

original: <Talks about their reason behind visiting New Vegas>
translation: <谈论他们访问新维加斯的真实目的>

original: <Talks about her home>
translation: <谈论她的家乡>

original: <Talks about Heck Gunderson>
translation: <谈论赫克·冈德森>

original: <Talks about being a rancher>
translation: <谈论成为农场工人>

original: <Talks about Walter's plans>
translation: <谈论沃尔特的计划>

original: <Ethel's goodbyes>
translation: <埃塞尔告辞>

original: So, 250 for Ted it is?
translation: 那泰德的命就250瓶盖咯？

original: That's what we said. So, do we have a deal?
translation: 是有这么一说。那么，我们成交？

original: Ted's worth 500 to you, then?
translation: 泰德的命对你来说值500瓶盖咯？

original: That's what we said. So, do we have a deal?
translation: 是有这么一说。那么，我们成交？

original: Heck for 500, correct?
translation: 赫克的命值500瓶盖，我们谈好的，对吧？

original: That's what we said. So, do we have a deal?
translation: 是有这么一说。那么，我们成交？

original: We said 1000 for Heck, right?
translation: 赫克的命值1000瓶盖，我们谈好的，对吧？

original: That's what we said. So, do we have a deal?
translation: 是有这么一说。那么，我们成交？

original: You might like to know that Heck's barely protected, right now.
translation: 有件事你可能想知道，现在赫克基本已经没什么人保护了。

original: So, Ted's nowhere to be found and Heck's quite unprotected while looking for him, huh?
translation: 所以，由于找不到泰德，赫克就把他所有的保镖都派出去了？

original: Hell, it sounds like the perfect time to get even. Heck won't know what hit him, what do you say?
translation: 妈的，听起来是个千载难逢的好机会啊。赫克这下是要连自己怎么死的都不知道了，你觉得呢？

original: Let's talk prices.
translation: 我们来谈谈价钱。

original: I hear you. What's on your mind?
translation: 我听着呢。你想说什么？

original: Consider it done.
translation: 等着好消息吧。

original: All right, kid! Be good.
translation: 好的，孩子！保重。

original: Consider it done.
translation: 等着好消息吧。

original: All right, kid! Be good.
translation: 好的，孩子！保重。

original: Consider it done.
translation: 等着好消息吧。

original: All right, kid! Be good.
translation: 好的，孩子！保重。

original: Consider it done.
translation: 等着好消息吧。

original: All right, kid! Be good.
translation: 好的，孩子！保重。

original: Consider it done.
translation: 等着好消息吧。

original: All right, kid! Be good.
translation: 好的，孩子！保重。

original: Kid, look around you, there's poison and death everywhere, and people like Heck are responsible for the misery we suffer.
translation: 孩子，看看这四周吧，到处是毒药，到处是死亡，像赫克这样的人，就应该为我们遭受到的痛苦负责。

original: What right do they have to continue with their mischief and killing, huh?
translation: 他们有什么权力肆无忌惮地作恶和杀人，嗯？

original: Heck's life? That's big game, a 1000 caps.
translation: 赫克的命？这可不是闹着玩的，1000瓶盖。

original: [FAILED] Cut that in half and we got a clean deal, kid.
translation: [失败] 价码砍掉一半，咱们就成交，孩子。

original: Heck's life and a safe future have a steep price, Walter. 1000 caps' my fee.
translation: 既要取赫克的命，又要确保将来无虞。这价码可不低啊，沃尔特。我要1000瓶盖。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I'll pay that much and die a happy man when my time comes. So, we got a deal?
translation: [成功] 反正这钱我出得起，等我大限到的那天，我宁愿自己开开心心地走。那咱们一言为定？

original: Maybe Heck would listen to your pleas if his son's life was at stake.
translation: 如果他儿子有生命危险，没准赫克会听你的意见。

original: A ransom? I doubt that snake's got enough soul to care that much for his own youngin. Besides, what's to stop him after his son's returned?
translation: 勒索他？我很怀疑这条毒蛇会关心自己的崽子。再说，万一以后我们把他儿子还回去了，又怎么和他谈条件？

original: Nah, Heck only knows greed and pain, kid. It's high time he got paid back in kind. His life, or his son's, either way I win.
translation: 没用的，赫克眼里只有贪婪和痛苦。也该让他尝尝一报还一报的滋味了。要么是他自己的命，要么是他儿子的命，无论怎样，都是我赢。

original: Yes.
translation: 是的。

original: No Vegas-banned items here, buddy. Just high quality standard stock.
translation: 我这儿不卖违禁品，伙计。虽然是日常货物，但都质量上乘。

original: No.
translation: 不。

original: [SUCCEEDED] In that case, yes I do.
translation: [成功] 这样的话，我倒是有一些。

original: Follow me.
translation: 跟我来。

original: [FAILED] All of my guns are special. If anything catches your eye, let me know.
translation: [失败] 我的商品都很特别，看中什么就告诉我。

original: Do you have any special items for sale?
translation: 你这儿有卖什么“特别商品”吗？

original: Why, do you work for one of the casinos?
translation: 怎么，你是在给某个赌场卖命吗？

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Anything else you want?
translation: 还有别的事吗？

original: <Pay 10 caps>
translation: <支付10个瓶盖>

original: Don't get wise. We charge per use, so make that first drink worth the caps.
translation: 别耍小聪明。我们按次收费，所以要珍惜点，别浪费了。

original: Can I buy bottled water?
translation: 我能买瓶装水吗？

original: Sure thing.
translation: 当然的。

original: How much for a drink?
translation: 水怎么卖？

original: Just a few caps for a good long swig.
translation: 只要几个瓶盖，就能买一大杯。

original: You already paid, bub. Get a drink then come back and see me if you still want more.
translation: 你已经付过了，伙计。先把水喝完，等有需要了再来找我。

original: Why charge for water?
translation: 为什么水也要收钱？

original: If we let everyone run amok, the damn NCR would shut us down. Gotta have some way to regulate usage.
translation: 如果让大家随意取用的话，NCR就会关掉水泵。总得想办法立个规矩。

original: The pump is property of The King. You'll need to pay if you want a drink.
translation: 这个抽水泵归猫王帮所有，想喝水就要付钱。

original: <Lie> I wasn't able to find out anything.
translation: <撒谎> 我没有发现什么。

original: That's too bad. These men really needed those supplies.
translation: 那就太糟糕了。这些士兵真的需要那些补给。

original: Thanks for looking into this, I appreciate it even though you didn't find anything.
translation: 谢谢你帮忙调查，我真的很感激，即使你没有发现任何情况。

original: No, not yet.
translation: 不，还没有。

original: Let me know when you do find something out.
translation: 如果你发现了些什么，就告诉我。

original: Yes. Private Stone was stealing them.
translation: 是。列兵斯通偷的。

original: Is that so! I'll have to talk to Major Polatli about this right away.
translation: 是这样吗！我要马上报告波拉特里少校。

original: I appreciate you doing this for me. Here's a little something for your trouble, it's not much, but it's all I can spare.
translation: 你帮我做这件事让我非常感激。这里是一点小意思，数量不多，但是我只能省出这么多了。

original: I wanted to talk to you about your missing medical supplies.
translation: 我想和你谈谈丢失医疗用品的事情。

original: I heard Private Stone turned himself in for stealing my medical supplies. You have my thanks.
translation: 我听说列兵斯通已经自首，是他偷了我的医疗用品。谢谢你。

original: Are you willing to look into this for me?
translation: 你想帮我调查这件事吗？

original: So you've found out what's happening with the supplies?
translation: 你已经找到补给失踪的原因了？

original: What would you like to know?
translation: 你想知道些什么？

original: Seems easy enough.
translation: 听起来很简单。

original: It's easy. Just bring back any NCR dogtags you find and I'll try to make it worth your while.
translation: 确实简单。你只要把发现的NCR狗牌都带回来就行了，我会给你合适的报酬的。

original: I found some NCR dogtags.
translation: 我找到了一些NCR狗牌。

original: Hey, you've been a big help. I wanted to give you something for helping me out. It's not much, but here you go.
translation: 嘿，你帮了不少忙。我很早就想给你些东西作为回报了。虽然不是很多，拿走吧。

original: Good work. If you find any more, you know where to find me.
translation: 做得好。如果你还能找到更多的狗牌，记得回来向我报告。

original: Uh, no thanks, maybe later.
translation: 啊，不了，谢谢，或许下次吧。

original: Suit yourself. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 随你吧。但是，你要是改变了主意就告诉我。

original: It depends on what sort of thing.
translation: 那要看是什么类型的事情了。

original: I'm always willing to give a helping hand.
translation: 我向来都很乐于助人。

original: I want you to collect NCR dogtags from our fallen troopers. That way I can keep track of who's gone and how to reallocate our supplies.
translation: 我要你回收死去的NCR骑兵身上的狗牌。这样我就可以了解谁已经死了，并及时调整给养的分配。

original: About that thing you wanted...
translation: 关于你问我的那件事……

original: Have you changed your mind? Are you willing to help me out with something real simple?
translation: 你改变主意了吗？你愿意帮我做一点简单的小事吗？

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: Me? I've been doing this shit for far too long and have been in too many battles to remember.
translation: 我吗？我干这破事不知有多少年了，也经历了数不清的战斗。

original: Still... this has got to be one of the worst situations I've been in. Not too much I can do about it but do my job and do it right.
translation: 尽管如此……这是我经历过的最糟糕的情况了。我也没什么办法，只能干好该干的，别犯错吧。

original: How're things around the camp?
translation: 营地的情况如何？

original: Not good. If we don't get more supplies, we're going to have to start using dirt for food and sticks and rocks for weapons.
translation: 不是很好。如果我们再得不到更多的补给，我们就要开始吃泥巴填肚子，用木棍和石头打仗了。

original: Hey, how'd you like to do something for me?
translation: 嘿，你愿意为我做些事吗？

original: Better now that all those Legion troops in Nelson are dead. The NCR might actually have a chance of kicking their asses after all.
translation: 现在好多了，纳尔逊那边的军团部队都完蛋了。NCR终于有机会可以狠狠教训他们一顿了。

original: Things are still pretty damn rough, but we're keeping it together.
translation: 情况依旧很糟，但我们还可以控制。

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才>

original: [SUCCEEDED] I think you're right. I've been through worse. I'll go to the fort and see if the Followers can watch over me while I recover.
translation: [成功] 你说的对。更糟的情况我都熬过来了。我会去天启追随者的要塞，看看他们能不能帮助我康复。

original: Jacob, be strong. You just need the support of your friends to get through this.
translation: 雅各布，坚强点。只要有朋友的支持，你一定会挺过去的。

original: [FAILED] Get the hell out of here. Think you're one of the Followers of the Apocalypse or something?
translation: [失败] 给我滚出去，你当自己是天启追随者啊？

original: Jacob, drugs are for the weak.
translation: 雅各布，只有弱者才靠毒品。

original: I've got the detox chems you need.
translation: 我拿来了你要的戒毒药。

original: Thank God! I thought I was going to die if you didn't come back soon.
translation: 感谢上帝！你要是再不来，我就要死了。

original: I'm going to head to the Followers' fort to get some rest and detox. You've saved my life, friend.
translation: 我准备去天启追随者的要塞强制戒断一阵子，顺便休养一下。是你救了我的命，朋友。

original: Thank God! I thought I was going to die if you didn't come back soon.
translation: 感谢上帝！你要是再不来，我就要死了。

original: I'm going to head to the Followers' fort to get some rest and detox. You've saved my life, friend.
translation: 我准备去天启追随者的要塞强制戒断一阵子，顺便休养一下。是你救了我的命，朋友。

original: What was I supposed to do again?
translation: 再告诉我一下我该做什么？

original: Either kill Pacer in a way that doesn't lead back to us, or talk the King into quelling the violence. It's not really that hard to remember.
translation: 要么杀了佩瑟，但别让人怀疑到我们头上；要么说服猫王让他们停止暴力行为。这些不难记住吧。

original: In any case, I expect to hear good news about this in the future. Keep me informed of your progress.
translation: 不论怎样，我希望我能听到你的好消息。如果你有了进展，记得回来向我报告。

original: Mr. Soren, please get to the point. The second half of your payment is late and I want to know why.
translation: 索伦先生，请说重点吧。你还有一半的款项没和我们结清，我想知道为什么。

original: Ms. Van Graff, my associates and I have decided that we wish to renegotiate the terms of our deal.
translation: 范格拉夫小姐，我和我的伙伴们觉得我们可能得重新评估一下这笔交易。

original: Might I ask for what reason? The shipment was delivered. The guns were tested before leaving this facility.
translation: 我能问问理由吗？货都已经发了，而且发货之前还验过的。

original: Regardless, we feel that the quality of the weapons is below expectation, and hoped to adjust the price accordingly.
translation: 但我们认为，那些武器的质量并没有达到我们的预期，所以我们要求调整一下价格。

original: Ah, I think I understand what the issue here is. Excuse me for a moment, would you?
translation: 啊，我知道问题出在哪儿了。请您稍等一下，可以吗？

original: Never break faith with the Van Graffs, Mr. Soren.
translation: 永远不要和范格拉夫家族耍花招，索伦先生。

original: I expect you'll have the rest of our payment ready tomorrow morning.
translation: 我希望在明天上午之前，剩余的款项能够结清。

original: Do it.
translation: 动手。

original: W-What is this, Ms. Van Graff?
translation: 这、这是什么意思，范·格拉夫小姐？

original: This is a lesson, Mr. Soren. A lesson in faith.
translation: 给您上一堂课，索伦先生，一堂诚信课。

original: I don't understand. Who is this man? What does this have to do with our deal?
translation: 我不明白，这个人是谁？和我们的生意又有什么关系？

original: Jean-Baptiste, could you bring out the volunteer?
translation: 杰·巴普迪斯特，能给我把那位志愿者带过来吗？

original: I always have what it takes.
translation: 我当然有那本事。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, confident. I like that.
translation: [成功] 哦，很自信。我喜欢。

original: So, what do you want to do with what you've got?
translation: 那么，你打算怎么展现你的本事呢？

original: I... don't know, uh, what does it take?
translation: 我…不知道，什么本事？

original: [FAILED] {Chuckles}Haha, not too bright, huh? It takes caps, honey, lots of them.
translation: [失败] 哈哈，你好像不大灵光啊？亲爱的，那可是需要瓶盖的，大把的瓶盖。

original: I just want to ask you some questions.
translation: 我只是想问你些问题。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All right, honey. What do you want to know?
translation: 好的，甜心。你想知道些什么？

original: I'd like to know more about you.
translation: 我想更多地了解你。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: I have questions about Gomorrah.
translation: 我想问有关蛾摩拉的问题。

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: What can you tell me about the Omertas?
translation: 关于黑手党你能告诉我些什么？

original: You'd best hold your tongue... friend, or someone here will take care of it, for good.
translation: 最好别乱说话……朋友，不然小心你舌头不保。

original: What do you want to know about those sons of bitches?
translation: 对这些狗娘养的东西，你想知道什么？

original: I'll see you soon, I'm sure.
translation: 我敢肯定，我们会再见面的。

original: Follow me, hon.
translation: 跟我来，甜心。

original: Follow me, hon.
translation: 跟我来，甜心。

original: Follow me, hon.
translation: 跟我来，甜心。

original: Okay. See you soon.
translation: 好的，再见。

original: Follow me, hon.
translation: 跟我来，甜心。

original: I'll... I'm sure something good.
translation: 我……我敢说我很不错。

original: [FAILED] Honey, I've had better than just "good." And you were being so amusing...
translation: [失败] 甜心，我要的人可不止是"不错"，也罢，我看你这人挺有意思的…

original: Okay, we can have more fun together, but it's not going to be free, hon.
translation: 好吧，想找乐子没问题，可是你得花钱哦，甜心。

original: The better question is what are *you* going to do with it.
translation: 我觉得，这个问题应该是要问你才对。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh my, aren't you something else...!? I guess you'll have to see for yourself what I can do, huh?
translation: [成功] 哦，你还挺有一套的嘛……看来你是想亲自领教一下我的能耐咯？

original: Consider it "on the house," honey.
translation: 那这趟就当我请了，甜心。

original: The better question is what are *you* going to do with it.
translation: 我觉得，这个问题应该是要问你才对。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh my, aren't you something else...!? I guess you'll have to see for yourself what I can do, huh?
translation: [成功] 哦，想不到你还挺有一套的嘛……你是想亲自领教我的能耐咯？

original: Consider it "on the house," honey.
translation: 那这趟就当我请了，甜心。

original: Lead the way.
translation: 带路。

original: Lead the way.
translation: 带路。

original: How does a 100 caps sound?
translation: 100个瓶盖怎么样？

original: Fine. Are you ready?
translation: 好的，准备好了吗？

original: How does 75 caps sound?
translation: 75个瓶盖怎么样？

original: Well... ladies are always a welcome change.
translation: 嗯……淑女们并不在意一点点讨价还价。

original: Fine. Are you ready?
translation: 好的，准备好了吗？

original: I am. Lead the way.
translation: 好了，带路吧。

original: I am. Lead the way.
translation: 好了，带路吧。

original: Actually, I'm short on caps right now.
translation: 其实，我手头有点紧。

original: {Irritated Disappointment}Damn shame. Anything else I can do for you?
translation: {Irritated Disappointment}真是可惜啊。那还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: Actually, I'm short on caps right now.
translation: 其实，我手头有点紧。

original: {Irritated Disappointment}Damn shame. Anything else I can do for you?
translation: {Irritated Disappointment}真是可惜啊。那还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: I have some questions.
translation: 我有一些问题。

original: Actually, let me ask you some questions.
translation: 其实，我是想问你一些问题。

original: I just have some questions for you.
translation: 我只是有些问题要问你。

original: What's your story?
translation: 你的身世是怎样的？

original: Oh, nothing special, hon. I'm the best lay in Gomorrah, and that's all you need to know.
translation: 哦，没什么可问的，甜心。我是蛾摩拉的当家头牌，你知道这个就行了。

original: Do you like it here?
translation: 你喜欢这里吗？

original: I like that you're here, doesn't that make you happy?
translation: 只要你在这里，我就喜欢。你开心吗？

original: Let's talk about having fun.
translation: 我们谈谈找乐子的事吧。

original: Let's go back to my other questions.
translation: 让我们谈谈其他问题吧。

original: What's the deal with Gomorrah?
translation: 蛾摩拉到底是个什么地方？

original: It's your paradise on this desolate earth, hon. Your troubles are gone, your pain forgotten, and your dreams come true.
translation: 它是这座荒芜星球上的天堂。在这里，你能摆脱所有烦恼，忘却一切痛苦，你的美梦将会成真。

original: Tell me about Gomorrah's clients.
translation: 说说蛾摩拉的客人们吧。

original: Everyone wants a piece of their own personal heaven. So, they come here, for hours... and hours, hon{chuckles}.
translation: 每个人都想分得属于自己的那一片天堂。于是他们到这儿来，一待就是很久……很久，甜心。

original: Military men, NCR ranchers, wandering travelers... they're all the same without their clothes on. What they want, the Omertas provide.
translation: 有当兵的，有NCR的工人，有流浪的旅行者……他们脱了衣服都一个样。无论他们想要什么，黑手党都能给。

original: I'm here for some fun.
translation: 我是来这儿找乐子的。

original: So you've followed the call of your desires... all the way to the arms of Joana, moi. Now that you've found me, I wonder, do you have what it takes?
translation: 看来你是遵循了自己的欲望……前来投入琼娜的怀抱咯。既然您亲自上门来了，那么我想知道，您有足够的本事吗？

original: Yes?
translation: 是的？

original: So, what do you want to do with what you've got?
translation: 那么，你打算怎么展现你的本事呢？

original: Consider it "on the house," honey.
translation: 那这趟就当我请了，甜心。

original: Okay, we can have more fun together, but it's not going to be free, hon.
translation: 好吧，想找乐子没问题，可是你就得花点钱咯，甜心。

original: Look, I can't right now. I just want to leave this place and be with Carlitos.
translation: 不，现在不行。我只想离开这里，去陪卡利托斯。

original: I couldn't convince her to attempt a escape.
translation: 我没能说服她逃离那地方。

original: That won't do... at all. Listen, it can't be the jet, Cachino's got her scared shitless.
translation: 这一招……没用的。听着，指望她能马上转过弯来是不可能的，卡奇诺已经把她吓傻了。

original: Find a way to make this work... please.
translation: 你一定要想个办法让她逃走……拜托了。

original: Joana's happy to hear from you and wants to escape Gomorrah.
translation: 琼娜很高兴听到你的消息，她也想逃离蛾摩拉。

original: She is...? Listen, no time to waste. Help her get to Freeside, that's our ticket out of this fucking city.
translation: 真的吗…？听着，不要浪费时间。只要你能帮她逃到自由城，我们就能彻底离开这该死的地方了。

original: I'll meet you there between midnight and dawn, though we could use some backup. We only got one chance to get this right, you hear?
translation: 我会在午夜到黎明之间在那儿等你，不过我们需要几个帮手。我们只有一次机会，听懂了吗？

original: These guys in Freeside, good shots, right? They owe me big time. Tell'em that Carlitos' back to collect his chips, they'll know what do.
translation: 自由城有几个家伙，他们都是好人，懂吗？他们还欠我个大人情。告诉他们，就说卡利托斯来兑现筹码了，他们知道该怎么做。

original: I'll be back when I convince her.
translation: 等我说服了她就回来。

original: Deal! Come back with news soon, you hear?
translation: 一言为定！尽快带着消息回来，听见没有？

original: He's got his reasons. And when that man gets a notion stuck in his head, he's like a Bighorner bull that's seen red.
translation: 他有他的理由。那个男人一旦认准了死理，就跟看见了红布的公牛似的。

original: And if it means Heck Gunderson's involved, then you better step aside before the stampede tramples you over.
translation: 如果这事还与赫克·冈德森有关，那你可千万要躲远了，免得被他那狂奔的牛蹄子踩成肉饼。

original: It's not my place to say much, Walter thinks this is a man's job. I swear, I won't see the day he'll get over that Heck Gunderson.
translation: 我不该发表太多意见，沃尔特认为这是男人之间的事情。不过我敢说，他这辈子都不可能放过那个赫克·冈德森。

original: Oh, a good ways west of here, in a place you've never been. Far as we concerned, only name it ever had was "Phebus Ranch."
translation: 噢，在离这儿很远的西边，你肯定没去过。就我们了解，那个地方以前名叫"菲巴斯牧场。"

original: That was before we lost some land to Heck Gunderson. The bank demanded payment in full the day after the Stockmen's Association bailed it out.
translation: 我们被迫把地卖给了赫克·冈德森。牧场主协会给它做了担保，第二天银行就要求全额付款。

original: If that's what you want to talk about, go see Walter. He'll talk your ear off.
translation: 如果你想聊这个，那去找沃尔特吧。他能把你的耳朵聊出茧子来。

original: Everything he says about the evils of Heck Gunderson is true, but I've never held the notion that fighting evil with evil carries the world forward.
translation: 他口中的赫克·冈德森恶贯满盈，而且每件都是板上钉钉的事实。但我从来不认为以暴制暴能让世界变得更美好。

original: I'm done talking about that man. If that's what you want, step on over to Walter.
translation: 我不想再谈那个人的事了。如果你想知道，就去找沃尔特吧。

original: A good life if you don't mind hard work. The only real fuss is the constant bother with varmints.
translation: 如果你不介意吃苦的话，那日子还算不错。唯一烦人的就是应付鼠害。

original: Fail to catch Molerats early in their breeding, and you'll have three or four head breaking their ankles in Molerat holes every day.
translation: 要是你没有在鼹鼠下崽之前就逮到它们，那你每天都能在鼠洞里撞见三四头摔折了腿的小崽子。

original: Of course, the worst varmint at all is a Brahmin Baron with his hands in the pockets of a Republic senator.
translation: 当然，所有老鼠里最可恶的还是某位双头牛大亨，他和另一位参议员串通一气。

original: That's a problem you can't solve with a Varmint Rifle, though I fear my husband's apt to try. He's got Heck Gunderson in his sights right now.
translation: 这可不是靠着猎鼠步枪就能解决的问题，但我担心我丈夫正有这个打算。他现在一门心思就想除掉冈德森。

original: All right, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。

original: That's very kind of you. Maybe this'll be the dawn of a new day.
translation: 你真是个好心人。说不定咱们的将来有希望了。

original: I'm not surprised. You don't see folks rushing to help each other around here.
translation: 我一点都不吃惊。你是没看见这里的人互帮互助有多积极。

original: What are you and he up to out here on the Strip?
translation: 你们俩打算到长街干什么？

original: Where are you from?
translation: 你从哪里来？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Tell me again why the two of you came to the Strip.
translation: 再跟我说一次你们俩为什么来长街。

original: What's the deal with this Heck Gunderson?
translation: 这跟赫克·冈德森有什么关系？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I don't suppose you have the magic powers necessary to bring my husband to his senses, do you?
translation: 你应该没有什么特殊的魔力能让我的丈夫恢复理智吧？

original: He swears he won't leave this godforsaken city until he's seen Heck suffer. So far as I can see, we're the only ones in pain.
translation: 他发誓除非赫克遭报应，否则他死也不会离开这座鬼城。要我说，放眼望去，这地方也就数我们两口子整天满脸愁容了。

original: As I was saying, I'd be grateful if you could convince Walter to give up this doomed crusade of his.
translation: 我之前说了，如果你能让沃尔特断了这个念想，我会非常感激的。

original: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我想想办法吧。

original: If you can't talk him out of it, seems worthless for me to try.
translation: 如果你都不能让他改变主意，那我也没什么尝试的必要。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All right, I'll talk to him.
translation: 好吧，我会和他谈的。

original: Maybe later.
translation: 以后再说吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Is there some way I could help you out?
translation: 我该怎么帮你？

original: Is there some way I could help you out?
translation: 我该怎么帮你？

original: What's so important about this Heck Gunderson?
translation: 赫克·冈德森有这么重要吗？
