original: Hold still. The Rad-Away burns a little.
translation: 别动。辐特宁会带来轻微灼痛感。

original: Fine, I'll come up with something later.
translation: 好吧，晚点再说。

original: Here you go.
translation: 给你。

original: I'll come back when I have enough.
translation: 等我钱够了我会回来的。

original: Take your time - the ghoul's not going anywhere.
translation: 慢慢来...反正那老尸鬼哪儿也去不了。

original: Here you go.
translation: 给你。

original: Pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 很高兴能和你做生意。

original: I'll come back when I have enough.
translation: 等我钱够了会再回来的。

original: Take your time - the ghoul's not going anywhere.
translation: 慢慢来...反正那老尸鬼哪儿也去不了。

original: Here you go, 150 caps.
translation: 给你，150瓶盖。

original: Pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 很高兴能和你做生意。

original: I'll pay you 100 and not a cap more.
translation: 就100，多一个瓶盖都没有。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Well, I see there's no fooling you in a horse trade. Fine - you've got a deal.
translation: [成功] 好吧，我们就各让一步吧——成交。

original: [FAILED] No, no I don't think you will. The deal is final.
translation: [失败] 不，我不同意。我的开价不变。

original: If you don't I'll tear out your spleen and then rip this place down.
translation: 如果你还不同意，我就先把你撕成碎片，再把这地方拆了如何？

original: Ah. I suppose that's a very... compelling negotiating stance. Fine. The contract is yours. I hope you choke on it.
translation: 啊。我想这是一个非常……难以拒绝的条件。好吧，合同归你了。希望你满意。

original: But how much do you lose on folk not coming into a place with a ghoul performer?
translation: 少一个尸鬼演员你能有多大损失？

original: [SUCCEEDED] I admit that thought had crossed my mind. Maybe you're right - maybe I'd do better with a human act. He's all yours.
translation: [成功] 我承认我也想过这个问题。也许你是对的——可能我还是该偶尔发发慈悲比较好。他是你的人了。

original: [FAILED] That may be the case, but I can't risk that kind of cash-flow. You'll have to do better than that.
translation: [失败] 可能是不会有什么损失，不过我为什么要拿钱去冒险？如果你想说服我，最好有更合理的理由。

original: He's not the right fit for this place. You'll find better performers.
translation: 他不适合这里。你会找到更好的演员的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I suppose you've got a point. Plenty of Brahmin on the prairie, and all that. Fine, I'll cut him loose. He's all yours.
translation: [成功] 我想你说到点子上了。大草原上还会缺双头牛？好吧，我放他走。他归你处置了。

original: [FAILED] That's the stupidest argument I've ever heard. I'm not letting my star performer go without some guarantee of new incomes.
translation: [失败] 我这辈子就没听过比这更蠢的理由。如果不能保证有新的收入来源，我为什么要放走我的明星演员？

original: I could pay you.
translation: 我可以付钱给你。

original: Now, you see, you should have opened with that. I'll sell you his contract, but it will cost you.
translation: 啊，你看，早这样开口不就好了。我可以把他的合同卖给你，不过价钱可不便宜。

original: I'd like to get Hadrian out of his contract.
translation: 我想解除哈德良的合同。

original: Now why would I want to do that? His performances make me quite a lot of money.
translation: 凭什么要我解约？他的演出可是让我赚了不少钱啊。

original: Oh really? Are you going to waste my time again, or do you have something substantive to offer?
translation: 哦，真的？这回你是想继续浪费我的时间呢，还是有什么实质性的意见？

original: I'm back to talk about Hadrian's contract.
translation: 我是来谈哈德良的合同的。

original: It's great to be up here, looking down at all your smiling faces. That won't last long.
translation: 能到这里来真是太好了，在台上俯瞰大家喜悦的表情。要知道你们很快就笑不出来了。

original: Hey, look at this guy! I didn't know they let Brahmin into this joint!
translation: 嘿，看看这个小伙儿！我不知道他们居然把双头牛放进来了！

original: Hey, look at this gal! I didn't know they let Brahmin into this joint!
translation: 嘿，看看这个小妞儿！我不知道他们居然把双头牛放进来了！

original: Hey, look at this guy! Those muscles are unreal - I mean it, they're imaginary!
translation: 嘿，瞧那个家伙！那肌肉太不真实了——我是说，它们跟假的似的！

original: Hey, look at this gal! Those muscles are unreal - I mean it, they're imaginary!
translation: 嘿，瞧那个小妞！那肌肉太不真实了——我是说，它们跟假的似的！

original: This guy's so sharp-eyed, he cuts himself every time he blinks!
translation: 这家伙的眼神真犀利，每眨巴一下眼睛就会划自己一刀。

original: This gal's so sharp-eyed, she cuts herself every time she blinks!
translation: 这女孩的眼神真犀利，每眨巴一下眼睛就会划自己一刀。

original: I tell ya, you've got great eyes. You could spot a Super mutant at three paces.
translation: 我告诉你年轻人，你的眼力很好。你能在三步之内就能辨认出超级变种人。

original: Buddy, you look tough enough to drink a pint of glowing water. Why don't you do us all a favor and try it?
translation: 老兄，你看起来很厉害嘛，感觉一瓶发光的水都能喝得下去。为什么不干脆来一碗呢？

original: Sister, you look tough enough to drink a pint of glowing water. Why don't you do us all a favor and try it?
translation: 小姐，你看起来很厉害嘛，感觉一瓶发光的水都能喝得下去。为什么不干脆来一碗呢？

original: Whoa, you don't look too healthy. Maybe you should see a doctor. Or an undertaker.
translation: 哇，你脸色不太好啊。或许你该去看看医生，找个火葬场也行啊。

original: I hear you've got a ready wit. Tell me when it's ready.
translation: 我听说你脑子很灵活，等你想灵活的时候告诉我一声啊。

original: My friend, you've got style, grace, and charm - the style of a feral Ghoul, the grace of a Super mutant, and the charm of a Deathclaw.
translation: 我的朋友，你很有风度，优雅，还有魅力，不过是狂尸鬼的风度，超级变种人的优雅，死亡爪的魅力。

original: Somebody told me the other day you were bright - I wasn't sure if he meant smart, or radioactive.
translation: 前几天有个人告诉我说你小子挺灵光，我不知道他说的是你聪明，还是说身上会发荧光。

original: The way I hear it, you've got brains to spare. Looks to me like a 7-10 split.
translation: 我听说，你的脑袋转的很快，依我看安上个叶片就能升天了吧。

original: And talk about your quick reflexes, this guy is so fast he beat me to the punchline.
translation: 还是说说你的反应速度吧，这家伙的动作确实快，打得我满嘴抖包袱。

original: And talk about your quick reflexes, this gal is so fast she beat me to the punchline.
translation: 还是说说你的反应速度吧，这小妞的动作确实快，打得我满嘴抖包袱。

original: Boy, you're clumsy. You're so clumsy when you slip in the shower, you fall up.
translation: 小子，你可真是蠢。蠢得连洗个澡都能摔得四脚朝天。

original: This guy right here, he's got an angel looking over his shoulder. If I were him, I'd get a restraining order.
translation: 这边的家伙，似乎有位天使在守护他。如果我是他，一定会把那天使拦在大门外的。

original: This gal right here, she's got an angel looking over her shoulder. If I were her, I'd get a restraining order.
translation: 这边的姑娘，似乎有位天使在守护他。如果我是他，一定会把那天使拦在大门外的。

original: You know, some people have all the luck. Some people, not you.
translation: 你知道，有些人的运气总是很好。不过那是有些人而已，不是你。

original: Was that suit made to order? It was? And where were you at the time?
translation: 那套衣服是定做的吗？是吗？量体型的时候你跑哪儿去了？

original: If you had your life to live over again, let me make a suggestion: Play in traffic.
translation: 如果你的生活可以重新开始，我给你个建议：别做出头鸟。

original: Look at you, you look like a talent scout for a cemetery.
translation: 看看你的样子，就像盗墓贼一样。

original: The more I think of you, the less I think of you.
translation: 你花的心思越多，我对你花的心思就越少。

original: How about a hand for the Rad Pack, the band that inspired that great saying, "Stop the music!"
translation: 为核子欢乐汇鼓掌吧，乐队正应了那句经典的谚语，"别再唱了！"

original: Swank is here, ladies and gentlemen. Make yourself at home, Swank - hit somebody!
translation: 斯万克来了，女士们先生们。斯万克，不要拘束，随便找个人开揍吧！

original: It's great to be here at the Tops, folks. The room I'm in has a lovely little closet. A nail.
translation: 能来到九重天简直太棒了，大伙。我住的房间里有个很漂亮的小壁橱。用钉子挂着的。

original: Thank you everybody, you've been a great audience, good night.
translation: 感谢大家，你们是最好的观众，晚安。

original: It's hard to sleep in this place, I tell you. Last night some girl was pounding on my door all night. Finally I had to let her out.
translation: 告诉你们，这地方真是难以入眠。昨晚有个女孩通宵砸我房门。最后我只能将她撵出去。

original: They really care about your privacy here at the Tops. Even room service has an unlisted number!
translation: 他们真的很注重你在九重天的隐私。甚至连客房服务的号码都是隐藏的！

original: My hotel room is so small, when I put the key in the lock, I broke the window!
translation: 我的房间实在太小了，上次我把钥匙插进锁孔时，居然把窗玻璃给捅破了！

original: How about that suit Benny wears? If I had a suit like that, the ladies would be all over me. What, you expect a punchline? This guy pays my salary!
translation: 本尼的衣服怎么样？如果我能有那样一套衣服，小姐们就会围着我转了。什么，你想听我说他的笑话？那家伙可是付了我工钱的！

original: I told my wife she was good-looking for a ghoul. It's just too bad she's not a ghoul.
translation: 我告诉我老婆，作为一个尸鬼她的确很漂亮。可惜她不是尸鬼。

original: I love these robots with the friendly little policeman's faces. Sure, they still rough you up, but they look so happy!
translation: 我喜欢那些长着好警察面孔的机器人。没错，它们虽然会揍你，但它们揍人时也面带笑容！

original: My cousin and his wife are a fastidious couple. She's fast and he's hideous.
translation: 我表哥和他老婆都很难伺候。她是个急脾气，而他是个丑八怪。

original: I know a guy, his motto is Love Thy Neighbor. He lives next door to a brothel.
translation: 我认识一个家伙，他的座右铭是睦邻友好。他就住在妓院的隔壁。

original: I try to be frank and earnest with women. In New Reno, I'm Frank and in the Boneyard I'm Ernest.
translation: 我对女性真的很忠实很坦白。在新里诺，我的化名叫老忠实，而在埋骨地，我的化名是老坦白。

original: I've been married for 17 years. Where did I go wrong?
translation: 我都结婚17年了。我哪里做错了？

original: I've been in love with the same woman for 17 years. If my wife ever finds out, she'll kill me!
translation: 我跟一个女人有17年的感情。这事要是让我老婆知道了，她会杀了我！

original: My wife and I know the secret to a happy marriage. Two times a week, we go to a nice restaurant. She goes Mondays, I go Fridays.
translation: 我老婆和我都知道维持幸福婚姻的秘诀。有家不错的餐馆，我们每周都去两次。她周一去，我周五去。

original: I take my wife everywhere, but somehow she keeps finding her way back.
translation: 我常带着我老婆四处逛，但不知怎么她总能自己找回家。

original: I bought my wife a little car here in New Vegas. An Omerta. It has a hood under the hood.
translation: 我在新维加斯给我老婆买了辆小车。黑手党的。还装了个折叠车篷。

original: People say it's hard to survive the Wasteland - how hard can it be, the water glows in the dark!
translation: 人们都说在废土难以生存——有多难，水在夜里会发荧光！

original: So I hear Mr. House runs the Strip. He took it over from the last guy, Mr. Mob-Infested Hellhole.
translation: 我听说豪斯先生经营着整条长街。他是从上一位拥有者——稀巴烂先生那里——接管了这个地方。

original: I had dinner at the Ultra-Luxe the other night. I told them my steak tasted funny. They said it was a clown.
translation: 前两天晚上我在奢华殿堂吃晚餐。我告诉他们我牛排的味道很奇怪。他们却骂我是个乡巴佬。

original: I hear James Garret drove 5,000 head of Brahmin to New Reno. No bodies, just the heads.
translation: 我听说詹姆斯·加勒特运了5000只脑袋的双头牛到新里诺。没有身体，只有脑袋。

original: A ghoul goes to a doctor and he says "Doctor, Doctor, I have this horrible rash!" The Doctor says "Son, that's called your face."
translation: 一个尸鬼去看大夫，他说"大夫，大夫，我起了很严重的疹子!"医生说"孩子，那就是你的脸啊。"

original: Well, tough luck. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 呃，那可真糟。如果你改主意了就告诉我。

original: Ain't my mind needs changing, kid, it's Garret's.
translation: 需要改主意的不是我，孩子，是加勒特。

original: I could talk to Garret and try to convince him to let you go.
translation: 我可以跟加勒特说说，看能不能说服他放你走。

original: Heh, good luck. Garret's a tough, mean sonofabitch, he's not likely to give up. Let me know if you make any headway.
translation: 呵，那祝你好运。加勒特是个难缠的小杂种，他不太可能会放人。但如果有进展的话，还是请告诉我一声。

original: Sure, I bet you're raking in the cash in this dump.
translation: 当然，我敢说你在这垃圾地方一定发了不小的财。

original: Really? How much are you making?
translation: 真的？你能挣多少？

original: Judging from the economic state of Freeside, they can't be paying you that much.
translation: 从自由城的经济状况判断，他们付不起你这么高的工资。

original: Okay, I admit it, I ain't exactly rolling in caps here, but whaddya want? I'm under contract, I can't get out.
translation: 好吧，我承认，我在这里的确挣不了几个钱，可还能怎么样？我已经签了合同，不能毁约啊。

original: {pained wince}Eesh... say, you wouldn't happen to have been my manager in a past life, would you? You've got all his money-smarts.
translation: {pained wince}哎……说起来，你不会刚好是我以前的经理转世吧？你的商业头脑和他真是一模一样。

original: I can't right now.
translation: 现在不行。

original: That's okay, I still need some time to get everything together. The logistics of an order like this are headache inducing.
translation: 没事，我还需要点时间准备。这么大的订单，后勤工作可是相当让人头疼。

original: We won't need to head out for a while yet, so stop back when you have the time.
translation: 我们暂时还不会出发，所以你可以等有时间了再过来找我。

original: Count me in.
translation: 算我一个。

original: Perfect. We're still getting everything together, but I can always find a use for idle hands in the meantime.
translation: 非常好。我们还在做准备，不过要是有人愿意帮忙，我们也照样欢迎。

original: Once we're settled, we'll head out to the rendezvous point.
translation: 等我们准备妥当，就会前往约定的交易地点。

original: I'm working on it.
translation: 我在想办法呢。

original: Well work fucking faster. I don't like thinking there's someone out there that hates me more than I hate them.
translation: 那你他妈的最好快点。一想到外面还有人讨厌我，比我讨厌他们更甚，我就心烦。

original: She's dead.
translation: 她翘辫子了。

original: Guess I don't have to worry about talking with her, then. About fucking time. Any longer and I was gonna track you both down.
translation: 看来我也不用再考虑怎么跟她谈了。你他妈也花了太长时间了。要是再久一点，我就把你们俩都抓过来宰了。

original: Anyway, Glory's been antsy lately because that big deal she's been working on is finally going down.
translation: 不管怎样，最近格罗莉急得像热锅上的蚂蚁，她那笔大买卖就差临门一脚了。

original: If this thing goes down, we'll have it made. Fucking {stressed}made, I tell you! Talk to her about it. I'm sure she'll want you along.
translation: 要是这一单能成，咱们可就发大财了！我和你说，绝对是他妈发财了！去和她谈谈吧。我敢说她一定非常想见你。

original: And don't think I forgot your pay. A job well done is its own reward, but it doesn't pay for pussy at the local brothel, does it?
translation: 对了，我还没忘了你的报酬。能把活干得这么漂亮本身就是一种奖励了，不过这样的奖励可没法让你去妓院爽一把，对吧？

original: Just thought I'd say hi.
translation: 我只是想过来问声好！

original: <Jean-Baptiste just stares at you.>
translation: <杰·巴普迪斯特·卡廷只是盯着你看。>

original: Count me out.
translation: 我不想干了。

original: You already agreed to take the job, asshole. There's no backing out now.
translation: 你已经答应过我了，混蛋。想反悔可没门。

original: I've changed my mind. I'll take the job.
translation: 我改变想法了，这活我接。

original: I'll do it.
translation: 我会干的。

original: Find her, bring her back here so we can talk. Needless to say, there's some good money in it for you.
translation: 找到盖西迪，把她带过来。不用说，我保证会有一大笔报酬在等着你。

original: Who is this girl?
translation: 这女孩是谁？

original: Her name's Rose of Sharon Cassidy. That's some fancy shit, right? {Beat, to himself}Don't know what her mother was thinking with a name like that.
translation: 她的名字是罗撒香·盖西迪。真是个奇葩的名字，对吧？{Beat, to himself}都不知道她老妈是怎么想出来的。

original: But this girl and I, we need to have a discussion. {Beat, cold}Find her, bring her here, so I can talk to her, one-on-one.
translation: 不过这女孩和我，有件事要商量。{Beat, cold}找到她，把她带过来。我来和她谈，面对面地谈。

original: In that case, I'm out.
translation: 既然这样，我不干。

original: I thought so. Come back when you've got a backbone.
translation: 我想也是。等你什么时候有胆了再回来吧。

original: I'm in.
translation: 我干。

original: What were you informed of?
translation: 他们跟你说了什么？

original: That you would have something for me. Now do you or not?
translation: 说你要给我东西。你到底给不给？

original: Never mind, I must have confused this with one of my other deliveries.
translation: 算了，估计我是把这次跟另一单货搞混了。

original: Fine, now do you have the package or not?
translation: 好吧，那你到底带没带包裹？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Such a thing is possible. I've been out in the field for some time. Fine, this should cover your grievance.
translation: [成功] 确实有可能，我也在外面跑过腿。行吧，这些钱应该能抵消你的不满了。

original: Now, the package, if you will.
translation: 现在，劳驾你把包裹交出来吧。

original: My employers managed to negotiate a small fee for this drop a short time ago.
translation: 我的老板之前已经和我商量好了，要给我这次运货加一点小费。

original: [FAILED] I've heard no such report. I'd have to check with my contacts before agreeing to such an exchange, and there's no time for that.
translation: [失败] 没听说过这种事。我得先咨询一下我的联系人，才能知道是否该出这笔钱，但眼下我可没那功夫。

original: Now, the package, if you will.
translation: 现在，劳驾你把包裹交出来吧。

original: Surely you were told to pay the Van Graffs' messenger?
translation: 肯定有人跟你说过，要给范·格拉夫家族的信使一点小费吧？

original: Where's the payment?
translation: 报酬呢？

original: I wasn't informed there was to be an exchange on my part. What are you talking about?
translation: 没人和我说过还要付钱啊。你什么意思？

original: It's right here.
translation: 就在这里。

original: Ah, then our business is concluded. Tell your superiors that we will contact them shortly.
translation: 啊，那咱们的这笔交易就做成了。告诉你老板，我们很快会联系他们的。

original: Who is we?
translation: 我们是谁？

original: We were told there would be no questions. Do you have what we requested or not?
translation: 不是说好了不会有人问东问西吗。你到底带没带我们要的货？

original: I'm sorry, you've mistaken me for someone else.
translation: 对不起，你认错人了。

original: I don't think so. My men watched you head straight for this location. Now do you have what we requested?
translation: 我不这么想。我的人可是看着你直接朝我走来的。你到底带没带我们要的货？

original: Maybe.
translation: 也许吧。

original: Don't play games with me. The question was just a formality. Now do you have what we requested?
translation: 别和我兜圈子。刚才那问题只是走个过场。你带没带我们要的货？

original: I am.
translation: 我是。

original: Do you have what we requested?
translation: 你把我们要的货带来了吗？

original: Okay, I'll let her know that you'll help.
translation: 好，我会告诉她你会帮忙的。

original: Deal! Come back with news soon, you hear?
translation: 一言为定！尽快带着消息回来，听见没有？

original: Will you answer my questions now?
translation: 你现在可以回答我的问题了吗？

original: I'll let her know.
translation: 我会让她知道的。

original: Deal! Come back with news soon, you hear?
translation: 一言为定！尽快带着消息回来，听见没有？

original: First, let me ask you some questions.
translation: 首先，让我问你几个问题。

original: Questions can wait, Joana can't.
translation: 有问题以后再问，琼娜可不能等。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Dammit! You're going to leave me hanging, huh? Don't know how else I can get her back.
translation: 操！你就想这样吊着我，是吧？我不知道还有什么办法能让把她救出来。

original: Until next round.
translation: 下一轮再说吧。

original: She didn't know if you were still alive.
translation: 她不知道你是否还活着。

original: Then she has to know! I'm ready to help her escape, once and for all.
translation: 那她必须知道！我准备好帮她逃跑了，成败在此一举。

original: {Reflects on his unfounded fear, having a break-through}Why am I even scared of Cachino and all those fuckers? Joana and I are dead anyway if we don't get the hell out of here.
translation: {Reflects on his unfounded fear, having a break-through}我为什么要害怕卡奇诺和那些混蛋？如果琼娜和我不能离开这鬼地方，那我们和死了还有什么区别。

original: I'm here on Joana's behalf.
translation: 我是受琼娜委托来到这里的。

original: What did you say...? I mean, Joana sent you?
translation: 你说什么……？我是说，琼娜派你来的？

original: Please, tell me! Is she all right? When did you see her? What does she have to say?
translation: 拜托，告诉我！她还好吗？你什么时候见到她的？她有什么要说的？

original: About your problem, let's go to your room.
translation: 有关你的问题，我们去你的房间谈吧。

original: Follow me, hon.
translation: 跟我来，甜心。

original: What can you tell me about the Omertas.
translation: 关于黑手党你能告诉我些什么？

original: The "where" is Freeside, and "now" would be a good time.
translation: "地点"是自由城，而"现在"正是时候。

original: {intently - going into battle}The Beards will be there.
translation: {intently - going into battle}胡子兄弟一定准时赶到。

original: Carlitos says he's ready to cash in his chips.
translation: 卡利托斯说，他准备好要兑现筹码了。

original: I see. Well, he can count on Little Beard and me for an assist. Tell us where and when, and we'll be there.
translation: 知道了。我和小胡子会助他一臂之力的。告诉我们地点和时间，我们一定赶到。

original: Carlitos is ready to cash in his chips.
translation: 卡利托斯要兑现他的筹码了。

original: I see. Well, he can count on Little Beard and me for an assist. Tell us where and when, and we'll be there.
translation: 知道了。我和小胡子会助他一臂之力的。告诉我们地点和时间，我们一定赶到。

original: So you said. All Little Beard and me need to know is the when and where.
translation: 你说过了。只要把时间和地点告诉我和小胡子就行了。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: See you around.
translation: 一会儿见。

original: We'll take care of Carlitos, don't worry.
translation: 我们会关照卡利托斯的，别担心。

original: What sort of debt do you owe Carlitos?
translation: 你欠了卡利托斯什么人情？

original: Let's just say it had something to do with the beards, and leave it at that.
translation: 我只能说是跟胡子有关系，就这样。

original: Does the name "Carlitos" ring a bell?
translation: “卡利托斯”这个人你熟不熟？

original: {suspicious}Depends on why you're asking.
translation: {suspicious}那得看你为什么问了。

original: I heard sounds of a struggle in the Ultra-Luxe Penthouse.
translation: 我听到奢华殿堂顶层公寓有打斗的声音。

original: You've done the right thing, citizen. Reporting struggles, scuffles, and tussles is the civic duty of every man, woman, and child.
translation: 你的做法是正确的，公民。向我们举报打架斗殴事件是每个男人、女人和孩子应尽的义务。

original: Thanks to you, we can all sleep in our beds a little sounder, knowing that swift justice awaits those who take moral shortcuts for personal gain.
translation: 谢谢，那些为了一己私利不择手段的小人很快就会受到正义的制裁，相信我们今后也可以睡得更安稳一些了。

original: Rest assured, I will apprehend the perpetrator and see him or her punished. Even though, in some ways, evil is its own punishment.
translation: 放心吧，我会立马逮捕罪犯，确保他受到应有的惩罚。不过从某种意义上说，作恶本身便是一种惩罚。

original: Er... probably just some mixed up people who are really sorry.
translation: 呃……或许就是些深感歉疚的糊涂蛋。

original: [FAILED] Who gives a rat's patoot if they're sorry? Sorry's what they'll be when they're strung up and lynched by my daddy's posse.
translation: [失败] 谁管他们歉不歉疚？等他们被我爸的手下吊起来打的时候，他们就知道什么是歉疚了。

original: These White Knuckles got hell to pay, I'll see to that when I get outta here.
translation: 这些白鸡爪会有好果子吃的，等我回去后倒要看看他们怎么办。

original: Your dad's powerful. Someone wants him to feud with the White Glove Society.
translation: 你父亲势力很大。有人想故意挑拨他和白手套社团结仇。

original: [SUCCEEDED] My daddy's got a lot of enemies. It don't make no sense that the White Pants Society would kidnap me. He's here to do business with them.
translation: [成功] 我爸是有很多敌人。但那个白裤子社团绑架我确实挺没道理的。我爸是来和他们做生意的。

original: Well, you got a point. But if you don't know who it is, my daddy's gonna be awful mad he ain't got anyone to shoot over this.
translation: 好吧，你说到点子上了。但如果连你也不知道谁是凶手，那我爸肯定会发疯的，因为他不知道该找谁算账。

original: All right. Let's get out of here.
translation: 行了。我们离开这里吧。

original: I'll do the job you proposed.
translation: 我接受你建议的工作。

original: I wanted to check on the troopers sent from Camp Forlorn Hope.
translation: 我是来确认飘零希望营地派往这里的士兵们的情况的。

original: Yeah, they were here a while ago. Gave them all I could, which wasn't much. But as many problems as we're having here, I know they've got it worse.
translation: 是的，他们之前来过这里。我把能给的都给他们了，不算太多。虽然我这儿的麻烦事也不少，但我看得出来，他们的情况更糟。

original: I've seen soldiers get assigned there. It's like they got told they were gonna die. I wouldn't wish it on anybody.
translation: 我见过有些被派到那儿去的士兵，那表情仿佛马上要上刑场了一样。我真的不希望任何人变成那样。

original: If you're trying to track them down, we put a GPS marker in the supply crate. You can track it with your Pip-Boy. Good luck.
translation: 如果你想找他们，我在补给箱里放了一台GPS定位仪。你可以用哔哔小子追踪他们的去向。祝你好运。

original: Veronica.
translation: 维罗尼卡。

original: Cass.
translation: 卡丝。

original: Boone.
translation: 布恩。

original: Arcade.
translation: 阿卡德。

original: <Hushed> Would my companion here make a suitable replacement meal?
translation: <小声> 我的同伴适合当替代品吗？

original: Which one?
translation: 哪一个？

original: Hmm. He's a little thin, but he looks like he comes from good stock with that strong jaw and upright posture.
translation: 唔……他有点瘦了，但从他那大下巴和直身板来判断，他的伙食应该不错。

original: Perhaps a little rugged, a little gamey. But he is in good shape and looks healthy.
translation: 可能肉会有点柴，还会有点腥。但他体形不错，看起来也挺健康。

original: From the smell of her I'd say we can skip the whiskey marinade. But other than her liver she seems to be in working order.
translation: 就凭她身上那股味道，我们都可以不必再用威士忌腌制了。除了她的肝，其他应该都还可口。

original: Her skin has a certain supple quality to it, doesn't it? She's kept it well. How mouth-watering.
translation: 她的皮肤可真细腻啊，不是吗？她保养得不错，真是让人流口水。

original: I'm sorry, but it absolutely must be a human. Former doesn't count.
translation: 不好意思，我们要的替代品必须是人类。哪怕以前是人类也不行。

original: I assume you're joking.
translation: 你是在开玩笑吧。

original: Very well. If you're able to convince young Mr. Gunderson to return to his father, replace him in the freezer with your friend and we'll have a deal.
translation: 很好。如果你能说服小冈德森先生回到他父亲身边，再把你的朋友作为替代品关到冷藏室里，我们就成交。

original: [Attack] I can't let you get away with what you've done.
translation: [攻击] 你犯了这么多事，我可不会让你走。

original: I'll think about it.
translation: 我会好好考虑的。

original: Very well, but I'll need to know soon or I'll be forced to make other plans.
translation: 很好，但一定要尽快做决定，否则我就只能做其他打算了。

original: I'll do it.
translation: 我会干的。

original: Splendid, splendid. The boy is being held in the kitchen beneath the Gourmand. Here are some keys that will allow you access to him.
translation: 很好，很好。那个男孩就关在美食家餐厅底下的厨房里。这些钥匙你拿着，你得穿过几扇门才能找到他。

original: The elder Gunderson is staying in our penthouse. I understand he's hired security, so be careful if you go up there.
translation: 老冈德森正在我们的豪华公寓里待着。据我所知他带了保镖，所以你上去的时候小心点。

original: And our Mr. St. Clair resides to the north. He rarely strays far from his house, and he's surrounded it with booby traps.
translation: 而我们的圣克莱尔先生则住在北边。他很少远离自己的房子，还在周围布满了陷阱。

original: What about the boy you kidnapped?
translation: 被你们绑架的那个男孩怎么办？

original: Ted Gunderson is his name. It would be simplest if you could convince him this was all an unfortunate misunderstanding.
translation: 他叫泰德·冈德森。如果你能让他相信这完全是个误会，那是最好不过。

original: But if he won't listen, we can't very well let him go. He'll have to be slaughtered and served. Then we wouldn't need the replacement.
translation: 但他如果不听，也不能让他一走了之。我们会把他宰了，然后端上餐桌。万一结果是这样的话，我们也不需要替代品了。

original: But you would need to deal with his father, Heck. Perhaps if you could smear some of Ted's blood around his father's hotel room, you could frame him.
translation: 但如此一来，你就得想办法摆平他父亲，赫克。如果你能把泰德的血涂在他父亲的客房周围，就可以陷害他了。

original: Tell me what I need to do.
translation: 告诉我我需要做什么。

original: I need a replacement, and I need the boy taken care of. The replacement must be healthy and well-bred. One can't very well make steak from gristle.
translation: 我需要一个替代品，好解决这个男孩的问题。这个替代品必须健康，并且有教养。粗人可烤不成嫩肉。

original: With so little time, we'll have go after our original choice, Carlyle St. Clair. He lives in a shack north of here. For freshness, we need him alive.
translation: 时间太紧，只能再把原来的猎物捉回来了，卡莱尔·圣克莱尔。他住在北边的一个小棚屋里。肉要新鲜，所以别把他弄死了。

original: If you could send him here or knock him out with this and drag him into the dumpster next to his house, we can do the rest.
translation: 要么把他骗过来，要么用这玩意敲昏他，再把他拖进房子旁边的垃圾箱里，剩下的我们来处理。

original: What did you do?
translation: 你做了什么？

original: I asked for a last-minute replacement. And they stole the son of the most dangerous Brahmin baron in New Vegas while he stayed at this very hotel.
translation: 我让他们去找一个应急的替代品。结果他们就把新维加斯最不好惹的双头牛大亨的儿子给我抓来了，而且还是在这间酒店里动的手。

original: Needless to say, this could be a disaster if things aren't put back the way they should be. And I still need somebody reputable to serve for dinner.
translation: 不消说，这件事如果摆不平，对我们绝对是一场灾难。而且我依然需要找个有名望的人来当晚餐。

original: Strictly speaking, we're no longer allowed to eat people. But I'm hoping the right person and preparation might sway Marjorie to see things my way.
translation: 严格说来，我们已经禁止吃人了。但我希望，如果能找到合适的猎物，再加以精心烹饪，那这道菜或许能让玛乔里改变观念。

original: I think you have the wrong person for this job.
translation: 这件工作找你怕是找错人了。

original: Perhaps I do. Forget I mentioned it.
translation: 可能吧。忘了这事吧。

original: [Attack] He's the least of your problems right now, cannibal.
translation: [攻击] 你还是别考虑他了，多考虑考虑自己吧，食人生番。

original: You barbarous cur.
translation: 你这个野蛮的混蛋。

original: The main course is a person?
translation: 主菜是个人？

original: Yes. The wrong person. We scouted the right one for weeks. The heir to a mercantile empire. Sort of a black sheep.
translation: 对。抓错人了。我们原本选了另外一个人，调查他好几周了。是个商业帝国的继承人，也算是个败家子吧。

original: He cut ties with his family and left their estate to wander. He was ideal. Corn-fed and well-to-do, but no one to miss him if he were to disappear.
translation: 他和家里断绝了关系，抛弃了家产四处游荡。他是最理想的人选。饮食优越、生活富裕，失踪了也没人会在意。

original: Unfortunately the trap my subordinates set for him failed. And as he escaped, he saw their faces. Now he's wary.
translation: 可惜我手下设的陷阱没能捉到他。而且他逃跑的时候还看到了他们的脸。他现在警惕性很高。

original: Do you have any work that needs to be done?
translation: 你这儿有没有什么工作？

original: No, not from the likes of you, I'm afraid. I don't think you'd have the stomach for it. Better look elsewhere.
translation: 恐怕没有，反正用不着你这样的人。我觉得你没有那个勇气。你最好去别的地方看看。

original: I do, but I need someone I know I can rely on. And I haven't heard a thing about you.
translation: 有，但我需要的是一个靠得住的人，而我对你一无所知。

original: Perhaps if you made more of a name for yourself around the Strip, we could talk. But not before.
translation: 如果你能在长街混出点名堂，也许我们还可以谈谈。但现在不行。

original: Yes, I'm glad you asked. I've heard about you, you know. You strike me as just the sort of person who can help me.
translation: 有，很高兴你有这份心。我听说过你。你给我的印象很深，你就是能帮上我的那种人。

original: I'm in a bind. I've been planning an exquisite Society dinner, but there's a bit of a problem with the main course.
translation: 我遇上了点麻烦。我筹划了一场绝妙的社团晚宴，但是主菜出了点小问题。

original: He's got a powerful and temperamental father.
translation: 我们的主菜有一位强势而又脾气暴烈的父亲。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Indeed. Let's.
translation: 当然。悉听尊便。

original: So it isn't true?
translation: 所以那不是真的？

original: I can assure you that the only thing the White Glove Society is guilty of is preparing the tastiest cuisine you'll ever sample.
translation: 我可以向你保证，白手套社团唯一的罪过，就是会为你烹饪出你这一辈子无法再尝到的美味佳肴。

original: That is, of course, if you can afford it.
translation: 当然，前提是你能吃得起。

original: <Lie> I sort of tasted human flesh once. Mmm mmm good. Tell me all your secrets.
translation: <撒谎> 我也尝过人肉的味道。呣，好吃。和我说说你的秘密吧。

original: [FAILED] Please, you're embarrassing yourself. I must request that you change the subject.
translation: [失败] 拜托，你这样只会让自己难堪。请你换一个话题。

original: <Lie> I, too, know what it is to feel the Craving. How can I support your cause?
translation: <撒谎> 我也理解你内心深处那种煎熬。我该怎么支持你？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Good. Then you know what it is to be discreet in matters of... nutrition. Perhaps you can help me.
translation: 很好。看来你也清楚……在营养均衡这件事上必须保持谨慎。也许你能帮我个忙。

original: I, too, know what it is to feel the Craving. How can I support your cause?
translation: 我也理解你内心深处那种煎熬。我该怎么支持你？

original: Good. Then you know what it is to be discreet in matters of... nutrition. Perhaps you can help me.
translation: 很好。看来你也清楚……在营养均衡这件事上必须保持谨慎。也许你能帮我个忙。

original: I've heard your group dines on human flesh.
translation: 我听说你们吃人肉。

original: Ah, yes, I've heard that one too. Jealous people say such nasty things. I feel sorry for them.
translation: 啊，是的，我也听说过。那些嫉妒心重的人什么话都说得出来。我真替他们感到悲哀。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Where do I find the Aces Theater?
translation: 王牌剧场在哪里？

original: The Tops casino, my friend! If you're in the mood to knock back a few and frolic the night away, ain't no better place on Earth!
translation: 在九重天赌场里！如果你想在痛饮中度过一个快乐的夜晚，那就没有比那儿更好的地方了！

original: Who is the Lonesome Drifter?
translation: 孤独的流浪者是谁？

original: Way I hear it, he's some whack job who used to spend his nights sitting around a campfire and howling to himself.
translation: 我听说他精神有问题，每天晚上坐在篝火旁边，对着自己狂吼。

original: "Who wants to hear songs that make you wanna cry?" I try to tell them. But hey, they don't pay me to ask questions.
translation: "谁想听催人泪下的歌？"我本来想跟他们说的，但是，他们付我钱可不是要我多嘴的。

original: Do me a favor - go see the show. Otherwise they'll think I didn't do my job.
translation: 帮我个忙——去看表演吧。不让他们会以为我根本就没干活。

original: A velvety-voiced cool cat fresh out of New Reno, that's who! When Bruce sings, his smokey, dulcet tones will transport you to another world!
translation: 刚从新里诺出道、声音轻盈圆润的帅哥，就是他！只要布鲁斯一开嗓，他那迷幻、美妙的声线将把你带到另一个世界！

original: Who's Bruce Issac?
translation: 布鲁斯·伊扎克是谁？

original: Get away from me.
translation: 离我远点。

original: No need to be rude, pal. Just trying to bring the joy of entertainment into your life!
translation: 别这么凶嘛，朋友。享受一下生命的乐趣呗！

original: Where do I find the Aces Theater?
translation: 王牌剧场在哪里？

original: At the coolest, hippest, swinging-est joint on the Strip, that's where! The Tops, baby - don't miss it!
translation: 就在长街上最酷、最炫、最欢乐的地方！九重天，宝贝——千万别错过了！

original: What sort of show are you talking about?
translation: 你说的是哪种表演？

original: Hadrian, the insult comic! "Did I stutter, fucktard?{"laughs}
translation: 哈德良，讽刺剧啊！"我刚才是不是口吃了，你个弱智？"

original: See, I'm using insults to promote the act. That was my idea!
translation: 看，我的表演特色就是拿人开涮。这就是我的创意！

original: One-liners! The epi-tome of comedy! Little nuggets of hilarity irresistibly bringing forth laughter!
translation: 一句话段子！最伟大的幽默艺术！只要一句话就可以带来无限欢笑！

original: You know, like "is that your face, or is a bowl of puke stuck in your collar?" I tell you, you gotta see this show!
translation: 你懂的，比如这个"原来这是你的脸啊，我还以为是一坨塞在你领口上的呕吐物呢"我跟你讲，你一定要去看表演！

original: What sort of debt do you owe Carlitos?
translation: 你欠了卡利托斯什么人情？

original: I framed Heck Gunderson and sent a Securitron to arrest him.
translation: 我诬陷了赫克·冈德森，并让一个电子保安逮捕了他。

original: So the baron has slaughtered his last Brahmin. How delightful. He was a pox on our business.
translation: 看来那位大亨的双头牛屠宰场要关门大吉了。真让人愉快。他就是个生意场上的毒瘤。

original: He would've driven the price of beef down to the point where any poor wretch could afford it. Can you imagine?
translation: 他会把牛肉的价格压低到连穷人都能买得起。你能想象吗？

original: But now we can price it even higher, create a new luxury market. Not for you, of course. You'll get a special discount.
translation: 不过从今往后，咱们又能提价了，培育一个新的奢侈品市场。当然，不包括你。你可以享受特别折扣。

original: We should attack from the ridge on the east.
translation: 我们应该从东边的山脊发动进攻。

original: East it is. Reports also say that they might have some NCR hostages. If that's true we need to do what we can to save them. So stay sharp.
translation: 那就东边。请报上说他们手里有NCR的人质。如果属实，那我们就要尽一切努力去解救他们，保持警惕。

original: Our main target is the Legion leader at Nelson. Intel has the commander as one Dead Sea. I've uploaded his last known location to your Pip-Boy.
translation: 我们的主要目标是纳尔逊的军团统领。情报说那人叫“死海”。我已经把他最后现身的方位上传到你的哗哗小子里了。

original: Let's move out!
translation: 开始行动！

original: Our main targets are the Legion leaders at Nelson. I've uploaded their last known locations to your Pip-Boy.
translation: 我们的主要目标是纳尔逊的军团指挥官们。我已经把他们最后现身的方位上传到你的哔哔小子里了。

original: Let's attack from the north.
translation: 让我们从北边进攻。

original: North it is. Reports also say that they might have some NCR hostages. If that's true we need to do what we can to save them. So stay sharp.
translation: 那就北边。情报里说他们手里可能有NCR人质。如果属实，那我们就要尽一切努力去解救他们。所以保持警惕。

original: Our main target is the Legion leader at Nelson. Intel has the commander as one Dead Sea. I've uploaded his last known location to your Pip-Boy.
translation: 我们的主要目标是纳尔逊的军团统领。情报说那人叫“死海”。我已经把他最后现身的方位上传到你的哔哔小子里了。

original: Let's move out!
translation: 开始行动！

original: Our main targets are the Legion leaders at Nelson. I've uploaded their last known locations to your Pip-Boy.
translation: 我们的主要目标是纳尔逊的军团指挥官们。我已经把他们最后现身的方位上传到你的哔哔小子里了。

original: I'm not ready yet.
translation: 我还没准备好。

original: Make it quick, we don't want to lose the element of surprise.
translation: 那么快点，我们不想浪费这个奇袭的机会。

original: Let's do this.
translation: 咱们上吧。

original: We don't have many troops, so we can only attack from one direction. Where should we focus the attack?
translation: 我们没有很多士兵,所以我们只能从一个方向进攻他们。我们应该从哪里进攻呢？

original: Why?
translation: 为什么？

original: A little morbid, isn't it?
translation: 你好像有点神经质，是不？

original: Maybe, but the situation around here calls for it. You gonna help or not?
translation: 或许吧，但现在的情形需要这样。你到底帮不帮忙？

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: All right. What did you want to know?
translation: 好的，你想知道什么？

original: What's the Atomic Wrangler?
translation: 原子牛仔是什么？

original: {shrugging}A den of iniquity. The Garrets do more than their share to keep the locals drunk or high enough to stay lazy.
translation: {shrugging}万恶之源。加勒特双胞胎一直在用酒精与毒品腐蚀本地人的神经，好让他们萎靡不振。

original: Their thugs, on the other hand, they keep wired on chems to stay dangerous. What is it with Freeside and brother-sister psychopath teams?
translation: 另一方面，他们还用药物来控制自己的爪牙。自由城怎么就净出这种脑子不正常的双胞胎兄妹档呢？

original: Tell me about the Van Graffs.
translation: 给我介绍下范·格拉夫兄妹。

original: Oh, them. They sell energy weapons, which are very popular with better-heeled prospectors looking to explore the wastes.
translation: 哦，他们啊。他们出售能量武器，但凡有点钱的废土淘金客，都很喜欢去他们那儿买东西。

original: Stay clear of them. Brother and sister are both psychopaths, though at least Gloria is rational. Jean-Baptiste likes killing.
translation: 别招惹他们。兄妹两个都不太正常，格洛丽亚至少还讲点道理，让·巴普蒂斯塔则非常喜欢杀人。

original: What's up with the Atomic Wrangler?
translation: 原子牛仔怎么样？

original: Their joint is the only place in Freeside to get it all under one roof. They've got gambling, booze, chems, and whores.
translation: 那是自由城唯一一个五脏俱全的娱乐会所，有酒，赌博，毒品，还有妓女。

original: They're good folks, just don't cross them. They're known for tidying up loose ends with a bullet to the brain box.
translation: 那儿的老板人还不错，前提是你不要去招惹他们。他们算账的方式可是出了名的简单粗暴。

original: Who are the Van Graffs?
translation: 范·格拉夫兄妹是谁？

original: They are the local energy weapon dealers in Freeside. When it comes to lasers and plasma, they're the only game in town and they keep it that way.
translation: 他们是自由城本地卖能量武器的商人。如果你要买激光和等离子武器，那只能去找他们，这里由他们垄断了市场。

original: Gloria's men are the best armed in Freeside and ruthless to boot, but her brother, Jean-Baptiste Cutting, puts them all to shame.
translation: 格洛丽亚的手下拥有全自由城最精良的装备，而且个个都不好惹。但比起她哥哥——让·巴普蒂斯塔·卡廷，也不过是小巫见大巫。

original: Who is The King?
translation: 谁是猫王？

original: If you haven't heard of The King, you must have been living under a rock or something.
translation: 如果你连猫王都没听说过，那你肯定是从山洞里钻出来的。

original: The King has his boys all over Freeside. He controls the water pump and is essentially the go-to guy for what goes around here.
translation: 自由城到处都有猫王的手下。他控制着水泵，在这儿遇到任何问题，都得先去找他。

original: I'd like to know more about Freeside.
translation: 我想知道更多关于自由城的事。

original: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么？

original: What do you know about Mick and Ralph?
translation: 你对米克和拉尔夫了解多少？

original: I know they sell a lot of guns - as if that's what Freeside needs. I hear Mick handles the guns. No idea what Ralph does.
translation: 我知道他们出售各类军火……好像还嫌自由城不够乱似的。听说米克主要负责枪支生意，拉尔夫负责什么我就不知道了。

original: Who are The Kings?
translation: 猫王帮是些什么人？

original: They've been Freeside's gang for the past five years or so, ever since Mr. House and his Three Families pushed everyone else out of Vegas.
translation: 自从人们被豪斯先生和三大家族赶出维加斯后，5年多来，他们一直是自由城本地的第一大帮派。

original: They've done a lot of good for the community - but that seems to be changing. The flood of NCR squatters has been an affront to them.
translation: 他们为社区做过不少贡献，但现在情况正在发生变化，NCR的流民不断涌入，侵犯了他们的利益。

original: I guess that explains the situation with the water pump. Usually The King wouldn't let his crew bully folks around like that.
translation: 估计水泵闹出那种事也是这个原因。通常猫王是不会允许他的手下如此欺压百姓的。

original: What's all the fuss about the water pump?
translation: 那个水泵是怎么回事？

original: Bill Ronte installed that pump a few years ago, back when he was sober. It was a major improvement for the community.
translation: 比尔·郎特在几年前装了那台水泵，那时他还没开始酗酒。对社区来说，那真是一件大好事。

original: But lately The Kings have started charging locals to use it - and NCR squatters twice as much. That'll come to no good.
translation: 可最近，猫王帮却开始向使用水泵的当地人收取保护费，对NCR流民则更是开出双倍的价钱。这样下去，注定不会有好结果。

original: Let's talk about Freeside.
translation: 来说说自由城吧。

original: What did you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么呢？

original: Santiago's your man.
translation: 就是圣地亚哥。

original: That honey-mouthed sonofabitch? Fine. At least he'll have to shut up occasionally.
translation: 那个嘴似蜜饯的小贱货？很好。至少以后能让他稍微闭一下嘴了。

original: Those pretty lips of his are going to see more traffic than a Brahmin trail in low summer!
translation: 那双漂亮的红唇会比初夏的双头牛小道还要忙碌！

original: Looks like that gives us a full roster of new ass to sell. Good work - enjoy the bonus.
translation: 看来我们又能推出不少新花样了。干得好，这笔奖金拿去吧。

original: {Hmph!}That honey-mouthed sonofabitch owes me a scad of caps! He'll feel like a Brahmin hitching post by the time he's worked off his debt!
translation: {Hmph!}那个甜言蜜语的家伙欠了我一大笔瓶盖！等他还清债务，估计都要累成栓牛桩了！
