translation: 糊弄你什么？

original: I'm here to help you. Andy sent me.
translation: 是安迪派我来帮你的。

original: Alice, Andy's just using you to get the money.
translation: 爱丽丝，安迪只是利用你在赚钱而已。

original: Okay, go ahead. I'll wait for you.
translation: 好的，去吧。我会等你的。

original: Yeah, okay... I'll shoot the lock off the door and... and then.... Argh, dammit!
translation: 好的……我会一枪把门锁嘣开……然后……呃，该死！

original: ... I can't do it, I can't. She deserves it, and worse, but I can't hurt my own mother!
translation: ……不行，我做不到。虽然她罪有应得，可我还是无法对自己的母亲下手！

original: Never mind, Andy sent me to help you, actually.
translation: 没关系。实际上是安迪派我来帮助你的。

original: <Attack> I'll help you leave, dead cold.
translation: <攻击>我会让你躺着出去的。

original: What's going on here?
translation: 怎么回事？

original: Do you have the money?
translation: 你拿到钱了吗？

original: They care for you, in their own way.
translation: 他们只是在用自己的方式关心你啊。

original: Do they? Look at my Mother, all she cares for is a patch of bare dirt where nothing green will ever grow to feed us.
translation: 关心我？看看我母亲，她关心的只有家里那一亩破荒地，上面一点绿都没有，根本无法养活我们。

original: My Father? A trading business that he'll never own, risking his neck every day against Wastelanders and cut-throat "merchants."
translation: 而我父亲呢？永远在为别人做生意，还要成天冒着生命危险，和废土流民以及那些雁过拔毛的"商人们"打交道。

original: And I'm supposed to be part of those dreams? What about my dreams, stranger? What about me?
translation: 我就应该这样屈从于他们的梦想吗？那我的梦想呢，陌生人？我怎么办？

original: What do you really want, Alice?
translation: 你到底想要什么，爱丽丝？

translation: [成功] 我……我也不知道我到底想要什么。可我讨厌这里，讨厌这些人。

original: It all used to be so simple. Why did they change? Why can't they see my pain?
translation: 本来一切都很简单的。为什么他们都变了？为什么他们看不到我的痛苦？

translation: [成功] 我……我也不知道我到底想要什么。可我讨厌这里，讨厌这些人。

original: It all used to be so simple. Why did they change? Why can't they see my pain?
translation: 本来一切都很简单的。为什么他们都变了？为什么他们看不到我的痛苦？

original: [FAILED] The money, yes! It's mine, and nobody can stop me from getting it!
translation: [失败] 是的，钱！钱是我的，没有人可以阻止我！

original: Why are you doing this? Just for the money?
translation: 你为什么要这样做？就是为了钱吗？

original: No, look at this note I found in his room.
translation: 不是的，看看我在他房里找到的便条。

original: ... That- that- that son of a bitch! I'll take the money and I'll kill him too!
translation: ……那个、那个杂种！我会把钱拿走，然后把他也杀了！

original: <Attack> I'll take over now, without you.
translation: <攻击>我会自己想办法的，用不着你。

original: What's going on here?
translation: 怎么回事？

original: Do you have the money?
translation: 你拿到钱了吗？

original: She's guarding it, I know she is!
translation: 她守着呢，我知道的！

original: She's locked the bedroom door - like that's going to stop me. I was... I've got a gun, I'm going to make her give it to me!
translation: 她把卧室的门锁上了，以为这样就能拦住我。我……我有枪，我会让她交出来的！

original: She's guarding it, I know she is!
translation: 她守着呢，我知道的！

original: She's locked the bedroom door - like that's going to stop me. I was... I've got a gun, I'm going to make her give it to me!
translation: 她把卧室的门锁上了，以为这样就能拦住我。我……我有枪，我会让她交出来的！

original: So, where's the money?
translation: 那么，钱在哪里？

original: Alice, Andy's just using you to get the money.
translation: 爱丽丝，安迪只是利用你在赚钱而已。

original: Wh-What are you talking about? Andy wants to help me leave this hole... doesn't he?
translation: 你、你说什么？安迪想要帮助我离开这鬼地方……不是吗？

original: <Attack> Time to put you down!
translation: <攻击>去死吧你！

original: I'm here to help you. Andy sent me.
translation: 我是来帮你的。安迪派我来的。

original: I hear you, and I'm not going to hurt you.
translation: 我听见了，我不会伤害你的。

original: <Attack> Time to put you down!
translation: <攻击>去死吧你！

original: What's going on in here?
translation: 到底怎么了？

original: I'm here to help you. Andy sent me.
translation: 我是来帮你的。安迪派我来的。

original: I just want to talk, that's all.
translation: 我只是想说说话。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Okay, but this better not be a trick!
translation: [成功] 好吧，不过你最好别耍什么花样。

original: [FAILED] I'm not stupid little girl anymore, you can't talk me out of this!
translation: [失败] 我已经不再是个傻姑娘了，你休想糊弄我！

original: I'm here to help you. Andy sent me.
translation: 我是来帮你的。安迪派我来的。

original: Dammit, I can take care of this by myself! That bitch is going to pay for all these years of bossing me around.
translation: 该死，我自己能照顾好自己！那贱人这些年一直在使唤我，我会让她付出代价的。

original: <Attack> Time to put you down!
translation: <攻击>去死吧你！

original: You too? Think I'm just a little girl? I'll show you!
translation: 你也一样？觉得我只是个小女生？那就让你见识一下吧！

original: What's going on here?
translation: 怎么回事？

original: It's payback time, that's what! They've got no right to screw me over, and I'm tired of it!
translation: 我要让他们尝到报应！他们没有权利毁掉我的人生，我已经厌倦了！

original: I'm not here to hurt you.
translation: 我不是来伤害你的。

original: Then what the hell {emphasis}do you want? Don't try anything, I mean it!
translation: 那你到底{emphasis}要干什么？别乱来，我是认真的！

original: <Attack> I'll make you do it.
translation: <攻击> 我会强迫你做的。

original: I should've known you don't have what it takes.
translation: 我早该知道你没这个本事。

original: Oh, you think I won't do it? You think I'm not right in wanting back my life!? I'll show you!
translation: 你觉得我不敢？你觉得我不想找回自己的生活？！那我就做给你看！

original: Give me your gun, Alice.
translation: 把枪给我，爱丽丝。

original: Fine. Take it. But what the hell am I supposed to do now?
translation: 好吧，给你。但我到底现在该干什么？

original: <Attack> You are no help, time to put you down.
translation: <攻击>你没用了，该干掉你了。

original: I'm not interested in this. Sort it out yourselves.
translation: 我对这事不感兴趣。你还是自己解决了吧。

original: Okay, go ahead. I'll wait for you.
translation: 好的，去吧。我会等你的。

original: I don't care about this. Sort it out yourselves.
translation: 我才不管这些事情。你自己去解决吧。

original: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么呢？

original: {Relieved}You must be the backup I've been calling for. Where are the rest of your men?
translation: {Relieved}你肯定就是我呼叫来的增援了，其他人呢？

original: I heard your radio broadcast. I'm here to help.
translation: 我听到了你的广播，就来帮忙了。

original: Thank God. I hoped someone would come eventually, but where are the rest of your men?
translation: 谢天谢地，终于有人来了，其他的人呢？

original: This is it, buddy.
translation: 都在这儿了，伙计。

original: {Urgent}Shit. Have you any damn idea what lives in these caves!? We need to get out of...{cut short realizing he's yelling}
translation: {Urgent}该死，你他妈知道这洞里都有些什么吗！？我们得马上……{cut short realizing he's yelling}

original: {Urgent hushed tone, fearful monsters will hear}We need to go now!
translation: {Urgent hushed tone, fearful monsters will hear}我们得赶紧走！

original: You think I need more men to get the job done?
translation: 你觉得我还需要其他人？

original: What killed the other troopers?
translation: 其他士兵是谁杀死的？

original: {anxious}I don't know. Some kind of man-fish freak like the one I killed over there.
translation: {anxious}我不知道，长得像人鱼一样的怪物，和我干掉的那个差不多。

original: I'd heard fishermen spin old tales of 'Lakelurks' swimming in the water, but I always thought they were just bullshit mermaid stories.
translation: 我以前听渔民们说过藏在水底的“湖沼蟹”的故事，但我以为那跟鬼扯的美人鱼童话没什么两样。

original: Are you okay?
translation: 你还好吗？

original: I managed to kill that thing, but not before it mangled my leg all up. No way I'm walking out of here like this.
translation: 我虽然干掉了那家伙，但它把我的腿给弄瘸了。我没法走出去。

original: I've been keeping quiet and hoping they don't realize one of their buddies is missing. We need to get out of here before they come back.
translation: 我只好保持安静，祈祷那些怪物不会发现它们少了一个同伴。我们得在它们回来之前赶快离开。

original: How did you kill that thing?
translation: 你是怎么干掉那东西的？

original: With my bare hands. I would have shot it, but I was cleaning my gun when they swarmed the camp.
translation: 赤手空拳。我本该用枪的，可那些东西溜进营地时，我刚好就在擦拭我的枪。

original: The ugly bastard knocked me down and started dragging me down into these caves. I managed to get my knife out and get a good throw into it's back.
translation: 这个丑八怪把我击倒在地，还想将我拖回洞里。我好不容易拔出匕首，奋力一投，正好命中它的背部。

original: Once he was on the ground, all it took was a bit of choking and punching to finish him off.
translation: 等他一倒地，我就立马扑上去掐住脖子，一顿乱拳结果了他。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Thanks a lot, doc. I think I should be able to walk out of here, now.
translation: [成功] 实在太感谢了，医生，我想我现在应该能走出这里了。

original: I don't want to risk running into a pack of those freaks alone, though. Could you escort me out of here?
translation: 但我可不想独自一人扎进怪物堆里，你能护送我出去么？

original: Looks like some nasty lacerations and a dislocated joint. You're lucky I found you.
translation: 看来有些严重的裂伤，还有一处脱臼，能遇到我算你走运。

original: [FAILED] Whoa there, buddy. What you're suggesting is downright archaic.
translation: [失败] 哇，伙计，你的建议还真是过时啊。

original: I think my tourniquet will work for now, but I still can't walk like this.
translation: 我想我的止血带应该管用，但我还是走不动。

original: If I had a doctor's bag, I could probaly fix it up myself.
translation: 如果你有医生的诊疗包, 也许我能自己治疗。

original: I think I've got a dull needle and twine in one of my pockets.
translation: 我的一口袋里应该有根钝针，还有些细线。

original: <Use Doctor Bag to heal his leg> This should help fix up your leg.
translation: <用医生的诊疗包治疗他的腿> 这应该有助于治好你的腿。

original: Thanks a lot, doc. Looks like I should be able to at least walk out of here, now.
translation: 谢谢你，医生。看起来我现在至少能走出这里了。

original: I don't want to risk running into a pack of those freaks alone, though. Could you escort me out of here?
translation: 但我可不想独自一人扎进怪物堆里，你能护送我出去么？

original: I'll be back.
translation: 我会回来的。

original: Great, just leave me here, then.
translation: 好的，就把我留在这儿算了。

original: That's a nice gun you've got there.
translation: 你身上那把枪不错。

original: You can have it if you get me out of here alive. I won't have a use for it when I get back to California.
translation: 如果你能带我活着走出这里，它就是你的了。等我回到加州，它也没什么用了。

original: You're free to leave. The way up is clear.
translation: 你可以离开了。上去的路已经安全了。

original: Great, I'll start heading back to California now. I'm not about to let myself get killed by future NCR incompetence.
translation: 太好了，我现在要动身回加州了。我可不想因为NCR的无能而白白丢了性命。

original: If you find my friends, please return their dogtags to the NCR. People need to know what happened here.
translation: 如果你找到我朋友的遗体，请把他们的狗牌交还给NCR。大家需要知道这里发生了什么。

original: If they won't listen, do what you can to make them listen. The dead need to be avenged.
translation: 如果他们不听，就想办法让他们听。必须要有人为死去的战友们复仇。

original: We need to clear the caves first.
translation: 我们首先需要肃清洞里的怪物。

original: Are you crazy? No way in hell am I going deeper into these caves.
translation: 你疯了吗？打死我也不会再往洞里多走一步的。

original: You haven't seen what they did to the other troopers, and I'd rather not find out why they took all of the bodies.
translation: 你没看见那些怪物是怎么对待其他士兵的，我真不想知道他们最后的下场。

original: You're free to leave. The way up is clear.
translation: 你可以离开了。向上的路安全了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right, you have a point. They were good men and deserved better.
translation: [成功] 好吧，你说的有道理。他们都是好人，不该落得这样的下场。

original: I can't guarantee I'll be much help against their numbers, but I'll do what I can. Chances are we won't get out of here alive anyway.
translation: 它们数量众多，我不能保证自己能发挥多少作用，但我会尽我所能的。反正我们也有可能出不去。

original: If we don't clear the caves, your friends' deaths were for nothing. Can you live with that?
translation: 如果我们不肃清那些怪物，那你的朋友们就白死了。你能活得安心吗？

original: [FAILED] Hey, I'm all for being a hero when the time is right, but there are at least 12 of those bastards lurking around in here.
translation: [失败] 嘿，要我做英雄没问题，但也得找准时机啊。洞里至少还盘踞着12头怪物呢。

original: I'd rather not join my buddies any time soon.
translation: 我可不想这么快就去跟我死去的兄弟们作伴。

original: More people are going to die if we don't do something.
translation: 如果我们什么都不做，那会有更多的人丧生的。

original: Let's get moving.
translation: 让我们行动吧。

original: Lead on.
translation: 带路。

original: Have a safe trip.
translation: 一路平安。

original: Nobody who threatens me lives to tell about it. Not even Nightkin.
translation: 敢威胁我的人都休想活命，即便是夜行族也一样。

original: I'll get back to you on that in a moment. Once I've analyzed the results - uh, oh.
translation: 我这边马上就好了。等我分析一下结果——呃，哦。

original: Awww... I liked having it on.
translation: 哦…我喜欢这种感觉。

original: Grrr! Lily smash! Haha.
translation: 呃啊！莉莉猛砸！哈哈。

original: Turning it on. Urgh... feels strange. Strange but good.
translation: 打开了。呃…感觉怪怪的，不过很不错。

original: All right, we're done here. Go ahead and power the Stealth Boy down, Lily.
translation: 好啦。把隐身小子的电源关上吧，莉莉。

original: Interesting. Try thinking aggressive thoughts now. Think about smashing a Radscorpion.
translation: 有意思。换个比较有攻击性的想法吧。想象你打烂了一头辐射蝎。

original: All right, power on the Stealth Boy, Lily.
translation: 好啦。把隐身小子的电源打开吧，莉莉。

original: Don't start just yet. I'll be back.
translation: 先别开始。我过一阵子再回来。

original: {impatient}Oh, all right.
translation: {impatient}哦，好吧。

original: Go ahead and start the tests.
translation: 可以了，开始测试吧。

original: Very well. Please stand back - I don't want any erroneous readings. You're welcome to stay and observe if you want, though.
translation: 很好。请往后站——我可不希望读数受到干扰。不过，如果你愿意，也可以在一旁观看。

original: Wait, Lily's not in position yet. Talk to me again once she's settled in.
translation: 等等，莉莉还没有就位。等她到位以后再告诉我。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Bye.
translation: 拜。

original: I'm looking into the Nightstalker mutation. Want to come along with me?
translation: 我在寻找夜行兽的变种。你想和我一起来吗？

original: Oooh, those Nightstalkers, always killing my Bighorners! It'll be nice to give them a piece of my mind!
translation: 哦，那些夜行兽，总是残害我们的大角羊！我早就想给他们一点颜色看看了！

original: Oh no, dearie, three makes a crowd.
translation: 哦，不，亲爱的，三个人太多了。

original: About Doctor Henry's experiment...
translation: 关于亨利医生的试验……

original: What makes you think that the Nightstalker mutation isn't natural?
translation: 你为什么觉得夜行兽的变异不是先天的？

original: I've compared the brain chemistry of a Nightkin to one of the local Nightstalkers we killed. They both exhibit similar neurochemical changes.
translation: 我把夜行族大脑的化学结构与我们杀死的本地夜行兽样本做了对比。发现它们的神经化学变异情况极为类似。

original: Now, I'm not claiming that Nightstalkers are running around wearing Stealth Boys, mind you. I just don't think it's all a coincidence.
translation: 先声明一下，我的意思并不是这些夜行兽都叼着个隐身小子四处乱跑。我只是觉得这不太像巧合。

original: I'm not ready yet.
translation: 我还没准备好。

original: Well hurry it up and get your shit together.
translation: 那就动作快点，别他妈浪费时间。

original: Yes, I'm ready.
translation: 我准备好了。

original: Good. Now Kimball is scheduled to give his speech tomorrow. We'll rest here tonight and talk over the plan first thing in the morning.
translation: 很好，金博尔明天才发表演讲，我们先在这里过夜，明天一大早再商量计划。

original: Get some sleep. You got a big day ahead of you.
translation: 好好睡一觉，明天你可要大显身手。

original: I've made my preparations. Let's get started.
translation: 我准备好了。开始行动吧。

original: Good. Kimball is scheduled to give his speech tomorrow. We'll rest here tonight and talk the plan over first thing in the morning.
translation: 很好，金博尔明天才发表演讲，我们先在这里过夜，明天一大早再商量计划。

original: Get some sleep. You got a big day ahead of you.
translation: 好好睡一觉，明天你可要大显身手。

original: Let's get on with this.
translation: 我们动手吧。

original: Right, straight to business. Good. No wonder Caesar sent you.
translation: 不错，简单粗暴。真不错，难怪凯撒派你过来。

original: Once we get started, we're going to be on a tight schedule. Are you ready to do this?
translation: 一旦开始行动，我们就必须争分夺秒。你准备好了吗？

original: Nice to meet you too.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: So you're the bigshot that Caesar put in charge of this mission. I've heard about you. You've got quite the reputation already.
translation: 这么说你就是凯撒寄予厚望的人了？我听说过你，你已经声名远扬了。

original: Well let's get down to business. Once we get started, we're going to be on a tight schedule. Are you ready to do this?
translation: 那我们谈正事把，时间紧迫，一旦开始行动，我们就必须争分夺秒，你准备好了吗？

original: So you're the bigshot that Caesar put in charge of this mission. Can't say I'm impressed, but let's just get down to business.
translation: 这么说你就是凯撒寄予厚望的人了？虽然我对你谈不上什么好印象，不过我们还是谈正事吧。

original: Once we get started, we're going to be on a tight schedule. Are you ready to do this?
translation: 一旦开始行动，我们就必须争分夺秒。你准备好了吗？

original: I don't care about any of this.
translation: 我才不在乎这些事情呢。

original: [Attack] I think you're better dead.
translation: [攻击] 我觉得你还是死了比较好。

original: Grab the money and run far away.
translation: 带上钱，然后远走高飞吧。

original: You think I really care about the money? I just... no, no, no!
translation: 你以为我的真的在乎钱？我只是……不，不，不！

original: Once I have my share, you can get out of here.
translation: 等拿到了我应得的那部分，你就可以走了。

original: I don't want to get out, do you hear me! I just... no, no, no!
translation: 我不想离开这里，你听到了吗！我只是……不，不，不！

original: [Attack] You're next!
translation: [攻击] 下一个就是你！

original: That was great! Good job, Alice.
translation: 太棒了！干得好，爱丽丝。

original: Are you out of your mind? I just... no, no, no!
translation: 你疯了吗？我只是……不，不，不！

original: Now there really is no turning back.
translation: 现在真的是无路可退了。

original: Father... what's he going to do to me? I can't stay here, I can't hide from this!
translation: 父亲……他会对我做什么呢？我不能再待着了，我掩饰不了的！

original: I give up. Sort it out on your own.
translation: 我放弃了。你自己解决吧。

original: Calm down. I just want to talk.
translation: 冷静下来。我只是想和你谈谈。

original: Okay, go ahead. I'll wait for you.
translation: 好吧，去吧。我会等你的。

original: <Attack> That won't do. Time to put you down.
translation: <攻击>那可不行。是时候该干掉你了。

original: So, where's the money?
translation: 那么，钱在哪里？

original: Alice, Andy's just using you to get the money.
translation: 爱丽丝，安迪只是利用你在赚钱而已。

original: <Attack> You're not going anywhere.
translation: <攻击>你哪里都别想去。

original: You should get out of here and never come back.
translation: 你应该离开，再也不要回来。

original: You should stay with your family - reconcile with them.
translation: 你应该和你的家人们呆在一起，与他们和睦相处。

original: Give them a chance.
translation: 给他们一次机会吧。

original: <Attack> Here's my answer.
translation: <攻击>这就是我的答复。

original: You should leave and never come back.
translation: 你应该离开，再也不要回来。

original: Only you can answer that.
translation: 只有你自己能回答。

original: [SUCCEEDED]... It's all me, isn't it? The pain, the anger, my joy, all of that's just me.
translation: [成功] ……都怪我自己，对吗？所有的痛苦，愤怒，愉悦，都是我自找的。

original: I should've met you before, stranger. Thank you.
translation: 要是能早点遇见你就好了，陌生人。谢谢你。

original: [FAILED] Some choice. I can't stay here now, and I don't have the means to leave.
translation: [失败] 好一个选择。我不能呆在这儿，可我也没有办法离开。

original: I... guess that's your choice.
translation: 我……想，那是你的选择。

original: <Attack> I'm not seeing it either, yet!
translation: <攻击>我也不会再看见了！

original: [Attack] I'm not seeing it either, yet!
translation: [攻击] 我也不会再看见了！

original: You should leave and never come back.
translation: 你应该离开，再也不要回来。

original: You should leave and never come back.
translation: 你应该离开，再也不要回来。

original: [Attack] Thanks for the gun, it will make this easier.
translation: [攻击] 多谢你把枪给我，这下事情容易多了。

original: You should get out of here and never come back.
translation: 你应该离开，再也不要回来。

original: You're right, there's no place for me here. Just... just tell them I'm sorry, and that they won't have to worry about me, ever again.
translation: 你是对的，这里没有我的容身之地。只是……请你转告他们，我对不起他们，以后不用再为我担心了。

original: You should stay with your family - reconcile with them.
translation: 你应该和家人们呆在一起，与他们和睦相处。

original: Maybe you're right... but what will they think? How can I look them in the face ever again?
translation: 也许你是对的……不过他们会怎么想呢？我以后怎么去面对他们？

original: Well, I guess I don't deserve any better, huh? So be it...
translation: 啊，看来这都是我自找的，对吧？那好吧……

original: Doctor Henry, do as he asks.
translation: 亨利医生，照他说的做。

original: You're not getting the Mark II specs.
translation: 你休想拿到二号原型机。

original: [Stare silently at him.]
translation: [静静地盯着他。]

original: Bah! Humans.
translation: 呸！人类。

original: How does that make you different from some humans?
translation: 你这样和某些人类又有什么不同？

original: It is different! Right now I'm trying very hard to remain civil, and you're not making it easy with your incessant questions!
translation: 当然不同！我现在就已经在努力保持克制了，你要是再这么无礼，我可就要发脾气了！

original: Do you have a problem with humans?
translation: 你和人类之间有什么过节吗？

original: Humans are always staring at things. We Nightkin don't like being stared at. Is is... uncomfortable.
translation: 人类总是瞅来瞅去。我们夜行族不喜欢被人盯着。感觉……不舒服。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Well, well. Congratulations on getting the Mark II prototype functional, doctor. Now just hand it over and we'll be on our way.
translation: 哎呀。恭喜你的II型原型机运行成功了，医生。把它交出来，我们自会离开。

original: What do you do in Jacobstown?
translation: 你在雅各布斯镇做什么？

original: I watch over the Bighorners. They're sweet, gentle creatures, but sometimes they get ornery. Just like my grandkids!
translation: 我负责照看大角羊。他们很可爱，也很温顺，但脾气坏起来也很吓人。就跟我的孙子们一样！

original: I've been a lot of help to you already. You can do me this one favor.
translation: 我已经帮了你不少忙吧？这次该你帮我了。

original: You have been a useful associate, that I'll grant you. Okay, he's yours for a discount. Just make sure the stage is downwind of the audience.
translation: 我承认，你是个很能干的合作伙伴。好吧，这次就便宜你了。不过你记得，一定要把舞台设置在观众席的下风口。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Can do.
translation: 好的。

original: What kind of crops do you grow?
translation: 你都种什么？

original: Everything I can. Farmers out here don't have the luxury of being picky. I get by mostly on maize and tobacco.
translation: 什么都种。这儿的农民可没资格挑三拣四。我种的大部分是玉米和烟草。

original: What are NCR troopers doing here?
translation: NCR的士兵在这里干什么？

original: They're part of the deal, the Thaler Act. We work the fields while they protect the crops and the water.
translation: 他们是受塞勒法案调遣来的。我们负责耕地，他们负责保护庄稼和水源。

original: Lotta folks come to New Vegas and lose everything in Freeside or the Strip. They get hungry, desperate, and try to take our hard work.
translation: 来新维加斯的人会有不少在自由城或长街输得倾家荡产。饥饿和绝望会迫使他们前来偷取我们辛苦种下的庄稼。

original: Much as I sympathize, their theft would put me in a bad spot. I got a crop quota to meet.
translation: 虽然我很同情他们，可偷粮食毕竟对我没好处。我还有上缴的指标要完成。

original: Why is this work a bum deal?
translation: 为什么说一团浆糊？

original: Bad soil and rationed water. It's to be expected around here, but the rationing's off. Worst part is NCR won't admit it.
translation: 土地贫瘠，水源稀缺。虽然我对此早有准备，可现在连定量配给都中断了。更糟的是NCR还不承认。

original: Pretty hard to meet their crop quotas with twenty percent less water than we're supposed to be getting. Not that OSI cares about any of this.
translation: 水量比原先计划的少了20%，很难满足作物的需求。而科工部一点也不关心。

original: What's the Thaler Act?
translation: 塞勒法案是什么？

original: Something the politicians back in Shady Sands came up with. They pay us to move here and farm the land. They even protect the fields.
translation: 都是沙荫镇那帮政客想出来的。他们付钱给我们，让我们到这里开垦荒地。甚至还为我们提供保护。

original: You work these fields?
translation: 你在这儿种田？

original: Sure do. Came from The Hub on account of the Thaler Act. Farming's decent work, but the whole thing's a bum deal.
translation: 当然。我是因为塞勒法案才从哈勃城迁过来的。虽然种田是个不错的活计，可这地方根本就是一团浆糊。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Adios.
translation: 再会。

original: Trent Bascom says he's not getting his full allotment of water.
translation: 特伦特·巴斯科姆说用来浇灌农田的水量不够。

original: The Office of Science and Industry has carefully calculated the amount of water needed for these crops. The whole thing is handled by computer.
translation: 科工部已经仔细计算过庄稼所需的水量了。它们完全是由计算机控制的。

original: Besides, most of these crops look fine to me. If the farmers can't handle the job, they shouldn't have signed up in the first place.
translation: 而且，我看大部分的庄稼长势也还不错。如果那些农民干不好这活，那他们当初就不该接手。

original: If there really is a problem, they can take it up with Lieutenant Boyd at McCarran. Farming isn't my department.
translation: 就算真有问题，他们也该去找麦卡伦营地的博伊德中尉。种田的事不归我管。

original: What can you tell me about these fields?
translation: 关于这个地方，你知道些什么？

original: Impressive, aren't they? You don't see anything like this outside of NCR territory, that's for sure.
translation: 挺不错的吧？我敢肯定，在NCR领土外，你见不到这样的地方。

original: We get the water - clean water - pumped in from Lake Mead. If you follow the big pipes, they'll take you all the way to the Lake.
translation: 我们有水——纯净的水——从米德湖抽出来的。只要沿着这些大管道，你就可以走到湖边。

original: Why are these fields being guarded?
translation: 为什么田地里有守卫？

original: A lot of the crops grown here support the various NCR camps in the region - McCarran, Golf, and Forlorn Hope, to name a few.
translation: 这里种的大片庄稼是要供应给该地区的几个NCR营地的——包括麦卡伦、高尔夫和飘零希望营地。

original: We can't have wastelanders popping in here for a free meal, so my squad and I are assigned to keep things from going to hell.
translation: 我们可不能让那些流民们进来白吃白拿。所以我的队伍就被派到这儿来维护治安了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Carry on.
translation: 继续。

original: What happens if Keene leaves?
translation: 如果基恩走了会发生什么？

original: That happens, there's a good chance other Nightkin will follow. It'll make it hard to get a cure to them.
translation: 如果他走了，其他夜行族也可能会随他而去。如此一来，要找到解药就会变得更加困难。

original: {Wary}Worse, if Keene and the Nightkin tear up the Mojave hunting for Stealth Boys, people are going get killed.
translation: 更糟的是，如果基恩与夜行族为了寻找隐身小子而不惜在莫哈维掘地三尺，那一定有不少人会遭殃的。

original: Most humans can't tell the difference between mutants. Might come here looking for payback.
translation: 大多数人类都分辨不出变种人之间的差别。他们很有可能会来找我们报仇。

original: Why does Keene want to leave?
translation: 为什么基恩想离开？

original: Because of a promise. One I haven't been able to keep. The Nightkin all suffer from schizophrenia. It's the Stealth Boys they use, used to use.
translation: 因为一个承诺。一个我不能信守的承诺。夜行族一直以来都饱受精神分裂的困扰。这都是他们过度使用隐身小子而产生的副作用。

original: Nightkin have a hard time being seen like normal folks. Can't stand it. A few already left to try and find more Stealth Boys.
translation: 夜行族很难被当作是正常人。他们戒不掉那种瘾。已经有好多人离开去寻找隐身小子了。

original: Miserable situation. They either stay here and suffer, or dig up Stealth Boys and lose their minds. Not much of a choice.
translation: 这样的处境相当痛苦。要么在这儿饱受煎熬，要么就沉浸在隐身小子中逐渐丧失心智。几乎没有别的选择。

original: What's the story with Keene?
translation: 基恩的身世是怎样的？

original: I'm looking for Corporal White. I was told that he'd spoken to you.
translation: 我在找怀特下士。我听说他曾经和你说过话。

original: Yes, he said he was looking into the water shortage, but I haven't heard back from him. Got the feeling he wasn't here in any official way.
translation: 是的。他说他正在调查缺水的问题，但至今没有回音。我有种预感，他很有可能已经被调走了。

original: White was talking to me about computer stuff and water delivery schedules through the pipes, but I'm just a farmer. Tech stuff is beyond me.
translation: 怀特和我说了什么计算机控制还有通过管道定时供水之类的事情，但我只是一个农民。技术问题我一窍不通。

original: The last person I saw him talking to was Lieutenant Romanowski. Romanowski's around here somewhere. Sorry I couldn't be more helpful.
translation: 我最后一次看到他时，他正在和罗曼诺夫斯基中尉说话。罗曼诺夫斯基应该就在这农地里。抱歉，我也只能帮你到这里了。

original: Can't you just grow less crops?
translation: 你就不能少种点庄稼吗？

original: I wouldn't be able to meet the quota, and the NCR would kick me out of my job, anyway. Nah, it's better I get out on my own terms.
translation: 那样我就没法满足指标了，NCR会把我开除的。不，最好还是我自己找理由走人吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Good luck to you out here.
translation: 祝你好运。

original: What are you going to do now?
translation: 现在你要怎么办？

original: I hear the Brahmin ranchers out in Redding are looking for some hard workers, so I might try there first. I hate working with Brahmin, though.
translation: 我听说瑞丁镇外的双头牛农场正在招人，我想先去那里试试。虽然我讨厌双头牛。

original: Me? I have no idea what you're talking about.
translation: 我？我根本就不知道你在说什么。

original: Sure you don't. All just a happy coincidence, am I right?
translation: 你当然不知道。这一切不过是巧合，对吧？

original: <Lie> The NCR admitted there's bad pipes somewhere, and took care of the problem.
translation: <撒谎> NCR承认管道有问题，他们会妥善处理的。

original: That's what I figured. Don't know why the heck they're so stubborn they couldn't just admit it.
translation: 果然被我猜到了。不知道为什么他们那么固执，就是不肯承认。

original: Water was being diverted to Westside, but I took care of the problem.
translation: 水被引向了西区，但我已经把这件事解决了。

original: Westside, huh? I hope the NCR does something about those thieving bastards. I appreciate it, and so do the rest of the farmers.
translation: 西区啊？希望NCR能对这种偷窃行为采取行动。非常感谢，其他农民也会感激万分的。

original: Maybe you don't want for food much, but you can sell these on the market for a good price. Like I said, we're much obliged for the help.
translation: 可能你不缺粮食，但这些也能在市场上卖个好价钱。正如我说的，非常感谢你的帮助。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Yes, please do.
translation: 好的，请。

original: Do you have something against White?
translation: 你和怀特有什么过节吗？

original: He's a glory hound, always looking for a way to get promoted to Ranger. Thinks he's too good to be a regular trooper like the rest of us.
translation: 他就是个沽名钓誉之辈，整天就想着晋升游骑兵。他自以为很出色，比我们这些普通士兵高一等。

original: You haven't heard anything more from White?
translation: 你没有怀特的其他消息了？

original: Haven't seen him. Serves him right if the NCR declares him AWOL.
translation: 没见过他。如果NCR宣布他擅离职守，那也是活该。

original: I'm looking for Corporal White. Trent told me you'd seen him.
translation: 我在找怀特下士。特伦特告诉我你曾经见过他。

original: Corporal White is currently solving the mystery of the {sarcasm}Great Water Shortage. Tried to convince me he had proof, even. I didn't buy any of it.
translation: 怀特下士目前正在调查{sarcasm}咱们水源紧缺的原因。他说他已经发现了证据，但我一点儿也不买他的账。

original: He went over to Westside to talk to Tom Anderson. Anderson's a Follower of the Apocalypse. Helps the people in Westside grow crops or something.
translation: 他之前去西区找汤姆·安德森了。安德森是天启追随者。他帮过西区的人种植庄稼。

original: I got a Deathclaw egg for you.
translation: 我给你找来了一颗死亡爪的蛋。

original: I just happen to have a Deathclaw egg with me. Here.
translation: 恰好我就带着一颗死亡爪的蛋。给。

original: I can't believe you actually got one. Give me a bit to get the recipe set up, then talk to me again.
translation: 不敢相信，你居然还真搞到了一颗。等我一下，我要先按菜谱准备下食材，过一阵子你再来找我吧。

original: Any trouble around here?
translation: 这附近有什么麻烦吗？

original: Well, there's the Deathclaws, of course, and there was that one group of Powder Gangers who stole all the dynamite.
translation: 嗯，有死亡爪，当然，还有一群偷了我们炸药的炸药帮成员。

original: I think we're too small and poor for anyone to bother with, really. I keep a weapon near my bunk, though - same as everybody here.
translation: 估计就是因为我们势单力薄又没钱，才没有人愿意搭理我们。不过我还是在床头放了一把武器，这儿的其他人也一样。

original: Are you from California?
translation: 你从加利福尼亚来？

original: Born and raised. Things back in California are better than they've ever been, according to my grandpa.
translation: 那是生我养我的地方。按我爷爷的说法，如今的加州比过去好得多了。

original: The Raiders are mostly gone now and it's easy enough to get a job at one of the mills or farms. But now there's taxes and laws and other things.
translation: 想在矿山或者农场找个工作非常容易，因为掠夺者已经几乎销声匿迹了。不过却多了税费啊，规章制度啊之类的东西。

original: The NCR keeps things safe and orderly, but it's all very boring. So, I came out east towards the frontier.
translation: NCR虽然让一切都变得井然有序，可就是太无聊了。所以，我就想到东部边境来看看。

original: You don't look like a quarry worker.
translation: 你看起来不像是采石工人。

original: Oh, I'm not. I'm making my way to New Vegas. They say anything goes there, and best of all, the NCR can't mess it up for you.
translation: 噢，我本来就不是。我要去新维加斯，路过这里。他们说好东西都在那儿，而且最棒的是，在那儿NCR管不着你。

original: I'll get there eventually. I've heard that you can't even get into the Strip unless you're rich.
translation: 我总归是要去那里的。咳咳…我听说，除非你身家万贯，否则连长街都进不去。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Sure thing.
translation: 当然的。

original: I had some questions about this place.
translation: 我对这地方有几个问题。

original: Sure. What did you want to know?
translation: 当然。你想知道什么？

original: About that Deathclaw Omelet recipe...
translation: 关于死亡爪煎蛋卷食谱……

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All right, then!
translation: 那好吧！

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: All right. Do you need anything to eat or drink?
translation: 好吧。你想来点吃的或者喝的吗？

original: What are you offering in exchange for a Deathclaw egg?
translation: 你拿什么东西来换死亡爪的蛋？

original: I don't have much in the way of money, but I'd be willing to share the secret of the recipe.
translation: 我没什么钱，不过我很乐意把食谱与你分享。

original: Where can I find a Deathclaw egg?
translation: 我在哪能找到死亡爪的蛋？

original: The quarry just north of here is full of Deathclaws, so there's bound to be an egg or two in there somewhere.
translation: 北边的采石场到处都是死亡爪，按理说那里肯定会有一两颗蛋。

original: Of course, a Deathclaw egg from anywhere will do. According to my Aunt Rose, those things have a ridiculously long shelf life.
translation: 当然啦，其他地方的死亡爪蛋也行。按萝丝姨婆的说法，那种东西能放很久。

original: Where did you come up with this recipe?
translation: 你从哪搞到这个食谱的？

original: My great-aunt Rose ran a bed and breakfast back in California, in a town called Modoc. She's the one who created the recipe in the first place.
translation: 我的叔祖母萝丝以前曾在加利福尼亚一个叫摩多克的镇上经营过小旅馆。是她最先发明了这个食谱。

original: I don't know how she managed to get a hold of a female Deathclaw, but she kept it in a shed. Aunt Rose had a steady supply of eggs for her omelets.
translation: 我不知道她是怎么抓到母死亡爪的，不过她的棚屋里确实关过一只。所以萝丝姨妈从来不缺做煎蛋卷的原材料。

original: At least, she did until some stranger came along and killed the Deathclaw. Shot it right in the eye.
translation: 后来，有个陌生人闯进了她的棚屋，搅黄了她的生意。那家伙一枪打爆了死亡爪的脑袋。

original: Anything that wasn't made 200 years ago.
translation: 只要不是200年前生产的东西就行。

original: {amused}Ha. Yeah, can you believe some people still eat that stuff? Anyway...
translation: {amused}哈。说起来，你能相信有人还在吃那种东西吗？反正……

original: {Ghastly Scavenger}Ghouls and Super Mutants sometimes taste like Brahmin steaks.
translation: {Ghastly Scavenger}感觉尸鬼和超级变种人尝起来和双头牛肉排也差不多。

original: You're just pulling my leg, right? Why would anyone... uh... never mind. Anyway...
translation: 你是在逗我吧？怎么会有人……呃……算了。反正……

original: I've got this recipe for a Deathclaw Omelet that I've been itching to try out. Trouble is - I need a Deathclaw egg. Kinda obvious, I suppose.
translation: 我拿到死亡爪煎蛋卷的食谱以后，就一直想动手尝试。问题是——很显然，我需要一颗死亡爪的蛋。

original: Why do you ask?
translation: 你为什么问这个？

original: {slightly excited, has a passion for cooking exotic recipes}I've got this recipe for a Deathclaw Omelet that I've been itching to try out. Trouble is - I need a Deathclaw egg. Kinda obvious, I suppose.
translation: {slightly excited, has a passion for cooking exotic recipes}我拿到死亡爪煎蛋卷的食谱以后，就一直想动手尝试。问题是——很显然，我需要一颗死亡爪的蛋。

original: {Cannibal}People have a rather unique taste, I've discovered.
translation: {Cannibal}我发现了，每个人吃起来都有独特的味道。

original: Uh... hmm... well, no accounting for taste I guess. Anyway...
translation: 唔……嗯……好吧，反正我也觉得味道不是重点……

original: I've got this recipe for a Deathclaw Omelet that I've been itching to try out. Trouble is - I need a Deathclaw egg. Kinda obvious, I suppose.
translation: 我拿到死亡爪煎蛋卷的食谱以后，就一直想动手尝试。问题是——很显然，我需要一颗死亡爪的蛋。

original: I killed the Deathclaw Mother and the Deathclaw Alpha Male.
translation: 我把哺崽的死亡爪母兽和雄性死亡爪族长都干掉了。

original: Coming from anyone else, I'd say they were drunk or crazy, but that look in your eyes - I believe you.
translation: 如果换做其他人，我肯定会觉得他们要么醉了要么疯了，但从你的眼神来看——我相信你。

original: I can pay you, but it ain't much for what you pulled off. I'll get on the ham radio first thing and tell people all about you, though.
translation: 我可以付钱给你，但比起你的功绩，一点小钱实在太微不足道。我会通过民用无线电，向大家传颂你的事迹。

original: I killed the Deathclaw Alpha Male.
translation: 我干掉了雄性死亡爪首领。

original: You... you did? That's pretty amazing - I figured you'd need artillery to take him out.
translation: 你……你干掉他了？了不起——我还以为你要用大炮才能干掉他呢。

original: I hate to say it, but as long as the Deathclaw Mother is still alive, that pack isn't going anywhere. She'll take another mate and keep laying eggs.
translation: 虽然不想扫你的兴，但哺崽的死亡爪母兽不死，这群怪物是不会散去的。她会另找一个配偶，继续下崽。

original: I killed the Mother Deathclaw.
translation: 我干掉了哺崽的死亡爪母兽。

original: You... you did? That's pretty amazing - I figured you'd need artillery to take her out.
translation: 你……你干掉她了？了不起——我还以为你要用大炮才能干掉她呢。

original: I hate to say it, but as long as the Alpha Male is still alive, that pack isn't going anywhere, even with the Deathclaw Mother out of the picture.
translation: 虽然不想扫你的兴，但死亡爪首领不死，这群怪物是不会散去的，就算死亡爪母兽被干掉了也一样。

original: I fixed Snuffles' leg.
translation: 我治好了鼻涕虫的腿。

original: I'd noticed Snuffles limping, but I didn't realize the problem was that serious. Thanks - that beast helps keep spirits up around here.
translation: 我注意到鼻涕虫一瘸一拐的，但没想到到问题这么严重。谢谢了——那头小畜生能帮着振奋人心。

original: I repaired your generator.
translation: 我修好了你的发电机。

original: It's nice to see things going the way they're supposed to, for a change. I'm going to pay you out of my own pocket for this one.
translation: 事情渐回正轨，真不错。作为回报，这次我自掏腰包感谢你。

original: I noticed you have a tame molerat.
translation: 我注意到你驯养了一只鼹鼠。

original: Yeah, he - or she, I guess - wandered into camp a couple of months back. Seemed friendly enough.
translation: 对，雄的——也可能是雌的，几个月以前爬到我们营地。看这家伙还挺友好的。

original: Ugly-looking thing, but the guys like having it around. Good for morale and all that.
translation: 虽然长得挺丑，不过大家都喜欢把它带在身边。可以提振大伙儿的精神。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: You don't get paid in caps?
translation: 你们的工资不是用瓶盖结的？

original: Nope. The NCR's been trying to switch over to using paper money, like in the Pre-War days. Trouble is that the exchange rates ain't exactly fair.
translation: 不是。NCR一直都想改用纸币，就像战前那样。可问题是汇率太低了。

original: For example, a hundred bucks in NCR money is valued at roughly half that in caps around here. Seems like a rotten deal for us, but work is work.
translation: 比如说，一百块的大钞在这里就只值差不多50个瓶盖。感觉我们吃了大亏，但工作还是得做。

original: What's a dragline?
translation: 挖掘机是什么？

original: It's a big machine which moves rocks around, piles at a time. It's Pre-War tech, so you need to thump it once in awhile to keep it running.
translation: 一种挖石头的大机器，一次能挖一大堆。不过都是战前技术了，你得时不时地捶它两下才能正常工作。

original: What does the NCR need with the cement?
translation: NCR要水泥来干什么？

original: It all gets shipped by rail over towards Boulder City and Hoover Dam. The NCR's probably building fortifications with it all.
translation: 水泥都被装上火车，运到巨石城和胡佛水坝去了。NCR可能在用水泥修防御工事吧。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: This is Sloan, a camp for us quarry workers. The actual quarry, Quarry Junction, is up the road north of here. The whole thing is an NCR operation.
translation: 这里是斯隆，我们采石工人的营地。采石场枢纽在路的北边。这里一整片都属于NCR。

original: We make cement for the NCR using the limestone we dig out with dynamite and draglines. Dirty work, but the pay's good.
translation: 我们用炸药和挖掘机采掘石灰岩，来给NCR造水泥。虽然是脏活，但薪酬不错。

original: Wish we got paid in caps, though. Not a lot of merchants like taking NCR paper money.
translation: 其实我们更希望能用瓶盖来结工资。愿意接受NCR纸币的商人可不多。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: I could take care of your Deathclaw problem.
translation: 我可以帮你解决死亡爪问题。

original: Have you even seen a Deathclaw? They're taller than a man and far, far stronger and faster. And, there's a whole pack of them out there.
translation: 你见过死亡爪吗？它们比人高，比人壮，动作迅速。更何况，采石场里面住的可是一家子。

original: You'd have to be the meanest, toughest, roughest bastard in the wasteland to have any chance against them, and I don't think that's you.
translation: 只有废土上最狡猾、最残暴、最野蛮的混蛋才有本事制服它们，我不认为你是那种人。

original: You'd need to take out the pack leaders - the Mother Deathclaw and the Deathclaw Alpha Male. Kill 'em, and the pack will scatter. Pretty tough job.
translation: 你得擒贼先擒王——干掉哺崽的死亡爪和雄性头领。它们一死，其他自然会作鸟兽散。这任务可不简单。

original: I don't what it is about you, but I think you could actually pull it off. Deathclaws are tough bastards, but you might be even tougher.
translation: 虽然我没领教过你的本事，但我觉得你可以尝试一下。死亡爪虽然凶残，但你可能比它们更凶残。

original: Nobody here's any use to you in a fight against Deathclaws, but take these medical supplies. You'll probably need them.
translation: 对付死亡爪，我们恐怕帮不上什么忙。不过你可以拿上这些药品。它们大概会派上用场。

original: To do the job right, you've got to get rid of the pack leaders - the Mother Deathclaw and the Deathclaw Alpha Male. Should run the rest of 'em off.
translation: 要降服它们，你得先搞定它们的头儿——死亡爪母兽和雄性首领。只要它们死了，剩下的应该能被吓跑。

original: Have you had problems with Deathclaws before?
translation: 你们这儿以前也闹过死亡爪吗？

original: We'd see them occasionally, but they didn't seem too keen on getting too close to the quarry. Not sure if it was the noise or all the workers.
translation: 我们以前偶尔也会看到它们，但那时候它们似乎并不会接近采石场。也不知道是因为噪声太大，还是工人太多。

original: I can't believe that an entire pack moved into the quarry. I thought that kind of bad luck only happened in New Vegas.
translation: 真不敢相信，现在采石场里居然来了整整一窝的死亡爪。我还以为这种倒霉事只会发生在新维加斯。

original: Tell me about the Powder Gangers.
translation: 说说炸药帮的事。

original: They're a bunch of escaped cons from down south. The NCR was using them to maintain the railways as part of their sentence.
translation: 他们是从南方来的越狱犯。NCR曾让他们去修铁路，以对他们进行劳改。

original: I don't know who screwed up, but the Powder Gangers are loose. It was one group that attacked us and took our entire supply of dynamite.
translation: 我不知道究竟是谁捅的娄子，但炸药帮最后逃出来了。他们袭击了我们，抢走了我们所有的炸药。

original: Where'd the Deathclaws come from?
translation: 那些死亡爪是从哪儿来的？

original: They moved into the quarry after the Powder Gangers came through and made off with most of our dynamite.
translation: 炸药帮偷走了我们绝大部分的炸药以后，它们就在采石场里安了家。

original: We shut the quarry down while we waited for the NCR to get us some more blasting sticks, but now the Deathclaws have shown up.
translation: 我们暂时关闭了采石场，等待NCR再送一些雷管过来，但现在死亡爪已经在底下横行霸道了。

original: The NCR's a no-show, and my men and I have got nothing to do but sit on our asses all day. It's damn frustrating.
translation: NCR的人却一直都没出现，我和我的人只能整天傻坐着。真他妈让人泄气。

original: What can you tell me about New Vegas?
translation: 关于新维加斯你能告诉我点儿什么？

original: I've been there once, and I don't recommend it. It's just a way to burn through a month's pay in five minutes.
translation: 我去过一次，再也不想去了。新维加斯是那种只消五分钟就能掏空你一个月薪水的地方。

original: I've seen a lot of folks come through here thinking they'll have the easy life once they get there. It never happens.
translation: 我见过很多人，以为到了新维加斯就能过上好日子。但那种事从来就没发生过。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: If you insist on going north, don't be expecting a rescue when you get into trouble.
translation: 如果你坚持要往北走，遇到麻烦了可没人去救你。

original: Yep.
translation: 是的。

original: I don't need a bomb.
translation: 我不需要什么炸弹。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: How hard can it be to put a bomb on a vertibird?
translation: 往飞鸟上放个炸弹有什么难的？

original: Harder than you think. I don't want you blowing this, so I'll just hold on to this.
translation: 比你想的难，我可不放心让你去干，所以我还是自己来吧。

original: I'm familiar with explosives, give it here.
translation: 我很懂炸药，给我吧。

original: Here you go. Put it to good use.
translation: 给你。别浪费了。

original: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢了。

original: Suit yourself. What else do you want to know?
translation: 随便你。你还想知道什么？

original: How hard can it be to put a bomb on a vertibird?
translation: 往飞鸟上放个炸弹有什么难的？

original: Harder than you think. I don't want you blowing us both up, so I'll just hold on to this.
translation: 比你想的难，我可不放心让你去干，所以我还是自己来吧。

original: I'm familiar with explosives, give it here.
translation: 我很懂炸药，给我吧。

original: Here you go. Put it to good use.
translation: 给你。别浪费了。

original: Let's go back to my other questions.
translation: 我问点其他的问题。

original: Okay, what would you like to know?
translation: 好吧，你想知道些什么？

original: Give me the security details.
translation: 告诉我安保布置的细节。

original: Security is going to be tight. Rangers are stationed all around the observation deck where Kimball is going to give his speech.
translation: 安保工作布置得很严密。游骑兵在金博尔发表演讲的地点周围全都设置了岗哨。

original: Security is led by a Ranger Grant. He's a pretty rough guy who's seen a lot of combat. It's best if you steer clear of him.
translation: 警备工作由一个叫格兰特的游骑兵负责，他可是个硬骨头，非常能打，可以的话最好避开他。

original: The crowd consists of troopers and a few select civilians who were lucky enough to bribe their way in. They shouldn't cause much trouble for you.
translation: 现场的观众主要由士兵和少数选出来的平民组成，应该不会给你造成什么麻烦。

original: Finally, there's the additional security that Kimball will be bringing with him. I wasn't able to find out much on that.
translation: 最后，金博尔身边肯定还布置了其他安保力量，但我不清楚到底是什么。

original: If I had more time in their computers I could've accessed the full duty roster and guard deployment. Maybe you'll have better luck.
translation: 如果再给我点时间入侵他们的电脑，搞不好就能弄到最终的值勤名单和安保方案。可能你的运气会比我好点。

original: Tell me about Kimball's schedule.
translation: 告诉我金博尔的行程。

original: The President is scheduled to arrive sometime in the afternoon. It's going to be a short visit to boost morale for the NCR troops.
translation: 按照行程，他下午才到。整个视察的时间很短，他只是来鼓舞一下士气的。

original: He's going to arrive, give a speech, and then leave. No meet and greet, no questions, just a quick in and out.
translation: 他抵达后会发表演讲，然后就离开。没有任何会见，也不回答问题，差不多是来了就走。

original: They're probably afraid something is going to happen. For good reason.
translation: 他们大概是怕出事，这么安排倒也在情理之中。

original: I wasn't able to find a final itinerary for his visit, but if you can find one, you can get more details on what's going to happen.
translation: 我实在是搞不到他们最后敲定的行程表，但如果你能自己搞到一份，就可以掌握更多信息了。

original: I don't have any more questions.
translation: 我没别的问题了。

original: If there's nothing else, then we should get moving.
translation: 如果没有别的事，那我们就该出发了。

original: Is there anything you can do to help?
translation: 你还能帮上什么忙？

original: Well, I have a bomb here that can be put on the vertibird that will detonate at a certain altitude, but it's a little unstable and dangerous.
translation: 我这里有个炸弹，你可以把它装到飞鸟里，这个炸弹在到达一定高度之后就会爆炸，不过它有点不太稳定，很危险。

original: How are we getting into the Dam?
translation: 我们该怎么进入水坝？

original: I have some disguises for us. I've already got mine. A wealthy Brahmin Baron who bribed his way into seeing the President.
translation: 我已经给咱们准备好了伪装。我会装扮成一个富有的双头牛大亨，花钱打通关系，就为了见总统一面。

original: As for you, I have a NCR trooper uniform that I acquired. It'll fool most of the troopers and civilians, but it probably won't fool the rangers.
translation: 至于你，我搞到了一套NCR士兵的制服。这玩意足够糊弄大部分士兵和平民，但恐怕骗不过游骑兵。

original: What sort of intel have you gathered?
translation: 你都有些什么情报？

original: I've been able to get some basic information on the schedule for Kimball's visit as well as getting some rough security details.
translation: 我弄到了金博尔的视察行程，以及安保工作的粗略安排。

original: Do you have any suggestions about the assassination?
translation: 关于这次刺杀行动，你有什么建议吗？

original: Suggestions, eh? I'd suggest you play to your strengths. There's probably plenty of ways to kill Kimball, just find one that works best for you.
translation: 建议啊？我建议你发挥专长。有很多方法可以干掉金博尔，你只要用你最擅长的方式就可以了。

original: We'll have a few hours before he arrives. You should look around and see if you can find anything that you can use.
translation: 还有几个小时他才会到。你应该先去看看周围有没有可以利用的东西。

original: Just be careful. You don't want to cause a scene before Kimball even shows up.
translation: 不过小心点，金博尔还没来，你可别打草惊蛇。

original: Let's get moving.
translation: 我们出发吧。

original: You're the boss.
translation: 听你的。

original: I'll be in the crowd. Do whatever you need to do, then find me before Kimball arrives.
translation: 我会混进观众里。做好准备，在金博尔抵达之前来找我。

original: Here's your disguise. This'll get you past most of the NCR there, but watch out for the rangers. Odds are this won't fool them.
translation: 这是你的伪装，足够骗过NCR的士兵和平民了，但是小心游骑兵，他们可不吃这一套。

original: I'll meet you there. Good luck.
translation: 我会在那里跟你碰头。祝你好运。

original: What sort of information do you have?
translation: 你都有些什么情报？

original: I've been spying in the dam for a while now. I've gathered quite a bit of information from various sources.
translation: 我监视水坝已经有一段时间了，从各个渠道收集到了不少情报。

original: It's none of your business.
translation: 不关你的事。

original: Fine, be like that. I'm just here to give you whatever information I can to help you get the job done.
translation: 好吧，随你的便。我会把我知道的所有情报都告诉你。

original: If you don't need my help, that's fine with me.
translation: 但你如果觉得不需要我帮忙，我也没意见。

original: I don't need a plan to put a bullet in his head.
translation: 不就是给他脑袋来一枪吗，我不需要计划。

original: True, but I don't think it'll be that easy.
translation: 确实。但我想这没那么简单。

original: Going in guns blazing with all the NCR Troopers and Rangers stationed at the dam will just get you killed.
translation: 水坝上那么多的NCR士兵和游骑兵，你冲上去硬碰硬肯定是死路一条。

original: I do have some information that you might find useful, if you're interested.
translation: 我这里倒是有些对你有用的情报，如果你感兴趣的话，可以问我。

original: I haven't given it much thought.
translation: 我还没仔细想过呢。

original: You better start thinking about it soon, we're on a limited time schedule.
translation: 你最好现在开始想。我们时间不多了。

original: I do have some information that could help you.
translation: 我这里倒是有些对你有用的情报。

original: Of course I have a plan.
translation: 我当然有计划。

original: Prepared already. I like it. There's no need to give me the details, it's probably best that way.
translation: 看样子你是有备而来，我喜欢。没必要告诉我细节，这样最好。

original: Even though you already have a plan, I may have some information that you might find useful.
translation: 即使你已经有计划了，我的情报对你也还是有点用的。

original: No reason. Sorry to bother you.
translation: 不会怎样。抱歉打扰你了。

original: Uh, sure. I'll just be going then.
translation: 呃，没事。那我先走了。

original: Hand over the necklace, thief.
translation: 把项链交出来，小贼。

original: Fat chance of that. What are you going to do if don't?
translation: 想得美。我不交你又能怎么样？

original: Kill you, I suppose.
translation: 应该会杀了你。

original: I'm going to see that justice is done.
translation: 我会伸张正义的。

original: Not if I kill you first!
translation: 我先干掉你吧！

original: Nothing, I guess.
translation: 没什么。

original: You are such a wimp! Die!
translation: 你这瘪三！死吧！

original: Let's just say I'll leave just enough of you left for the dogs to fight over.
translation: 这么说吧，我会留你个全尸，让那些野狗为你打架。

original: H-here. You can have the damn necklace. Just leave me alone!
translation: 拿——拿去。这该死的项链归你了。饶了我吧！

original: You stole that cap necklace from that poor man.
translation: 你从那个可怜人那里偷走了瓶盖做的项链。

original: So what if I did? What are you going to do about it?
translation: 是又怎么样？你能把我怎么着？

original: Actually, the necklace is made of seven caps. It's not really yours, is it?
translation: 实际上，这串项链上有七个瓶盖。它其实不是你的，对吧？

original: Well, I guess you're just too smart for me. Unfortunately, I can't leave any witnesses behind.
translation: 好吧，你还真是有点聪明过头了。很不幸，我不能留下活口。

original: They are nice, aren't they? I'm very proud of them.
translation: 它们真漂亮，不是吗？为此我可自豪了。

original: Nothing like those six you've got there.
translation: 和你这六个瓶盖一样的东西，我手上没有。

original: Pretty sure, yeah. it's really nice, isn't it? Have you ever seen caps with pretty blue stars on them like these?
translation: 非常确定。它真的很漂亮，不是吗？你见过这种上面有漂亮蓝色星星的瓶盖吗？

original: Are you sure that necklace is yours?
translation: 你确定那条项链就是你的？

original: Sure have. And I'm thinking of adding yours to my collection.
translation: 当然有了。而且我还在考虑把你的也拿过来。

original: You know, I was just thinking the same thing about you.
translation: 巧了，我也在想同样的事。

original: No, can't say that I have.
translation: 不，我没有。

original: That's too bad. They're very rare. Well, I should be going. Nice talking to you.
translation: 那太糟了。它们非常稀有。嗯，我该走了。和你交谈很愉快。

original: Yes, I've got a few myself.
translation: 对，我自己就有一些。

original: Ah, then you know how rare they are. I'm just glad they're back where they belong. You can never be too careful these days.
translation: 啊，那你也应该知道它们的稀有程度吧。很高兴它们又物归原主了。这年头你怎么小心都不为过。

original: Well, it was nice to meet you. I'm going to take a few moments to get myself together, then head out.
translation: 嗯，很高兴见到你。我得先花几分钟平复一下心情，再上路。

original: What was that you took from his corpse?
translation: 你从他的尸体上拿了什么？

original: What? This? He stole this from me at gunpoint. Lucky for me, he got distracted and I got a chance to draw on him.
translation: 什么？这个？这是他拿枪逼着我交出来的。好在他当时走神了，让我有机会以牙还牙。

original: It's a, uh, necklace that I made out of these special caps. You ever see any caps with a blue star on them like these?
translation: 这条项链…呃，是我用特殊瓶盖做成的。你见过这种上面有蓝色星星的瓶盖吗？

original: Don't mention it. I'll be on my way.
translation: 别客气。我走了。

original: Stay safe. The road's dangerous in these parts. Or so I hear.
translation: 注意安全。这一带都挺危险，至少我是这么听说的。

original: Figure it out yourself. I need to get out of here.
translation: 你自己想办法解决吧。我要走了。

original: Just be more careful in the future, okay?
translation: 以后多长个心眼，好吗？

original: I will. That's the last time I pick up a straggler on the road, believe me.
translation: 我会的。以后我再也不会和路上撞见的陌生人搭讪了，相信我。

original: Just get rid of them. It doesn't matter how you do it.
translation: 丢掉它们就是了。怎么丢随你便。

original: You got it. I'm glad I ran into you. Thanks for the advice.
translation: 好的。很高兴能遇上你。谢谢你的建议。

original: I can hold onto them for you. I'm not worried about the people that are looking for them.
translation: 我会帮你好好保管的。我可不怕那些来抢瓶盖的人。

original: They're all yours. I sincerely hope they work better for you than they did for me.
translation: 都送给你了。我真诚希望它们能给你带来比我更好的运气。

original: Lucky for me, you mean. Hand them over or I gut you like a fish.
translation: 运气好的人是我。把它们交出来，否则我活剥了你的皮。

original: Uh, yeah, sure. H-here you go. Just don't hurt me.
translation: 呃，好的，当然。给——给你。别伤害我。

original: Lucky for me, you mean. Hand them over.
translation: 运气好的人是我。把它们交出来。

original: What? The hell I will!
translation: 什么？别做梦了！

original: [SUCCEEDED] Really? I had no idea. And here I've been carrying them all this time, never knowing how dangerous they were.
translation: [成功] 真的？我不知道。我把它们戴在身上这么久，不晓得它们居然这么危险。

original: What do you think I should do with them? Bury 'em or something?
translation: 你觉得我应该怎么办？把它们埋了还是怎么着？

original: All sorts of nasty people are looking for caps like those. You'd be safer if you got rid of them.
translation: 有不少卑鄙小人盯着这种瓶盖，我看你还是把它们丢掉比较安全。

original: [FAILED] Even if what you're saying is true, I think I'll take my chances. This necklace and I have been through a lot, and we're both still kicking.
translation: [失败] 就算你说的是真的，我还是宁愿相信自己的运气。我和这条项链一块儿出生入死，现在不也还活蹦乱跳的。

original: If that's not lucky, what is?
translation: 如果这都不算好运气，什么才算好运气呢？

original: Those caps are bad luck. Why don't you let me hold onto them for you?
translation: 这些瓶盖不吉利。为什么不交给我来保管呢？

original: I have to be going.
translation: 我得走了。

original: Lucky charm necklace?
translation: 幸运项链？

original: Yeah, every once in a while you can find a cap with a blue star on it. They're pretty rare, so I started collecting them.
translation: 对啊，很偶然的机会，我发现了一些印有蓝色星星的瓶盖。它们非常罕见，所以我就开始收集。

original: Once I had enough, I made a necklace out of them, since I thought they were lucky.
translation: 收集了几枚以后，我就拿它们做了一串项链，因为我觉得它们肯定会给我带来好运。

original: And maybe they are, since you managed to show up at just the right time.
translation: 搞不好它们还真给我带来了好运，要不然你怎么会及时出现？

original: Yeah, every once in a while you can find a cap with a blue star on it. They're pretty rare, so I started collecting them.
translation: 对啊，很偶然的机会，我发现了一些印有蓝色星星的瓶盖。它们非常罕见，所以我就开始收集。

original: Once I had enough, I made a necklace out of them, since I thought they were lucky.
translation: 收集了几枚以后，我就拿它们做了一串项链，因为我觉得它们肯定会给我带来好运。

original: Did you know her?
translation: 你认识她吗？

original: Not for long. I met her on the road a few days ago, and we've been traveling together since.
translation: 认识没多久。我是几天前在路上遇到她的，之后我们就结伴旅行了。

original: Surrender, general. The dam is almost taken.
translation: 投降吧，将军。大坝已经几乎被占领了。

original: This battle is far from over. Once the reinforcements from McCarran arrive, the counteroffensive will begin.
translation: 这场战斗远没结束。一旦麦卡伦的增援抵达，反击就会开始。

original: So, you must be the Courier the reports mentioned. Pass this message on to your commander - Hoover Dam will not fall while I still draw breath.
translation: 看来你就是报告里提到的那个邮差了，给你的指挥官带个话：只要我还有一口气，就绝不会交出胡佛水坝。

original: How do you like being part of the NCR military?
translation: 你觉得在NCR当兵的待遇如何？

original: It's better than farming or herding Brahmin. As long as they don't send me to the front lines, I'm a happy man.
translation: 肯定比种地或者放牛强。只要不送我上前线，我就没啥好抱怨的。

original: About those chemical supplies...
translation: 那些药……

original: Still got 'em. You ready to pay up?
translation: 当然还在。钱准备好了吗？

original: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 算了。我们说点别的。

original: Whatever. You know where to find me.
translation: 随便。你知道该去哪找我。

original: Here's 300 caps. Hand over those supplies.
translation: 这是300瓶盖。东西给我。

original: Pleasure doing business with you. {winking}Of course, this whole deal never happened, am I right?
translation: 和你做生意真痛快。{winking}当然，这笔生意从一开始就不存在，对吧？

original: < Barter 35 >
[SUCCEEDED] Fine, I'll just eat the cost and do a favor for Chomps. Just this one time only.
translation: [成功] 好吧，我就吃点亏，权当送托姆斯一个人情。不过下不为例。

original: Is 300 caps worth being known as a deal-breaker? Seems like bad business to me.
translation: 为了300瓶盖就连信用都不要了？买卖不成仁义在啊。

original: [FAILED] Hey, that's just business.
translation: [失败] 嘿，生意就是生意。

original: It's not a fair trade, and you know it.
translation: 这生意做得不地道，你自己也知道。

original: < Speech 40 >
[SUCCEEDED] I've reconsidered my position, and I think it would be in my best interest if I were to sacrifice my profit on this particular deal.
translation: [成功] 我又重新考虑了一下，确实单就这笔生意而言吧，稍微牺牲点利润反而更有好处。

original: I say the word and someone else will start making deliveries to Nevada, not you.
translation: 只消我一句话，自然有别人往内华达送货，不是非你不可。

original: [FAILED] {completely insincere}I'd love to help you and Chomps, but I got my own expenses to worry about.
translation: [失败] {completely insincere}我是很想帮你和托姆斯，可是我也要养家糊口啊。

original: Come on. Give me a break, just this once.
translation: 拜托。你就行行好，破一次例嘛。

original: You were already paid in advance.
translation: 货款不是预付了吗。

original: Yeah, and as it turns out, the advance wasn't enough. The price has gone up. That's just how it goes.
translation: 没错，不过现在这个形势，预付款不够。涨价了。就是这么回事。

original: A friend in Sloan told me to come to you about some chemical supplies.
translation: 一个在斯隆的朋友让我来找你搞点药。

original: {hushed}You trying to get me busted? Keep your damn voice down - Lieutenant Hayes already has his eye on me.
translation: {hushed}你想害我进班房吗？妈的小声点——海耶斯中尉已经盯上我了。

original: Look, I already told Chomps that the NCR's getting suspicious of all these "misplaced" supplies. Bigger risk means bigger cost - 300 caps bigger.
translation: 听着，我跟托姆斯说过了，NCR已经开始对这些"失踪"的物资起疑了。风险高了，成本自然就上去了——你得再多给300瓶盖。

original: Keep your damn voice down. Even though Lieutenant Hayes got himself killed recently, somebody else might be watching me.
translation: 你他妈小声点。就算海耶斯中尉已经死了，也会有其它人盯着我的。

original: Look, I already told Chomps that the NCR's getting suspicious of all these "misplaced" supplies. Bigger risk means bigger cost - 300 caps bigger.
translation: 听着，我跟托姆斯说过了，NCR已经开始对这些"失踪"的物资起疑了。风险高了，成本自然就上去了——你得再多给300瓶盖。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: Just making some deliveries to the troops here in Primm. I'm stationed in California, but I come across the border a couple times a month.
translation: 给驻扎在普瑞姆的士兵送点东西罢了。我的驻地在加利福尼亚，不过每个月都要穿越几次边境。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Later.
translation: 回见。

original: How do you know Melissa?
translation: 你怎么认识梅丽莎的？

original: She's my daughter. Takes a little too much after her mother, rest her soul, but she's happy with the Great Khans, and that's enough for me.
translation: 她是我女儿。她母亲过世后——愿她的灵魂安息——她受了一些打击，但她在大汗帮里过得很快乐，对我来说这样就够了。

original: All right. I'll go pay a visit to Tyrone.
translation: 好的。我会去拜访一下这位泰隆的。

original: Good luck.
translation: 好运。

original: Has Tyrone cheated you before?
translation: 泰隆以前骗过你吗？

original: He's always been shady, but this is the first time he's outright screwed me.
translation: 他本来就不是什么好人，但这样耍我还是第一次。

original: You don't care that you're helping the Great Khans?
translation: 即便替大汗帮卖命，对你来说也无所谓是吗？

original: I'm just the middle man. The Great Khans are a hard group, and some of them are no good, but they're not all the same.
translation: 我只是个中间人。大汗帮是个庞大的组织，虽然其中有些坏心眼，但也并非人人都那样。

original: I believe in the NCR, but that doesn't make it right for them to roll over anyone who doesn't want any part of 'em.
translation: 我相信NCR，可他们却使用武力去对付那些不愿意服从他们的人，这种做法无论如何都是不对的。

original: I'm looking for a suitcase filled with chemical supplies for a... friend. Know anything?
translation: 我在找一个装满了化学品的手提箱，帮一个……朋友找的。你有什么线索吗？

original: Ah, yes. I think I know which friend you mean. Even if there weren't Deathclaws in the quarry, there'd still be no delivery.
translation: 啊，是的。我想我知道你说的朋友是谁。就算采石场没有闹死亡爪，也不会有人送货来的。

original: The supplier, a guy in Primm named Tyrone, is a cheating son of a bitch who won't deliver even though he's already been paid in advance.
translation: 供货的是个叫泰隆的家伙，住在普瑞姆，没信用的杂种，收了预付款也不发货。

original: Where can I find the rest of the Great Khans?
translation: 我在哪可以找到大汗帮的其他人？

original: Our main camp is up in Red Rock Canyon, but we don't allow just anyone to come on in.
translation: 我们的大本营在红岩峡谷，不过那地方未经允许不得入内。

original: The NCR can't touch us there - too many places for us to ambush them. We see their scouts poking around once in awhile, but they keep their distance.
translation: 在那儿，NCR奈何不了我们——地形对我们有利，想伏击他们很容易。我们偶尔会看到他们的斥候在周围晃悠，但都离得很远。

original: What happened between the Great Khans and the NCR?
translation: 大汗帮和NCR之间到底有什么过节？

original: Bitter Springs happened. Women and children died when the NCR attacked the Great Khans there, and the NCR just pretends it never happened.
translation: 苦泉大屠杀。NCR袭击了定居在苦泉的大汗帮，杀死了大批妇孺百姓，却装作什么都没发生过。

original: <Lie> Just trying to get on the good side of the Great Khans.
translation: <撒谎> 我只是想讨好大汗帮而已。

original: That's a smart move. The Great Khans look out for their friends.
translation: 你的做法很聪明。大汗帮向来待朋友不薄。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Let's talk about something else now.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Tell me about the Great Khans.
translation: 跟我说说大汗帮。

original: We're an independent group. We take care of our own and don't take crap from anybody, especially the NCR.
translation: 我们是独立的族群。我们自力更生，不用看任何人的脸色，尤其是NCR。

original: I got the chems for you.
translation: 我把化学品给你带来了。

original: You actually came through for us. I... didn't expect that. Anyway, the Great Khans pay their debts and don't forget their friends.
translation: 你真的做到了。我……还真没想到你能成功。不管怎么说，大汗帮有债必还，有恩必报。

original: If you ever come out to Red Rock Canyon, I'll put in a good word for you.
translation: 如果你有朝一日到红岩峡谷去，我会帮你美言几句的。

original: Anything else I should know?
translation: 还有什么我应该知道的吗？

original: Don't kill anybody if you don't have to. I'm a scout, and I like to keep a low profile.
translation: 不到万不得已不要杀人。我只是个斥候，可不希望桐大篓子。

original: Got it. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 明白了。我们谈点别的。

original: {slightly suspicious}Like what?
translation: {slightly suspicious}比如说？

original: Are these chemicals dangerous?
translation: 这些化学品危险吗？

original: I wouldn't eat or drink them, but no, they won't explode if you drop them or anything.
translation: 我反正是不会把它们塞进嘴里，但它们并不危险，哪怕扔到地上或怎么样，也不会爆炸的。

original: Well, I am expecting to be paid, of course.
translation: 我希望能得到报酬。

original: That's a motive I can understand.
translation: 这个目的我能理解。

original: A favor for a favor.
translation: 我帮你，你帮我。

original: All right, fair enough. You help us out, and I'll owe you one.
translation: 很好，非常公平。只要你肯帮我们，日后我保证还你一份人情。

original: No angle. I just want to help.
translation: 什么也不为。我就是喜欢帮助别人。

original: {still not trusting}Right. All right, here's the deal.
translation: {still not trusting}好吧。好，事情是这样的。

original: I was expecting a shipment of chemicals. It's usually in a suitcase dropped off in one of the big machines up here.
translation: 我在等一批化学原料。它们通常会被装在手提箱里，藏在附近的某座大型机械底下。

original: Because of the Deathclaws, I have to assume that the suitcase is still in Sloan. Snoop around the place and get it for me.
translation: 由于死亡爪的缘故，我估计箱子目前还在斯隆。去那儿找找看，把箱子交给我。

original: Seems like an odd place to pick up a delivery.
translation: 怎么会选这种奇怪的地方交货。

original: The Khans and the NCR don't get along - they prefer to shoot us on sight, even if we're not looking for a fight.
translation: 大汗帮和NCR没法和平相处——哪怕我们不来找事，他们也是一见到我们就开枪。

original: What kind of delivery are you expecting?
translation: 你等的是什么货？

original: Supplies to make chems. The NCR's the best source since they're hard to come by anywhere else.
translation: 制作药品的化学原料。其他渠道进货都太难了，所以NCR反而成了最好的货源。

original: We don't really use the chems ourselves, just sell them to anybody with the caps. If it ends up hurting the NCR in the process, that's a bonus.
translation: 我们自己其实不嗑药，那些药是卖给愿意掏钱的人的。如果还能顺便打击一下NCR，那就更好了。

original: I'll help you with your problem.
translation: 我会帮你解决你的问题的。

original: {not trusting player}Is that right? What's your angle?
translation: {not trusting player}真的？你为什么要这样做？

original: {Great Khans - Vilified}I know something of your reputation with my gang, and I can't be seen working with you. Sorry, but I'll handle this.
translation: {Great Khans - Vilified}我知道你和我的人有点过节，如果让他们发现我们有合作关系，那我可不好交待。抱歉，这事我自己处理。

original: What are you doing up here?
translation: 你在这儿干什么？

original: Awaiting a delivery, but it's a no-show. I'm guessing that the Deathclaws in the quarry have something to do with that.
translation: 在等送货的人，不过直到现在也连一个人影都没见着。我猜和采石场里的死亡爪有点关系。

original: I'm looking for some Great Khans who stole something from me in Goodsprings.
translation: 我在找大汗帮的人，他们在清泉镇偷了我的东西。

original: The only Khans this far into NCR territory is me and my crew, and I didn't steal squat from you.
translation: 我和我的手下是目前唯一潜入NCR领地内的大汗帮成员，我可没偷你什么东西。

original: Besides, even if some of my gang did steal from you, I wouldn't rat them out. Loyalty actually means something to the Great Khans.
translation: 另外，即便我的人真偷了你的东西，我也不会把他们供出来的。对大汗帮来说，忠诚是很重要的。

original: As far as I know, it's just me and my crew out here, and if it really was Great Khans who mugged you, they didn't come this way. I'd have seen 'em.
translation: 据我所知，这附近就只有我和我的手下，如果真有大汗帮的人劫了你的道，他们也没走这边。否则我早就看到他们了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Don't leave a trail.
translation: 别留下痕迹。

original: < Medicine - 30 >
[SUCCEEDED] <snuffle!>
translation: [成功] <鼻音!>

original: [Clean the wound with antibiotics and expertly bind Snuffles' injured leg.]
translation: [用抗生素为鼻涕虫清创，并熟练地包扎它的伤腿]

original: [FAILED] <whuff!>
translation: [失败] <喘气!>

original: [Do your best attempts at first aid to treat Snuffles' injured leg.]
translation: [尽量为鼻涕虫的伤腿进行急救。]

original: How's it going?
translation: 进展如何？

original: <whuff>
translation: <喘气>

original: <snuffle!>
translation: <鼻音!>

original: Hmmm... your leg appears to be injured.
translation: 嗯……很明显你的腿受伤了。

original: <whuff>
translation: <喘气>

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: <snuffle>
translation: <鼻音>

original: Will the White Glove Society ally with Caesar now?
translation: 白手套社团可以和军团结盟了吗？

original: I should think so, but it would be up to Marjorie.
translation: 我没有问题，但这得玛乔里说了算。

original: I have, however, told her how instrumental you were in revolutionizing our cuisine. And she knows what we stand to gain from a ruler who supports it.
translation: 当然，我已经对她说明了你在这次菜式革新中所起的作用。同时她也清楚，如果能有一位统治者支持这项改革，那对我们必然大有好处。

original: Have a word with her, see what she says. I daresay she'll be more receptive with these new developments.
translation: 去跟她谈谈吧，看她怎么说。经过这次事件的洗礼，我相信她会接受的。

original: Do you have a means of changing her mind? Something I can do?
translation: 你有没有能让她改变主意的办法？有什么我能做的？

original: Caesar wishes to extend your society an offer of alliance with his Legion.
translation: 凯撒希望你们的社团能通过与他的军团结盟来发展壮大。

original: Tell your ruler we have no interest in such ties. Caesar's Legion is a collection of unclean barbarians.
translation: 回去告诉你们主子，我们对这种盟约没兴趣。凯撒军团里全是肮脏的野蛮人。

original: Any time the White Glove Society is mentioned in the same breath, it sullies our good name.
translation: 把白手套社团和军团相提并论，我们的好名声可受不了这样的玷污。

original: As much as Mortimer and some of the other members have tried to convince me otherwise, I will not have us seen as savages.
translation: 无论莫蒂默和其他少数会员用什么方法来说服我，我都不会允许我们的社团与野人为伍。

original: Looking to elevate his social status, is he?
translation: 他想提升自己的社会地位，是吗？

original: I'll admit, I could see benefits to living under his rule. Certain... transgressions he'd be willing to overlook.
translation: 必须承认，做他的臣民当确实会给我们带来一些好处。也许他能对某些……违反公序良俗的行为视而不见。

original: But that's neither here nor there, I'm afraid. Marjorie won't have it, as long as she fails to see the wisdom of my perspective.
translation: 不过事情恐怕没这么简单。玛乔里她根本领悟不到我的观点是有多么富有远见，她不会接受的。

original: I don't care for their incivility or the hodgepodge of sporting equipment that passes for fashion with them.
translation: 我很反感他们粗鲁的举止，也不喜欢他们那种混搭了运动装备的古怪时尚。

original: Nevertheless, I have heard Caesar has a stately dignity about him. And I understand his policies will agree with our new menu.
translation: 然而，我听说凯撒本人气宇不凡。我也知道，以他的政策，一定可以接纳我们现在的饮食习惯。

original: I prefer Mr. House, of course, but he may not be around forever. And the NCR will surely set back our cuisine. Tell your Mr. Caesar we are with him.
translation: 当然，我更喜欢豪斯先生，但他不大可能永远统治长街。而NCR肯定容不下我们的美食理念。所以回去告诉你的凯撒先生，我们同意结盟。

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: Momma always told me not to talk to strangers, but you seem like a nice person.
translation: 妈妈不让我跟陌生人说话，但你看起来不像坏人。

original: Momma left me on a farm when she went out prospecting, but when she never came back, the owner didn't want me around and kicked me out on my own.
translation: 妈妈出去捡破烂的时候把我留在了农场，但她再也没有回来。东家不想再看到我，就把我一个人踢了出来。

original: A nice guy came up and asked me if I wanted to join the NCR so I did. Now the Troopers are my family. I like it here. Everyone is so nice.
translation: 后来出现了一个好人，问我想不想加入NCR，我就答应了。现在部队就是我的家。我喜欢这里，每个人都是那么善良。

original: What do you know about the President's visit?
translation: 关于总统来视察的事，你都知道些什么？

original: He's coming to give a big fancy speech to all of us troops stationed here at the dam.
translation: 他是来给我们这些驻守在水坝的士兵演讲的。

original: I'm pretty excited. He seems like such a nice guy and I get to meet him.
translation: 我很兴奋。他看起来人不错，我很想见见他。

original: He's giving me a medal. I don't know why though. I'm just doing my job like all the other guys. I'm still excited though.
translation: 他要给我授勋，虽然我不知道为什么。我只是像其他士兵一样做好本职工作罢了。但我还是很激动。

original: I can't believe someone killed President Kimball. He was such a nice guy, why would anyone want to hurt him?
translation: 真不敢相信有人杀了金博尔总统。他那么好的一个人，为什么要害他？

original: I can't believe someone wanted to kill President Kimball. I'm glad he got out of here safe.
translation: 真不敢相信有人想杀了金博尔总统，幸好他安全撤离了。

original: Your helmet is right over there.
translation: 你的头盔在那边。

original: {confused}It's always in the last place you look. I wonder why that is.
translation: 找不到的东西怎么总出现在找过的地方。真是奇怪。

original: Thanks mister, you're the greatest.
translation: 谢谢，先生，你最好了。

original: {confused}It's always in the last place you look. I wonder why that is.
translation: 找不到的东西怎么总出现在找过的地方。真是奇怪。

original: There it is! Thanks lady, you're the greatest.
translation: 就是它！谢谢，女士，你最好了。

original: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

original: So you have to do whatever Lawson tells you.
translation: 所以你其实是听命于劳森了？

original: No, man. That's just what I'm supposed to do.
translation: 不，老兄。我不过是假装听他的罢了。

original: But when he tells me to push the middle button to divert the intake, and the right button feels nicer when I touch it, I know where my loyalty is.
translation: 但是当他让我按中间的按钮来排水时，即便右边的按钮我觉着更顺手，我还是会老老实实听他的。

original: Man, I just don't know how an idiot like that gets put in charge of anything.
translation: 老兄，我只是搞不懂，怎么能让他那样的白痴来管事呢。

original: They put you in charge of Hoover Dam?
translation: 他们让你来管胡佛水坝？

original: They sure as shit did. I mean there's still formalities, like I have to run everything by Lawson before I do it.
translation: 这真是个狗屁决定。我是说，他们也太迂腐了，不管我想做什么，都得提前向劳森请示。

original: But do I ever do that? Is his name Fantastic?
translation: 你以为我会请示？那我还叫珍世邦？

original: What are your responsibilities now?
translation: 你现在负责什么？

original: Man, what aren't my responsibilities? Dam overflow, dam underflow. Dam leakage. Sometimes the dam gets too big and I have to shrink it down.
translation: 伙计，你应该问，还有什么是我不负责的？这水坝一会儿溢流，一会儿露底，一会儿又破堤。反正每次它一发脾气，我就得想法子哄好它。

original: People come to me to resolve their disputes with my wisdom.
translation: 大家都需要我的智慧来帮助他们裁定争端。

original: Like, hey  Fantastic, who gets to keep this doodad we found? Or, yo, Fantastic, when will you accept that you're the father of my child? It's crazy.
translation: 比如，嘿，珍世邦，我们发现的这个小玩意该归谁呀？或者，哟，珍世邦，你什么时候才能宣布你是我孩子的爸爸呀？真是太疯狂了。

original: Get this straight. You're not my master.
translation: 我就直说吧，你不是我的主人。

original: Whoa, hey. All right, man. It's cool. Who said anything about being your master?
translation: 哦，嘿，老兄。冷静点。谁说我是你的主人了？

original: I'm just the guy who tells you to do the stuff you do before you do it.
translation: 我不过是想在你行动前，告诉你该怎么做而已。

original: Fantastic? What are you doing here?
translation: 珍世邦？你在这里做什么？

original: What's it look like, man? I'm fucking king of the NCR. Caesar's Legion has Caesar, the NCR's got Fantastic. It's Fantastic's NCR now.
translation: 你觉得我在干什么，老兄？我可是他们NCR的王啊。凯撒军团有凯撒，NCR有珍世邦。如今的NCR早已是我珍世邦的天下了。

original: This whole war's about power, man. Caesar wants it. NCR wants it. Fantastic's got it.
translation: 这场战争就是因电力而起的，老兄。凯撒想要电，NCR也想要电。而电全掌握在我珍世邦的手里。

original: After I fixed HELIOS One and basically saved the NCR from the dumbshits who run it, I got myself a little promotion. Now I run the whole shebang.
translation: 是我修好了太阳神一号，救了NCR的小命，不久我就要升官啦，现在这整个地方都归我管了。

original: He was hurting you?
translation: 他伤害你了？

original: Ever since he lost his job a few years back he hasn't been the same. He took a switch to us for the tiniest things.
translation: 自从几年前他丢了工作后，他就像变了个人似的。哪怕一点小事，他都会对我们大打出手。

original: We were trying to get away when the legion showed up. I'm glad he ran off like a coward, but slavery wasn't the kind of escape I was looking for.
translation: 军团出现后，我们便开始逃难。我很高兴他像懦夫一样消失得无影无踪，但成为奴隶可不是我们想要的归宿。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Anything you can do to help, just please get us out of here.
translation: 无论做什么都行，求求你，让我们离开这里吧。

original: [Lie] Do you mean the helmet I just threw off the dam?
translation: [撒谎] 你是说我刚从水坝扔下去的那个头盔？

original: Ha ha, you big joker you. You're funny. I like you.
translation: 哈哈，你真会开玩笑。你真有趣，我喜欢你。

original: I really need to find my helmet though. Thanks anyway.
translation: 我真得去找我的头盔了。无论如何，谢谢你。

original: I haven't seen it.
translation: 我没看到。

original: That's too bad. I need it for the ceremony. I need to look my best and I need my lucky helmet.
translation: 真是太糟糕了，我参加典礼需要这东西。我需要我的幸运头盔来打扮得尽量体面些。

original: I'll just have to keep looking. Thanks anyway.
translation: 我只能继续找了。无论如何，谢谢你。

original: It's right over there.
translation: 就在那里。

original: Have you seen my helmet? I can't seem to find it.
translation: 你看见我的头盔了吗？我找不到了。

original: I've already destroyed their bunker.
translation: 我已经摧毁了他们的地堡了。

original: {nonplussed}You have?
translation: {nonplussed}是吗？

original: It's a good thing we stopped the Omertas in time.
translation: 还好我们及时阻止了黑手党的计划。

original: Indeed. Moving on...
translation: 的确。接下来……

original: They had it coming. The Omertas disgust me!
translation: 他们完全是咎由自取。黑手党那帮人令我作呕！

original: The Omertas were clever, but no match for me.
translation: 黑手党的人虽然很聪明，但跟我没法比。

original: Arrogance was their undoing. {referring to the player}There might be a lesson in that. But moving on...
translation: 正是自大导致了他们的毁灭。{referring to the player}这件事也许该引以为戒。不过还是说说下一步吧……

original: I'm going to kill you now, Mr. House.
translation: 我现在就要杀了你，豪斯先生。

original: After all that we've accomplished?
translation: 我们可是携手取得了如此多的成就啊？

original: The Omertas? No thanks.
translation: 黑手党？还是算了吧。

original: I'll check into the Omertas.
translation: 我会调查黑手党的。

original: The Omertas are fanatically loyal to each other. Still, among any group, one can find the occasional degenerate.
translation: 黑手党的成员都很讲江湖义气。可惜，任何组织里都少不了一两棵墙头草。

original: Gomorrah's receptionist happens to be one. For years she passed on whispers of what was taking place at the casino, in exchange for payment.
translation: 恰巧蛾摩拉的接待员就是这么一号人。许多年来，她都在用赌场里的线报换取外快。

original: A few months ago, she clammed up. Odds are she's scared, but I've had no way of approaching her. Start with her.
translation: 几个月前她突然噤声了。估计是受了威胁，但我没法接近她。你就从她开始入手吧。

original: The print-out I've given you lists every lead I've been able to uncover. See what you can find out.
translation: 我给你的表单里已经列出了我能找到的所有线索。看看你还能不能挖出点别的。

original: Let me think about it.
translation: 让我想一想。

original: There's nothing to think about. You have a job to do, so do it.
translation: 没什么好想的，你手上有一份工作，你就该去完成它。

original: What do you want me to do?
translation: 你想让我做什么？

original: Simple - an NCR Ranger named Grant is in charge of security arrangements for the visit. Present yourself to him, let him know you want to help.
translation: 简单——有个名叫格兰特的NCR游骑兵，专门负责总统来访的安保工作。你去找他，告诉他你愿意帮忙。

original: Given your reputation, it's a near-certainty that he'll accept your offer.
translation: 就以你的名望，他肯定会接受你的提议。

original: Don't dally. The precise time of Kimball's visit is a closely-guarded secret, but it will happen soon.
translation: 不要耽搁了。金博尔到访的准确时间是严格保密的，但应该就在最近。

original: I don't want to kill off the entire Brotherhood.
translation: 我不想把兄弟会赶尽杀绝。

original: Don't tell me that you've fallen for the stories of noble paladins on crusade, preserving mankind's technology in a benighted age? Dross!
translation: 别告诉我你信了他们那套鬼话，高尚的圣骑士们在黑暗时代守护着人类科技？根本一派胡言！

original: {not unkindly}In any case... this is an employer - employee relationship. I've given you an assignment, and the directions are clear.
translation: {not unkindly}不管怎么说…我们是雇佣关系。我已经给你安排了任务，并且目标很明确。

original: Any possibility of a diplomatic solution?
translation: 没有外交解决的途径吗？

original: We're talking about a {COAT-ah-ree}coterie of bulging-eyed fanatics who think all Pre-War technology belongs to them.
translation: 我们讨论的是一帮{COAT-ah-ree}鼓着大眼自以为战前科技全该归他们所有的狂热分子。

original: They'll never accept my using an army of robots to defend New Vegas. While it's a fight I can win, I'd rather sidestep it altogether.
translation: 他们绝不会允许我用一整支机器人部队来保卫新维加斯。尽管我可以打赢他们，但我更愿意避这场免冲突的发生。

original: Where do you want me to start?
translation: 你想我从哪里开始呢？

original: Since 2278, I've lost five roaming Securitrons near Hidden Valley.
translation: 自从2278年来，我已经在隐谷附近失去了5个电子保安。

original: I didn't receive any clear video of the incidents, but telemetry from the units destroyed indicates they were attacked with energy weapons.
translation: 我从未得到过事件的清晰影像，但从机器人毁坏前送回的遥测数据来看，它们是被能量武器攻击的。

original: It's obvious that the Brotherhood has a base in Hidden Valley or thereabouts. Finding it won't be easy, but getting inside will be the real trick.
translation: 很明显，兄弟会在隐谷或附近有一座基地。要找到它并不容易，但更难的地方在于想办法混进去。

original: The Boomers have already vowed to help me out.
translation: 大炮族已经宣誓要帮我的忙了。

original: The Boomers and I had a disagreement a while back. I pretty much wiped them out.
translation: 大炮族和我闹了些不愉快，我已经把他们都杀光了。

original: If I want more work, I'll come see you.
translation: 如果我想找事做的话，我会来找你的。

original: You laid the foundation for my victory, so fine - I'll permit some {beat, begrudging}latitude in how you schedule your work.
translation: 你为我的胜利打下了坚实的基础，好吧——我允许你{beat，begrudging}一定程度上调整自己的工作安排。

original: You're welcome.
translation: 没关系。

original: Tell me about the mission.
translation: 给我说说这次任务的情况。

original: I'd like to ask some questions.
translation: 我想问些问题。

original: <Decline quest to neutralize Boomers.>
translation: <拒绝消灭大炮族的任务。>

original: I've done enough work for you for the moment.
translation: 我给你干的活已经够多了。

original: I'll make sure they support the right side.
translation: 我会让他们站在正确的一边的。

original: Use extreme caution when approaching the base. Their firepower is... considerable.
translation: 当你靠近他们的基地时，一定要多加小心。他们的火力……不容小觑。

original: Recently, one of my roaming Securitrons observed a man near the base studying the pattern of its artillery fire. Maybe he's learned something.
translation: 最近，我手下的一个电子保安在巡视时发现基地附近有个人正在研究火炮的攻击模式。也许他已经发现什么了。

original: I've come here to kill you, Mr. House. <Attack Mr. House.>
translation: 我是来杀你的，豪斯先生。<攻击豪斯先生>

original: {first Benny, now the player}Why is good help so impossible to find?
translation: {first Benny，now the player}为什么找个好帮手就这么难呢？

original: I've done enough work for you.
