original: Do you have any leads on possible security threats?
translation: 你觉得哪里还可能存在安全隐患？

original: The Legion will definitely try something, but we don't have any solid leads yet.
translation: 军团肯定会搞点动静出来的，只是不知道会怎么搞。

original: I'd almost expect something direct from them, but given the circumstances there's a possibility of something more subtle like sabotage.
translation: 我倒是希望他们能直接动手，但看现在这个情况，估计他们更可能在背地里耍阴谋。

original: But since we don't have anything solid we'll just have to keep our eyes out for anything out of the ordinary.
translation: 不过既然没什么头绪，我们也只能多留意一些不寻常的情况了。

original: {Thinking aloud}Possible security threats... there was a new guy allowed to help with security at the last minute. {Awkward pause}Other than that, we don't have any solid leads.
translation: 可能的安全隐患……刚才倒是有个新人被派过来帮忙。{尴尬地停下}除此之外就没什么可疑的了。

original: Do you have a detailed schedule for the visit?
translation: 你有这次访问的详细时间表吗？

original: I have a full itinerary here. Here you go.
translation: 我这份有完整的行程表，给你。

original: The President arrives, gives a speech, and then leaves. That's all someone like you needs to know.
translation: 总统到场，发表演讲，然后离开。你这样的人只需要知道这些。

original: What are your security arrangements?
translation: 你对安保工作有什么安排？

original: Security detail consists of rangers stationed here at the dam. Some will keep an eye on the crowd while others will watch the perimeter.
translation: 安保工作主要由部署在此地的游骑兵负责。他们会监视观众，而其他人则负责盯住周边地区。

original: Snipers and sharpshooters have been assigned to key locations and we also have a special K9 unit sniffing out members of the crowd.
translation: 狙击手和神枪手都已经就位，此外我们还安排了一个K9特别单位探查观众里的可疑分子。

original: I've also locked down access to critical locations such as the landing platform on the visitor center.
translation: 我还封锁了停机坪和访客中心等重要地区。

original: Can I use my weapons during the President's visit?
translation: 总统视察期间我能使用武器吗？

original: We trust you, so you're free to have your weapons. Just don't do anything too crazy and we'll back you up.
translation: 我们信任你，所以你可以留着武器，不过别干傻事，不然我们就得收拾你了。

original: You'll be allowed to carry your weapons, but they must remain holstered.
translation: 你可以带着武器，不过只能带着，不准拔出来。

original: If you pull them out, my men will shoot you. Understand?
translation: 敢掏家伙的话，我的人就会立马毙了你。明白了？

original: Glad you could join us. Most of my men are already on duty and the crowd has already started gathering outside.
translation: 你能来真是太好了，我的手下大多有任务在身，但外面的观众已经开始聚集了。

original: We've got a busy day ahead of us.
translation: 今天咱们有得忙了。

original: I have some questions.
translation: 我有些问题要问。

original: Ask your questions, but keep it short.
translation: 问吧，长话短说。

original: I need to prepare first.
translation: 我得先准备准备。

original: Make it quick.
translation: 快一点儿。

original: I'm all set.
translation: 我准备好了。

original: Good. The President doesn't arrive until tomorrow. Get some rest, I'll brief you in the morning.
translation: 很好，总统明天才会到，你先休息，明早我再给你布置任务。

original: Can I ask you about your dog tag first?
translation: 我能先问问狗牌的事吗？

original: Can I ask you something else?
translation: 我能问你点别的吗？

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: There's an NCR soldier who wants me to kill you for it.
translation: 有个NCR士兵可是希望我把你杀了，取走狗牌。

original: Can I have it?
translation: 能给我吗？

original: Before I take care of them, can I ask you about your dog tag?
translation: 在我料理他们之前，能问问你狗牌的事么？

original: What do you want to know?
translation: 你想知道什么？

original: Actually, I want to talk about something else.
translation: 实际上，我想聊点别的。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: [Attack] You're a rabid dog that needs to be put down.
translation: [攻击]你这样的疯狗就该被干掉。

original: I'll kill you for that!
translation: 老子弄死你！

original: He thinks you're suffering.
translation: 他认为你正在遭罪。

original: Suffering? I may be suffering but I still want to live. You tell that bastard that I have every intention of doing so.
translation: 遭罪？就算是遭罪我也要活下去。你去告诉那个混蛋，我要干什么我自己清楚着呢。

original: Give me your dog tag, now!
translation: 把你的狗牌给我，快！

original: [FAILED] Bullying me won't make me give it to you.
translation: [失败] 再怎么恐吓我，我都不会屈服的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Fine, here. Take it. Just leave me alone.
translation: [成功] 好吧，给你。拿好了。离我远点。

original: You define who you are, not some dog tag.
translation: 决定你是谁的是你自己，而不是狗牌。

original: [FAILED] Sorry, I'm not giving it to you.
translation: [失败] 抱歉，我不能给你。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You're probably right. Here, take it.
translation: [成功] 也许你是对的。给，拿着。

original: Your humanity is a part of you, not kept in some dog tag.
translation: 你的人性才是你不可分割的一部分，不是狗牌。

original: On second thought, let me ask you something else.
translation: 我仔细想了一下，还是问点别的吧。

original: Alright.
translation: 好的。

original: What's the history of the camp?
translation: 营地都有些什么历史？

original: I know that this place was originally a mining town before the NCR took it over.  I think they mined gold before the war.
translation: 我知道在NCR占领以前，这地方原本是个矿镇。他们战前应该是在这里开矿。

original: Sorry I don't know much more than that.
translation: 抱歉，我就只知道这些。

original: Can you tell me anything about Camp Searchlight?
translation: 关于探照灯营地你都知道些什么？

original: <Lie> Oh yeah, I'm sure he'd love to see you.
translation: <撒谎>噢，对，我肯定他会很高兴见到你的。

original: [FAILED] I'm still not so sure about that.
translation: [失败] 我还是不太确定。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Guess it can't hurt to say hello.
translation: [成功] 我也觉得打个招呼应该不会有问题。

original: Astor has agreed to let you join him.
translation: 阿斯特已经同意你加入了。

original: Maybe now I can get my old life back, or at least most of it.
translation: 也许我可以过回以前的生活了，至少是大部分吧。

original: It's not much, but I want you to have this. Thanks for your help.
translation: 我知道这些礼物不算多，但还是希望你能收下。谢谢你的帮忙。

original: You were with the Enclave?
translation: 你参加过英克雷？

original: Yes, but the leadership and I didn't see eye to eye, so I left. It was the right decision, since the Enclave's oil rig was destroyed not long after.
translation: 是的，但我和上头合不来，所以就辞职了。事后证明这是个正确的决定，那之后不久，英克雷的钻井平台就被人给摧毁了。

original: Canine neuroscience?
translation: 犬类神经科学？

original: Cyber-dogs and the like. It's not a field I work in much anymore.
translation: 比如机械狗之类的。这个领域我已经很久没涉足了。

original: You're a scientist?
translation: 你是一个科学家？

original: Yes. Specializing in neuroscience, both human and canine. Of course, this lab is nothing compared to what I had when I was with the Enclave.
translation: 是的。专攻神经科学，包括人类和犬类。当然，这地方与我过去供职的英克雷实验室相比，实在不值一提。

original: [Speech]{Try to convince Caesar of the Brotherhood's usefulness.}
translation: [口才]{Try to convince Caesar of the Brotherhood's usefulness.}

original: [SUCCEEDED] And you think the value of their attack on HELIOS, the chaos it will sow behind the Profligates' lines, is worth letting them live.
translation: [成功] 你认为派他们进攻太阳神电站会搅乱荒淫之人的后方，光凭这点就足以放他们一条生路。

original: All right, let it be so. The Brotherhood will have to be dealt with eventually, but for the moment, they {getting one over on them}live to serve.
translation: 好吧，言之有理。虽然我们迟早还是要对付兄弟会，不过目前，还是先让他们为我所用吧。

original: When the Legion attacks Hoover Dam, the Brotherhood will attack HELIOS One.
translation: 只要军团进攻胡佛大坝，兄弟会就会突袭太阳神一号。

original: [FAILED] And you think they'll stop at that? How long before they attack the dam, or Vegas?
translation: [失败] 你以为他们会就此罢休吗？下一步他们是不是就该进攻大坝，或者维加斯？

original: The risks outweigh the rewards. Go back to their bunker and finish the job.
translation: 我看是得不偿失。你还是回到地堡，完成你的工作吧。

original: When we attack the dam the Brotherhood will rise from their bunker to conquer HELIOS One!
translation: 当我们进攻胡佛大坝时，兄弟会将如潮水般大举进犯太阳神一号！

original: I'll handle the Boomers for you.
translation: 我会帮你搞定大炮族的。

original: Good. Your first challenge will be to reach their settlement without getting blown up. After that, should be easy.
translation: 很好。你的第一个挑战就是要想办法穿过炮击区，抵达他们的驻地，之后就简单了。

original: I've already reverted the White Glove Society back to cannibalism.
translation: 我已经帮助白手套社团恢复了食人传统。

original: All right, that's a start. But now you have to convince them to support my Legion.
translation: 很好，但只是个开端。你现在必须说服他们支持我的军团。

original: Tell them they'll be allowed to continue practicing their {beat}dietary habits without interruption. {slightly amused}They can eat a portion of what they conquer.
translation: 告诉他们，他们可以继续保留这一嗜好。{slightly amused}只要是征服的敌人，我可以分一部分给他们尽情享用。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Do you have any dealings with New Vegas?
translation: 你和新维加斯有任何生意来往吗？

original: Not really. Heard it's paradise in the wasteland. Never been in there myself, doubt they'd let a mutant in.
translation: 没有。听说那儿是废土的天堂。我从没去过那个地方，估计他们也不会放一个变种人进去。

original: {To himself, slight humor at human nature}Amazes me people would come from all over the wastes to throw away everything they've got in that town.
translation: 让我不可思议的是，那地方居然会吸引来自四面八方的人们，让他们心甘情愿地把自己的满身家当全都砸到里头。

original: Anything else can you tell me about the NCR?
translation: 关于NCR你还有什么能告诉我的吗？

original: Seen them grow from a single town - Shady Sands - into the republic. They've done good for the most part.
translation: 他们从一个小镇——沙荫镇——逐步发展成一个泱泱大国。要论好事，他们还是做了不少的。

original: What makes the NCR too ambitious?
translation: 是什么让NCR那么野心勃勃？

original: They expand, fast. If you've got land they want, they'll take it, eventually. Did it out West, they'll do it here.
translation: 他们扩张得很快。要是你的地盘被他们看上，他们就一定会把它抢下来。在西部他们就是这么干的，到这儿也一样。

original: {Warning tone to govt}They keep rolling over people, they'll regret it. That's how revolutions start.
translation: {Warning tone to govt}他们不停地压迫人民，他们会后悔的。有压迫就有反抗。

original: What do you know about the Legion?
translation: 关于军团你都知道些什么？

original: {contempt}{KAI-zar}Caesar thinks he can change human nature. Most of the Legion is following {KAI-zar}Caesar, not {KAI-zar}Caesar's ideals. When he's gone, it'll crumble.
translation: 凯撒想要改变人类的本性。而军团里多数人追随的并不是他的理想，而是他本人。要是没了他，军团就会土崩瓦解。

original: Might not happen overnight. Might take a few decades. But it'll happen. Basic human nature - greed, ambition, jealousy - will see to it.
translation: 这也许不会在一夜之间发生。也许要几十年。但这是迟早的事。人类的本性——贪婪，野心，嫉妒——终究会暴露无疑。

original: Why do some of the Super Mutants here dislike the NCR?
translation: 为什么这里的一些超级变种人讨厌NCR？

original: Lot of bad blood between Super Mutants and humans. Goes back years. Some here still got the scars and memories.
translation: 变种人与人类之间结怨太深。已经过去了很多年，还有不少人无法遗忘当年的伤痕与记忆。

original: Me, I don't really have a problem with the NCR. Set their sights a little too high sometimes, but they try. {Beat, gets serious}Legion, that's another story.
translation: 我呢，倒是对NCR没有太大的成见。虽然他们是有些好高骛远，但至少还肯干点实事。至于军团，那就另当别论了。

original: All right, all right, don't get touchy. Just stick around for a while. I might change your mind.
translation: 好吧，好吧，别这么敏感嘛。给我几分钟，没准我能改变你的想法。

original: We'll remain until the camp is packed up. If you have some plan, see to it quickly.
translation: 在行李全部整理好之前，我们还会留在这里的。如果你有什么计划就快说。

original: Just asking. Good luck on your migration.
translation: 问问而已。祝你们迁移顺利。

original: So if you were in charge of the tribe, you'd fight with the NCR against Caesar if asked?
translation: 这么说，如果你掌管部落的话，你会应NCR之邀，共同对抗凯撒？

original: I suppose if asked, I would. But that's a moot point, because Papa's in charge now, and he's not going anywhere.
translation: 我想我会的。但说这些都没用，现在部落的酋长是父汗，他也不会改变看法的。

original: Interesting opinion, Karl. I wonder what Papa Khan will say about this.
translation: 有趣的想法，卡尔。不知道父汗听到这些话会怎么想。

original: You motherless bastard. You'll pay for this!
translation: 你这个没娘养的野种，你会付出代价的！

original: Because you know they'd come up lacking?
translation: 因为你知道他们都是纸老虎？

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Furious}Enough! How dare you compare Caesar's finest to this tribe of savages? The mightiest Great Khan is scarcely a match for a Legion recruit!
translation: [成功]{Furious} 够了！你怎么敢把凯撒手下的精锐和这个部落的野蛮人相比？哪怕大汗帮里最强的战士，也比不上一名军团新兵！

original: The Burned Man would leave their mightiest shitting themselves in terror! I would... {Beat, realizing what he's just done}Uhhh, that is....
translation: 浴火者会把他们吓得屁滚尿流！我会……{Beat, realizing what he's just done}啊——，我是说……

original: [FAILED] Win? I wasn't aware we were competing.
translation: [失败] 赢？我可不觉得我们是在比赛。

original: Well-spoken. You win this round.
translation: 说得好。这次算你赢了。

original: But surely a warrior in service of glorious Caesar is the equal of any tribe's finest?
translation: 一个为凯撒的荣耀而战的勇士，放在任何部落里不都是数一数二的？

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Getting annoyed}Of course I am! {Smoother, recovering}That is to say, Caesar has many fine warriors, and I wouldn't wish to compare them to the Great Khans.
translation: [成功] {Getting annoyed}废话！{Smoother, recovering}我的意思，凯撒麾下有很多优秀的战士，我不希望他们被拿来和大汗帮相提并论。

original: [FAILED] You insult our hosts, where I wouldn't dare to. You might want to watch that talk around Papa Khan.
translation: [失败] 你好大的胆子，居然敢侮辱我们的东道主。不知道这话传到父汗耳边会怎么样。

original: Wow, you're not worthy to join a scruffy tribe of has-been desert raiders? You must suck.
translation: 哇哦，那你连加入这个由掠夺者组成的部落都不够格？你可真是垃圾。

original: Not while there are still spines un-shattered.
translation: 还有没剃光的刺儿呢。

original: Oh God help us!
translation: 哦，上帝，帮帮我们！

original: Not really, no. Let's do this.
translation: 不。来吧。

original: Ave Caesar!
translation: 凯撒万岁！

original: Oh good, I've been needing a new head for my trophy spike.
translation: 哦，很好，我的战利品里又要新增一个首级了。

original: Aieee!
translation: 呃啊——！

original: If you think you can take me, then.
translation: 如果你认为你能干的动我，就放马过来。

original: I hope you'll be a half-decent challenge.
translation: 希望不会在你身上浪费太多时间。

original: What? Wait, can't we talk about this?
translation: 什么？等等，我们就不能谈谈吗？

original: I'm afraid not. Our instructions were very specific. You have to die.
translation: 恐怕不行。我们已经说得很明白了。你必须死。

original: Send your whole damned Legion if you want - I'll water the desert with their blood.
translation: 要是你有那个胆子，就把你那该死的军团整个派过来吧——我会要他们血流成河。

original: Noooooooo!
Let's get this over with then.
translation: 那我们赶紧搞定吧。

original: Well-spoken.
translation: 说得好。

original: Karl sends his regards.
translation: 卡尔向你表示问候。

original: You don't give up, do you?
translation: 你怎么就学不会消停呢？

original: You've been a persistent annoyance. I had hoped to avoid this, but it seems I have no choice but to deal with you myself.
translation: 你一直在坏我们的好事。我本以为可以不必动刀子，但看来我已经别无选择，只能亲手除掉你了。

original: Any idea what our chances are?
translation: 你觉得我们能赢吗？

original: Their men take comfort in - and rely on - killing at a distance. They will not have the luxury of such comforts this time.
translation: 他们的人太过于喜欢——应该说是太依赖于远距离攻击了。不过这次，他们可别想那么轻松了。

original: Our warriors will wash over them in a tide of blood, severing arms before they can attack, legs before they can run, and heads before they can pray.
translation: 我的勇士必将血洗他们，让他们还来不及回击，就砍断他们的臂膀；还来不及逃跑，就剁掉他们的双脚；还来不及祈祷，就割下他们的脑袋。

original: So yes, fortune favors our chances, messenger. Provided *you* move quickly.
translation: 所以，是的，这一次命运会眷顾我们的，信使。前提是*你*必须尽快行动。

original: What do you think of the NCR?
translation: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

original: They are passable foes. {Slight disdain}Like their citizens, they prefer their war from a distance, and at that, they excel.
translation: 他们是个值得称道的对手。{Slight disdain}就像他们的人民一样，他们喜欢长距离作战，这是他们的优势。

original: {Reflective}Their leaders have on occasion shown brilliance, their rangers in particular have adapted well to our strategies.
translation: {Reflective}他们的领袖偶尔也会显示出一丝睿智，尤其是他们的游骑兵，每次都能很好地对我们的战略作出反应。

original: But their rangers are few, and this General Oliver we face is not their best. I regret not being able to face Hanlon, the one who led them last time.
translation: 可惜他们人太少，而这次我们面对的这个奥利弗将军，也不是他们当中数一数二的良将。可惜我没法与汉隆亲自较量，上次是他带的兵。

original: Are you looking forward to the battle?
translation: 你期待这场战斗吗？

original: I live to serve Caesar's will - and the will of the Legion. If my victory serves them both, then I am pleased.
translation: 我活着就是为了执行凯撒的意志——当然还有军团的意志。如果我能用胜利来证明这一点，那么我自然高兴。

original: I wanted to know more about you.
translation: 我想了解更多关于你的情况。

original: What does Lanius mean?
translation: “拉尼厄斯”是什么意思？

original: The word means "butcher" in Latin. I was granted the name after proving myself in several battles.
translation: 这个词在拉丁文中意为"屠夫"。我在一系列战斗中证明了自己，才得以获此称号。

original: Perhaps after today's battle, you too will earn yourself a new name.
translation: 也许在今日的战斗后，你也能获得一个新的称号。

original: And what do you want me to do?
translation: 那么你想让我做什么？

original: Our forces are better equipped to take objectives than hold them. I do not wish to defend this place if another option exists.
translation: 我们的军队善于攻城掠地，却不擅长防守。如果有别的选择，我实在不想费功夫把守这里。

original: Our opponents follow a strict chain of command, which is both a strength and weakness. I intend to use you to strike at that weakness.
translation: 我们的对手军纪严明，奉令唯谨。这既是优点，也是弱点。而我希望你能利用这个弱点。

original: Find the enemy commander, this General Oliver. Kill him or his resolve. Do this, and his cowards will retreat, leaving the dam to us.
translation: 去找敌人的指挥官奥利弗将军。要么杀了他，要么瓦解他的决心。这样一来，他的手下必将不战自溃，而大坝也能手到擒来了。

original: You're the Legate, I'm guessing?
translation: 我猜，你大概就是那个特使了？

original: I am the commander of this army. The Son of Mars has granted me the name Lanius. And the time to serve him has come once more.
translation: 我是这支军队的指挥官。战神之子为我赐名拉尼厄斯。如今，为他效忠的时刻再次到来了。

original: You mean your army is about to attack?
translation: 这么说你们的军队是非进攻不可咯？

original: My army has been ready for some time now. My orders were to await the coming of a messenger.
translation: 我的军队早已整装待发。但我的命令是等待信使到来。

original: You are messenger and message both, it would seem.
translation: 看样子你就是那位信使了，而要捎的信也刻在了你的脸上。

original: You should just go kill him.
translation: 你应该去杀了他。

original: [FAILED] I may be angry, but I'm not stupid.
translation: [失败] 我是很生气，但是我不笨。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You're right, I should.
translation: [成功] 你是对的，我确实该那样做。

original: Just get out of the way.
translation: 给我滚蛋。

original: No, radio it in first.
translation: 不，先用无线电报告。

original: Fuck it, you're more trouble than you're worth.
translation: 操，你这家伙怎么这么烦人。

original: Okay, but let's make it quick.
translation: 好，但是快点。

original: Let's radio it in first.
translation: 我们先用无线电报告吧。

original: Uh... I think I should check it out first before radioing it in.
translation: 呃……报告之前我还是先去看看吧。

original: Is it okay to leave your post?
translation: 你离开岗位没问题吗？

original: We're just going to be a moment. We should both take a look first.
translation: 去一下就回来。我觉得我们俩应该先去看一看。

original: Let's go!
translation: 出发！

original: Okay, lead the way!
translation: 好，带路！

original: I need you to radio in an emergency report!
translation: 我需要你立刻用无线电报告紧急情况！

original: Settle down. No one uses the radio until I know what's going on.
translation: 冷静点。在我搞清楚状况之前，谁都不许动无线电。

original: There's a dead ranger downstairs!
translation: 楼下有个死了的游骑兵！

original: {feigning surprise}Oh shit... really? We should go take a look!
translation: 该死……真的？我们得去看看！

original: Maybe I should go get the MPs.
translation: 也许我该去找宪兵来。

original: Bad idea.
translation: 坏主意。

original: Die, infidel!
translation: 去死吧，异端！

original: Why don't we take this somewhere private?
translation: 为什么我们不找个没人的地方谈谈呢？

original: I don't have time for this.
translation: 我可没那个时间。

original: Death to the Legion's enemies!
translation: 军团的敌人必死无疑！

original: My mistake.
translation: 我的错。

original: Yeah, thought so.
translation: 嗯，我也这么想。

original: Just come with me, right now.
translation: 跟我走一趟，马上。

original: Sorry, that just ain't gonna happen.
translation: 对不起，不行。

original: For {KAI-zar}Caesar!
translation: 为了凯撒！

original: Would you happen to know who did maintenance on the President's vertibird?
translation: 你该不会恰好知道是谁在负责维护总统的飞鸟吧？

original: {Pause}You will regret this.
translation: 你会后悔的。

original: Die, Profligate!
translation: 去死吧，荒淫之人！

original: I found this detonator in your pocket.
translation: 我在你的口袋里发现了这个引爆器。

original: What the... how'd you...
translation: 搞什么……你怎么……

original: {Yelling} For the Legion!
translation: 为了军团！

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: No problem.
translation: 没问题。

original: Then leave me alone.
translation: 那就离我远点。

original: My dog here doesn't like you.
translation: 我的狗不喜欢你。

original: Well that's too bad. I'm just here to enjoy the show so if you don't mind...
translation: 那太糟了。我就是来观礼的，如果你不介意的话……

original: You're the problem here.
translation: 你就是问题。

original: I'm not sure what you mean. I think you have me confused with someone else.
translation: 没明白你是什么意思。我想你是把我和别人搞混了吧。

original: <Raise arms>Boogedy boogedy boo!
translation: <举起双臂>啵哔~啵哔~咻~~！

original: {Fearful, surprised}Ahhh!...
translation: {Fearful, surprised}啊！！……

original: {Realizes player isn't a monster}You sick bastard, I could have shot you! You must be the backup I've been calling for.
translation: {Realizes player isn't a monster}你这个贱人，我真该开枪打死你！你一定就是来支援我的人了。

original: {Concerned}Where are the rest of your men?
translation: {Concerned}其他人呢？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Enjoy your stay at The Tops.
translation: 希望您能在九重天玩得尽兴。

original: Legion money, please.
translation: 军团币，麻烦了。

original: Very well. Will there be anything else?
translation: 好的。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: Pay me in NCR money.
translation: 付给我NCR纸币吧。

original: Here's your NCR money. Will there be anything else?
translation: 给您NCR纸币。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: I'll take my payout in caps.
translation: 我想换成瓶盖。

original: Caps it is. Will there be anything else?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: 40 chips for $100 NCR.
translation: 100元NCR纸币换40筹码 .

original: Here's your chips. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: 8 chips for $20 NCR.
translation: 20元NCR纸币换8筹码 .

original: Here's your chips. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: 2 chips for $5 NCR.
translation: 5元NCR纸币换2筹码。

original: Here's your chips. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: I'd like to turn in my chips.
translation: 我想兑换我的筹码。

original: In what currency would you like your payout? Non-caps currencies will have fractions paid out in caps.
translation: 您想兑换成哪种货币？非瓶盖货币会按其等值的瓶盖数量来兑换。

original: I'd like to exchange NCR money for chips.
translation: 我想用NCR纸币换筹码。

original: How many chips would you like?
translation: 您想换多少筹码？

original: 80 chips for 20 Legion Denarii.
translation: 20第纳尔换80筹码。

original: Here's your chips. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: 40 chips for 10 Legion Denarii.
translation: 10第纳尔换40筹码。

original: Here's your chips. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: 20 chips for 5 Legion Denarii.
translation: 5第纳尔换20筹码。

original: Here's your chips. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: 100 chips for 1 Legion Aureus or 25 Legion Denarii.
translation: 25第纳尔换100筹码。

original: Here's your chips. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: 4 chips for 1 Legion Denarius.
translation: 1第纳尔换4筹码。

original: Here's your chips. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 这些是您的筹码。还有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: I'd like to exchange Legion money for chips.
translation: 我想用军团第纳尔来换筹码。

original: How many chips would you like?
translation: 您想换多少筹码？

original: I could look for the source of the Nightstalker mutation for you.
translation: 我可以帮你寻找夜行兽变异的源头。

original: Thank you. I strongly suspect that the source of the mutation is artificial, but the Super Mutants found nothing. Your fresh eyes may do better.
translation: 谢谢。我怀疑变异的源头是人为的，可我派出去的超级变种人全都一无所获。你这个新面孔也许能做得更好。

original: Lily might be interested in coming with you - she's lost a few of her Bighorners to Nightstalker attacks and would enjoy a little revenge.
translation: 莉莉大概会愿意和你一块儿去——她有几只大角羊被夜行兽给咬死了，她正想报仇呢。

original: What are you working on?
translation: 你在研究什么？

original: The Nightkin have varying degrees of mental instability due their addiction to Stealth Boy use. I've been trying to come up with a cure.
translation: 由于长期依赖隐身小子，夜行族都患有不同程度的精神失常。我一直在寻找治愈的方法。

original: I'm currently investigating the local Nightstalker population since they seem to have developed a natural stealth field.
translation: 目前我正在调查本地的夜行兽种群，因为它们似乎进化出了一种天然的隐形力场。

original: I've also gotten my hands on a working Stealth Boy Mark II prototype, but that experiment is riskier. I'd rather not pursue that research just yet.
translation: 我手头倒是有一台II型隐身小子的原型机，但实验的风险太大。我暂时还不打算用它来做研究。

original: I'm surprised to find another human here.
translation: 很惊讶竟然看能在这儿看到另一个人类。

original: I prefer the solitude, and having a bunch of Super Mutants around tends to keep things safe and quiet.
translation: 我喜欢独来独往，周围都是超级变种人，反倒让我觉得太平清静。

original: Hold off for now.
translation: 先等等。

original: All right, if you want.
translation: 好吧，听你的。

original: I got a brain from Lupa, the mother of many Legion Mongrels.
translation: 我得到了鲁帕的大脑, 它产下过很多军团杂交犬的崽子。

original: Rex will be tougher.
translation: 雷克斯会变得更强悍的。

original: I took down a Fiend dog named Violetta.
translation: 我解决了一条名叫维奥列塔的恶犬。

original: Rex will be faster.
translation: 雷克斯会变得更迅速的。

original: This brain is from Rey, one of Old Lady Gibson's dogs.
translation: 这是雷伊的大脑，它是吉布森老太太的狗。

original: Let's see... good guard dog tendencies. If I transplant this brain into Rex, he'll be a bit more ferocious in his attacks.
translation: 我看看……良种看门犬啊。如果我把它移植到雷克斯身上，他的进攻会变得更加凶猛。

original: You're not getting the Mark II specs.
translation: 你不会得到II型机的。

original: {snapping into berserk mode}I knew humans could never be reasonable! I knew it! Stupid, stupid humans! I'll kill you!
translation: {snapping into berserk mode}我就知道人类讲不成道理！我就知道！愚蠢，愚蠢的人类！我要杀了你们！

original: Doctor Henry, do as he asks.
translation: 亨利医生，照他说的做。

original: Good, good. Smart move, human.
translation: 很好，很好。你很明智，人类。

original: The Mark IIs are even more dangerous than standard Stealth Boys.
translation: II型甚至比普通隐身小子更危险。

original: Our lives, our decision to make. We're tired of sitting around in Jacobstown waiting for a cure.
translation: 我们的命运由自己掌控。我们已经厌倦在雅各布斯镇干等了。

original: What are you planning to do once you have the specs?
translation: 你拿到原型机配置以后打算怎么办？

original: There are caches of Stealth Boys out there. With the Mark II in hand, it shouldn't be difficult to upgrade every one of them.
translation: 外面还有许多隐身小子。只要我们手握II型机，把它们一个个升级应该不是什么难事。

original: < Speech 80 >
[SUCCEEDED] No, I didn't, not until now anyway. Very well, human. You've made your point, and I withdraw my... request.
translation: [成功] 不，没有，在你提到之前，都没有。很好，人类。你说得很有道理，我撤回我的……请求。

original: What you do in the wasteland affects all the mutants here, but you didn't think about that, did you?
translation: 你在废土的所作所为会影响这里所有的变种人，但你从来都没想过这一点，对吧？

original: [FAILED] No more negotiating, and definitely no more waiting. This is your last chance before we take it by force.
translation: [失败] 不必白费口舌了，我也没耐心再等。这是你最后的机会，否则我们只能采取武力了。

original: Doctor Henry doesn't have the cure just yet, but he's almost there. Be patient.
translation: 亨利医生还没研究出治疗方法，但已经快了。耐心点。

original: < Speech 80 >
I had some questions about Jacobstown.
translation: 我想问一些跟雅各布斯镇有关的问题。

original: Such as?
translation: 比如？

original: What's the story with Keene?
translation: 基恩到底是个怎样的人？

original: {Keene alive}Smart, charismatic. Hell of a mean streak. Doesn't care for humans. Prefers fighting them to talking.
translation: 他很聪明，能说会道，心眼却很坏。丝毫不在乎人类。宁可与他们开战也不愿好好商量。

original: He's got a lot of pull with Nightkin, though. He talks, they listen. Was hoping he could draw other Nightkin to Jacobstown.
translation: 但他在夜行族内部很有影响力。凡是他说的话，他们全都听。我本来还希望他能多招徕些夜行族到雅各布斯镇来。

original: Keene is saner than most, but I know he's thinking of going his own way again. He's aggressive, impatient. Can't stand sitting around.
translation: 基恩比多数人都要理智，但我知道他又要开始独断专行了。他太好战，又没耐心。肯定坐不住。

original: It's your own fault for finding this - now I'm going to have to kill you.
translation: 这是你自找的——我现在只好干掉你。

original: {Triumphant, taunting the dead}Ha! How do you like that you sons of bitches?!
translation: {Triumphant, taunting the dead}哈！放马过来吧，你们这些婊子养的！？

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: I represent the Nightkin. {smug}Marcus may lead this town, but the Nightkin listen to what I have to say.
translation: 我代表夜行族。虽然这个镇子是马可世领导的，但夜行族都听我的号令。

original: That doesn't mean I don't respect Marcus for what he's trying to do. However, he doesn't truly understand the difficulties of being a Nightkin.
translation: 我并非不尊重马可世，他确实付出了很大的努力。但他并没有真正理解我们夜行族的苦衷。

original: Who's the other human you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的另外一个人类是谁？

original: Doctor Henry. He's one of you - go speak with him instead of me.
translation: 亨利医生。他和你是同类——去和他说吧，别来找我。

original: What great legacy do the Great Khans have? Your tribe is nothing but ghosts and martyrs.
translation: 大汗帮有什么堪称伟大的？你们的部落根本一无是处，只有一帮死掉的孤魂野鬼和烈士。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I should have you torn apart for speaking like that - but maybe you're right. The glory of the past is an empty dream.
translation: [成功] 你居然敢说这种话，我真该把你撕碎——但也许你是对的。往日的荣耀只是过眼云烟。

original: If the Khans are to be immortal, we must make our own destiny. We won't fight for Caesar, but when he strikes, we will ride out one last time.
translation: 想让大汗帮真的不朽，我们就必须把握自己的命运。我们不会为凯撒卖命，但如果他因此而向我们动手，我们也不惜与他决一死战。

original: Time to go pay General Oliver a visit.
translation: 该去拜访一下奥利弗将军了。

original: Mars's eyes are upon you. Do not fail him - or us.
translation: 战神注视着你，别让他失望——我们也一样。

original: Then let's go.
translation: 那么我们出发吧。

original: I have questions.
translation: 我有问题。

original: Then ask them. But don't waste my time. The battle draws near.
translation: 那就问吧。不过别浪费时间，战斗就要开始了。

original: What can you tell me about the layout of the dam?
translation: 关于大坝的布局，你能给我提供些什么吗？

original: It was not intended for war - its top sides are bound to two intake towers by a series of bridges. No doubt snipers nest there.
translation: 大坝并不是为打仗设计的——其顶部两侧各有一座进水塔，中间由一系列桥梁连结。毫无疑问那儿肯定布有狙击手。

original: On the far side of the dam, a small building provides access to the power plant below. That is where Oliver hides.
translation: 大坝的背面有一幢小型建筑，从那儿可以进入下方的发电机房。那里就是奥利弗的藏身之处。

original: I'm ready. What is the plan?
translation: 我准备好了。计划是什么？

original: In the past, the NCR has relied upon attrition, withering our numbers with ranged fire and falling back as necessary.
translation: 过去，NCR习惯打消耗战，他们喜欢用远距离攻击与步步为营的战术来逐步削减我方人员。

original: Not this time. The dam contains tunnels to its heart, overlooked by the NCR... now occupied by the Legion.
translation: 但这次不同了。大坝上分布着不少隧洞，直通其心脏部位，这些被NCR忽略的地方……如今却将被我们军团占领。

original: When the battle begins, the NCR will find our teeth at their throats in a dozen places. There will be no attrition, no falling back, only carnage.
translation: 等战斗一打响，NCR就会发现，我们的利齿早已狠狠咬住了他们的喉咙。那时，他们既打不成消耗战，也无法撤退，就只能坐以待毙。

original: Can I ask you something else?
translation: 我能问你点别的吗？

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Can I ask you something else?
translation: 我能问你点别的吗？

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: I've got a package here from your friends Jack and Diane.
translation: 我有一个包裹，是你的朋友杰克和黛安送来的。

original: Huh? Oh! Oh, right. Yeah. I'll take that. You should go now, before you draw any attention.
translation: 呃？哦！哦，好吧，我收下了。在你被人注意之前快走吧。

original: I've got a package here from your friends Jack and Diane.
translation: 我有一个包裹，是你的朋友杰克和黛安送来的。

original: About goddamn time. Tell the Khans if they can't keep a steady supply, we'll find someone who can.
translation: 早他妈该到了。告诉大汗帮，要是他们不能稳定供货的话，我们就找别人了。

original: Sounds too dangerous, I'll pass.
translation: 听起来太危险了，我不干。

original: Piece of cake.
translation: 小菜一碟。

original: Don't get cocky, the Fiends are twitchy. Most of them won't bother a Khan, but the ones outside the Vault... well, they're outside for a reason.
translation: 千万别大意，恶魔帮非常难以捉摸。他们虽然基本不会招惹大汗帮，但如果是避难所外面的人……好吧，他们在外面游荡可不是没有原因的。

original: Here's the package - good luck. Your payment will be waiting when you get back.
translation: 这是包裹——祝好运。等你回来，我们会付给你报酬的。

original: Don't get cocky, the Fiends are twitchy. Most of them won't bother a Khan, but the ones outside the Vault... well, they're outside for a reason.
translation: 千万别大意，恶魔帮非常难以捉摸。他们虽然基本不会招惹大汗帮，但如果是避难所外面的人……好吧，他们在外面游荡可不是没有原因的。

original: Here's the package - good luck. Your payment will be waiting when you get back.
translation: 这是包裹——祝好运。等你回来，我们会付给你报酬的。

original: I'm not interested in being a drug mule.
translation: 我可没兴趣给人运毒。

original: Sure, I'll do it.
translation: 好，我知道了。

original: Great. Here's the package - your contact is Don Hostetler at the Crimson Caravan. Come back and see me when you're done.
translation: 非常好。这是包裹——去和深红商队的唐·霍斯泰特勒接头。办好了就回来见我。

original: We've got an associate in the Crimson Caravan Trading Company who distributes for us in Outer Vegas. He's been after us for a new shipment.
translation: 我们在深红商队贸易公司有个线人，他负责维加斯外围的买卖。最近他一直在追着我们要新一批货。

original: Groodalicious. That ought to rake in the caps. What do I owe you?
translation: 美呆了。这下可要发大财了。你要什么样的报答？

original: On second thought, never mind.
translation: 我又想了想，还是算了吧。

original: Sure, what have you got?
translation: 当然，你还有什么事？

original: With Anders out of commission for so long, we're shorthanded on runners, and some backlogs have piled up.
translation: 由于安德斯脱岗太久，我们人手紧缺，积压了很多待办事项。

original: We've got an associate in the Crimson Caravan Trading Company who distributes for us in Outer Vegas. He's been after us for a new shipment.
translation: 我们在深红商队贸易公司有个线人，他负责维加斯外围的买卖。最近他一直在追着我们要新一批货。

original: You up for something challenging?
translation: 你想做点有挑战的事么？

original: I've got a shipment of Jet and Psycho that needs to be delivered to Motor Runner at Vault 3.
translation: 我有一批杰特和疯狂药，需要有人运给3号避难所的轰鸣恶煞。

original: Okay, I'll be back as soon as I have any news.
translation: 好，一有消息我就回来。

original: Thanks. Prove you're reliable on this, and I'll have more for you later.
translation: 谢谢。只要你能证明你足够可靠，以后合作的机会多的是。

original: Sounds like more trouble than it's worth. I'll pass.
translation: 听起来可不像什么好差事。我不干。

original: Okay then. Job'll be waiting if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。如果你改变主意，这份差事依然留给你。

original: Sure, just tell me who I'm looking for and where to start.
translation: 当然，告诉我要找谁、从哪开始吧。

original: About three weeks ago I sent Anders southeast to find a route into Arizona to open new markets for our product.
translation: 大概三周之前，我派安德斯去东南边寻找进入亚利桑那的通路，好为我们的产品开拓新市场。

original: He should have been back two days ago, but there's been no sign of him.
translation: 他两天以前就该回来了，可到现在都还没消息。

original: You've got an impressive setup here - have you considered making more helpful chems?
translation: 你的设备看起来相当不错啊，有没有兴趣做一些更有用的药品？

original: Already on it. I whipped up a few Stimpaks already, but if you've got any more recipes I'll take them.
translation: 已经在做了。我配制了一点治疗针，不过如果你能提供一些别的配方，就更好了。

original: How's the medical work going?
translation: 制药工作怎么样啊？

original: What do you mean, helpful? My stuff already makes people feel groodalicious.
translation: 你说有用是什么意思？我的东西已经能让人飘飘欲仙了好吗。

original: Yeah, you made a pretty good argument. We'll keep it small for now, but if it turns a profit we might expand.
translation: 是啊，你的提议很有道理。我们现在的生意虽小，不过如果有利可图的话，我们会考虑做大的。

original: Have you started making meds yet?
translation: 你开始做药了吗？

original: Helpful? What, like bathtub Stimpaks? What's the point of that?
translation: 有用？什么有用，治疗针吗？那又有什么意思？

original: What do you have for sale?
translation: 你这儿都卖些什么？

original: Oh, you're buying? Cool.
translation: 哦，你要买？好极了。

original: Oh, you're buying? Tell you what, since you've been acting all, well, random lately, how about a discount? Might calm you down.
translation: 哦，你要买？这么着吧，看你最近似乎挺，呃，瞎胡闹的，我就给你打个折怎么样？或许能让你冷静点。

original: Jack handles the small-time purchases. You should talk to him unless you're looking for a major shipment.
translation: 杰克负责零散买卖。如果你不是来做大单生意的，那就去找他。

original: I know a few recipes for chems you might want. I could teach you.
translation: 我倒是知道几种药品的配方。我可以教你。

original: Right on. What have you got?
translation: 好极了。你都会什么？

original: I'm looking to make a few caps. Got any work for me?
translation: 我想挣点外快，有什么工作吗？

original: I don't have any compelling reason to trust you, given your behavior. So no, I'm not really inclined to give you a job.
translation: 鉴于你的表现，我没有理由相信你。所以很抱歉，我不打算给你什么工作。

original: {Thoughtful}Hmm... you look like you could handle yourself in a fix. All right, I'll tell you what. Anders, one of my best runners, is overdue to report back.
translation: {仔细掂量}嗯……看起来你有两下子。好吧，我告诉你，安德斯，我最好的走私商之一，没有按时回来报告。

original: If you can find out what happened to him, I'll give you some real work.
translation: 如果你能查明白他到底出了什么事，我会给你些像样的工作。

original: Great! Here's your payment.
translation: 很好！这是你的报酬。

original: I finished the Crimson Caravan run.
translation: 我完成了深红商队的生意。

original: And you didn't even get skinned alive. I'm impressed. Here's your payment.
translation: 你竟然毫发无伤地回来了。真令人惊讶。这是你的报酬。

original: I finished the Vault 3 run.
translation: 我完成了3号避难所的生意。

original: Like I said, find Anders first, then we'll see about trusting you with more work.
translation: 我说了，先找到安德斯，然后再来谈别的工作。

original: Any new jobs for me?
translation: 有什么新工作给我吗？

original: Yeah, you did good finding him. Okay, if you want a little work, I think I can find you something.
translation: 嗯，你干的不错。好的，如果你想要工作的话，我可以帮你找一些来。

original: Now that Anders is back, how about that work?
translation: 既然安德斯回来了，说好给我的工作呢？

original: Okay, if you want a little work, I think I can find you something.
translation: 好的，如果你想要工作的话，我可以帮你找一些来。

original: Any new jobs for me?
translation: 有什么新工作给我吗？

original: Not right at the moment, but you could talk to Jack - he's always looking for new recipes.
translation: 暂时没有，不过你可以去找杰克——他一直都在寻找新的配方。

original: Any new jobs for me?
translation: 有什么新工作给我吗？

original: Ordinarily I would, but it seems like all our clients have ended up dead. You could talk to Jack - he's always looking for new recipes.
translation: 通常是有的，不过似乎我们的客户都死了。你还是去和杰克聊聊吧，他一直都在寻找新的配方。

original: Any new jobs for me?
translation: 有什么新工作给我吗？

original: Diane handles most of the transactional elements of this little enterprise, but I'm always in the market for new recipes if you've got the spark.
translation: 我们这个小作坊的生意向来是黛安在打理，不过只要你有新的配方，我都愿意收购。

original: Are there any town rules I need to know about?
translation: 镇上有什么规矩吗？

original: Same as any civilized town - don't start any fights or steal anything, we'll treat you fair. Not a lot to ask.
translation: 和其他有文明的地方一样，别惹事生非，别偷东西。我们对所有人都一视同仁。也就这些了。

original: What's wrong with the Nightkin?
translation: 夜行族有什么问题？

original: Nightkin suffer schizophrenia from the Stealth Boys they're always using. One of the reasons I settled Jacobstown was so they could be cured.
translation: 夜行族因为长期使用隐身小子而饱受精神分裂之苦。我之所以选择在雅各布斯镇定居，其中一个原因就是为了找到解药。

original: While they're in town, the Nightkin aren't allowed to have Stealth Boys so their craziness doesn't get worse.
translation: 在这里，他们不允许使用隐身小子，所以狂躁症会有所减轻。

original: Trouble is the Nightkin don't like being visible, either. They don't take being exposed too well.
translation: 问题是夜行族也不想被人看见。他们不喜欢太过暴露。

original: I need something repaired.
translation: 我需要修理。

original: Let me take a look.
translation: 让我看看。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 给我看看你卖的东西吧。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: Why the hostility?
translation: 怎么这么不客气？

original: Look, I don't need your shit. Either get out of the way or things are gonna get rough.
translation: 听着，我懒得理你。给我滚开，否则场面可就要变得难看了。

original: I'm hunting ghouls.
translation: 我在狩猎尸鬼。

original: Then why are you in here bothering me instead of out there hunting them?
translation: 那你快去捕猎它们呀，还在这里烦我干什么？

original: Nothing, I'm just passing through.
translation: 没什么，只是路过。

original: You must be crazy if you're just "passing through" this place.
translation: 你肯定是疯了才会"路过"这地方。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 好，随便。

original: Not really.
translation: 不认识。

original: That's okay, I wouldn't expect anybody to. I think they tend to keep to themselves.
translation: 没关系，我也不强求别人非得认识。我觉得他们很封闭。

original: Yeah. I know to shoot them on sight.
translation: 是的。我见到他们就会开枪。

original: That bad, huh? Guess I'm lucky I got away with my life. I'll make sure and avoid them from now on. Thanks.
translation: 有这么糟？那我能活下来可真是走运了。以后我会躲着他们的。谢谢。

original: I know who they are but I don't care about their agenda.
translation: 我知道他们是谁，但我不关心他们的计划。

original: Yeah, it's pretty far out, right? Fixating on old technology just doesn't seem very relevant to most people's lives.
translation: 是啊，他们早就过时了，对不对？专注于古老的科技，似乎跟大多老百姓的生活都不沾边。

original: They've got the right idea.
translation: 他们的理念是正确的。

original: Do they? That's a relief. I wasn't so sure, myself. Protecting people from technology seems like a big job for such a small group.
translation: 真的吗？那可太好了。我倒不是那么肯定。对这么一个小团体来说，保护人们不受科技的戕害是个大工程。

original: They're enemies of the NCR. If you know where they are you should turn them in.
translation: 他们是NCR的敌人。如果你知道他们在哪里，你应该去向NCR报告。

original: Oh my gosh, really? Well, I didn't see where they went, but I'll keep an eye out. Wow, I had no idea they were so dangerous.
translation: 噢，我的天，真的吗？嗯，我没见过他们，但我会密切留意的。哇哦，我不知道原来他们如此危险。

original: Thanks for letting me know. Glad I didn't do any business with them.
translation: 谢谢你告诉我。还好我没和他们做过买卖。

original: They're usually harmless unless you use advanced technology around them.
translation: 他们通常是很少伤害人，除非你在他们附近使用高科技。

original: Well that shouldn't be a problem for me. I can't afford anything like that.
translation: 那这对我来说不是什么问题。我可用不起高科技。

original: I met a group of them in a bunker west of here.
translation: 我在西边的地堡里遇见过他们。

original: And?
translation: 还有呢？

original: What did you want to ask me earlier?
translation: 你刚才要问我什么？

original: Some other time, maybe.
translation: 下回再说吧。

original: Sure. It's a small wasteland. I'm sure we'll run into each other again.
translation: 当然可以。废土很小。我相信我们会再次碰面的。

original: I'd rather you didn't.
translation: 我还是不说的好。

original: Forget I said anything, then.
translation: 那么，忘了我说的话。

original: Go ahead.
translation: 继续。

original: I had a run-in with this group calling themselves the Brotherhood of Steel. Pretty strange bunch. Do you know anything about them?
translation: 我遇到过一个自称为钢铁兄弟会的团体。很奇怪的一群人。你认识他们吗？

original: So you just leave your family in the bunker?
translation: 所以你就离开你在地堡里的家人了？

original: Yeah. I'm not worried. They can handle themselves. But somebody has to get the groceries, know what I mean?
translation: 是啊。其实我并不担心。他们知道如何照顾自己。但总要有人负责外出养家嘛，明白我的意思吗？

original: And actually these days I think they'd rather have me out here anyway. But that's a whole other story.
translation: 不过我最近倒是觉得，他们似乎巴不得我留在外面呢。当然，这件事就另当别论了。

original: So, listen, can I ask you something on the level?
translation: 听着，你能诚实地回答我一些问题吗？

original: You live in a hole in the ground?
translation: 你住在地洞里？

original: Well, a bunker, if you want to get technical. I think it sounds more interesting my way.
translation: 好吧，准确的说，是地堡。我觉得我的叫法更有意思。

original: But I'm not there much anymore. I'm usually out here picking up food and supplies for my family. Whatever they need.
translation: 但我现在也很少回去了。我经常出来为我的家人寻找食物和其他生活用品。尽力满足他们的需要。

original: None of your business.
translation: 和你没关系。

original: That's why I asked. My business is boring. You try trading and scavenging for a living and see if you don't start nosing into other people's affairs.
translation: 所以我才问你的嘛。我的生意很无聊。要换做你，成天与形形色色的顾客和垃圾打交道，你也会变得爱打听别人的八卦的。

original: I'm not entirely sure.
translation: 我记不清了。

original: Yeah, guess the roads must've been long, then, if you forgot where you started from.
translation: 是啊，连自己从哪儿来都忘了，看来你真的走了挺远的路。

original: The grave.
translation: 坟墓。

original: Huh. Well, in that case I take it back. You look pretty good, given the circumstances.
translation: 哈，既然这样，那我收回我的话。不过你的经历虽然惨，居然还是这样满面红光。

original: Goodsprings.
translation: 清泉镇。

original: Wow, you {emph}have come a long way, then. I've never been there, but I've met some traders who pass that way.
translation: 哇，那你算{emph}是远道而来了。我从来没有去过那里，但我认识一些路过那里的商人。

original: Well, welcome, then. I'm Veronica. I live in a hole in the ground.
translation: 哦，欢迎。我是维罗妮卡。我住在一个地洞里。

original: Anything I can do to help around here?
translation: 这附近有什么我能帮忙的吗？

original: More than you already have? Might want to ask around, but truth is, you've already helped out a lot in the short time you've been here.
translation: 你还没帮够？那你在附近再问问吧，但老实说，这几天你已经帮了我们不少忙了。

original: I suppose you could talk to Ghost, up on top of the barracks - uh, Ranger Ghost. Something about trouble in Nipton, maybe.
translation: 我觉得你可以去和幽灵谈一谈，就在营房的屋顶上——呃，我是指那个叫幽灵的游骑兵，据说尼普顿出事了。

original: {A little surprised by the offer}Help? Oh, well... you could speak to Ranger Jackson. He might have something for you.
translation: 帮忙？哦，好吧……你可以去和游骑兵杰克森谈谈，他可能会有差事给你。

original: He sort of runs things around here, mostly ends up sending reports back West that aren't filled with the best news.
translation: 他算是这儿的负责人，不过大部分时间往西部发回的都是坏消息。

original: I need repairs.
translation: 我需要修理。

original: All right then... just sign here, here, and... here.
translation: 好吧……这儿，这儿还有这儿……签个字就好。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: May I ask you a few questions first?
translation: 我能先问你几个问题吗？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Sure, I'll go talk to them.
translation: 当然，我会去和他们谈的。

original: Thank you. We'll wait here until we hear from you.
translation: 谢谢。在得到你的消息之前，我们会一直在这儿等的。

original: You're right, it is.
translation: 对了，就是那样。

original: You're doing the right thing.
translation: 你在做正确的事。

original: Thank you. I think I just needed to hear someone else say it. I suppose without rule of law, we're no better than raiders.
translation: 谢谢。我希望能听到别人这么说。如果没有法律的约束，我们和掠夺者也没什么区别。

original: Have you considered joining the Great Khans?
translation: 你考虑过加入大汗帮吗？

original: [FAILED] No, this needs to end. I'm tired of running and living like scavengers.
translation: [失败] 不，该结束了。我已经厌倦了拾荒者那样奔波的日子。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I hadn't thought of that. Would you be willing to talk to them on our behalf?
translation: [成功] 我没想过。你愿意代表我们去和他们谈谈吗？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Why do you want to surrender?
translation: 你为什么想投降？

original: We can't survive like this - there are too many of us and we don't have the resources. And maybe it's the right thing to do.
translation: 我们这样是活不下去的——人太多，物资太少。也许投降才是正确的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'm still working on it.  May I ask you some questions?
translation: 我还在努力。我能问你几个问题吗？

original: The Khans will accept you as long as you pass the initiation rite.
translation: 只要你通过入会仪式，大汗帮就会接受你。

original: Well, that's a hell of a lot better than going back to prison.
translation: 好吧，这总比回他妈的监狱强。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'm working on it, but I had some questions.
translation: 我正在想办法，但有些问题。

original: Yes.
translation: 是的。

original: Good to hear. Without access to the sulfur, Cooke doesn't have much to offer the gang. I... I guess it's over, then. We can turn ourselves in.
translation: 很好。没了硫磺矿，库克也就失去了号令众人的手段。我……我想这事也该结束了。我们可以去自首了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Will you check out the caves and see if there's anything you can do?
translation: 你能不能去洞里察看一番，想想有什么办法？

original: Without access to the sulfur, he'll lose what influence he has left with the men here.
translation: 如果通往硫磺矿的道路封了，他就没有办法把大家都留在这里了。

original: I'll do it.
translation: 我会干的。

original: Thanks. Take this keycard - I tried hacking the locking mechanisms on the doors, but it seems that the only way in is with one of these.
translation: 谢谢。拿着这张门禁卡——我尝试过破解门锁系统，不过似乎唯一能让人进出的办法就是门禁卡。

original: Why can't you do it?
translation: 你为什么不能做？

original: I have to watch Cooke. I wouldn't put it past him to just start killing the opposition, starting with me.
translation: 我得盯着库克。可不能任由他把反对他的人都杀了，我可是他的头号眼中钉。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Not right now, may I ask you some questions?
translation: 先等一下，我可以问你几个问题吗？

original: Sure, what do you need done?
translation: 当然，需要我做什么？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'm still working on it, may I ask you some questions?

original: Yes. You can join then, but he says you would all still have to pass the initiation rite.
translation: 是的。你们可以加入了，不过他说你们都还是需要通过入会仪式。

original: I'd rather not, but fair enough. We'll do it.
translation: 我不是很愿意，但也行吧。我们会照做的。

original: Goodbye.

translation: 很好。嘿，如果你有兴趣的话，我这还有个活儿。

original: I've heard the muties there are different. Completely insane, and supposedly they use some kind of invisibility technology. I'd stay away.
translation: 我听说那些变种人比较特别。它们是彻头彻尾的疯子，而且据说还拥有某种隐身技术。反正我会和它们保持距离。

original: Why's the area so dangerous?
translation: 这片区域为什么这么危险？

original: Tell me about the Great Khans.
translation: 跟我说说大汗帮。

original: They've been through some rough times, but they can hold their own. I wouldn't mind taking the boys and signing up with them, if it weren't for Lem.
translation: 他们几经沉浮，但依然能坚持不倒。要不是因为莱姆，我还真想带着大伙去投靠他们。

original: Tell me about McCarran.
translation: 跟我说说麦卡伦。

original: It's the main base for the NCR, and a breeding ground for oppression in the name of patriotic bullshit. Do humanity a favor and blow it up.
translation: 那是NCR的大本营，一个打着狗屁爱国主义旗号剥削民众的地方。你要是想拯救人类的话，就把那地方炸飞吧。

original: Tell me about Quarry Junction.
translation: 跟我说说采石场枢纽。

original: The NCR's been mining there for awhile, but now it's full of Deathclaws. Don't go there unless you want a quick, bloody death.
translation: NCR以前在那儿采过一段时间石头，不过现在里面全是死亡爪。除非你想死得很惨，否则最好还是别去那地方。

original: Tell me about the Fiends.
translation: 跟我说说恶魔帮。

original: Like raiders, but worse - these guys are messed up on every damn chem there is. You can spot them by the horned skulls they wear as hats.
translation: 他们和掠夺者差不多，不过比掠夺者更糟——这帮家伙个个都嗑药。他们头上戴着有角的骷髅，你可以用那个来辨认他们。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Tell me about the area outside the vault.
translation: 跟我说说避难所之外的区域。

original: It's a fucking deathtrap around here. Fiends swarm all over Vault 3 in the east, and there are fucking Deathclaws south of that, at Quarry Junction.
translation: 这地区真他妈的危险。恶魔帮占据了东边的3号避难所，南边的采石场枢纽全是他妈的死亡爪。

original: If you're looking for humans, the Khans are north of us and an NCR base at McCarran, past Vault 3. Supposedly there are muties to the southeast.
translation: 如果你要找人类的话，我们的北边是大汗帮，过了3号避难所有个NCR基地在麦卡伦机场。我估计东南边还有变种人。

original: So, what brought you to this place?
translation: 你是怎么到这儿来的？

original: Heard there was an abandoned vault along this mountain ridge, and that the wildlife here had teeth big enough to keep the NCR away.
translation: 我之前就听说沿着这条山脊走有间废弃的避难所，而且这里的野生动物很厉害，NCR不敢轻易涉足。

original: What do you need the sulfur for?
translation: 你要硫磺做什么？

original: Why can't you do it?
translation: 你为什么不自己去做？

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Let's talk about something else.

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's talk about something else.

original: Yes.
translation: 是的。

original: I'll do it.
translation: 我会干的。

original: Great. Get to it. Oh, and take this - there's some weird shit with this Vault's security and some doors will only open if you have a keycard.
translation: 很好，去吧。噢，对了，拿着这个——这个避难所的安保系统有点诡异，必须有门禁卡才能开门。

original: I'll do it.
translation: 我会干的。

original: Great. Come back as soon as you can.
translation: 很好。事办成了就马上回来。

original: Why do you want to join the Great Khans?
translation: 你为什么要加入大汗帮？

original: There aren't enough of us here to make a real impact on the NCR, and the Khans probably hate the NCR more than we do. Strength in numbers, they say.
translation: 以我们的规模真的很难对NCR造成什么威胁，而大汗帮可能比我们更恨NCR。按他们的说法，人多力量大。

original: So, will you talk to Papa Khan on our behalf?
translation: 所以你会代表我们去和父汗谈判吗？

original: Yes.
translation: 是的。

original: Yes.
translation: 是的。

original: What do you want the sulfur for?
translation: 你要硫磺做什么？

original: Explosives. Bombs. Big, big fucking bombs. You gonna help us or not?
translation: 造炸弹。大炸弹。超大号的炸弹。你到底帮不帮我们？

original: Why can't you do it?
translation: 你为什么不自己去做？

original: I have to keep an eye on that bastard Lem. The second I turn my back, he might go crying to the NCR.
translation: 我得盯着莱姆那个杂种。我担心一不留神，他就会跑去找NCR哭鼻子。

original: So, what do you say? You going to take care of those geckos?
translation: 所以，你觉得如何？愿意帮我去料理那些蜥蜴吗？

original: Why did you kill Lem?
translation: 你为什么要杀莱姆？

original: Didn't have a choice. He was confusing the men, and I need to control them or we're just a bunch of disorganized idiots.
translation: 我没得选啊。他把大伙弄得人心惶惶，我总得稳住他们吧，否则我们不就成了一帮乌合之众。

original: Why do you hate the NCR?
translation: 你为什么恨NCR？

original: Tell me about the prison break.
translation: 跟我说说越狱的事。

original: A beautiful thing. Saved a little blast powder here, hid a makeshift weapon there, and one day I orchestrated a little symphony for the  NCR.
translation: 美好的回忆。我私藏了一些火药，外加几把土制武器。后来有一天，我就用它们奏了一曲交响乐，献给了伟大的NCR。

original: How did you end up in prison?
translation: 你怎么进监狱的？

original: I was blowing up supply caravans along the 15 freeway. The NCR got wise to my ambush spots, picked me up and threw me in a cage.
translation: 我本来在15号公路上打劫过往的补给商队。结果NCR摸清了我的埋伏地点，把我抓起来扔进了班房。

original: Who's Lem?
translation: 莱姆是谁？

original: He was an inmate like the rest of us. He was useful during the jailbreak, but now...
translation: 他和我们其他人一样，都是囚犯。在越狱期间他大放异彩，可现在……

original: He's just another coward. He wants us to leave the vault and hand our asses to the NCR, as if they'd treat us like human beings.
translation: 他成了一个胆小鬼。他想让我们离开避难所，向NCR缴械投降，估计他还以为对面会优待我们呢。

original: Tell me about Lem.
translation: 和我说说莱姆。

original: He was an inmate like the rest of us. He had his uses, but he's a coward and a troublemaker.
translation: 他和我们其他人一样，都是囚犯。他虽然有点小聪明，可就是软弱，还总捣乱。

original: Got any work?
translation: 有活要干吗？

original: Tell me about NCR.
translation: 跟我说说NCR。

original: Their "republic" is a joke. They're a bunch of tyrants led by an even greater tyrant, that idiot Kimball.
translation: 他们的"共和国"就是个笑话。他们是一个由白痴大暴君金博尔所领导的暴君集团。

original: They think they have the right to annex every inch of dirt in the West and force their system on every man, woman, and child.
translation: 他们自认为有权吞并西部的每一寸土地，还企图把他们那套体系强加给每一位男女老少。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: You really don't know? I'm Samuel Cooke. I was the brains behind the NCRCF prison break.
translation: 你真不知道？我就是塞缪尔·库克，NCR劳教所越狱行动的幕后主使。

original: Do you know anything about this vault?
translation: 关于这个避难所你都知道些什么？

original: Some of the computers still work, but the only files are diaries and garbage. Typical vault.
translation: 这里有些电脑还能用，不过里头存的都是些日记和垃圾。避难所全都一副德性。

original: What's going on here?
translation: 怎么回事？

original: That coward Lem has been talking about surrendering to the NCR. Now the men are confused, not sure who's leading this gang. Fucking idiots.
translation: 莱姆那个胆小鬼居然鼓动大家向NCR投降。现在帮里人心惶惶，连谁是老大都不知道了。妈的一群草包。

original: Lem's been taken care of. We can start mining that sulfur now, thanks to you.
translation: 莱姆已经被收拾了。多亏了你，我们现在可以开采硫磺了。

original: I'll take the recipe.
translation: 我要配方。

original: Here you go. Enjoy it.
translation: 拿去吧。好好利用。

original: I'll take the caps.
translation: 我要瓶盖。

original: Here you go, you've earned these.
translation: 拿去吧，都是你应得的。

translation: 我仔细想了一下，先算了吧。

translation: [失败] 行啊。下次吧。

original: Medical supplies are always scarce, and they don't kill the buyer as often. Think of the profits!
translation: 医疗物资永远都短缺，他们也不会没事和买家过不去。想想这其中的利润吧！

original: [SUCCEEDED] You've got a point. Selling meds to the locals could be a pretty nice side gig. All right, I'll tell Jack to give it a try.
translation: [成功] 还真让你说到点子上了。把医疗用品卖给本地人确实是个好主意。很好，我会告诉杰克试一下的。

original: [FAILED] That's touching, but it would take away from our bottom line. I'll have to pass.
translation: [失败] 真是令人感动，可惜这触犯了我们的底线。我不会答应的。

original: But you could turn a profit and help the people of the Mojave!
translation: 但你可以牺牲一些利润去帮助莫哈维的人民呀！

original: Okay, I'll do that.
translation: 好，我会做的。

original: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

original: But think of all the people who overdose on Jet and Psycho. It's bad for your karma.
translation: 但想想那些滥用杰特和疯狂药的人吧。你好歹也给自己积点德呀。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Whoa... you're right. I should start a side project making meds to keep my aura clean.
translation: [成功] 呃……你说得对。我应该搞个另外的项目，制造一些治疗用的药品，免得将来遭报应。

original: [FAILED] I don't know what you've been smoking, but where can I get some?
translation: [失败] 我不知道你抽的是什么大烟，你能告诉我哪儿搞到的吗？

original: If "groodalicious" means "dead," maybe. Think of the children, man! The *children!*
translation: 你总不希望"美呆了"等于"嗝屁"吧。考虑一下孩子啊，老兄！孩子！

original: Thanks for letting me borrow your dog.
translation: 谢谢你把狗借给我。

original: No problem. Glad I could help out.
translation: 没关系，很高兴能帮上忙。

original: I have other questions.
translation: 我还有些问题要问。

original: Make it quick.
translation: 快一点儿。

original: Nevermind.
translation: 算了。

translation: 好吧，还有别的事吗？

original: Come on, it's just a dog.
translation: 拜托，一条狗而已。

original: You know what? I think it's best if he stays with me.
translation: 说实话，我觉得他最好还是留在我身边。

original: It's okay, I'm good with animals.
translation: 没问题的，我很擅长和动物相处。

original: Okay. Take good care of him and bring him back when you're done.
translation: 好吧。好好照顾他，完事之后记得送他回来。

original: How do you get his coat so shiny?
translation: 你怎么把他的毛弄得这么亮的？

original: I brush it every day. One hundred brushes.
translation: 每天都刷。刷一百次。

original: Would you mind if I borrowed him to check out the area?
translation: 你介意把他借给我去巡逻一下吗？

original: I don't think so. You already have a dog right there.
translation: 恐怕不行。你已经有一条狗了。

original: I don't know about that...
translation: 我不知道……

original: Can I ask what you're looking for?
translation: 我能问问你这是在找什么吗？

original: Okay, I'm ready to go.
translation: 好，我准备好动身了。

original: Yep, I'm ready to go.
translation: 是，我准备好动身了。

original: It's about damn time.
translation: 差不多是时候了。

original: Can I ask where we're going?
translation: 我能问问我们这是要去哪儿吗？

original: What do you hope to find?
translation: 那你希望能找到什么？

original: Anything that's valuable. You done with the questions yet?
translation: 只要是值钱的东西就行。你那些问题解决没有？

original: Where exactly are we going?
translation: 我们到底要去哪？

original: We're gonna check out the police and fire stations. They were the buildings used the most by the NCR, so they're our best chance at good shit.
translation: 我们要去检查一下警察局和消防局。NCR以前经常使用这两栋建筑，所以能在里面找到东西的概率也最高。

original: I found the keys on one of the trooper corpses.
translation: 我在一个游骑兵的尸体上了发现了这串钥匙。

original: Can I ask you something before we go?
translation: 我们走以前，我能问你点事吗？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Hang on, I gotta take care of something first.
translation: 等一等，我还有点事要先处理一下。

original: Well hurry the fuck up, I don't wanna wait all day.
translation: 很好，给我他妈快一点，我可不想等一整天。

original: Yeah, I'm ready.
translation: 是的，我准备好了。

original: Good, we're going to the Police Station first. Here's the key, we'll follow you there.
translation: 很好，我们先去警察局。这是钥匙，我们会跟着你的。

original: And just so you know, I'm not leaving town until I get what I came for. If you decide to go wandering off somewhere else, don't expect me to follow.
translation: 顺便提醒你一句，没拿到东西我是不会走的。所以如果你打定主意想去别的地方转悠，可别指望我会跟着你。

original: Okay. I'll be back.
translation: 好的。我会回来的。

original: Just go already.
translation: 快去吧。

original: Fine, I'll do it.
translation: 好吧，我会干的。

original: Good, now get going.
translation: 好，现在就动身。

original: I'd better get a bigger share for this.
translation: 你叫我干这破事，最好能多分我一点。

original: [FAILED] Fuck you. You'll get the same as everyone else.
translation: [失败] 操你妈。所有人的分成都一样。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, fine, but you gotta bring us those suits first.
translation: [成功] 可以，没问题，但你得先带我们找到那些衣服。

original: I can do that.
translation: 我可以。

original: Well then, get your ass out there.
translation: 好吧，那就快点给我行动。

original: I'll check it out.
translation: 我会查出来的。

original: Yeah you do that.
translation: 是啊，去吧。

original: What are you looking for in the computer?
translation: 你在电脑里查什么呢？

original: The location of some radiation suits. I found an inventory list that says they should be here but I can't seem to find them anywhere.
translation: 辐射服的存放地点。从我发现的物品清单来看，它们应该就存在这里，但哪儿都找不到。

original: The computer should know what happened to them.
translation: 电脑里应该会有记录。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Are you looking for something?
translation: 你在找什么东西吗？

original: I could ask you the same thing.
translation: 这事应该换我问你才对。

original: Who is your employer?
translation: 你的雇主是谁？

original: Some caravan company, Crimson something or other. Some old broad said they're looking to expand their business, be more competitive or some shit.
translation: 某个商队公司，是叫深红还是什么来着。有个老家伙宣称要拓展业务范围，提升竞争力……还是什么狗屁来着。

original: I don't really care, so long as I get paid.
translation: 反正只要我能拿到钱，别的关我屁事。

original: Can you tell me anything about Camp Searchlight?
translation: 你能跟我说说探照灯营地的事么？

original: All I know is that the whole place is filled with radiation, there are nasty creatures roaming about.
translation: 我所知道的就是这地方完全被辐射污染了，到处都是恶心的生物在爬来爬去。

original: And that my employer is paying me a pretty penny to loot it.
translation: 我的老板付了我一大笔钱，要我来这个鬼地方搜刮物品。

original: Maybe I can help?
translation: 没准我能帮忙？

original: Look if you really want to help either get the fuck out of our way or hack that damn computer over there.
translation: 如果你真想帮忙的话，要么就他妈给我滚，要么就黑了那台该死的电脑。

original: What is this initiation?
translation: 入盟仪式是什么意思？

original: Everybody has to do it. Well, everybody who wants to be a Khan, anyways. They toss you into the ring there and beat on you for a solid minute.
translation: 每个人都要过这一关。呃，我指的是想要加入大汗帮的人。他们会把你扔进场子里，然后让你整整挨上一分钟的打。

original: If you survive, you're in.
translation: 如果你还能喘气儿，就算通过了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I took care of those geckos.
translation: 我料理了那些蜥蜴。

original: You won't get a fucking cap from me, and you're lucky I don't blow your goddamn head off.
translation: 你休想从我这拿走他妈的一个瓶盖，老子没一枪爆了你的狗头已经算你他妈走运了。

original: The whole point of killing the geckos was so we could get at the sulfur and you've just made that a hell of a lot more difficult. Now fuck off.
translation: 让你杀蜥蜴的本义是为了进入硫磺洞，你倒好，现在我们要进去的难度更大了。赶紧给我滚蛋。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: May I ask you some questions?
translation: 我能问你几个问题吗？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

translation: 我是来找活干的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Why don't you join the Great Khans?
translation: 你为什么不加入大汗帮？

original: Why do you want to surrender?
translation: 你为什么要投降？

original: Why were you in prison?
translation: 你为什么进的监狱？

original: Tell me about the prison break.
translation: 跟我说说越狱的事。

original: Who is Samuel Cooke?
translation: 塞缪尔·库克是谁？

original: Cooke organized the breakout. But he's just an overambitious prick who's going to get us all killed.
translation: 库克组织了越狱。不过他只是个好高骛远的杂种，迟早把我们全害死。

original: Who's Cooke?
translation: 库克是谁？

original: Tell me about the prison break.
translation: 跟我说说越狱的事。

original: I can be pretty sneaky when I need to be, and the prison guards were a joke.
translation: 我的潜行功夫很是了得，监狱里的守卫就是个笑话。

original: So when Cooke told me his plan, I spread the info to anyone that might be useful.
translation: 所以当库克把计划告诉我时，我就把消息传给了所有能派得上用场的人。

original: Who's Cooke?
translation: 库克是谁？

original: Samuel Cooke. It was his idea to organize a jailbreak, but now he's just an overambitious prick who's going to get us all killed.
translation: 塞缪尔·库克。组织越狱就是他想出来的，不过他现在只是个好高骛远的杂种，迟早会把我们全害死。

original: How did you get out?
translation: 你怎么出来的？

original: Made it out during Cooke's big prison break, like the rest of the guys here.
translation: 和这里的其他家伙一样，库克发动越狱的时候逃出来的。

original: What did you do?
translation: 你做了什么？

original: I made my living sneaking into NCR camps looking for shit to steal. I got sloppy, and then I got caught.
translation: 我讨生活的方式，就是潜入NCR营地，随便偷点垃圾。结果因为太粗心，被抓了。

original: Got any work?
translation: 有活要干吗？

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: I'm a nobody. Just a survivor. Things were well enough until the NCR threw me behind bars.
translation: 我只是个无名小卒。努力讨生活罢了。在NCR把我扔进监狱之前，日子本来很顺利的。

original: Tell me about Cooke.
translation: 和我说说库克。

original: Cooke is just an overambitious prick, and he's going to get us all killed.
translation: 库克就是个好高骛远的杂种，他迟早会把我们全害死。

original: What's going on here?
translation: 怎么回事？

original: Fucking Cooke has us trapped here. After we escaped from an NCR prison, he dragged us around the wasteland until we ended up in this shit hole.
translation: 该死的库克害我们被困在这儿了。我们逃出NCR监狱以后，他就拖着我们满废土乱转，最后却让我们陷在这鬼洞里。

original: A group of us want to leave, go back to the NCR and surrender. But Cooke won't let us.
translation: 我们有一部分人想离开，向NCR投降。但库克不允许。

original: After you cut off access to the sulfur, Cooke left. I guess we're free to surrender to the NCR now.
translation: 你切断了通往硫磺矿的道路后，库克就走了。看来我们现在可以去向NCR投降了。

original: We're waiting on you.  A lot of us are interested in joining the Khans.
translation: 我们还在等你消息呢。许多人都挺想加入大汗帮的。

original: Got any work?
translation: 有活要干吗？

original: What's going on around here?
translation: 这儿出什么了事？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: What if you joined the Great Khans?
translation: 如果你加入了大汗帮会怎么样？

original: You're doing the right thing.
translation: 你做了对的事。

original: Let's go.
translation: 我们走吧。

original: I'm ready to travel with you.
translation: 我准备和你一起旅行。

original: Good. I hoped you'd come around. Shall we?
translation: 好。我就知道你会想通的。那咱们上路吧？

original: Don't you have a family to feed?
translation: 你不是要养家吗？

original: Like I said, they can handle themselves. And I'm not the only one getting supplies for them. It's a big family.
translation: 我说了，他们自己能照顾好自己。而且负责养家的人又不止我一个。我们是大家庭。

original: Not interested.
translation: 没兴趣。

original: Suit yourself. You can always change your mind.
translation: 随你便。你可以随时改变主意。

original: I'd like to, but I can't take you with me right now.
translation: 本来想的，但我现在不能带你走了。

original: Aw, you really know how to make a girl feel like a stray cat.
translation: 哦，你还真是会放女生的鸽子啊。

original: But okay. My offer stands, if we run into each other again.
translation: 但没关系。如果我们以后再见面，希望还能有机会同行。

original: Okay, let's travel together.
translation: 好吧，我们一起旅行吧。

original: Now you're talking. One thing you should know, first, though. I asked you about the Brotherhood because I'm one of them.
translation: 这才像话嘛。不过首先有一件事你应该知道。我之所以会问你对兄弟会的看法，是因为我正是他们的一份子。

original: I know, I know. But I had to know how you'd react when I told you. We've made a lot of enemies.
translation: 我知道，我知道。我总得先观察一下你的反应吧，毕竟我们树敌不少。

original: You still okay bringing me along?
translation: 你还愿意带我一起去吗？

original: Where are you hoping to go?
translation: 你希望到哪里去？

original: Oh, nowhere in particular, really. Just hoping to see more of the world. Looking for a fresh perspective.
translation: 哦，没什么特别的目的地，真的。只是希望多看看这个世界。看看不一样的景色。

original: I want to see how different groups have adapted to survive in the Mojave. See if there's something I can learn from.
translation: 我想了解不同族群是如何在莫哈维沙漠中生存下来的。以便从中学习一些经验。

original: You don't look like much. What do you bring to the table?
translation: 你看起来挺娇贵的啊，你有什么本领？

original: Heh. Good. That's the look I was going for. Trust me on this one, though. You'll be glad you brought me along.
translation: 嘿，很好。我就喜欢你这态度。不过你大可以放心，带上我是绝对不会让你吃亏的。

original: If I turn out to be a burden, we can part ways at any time. No hard feelings.
translation: 万一你觉得我成了累赘，那我们随时可以分开。没有什么好顾虑的。

original: Going to see an old friend.
translation: 去看望一个老朋友。

original: This is quite a journey you're going on, then. Must be an interesting relationship to have brought you all this way.
translation: 那你还真的走了好长一段路啊。能让你长途跋涉这么远，你和那人的关系肯定不一般。

original: I go where I'm needed.
translation: 哪儿需要我，我就去哪儿。

original: Guess we have that in common, then.
translation: 看来我们有共同语言了。

original: What's it to you?
translation: 这跟你有关吗？

original: I'll be honest. You're the first person I've run across out here that looks like he can really handle himself.
translation: 我说实话吧。你是我在这里遇到的第一个看起来能独当一面的人。

original: I'll be honest. You're the first person I've run across out here that looks like she can really handle herself.
translation: 我说实话吧。你是我在这里遇到的第一个看起来能独当一面的人。

original: There are places I've never been to that'd be too dangerous for just me. What do you think? Maybe we could travel together, help each other out.
translation: 有些地方对我来说太危险，我没去过。你怎么想？也许我们可以一起旅行，互相帮助。

original: I just kind of drift from place to place.
translation: 四处流浪罢了。

original: Just wherever the wind takes you, huh? I like that. Keeps things interesting.
translation: 随风漂泊啊？我喜欢这样，时刻都能保持新鲜感。

original: Hoover Dam.
translation: 胡佛大坝。

original: Huh. Just on your way to do a little heavily fortified sightseeing. Kind of a thrillseeker, aren't you?
translation: 哈。你要去戒备森严的地方观光啊。你挺爱找刺激的，对吧？

original: The Strip.
translation: 长街。

original: Ooo. Very exciting. Gonna strike it rich, huh?
translation: 噢，让人兴奋的地方。能一夜暴富，是吧？

original: I don't really know anything about them.
translation: 我真的不了解他们。

original: I've heard they shoot lasers from their eyes.
translation: 我听说他们的眼睛里能射激光。

original: Wow. I've got to admit, you have completely defied my first impression of you.
translation: 哇。我得承认，你已经完全颠覆了我对你的第一印象。

original: Eye lasers. I'll be sure and look out for that next time.
translation: 眼睛射激光。那我下次一定要小心了。

original: Any other juicy bits of intel?
translation: 你还知道什么新鲜事吗？

original: I don't care for them.
translation: 我不关心他们。

original: Not very friendly, are they?
translation: 他们不是很友好，对吗？

original: Well, thanks for weighing in. Gives me something to think about.
translation: 嗯，感谢你告诉我。看来我得好好想想了。

original: I'm reserving judgment.
translation: 我保留我的看法。

original: That seems wise. I think I am, too. Although for how much longer, I'm not sure.
translation: 似乎挺明智的。想想我也是如此。但不知道我还能坚持多久。

original: They seemed all right.
translation: 他们看起来很好。

original: You think? Well good, then. That puts me a little more at ease.
translation: 你这么觉得？好吧。这让我安心多了。

original: Hey, so where are you headed, anyway?
translation: 嘿，你要到哪里去啊？

original: I killed them all.
translation: 我杀了他们。

original: God, you're not lying, are you? You really did kill them.
translation: 天啊，你不像在撒谎，对吧？你真的杀了他们。

original: In that case, this is for them.
translation: 那样的话，我要为他们报仇。

original: Did you still want to help Doctor Henry run his experiment?
translation: 你仍然想帮助亨利医生做实验吗？

original: Of course, dearie. I know it's dangerous, but it'll all turn out for the best, you'll see. I'll go to him now - it would be rude to keep him waiting!
translation: 当然，亲爱的。我知道很危险，但是值得，你会看到的。我现在就去见他——让他一直等着太不礼貌了！

original: I need to think about this.
translation: 我得好好想想。

original: Once you're done thinking, talk to Lily.
translation: 等你作出决定后，再去找莉莉。

original: Why is the Stealth Boy Mark II riskier?
translation: 为什么II型隐身小子的风险更大？

original: The stealth field has been modulated to use less power and thus last longer, but for some reason it has pronounced negative effects on the user.
translation: 该型号的隐形力场做了调整，能耗更少，持续时间也更长。但不知为何，对使用者的副作用也很明显。

original: However, these pronounced effects will allow me to pinpoint exactly what parts of the brain they're affecting.
translation: 然而，我可以通过观察这些副作用，来清楚地判断究竟是大脑的哪一个部分在受到影响。

original: Unfortunately, I'll need to run the test on a live subject, and Marcus has encouraged me to investigate the Nightstalker mutation first.
translation: 不幸的是，这个实验必须在活体身上进行，此外马可世也鼓励我先调查夜行兽的变异。

original: What are the risks of the experiment?
translation: 实验有什么风险？

original: Possibly immediate and permanent mental damage. There's a reason the Stealth Boy Mark IIs never got beyond the prototype stage.
translation: 有几率导致即发性的永久精神损伤。II型隐身小子之所以无法通过原型机测试阶段，也是由于这个原因。

original: Lily already has a pre-existing condition, and the experiment will likely make things worse for her.
translation: 莉莉的精神状况本来就有问题，试验可能会令她的情况更加恶化。

original: I'll talk to Lily, then.
translation: 那么，我会和莉莉谈谈。

original: I'll be waiting.
translation: 我会等着的。

original: Why Lily and not some other Nightkin?
translation: 为什么是莉莉，而不是其他的夜行族？

original: Lily is eccentric, certainly, but I've never felt she was dangerous. More importantly, she asked if she could help me in some way.
translation: 莉莉虽然性格反常，但我觉得她并不危险。更重要的是，她主动提出过要助我一臂之力。

original: I've told her about the risks, and she still insists on helping me.
translation: 我和她说过实验有风险，但她依然坚持要帮我。

original: I found a chewed up Stealth Boy in the Nightstalker lair.
translation: 我在夜行兽的巢穴里找到了一个被咬坏的隐身小子。

original: Hmmm... there's still power, but the casing is cracked. I'm astonished that exposure to the stealth radiation could induce mutations so rapidly.
translation: 嗯……还有电，但外壳已经被咬碎了。我很惊讶，暴露在隐形力场中的生物居然会如此迅速地发生变异。

original: More importantly, this explains why my research into this group of Nightstalkers hasn't come up with a cure for the Nightkin.
translation: 更重要的是，这也解释了为何我针对本地夜行兽种群所做的研究始终未能得到理想的结果。

original: There's only one avenue left for me - I need to run the Mark II test on Lily. It's the only way.
translation: 如此一来，就只剩一条路可走了——我要在莉莉身上测试II型原型机。这是唯一的方法。

original: {Lily dead}Hmmm... there's still power, but the casing is cracked. I'm astonished that exposure to the stealth radiation could induce mutations so rapidly.
translation: 嗯……还有电，但外壳已经被咬碎了。我很惊讶，暴露在隐形力场中的生物居然会如此快地发生变异。

original: More importantly, this explains why my research into this group of Nightstalkers hasn't come up with a cure for the Nightkin.
translation: 更重要的是，这也解释了为何我针对本地夜行兽种群所做的研究始终未能得到理想的结果。

original: I did have a test in mind using Lily, but since she's dead, that's no longer a possibility. Regrettable. Anyway, you've done all you can.
translation: 我本想对莉莉做个测试，可她已经死了，测试也就无从谈起。真是令人遗憾。不管怎样，你已经尽力了。

original: He's got no resources but a decent cause. We've got plenty of resources and a totally lost cause.
translation: 他除了远大的理想之外，已经一无所有了。而我们占尽天时地利，却自己断送了前程。

original: No power armor. No energy weapons. And they're giving the NCR more trouble than we ever did.
translation: 没有动力装甲。没有能量武器。可他们给NCR制造的麻烦却比我们多得多。

original: Ordinary guys with knives and bullets, and they're taking over Nevada.
translation: 这些凡夫俗子手中有的只是刀子与子弹，可他们却要将内华达收入囊中了。

original: There's a lot more troops here than we thought. No wonder we couldn't hold HELIOS One.
translation: 这里的部队比我们想象的多。难怪我们没法守住太阳神一号。

original: A bunch of shut-ins who scorn outsiders and hold technology over them. Gee, where have I heard that one before?
translation: 一群固步自封的家伙五十步笑百步，怀揣着科技抱残守缺。噫，怎么听起来那么耳熟呢？

original: Can't help but be impressed with what they're doing here.
translation: 不由自主地佩服他们在这儿做的工作。

original: Even the stupid NCR is investing in new research. We're getting left in the dust.
translation: 即使是愚蠢的NCR也懂得研究新科技。我们实在望尘莫及。

original: Leading his people to a new land with big dreams and a clean slate. Makes me think of my old mentor.
translation: 带领着人民，怀揣着梦想前往新大陆。不禁让我想起了我的导师。

original: Holy hell, that's a lot of energy weapons. Guess we dropped the ball on that one.
translation: 见鬼，这儿的能量武器真多。光是这点上我们就已经落后了。

original: Let's keep moving.
translation: 咱们接着走吧。

original: Let's.
translation: 走吧。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Darn it, I had some spectacular answers coming, too.
translation: 该死，我本来还想到了一些精彩的回答呢。

original: Any thoughts about Caesar's Legion?
translation: 你对凯撒军团有什么看法？

original: Silliest dressed band of raping, slaving marauders you'll see east of California, I'll say that. Where's that touch of Old World class?
translation: 要我说，他们是加州以东穿着最没品、手段最凶残、最无恶不作的一群坏蛋。旧世界的格调去哪儿了？

original: Although I hear the soldiers mount each other as much as they mount their women, so maybe they did keep a little something from the Empire.
translation: 不过我听说，他们的士兵除了骑女人外，还会互相骑，好歹是保留了一点古罗马帝国的传统。

original: No such privilege for the women, though. Figures. So... to answer your question... they're a bunch of hypocritical jerkwads. {beat}It's a word.
translation: 但女性就没这样的权利了。不出所料啊。总之……我觉得……他们就是一群衣冠禽兽。{beat}就是这样。

original: What do you think of the NCR?
translation: 你认为NCR怎样？

original: I'm worried they'll be the death of the Brotherhood. They take what they want. We defend our interests to the death.
translation: 我担心兄弟会有可能葬送在他们手里。他们为所欲为。我们会誓死捍卫自己的信念。

original: But there's a handful of us and tens or hundreds of thousands of them. So it's not going to end well.
translation: 但我们人少，他们人多，成千上万。结局肯定会很惨烈。

original: Last time we clashed we lost a lot of people. Retreated to our bunker. Now we're afraid to even move around during the day.
translation: 上次我们两边爆发过冲突，死了很多人。结果我们撤进了地堡，到现在我们甚至都不敢在白天外出活动。

original: Know anything about New Vegas?
translation: 新维加斯有什么特别的地方吗？

original: Yep. It's your typical city layout. Rich people in a gated community surrounded by extreme poverty.
translation: 是的。典型的阶级城市。封闭的富人区被大片贫民窟所包围。

original: House gave the area around the Strip to the locals, but he has no interest in it, so he ignores it entirely. It just needs new management.
translation: 豪斯把长街周边的地区都留给了本地人，但他对那里毫无兴趣，所以从不插手。那儿需要换批人来管。

original: I'd love to see the Brotherhood do it, but since the Codex doesn't say "clean up Freeside" no one listens to me. Bunch of sticklers.
translation: 我倒希望兄弟会能接过这个担子，但由于法典上没写着要"扫清自由城"，所以就没人听我的了。一帮固执的家伙。

original: Ever hear of a guy called Benny?
translation: 听说过一个叫本尼的家伙吗？

original: Sure, he's one of the hotel managers on the Strip. He comes up in the news now and then.
translation: 当然，他是长街一家酒店的经理。偶尔会在新闻里出现。

original: Him and the other Chairmen run the Tops. It's one of the nicer hotels, or so I hear.
translation: 他和董事会的其他人一起经营九重天。那是一家豪华酒店，至少我是这么听说的。

original: Elder McNamara wouldn't shell out for a passport for me, so I've actually never been to the Strip. Why do people get so cheap when they get old?
translation: 麦克纳马拉长老不肯给我办护照，所以我从未到过长街。为什么人一老就会变得小气？

original: Can you tell me anything about this platinum chip?
translation: 你能告诉我有关白金筹码的事吗？

original: Yeah. It's not for poker.
translation: 可以。反正不是打扑克用的。

original: I've never seen anything quite like it, but I can tell you it looks like it was fabricated before the War, and not at a mint.
translation: 我从没见过这样的东西，但我可以告诉你，它看起来像是战前制造的，而且不是铸币厂里造的。

original: Some kind of tech... I'm gonna say... mid-2200s. Hold onto it. Might be your lucky chip.
translation: 从技术上看……我认为……应该是属于23世纪中叶的。拿好它，可能是你的幸运筹码。

original: Ever heard of Mr. House before?
translation: 之前听过豪斯先生吗？

original: Yeah. They say he built the Strip. Of course, they say a lot of things. No one's actually met him.
translation: 是啊。听说是他建立了长街。当然，他们说了很多东西。但没人真正见过他。

original: Me? I think it's a hoax. Probably a group of people who want to avoid attention, or some made-up persona of a self-aware computer.
translation: 我倒觉得这一切都是编出来的。所谓的豪斯，可能是一个不喜欢抛头露面的秘密团体，也可能是一台具有自我意识的人工智能。

original: Why else would he shut himself in like that?
translation: 否则的话，他为什么要把自己关起来呢？

original: I have questions I wanted to ask you.
translation: 我有问题想问问你。

original: He was dead when I got there.
translation: 我到的时候他已经死了！

original: This better not be about the meaning of life.
translation: 最好别是什么人生的哲理。

original: Well, when two people really love each other... you really don't know this stuff yet?
translation: 如果两个人真心相爱……你真的不懂这种事吗？

original: Ooo, do I get a prize if I answer right?
translation: 噢，如果我答对了有奖励吗？

original: I was told we wouldn't be tested on this.
translation: 不是说好不做测试题的嘛。

original: A lifetime supply of Fancy Lads Snack Cakes, revenge against my enemies, and world peace. In that order.
