translation: 你怎么知道那么多关于我的事？

original: What are you saying I have to do?
translation: 你说我必须做什么？

original: I should be going.
translation: 我该告辞了。

original: Just give me back the Platinum Chip and I'll be on my way.
translation: 只要把白金筹码还我，我就走。

original: Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way.
translation: 只要让我处理了本尼，我就离开。

original: What are you saying I have to do?
translation: 你说我必须做什么？

original: How do you know so much about me?
translation: 你怎么知道那么多关于我的事？

original: Just give me back the Platinum Chip and I'll be on my way.
translation: 只要把白金筹码还我，我就走。

original: Oh, I'll give you the Platinum Chip. And then you'll use it exactly like I tell you to.
translation: 哦，我会把筹码给你的。但你得照我的命令来使用它。

original: I should be going.
translation: 我该告辞了。

original: I should be going.
translation: 我该告辞了。

original: {putting player in his/her place}You should be listening, that's what you should be doing.
translation: 你应该听我说，那才是你该做的事。

original: {keeping player in his/her place}That's right, you should be going - because you have work to do.
translation: 没错，你该走了，因为你还有任务在身。

original: Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way.
translation: 只要让我处理了本尼，我就离开。

original: Benny is my prisoner. You don't "deal with him" unless you've dealt with me.
translation: 本尼是我的俘虏。你没有权利"处置他"，除非获得我的首肯。

original: {I can read your mind}Don't worry, you'll get the Platinum Chip he was carrying. And then you'll use it like I tell you to.
translation: 别担心，你会得到他身上的白金筹码的。不过你得照我的命令来使用它。

original: I won't fight for the Legion.
translation: 我不会为军团而战的。

original: What did you just say?
translation: 你刚才说什么？

original: That's enough questions for now.
translation: 我暂时没有问题了。

original: What else, then?
translation: 还有什么事？

original: I apologize for my failure, mighty Caesar. It will not happen again.
translation: 我为我的错误感到抱歉，伟大的凯撒。下次一定注意。

original: That's right. Under normal circumstances, the reason it wouldn't happen again is that you'd be crucified - or worse.
translation: 没错。通常情况下，你也不可能再有犯错的理由了，因为你会被钉上十字架，甚至更加悲惨。

original: Only in light of the extraordinary service you've rendered unto me am I going to overlook this failure.
translation: 看在你曾为我立下汗马功劳的份上，我才原谅你的这次过错。

original: Bear in mind how much you have to make up for, how much you have to prove yourself in your next task...
translation: 给我记住，想要将功补过，就得全力以赴。下个任务你要好好下功夫……

original: I've committed no other crimes.
translation: 我没有犯过其他罪行。

original: Understand this. From this moment forward, any other crimes will be punished by death. No exceptions.
translation: 给我记住。从现在起，要是你再犯下任何罪行，我就立刻处死你。绝无例外。

original: I will have you hacked into pieces by my Praetorians - for my amusement. Understand?
translation: 我会让禁卫军将你碎尸万段，以供我消遣。明白了？

original: Now getting back to business...
translation: 那么说正事吧……

original: I defused the bomb on the monorail.
translation: 我把单轨铁路的炸弹拆除了。

original: Do you have any idea how much effort it took to place a mole at Camp McCarran? What else have you done?
translation: 你知不知道在麦卡伦营地安置一个线人得花多少功夫？ 你还做了什么？

original: The Legionaries at Nelson attacked me, so I had to fight back...
translation: 纳尔逊的军团士兵袭击我，我只好反击……

original: And so you wiped out the garrison I placed at Nelson? That strategically vital garrison? {beat}What else?
translation: 所以你就把我派到那儿的军队一锅端了？那可是战略要地啊！还有什么？

original: I may have disrupted plans to recruit the Great Khans to your cause.
translation: 我可能得放弃招募大汗帮的计划了。

original: Weeks of effort to convince those miserable Khans to join the Legion - ruined. Any other crimes?
translation: 花了几个星期苦口婆心地劝大汗帮加入军团，这下全泡汤了。还有其他坏消息吗？

original: I killed the Omertas who were scheming to attack the Strip.
translation: 我消灭了企图进攻长街的黑手党。

original: Months spent feeding the Omertas bribes, nursing their betrayal - all for nothing. Any other crimes?
translation: 几个月来在黑手党身上使了那么多钱，绞尽脑汁地策反他们，到头来却是竹篮打水一场空。还有什么坏消息吗？

original: I'm still working on the White Glove Society.
translation: 我还在处理白手套社团的问题。

original: {what the fuck are you doing talking to me, then?}Then get to it.
translation: 那就快去。

original: There's no way the White Glove Society will be cannibals again - I've already seen to that.
translation: 白手套社团不会再吃人了，我可以担保。

original: You've been resourceful in the past. Why are you a failure now?
translation: 你过去表现得那么出色，为何如今却失败了？

original: You'd best step up your performance with this next assignment...
translation: 你最好在下个任务里好好表现……

original: The White Glove Society has agreed to an alliance with Caesar's Legion.
translation: 白手套社团已经同意与凯撒军团结盟。

original: {satisfied}Good. It will be valuable to have allies on the Strip when Hoover Dam is taken. {beat}Now, as for your next assignment...
translation: 很好，攻下胡佛水坝时，如果能得到长街的支持，那将会事半功倍。好了，关于你的下一个任务……

original: The cannibals among the White Glove Society are dead.
translation: 白手套里的食人者已经死了。

original: They'll be of no use to the Legion, then.
translation: 那他们就对军团没有用处了。

original: You squandered a potentially valuable resource. {direct}Do better with your next assignment or there will be trouble...
translation: 一个潜在的宝贵资源就这样被浪费了。{direct}下次执行任务时，你最好能多上点心，不然会有麻烦的……

original: The White Glove Society won't listen to me - I've caused them too much trouble.
translation: 白手套社团不会听我的了，我在那儿制造了太多的麻烦。

original: So what you're telling me is, you're useless. You have no ability to influence events, so I'm forced to work around your incompetence.
translation: 所以你是想告诉我你就是个废物。你不仅没办法控制局面，还要我来花力气来替你收拾烂摊子。

original: Try to do better with your next assignment...
translation: 希望下个任务你能有点长进……

original: The Boomers hate me. They'll never follow my lead.
translation: 大炮族讨厌我。他们不会听我指挥的。

original: {irritated - the solution is obvious}Then you'll have to be extraordinarily persuasive. Or kill them - their leaders, at least.
translation: 那你除非有三寸不烂之舌，否则就只能除掉他们——至少，也要清除他们的领导层。

original: Get to it, will you? You're wasting my time.
translation: 快去吧，好吗？你这是在浪费时间。

original: I've won over the Boomers. They'll do as I say.
translation: 我赢得了大炮族的信任。他们会听我的话的。

original: Good. Make sure they help the Legion when the time comes. As for your next assignment...
translation: 很好。你必须确保他们届时能助军团一臂之力。那么，下一个任务……

original: I had to wipe out the Boomers' leaders.
translation: 我已经清除了大炮族的领导层。

original: A perfectly satisfactory way of resolving the threat they posed. It's impressive that you made it through their barrage.
translation: 用这种方法除掉威胁堪称完美。你居然能枪林弹雨中活下来，我不禁对你刮目相看。

original: Now, as for your next assignment...
translation: 那么，你的下一个任务……

original: I'm done working for you.
translation: 我不会再为你卖命了。

original: Mark my words, you piece of shit. This is the last time you will ever refuse to perform an order I've given you.
translation: 记住我的话，你这个废物。这是你最后一次拒不执行我的命令。

original: If you meant what you said, you best be on your way, and at good speed. And forget all that I could have given you.
translation: 如果你真有这个意图，那我建议你最好马上动身离开，把我对你的许诺统统忘掉。

original: If you ever - ever - disobey me again, I will order my Praetorians to hack you to death with their machetes for my entertainment.
translation: 如果你再敢——再敢违抗我的话，我就让禁卫军用砍刀将你凌迟处死。

original: I warned you about the price of disobedience. I guess you weren't listening.
translation: 我已经警告过你不服从命令会是什么后果，看来你没有听进去。

original: Praetorians! Kill this nuisance!
translation: 禁卫军！杀了这个渣滓！

original: Why must Mr. House be killed?
translation: 为什么一定要杀死豪斯先生？

original: Because he complicates the equation of force. He's a free agent, an unpredictable element.
translation: 因为他打破了势力间的均衡。他不受任何一方约束，是个不稳定因素。

original: I'm sure he's trying to sit out this battle, just as he did four years ago, hoping the Legion and Profligates will wipe each other out.
translation: 我敢肯定他这次还会像四年前一样作壁上观，盼着军团和荒淫之人两败俱伤。

original: When he sees the Profligates losing this battle, however, he might throw his support behind them. Except he won't, because he'll be dead.
translation: 不过，如果这次荒淫之人输掉的话，他可能会派出援军。当然，假如他死了，我们就不必再操心了。

original: I have some questions to ask.
translation: 我有些问题要问。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: What should I expect at the dam?
translation: 大坝的战事将会如何？

original: {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius will be waiting for you. Your arrival will signal to him that it's time to launch the attack.
translation: {Lah-nee-OOS}拉尼厄斯会等你的。只要你一到，他就会发起进攻。

original: As for what to expect, it's going to be the greatest battle - and victory - mankind has seen since it almost wiped itself off the face of this Earth.
translation: 能够料想的是，这将是人类自几乎灭绝以来所经历的规模最大的一场战役——也将是一次最为伟大的胜利。

original: Tactically, it's simple - kill and kill some more. I may have a few surprises in store for the NCR, but that won't concern you.
translation: 战术上其实很简单，就是能杀多少杀多少。我也许会给NCR留一点小惊喜，不过这与你无关。

original: Are your bodyguards special in any way?
translation: 你的保镖有什么过人之处吗？

original: My Praetorians embody the martial ideals of my Legion. Each one of them has done enough conquering and killing to deserve the rank of {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion.
translation: 禁卫军象征着军团勇往直前的尚武精神。他们中的每一个人都曾立下过赫赫战功，完全有资格获得百夫长的头衔。

original: Instead, I invited them to join my guard. So the invitee chooses whichever current guard he thinks is weakest - and challenges him.
translation: 但我不让他们领军，而是邀请他们加入我的卫队。受邀者必须从现有的禁卫军中挑出一名他认为最弱的守卫，并与他决斗。

original: The fight is to the death. It keeps them from getting complacent.
translation: 决斗至死方休。只有这样才能防止他们骄傲自矜。

original: Lucius has been the head of my guard for five years now. He was a subordinate guard for eight before that.
translation: 卢修斯给我当卫队长已经有5年了。此前8年他一直都在卫队中效劳。

original: No invitee has dared to challenge him yet. Maybe it's an issue of respect - he is getting on in years.
translation: 目前还没有受邀者胆敢挑战他。或许多半是出于敬意——毕竟他年事已高。

original: How long has Lucius been the head of your Praetorians?
translation: 卢修斯当你的禁卫军首领多久了？

original: Tell me about Vulpes Inculta.
translation: 说说沃尔普斯·因库塔吧。

original: {WUHL-pace}Vulpes is the best of my {Froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii. A remarkable individual from an unremarkable tribe south of the Utah.
translation: 沃尔普斯是我手下最优秀的特务。他虽然来自犹他一个不起眼的部落，却拥有极其出众的本领。

original: He was brought into the Legion as a boy, survived training, fought well enough as Legionary to be promoted to the rank of {deh-CAN-us}Decanus.
translation: 他在孩童时期就进入了军团，几经磨练后，优异的表现令他从普通士兵一跃升为十夫长。

original: Then, in battle against an {dismissive}unimportant tribe, he broke ranks and led his {con-too-BUR-nee-um - a Roman squad}contubernium through a hole in their defenses to capture its chieftain.
translation: 后来，在对抗一支不起眼的小部落的战斗中，他擅自违反军令，带领同帐小队穿过敌军的防守空当，活捉了他们的首领。

original: {amused}Well, his {ken-too-REE-on}Centurion wanted him crucified for disobedience. So I made him a {froo-men-TAR-eye}Frumentari.
translation: 他的百夫长本打算以军法将他处死。是我亲自发话，才将他破格提拔为军团特工。

original: Whatever I require. Infiltration, assassination, dramatic atrocities to break the spirit of the enemy - {souless, matter of fact}et {KEH-tur-ah}cetera.
translation: 我要他们做什么就做什么。渗透、暗杀、削弱敌人士气……不一而足。

original: They're mentally flexible. They operate behind enemy lines for extended periods, imitating the enemy's customs without becoming {slight beat}sullied.
translation: 他们个个狡猾透顶。他们能深入敌后潜伏很长时间，甚至完全同敌人打成一片，也不会被识破。

original: In all these things, {WUHL-pace}Vulpes is a master.
translation: 在这些方面，{WUHL-pace}沃尔普斯是大师。

original: What do the Frumentarii do?
translation: 军团特工主要做什么？

original: I've heard rumors of your legate, Lanius. What's his story?
translation: 我听说过很多有关特使拉尼厄斯的谣言。他有什么故事？

original: {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius is the greatest of my battlefield commanders. Some might call him a great man, but I'm not sure he qualifies.
translation: {Lan-ee-OOS}拉尼厄斯是我最好的战场指挥官。有人说他是伟人，但我并不觉得他配得上这个称号。

original: Once, he was the greatest warrior of the Hidebarks, a tribe of the Arizona. Maniacal in battle. Sometimes he'd ambush Legion patrols {emphasis}by himself.
translation: 他曾是隐吠部族最优秀的战士，这个部族来自亚利桑那。那时他凭一人之力就能端掉整支军团的巡逻队。

original: When, after several {emphasis, usually campaigns are faster}months we found and surrounded the Hidebarks' camp, their Chieftain raised a banner of surrender.
translation: 后来，我们找到并包围了隐吠部落，几个月后，他们的首领宣布投降。

original: The warrior who was not yet {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius went insane with rage. {a pleasing memory}He struck down his Chieftain and attacked his own tribe.
translation: 那个尚未被赐名拉尼厄斯的战士突然发起疯来，杀掉了自己的头领，还袭击了自己的同族。

original: He killed fifteen before they brought him down. He didn't die, obviously.
translation: 在被打倒前，他一共杀了15个人。当然，他自己没有死。

original: I had him tended to. He was {beat}maimed, most of face torn off. It was days before he regained consciousness.
translation: 我收留了他。他整个人都残了，脸也没了一大半。过了好几天，他才恢复了意识。

original: When he did, I went to his bedside and showed him the helmet I'd had forged to cover his face. I said he could have it if he'd fight for me.
translation: 他醒来后，我坐到他的床边，给他看了一顶头盔，那是我为了遮掩他受伤的面部而特意为他打造的。我告诉他，只要为我效命，头盔就是他的。

original: He accepted... on condition that he be allowed to kill the surviving males of his tribe. {chuckle}I said, make it the {emph}adult males and you have a deal.{Children are malleable and thus valuable to the Legion.}
translation: 他接受了……开出的条件是，他必须亲手宰掉自己部落中所有剩余的男子。我说，只能是成年男子，否则我不会应允。

original: What happened when Lanius attacked his own tribe?
translation: 拉尼厄斯为啥会对自己的族人拔刀相向？

original: {Lan-ee-OOS}Lanius is savage. Savagely loyal, too, but only to me - he has no love for my Legion. But this has its uses.
translation: 拉尼厄斯是个野人。他像狗儿一般忠诚，但他只忠于我，对军团没有感情。不过这也自有其好处。

original: He has no attachment to his men, no compunction about battlefield losses. All he cares about is destroying the enemy.
translation: 他从不体恤下属，对伤亡也毫无顾忌。他只关心能否摧毁敌人。

original: When another legatus or a {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion fails to achieve results, I send {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius to make things right.
translation: 当其他特使或百夫长失败时，我就会去派拉尼厄斯去训诫他们。

original: His first step is to beat the failed commander to death in front of his assembled troops. Then he orders the ritual of {deck-ih-MAH-tee-oh}decimatio.
translation: 他做的第一件事，就是把他们的指挥官拖到众人跟前活活打死。再执行所谓的十一抽杀律。

original: He sounds more like a savage than a general.
translation: 他听起来更像是个野人，而不是将军。

original: It means "decimation," but in ancient Rome the word had a very specific meaning - a punishment for cowardice.
translation: 这个词的原意是"抽签"，但在古罗马却有另一层涵义——是一种专门用于来惩罚懦夫的刑律。

original: The Legionaries are lined up in ranks. Every tenth man steps forward and is beaten to death by his brothers.
translation: 士兵们按军衔列队。每十个人中必须有一位都出列，在他的兄弟们面前被活活打死。

original: It instills a certain... robust obedience.
translation: 这会令他们从心理上……彻底服从。

original: What is "decimatio?"
translation: 什么是"十一抽杀律"？

original: {Lan-ee-OOS}Yes. This time my Legionaries will be more frightened of the commander behind them than the enemy before them.
translation: 是的。这一次，我要让士兵们害怕他们身后的指挥官，甚于他们面前的敌人。

original: There will be no failure this time, no retreat, no years of gathering slaves and resources for another assault.
translation: 我们将背水一战，绝不会撤退，也不会再去养精蓄锐准备下一次进攻。

original: With {Lah-nee-OOS}Lanius to drive the Legion forward, the dam will be taken. It will be our {slight beat}bridgehead across the Colorado.
translation: 有拉尼厄斯率领军团，我们必能攻陷大坝。它将成为我们跨越科罗拉多的桥头堡。

original: Lanius will lead the assault on Hoover Dam?
translation: 拉尼厄斯将会领导胡佛大坝的进攻？

original: It's not going to happen again. That's all I have to say about it.
translation: 不会再有第二次了。我就说这些。

original: Why did the Legion lose the first battle?
translation: 为什么军团会在第一次战役中失败？

original: And I've heard it's a bad idea to tempt the wrath of {KAI-zar}Caesar. Change the subject.
translation: 我也听说随便试探凯撒的底线是很危险的。换个话题吧。

original: I've heard the commander of the first battle called "The Burned Man."
translation: 我听说第一场战役的指挥官叫"浴火者。"

original: What's your opinion of President Kimball?
translation: 你觉得金博尔总统怎样？

original: A man of potential, held back by the {slight beat}craven political context he inhabits. You realize he was a general? "The Hero of the Mojave," they called him.
translation: 很有潜质的一个人，可惜却被懦弱的政权拴住了手脚。你能看出他曾经当过将军吗？"莫哈维的英雄"，当时人们都这么叫他。

original: A title he earned by extirpating lesser tribes that dared attack NCR citizens. His responses were {approving}swift and draconian.
translation: 他曾在铲除部族武装的战斗中立下过汗马功劳，那些小部族入侵过NCR，而他领导的反击不仅果断，而且强硬。

original: President Tandi, the "founding mother," coddled hostile tribes... but her successors were less naive, so they gave Kimball free rein.
translation: 坦蒂总统，他们的"国母"，惯坏了那些敌对部落…但她的继任者就没那么天真了，所以他们给了金博尔极大的自主权。

original: And after a respectable military career, what does he do? Become a {distaste}politician.
translation: 可在度过了一段受人尊崇的戎马生涯后，他又做了什么呢？成了一名政客。

original: But he did so by {disapproving}election. What better way to stunt the growth of leaders, not to mention whole cultures?
translation: 但他却是通过选举上位的。还有什么能比这个更加阻碍领袖的成长呢？更别提整个文化了。

original: A leader shouldn't have to kowtow to those who serve him. With so much energy wasted on those below, how is he ever to move forward?
translation: 一名领袖不应该向他所领导的人民卑躬屈膝。把精力全都浪费在比他低贱的人身上，那又如何能带领人民进步？

original: Had he taken the government by force, used his army to stage a coup, things would be very different.
translation: 如果他用武力夺权，用军队维持秩序，那一切就会截然不同。

original: I'll just have to do it for him.
translation: 而我会替他完成这个目标。

original: Isn't it natural for someone like Kimball to seek greater power?
translation: 像金博尔这样的人，追求权力不是很正常吗？

original: It'll frighten them. If I can reach out and kill whomever I choose, then they know the only reason they're alive is I haven't tried yet.
translation: 会令他们畏惧。如果所有人的生死都在我的一念之间，那他们就会明白，他们能活到今天，纯粹是因为我的仁慈。

original: You have to understand that Kimball is a symbol. Without him, there would be no NCR occupation of the Mojave.
translation: 你必须明白，金博尔是个象征。没有他，NCR根本无法占领莫哈维。

original: He mustered the troops - {distaste}as many as his senate would allow - and sent them in. All the right reasons, done all the wrong ways.
translation: 是他依靠着参议院的许可，集结了军队，把他们送到这里来的。目标很正确，可惜方法错了。

original: Any invasion by a democracy is a half-measure. When Kimball dies, the NCR will {emphasis}recoil from the Mojave, and from his legacy.
translation: 任何民主政权发动的侵略都不会长久。只要金博尔一死，NCR就会撤出莫哈维，他所留下的一切都将化为泡影。

original: By the time they recover and try to strike back, I'll be invading them.
translation: 等他们恢复元气，试图反击之时，我就将入侵他们的领地。

original: How will the NCR react to Kimball's death? Won't it just anger them?
translation: 如果金博尔死了，NCR会有什么反应？不会惹怒他们吧？

original: What do you think of the Brotherhood of Steel?
translation: 你怎么看钢铁兄弟会？

original: The worst impulses of mankind, concentrated in one insane, backward tribe.
translation: 一个既疯狂又落后的部族，集合了人类当中最狂热的分子。

original: The Brotherhood seems to have formed not long after the great atomic war. It's hard to know - they care little for history.
translation: 兄弟会似乎在核大战后不久就成立了。实际情况不太清楚，他们自己也很少关心历史。

original: Some of the Brotherhood scribes we captured further East didn't even know the name of their founder, Roger Maxson.
translation: 我们在东部抓到的一些兄弟会学士甚至连他们的创始人罗杰·麦克森都不认识。

original: They like to pretty up their mission with trappings of chivalry, but the truth is they're horders. They horde technology.
translation: 他们喜欢用骑士精神来粉饰自己的行为，可这些家伙其实就是一群野蛮人，把科技当图腾来崇拜。

original: It's been 200 years, and they still have the mentality of scavengers. They say they're preserving these technologies, but for what?
translation: 已经200年了，他们的行为方式却还和捡破烂差不多。说是为了保护旧时的技术，可保护了又能怎么样呢？

original: They have no vision. They offer no future. They're a dead end.
translation: 他们目光短浅，缺乏长远打算。跟着他们只有死路一条。

original: You don't think very far ahead, do you?
translation: 你并没有考虑得很长远，对吧？

original: Sure, their hatred of the NCR would seem to qualify them for use as proxies. But then what do you do with them? Each paladin is quite powerful.
translation: 当然，我们可以利用他们对NCR的憎恨，可之后又该如何处置他们？每个圣骑士都很厉害。

original: I'd have to be convinced that present benefits outweighed future costs.
translation: 除非我当下得到的利益会比将来付出的代价更多，否则别想说服我。

original: Couldn't you use the Brotherhood to your advantage?
translation: 你就不能让兄弟会为你所用吗？

original: Tell me about the Boomers.
translation: 和我说说大炮族吧。

original: The Boomers settled at the old air base northeast of Vegas many years ago. No one knows exactly how long it's been.
translation: 大炮族很多年前就在维加斯东北面的一座空军基地里定居了，没人知道他们是何时到那儿的。

original: It may be that no one's traded with them or even spoken to them that entire time. If so, they're sitting on one hell of a stockpile of ammunition...
translation: 也许从来就没有人与他们交流或通商过。如果这样的话，那他们手上肯定还握有大量的弹药储备……

original: My scouts have seen people moving around the base. The perimeter is guarded, with spotters in towers directing the artillery fire.
translation: 我的探子曾看到有人在基地周边活动。基地周围都有守卫，还有观察员在塔楼里操作火炮。

original: They must have extraordinary vision. Some of my scouts were targeted at extreme distances.
translation: 他们的侦察设备一定相当先进。我的探子甚至在很远的距离外都能被他们发现。

original: So no, I can't tell you what to expect inside the base. No one's been inside it, except them.
translation: 所以我也不知道那个基地里究竟有什么。除了他们自己，没有人进去过。

original: Don't you know anything about their society?
translation: 你对他们有了解吗？

original: You should use Mr. House's technology to attack the dam.
translation: 你应该利用豪斯先生的技术来进攻大坝。

original: You don't get it, do you? The weapons I wield are forged from blood, flesh, sinew, bone - mortal stuff. Fragile, even.
translation: 你不明白，对吗？我所拥有的武器是由血肉筋骨所铸成的。诚然，肉体是脆弱的。

original: And yet my Legion obeys me, even unto death. Why? Because they live to serve the greater good, and they know of no alternatives.
translation: 可即便如此，我的将士依然对我唯命是从，随我赴汤蹈火。为什么？因为他们都怀着崇高的抱负，也知道想要成就伟业，除此之外，别无他法。

original: House's machines, his technologies - what do they propose? The possibility of victory without sacrifice. No blood spilled, just... rivets.
translation: 豪斯的机器和科技，它们所鼓励的又是什么呢？无非是不用牺牲即可取胜。兵不血刃，只要落下一堆……铆钉就行。

original: That's not an idea to be put in circulation. If mankind's going to survive this moment in history, it needs warriors, not {contempt}gadgets.
translation: 这种想法根本不切实际。此时此刻，如果人类还想要生存下去，就必须奋勇搏杀，而不是靠什么奇巧淫技。

original: Maybe Benny could do this for you.
translation: 也许本尼可以替你做这事。

original: I wouldn't trust Benny to lick my boots clean. This one falls to you.
translation: 我不相信本尼会心甘情愿替我卖命。交给你了。

original: Can't your Legionaries take care of this?
translation: 难道你就不能派军团士兵去处理这件事吗？

original: Yes. But then I'd have to kill them.
translation: 可以，但之后我就只能杀了他们。

original: What's on the other side of those doors?
translation: 门的另一边是什么？

original: Benny's theory, if I understood it through all the screaming, was that Mr. House stashed some kind of ultimate weapon down there.
translation: 从本尼的惨叫声中，我倒是大概听懂了他的意思，他说豪斯先生在下面藏了某种超级武器。

original: A gigantic robot to stomp us all to death, who cares? Whatever it is, House built it, so I want it destroyed.
translation: 把我们踩成肉饼的巨型机器人，那又如何？不管什么玩意，既然豪斯造出来了，那就给我毁掉它。

original: I don't know. And I don't like not knowing.
translation: 我不知道，我也不想知道。

original: {there's an alternate take with "couldn't" instead of "can't"}I know Mr. House built it. I'm thinking it's probably some kind of weapon that he can't activate from a distance.
translation: 我只知道那是豪斯先生的杰作。我觉得可能是某种武器，但他无法远程启动。

original: How do you know so much about me?
translation: 你怎么知道这么多关于我的事情？

original: I have eyes and ears everywhere. {kind of obvious}It behooves me not to invade the west blind and deaf.
translation: 我的耳目遍布八方。既然我要入侵西部，自然要对这里的局势了若指掌。

original: It hasn't been hard to track your progress. It's not as though you've been keeping a low profile.
translation: 要掌握你的行踪并不困难。而且你似乎也不是很低调。

original: What do I have to do?
translation: 我要做些什么？

original: Just give me back the Platinum Chip and I'll be on my way.
translation: 把筹码给我，我这就上路。

original: What were you looking to start?
translation: 要怎样开始着手呢？

original: The time is fast approaching when my Legion will assault the great dam and invade the west.
translation: 我的军团进攻大坝和西部的日子已经越来越近了。

original: Before that happens, I want Mr. House knocked out of the game, a quick one-two punch - with you doing the punching.
translation: 在那之前，我想先尽快消灭豪斯先生，最好能速战速决，而你是不二人选。

original: Before that happens, I want Mr. House erased from the picture. Not just the man you killed, but what he left behind. His legacy.
translation: 在那之前，我想先除掉豪斯先生。光杀人是不够的，还要毁掉他留下的一切，他的遗产。

original: Just let me deal with Benny and I'll be on my way.
translation: 先让我处置了本尼，然后我们再谈。

original: How may I serve your Legion, Caesar?
translation: 我愿为您的军团效劳，凯撒。

original: {pleased}I like the servile attitude. Keep it up.
translation: 我喜欢这样顺从的态度。下次也当如此。

original: You spread word of the massacre of Nipton, just like {WUHL-pace}Vulpes asked you.
translation: 你遵照沃尔普斯的吩咐散播了尼普顿屠城的消息。

original: Beams of light shot down from the sky over HELIOS One, killing who knows how many Profligate troops.
translation: 数道金光从天而降，笼罩了太阳神一号，许多荒淫之人因此殒命。

original: Silus, the {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion who let himself get captured, died at McCarran before he could reveal sensitive information.
translation: 希鲁斯, 那个被俘的百夫长，一个字都没吐就死在了麦卡伦营地。

original: You freed the {Ken-TOO-ree-on}Centurion Silus from McCarran so that he might be punished for his cowardice.
translation: 虽然你从麦卡伦营地救出了百夫长希鲁斯，但他还是要为自己的懦弱接受惩罚。

original: The monorail that the Profligates rode from McCarran to the Strip has been destroyed.
translation: 荒淫之人使用的那辆连接麦卡伦与长街的单轨列车已经被摧毁了。

original: You turned Camp Forlorn Hope into a mass grave.
translation: 你将飘零希望营地变成了一座坟墓。

original: Chief Hanlon, a nemesis of my Legion, died the humiliating death he deserved.
translation: 军士长汉隆，曾经数次与我们作对，如今却在屈辱中死去，真是罪有应得。

original: In Boulder City, you let the renegade Khans go free, but left NCR troopers gurgling on the ground, drowning in their own blood.
translation: 你在巨石城放走了大汗帮的人，却让NCR的部队溃不成军，死伤惨重。

original: A number of NCR Ranger stations have been wiped off the face of the Mojave, thanks to you.
translation: 许多NCR游骑兵哨站已经彻底从莫哈维沙漠上消失了，谢谢你。

original: {ironic}The Profligates still hate me more than they hate you, I think, but I've been at this longer than you have.
translation: 也许比起你，荒淫之人还是更恨我一些。不过我毕竟比你资历老。

original: I get it. We share a common enemy. And now you come before the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar to what - offer your services?
translation: 我明白了。看来我们拥有共同的敌人，那么你来到伟大的凯撒跟前来又是为什么，要效忠于我吗？

original: {WUHL-pace in-CUHL-tah}Vulpes Inculta, the best of my {froo-men-TAR-ee}frumentarii, is dead.
translation: 沃尔普斯·因库塔,我最好的{froo-men-TAR-ee}特务官，已经死了。

original: {player killed Omerta leaders}All the bribes I sent to the Omertas ended up buying me {beat}nothing.
translation: 这下我送给黑手党的那些钱全打了水漂。

original: {Player spoiled his plans for the Great Khans.}The Great Khans aren't exactly clamoring to fight for my Legion now.
translation: 大汗帮现在已经不会再为我的军团卖命了。

original: The garrison I established at Nelson has been wiped out.
translation: 我派驻在纳尔逊的军队被全歼了。

original: Years of meticulous scheming to place a mole at Camp McCarran - wasted.
translation: 这么多年苦心计划，就为了在麦卡伦营地安插一个线人……如今也作废了。

original: The Kings of Freeside are cooperating with the NCR now, which frees up soldiers to defend the dam.
translation: 自由城的猫王帮与NCR联手了，他们会派人去防守大坝。

original: You even disrupted a promising weapons deal with the Van Graffs.
translation: 你居然切断了我们与范格拉夫之间的军火交易。

original: Is it any wonder my Legion has so little love for you?
translation: 知道为什么我的军团这么不喜欢你吗？

original: So tell me this, because I really want to know. I am feared - with good reason.
translation: 我有个疑问，你必须好好回答我。无论任何人，都会不由自主地畏惧我。

original: But you - of all people - dare to come here and stand before me, the mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar. {beat}What were you thinking?
translation: 而你，居然能若无其事地走进来，站在我——伟大的凯撒的面前。你到底在想什么？

original: That I'd decorate this tent with your guts.
translation: 我要用你的内脏来装饰这顶敞篷。

original: {Pray-TOR-ee-ahns}Praetorians, to me!
translation: {Pray-TOR-ee-ahns}禁卫军，快过来！

original: Death to tyrants! <Start combat.>
translation: 受死吧！<开始战斗>

original: Praetorians, to arms!
translation: 禁卫军，准备战斗！

original: I had to see the Mighty Caesar with my own eyes.
translation: 我想要用双眼亲自见见伟大的凯撒。

original: Maybe I should have you struck blind so my face is the last sight you ever behold. {tiring of the jest, to business}Look...{transitioning to "You do know why I wanted to meet you, right?"}
translation: 也许我应该把你弄瞎，这样你看到的最后画面就会是我的脸了。听着……{transitioning to "You do know why I wanted to meet you, right?"}

original: You're in possession of something that interests me.
translation: 你手头的东西我很感兴趣。

original: We'll deal with Benny when the time comes. In the meantime...
translation: 等时机成熟，我们再去对付本尼。现在呢……

original: We'll talk about the Platinum Chip when the time comes. In the meantime...
translation: 等时机成熟，我们再去管那个白金筹码。目前呢……

original: I need to get that Platinum Chip back.
translation: 我要把白金芯片拿回来。

original: You guaranteed my safety.
translation: 你答应过会保证我安全。

original: And you fell for that? Really? Because I'm going to have you killed now.
translation: 然后你就信了？真的？现在我可就要杀了你。

original: You do know why I wanted to meet you, right?
translation: 你知道我为什么要见你，对吧？

original: A man nearly kills you, so you track him across the breadth of the Mojave?
translation: 就因为有个人要杀你，你追着他一路穿过了莫哈维沙漠？

original: You arrive on the Strip and waltz into the Lucky 38 like someone left you a key under the doormat?
translation: 你居然刚到长街就能大摇大摆地走进幸运38？难不成有人从门缝里塞了把钥匙给你？

original: You assassinate the head of the Chairmen {emphasis}in his own casino - and get away with it?
translation: 你闯入董事会的赌场，刺杀了他们的头目，还逃走了？

original: You visit the Tops, and next thing you know, the head of the Chairmen is fleeing the Strip like a whimpering little pup?
translation: 你去了九重天，然后董事会的首领就如丧家犬似的逃出了长街？

original: Then something happens to Mr. House's robots - some kind of military upgrade?
translation: 接着，豪斯先生的机器人就获得了……武器升级？

original: But the topper, the {coo de gras, "s" not silent}coup de grace? Mr. House dies - while you're visiting him at the Lucky 38.{grunt of admiration}
translation: 不过首先，最关键的是，我们的豪斯先生，在你拜访幸运38的时候死于非命。{grunt of admiration}

original: When you set your mind to something, you get results. I like that.
translation: 有志者事竟成。我喜欢。

original: {beat}...Relax. I'm fucking with you.
translation: {beat}…放松点。我开玩笑呢。

original: Mr. House sent me to infiltrate your camp.
translation: 豪斯先生派我潜入你们的营地。

original: Mission accomplished, asshole. {playing with him}I never would've suspected a thing if you hadn't told me - but now I'll have to have you killed.
translation: 那你的任务算是完成了，混蛋。你要是不告诉我，我还不会怀疑你。可惜现在，我只能除掉你了。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: I'm in charge of the radio - hence the title "Comm Officer." I'd much rather be out on patrol, since nothing much happens around here.
translation: 我负责无线电——所以我的职务是"通讯官"。其实我更宁愿出去巡逻，因为这里基本没什么事。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Come back when you have news about the Boomers.
translation: 等你有了大炮族的动向时再回来告诉我。

original: Come back when you know more about the White Glove Society.
translation: 等你有了白手套社团的动向时再回来告诉我。

original: Return to me when you've destroyed the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 消灭了钢铁兄弟会后回来找我。

original: Come back when you've destroyed whatever you find down in that bunker.
translation: 毁掉地堡里的东西后再回来找我。

original: Complete your mission, then return to me.
translation: 先去完成任务，再来向我复命。

original: {WAHL-ay}Vale.
translation: {WAHL-ay}再会。

original: Nevermind, I'll be back.
translation: 算了，我以后再来。

original: All right, come back any time.
translation: 好的，随时恭候。

original: Any interesting places around here?
translation: 这附近有什么好玩的地方吗？

original: Have you ever heard the story of the bomber that crashed into the lake before the War? Supposedly it's mostly intact, even after all that time.
translation: 你有没有听过一个故事？战前曾经有一架轰炸机坠入湖中。据说过了这么多年，它的残骸依然保存完好。

original: Forget about it. It's over.
translation: 算了吧。都结束了。

original: {disappointed}Oh. Well, thanks for helping get to the bottom of this, I guess.
translation: {disappointed}哦。好吧，谢谢你帮忙查明真相。

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: I handle communications for Camp Forlorn Hope, compiling reports I've received from the Rangers at Camp Golf as well as the brass at McCarran.
translation: 我负责飘零希望营地的通讯，编译从高尔夫营地接收到的游骑兵报告和麦卡伦营地的首长指示。

original: {annoyed and underappreciated}Unofficially, I'm also in charge of radio security. No one else seems to take it as seriously as I do.
translation: {annoyed and underappreciated}私下告诉你，我还负责无线电安全。似乎也没有谁会比我更认真的了。

original: Have you heard anything unusual about any of the other Ranger stations?
translation: 其他的那些游骑兵驻站，你听到什么消息了吗？

original: Nothing as severe. Charlie seems to be getting a lot of extra medical supplies for some reason, while Bravo hasn't requested a resupply in awhile.
translation: 没什么特别的。查理驻站不知为何得到了一大批额外的医药补给，而布拉沃驻站已经有好一阵子没申请物资补给了。

original: Echo has been reporting heavy Legion activity down on their end, but that's about it.
translation: 艾柯驻站报告说军团在他们那儿的活动十分频繁，不过也就那样。

original: Not without out fight. <Attack.>
translation: 打赢了我再说吧。<攻击。>

original: Good thing you're wearing a skirt, makes pissing yourself go easier. <Attack.>
translation: 还好你穿着短裙，这样至少不会尿到裤子上。<攻击。>

original: {Afraid}Brothers, help!
translation: {Afraid}兄弟们，救命！

original: What's a Decanus?
translation: 十夫长是什么？

original: {outraged by player's ignorance}My commander, you ignorant degenerate! {final chance}Now, will you go before Dead Sea?
translation: {outraged by player's ignorance}是我们的司令官，你这个无知的堕落者！{final chance}你到底想不想去去见死海？

original: Yes, I'll go before your Decanus.
translation: 是的，我愿意去见你的十夫长。

original: Follow me. {warning}Make any trouble, and you'll wind up on a cross - if you're lucky.
translation: 跟我走。{warning}你敢惹麻烦，就等着在十字架上风干吧——前提是你走运。

original: I'm just passing through.
translation: 我只是路过。

original: The Legion will decide that, Profligate, not you. Will you go before my {Deh-CAN-us}Decanus for judgement, or be killed where you stand?
translation: 荒淫之人，作出决定的应该是军团，而不是你。你想{Deh-CAN-us}接受我们十夫长的审判呢，还是愿意就地受死？

original: I came seeking yours, skirt boy. <Attack.>
translation: 我是特地来要你们命的，穿短裙的娘娘腔。<攻击。>

original: {Afraid}Brothers, help!
translation: {Afraid}兄弟们，救命！

original: You just messed with the wrong gal. <Attack.>
translation: 你惹错人了。<攻击。>

original: {call to arms}Brothers! Attack!
translation: {call to arms}兄弟们！攻击！

original: You just messed with the wrong guy. <Attack.>
translation: 你惹错人了。<攻击。>

original: <Brothers! Attack!>
translation: <兄弟们！攻击！>

original: Easy, I'm a friend of the Legion.
translation: 别紧张，我是军团的朋友。

original: {recognizing player}Ah - you must be the courier who's been of service to us lately. I'll take you to my {Deh-CAN-us}Decanus at once.
translation: {recognizing player}啊——想必你就是近来在为我们效劳的那个邮差了。我现在就领您去见{Deh-CAN-us}十夫长。

original: I bear the Mark of Caesar.
translation: 我带着凯撒的徽记。

original: {surprised}Forgive my challenge. I'll take you to my {Deh-CAN-us}Decanus at once.
translation: {surprised}恕我冒犯。我现在就领您去见{Deh-CAN-us}十夫长。

original: [PRESS DEMO] Enough gambling, more fighting. Take me to the no man's land near Camp Forlorn Hope.
translation: [PRESS DEMO]少赌博，多干事。带我去飘零希望营地附近的无人区。

original: You'll need someone to watch your back - Craig Boone, an NCR sniper, will be joining you. Keep your head down out there!
translation: 你需要有人掩护——克雷格·布恩, 一名NCR的狙击手， 他会帮你。 多加小心！

original: I'd like to know more about the Rangers.
translation: 我想再多了解一些游骑兵的作用。

original: Well, when there's trouble regular NCR troops can't handle, they send in a Ranger. Problem solved.
translation: 哦，只要发生了NCR军队应付不了的事，派个游骑兵过来，事情准能解决。

original: We're also responsible for keeping the borders of the NCR secure, scouting out threats, that sort of thing.
translation: 我们同时也负责NCR边境的守卫工作。侦察这附近是否存在威胁，诸如此类。

original: I'd like to know more about the NCR Rangers.
translation: 我想再多了解NCR游骑兵的能力。

original: Best of the best, that's all there is to it. Really nothing more to say than that.
translation: 人中龙凤，只能这么说。也没什么能比这个词更贴切的了。

original: How does someone become a Ranger?
translation: 怎样成为游骑兵？

original: The Rangers mostly draw from the basic NCR army. A trooper who shows exceptional skill at fighting and scouting can be nominated for the training.
translation: 游骑兵大都从NCR的常规部队中选拔产生。只要在战斗或侦察任务重表现优异，就可以获得推荐，参加训练。

original: Are there a lot of Rangers in the Mojave?
translation: 在莫哈维有很多游骑兵吗？

original: Couple dozen, I'd say, most of them posted at stations like this one. We either man the station or patrol the immediate area.
translation: 还是有不少的。他们大部分都驻扎在驻站里，比如这个。通常我们要么在这里值守，要么就是在附近的区域巡逻。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Tell me about the Rangers.
translation: 跟我说说游骑兵的事吧。

original: We're part scout, part commando, part sheriff. The training is brutal, and I'd say eight out of ten recruits washes out before the end.
translation: 我们既是侦察员，又是突击手，还是治安官。训练很艰苦，会有八成的新兵被淘汰。

original: Before you get your Ranger badge, you've got to prove you can be quieter than a shadow and more ferocious than a Deathclaw.
translation: 想要拿到游骑兵徽章，你得证明自己比黑影还要安静，比死亡爪更加冷酷。

original: So, you're a Ranger?
translation: 那么，你是游骑兵？

original: For about ten years now. Toughest training I've ever done, and was the proudest day of my life when I got my Ranger badge.
translation: 已经干了10年了。从没接受过那样严苛的训练，拿到游骑兵徽章的那天是我生命中最自豪的一天。

original: Did you know that the first battle at Hoover Dam was won because of the Rangers? Legion had the numbers, but we had the skill.
translation: 你知不知道第一次胡佛大坝战役是靠游骑兵才赢下来的？虽然军团人数众多，可我们却技高一筹。

original: Tell me about the Rangers.
translation: 跟我说说游骑兵的事。

original: I'm not really much of a historian. The short version is that the Rangers are the elite of the NCR military. Best fighters in the wasteland.
translation: 我可不是什么历史学家。简而言之，游骑兵是NCR军队中的精英。废土上最优秀的战士。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: Ranger Station Alpha. Ranger Lineholm is in command here.
translation: 游骑兵阿尔法驻站。游骑兵兰霍姆是这儿的负责人。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Later.
translation: 回见。

original: Can I ask you some questions?
translation: 我能问你些问题吗？

original: Shoot.
translation: 说吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: {nodding}Goodbye.
translation: {nodding}再见。

original: What's going on with the Great Khans?
translation: 大汗帮的人怎么了？

original: One of my patrols was on its way back from Novac when it came under fire from the Great Khans.
translation: 我的一支巡逻队刚从诺瓦克回来，就遭遇了大汗帮的袭击。

original: They radioed for reinforcements, but instead of waiting for us, they chased the Khans into the ruins where they were caught in a crossfire.
translation: 他们用无线电请求支援，但没等我们抵达，他们就跟着那伙大汗帮进了废墟，之后就被敌人包了饺子。

original: No deaths, but not all of the squad got out. The Khans have Private Ackerman and Private Gilbert as hostages.
translation: 虽然没有人阵亡，但队伍里有几个人没能突围出来。大汗帮的人抓了列兵阿克曼和吉尔伯特当人质。

original: I had some questions.
translation: 我有些问题想问你。

original: I'm sure you have all the good dirt on what goes on around here.
translation: 我相信你也对本地发生的事情有所耳闻。

original: I sure do, but loose lips{giggle} sink ships.
translation: 确实，不过俗话说得好，碎嘴{giggle}坏大事。

original: <Speech Options>
translation: <口才选项>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Alright, you look pretty trustworthy.
translation: [成功] 也对，你看起来还挺可靠。

original: Don't worry about me, I can keep your secrets.
translation: 别担心，我会保密的。

original: [FAILED] Sorry, but the Omertas don't look very kindly upon gossiping.
translation: [失败] 抱歉，黑手党对流言可没什么好印象。

original: A little gossip never hurt anyone.
translation: 一点点流言无伤大雅。

original: <Cherchez La Femme>
translation: <总找女人>

original: I...{stammer} well, since you ask so nicely, and I'm not sure I could resist those pretty eyes. What do you want to know?
translation: 我……{stammer}你嘴那么甜，眼睛又这么迷人……你想知道些什么？

original: Beautiful, I would love to help you loosen those lips.
translation: 美人儿，我会很乐意帮你开口的。

original: What can you tell me about what's going on around the Strip?
translation: 长街周围发生的事你都知道些什么？

original: I've heard some pretty shady rumors about the Ultra Luxe.
translation: 我听说了一些关于奢华殿堂的糟糕传闻。

original: I'm not sure what the deal is, but although they try to put on airs, that place is just plain creepy. Maybe it's the masks.
translation: 我不清楚交易的具体内容。虽然他们一直在掩饰，但也盖不住那地方一股诡异的气息。可能是因为面具吧。

original: Not much of a rumor, but I hear the Tops is always looking for new talent. Lord knows they've needed it for a long time.
translation: 也不算是流言了，但我听说九重天一直在寻找有艺术天赋的新人。好像找了很长一段时间了。

original: I'm not sure what's going on at Lucky 38. That place is weird. Nobody ever goes in. Nobody ever comes out.
translation: 我不知道在幸运38里发生了什么。那个地方很诡异。从来没见有人进去过，也没见有人出来。

original: I hear you've actually been inside Lucky 38? You're the first person who's been in there in as long as anybody can remember.
translation: 我听说你真的进到幸运38里面去了？这么久了，你是第一个进去的人。

original: It's hard to believe that not too long ago most of the families on the Strip were little more than warring tribes.
translation: 说出来没人信，不久以前长街的绝大部分家族都还只是些就知道寻衅滋事的小帮派。

original: The Omertas even had a big war with the Khans, once upon a time.
translation: 黑手党甚至还和大汗帮干过一架。

original: Sorry, that's all the news worth talking about. All I have at least.
translation: 抱歉，至少就我知道的事情，有价值的我已经都说了。

original: What can you tell me about what's going on in Gomorrah?
translation: 蛾摩拉的事，你知道多少？

original: Gossip is one thing, dirt on the Family is something else totally.
translation: 打听街上的流言是一回事，打听家族里的丑事可就是另外一回事了。

original: {sigh}I knew someone would call in that mark soon. What do you want to know?
translation: {sigh}我就知道迟早会有人来问的。你想知道些什么？

original: I'm calling in for an outstanding balance for some information. Tell me what the Omertas are up to.
translation: 我想打听一些情况，钱不会少给的。告诉我黑手党到底在策划什么阴谋诡计？

original: That was one of my sisters, but my family always repays our debts. What do you want to know?
translation: 那是我的一个姐妹，但是我的家族总是有债必还。你想知道些什么？

original: I'm calling in for an outstanding balance for some information. Tell me what the Omertas are up to.
translation: 我想打听一些情况，钱不会少给的。告诉我黑手党到底在策划什么阴谋诡计？

original: Can you help me find someone?
translation: 你能帮我找个人吗？

original: Depends on who you're looking for.
translation: 那要看你是找谁了。

original: I'm looking for Cachino.
translation: 我在找卡奇诺。

original: Cachino is usually on this floor in Brimstone, having drinks. If he isn't there then he's probably in his room upstairs.
translation: 卡奇诺通常会待在硫磺火喝酒。如果他不在那儿，那就可能在他楼上的房间里。

original: Can you tell me where Troike is?
translation: 你能告诉我卓伊克在哪吗？

original: Troike spends all his days down in Zoara on the lower level.
translation: 卓伊克大部分时间都在无眠俱乐部的楼下。

original: Troike is dead, but I'm sure you know that.
translation: 卓伊克已经死了，相信你也知道。

original: Do you know someone named Clanden?
translation: 你知道一个叫克兰顿的人吗？

original: Yeah. I know him.{unhappy, spoken with contempt} You'll probably find him in his room upstairs. He usually just sends down for girls or food.
translation: 嗯，知道。{unhappy, spoken with contempt}你可以在他楼上的房间里找到他。通常只有食物和女人才能让他下楼。

original: I knew someone named Clanden. Good fucking riddance.
translation: 我知道那个叫克兰顿的人。该死的垃圾，死得好。

original: Where can I find the management?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到管事的？

original: Big Sal and Nero split their time in Zoara overlooking the main casino floor from the balcony. No one but Family is allowed up there, though.
translation: 大萨尔和尼禄轮流在无眠俱乐部楼上的包厢里值班，监视下面的赌场。不过，除了家族里的人，没人可以上去。

original: I need to know who to talk to about what's been going on in Gomorrah.
translation: 我就想知道谁能告诉我蛾摩拉目前的情况。

original: All I can tell you is to find Cachino. He's the lowest level Lieutenant you're going to be able to talk to.
translation: 我只能告诉你去找卡奇诺。只有他这种最底层的小头目才会和你打交道。

original: Some of the girls say he's been involved in some shady business the Family wouldn't really like. Ask him about it.
translation: 有姑娘说他卷入了一些肮脏的交易，家族里的人对他不是很待见。你可以去问问他。

original: Tell me what the Family is up to.
translation: 告诉我家族在策划什么。

original: Sorry, they don't tell me their plans and I don't want to know. I'm just happy they don't make me fuck anybody anymore.
translation: 抱歉，他们没有告诉我计划，我也不想知道。我只是很高兴他们没再让我去和别人睡觉。

original: Moore sent me to talk to you about the Omertas.
translation: 莫尔让我来跟你谈谈黑手党的事。

original: Ah, excellent. I received word you may be coming. We helped the receptionist over at Gomorrah with some thugs that were taking advantage of her.
translation: 啊，太好了。我听说了你要来。在蛾摩拉有几个恶棍想占接待小姐的便宜，我们出手救了她。

original: She owes us a favor. Go talk to her, she'll be able to point you in the right direction.
translation: 她欠我们个人情。去找她吧，她会给你指路的。

original: Let me ask you about something else.
translation: 我想问你点别的。

original: Fire away.
translation: 随便问吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Enjoy yourself.
translation: 自便。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Be careful.
translation: 当心！

original: Well, I'm not, and I believe you have something of mine.
translation: 我不是，但我相信你身上有我想要的东西。

original: Yeah... about that...
translation: 是啊…这样的话……

original: Why did Benny betray you?
translation: 为什么本尼要背叛你？

original: He's a snake, that's why. He owed us the rest of the pay for the job, so maybe he didn't want to pay up.
translation: 因为他是个卑鄙小人。他还欠我们一笔尾款呢，也许他是不想付钱了。

original: What do you know about the Platinum Chip?
translation: 关于白金筹码你知道些什么？

original: Just a big, fancy poker chip as far as I know. Don't know why anyone would make one out of platinum, though.
translation: 据我所知，就是个很大、很精致的扑克筹码，至于为什么会有人要把它做成白金的，我就不清楚了。

original: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 算了，我们聊点别的吧。

original: Fine.
translation: 很好。

original: What can you tell me about Benny?
translation: 有关本尼，你能告诉我些什么？

original: He's one of the Chairmen, big shots who run The Tops casino in New Vegas. A friend from the city contacted me with info on a big job.
translation: 他是“董事会”的一员，那帮人管理着长街上一家名叫九重天的大赌场。当时城里有个朋友找到我，说有桩大买卖。

original: I should've known that the caps were too good to be true, but there was still no way I could pass up the chance.
translation: 我早该想到，报酬太高的差使，肯定有猫腻。可我当时实在拒绝不了这么好的机会。

original: I want some more answers.
translation: 我想要更多答案。

original: Yeah? On what?
translation: 是么？有关什么的？

original: Where's the Platinum Chip?
translation: 白金筹码在哪儿？

original: Don't have it. Benny stole it, right before he stabbed us in the back. He's probably back at the Strip by now, laughing at me.
translation: 不在我身上。本尼偷了那玩意，然后就背叛了我们。他大概已经回到长街了，也许现在正在嘲笑我呢。

original: I got better.
translation: 我没事。

original: And here I thought us Great Khans were tough to kill. So, what happens now?
translation: 我还以为只有我们大汗帮才命硬呢，那么，你想怎样？

original: All right, get ready.
translation: 好吧，准备好。

original: {frustrated the player's taking so long}What ya talking about? I been ready!
translation: {frustrated the player's taking so long}你在说什么呢？我早准备好了！

original: How about I bust you out?
translation: 我救你出去怎样？

original: About setting you free...
translation: 关于帮助你逃脱……

original: Goodbye, Benny.
translation: 再见了，本尼。

original: {enraged}Thanks for nothing, you fink!
translation: {enraged}求之不得，你这人渣！

original: Time to die.
translation: 去死吧。

original: You're next. Say your prayers.
translation: 下一个上西天的就是你了。说遗言吧。

original: What happens if I let you go?
translation: 如果我放你走会怎样？

original: Baby, that can go any direction you want. We can take Vegas together, or I can head for the nearest sunset. Your call.
translation: 宝贝，反正一切都照你安排。我们可以一起去征服维加斯，也可以一起去看日落。你说了算。

original: I don't know how to open this cage...
translation: 我不知道怎样打开这笼子……

original: I'm leaving you here.
translation: 我不管你了。

original: Baby, you can't just leave me tied up! Those Legion boys'll hoist me up on a cross for the mess you made - if I'm lucky!
translation: 宝贝，你不能就这样丢下我！那些军团流氓看到你留下这个烂摊子，一定会把我钉在十字架上的——那还是算我走运了！

original: Here, I'll set you free. <Untie Benny.>
translation: 来，我放了你。 <给本尼松绑。>

original: That's it, baby! Time to vacate these premises!
translation: 这就对了，宝贝！也该清理一下这鬼地方了！

original: Actually... I'd rather kill you now.
translation: 事实上…我更想现在杀了你。

original: {outraged}You fink! Murdering me like this, down on my knees?
translation: {outraged}你这混蛋！就这样趁我无力还手杀了我吗？

original: Okay, let's do it.
translation: 好吧，我们行动吧。

original: Ring-a-ding-ding, baby. I've got your back.
translation: 够胆量，宝贝。我来掩护你。

original: How about I untie you?
translation: 放了你怎么样？

original: What am I gonna say? {sarcastic}"No thanks?"
translation: 我应该说什么？{sarcastic}"不必，谢了？"

original: If you can get these ropes off, I'll do my best to take down my share of the guards.
translation: 如果你能松开这些绳子，我一定会尽力去摆平那些守卫的。

original: We talked about how you might sneak out of here...
translation: 我们已经谈过你怎么偷偷溜出去的事了……

original: {I can't believe you're bringing this up}Yeah, we talked about it, but that went a big fat nowhere.
translation: {I can't believe you're bringing this up}嗯，我们谈过了，但什么结果都没有。

original: It's too late for that, baby. This decision you gotta make is going down {emphasis}now. So what's it gonna be?
translation: 已经太迟了，宝贝。现在到了你不得不做决定的时候了。你打算怎么办？

original: {ambushing the player while using Stealth Boy}Thanks for getting me outta that cage! Now for once will you just {emphasis, player's resilience is vexing}lay down and stay down?
translation: {ambushing the player while using Stealth Boy}多谢你帮我离开了那笼子！ 这回你可不可以{emphasis, player's resilience is vexing}乖乖合作点？

original: No one rules Vegas {'cept}except me, got it? You're a lowdown gofer! You deliver mail!
translation: 除了我没人能统治维加斯{'cept}，明白吗？你就是个低贱的跑腿卒！不过是个送信的！

original: How ya like being Mister Good-Two-Shoes, hey? How's it feeling?
translation: 当和事老感觉很满足吧，嘿？感觉如何啊？

original: How ya like being Miss Good-Two-Shoes, hey? How's it feeling?
translation: 当和事老感觉很满足吧，嘿？感觉如何啊？

original: Keep dreaming.
translation: 继续做梦吧。

original: If I help you escape, what will you do next?
translation: 如果我帮你逃掉，你之后打算干什么？

original: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会想想办法的。

original: Here's the Stealth Boy and Bobby Pin you need.
translation: 这是你要的隐身小子和发夹。

original: About helping you escape...
translation: 帮你逃跑这件事……

original: Yeah? What about it?
translation: 啊？怎么样了？

original: Keep dreaming.
translation: 继续做梦吧。

original: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会想想办法的。

original: Check's in the mail, hey? Don't get my hopes up.
translation: 开空头支票呢？别让我希望落空啊。

original: Keep dreaming.
translation: 继续做梦吧。

original: No one likes a tease, baby.
translation: 没人喜欢被嘲弄的感觉，宝贝。

original: Then stop bringing it up!
translation: 那就别说出来！

original: You're not getting out of that cage.
translation: 放你从笼里出来，没门。

original: If I help you escape, what will you do next?
translation: 如果我帮你逃掉，你之后打算干什么？

original: Baby, if you show me the door to scramsville, that's where I'll go - out of your hair, never to return.
translation: 宝贝，如果你能为我指一条活路的话，我马上就走，再也不找你麻烦，再也不回来了。

original: I been a fink to you, caused more than my share of grief by a hard mile. Let me go, you won't see me again.
translation: 我出卖了你，这已经让我吃够苦头了。让我走吧，你不会再见到我的。

original: Here's the Stealth Boy and Bobby Pin you need to escape.
translation: 这是你要的隐身小子和发夹。

original: Baby... your generosity and spirit of forgiveness? Off the charts.
translation: 宝贝……你居然如此慷慨和宽容，真出乎我的意料。

original: This little care package is everything I need. I'll take it from here.
translation: 这个小包裹里装的就是我需要的东西了。接下来交给我吧。

original: What if I helped you escape?
translation: 我帮助你逃出去怎样？

original: Sweet to offer, baby, but if you cut these ropes every Legionary in this camp's gonna come running. With machetes.
translation: 那真是太好了，宝贝，但只要你一解开绳子，那些军团士兵就会举着大砍刀冲过来的。

original: Now on the other hand, if I had a Stealth Boy and a Bobby Pin, I could see myself out. Know what I mean?
translation: 换种思路，如果我有个隐身小子和一枚发夹，我就能自己逃出去了。懂我的意思吗？

original: I know I been bad, but it's cruel to jerk me around like this...
translation: 我知道我不是个好人，可这样戏弄我也太过残忍了……

original: Like I said, baby, all Benny needs is a Stealth Boy and a Bobby Pin.
translation: 我说过，宝贝，本尼需要一个隐身小子和一枚发夹。

original: That's it, baby! Show these punks what you got!
translation: 就是这样，宝贝！给那些痞子们点颜色看看！

original: Groovy, baby! Plant these losers in the ground!
translation: 漂亮，宝贝！把这些废物都打倒！

original: That's it - sock it to the Legion, baby!
translation: 就是这样——让这些军团狗尝尝苦头吧，宝贝！

original: Keep it up! Show these finks what's what!
translation: 再来！让这帮人渣看看究竟自己有多少斤两！

original: They got nothing on you, baby! Keep it up!
translation: 他们对你来说什么都不算，宝贝！再加把劲！

original: Yeah! Give these {preh-TOR-ee-an}Praetorian bums the big send-off, baby!
translation: 对！让这些{preh-TOR-ee-an}禁卫军的屁股飞上天吧，宝贝！

original: More complications. Just what I needed.
translation: 越来越复杂了。真是棒极了。

original: Forget what I said. Kill them all.
translation: 忘了我说的话吧。干掉他们。

original: I don't like it, but orders are orders.
translation: 虽然我不喜欢这样，但毕竟军令如山。

original: If you have any integrity, then you'll honor the deal.
translation: 如果你还有点良知的话，就应该履行约定。

original: You're right. The Great Khans are free to go.
translation: 你是对的，大汗帮的人可以走了。

original: About that bribe...
translation: 有关贿赂…

original: 500 caps was the amount requested.
translation: 说好的，500个瓶盖。

original: We agreed on 400 caps.
translation: 我们说好400个瓶盖的。

original: I'm a ghost, here to haunt you. Oooooh...
translation: 我是个幽灵，是来缠着你的。呜呜呜呜……

original: {annoyed at the player's flippant reaction}All right, quit fucking around. You survived and you tracked us down. What now?
translation: {annoyed at the player's flippant reaction}行了，别他妈闹了。你根本就没死，还找到了我们。你想怎么样？

original: I don't have the caps with me right now.
translation: 我现在身上没有瓶盖。

original: I'll be back with the caps.
translation: 等我带够了瓶盖再回来。

original: Here's the caps.
translation: 瓶盖在这。

original: This doesn't feel quite right, but it resolves things and gets my troopers back in one piece.
translation: 虽然我觉得这么做不太对，但至少问题解决了，我的士兵也没流血。

original: I'll consider your offer.
translation: 我会考虑你的建议的。

original: < Barter 45 >
[SUCCEEDED] That makes sense, and it's still more than these troopers see in a month.
translation: [成功] 可以，至少比这些士兵每个月的军饷要来得多。

original: 400 caps is a less suspicious amount. You have enough trouble here as it is.
translation: 400个瓶盖吧，免得让人生疑。毕竟你在这儿的麻烦已经够多了。

original: [FAILED] You're asking me to accept a bribe. I'd like to make sure the risk to my career - and freedom - benefits the families of my troops.
translation: [失败] 你企图贿赂我。我可不想丢掉自己的饭碗和自由，我手底下的战士还指望我来给他们养家糊口呢。

original: Way too much. Bring that price down and I'll consider it.
translation: 太多了。少一点吧，我会考虑的。

original: I'll be back with the caps.
translation: 等我带够了瓶盖再回来。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: Done. Here's the caps.
translation: 成交，瓶盖给你。

original: This doesn't feel quite right, but it resolves things and gets my troopers back in one piece.
translation: 虽然我觉得这么做不太对，但至少问题解决了，我的士兵也没流血。

original: Never mind. Forget I said anything.
translation: 算了，把我先前说的都忘了吧。

original: Right.
translation: 对。

original: Yes or no, that's all I want to hear.
translation: 我只想听“是”或者“不是”。

original: Look at it this way - nobody dies.
translation: 你要这样想——大家何苦你死我活呢？

original: 500 caps would go a long way for some soldier's families.
translation: 500个瓶盖应该够我手下一些士兵养家糊口的。

original: How much money would it take for you to look the other way while the Great Khans left?
translation: 如果要让你们对那几个大汗帮的人视而不见，需要多少钱？

original: You mean... just let them go? How would I explain this to my superiors?
translation: 你是说…就这样放了他们？可这让我怎么和上级交代啊？

original: I've been thinking about it since you brought it up earlier. 500 caps would go a long way for some soldier's families.
translation: 之前你提过这个，我想了一下，500个瓶盖应该够我手下一些士兵养家糊口了。

original: < Speech - 45 >
[SUCCEEDED] I can't believe I'm doing this, but all right, the hostages can go. The NCR had better keep their end of the deal, though.
translation: [成功] 我真不敢相信自己会同意，好吧，人质可以走了。不过NCR最好能说话算话。

original: Here - a souvenir for you. It's Benny's lighter. Shove it up his ass when you catch up with him.
translation: 这个送你，就当留个纪念吧。这是本尼的打火机。等你追上他，记得替我把这玩意塞进他的屁眼里。

original: Free the hostages now, and I'll have the NCR escort you out of their territory.
translation: 现在立马放了人质，然后我会让NCR护送你们离开。

original: [FAILED] Right, and they'd probably give us all medals, too. Maybe I should kill a hostage because you wasted my time with this shit.
translation: [失败] 是啊，说不定他们还得给我颁发个奖章呢。也许我该现在就杀掉一个人质，因为你他妈根本是在浪费时间。

original: If you let the hostages free now, maybe the NCR would just let you go.
translation: 如果你现在立马放了人质，也许NCR还能让你们离开。

original: I'm willing to hear other suggestions.
translation: 我倒希望听听其他的建议。

original: {Jessup mentions bribe option}We'd try to bribe our way out, but seeing as how Benny didn't pay us yet, that won't happen.
translation: {Jessup mentions bribe option}我们也想花钱买条命出去啊，可本尼又没付给我们报酬，这办法行不通。

original: Any chance you're willing to surrender?
translation: 如果你主动投降怎么样？

original: And face NCR "justice?" No thanks. I'd rather not spend the next ten years doing hard labor.
translation: 然后让NCR"审判"我？不，谢谢。我可不想接下来十年一直干苦役。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye
translation: 再见。

original: I'll try to remember that.
translation: 我会记住的。

original: See that you do.
translation: 我知道你会的。

original: Where else?
translation: 其他哪里？

original: Nah, I'm gonna chill with my girl.
translation: 不，我要去跟我的姑娘玩。

original: Can't. The King's got me busy on something.
translation: 不行。猫王最近可没让我闲着。

original: What about Gloria?
translation: 格罗莉亚怎么样？

original: Glory? Glory's fucking {heavyily stressed}crazy.
translation: 格罗莉？格罗莉是个他妈的{heavyily stressed}疯子。

original: Some of my siblings are real pieces of work, but I'd bet on Glory if she were facing down a deathclaw with a plastic spoon.
translation: 我家兄妹里，有的是天生的干将，但格罗莉嘛，即便她拿着塑料勺子对阵死亡爪，我都敢赌她赢。

original: She's got the smarts to do whatever she wants, but she and momma are always butting heads, so she gets all the shit jobs.
translation: 本来她的聪明才智能可以让她随心所欲的，可她总和老妈对着干，所以各种脏活累活也就都落在她头上咯。

original: I had other questions.
translation: 我有些其他的疑问。

original: Make it quick. I got shit to do.
translation: 有话快说，我还有事做。

original: What about you?
translation: 你呢？

original: I'm not one for running a business. Never really had a head for numbers or smooth-talk. My talents are a little more... direct.
translation: 我不是做生意的料。我的脑子不擅长做数学题或是和人打交道。我的才能……比较简单粗暴。

original: Mama always said that was my gift. When we were kids, the others used to fight over and steal one another's toys. I always broke mine.
translation: 老妈总说这是我的天赋。小时候其他孩子喜欢打打闹闹，抢别人玩具，我却总是把自己的玩具给弄坏。

original: And if any of the others messed with me, I broke theirs too. Sometimes I'd break them even if they were nice to me, just to show them what's what.
translation: 如果别人敢惹我，我就把他们的玩具也弄坏。有时就算他们对我好，我也会这么干，我只想教他们一点规矩。

original: One day mama took me aside and said, "Boy, you're never going to go very far, but you're going to make a whole lotta people come up short."
translation: 后来有一天，我妈把我叫到一旁，说："小子，你这辈子注定成不了大事，但你也可以让其他人走不长远。"

original: C'mon, girl. Let's get going.
translation: 来吧，姑娘。我们走吧。

original: Betsy, I need to go on by myself. Are you going to be okay, girl?
translation: 贝琪, 我要走了。你会没事的吧，姑娘？

original: Why don't you just shoot your way out of here?
translation: 你为什么不杀出一条血路离开这里？

original: I'm not afraid of a gunfight, but I'd rather get back to Red Rock without a few extra holes in me if I can help it.
translation: 我倒是不怕战斗，但我还是宁愿平平安安地回到红岩峡谷，不用在身上加几个弹孔。

original: Why did Antony take him away?
translation: 为什么安东尼把他拿走？

original: Antony said he was punishing me for trying to hide it from the Legion.
translation: 安东尼说因为我背着军团藏东西，他要惩罚我。

original: How did you end up joining the Legion?
translation: 你是怎么加入军团的？

original: When the Legion showed up, we fought, most tribes did. Hangdogs hung out longer than most... {beat}broke us by throwing our dogs on the fire.
translation: 军团来袭的时候，我们奋起抵抗，其他部落大多也是这么做的。罪狗部落撑得久一些……{beat}可当他们把我们的狗扔进火堆时，我们崩溃了。

original: {A little quiet, to himself, painful memory - scornful he ever believed this}So we gave up, our elders couldn't bear the idea of our spirit animals burning in the afterlife.
translation: {A little quiet, to himself, painful memory - scornful he ever believed this}我们只能投降，长老们无法眼睁睁地看着我们的守护神被火烧死。

original: {Rallies}Still, Caesar was impressed enough to conscript us, use our skills with dogs to join the Legion as houndmasters.
translation: {Rallies}但凯撒却不计前嫌，将我们招致麾下。由于我们出色的驯犬能力，我们加入了军团，成为了驯犬师。

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: I've been around dogs all my life. They're my life, always were - {pauses, thinking back, as if he's forgotten}all the way back when I was a tribal, one of the Hangdogs, outside Denver.
translation: 我一生都与狗为伴。它们是我的命，我和它们的缘分，从我还是丹佛城外罪狗部落的一员时就开始了。

original: {Still thinking back}Dogs roamed that city. Our tribe made peace with them. {Scoffs, trying to dismiss painful memory}Thought they were our spirit animals - helped us hunt, provided for us in some lean times.
translation: {Still thinking back}那时城里到处是流浪狗。我们部落却与这些动物和睦共处。我们把它们视为守护神——它们既帮我们打猎，在苦难时期，也能填饱我们的肚子。

original: Then the Legion came. {Beat}Good thing, too. {Trying to convince himself}Stronger now, don't need those beliefs anymore.
translation: 后来军团来了。{Beat}算是好事吧。{Trying to convince himself}如今我们强大了，也就不再需要那些信仰了。

original: Do you have a problem with women?
translation: 你对女人很意见吗？

original: {Female PC}Women are beneath notice, as {KAI-zar}Caesar has taught us. I'm only allowing you to speak to me because you are {KAI-zar's}Caesar's guest.
translation: 女人都是贱种，凯撒就是这样教导我们的。因为你是凯撒的客人，所以我才允许你和我说话。

original: I may yet, if {KAI-zar}Caesar commands it.
translation: 如果凯撒授意，我也可能会回答你的问题。

original: Who's in charge of the prison now?
translation: 现在管监狱的是谁？

original: {Eddie alive}That'll be Eddie. You can usually find him sitting in the warden's old chair up in the main building.
translation: {Eddie alive}是埃迪，你应该能在主楼的监狱长办公室找到他。

original: {Eddie dead}Not sure who's gonna take over with Eddie dead.
translation: {Eddie dead}不清楚埃迪死后谁在管。

original: What exactly is a Powder Ganger?
translation: 炸药帮到底是个什么帮派？

original: That's us. We got sent here to fix the rails and make some new ones, and for that we got to use dynamite.
translation: 我们就是炸药帮。我们被派来修理和建造铁路，所以要用到炸药。

original: Of course, dynamite works pretty good against caravan guards, too. So, that's what we do - rob and blow things up.
translation: 当然，炸药用来对付商队的警卫也很管用。所以我们专干这个，抢完东西后就把一切都炸上天。

original: If you're free, why are you sticking around?
translation: 既然你们都自由了，为什么还呆在这里？

original: We've got the biggest, baddest fort in the wasteland. There's water and power, and if we need grub, we just go out and steal it.
translation: 我们的堡垒是全废土最大、最屌的。这儿有水、有电，想要吃的话，出去偷就行了。

original: What did you do to end up in here?
translation: 你为什么来到这？你都干了些什么？

original: Me? I ran with the toughest gang in the Hub. You've heard of the Hub, right? It's, uh, west of here, I think, back in California.
translation: 我吗？我可为哈勃城最厉害的帮派打过下手。你听说过哈勃城吧？它就在……嗯，我想是西边，应该是在加州。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Quit wasting my time.
translation: 别再浪费我时间了。

original: Here's the caps.
translation: 给你钱。

original: All right, you can go on in. Can't guarantee your safety, though. Just saying.
translation: 好吧，你进去吧。顺便说一下，我无法保证你在里面的安全。

original: Can I go in?
translation: 我可以进去吗？

original: {he does know}Well, I don't know. Depends on if you can make it worth my time. A hundred caps sounds right to me.
translation: {he does know}我不知道。取决于你愿意掏多少钱了，100个瓶盖应该够了。

original: {Helped Powder Gangers in Goodsprings}Yeah, all right. Figure you could help us out the way you helped out Cobb's crew over in Goodsprings.
translation: {Helped Powder Gangers in Goodsprings}行，没问题。你在清泉镇帮助了科布一伙，我想你也会同样帮助我们的。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: This? This is - or was - the big house. The New California Republic Correctional Facility. Not much "correcting" went on here, just slave labor.
translation: 这里？这儿是——或者曾经是——班房。新加州共和国劳改营。但几乎不存在什么"改造"，只有奴役劳工。

original: One day, us prisoners decided to liberate ourselves. Killed the warden, killed the guards, took over the whole damn territory.
translation: 有一天，我们囚犯决定起义。我们杀死了监狱长和警卫，接管了这个该死的地方。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Yup.
translation: 行。

original: {Cherchez-la-Femme}Only all the time.
translation: {Cherchez-la-Femme}随时恭候。

original: You and me at Gomorrah, rolled up in those silk sheets. I got leave coming up in a bit, so let me know if you'll be around.
translation: 就咱俩，去蛾摩拉酒店，在丝绸床上好好玩玩。我过会儿就放假，你有空可得来找我。

original: Tell Caesar I accept his invitation.
translation: 告诉凯撒，我接受他的邀请。

original: {Strip}Seek {KAI-zar}Caesar by way of Cottonwood Cove, south of Nelson. The Cursor Lucullus will be waiting.
translation: 去纳尔逊南面的棉白杨湾。库瑟·卢库勒斯会在那儿等你的。

original: If this is a trap, I'm going to take a lot of you with me.
translation: 如果这是个圈套，那我就算死也要拉你们一帮人垫背。

original: {offended}The mighty {KAI-zar}Caesar has bestowed upon you his Mark and guaranteed safe-conduct. If he wanted you dead, you would be dead already.
translation: 全能的凯撒已经将他的徽记赐给你了，它会保你周全。如果他真的想让你死，你早就死了。

original: You said Caesar has an offer for me. What kind of offer?
translation: 你说凯撒想和我做笔交易？什么内容？

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar chose not to give me that information. I was only told to find you and bring you the message.
translation: 凯撒没告诉我具体内容，只是叫我来捎个信给你。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: {WAH-lay}Vale.
translation: {WAH-lay}再见。

original: What are the Frumentarii?
translation: 弗鲁曼塔里伊是啥？

original: We are soldiers of a different stripe, capable in battle, but skilled as infiltrators and agents as well.
translation: 我们这类士兵肩负了特殊的使命，既可以正面作战，也可以进行渗透或间谍工作。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: I am {WUHL-pace In-CUL-tah}Vulpes Inculta, of {KAI-zar's}Caesar's Legion. I serve my master as the greatest of his {froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii.
translation: 我是沃尔普斯·因库塔，隶属凯撒军团。我是主子手下最优秀的弗鲁曼塔里伊。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: {WAH-lay}Vale.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Be seeing you around.
translation: 再见。

original: I need something repaired.
translation: 我有些东西需要修理。

original: I'll grab my tools.
translation: 交给我好了。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Have a look.
translation: 看吧。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: Is this change behind your loss of inspiration?
translation: 你失去灵感就是因为环境改变了吗？

original: Do you know Doc Mitchell?
translation: 你知道米切尔医生吗？

original: {Surprised}You mean, Mitch? It's been ages since I've heard the name. My sister and I used to call him "Mole-butt." Don't ask.
translation: {Surprised}你是说米奇？我已经好多年没听到这个名字了。我妹妹和我曾经管他叫"鼠屁股"。别问我为什么。

original: That was a long time ago, before we exchanged the warmth of our home for the thin air of the Wasteland.
translation: 都是陈年往事啦，后来我们放弃了避难所温暖的家，换来的却是废土稀薄的空气。

original: Why do you say that Vault 21 has come a long way?
translation: 为什么你说21号避难所比以前好多了？

original: Why do you say that Vault 21 has come a long way?
translation: 为什么你说21号避难所比以前好多了？

original: I don't have enough for a room.
translation: 我身上的钱不够。

original: I don't have enough for a room.
translation: 我身上的钱不够。

original: Vault 21 hopes to service your needs in the future. Goodbye.
translation: 希望今后您还能再次光临21号避难所，再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I need a room.
translation: 我要个房间。

original: Proceed to your accomodations. Please, enjoy your stay at Vault 21.
translation: 请前往您的房间，希望您在21号避难所住得愉快。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Observe the rules, citizen.
translation: 请遵守规章制度，公民。

original: What's a Securitron doing here?
translation: 电子保安在这里干什么？

original: Vault 21's previous manager is no longer capable of servicing your needs. Hotel arrangement functions are now purview of Mr. House.
translation: 21号避难所的前任经理已无法再为您效劳了。旅馆的经营业务现在由豪斯先生全权接管。

original: I need a room.
translation: 我想要个房间。

original: Get my room keys, and pass by later. I've got something for you.
translation: 给我房间钥匙，迟些时候过来，我给你看样东西。

original: Get my room keys, and pass by later. I've got something for you.
translation: 给我房间钥匙，迟些时候过来，我给你看样东西。

original: Do you get a lot of business here?
translation: 你这儿生意挺好的？

original: You know Doc Mitchell?
translation: 你认识米切尔医生？

original: You know Doc Mitchell?
translation: 你认识米切尔医生？

original: You know Doc Mitchell?
translation: 你认识米切尔医生？

original: {Surprised, Excitedly}Mitch!? You know "mole-butt?"
translation: 米奇！？你认识“鼠屁屁”？

original: I hadn't thought about that name in a long time. I was just a child, and he had a big mole in his rear bumper.
translation: 我很久都没听到过这个名字了。那时我还是个孩子，他屁股上有颗很大的痣。

original: You understand, kids and all that. Everyone knows about each other in a Vault, there's no other way. I hope mol... I mean Mitch, is doing well!
translation: 小孩子之间那些事嘛，你懂的。那时还在避难所里，大家彼此都很熟。我希望鼠……米奇过得幸福！

original: I'm looking for Carlitos. Do you know him?
translation: 我在找卡利托斯，你认识他吗？

original: I'm looking for Carlitos. Do you know him?
translation: 我在找卡利托斯，你认识他吗？

original: I'll let you in, later, when you're ready for a night to remember.
translation: 晚些再来找你，我会让你度过一个难忘的夜晚的。

original: I'm looking for Carlitos. Do you know him?
translation: 我在找卡利托斯，你认识他吗？

original: {Almost Suspicious}Carlitos, huh? Yeah, I do. Try the diner, but don't start any trouble, you hear?
translation: 卡利托斯，嗯？是的，我认识。去餐厅找找吧，但别惹麻烦，听到了吗？

original: Yeah, pass by my room and we'll catch up.
translation: 好，到我房间坐坐，我们正好谈一谈。

original: I'll let you in, later, when you're ready for a night to remember.
translation: 晚些再来找你，我会让你度过一个难忘的夜晚的。

original: {Playful Seduction}You're kicking me into gear, huh? I think I'll drive my chassis over to your pad. Wait for me down there, and don't forget the oil.
translation: {Playful Seduction}怎么，你想和我大战三百回合？小心我让你底盘冒烟哦。在下面等着吧！别忘了带润滑油。

original: Oh mighty Fantoma, I hope one day I can fight for the forces of good by your side!
translation: 噢，强大的夜魔侠，我希望有一天能与你一起伸张正义。

original: Yes! It has been a long time since La Fantoma had a good sidekick!
translation: 好极了！夜魔侠已经好久没有忠诚的伙伴了！

original: <Mock Surrender> Woah, no way I'm fighting with the mighty Red-Brick.
translation: <假装投降> 哇，红发小子这么厉害，我打不过啦。

original: You better believe it. I'll knock your block off!
translation: 你当然打不过我。我一拳就能敲烂你的防护！

original: I have no money for your toll, surely you will let a fair traveller pass through your gate.
translation: 我没钱付通行费，看在我是个善良的旅行者的份上，你就让我过去吧。

original: {Thoughtful}Very well traveller{difficulty with the word}. You may pass.{laughs}
translation: {Thoughtful}好吧，旅行者{difficulty with the word}。你过去吧。{laughs}

original: I bet when you get bigger you'll be able to fly your own plane.
translation: 等你长大了，你会有自己的飞机的。

original: You bet I will, I'm almost old enough to fly in the VR sims. That'll be awesome!
translation: 当然会了，我也不小了，很快就能在虚拟世界里驾驶飞行了。那真是太棒了！

original: I'm a vicious velociraptor. ROAR!
translation: 我是超级迅猛龙，吼！

original: Ooo, you know a lot about dinosaurs.
translation: 哇，你对恐龙懂得挺多的啊。

original: You don't need toys, I bet you can get a fun game of Boomers and targets.
translation: 你不需要玩具，听说过“炮兵和靶子”的游戏吗？很有趣的。

original: That is a neat idea. I'll be the spotter. I'll find someone to play the target.
translation: 有道理，我要做观测手，我再去找个人当靶子。

original: That's right. I've battled giant mutated animals, crazed raiders, and braved many other dangers.
translation: 没错，我和那些巨大的变种动物、疯狂的掠夺者干过仗，还多次化险为夷。

original: {Awed}Wow, you sound {emphasized}awesome.
translation: {Awed}哇，你听起来 {emphasized}好厉害。

original: You make an excellent point. I never liked that Cachino fuck anyway. Here you go.
translation: 你说得有道理。我一点都不喜欢他妈的卡奇诺。给你。

original: I know you feel safe here, but I could crush your windpipe before anyone noticed.
translation: 你别以为自己躲在桌后头很安全，但我只要一眨眼功夫就能捏碎你的喉咙。

original: With those skinny little arms? Not before the bouncer put two in the back of your head. Now stop being stupid.
translation: 就凭你这小胳膊小腿？小心被保镖打得满头包。别发傻了。

original: I bet I could beat you up.
translation: 我打赌，我能揍趴你。

original: You make an excellent point. I never liked that Cachino fuck anyway. Here you go.
translation: 你说得有道理。我一点都不喜欢他妈的卡奇诺。给你。

original: I know you feel safe here, but I could crush your windpipe before anyone noticed.
translation: 你别以为自己躲在桌后头很安全，但我只要一眨眼功夫就能捏碎你的喉咙。

original: With those skinny little arms? Not before the bouncer put two in the back of your head. Now stop being stupid.
translation: 就凭你这小胳膊小腿？小心被保镖打得满头包。别傻了。

original: I bet I could beat you up.
translation: 我打赌，我能揍趴你。

original: I'm planning on playing some games in the Casino.
translation: 我想去赌场玩几把。

original: Of course, after all you did for me, here are some chips for you. Play, have some fun.
translation: 当然，你摆平了这么多事情，拿着这些筹码去玩吧，玩高兴点。

original: You play some games, have some fun. You did right by us.
translation: 去找点乐子吧，你可是帮了我们不少忙。

original: {Laughs}Real subtle. Here you go. Play some games. Have some fun.
translation: {笑}挺狡猾的嘛。拿去吧，玩开心点。

original: I'd have given the money away.
translation: 我要把钱送给别人。

original: ...Really? Wow, it never occurred to me to actually give the money away. Do people really do things like that?
translation: ……真的？哇，我从来没见过有人把钱送给别人的。世上真有这种人么？

original: I'd have saved the money, so I could someday get the hell out of here.
translation: 我会把钱攒起来，兴许将来哪天我能离开这个鬼地方。

original: Hmmm... you're a long-term thinker, man. I like that. You might be on to something there.
translation: 嗯……你想得很长远，伙计，我喜欢。看得出来你是个有抱负的人。

original: Probably a weapon, given how dangerous it is around here.
translation: 武器吧，毕竟这地方很危险。

original: Yeah... that's a good idea... no sense making money and waiting for someone to just come and take it, right?
translation: 是啊……这也是个好主意……好不容易赚到钱，到头来全送给了掠夺者，那可太不值当了，对吧？

original: You look like an idiot.
translation: 你看起来像个傻瓜。

original: Yeah, it does look pretty sweet, doesn't {it}i- hey, screw you! Who asked you anyway? The crap I put up with...
translation: 是啊，确实挺可爱的，对吧——嘿！去你的！谁问你意见了？再多嘴我可……

original: It's not exactly what I would have bought for myself.
translation: 我可不会给自己买这种东西。

original: Oh yeah, what would you have gotten?
translation: 哦，是吗，那你希望买什么？

original: Yeah, it looks great.
translation: 好啊，挺不错的。

original: Exactly what I was thinking. It's nice to have a little style, you know?
translation: 我也这么想的。做人嘛，总得要有些个性才行，对吧？

original: But you're probably here for more of my special commodity, and luckily for you, I haven't been idle since last we spoke.
translation: 不过你应该是来找我求购特殊商品的吧。幸好，上次你走后，我也没闲着。

original: However, all that hard work on my part means that the price has gone up. 100 a tip, now. You game?
translation: 只是价钱恐怕要抬高了，否则对不起我这一番辛劳啊。现在是100个瓶盖一条情报，买吗？

original: Hey, listen, I'd love to sell you some more info, but you've tapped everything I've heard lately.
translation: 嘿，听着，虽然我很乐意把更多情报卖给你，但我已经将最近打听到的消息都告诉你了。

original: Come back in a few days. I'll put my ear to the ground and hopefully have heard a few more things by then.
translation: 过几天再来吧。这段时间我会帮你多加留意的，说不定还能打听到更多消息呢。

original: What do ya say, want another tip?
translation: 怎么样，还想要别的情报吗？

original: I got more where that came from. Want another?
translation: 我还有很多情报呢。想知道下一条吗？

original: That one was pretty good, right? How about another?
translation: 这条很不错吧？要不要再来一条？

original: I've heard here and there that the word "Hope" has recently become quite popular with the Squatters.
translation: 听人说，最近"希望"这个词突然在流民当中很火。

original: But that's all I've heard. If I knew more, I'd try to bilk you out of more caps. You interested in one of my other tips?
translation: 可惜我只打听到这些，否则的话，我肯定会狠狠敲你一笔。所以，要不要再来一条情报？

original: I'd like to talk about something else.
translation: 还是说点别的吧。

original: What kind of upgrades?
translation: 什么样的升级？

original: Tell me about the other attractions.
translation: 和我说说有哪些好去处吧。

original: Well, let's see: the NCR has an embassy here, but why you'd want to go talk to a bunch of boring old politicians I surely don't know.
translation: 好的，我想想，NCR在这儿设了家大使馆，但我想你应该是不会有兴趣去和那帮迂腐的老头们聊天的吧。

original: Oh, and the Vault 21 Hotel and Gift Shop has an adorable collection of old Vault-Tec memorabilia.
translation: 哦，21号避难所酒店和礼品店里有不少避难所时代留下的精美藏品。

original: And I suppose if you like neon signs, you might check out Michael Angelo's sign shop.
translation: 如果你喜欢霓虹招牌的话，我建议你去米开朗琪罗的招牌铺子逛逛。

original: Tell me about the casinos.
translation: 和我说说赌场吧。

original: Well, of course there used to be a lot more of them, but these days there are three open to the public: The Tops, the Ultra-Luxe, and Gomorrah.
translation: 好吧，以前赌场是遍地开花，可如今就只剩下三家还在对外营业了，他们分别是九重天、奢华殿堂、和蛾摩拉。

original: And the Lucky 38 of course, but we're not open to the public. You're a special case, sugar.
translation: 当然还有幸运38号，但我们不对公众开放。不过你是个特例，甜心。

original: Tell me about the Three Families.
translation: 和我说说三大家族吧。

original: They're just new money, sugar. They might pretend they're sophisticated, but between you and me, they're not far off from tribals.
translation: 甜心，他们是一群暴发户。面子上装得很高雅，但我说句不客气的话，他们和蛮族其实没有多大区别。

original: The Omertas especially are just awful brutes. The Chairmen and the White Glove Society at least pretend to have some culture.
translation: 尤其是黑手党家族，他们就是一群野兽。董事会和白手套至少还装得比较有文化。

original: I really don't want to think about that.
translation: 真是不敢再往下想了。

original: Then maybe you shouldn't pry into a lady's particulars, hmm?
translation: 那也许从一开始你就不该刺探女士的隐私，对吗？

original: So you're... a copy of a dead woman? What exactly do you do for Mr. House?
translation: 这么说，你是……一个过世女人的复制品？你都为豪斯先生做些什么？

original: Mr. House has a lot of needs, sugar. I take care of all of them, and a lady doesn't kiss and tell.
translation: 豪斯先生有很多需求，甜心。而我负责满足它们，至于细节，作为一位女士，我是不会轻易告诉你的。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Anything you like, sugar.
translation: 您所言极是，甜心。

original: I didn't realize robots could have such strong feelings about people.
translation: 我没想到机器人居然也会对人产生如此深厚的感情。

original: Sugar, I may be a robot on the outside, but on the inside, my neuro-computational matrix is an exact copy of Mr. House's favorite girl.
translation: 甜心，虽然我外表看起来是个机器人，可在内部，我的神经运算矩阵可是完全从豪斯先生最爱的女孩身上复制而来的。

original: Sounds like you're pretty fond of him.
translation: 你好像很喜欢他。

original: Well, of course I am, silly! Mr. House is just the smartest, most wonderful man there ever was!
translation: 当然了，傻瓜！豪斯先生可是有史以来最聪明、最出色的男人！

original: Why, did you know he single-handedly reclaimed New Vegas from all those nasty tribes that used to live here?
translation: 你知道吗，他光凭一己之力就从蛮族手中夺回了整个新维加斯？

original: Well, he single-handedly sent in his Securitrons to do it, but that counts in my book.
translation: 好吧，其实他是凭一己之力派了机器人大军去完成这个任务的，不过在我看来也算是丰功伟绩了。

original: What's with the snowglobe collection?
translation: 雪花球收藏是怎么回事？

original: Not many people know this, but Mr. House is one of the world's biggest collectors of antique snow globes!
translation: 鲜有人知道，豪斯先生可是世界上最大的古董雪花球收藏家哦！

original: If you happen to find any out in the Wasteland, you can bring them to me and I'll add them to his collection! You'll get a reward, of course.
translation: 如果你在废土碰巧找到这种小玩意，可以把它们交给我，我会将它们加入他的收藏。当然啦，你也会得到一些奖励。

original: In fact, one of Mr. House's favorites went missing when we moved the collection. If you have a look around the Lucky 38, you might even find it!
translation: 事实上，我们在整理收藏柜时就不小心落了一个。如果你在幸运38周围找找，很可能就会找得到呢！

original: You do? Why, that's just wonderful! I'll take it and put it with the rest of the collection.
translation: 你有吗？太好了！我会立刻把这件和其他收藏放在一起。

original: I've got a snowglobe for Mr. House's collection.
translation: 我有一个雪花球要交给豪斯先生。

original: You do? Why, that's just wonderful! I'll take them and put them with the rest of the collection.
translation: 你有吗？太好了！我立刻把这几件和其他收藏放在一起。

original: I've got some snowglobes for Mr. House's collection.
translation: 我有一些雪花球要交给豪斯先生。

original: Aw, sugar, why'd you have to go make Mr. House mad? Now we've got to get all messy shooting you to little bits.
translation: 噢，甜心，你怎么能让豪斯先生这样大动肝火呢？现在我们只好把你打成筛子了。

original: What kind of robots are you?
translation: 你到底算是哪种机器人？

original: Why I'm a RobCo PDQ-88b {Mark}Mk I Securitron, you silly goose! We're the finest in personal or civil robotic security on the market!
translation: 傻孩子，我可是罗科PDQ-88bI型电子保安！我们是市面上最好的个人和民用电子安保机器人！

original: How sweet of you to notice, sugar! I've been upgraded to the Mark II software, and it's peachy having these high-explosive weapons fully accessible!
translation: 你的关心真让我感动，甜心！我的操作系统已经被升级成II型了，能获得高爆武器的使用权限，我感觉棒极了！

original: You look different somehow. Did you cut your hair?
translation: 你看起来和原来不太一样？是理发了吗？

original: What can you tell me about New Vegas?
translation: 关于新维加斯，你知道什么？

original: Oh, there's lots of things to tell, I'm sure. There's the Three Families, the casinos, the other attractions - what would you like to know?
translation: 噢，我知道的事情可多了。三大家族、赌场、各类风景名胜——你想知道哪个？

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？
