original: This is the Lucky 38 Resort and Casino - or, it used to be. Mr. House has kept the place locked up tight for ages now, nobody comes in or out.
translation: 这里是幸运38号赌场——或者说曾经是。豪斯先生已经把这地方封锁了很长时间，从没有人出入过。

original: Can you tell me about Mr. House?
translation: 你能告诉我一些豪斯先生的事情吗？

original: Why, sugar, he's the maximum utmost! If it weren't for Mr. House, we wouldn't have this fabulous wonderland of New Vegas, would we?
translation: 甜心，他是最万能的！没有豪斯先生，就没有新维加斯这片仙境，不是吗？

original: Why does Caesar want to see me?
translation: 为什么凯撒要见我？

original: Go to him, and you will understand.
translation: 去见他你就知道了。

original: How did you find me here?
translation: 你怎么在这儿找到我的？

original: I am one of {KAI-zar's}Caesar's {froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii, an infiltrator, a spy. You were not difficult to track.
translation: 我是凯撒手下的一名弗鲁曼塔里伊。是间谍、特务。找到你并不难。

original: Do I need to remind you that the NCR hates me?
translation: 我是不是要提醒你一下，NCR讨厌我？

original: No cause for alarm - you'll have an escort of Securitrons to help you fight your way onto the dam.
translation: 不必在意——你会有一小队电子保安，帮助你突破大坝附近的防线。

original: Sounds like I get to kill lots of Legionaries.
translation: 看来我得杀掉不少军团士兵。

original: Indeed you will. Just bear in mind that's not the reason you're there.
translation: 是的。但要记住，那不是你此行的真正目的。

original: What's the goal?
translation: 目标是什么？

original: Your objective is to reach a control room halfway across the dam and install an override module similar to the one you used at the Substation.
translation: 你的目标是前往在大坝中部的控制室，安装一个强制控制模组，就像你在电站里用过的那个。

original: The override will enable to control the entire dam's power output.
translation: 这个控制模组可允许使用者操纵整座大坝的电力输出。

original: You may remember how the bunker at the Fort was rather dimly lit? Well, just like the Lucky 38, it needs a big jolt of electricity to power up.
translation: 你还记得城堡下的那座地堡里灯光昏暗吧？和幸运38一样，它需要强大的电流才能正常运作。

original: You've already uploaded the new operating system to the Securitrons. All they need is power and they'll be in fighting trim.
translation: 你已经为电子保安上传了新的操作系统。只要再给它们一些电力，它们就能所向披靡。

original: As I've said, your objective is to install an override module in the control room halfway across the dam. Are you ready perform this task?
translation: 如我所说，你的目标是前往在大坝中部的控制室，安装一个强制控制模组。你准备好执行这次任务了吗？

original: Why do I need to be there? The NCR has an army.
translation: 为什么要我去那儿？NCR不是有军队吗。

original: Indeed they do - an army that'll be too distracted with killing Legionaries to notice the real reason you're there.
translation: 的确是有——但他们要忙着抵御军团士兵，根本无暇注意到你的真实目的。

original: I'll take care of it.
translation: 我会处理的。

original: I'll take care of it.
translation: 我会处理的。

original: I'll take care of it.
translation: 我会处理的。

original: You already have power. Why is this important?
translation: 你已经获得电力了，这事还那么重要吗？

original: This is not a good time to be dependent on energy from Hoover Dam. When the Legion attacks, the NCR may cut power altogether.
translation: 现在可不是依赖胡佛大坝能源的时候。等军团发起进攻，NCR说不定会切断电源供应。

original: And I'll be needing a good deal more power than the NCR has allotted to the Strip.
translation: 而且到那时候，我肯定会需要比原先更多的电力。

original: Broadcasting encrypted VMQ-boosted command signals to hundreds of Securitrons eats up more power than you might expect.
translation: 向成百上千的电子保安发送加密的VMQ启动命令可远比你想象的要耗电。

original: Why didn't you restart the reactor earlier?
translation: 你为什么不早点重启反应堆呢？

original: I needed the operating software on the Platinum Chip to bring it back online.
translation: 我需要白金筹码上的操作软件才能使它重新运作。

original: And to start the reactor itself requires a tremendous jolt of current. Very attention-getting.
translation: 而且开启反应堆需要大量的电力。很容易引起注意。

original: The NCR has its hands full now, of course. I doubt they'll raise much of a fuss.
translation: 当然，NCR现在正忙得不可开交。我估计他们无暇他顾。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Come back when your work at the substation is done.
translation: 等你完成了变电站的工作，再回来找我。

original: What's this about a dormant reactor?
translation: 休眠反应堆是怎么回事？

original: The strain of defending Las Vegas from annhilation exceeded my power systems' capacity. My primary reactor shut down.
translation: 为了保护拉斯维加斯，我的能源系统已经不堪重负。主反应堆很早就关闭了。

original: For years, I played a miser with my emergency power supply. I began to run out of reserves around the time I woke the first batch of Securitrons.
translation: 这么多年来，我一直在小心翼翼地使用备用能源。在唤醒第一批电子保安之后，连我的备用能源也开始日渐枯竭。

original: Negotiating an allotment of power from Hoover Dam was crucial. That's what's powered the Strip for the past seven years.
translation: 好在我之后通过谈判，从胡佛大坝分得了一部分能源，这些能源是确保长街在过去七年里正常运作的关键。

original: I'll take care of it.
translation: 我会处理的。

original: With this accomplished, all preparations will have been made. The battle for Hoover Dam will be upon us before long.
translation: 等这件事做成之后，我们就万事具备了。胡佛大坝之战很快就会来临。

original: What more could I have done?
translation: 我还能怎么办？

original: You could've succeeded!
translation: 你本来能成功的！

original: <Use Speech to deny responsibility.>
translation: <使用口才来推脱责任。>

original: [SUCCEEDED] They knew you were coming? They were better prepared than I anticipated, then. I won't underestimate them again.
translation: [成功] 他们知道你会来？看来他们比我预想的要准备充分。我不会再低估他们了。

original: Before that happens, I'd ask you to complete one final task. It may seem trivial, but that's far from the case.
translation: 在那之前，我要求你完成最后一项任务。尽管它看上去微不足道，但事实并非如此。

original: I was set up. The Legion used me as a patsy.
translation: 我被算计了。军团把我耍了。

original: [FAILED] Whatever your reasons, you've jeopardized the success of this entire concern!
translation: [失败] 不管你的理由是什么，你都已经影响到了整个计划。

original: It... it wasn't Kimball, it was an imposter. It had to die!
translation: 那…那不是金博尔，那是个冒牌货。它必须得死！

original: I had my reasons.
translation: 我有我的理由。

original: Whatever those reasons may be, you've jeopardized the success of this entire concern.
translation: 不管你的理由是什么，你都已经影响到了整个计划。

original: Okay, I'll do it.
translation: 好，我会做的。

original: I'll be on my way, then.
translation: 那我先走了。

original: Fine, I'll do it.
translation: 好的，我会干的。

original: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢谢。

original: Not so eager to take on a suicide mission, is that it? If you'd shown moderation in your dealings with the NCR, we wouldn't be in this position.
translation: 现在你又来可怜自己这条小命了？如果你当初跟NCR打交道时能表现得温和一点，我们就不至于走到今天这一步了。

original: Let Kimball Visit. Whatever happens, happens.
translation: 让金博尔来访吧。该来的总要来的。

original: I'll do it.
translation: 我会干的。

original: Don't attack unless there are clear signs that Kimball's visit is imminent. Cause enough chaos to cancel the visit, no more. Then return to me.
translation: 如果金博尔没有确定来访，那就不要轻举妄动。想办法制造混乱，让他取消这次行程。等事成之后再回来找我。

original: I'll be leaving, then.
translation: 那我走了。

original: Oh no, not so quick. I still have work for you.
translation: 噢，不，别那么急。我还有工作交给你。

original: What should I do in the meantime?
translation: 那我能做些什么？

original: There nothing I can do to protect Kimball?
translation: 保护金博尔这事上我什么也做不了？

original: I can't use you. Had you shown moderation in your dealings with the NCR, we'd be in a different position.
translation: 我不能用你。如果你当初在跟NCR打交道时能表现得温和一点，那今天情况就会大不一样了。

original: Let's get back to business.
translation: 让我们回到正题上来。

original: I don't want to kill off the entire Brotherhood.
translation: 我不想把兄弟会赶尽杀绝。

original: I'd like to ask some questions.
translation: 我想问些问题。

original: Is there any possiblity of a diplomatic solution?
translation: 就没有外交解决的可能性吗？

original: Any recommendations on how to complete the mission?
translation: 有什么任务建议吗？

original: From time to time, the NCR has assaulted Brotherhood bunkers. In four of the six incidents I know of, the bunkers self-destructed.
translation: NCR曾对兄弟会分布于各地的地堡发起过数次进攻。就我所知的六次进攻中，有四次都是以地堡的自毁而告终。

original: I surmise it's standard practice for the Brotherhood to install a self-destruct system. It's consistent with their {disdain}uncompromising nature.
translation: 因此我推测，兄弟会应该在每一间地堡内都安装了自毁装置。这与他们{disdain}宁死不屈的性格很相称。

original: You might use that against them. Or kill them another way, it's up to you. Return when it's done.
translation: 你可以反过来利用这点。但直接杀光他们也行，随你的便。等你事办完了再回来吧。

original: I'd like to ask some questions.
translation: 我想问些问题。

original: I don't want to kill off the entire Brotherhood.
translation: 我不想把兄弟会全杀掉。

original: The Brotherhood is holed up in Hidden Valley.
translation: 兄弟会在隐谷里藏身。

original: {admiring the player's knowledge}You're absolutely right. You must've had run-ins with them. As have I...
translation: {admiring the player's knowledge}说得真没错。你肯定是撞上了他们。就像我一样……

original: Send your Securitrons into Gomorrah and kill off the Omertas' leaders.
translation: 派你的电子保安前往蛾摩拉，杀掉黑手党的头领。

original: Exactly how many civilians did you want to die in that crossfire?
translation: 你究竟想要多少平民在这次交火中丧生？

original: Still, you raise a fair point. My Securitrons can handle this. When the Legion attacks Hoover Dam, I'll be waiting for the Omertas.
translation: 不过，你的想法也不无道理。我的电子保安能搞定他们。当军团进攻胡佛大坝的时候，我会等着黑手党大驾光临的。

original: Wait for them to make their move. Forewarned is forearmed.
translation: 让他们先行动。后发制人，先发者制于人。

original: I suppose you're right... When the Legion assaults Hoover Dam, my Securitrons will be waiting for the Omertas. They won't accomplish much.
translation: 你说的有道理……等军团进攻胡佛大坝的时候，我会让电子保安做好应付黑手党的准备。他们不会得逞的。

original: Nothing I can do. Trying to stop them would be a suicide mission.
translation: 我什么也做不了。阻止他们纯粹是送死。

original: Can't put the genie back in the bottle, is that it? Maybe you should've thought of that {emphasis}before you conspired to destroy my property.
translation: 请神容易送神难，是吗？也许你在{emphasis}密谋毁掉我的财产之前就应该想清楚。

original: {lightening somewhat}That said, I'd know nothing of the Omertas' plot if you'd kept it secret. Perhaps I owe you my gratitude, after all...
translation: {lightening somewhat}这样说来，如果你死不开口，我还真对黑手党的阴谋一无所知。看来，我还是欠了你一份人情啊……

original: The information you've provided will suffice. When the battle for Hoover Dam comes, I'll make sure my Securitrons are waiting for the Omertas.
translation: 你的情报会发挥作用的。当胡佛大坝的战斗打响时，我会让电子保安们做好准备，等待黑手党的光临。

original: It means I have to kill you.
translation: 意味着我不得不杀了你。

original: <Speech to lie to Mr. House about RACKET involvement.>
translation: <使用口才就介入暴动一事对豪斯先生撒谎。>

original: [SUCCEEDED] In that case, I commend you for your initiative. What do you recommend for next steps?
translation: [成功] 如果是这样，那可我得赞扬一下你的机智果敢。你对下面的计划有什么建议？

original: I infiltrated the Omertas in order to gain their confidence.
translation: 我是为了获取他们的信任，才决定去做卧底的。

original: [FAILED]{quiet rage}And you assisted them? That's what you mean to say, isn't it?
translation: [失败] {quiet rage}所以你就帮了他们？你想说的就是这个？

original: Well, thing is... I, uh... they tried to involve me...
translation: 其实……我，呃……是他们邀请我加入的…

original: I kind of helped them perfect their plan...
translation: 某种程度上说，是我帮他们完成了计划……

original: {quiet outrage}I see. So where does that put us?
translation: {quiet outrage}我明白了。那你觉得这事该怎么算呢？

original: Never mind, I'll check into it.
translation: 算了，我会去看看的。

original: When the Legion assaults Hoover Dam, the Omertas are going to massacre everyone on the Strip.
translation: 军团进攻胡佛大坝之时，黑手党会进攻长街，将所有人全部杀光。

original: {shocked at magnitude of Omerta plot}And how do you know this?
translation: {shocked at magnitude of Omerta plot}你怎么知道的？

original: I may know something about that...
translation: 这件事我可能知道……

original: You'll have to be more specific.
translation: 你得说得再具体一点。

original: No thanks.
translation: 不，谢了。

original: I much prefer working with robots...
translation: 我还是更喜欢和机器人一起工作……

original: I'll be on my way.
translation: 我先告辞了。

original: {cross}There's a job that needs doing here, and I'm assigning it to you.
translation: {cross}现在有个任务要完成，而我决定交给你。

original: {sarcastic}Marvellous work ethic, bravo.
translation: {sarcastic}你还真有职业道德啊，不错。

original: The Omertas had it coming.
translation: 黑手党罪有应得。

original: {dry}An opinion you expressed with supreme subtlety and finesse. Moving on...
translation: {dry}你的观点相当具有敏锐性与战略性。继续你的工作吧……

original: 1250 caps it is. <Give the Platinum Chip to Mr. House.>
translation: 说好了1250个瓶盖。 <把白金筹码给豪斯先生。>

original: Not interested.
translation: 没兴趣。

original: Were you aware that Benny hijacked one of your Securitrons and used it to infiltrate your network?
translation: 你知道本尼劫持你的机器人，并利用它来入侵你的网络吗？

original: Benny set me up for an ambush.
translation: 本尼设计伏击了我。

original: He set me up for an ambush.
translation: 他设计伏击了我。

original: Does the NCR usually offer bounties on people?
translation: NCR经常悬赏抓人么？

original: If they've proven hard to kill, yes. Whatever it takes to get the job done, even if means hiring help from outside the military.
translation: 只要是很难对付的人，我们就会张榜悬赏。不论方法，不计代价，就算雇用非军方人员来处理，也在所不惜。

original: Tell me about First Recon.
translation: 跟我说说第一侦察营吧。

original: We're the finest sniper outfit in the whole NCR. If you need a bullet put into a target's eye from 800 yards away, you call us.
translation: 我们是全NCR最厉害的狙击手小队。如果你想让谁的眼睛在800码外被子弹穿个洞，找我们就对了。

original: Some of my team aren't without their share of scars, though, like Betsy and Sterling.
translation: 不过我们也有些人挂了彩，比如贝茜和斯特林。

original: We're the finest sniper outfit in the whole NCR. If you need a bullet put into a target's eye from 800 yards away, you call us.
translation: 我们是全NCR最厉害的狙击手小队。如果你想让谁的眼睛在800码外被子弹穿个洞，找我们就对了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: {military dismissal, said out of habit}Carry on.
translation: {military dismissal, said out of habit}解散。

original: I'm sure it doesn't.
translation: 我想没有。

original: D-d-damn right.
translation: 说的太、太对了。

original: Fiends aren't enough of a challenge for you?
translation: 恶魔帮对你来说已经不成挑战了？

original: Nasty how?
translation: 怎么个麻烦法？

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: We're at your service, if you need us. Until Driver Nephi is dead. Major's orders.
translation: 只要你说话，我们随时愿意效劳。这是少校的命令，必须除掉球杆尼法。

original: Major Dhatri said I should talk to you about taking down Driver Nephi.
translation: 达特里少校说我可以和你讨论有关消灭球杆尼法的事情。

original: Whatever you need, we'll make sure it gets done.
translation: 你有什么需要，我们都会尽力而为。

original: If you need help from my team, just give the word. Driver Nephi's earned himself a few bullets in the gut.
translation: 如果你想要我的人帮忙，只管说话。我们早就想在球杆尼法的身上开几个窟窿了。

original: The NCR will welcome my help.
translation: NCR会很高兴的接受我的帮助的。

original: Precisely. You'll have no trouble joining the battle on their side, and they'll be too distracted to notice why you're really there.
translation: 正是。你大可以直接加入他们的战斗，他们根本就无暇顾及你的真实目的。

original: Cachino was talking about big plans for the Family.
translation: 卡奇诺把家族的计划都说出去了。

original: Really? That two-faced son of a bitch. I'm glad now that we kept him mostly out of the loop. Look, we could use your help with some things.
translation: 真的？这个狗娘养的两面派。还好我们没有让他知道得太多。听着，你可以帮我们。

original: Especially with Cachino gone, we could use another pair of competent hands, and I think you can provide that.
translation: 既然卡奇诺完蛋了，我们需要再找一个能干的人来代替他。我觉得你正合适。

original: You can't have the tapes, but I'll keep them to myself if you leave and never come back.
translation: 磁带不能给你，但如果你卷铺盖走人，再也不回来，我可以保证不把它们泄露出去。

original: Fuck, I was getting tired of this place anyways. I can find girls to play with somewhere else.
translation: 妈的，反正我也受够了这鬼地方，就算去别处我也能找到姑娘。

original: Nevermind.
translation: 算了吧。

original: Then get the fuck out of my face.
translation: 那么就他妈的从我面前滚开。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: I'm not sure I have anything I want to hear from you, but you can have your moment.
translation: 我没什么事要问你的，不过你可以在这儿随便转转。

original: I heard you're Bitter-Root's father.
translation: 我听说你是苦根的父亲。

original: {Bitter-Root alive}Adoptive father, yes. I was very proud when he made First Recon. I know that every time I send them out, I could be sending him to his death.
translation: {Bitter-Root alive}应该说是养父。他能加入第一侦察营，我感到非常自豪。我知道每次派他们去执行任务，都有可能是把他推上绝路。

original: But, if it's not me, it'll be somebody else. At least this way I get one more chance to see him.
translation: 但就算我不下令，也会有其他人代劳。至少我亲自出马，还能让我再多看他一眼。

original: {Bitter-Root dead}I was. I thought I'd accepted the fact that I could be the one ordering him to his death, but it's been more difficult than I thought.
translation: {Bitter-Root alive}}是的。是我亲手把他送上绝路的，我本以为自己能接受这个事实，但实际上比我想象的要困难得多。

original: Excuse me, but I'd rather not speak of this.
translation: 抱歉，我不想再谈这件事了。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: How would you put it?
translation: 你要怎么解释？

original: Well, don't.
translation: 好吧，最好别。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Some trick without a nose.
translation: 雕虫小技。

original: Heh, I like you, friend. Have I mentioned that?
translation: 嘿，我喜欢你，朋友。我之前说过么？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: What do you want from me?
translation: 你到底想要我怎么样？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: See ya round, buckaroo.
translation: 再会，牛仔。

original: Well, happy trails, then!
translation: 好吧，祝你一路顺风！

original: 'Til our trails cross again, pardner.
translation: 期待下次再会咯，朋友。

original: You saying I owe you?
translation: 这么说我欠你一次人情？

original: I wouldn't put it exactly like that, friend.
translation: 我可不会说得那么直接，朋友。

original: I can take care of myself.
translation: 我能照顾好自己的。

original: Sure you can, friend, but everyone needs a hand from time to time. Maybe you'll return the favor one day.
translation: 当然可以，朋友。但人总是需要帮忙的嘛，说不定将来哪天你还得报答我呢。

original: How did you know I was in trouble?
translation: 你怎么知道我麻烦缠身？

original: Heck, I can smell trouble a mile away.
translation: 嘿，我在一英里外就能闻到麻烦的味道。

original: 'We'? Who is 'we'?
translation: “我们”？“我们”指的是谁？

original: Are you threatening me?
translation: 你在威胁我吗？

original: Heh, well of course not. We just wouldn't want anything to happen to you is all.
translation: 哈，当然不是。我们只是不希望你再出事罢了。

original: Are you following me?
translation: 你在跟踪我吗？

original: I saved your life so I kinda feel responsible for you is all.
translation: 我救了你的小命，所以我觉得应该对你负责到底。

original: Does it mean anything?
translation: 这有什么含义吗？

original: Yeah. It means you don't get shot.
translation: 含义就是你不会挨枪子。

original: Guess he wants to do this the hard way, boys. Take him down.
translation: 看来他是敬酒不吃吃罚酒。小子们，干掉他。

original: NCR citizens are dying in Freeside and the NCR wants you to stop it.
translation: 有NCR公民在自由城丧生，NCR希望你停止这种行为。

original: Well, Freeside citizens are also being attacked and I'd like you all to stop it, but I'm guessing that's not going to happen, is it?
translation: 噢，自由城公民同样遭到了袭击，我希望你们也停止行动，但我猜这办不到，对吧？

original: This little show of force accomplishes nothing. So take your toy soldiers and go home. Show's over.
translation: 来我这儿耀武扬威可没用。带着你的玩具兵们回老家去吧。演出结束了。

original: The NCR wants you to curb the violence in Freeside. Or else.
translation: NCR要求你制止自由城里的暴力活动，否则……

original: You know, it's that "or else" part that gets stuck in my craw. It just sounds a little too much like you're trying to tell us what to do.
translation: 你知道吗，就是这个"否则"让我十分不爽。听上去你好像要来命令我们似的。

original: And nobody tells the Kings what to do. So why don't you and all of your little friends get the hell out of here. Or else.
translation: 没有人能命令猫王帮。你和你这帮朋友最好赶紧给我滚出去，否则……

original: I'm here to deliver an ultimatum from the NCR. Cease hostilities against the NCR or perish.
translation: 我带来了NCR的最后通牒。要么停止对NCR的敌对行为，要么等着被灭吧。

original: An ultimatum? Do you even know who you're talking to? We're the Kings, and no King will ever accept an ultimatum.
translation: 最后通牒？你知道你在和谁说话吗？我们是猫王帮，猫王帮的人是不会接受最后通牒的。

original: Go back to your general or commodore or whatever-the-fuck and tell them to shove their ultimatum where the sun don't shine.
translation: 回去告诉你那将军，或是指挥官，或是随便什么操蛋玩意，让他们找个没人的狗洞去发这什么通牒吧。

original: Maybe you can tell me what the hell is going on here. These stony face bastards haven't said a word other than to say they're here under orders.
translation: 你跟我说说这到底是怎么回事。这帮面无表情的狗杂种除了说自己是奉命行事外，连个屁都不放。

original: Where was I supposed to meet Price, again?
translation: 在哪我才能在遇到普莱斯？

original: Pawn shop in Westside called Miguel's. It's in outer Vegas, northwest of the Strip.
translation: 西区的米格尔典当铺，在维加斯外围，长街的西北面。

original: Blake is where, exactly?
translation: 布莱克在哪，准确的位置？

original: The Crimson Caravan is up north past the Gun Runners. During the day Blake is usually in their main office.
translation: 深红商队就在军火贩子地盘的北边，白天布莱克通常都待在办事处。

original: Remind me where Isaac is.
translation: 再和我说一次艾萨克在哪。

original: The Gun Runners are almost straight north of here. A little east. Isaac has a house in their compound.
translation: 军火贩子的聚居地大致在此地的正北边，往东走一点。艾萨克的屋子就在他们的地盘里。

original: I'm going to pollute the ventilation system with the strinking corpse of an NCR private.
translation: 我打算把一具NCR列兵的尸体塞进营地的通风管道。

original: ...but relief must follow unbearable suffering.
translation: ……但解放必然伴随着巨大的痛苦。

original: {Terrified}Holy Christ. Get- get away from me!
translation: {Terrified}我操。离——离我远点！

original: Now both the Fiends and the NCR know not to fuck with me.
translation: 现在不管是恶魔帮还是NCR，都不敢轻易惹我了。

original: Yeah, well, it looks like it might be too late for the Fiends. But we got the message loud and clear.
translation: 是的，不过我估计恶魔帮就算明白这一点，现在也已经来不及了。但我们懂你的意思。

original: I made a promise to Private Morales.
translation: 我向列兵莫拉莱斯做过承诺。

original: That must be {emph. "some kind," as in, an impressive one}some kind of code of honor you hold yourself to. You're like a woman possessed.
translation: 看来{emph. "some kind," as in，an impressive one}你有自己的一套荣誉观。你真是个意志强大的女人。

original: That must be {emph. "some kind," as in, an impressive one}some kind of code of honor you hold yourself to. You're like a man possessed.
translation: 看来{emph. "some kind," as in，an impressive one}你有自己的一套荣誉观。你真是个意志强大的汉子。

original: I just did what anybody else would've done.
translation: 我只是做了任何人都会做的事。

original: {emphasize 2nd syllable, draw out}Bullshit. What anybody else would've done is get their asses killed. You're leading some kind of charmed life.
translation: {重音放在第二个音节上，拖长音}胡扯。换成别人，只会白白把小命给送掉。你真是有福气。

original: We'll make sure Ranger Morales' body gets sent back home. You don't have to, you know, pick him up on your shoulder and haul him to California.
translation: 我们会把游骑兵莫拉莱斯的尸体送回家的。那个，你也没必要，呃，把他一直扛在肩上走回加州了。

original: Even though I believe you would if you had to. You should go tell Private Morales the news. I know she'll be relieved.
translation: 虽然我觉得你肯定干得出这种事。你现在应该去把这件事告诉列兵莫拉莱斯。至少能给她一些安慰。

original: Oh my God, are you okay? You've gotta get to a medic. Doc Kemp can patch you up back at base.
translation: 哦，天哪，你没事儿吧？你必须马上接受治疗。基地的肯普医生可以给你包扎一下。

original: How could you just sacrifice your body like that? You never even met him. If the NCR doesn't have a medal for this, they should make one up.
translation: 你何苦这样置生死于度外呢？你跟他明明素不相识。NCR真该给你颁个勋章，如果没有，就让他们临时给你造一个。

original: I don't believe it. Who the hell are you, man? How did you just walk right up and pull him out of there?
translation: 我真不敢相信。你究竟是何方神圣啊，哥们？你是怎么把他从那儿拽回来的？

original: I don't believe it. Who the hell are you, lady? How did you just walk right up and pull him out of there?
translation: 我真不敢相信。你究竟是何方神圣啊，小姐？你是怎么把他从那儿拽回来的？

original: Where does the concrete come from?
translation: 这些水泥是哪来的？

original: {Quarry Junction Deathclaws dead}Most of the limestone comes from Quarry Junction out west. The supply had stopped for awhile because of a Deathclaw problem.
translation: {Quarry Junction Deathclaws dead}石灰大多是从西边的采石场里运来的。不过由于死亡爪肆虐，那里的供应一度中断了。

original: I heard some badass wastelander killed the Deathclaws, and deliveries of limestone have been coming in again.
translation: 我听说有个厉害的流浪者干掉了那些死亡爪，现在石灰的运输又恢复了。

original: I don't think they've gotten the trains up and running yet, but most of the concrete plant workers have come back to town now. Good for business.
translation: 虽然铁路应该还没有修好，但大多数水泥厂的工人都已经回到镇上来了。对工厂来说是件好事。

original: {Quarry Junction Deathclaws not dead}Most of the limestone comes from Quarry Junction out west, but I hear some Deathclaws overran the quarry.
translation: {Quarry Junction Deathclaws not dead}石灰大多是从西边的采石场里运来的，但我听说采石场那边的死亡爪已经泛滥成灾了。

original: With no work to be had, all the workers around here have wandered off. I'm the only one left in town.
translation: 没有活可干，附近的工人也就纷纷跑路了。我是唯一留在这镇上的人。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye, thank you.
translation: 再见，谢谢你。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: I killed the Deathclaw Alpha Male and Mother at Quarry Junction.
translation: 我在采石场杀死了死亡爪首领和母兽。

original: Nice!
translation: 漂亮！

original: Boulder City stuff.
translation: 巨石城员工。

original: What about Boulder City?
translation: 巨石城怎么样了？

original: Who's in charge of the Powder Gangers?
translation: 谁在掌管炸药帮？

original: Right now, Eddie and his boys run the place. They've got the guns and the dynamite, so they call the shots.
translation: 目前掌管这个地方的是埃迪和他的手下。他们有枪和炸药，所以在这儿他们是老大。

original: Why are you still here?
translation: 为什么你还留在这儿？

original: I'm not quite sure the kind of greeting NCR troopers will give an escaped con like myself. Figure it's better to stay put for now.
translation: 我不确定NCR部队会以何种方式欢迎像我这样的逃犯。我想现在还是待在这里为妙。

original: Where can I find Cooke?
translation: 在哪儿能找到库克？

original: He went north with some of the other guys. Didn't say where, didn't say why. All I know is he's got some kind of score to settle with the NCR.
translation: 他和其他一些家伙往北边去了，没说去哪儿，也没说为什么。我只知道他有笔账要和NCR算。

original: Who's Cooke?
translation: 谁是库克？

original: Some kind of anti-NCR rebel. Some people just don't like being pushed around and told what to do.
translation: 一个反对NCR的叛党。这世上有些人就是不喜欢受指使、守规矩。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Watch yourself out there.
translation: 在外面注意自己。

original: Tell me more about what happened in the prison.
translation: 和我说说监狱里发生的事情。

original: I understand that Cooke was behind it all. I kept my head down the whole time. Didn't want any part of it.
translation: 我知道库克是这一切的幕后主使。我完全没有参与。我不想和他们扯上任何关系。

original: I stuck around, figuring the NCR would show up and put things back the way they were. No sense in making myself look guilty, right?
translation: 我之所以留下来，是觉得NCR应该会出面让一切恢复原状。反正我也没必要心虚，对吧？

original: What did you do before you ended up incarcerated?
translation: 你是因为什么事被关起来的？

original: I was a sheriff, believe it or not, for a small town far to the west of here.
translation: 信不信由你，我曾在西部离这儿很远的一个小镇上做过治安官。

original: The short version is that sometimes justice is a little slow, and I helped speed it up one too many times.
translation: 来这儿的原因，一句话概括，就是正义有时来得太慢，我想让它快一些，但做得有些过了。

original: I'm not sorry for anything I did, but I will do the time. Fair enough trade, if you ask me.
translation: 对于我做的事，我问心无愧，让我坐牢，我也认了。在我看来，这很公平。

original: How did you all manage to escape?
translation: 你们大家是怎么逃跑的？

original: One night, there was a big explosion from the other cell block. I had no idea what was going on, so I took cover in my bunk.
translation: 一天夜里，有个牢区突然发生了大爆炸，我不知道出了什么事，就躲到了床底下。

original: When it was all over, the guards were dead and we were free. Most of the other prisoners scattered, but a few of us stuck around, obviously.
translation: 等骚乱平息后，我们发现所有警卫都死了，我们自由了。大多数囚犯都逃走了，只有我们这一小部分人留了下来。

original: What's your reason for staying?
translation: 为什么你要留在这？

original: The location to the highway makes it a good spot to shake down any travelers passing through. That's why Eddie and the rest are still around.
translation: 靠近公路的地理位置，使得这里成为了伏击过往行人的理想地点。所以埃迪和其他人才留着不走。

original: Me, I like having big walls between myself and the wasteland.
translation: 至于我，比起做废土游民，还是待在高墙里更舒服。

original: What did you do before?
translation: 之前你是干什么的？

original: Let's see... I've been a farmhand, a bouncer, a bandit, and an NCR trooper. I don't recommend any of them.
translation: 让我想想……我之前当过雇农，保镖，掠夺者，NCR士兵，这些工作我都不喜欢。

original: What did you do to end up in here?
translation: 你做了什么才落得这般下场？

original: Medical supplies go for a decent amount of caps in the right markets. I figured the quartermaster wouldn't notice any missing. I was wrong.
translation: 医疗用品在市场上非常值钱。我以为军需官不会注意到药品丢失，可是我错了。

original: Why are you "sort of" the doctor?
translation: 为什么说你只能"勉强"算个医生？

original: I was an NCR medic for six months, so I'm not exactly a "doctor." Still, it's more medical training that any of the other guys here.
translation: 我在NCR当过六个月的医疗兵，所以我不是一个真正的"医生"。不过，我受过的医疗训练仍然比这里的其他人要多。

original: It also gives me an excuse to stay out of any raiding parties. The gang can't lose its only doctor now, can it?
translation: 所以我也有借口不必和他们一块儿去打劫了，帮会里总不能没有医生，对吧？

original: I need a doctor.
translation: 我需要一个医生。

original: The fact that you're still on your feet is... surprising.
translation: 你居然还能站着……真令人惊讶。

original: Life can be pretty rough sometimes.
translation: 生活不易啊。

original: I've seen worse.
translation: 还不算太糟。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Later.
translation: 回见。

original: Why do you stay here?
translation: 你为什么呆在这？

original: Don't have any other place to go. I'd just end up back in another prison, or dead out in the wasteland.
translation: 因为没别的地方可去了。要么死在另一所监狱里，要么就死在废土上。

original: What can you tell me about this place?
translation: 你能和我说说这个地方吗？

original: This is where the NCR sent prisoners to "reform" through hard labor. I never saw much reforming around here, myself.
translation: 这是NCR关押犯人，进行"劳动改造"的地方。不过我从未看见有人被改造过。

original: What did you do to end up here in the first place?
translation: 你为什么会到这儿来？你都犯了什么事？

original: I worked in a casino in New Reno, and one of the pit bosses decided he didn't like me. Framed me over some caps, and I ended up in here.
translation: 我之前在新里诺的一家赌场里工作，有个赌场经理不喜欢我。他诬告我偷了他的钱，结果我就到这儿来了。

original: You're a trader?
translation: 你是一个商人？

original: I was always the guy who could get things, if you know what I mean. Figured I might as well keep on doing it.
translation: 我以前路子很广，你懂我的意思吧？所以我觉得继续做这行当也不差。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: See you.
translation: 回头见。

original: Show me what you have for sale.
translation: 给我看看你都卖些什么。

original: If I don't have anything you like, well... tough. I don't do special orders.
translation: 如果我这儿没有你喜欢的东西，嗯……那你忍着吧。我不接受特别订单。

original: You got it.
translation: 我马上照办。

original: How do Wastelanders cope with current times?
translation: 咱们这些废土游民该怎么应对眼下的状况？

original: What are the most dangerous places in the Wasteland?
translation: 废土最危险的地方在哪里？

original: How do Wastelanders cope with current times?
translation: 咱们这些废土游民该怎么应对眼下的状况？

original: What are the most dangerous places in the Wasteland?
translation: 废土最危险的地方在哪里？

original: What are the most dangerous places in the Wasteland?
translation: 废土最危险的地方在哪里？

original: {Hint of Irony}Hell, it's all dangerous. Know why? Because you can't trust anything that stands on two legs.
translation: {Hint of Irony}妈的，哪里都危险。知道为什么吗？因为所有长着两条腿的东西都不可信。

original: If you're looking for the real trouble, head straight into the mountains. Men don't walk up there, for good reasons, kid.
translation: 你要是真想跟自己过不去，那就往山里走吧。人类是不会到那儿去的，理由很充分，孩子。

original: If you're looking for the real trouble, head straight into the mountains. Men don't walk up there, for good reasons, kid.
translation: 你要是真想跟自己过不去，那就往山里走吧。人类是不会到那儿去的，理由很充分，孩子。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Is there any work to do here?
translation: 有什么事要帮忙吗？

original: I've got proof of what I've said.
translation: 我有证据可以证明我所言非虚。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Yeah, that's right - good to say bye to you.
translation: 对，没错，再见啦。

original: What do you know about Cooke?
translation: 关于库克你都知道什么？

original: One mean son of a bitch. Really, truly hates the NCR for some reason, and he got a lot of the other guys around to his way of thinking.
translation: 一个卑鄙的狗杂种，他是真的恨NCR，在他的鼓动下，有许多人也支持他的想法。

original: Where is Cooke now?
translation: 现在库克在哪？

original: He and his crew went north. I heard talk about some sort of "big plan" to get back at the NCR, but haven't seen them since.
translation: 他和他的人往北边去了。我听说他们正在筹备什么"大计划"要报复NCR，不过我再也没见过他们。

original: What can you tell me about the prison?
translation: 你能和我介绍一下这个监狱吗？

original: The NCR called it a "work-release" prison. We lucky prisoners got the privilege of fixing up the rail lines and blasting rock for new lines.
translation: NCR称它是"劳改"监狱。我们这些幸运的囚犯可以享受优待，去维修铁路，炸石头，开新路。

original: They got sloppy, though. Some of us managed to hide away some dynamite, and look who's in charge now.
translation: 后来NCR的管理松懈了。我们有几个人设法藏了一些炸药，如今风水轮流转了。

original: How did the breakout happen?
translation: 越狱是怎么发生的？

original: It was all Cooke's idea. He and his boys managed to swipe some dynamite and hide it away in their cells.
translation: 这都是库克的主意。他和小弟们设法偷了一些炸药藏在牢房里。

original: The rest of us just tagged along. Cooke's crew headed north while the rest of us stuck around for payback.
translation: 我们其他人只是跟着起事罢了。现在，库克带着人去了北边，而我们则留下来，和NCR算账。

original: How did you end up in this place?
translation: 你是怎么到这里来的？

original: Why do you care? Answer: you shouldn't. I don't feel like trading life stories.
translation: 你关心这个干嘛？我看你还是少管一点的好。我不喜欢和他人分享自己的故事。

original: What am I looking for in Primm?
translation: 要我去普瑞姆干嘛？

original: I know the NCR has troops near Primm, so talk to the locals and find out if any of those troops are going to be coming our way.
translation: 我知道在普瑞姆附近驻有NCR的军队，和当地人谈谈，调查一下那些军队是不是正准备朝我们这边来。

original: I got rid of him.
translation: 我解决他了。

original: Good. Had him figured for NCR, one of the rangers maybe. Anyway, speaking of the NCR, I need you to take a walk down to Primm.
translation: 很好。他可能是NCR，也可能是游骑兵。说到NCR，我希望你去一趟普瑞姆。

original: The NCR hasn't raised hell over our breakout, and I want to find out why. They're up to something, I can feel it.
translation: 我们越狱后，NCR还没有发起反攻，我想知道为什么。凭我个人的直觉，他们一定在搞什么名堂。

original: What exactly is "funny" about that merchant you want me to check out?
translation: 你要我去盘查的那个商人到底哪里"可笑"了？

original: {Non-dummy}Most people already know we run this territory, and are usually in a hurry to get out. Not this guy. It's like he wants us to come get him.
translation: {Non-dummy}多数人都知道这里是我们的地盘，通常会避着走，可这家伙却是个例外，感觉他明摆着就是要我们去抢劫的。

original: {Dummy}{annoyed a player's stupidity}Not "ha ha" funny, you moron. Funny as in suspicious. He's not trying to run away like most people.
translation: {Dummy}{annoyed a player's stupidity}我不是指"哈哈"大笑，你这个白痴。是很可疑的意思。他和其他人不一样，居然没有逃走。

original: Chavez has been dealt with. You won't see him around here anymore.
translation: 查韦兹已经完蛋了，你再也不会看见他了。

original: I'm happy you cleaned that up for me, but we've got another situation to worry about. There's a merchant hanging around near the prison.
translation: 很高兴你帮我除掉了那个杂种，但又出了个状况，监狱附近有个商人在晃悠。

original: Something feels funny about him, and I want you to deal with him. Shake him down if he's legit, but if he's not, take him out.
translation: 感觉这人有点可笑，你去和他打个交道。如果他是干合法生意的，就勒索他一把，如果他另有目的，就做了他。

original: What do you need done?
translation: 你要我去做什么？

original: This is Powder Ganger territory - my territory. Most of the guys around here understand that. One, Chavez, doesn't.
translation: 这是炸药帮的地盘，我的地盘。这周围绝大多数人都明白这点。只有一个人，查韦兹，他不明白。

original: Chavez formed his own crew and have been hitting traders on their own. Everybody I've sent after him either got killed or weren't able to catch him.
translation: 查韦兹自己组织了团伙去袭击商队。而我派去追捕他的人要么被杀了，要么都失败而归。

original: That leaves you. What do you say?
translation: 所以这件差事就托付给你了，你说呢？

original: Nothing's changed. Chavez won't answer to me, but he and his crew operate in {emphasis "my"}my territory. Deal with him.
translation: 没什么改变，查韦兹依然不听我的话，他和他的团伙还在{emphasis "我的"}我的地盘里胡作非为。把他解决掉。

original: No.
translation: 不。

original: Inform me when you are ready to go.
translation: 准备好了就告诉我。

original: Yes.
translation: 是的。

original: Let's proceed.
translation: 我们走吧。

original: This is bullshit! Why are we even talking about dealing with these guys?
translation: 放屁！为什么我们得跟这些家伙谈条件？

original: Pace, this isn't really a good time to have this discussion...
translation: 佩瑟，现在不是讨论这种事的时候……

original: Wrong. This is exactly the right time. I'm about to prevent you from making a huge mistake.
translation: 错。现在正是时候。我要阻止你犯下大错。

original: Pace, don't do this. I won't stand with you if you do.
translation: 佩瑟，别这样。我不会站在你那边的。

original: Then I'll stand on my own, just like I always have. Just like a King should.
translation: 那我就为自己而战吧，何况我一直如此。身为猫王帮的人就该如此。

original: Don't take that tone with me. These soldiers would wipe the floor with your men.
translation: 别用这种腔调和我说话。要不然这些士兵会拿你手下的尸体擦地板。

original: Sounds like a challenge. Boys, let's do this!
translation: 这是在挑衅我么。小子们，动手！

original: I apologize for their rudeness. The NCR wants peace in Freeside, and offers additional supplies.
translation: 我为他们的鲁莽向你道歉。NCR希望和平解决自由城问题，他们也愿意提供额外的物资。

original: And I suppose they want me to help see that happen? That seems pretty reasonable.
translation: 所以为了这个目的，他们要找我帮忙？听起来很合理。

original: I've been instructed to offer you more resources in exchange for your word that the violence stops.
translation: 我接到命令，如果你们保证停止暴力行为，我们可以为你们提供更多资源。

original: That sounds fair. And all I have to do is try to tone down the attacks on the Squatters, you say?
translation: 听起来很公平。所以我只需要制止针对流民的袭击就行了，是吧？

original: Okay, I need some answers, now. These guys just barged in here and said they were under orders to keep me here until you arrived.
translation: 好了，我需要个说法。这帮人刚刚突然闯进来，说他们接到命令，让我必须留在原地，等你过来。

original: I'm about five seconds away from telling my men to take them down, so speak fast.
translation: 如果你再晚来五秒钟，我就要命令手下把他们干掉了。所以你有话快说。

original: The ambassador didn't think Colonel Moore would handle the situation correctly.
translation: 大使认为莫尔上校处理这件事的手段恐怕会引起麻烦。

original: Moore's got her hands full right now, and she's not a subtle person in the best of times. Her solution would be quick and dirty.
translation: 莫尔手头的事已经不少了，况且她平日里也的确不是能一个分得清轻重缓急的人。她的解决方案肯定是快刀斩乱麻。

original: I agree with Crocker that a more peaceful solution is preferable, especially for the long term.
translation: 我同意克罗克的想法，从长远来看，和平解决才是更好的方法。

original: He said you might have a better way of dealing with the issue.
translation: 他说你也许有更好的办法可以解决问题。

original: Well, I do get to make the calls on the distribution of supplies there.
translation: 嗯，我确实是在负责那个地区的物资补给。

original: Crocker was probably counting on me being able to offer the Kings a carrot. And that's what I'm inclined to do.
translation: 克罗克也许是指望我能给猫王帮一点甜头，来缓和一下局势。我也正有此意。

original: He said those were his official orders, but suggested seeing you anyway.
translation: 他说虽然台面上的要求是这样，但他建议我无论如何还是要来见你一面。

original: Because he's looking to avoid a bloodbath. I get it. He knows me.
translation: 因为他想避免流血冲突。明白了。他很了解我。

original: All right. Moore's not gonna like it. But that's for Crocker to worry about.
translation: 好吧。虽然莫尔肯定会不爽，但该担心这事的人是克罗克，不是我。

original: Go to the leader of the Kings and tell him that I'll make sure Freeside gets more water, power, and food as long as the violence there stops.
translation: 你去找猫王帮的首领，告诉他只要停止暴力行为，我就同意向自由城输送更多的水电，还有粮食。

original: Ambassador Crocker said to come see you about the situation with the Kings in Freeside.
translation: 克罗克大使叫我来协助你处理一下自由城猫王帮的事。

original: Ah, that. I'm surprised he didn't send you to Colonel Moore. That'd be her jurisdiction.
translation: 啊，那件事啊。我很惊讶他居然没让你去找莫尔上校。这种事本来应该是由她来负责的。

original: I've already received a communique from Colonel Moore saying that she's sent a squad down to Freeside.
translation: 我收到了莫尔上校的电报，上面说她已经向自由城派遣了一支小分队。

original: If you'd come to me first, I might have been able to do something. But at this point, my hands are tied. Sorry.
translation: 如果你能先来找我，或许我还能想点别的办法。但现在已经走到这一步，我也束手无策了。抱歉。

original: Let's take our chances. <Untie Benny.>
translation: 让我们碰碰运气吧。<给本尼松绑。>

original: Let's take our chances. <Untie Benny.>
translation: 我们还是碰碰运气吧。<松开本尼。>

original: Blow on the dice, baby. We're gonna need luck to get outta here alive.
translation: 那你得好好赌一把，宝贝。想活着从这儿逃出去真的需要运气。

original: You invited me and promised safe-conduct.
translation: 你邀请我时已经强调过要保证我安全的。

original: No, I came to decorate this tent with your guts.
translation: 不，我来这是让你血溅当场的。

original: Step closer to the demonstration area, if you would...
translation: 再往前几步，到展示区来……

original: I expect you're well familiar with my Securitrons by now.
translation: 我想你应该对我的电子保安已经很熟悉了。

original: The titanium alloy housing that protects its electronic core deflects small arms and shrapnel easily enough...
translation: 钛合金的框架保护着它的电子核心，使它能很轻易地抵挡轻武器和榴弹的攻击。

original: Its X-25 gatling laser, produced to spec by Glastinghouse, Inc., is deadly  against soft targets at medium range...
translation: 它配备了由伽马镜屋有限公司制造的X-25激光加特林，能对中等距离的普通目标给予致命打击……

original: And for close-range suppression or crowd control, the Securitron is armed with a 9mm submachinegun.
translation: 至于近距离的火力压制和镇压暴乱，电子保安则配备了9毫米的微型冲锋枪。

original: All of this, you probably already knew...
translation: 这一切，你可能早就知道了……

original: What you did not know is that these are the Securitrons' {emphasis}secondary weapons.
translation: 但你不知道的是，这些都只是电子保安的{emphasis}辅助武器。

original: All this time, my Securitrons have had to get by running the Mark I operating system, which lacked software drivers for their primary weapons!
translation: 一直以来，我的电子保安所使用的都是I型操作系统，这个系统缺少了运行主武器所需的驱动程序！

original: Today, with the delivery of the Platinum Chip, all that changes. Behold, for the first time, Securitrons running the Mark II OS!
translation: 今天，有了白金筹码，一切都将改变。看好了，这将是有史以来第一次，电子保安运行II型操作系统！

original: The M-235 Missile Launcher gives the Securitron the ability to engage ground and air targets at significantly longer ranges...
translation: M-235导弹发射器赋予了电子保安超远距离对地及对空的打击能力。

original: And a rapid-fire G-28 grenade launching system ensures the Securitron is deadly in close-range engagements.
translation: 外加一台高速G-28榴弹发射系统，确保电子保安在近距离作战中所向披靡。

original: The software upgrade also includes drivers for the Securitrons' highly sophisticated onboard auto-repair systems.
translation: 软件升级包中还囊括了针对电子保安的高精密机载自动修复系统的驱动程序。

original: All together, the Mark II {emphasis}software upgrade confers a 235% increase in combat effectiveness per unit.
translation: 综上所述，II型操作系统将使每个单位的作战效率提升235%。

original: The city of New Vegas finally has soldiers worthy of protecting it!
translation: 新维加斯终于迎来了一批骁勇善战的保卫者！

original: Return to the penthouse now. We have much to discuss...
translation: 回到顶楼来吧，我们还有很多要谈……

original: If this statement is being broadcast, I am deceased. Please approach a Securitron and take one of the printed obituaries.
translation: 如果有人听到这个广播，那证明本人已不在人世。请向就近的电子保安领取我的讣告。

original: I, Robert Edwin House, am deceased. Please approach a Securitron and take one of the printed obituaries.
translation: 本人，罗伯特·艾德温·豪斯，已经不在人世。请向就近的电子保安领取我的讣告。

original: I should be going.
translation: 我该走了。

original: <Lie> Sure, what about the place?
translation: <撒谎> 当然，那个地方怎么啦？

original: Violence is something of a way of life there, but there's been a disturbing rise in the number of attacks on our people lately.
translation: 暴力是那里的家常便饭，不过最近有一种不好的趋势——针对我们公民的袭击在不断地增加。

original: More worrying is the fact that our sources suggest the violence is being perpetrated by the gang that runs the place, the Kings.
translation: 更令人担心的是有情报显示：这些暴力事件是由统治那个地方的帮会“猫王帮”犯下的。

original: I need someone to look into this that won't attract attention. Would you be interested?
translation: 我需要有人帮我秘密调查此事。你有兴趣吗？

original: <Lie> No, I haven't.
translation: <撒谎> 不，我没有。

original: It's a beastly place. Poverty is rampant, and all that goes with it - drugs, alcohol abuse, the usual.
translation: 那是个野蛮的地方。贫穷无处不在，而吸毒、酗酒这些贫穷的副产物，也随处可见。

original: I have a better idea. Why don't I just take all my caps back from your corpse?
translation: 我有个更好的主意。我为什么不能从你的尸体上拿回我所有的瓶盖呢？

original: You're welcome to try.
translation: 你不妨试试。

original: I'm not giving you my caps.
translation: 我不会把瓶盖给你的。

original: Then you give me no choice.
translation: 那我别无选择了。

original: Why are you doing this?
translation: 你为什么要这么做？

original: Man, I'm tired of scrounging for caps from ungrateful idiots like you. It's past time I moved on to bigger and better things.
translation: 我已经厌倦了从你们这帮不知感恩的白痴身上榨取瓶盖了。我早就该改行去干大事了。

original: Now are you going to hand over your caps, or am I going to shoot you and take them anyway?
translation: 现在，你是自己把瓶盖交出来，还是让我先毙了你，再从你尸体上拿？

original: Don't shoot! Here you go.
translation: 别开枪！给你。

original: Wow, I didn't think it would be this easy. I should have done this years ago. Guess I'll be going then.
translation: 哇，没想到这么容易。要是我早几年就开始这么干该多好。那我先告辞啦。

original: Oh, here's a final tip - don't ever follow anyone into a dark alley in Freeside. Later, chump.
translation: 喔，最后一条建议——在自由城里，千万别跟着他人进巷子。再会啦，笨蛋。

original: No right now. I'm busy.
translation: 现在不行。我很忙。

original: Well, don't wait too long. What I've got is something you'd need to act on, quick.
translation: 好吧，别让我等太久。我这条情报很急，需要你立刻行动。

original: Sure. What is it?
translation: 当然。是什么？

original: I don't want to mention it out in plain sight like this. You never know who might be listening. Follow me.
translation: 我可不想在大庭广众之下告诉你。毕竟到处都有人偷听。跟我来。

original: I don't care. Do you have any new info?
translation: 没兴趣。你有新的情报吗？

original: Yeesh, you're just all business, aren't you? Well, I like how I look, and that's what's important. Though it'd be nice if other people did too.
translation: 哎呀，你也太正经了。好吧，只要我自己喜欢我的长相就行。当然，如果别人也这么想就最好了。

original: As good as a ghoul in a suit can look.
translation: 尸鬼再怎么打扮，也就这个样了。

original: Fuck you, human. We don't all share your wonderful complexion. Some of us have to make do, you know?
translation: 去你妈的，人类。我们不像你们各个细皮嫩肉。有些事只能凑合，你懂吗？

original: Anyway, I was just going to tell you that I've come across some new tidbits you might find interesting.
translation: 算了，我正想告诉你我，我又打听到一些消息，也许你会感兴趣。

original: And since you're just about my favorite person in the world, each one is only going to cost you 100 caps. Interested?
translation: 既然你和我关系这么好，那我每条情报就只收你100个瓶盖好了。怎么样？

original: Very classy.
translation: 很吸引人。

original: You said it. With these threads, people are finally going to start noticing me.
translation: 可不是嘛。有了这些东西，人们终于开始能注意我了。

original: I've already forgotten it.
translation: 我已经忘了。

original: Yeah, I bet you have. Not important enough for you to remember, huh?
translation: 对，我打赌你已经忘了。对你来说不值一提，对吧？

original: I'm sorry. I was out of line before.
translation: 对不起。我之前有些过分。

original: It's cool. I'm just a little touchy about people making fun of me, especially smoothskins. But you're not all bad. Take the Followers, for example.
translation: 没事儿。我只是对人们拿我开涮比较敏感，尤其是滑皮肤。不过你们人类也并非都是坏人，比如天启追随者就不错。

original: Why, just the other week, one of them offered me a job. Can you imagine? Me, with a real job?
translation: 你知道吗，几个礼拜前，他们居然说要给我提供工作。你能想象吗？我，正经工作？

original: Can you imagine? Me? With a real job?
translation: 你能想象吗？我，正经工作？

original: I'm sorry. Sorry you're such a prissy asshole.
translation: 我很抱歉。抱歉你妈生了你这么一个没出息的狗东西。

original: You're a real piece of work, you know that?
translation: 你也是你母亲的杰作，知道吗？

original: Sure, but what about this place? Isn't it your home?
translation: 是啊，可这儿怎么办？这儿不是你的家吗？

original: This place is a shithole, but yeah, it's home. I've lived here all my life. I'd be leaving a piece of myself behind if I left.
translation: 这儿就是个粪坑，不过，这儿也的确是我的家。我在这里住了一辈子。即便离开，我也会时常挂念起它。

original: There'd be things I'd miss - the fun of watching the Kings kick the crap out of a thief, or the look of joy on a child's face after catching a rat.
translation: 我会怀念发生在这里的各种趣事——比如猫王帮把小偷打得屁滚尿流，或者孩子们抓到老鼠时流露出的快乐神情。

original: Ah, now you've got me all nostalgic-like. Maybe I'd be better off trying to find a way to make this place better than giving up and leaving.
translation: 啊，你搞得我突然开始念旧了。也许我该想个办法改变这里的现状，而不是自顾自地一走了之。

original: You wouldn't last ten seconds out in the waste.
translation: 你在废土上坚持不了10秒的。

original: That's a hell of a thing to say. Build up a man's hopes, then dash them in front of him.
translation: 你这么说真是太残忍了。先给人希望，然后又硬生生地把它砸碎。

original: And who says I couldn't survive just as well as you out there? People are always underestimating me, damn.
translation: 谁说我不能像你一样在外面逍遥自在？人们总是低估我的实力，妈的。

original: I go places all the time. It's actually pretty easy to just pick up and leave.
translation: 我经常四处旅行。其实收拾一下铺盖离开这里很容易的。

original: That's true, you seem to always be on the move and it seems to be working out for you pretty well.
translation: 说得对，我看你应该是经常浪迹天涯的那种人，貌似你也很适应这种生活。

original: I've already got a decent amount saved up. If I keep it up, there's no reason I shouldn't be able to go start over somewhere else soon.
translation: 我倒是也攒了一点钱。照这个势头下去，到别的地方过上好日子也是迟早的事。

original: You believed that crap I said about giving the money away?
translation: 我就是随口说说把钱送掉的屁话，你也信？

original: What? N-No, I knew you were just kidding. Ha ha. You're a funny one, all right.
translation: 什么？不，不，我就知道你是开玩笑。哈哈。你真有意思，好吧。

original: Freeside's problems are too big for you to have much impact.
translation: 自由城的问题已经太严重了，很难再有改变了。

original: You're probably right. This place has been going downhill for a long time. Maybe I could start over somewhere else.
translation: 也许你说得对。这个地方已经走了很长时间下坡路了。也许我该另外找个地方。

original: Just think of it. A new life...
translation: 想象一下吧。崭新的生活……

original: Oh yeah, I heard some new things that you might find interesting. I'm going to have to start charging 100 caps per tip, though.
translation: 哦，对了，我又打听到一些消息，也许你会感兴趣。不过每条情报我要收你100个瓶盖。

original: After all, I have to save up for my ticket out of here, right?  So how about it? Want a tip?
translation: 毕竟，我总得存点钱，才能买张票离开这里，对吧？怎么样？要情报吗？

original: No, you could make a real difference.
translation: 不，你应该有所作为。

original: You really think so, pal? I'll start looking into it. I bet I can help a lot of people around here.
translation: 你真这么想啊，朋友？这我可得好好考虑一下。我应该能帮到这里不少人。

original: Now you'll get some respect. You should give some hell to the people that used to push you around.
translation: 应该让自己先出人头地。然后找到当初那些对你无礼的人，把他们狠狠教训一顿。

original: Yeah... yeah, that's a good idea. They'll learn that shouldn't have messed with me. Just wait till they get what's coming to them!
translation: 是啊……是啊，这是个好主意。一定要让他们悔不当初。那些人就等着遭报应吧！

original: Good for you. No one should have to be afraid all the time.
translation: 你做的对。没有人应该永远活在恐惧中。

original: Unfortunately, it comes with the territory around here. But being afraid sucks, no doubt about it.
translation: 可惜的是，这附近的环境就很让人恐惧。不过老活在恐惧中是没好处，这点毫无疑问。

original: Oh, hey, I almost forgot to tell you I heard a few things you might be interested in.
translation: 哦，嘿，差点忘了告诉你，我又打听到一些消息，也许你会感兴趣。

original: I'm kind of sorry about this, but I'm going to have to up my price to 100 caps per tip from now on.
translation: 虽然有点儿过意不去，不过从现在起，每条情报得收你100个瓶盖啦。

original: It's getting tougher to discover new things that might interest a traveler such as yourself. I'm sure you understand. So, you interested or what?
translation: 毕竟你们这些旅行者越来越难伺候了，我四处搜罗新鲜事也很辛苦啊。希望你能理解。那么，你感兴趣吗？

original: Whoa, now. Watch where you point that thing. It's dangerous.
translation: 哇，这玩意小心点，别指着人，很危险的。

original: Dangerous... I like that. Maybe it's time people starting being afraid of me rather than the other way around.
translation: 危险……我喜欢。也该让人们对我有所忌惮了，否则他们会得寸进尺的。

original: Oh yeah, I wanted to tell you that I got some new info for you. Each tip's gonna cost 100 caps now though.
translation: 哦，对了，我刚想告诉你，我手上有些新情报。只不过每条都得收100个瓶盖。

original: Cause I got plans. Big plans. So what do you say? Want a tip?
translation: 因为我可是有计划的，大计划。怎么样？感兴趣么？

original: I want to ask you general questions.
translation: 有些普通的问题想问问你。

original: Let me ask you more about you and Vault 21.
translation: 我还得再问一些关于你和21号避难所的问题。

original: Mr. House won't give you any more trouble. I took care of that.
translation: 豪斯不会再找你麻烦了。我把他除掉了。

original: {Incredulous}Do you mean that he's a goner? I can have my Vault back?
translation: 你是说……他已经死了？我可以收回我的避难所了？

original: {Celebratory}That's just super! I thought we'd never see a different New Vegas, one that belongs to the people.
translation: 这真是太棒了！我从没想过我们可以见到这样一个新维加斯——一个属于人民的新维加斯！

original: But not to me. I'll sever your head and carry it with me always - a message to would-be traitors.
translation: 可惜对我没用。我会把你的脑袋剁下来带在身上——好给那些企图叛变的家伙提个醒。

original: No! Stay away from me!
translation: 不！离我远点！

original: Very well. I'll try and help you.
translation: 很好，我会想法子帮你的。

original: I knew you'd be reasonable. Now... how did you find me? Did the officer send you?
translation: 我就知道你是个讲道理的人。对了……你是怎么找到我的？是那个军官派你来的？

original: [Attack] Caesar's laws are absolute. He does not grant exceptions.
translation: [攻击] 凯撒的律法神圣不可侵犯。没有例外。

original: Then he's a fool!
translation: 那他真是蠢货！

original: I'm with the Legion. I'm here to kill you before you talk.
translation: 我是军团的人，我的任务就是让你永远闭嘴。

original: What? No! Listen, Caesar's secrets are safe with me. I stayed alive because Caesar would've wanted it. I'm useless to him dead.
translation: 什么？不！听着，我一直严格保守着凯撒的秘密。我之所以活着，也是凯撒的意思。我死了对他没有好处。

original: So you want me to do what you can't.
translation: 所以你才想请我去做你做不到的事。

original: I think if you rough him up enough and really put some fear into him, he'll sing like a choir boy.
translation: 我觉得你只要跟他来点硬的，唬唬他，马上就能让他老实。

original: So let's do this. When you're ready, I'll go in and give you a little intro. Then I leave the room and you make him regret the day he was born.
translation: 要不这样好了。等你准备好，我就进去给你做番介绍。然后怎么办就全看你了，总之你一定得想办法让他痛不欲生。

original: We go back and forth a couple of times until either he talks or he can't move his jaw anymore. Either way we've had our entertainment for the day.
translation: 我们就这么反复几次，直到这小子招了为止，要么就让他连嘴都张不开。不管他招不招，我们今天都算是找到乐子了。

original: What do you think it means?
translation: 你认为这是什么意思？

original: Well, I don't know about you, but to me that sounds like a man who's willing to cooperate. Except he hasn't.
translation: 呃，我不知道你怎么想，但在我看来，这家伙也许是愿意合作。可他到目前都没有这个意向。

original: Only times he speaks up are to insult you. He's a real prick, by the way. And I'm supposed to get information out of this guy.
translation: 他一直在不停地骂人。说实在的，他绝对是个硬茬。可我现在却偏要从这硬茬子的嘴里撬出几句有用的话来。

original: Is that a big deal?
translation: 这很重要吗？

original: Better believe it. Everybody, everybody in Caesar's Legion from Caesar on down will kill themselves before they can be captured.
translation: 说来你可能不信。每一个凯撒军团的成员，每一个，上至凯撒本人，下至无名小卒，都是宁死不降的。

original: They're so twitchy they'd probably do it if you reached out to hug them.
translation: 他们可敏感了，哪怕你上前拥抱他们，都有可能让他们立刻拔剑自刎。

original: But here's this guy who's an elite commander in their army and he just gives himself up, even as his men are slitting their own throats around him.
translation: 不过里边这位仁兄，身为凯撒手下的精锐指挥官，居然缴械投降了。要知道，他的士兵们全都亲手割断了自己的喉咙。

original: Would you be willing to give me the control tower access key so I can check it out?
translation: 你能把控制塔的进门口令给我，好让我进去查看一下吗？

original: Sure, if you want to investigate. It's not like there's anything to steal up there. Just a bunch of old communications equipment.
translation: 如果你真想调查的话，那当然可以。反正里面也没什么可偷的，就是一堆老式通讯设备。

original: If you can find out any more, I'd be interested to hear it.
translation: 要是你还能找到别的东西，那我倒是要洗耳恭听了。

original: There's something about this I really don't like, and if I weren't tied up here I'd be staking it out personally.
translation: 这儿有些东西我实在看不惯，要不是我走不开，早就自己去追查这件事了。

original: Anyone else missing?
translation: 还有谁失踪了吗？

original: Yeah. The man I'm more interested in is Corporal White.
translation: 是的。我比较关心的是怀特下士的下落。

original: White had a lot of promise. Wanted to be a ranger as bad as anyone I've seen. But he also had some extracurricular activities going. Now he's gone.
translation: 怀特是个很有前途的家伙。他极其渴望成为一名游骑兵，都快想疯了。不过这家伙也做过一些不合规矩的举动，现在他失踪了。

original: <Continue Listening>
translation: <继续倾听>

original: I haven't breathed a word about the officer we planted here - he continues to radio intelligence to Caesar's camp nearly every night.
translation: 我还没说我们安插在这儿的那位军官呢——他几乎每晚都会用无线电向凯撒的营地传递情报。

original: I've proven my loyalty. All you're doing is killing a loyal soldier. If that's Caesar's policy, then I say his empire will crumble.
translation: 我已经证明了我的忠诚。你们这样做是在残害一名忠诚的士兵。如果这真是凯撒的旨意，那我只能说，他的帝国行将就木了。

original: <Continue Listening>
translation: <继续倾听>

original: Time was essential for my mission, but we waited three days for him to dispatch us. Another of his headaches. Does that sound like a man in command?
translation: 时间对我的任务来说至关重要，可我们足足等了三天才等到他的调令。又是借口头疼，这还像是个指挥官吗？

original: He has an operative planted in this very base, but does he use his agent to rescue me? No.
translation: 其实他在这基地里安插了一名密探，可他派那间谍来救我了吗？没有。

original: He's content to have the agent spend his nights radioing troop positions back to our base camp. He knows I'm here, and he's left me to rot.
translation: 他只会命令那个间谍整晚用电台向他通报敌人的动向。他知道我在这儿，却始终不闻不问。

original: Let's discuss something else.
translation: 咱们谈点别的吧。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: So where do I find his footlocker?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到他的脚柜？

original: His footlocker is in the barracks in the main concourse.
translation: 他的脚柜就在主厅的营房里。

original: Is that everything?
translation: 就这些了吗？

original: Report him to Colonel Hsu. Do all that and we should be free and clear.
translation: 还要去向许上校告发他。等这些都做完，咱们就万事大吉了。

original: Oh, and Crenshaw should be dead before you report him. Don't leave any chance for him to deny the bombings. Let's say he pulled a gun on you.
translation: 哦，对了，在你告发他之前，一定要先把他做了。不要给他任何辩解的机会。就说他拿枪顶在你头上好了。

original: I've got him on guard duty patrolling the tarmac just inside the south gate. And I reassigned the other guard, so he should be alone.
translation: 我已经安排他到南门的停机坪附近巡逻。另外一个守卫我也换掉了，所以他执勤时应该是独自一人。

original: What do I do when I'm at the train?
translation: 我上了火车以后该怎么做？

original: Put the bomb in one of the vents inside the train on the back wall, towards the joint that connects the cars.  Arm it, and get out of there.
translation: 把炸弹安到车厢尾部连接处的一座通风口里。启动炸弹，然后下车走人。

original: I've also left some bomb ingredients in with the explosives. You are to take those to the footlocker of a Private Crenshaw.
translation: 我还留了些制作炸弹的原料，就和炸弹放在一起。你可以把那些东西丢进列兵克伦肖的脚柜。

original: Crenshaw's a problem child. Lots of run-ins with his superiors. It'll be easy for them to believe he's working for the Legion.
translation: 克伦肖是个问题儿童，曾多次顶撞上司。所以他们很容易就会相信他是军团的卧底。

original: Where should I start?
translation: 我该从哪儿开始？

original: You want my advice, start by talking to people with a lot of eyes in the field. People like Lieutenant Boyd, or Sergeant Contreras, maybe.
translation: 我个人建议，你可以先去找消息比较灵通的人士。比如博伊德中尉，或是孔特雷拉斯中士。

original: Careful with Contreras, though. He's not above suspicion himself.
translation: 不过你要小心孔特雷拉斯。他自己都有些形迹可疑。

original: Keep me apprised of any leads you get. This guy's gotten a lot of my men killed. I'm just itching to return the favor.
translation: 如果发现任何线索，记得一定要向我报告。这个奸细害我损失了不少手下，我正想着该怎么好好报答他呢。

original: So what's the plan?
translation: 那么计划是什么？

original: All right, forget about blaming Crenshaw. Just bomb the monorail.
translation: 好吧，栽赃给克伦肖的事情就算了。把单轨列车炸掉就行了。

original: Without a fall guy, it's dangerous for us to be seen together. We shouldn't speak again.
translation: 没了替罪羊，以后要是再被人看到我们在一起就危险了。所以你别再和我说话了。

original: If you believe in the Legion's cause, your mission is a reward in and of itself. Good luck.
translation: 如果你真的忠于军团，那这项任务本身就是对你最好的嘉奖。祝你好运。

original: Where does that leave you?
translation: 你们现在情况如何？

original: Now we're trying to secure the Strip and the Dam at the same time, and it's costing us.
translation: 我们目前得同时兼顾长街和水坝两边的防务，压力非常大。

original: And in the meantime General Oliver won't approve any offensive maneuvers because he doesn't want to risk losing our positions.
translation: 此外，奥利弗将军还不同意我们主动进攻，因为他害怕会丢掉我们好不容易才取得的优势。

original: So we're in a holding pattern here. And Caesar's on the other side of the river, planning.
translation: 所以现在我们完全施展不开手脚。凯撒却在河对岸谋划着新一轮行动。

original: Any other problems?
translation: 还有什么问题？

original: Yeah. On top of everything else, I can't send a patrol on a bathroom break without it being ambushed by someone who heard they were coming.
translation: 有的。最首要的问题就是，我现在都不敢让巡逻队休息，因为他们哪怕是上个厕所的功夫，都会遭遇伏击。

original: So somebody's getting the word out.
translation: 肯定是有人走漏了情报。

original: What challenges does the NCR face here?
translation: NCR在这里面临的困难是什么？

original: Everything was going according to President Kimball's plan at first. We met minor resistance from local troublemakers.
translation: 起初一切都按照金博尔总统的战略顺利进行。我们只遭遇到了本地一些顽固分子的零星抵抗。

original: But our two main objectives are still contested. Mr. House controls the Strip and he won't so much as meet with our ambassador.
translation: 可现在我们却面临着两大无从化解的难题。豪斯先生控制着长街，但他却连我们的大使都不愿意见。

original: And we're holding Hoover Dam, but Caesar's Legion is positioning itself to overrun it. If it falls, so will New Vegas. We'd be forced to withdraw.
translation: 同时，虽然胡佛水坝处于我们的掌控之下，但凯撒军团却一直在调集兵力想要冲垮我们。如果那里失守了，新维加斯也一样保不住。到时我们就只能被迫撤离。

original: Are things mostly quiet between here and the Dam?
translation: 营地和水坝那边的情况都还好吧？

original: Unfortunately, no. In fact, the word from the Ranger stations has been especially concerning lately.
translation: 很遗憾，并不好。事实上，最近从各家游骑兵驻站传来的消息很是让人担忧。

original: It sounds like they've run into overwhelming resistance, and supplies just aren't reaching them.
translation: 他们似乎遭遇了非常顽强的抵抗，而且一直都没得到补给。

original: It's been so bad I asked Sergeant Reyes at Camp Forlorn Hope to look into it and see how it is that things could be so fouled up there.
translation: 情况简直糟糕透顶。我已经让飘零希望营地的雷耶斯军士前去调查，看看到底是什么原因让我们落到这步田地。

original: What's Camp McCarran's role in NCR operations?
translation: 麦卡伦营地在NCR的战略里扮演着怎样的角色？

original: It's our main base. We took it because it lets us keep an eye on the Strip. And it had already been fortified before the Great War.
translation: 它是我们的大本营。我们选择麦卡伦是因为从这里可以监视长街的情况。而且机场在大战之前就已经修筑了防御工事。

original: From here we handle most of the logistics for our operations in Nevada. Troop allocation, supply distribution, intel.
translation: 大部分内华达驻军的后勤工作都是由这里进行指挥的。包括兵力调遣，补给分配以及情报交换。

original: Usually General Oliver runs the show here, but he's on his way to the Dam now, so I've taken on a lot of his duties here.
translation: 通常大本营的事务是由奥利弗将军主持，但现在他要去协防水坝，所以大部分工作都交由我暂时代理。

original: Seen anything suspicious lately?
translation: 最近见过可疑的人吗？

original: You mean other than some stranger with no military ID interrogating me inside our base?
translation: 你指的是某个明明没有军人身份，却跑到基地里来盘问我的陌生人吗？

original: Did Boyd put you up to this? I am so sick of this harassment. You tell her to stop wasting my time with this bullshit.
translation: 是博伊德派你来的？我真是受够了这种骚扰。你告诉她，别再用这些狗屁来浪费我的时间了。

original: No. I haven't seen anything suspicious. It's been business as usual.
translation: 没有，我没见过任何可疑的事情。我只是正常做生意而已。

original: I heard a rumor that there's something between you and the Van Graffs. What happened?
translation: 我听说你和范格拉夫家族之间有过节，发生什么事了？

original: Pfff, that's old news. I had some fun with that girl that runs their operation, and then I got tired of her. So I moved on.
translation: 嘁，都是些陈芝麻烂谷子事了。我和他们老板娘处过一段时间，后来我倦了，就分手了。

original: She don't like that, see? Normally, I bet she'd just have a guy killed for doing that, but as you can see, I'm still around.
translation: 可能她对此怀恨在心吧？要换做别人，也许早就被她给宰了，但你也看到了，我现在还活着呢。

original: Most people think it's cause she doesn't want to start an all-out war with us, but that ain't it at all. She's still got it bad for me.
translation: 人们都以为她没动手是因为不想和我们硬碰硬，但其实还有别的原因。她依然对我有意思。

original: Don't the Kings run this place, though?
translation: 这地方难道不是猫王帮在掌管吗？

original: We do what we want, just like everybody else. We just have more guys, so other people tend to do what we want, too.
translation: 我们也和其他人一样，随心所欲，自由自在。只不过我们人数比较多，所以其他人自然就顺着我们了。

original: If somebody does something we don't like, we let them know about it. If they're strong enough not to care about us liking it, good for them.
translation: 如果有人和我们唱反调，我们会让他们懂点规矩。如果他们足够强大，可以不用再管我们，也算他们走运。

original: What about crime?
translation: 那犯罪怎么办？

original: What about it? Someone takes your stuff, you're free to take it back. If you can't, maybe you shouldn't have come to Freeside in the first place.
translation: 犯罪？别人拿了你的东西，你再拿回来就是了。如果你没这个本事，那你最好也别来自由城。

original: I'm trying to get to the Strip. Know anything that could help me out?
translation: 我想去长街。你能不能给我指条明路？

original: You're looking to get past those tin cans at the gate, right? They let people by all the time, if they've got the caps.
translation: 你是想绕过那些把守大门的铁皮罐头吧？其实只要你有瓶盖，他们是不会阻拦你的。

original: But if you're not rich, and I can tell you ain't, the King might be able to help you out, provided he likes you.
translation: 可如果你很穷——我也看得出你穷——也许猫王可以帮你，但前提是他得喜欢你。

original: How did you join the Kings?
translation: 你是怎么加入猫王帮的？

original: I didn't join the Kings. I helped start the Kings. This whole operation you see here was put together by the King and yours truly.
translation: 我没有加入猫王帮，而是协助创立了猫王帮。这里的一切都是猫王和本大爷我白手起家奋斗来的。

original: What can you tell me about the Kings?
translation: 你能和我介绍下猫王帮吗？

original: Not much to tell. We're a bunch of guys that just want to do our own thing, and anyone who's got a problem with that can shove it.
translation: 没什么好说的。我们只是一群喜欢自由自在的人罢了。对此有意见的人，可以滚边儿去。

original: Tell me about Freeside.
translation: 跟我说说自由城吧。

original: It ain't much to look at, but this dump has something that even the Strip doesn't, and that's absolute freedom.
translation: 没什么可说的，但这破地方有样东西是长街所没有的，那就是绝对的自由。

original: You go other places, and there's always someone screaming at you to act a certain way, or to not do certain things.
translation: 你去别的地方，总会有人冲着你嚷嚷，要你做这个，或者不许你做那个。

original: Freeside's not like that. Everyone here is free to do whatever they want, and I for one wouldn't want it any other way.
translation: 但自由城却不同。每个人都可以随心所欲，我希望这样的生活能永远持续下去。

original: I'm looking to score some Med-X. Can you help?
translation: 我正在收购吗啡针-X。你能帮忙吗？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: You know where to find me.
translation: 你知道在哪里能找到我。

original: I hear you spend most of your caps on Sweetie.
translation: 我听说你把大部分瓶盖都花在了小甜甜身上。

original: That's private. I don't go asking about how you like to get laid, and I don't wanna know. Enough of that.
translation: 这是私事。我又不会去问你平常是怎么和人嘿咻的，而且我也没兴趣知道。你说够了吧。

original: Tell me about Dermot, your partner.
translation: 和我说说你搭档德莫特。

original: {unstable and not especially bright}What do you even mean? He's Dermot.
translation: {unstable and not especially bright}你什么意思？他可是德莫特。

original: Dermot knows how to work salvage than any man I ever met. Doesn't go asking questions all day, neither.
translation: 德莫特比我遇到过的任何人都懂得收拾废品。他也不会整天问问题。

original: I found this teddy bear in your partner's room. Strange, don't you think?
translation: 我在你搭档的房间发现了这只泰迪熊。你不觉得很奇怪吗？

original: I know what you and your partner have been up to - I got the evidence from your rooms.
translation: 我知道你和你搭档在做肮脏的勾当，我在你的房间找到了证据。

original: You're right about that. {shouting for your partner, starting combat} Saint James! Got a thief here!
translation: 你说对了。{shouting for your partner, starting combat}圣詹姆斯！这儿有个贼！

original: I hear you and your partner are coyotes.
translation: 我听说你和你搭档在做蛇头。

original: Don't believe everything you hear. Me and Saint James earn our caps working salvage.
translation: 不要信那些话。我和圣詹姆斯都靠捡破烂维持生计。

original: It's hard work, so when I'm not working I like to relax. Which means it's time for you to fuck off.
translation: 工作很累人，没干活的时候，我就需要休息。我说这句话的意思，就是你该滚蛋了。

original: Like I told you, we work salvage. We aren't coyotes. And like I told you, fuck off.
translation: 我跟你说了，我们只捡垃圾，我们不是蛇头。不用我再说一遍吧，给我滚。

original: Why is your partner called Saint James?
translation: 为什么你的搭档被叫做圣詹姆斯？

original: {'Cause}Because it's his name. He may be high-strung, but he's all right. Hauls his half of scrap, which is all I need.
translation: {'Cause}因为那是他的本名。虽然他神经过敏，但人不错。只要他能把那一半破烂拉回来，对我来说就够了。

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: Me and my partner Saint James work salvage around Westside, that's all.
translation: 我和我的搭档圣詹姆斯在西区附近捡破烂，就这些。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: See you.
translation: 回头见。

original: <200 caps needed> I'm kind of short on caps right now.
translation: <需要200瓶盖> 我现在没有足够的瓶盖。

original: No freebies, Sugar. Not even for you.
translation: 白嫖可不行，帅哥。哪怕是你也一样。

original: Not interested.
translation: 没兴趣。

original: {Male PC}You can play hard-to-get. I understand. I know the game.
translation: {Male PC}想玩欲擒故纵啊。我懂的。我知道游戏规则。

original: {Female PC}Oh honey, I know you're interested. I just don't go that way is all.
translation: {Female PC}哦，甜心，我知道你感兴趣。可惜我没法奉陪啊。

original: <200 caps> Let's do it.
translation: <200瓶盖>来吧。

original: Oh, we will, sugar. We will.
translation: 喔，当然，宝贝。当然。

original: I'll do my best to live up to my last performance.
translation: 我会尽量表现得和上次一样好的。

original: How much for your services?
translation: 你的服务要多少钱？

original: {Male PC}A pittance, sugar - and I'll leave you without a care in the world.
translation: {Male PC}用不了几个钱的，帅哥。我会让你乐不思蜀的。

original: {Female PC}Sorry, ma'am, but ain't enough caps in all of New Vegas to make me do that. Nuh-uh.
translation: {Female PC}抱歉，女士，就算你把整个新维加斯的瓶盖全都拿出来，我也不会干的。不行。

original: {Male PC}Same price as before, sugar, and the same fun, too.
translation: {Male PC}和以前一样，帅哥，乐趣不减哦。

original: {disgusted by memory of having sex with a woman}I told you, I ain't ever doing that again - ever. It was like being a slave all over again.
translation: {disgusted by memory of having sex with a woman}我告诉过你，我再也不会做这种事了，再也不会。感觉我又变成了奴隶。

original: Tell me about Pretty Sarah.
translation: 你觉得美人萨拉怎么样？

original: She's an honest woman. Splits the earnings fair, and keeps Sweetie and Maude in line.
translation: 她是个正直的女人。给的提成很公道，小甜甜和莫德也被她管得服服帖帖。

original: Minds her own business, too. She knows what it's like for people to go through things they'd rather not talk about.
translation: 从不多管闲事。她知道人们都不愿过多谈及那些不堪回首的往事。

original: That's quite a story, Jimmy.
translation: 真是跌宕起伏的人生啊，吉米。

original: Yeah, I lived through it. I like it here better.
translation: 是啊，但我挺过来了。我更喜欢这儿。

original: Sounds like life in the Legion is tough.
translation: 听起来你在军团的日子过得很艰难。

original: It's tough on both sides of the fence, really. I think women have it worse. They're like money, given as rewards. {Shakes head}Breeding stock.
translation: 事实上营地内外都很艰难。女人的情况更糟。她们就像货币，是用来赏赐的奖品。 {Shakes head}好比育种的牲口。

original: Honestly, as long as men meet obligations and the child count, "friendships" are a sight more equal than the level of most Legion husbands and wives.
translation: 说实话，只要男人有责任感，知道照顾孩子，就连"友谊"都比大多数军团夫妻的关系都要平等。

original: I hear you were a slave of Caesar's Legion.
translation: 我听说你以前是凯撒军团的一个奴隶。

original: What Marco said is true. The Legion attacked my village when I was 16.
translation: 马可没说错。军团在我十六岁那年劫掠了我的村庄。

original: My parents were killed as examples. The rest of us, chained and dragged to some kind of camp. A Centurion there chose me as his tent servant.
translation: 我的父母成了杀鸡儆猴的牺牲品。而我们剩下的人则被拖枷带锁送到了一个营地。有个百夫长挑了我去他的营帐里当仆人。

original: He was handsome, and gentle, most of the time. Said it was our secret, and he'd protect me. Gave me little gifts, stupid things.
translation: 他很英俊，多数时候也很温柔。他说这是我们两人之间的秘密，他会保护我。还经常送给我些小礼物之类的。

original: But Caesar punishes homosexuality with death, and we nearly got caught, and there were suspicions. So when he took me out into the desert...
translation: 但凯撒对同性恋严惩不贷，我们差点被逮到，周围的人也起了疑心。后来他就带着我逃进了沙漠……

original: Well, I knew he was going to get rid of me. So I kicked him where it counts and I ran. And then swam. And ran some more. Wound up here.
translation: 呵，我知道他其实是想除掉我，于是我一脚踢中他的要害，然后撒腿就跑。我游了好远，又拼命地跑。之后就到了这儿。

original: Baby, who I am doesn't matter. I'll be anybody you need me to be. It's better that way, you'll see.
translation: 宝贝，我是谁无关紧要，只要你喜欢，我可以是任何身份。这样更好，你会明白的。

original: I'm just a fantasy come to life. But you already knew that.
translation: 我只是个传说罢了。不过你已经知道了。

original: Been working here long?
translation: 你在这里工作很久了吗？

original: Half a year or so. The Casa's a dump and Marco's a pig, but Pretty Sarah makes sure I don't get hassled.
translation: 差不多半年了。这地方就是个垃圾堆，马可是头猪，但美人萨拉会保护我不受骚扰。

original: I don't get as many customers as Sweetie or Maude. But the customers I do get always come back.
translation: 我的顾客虽然没有小甜甜或者莫德那么多。但全都是回头客。

original: I found this teddy bear in Saint James's room.
translation: 我在圣詹姆斯的房间找到了这个泰迪熊。

original: Do you know Saint James?
translation: 你认识圣詹姆斯吗？

original: Sure do. Saint James is my number one customer. He's a prospector who pays Marco to stay here at the Casa week to week.
translation: 当然认识。圣詹姆斯是我的头号贵宾。他是个淘金客，就住在这里，每周都会付给马可房钱。

original: I don't know why his friend Dermot chose to stay here - he's never been with me or nobody else. But Saint James likes having me close at hand.
translation: 我不知道为什么他和他朋友非得住在这儿——他从来没跟我或者任何人谈起过。但圣詹姆斯喜欢接近我。

original: No thanks.
translation: 不了，谢谢。

original: Fine by me. You the one missing out on exciting details.
translation: 无所谓，反正错过精彩部分的人是你。

original: I don't have 200 caps.
translation: 我没有200瓶盖。

original: Then I guess there's no need for us to keep talking, honey. Sorry.
translation: 那咱们也没必要谈下去了，甜心。对不起了。

original: All right. 200 caps it is.
translation: 好吧。这是200个瓶盖。

original: Saint James has problems, that's for sure. Never wants me to say a thing, or for me to move around, either.
translation: 毫无疑问，圣詹姆斯有问题。他什么都不让我说，也不喜欢我四处乱动。

original: Lately he brings a teddy bear with him and props it on the bed like it's watching us. It's creepy as hell.
translation: 最近他带了一只泰迪熊，还把它支在床边，好像时刻都盯着我们似的。实在太渗人了。

original: Not the worst I ever been with, but more a pervert than most.
translation: 虽然我见过比这还恐怖的景象，但他的病态程度也足以胜过多数人了。

original: All right. 200 caps it is.
translation: 好吧。这是200个瓶盖。

original: < Barter 30 >
[SUCCEEDED] {mischievous}Funny how I make caps every time I open my mouth.
translation: [成功] {mischievous}真有意思，每次我只要动动嘴，就能赚到瓶盖。

original: Saint James has problems, that's for sure. Never wants me to say a thing, or for me to move around, either.
translation: 毫无疑问，圣詹姆斯有问题。他什么都不让我说，也不喜欢我四处乱动。

original: Lately he brings a teddy bear with him and props it on the bed like it's watching us. It's creepy as hell.
translation: 最近他带了一只泰迪熊，还把它支在床边，好像时刻都盯着我们似的。实在太渗人了。

original: Not the worst I ever been with, but more a pervert than most.
translation: 虽然我见过比这还恐怖的景象，但他的病态程度足以胜过大多数人了。

original: Let's say 100 caps. Or you could earn zero keeping your mouth shut.
translation: 100个瓶盖足够了。如果你不说，你就什么也得不到。

original: [FAILED] {unimpressed}I'll leave it. You can leave, too.
translation: [失败] {unimpressed}那我不要也罢。你可以走了。

original: 100 caps. Take it or leave it.
translation: 100瓶盖。其余免谈。

original: Does Saint James pay you for anything "unusual"?
translation: 圣詹姆斯有没有让你提供过"特殊"的服务？

original: A client's got a right to privacy. So it'll cost 200 caps for me to tell you all about it.
translation: 我的客人理应享有隐私权。想让我告诉你，就拿200瓶盖来。

original: Like I said - 200 caps to hear all about it.
translation: 我说过，只要200瓶盖，你就知道一切。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Keep telling yourself that, sugar. You'll be back.
translation: 别再抵挡了，甜心。你迟早会回来的。

original: <300 caps needed> I don't have enough on me right now...
translation: <需要300个瓶盖> 我现在身上没带够钱……

original: Then I guess you won't be getting on me, either. Improve your prospects and come back, sugar. I'll be waiting.
translation: 那看来你也无福享受我的温存了。等你飞黄腾达了再回来吧，甜心。我会等着你的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: You know you'll be back.
translation: 你肯定会流连忘返的。

original: <300 caps> Here's your money.
translation: <300瓶盖> 这是给你的钱。

original: Get ready, honey. I'm going to make it good for you.
translation: 准备好了，甜心。我会让你飘飘欲仙的。

original: {mischievous - she's what the player will be slipping into}Let me help you slip into something a little more comfortable.
translation: {mischievous - she's what the player will be slipping into}让我来教你怎样会更舒服一些吧。

original: I am going to make your toes curl, baby.
translation: 我会让你激情难耐的，宝贝。

original: So get on the bed already. I got something to show you.
translation: 乖乖躺到床上去吧，我来给你展示一番。

original: How much does it cost to hire you?
translation: 和你睡一晚需要多少钱？

original: It's worth every cap, baby. I'll do things to you you didn't think was possible, and leave you feeling like everything's right in the world.
translation: 我保证你能值回票价，宝贝。哪怕你觉得不可能的事，我也能做，我会让你觉得世间万物是如此畅快。

original: I'm not surprised. Whip out your caps and away we go.
translation: 不出我所料。把瓶盖掏出来，咱们就办正事。

original: Same price as before, baby, and worth every little cap.
translation: 跟以前一个价，宝贝，保证不会浪费你一枚瓶盖的。

original: Wouldn't you make more money working on the Strip?
translation: 你难道不想去长街工作，多赚些钱？

original: I got my start at the Gomorrah, good money, but I saw how those Omertas hook girls on free Jet or Med-X - then start charging.
translation: 我开始在蛾摩拉干过，收入不错，但我发现黑手党会利用免费的杰特和吗啡引诱那些女孩，再开始向她们收钱。

original: Slavery through a needle is what that is. I earn less out here, but I keep more.
translation: 在潜移默化中奴役她们，这就是蛾摩拉的阴谋。我虽然在这里挣得少，但我存的多。

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: I'm called Sweetie because I'm the sweetest piece you'll find anywhere outside of the Strip. I could work in those casinos if I wanted.
translation: 我叫小甜甜，因为我是你在长街外能找到的最甜美的女人。其实只要我愿意，我完全可以留在赌场里工作。

original: You work for Pretty Sarah?
translation: 你为美人萨拉工作？

original: I bring in the customers, and she makes sure no one gets rough. Sarah's good people. Good enough, anyway.
translation: 我负责拉顾客，她则负责把大家都伺候好。萨拉是个好人，真的够好了。

original: Tell me about Pretty Sarah.
translation: 和我说说美人萨拉。

original: Ain't so pretty, is she? Not since she had a run-in with those Fiends over near McCarran.{Ha!}
translation: 其实并不算美人，对吧？她在麦卡伦附近遇到了恶魔帮，之后就变成了现在这副模样。 {Ha!}

original: This Fiend named Cook-Cook on account of the flamethrower he wears? He had his way with Sarah, every way it can be done.
translation: 恶魔帮有个叫大厨库克的，因为背着个喷火器而叫这个名字。他把萨拉当玩具一样，所有花样都玩过了。

original: Then he starts frying her up for kicks. Guess it was how he signed his work. {Ha!}
translation: 后来他腻了，就开始拿火烧她。估计他就是用这种方式在自己的杰作上签名的。

original: Take a look at this ledger I found in Dermot's room.
translation: 你看看我在德莫特的房间里找到的这个账本吧。

original: I'll take a look, but you better have a good reason for asking me to violate his privacy.
translation: 我会看的，但你最好能给我一个充分点的理由，这可是在侵犯他人的隐私啊。

original: {mounting fury}What?... Those bastards! Selling folks off to the Fiends? Selling children - to Cook-Cook...?
translation: {mounting fury}什么？……那些混蛋！居然把人卖给恶魔帮？把孩子卖给——大厨库克？

original: {Resolving to kill them.}I've seen enough. They're done for, both of them.
translation: {Resolving to kill them.}我看不下去了。他们完了，他们俩都完了。

original: {Cook-Cook dead}You might be interested to know that I killed a fiend named Cook-Cook.
translation: {Cook-Cook dead}我杀掉了恶魔帮一个叫大厨库克的，你应该会感兴趣吧。

original: You did? Well, that's one hell of a service to humanity, then.
translation: 真的吗？那可真是件造福全人类的大好事啊。

original: I guess I always thought maybe I'd be the one to do it, but I just... never got my nerve up.
translation: 我一直也想这么做，但我始终都没办法……鼓起勇气。

original: Maybe I'll sleep good tonight... {deciding not to share details}Here, take this. It's how I say thanks.
translation: 或许我今晚终于能睡个好觉了……{deciding not to share details}给你，拿着吧。权当是表达我的谢意。

original: How did you get burned so badly?
translation: 你怎么烧伤的这么严重？

original: We don't talk about that. Next topic.
translation: 我们不谈这个。下一个话题。

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: I look after the only reasons anyone would want to spend any time here. I'm a pimp.
translation: 我的工作就是想方设法把客人拉到店里来消费。我是个皮条客。

original: All Marco does is collect rent and take a small cut of my action. He sure as hell doesn't clean the rooms.
translation: 而马可只负责收租，以及从我这儿领取分红。他从来都不会打扫房间。

original: I look after the only reasons anyone would want to spend any time here. I'm a pimp.
translation: 我的工作就是想方设法把客人拉到店里来消费。我是个皮条客。

original: Now that Marco's no longer around, I guess it's up to me to collect rent, too.
translation: 如今马可已经不在了，估计得由我自己去收租了。

original: I'm interested in learning more about Dermot and Saint James.
translation: 我有兴趣多了解一些德莫特和圣詹姆斯的事。

original: They don't look like much, but they earn a pretty good living by selling scrap and salvage.
