original: To name a few things off the top of my head - expand his borders, get the NCR and Legion to wipe each other out, and seize Hoover Dam.
translation: 我能想到的就是——扩张他的地盘，让NCR和军团斗个两败俱伤，然后他再来占领大坝，坐收渔翁之利。

original: Any other questions?
translation: 还有其他问题吗？

original: I wanted to ask you some questions.
translation: 我想问你一些问题。

original: Very well, but be brief.
translation: 很好，但长话短说。

original: What if I can convince them not to join the Legion?
translation: 如果我能说服他们不加入军团呢？

original: Don't fool yourself. I've dealt with enough of these gangs to know that they can't be trusted. Was there anything else?
translation: 别说蠢话了。我跟这些家伙打的交道够多了，他们根本不可信。还有其他事吗？

original: Where should I start looking for them?
translation: 我应该从哪儿开始找他们？

original: As I said, our scouts were some ways west of HELIOS when they disappeared.
translation: 就像我所说的，我们的侦察兵是在太阳神一号西边失踪的。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: What kind of weapons do they use?
translation: 他们用的是什么武器？

original: Their standard kit seems to be a blade of some sort and light armor. Guns are not uncommon, but are of questionable condition.
translation: 他们的制式装备似乎是某种利刃和轻甲。虽然枪支并不少见，但大部分缺乏保养。

original: While they prefer to use their blades, it's common for them to scavenge better weapons from their enemies and use those.
translation: 虽然他们倾向于使用利器，但也经常使用从敌人身上掠夺来的更好的武器。

original: The men have been told to toss their weapons over the side of the dam if they receive a fatal wound, but I doubt many will remember.
translation: 我已经命令士兵们在受重伤时把武器抛下大坝了，但我很怀疑到时会有多少人记得这个命令。

original: You mentioned that they were in good shape?
translation: 你刚才说他们身材魁梧？

original: Yes, extremely so. They must use conditioning routines on par with the rangers, or better.
translation: 是的，非常强壮。他们的训练强度肯定和游骑兵差不多，甚至更严格。

original: Their soldiers can run near half again as fast as my best men, and close distances with frightening speed. And they're as strong as they are fast.
translation: 他们的士兵跑得比我身手最敏捷的士兵还快一大半，迫近的速度简直恐怖。而且他们的身体素质和他们的速度一样不得了。

original: Their superior physicality makes them extremely dangerous up close, so I've had the men run drills for taking on larger, stronger opponents.
translation: 他们优越的体格使得他们在贴身战斗中非常危险，所以我已经让士兵们在训练中以更高大、更强壮的对手作为假想敌了。

original: But they've all been instructed to take them down at range, if possible. I've made it clear I don't want any heroes in my squad, just survivors.
translation: 不过我仍然指示士兵们尽可能地在远距离干掉敌人。我清楚地告诉过他们：我的队伍里不需要英雄，只需要活人。

original: What impressed you about their discipline?
translation: 他们在纪律性这一点上给你最深的印象是什么？

original: I've never once seen a single one of them back down, or disobey an order.
translation: 我从没见过他们有人擅自后撤，或者违抗命令。

original: They'll happily charge a fortified position with little more than a sharpened stick if ordered to, and do so without hesitation.
translation: 只要接到命令，他们就会士气高昂地向整道防线发动冲锋，即便手里只有一根削尖的木棍，也不会有半点犹豫。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: I can only spare a few more moments. What did you wish to speak about?
translation: 我的时间很紧。你想说什么？

original: It's better to be in charge.
translation: 当长官总有好处。

original: Oh, it has its perks, to be sure. I'm free to see that things on a large scale are done my way, and don't have to tolerate any disagreement.
translation: 噢，会有一点特权，那是肯定的。我可以让事情在大方向上按我的设想来推进，而且不用忍受什么非议。

original: Those few people in a position to countermand my orders only care about results, and in that regard I never leave them less than pleased.
translation: 那几个有权撤销我命令的人都只关心结果，这一点上我从没让他们失望过。

original: Sounds like you miss it.
translation: 听起来你很怀念那段时光。

original: I do, sometimes. There are days I'd give anything to out in the open air, planting explosives and laying down covering fire.
translation: 是的，有时候是很怀念。那段日子，我成天都巴不得到外面去，忙着埋炸药，给战友掩护射击。

original: But here I am, stuck in the same stale office day after day, while other people get to do the actual fighting.
translation: 现在呢，别人在战场上真刀真枪搏杀的时候，我却只能日复一日地呆坐在陈腐的办公室里。

original: But enough reminiscing. Did you have other questions?
translation: 不过怀旧到此为止。你还有其他问题吗？

original: Are you in charge of the NCR around here?
translation: 你负责这一带NCR所有的事务吗？

original: I command the garrison here at the dam, yes, but Colonel {shoo}Hsu over at McCarran is technically in charge of the area's forces.
translation: 我负责指挥大坝上的守军，所以算是吧。但理论上是在麦卡伦的{shoo}许上校负责。

original: What do you know about Caesar's Legion?
translation: 你对凯撒军团有什么了解？

original: They're organized, I'll give them that. The few times I've encountered them firsthand, I've been impressed with their discipline.
translation: 要我说的话，他们组织很严密。有几次我和他们短兵相接，他们的纪律性让我印象深刻。

original: I've heard they don't allow women in their military, considering them nothing more than breeding stock.
translation: 我听说他们不允许女人参军，只把她们当成繁殖工具。

original: Their men, however, are typically quite large, in phenomenal condition, and prefer close-quarter weapons.
translation: 但是，他们的男人普遍都很魁梧强壮，而且偏好冷兵器。

original: Recent engagements have taught us to fear their shock attacks, so it's a blessing that we seem to have superior firearms.
translation: 最近的战斗更是让我们领教到了他们冲锋突击的威力，好在我们的装备比他们要精良得多。

original: What can you tell me about Hoover Dam?
translation: 能跟我说说胡佛大坝的事吗？

original: It's of immense strategic value to the NCR. Hoover Dam sends enough electricity west to light every city and major settlement.
translation: 它对NCR来说有巨大的战略价值。胡佛大坝向西输送的电力足够点亮所有的城市和定居点。

original: It's moderately defensible, with a single point of entry on the east side. To get to the power plants below, the enemy has to cross the entire top.
translation: 它只在东侧有一个入口，非常适合防守。想到达下面的电机房，敌人们必须穿过大坝顶层。

original: The Legion's tried to cross the water on a few occasions, but slow-moving boats make easy targets for sharpshooters.
translation: 军团曾经试图从水面发动进攻，但缓慢移动的船只全都成了狙击手们的活靶子。

original: How did you get to be a colonel in the NCR?
translation: 你是怎么成为NCR上校的？

original: I joined up at a young age. Was barely sixteen when I left home and volunteered to be in the military.
translation: 我很小就参军了，自愿离家入伍的时候我还不到十六岁。

original: Got a few strange looks at first, but those stopped when I got top marks across the board during training, and became an officer at seventeen.
translation: 一开始人们都对我抱有异样的眼光，但随着我在各色训练中名列前茅，那些眼光都消失了。十七岁的时候，我就当上了军官。

original: A few years went by, my squad helped take down gangs of raiders here and there, and one day an invitation to join the Rangers arrived.
translation: 随后数年间，我一直带队四处剿灭掠夺者，直到有一天我收到了加入游骑兵的邀请。

original: Those were the best years of my life. Doing something that truly matters, and having the freedom to handle it as you see fit. Then I got injured.
translation: 那是我一生中最美好的时光。我能随心所欲地按照自己的想法去做一些真正有意义的事。可惜我后来受了伤。

original: Everyone was very supportive. I received a promotion to colonel and given greater responsibility, but my days as a Ranger were over.
translation: 大家都很关照我。我被晋升为上校，担负起更加重大的责任，但游骑兵的岁月也就此终结。

original: Tell me about the NCR.
translation: 跟我说说NCR。

original: I don't have time to discuss all the different aspects of the NCR with you, but if you want it all in a nutshell - the NCR is progress.
translation: 我没时间和你细说NCR的各个方面，但我可以用一句话总结——NCR就是废土进步的方向。

original: If you wander around the wasteland you'll find all sorts of tribes, villages, and such where people spend most of their time trying to survive.
translation: 如果你在废土多走走，就会发现各种部落、村庄之类的地方，他们大部分时间都在挣扎求存。

original: The NCR gives its citizens a shot at something more. We have laws, currency, health care, government. All the things that were lost.
translation: 但NCR却能给予公民生存之外的其他东西。我们有法律、货币、医疗保障、政府。这都是人类曾经失去的东西。

original: It's not perfect, but it's worth protecting, which is why we also have the largest military in existence.
translation: 虽然还不够完美，但值得我们去保护，所以我们才同时配备了废土上规模最大的军队。

original: Not until you tell me where you get the food from.
translation: 你先告诉我这吃的是从哪里来的。

original: I have my little helpers out and about, always looking for fresh things to add to the stewpot.
translation: 我在外面有几位小帮手，他们会替我找一些新鲜的东西来烹饪。

original: You may have seen them around somewhere yourself. Now, deny your hunger no longer!
translation: 也许你已经见过他们了。所以，别再抵抗美食的诱惑了！

original: I could use some help with my reputation in Freeside.
translation: 我想找人提升下我在自由城的声望。

original: {Curious}For the right caps I might be able to put in a good word or let people know you're not such a bad guy. What do you have in mind?
translation: {Curious}价钱合适的话，我或许可以帮你美言几句，让人们知道你并没有那么坏。你觉得怎样？

original: I could use some help with my reputation in Freeside.
translation: 我想找人提升下我在自由城的声望。

original: I need people to forget about some things I've done.
translation: 我想让人们忘记我干过的坏事。

original: All right, you let your caps do the talking. How much exactly are you looking for the locals to forget?
translation: 没问题，只要花钱就行。你希望人们忘掉多少坏事？

original: Sorry, bub, but I'm fresh out of ideas. I've done all I can to scrub up your rep around here. What's done is done.
translation: 不好意思，伙计。我是黔驴技穷了。我已经想尽办法要挽回你的名声，可实在是无力回天了。

original: I want people to like me.
translation: 我要人们喜欢我。

original: All right, I can chat you up, but it is going to cost you. I'm not risking my reputation around here for nothing.
translation: 好的，我可以帮你美言几句，不过你得破点财。我可不能白白拿我的名声冒险。

original: Sorry, chum, but I've done all I can to chat you up to the locals.
translation: 抱歉，兄弟，我已经尽可能帮你说好话了。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: What do you need, then?
translation: 你有什么事？

original: <Pay 250 caps> Just a few things here and there. I'm no monster.
translation: <支付250个瓶盖> 帮个小忙，替我打点一下。我可不是坏人。

original: Very well, I'll let the townsfolk know you had your reasons, and convince them they were of the most benevolent means.
translation: 好吧，我会告诉镇上的人你也有苦衷，争取让他们网开一面。

original: Okay, I'll reassure the townies your intentions are good, but if you keep it up, they aren't going to believe me in the future.
translation: 好的，我会让镇里的人明白，你的用意是好的，不过你要是继续这样，他们以后也不会再相信我了。

original: <Pay 250 caps> Nothing big, just a few things.
translation: <支付250个瓶盖> 没什么大不了的，一些小事。

original: <Pay 500 caps> I think they may have gotten me mixed up with someone else.
translation: <支付500个瓶盖> 我想他们是把我当成别人了。

original: You've got yourself a deal. I'll let the townsfolk know some ill-tempered goon has been spreading nasty rumors about you.
translation: 成交。我会让镇上的人明白，是有卑鄙小人在暗地里散播谣言污蔑你。

original: All right, but this is the last time I can use this line with the townies. I can only discredit so many people.
translation: 好吧，但这是我最后一次用这种话糊弄镇上的居民了。我骗不了所有人。

original: <Pay 500 caps> Someone is still spreading horrible rumors about me!
translation: <支付500个瓶盖> 还有人在散播恶意中伤我的谣言！

original: <Pay 1000 caps> I must have been possessed by the Devil to have done what I did.
translation: <支付1000个瓶盖> 我做的那些事真的是鬼迷心窍了。

original: This'll take some work, but I'm sure I can convince them you were off your rocker in the past and you've changed your ways.
translation: 这事可不好办，不过我可以告诉他们，你之前精神错乱，现在已经恢复正常了。

original: However, this is a once-only affair. Screw me once, shame on you, and all that jazz.
translation: 但机会仅有一次。毕竟被骗一次算你狠，被骗两次就是蠢，道理你也懂。

original: People aren't going to believe me if you go on another spree and claim the Devil made you do it.
translation: 如果你继续乱来，人们就不会再相信我说的什么鬼上身之类的话了。

original: <Pay 250 caps> Just a few things here and there.
translation: <支付250个瓶盖> 帮个小忙。

original: Great, I'll let the townsfolk know you help old ladies across the street and do your best to keep the town clean if you notice litter.
translation: 很好，我会让镇里的人知道，你不但帮老奶奶过马路，还会清理别人乱丢的垃圾。

original: Okay, I'll tell the locals you've been keeping an eye on local thugs as a sort of neighborhood watch.
translation: 好的，我会告诉当地人，你一直在与当地的恶势力作斗争，守望他们的家园。

original: I'll see what I can do, but there isn't much more I can say about you that won't require more caps.
translation: 我看看吧，但如果你不再多加点钱的话，恐怕我也没什么可说的了。

original: <Pay 500 caps> I'm a great guy. I do my best to help those in need.
translation: <支付500个瓶盖> 我是个好人，我经常助人为乐。

original: That'll do nicely. I'll spin some stories about how you stopped a mugging or two and saved a kid's pet rat from certain doom!
translation: 酬劳正合适。我会尽量编些故事的，比如你路遇抢劫拔刀相助，还救下了一位小孩的宠物鼠！

original: Thanks, I'll spin up some tales of you slaying some nasty critters infesting some of the local homes and donating the leftovers to charity.
translation: 酬劳正合适。我会编些故事的，比如你积极帮助本地居民清除家中鼠患，还把余下来的钱捐给了慈善机构。

original: Okay, but this is the last story I can tell without a bigger risk to my rep.
translation: 好吧，但这是我最后一次帮你编故事了，再往下我的名声就要受影响了。

original: I'll tell them you took out a band of NCR raiders planning to rob locals as they left Freeside.
translation: 我会告诉他们，你消灭了一队企图从自由城逃跑的NCR掠夺者，他们正打算抢劫当地居民。

original: <Pay 500 caps> I'm a great gal. I do my best to help those in need.
translation: <支付500个瓶盖> 我是个好人，我经常助人为乐。

original: That'll do nicely. I'll spin some stories about how you stopped a mugging or two and saved a kid's pet rat from certain doom!
translation: 酬劳正合适。我会尽量编些故事的，比如你路遇抢劫拔刀相助，还救下了一位小孩的宠物鼠！

original: Thanks, I'll spin up some tales of you slaying some nasty critters infesting some of the local homes and donating the leftovers to charity.
translation: 酬劳正合适。我会编些故事的，比如你积极帮助本地居民清除家中鼠患，还把余下来的钱捐给了慈善机构。

original: Okay, but this is the last story I can tell without a bigger risk to my rep.
translation: 好吧，但这是我最后一次帮你编故事了，再往下我的名声就要受影响了。

original: I'll tell them you took out a band of NCR raiders planning to rob locals as they left Freeside.
translation: 我会告诉他们，你消灭了一队企图从自由城逃跑的NCR掠夺者，他们正打算抢劫当地居民。

original: <Pay 1000 caps> I'm a damn beacon of morality here! People should be lining up to shake my hand.
translation: <支付1000个瓶盖> 我是个道德楷模！人们应该争着排队与我握手。

original: Great, this is going to require an epic tale of heroism...
translation: 太好了，这次得编个富有传奇色彩的英雄故事才行…

original: I've got it! I'll say you slew a nest of Deathclaws living in the sewers! It was bloody work, but you waded through the pack like a man possessed!
translation: 有了！我就说你在下水道里把整整一窝死亡爪全都干掉了！过程虽然无比惨烈，但你无所畏惧，犹如天神附体！

original: Just to make this clear, I can only spin a whopper this big once. There's only so much people will believe before they see through the bullshit.
translation: 我丑话说在前头，这样的弥天大谎我只能撒一次。能上当的人也就那么多，他们迟早会看穿的。

original: I'm not interested.
translation: 我不感兴趣。

original: Suit yourself.
translation: 听你的。

original: I'm all ears.
translation: 我听着呢。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I'd like to switch to my Pip-Boy.
translation: 我想切换成哔哔小子。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: I'd like to switch to my Pimpboy.
translation: 我想切换成啪啪小子。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Why, do you have something better to do?
translation: 怎么，你还有别的事情要做？

original: {slightly offended}Hey, I was just asking. No need to get uppity about it. I'll be at the reunion, don't you worry.
translation: {slightly offended}嘿，我只是多问一句罢了。别那么性急嘛。不要担心，我会参加的。

original: I'm gathering allies - just in case.
translation: 我在找盟友——以防万一。

original: Yeah, the NCR and the Legion are about due for another dustup. So, you're going to get yourself involved in that? All right, I'm in. Could be fun.
translation: 是的，NCR和军团之间又要干一场了。你也准备去凑热闹？好吧，算我一个。这一定会很有趣的。

original: He thinks your experience and technology will help resolve the conflict in this region.
translation: 他认为你们的经验和技术可以帮忙解决这个地区的争端。

original: Well, now, there's an interesting idea - do a bit of good before we're all dead and forgotten. You can count me in.
translation: 好吧，这想法倒是挺有趣的——至少我们进棺材之前还能再发挥些余热。算我一个。

original: Oh, and in case Arcade forgot to mention it, there's a five-word pass phrase needed to get into the bunker. My word is "old" - appropriate, huh?
translation: 哦，不知阿卡德说过没有，进入碉堡需要一个5个词组成的密码。我的那个词是"老"——很恰当，对吧？

original: Arcade asked me to gather all the remaining members of the Enclave in the Mojave.
translation: 阿卡德让我召集所有在莫哈维的英克雷残部。

original: {Arcade hired}Thought I recognized the fellow with you. So, what's this reunion all about, then?
translation: {Arcade hired}我就觉得你身旁那小伙子看着眼熟呢。这次集会有什么目的？

original: {Arcade not hired}There's a name I haven't heard in awhile. So, what's this reunion all about, then?
translation: {Arcade not hired}那个名字我很久没听过了。这次集会有什么目的？

original: <Log Playback::End>
translation: <日志回放::结束>

original: <makes beeping sounds>
translation: <发出哔哔声>

original: <Log Playback::Continue>
translation: <日志重放::继续>

original: Eyebot Duraframe Subject E is both the prototype, and the last functional model in this test group.
translation: 眼球机器人“杜拉骨架”实验体E型，是本实验组中最初的原型机，也是最后的可用型号。

original: I was prepared to make several significant upgrades to the machines.
translation: 我原本要对这些机器进行几项重大的升级。

original: However, as the project was canceled and all Duraframe assets are being diverted to Hellfire Armor, I am sending this model to the Navarro outpost.
translation: 然而，随着计划的取消，用于研发杜拉骨架的资源全都转移到了地狱火装甲上，我打算将这一型号送往纳瓦罗前哨站。

original: Subject E: Diagnosis complete. Begin Recording.
translation: 实验型号E: 诊断完成。开始记录。

original: My name is Whitley. I'm a researcher at Adams Air Force base. Until recently I was in charge of the Duraframe reinforcement project for the combat model Eyebots.
translation: 我叫韦斯利，是亚当斯空军基地的一名研究员。最近一段时间，我都在负责战斗型眼球机器人“杜拉骨架”的强化项目。

original: <Log 1 Playback::Begin>
translation: <日志1回放::开始>

original: Yeah, let's play again.
translation: 好啊，再来。

original: I hope you're ready for this.
translation: 希望你准备好了。

original: No more magic spells this time.
translation: 这次不准玩花样。

original: I've got a good feeling about this hand.
translation: 我预感这次手风会顺。

original: Let's get this started!
translation: 来，开始！

original: Excellent. Let the game begin!
translation: 太好了，开始吧！

original: Very well. I would wish you luck, but of course peerless intellect is all that matters here.
translation: 很好。祝你好运，但显然智力才是决定因素。

original: Ok, hope you're ready to lose.
translation: 准备好迎接失败了么？

original: Let the Caravan Lesson begin.
translation: 让我好好教你该怎么玩商队牌。

original: I'm all done playing for now.
translation: 就这样了，不玩了。

original: I'll be here if you ever want a rematch.
translation: 想再玩的话我随时奉陪。

original: Dang it, No-bark, just when you was making a friend.
translation: 见鬼了，疯嘴，你这是在故意示好么。

original: Shucks, well, let's do it again sometime.
translation: 哎呀，好吧，总之有时间再来吧。

original: Okay. If you want to play again sometime, let me know.
translation: 好吧。什么时候想再玩玩就来找我。

original: Another time then, perhaps.
translation: 下次再来吧。

original: As you wish. Once you've salved your battered ego, perhaps you'll make another go of it.
translation: 如你所愿。等你什么时候又想玩了就来吧。

original: You know where to find me if you want to play again.
translation: 想玩的话，记得来找我。

original: What? Afraid to lose. Well come find me if you want to play again.
translation: 怎么？输不起了？总之想再玩就叫我吧。

original: That was too easy. How about we play again and this time you actually try.
translation: 太容易了吧。再来一把如何？也许你这次能认真点？

original: No-bark wins! A few more like that and the curse'll get lifted for sure.
translation: 疯嘴获胜！再来几次就能打破魔咒了。

original: Don't take it to heart. I've studied the strategies of the masters.
translation: 别太难过，我可是研究了不少大师的策略。

original: {Laughs}Nice try. Care to try your luck again?
translation: {Laughs}还不坏。要不要再试试手气？

original: It looks like you need a bit more practice. Another lesson perhaps?
translation: 看来你还需要练习啊。我再给你指点一下？

original: I am unsurprised regarding your appalling lack of talent. Perhaps you'd care to try another hand? After all, you can only improve.
translation: 不出我所料，你根本没有玩牌的天赋。再来一把？反正你的技术也不能再烂了。

original: Here I was thinking you'd be a challenge, want a rematch?
translation: 不算太差，还来吗？

original: {Laughs}Nice try. Let's play another game.
translation: {Laughs}还不坏，来，继续。

original: Dammit. I should have won that match. Let's play again.
translation: 哦，该死。我没理由输的。再来。

original: Dang it! Shoulda known you was getting caravan hints from the bloatfly spirits what live in these parts.
translation: 见鬼！肯定是那些辐射蝇的幽灵帮你作弊了！

original: Well I'll be cold and rotting before I let them get the best of me. Let's go again.
translation: 哼，就算我进了棺材，也绝不能容许有人比我强。再来。

original: Huh. I wonder where I went wrong. Let's try that again.
translation: 啊，我究竟是哪里搞错了。我们再来一把好了。

original: Not too bad. How about we play again?
translation: 不错嘛，要不要再来？

original: Impressive. That was a very good game. Would you care to play again?
translation: 好样的，玩得不错。介意再来一局吗？

original: Well now, this is an unexpected variable. You really must let me challenge you to a rematch, so I can analyze what passes for your strategy.
translation: 啧，这可是意料之外。请你再和我玩一把，让我分析分析你用的到底是什么策略。

original: Dammit, I thought I had you there. Let's play again.
translation: 该死，我还以为我赢定了。再来！

original: Wow, you're good. Give me another game.
translation: 你玩得很好啊，再和我来一把。

original: Want to play a hand of Caravan?
translation: 来一把商队牌？

original: All right, let's play.
translation: 好啊，来呀。

original: A fellow enthusiast, huh? That's great! Let's play.
translation: 你也爱玩牌？太好了，来吧！

original: Sure. Old No-bark is always looking to play. Not for entertainment, mind you, but because if you look at the cards right you can know the future.
translation: 没问题。老疯嘴可是很喜欢商队牌的。要知道，这可不是单纯的消遣，只要你能看出这些牌的门道，你就能预知未来。

original: Damn straight I would! Let's see what you got.
translation: 那还用说？来看看你手气如何吧。

original: Bring it on, buddy!
translation: 尽管放马过来，哥们儿！

original: I always have time for a good game of Caravan. I hope you're up to the challenge.
translation: 玩商队牌我当然有空。就看你有没有本事和我较量一番了。

original: A fascinating proposition. Naturally, my considerable genius makes me a master of the game, so try not to be disappointed if you lose miserably.
translation: 诱人的提议。以我的天赋，这种游戏根本不在话下。所以如果你输太惨，也没必要伤心哦。

original: You betcha! Caravan's got me through many a long night before. I hope you're ready.
translation: 那还用说！商队牌可是伴我度过了多少不眠夜啊。希望你准备好了。

original: You think you have what it takes, kid?
translation: 你真觉得自己牌技不错吗，小子？

original: All right, let's see what you got.
translation: 好啊，看看你究竟有多大本事。

original: I'm going to roll over you.
translation: 我会让你输得心服口服的。

original: Let's go back to talking about the Brotherhood.
translation: 我们谈谈兄弟会的事吧。

original: Fine by me. Have you found them yet?
translation: 我没问题。你找到他们了吗？

original: Let's go back to discussing Mr. House.
translation: 我们谈谈豪斯先生的事吧。

original: Okay. Is he still a threat?
translation: 好的。他还是个威胁吗？

original: Let's go back to talking about the Omertas.
translation: 我们谈谈黑手党的事吧。

original: Very well. Do you know what they're up to?
translation: 很好。你知道他们到底在搞什么名堂了吗？

original: Let's go back to speaking of the Khans.
translation: 我们谈谈大汗帮的事吧。

original: Of course, have they been dealt with?
translation: 当然，他们被处理掉了吗？

original: What happened to the Legion?
translation: 军团出了什么事？

original: With their leader dead, the rest of their army retreated to the east. We've sent scouts to track them, but that's it.
translation: 他们的头领死了，残兵退回了东部。我们已经派出斥候去追踪他们，但也仅此而已。

original: We don't have the forces or supplies necessary to chase them down. More's the pity.
translation: 我们没有足够的军队和补给去歼灭残敌。真是太遗憾了。

original: Still, I've sent a few skilled men out to make sure their journey is "eventful". It should be a long time before they even think of returning.
translation: 不过我还是派了几个能干的人，去给他们的归途增添一些"小插曲"。等他们下次再想来这里，应该是很久以后的事了。

original: Do you have any work for me?
translation: 你有什么工作需要我做吗？

original: I'm afraid I'm going to have to disappoint you. There's much to be done, but nothing for someone with your skills.
translation: 恐怕我要让你失望了。是有很多工作需要做，但都不值得你亲自出马。

original: You should take some time off. You've earned it.
translation: 你应该去休个假。这是你应得的。

original: How have things been since the battle?
translation: 战斗结束以来的情况如何？

original: Surprisingly good. Our forces have managed to secure the region with little resistance, and trade should soon reach an all-time high.
translation: 出奇的好。我们的军队没遇到什么抵抗就占领了这个地区，贸易总额应该很快就会创新高。

original: The brass was particularly surprised by the lack of domestic threats in the area. They were prepared to spend months pacifying known troublemakers.
translation: 长官们反而对这个地区的安全状况感到很惊讶。他们原本还打算花几个月的时间来清理那些刺头。

original: When they found those threats absent, they turned to the man in charge of the area, but Hsu being Hsu, he denied having anything to do with it.
translation: 后来他们发现找不到威胁，就去找了这个地区的负责人问话，但许上校就是许上校，他死活都不承认和这事有关联。

original: So now the men have to answer to Brigadier General Moore, and both they and I have you to thank for it.
translation: 所以现在，我的士兵都得称呼我为莫尔准将了，而我们所有人都要感谢你。

original: We made a good team. I hope we can work together again in the future.
translation: 我们合作得很愉快。我希望将来还能继续合作。

original: I'm ready for you to join me at the Lucky 38.
translation: 我已经准备好在幸运38迎接你的加入。

original: Mr. House is out of the picture and you have the Platinum Chip? Wonderful! Let's go!{Yes Man heads for the Lucky 38.}
translation: 豪斯先生完了，你也拿到白金筹码了？好极了！我们出发吧！{Yes Man heads for the Lucky 38.}

original: The Chip was supposed to activate an army of Securitrons at the Fort, but I blew it up.
translation: 那筹码本来是用来启动城堡里的一支机器人部队的，不过我已经把它炸掉了。

original: {forced to remain positive despite disaster}You... blew it up? It's just funny, because that... army... seems like the secret weapon that was the whole point of... you know?
translation: {forced to remain positive despite disaster}你……炸了它？真有趣，因为那支……部队……似乎才是这整个计划最关键的秘密武器……你知道吗？

original: I really admire how you stack the odds against yourself! Yeah, make things challenging!
translation: 你还真是会给自己出难题啊！对，这下可就更有挑战性了！

original: It's great. Really. Yeah. So anyway...
translation: 棒极了，真的。没错，那么……

original: Once I get the Platinum Chip, what then?
translation: 一旦我拿到了白金筹码，我该做什么？

original: I'd take it straight to Mr. House if I were you! He'll think you're helping him out! Then when he's not looking - KER-POW!
translation: 如果我是你，就会直接把它面呈给豪斯先生！这样他才能信任你！然后你就可以趁他不备——砰-砰！

original: The big question is whether to give him the Chip before you do him in! He's the one who'll know exactly what to do with it, after all!
translation: 最大的问题是，在你做掉他之前究竟要不要把筹码给他！毕竟他才是最清楚这块筹码用途的人！

original: He might upgrade his defensive capabilities right away! Or even unlock new ones!
translation: 他可能在拿到筹码之后立刻升级他的防卫设施，甚至可能解锁新的装备！

original: But then those defensive upgrades might make it harder for you to finish him off! Hard to say! It's up to you!
translation: 但他一旦升级了防护措施，你要干掉他就更难了！这可不好说！你自己决定吧！

original: It looks like you'll have to fight your way inside the Lucky 38 and take care of Mr. house with your own two hands! Or weapons held in them!
translation: 看来你得一路杀进幸运38，才能除掉豪斯先生了！不论是赤手空拳，还是用武器！总之必须亲自干掉他！

original: You already took care of House, so when you get the Chip, all you have to do is let me know.
translation: 你已经收拾了豪斯，所以你拿到筹码的话，只要告诉我一声就好。

original: {DUPLICATE?}I'll roll over to the Lucky 38 and see what I can do. If I'm right about the Platinum Chip, I should be able to install myself on House's mainframe!
translation: 我会去幸运38看看我能做什么，如果我对白金筹码的猜测是对的，那我应该可以将自己接入豪斯的主机！

original: Let me know when it's done and I'll roll over to the Lucky 38. If I'm right about the Chip, I should be able to install myself on House's mainframe!
translation: 搞定了就告诉我，我会前往幸运38，如果我对白金筹码的猜测是对的，那我应该可以将自己接入豪斯的主机！

original: This is going to be great! I'm going to help you accomplish so much, whether I want to or not!
translation: 这真是太美妙了！我一定可以帮你成就一番伟业的，无论我愿不愿意！

original: I used the Chip to put an entire army of Securitrons on standby at the Fort.
translation: 我用筹码把要塞底下驻扎的电子保安部队全部设置成待命状态了。

original: {DUPLICATE?}Really? An army of Securitrons - upgraded, no less? What a development!
translation: ｛不断重复着｝真的，真的？一支电子保安部队——升级了的？这真是了不起的进展。

original: An army like that should be enough to defend Vegas from - I'm gonna say anybody!
translation: 我敢说，这样的军队足以击退所有胆敢入侵维加斯的敌人了！

original: The Platinum Chip upgrades the Securitrons - and there's a whole army of them under the Fort.
translation: 白金筹码升级了所有的电子保安——而要塞下面藏着的机器人数量堪比一支大军。

original: Really? An army of Securitrons - upgraded, no less? What a development!
translation: 真的？一整支电子保安大军——还都是升了级的？真是了不起的进展！

original: An army like that should be enough to defend Vegas from - heck, anybody!
translation: 这样的军队足以击退所有胆敢入侵维加斯的敌人了！该死，所有人啊！

original: Let me know as soon as you have the Platinum Chip {emph}and Mr. House is out of the way!
translation: 拿到了筹码立刻告诉我，一旦你拿到白金筹码{强调}，豪斯先生就不足为惧了！

original: I'll roll over to the Lucky 38 and see what I can do. If I'm right about the Platinum Chip, I should be able to install myself on House's mainframe!
translation: 我会去幸运38看看我能做什么，如果我对白金筹码的猜测是对的，那我应该可以将自己接入豪斯的主机！

original: I know the Chip upgrades his Securitrons.
translation: 我知道这块筹码可以升级他的电子保安。

original: Isn't it exciting? I always wondered why I had missiles in my shoulders but couldn't launch them. Not that I'd ever want to!
translation: 难道不令人兴奋吗？我就一直奇怪，为什么我肩膀上装了导弹却不能发射，虽然我不是真的要搞破坏！

original: The upgrade really boosts the hitting power of each Securitron! Now you just need a way of controlling them!
translation: 升级可以显著提高电子保安的攻击力！你现在需要的是控制它们的手段。

original: Mr. House has dared me to visit him at the Lucky 38... so he can kill me.
translation: 豪斯先生打算让我去幸运38见他……这样他才好杀掉我。

original: Well, that's just mean! I don't like Mr. House one bit! No wonder the good guys want to kill him and take his stuff!
translation: 哎呀，真是个卑鄙小人！我一点也不喜欢豪斯先生！难怪有那么多人想要他的命，劫他的财！

original: {upbeat}You should accept his invitation and then {enthused}murder him when he least suspects it!
translation: {upbeat}你应该假装接受他的邀请，然后{enthused}在他没有起疑之前伺机杀了他。

original: I don't have the Platinum Chip. Maybe it's on Benny's corpse.
translation: 我手头没有白金筹码，也许在本尼的尸体上。

original: {pretty fucking obvious}Hmm. You should probably check on that, huh?
translation: {pretty fucking obvious}噢。那你干嘛不再去找找呢？

original: I hope that didn't sound condscending. I didn't mean to be!
translation: 希望我的口气不会吓着你。我没别的意思！

original: Benny seems to have run off with the Platinum Chip.
translation: 本尼似乎带着白金筹码逃走了。

original: No kidding! He was running fast! He better pace himself - he has to run all the way to Fortification Hill!
translation: 的确如此！他逃得可真快！希望他能控制好步调——他可是得一路逃到堡垒山去！

original: There's an underground facility there that might have the special hardware required to use the data on the Platinum Chip!
translation: 那儿有座地下工厂，也许可以读取白金筹码数据的特殊硬件设备就在里面！

original: It's too bad Caesar's Legion built its camp right above it. Talk about inconvenient!
translation: 凯撒军团竟然还把营地盖在上面。真是麻烦啊！

original: Where is the Platinum Chip?
translation: 白金筹码在哪里？

original: Benny carries it with him at all times. I think he's paranoid that someone might want to take it from him.
translation: 本尼总是随身带着。我想他真是拿它当宝贝了，成天担心有人会从他那儿夺走它。

original: I have the Platinum Chip, remember?
translation: 我有白金筹码，你忘了？

original: {uncaring that Benny is dead}Of course you do! Sorry about that! And it's wonderful that you do!
translation: {uncaring that Benny is dead}对哦！实在抱歉！你有的话就太好了！

original: I've been inside the Lucky 38... but Mr. House and I didn't get along.
translation: 我去过幸运38……但是豪斯先生跟我不对付。

original: It sounds like Mr. House is just plain mean. No wonder the good guys want to kill him and take his stuff!
translation: 听起来这个豪斯先生挺刻薄的，难怪是个好人就想干掉他，抄他的家！

original: If you've been inside the Lucky 38 before, I bet you can get in again! And that's amazing!
translation: 既然你曾经进去过幸运38，那你肯定还能再进去一次，太厉害了！

original: I've been invited to visit the Lucky 38.
translation: 我曾受邀进入幸运38。

original: Wow! Do you have any idea how special that is? Red carpet treatment!
translation: 哇！你知道那有多么特别吗？贵宾待遇啊！

original: {slightly troubled}Seems a little mean to use his invitation against him like that, but {upbeat}I'm sure it's all for the best!
translation: 虽然做客时谋害主人似乎有点不地道，但我敢肯定这是为了所有人好！

original: I've been inside the Lucky 38.
translation: 我去过幸运38。

original: You have? Wow! That's amazing! You can murder Mr. House whenever you want!
translation: 你去过？哇，太厉害了，那你岂不是随时都可以干掉豪斯先生！

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Come over and introduce yourself.
translation: 过来吧，介绍一下你自己。

original: Come now, don't keep me waiting.
translation: 过来，别再让我等了。

original: I invited you here so we could talk, not so you can nose around.
translation: 我邀请你来，是为了和你说话，不是叫你东张西望的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Have you been in Westside long?
translation: 你在西区呆了很长时间吗？

original: My grandfather opened up this shop. Took over from him when the Fiends killed him.
translation: 我的祖父开了这个店，他被恶魔帮打死后，店就被我接管了。

original: I'm looking for Cass. The Van Graffs told me to check in with you.
translation: 我在找卡丝。范·格拉夫要我来找你问问。

original: {Cass not hired}Coincidentally, I'm also looking for her. I've got a business offer she'd be interested in.
translation: {Cass not hired}真是巧了，我也在找她。我手上有一单她应该会感兴趣的生意。

original: I believe Cass frequents the Mojave Outpost, far south of here, near the California border.
translation: 卡丝经常去莫哈维前哨站。往南，离这儿挺远的，已经接近加州边境了。

original: What other responsibilities does this office have?
translation: 这间办公室还负责什么别的工作吗？

original: We aid some programs the Republic has sponsored involving sharecropper farms in the area, but those haven't panned out too well from what I hear.
translation: 这地区有一些佃农项目是国家资助的，我们负责提供指导。不过我听说项目进展得并不顺利。

original: There've been complaints about the amount of water we're supplying, but those are just excuses for lack of diligence, I'm sure.
translation: 有人抱怨我们的供水量不够。不过我敢说那些都是偷懒的借口。

original: We aid some programs the Republic has sponsored involving sharecropper farms in the area, which seem to be coming along nicely.
translation: 这地区有一些佃农项目是国家资助的，我们负责提供指导。不过我听说项目进展得并不顺利。

original: There was some sort of trouble involving the water supply recently, but it sorted itself out, as these things often do.
translation: 前一阵供水好像出了点问题，不过它自己又修好了。这种事挺常见的。

original: {RACKET complete}I'm in good with the Omertas - ask around. Feel like quitting yet?
translation: {RACKET complete}我和黑手党交情不错，不信的话可以去问问。现在想离职了吗？

original: Uh, yeah, actually. I'm still good for the money, but I'll get it some other way. You can tell the old hag I'm gone.
translation: 呃，这样。我还是缺钱，不过看在你的份上我会另想办法的。你可以告诉那老巫婆，我走了。

original: {NCR - liked}The NCR thinks pretty highly of me. Let's say I get word to your parents...
translation: {NCR - liked}NCR和我关系不错。万一我想带话给你父母……

original: All right, all right! I believe you. Just don't say anything to my folks. You can tell the old hag I'm gone.
translation: 好了，好了，我信了！别对我爸妈说起这事。你可以告诉那老巫婆，我走了。

original: {NCR - Mixed}Look, I take advantage of the NCR, too, but I don't make them my enemy.
translation: {NCR - Mixed}听着，我也占NCR的便宜，但我不想得罪他们。

original: Yeah, all right. If McLafferty complains long enough, my folks might haul me back to California just to shut her up. Tell the old hag I'm gone.
translation: 好吧，好吧。如果麦克拉弗蒂继续唠叨的话，我爸妈或许会把我拖回加州来让她闭嘴。告诉那老巫婆，我走了。

original: What do you do in Westside?
translation: 你在西区做什么？

original: I help tend the crops, stand watch for Fiends, and generally help keep things civilized.
translation: 我帮忙照看庄稼，提防恶魔帮，大部分时候协助维护秩序。

original: Arcade asked me to find you. I'm gathering the Remnants.
translation: 阿卡德让我来找你。我正在召集英克雷的残部。

original: {Arcade hired}{to another person}Hello, Arcade. Making some new friends, are you?
translation: 你好啊，阿卡德。你又交到新朋友了？

original: {to the player}Why the need for a bunch of old warhorses like us?
translation: {to the player}要我们这群老兵干什么？

original: {Arcade not hired}Why the need for a bunch of old warhorses like us?
translation: {阿卡德 not hired}要我们这群老兵干什么？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: {as a way of goodbye}Uh-huh.
translation: {as a way of goodbye}嗯哼。

original: You sure you don't know anything?
translation: 你确定你什么都不知道？

original: No. I gotta go.
translation: 是的。我得走了。

original: {Child At Heart}It's okay if you tell me - I won't get you in trouble.
translation: {童心未泯}告诉我是不会有问题的——我不会给你惹麻烦的。

original: I didn't want to get Mr. Anderson in trouble. He says the Westside needs to be able to take care of itself.
translation: 我不想让安德森先生惹上麻烦。他说西区要想办法自给自足。

original: Corporal White caught me taking the water and made me tell on Mr. Anderson. I think something bad happened, but Mr. Anderson told me not to worry.
translation: 怀特下士在我取水的时候逮到了我，还让我告发安德森先生。我以为出了大事，可安德森先生却让我不用担心。

original: You're making me angry, Hector. Tell me about the water - now.
translation: 你让我很失望，赫克托。告诉我这水到底是怎么回事，马上。

original: < Speech 80 >
[SUCCEEDED] I didn't want to get Mr. Anderson in trouble. He says the Westside needs to be able to take care of itself.
translation: [成功] 我不想让安德森先生惹上麻烦。他说西区要想办法自给自足。

original: Corporal White caught me taking the water and made me tell on Mr. Anderson. I think something bad happened, but Mr. Anderson told me not to worry.
translation: 怀特下士在我取水的时候逮到了我，还让我告发安德森先生。我以为出了大事，可安德森先生却让我不用担心。

original: If something happened to White, tell me. You know it's the right thing to do.
translation: 如果怀特出了事，你必须要告诉我。好孩子应该懂得明辨是非。

original: [FAILED] I said I don't know anything. Leave me alone!
translation: [失败] 我什么都不知道。饶了我吧！

original: Are you lying, Hector?
translation: 你在说谎吗，赫克托？

original: Sounds reasonable, but what about Corporal White?
translation: 听起来很合理，但是怀特下士怎么样了？

original: Where does Corporal White come into this?
translation: 怀特下士是怎么调查到的？

original: It's stealing, no matter who it's for. Corporal White found out, didn't he?
translation: 不管为了谁，这都算偷。怀特下士发现了这件事，对吗？

original: He caught me and made me tell on Mr. Anderson. I don't know what happened after that, but when I asked, Mr. Anderson said not to worry.
translation: 他逮到了我，还让我告发安德森先生。我不知道那之后发生了什么，不过我问了安德森先生，他让我不用担心。

original: But... Mr. Anderson had this look on his face. It's the look grownups get when they've done something bad.
translation: 可是…安德森先生脸上的表情，看着就像是大人干了坏事后通常会有的那副样子。

original: Caught you red-handed. Tell me where you're taking that water.
translation: 抓到现行了，告诉我你要把这里的水运到哪儿去。

original: You look like you're gathering water. The Westside isn't supposed to have a water supply.
translation: 你好像在接水啊。西区应该没有供水系统。

original: Uh... it's for the co-ops. Mr. Anderson told me to do it - he said it wasn't stealing if it's for the good of everybody.
translation: 呃……这都是为了合作社。是安德森先生让我这么做的。他说只要是为了大家好，就不算偷。

original: Do you know anything about Corporal White?
translation: 你认识怀特下士吗？

original: {nervous, hiding a secret}Corporal White? I don't know where he - {obviously changing his lie mid-sentence}uh, I mean, never heard of him. Uh, I gotta go...
translation: {nervous, hiding a secret}怀特下士？ 我不知道他在哪——{obviously changing his lie mid-sentence}呃，我的意思是，没听说过这个人。嗯，我要走了……

original: What do you do here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: I deliver things and stuff for the people here. They give me caps to do it.
translation: 我为这里的人送东西。他们会付我钱。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Bye.
translation: 拜。

original: Let me see what you have for sale.
translation: 让我看看你都卖些什么。

original: You won't find better.
translation: 别家可没有这么好的东西哦。

original: Remember, an impressive gratuity sends a message.
translation: 记住，一笔可观的小费能给我们极大的鼓舞。

original: Our drinks have many subtle flavors.
translation: 我们的酒水口味丰富而又细腻。

original: {Confirmed Bachelor}Back rubs are a specialty of mine. Maybe I'll show you sometime.
translation: {Confirmed Bachelor}推拿可是我的看家绝活。也许什么时候我可以给你展示一下。

original: Oh, I think I'd like that. A lot. Maybe even give you a discount for my... company.
translation: 哦，这倒是不错，我喜欢。你如果……服侍好了，说不定我还能给你打个折呢。

original: Any chance you could help me get into Saint James' room?
translation: 你有办法能帮我进入圣詹姆斯的房间吗？

original: {Saint James dead}Since he's dead, I don't think he'll mind. Here.
translation: 反正他已经死了，我想他不会在意的。给你。

original: I do have his spare key, but I'm not sure he'd like it if I let you in there. Saint James can be a little crazy sometimes.
translation: 我倒是有他的备用钥匙，但他如果知道是我放你进去的，肯定会不高兴的。圣詹姆斯发起疯来也挺可怕的。

original: I still don't think he'd like it if I let you in there.
translation: 我还是觉得他不会甘愿我放你进去的。

original: This is a golden opportunity for the Followers to spread knowledge and care throughout the Mojave.
translation: 传播知识造福整个莫哈维地区，这对天启追随者来说是次千载难逢的机会。

original: It is indeed our duty to teach and improve the living conditions of our fellow man, but we're talking an insane amount of logistics to make this work.
translation: 为同胞们提供教育、改善民生的确是我们的使命，但要实现这个目标，必须建立起一个惊人的交通体系。

original: Part of my plan involves automated security for the region.
translation: 我计划的其中一环，就是将本地的防卫力量全部机械化。

original: That is somewhat reassuring, but we still don't have the resources to care for the entire Mojave by ourselves.
translation: 这倒是有助于维护治安，但我们手头的资源依然无法顾及整个莫哈维地区。

original: We already experience regular supply shortages. Opening our door to the entire region... I don't see how this could ever work.
translation: 我们经常遭遇物资短缺的问题。如果向整个地区都敞开大门……我不知道这该如何办到。

original: You would act as medical support, safely away from combat.
translation: 你们就在远离战场的安全地带提供医疗支援。

original: The Followers would act as support safely away from combat.
translation: 天启追随者可以在远离战场的安全地带提供支援。

original: In that case, they'll have our support. We cannot afford to let the Legion win.
translation: 这样的话，我们愿意提供支援。我们无法承受军团获胜的后果。

original: They won't have nearly enough doctors without the Followers' support.
translation: 没有天启追随者的支援，他们的医生远远不够。

original: But the Followers aren't fighters. We'd get annihilated as front-line medics.
translation: 可是天启追随者并不是战士，把他们派去前线做医护兵等于是送死。

original: I'm setting plans in motion which will ensure both the Legion and NCR are pushed out of the Mojave.
translation: 我正在制定计划，把NCR和军团都赶出莫哈维。

original: Wow. Whatever you have planned must be pretty big to give them the boot, but this sounds dangerous.
translation: 哇，不管你的计划是什么，能把他们赶走，这个计划一定很庞大，但同时应该也很危险。

original: I refuse to put my people at risk. If the NCR are pushed out, the raiders and other scum will run amok.
translation: 我不能让我们的人冒这个险。如果把NCR赶走了，掠夺者流氓就会肆意妄为。

original: Would you rather see Caesar's Legion win and enslave everyone?
translation: 你更愿意看到凯撒军团获胜后奴役所有人吗？

original: No, but there is still a good chance the NCR could hold them off and we're not equipped to fight a war, here.
translation: 不，但NCR仍然有很大的希望能击退他们，而且我们也没有能力去打仗。

original: I think the Followers should support an Independent Vegas through the coming battle at the dam.
translation: 我认为天启追随者应该在接下来的大坝决战中支持维加斯独立。

original: I'm sure you have your reasons, but we are much too busy to waste our time on those selfish bastards.
translation: 我知道你有自己的理由，可我们很忙，没空在那些自私的混蛋身上浪费时间。

original: Even if we wanted to, we don't have the resources to handle such a monumental task right now.
translation: 即便我们想帮，也没有足够的资源来完成如此艰巨的任务。

original: Unless you can handle our supply shortages, the best we can do is scrape by in here in Freeside.
translation: 除非你能解决我们的物资短缺问题，否则我们最多也只能在自由城这里摇旗呐喊。

original: Why should we support Vegas? They've locked Freeside out of the city and do nothing to help their neighboring townsfolk.
translation: 我们为什么要支持维加斯？他们把自由城隔离在城外，对自己的邻居都置之不理。

original: I think the Followers should support NCR in the coming battle at the dam.
translation: 我认为天启追随者应该在接下来的大坝决战中支持NCR。

original: I'm sure you have your reasons, but we are much too busy to waste our time on those selfish bastards.
translation: 我知道你有自己的理由，可我们很忙，没空在那些自私的混蛋身上浪费时间。

original: Even if we wanted to, we don't have the resources to handle such a monumental task right now.
translation: 即便我们想帮，也没有足够的资源来完成如此艰巨的任务。

original: Unless you can handle our supply shortages, the best we can do is scrape by in here in Freeside.
translation: 除非你能解决我们的物资短缺问题，否则我们最多也只能在自由城这里摇旗呐喊。

original: Why should we support the NCR? Their continual operational incompetence gets their soldiers killed, and they hold a monopoly on water in the mojave.
translation: 我们为什么要支持NCR？他们指挥不力，总是让自己的士兵白白送命，还垄断了莫哈维的水资源。

original: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

original: I'd like to talk about joining the Followers of the Apocalypse.
translation: 我想聊一下加入天启追随者的事。

original: Great, did you change your mind?
translation: 太好了，你改变主意了？

original: Sure let me take a look at those magazines.
translation: 当然，让我看下那些杂志吧。

original: Take a look.
translation: 看吧。

original: What does it mean to join the Followers of the Apocalypse?
translation: 天启追随者的理念是什么？

original: Our aim is to gradually shape a better brighter future for the wasteland.
translation: 我们的目标是为废土打造一个美好光明的未来。

original: We seek to heal the planet through efforts not unlike the medicine and education we offer here in the Old Mormon Fort.
translation: 我们希望通过医疗和教育来逐步改善生活环境，就像我们在旧摩门要塞做的一样。

original: All we ask is members and those seeking aid do their best to help those in need when the opportunity arises.
translation: 我们唯一的要求，就是希望我们的成员和那些寻求帮助的人，能够在他人有难时伸出援手。

original: I'm not interested right now.
translation: 我暂时没兴趣。

original: That is unfortunate. If you change your mind, please see me right away.
translation: 真遗憾。如果你改变主意，请立刻来找我。

original: Yes! I'll join.
translation: 好啊！我加入。

original: Excellent! The Followers' mission will be better served with someone like yourself traveling around the Mojave.
translation: 好极了！有你这样时常在莫哈维沙漠旅行的人帮忙，天启追随者必将如虎添翼。

original: As a representative of the Followers, I present you with your very own Lab Coat. Wear it well, and may it aid our cause.
translation: 我谨代表天启追随者向你赠送一件专属的实验室外套。希望你能好好珍惜，并为我们的事业做出积极的贡献。

original: Also, before I forget, here is a key to a safehouse you can use to rest if you happen to be in the area. I'll just mark it mark it on your map.
translation: 还有，差点忘了，这把钥匙可以打开我们的一间安全屋，如果你恰巧经过那附近，可以到里头休息。我会在地图上标记出它的地点。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: You just gotta help her, man.
translation: 你一定要救救她。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Uh...where is she again?
translation: 呃……她在哪？再说一次？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Sorry, too dangerous.
translation: 抱歉，太危险了。

original: But she'll die if you don't help!
translation: 可你要不救她，她会死的！

original: I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会想想办法的。

original: You will? Thank you for helping me. Please hurry.
translation: 你答应救她了？谢谢你肯帮我，请快一点。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Where is she?
translation: 她在哪？

original: Go up the path past the broken radio tower and go to the right... they're at the top of the trail.
translation: 沿着这条道理往前走，经过那个坏掉的广播塔，然后往右……就在这小路的尽头。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Let's hear it then.
translation: 给我说详细一些。

original: 50 caps or I walk.
translation: 50个瓶盖，否则免谈。

original: I'll give you whatever you want, just hurry!
translation: 你要什么都行，快啊！

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Fine, just leave me to my misery then.
translation: 好啊，你就留我一个人痛不欲生吧。

original: Bastard. You're just like everyone else around here.
translation: 混蛋。你和周围的人都一样。

original: I hope someone helps my girl before it's too late.
translation: 希望能有人快来救救我的女儿。

original: Sorry, got my own problems.
translation: 抱歉，我自己还有事。

original: I could pay you.
translation: 我可以付你钱。

original: What's wrong?
translation: 发生了什么事？

original: My girl is trapped by geckos on the ridge and I can't get to her. Please, she's going to die!
translation: 我女儿在山脊那边被蜥蜴困住了，我没法靠近她。求求你，她就要死了！

original: Rangers, this is the chief. I know I can ramble on sometimes, but I need you to listen close for the next minute or so. I've got some bad news.
translation: 游骑兵们，我是军士长。我知道有时候我有点唠叨，但接下来的几分钟，请你们竖起耳朵听好。我有一个坏消息要宣布。

original: I messed up. Made a mistake. I thought I could help get us out of here, but... it didn't work out.
translation: 我错了。我犯了一个重大的错误。我原以为能帮助大家离开这里，但是…我失败了。

original: Rangers get injured all the time. It's part of the job. But if you lose a few fingers, get a bad break, that's it. You step down.
translation: 只要当游骑兵就会受伤。大家干这行的，也自有分寸。可你要是断了指头，或者身体的哪一截成了麻花，那就该解甲归田了。

original: We rely on each other too much to let our infirmities become a liability. A ranger knows when it's time. Only I didn't.
translation: 我们同生共死，谁都不想因为伤病而变成他人的累赘。游骑兵应该懂得见好就收的道理，可我却忘了。

original: Somewhere along the way, something broke inside me. I couldn't find us a way out of this desert. I wrestled with it, and it took me down a dark road.
translation: 一路走来，我迷失了。我找不到和大家一起走出这片沙漠的方法。我奋力挣扎，却在这条漆黑的道路上越陷越深。

original: I wish I could explain it to you. The old chief's finally at a loss for words.
translation: 我希望能把一切都向你们解释清楚。但这一次，你们的老士官长终究无话可说了。

original: Send me all the Legion you can. I'll be waiting for them.
translation: 把军团的人都送来和我做伴吧。我在地狱里等着他们。

original: <250 caps needed>I can't meet your price right now.
translation: <需要250个瓶盖> 我现在没有这么多。

original: Too bad. No caps, no key.
translation: 太糟了。没瓶盖就免谈。

original: <250 caps> This should be enough.
translation: <250个瓶盖> 这应该够了。

original: And here's your key.
translation: 给你钥匙。

original: Forget I said anything.
translation: 忘了我说过的话吧。

original: {cheerful, forgiving}Already forgotten!
translation: {cheerful, forgiving}已经忘记了！

original: {Lady Killer}You'd say no to a guy like me? And here I thought you were special...
translation: {Lady Killer}你居然拒绝我这样的男人？我还以为你有多特别呢……

original: {playful}Oh, don't you dare play that game with me. Fine, here's the key since it's so important to you. Just don't say where you got it.
translation: {playful}哦，别和我玩这种游戏。好吧，既然这钥匙对你这么重要，那就给你。别说你是从哪儿拿到的。

original: {Cherchez La Femme}We girls need to stick together, and this'll be our secret.
translation: {Cherchez La Femme}我们女孩应该互相团结，我会保密的。

original: I could never resist a woman like you. Here, take the key, but don't tell anyone where you go it.
translation: 我永远也无法抵抗你这样的女人。给你，钥匙拿去，但别告诉其他人你是怎么拿到的。

original: I'll pay you for the key.
translation: 只要给我钥匙，我愿意花钱。

original: We can come to a deal. My price is firm, though - Saint James is a good customer and it better be worth it if I'm going to lose him.
translation: 我们可以做笔交易。但我的要价可不低——圣詹姆斯是个好客户，万一他翻脸了，你给的钱总该够弥补我的损失吧。

original: Know anything about Saint James?
translation: 知道圣詹姆斯的底细吗？

original: Guy's unstable, but he pays his rent and Sweetie seems to like him all right.
translation: 这伙计脾气不大好，但他交房租倒是挺积极，小甜甜似乎也很喜欢他。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Yeah, beat it.
translation: 是啊，那又怎样。

original: Is that what you guys do, pretend to be this guy?
translation: 所以你们也在模仿那个人吗？

original: Somethin' like that, yeah. There were some working tapes here when we first got here, so we know what he sounded like.
translation: 对，差不多吧。我们刚来的时候，这里还有些可以使用的磁带，所以我们能听到他的声音。

original: Sadly, they stopped working a few years back, so I sold them to a junk merchant who was passing through, otherwise I'd play some for you.
translation: 可惜，几年前磁带坏了，我把它们卖给了路过的垃圾商人，不然我还可以放给你听听。

original: All the outfits you see my guy wearing around were originally found in here, too. Along with more hair gel than you can shake a stick at.
translation: 我手下穿的制服也都是从这里找到的。同时我们还发现了数不清的发胶。

original: And that's where you got the name from.
translation: 所以这也是你名字的由来。

original: Well, that and the giant sign outside. This place could have been "The King's House of Dog Chow" and I still would have taken the name.
translation: 是的，还有外面那块大标志牌也是来源之一。哪怕这地方叫"猫王的狗粮仓库"，我也一样会借用它的名字。

original: But I like to think I keep the memory alive.
translation: 但我更觉得是我再现了往日的记忆。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Sure thing. What'd you have in mind?
translation: 当然。你有什么想法？

original: If this was a school, what was taught here?
translation: 如果这以前是个学校，那这里教些什么？

original: As far as we can tell, the guy that built this place was considered the coolest of the cool, and taught other people how to be more like him.
translation: 据我们所知，这地方的建造者是一个酷到没边的家伙，他建这里的主要目的就是教别人如何像他一样酷。

original: People would come from all around to learn how to sing, dance, dress, and even speak the way he did.
translation: 人们从四面八方慕名而来，学习如何唱歌，跳舞，穿衣，甚至学他的说话方式。

original: Tell me more about him.
translation: 和我说说他到底是什么人吧。

original: Not a whole lot to tell. There were only a few books left in here when we found it, and those were rotted away.
translation: 也没什么可说的。我们来的时候，这里只剩下几本书，而且都已经腐烂了。

original: There were some posters left that were pretty well preserved, which is how we know all this stuff was based on the same guy.
translation: 倒是有不少海报完整地保存了下来，所以我们才能知道这房子里的所有布置都与某个人有关。

original: The thing of it is, we don't even know what his name was. All the posters just referred to him as "The King".
translation: 然而问题在于，我们却不知道他的真名。所有的海报上都称他为"猫王"。

original: This building is... interesting. What do you know about it?
translation: 这栋房子…很有意思。你知道它的历史吗？

original: Near as I can tell, it was some sort of religious institution.
translation: 据我推断，这里以前应该是一处宗教场所。

original: Oh, I know it says "school" out front, but everything in here seems to be related to the worship of some guy from back in the day.
translation: 哦，我知道它的外墙上写着"学校"，但种种迹象表明，这个地方过去曾被用来崇拜某个人。

original: People used to come here to learn about him, to dress like him, move like him. To {stressed}be him. If that's not worship, I don't know what is.
translation: 人们会到这里专门学习他的穿着打扮和行为举止。尽力模仿他。如果这不是崇拜，那我不知道这该叫什么。

original: I have other things to do.
translation: 我有其他事情要做。

original: That's all right. My friends got beat so bad they'll be recuperating for quite some time, so head over there when you can.
translation: 没关系。我的朋友们伤得很厉害，需要很长时间才能康复。如果你有空，可以随时过去看看。

original: <Log Playback::Continue>
translation: <记录回放::继续>

original: Please handle this information with the utmost care as it represents the sum total of the results of my research on the Duraframe Eyebots.
translation: 请谨慎处理这些信息，这可是我对眼球机器人“杜拉骨架”研究的全部成果。

original: There are also several databanks with information on my research into Poseidon Energy and some projects they were working on in the Mojave area.
translation: 同时还有若干数据库，储存了我对海神能源公司的研究记录，以及他们当时在莫哈维地区所进行的部分项目的基本情报。

original: Download Complete. Begin Recording.
translation: 下载完成。开始记录。

original: Navarro outpost scientists, I am glad that ED-E has reached you. You will find several databanks of information on this machine.
translation: 纳瓦罗前哨站的科学家们，我很高兴ED-E顺利抵达。你们会在这台机器上找到一些可用的数据。

original: <Log 2 Playback::Begin>
translation: <日志2回放::开始>

original: <Log Playback::Continue>
translation: <记录回放::继续>

original: If you are listening to this log from one of our Enclave Outposts in Chicago, give this unit whatever repairs it needs so it can continue to Navarro.
translation: 若你收到这段从我们芝加哥英克雷前哨站的发出的录音，请对此单位进行必要的维护，以使其能够继续前往纳瓦罗。

original: How do you know about Benny?
translation: 你怎么知道本尼的情况？

original: Little escapes the notice of {KAI-zar}Caesar. He has eyes everywhere.
translation: 没有什么能瞒过凯撒的眼睛。到处都是他的眼线。

original: Got any spare powder and dynamite available?
translation: 有多余的火药或炸药吗？

original: {Player lost Good rep}Nope, not for you. Rumor is you've been working against us, so the deal's off.
translation: {Player lost Good rep}没有，有也不给你。传言说你在和我们作对，我不会和你做生意的。

original: {Available}Yeah, we do. Here.
translation: {Available}是的，我们有，给你。

original: {Not available}We're out at the moment. Come back later.
translation: {Not available}现在没货，下次再来。

original: I've recovered the Platinum Chip.
translation: 我已经找回了白金筹码。

original: Super! Now when Mr. House is out of the way, we can use the Chip to install me at the Lucky 38.
translation: 太好了！现在只要等豪斯先生完蛋，再用筹码将我安装到幸运38的终端机中就大功告成了。

original: You have to get Mr. House out of the way, that's what! And then we'll install me on the Lucky 38's mainframe!
translation: 你要先将豪斯先生扫地出门，这是必须的！然后才能将我安装到幸运38的主机上！

original: Now that I have the Platinum Chip, what's next?
translation: 我已经拿到了筹码，然后呢？

original: I took care of Mr. House.
translation: 我干掉了豪斯先生。

original: {proud of the player}You did? Wow, that's great!
translation: 你做到了？哇，太棒了！

original: Once you get ahold of that Platinum Chip, I'll be able to help you in all sorts of ways.
translation: 只要你能搞到白金筹码，我就能通过各种渠道帮助你。

original: Not interested.
translation: 没兴趣。

original: The last thing Vegas needs is more robots.
translation: 维加斯不需要更多的机器人了。

original: {rushing to agree}Oh, yeah, I'm sure you're right. I mean, for one thing, it's you saying it, and you always know what you're talking about.
translation: {rushing to agree}噢，没错，你说的对。我是说，首先，你肯定是经过了深思熟虑，才得出这个结论的。

original: And if you had, you know, a huge killer robot at your command, yeah, that would just clutter things up.
translation: 其次，万一你手上有了一台，比方说，巨大的战斗机器人，嗯，那就足以把这里搅得天翻地覆了。

original: And a lesser person might want that kind of overwhelming force on their side, but you know - where's the challenge in that?
translation: 像你这样渺小而又脆弱的人类，肯定是很希望能得到这种武器的，问题在于——那样做又有什么挑战可言呢？

original: I'll think about it.
translation: 我会考虑的。

original: I have to admire your prudent nature. Why get caught up in action, you know? And results?
translation: 我欣赏你的谨慎。为啥要趟这浑水呢？又会有什么好处？

original: I'll go check it out.
translation: 我会去看看的。

original: Neat. Let me know what you find out!
translation: 利索点。发现什么就赶紧告诉我！

original: You said something about a bunker at the Fort?
translation: 你提到过城堡里有一座地下工厂？

original: Right, it's one of two locations on House's network with non-standard hardware.
translation: 没错，在豪斯的网络中，有两处地方运用了非常规的硬件设备，其中一处就是那里。

original: My guess is that it has a reader that can decode the chip, and who knows what else? Maybe a giant robot or something!
translation: 我猜那个设备应该就是能够读取筹码数据的东西，不过谁知道它是什么呢？搞不好是台大型机器人呢！

original: That's right! Like I said, it's probably pretty important because it has non-standard hardware, just like the Lucky 38!
translation: 是的！我说过，那个地点也许十分重要，因为它使用的硬件十分特殊，就和幸运38里的一样！

original: The data on that Platinum Chip is a big secret, unless you can find a dedicated reader to decode it. Isn't that frustrating?
translation: 白金筹码里的数据是个天大的秘密，除非你能找到读取装置。这的确很令人沮丧，不是吗？

original: Remind me what you said about some bunker at the Fort?
translation: 你好像提过城堡里有一个地下工厂的事情？

original: What do you do around here?
translation: 你在这儿是做什么的？

original: {Eddie alive}I keep an eye on my buddy Eddie. Anybody messes with him and I scramble them real good.
translation: {Eddie alive}我负责保护我兄弟埃迪。只要有人敢找他麻烦，我就赏他们一顿暴揍。

original: {Eddie dead}Used to guard Eddie, but not anymore.
translation: {Eddie dead}我之前负责护卫埃迪，但现在不需要了。

original: You'd better leave while you can. The Powder Gangers won't fall for your trick.
translation: 趁你还能动弹，赶紧给我滚吧。炸药帮才不会上你的当呢。

original: Yeah, was a stupid idea, anyway. See you around.
translation: 哦，你这想法可不大聪明。好吧，回见。

original: You think you can take on Powder Gangers by yourself?
translation: 你以为就凭你一个人就能扫平整个炸药帮？

original: Not a whole gang or anything - just two, maybe three. I was a caravan guard, so I know how to handle a gun pretty well.
translation: 扫平整个帮派当然不可能，不过对付几个三脚猫绰绰有余。我当过商队的保镖，枪还是玩的很溜的。

original: {Intelligence 6+}Traveling a little light for a merchant, aren't you? No pack Brahmin?
translation: {Intelligence 6+}商人还有你这样轻装上阵的？没有双头牛帮你驮货物吗？

original: Well, you see, I... fuck. I'm really a bounty hunter trying to catch some Powder Gangers, but they probably saw through me, just like you did.
translation: 好吧，被你识破了，我……见鬼，我其实是名赏金猎人，专门追杀炸药帮的人，不过也许他们早就看穿我了，就跟你一样。

original: I've been hanging around hoping to ambush some of them, but haven't had any success.
translation: 我在这附近四处转悠，就是希望能亲手逮到他们。可一直都没成功过。

original: < Speech 30 >
[SUCCEEDED] Guess I was a little too obvious. I'm actually a bounty hunter - I was hoping to bag some Powder Gangers if they tried to rob me.
translation: [成功]看来我还是太显眼了。其实我是个赏金猎人——要是有炸药帮的人胆敢抢劫我，我会愿意把他们的人头提回家的。

original: A real merchant would be much more worried about Powder Gangers, you know.
translation: 要知道，正宗的商人见到炸药帮一般都会被吓破胆的。

original: [FAILED] Yeah, I'm a merchant, just like I said.
translation: [失败]当然了，我只是个游商，我已经说过了。

original: You sure you're actually a merchant?
translation: 你真是商人？

original: You won't live to collect that bounty.
translation: 你不会活着拿到赏金的。

original: We'll see about that.
translation: 那就试试看吧。

original: < Speech 30 >
[SUCCEEDED] Hmmm... that's a good point. Sorry I, uh, tried to ambush you there. No hard feelings, I hope.
translation: [SUCCEEDED] 嗯……说的没错。抱歉，我，呃，刚才想要伏击你。希望你不要介意。

original: Even if you managed to kill me, the Powder Gangers are already on to you. It's why I'm here.
translation: 就算你杀了我，炸药帮也不会放过你。所以我才敢站在这里和你说话。

original: [FAILED] I don't think it's a waste of time. A handful of dead Powder Gangers ought to get the NCR to cough up some caps.
translation: [FAILED]我可不觉得是浪费时间。就凭几个炸药帮的人头，说不定还能在NCR那里换来一大笔钱呢。

original: So, there's no official bounty? Waste of time, if you ask me. Better walk away while you can.
translation: 所以，其实根本就没什么悬赏？真是浪费时间。要我说，你还是快点滚蛋吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Nope, not going to be that easy.
translation: 不，没那么容易。

original: There's a bounty out on Powder Gangers?
translation: 居然有人在悬赏炸药帮的人吗？

original: No, but there really ought to be. I'm just taking the initiative, is all.
translation: 不，但我觉得真该下个悬赏令。我只是带头提出个倡议，就这样。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Watch your back out there.
translation: 在外头多加小心。

original: No, thanks.
translation: 不，谢了。

original: Then get out of here.
translation: 那么就离开这儿。

original: Yes, please.
translation: 当然可以。

original: Take a look.
translation: 看一下吧。

original: Hmm, indulgent, what rhymes with indulgent? Efful- no, no, that's terrible.
translation: 嗯，放纵，和放纵押韵的词儿有哪些？光芒闪动——哦，不，不，太糟了。

original: Silver... silver what? Silver eyes? No, "eyes" doesn't rhyme...
translation: 银色…银色什么？银色双眼？不，"眼"不押韵…

original: One, two, three... dammit, too many syllables!
translation: 一，二，三…该死的，怎么这么多音节！

original: There once was a man of stout heart... heart, heart, what rhymes with heart?
translation: 从前有个男人怀着坚强的心…心，心，什么词儿和心押韵？

original: I wonder if anything rhymes with "Cazador?"
translation: 不知道有没有词儿和"猎蜂"押韵？

original: Hmm, maybe I should write something about how much the Great Khans suck.
translation: 嗯，也许我该写首诗说说大汗帮究竟有多烂。

original: How do you spell "gesticulate?"
translation: "哑语"这两个字怎么写？

original: That was terrible. Really, really awful.
translation: 很可怕。真的，可怕，太可怕了。

original: {Sullen youth}Psh. Whatever.
translation: {Sullen youth}滚。有多远滚多远。

original: Wow, that... really was something.
translation: 哇哦，还真……像那么回事。

original: You liked it? Wow, you're the first one who ever did!
translation: 你喜欢吗？哇，你是第一个这么说的！

original: Actually, I already found him. He's dead.
translation: 实际上，我已经找到他了。他死了。

original: Would you like to scan me again?
translation: 你想要重新扫描我吗？

original: Don't you get lonely here, with no one but Marilyn and Jane to keep you company?
translation: 除了玛丽琳和简，就没人来陪着你了，你不觉得孤独吗？

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Was it just me, or were there signs of attraction earlier?
translation: 是我看错了吗，刚才有人想勾引我？

original: I'm ready to go to the dam.
translation: 我已经准备好去水坝了。

original: Great! So I've been looking over Mr. House's force projections and running some calculations...
translation: 太棒了！我刚刚查阅了豪斯先生就双方兵力所作的评估，还进行了一番运算……

original: It turns out there are two ways we can win this thing! Hear that? We have options!
translation: 结果是，我们有两种方法可以取胜！听见没？我们有得选！

original: Great! So I've been looking over Mr. House's force projections and running some calculations...
translation: 太棒了！我刚刚查阅了豪斯先生就双方兵力所作的评估，又进行了一番运算……

original: It turns out there's only one way for us to win this battle and make it stick! We have to render Hoover Dam inoperable!
translation: 结果是，我们只有一种方法可以彻底取胜！那就是废掉整座胡佛水坝！

original: Is there anything else I should do before the battle?
translation: 战斗开始之前我还有什么必须做的吗？

original: Well, some of Mr. House's projections predict a {reading}"moderate probability of civil instability subsequent to the NCR being driven from the Vegas region."
translation: 其实，豪斯先生的估测中还有一项，就是认为"NCR有较大的可能因民众矛盾激化而被赶出维加斯。"

original: One of the "mitigating contingencies" he planned was to enlist the Followers to  provide increased medical aid throughout the region.
translation: 他提出的"调解方案"之一，就是让天启追随者为整个地区提供更多的医疗服务。

original: Just seems like it might help keep things stable when we go independent. Not that I know what I'm talking about!
translation: 我觉得这个方案也可以帮助我们在独立后维护稳定。不过我也不是很清楚！

original: We shall be here, and we shall meet you on the battlefield.
translation: 我们应该在这儿，我们应该在战场上相见。

original: I will await that day, Legate.
translation: 我会等着那天的，特使。

original: Then until our return... {To himself, walking away}True to Caesar.
translation: 那么后会有期……{To himself, walking away}忠于凯撒。

original: If you feel that war matters that much, perhaps you will see differently in time.
translation: 你要真觉得这场仗那么重要，我想过不了多久你就会改变想法的。

original: There is victory in wisdom, Legate.
translation: 有一种胜利叫睿智，特使。

original: As for wisdom... there is wisdom in your words, woman of the West.
translation: 说到睿智……你的话语里确实有股睿智，西部来的女人。

original: As for wisdom... there is wisdom in your words, man of the West.
translation: 至于睿智……你的话里确实有股睿智，西部来的汉子。

original: Know that I shall return East. I shall not remain there forever. On that day, the strength of the bear shall be tested.
translation: 我会回东部去的，但我绝不会一辈子龟缩在那儿。总有一天，我会与巨熊来场真正的较量。

original: If the West is one day filled with ones such as you, perhaps it shall be a worthy fight, indeed.
translation: 如果有一天，西部都是你这样的人。那么，也许我们才真正值得一战。

original: Eventually - but moving your whole army West means losing the East. You can't hold both.
translation: 可你把整支部队调来西部，东部就保不住了，鱼和熊掌不可得兼。

original: [SUCCEEDED] The East was a hard-fought campaign. Even now, Caesar drew too much of the Legion's blood needed there for... this.
translation: [成功] 征服东部的战争确实打得太过艰难。凯撒把太多部队都耗在了那里……以至于现在缺兵少将。

original: Hoover Dam is but a place. I will not have it be the gravestone of the Legion - whether quickly, or as you describe, slowly... by attrition.
translation: 胡佛大坝说到底不过是块地标。我绝不会让它成为军团的葬身之地——无论是瞬间瓦解，还是如你所说……一步步被消耗殆尽。

original: NCR's weakness is its size - it'll take your entire army to hold the West.
translation: NCR的弱点就是战线太长——要是你来守卫西部，你的部队也会吃不消。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Frown}That does not mean we would not succeed.
translation: [成功] {Frown}可那并不意味着我们不会成功。

original: Good, because the Omertas' plan was stopped, Vegas is as strong as ever.
translation: 很好，由于黑手党的阴谋败露，维加斯又变得像以前一样强大了。

original: {Angered}A plan by Vulpes... treachery is a weapon that one should never rely on.
translation: {Angered}这都是沃尔普斯一手策划的……依靠叛变来取胜本来就是行不通的。

original: I can only hope that the Omertas died when their treachery was exposed, to have the plan succeed only would have sullied the Legion.
translation: 我只希望黑手党阴谋败露后已经得到了应有的惩罚，要是让这个计划得逞，军团将颜面无存。

original: It does not matter, victory shall be ours, it shall be swift, and it will be honest, purchased with blood.
translation: 无所谓，胜利终究是我们的，我们要赢得利落，赢得干净，要用鲜血来换取那面旗帜。

original: You sound pretty sure of yourself. I don't think it'll be that easy.
translation: 你听起来很自信。我倒觉得没那么容易。

original: Really? I hope you're not counting on the Omertas to help you.
translation: 真的？你该不会指望让黑手党来帮你吧。

original: {Pauses}I count on no one.
translation: {Pauses}我不指望任何人。

original: That's an optimistic attitude for a general, and that's how wars get lost.
translation: 作为将军，你可真够乐观的。知道吗，不少战争就是这样输掉的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Curious}Your weakness? You seek to thwart me by claiming the Legion is too strong for you?
translation: [成功] {Curious}你们的软弱？你想用向我们示弱的方式来阻止我进攻吗？

original: It is not the strength of the West that will slow you, it is their weakness.
translation: 拖累你的并不是西部人的力量，反而是他们的软弱。

original: [FAILED] And how {emp}battles are lost... when you bring nothing but words to a contest of strength.
translation: [失败] 战争输掉的原因……就是因为你这种只会耍嘴皮子的人。

original: Well... except Vegas.
translation: 哦……还有维加斯呢。

original: Vegas will fall.
translation: 维加斯不堪一击。

original: Look, you're not listening to me - it's not about the Dam, really.
translation: 听着，我不是那个意思，这和大坝没关系，真的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] The victory here shall be swift. Our forces shall take the Dam, secure it, then build a road west on the bodies of the NCR.
translation: [成功] 那我们就能速战速决。我的军队将占领大坝，控制它，打开一条通往西部的道路，直插NCR腹地。

original: The East will hold. Once across the Colorado, nothing to rival Hoover Dam remains.
translation: 东部会保住的。只要一过科罗拉多，就没有什么能与胡佛大坝相提并论。

original: If you need all the East to crush the West...
translation: 要是你把东部所有的军队都调来进攻西部的话……

original: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.
translation: [失败] {Angered, cutting the player off}够了。

original: Look, my point about Hoover Dam is that it's hard to take, so...
translation: 听我说，我觉得胡佛大坝很难被攻下，所以……

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Angered, confused}You speak in circles - what of the East? {beat}I am the East, and I will prove it this day.
translation: [成功] {Angered, confused}你在和我兜圈子——东部怎么办？ {beat}我就是东部，而且我今天会证明这一点。

original: And then what of the East?
translation: 那东部怎么办？

original: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.
translation: [失败] {Angered, cutting the player off}够了。

original: Surely there are terms you would hear? Anything?
translation: 你就不想谈谈条件吗？什么都不想谈？

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hoover Dam has never seen the massed strength of the East. Only Legates such as Graham... who deserved the fire Caesar blessed him with.
translation: [成功] 那是因为胡佛大坝从未见识过我们在东部横行无阻的英姿。这里只有像格雷厄姆那样愚蠢的特使……他活该被凯撒施以火刑。

original: Now I am here, and make markers of your people as the Legion carves its way West.
translation: 如今我来了，我将率领军团横扫整个西部，征服你们所有人。

original: Move forward? The Legion spent years trying to take Hoover Dam.
translation: 西进？你们军团为了夺下胡佛大坝已经花了不知道多少年了。

original: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.
translation: [失败] {Angered, cutting the player off}够了。

original: I suspect the bear will surprise you in ways... in ways I can't even describe.
translation: 我敢打赌那头巨熊会给你们一个惊喜的……虽然我也不知会怎样。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Mocking}So you seek quarter? Terms of surrender?
translation: [成功] {Mocking}这么说你是来求和的？投降的条件呢？

original: Our roads into NCR are hung with the bodies of those who attempted to {disgust}negotiate with us.
translation: 在我们征服NCR的路上，早已挂满了那些企图与我们谈判的人的尸体。

original: Save your speeches, we will take Hoover Dam and move forward until our feet crush the setting sun beneath them.
translation: 所以不必浪费口舌了，胡佛大坝已是我们囊中之物，我们将一路西进，直到将夕阳都踩在脚下。

original: This battle is decided, that's why I am here.
translation: 开战已无可避免。所以我才来的。

original: [FAILED] It is the Legion that will surprise the West, but you will not be alive to see it.
translation: [失败] 该带惊喜来的是我们军团才对，可惜你不能活着看到了。

original: And I grant you that time as well.
translation: 我会等着你的。

original: So... you'll retreat?
translation: 这么说……你决定撤退了？

original: Retreat? {Beat, as if the word is new to him.}Retreat.
translation: 撤退？…撤退。

original: {Growing anger}I was a fool to listen to you... you know nothing of who I am.
translation: {Growing anger}我真是个傻瓜，居然听信了你的话……你根本不知道我的能耐。

original: I have faith. Trade helped us survive the Great War, it will do so again.
translation: 我有信心。是贸易让我们在大战后的世界得以幸存，这次，它也能拯救我们。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hnh. Then when I return, woman of the West... we shall see if your belief will withstand the blades of the Legion.
translation: [成功] 哼。那等我回来时，西部的女人……看看你的信念是否能帮你挡住军团的利刃吧。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hnh. Then when I return, man of the West... we shall see if your belief will withstand the blades of the Legion.
translation: [成功] 哼。那么等我回来时，西部的汉子……看看你的信念是否能帮你挡住军团的利刃吧。

original: But I shall give you the time you need to prepare.
translation: 不过，我会给你时间准备的。

original: Where you see death, I see change - and I see it as a strength.
translation: 你只看到了死亡，而我却看到了改变——我认为这才是真正的力量。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hnh. My coming would have saved you, set your people free in ways they cannot see.
translation: [成功] 哼。只有我的到来才能拯救你们，让你们的人民获得自由。这种自由他们是察觉不到的。

original: War would have tested them. Broken the weak with its violence, yet allowing the strong to arise.
translation: 战争将考验他们，武力可以淘汰所有的弱者，唯有真正的强者才能留下。

original: Violence gave you that strength, awakened you - I can see it upon your face, where two bullets left their mark.
translation: 是武力赋予了你力量，令你觉醒——你脸上的那两条弹痕恰好印证了这一点。

original: As Legate, do you really believe that, or are you taking a chance?
translation: 你可是特使啊，你真的相信那种话吗？还是你根本就在赌博？

original: Hnh. {Beat}Long ago... when taking Denver, I had to face such a challenge. Many died, over many years to claim the city as ours.
translation: 哼。{Beat}很久以前……我攻打丹佛的时候，也遇到过同样的问题。为了夺下那座城市，我们耗费了数年精力，还损失了大批士兵。

original: {Reflective}It was the lines of food and water that nearly broke the Legion's strength... and the lack of tribals near that cursed city.
translation: {Reflective}食物和饮水不足差点拖垮了整个军团……而且，那座该死的城市周围竟然没有一个村落。

original: What I felt in that struggle, I felt as I saw the map of the West. The West is a trap. The bear has already been caught in it, and it is dying.
translation: 那次惨烈的战斗后，我的脑海中就浮现出了整个西部的图景。西部就是一座死亡陷阱。而那头巨熊早已深陷其中，奄奄一息。

original: You know you can't supply all the West anymore than the Republic can.
translation: 你心里清楚，你们不可能比共和国更有能力去补给整条西部战线。

original: No, the taming of the West is what has defeated you - NCR's weakness is their defense.
translation: 不，你想要征服整个西部，这迟早会把你拖垮——NCR的弱点就是防守。

original: But the Legion... it's destroyed a bunch of... well, towns you need.
translation: 可军团……早就夺下了，呃，不少城镇。你也该满足了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Pauses}Vulpes... brought the touch of Caesar to such places.
translation: [成功] 是沃尔普斯……用凯撒的火焰点燃了这些地方。

original: {Beat}It was necessary to weaken the West, show that the Legion could strike deep into the places where NCR thought it safe.
translation: {Beat}给西部一个下马威是必要的，好让人们知道军团可以轻而易举地摧毁那些NCR自以为固若金汤的宝地。

original: {Rallying}But we do not need *those* towns. Like Hoover Dam, there is the power within Vegas... we can harness it for our needs.
translation: {Rallying}可我们并不需要那些城镇。如同胡佛大坝一样，维加斯城内也有取之不尽的能源……这才是我们想要的。

original: Towns? The Legion destroyed Nipton, poisoned Searchlight, butchered Nelson.
translation: 城镇？军团摧毁了尼普顿, 还在探照灯营地下毒，甚至屠光了整个纳尔逊。

original: Look, you haven't thought the economics of this through, all right?
translation: 听着，难道你就没搞清楚这其中的利弊吗？

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Confused}You rely too much on the trappings of... civilization. The people of the West were once tribes - they will relearn their ways, or...
translation: [成功] {Confused}你太信赖那些所谓的……文明了。过去，这些西部人也都是原始部落，如今，我会重新教化他们，否则……

original: The settlements West are *not* self-sufficient tribes - they need NCR, and the caravans.
translation: 西部的城镇和那些自给自足的部落根本不同——他们需要NCR的帮助，需要和商队做买卖。

original: [FAILED] {Angered, cutting the player off}Enough.
translation: [失败] {Angered, cutting the player off}够了。

original: The farther West, your strength will fail you, I promise you.
translation: 越往西，你就会越力不从心，我向你保证。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Growing anger}There are many towns, many slaves... ripe for the taking as the tribes from the East were.
translation: [成功] {Growing anger}有那么多城镇，那么多奴隶……就跟当初东部一样，正等着我们去征服。

original: There's no communities to support you in the West - you've seen to that.
translation: 你在西部可是孤军奋战，其他地方是不会帮你的，好好想想吧。

original: [FAILED] {Growing anger, disgust}I shall carve your {emph}promises into your skin so that you might think on them - and let that be the lesson this day.
translation: [失败] {Growing anger, disgust}我应该把你说的这句所谓的“保证”刻在你身上，好让你能时刻铭记今天的教训。

original: So you, uh, think military strength is enough, even without supplies?
translation: 所以说你，呃，觉得军队的战斗力已经足够了，连补给都不需要？

original: So you, uh, think military strength is enough, even without supplies?
translation: 所以说你，呃，觉得军队的战斗力已经足够了，连补给都不需要？

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Derisive}You think we would march without a means of resupply? We have the Fort, we will have the Dam - other communities will fall.
translation: [成功] {Derisive}你觉得我们的军队没办法取得补给？我们有城堡，我们也将拿下大坝——其他城镇都一样会落入我的掌心。

original: And we shall harvest as we move West. {With conviction}We only need move forward.
translation: 而且我们在一路西进时，也能收割战果。我们的军队只要不断前进就行。

original: And they don't *need* to send an army, your supply lines will kill you first.
translation: 他们根本不用派军队来，只要断了你的补给线，你就完了。

original: [FAILED] Your reliance on comfort... it rots you from the inside. You are in need of the teachings the Legion will bring to your people.
translation: [失败] 你们就是喜欢坐享其成……这迟早是要栽跟头的。你们需要军团给你们的人民好好上一课。

original: Look... there must be some deal we can make to stop this fighting - it's useless.
translation: 听着……我们可以想办法化解这场争端——这毫无意义。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Contempt}I have no *need* to hold it - anything the West sends against me shall break against the wall that is the Legion.
translation: [成功] 我没必要守住，无论西部用什么花样来对付我，他们都将在军团的铜墙铁壁上撞得粉碎。

original: You could take the West. *Holding* it is another matter.
translation: 就算你能占领整个西部，能不能*守住*它还是另一回事。

original: [FAILED] {Disgust}You seek to buy my conviction, like some merchant from the West.
translation: [失败] {Disgust}你休想像西部的那些商人一样，用花言巧语欺骗我。

original: Worth the gamble - now for the hard way.
translation: 好话说尽了——那还是来硬的吧。

original: I'm sick of talking, let's end this.
translation: 我懒得废话了，来做个了断吧。

original: <Bluff> Uh, yeah, probably don't think you can take me by yourself, huh?
translation: <恐吓> 呃，好吧，也许你觉得自己不能把我亲手干掉，是吗？

original: Maybe you'd want something more fair? Like a fair fight?
translation: 那就来点更公平的如何？比如一场公平的较量？

original: [FAILED] No, I shall make it a contest - whether I can kill you *before* my hounds tear you apart.
translation: [失败] 不，我宁愿和猎狗们比赛……看看究竟是我先将你结果掉，还是它们先把你撕成碎片。

original: [Karma] Why don't you fight me yourself if you've got the spine for it, shithead.
translation: [业力] 既然你那么有本事，干嘛不来和我单挑呢，臭屎壳子？

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}The West's treatment of bitches such as you is their weakness. {Beat, second thought}But... by my honor, I shall face you alone, as you request.
translation: [成功] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}西部居然能让你这种荡妇如此逍遥，实在是教化不严。{Beat, second thought}不过……为了我的荣誉，我会尊重你的请求，与你单独决斗。

original: {Snarling}Woman of the West... you will learn your place - in my tent, and again, when you beg for release on the edge of my blade.
translation: {Snarling}你们这些西部娘们……等我把你拖回营帐，让你俯在刀尖上向我求饶时，我会好好让你明白自己的地位的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}I shall make a cape of your skin. And your skull - it shall sit by my side, mute, watching as my armies march West.
translation: [成功] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}我要剥了你的皮做披风。我要将你的头颅放在手边，让你安安静静地亲眼看着我的军队踏平整个西部。

original: {Snarling}I shall honor your last words... and face you alone, as you request. No man will say I refused your challenge.
translation: {Snarling}我会尊重你的遗愿，与你单独决斗。所有人都可以证明，我没有拒绝你的挑战。

original: <Bluff> If you're such a "Terror" of the East, call off your dogs and face me one on one.
translation: <恐吓> 要是你在东部真有那么所向披靡，那就叫你的手下让开，我们单挑。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}The West's treatment of bitches such as you is their weakness. {Beat, second thought}But... by my honor, I shall face you alone, as you request.
translation: [成功] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}西部居然能让你这种荡妇如此逍遥，实在是教化不严。{Beat, second thought}不过……为了我的荣誉，我会尊重你的请求，与你单独决斗。

original: {Snarling}Woman of the West... you will learn your place - in my tent, and again, when you beg for release on the edge of my blade.
translation: {Snarling}你们这些西部娘们……等我把你拖回营帐，让你俯在刀尖上向我求饶时，我会好好让你明白自己的地位的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}I shall make a cape of your skin. And your skull - it shall sit by my side, mute, watching as my armies march West.
translation: [成功] {Takes a ragged, angry breath}我要剥了你的皮做披风。我要将你的头颅放在手边，让你安安静静地看着我的军队踏平整个西部。

original: {Snarling}I shall honor your last words... and face you alone, as you request. No man will say I refused your challenge.
translation: {Snarling}我会尊重你的遗愿，与你单独决斗。所有人都可以证明，我没有拒绝你的挑战。

original: [Karma] Any man can claim bravery when he outnumbers his opponent.
translation: [业力] 人多底气足，只要人数占优，谁都敢说自己是勇士。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Frowns}Hnh. I have seen little of true battle this day. And you were brave to come here to face me when all of NCR would not.
translation: [成功] {Frowns}哼。确实，今天都没真刀真枪地打过仗。NCR全做了缩头乌龟，而你却敢来面见我，说明你很有勇气。

original: {Nods, respectful}I shall honor your last words and face you alone. No man will say I refused your challenge.
translation: {Nods, respectful}我会尊重你的遗愿，与你单独决斗。所有人可以证明，我并没有拒绝你的挑战。

original: Whatever... just hurry before NCR finishes their plans.
translation: 无所谓……动作快点，可别让NCR的计谋得逞。

original: The West will be waiting.
translation: 我们西部拭目以待。

original: I will await that day, Legate Lanius.
translation: 我等着那一天，拉尼厄斯特使。

original: {Final word, slight suspicion}Perhaps it is unfortunate Vulpes was not here to hear your words... something tells me you would prove more than his match.
translation: {Final word, slight suspicion}可惜沃尔普斯不能亲耳听到你说这种话了……我有种感觉，你比他要强得多。

original: {Final word, slight suspicion}Perhaps it is fortunate Vulpes went to his death before this day... something tells me your words would have surpassed even his skills.
translation: {Final word, slight suspicion}也许沃尔普斯没能活到今天反而是件幸事……我有预感，你的本领远在他之上。

original: Until the day when our armies meet again, NCR - I shall wait for you on the battlefield.
translation: 那么就让我们来日再交手吧，NCR——我会在战场上等着你们的。

original: Until the day when our armies meet again, envoy of Vegas - I shall wait for you on the battlefield.
translation: 那么就让我们来日再交手吧，维加斯的使者——我会在战场上等着你的。
