original: Until the day when our armies meet again, courier - I shall wait for you on the battlefield.
translation: 那么就让我们来日再交手吧，邮差——我会在战场上等着你的。

original: When your own must ally with the West in order to remove you? Such treachery must be answered.
translation: 想想看，你的手下为了消灭你，居然和西部结盟了。如此公然背叛领袖，你还能坐得住？

original: You speak with conviction, and more importantly, with honor. {Beat}And we secured a foothold on the Dam... easily, as you have said.
translation: 你说的有理有据，更重要的是，你展现出了军人应有的尊严。{Beat}确实正如你所言……夺取这大坝上的据点实在太顺利了。

original: Graham's overconfidence forever branded him with fire, I will not follow his trail of fire into the depths of the Grand Canyon.
translation: 格雷厄姆就是因为盲目自信，才会最终玩火自焚，我绝不会重蹈他的覆辙。

original: {Resolved}The Republic shall keep their Old World gate this day, I shall return East. When I return, I shall have all the armies of the Legion with me.
translation: {Resolved}今天，就让共和国继续把守着这扇旧世界的大门吧。我要回东部去了，当我归来时，我身后跟着的将是军团所有的部队。

original: I do not wish to die this day, it is true. But nor do I wish to win through trickery.
translation: 我当然不想死。但我也觉得，用这种阴谋诡计来取胜实在不够光彩。

original: If you return East and exact vengeance, it buys the West time - and thins the Legion ranks.
translation: 如果你回东部去制裁那些小人，就等于给了西部喘息的机会。而且军团的战斗力也会受到影响。

original: If what you say is true, then they shall answer for it.
translation: 如果你说的是真的，那他们就应当受到惩罚。

original: But you suggest I turn from battle to answer these crimes, when I can prove myself greater by meeting them - then returning with the Dam as ours.
translation: 而你现在却要我抛下眼前的战斗，去追查这些罪行。我宁可将计就计，夺下大坝，带着累累的战果凯旋，如此更能证明我的能力。

original: You almost convinced me otherwise... but justice comes to all in time, and it now comes to you.
translation: 我差点就中了你的计……正义终究会得到伸张，而现在，先轮到你吧。

original: There are those among the Legion that would see you fall as Graham did.
translation: 军团里有人想要你和格雷厄姆一样完蛋。

original: Perhaps the treachery of your own ranks disgusts you as it disgusts me.
translation: 也许是因为我与你一样，对手足同袍背叛自己感到深恶痛绝吧。

original: Of course. And I guard myself from such acts of cowardice and jealousy.
translation: 当然。我自己是绝不会做出如此懦弱和嫉妒的举动的。

original: You claim that word of my coming has been given to the West so that I might die here... even as I take the Dam?
translation: 你说我的动向已经被透露给了西部，即便夺下大坝……我也会死在这里，是吗？

original: Telling me this does not benefit you at all... you gamble with your words, and your coin is lacking.
translation: 这种话对你一点好处也没有……你想靠花言巧语来赌博，可你却没有多少筹码。

original: <Bluff> How could a lone opponent like me reach you so easily, then?
translation: <恐吓> 那么，我这样单枪匹马又是如何这样轻易地来到你身边的呢？

original: <Bluff> Graham did not smell the C4 until he entered Boulder... he only smelled victory.
translation: <恐吓> 格雷厄姆直到进入巨石城，才发现有C4……就是因为他被胜利冲昏了头。

original: <Bluff> Your success was too easy, though, wasn't it? You think I reached you by chance?
translation: <恐吓> 你没觉得自己的进攻太顺利了吗？你以为我是恰好撞见你们的？

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Suspicious}You play on my instincts. Yet your intention in this... you have nothing to gain by telling me of this... "trap."
translation: [成功] {Suspicious}你在嘲笑我的直觉。可你究竟什么企图……就算你告诉我这是……圈套，你也没有好处可拿。

original: {Angry}Unless you seek to goad me into a retreat, leaving the battlefield and leaving my honor here to be trampled underfoot by Republic cowards.
translation: {Angry}除非你是打算逼我撤退，逼我将尊严丢在战场上，任由那些共和国的懦夫们践踏。

original: <Bluff> That strength... other Legates didn't see it either, until it was too late.
translation: 他们很厉害……其他特使一开始也都胸有成竹，等发现已经来不及了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Slightly to himself}We did take the towers easier than expected. I cannot believe even the Republic would overlook such an opening in their defenses.
translation: [成功]{Slightly to himself} 我们确实没花多少力气就夺下了进水塔。我也不明白共和国为什么会在防线上留下这么一大个漏洞。

original: {Rallying}Yet we are at throat of the Great Bear. Victory is at hand.
translation: {Rallying}不过我们已经将刀刺入了巨熊的喉咙。胜利在望了。

original: <Bluff> The position of your veterans, using the Dam's intake towers - all as expected.
translation: 你那些精兵的位置，还有你们利用大坝进水塔来进攻的手段——都正如我们的预料。

original: [FAILED] I am not another Legate, and I am not such a fool as Graham, to be painted in pitch and set aflame.
translation: [失败] 可惜我和他们不同，我才不会像格雷厄姆那样，被涂上沥青烧成焦炭。

original: If all NCR believes as you do, then this battle is already won.
translation: 如果NCR的所有人都像你那样想的话，那么我们就已经胜利了。

original: <Bluff> I think they believe you'll be tricked as easily... maybe easier.
translation: 可能他们觉得你很容易上当……或者不能说是容易，而是一定。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Thinking}Hnh. {Beat}You believe your own words, even if I do not.
translation: [成功] {Thinking}哼。{Beat}你自己信去吧，反正我不信。

original: {Slightly suspicious}Perhaps NCR has the strength of a cornered animal... it will not be enough to hold this place.
translation: {Slightly suspicious}也许NCR能使出困兽犹斗般的力量……但他们也不可能守得住这里。

original: They know nothing of my tactics - or the strength of my forces. They will learn.
translation: 他们不了解我的战术……不了解我的军队。他们会尝到苦头的。

original: <Bluff> NCR has studied you as they did Graham, and the trap is ready for you.
translation: NCR对你们早就了如指掌了，格雷厄姆就是例证。他们已经下好套了。

original: [FAILED] {Contempt}Then they know nothing of me or the Legion's subjugation of the East.
translation: [失败] {Contempt}那我只能说，他们根本没见识过我和军团征服东部时的英姿。

original: And to send you to deceive me... it is you that they have tricked, not I.
translation: 他们居然还想派你来蒙骗我……我看他们骗的不是我，是你。

original: <Bluffs> But... history has shown defeat is assured. Uh, yours, that is.
translation: 可是……历史会证明失败是必然的……呃，我是说你们。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Insulted}You dare speak that name? Comparing him to any man of Caesar will only earn you a slow death.
translation: [成功] {Insulted}你竟敢说出那个名字？竟敢拿他与凯撒的勇士们相提并论，我要你不得好死。

original: {Anger building}You think me some lesser man, some other Legate? I am the first of the Legion, and this gate to the West shall be ours this day.
translation: {Anger building}你以为我是个无能的懦夫特使？我可是军团里数一数二的人物，今天，这扇通往西部的大门必将为我们的军队敞开。

original: <Bluff> Persist and learn what Graham learned at the Dam - and Boulder City.
translation: 一意孤行的话，那就等着和格雷厄姆一个下场吧，想想当年他在大坝和巨石城的遭遇。

original: [FAILED] {Slight sneer}Those are your final words? They are too weak to even wash the stain of your disgrace this day.
translation: [失败] {Slight sneer}这就是你的遗言了吗？真是无足挂齿，连你那一点丢掉的颜面都无法弥补。

original: Yet if those are the words you wish to be remembered for, then I shall... {beat, disgust, as if "honor is undeserving}*honor* them.
translation: 不过既然你想把这句话留给后人，那么我……还是会*尊重*你的意愿的。

original: Nice mask, can't wait to take it as a trophy.
translation: 面具真不错呀，我都等不及要拿回去当战利品了。

original: We shall see how brave you are when nailed to the walls of Hoover Dam, your body facing West so you may watch your world die.
translation: 等我把你钉到胡佛大坝的墙上，看你还有多少勇气这么说。我要让你面向西方，看着自己脚下的世界化作一片焦土。

original: I'm here to kill you. The Legion's advance ends here.
translation: 我是来杀你的。你的军团休想再前进半步。

original: {Respectful, eager}Enough words, then. Let our strength settle this.
translation: {Respectful, eager}那就不必多言了，让我们用凭实力来做个了断吧。

original: {Caesar dead}What, Caesar giving you orders beyond the grave?
translation: {Caesar dead}怎么，凯撒都进坟墓了，你还在听从他的命令？

original: Caesar's will is the will of the Legion. And the West... all beneath the flag of the Great Bear exist to test the strength of the Legion.
translation: 凯撒的意志就是军团的意志。而西部……凡是打着狗熊旗的人，都是在企图挑战军团的力量。

original: The West shall fall as the East fell, and all the tribes that stretch to the setting sun shall bear the mark of the Legion.
translation: 西部终将像东部一样陷落，到那时，所有位于日落之地的部族都将刻上军团的印记。

original: {Caesar alive}What, Caesar wasn't brave enough to come take the Dam himself?
translation: {Caesar alive}什么，凯撒连御驾亲征夺取大坝的勇气都没有吗？

original: Caesar's will is made truth through me. I am a hammer against all that defy his rule.
translation: 凯撒的意志由我来执行。我是他的铁锤，任何反对他统治的人都将被我消灭。

original: If you seek to stand against me, you shall fall as the West falls.
translation: 如果你也想反抗我，那么你和整个西部都将一同化为灰烬。

original: Maybe you're willing to listen to reason.
translation: 也许咱们可以讲讲道理。

original: {Disgust}I see you fight with words, like all beneath the flag of the bear. Let us hope your skill with weapons proves greater.
translation: {Disgust}你和狗熊旗下的那些渣滓没什么两样，都是满嘴的花言巧语。还是看看你在战场上能有多大的能耐吧。

original: If you think you've got any chance of taking Hoover Dam, you're wrong.
translation: 你要是以为自己真能夺下胡佛大坝，那就大错特错了。

original: {Disdain}Many graves in the East are filled with those who said as much, with braver words, not backed by strength.
translation: {Disdain}东部坟头里埋着的那些家伙，说过的话可比你还要豪情万丈，可惜他们太自不量力。

original: It is Caesar's {emph}will this gate to the West bear the flag of the Legion. {Beat, a little quieter, resolved}Caesar's will shall be done.
translation: 在通向西部的大门上立起军团的旗帜是凯撒的意志。{Beat, a little quieter, resolved}凯撒的意志必须要实现。

original: Who do you think will win at Hoover Dam? The NCR, or Caesar's Legion?
translation: 你觉得胡佛大坝的战役谁会赢？NCR还是凯撒军团？

original: I'll put you back in your tube, good as new.
translation: 我会把你放回管子里的，就和新的一样。

original: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}No... ruined everything... exposed... germs... a year of... life, if... at most...
translation: {rasping，wheezing voice，like you have emphysema}不……毁了一切……暴露在……细菌下……最多……一年……可活……

original: You won't be able to control anything, but I'll let you live.
translation: 你再也无法控制任何东西了，不过我会留你一条小命的。

original: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}No! ...Don't disable... cerebral... I'd rather be... killed... just kill... me...
translation: {rasping，wheezing voice，like you have emphysema}不！不要关掉……我的大脑系统……我宁愿……死……杀了我……好了……

original: Time for you to die, Mr. House.
translation: 你的死期到了，豪斯先生。

original: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}May there be... a hell... for you... a Tartarus...  bleak, unending...
translation: {rasping，wheezing voice，like you have emphysema}愿你……下地狱……昏暗、无尽的……冥界……

original: Yes Man needs you out of the way.
translation: 好好先生嫌你碍事了。

original: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}{bitter, wheezing laugh}Your... vanity project... doomed to fail...
translation: {rasping，wheezing voice，like you have emphysema}{bitter，wheezing laugh}你们……这个自负的计划……注定失败……

original: By Caesar's command, you will die.
translation: 奉凯撒之命，你必须死。

original: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}Slavery... the future of... mankind? What... have you... done?
translation: {rasping，wheezing voice，like you have emphysema}奴隶制……人类的……未来？……你……到底……做了什么？

original: The NCR asked me to get rid of you.
translation: NCR要我除掉你。

original: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}Those snakes? ...for them? ...you sad, misguided... whore.
translation: {rasping，wheezing voice，like you have emphysema}那些毒蛇？……为了他们？……你这个可怜的，被蒙蔽的……小人。

original: I don't like you.
translation: 我不喜欢你。

original: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}Fool... to let... personalities... derail future... of mankind? ...Stupid!
translation: {rasping，wheezing voice，like you have emphysema}蠢货……让……情感……凌驾于人类的……未来之上？……愚蠢！

original: It's just business.
translation: 只是工作罢了。

original: {rasping, wheezing voice, like you have emphysema}If personal gain... what you sought... should've done... as asked...
translation: {rasping，wheezing voice，like you have emphysema}如果你追求的……个人利益……能由我……去满足的话……

original: Aggressive acts on the casino premises will be met with lethal force. Vacate the premises immediately.
translation: 在赌场内寻衅滋事将会受到严肃处理。请立即撤离该场所。

original: Vacate the premises immediately. The casino is off-limits for 24 hours.
translation: 立刻撤离该场所。赌场将关闭24小时。

original: Vacate the premises immediately. All Securitrons are at a state of high alert.
translation: 立刻撤离该场所。所有电子保安进入高度警戒状态。

original: Hold on, now, hold on. Just a moment...
translation: 等等，等等。再等一下……

original: Turn around and leave, and I'll... I won't attack you any further.
translation: 你走吧，我不会……我不会再攻击你了。

original: Just... stay away from the console. It doesn't do anything...
translation: 别……别靠近控制台。它一点用都没有。

original: You've come back to kill me this time, I assume?
translation: 你是来杀了我的，是吗？

original: Ironic, how this turned out. The thousands of hours I spent calculating odds, running projections, planning for every contingency...
translation: 真讽刺啊，竟然是这种结局。我花了数千个小时，计算概率，推演未来，穷尽了所有的可能……

original: ...only to be done in by a mail carrier with a grandiosity complex.
translation: ……可这一切都毁在了一个送信小卒的手里。

original: Get it over with, will you?
translation: 来做个了结吧，好吗？

original: Think you're doing well to have made it this far?
translation: 你以为能走到这一步是你的本事？

original: Your chances of breaking through my defenses, they're... minimal, at best!
translation: 你攻破我防御系统的几率，哪怕在最理想的情况下，也几乎……为零！

original: Why are you doing this?
translation: 你为什么要这么做？

original: I would've made you wealthy! You could've helped change the world!
translation: 我本可以让你富甲一方！你本可以助我改变世界！

original: You're actually going to do this all over again?
translation: 你真的打算再来一次吗？

original: Damn it, will you die already?
translation: 该死，你怎么还活着？

original: You dared come here, after what you did?
translation: 你干出那种事，竟然还有脸来？

original: What do you think you're going to do? Fight you way up to the penthouse and assassinate me?
translation: 你想搞什么名堂？一路杀到顶楼来干掉我吗？

original: You came here to finish what you think you started?
translation: 你是来为自己闯下的祸都做个了结吗？

original: This is nothing compared to what's waiting for you up in the penthouse.
translation: 等到了顶层，你就会发现自己所做的一切是多么愚蠢。

original: Vegas will still rise again. Your betrayal won't defeat me!
translation: 维加斯必将东山再起，你的背叛是不会令我倒下的！

original: The Lucky 38 will be your grave. I'll finish what Benny couldn't get right!
translation: 幸运38将是你的葬身之处。本尼没做成的事，就由我来完成！

original: Cannibalism was strictly forbidden in their contract. If some of them broke that stricture, they deserved whatever punishment you dealt them.
translation: 食人在合同里是被明令禁止的。如果他们中有一部分人违反了条款，你可以随意处置他们。

original: Did you know I killed some White Gloves who were eating their customers?
translation: 你知不知道我杀死了一些白手套社团的成员？他们竟然吃人。

original: {perturbed}No, I was not aware of this.
translation: {perturbed}不，我不知道这些。

original: Is it really so hard {emphasis}not to engage in cannibalism? My goodness...
translation: 难道学会不吃人就这么{emphasis}困难吗？我的天啊……

original: It's a violation of their contract. I authorize you to deal with them in any way you see fit.
translation: 他们违反了合同。我授权你任意处置他们。

original: Did you know some of the White Gloves are... eating people again?
translation: 你知道一些白手套社团成员……又开始吃人了吗？

original: {not going to deny it}Yes, of course. But refraining from those "dietary practices" is a primary requirement of their contract.
translation: {not going to deny it}是的，当然。但在我与他们签署的合同中，最主要的一点就是他们必须戒除这一"饮食习惯"。

original: They've been good to their word. Put together one hell of a resort hotel, too.
translation: 他们还算守信。把一间破酒店经营得井井有条。

original: From what I hear, I'd want to eat at the Gourmand every night... if I were ambulatory.
translation: 据说，他们的格调还挺高，如果我还能动弹的话……我也想每晚去美食家餐厅品尝佳肴。

original: Were you aware that the White Glove Society used to be cannibals?
translation: 你有没有意识到白手套社团以前是食人族？

original: Why is the terminal on the North wall off-limits?
translation: 为什么北面墙上的终端被禁止使用？

original: I recommend following the Securitron's instructions. Its programming is... {beat}strict, and I don't have time to change it.
translation: 我建议你遵照电子保安的指示。它的程序设定…{beat}很精密，我没时间做修改。

original: Where does New Vegas get all its electricity?
translation: 新维加斯哪里来的电力？

original: {stating the obvious}Hoover Dam, of course. A hydroelectric dam?
translation: 哦，当然是胡佛大坝。那是一座水电站。

original: The NCR had it up and running at 50% capacity within a year of occupying the dam. By treaty, New Vegas receives 5% of its output - more than enough.
translation: NCR占领大坝还不到一年，就恢复了其50%的产能。根据协议，新维加斯可以分得其5%的电力——这就完全够用了。

original: You do know Caesar is dead, don't you?
translation: 你知道凯撒已经死了吧？

original: By my calculations, his death will affect the shape of the battle for Hoover Dam minimally, if at all.
translation: 根据我的计算，他的死对胡佛大坝战役的影响微乎其微，甚至可以忽略不计。

original: The Legion's aggression will outlive Caesar. Indeed, they'll try to take the dam as a tribute to his memory.
translation: 军团好斗的本质并不会因为凯撒的死而改变。事实上，他们会更渴望用一场胜利来祭奠自己曾经的领袖。

original: Given a year, they'd have him deified - but by then the Legion will be breaking down, riven by internal conflicts, a monster consuming itself.
translation: 不到一年，他们便会将他奉若神明——但那时候，军团就会因内讧而四分五裂，犹如一头巨兽，逐渐被自己消耗殆尽。

original: It's irrelevant. In the short term, the Legion is still monster enough that defeating it will make me look powerful indeed.
translation: 但这都无关紧要。短期来看，军团依然是一只强大的怪物，而战胜它，无疑会给我带来巨大的威望。

original: What's the deal with the snowglobe collection?
translation: 你收集这些雪花球模型要做什么用呢？

original: What of it? I enjoy them. There's something about a little diorama set inside a glass dome that I... {beat}find pleasing.
translation: 做什么用？我喜欢它们。看到这样一个小巧的模型被装在玻璃罩子里，我感到……很开心。

original: If you run across any out in the wastes, turn them in to Jane. She'll compensate you.
translation: 如果你在废土旅行时发现了类似的东西，交给简，她会给你报酬的。

original: I'll see what I can do to convince him the Dam belongs to us.
translation: 我会想办法说服他，让他知道大坝是我们的地盘。

original: If you needed someone killed, all you need to do is say so.
translation: 如果你想让某个人死，你只需要说一声就行了。

original: How do you propose we deal with NCR?
translation: 你觉得我们该怎么对付NCR？

original: Hope NCR's a lot less entrenched than they seem.
translation: 希望NCR的势力没有看起来那么强大。

original: Fine. Let's hear it, then.
translation: 好啊，说说看。

original: About time. I was starting to get bored with all this waiting around.
translation: 差不多了。我实在是等得不耐烦了。

original: {Angry}As was I... yet I was ordered to await you. Now that you are here, we may act.
translation: {Angry}我也一样……可我的命令就是等你前来。现在你来了，我们可以行动了。

original: I'm ready, what needs to be done?
translation: 我准备好了，需要做些什么？

original: I've got other questions for you.
translation: 我还有其他问题要问你。

original: Okay, bring it on!
translation: 好了，放马过来吧！

original: {A hint of sincere emotion shows through her otherwise stoic mask}I've come to expect nothing less from you, brave stranger.
translation: {A hint of sincere emotion shows through her otherwise stoic mask}我对你抱有极大的期望，勇敢的陌生人。

original: Get to your cage and ready your arm.
translation: 进笼子里去，准备好战斗吧。

original: I'll defeat as many as you've got.
translation: 无论你来多少，我都照杀不误。

original: {Pauses to judge players' words, quite taken}I can see your resolve, determined like the nature of a beast. So be it.
translation: {Pauses to judge players' words, quite taken}我能看出你的决心，和野兽一样坚定。那就如你所愿。

original: {Enjoys the over compliment, but retains composure}Bold, as it pleases The Thorn, and me. But it does take more than that to earn my admiration.
translation: {Enjoys the over compliment, but retains composure}你很胆大，荆棘街喜欢这种品质，我也一样。但想要赢得我的赞赏，光有胆量还远远不够。

original: You speak like a hunter, yet only actions prove one's worth. The Thorn requires a tribute of blood, and so do I.
translation: 你虽然说话的口气像个猎手，可只有行动才能证明一个人的价值。荆棘街需要他人奉上鲜血，我也一样。

original: You show great promise. I look forward to the time when I can call you{weighing the words "My Hunter" as something special} "My Hunter," but that time has not yet arrived.
translation: 你前途无量。我等着能把你叫作{weighing the words "My Hunter" as something special}"我的猎手"的那一天，但现在还没到时候。

original: {Softer, gentler, if still confident, voice}Your bravery surpasses that of any other, and I've come to admire your actions.
translation: {Softer, gentler, if still confident, voice}你的勇气远胜他人，我很欣赏你的举动。

original: Before death takes us, I would know you deeper. Come with me...{slight pause to savor the words} My Hunter.
translation: 在死亡带走我们之前，我想更深入地了解你。跟我来……{slight pause to savor the words}我的猎手。

original: What's your take on the state of affairs of the Mojave Wasteland?
translation: 你对莫哈维废土的局势怎么看？

original: The land does not care about petty squabbles among lesser men. I don't care about that either.
translation: 这片土地是不会在乎下等民众的小打小闹的。我也一样。

original: In the end, the people of New Vegas will continue to live and die here. It matters not who their{A hint of Mockery} self-appointed "master" is.
translation: 反正到头来，新维加斯的人民依旧会在这里生息繁衍。无论是谁自诩为"王"，都不会有差别。

original: How did you become the master of The Thorn?
translation: 你是怎么成为荆棘街的主人的？

original: {Not chiding, but stating it as a fact of belief}The Thorn is my master, not the other way around. I live to make our kin able to transcend their limitations.
translation: {Not chiding, but stating it as a fact of belief}荆棘街是我的主人，而非相反。我的使命就是为了激励同胞们超越自己的极限。

original: {Not a lament, but a matter of fact, of human condition}Our land is harsh, and hostile. Our lives are cheap, and fragile. Death is our assured fate, striking when least we expect it.
translation: {Not a lament, but a matter of fact, of human condition}这片蛮荒之地充满了危险，我们的生命却又如此渺小脆弱。无人能逃脱死亡的命运，可它却总在不经意间突然降临。

original: The Thorn awakens us to the truth. Here we escape from our bonds, and choose the moment of death against the will of destiny.
translation: 荆棘街用真相唤醒了我们。在这里我们挣脱宿命的枷锁，用主动迎接死亡来对抗命运的意志。

original: Westside attracts all sorts of travelers, including merchants and farmers. They come here to exchange their goods, or to seek protection.
translation: 西区接纳各色各样的旅行者，包括商人和农夫。他们来这儿做生意，或者寻求保护。

original: Our community provides enough food, clothes, weapons and medicine to encourage trade, and to arm our defenses.
translation: 我们的社区提供充足的粮食、衣物、武器和医疗服务，不仅能促进贸易，也能维护治安。

original: {Proud}The Thorn demonstrates, beyond anything else, that we're self-sufficient. Our desert-blood has overcome even the strongest beasts of the Wasteland.
translation: {Proud}而荆棘街则进一步证明了我们可以自给自足。即便是废土上最强的野兽，在我们的荒漠血性面前也要俯首称臣。

original: Is Westside part of New Vegas?
translation: 西区是新维加斯的一部分吗？

original: New Vegas has many faces, stranger. Despite everything, it shall never be whole.
translation: 新维加斯在世人眼中千变万化，陌生人。但无论如何，它都不可能是一个整体。

original: When the land hunts you, when fighting for survival is the norm, your neighbors become either saviors, or enemies.
translation: 如果这片土地随时都能置你于死地，如果为生存而战成为普天共有的常态，那么你周围要么是你的救主，要么就是你的敌人。

original: Westside is a part of New Vegas, just as much as it's a part of the Wasteland. In the end, stranger, we need them both to continue making our fate.
translation: 西区是新维加斯的一部分，但它也是废土的一部分。说到底，陌生人，要创造我们自己的命运，这二者缺一不可。

translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: Gun for hire?
translation: 雇佣兵？

original: When I quit the escort job, I had enough money to buy a pistol belt and some other gear.
translation: 辞去伴游的工作后，我就拿出积蓄，买了武器装备。

original: Bodyguards make a good honest living, and I had the wits and physical build to handle most thugs.
translation: 当保镖挣钱，心里踏实，我的体型和智商也足以应付绝大多数坏人。

original: After saving a few tourists from trouble, I got a reputation for being a stand-up guy again, and after a decade managed to save up enough to retire.
translation: 在帮助一些游客摆脱麻烦后，我又成了人们眼里的一条好汉。后来十年，我存够了养老钱，就退休了。

original: Oh, I could never do that.
translation: 哦，我可不会干这种活儿。

original: Well, I didn't have any other career opportunities open to me at the time and had to make ends meet.
translation: 哎，那时我也没得选啊，日子总得过下去吧。

original: I was good at it too, but after a while I just felt like a piece of meat and had to quit.
translation: 其实我干得很不错。但过了不久，我感觉自己像是一具行尸走肉，于是就不干了。

original: So you got paid for sex?
translation: 这么说你指的是有偿性服务？

original: Yep. I was damn good at my job, too. But after a while I just felt like a piece of meat and had to quit.
translation: 对，其实我干得很不错。但过了不久，我感觉自己像是一具行尸走肉，于是就不干了。

original: You said escort? Like armed guard?
translation: 你说伴游？是指陪人出游吗？

original: Well, I supposed you could look at it that way, but I was packing a whole different kind of heat. No, escort just sounds better than man-whore.
translation: 呃，你这样理解也行，不过我主要负责帮人降火。所谓伴游，只是对男妓委婉一点的称呼罢了。

original: Wrong place at the wrong time, if you ask me.
translation: 要我说，这就是点儿太背。

original: Yeah, shit indeed happens. I was stripped of my casino apartment and all of my belongings and booted back into Freeside.
translation: 是啊，人生不如意十之八九。我被从赌场公寓赶回了自由城，所有东西都被没收了。

original: From there I didn't have a lot of career options, as my rep was destroyed. So, the escort job sort of fell into my lap, no pun intended.
translation: 我的名声彻底毁了，各家老板纷纷对我关上大门。于是，私人伴游的工作也就自然而然落到了我的裤裆里，这不是冷笑话。

original: That's horrible!
translation: 这太可怕了！

original: Yeah, but what can you do? I was stripped of my casino apartment and all of my belongings and booted back into Freeside.
translation: 是啊，但你又能怎样？我被从赌场公寓赶回了自由城，所有东西都被没收了。

original: From there I didn't have a lot of career options, as my rep was destroyed. So, the escort job sort of fell into my lap, no pun intended.
translation: 我的名声彻底毁了，各家老板纷纷对我关上大门。于是，私人伴游的工作也就自然而然落到了我的裤裆里，这不是冷笑话。

original: What happened?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Well, being a suave young guy, I chatted up the ladies from time to time, and one of the managers' girls started to take a liking to me.
translation: 那时候我年轻英俊，经常和姑娘们谈天说地，有个经理的女人看上了我。

original: I never touched the woman, but the jealous prick decided it was my time to go. He framed me by saying I'd stolen from the casino.
translation: 虽然我从没碰过那姑娘，但那小子还是出于嫉妒把我赶走了。他诬陷我，说我偷了赌场的东西。

original: Sure enough, a few grand was missing from the casino vault. I have to assume the bastard stole the funds and figured I was a convenient fall guy.
translation: 结果赌场的金库果真丢失了几千块钱。我想肯定是那混蛋偷了之后栽赃到我头上的。

original: Crier? What was that job?
translation: 通告员？那是什么工作？

original: After a while I made enough money to get a passport into Vegas. Back then you could get approved for entry for a fraction of what it costs now.
translation: 我靠着攒下的一点儿积蓄买了一本进入维加斯的通行证。那时候的价钱还不到现在一个零头。

original: Well, I got a job working as a crier outside of The Tops advertising for the local talent performing at the casino. That didn't last long.
translation: 我找到了一份通告员的工作，在九重天外面，为赌场里表演的艺人打广告。但我没干多久。

original: That sounds odd.
translation: 听起来有问题。

original: You're telling me. Not long after my father's shop went under and he passed away from the loss, people around town started experiencing shakes.
translation: 你说的没错。就在我父亲因为屠宰场关门而黯然去世后不久，镇上的人便出现了抽搐的症状。

original: No one gets shakes like that unless they're eating human flesh, but no one would believe me. The sick bastard gradually went insane and passed away.
translation: 除非是吃了人肉，否则不会抽成那样，可没人相信我。那个卖肉的混蛋逐渐失去理智，后来也死了。

original: Wasn't long before someone moved into the guy's place and found half-buried human remains in the crawlspace. I didn't bother saying told ya so.
translation: 不久之后，有人搬进了他住的屋子，才在地板下面发现了埋在土里的人体残骸。我也懒得再和他们说”不听老人言“了。

original: Butcher? How did you get into that?
translation: 屠夫？你怎么会干这个勾当？

original: My father ran a butcher shop here in town, but business went downhill when another vendor started selling this strange meat at half of our prices.
translation: 我父亲曾在镇上开过一间屠宰场，可后来有个商人卖起了来路不明的肉，价格只有我们的一半，我们的生意从此一落千丈。

original: Courier? I used to be a courier before I got shot in the head.
translation: 邮差？在我脑袋挨了别人一枪前，我也是个邮差。

original: Exactly one of the reasons I got out of that job. Too many shifty characters looking to have someone else move their hot items.
translation: 这也是我退出那行当的原因之一。别有用心的人太多，总是找其他人帮他们运送危险货物。

original: How would you like to work for the Garrets?
translation: 有兴趣为加勒特家族工作吗？

original: I'm retired, but life has been a bit dull without some kind of action. What's the job?
translation: 虽然我已经退休了，但人活着不找点事做还真是无聊。什么工作？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: What's your story?
translation: 你的身世是怎样的

original: I've done a bit of everything around here - courier, butcher, crier, escort, gun for hire...
translation: 我在这儿什么都干过，邮差，屠夫，通告员，伴游，雇佣兵…

original: Some of which I'm not proud of, but I do my best to help around town when needed.
translation: 有些工作让我难以启齿，但镇上需要的时候，我总是竭尽所能。

original: Why wouldn't I want to go past the greeter?
translation: 为什么我没法通过迎宾人员的盘查？

original: Those bots are programmed to vaporize anyone who enters the fenced-in area without authorization from the greeter.
translation: 那些机器人都内置了程序，凡是没得到迎宾人员的许可就企图往高墙里闯的人，都会被它们轰成灰。

original: Thanks for the free advice. Who are you?
translation: 谢谢你的忠告。你是谁？

original: The name's Old Ben. I've been living in Freeside since the day I was born.
translation: 我叫老本。自打出生起，我就住在自由城了。

original: How do you like the new job?
translation: 新工作还适应吗？

original: It is a dream come true. Santiago never thought he could work in such a wonderous den of vice and iniquity.
translation: 简直就像美梦成真，圣地亚哥从没想到能在这么好的地方工作。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Your loss, my friend.
translation: 这是你的损失，我的朋友。

original: I don't believe this means we'll see the last of you - or the Legion.
translation: 我可不相信你会就此罢手——还有你的军团。

original: I already defeated the Legate and the Legion, you won't be much trouble.
translation: 我已经击败了特使和军团，对付你也不会是什么大问题。

original: If you intend to fight, go ahead, it doesn't matter to me.
translation: 如果你坚持要战斗，那请便，反正我不在乎。

original: Ever resisted arrest on the Strip? Then you know the odds.
translation: 你看长街上有人拒捕过吗？你自己也知道胜算渺茫。

original: You will because the alternative is worse - and useless. Much like NCR.
translation: 你会的，因为其他选择只会更糟，也毫无益处。就和NCR一样。

original: We held this place for years, kicked one Legate out of here so hard Caesar burned him to a crisp. It's our post, we've fought for it.
translation: 我们戍守此地多年，将凯撒的特使打得一败涂地，气得凯撒把他烧成了人干。我们为了它拼尽全力，这里就是我们的职责所在。

original: I'll fight for it again today. If you're looking to convince me otherwise, you better have a lot more reasons than you just telling me to go.
translation: 所以今天，我会再次为它而战。如果你想说服我离开，那你最好准备一些更加充分的理由。

original: {Chuckles}Look, House... Vegas... it's pretty, got you blinded a bit maybe, but NCR's got perks, too. Think about it before you sign on with him.
translation: 呵，听着，豪斯……维加斯……它是很美，可以美到让你一时眼花，但NCR也并非一无是处。在你把自己卖给他以前，再好好想想吧。

original: And if you say "no," keep in mind what that means. NCR may have its problems, but when we're riled, watch out.
translation: 如果你的回答是"不"，那你最好有个心理准备。NCR是有些问题要解决，但如果你把我们惹火了，那你可要小心了。

original: I don't need your opinions, only your compliance.
translation: 我不需要你的看法，我只需要你服从。

original: Actually, I took the Dam, General Oliver - with Mr. House's backing.
translation: 实际上，我已经占领大坝了，奥利弗将军——而我的背后可是豪斯在撑腰。

original: If that's what makes you feel comfortable, I'm not judging you.
translation: 希望我说的话没有打击到你，我并不是在评判你的能力。

original: You know I won't surrender the Dam, and {contempt}certainly not to the ghost man of Vegas and his new right-hand-of-the-week.
translation: 你知道我是不会交出大坝的，{contempt}更不可能向一个飘荡在维加斯上空的幽灵，或者他的走狗投降。

original: I can't take all the credit, but it wasn't really a gamble, either.
translation: 我可受不起这些赞誉，但这也不是一场赌博。

original: Gambling? What, you looking to start a game now that the smoke's died down-
translation: 赌博？什么，现在事情都尘埃落定了，你还想再玩什么游戏——

original: Mr. House sends his regards, Oliver. He's... expanding.
translation: 豪斯先生向你致意，将军。他正准备……扩张自己的领土。

original: What the hell are you on about? House? He's just a rumor on the Strip, never leaves his...
translation: 你他妈在说什么？豪斯？他不过是长街上的传闻而已，他从来都没离开过他的……

original: I didn't take the Dam for you, General - I took it for Vegas.
translation: 我不是为了你才夺取的大坝，将军——我是为了维加斯。

original: {Confused}Vegas? What, the families? {Beat, sudden surprise/sinking feeling}Or... House. You're talking about House.
translation: {Confused}维加斯？什么，你是说那几个家族？不对……豪斯。你说的是豪斯。

original: That day's not likely to come, General.
translation: 那一天似乎是不会来了，将军。

original: Is that all? Because I've got work to do, and NCR words don't mean much around here.
translation: 说完了吗？因为我还有工作要做，而且NCR说的话在这里也没什么太多的意义。

original: Fine. Come on, men, we're moving out.
translation: 好吧。来吧，弟兄们，我们走。

original: Insults? Tsk tsk. Securitrons, please erase all trace of NCR from the area.
translation: 侮辱我？啧啧。电子保安，请抹掉该区域所有的NCR痕迹。

original: I see. Yes Man, please throw General Oliver from the Dam.
translation: 我知道了。好好先生，请把奥利弗将军从大坝上扔下去。

original: My sycophant tells me "yes."
translation: 拍我马屁的人告诉我"是的。"

original: I guarantee I've put more thought into the state of the Mojave than you or anyone in NCR.
translation: 我向你保证，我比你或NCR的其他人都更细致地评估过莫哈维的情况。

original: Can't do a worse job than the Republic, that's for sure.
translation: 反正肯定不会比共和国做得更糟。

original: {Sighs}Hell. Can't believe we got suckered by a slip of a woman. Should've watched the flank while Caesar's best were making all that noise.
translation: {Sighs}该死。真不敢相信我们被一个女人摆了一道。在凯撒的精锐吸引我们注意力的时候，我们居然没留心侧翼。

original: {Sighs}Hell. Can't believe we got suckered by some road jockey. Should've watched the flank while Caesar's best was making all that noise.
translation: {Sighs}该死。真不敢相信我们被一个送货小子摆了一道。在凯撒的精锐吸引我们注意力的时候，我们居然没留心侧翼。

original: I know what those robots of yours can do on a bad day, and I'm not eager to toss lives at them just to make a point.
translation: 我知道你手底下那些机器人的厉害，我也不想为了印证自己的观点就让我的士兵白白送命。

original: {Lowers voice}But if you're taking this place, you better hope you can hold it. I'll give my superiors my opinion, but I don't think they're going to listen.
translation: {Lowers voice}但如果你想占领这个地方，希望你最好能守得住。我会向上级汇报我的看法，但我觉得他们是不会听的。

original: So if NCR comes at you, and it will, pray you're ready. I promise you, our situations reversed, I'd see you hang.
translation: 所以如果NCR卷土重来——那是必然的——你最好祈祷自己能赢吧。我向你保证，到时风水轮流转，我会看着你被绞死。

original: I was hoping we could be pleasant about this.
translation: 我本来还希望咱们能和气一点呢。

original: I make the laws here now, and my law is simple: No NCR on the Colorado.
translation: 我现在就在此颁布法令，这条法令很简单：科罗拉多不允许再有NCR活动。

original: General, the Republic has outstayed its welcome - this land is mine.
translation: 将军，共和国不再受欢迎了——这片土地现在是我的。

original: How about I ask these robots to fuck you and your entire battalion with a rocket barrage?
translation: 我让这些机器人用密集火箭弹把你和你的人全操翻怎么样？

original: You want me to make tracks out of here, head back West, tail between our legs?
translation: 你想让我就这样乖乖夹着尾巴逃回西部？

original: No, I came for a fight today, and if you're looking to make me budge, you better have a damn good left hook or I'm not going anywhere.
translation: 没门，我今天本来就是来打仗的，想要我改变主意，除非你先他妈一拳把我撂倒，否则我哪儿也不去。

original: Do you know what you're doing? Making a nation -  like you think you're doing, ain't like chowing down on a pile of Fancy Lad Snack Cakes.
translation: 你知道你在做什么吗？你想建立一个国家，这可不像吃俏男孩夹心蛋糕那么简单。

original: Think you got the guts to carve out a frontier? Build towns, protect the roads, run supplies, train troops?
translation: 你有本事划定边界吗？建设城镇，保护道路，运送物资，训练军队，你想过没有？

original: Leave on your feet, or leave wrapped in your flag.
translation: 要么自己走，要么你就等着被裹在旗子里运回去吧。

original: Retreat, or we wipe NCR off the face of the Dam.
translation: 撤退，否则我们就把大坝上的NCR全扫光。

original: I don't want any more violence, there's been enough today.
translation: 我不想再使用暴力了，今天已经够多了。

original: Are you sure that's wise?
translation: 你确定那样做明智吗？

original: {Cold}Look, I know you're riding high right now, but let me tell you - you ain't pissing on me right now, you're pissing on the Bear.
translation: {Cold}听着，我知道你现在尾巴都要翘上天了，但我告诉你——你现在挑衅的不是我，你是在挑衅巨熊。

original: You been far enough West I'm guessing to know how far that claw stretches. Fuck with the Bear, and...
translation: 你应该到过西部，知道我们的爪子能伸得有多长。敢招惹双头熊，下场……

original: The Dam is won... for me. You and the Legion have both lost this day.
translation: 大坝的胜利属于……我。你们和军团今天都输了。

original: I suggest you leave before my "boys" open fire on your men.
translation: 我建议你在我的"小伙子们"向你的人开火之前离开。

original: General Oliver, Hoover Dam is ours. Leave at once.
translation: 奥利弗将军，胡佛大坝是我们的了。请你马上离开。

original: {Cold}I would sooner spit on the grave of my dead mother than let some courier-walk-the-wasteland-fuck talk to me like that.
translation: {Cold}我宁可一口痰吐在我死去老妈的坟上，也不愿意让一个在废土上送货的该死的邮差这么对我说话。

original: Who the hell do you think you are? Looking to cash your chips to the sound of NCR bullets, eh? I can oblige.
translation: 你他妈以为你是谁？想尝尝NCR子弹的厉害吗，嗯？我可以满足你。

original: Have you seen an entire army of upgraded Securitrons, General?
translation: 你见过一整支升级版的电子保安大军吗，将军？

original: Can't take all the credit, had some help from my allies here.
translation: 我也没法独揽功劳，毕竟还有盟友提供帮助。

original: Think that's great? You won't believe what happens next.
translation: 觉得这就完了？你不会相信接下来还要发生什么的。

original: Hold that thought, General. I wanted to introduce you to some friends.
translation: 先别急着下结论，将军。我还想给你介绍一些朋友。

original: {Uneasy, army of robots suddenly appear}And... uh... well. These uh... these boys with you? Hello, there, smiley.
translation: {Uneasy, army of robots suddenly appear}那么……呃……好吧。这些，呃……这些小伙子是和你一起的？嘿，你们好，很高兴见到你们。

original: On second thought, I can't let you in, sir.
translation: 我改变主意了，我不能放你进去，先生。

original: Go on in, sir.
translation: 进去吧，先生。

original: Think I'll do just that.
translation: 那我就恭敬不如从命了。

original: She's clean.
translation: 她没问题。

original: He's clean.
translation: 他没问题。

original: More like he's going to the Wrangler for another drink. You watch.
translation: 我估计他更像是要去牛仔酒吧喝两杯，你看着吧。

original: Hoo boy, Gloria's gonna have your ass for letting that wino in. You're not starting the day well, rookie.
translation: 呵，小子，你把那个酒鬼给放进去，格罗利亚肯定会让你屁股开花的。你还真是连开张都开不好啊，菜鸟。

original: Good. Stick to the rules.
translation: 很好，严守规矩就对了。

original: Get the hell out of here, you drunk!
translation: 滚，你这个醉鬼！

original: Fine, I'm going, I'm going. And I'll take my business elsewhere!
translation: 好吧，我走，我走。我再找别的地方！

original: Sorry sir, but I can't let you in. Company policy.
translation: 对不起，先生，我不能让你进去。这是公司规定。

original: Sounds like a stupid policy to me.
translation: 真是个愚蠢的规定！

original: Sure is, go on in.
translation: 当然了，进去吧。

original: Great! I've been wanting to get a laser gun for a while now.
translation: 太好了！我早就想买把激光枪了。

original: {Rhonda} Utobitha, I'm here with Best Friend Tabitha, who has a message for all the dumb-dumbs out there.
translation: {朗达}乌托比萨，好朋友塔比瑟正和我在一起，她有重要信息要告知所有收听广播的蠢蛋变种人们。

original: {Tabitha} It has come to my attention that some of you dumb-dumbs took me a little too seriously in the past when I warned you about the battle cattle.
translation: {塔比瑟}我注意到当我提醒你们留心凯撒军团的崽子的时候，你们中的一些呆子表现得有点过于紧张了。

original: {Tabitha} While battle cattle are indeed a dangerous foe, they are one that should be fought ferociously.
translation: {塔比瑟}虽然凯撒的小卒确实是可怕的敌人，但大家必须抱着拼死相搏的精神与他们战斗。

original: {Tabitha} Recently I've heard about several incidents where some of you have been seen running away from a fight where battle cattle were involved.
translation: {塔比瑟}我最近偶有耳闻，说你们当中有的人在和凯撒军团发生冲突的时候临阵脱逃了。

original: {Tabitha} This is not acceptable. No self-respecting soldier of Utobitha should ever be seen running like a scared little human.
translation: {塔比瑟}这是无法容忍的。乌托比萨的无畏士兵怎么会像懦弱的人类一样惊惶失措。

original: {Tabitha} Bah, I don't even know why I try. It's not like the dumb-dumbs are even going to understand this.
translation: {塔比瑟}呸，我说这些干啥。好像这些蠢蛋们能听懂似的。

original: {Rhonda} You heard her, Utobitha! Beware the battle cattle, but don't *fear* the battle cattle. More after this!
translation: {朗达}大家都听到了，乌托比萨！小心凯撒军团，但是不要对他们心存*恐惧*。待会回来！

original: {Rhonda, faint, she's not speaking into the mike} What do you think we should play next?
translation: {朗达}那你觉得我们接下来该放点什么？

original: {Tabitha, same, not speaking into mike} It doesn't matter, just grab something. And check on Raul while you're at it.
translation: {塔比瑟}无所谓了，随便放点东西了。对了，你顺便看看劳尔的情况。

original: {Tabitha, faint, coming from a speaker in Raul's room} Raul! Why are you on the radio?
translation: {塔比瑟}劳尔！你怎么跑到广播里来的？

original: {Raul} Uh, I don't know. Did you hit that switch I, ah, keep telling you not to press?
translation: {劳尔}呃，我也不知道啊。你切到我这边来的，啊，告诉过你不要按切换键的嘛？

original: {Rhonda} Sorry about that, Utobitha! Here's some music!
translation: {朗达}不好意思，乌托比萨！音乐时间！

original: {Rhonda} You're listening to another edition of Know - Your - Mutants, with Best Friend Tabitha!
translation: {朗达}欢迎再次收听变种人面面观！欢迎好朋友塔比瑟！

original: {Rhonda} So, Best Friend Tabitha, who will we learn about today?
translation: {朗达}那么，我的朋友塔比瑟，今天又有什么新鲜事呢？

original: {Tabitha, sounding like she's really not looking forward to this} I guess it's time we talked the dumb-dumbs.
translation: {塔比瑟}我想今天我们来说说蠢蛋们吧。

original: {Rhonda} Oh, you mean the second generation Super Mutants who aren't so bright?
translation: {朗达}哦哦，你是说第二代超级变种人吗，大脑不怎么聪明的那群人？

original: {Tabitha, grasping for something meaningful to say} That's them. Dumb-dumbs... ah... that is... they...
translation: {塔比瑟}对，就是他们。蠢蛋嘛…啊…很笨…就是他们…

original: {Rhonda, throwing her a lifeline} They're very big. And strong.
translation: {朗达}他们高大。强壮。

original: {Tabitha, grateful} Yes! They're just as big as other mutants, and as strong as they look. Beyond that, uh...
translation: {塔比瑟}对！他们和其他变种人一样巨大，也一样强壮。此外，嗯…

original: {Rhonda, another lifeline} And there's a lot of them.
translation: {朗达}数量众多。

original: {Tabitha} Oh yeah, dumb-dumbs are the most common type of mutant that most travelers will encounter, and make up more than half the mutants here in Utobitha.
translation: {塔比瑟}对，这群蠢蛋就是旅行者在大陆上经常能遇到的那种，居住在乌托比萨的变种人中，超过半数都来自他们的族群。

original: {Rhonda} Best Friend Tabitha, some of our listeners may wonder how you can call them dumb-dumbs on the air like this.
translation: {朗达}我的朋友塔比瑟，一些听众可能会好奇，为什么在广播中你要称他们为蠢蛋。

original: {Tabitha} That's a good question, Rhonda. The truth is, they're so dumb they don't even know that I'm talking about them right now.
translation: {塔比瑟}很有趣的问题，朗达。事实上，他们简直蠢到听不懂我在骂他们蠢。

original: {Rhonda} And that's another revealing look at mutantkind. Second generation Super Mutants. Big. Numerous. {said with a flourish}Dumb. More after this!
translation: {朗达}这是对于变种人种族最直接的一种评价。第二代超级变种人。巨大。数量庞大。并且笨。甚至比想象的还要笨！

original: {Rhonda} Welcome, Utobitha, to another episode of Know - Your - Mutants!
translation: {朗达}欢迎再次收听新一期的变种人面面观！

original: {Rhonda} Today we're proud to have Best Friend Tabitha with us. Welcome to the show!
translation: {朗达}今天我们很荣幸的请到塔比瑟和我们坐在一起。欢迎光临！

original: {Tabitha} Good to be here, Rhonda.
translation: {塔比瑟}很高兴来到这里，朗达。

original: {Rhonda} So what type of mutant did you want to talk about this time, Best Friend Tabitha?
translation: {朗达}今天我们来谈谈哪种变种人呢，我的好朋友塔比瑟？

original: {Tabitha} I thought I'd briefly talk about first generation Super Mutants, Rhonda.
translation: {塔比瑟}我想我们应该说说第一代超级变种人，朗达。

original: {Rhonda} Oooh, what can you tell us about them?
translation: {朗达}啊哈，你能告诉我们些什么呢？

original: {Tabitha} What we call the first generation of Super Mutants, Rhonda, were actually created by the Master himself.
translation: {塔比瑟}我们现在说的第一代超级变种人，朗达，是由主教本人亲自创造出来的。

original: {Tabitha} Like everything the Master took a direct hand in, they were better than the ones who came later, the ones made by accident.
translation: {塔比瑟}看来只要是主教亲自做的事情，总会比后人要出色的多，比如后来那些因意外而产生的变种人。

original: {Tabitha} They were smarter, almost as smart as Nightkin, and were able to think and act for themselves.
translation: {塔比瑟}他们更聪明，甚至和夜行族一样聪明，可以自由支配自己的意志与行动。

original: {Tabitha} However, the first generation seems to have some kind of suicidal urge that they can't control.
translation: {塔比瑟}即便如此，第一代变种人好像很容易出现自杀倾向，而且无法控制这种倾向。

original: {Rhonda} How terrible! What makes you say that, Best Friend Tabitha?
translation: {朗达}那太恐怖了！为什么这么说呢，我的朋友塔比瑟？

original: {Tabitha} So far, all first generation Super Mutants that have come to Utobitha have left not soon after.
translation: {塔比瑟}至今为止，所有来过乌托比萨的第一代变种人都在不久之后就离开了。

original: {Rhonda} How strange! Why would anyone leave the safety and comfort that Utobitha provides?
translation: {朗达}匪夷所思！为什么他们要离开这么舒适安全的土地呢？

original: {Tabitha} Why, indeed. But now there's not a single first generation Super Mutant in Utobitha.
translation: {塔比瑟}为什么，问的好。但是据我所知没有任何第一代留下来。

original: {Rhonda} Except Neil.
translation: {朗达}除了尼尔。

original: {Tabitha, grumbling}Except Neil.
translation: {塔比瑟}除了尼尔。

original: {Rhonda, speaking quickly, sounding nervous, like Tabitha might attack her}Well! I think we've all learned something today. Let's go to music!
translation: {朗达}啊哈，先说到这儿吧！我想今天我们都上了一堂温习课。让我们进一段音乐！

original: {Rhonda} Welcome to another episode of Know - Your - Mutants!
translation: {朗达}欢迎再次收听这一期的变种人面面观！

original: {Rhonda} Special guest star Best Friend Tabitha is with us in the studio to share her insights on this topic that affects us all.
translation: {朗达}同时欢迎特别来宾，也是我们的好朋友塔比瑟，来到演播室，与我们分享她对目前关键形势的见解。

original: {Tabitha} Thank you, Rhonda. Today I'd like to talk about a subject near and dear to my heart, the nightkin.
translation: {塔比瑟}再次感谢，朗达。今天让我们来谈谈我最关心也是我一直惦记的一件事，夜行族。

original: {Rhonda} Ooooh, you must know a lot about the nightkin, Best Friend Tabitha, seeing as how you are one!
translation: {朗达}哦哦，关于夜行族你肯定无所不知，塔比瑟，毕竟你就是其中最出色的一员！

original: {Tabitha} That's true, Rhonda. I am in a unique position to speak to the natural superiority of my kind.
translation: {塔比瑟}没错，朗达。我的地位让我有足够的资格来阐述我的族类天生的优越性。

original: {Tabitha} {clears throat}Our story begins, as most stories do, with the Master. Our glorious leader had created the Super Mutants, but something nagged at him.
translation: {塔比瑟}咳咳…故事的开头都一样，得从我们伟大的主教开始说起。我们伟大的领袖制造了超级变种人，但却让他自己备受煎熬。

original: {Tabitha} "I can do better", he must have said to himself. And boy did he ever!
translation: {塔比瑟}“我可以做得更好”，他肯定不断这样对自己说。而他也的确做到了！

original: {Tabitha} A new type of mutant was created - stronger, faster, smarter, more dangerous in every way.
translation: {塔比瑟}新的变种人就这样被创造出来——更强大，更迅猛，更加聪明，而且异常凶残。

original: {Tabitha} We were to normal super mutants what they were to humans, and they were told to defer to us in all things.
translation: {塔比瑟}我们之于超级变种人，就像他们之于普通人类。而且他们被创造出来就是为了服从于我们。

original: {Rhonda} And you're the leader of all the nightkin, correct?
translation: {朗达}况且你还是夜行族的领袖，对么？

original: {Tabitha} Yes, as the highest ranking nightkin alive, my voice speaks for all nightkin everywhere, ever.
translation: {塔比瑟}对的，作为仍然在世的最高阶层的夜行族，我所说的话就代表了整个族群的意志。

original: {Rhonda} Which is why all super mutants should do what you say, right?
translation: {朗达}也就是说所有超级变种人都应完全服从于你，对么？

original: {Tabitha} That's right! My position of supreme authority must never be questioned!
translation: {塔比瑟}你说对了！我至高无上的权力不容置疑！

original: {Rhonda} One last thing. Is there any truth to the rumor that all Nightkin are slightly crazy from their overuse of psychologically damaging pre-war tech?
translation: {朗达}最后一件事。有谣言传说夜行族因为滥用战前对神经有害的科技，导致全族人都变得有点疯癫，这是事实吗？

original: {Tabitha} None at all, Rhonda.
translation: {塔比瑟}一派胡言，朗达。

original: {Rhonda} There you have it, Utobitha! Nightkin, your benevolent overlords, who are most certainly *not* crazy. We'll be back after this!
translation: {朗达}现在你们听到了，乌托比萨！夜行族，你们的最高领袖，现在可以证实他们一点都*没有*发疯。广告之后更精彩！

original: {Tabitha} Do you remember the good old days where the Master ruled over us all?
translation: {塔比瑟}还记得主教麾下的那些美好时光吗？

original: {Rhonda} When his gentle, compelling, and yet oddly insistent voice crawled through your mind and told you exactly what to do?
translation: {朗达}还能想起他那那彬彬有礼，温而文雅，却略带奇怪的音调划过你脑海时的感受吗？

original: {Tabitha} Do you miss a time when you didn't have to think for yourself, and enjoyed lazy days of following the bellowed commands of others?
translation: {塔比瑟}你是否怀念过去那不用自己动脑，只需要服从他人命令的慵懒日子？

original: {Rhonda} Those days can be yours again, for Best Friend Tabitha, the esteemed leader of the State of Utobitha, is here to tell you what to do!
translation: {朗达}那样的日子就要再度降临了，因为我们最好的朋友塔比瑟在此。万人敬仰的领袖将引领你们！

original: {Tabitha} That's right! I, Tabitha, will take on the burden of your obedience!
translation: {塔比瑟}非常正确！我，塔比瑟，愿意担负起指挥你们的重任！

original: {Rhonda, sotto voce} Acceptance into Utobitha pending Best Friend Tabitha's approval.
translation: {朗达}加入乌托比萨的申请需要得到塔比瑟本人的同意。

original: {Rhonda, sotto voce}Best Friend Tabitha reserves the right to turn down applicants for any reason, including whimsy or boredom.
translation: {朗达}而塔比瑟保留了可以因各种理由拒绝他人加入的权利，包括但不限于饿了累了烦了等等。

original: {Rhonda, sotto voce} Acceptance into Utobitha open to mutants only. Former human servants of the Master conditionally accepted for purposes of centaur feeding duties.
translation: {朗达}加入乌托比萨的权利只对变种人开放。而过去主教的那些人类仆人只能作为多脚兽的饲料加入。

original: {Tabitha} Utobitha! Come, take a load off your mind!
translation: {塔比瑟}乌托比萨！加入吧，别再让自己不堪重负了！

original: {Rhonda} We're here once again with our beloved leader. Best Friend Tabitha, why don't you tell our listeners what you just told me?
translation: {朗达}我们再次邀请到了万人敬仰的领袖。她就是我们最好的朋友塔比瑟，为什么不和听众们谈谈刚才你和我提到的事儿？

original: {Tabitha} I was just saying that I think there's a fundamental misunderstanding about the mutants here in the State of Utobitha.
translation: {塔比瑟}我刚才说，我们可能对乌托比萨境内出现的变种人有一些根本上的误解。

original: {Rhonda} And what would *that* be?
translation: {朗达}那是*什么*意思？

original: {Tabitha} I believe that the mutants here are generally considered to dislike humans. And nothing could be further from the truth.
translation: {塔比瑟}这里的变种人都对人类抱有厌恶。我认为他们这种想法是大错特错。

original: {Tabitha} During their stay here, mutants are taught to tolerate, and even accept, the existence of inferior, frail creatures, humans included.
translation: {塔比瑟}在这里，变种人们必须学会忍耐，甚至去接受那些低等的，心智未开的生物，这其中就包括人类。

original: {Rhonda} Ooh, how insightful! So then how do you think this misunderstanding came about?
translation: {朗达}哇哦，好一个真知灼见哪！那么以你之见，这些误会是怎样出现的呢？

original: {Tabitha} My guess is that it has something to do with the fact that every mutant in the State of Utobitha  has been give explicit orders regarding security.
translation: {塔比瑟}我认为是这样的：乌托比萨境内的变种人都无一例外都肩负着重要任务，这任务无外乎就是保卫这里的安全。

original: {Tabitha} Those orders naturally include shooting humans on sight. Or pounding them with whatever happens to be handy. Guns being in short supply, you see.
translation: {塔比瑟}为了执行任务，他们对人类必须格杀勿论。利用手头任何工具对他们予以重击。你也看到了，枪支因此变得短缺。

original: {Tabitha} As I've explained, there are numerous dangers to humans here, and we have a duty to drive them away. It's for their own good, really.
translation: {塔比瑟}如你所说，人类在这里的处境真是万分危险，我们有责任驱逐他们。这也是为他们自己好。

original: {Rhonda} Makes sense to me! And the silly humans think we don't care. {said dramatically}For shame. Stick around, Utobitha, for more after this!
translation: {朗达}如你所言！但是那些可悲的人类竟然觉得我们不在乎他们。可悲啊。请别走开，乌托比萨，马上回来！

original: {Rhonda} We're back with Best Friend Tabitha, who was telling us why humans should {cue angry Tabitha voice}STAY THE HELL AWAY, {back to normal Rhonda voice}ier, keep their distance from the State of Utobitha.
translation: {朗达}我们的好朋友塔比瑟又回来了，她曾告诉我们，人类应该滚得远远的，或者说，他们必须远离乌托比萨的领土。

original: {Tabitha} Thank you, Rhonda. As you know, one of the many benefits of living in Utobitha is the ready availability of pet centaurs.
translation: {塔比瑟}非常感谢，朗达。你也知道，居住在乌托比萨的另一个福利就是可以饲养多脚兽宠物。

original: {Rhonda} Ooh, I love the centaurs. They're just so cute!
translation: {朗达}啊哈，我喜欢多脚兽们。他们真是太可爱了！

original: {Tabitha} Exactly, Rhonda, who could resist those sweet little faces, and that cute way they shuffle around on all those hands they have.
translation: {塔比瑟}完全正确，朗达，有谁能拒绝那些可爱的小脸蛋呢，而且他们总是把自己的小手们摆来摆去。

original: {Tabitha} But humans must be so caught up with their pleasant features that they forget the most important thing about centaurs.
translation: {塔比瑟}但人类肯定是被这种可爱的特点给冲昏了头，而忘记了多脚兽最重要的本性。

original: {Rhonda} And what might that be, Best Friend Tabitha?
translation: {朗达}此话怎讲呢，我的朋友塔比瑟？

original: {Tabitha} Centaurs {stressed}eat humans, Rhonda! You see, humans are a lot smaller, and much more tender than you or I, so centaurs naturally see them as food.
translation: {塔比瑟}多脚兽吃人啊，朗达！你看，人类这个物种，比你我都更加脆弱和渺小，所以多脚兽就自然将视他们为食物。

original: {Rhonda} Ah, that *would* make it hard for them to get along, wouldn't it?
translation: {朗达}啊，那*的确*解释了为什么人类和他们无法和平相处，不是么？

original: {Tabitha} Indeed. Given the situation, I had to make a hard choice when I created Utobitha - do we invite weak, greedy humans who would just die anyway?
translation: {塔比瑟}对啊。当我创立乌托比萨就面临着一个艰难的选择，是要邀请那些软弱，贪婪且不知死活的人类到这里来呢？

original: {Tabitha} Or cute, loveable centaurs, who fight and die for us and ask nothing in return? After much deliberation, I went with the centaurs.
translation: {塔比瑟}还是选择那些可爱又惹人怜惜的，曾为我们出生入死，却别无所求的多脚兽呢？经过一番权衡，我还是选择了让多脚兽们进入这里。

original: {Rhonda} And there you have it, Utobitha. The next time you play with a huggable, loveable centaur, remember that Best Friend Tabitha made it all possible.
translation: {朗达}所以大家该明白了吧，乌托比萨的居民们。下次你们和那些可爱的，有趣的多脚兽们玩耍之时，记得是你们最好的朋友塔比瑟赋予了你们这一切。

original: Let's discuss something else.
translation: 我们谈点别的吧。

original: Did you have something to do with that NCR messenger getting attacked?
translation: NCR信使遇袭的事与你有关吗？

original: Look, I already told you that was bullshit. Probably just an excuse those lying soldier scum made up to not share their grub with us.
translation: 听着，我都说了，这完全是血口喷人。估计是那些混蛋阿兵哥不想分给我们粮食，才特意编了这个借口。

original: So don't ask me about it again, you hear me?
translation: 所以别再问我这件事了，明白吗？

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: What's the skinny on Mick and Ralph?
translation: 米克和拉尔夫是怎么回事？

original: Mick and Ralph sell all sorts of things at a small store over by the east gate. They've done all right by us, and they'll do all right by you.
translation: 米克和拉尔夫在东门边开有一间小商铺，出售各式各样的商品。他们和我们的关系不错，他们应该也会好好招待你的。

original: You want to know about anyone else?
translation: 还想了解别的人吗？

original: Who are the Van Graffs?
translation: 范·格拉夫兄妹是什么人？

original: They're a family-run business from out west that deal in weapons mostly. A word of caution, though. They're not a friendly bunch. Not at all.
translation: 他们是一个家族，来自西方，基本都从事军火贸易。但听我一句劝。他们可不是什么善茬。真的。

original: Their store is just past the Wrangler, and sells all kinds of fancy weapons that most people around here can't afford.
translation: 他们的商店就在原子牛仔后面，出售各种各样的花哨武器，不过这里的大多数人都买不起。

original: Anyone else you wanted to know about?
translation: 还想了解别的人吗？

original: I'd like to hear about the Garret Twins.
translation: 我想了解一下加勒特双胞胎。

original: Them twins run the Atomic Wrangler, the only working casino here in Freeside. It's become pretty much {thee}the place to go around these parts.
translation: 这对双胞胎经营着原子牛仔酒吧，那是自由城唯一的赌场，也是这附近最值得去的地方。

original: Give it a whirl when you've got some time.  Now, was there anyone else you wanted to know about?
translation: 如果你有空，可以去那儿碰碰运气。好了，你还有想打听的人吗？

original: Tell me about Julie Farkas.
translation: 和我说说朱莉·法卡斯。

original: Julie represents the Followers of the Apocalypse. They're a group that tries to help people out whenever they can, so we get along just fine.
translation: 朱莉是天启追随者的代表。他们是一个乐于助人的团体，所以我们相处得还不错。

original: If you ever need to get patched up, one of their docs'll have you right as rain in no time flat. They sell supplies, too. Or used to.
translation: 如果你需要医护，他们的大夫会像春雨一样立马将你治好。他们以前也出售物资，不过现在不卖了。

original: Heard they were having trouble bringing stuff in, or keeping up with the demand, or something, lately.
translation: 听说他们最近好像在物资补给方面遇到了点小麻烦，似乎无法满足病人的需求。

original: Did you want to know about anyone else?
translation: 你还想了解其他人吗？

original: Who are the important people in Freeside?
translation: 自由城里有哪些重要人物？

original: There's me, but I don't really like talking about myself. There's Julie Farkas and the other Followers down at the ol' Mormon Fort.
translation: 有我本人，但我不喜欢谈论自己。还有旧摩门要塞的朱莉·法卡斯和其他天启追随者成员。

original: The Garret Twins up at the Wrangler deserve mention. Wouldn't be right not mentioning the Van Graffs, I suppose.
translation: 值得一提的还有原子牛仔酒吧的加勒特双胞胎。说到这个，恐怕也得提一下范·格拉夫兄妹。

original: And while they're not important in the overall scheme of things, there's Mick and Ralph, too. Just don't tell them I said that.
translation: 此外还有米克和拉尔夫，虽然他们在这里也并不算多重要。但你可千万别告诉他们是我说的。

original: Who all did you want to know about?
translation: 你想了解谁？

original: What can you tell me about Pacer?
translation: 关于佩瑟你能告诉我些什么？

original: Pace? He and I grew up together around here. We've been through a lot together, and there's no man I'd rather have at my side in a pinch.
translation: 佩瑟？我和他一起在这里长大。我们共同经历了很多事情，他是我在危急关头最得力的左膀右臂。

original: Don't judge him too harshly for trying to get some caps out of you. He probably took you for a squatter, looking for a place to settle down.
translation: 你可不要因为他坑了你的钱，就觉得他是个坏人。他可能把你当成了四处寻找安顿之所的流民。

original: There've been a lot of people moving into the area lately, and it's got some people riled. Can't blame 'em myself. There's only so much to go around.
translation: 最近这里来了不少人，搞得有些老百姓很不满。我也不能责怪他们。毕竟这地方已经够乱的了。

original: I had other questions.
translation: 我还有些问题。

original: So why isn't every man in Freeside in your gang?
translation: 为什么不把自由城的每个人都吸纳为你们的成员？

original: We've tried to pass our philosophy on to the people of Freeside, but not everyone is ready to be a King.
translation: 我们虽然一直在向自由城人民传播我们的理念，但并非每个人都有条件加入猫王帮。

original: The kids love us, but the old-timers tend to shy away and keep to themselves. They probably couldn't pull off the look, anyway.
translation: 年轻人喜欢我们，但老年人却对我们嗤之以鼻。他们大概无法放下成见。

original: As for the others, some people just plain don't respect others, and that's a no-no. If there's one thing I won't tolerate, it's lack of respect.
translation: 至于其他人，有些家伙明显不懂尊重别人，这就犯了忌了。我们唯一不能容忍的就是不尊重他人。

original: What is there to do in Freeside?
translation: 自由城有什么好玩的地方吗？

original: Aside from this place, there's the Atomic Wrangler just up the street. Women, gambling, booze, you name it, they got you covered.
translation: 除了这里以外，街那头还有一间原子牛仔酒吧。女人，赌博，酒，无论你要什么，他们那儿都有。

original: If you're more of a prude, the Followers run a mission out of the Old Mormon Fort up toward the north gate. Great place if you're hurt, I guess.
translation: 如果你放不开的话，北门那里还有个天启追随者开设的旧摩门要塞据点。你要是受伤了，我觉得那儿会是个好去处。

original: If you like things dangerous, just past the Wrangler is the Silver Rush, where the Van Graff family peddles their weapons.
translation: 如果你喜欢刺激，过了牛仔酒吧就是银色冲击，范格拉夫家族在那里出售军火。

original: Their stuff is outrageously priced, but if you want to shoot something hi-tech, they're the best game in town.
translation: 他们的东西特别贵，但你要是喜欢高科技武器的话，去那里是最好的选择。

original: Let's talking about something else.
translation: 让我们谈谈别的吧。

original: So there's no law here at all?
translation: 这么说，这里完全就是无法无天咯？

original: People can do whatever they want, they just have to keep in mind what'll happen afterward.
translation: 人们想做什么都可以，不过后果得自负。

original: I guess you could say we don't have law so much as consequences.
translation: 所以与其说是无法无天，倒不如说是善恶有报。

original: Is there anyone like that in Freeside?
translation: 自由城还有谁是这样的吗？

original: Well, the Van Graffs for one. We had a slight difference of opinion when they first showed up.
translation: 范格拉夫兄妹算是一个。他们刚来的时候，我们还有些矛盾。

original: Changed our minds pretty quick after a brief demonstration of how much firepower they're packing.
translation: 在见识了他们的火力之后，我们很快就改变了主意。

original: We could probably take them, but we'd lose a lotta guys doing it.
translation: 其实要干掉他们也行，但那样会牺牲掉很多弟兄。

original: Then it's best we kill you all now. Securitrons? Please erase NCR from the Dam.
translation: 那我们最好现在就把你们杀光。电子保安？请把所有大坝上NCR统统消灭。

original: Tell your soldiers you're going to attack Vegas, see what happens.
translation: 和你的士兵说你们要攻打维加斯，你看看会发生什么。

original: Attack me, and I'll order an attack on NCR at McCarran, the Embassy, and the Strip.
translation: 如果受到攻击，我会命令部队向驻守在麦卡伦、大使馆和长街的NCR部队发动全面进攻。

original: NCR can't hold the Mojave already, and now you're threatening me?
translation: NCR都已经无法守卫莫哈维了，你居然还敢威胁我？

original: I'm not going to throw away the lives of my men just to make a point. And there'll be other days.
translation: 我不会为了印证一个观点就让我的人白白送命。咱们走着瞧吧。

original: No, General, you keep it in mind - and our conversation is over.
translation: 不，将军，你自己记住就行——我们的谈话结束了。

original: Well, at least I can talk to you unlike that bastard Caesar and that plate-faced general. It'll do.
translation: 好吧，至少我还能和你谈判，不像那个杂种凯撒，或者那个面瘫将军。这样就够了。

original: {Chuckles}Guess sometimes you get the bull, other times you get the horns. Still, at least some lives got saved this day.
translation: {Chuckles}呵，看来人生确实无常。但至少今天不必再有人流血了。

original: Oh man, Gloria's going to be pissed when she hears about this. Still, he started it, so we probably won't go to war with the Kings.
translation: 噢，老兄，格罗利亚知道了肯定会发火的。不过话说回来，又不是我们先动的手，猫王帮大概不会和我们撕破脸吧。

original: What the hell are you doing?
translation: 你他妈在干什么？

original: Way to keep your head, rookie. There's hope for you yet.
translation: 干得不错呀，菜鸟，看来你还有救。

original: Work is work, right?
translation: 工作归工作，对吧？

original: Spoken like a chump. A King doesn't have to grovel before others to get paid. Anyway, I've got better things to do than shoot the shit with you.
translation: 真是蠢话。猫王帮的人可从来不靠给人提鞋来赚钱。算了，我懒得陪你在这儿吹牛逼，还有更重要的事要做。

original: Watch your mouth or my trigger finger might twitch.
translation: 管住你的舌头，否则我扣扳机的指头可能会控制不住。

original: Nah, I've just risen up in the world.
translation: 别啊，我刚在这世上混出点人样呢。

original: Ha, you've got yourself a live one here, Simon. Anyway, I've got things to do. Later.
translation: 哈，你招来了一个活宝啊，西蒙。算了，我还有事要做呢，回见啦。

original: Do you ever stop talking tough?
translation: 你就不能说话和谐点？

original: Yeah, right before I beat somebody down. Let's take this fool, boys.
translation: 是啊，等我先把某人痛扁一顿之后再说。兄弟们上，揍这白痴。

original: Never mind. Just forget I said anything.
translation: 别介意，忘掉我说过的吧。

original: Yeah, that's what I thought.
translation: 是哦，我也这么觉得。

original: Actually, it does. What are you going to do about it?
translation: 我就说了。你想怎样？

original: You asked for it, punk!
translation: 你自找的，小痞子！

original: Apparently I do. Something wrong with that?
translation: 我当然能说。你有意见？

original: No, nothing wrong at all. By all means, carry on.
translation: 没，完全没有。请你继续。

original: Why don't you just get the hell out of here?
translation: 你为什么不他妈的从这里滚出去？

original: Who do you think you're talking to? Just because the King happens to like you, doesn't mean you can run your mouth any way you damn like.
translation: 你以为自己在对谁说话？别以为猫王喜欢你，你就能到处喷粪。

original: Good to see you, too, Pacer.
translation: 我也很高兴见到你，佩瑟。

original: I'm sure it's the highlight of your day. Anyway, I've gotta bounce. Things to do, and all that.
translation: 一定是你这辈子最辉煌的时刻吧。算了，我得走了。有事要忙。

original: Care to back that up?
translation: 不介意靠边站吧？

original: Let's take this chump, guys!
translation: 咱们来搞定这呆瓜，伙计们！

original: It's fine, Simon. I won't let him get to me.
translation: 没事的，西蒙。我不会让他碰我一根寒毛的。

original: Get out of here before you get hurt.
translation: 趁早滚蛋，小心挨揍。

original: Ouch, this one's got a bite, Simon! Call him off, or he'll get put down.
translation: 哎呦，这家伙够能咬人的啊，西蒙！你可得把他拴好，不然他死定了。

original: Ouch, this one's got a bite, Simon! Call her off, or she'll get put down.
translation: 哎呦，这家伙够能咬人的啊，西蒙！你可得把她拴好，不然她死定了。

original: Why not tell her yourself?
translation: 你怎么不自己跟她说？

original: I would, but I tend to distract the boss lady a little too much. She can't help herself.
translation: 本来我想说的，但我似乎已经迷得你们那老板娘有点心烦意乱了，她把持不住自己。

original: Anyway, I've got things to do. Later, Simon.
translation: 总之，我还有事要做。回见啦，西蒙。

original: I'll be sure to pass it along.
translation: 我一定帮你转达。

original: That's a good dog. Well, I'm out of here. Later, Simon.
translation: 真是条好狗。那我走了。回见，西蒙。

original: Actually, I've got a better idea. Make the new hire tell her. You'll do that for me, won't you?
translation: 其实，我有个更好的点子。让新来的人去告诉她。干脆就派你好了，怎么样？

original: Hey, I've seen you before around our place. You've really fallen on hard times if you're working for these clowns.
translation: 嘿，我好像以前在帮会门口见过你。你居然沦落到给这帮小丑卖命了啊。

original: Hey, you're the one who helped us out with those NCR chumps. You really get around, don't you?
translation: 嘿，你就是帮我们解决了那群白痴NCR的人啊。你还真有两下子嘛。

original: Hey, Simon. How's it hanging? Looks like you've got a little helper today.
translation: 嘿，西蒙，最近怎么样啊？看样子你今天身边多了个小帮手嘛。

original: {Tiny bit of distaste here, he doesn't like Pacer}What can I say? Business has been good lately. We can afford the help.
translation: {语气略带厌恶地，因为他不喜欢佩瑟}还能怎么样？生意不错，所以我们雇得起人。

original: Good to hear, buddy. So is the boss lady in?
translation: 这就好，老兄。话说，你们老板娘在吗？

original: {mood gets darker, Simon doesn't like Pacer talking about Gloria}You know she is. {This is a threat, Pacer's dead if he goes inside}Why don't you go in and say hi?
translation: {情绪更加恶劣地，因为西蒙不喜欢佩瑟说起格罗利亚的语气}她当然在。{威胁地语气，意即如果佩瑟敢进去就宰了他}怎么，不进去打声招呼吗？

original: Nah, I've got some rounds to run. But do pass along that I'm always thinking of her.
translation: 算啦，我还有事儿要忙呢。不过帮我带个话吧，就说我一直很想她。

original: Crap. {stressed}This I do not need today. Keep your head straight, rookie. Things are about to get interesting.
translation: 该死。{紧张地}今天还真是倒霉。脖子伸直了，菜鸟，好玩的来了。

original: Heads up. Looks like we've got another customer.
translation: 把头抬起来，看来我们又有顾客上门了。

original: You don't listen too well, do you? We're supposed to pat everyone down. That's going in my report.
translation: 你是没听懂还是怎么着？我们应该搜查每个人。我会在报告里记上一笔的。

original: You keep losing us business like that, and you can forget about being paid.
translation: 你搅黄了这么多生意，就别想要工钱了。

original: He's clean.
translation: 他没问题。

original: See? Told you so.
translation: 你看？早就跟你说了。

original: You just going to let everyone in without checking them? Bad move, rookie. That's going in my report.
translation: 你都不搜身就把人放进去？这很不好，菜鸟，我会在报告里记上一笔的。

original: Wow, you're a real people person, aren't you?
translation: 哇，你挺擅长交际的嘛，不是吗？

original: We'll have to pat you down first, sir.
translation: 我们必须先搜您的身，先生。

original: Pardon me, sir my mistake. Go on in.
translation: 对不起，先生，是我错了，请进吧。

original: Hmph. That's better.
translation: 啊，这还差不多。

original: I think you may be drunk, sir.
translation: 我觉得你喝醉了，先生。

original: I haven't had a drink all day! Screw this place, I'll go spend my money elsewhere!
translation: 我一天都没沾过酒！干你妈这破店，老子想花钱还怕找不到地方！

original: In a word, no.
translation: 两个字，没门。

original: If that's the case, then I guess I'll go spend my money elsewhere.
translation: 既然如此，那我就只能到别的地方花钱了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I suppose it's all right, if there's no other choice.
translation: [成功] 那就听你的吧，我也没有别的选择。

original: I'm sure you're a man of your word, sir, but we still need to pat you down. No exceptions.
translation: 我知道您一言九鼎，先生，但是我们必须检查您的物品。没有例外。

original: [FAILED] I just don't see why it's necessary. Now, are you going to let me in or not?
translation: [失败] 我他妈的就是不明白干嘛非得这么干。你到底放不放我进去？

original: Your word doesn't matter. It's just company policy.
translation: 你说什么可不算，这是公司规定。

original: It should be fine, go on in.
translation: 没事的，进去吧。

original: Sorry, sir. I can't let you in.
translation: 对不起，先生。我不能让你进去。

original: What? Why the hell not?
translation: 什么，妈的为什么不能？

original: Welcome to the Silver Rush. Go on in.
translation: 欢迎来到银色冲击。请进。

original: Thank you kindly.
translation: 十分感谢。

original: Certainly, sir. We need to pat you down for weapons first.
translation: 当然了，先生。我们需要先搜身来检查是否有武器。

original: Now hold on there, I'm not packing any heat. Ain't my word good enough for you?
translation: 等等，我确实没带枪啊。难道我的话你还不信么？

original: If you don't accept my gifts, the technologies rolling into NCR will be Securitrons, I promise you.
translation: 如果你不接受我的施舍，那么流向NCR的技术就将是电子保安大军，我保证。

original: You've witnessed what we can do this day to the Legion - we can shut down the Dam, Vegas, and NCR.
translation: 你已经见识过我们是怎么收拾军团的了——我们也可以毁掉这座大坝，毁掉维加斯，毁掉NCR。

original: As long as that's not a "no," then I'd take that doubt to your superiors.
translation: 只要你的回答不是"不，"我就把争执带到你的上级那里去。

original: No, no, no... you've given me enough ammo for the Republic... but what one head may like, the other bear head may not.
translation: 不，不，不……你已经帮我给共和国找了不少麻烦了……何况只要有一个头头喜欢，就会有其它的头头不喜欢。

original: Still, I'm not about to add blood to the mix since you could've done us like the Legion now if you wanted.
translation: 不过，我也不打算让矛盾激化，毕竟你现在随时都可以像对付军团那样收拾我们。

original: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
translation: 我们必须守住它，因为它的技术含量很高。非常高。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hmmm. Well... Vegas burns brighter than most cities West of the Divide, and that glitter has its appeal.
translation: [成功] 嗯。好吧……维加斯比大裂谷西部的绝大多数城市都先进，也能满足我们的需要。

original: Not sure that's going to mend fences with the folks back West, though. But...
translation: 虽然不知道这样能不能修补我们与西部父老乡亲之间的关系。但是……

original: There are... technologies in Vegas we may be able to provide to NCR. Not all, but some.
translation: 我们在维加斯有一些……技术可以提供给NCR。全给是不可能的，但可以分一点给你们。

original: [FAILED] No, you tricked us once, and taking more gifts from you deeper into NCR's just asking for trouble by my book.
translation: [失败] 不，你已经耍过我们一次了。把你施舍来的东西带进NCR腹地，在我看来后患无穷。

original: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
translation: 我们必须守住它，因为它的技术含量很高。非常高。

original: [SUCCEEDED] So you're saying without you, Hoover Dam just beats slower and dies. I believe it, I saw it myself this day, you woke it up, true enough.
translation: [成功] 所以你的意思是，如果没有你，胡佛大坝就会逐渐报废。这一点我相信，今天我已经亲眼见证了，是你让它重获新生。

original: Still, even power from the Dam - that's not enough to wash the salt out of the wound here, and it only benefits NCR in the Mojave, not the West.
translation: 不过，即便有大坝产生的电力——也不足以冲洗掉我们这伤口上的盐，而且它只能让莫哈维的NCR受益，无法将电力送回西部。

original: The reason we need to hold on to it is because it's very technical. Very.
translation: 我们必须守住它，因为它的技术含量很高。非常高。

original: [FAILED] Well, that kind of fence-sitting is exactly what makes me think we can make use of the... improvements here. Without you.
translation: [失败] 好吧，就是因为你们这种模棱两可的态度，我觉得还是干脆抛弃你，直接利用这里的……先进设施算了。

original: Well, we might be able to open the East up faster if we work harder at it.
translation: 好吧，如果我们再努力一些，也许能更快打开通往东部的商路。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hnh. Willing to tackle the caravan families? Keeping that bunch in line... well, that's no easy job.
translation: [成功] 哼。难不成你想控制那些商人集团？让那群家伙听话……呵，可不是什么容易的事。

original: In fact, that's such a shitty job, those caravan families will be the one bottlecapping you to death inch by inch - and that sounds good to me.
translation: 事实上，根本就是放狗屁，那些商队会一点一点勒死你——当然，这对我来说是好事。

original: Be a nice turnabout from your friend, House, and all the bottlecapping he's been doing to NCR for years. Sounds sweet to me.
translation: 到时候，你的朋友豪斯就会领教到什么是一报还一报了，想想这么些年他是怎么坑NCR的，我可高兴坏了。

original: We'd also guarantee protection to the caravans - and enforcement of fair trade practices.
translation: 另外，我们承诺保证商队的安全——并且严格执行公平交易条款。

original: [FAILED] {Snorts}With your wheeled buddies as merchants? No, the East is going to be a hard nut to crack, and I don't think you know what you're in for.
translation: [失败] {Snorts}难道你要让你那些脚踩轮子的伙计们去做生意？不，东部的问题相当棘手，我觉得你根本就不明白情况。

original: Maybe we could... give you some caps, from the battle?
translation: 也许我们还能……给你些瓶盖，何必动粗呢？

original: [SUCCEEDED] If you're buying our ear for the moment, Hoover Dam's more than a fistful of caps to my superiors. Vegas is interesting... the East...
translation: [成功] 你是想抓人眼球拖延时间，要知道胡佛大坝在我上级眼里可是比一堆瓶盖要值钱得多。维加斯很有趣……东部嘛……

original: That'll take too long to build up to generate capital - 'course, since you'd have to guard it during that time... don't know, could go either way.
translation: 对我们来说，这笔买卖的回报周期太长了——当然，前提是你真能守那么久……不知道，什么都有可能发生。

original: What if we give NCR some concessions in trade with Vegas - and the East?
translation: 如果我们在NCR和维加斯以及东部的贸易上给些优惠，怎么样？

original: [FAILED] {Irritated}What, loot we'd get anyway once we kicked your ass and more? No, I don't think so.
translation: [失败] {Irritated}什么，你觉得这个条件会比我们干掉你以后拿到的战利品还丰厚？不，我可不这么想。

original: We want the Dam, but the power it generates can be shared.
translation: 我们想要大坝，但是它发的电可以分一些给你们。

original: You sure got its heart beating in new ways... but that just makes me want all of it, not handouts.
translation: 你这个新提案确实很吸引人……但我既然可以喝光整碗汤，又为何只要一杯羹呢。

original: I have no intention of leaving you empty-handed.
translation: 我可没打算让你空空手地走。

original: {Frowns}Looking to make a deal, then? All right... let's hear it.
translation: {Frowns}这么说，你是想做笔交易？好吧……我洗耳恭听。

original: Well, I guess we can talk some more, if it'll settle things.
translation: 好吧，既然能解决问题，咱们不妨再多商量一下。

original: [SUCCEEDED] True, guess I'm a little too used to seeing Securitrons in Vegas to think they'd turn and be bad news - and I know how bad they can get.
translation: [成功] 确实，大概我是有点太习惯在维加斯看到电子保安了，没想到它们的出现会变成坏事——我也明白它们的本事。

original: <Bluff> The fact you're talking me with me says a lot about your willingness to fight.
translation: <恐吓> 你愿意和我谈判，其实已经说明你内心并不想开战。

original: [FAILED] {Chuckles}If that's your idea of diplomacy, then things are looking miles better on my side of the fence.
translation: [失败] {Chuckles}如果你觉得这也能算外交的话，那看来我这边的胜算还不小啊。

original: Look, you've got two choices - leave, or fight.
translation: 听着，你有两个选择——要么离开，要么咱们就开打。

original: I think you're cashed out enough that my chances are pretty good. And like I said, I'm not leaving the Dam now the Legion's been broken.
translation: 我想刚才你的话已经确实证明了我的胜算很大。而且我也说了，军团已经溃不成军，我是不会离开大坝的。

original: Forget it, let's finish this.
translation: 算了，我们来做个了结吧。

original: <Attack> Actually, nothing of the sort. We've come to exterminate you.
translation: <攻击> 其实，没那回事。我们就是来消灭你的。

original: Figured as much. Come on, you sons of bitches, we're ready.
translation: 不出所料。来吧，小杂种们，我们准备好了。

original: The Boomers might be willing, too... if I ask them. Which I will.
translation: 大炮族可能也会愿意……如果我去求他们的话。我会去的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Defeated}This has been a fuck of a day.
translation: [成功] {Defeated}真是操蛋的一天。

original: And once the Boomers join them?
translation: 那如果大炮族也和他们一起来呢？

original: [FAILED] You go on and do that. Me? I think they shot their last wad today... from now on, they'll prefer targets closer to home.
translation: [失败] 随你的便吧。我想他们今天已经打光了所有拿得出手的东西……从今往后，他们也不会再瞄准那些离家远的目标了。

original: Oh, I think it is... numbers aren't everything, really.
translation: 哦，我想……数量并不意味着一切，真的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Defeated}First the Legion, then the Brotherhood hitting us is about the last thing the Republic needs right now.
translation: [成功] {Defeated}先是军团，然后又是兄弟会，共和国经不起这样的车轮战。

original: Exactly - and while you've been occupied here, they're ready.
translation: 正确——而且当你忙于战斗时，他们已经准备好了。

original: [FAILED] Yeah, and we'll kick their ass again like we did at HELIOS One - tell them to come, we got a whole mess of armor-piercing rounds.
translation: [失败] 对，然后我们就会像在太阳神一号时那样再次把他们干翻——让他们来吧，我们有一大堆的穿甲武器。

original: Then... the Brotherhood might be willing to help me, I think.
translation: 那……兄弟会可能会愿意帮我，我想。

original: [SUCCEEDED] The Brotherhood? {Beat}Last thing we fucking need now.
translation: [成功] 兄弟会？{Beat}现在我们最他妈不需要的就是兄弟会。

original: Then maybe the Brotherhood would have more incentive.
translation: 那么兄弟会也许会更有动力和你们打。

original: [FAILED] Yeah, and we'll kick their ass again like we did at HELIOS One - tell them to come, we got a whole mess of armor-piercing rounds.
translation: [失败] 对，然后我们就会像在太阳神一号时那样再次把他们干翻——让他们来吧，我们有一大堆的穿甲武器。

original: <Bluff> Seems to me you're doing a lot of talking for someone ready to fight.
translation: <恐吓> 以一个准备战斗的人来说，你的话有点太多了。

original: The Generator's destroyed, the Dam is useless to you.
translation: 发电机组被毁了，大坝对你没用了。

original: Well, uh, one percent... are you sure? Seems weak to me.
translation: 好吧，呃，百分之一……你确定？对我来说那也太差劲了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Gives up, he's been beaten}Godammit.
translation: [成功] {Gives up, he's been beaten}该死。

original: Really? We should play cards some time, you're bluffing.
translation: 真的？我们下次改玩牌吧，你虚张声势的本事不错。

original: [FAILED] If that's the best you can muster, then it's you who should be backing up slow, and your buddies with you.
translation: [失败] 如果你就只有那么点嘴上功夫，你最好还是带着你的伙计们慢慢靠边站吧。

original: Look, either you're going to leave, or you're going to fight. So decide.
translation: 听着，要么你们自己走人，要么你们就从我的尸体上跨过去。自己选吧。

original: I think you're cashed out enough that my chances are pretty good. And like I said, I'm not leaving the Dam now the Legion's been broken.
translation: 我想你刚才的话已经确实证明了我的胜算很大。而且我也说了，军团已经溃不成军，我是不会放弃大坝的。

original: Um, well, I'm sure if ask them they'll be on board.
translation: 呃，好吧，我是说如果叫他们帮忙的话，他们肯定会帮的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Defeated, pissed}This has been a fuck of a day.
translation: [成功] {Defeated, pissed}真是操蛋的一天。

original: Who's to say? I just suggested coming to Hoover Dam to them, and BOOM.
translation: 谁料得到呢？我只是建议了一句让他们到胡佛大坝来，然后就“轰！”。

original: [FAILED] No, I think they blew their load here today with their fireworks... they'll prefer targets closer to home.
translation: [失败] 不，我觉得他们就只会点几根爆竹而已……何况他们更喜欢离家近的目标。

original: Once I radio the Brotherhood, they can handle the fighting elsewhere.
translation: 一旦我给兄弟会发信号，他们就会在其他地方发起进攻。

original: The Brotherhood? On the attack? I think we would have heard something from them by now.
translation: 兄弟会？进攻？我早就在想，啥时候才能听到他们的动静呢。

original: I think how I handled the Legate should be enough for you.
translation: 我想我搞定特使的手段你也见识到了吧。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Defeated, downcast}No... no, you're here in the Legate's camp first, I think that says enough.
translation: [成功] {Defeated, downcast}不……不，你能捷足先登来到特使的营地，我想就足够证明了。

original: I just stood down Caesar's toughest General... you think I won't?
translation: 我连凯撒最厉害的将军都能打退……你还觉得我不行？

original: [FAILED] And maybe you fed him a line of Brahmin shit, too, enough to make his dumb ass think twice... I ain't Legion, and I need more than words.
translation: [失败] 那可能是因为你喂了他一泡双头牛屎，撑得他脑子转不过弯……我不是特使，光凭几句话可唬不了我。

original: While the Boomers fly West? Works for me.
translation: 如果我让大炮族往西边飞呢？倒是不错哦。

original: They wouldn't.
translation: 他们不会的。

original: I doubt you know how bad the generator is by looking at it, trust me.
translation: 我看你是不清楚发电机的情况看起来有多糟，相信我。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Beaten}No... I can tell it'd just be a wasted trip.
translation: [成功] {Beaten}算了……我敢肯定是白跑一趟。

original: Send an engineer down to inspect the turbine and the housing - let them tell you.
translation: 派个工程师去下面去检查涡轮机组和外壳吧——让他们来告诉你。

original: [FAILED] Considering how long we've been here, we know it well. We've patched this place up plenty - we'll get it running again.
translation: [失败] 我们在这地方待了那么久，情况我们清楚得很。这地方来回修修补补已经很多趟——我们会让它重新运转起来的。

original: Even if you fixed the generators, hacking the code won't be easy.
translation: 就算你修好了发电机，破译密码也不是件简单的事。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Fucking PreWar RobCo pieces of shit...
translation: [成功] 操他妈的罗科战前狗屎科技……

original: Even if you fix it, you couldn't re-program the power grid, the systems are fried.
translation: 就算你修好了，你也不可能重新设定电网，整个系统现在一团糟。

original: [FAILED] {Sarcastic}Yeah, now where would we find an experienced computer specialist in the NCR? We'll find one, don't you worry.
translation: [失败] {Sarcastic}没关系，在NCR还怕找不到资深电脑专家？我们随便就能抓一个来，不用你操心。

original: <Bluff> Last I looked, that generator was on its last legs.
translation: <恐吓> 我记得上一次看到的时候，发电机已经转不动了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {He's beaten}Of all the goddamn luck...
translation: [成功] {He's beaten}真是倒了血霉……

original: <Bluff> The generator is beyond repair, trust me.
translation: <恐吓> 发电机已经修不好了，相信我。

original: [FAILED] Oh, "last you looked," huh? Yeah, we'll take another look... after you haul ass outta here.
translation: [失败] 哦，"你上一次看到的时候"？好吧，我们会再去看一次……就在你滚蛋之后。

original: Oh, with a crack squad like at HELIOS One? Try it.
translation: 哦，比如你们驻扎在太阳神一号的那些蹩脚的技术员？不妨试试。

original: Even if we're running at one percent for a year, it's still worth holding this place.
translation: 就算我们只能用百分之一的效能运转一年，这个地方也依然值得把守。

original: <Bluff> Is talking all you can do? I can talk tough, too - real tough.
translation: <恐吓> 你就只剩下耍嘴皮子的本事了吗？我也会耍嘴皮子——而且比你利索。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Yeah... but I wasn't expecting a fight when I came up here. {Beat}And now that we're talking, I don't like the sound of things.
translation: [成功] 是的……但我来这儿的时候没想要打仗。{Beat}既然咱们是在谈判，我可不太喜欢现在这种氛围。

original: <Bluff> Because you're talking and not attacking?
translation: <恐吓> 就凭你只敢叫唤不敢进攻？

original: [FAILED] {Chuckles}That so, well, if all you brought is words, then this is going to be one short conversation.
translation: [失败] {Chuckles}是吗，如果你光会耍嘴皮子，那么我们也聊不了多久的。

original: You think these robots are all the forces I have?
translation: 你以为我就只有这么点机器人吗？

original: Right now, they're all that's standing here - well, except for the corpses. So that's your plan, hold the Dam here all by your lonesome?
translation: 就目前来说，你的部队全都在大坝上——好吧，除了残骸。所以这就是你的计划？独自一人坚守大坝？

original: Because the Generator's destroyed, the Dam is useless to you.
translation: 因为发电机组已经被毁了，大坝对你来说也没用了。

original: Lot of PreWar factories and tech lying around the Mojave, our engineers'll get it running again, no matter how much damage you've done down there.
translation: 莫哈维散落着很多战前工厂和科技，不论你造成了多大的伤害，我们的工程师都会让它们再次运转起来的。

original: Securitrons - erase NCR from the area.
translation: 电子保安——请把该区域所有NCR统统消灭。

original: I wasn't able to find all of the escorts you're looking for.
translation: 我没能找到你需要的所有伴游。
