original: Independent New Vegas. If that isn't redundant, I don't know what is.
translation: 独立的新维加斯。如果这不算画蛇添足，我不知道什么才算。

original: But I like its chances.
translation: 不过，我喜欢无限可能。

original: What did you do when you were with the Enclave?
translation: 你在英克雷时是干什么的？

original: Heavy weapons trooper. {grim glee}Nothing better than hosing down a target with an excess of bullets and laser fire.
translation: 重武器操作员。{grim glee}没有什么能比将敌人淹没在子弹与激光组成的暴雨中更有乐趣的了。

original: By the time I got through with things, not much was left standing. Any morons who didn't run when they saw me coming got what they deserved.
translation: 等我打得差不多了，还能站着的也不剩几个。那些见到我却不知逃跑的家伙，全都得到了应有的下场。

original: Back then, it was war. {growling}If we'd been on the winning side, I'd be called a hero.
translation: 这就是战争。{growling}如果当时赢的是我们，那我现在早就成英雄了。

original: You make it sound like avoiding innocent deaths was uncommon in the Enclave.
translation: 听你说的，好像错杀无辜在英克雷是很平常的事。

original: I'm sorry to say that it was. Civilian casualties was acceptable and sometimes... encouraged. My former squadmate Moreno didn't need encouraging.
translation: 很抱歉，确实如此。平民伤亡是可以接受的，甚至有时……是必要的。我的前战友莫雷诺就很热衷于此。

original: Moreno and I might've killed each other if Captain Kreger hadn't been there to pull us apart.
translation: 如果不是克里杰队长把我和莫雷诺分开，估计我们俩早就拔刀相向了。

original: What did you do when you were with the Enclave?
translation: 你在英克雷的时候都做些什么？

original: Squad marksman. I'm pretty proud of the fact that I never killed a single soul who wasn't trying to kill me or one of my team first.
translation: 我是队里的神射手。除了想取我和我战友性命的人之外，我还从未错杀过一个人。这一点我颇为自豪。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Be seeing you. {beat, afterthought - he's very old and could die any time}Maybe.
translation: 再见。{beat，afterthought - he's very old and could die any time}也许吧。

original: How did you like flying vertibirds for the Enclave?
translation: 你觉得为英克雷驾驶飞鸟怎么样？

original: {nostalgia}I never was happier than when I was in the cockpit. I was able to go just about anywhere and everywhere, limited only by the fuel I could carry.
translation: {nostalgia}我最喜欢坐进驾驶舱时的感觉。开着它我能去任何地方、见任何人，只要我的燃料充足。

original: There were more than a few missions where I took the scenic route home just so I could stay in the air. Caught hell for it every time, but worth it!
translation: 好多次任务我都在返回的路上故意绕个远路，就为在空中多待一会。每次都被痛骂，但值得！

original: {more sober, slightly defensive}Some of the things we did were questionable, I know. That's just how it was back then. Figure I've done enough good to make up for any sins, anyhow.
translation: {more sober，slightly defensive}我知道，我们的所作所为，有些并不是很正当。可那时世道如此。不过，我做过的善事应该能弥补我犯下的罪过了吧。

original: I'd like to know more about your former squad.
translation: 我想多了解一些你以前当兵时队伍的情况。

original: I was the officer in charge, and Johnson and Moreno were my heavy hitters. Henry handled tech things, and Whitman flew the chopper.
translation: 我是指挥官。约翰逊和莫雷诺负责火力，亨利处理技术问题，惠特曼驾驶飞鸟。

original: Johnson and Moreno never got along, and I had my hands full keeping those two apart some days.
translation: 约翰逊和莫雷诺的关系始终不好，为了让这两个家伙安分点，我常常被搞得头昏脑胀。

original: It was a difference in philosophy, mostly. "Mercy" was not part of Moreno's vocabulary.
translation: 他们两人的处事方式完全不同。"仁慈"这个字眼在莫雷诺的词典里是找不到的。

original: What happened to the Enclave oil rig and Navarro?
translation: 英克雷的钻井平台和纳瓦罗基地都出了什么事？

original: Internal sabotage took down the oil rig - never did get the full story. The NCR took out Navarro, saying we posed a threat to the region.
translation: 钻井平台是从内部被炸毁的——我不知道确切的情况。NCR攻陷了纳瓦罗，他们认为我们对那个地区构成了威胁。

original: Tell me about the old days with the Enclave.
translation: 给我讲讲你在英克雷时的情况。

original: {wistful}I miss those days sometimes. We all had a purpose, you know? I admit that some of the folks in charge were pretty ruthless.
translation: {wistful}我偶尔还会怀念那个时候。我们当年可是有理想的，你知道吗？我承认，有些高层人士的做法确实太过残忍。

original: The rest of us, though - we were just trying to civilize things. The NCR was still new and it didn't look like they'd last all that long.
translation: 可剩下的人——我们只想为废土带去文明。那时NCR刚诞生不久，原以为他们那样子根本成不了气候。

original: Then, we lost the oil rig and shortly after that, the base at Navarro. Nobody left except us Remnants.
translation: 谁知不久之后，我们的钻井平台就陷落了，紧接着纳瓦罗基地也失守了。只剩我们这些残部幸存了下来。

original: {Terrifying Presence}I'm sorry for what I'm about to do to you. Well, not really.
translation: {Terrifying Presence}抱歉我差点就对你下了手。嗯，幸好我没真那样做。

original: Like I'd hang around to find out!
translation: 这话还用得着你说！

original: How long have you lived in Westside?
translation: 你在西区住了多久？

original: Couple of years now. I was a trader for awhile, but got tired of all the walking. Westside was a good place to settle down as any.
translation: 已经好几年了。我做过一阵子商人，后来厌倦了四处漂泊的日子。西区是个安家的好地方。

original: So what did you do before you were retired?
translation: 你退休前是干什么的？

original: I was a soldier. Why do you even care? I came out here to forget about the past, so quit bringing it up.
translation: 我是当兵的。你关心这个干嘛？我来这儿就是为了忘掉过去。别再提了。

original: You must be the courier folks have been talking about. Word on the radio is that someone wronged you back in Goodsprings.
translation: 你一定就是大家都在谈论的那个邮差了。收音机上说你在清泉镇被人给害了。

original: The Mojave has a way of burning decent people up, but it sounds like you've done right by the NCR. It's appreciated. Now what can I do for you?
translation: 莫哈维就是个能把好人烧成灰的地方，不过听说你帮NCR做了不少事情。我很感谢你。有什么能为您效劳的吗？

original: I know a bit about you, courier. Heard someone messed you up pretty bad over in Goodsprings. I heard a few other things too. Some good, but not all.
translation: 我听说过一些你的事迹，邮差。据说有人在清泉镇把你伤得不轻。我还听说了其他的事情。有些是好事，但并非是全部。

original: If you're going to be associating with rangers, you'd best stay on their friendly side. With that out of the way, what can I do for you?
translation: 如果你想要与游骑兵合作，那你最好还是与他们的立场保持一致。且不说这个了，我能帮你什么忙吗？

original: I'm surprised to see you here. Folks with your kind of reputation, I expect to see them cooking in the sand with some {forty four}.44 slugs to keep them company.
translation: 能在这儿遇到你，让我非常吃惊。像你这样声名狼藉的家伙，我以为都是风餐露宿，身边还放着一堆.44口径弹药。

original: If the rangers haven't caught up to you yet, they will. Myself excluded, of course. {joking}The only thing I catch up on now is chair time.
translation: 如果游骑兵还没有抓住你，那他们迟早会的。当然，不包括我。{joking}我现在唯一能做的就是坐在椅子上消磨时光。

original: I don't think we've had the pleasure of meeting before. What can I do for you?
translation: 我想我们以前应该没见过面吧。我能为您做些什么呢？

original: {Player doesn't have Power Armor training}I'll talk to her, then.
translation: {Player doesn't have Power Armor training}那我这就去找她。

original: The training might take several hours, so keep that in mind.
translation: 训练可能会花好几个小时，一定要记牢了。

original: {Player has Power Armor training}I already know how to wear Power Armor.
translation: {Player has Power Armor training}我已经知道怎样使用动力装甲了。

original: Good. That'll save us some time.
translation: 很好。这倒省事了。

original: What do you know about the dam?
translation: 关于水坝，你都知道些什么？

original: Well, the dam here is the key to helping the NCR make the world a better place.
translation: 嗯，这个水坝是NCR让世界变得更加美好的关键。

original: With the power from the dam we can help the people here and back home have a better quality of life.
translation: 有了水坝生产的电力，我们就能让这里的人民和家乡的父老乡亲都过上好日子。

original: We can't trust the Legion or Mr. House to do the same. The NCR is the only one looking out for the people. And we need the dam to do that.
translation: 我们可不相信军团或者豪斯先生能做到这一点。只有NCR才真正关心百姓福祉，而这就需要水坝为我们服务。

original: And I pity the people that try to take it from us.
translation: 那些想从我们手上夺走水坝的人是绝对不会得逞的。

original: What are your thoughts about the Legion?
translation: 你觉得军团怎么样？

original: They're a bunch of evil savages if you ask me. We're out here trying to save these good people from being enslaved by those bastards.
translation: 要我说，他们就是一群邪恶的野蛮人。而我们则是来拯救这里善良的人们免受他们奴役的。

original: I hope we kill 'em all.
translation: 我希望能把他们都干掉。

original: How do you feel about the NCR being out here?
translation: 你觉得NCR怎么样？

original: The NCR is out here to make the world a better place. For those out here and for all those back home. I'm glad I can be a part of that.
translation: NCR会让这个世界变得更美好。不光是这里的人民，还有家乡的父老们。我很高兴自己是NCR的一员。

original: Let's go back to my other questions.
translation: 嗯，说点别的吧。

original: Make it quick.
translation: 快一点儿。

original: I guess I can make an exception, just for you.
translation: 我想，为了你我还是可以破一下例的。

original: I completely understand, but I am working for the good of the NCR too.
translation: 我完全理解，不过我也在为了NCR而努力呀。

original: It's still against regulations, I can't help you.
translation: 但违规就是违规，我帮不了你。

original: Come on! Who's going to know?
translation: 拜托！谁会知道？

original: Well, that is great and all, but it's really against regulations.
translation: 你确实不错，但这么做真的违反规定了。

original: Not even to a friend of the NCR?
translation: 就连NCR的朋友也不行吗？

original: I'm not here to make money, I'm here to watch the NCR supplies for the dam and that means no supplies for you.
translation: 我不是来这挣外快的，我的任务是管理NCR在水坝的装备补给，所以我不可能把补给卖给你。

original: Come on! Don't you want to make a few caps?
translation: 拜托！难道你就不想挣点外快？

original: I have some questions about the NCR.
translation: 我有几个关于NCR的问题。

original: I guess I can trust you. What would you like to know?
translation: 我想我可以信任你，你想知道什么？

original: Sure, what would you like to know?
translation: 当然，你想知道什么？

original: I'm not required to answer questions from a civilian and I don't trust you enough.
translation: 我没有义务回答平民的问题，何况我也不信任你。

original: Go bug someone else with your questions.
translation: 去问别人吧。

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: I guess I can spare a minute or two for you. Things are a little slow at the moment anyway.
translation: 那我就姑且抽几分钟时间和你聊聊，反正我这里也没什么急事。

original: Me? I've been in the military my entire life. It's a family sort of thing. My father served, my brothers serve, and I serve.
translation: 我？我在军队里待了一辈子，也算是家族传统吧。我老爹当兵，我兄弟当兵，我也当了兵。

original: I've had the honor of serving all over the NCR and now I get to be out on the front lines as the NCR comes out east to help these folks here.
translation: 我曾有幸在NCR各地服役过，现在我被调来了东部前线，帮助这里的人民。

original: Once we get rid of the Legion, this will be a better place for everyone, and I'm proud to be a part of that.
translation: 一旦我们打败了军团，大家就能过上好日子了。我很自豪自己能参加对军团的战斗。

original: I'm on duty here. I don't have time to chit-chat.
translation: 我正在执勤，没时间陪你闲扯。

original: I'd like to purchase some supplies.
translation: 我想买点补给。

original: Sure thing.
translation: 当然的。

original: Unfortunately for you, I'm not authorized to trade with you. It's against regulations.
translation: 非常抱歉，上级并未批准我和你做生意。这样做违反规定。

original: Why is the Brotherhood interested in Nevada?
translation: 兄弟会为什么对内华达感兴趣？

original: It was the Dam, really. We'd heard rumors it was working. Figured we could claim it, put it to use.
translation: 因为大坝，真的。我们听到传闻说大坝仍在运行。以为能占领它，将它再次利用起来。

original: {Putting it delicately}And... it may also have been partly that our Elder at the time had worn out his welcome.
translation: {Putting it delicately}不过……也有一部分是因为我们当时的长老在总部已经不怎么受人待见了。

original: Didn't end up mattering. We got sidetracked at HELIOS One and the NCR took the Dam in the meantime. We're still after it, though. In theory.
translation: 反正结果都一样。我们被太阳神一号分散了精力，NCR趁机夺取了大坝。不过理论上，我们仍未放弃那个目标。

original: What are you doing in here?
translation: 你在这里干什么？

original: Well, a deputy isn't much good without a sheriff. {cowardly and hesitant}So I figured I'd come in here and protect these good people until someone finds us a new one.
translation: 嗯，失去了警长，一个副警长也难成气候。{cowardly and hesitant}所以我觉得在找到新警长之前，我得留在这里保护这些善良的百姓。

original: Why do you keep calling them Gangsters? I thought they were called Powder Gangers.
translation: 你为什么总管他们叫掠夺者？我记得他们是叫炸药帮啊。

original: Gangers, gangsters, all sounds like trouble to me.
translation: 炸药帮也好，掠夺者也罢，对我来说都是麻烦。

original: Didn't your friend just say so?
translation: 不是你朋友说的？

original: Yeah, if he vouches for you, I guess I can trust you.
translation: 好吧，既然他替你担保，那我就相信你吧。

original: You're not hiding something from me, are you?
translation: 你没隐瞒什么吧？

original: What? No! I thought you were supposed to be here to help, and here you are making accusations.
translation: 什么？没有！我以为你是来帮忙的，没想到你居然倒打一耙。

original: The boy means well, but he's dumb as a mutant sometimes.
translation: 那孩子本性不坏，就是有时候脑袋不灵光。

original: He probably said "lieutenant", Wayne.
translation: 他说的好像是“中尉”，韦恩。

original: Your friend looks like he's in bad shape.
translation: 你朋友看起来很糟糕。

original: Yeah, the docs say he's going to be laid up for a while, assuming he doesn't get any worse.
translation: 是的，医生说他得躺上好一阵子，前提是他的伤势不会继续恶化。

original: Sorry, didn't mean to intrude.
translation: 抱歉，我无意冒犯。

original: You were just curious. No harm in that. I'm just worried sick about my friend here.
translation: 我知道你只是好奇。没关系。我只是非常担心我朋友的情况。

original: I wanted to speak to you about the Great Khans.
translation: 我想和你说说大汗帮的事。

original: What precisely about them did you wish to discuss?
translation: 你具体想说点什么？

original: Should I leave you two alone?
translation: 也许我该给你们俩一点时间团聚？

original: Naw, I'm just happy to see my pup back on his feet and happy. I can't thank you enough for this.
translation: 不必了，只要看到我的小狗继续快乐地活蹦乱跳，我就很高兴了。真不知该如何感谢你。

original: Hopefully, he's been making himself useful as a way of paying you back. But where are my manners, did you need something?
translation: 希望他能成为你的得力助手，好好报答你的恩情。瞧我都有些失态了，你还有什么事吗？

original: I don't have to give him back just yet, do I?
translation: 我不用现在就把他还给你吧？

original: No no, you can hold onto him for a little while longer, I think. You deserve that much at least, for what you've done.
translation: 不用，不用，你可以继续带着雷克斯。你为他做了这么多，这是你应得的。

original: But aside from the good news about my Rex, was there something you wanted?
translation: 除了我的雷克斯终于有好消息外，你还有什么事要告诉我吗？

original: He sure did.
translation: 他的手术成功了。

original: You're a man of your word, no doubt about it. I can't thank you enough.
translation: 毫无疑问，你是个信守诺言的人。真不知该怎么感谢你。

original: If you want, hold onto Rex for a little while longer. I'm sure he'd enjoy that. Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 如果你愿意，可以继续带着雷克斯。我相信他也会很高兴的。还有什么事吗？

original: You know, I really don't pay attention to him, so your guess is as good as mine.
translation: 我并没有怎么注意他。所以我也不知道他的情况。

original: I expect you to treat my Rexie with a little more care. I'm expecting him back now, you hear?
translation: 我希望你能多关心下我的雷克斯。我希望他能回来，你明白吗？

original: Now, was there something you wanted to talk about?
translation: 你还有什么事情要告诉我？

original: Rex died in battle, saving my life.
translation: 雷克斯死于一场战斗，为了救我。

original: I hate to tell you this, but Rex is dead.
translation: 我不想告诉你，但是雷克斯死了。

original: {Overwhelmed by emotion}That's... that's terrible. I hope the poor little guy gave as good as he got. {Sad, but proud}He always was a fighter.
translation: {Overwhelmed by emotion}这…太糟糕了。我希望这可怜的小家伙能死得其所。{Sad, but proud}他一直是个战士。

original: {Breaking down a little}Why I remember one time when he... {Tries to switch topics to cover}do you mind if we talk about something else?
translation: {Breaking down a little}我记得有一次他……{Tries to switch topics to cover}介不介意我们谈点别的？

original: [SUCCEEDED] O-Of course not! We're here to serve the good citizens of the NCR. Please, head on through.
translation: [成功] 当然…不是！为善良的NCR公民服务是我们的职责。请进吧。

original: You already let me in the other night! Do all of us civilians look the same to you soldier boys?
translation: 那天晚上你都放我进去过了！难道在你们当兵的眼里，我们老百姓都长一个样吗？

original: [SUCCEEDED] If you're here to see the Major, then I suppose it's all right. Head on through.
translation: [成功] 如果你是来找少校的，那应该没问题。进去吧。

original: I'm here to see Major Kieran on urgent business. Please let me pass.
translation: 我是来找基兰少校的，有要紧事。让我过去。

original: [FAILED] Since you put it like that, no. Not unless you know the password. Do you know the password?
translation: [失败] 看看你这态度，不行。除非你知道暗号。暗号是什么？

original: Come on, guys, you can let me in, right? Right?
translation: 得了吧，伙计，你就通融通融让我进去吧，行吗？行吗？

original: I'll leave things here to you, then.
translation: 那我就把这儿的善后工作交给你了。

original: Be safe, human. And thanks again for everything.
translation: 一路平安，人类。再次感谢你所做的一切。

original: With Tabitha gone, what will happen to this place?
translation: 塔比瑟走后，这儿会怎么样？

original: Who knows? It might stay abandoned, get used as a base for raiders, or even become another colony for mutants.
translation: 谁知道？也许继续荒废着，也许会变成掠夺者窝，甚至有可能会成为变种人新的据点。

original: The future is not written, human, and it is foolish to squint at what cannot be seen.
translation: 未来是飘渺不定的，人类，对看不见的事物妄加揣测，是相当愚蠢的行为。

original: There's a human down the path. Tabitha's orders are to kill all human intruders. Go!
translation: 下面路上有个人类。塔比瑟对人类下了格杀令。快去！

original: They were distributing supplies down by the old train station, but I dealt with them.
translation: 他们在老火车站分发补给, 但我已经搞定了。

original: I'll send some guys to check out your story, but that's some good news for a change.
translation: 我会派人去查证你所说的话，不过总算是有好消息了。

original: Word will probably spread about this, and quickly. The NCR'll know not to come around these parts if they know what's good for 'em.
translation: 这件事很快就会传开的，NCR如果识相，以后应该就不会再踏足此地了。

original: You've helped us plenty, so I'll tell you what. Just this once, name whatever you want, and if I can make it happen, it's done.
translation: 你帮了我们不少忙，这样吧，你可以向我提一个要求，就一个，只要是我力所能及的，我一定办到。

original: Don't rush it, though. Toss it around in your head a little. You only get one favor from The King.
translation: 不过你可别着急。等想好了再提。你只有一次机会。

original: Nevermind.
translation: 算了。

original: Sorry about that, friend.
translation: 对不起，朋友。

original: I changed my mind. I'm not going inside, either.
translation: 我改主意了。我也不进去了。

original: Thanks. Wasn't wild about sticking around here on my own.
translation: 谢谢。留我一个人在这儿瞎逛有点太疯狂了。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Don't take too long, all right?
translation: 别花太长时间，好吗？

original: Is there someplace you wanted me to take you?
translation: 你想去什么地方吗？

original: Nowhere specific. I just know there are a lot of groups who're actually doing well for themselves out here.
translation: 没什么特别想去的地方。我知道外面有不少族群的生存状况都挺不错。

original: I want to understand how and why. See them at work.
translation: 我就想搞清楚为什么。学习一下他们是如何运作的。

original: See? Just because it doesn't shoot lasers doesn't mean it's not worth looking into. We could do amazing things with this data.
translation: 看到了吗？别以为它射不出激光就没有研究价值了。我们可以用这些数据创造奇迹。

original: Huh. Figured it'd have more buttons and dials and stuff, you know? Oh, well. It's still the electronic equivalent of a disease from Gomorrah.
translation: 呵，我还以为这玩意会有更多的按钮和转盘之类的呢。哦，好吧。它这造型倒是很符合蛾摩拉的那种病态时尚。

original: Oh, God, I don't know if I can do this.
translation: 哦，上帝，我不知道我是否能做到。

original: Hey, the gang's all here! {Then, sincerely}Let's give the Mojave something to remember us by.
translation: 嘿，大伙都来了！{Then, sincerely}就让这片沙漠永远记住我们的名字吧。

original: I never thought I'd see you again. I'm glad you're here.
translation: 我从未想过会再次见到你们。我很高兴你们能来。

original: Hey, the gang's all here!
translation: 嘿，大伙都来了！

original: Hey. I, uh, I can't go in with you. I'll wait here, okay?
translation: 嘿。我，嗯，我不能跟你一块儿进去。我就在这儿等着，好吗？

original: Sorry about that. Just because I love them doesn't mean some of them aren't assholes.
translation: 真是抱歉，虽然我很爱他们，可他们中有些人确实太混蛋了。

original: Could you help me craft something?
translation: 你能帮我造些东西吗？

original: Step into my office.
translation: 找我就对了。

original: Anything else?
translation: 还有吗？

original: Yeah. I've been taking things apart and putting them back together since before I said my first word.
translation: 是的。从我咿呀学语开始，我就喜欢把东西拆开，再把它们装回去。

original: You want to build something, talk to me, and we can do it right there on the spot. Workbenches are for novices.
translation: 你想组装什么东西，就随时跟我说，我们可以当场制造。只有新手才需要钳工台。

original: Who knows, I might even be able to show you a Brotherhood trick or two.
translation: 搞不好我还可以教你几招兄弟会里流传的小技巧呢。

original: Could you could teach me to punch better?
translation: 你能教我更好的拳法吗？

original: Not right now.
translation: 现在不行。

original: You sure? Some other time, then.
translation: 你确定？那就改天吧。

original: Sure, teach me.
translation: 当然，教教我。

original: All right, put 'em up. Let's see what you got.
translation: 好的，来吧。让我看看你有什么本事。

original: <Gasps> For me? Do you mean it? No, no, it's too much! Well, okay. But it's too much! It's perfect. Thank you. Thank you.
translation: <倒抽气>给我的？真的吗？不，这太贵重了！呃，好吧。但真的太贵重了！好美啊。谢谢。谢谢。

original: I... wish I had something to give you. I- wait! What about punching? That's the gift that keeps on giving.
translation: 我……希望能送你点东西。我——等等！拳法怎么样？这是我唯一能送别人的礼物。

original: I could work on your punching with you, if you like. Show you how to counter like a Scribe.
translation: 如果你喜欢的话，我可以教你拳法。让你看看兄弟会学士是怎样反击的。

original: <Gasps> For me? Do you mean it? No, it's too much! Well, okay. But it's too much! It's perfect. Thank you. Thank you.
translation: <倒抽气>给我的？真的吗？不，这太贵重了！呃，好吧。但真的太贵重了！好美啊。谢谢。谢谢。

original: Hey, a dress! Thank you! I'm totally trying this on later.
translation: 哇，一件礼服！谢谢！过一会我要试穿一下。

original: Aw, you shouldn't have! It's just my taste. Thank you.
translation: 哦，不会吧！这正合我口味。谢谢。

original: Oh my God, oh my God, oh my God! Look what they're wearing! I've only seen dresses like those in my dreams. And even then I couldn't afford them.
translation: 噢，我的上帝，我的上帝啊，我的上帝！看看他们穿的衣服！我只在梦里见过这样的衣服。而且我在梦里都买不起。

original: Got the whiskey, let's do this.
translation: 威士忌来了，开始吧。

original: All right then, I already got a head start, but I'll go first anyway.
translation: 好吧，虽然我已经拔得头筹了，不过这次我还是先来吧。

original: Here's a dozen bottles, let's go.
translation: 这有一打，来吧。

original: All right then, I already got a head start, but I'll go first anyway.
translation: 好吧，虽然我已经拔得头筹了，不过这次我还是先来吧。

original: I'll get a dozen bottles of whiskey and be back.
translation: 等我再拿一扎威士忌，咱们回来接着拼。

original: I'll be waiting, then. {Beat, smiling}And training.
translation: 那我就等着吧。我也会好好练练的。

original: What will you do now?
translation: 你现在打算做什么？

original: {Slightly confused}No idea. Maybe... head back West? Though the idea of heading back there with my tail between my legs isn't appealing.
translation: {Slightly confused}我也不知道怎么办，要么回西部去？可我也不想就这样夹着尾巴溜走啊。

original: I'll be going now.
translation: 我先走了。

original: Take care now.
translation: 多保重啊。

original: I had something else I wanted to ask.
translation: 我还有些问题想问。

original: {Sold Caravan}What will you do now?
translation: {Sold Caravan}你现在打算做什么？

original: {Sighs}That's the question I been asking myself.
translation: 我也一直在问自己这个问题。

original: Helped out Jackson and cleared the road North.
translation: 我已经帮杰克逊把北面的商路清理干净了。

original: {Takes a breath}Guess that settles that, then.
translation: {Takes a breath}看来事情已经搞定了啊。

original: I may be honest, but at least I'm not blinded by pride.
translation: 我也许是很坦率，但至少我拿得起放得下。

original: {Blinks}That's fair. {Beat}But there's been that voice inside me saying the same thing, and whiskey wasn't killing it.
translation: 说得不错。但我内心有个声音也在重复着同一句话，无论灌下多少威士忌我都忘不掉。

original: {Sad}Give me that paper, I'll put my name to it. No sense trying to hold the past between your fingers when it's nothing but dirt.
translation: 把文件给我，我来签字。既然都已经化为灰了，也没必要再攥着过去不放了。

original: Who believes in holding on to a dead caravan?
translation: 谁还会守着个名存实亡的商队不放呢？

original: Me, that's who. I'm not going to let it go just yet. There... there might be some survivors... or...
translation: 不是谁，就是我。我还没放弃希望呢。也许……也许还会有幸存者……或许……

original: Who am I kidding. There's nothing left, and I wouldn't be here, drinking in some shitty bar in the ass end of nowhere if it wasn't true.
translation: 算了，不开玩笑。确实什么也没剩下，否则的话，我也不会找个破旮旯角的烂酒吧来买醉了。

original: I wanted to talk to you more about buying your caravan.
translation: 我想和你谈谈收购商队的事情。

original: If you think staying here's any better...
translation: 如果你觉得留在这里更好的话……

original: [SUCCEEDED] That... that's a good point, it's the caravan clearance that's got me stuck here. I'm sure this bar's getting tired of propping me up.
translation: [成功] 你……你说到点子上了，正是因为商队许可证的原因，我才会被困在这儿。我看这酒吧也应该不怎么待见我了。

original: This Outpost is the last place you want to be trapped.
translation: 你总不想在这个前哨站里过一辈子吧。

original: [FAILED] I got a bar, men who don't say a word, and plenty of whiskey, I'm fine.
translation: [失败] 我还有酒吧，这儿的人话又不多，还有成打的威士忌。我觉得够好了。

original: Are you sure?
translation: 你确定？

original: Look, I know you came all this way, and that takes some drive, especially these days.
translation: 听着，我知道你大老远地赶来，肯定费了不少功夫，尤其最近这个状况。

original: Just doesn't feel right, trading history for a slip of paper.
translation: 我就是觉得不行，好歹也算一段历史，就这么一张纸给卖了。

original: Never mind. I'll be going.
translation: 算了。我先走了。

original: You take care now.
translation: 你自己保重。

original: Forget it, then. I had something else I wanted to ask.
translation: 算了。我想问点别的。

original: So what... you're just going to keep it?
translation: 怎么……你就打算留着这名字？

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Low, angry}{emph}What did you just say to me? Cause you sure as hell got my attention now.
translation: [成功] {Low, angry}{emph}你刚才说什么？你他妈倒是让我觉得有点意思了。

original: If you made the caravan, you're responsible for killing it.
translation: 既然是你创建了商队，那你就有责任解散它。

original: [FAILED] Yeah, yeah I will, and you sure as hell aren't taking it. Can't believe I was even listening to you.
translation: [失败]是的，是的，反正你啥也别想得到。不敢相信我居然听你啰嗦了这么久。

original: Whatever gets the job done. Sign here.
translation: 随便吧，办完一桩是一桩。签字吧。

original: Let's just say I prefer when both sides are happy.
translation: 这么说吧，我不想看到双方伤了和气。

original: Just insuring future work with the Crimson Caravan.
translation: 只是希望将来你还能继续和深红商队合作。

original: Which means they're paying you to rebuild Cassidy Caravans, not sell it.
translation: 意思是他们付钱给你是为了重建盖西迪商队，而不是让你卖了它。

original: After Cassidy Caravans gets renamed, just start it up again.
translation: 等盖西迪商队改了名，你可以再开一个。

original: The Crimson Caravan will most likely change the name once they buy it.
translation: 深红商队很可能一买下商队就马上改名。

original: So you're telling me, I could take this money you're offering, give them nothing, and then go on to strike up another caravan, same as before?
translation: 所以你的意思是，我等于拿走你的钱，什么都没给你，还能和以前一样开商队，出去再立门户？

original: {Disbelieving}What kind of fucking negotiator are you? {Impressed}Hope Alice knows the kind of snake she's got working for her.
translation: 天底下还有像你这样谈生意的？真希望爱丽丝能看清楚，她手底下的人是有多鬼。

original: Far from it, to turn down the original terms.
translation: 想压低条件，恐怕还差得远呢。

original: All right, it's a deal, hand over that paper. Hnh. Can't believe I'm parting with it.
translation: 好吧，成交，拿文件来。哼，不敢相信我真的要把它卖了。

original: {Signing}All right... there you go, caravan's yours. {Beat}Feel kind of relieved, actually. Guess I didn't realize how much I was carrying around with just the name.
translation: {Signing}好吧……行了，商队是你的了。{Beat}说实话，我倒觉得有些如释重负。也许我真没意识到这个名字已经成了我的累赘。

original: I think you're a realist, and know a good offer when you see one.
translation: 我相信你很务实，这么好的条件，你是不会错过的。

original: That amount's enough to start a new caravan... with the old name.
translation: 就这数目，你都足够用旧名字组建一个新商队了……

original: Old name? What old name?
translation: 旧名字？什么旧名字？

original: Maybe... there's something else we could trade?
translation: 也许……我们可以用别的方式来做成这笔交易？

original: [SUCCEEDED] You challenging me? Serious now.
translation: [成功] 你想挑战我？这可有意思。

original: All right, you come here, armed with whiskey, we'll make a sport of it.
translation: 好吧，只要你准备好威士忌，我们俩就来比比深浅吧。

original: And none of that radioactive shit, I'm talking whiskey, not Dixon Whiskey - whiskey.
translation: 对了，我不要那种带辐射的狗屎，我要的是威士忌，不是迪克森威士忌，而是——威士忌。

original: I'm not going to offer money, I wanted to drink for it.
translation: 我不想出钱，咱俩拼酒量。

original: [FAILED] You are definitely barking up the wrong bar stool. Whatever you're suggesting, {emph}not interested.
translation: [失败] 那你明显是找错人了。无论你说啥，{emph}我都没兴趣。

original: It's just a name, this - this is money.
translation: 不过是个名字罢了，这——这可是钱哪。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Impressed}You're obviously putting your money where your mouth is - on top of that offer letter, that is a lot of caps.
translation: [成功] {Impressed}你还挺有诚意的嘛——直接在这信封里装这么多钱，这还真不少哦。

original: {Hesitating}Still... what makes you think that's enough. What, you think I'm cheap?
translation: {Hesitating}不过……你觉得这么些就够了？你觉得我是随便就能打发的吗？

original: I'm prepared to offer you the terms, plus 750 caps.
translation: 我就按这上面的条件，再加750个瓶盖。

original: [FAILED] "Just a name?" {Scoffs}You obviously don't know me at all to {sarcastic}sweet talk me like that.
translation: [失败] "不过是个名字？"看来你是不了解我，我可不是几句甜言蜜语就能哄得了的。

original: {As if to a child}You take your letter, pay my respects to Alice, then kindly go fuck yourself.
translation: 拿着你的信，回去代我向爱丽丝问好，然后圆润地给我滚。

original: I have the offer letter here, the terms are fair.
translation: 开的价钱就在这封信里头，已经很公道了。

original: {Studying letter}Alice McLafferty, eh? No, I see the zeroes... and I know she's good for them.
translation: {Studying letter}爱丽丝·麦克拉弗蒂啊？不，我瞧见这零头了…我知道她善于耍这种把戏。

original: Still, it's not about the money. Dad'd spin like a twister if he ever heard I sold our name for anything.
translation: 即便如此，这也不是钱的事。老爸如果知道我把商队卖了，他一定会发失心疯的。

original: So even if you have nothing, you won't sell?
translation: 那就算你已经一无所有了，你也不打算卖？

original: If someone came up to you and offered you a thousand caps for your {emph}name, would {emph}you take it?
translation: 如果有人跟你说，他愿意花一千瓶盖买你的名字，你会答应么？

original: Actually, you know what, fuck it, I don't want to hear your answer anyway.
translation: 说老实话，去它妈的，我才不想听你回答。

original: Point is, I made the caravan what it is, it's mine.
translation: 问题在于，商队是我建立的，所以它是我的。

original: You haven't even seen the offer yet.
translation: 你还不知道我开的条件呢。

original: Why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？

original: Wait, what happened to your caravan?
translation: 等等，你的商队怎么了？

original: {Frowns, sighs}Mojave happened - hit by raiders packing some heavy firepower. Can't believe the Crimson Caravan haven't heard.
translation: 这儿是莫哈维，还能怎样，被全副武装的掠夺者给劫了呗。不敢相信深红商队居然不知道这件事。

original: So if you want to buy all of Cassidy Caravans, you're looking at it - and what I got in my pockets. Still, as little as that is, not looking to sell.
translation: 所以，如果你想买下盖西迪商队，那你眼前的就是了，勉强再算上我口袋里那点东西。不过，哪怕就剩个壳子，我也不卖。

original: Crimson Caravan sent me, they want to buy out your caravan.
translation: 深红商队公司派我来的，他们想买下你的商队。

original: {Disbelief}They want to buy Cassidy Caravans? Don't they know it's burned to ash?
translation: {Disbelief}他们想买下盖西迪商队？他们不知道它早就被烧得精光了吗？

original: {Wary}No... even times being what they are, not sure I'm looking to sell, even for all the whiskey in Reno.
translation: 不……哪怕赶上好光景，我也不卖，就算用整个新里诺的威士忌和我换也不行。

original: Still, Jackson's not letting me out of his sight as long as there's still trouble up North.
translation: 只要北边的麻烦一刻不消停，杰克逊就一刻不会放我离开。

original: You settle things with him, help the others around here, too, I'll sign the paper if it means getting out of here.
translation: 你去帮他解决问题吧，顺便也帮帮其他人，如果这样能离开这儿，我就立马签字。

original: {Resolved, sigh}Walking the Mojave with you can't be any worse than here, that's for sure. All right, I'm in.
translation: 和你一起在莫哈维四处转转，总比呆在这儿强，这倒是实话。好吧，算我一个。

original: Now, onto settle accounts with Gloria Van Graff. Putting her down would suit me just fine.
translation: 现在，也该找格罗利亚·范格拉夫算算总账了。把她干掉对我来说是个不错的选择。

original: Might be a little tougher than the Crimson Caravan - Van Graffs are like a nest of rattlers, and the guns they've got are Brotherhood-caliber.
translation: 可能会有些难对付，毕竟范格拉夫家狡猾得很，他们的武器又都是从兄弟会里淘换来的。

original: Now, onto settle accounts with Alice McLafferty. Putting her down - that would suit me just fine.
translation: 现在，也该找爱丽丝·麦克拉弗蒂算算总账了。把她干掉对我来说是个不错的选择。

original: Can't wait to see the look on her face when I show up. She'll know why.
translation: 真想看看她见到我时会是什么表情，她一眼就会明白的。

original: Payback's a bitch, ladies, and between Gloria and Alice, that settles accounts, as far as I'm concerned.
translation: 出来混，迟早是要还的，姑娘们。不管格罗利亚还是爱丽丝，我只管这笔血债能有个说法。

original: Hope they're in hell right now, blinking, trying to figure out where they fucked up.
translation: 希望她们此刻正在地狱里，一边哭着鼻子一边琢磨自己究竟哪儿出了问题。

original: My point before? Is that you know the Mojave, and it's a hard place.
translation: 我不都说了？莫哈维就是这样，日子太难过了。

original: Hi, I'm Jean-Baptiste, and you're about to stop being a pain in my ass.
translation: 嗨，我是杰·巴普迪斯特，从今往后，你不必再当我的眼中钉了。

original: I've changed my mind. I'm not going to do it.
translation: 我改变主意了，我不想干了。

original: That's just fucking great. I knew you didn't have what it takes from the start, but would Glory listen to me? No.
translation: 真他妈棒啊，我从一开始就知道你干不成这事。但格罗莉会听我的吗？没可能。

original: Still, my sister has plans for you, so I'll cut you a break. You bring the girl here, and I'll take care of the fun part. That's fair, eh?
translation: 不过，我妹妹对你另有安排，所以这次我就放你一马。把那个女孩带来，剩下的部分就交给我来办。够公平了吧？

original: Whtttchumnn
translation: 怎……怎么……么了

original: When I mmmet you I thought you were thbiggst bitch.
translation: 我头……头次看到你，就觉得你是个……大……大婊子。

original: Awwww. Now ain't that sweet.
translation: 哦，瞧你都说的些什么啊。

original: I totally love you and your little hat.
translation: 我真的很喜欢你，还有你那顶小小的帽子。

original: I think... think my liver's trying to crawl out my ass.
translation: 我觉得……我的肝快要从屁股里爬出来了。

original: Yeah... well, feel a... a little dizzy.
translation: 嗯……嗯，感觉……有点晕。

original: You know you put up a good fight. I'm impressed.
translation: 你表现得真拼命。我佩服你。

original: Thing is, I really just wanted an excuse to drink - should last me for a while.
translation: 其实，我就是想找个借口喝几杯而已——至少这样能让我好受些。

original: Might just be the whiskey talking, but I think I might feel a whole lot better leaving the caravan business behind me...
translation: 你就当我说醉话吧，我觉得，如果把商队的事情抛到脑后，也许我会轻松许多……

original: Makes me a little teary-eyed, but now I've got a bottle to put 'em in. Hand over that paper, I'll put my name to it.
translation: 虽然会有些不舍，可我好歹能有个酒瓶子把它兜着。拿文件来吧，我这就签字。

original: Hmm? MmmMmmm.
translation: 嗯？嗯，嗯。

original: I flll fnnne.
translation: 我还~~~好。

original: <Laughs> All right, all right, you just hang on to the bar here... that's it.
translation: <大笑> 好吧，好吧，你就先呆在酒吧里吧……行了。

original: Didn't take you for the toughest courier in the West when you walked in, but you walked all the way to the Outpost, so at least you have guts.
translation: 我瞧你进来的时候，也没觉得你这邮差有多大本事。不过你起码是一路走到了前哨站，说明你还是有点胆量的。

original: Still feel a little parched.
translation: 我还是觉得有些燥热。

original: You want... want to drink more?
translation: 你还……还想再喝？

original: I feel great, actually. Another?
translation: 我觉得不错呀，再来一瓶？

original: Another?!
translation: 再来一瓶？

original: {Winding Down}No... no, I... you got me beat. I'm done, caravan's yours. Give me that paper, I'll... phew... put my name to it.
translation: {Winding Down}不……不行了，我……你行。我服了，商队是你的了。把文件给我，我要……要在上面撒尿……不……签字。

original: We haven't finished all the bottles yet.
translation: 我们还没喝完呢。

original: Uh... as long as we don't share the same bottle.
translation: 呃……只要咱们不喝同一个瓶子就好。

original: Wouldn't suggest otherwise.
translation: 我也没别的要求。

original: Be my guest.
translation: 你随意吧。

original: {Drunk out of her skull}Oh my fucking god... get away from me, all three... four of you, don't need your...
translation: 哦，去你妈的吧……离我远点……你们三个……四个，我不需要你们……

original: Oh god, I think I'm going to be sick, and you... you look fine.
translation: 哦，我的天，我怕是要不行了，你……你倒是面不改色啊。

original: {Surprised}Well, guess you're a little tougher than I thought... still, looks like you're feeling it, eh, slick?
translation: 好吧，看来你的酒量比我想象得要强一些嘛……不过，我猜你也已经有点撑不住了吧，嗯，老滑头？

original: You... you all right? You took a little spill there, one moment you're smiling, then...
translation: 你……你还好吧？你喝得有点多，前一秒还笑嘻嘻的，突然就……

original: Had some questions I wanted to ask you.
translation: 我有些问题要问你。

original: Just passing through.
translation: 只是路过。

original: Looking to join up with me again?
translation: 想再次与我同行吗？

original: Was reminded why I left this place soon as I walked in. {Nods}Let's go.
translation: 我刚一踏进这鬼地方，就想起我为啥要离开了。咱们走吧。

original: How about a drink instead?
translation: 不如先喝一杯？

original: "How about a drink?" How about a {emph}couple, is what you mean.
translation: "不如先喝一杯？"我看你的意思是，先干两杯吧？

original: Was looking for someone worth my time, I was mistaken.
translation: 我本来还以为是个有点本事的人呢，看来我是错了。

original: A sober woman might take insult at that. {Serious}Me, I might just bust you one.
translation: 这话要是说给一个清醒的女人听，她绝对会认为你在侮辱她。我呢，估计会直接揍你一拳。

original: If you ain't drinking, then leave. If you're making to see if I'm an easy lay, I got a caravan shotgun that'll cure that desire right quick.
translation: 不想喝，就走开。如果你把我当成一个随便的女人，我可以立马用我的商队霰弹枪好好治一治你的脑子。

original: Surprised you can see me from that deep in the bottle.
translation: 喝了这么多，还能看见我，真叫人惊讶。

original: Deep? {Laughs, then matter of fact}Ain't deep by half. Closed down the bar yesterday, going to close it again today - rinse and repeat.
translation: 喝多？还没到一半呢。昨天我就喝到酒吧打烊，估计今天又得如此了，周而复始。

original: Not yet.
translation: 还不行。

original: Well, let me know when it is.
translation: 好吧，到时候记得告诉我。

original: Neil told me about this town.
translation: 尼尔和我说了这个镇子的事。

original: {appreciative}Lot of the mutants here found out about Jacobstown because of Neil. {rueful}Our isolation works against us sometimes.
translation: 很多变种人都是因为尼尔才知道了这个地方。与世隔绝还是会带来一些弊端。

original: Can you teach me the Praetorian unarmed technique?
translation: 你能教我禁卫军的徒手搏击技巧吗？

original: {Bad rep with Legion}You have a poor reputation in the Legion. It wouldn't be acceptable for me to teach you anything right now.
translation: {Bad rep with Legion}你在军团臭名远扬，还指望我教你？

original: {Not enough Unarmed skill}[FAILED] I've watched you move, and I can tell you simply don't have the skill to learn the technique.
translation: [失败] 我仔细观察过你的动作，我就直说了吧，你现在还不是这块料。

original: [SUCCEEDED] Of course. This will take some time, and I'm not a forgiving teacher.
translation: [成功] 当然。只不过需要点时间，

original: I've noticed that you don't carry a gun.
translation: 我注意到你没带枪。

original: It's a tradition in the {pray-TORR-ians}Praetorians to specialize in unarmed combat because weapons can break or jam when needed most.
translation: 徒手搏击是禁卫军的传统，因为枪械极有可能在你最需要的时候出故障或者卡壳。

original: However, our unarmed techniques favor offense over defense. We can charge the enemy and flatten him with our first strike before he can react.
translation: 我们的搏击技巧更注重进攻，而非防守。我们能在敌人做出反应之前，就杀至跟前将其一击毙命。

original: Would Chet be willing to give us his supplies?
translation: 切特会愿意把他的补给送给我们？

original: {annoyed at Chet's selfishness}I don't think "give" is in Chet's vocabulary. Even with the town at stake, he'd still make you barter with him.
translation: {annoyed at Chet's selfishness}我觉得切特的字典里没有"送"这个字。即使镇子陷入危机，他想的还是怎么和你讨价还价。

original: What's with the soldiers?
translation: 这些士兵怎么了？

original: Not yet.
translation: 还不行。

original: Well, if you can help, I'd appreciate it. Need to get these caravans moving.
translation: 好吧，如果你能帮忙，我会十分感激。商队不能再堵在这了。

original: Haven't been to Nipton yet.
translation: 没去过尼普顿。

original: If there were any survivors, they're going to be in the Town Hall. If you can get inside, let me know if you find anyone.
translation: 如果还有幸存者的话，他们应该都躲进城镇大厅了，要是你能找到他们，务必告诉我。

original: The children here don't seem interested in guns.
translation: 这里的孩子看起来对枪没什么兴趣。

original: Few children are, especially when they are born during a relatively safe time in our history.
translation: 很少有孩子会喜欢枪，毕竟他们从小是在相对安全的环境中长大的。

original: Our children are protected from the outside world, but they are not ignorant of the dangers it holds.
translation: 虽然我们的孩子被保护得很好，但是他们并非对外面世界的危险一无所知。

original: I think I could improve your curriculum.
translation: 我想我能提高你们的课程水平。

original: Really, Outsider? I'm open to ideas.
translation: 真的吗，外来者？我很乐意听取各类意见。

original: Good to hear. The wasteland is no place for children.
translation: 很有道理。对孩子来说，废土不是个好地方。

original: I agree. That is why we do everything we can to teach the children from birth to defend themselves and serve the tribe.
translation: 我同意。所以我们自打小孩出生起，就在竭尽所能教他们如何自我保护，以及为族群服务。

original: What happens when they come of age?
translation: 他们长大后会怎样？

original: All of us are trained in combat and farming from a very early age. When we reach adulthood, we serve in whatever capacity we are best suited.
translation: 我们每个人从小都会接受战斗或务农方面的培训。成年后，我们就会去从事最适合我们的工作。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Bye.
translation: 拜。

original: I can spare 2.
translation: 我可以拿2个出来。

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: I can spare 4.
translation: 我可以拿4个出来。

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Actually. I can't spare anything right now.
translation: 我这儿已经没有多余的了。

original: That's too bad. I was hoping to melt some more down for machining.
translation: 太糟了。我还指望能再熔一点材料，好用来深加工。

original: I can spare 2 more.
translation: 我可以再给你2个。

original: I can spare 3 more.
translation: 我可以再给你3个。

original: Just take all of it.
translation: 全拿去吧。

original: Okay, I'll let you know if I find a pressure cooker.
translation: 好的，要是找到了压力锅，我会让你知道的。

original: Great, that's all I need to get the rebreather to work right. I don't think you'd want to start breathing water halfway down.
translation: 很好，只要有了这东西，我就能让呼吸器正常工作了。你也不希望下潜到一半就溺水吧。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: What do you have in mind?
translation: 你有什么想法？

original: That's a bit cryptic, Beatrix.
translation: 挺有神秘感的，比阿特克丽丝。

original: Hey, who doesn't enjoy a little pinch and squeal every once in a while?
translation: 嗨，谁会不喜欢偶尔来点云雨之事啊？

original: Sounds like you're a bit of a dom, Beatrix.
translation: 听起来你似乎有点施虐倾向啊，比阿特克丽丝。

original: You should know I've been helpful to the Followers, so come clean about White if you know something.
translation: 你应该知道我帮助过天启追随者，所以如果你知道真相，最好老实交代。

original: Some of the other Followers mentioned you. All right - the truth, then.
translation: 的确有些天启追随者成员提起过你。好吧，那我就告诉你真相吧。

original: I killed Corporal White to protect Westside's self-reliance. It was rash, and I regret it now.
translation: 为了保护西区的独立，我杀掉了怀特中士。这么做太过鲁莽，我现在后悔了。

original: We don't have the money to pay for the water, so I rigged the pump station to divert water to the local cisterns from time to time.
translation: 我们没有钱来支付水费，所以我时常会用些不正当的手段将泵站里的水引到本地的蓄水池里。

original: It was easy to figure out that the NCR water shortage points to you - save me some time, will you?
translation: NCR缺水明显是你干的，要查明真相很容易。咱们就别绕弯子了，行吗？

original: {PC Intelligence 6+}Fair enough. Since you seem to have pieced it together, I won't insult you by denying it any further.
translation: {PC Intelligence 6+}行吧。既然你都查出来了，我也没必要再否认了，免得侮辱你的智商。

original: I killed Corporal White to protect Westside's self-reliance. It was rash, and I regret it now.
translation: 为了保护西区的独立，我杀掉了怀特中士。这么做太过鲁莽，我现在后悔了。

original: We don't have the money to pay for the water, so I rigged the pump station to divert water to the local cisterns from time to time.
translation: 我们没有钱来支付水费，所以我时常会用些不正当的手段将泵站里的水引到本地的蓄水池里。

original: I thought you said I didn't have to kill her.
translation: 我记得你说过我用不着杀她的。

original: Yeah, if you brought her back here. Is she behind you or something? 'Cause I don't see her.
translation: 是的，如果你能把她带来，那当然不用。她现在就躲在你身后吗？我怎么没看见？

original: Now stop stalling, get out there, and do your fucking job already. Sheesh.
translation: 别再闲逛了，出去，赶紧干你妈的活去。真是。

original: Can we discuss this another time?
translation: 我们能换个时间再谈吗？

original: Sure, boss. Whenever's good for you - I've probably got three, maybe four months before I keel over.
translation: 当然，老大。时间随你挑——我可能还要3个月，也许4个月才会翘辫子。

original: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？

original: That Loyal guy. He's getting up there in years, but he still finds a way to make himself useful to his people.
translation: 那个叫罗亚尔的家伙。他一只脚都进棺材了，还依然在为人们尽心尽力。

original: If you ask me, that's better than withering away all alone, or holding on to some faded piece of glory from your past.
translation: 要我说，那可比独自一人黯然凋零，或者沉迷过去孤芳自赏，要强得多。

original: What is it about Ranger Andy that reminds you of yourself?
translation: 游骑兵安迪让你想起了自己？

original: Is that what you did?
translation: 你也干过这样的事？

original: Would it surprise you to know I used to be a gunslinging adventurer?
translation: 如果我说自己曾经是一个流浪枪手，你会不会有点吃惊？

original: We're not just talking about Ranger Andy, are we?
translation: 我们谈论的不止是游骑兵安迪吧？

original: Not really, boss, no.
translation: 确实不止，老大。

original: Why do you care so much, anyways?
translation: 你管那么多干嘛？

original: He reminds me of me in some ways.
translation: 某种程度上，他让我想起了自己。

original: It sounds like maybe you're talking about yourself there, Raul.
translation: 听上去你好像是在说自己，劳尔。

original: It's a question I've asked myself often enough.
translation: 这个问题我也经常问我自己。

original: Why do I get the impression this is more personal to you?
translation: 为什么我觉得，你说这话更多是出于个人感情因素啊？

original: I guess it reminds me of my own life.
translation: 估计是让我想起了自己的一生吧。

original: You're talking about the Great War? What do you remember about it?
translation: 你是说大战吗？你都记得什么？

original: It might seem harsh, but a soldier can't do his job properly with those limitations.
translation: 这话虽然很残酷，可既然身体条件已经这么差了，当兵也是累赘。

original: You're preaching to the choir here, boss. Once a man's prime is behind him, he should let it go.
translation: 所见略同啊，老大。人过了巅峰期，就应该服老。

original: With those injuries, he's nothing but a drain on resources. He should retire.
translation: 受了那么多的伤，他已经没用了，就是个吃闲饭的。他应该退伍。

original: That's what I love about you, boss; the pity you show for the less fortunate than you.
translation: 我就喜欢你这点，老大；对那些福分没你大的人，你总是这么不留情面。

original: The NCR put a lot of time and money into his training. He owes it to them to use it however he can.
translation: NCR在他身上花了大量的时间和金钱。他理应报效国家。

original: Even if he can't use them any more? Isn't that like asking you to come up with one of your brilliant schemes after suffering a crippling head wound?
translation: 哪怕他已经没多大能耐了？那岂不是就和你脑袋开花后，还要逼着你想出好点子一样吗？

original: Err, another one, I mean?
translation: 呃，我是说，又一个好点子？

original: I think it's good that he's so devoted to his duty. More people should act that way.
translation: 我觉得他忠于职守很好啊。应该有更多的人像他那样。

original: You think so, boss? Because I remember a time when a lot of people stuck to their duty no matter what.
translation: 你真这么想，老大？我记得以前，有很多人都会不顾一切地恪尽职守。

original: It ended with nuclear bombs falling on my hometown.
translation: 只是当核弹落到我家乡时，就再也没人那样做了。

original: I don't have time for your useless chatter.
translation: 我没时间和你闲扯。

original: Sure, boss. I know you've got a lot on your mind, what with all that wandering the empty desert wastes.
translation: 当然，老大。我知道你心事重重，毕竟在这空荡荡的沙漠上晃荡了这么久嘛。

original: Not now, Raul.
translation: 现在没空说话，劳尔。

original: Okay, boss. When you feel like availing yourself of my centuries of experience, you know where I'll be.
translation: 好吧，老大。等你觉得我那积攒了几个世纪的人生经验有用武之地的时候，再来找我也不迟。

original: Sure, what's on your mind?
translation: 当然，你在想什么？

original: Meeting Corporal Sterling, well... it kind of got me thinking.
translation: 遇到斯特林下士，哦…让我产生了一些想法。

original: Here's a guy that's been beat all to hell, right? I mean, he could have retired from the service, but instead he signs back on and does what he can.
translation: 这家伙真是倒霉到家了，对吗？我的意思是，他本来可以退休的，可他却还是选择留下来，发挥余热。

original: You think he did the right thing?
translation: 你觉得他这么做对吗？

original: You could come with me.
translation: 你可以和我一起走。

original: Go with you? {Thinking}And why the hell would I do that.
translation: 和你？我凭什么要和你走。

original: You got one too many by my count.
translation: 你身边已经有人了。

original: Fine - wasn't planning to share anyway.
translation: 好吧，我也没打算分给你。

original: Calm down. I had some questions.
translation: 冷静点。我还有些问题。

original: What's the problem?
translation: 怎么了？

original: My father had heart problems, and it ran down the family tree to me.
translation: 我爸心脏有问题，我也遗传了这个毛病。

original: Not looking to have my heart skip its last beat, even if I considered putting that junk in my system, which I don't.
translation: 就算我再不怎么爱惜自己的身体，我也不想让自己的心脏立马歇菜。

original: Just needed a little pick-me-up.
translation: 我就想提提神。

original: Well, keep it away from me, won't have anything to do with it.
translation: 好吧，那你还是离我远点，我可不想沾上这玩意。

original: Tell me about your Dad.
translation: 说说你老爸吧。

original: Where'd you get that pendant?
translation: 你从哪里弄来的这个坠饰？

original: Gift from my Dad, along with my name. {Wistful}Rose of Sharon Cassidy.
translation: 这是我爸留下的礼物，上面有我的名字——盖西迪·罗撒香。

original: Mom said he got the name out of some Old World book about dirt pilgrims. {Beat}Name sure sounds sweet, though.
translation: 老妈说他是从旧世界一本关于朝圣者的书里取的名字。这名字倒是挺好听的。

original: Anyway, pendant's a little rose. Originally thought it was one of Mom's tribal necklaces, but no, came from Dad.
translation: 不管怎么说，坠饰是朵小蔷薇。我本以为这是我妈部族里戴的项链，可它不是，居然是我爸的。

original: Any idea why he went East?
translation: 知道他为什么去了东部吗？

original: Not a clue. When he left, I was too in my crib to understand why, and around the time Mom passed, I was too into my teens to listen.
translation: 怎么知道。他走的时候我还在襁褓里呢。而我妈去世的时候，我年轻气盛，什么也听不进去。

original: Got his name, got this pendant, and that's about it.
translation: 我就知道他的名字，还有这个坠饰，也就这些了。

original: Tell me about your Dad.
translation: 说说你老爸吧。

original: Not much to tell. He ended up walking East one day when I was young and never came back. Not a family deserter like some, though.
translation: 没什么好说的。他在我小的时候就去了东部，再也没回来。不过，他和某些抛家弃子的家伙并不一样。

original: Mom died waiting for him, and she had me to raise. She was sick but she held off dying until I was old enough to be getting into trouble with boys.
translation: 我妈一直等他到去世，当时她还要养我。她身体不好，但还是硬把我拉扯大，等我长到了不再会被男生欺负的年纪，她才撒手人寰。

original: As for Dad, I figure he just got himself lost or dead. {Shrugs}Happens... and I'm not all boo-hoo about it, so save your glass for someone who's crying.
translation: 至于我爸，我就当他是死了或者失踪了。随便吧……我才不会为他哭鼻子呢。所以你还是省着点纸巾吧。

original: Your mother was a tribal?
translation: 你妈妈是部落民？

original: You know, like one of the tribes from the East - we got 'em out West, too. NCR's herding 'em up, though, domesticating them.
translation: 你懂的，就和东边那些部落一样，西边也有类似的族群。不过NCR正逐渐将他们整合到一起，试图同化他们。

original: Mom was from East of the Colorado, though, not sure what tribe. Was before the time Caesar rounded them up, made them Legion.
translation: 不过，我妈是从科罗拉多东边来的，不清楚是哪个部族。那时候凯撒还没俘虏他们，也没有组建军团。

original: She walked a hell of a way until she crossed paths with my Dad and he convinced her to stop walking. And lucky for me, he was a horny old bastard.
translation: 她走了很远的路，直到遇见了我爸才停下脚步。也算我走运，那男人就是个器大活好的老淫棍。

original: Any other weapons you know how to use?
translation: 你还会用其他什么武器吗？

original: What, you mean like spears? No, none of that. Mom was a tribal, but she didn't teach me anything like that.
translation: 你是说长矛之类的？不，不会。我妈虽然生在部落，但她从来没教我用过这类东西。

original: Never mind. Let's move on.
translation: 算了，我们走吧。

original: Sounds good to me.
translation: 我觉得挺好的。

original: I had some other questions.
translation: 我还有些别的疑问。

original: And where did you learn how to handle dynamite?
translation: 还有，你在哪里学的炸药？

original: You've used explosives?
translation: 你玩过炸药？

original: Dynamite's for when you don't have enough bullets, want to clear a pass, or scare off Geckos from a caravan.
translation: 炸药是留着没子弹的时候用的，也可以拿来用来清道，或是用来赶跑大蜥蜴。

original: Some of the twisters out of the Divide can block off a pass in no time, so you learn how to handle powder so you don't get trapped somewhere.
translation: 大峡谷外刮的龙卷风有时不消片刻就能把你堵在路上。如果你懂得如何倒腾炸药，就不至于被困死。

original: Any event, I prefer shooting if it comes down to an argument. Don't worry, I'll carry my weight if a disagreement arises.
translation: 任何事情，只要演变成吵架，我都宁愿用枪来解决问题。别担心，如果真的出现异议，我会担起责任的。

original: Where did you learn to shoot?
translation: 你在哪学的枪法？

original: Short of caps is what taught me, mostly. Ammo's expensive... so I learned to make every shot count.
translation: 其实，我的枪法都是没钱给磨出来的。子弹太贵了……所以我必须学会如何节约弹药。

original: And hear tell, my Dad was a crack shot, so I don't want to dirty the family name. Not out of pride - respect.
translation: 听说我父亲是个神枪手，所以我也不想坏了家族的名声。并非因为骄傲，而是尊严。

original: You any good in a fight?
translation: 你战斗方面怎么样？

original: I'm fair with chucking dynamite {rising smugness}and not bad with a pistol, if I do say so myself. {Beat, a little lower}Carry a knife, too, but that's more for practical reasons.
translation: 我对炸药还算在行。自我感觉的话，手枪也玩得不错。随身还带着匕首，不过那只是为了应付不时之需。

original: Prefer settling things with my fists, though. Made more friends than corpses in bar fights - plan on keeping it that way.
translation: 但我还是喜欢用拳头说话。酒吧里都是不打不相识，我也习惯了这种作风。

original: {Frowns, a little defensive}Don't think I'm some kind of Vault City pacifist, though - if things get heated, I'll start shooting, trust me.
translation: 不过别把我当成地下掩体市那些和平主义者，只要情况不对，我会立马开枪，相信我。

original: {narrating}After Hoover Dam, the leaderless Powder Gangers at the Correctional Facility vanished into the wastes, leaving the prison empty.
translation: {narrating}胡佛大坝战役结束后，群氓无首的炸药帮便消失在了废土上，只留下了一座空荡荡的监狱。

original: {narrating}The Correctional Facility became another abandoned ruin in the wasteland, its carcass occasionally picked over by enterprising prospectors.
translation: {narrating}劳教所很快就化为了废墟，偶尔会有大胆的拾荒者前来这里查探。

original: {narrating}With the Dam firmly in their grasp, the NCR turned its attention towards wresting the Correctional Facility from Powder Ganger hands.
translation: {narrating}NCR在牢牢控制了大坝后，便将注意力转向了被炸药帮占领的劳教所。

original: {narrating}The Powder Gangers are no match for the battle-hardened troops of the NCR, and summary execution awaited the Powder Gangers who managed to survive.
translation: {narrating}炸药帮在受过战争洗礼的NCR部队面前完全不堪一击，侥幸活下来的成员也被集体枪决。

original: {narrating}Most Powder Gangers at the Correctional Facility fled into the wasteland rather than face the advancing forces of the Legion.
translation: {narrating}大多数盘踞在监狱内的炸药帮成员宁可逃入废土，也不愿意直面来势汹汹的军团。

original: {narrating}Those brave or foolish to remain were killed or crucified by the merciless Legionaries.
translation: {narrating}有些不知是勇敢还是愚蠢的人选择了留下，但他们最后要么被无情残杀，要么就上了十字架。

original: {narrating}The NCR, battered by the loss of the Dam, were unable to devote any troops to retaking the Correctional Facility from the Powder Gangers.
translation: {narrating}在胡佛大坝一战中元气大伤的NCR已无力再派遣军队收复被炸药帮占领的劳教所。

original: {narrating}As a result, Powder Ganger raids on caravans became an unfortunate fact of life in the Mojave for years to come.
translation: {narrating}在之后的许多年间，往来莫哈维沙漠的商队都时常会遭到炸药帮的抢劫。

original: Ethel, darling!{Pause, as anger boils inside - wife just got killed} I'll... I'll join you soon again! Someone's gonna pay first, though.
translation: 埃塞尔，亲爱的！{Pause, as anger boils inside - wife just got killed}我……我马上就来陪你！但是，有人得先偿命！

original: Anyone stupid enough not to set a watch deserved what they got.
translation: 你们蠢到连个放哨的人都没有，活该。

original: {angry, but more tired}Maybe we made a mistake. It was early on, we didn't know just how serious it was out there.
translation: {angry，but more tired}我们也许是犯了错，那时候我们都还没意识到外面局势到底有多严重。

original: But to say they deserved it? What kind of devil are you, {sarcastic emphasis}boss?
translation: 可你说他们活该？你到底是不是人生父母养的，{sarcastic emphasis}老大？

original: You can't think it was your fault. No one could stand against a dozen armed men all alone.
translation: 别把这当成是自己的错。独自一人对付十几个拿枪的壮汉，换做谁都没有胜算的。

original: I know that, boss. That's not what I'm getting at. I'm just getting sentimental in my old age. Anyways, forget it. Just wanted that off my chest.
translation: 我知道，老大。我说的不是这件事。只不过我年岁一大，有些多愁善感罢了。不管怎样，忘了它吧。我只是想一吐为快。

original: And you blame yourself for this?
translation: 你为此感到自责吗？

original: Maybe. I don't know. All I know is that for all my skill with a pistol, I couldn't help them.
translation: 也许吧。我不知道。但我知道就算我的枪法再好，也救不了他们。

original: Anyway, that was weighing on my mind. Thanks for letting me get it out in the open, boss.
translation: 总之，这件事压在我的心头很久了。多谢你终于让我说出来了，老大。

original: What happened then?
translation: 之后发生了什么？

original: Rafaela and I ran. We were pursued by some of the men who attacked our home, but I was always a good shot.
translation: 拉法拉和我一路狂奔。有几个烧房子的人来追我们，可我的枪法向来不错。

original: The ones who came after us, I killed. The rest, I left be. I had to take care of Rafaela, not throw my life away on revenge.
translation: 追我们的人都被我杀了。其他的人我放走了。我还要照顾拉法拉，不能为了报仇而置性命于不顾。

original: What happened then?
translation: 之后发生了什么？

original: About two dozen men came back in the night, after we'd gone to sleep. They set fire to the ranch house and barred the doors from the outside.
translation: 大约二十几个人趁着夜里我们睡着的时候又回来了。他们放火烧了农场的房子，还把门从外面堵上了。

original: My whole family was trapped inside. I smelled the smoke and got myself and my little sister, Rafaela, out though a window, but everyone else....
translation: 我们一家人都被困在屋里。我闻到了烟味，于是带着我的小妹妹拉法拉爬出了窗户，可其他人……

original: My parents, my grandmother, my two brothers and two of my sisters all died.
translation: 我的父母、祖母、两个兄弟和两个姐妹，都死了。

original: Go on.
translation: 继续。

original: Just a few days after Mexico City was vaporized, refugees started pouring down the road to our ranch. We helped who we could, but there were so many.
translation: 就在墨西哥城毁于核弹的几天后，大批难民涌进了我们的农场。我们一直在努力帮助他们，可人实在太多了。

original: Eventually, my father started turning people away before we ran out of food. Things got violent. My father and I got our guns, and we drove them off.
translation: 终于，父亲开始驱逐那些人，因为我们的食物已经所剩无几。情况迅速恶化，我和父亲只好拿枪赶跑了那伙难民。

original: I don't really have time for this, Raul. Maybe later?
translation: 我真的没有时间，劳尔。以后再说吧？

original: Sure, boss. Whenever's good for you.
translation: 当然，老板，等你觉得合适了再谈。

original: Are you talking about something from your own past?
translation: 你是在说你自己的过去吗？

original: A memory from a long time ago.
translation: 那是很早以前的事了。

original: I suppose if you're happy with that kind of life, it's not so bad.
translation: 我认为，如果你乐意过那种生活，那还是不错的。

original: Maybe... but what if you miss the old days, sometimes?
translation: 也许吧……可万一哪天你怀念起了旧日时光呢？

original: Is that something you're afraid of?
translation: 你就害怕这种事？

original: That fear has always been a part of my life.
translation: 我一直生活在这样的恐惧中。

original: At least he knew when to step back and start to take it easy. A lot of people don't.
translation: 至少他知道何时退居二线，放下包袱。很多人却不知道。

original: Yeah, it beats dying alone in the Wasteland because you were too slow.
translation: 是的，至少比腿脚不利索死在废土上要强。

original: What's on your mind?
translation: 你有什么想法？

original: Old history, boss.
translation: 陈年老黄历了，老大。

original: Loyal's using his years of knowledge to help his tribe. I think that's a noble goal.
translation: 罗亚尔用他多年积累的经验帮助他的人民。我认为这很崇高。

original: {A little uncertain}Yeah. That's what I thought, too.
translation: {A little uncertain}是的。我也这么想。

original: Don't waste my time with your reminiscing, Raul.
translation: 别拿你那些陈年旧事来浪费我的时间，劳尔。

original: Whatever you say, boss. I'll just stay back here and be quiet in case you have a sudden flash of brilliance you need to share.
translation: 你说了算，老大。我就老实在这儿待着，等你灵光乍现的时候，我再来沾点光也不迟。

original: Already cleared the roads for Jackson.
translation: 我已经为杰克逊扫清了道路。

original: {Blinks}No shit? Drink's on me, then.
translation: 没骗人？那这杯我请了。

original: Still, not like I'm going anywhere. Caravan title's still keeping me here, even though it's dead and gone.
translation: 不过，我还是走不掉。商队的名号把我束缚在这里，哪怕它早就连根毛都不剩了。

original: That drinking's going to get you in trouble in a second.
translation: 再喝下去，你会惹麻烦的。

original: Trouble's already come and went, so anything {emph}you bring will make my next drink go down easier.
translation: 麻烦早就经历过了，所以不论不管你说什么，也只会让我喝得更痛快而已。

original: I'd slow down on that whiskey, if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会喝慢点，那样对身体好。

original: Yeah, well, you {emph}aren't me, so good-for-fucking-you.
translation: 没错，好吧，不过你{emph}不是我，所以去你妈的。

original: So you're out of the caravan business?
translation: 那么你不再跑商队了？

original: Sure am. Burned for the last time, and this time, it's for good. Worse, it's not done kicking me - I'm still {emph}trapped here.
translation: 当然，都被烧了个精光，这次算是彻底玩完了。更糟的是祸不单行，我还被困在这儿了。

original: What are you going to do?
translation: 你接下来想要干什么？

original: Drink. Got a lot of memories to drown. If I die while doing it, so be it. Got nowhere else to go.
translation: 喝酒呗，我想忘掉的事多着呢。如果我喝死了，那就死了吧。反正我也没地方可去。

original: Who's Jackson?
translation: 谁是杰克逊？

original: NCR officer, trooper, whatever - runs the place. He's over in the main building, the one {emph}without a bar.
translation: NCR军官，士兵，谁知道呢——总之这儿归他管。他就在主楼里，就是没有酒吧的那栋。

original: Jackson won't let me head north, it's not safe... and even though my caravan's gone, my caravan {emph}papers are keeping me here.
translation: 杰克逊不让我北上，说不安全…而且就算我的商队完蛋了，货单还在，我无法就这么一走了之。

original: So if you came here for work, {emph}my advice? Go find the Crimson Caravan branch, south of Vegas. {Bitter, emph}They can help you out.
translation: 所以，你要找工作的话，我建议你去维加斯南边找深红商队吧。他们会帮你的。

original: Might have been Fiends, they're crazy like that.
translation: 可能是恶魔帮的人干的，他们像是会做这种事的人。

original: Doesn't sound like raiders.
translation: 听着不像是掠夺者。

original: Why would they do that?
translation: 为什么他们要那样做？

original: My guess is Legion, they're trying to cut NCR's supply line... and the Mojave Outpost is proof. Got us locked up tighter than a New Vegas virgin.
translation: 我猜是军团干的，为了切断NCR的补给线……莫哈维前哨站就是证明。他们想把我们活活夹死，就像未开苞的处女一样。

original: No caravans in, out, and just {emph}try arguing with Jackson about it. "Roads aren't safe," he says.
translation: 商队被禁止进出，和杰克逊争辩也不会有结果。"道路不安全。"他就这一个说辞。

original: No shit, you washed-out old fuckup, I didn't need a Brotherhood Scribe to tell me that.
translation: 废话，不中用的老混蛋。我当然看得明白，这道理又不是只有兄弟会学士才懂。

original: Uh, how about you keep your hands by your sides.
translation: 嗯，您的手还是稍微老实点可以吗？

original: Don't worry, not looking to throw punches just yet. {Beat}And something tells me hitting you would be a mistake I wouldn't want to repeat.
translation: 别担心，我还没打算动粗呢。而且我有种感觉，揍你是不会有好结果的，我可不想再吃苦头。

original: Back West?
translation: 西部？

original: Yeah, if you couldn't tell, I'm not from around here and I'm not NCR. I run a caravan... or did.
translation: 是的，也许你没听出来，我其实不是本地人，也并非来自NCR。我是开商队的……或者曾经是。

original: What are you trying to forget?
translation: 你想忘记什么？

original: Lost my caravan heading north, the driver burned to ash - and they didn't even take the cargo, they just burned that, too.
translation: 去北部的途中我的商队没了，司机被烧成了灰。他们居然没抢货物，只是把它也一把火烧了。

original: Think we got off on the wrong foot. How about a drink?
translation: 看来出师不利啊。咱们来喝一杯？

original: Are you all right?
translation: 你还好吗？

original: All right? No, I'm not all right.
translation: 好？不，一点也不好。

original: Drinking to forget, and it's only getting me mad instead. Whiskey always gets my temper up - now more than ever.
translation: 本想着借酒浇愁，却只会让我更加愤怒。威士忌让我的脾气变得比以前更暴躁了。

original: Drinking used to cause all sorts of trouble back West - before I punched enough people, that is, and they learned to lay low when the whiskey hit.
translation: 以前在西部，喝酒总是会让我惹上各种麻烦，但自打我用拳头教训过不少人之后，人们看到我喝威士忌就不敢再放肆了。

original: Pendant?
translation: 坠饰？

original: Tell me about the pendant.
translation: 跟我说说这个坠饰。

original: Whiskey Rose?
translation: 威士忌玫瑰？

original: Yeah, on account of my name... and the blossoms on my cheeks when I drink too much.
translation: 不错，因为我的名字……也因为我喝多的时候，脸颊会红得像开花一样。

original: Won most of those fights, too. Can take a hell of a punch and give it right back when I've got a bottle in me.
translation: 打架基本都是我赢。只要一瓶酒下肚，我就能挨上很多拳，再反败为胜。

original: It's all in how you drink it, though - there's a trick to it. {Beat, nods}When we pass the bottle, I'll show you how it's done.
translation: 不过，就看你怎么喝了，这里头是有技巧的。等咱俩干杯的时候，我再秀给你看。

original: Is whiskey your drink of choice?
translation: 你最爱选的酒就是威士忌吗？

original: Not sure if I chose it or it chose me. {Beat}Dad ran a bar a long time ago, and it was a labor of love, Mom said. Didn't sound like it made her happy.
translation: 也不知是我选的它还是它选的我。老爸以前就是开酒吧的。我妈说他喜欢这一行当，可她似乎不怎么高兴。

original: Still, I'm guessing I got some of Dad's love of whiskey in me, because the burn suits me fine.
translation: 不过，我觉得我多少遗传了一些我爸酷爱威士忌的基因，因为那种口感真的让我很舒爽。

original: Used to call me "Whiskey Rose" back West, before I punched enough people, so now they say it, but quiet and when I'm not around.
translation: 在西部的时候，他们都管我叫"威士忌玫瑰"，后来我听见一次就火一次，现在他们只敢在我背后偷偷用这个名字了。

original: All right. Come on, let's go.
translation: 好吧。来吧，我们走。

original: {Relieved to be leaving}Thank god, the sooner the better.
translation: {Relieved to be leaving}感谢上帝，越快越好。

original: What's wrong?
translation: 这儿地方有啥不好？

original: {Sarcastic}Aside from the TV-faced robots, the dust, and the old man smell in every room? Nothing, it's a paradise.
translation: 除了头顶电视屏幕的机器人，满地的尘土，以及满房间的老男人味儿？是啊，这里简直就是天堂。

original: {Uneasy}This place has the Old World Blues about it. Everything in here feels like it should have passed on a long time ago.
translation: 用旧日情怀来形容这地方真是再恰当不过，这儿的每样东西都让人觉得恍若隔世。

original: Hell, it's hard to believe Vegas is right outside. So, yeah, I'm looking to leave whenever you're ready.
translation: 见鬼，真不敢相信维加斯就在附近。行吧，只要你准备好，我随时都能出发。

original: Stay here, you know exactly what's going to happen, day in, day out.
translation: 待在这里的话，你就能对一切了如指掌，每天都是一样的。

original: So fighting boredom is your argument, huh?
translation: 所以你的观点就是想办法打发时间？

original: Do you really want to stay in this shithole?
translation: 你真的想呆在这个狗屎地方吗？

original: {Player's got a point}Hnh. The Outpost lost its charm about three bottles ago, and that was just this morning.
translation: 哼。我才喝了三瓶，就已经觉得这地方无聊透顶。可只过了一个早上。

original: If your world's a whiskey bottle, there's more out there.
translation: 如果你的世界就是一瓶威士忌，那你应该知道，外面的世界还有更多。

original: {Sarcastic}Oh, that's got just the right bite of judgment to it, stings a little, too. {Beat}Did you hear that from a Followers preacher?
translation: 哦，这番说教倒是冠冕堂皇，还有点戳人痛处哩，你是从天启追随者那里听来的吗？

original: I bet you could preach all day, who knows what other little bits of wisdom might spill out.
translation: 我看你干脆就在这儿说上一整天得了，保不齐能有一两句真知灼见呢。

original: Why not? I could use someone who knows the roads.
translation: 为何不呢？我希望能找个认识路的家伙。

original: So you're looking for someone to help, not just tag along? Hnh.
translation: 那么你是真的想找个帮手，而不是跟屁虫咯？嚯。

original: Maybe it's not where you go, it's the company.
translation: 重要的并不是所选的路，重要的是同伴啊。

original: {Incredulous}"It's the company?" That has {emph}got to be the biggest load of Brahmin shit I've ever heard.
translation: 重要的是同伴？这可是我听过的最没用的屁话了。

original: Still, if you got more like that...
translation: 不过，你要是真这么觉得的话……

original: There's other places to go.
translation: 还有其他地方可以去啊。

original: {Irritated}Where? Like Vegas? Chewed and spit enough friends out. East? Get put in one of Caesar's little "camps?" No thanks.
translation: 去哪儿？新维加斯？已经有够多朋友被坑死在那儿了。东部？被凯撒拖进营帐里关起来？不，谢了。

original: Head back West? I already know the Big Circle and everyone in it - 'cept now I go back there, ruined.
translation: 回西部？我已经在这儿的圈子里积攒了好些人脉，要是现在回去，岂不是全白搭了。

original: {Thinking}Never really realized how small the Mojave's getting nowadays, hard to find a place to go to that's worthwhile.
translation: 真没想到现如今的莫哈维是越来越小了，要找个能待的地方竟然这么难。

original: That's... one way to put it.
translation: 这……说法倒是新奇。

original: Didn't ask Mom to elaborate. Never heard her complain about his bedroom behavior, only complain he wasn't around to do it no more.
translation: 我没向老妈咨询过，也从没听过她抱怨他在床上的举动，倒是他一走，她反倒觉得空虚寂寞。

original: I've met him. Nice impersonation.
translation: 我见过他了。穿着不错。

original: Yeah, he's been with NCR so long all he can see is the worst outcome of everything - so he doesn't do anything.
translation: 对，他在NCR太久了，见识过无数惨剧——所以他才会变得如此麻木。

original: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
translation: 你可以和我说说有关这座前哨站的事情吗？

original: You're looking at it. It's a watering hole without much to brag about.
translation: 正如你所见，这儿就是个臭水坑，没什么值得炫耀的地方。

original: It's like a Brahmin drive gone wrong - supposed to be a gate north, but you come here, you get caught in the pen. Better to head back home.
translation: 感觉像走错了方向似的，原本应该是通往北部的门户，可你一到这儿，就会立马掉进坑里。我看还是回家得了。

original: If you don't have a gun and a will, don't matter much what you do when you reach here, except stare at that fucking monument outside.
translation: 如果你手上没枪，也没什么志气，那你到这儿来，除了盯着外面那个破纪念碑看，也就没什么可做的了。

original: That fucking monument outside?
translation: 破纪念碑？

original: Don't even tell me you missed it coming in. It's like NCR showing its dick to all the East.
translation: 别跟我说你没看见它。那玩意就像是NCR把自己的鸡巴亮出来给整个东部看。

original: If the Republic put as much effort into protecting the East as they put into those two asinine giants outside, then they'd be {emph}worth that monument.
translation: 如果共和国能把建造这两个傻大个的精力用在保护东部的领土上，那他们才算配得上这座纪念碑。

original: {Shakes head}Statues of two men shaking hands covered in blood don't seem to be nothing to brag about.
translation: 那两座雕像也只是在用握手掩盖掌心的鲜血罢了，没什么可吹牛的。

original: Covered in blood?
translation: 掩盖鲜血？

original: {Slight exasperation}I'm speaking figurative, isn't any blood on their damn hands. {Beat, to herself, serious}Course, when Caesar comes walking through here, there'll be blood for real.
translation: {Slight exasperation}打个比方而已，并不是上面真的沾了血。当然，要是凯撒来了，那是必然会流血的。

original: And after the blood dries in the sun, he'll melt that piece of Jet-induced sculpture down, and reshape it into a bull.
translation: 等血干了以后，他就会把这座磕了药似的塑像融掉，将它重新雕成一头公牛。

original: Which by my reckoning is making up for a deficiency of his. But no matter what the state of his pecker, he's sure giving the West a good fucking.
translation: 依我看，那也是为了掩盖他的生理缺陷。但无论他的老二够不够硬，他都肯定会狠狠地操西部一番。

original: What are those statues supposed to be?
translation: 那两座雕像是什么意思？

original: {Irritated, doesn't much care}One's a ranger, one's an NCR trooper, supposed to represent unification of West and East... or some such shit.
translation: 一个是游骑兵，一个是NCR的士兵，可能是代表东西统一吧……反正差不多是这意思。

original: As far as those two iron lovebirds go, they've got more spine than you'll see in a year from the NCR government.
translation: 不管这两只铁皮比翼鸟恩爱几何，至少他们都比你在NCR政府里看的那些人要有骨气得多。

original: What did you mean about "covered in blood" before?
translation: 你之前说的"掩盖鲜血"是什么意思？

original: Why are you here at the bar?
translation: 你为什么会在酒吧里？

original: Whiskey and me are old friends, keeps me going when times get rough. Like now.
translation: 我和威士忌是老朋友了，他帮我度过了许多次难关。比如这次。

original: Got me into the caravan business, you know - had to start transporting water instead of liquor, though.
translation: 会做商队买卖也是拜它所赐，不过后来我就发现自己做不了酒类生意，只能改运淡水。

original: If I hadn't switched over, I'd end my trip with nothing but glass bottles rattling on the back of the Brahmin.
translation: 如果不改行的话，那我最后肯定会一无所有地醉倒在双头牛背上，旁边还吊着几个叮当作响的空酒瓶子。

original: Any work around here?
translation: 这附近有什么工作吗？

original: If you're looking to sign on with a caravan, no - traders are bottled up tight here.
translation: 如果你想进商队找差事，那还是算了，商人们全都被困在这里了。

original: Caravan work's up north, check with the Crimson Caravan, maybe. Gun Runners might have work, wouldn't know for sure, though.
translation: 商队的活计大多在北边，也许你可以去深红商队那儿看看。军火走私商可能也有活干，但我不确定。

original: Still, if you got a gun, guts, and feeling like going on patrol, might be some of the soldiers around here have work for you.
translation: 不过，如果你有枪，有胆量，愿意去巡逻的话，这儿的士兵应该也有事给你做。

original: [NCR] I think they're both rangers, one desert, one NCR.
translation: [NCR]我想他们都是游骑兵，同一个沙漠，同一个NCR。

original: Hnh. Maybe you're right. Brimmed hats always throw me off.
translation: 嗯。也许你是对的。反正看见宽边帽就让我觉得不爽。

original: Well, fine, whatever, they can be shaking each other's dicks, wouldn't change the Mojave now.
translation: 随便啦，他们爱互相握鸡巴就握去吧，反正也改变不了莫哈维的现状。

original: Running and gunning sounds interesting.
translation: 边跑边打听起来挺有意思的。

original: Jackson might have something for you, if you haven't already spoken to that old buzzard.
translation: 杰克逊似乎有话要和你说，不知你去见过那老混账没有。

original: He was looking to try and get troops to clear the north road. You can find him over in the other building - the one without a bar.
translation: 他正在想办法清理北边的道路。你可以在另一栋建筑里找到它，就是没酒吧的那栋。

original: Any other work?
translation: 还有其他工作吗？

original: I don't know, seems to be a lot of attention on Nipton. Word is, one of the snipers in the nest on the roof spotted smoke from the East.
translation: 不知道，最近大家似乎都在关注尼普顿。据说屋顶上的狙击手发现东边冒起了黑烟。

original: Sniper on the roof?
translation: 屋顶上的狙击手？

original: Yeah, her name's... Ghost or something... {mocking}fucking scary, ooooooh. {Sarcastic}Guess it's cause you'll never see her 'til your dead.
translation: 没错，她叫……幽灵还是什么的，反正特吓人。哦。估计是因为只有死掉的人才能看见她。

original: NCR and their goddamn nicknames, as if Caesar himself's gonna piss and run if he hears them.
translation: NCR的人就喜欢起些狗屁外号，好像凯撒一听见这些名字就会吓得屁滚尿流似的。

original: Anyway, go on and head up top, ask her what's going on, if you haven't already. I don't much give a shit.
translation: 总之，如果你有兴趣，可以去屋顶上问问她到底是怎么回事。反正我是不在乎。

original: Any other work?
translation: 还有其他什么工作么？

original: Um, I should probably go.
translation: 呃，我大概得走了。

original: I'll just wait here for Mistress Tabitha.
translation: 我会继续在这儿等待塔比瑟女士。

original: I hate to tell you, but Tabitha's dead.
translation: 虽然我不想告诉你，可塔比瑟已经死了。

original: And I suppose you're taking credit for the deed, fiend! I will avenge her!
translation: 我看你似乎还挺得意的啊，恶棍！我会为她报仇的！

original: Yes, Rhonda.
translation: 是的，朗达。

original: Mistress Tabitha, we should be heading off. Our journey has been much delayed, but we can catch up if we hurry.  Come along, now.
translation: 塔比瑟夫人，我们应该即刻动身。行程已经被严重耽搁了，但如果我们抓紧时间，应该还来得及。现在请跟我来。

original: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。

original: It's just... such a shock to see Rhonda up and about again. I'm not sure what to do now.
translation: 就觉得……能再次见到它，实在太令我震惊了。我真的不知道该怎么办了。

original: It is, Mistress Tabitha. How I've missed you so. This stranger here fixed me up right as rain. Is he a friend of yours?
translation: 是的，塔比瑟夫人，我十分想念您。这位陌生人完全修好了我。他是您的朋友吗？

original: It is, Mistress Tabitha. How I've missed you so. This stranger here fixed me up right as rain. Is she a friend of yours?
translation: 是的，塔比瑟夫人，我十分想念您。这位陌生人完全修好了我。她是您的朋友吗？

original: {Tabitha}R-Rhonda? Is that you?
translation: {Tabitha}朗，朗达？是你吗？

original: Does this mean you're not going to kill me?
translation: 所以你不会杀了我咯？

original: {Laughs}No, of course not. I... don't know what I'm going to do now with Rhonda back...
translation: {Laughs}不，当然不。我……我都不知道朗达回来后我该做什么……

original: Well, in the meantime, he's given me a suite at the Lucky 38.
translation: 好吧，其实他还赏了我一套单间，就在幸运38。

original: Does it come with its own Deathclaw? Trust me, if you can't see it, something just as nasty's waiting.
translation: 是不是还附赠了一只死亡爪？相信我，要是你不能亲眼所见，就说明这其中一定有鬼。

original: Whole Lucky 38... the idea that there's this casino in the middle of a town of people, and only you're ever let inside?
translation: 整个幸运38……坐落在一个如此繁华的城镇中央，而只允许你一个人进去？

original: {To herself}Feels like other places I've been. Something that isolated from everyday folks starts to take on a bad shine.
translation: {To herself}感觉和我去的其他地方差不多。都是人迹罕至，还有一种莫名的吸引力。

original: Didn't introduce himself, wore a bad suit.
translation: 没说他是谁，穿着个破烂西服。

original: Bad suit, huh? Well, if assholes had taste, we'd all be feasting on shit.
translation: 破烂西服？好吧，要是连混蛋都有品位，那我们还不如去吃屎呢。

original: Still... suit means money, and suits stand out, especially here in the Mojave. One of the larger towns, or Vegas, might be the place to go.
translation: 依我看……西服至少说明他有钱，而且西服也很显眼，尤其在莫哈维。你可以去那些大一点的城镇，或者维加斯找找看。

original: {Cold}Don't you worry, though, we'll sort this asshole out, rattle his cage a little.
translation: 不过别担心，我们会把这个混蛋揪出来的，决不能让他有喘气的机会。

original: Benny, wore a checkered suit.
translation: 本尼，穿着花格子西服。

original: {Frowns}Can't say I've heard the name. Or heard about any man dressed like a seat cover.
translation: 我应该没听过这个名字。也没听说有谁穿得像个沙发套似的。

original: I don't think it was personal.
translation: 我觉得这不是个人恩怨。

original: {Slight incredulous that the player would be dismissive of being shot}Well if it wasn't before, it is now.
translation: 如果之前不是，那么现在是了。

original: Did he bother to introduce himself, or did he not take you for somebody who'd get up again when killed?
translation: 他有自我介绍过吗？还是没把你当成那种死了又会爬起来的奇人？

original: He wanted something I was carrying.
translation: 他想要得到我身上的某样东西。

original: So he robbed you? Robbing a courier's low, and any family or group he's with is going to get a black eye for it.
translation: 所以他就抢劫你？劫邮差真是下作，无论他是哪个组织的人，都该好好教训他一顿才是。

original: Caravan code of the wastes is you don't fuck with the one who brings you your mail, and you don't fuck with your supply line.
translation: 商队的荒野生存守则之一，就是绝不能对送信的人下手，否则等于掐断自己的财路。

original: Hope this shithead knows what he's in for. From both of us... what's his name?
translation: 希望这个渣滓知道自己干了什么好事。咱俩迟早要给他点厉害……他叫什么名字？

original: A doctor helped patch me up.
translation: 一个医生帮我缝的伤口。

original: Two shots in the head without an Auto-Doc is a lot of patching. Hope you thanked him properly.
translation: 脑袋中了两枪，又没有自动医生，还能治好真是不容易。但愿你有好好答谢他。

original: Who's this snake that put bullets in your head? Did he have cause, or...?
translation: 是谁这么狠，朝你脑门开枪？你和他有过节吗，还是……？

original: Twice. In the head.
translation: 两枪，都打在脑袋上。

original: {Echoing}And you got better.
translation: 那你倒是越挫越勇了啊。

original: Don't really want to talk about it.
translation: 我不想谈这件事。

original: Fine, then, not trying to pry. Just wondering what would make a Courier run around the desert without a contract is all. Forget I asked.
translation: 好吧，我也不是故意要试探你。只是好奇为啥一个邮差会闲着没事在沙漠里满地跑。当我没问好了。

original: Looking for a man who shot me.
translation: 为了找一个开枪打我的人。

original: {Echoing}A man who shot you.
translation: {Echoing}开枪打你的人。

original: Not exciting enough for you?
translation: 对你来说不够刺激？

original: It ain't so bad. If Caesar's Legion decides to push West through Nipton ol' Mojave Outpost here will be the front line.
translation: 倒也没那么糟，如果凯撒军团决定绕过尼普顿向西进军的话，这个哨站还是会变成前线的。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: {Surprised a bit that someone would care to ask}Me, I'm Knight - Major Knight. I've been stuck here dealing with these caravans for ages now, but somebody's gotta do it.
translation: 我，我是奈特——奈特少校，我奉命在这里接待商队，我不是很喜欢这个差事，但总得有人来做。

original: Can you tell me about the Outpost?
translation: 能和我谈谈这个哨站吗？

original: NCR border guard duty mostly. It's our job to make sure the caravans can move safely along I-15 and Highway 95.
translation: 这儿的作用基本上就是保卫NCR的边疆。我们的任务是确保商队能够安全地通过15号州际公路和95号高速公路。

original: Not the best posting or assignment, but it beats being sent East, or patrolling the Colorado. Legion's pretty thick there.
translation: 算不上美差，但总比被派到东边或科罗拉多巡逻好。那些地方军团的势力都很猖獗。

original: I changed my mind. This is something we should confront together.
translation: 我改主意了。这件事我们要共同面对。

original: No. This is something for {emph}me to deal with. But I'm glad you're here.
translation: 不。这是{emph}我的私事。但我很高兴你能在这里。

original: I've heard enough. Let's move on.
translation: 好了。接着走吧。

original: All right, then.
translation: 好吧，那。

original: I wanted to ask you some questions.
translation: 我想要问你一些问题。

original: {Companion Questions}I had other questions.
translation: {Companion Questions}我还有疑问。

original: I wanted to ask you something else.
translation: 我想问些别的事情。

original: I guess this is goodbye, then.
translation: 看来我们只好说再见了。

original: Can we talk about this?
translation: 我们能谈谈吗？

original: Fuck that. You can walk the road to hell on your own.
translation: 去你的吧。你要下地狱没人拦你。

original: Come on, I can change, really.
translation: 真的，我能改，真的。

original: Look, the Mojave's a tough place, all right?
translation: 听着，莫哈维的环境太险恶了，好吗？

original: You need to be tougher. If you let the Mojave get you down, then you've given up on life.
translation: 那你就必须变得更强，要是被莫哈维打倒了，那你就真的没活路了。

original: So straighten out, stop being so shifty and... {struggles to find the words for the player's evil}downright mean, and see if that doesn't change your outlook.
translation: 所以直接点，别这么优柔寡断……也别再成天一肚子坏水了，看看这样你会不会有所改观。

original: I'm trying to do better... really trying.
translation: 我真的想做的更好……真的努力了。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitating}All right... maybe I was a little harsh. I can be that way.
translation: [成功] {Hesitating}好吧……可能我有点太严厉。我可以网开一面。

original: I've made mistakes. You judging me doesn't help.
translation: 我错了。但你这样也于事无补。

original: [FAILED] Trying's the same thing as giving up, the way you're saying it.
translation: [失败] 听你说话的口气，我看就算再努力也注定会失败。
