original: <Lie> I heard you, I did. I've changed... inside.
translation: <撒谎> 我听了你的话，真的。我已经改了……从内心。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitating}I'll hold you to that promise, then. I'm not known for my patience, though.
translation: [成功] {Hesitating}我就信你一回，但我不清楚我还有多少耐心。

original: <Lie> I'll change Cass, I promise.
translation: <撒谎>我会改的，我保证。

original: [FAILED] {Scoffs}Inside? Yeah, must be deep inside, all right.
translation: [失败] {Scoffs}内心？是啊，是够内心的，好吧。

original: I'm... not proud of what I've done. I'm trying to change, really.
translation: 我……我也并不觉得我做的事有多光彩，我一直在试着改变，真的。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitating}Well... all right. I'll stick around for a little while longer, but if you get out of line again...
translation: [成功] {Hesitating}好吧……好吧。我会再多呆一会，但是如果你再越过底线的话……

original: Tough words, but I needed to hear them. I'll change, I promise.
translation: 忠言逆耳利于行。我会改正的，我保证。

original: [FAILED] That's your excuse?
translation: [失败] 这就是你的借口？

original: <Lie> Look... I'm trying to change, life's tough.
translation: <撒谎>你看……我也尝试着去改变啊，生活不容易啊。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {Hesitating}Well... all right. I'll stick around for a little while longer, but if you get out of line again...
translation: [成功] {Hesitating}好吧……好吧。我会再多呆一会，但是如果你再越过底线的话……

original: <Lie> The Mojave's a hard place. But I need to rise above that.
translation: <撒谎>莫哈维充满了艰辛，但是我需要去克服这一切。

original: [FAILED] That's your excuse?
translation: [失败] 这就是你的借口？

original: <Attack>That's it. Tired of listening to you anyway.
translation: <攻击>够了。我听厌了。

original: {Surprised}You're seriously going to draw on me? Fine, do it, see what happens.
translation: {Surprised}你真的要来找我麻烦？好吧，来吧，看看会有什么后果。

original: Life means we have to make tough choices - me included.
translation: 要生活，就意味着我们必须做出艰难的抉择，我也一样。

original: Who you are comes from the choices you make when life {emph}gets tough.
translation: 正是你所做出的这些艰难抉择，造就了你这个人。

original: So if you're saying that life is dragging you down, I don't buy it. You better start changing your attitude, or I'm heading back West, you hear?
translation: 所以如果你说是生活把你逼上绝路的，我才不买帐。你最好改变一下人生态度，不然我就回西部去了，明白吗？

original: Good, go back to your famil... oh wait, they're fucking dead.
translation: 好吧，那就回去找你的家人……哦，等等，他们早他妈死了。

original: {Cold}You son of a bitch. {Beat}You know, I was just going to give you a piece of my mind and now? Now I'm going to put you down.
translation: 你这个狗娘养的。你知道吗，刚才我只是想说你两句，现在，我要打得你再也爬不起来。

original: Go back West, then, see if I care.
translation: 那你回西部去吧，我才不管呢。

original: Fine, I will, jackass.
translation: 好了，我走了，混蛋。

original: You can have your shit back, I don't need it or want it. You go your way, I'm going mine.
translation: 你可以把你的垃圾全都拿回去，反正我不想要。从今往后，你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥。

original: And don't try looking for me - it was a mistake to show up in the Mojave in the first place, and I'm not about to repeat that mistake twice.
translation: 你也别指望能找到我——我来莫哈维从一开始就是个错误。我不会再犯第二次了。

original: <Barter Options>
translation: <交易选项>

original: [SUCCEEDED] I see the wisdom in that. I'll radio for a unit to head up to Primm and offer some additional support.
translation: [成功] 言之有理，我会派一支部队去普瑞姆，并且给那边提供一点额外的补给。

original: Having Primm - and the trade route - under NCR control would help the West.
translation: 将普瑞姆及附近的商路都控制在NCR手上，对西边会比较有利。

original: [FAILED] {Player just said something stupid}NCR is not in the habit of buying and selling towns... unless that was some sort of joke on your part.
translation: [失败] 让NCR出卖城镇……我看你是在开玩笑吧。

original: If the NCR runs Primm... I bet you could sell it to... someone... somewhere.
translation: 如果NCR控制了普瑞姆……我觉得你可以把它高价卖给什么人……总会有人愿意出价的。

original: One of the convicts from NCRCF is looking for a pardon so he can protect Primm.
translation: NCR监狱里有一个犯人希望能得到特赦，这样他就可以保护普瑞姆了。

original: {Disbelief}One of the Powder Gangers? {Slight anger, they're like terrorists}They've been nothing but trouble for us - why would we want one of them anywhere in an official capacity?
translation: 炸药帮的人？他们除了会惹麻烦一点用都没有——我们凭什么要找他们的人当警长？

original: Hayes is undermanned and is requesting some additional support.
translation: 海耶斯现在人手不足，需要一些增援。

original: {Frowns}I'd like to help - {beat, hates this}but we can't spare any more units. {Reciting the official line, even though he hates it}We have to maintain a minimum headcount at the Outpost, orders from the West.
translation: 我是很想帮忙——但我这里也抽不出人来。我们必须在哨站里驻扎足够的人手，这是西边的命令。

original: I'd like to talk to you about Primm.
translation: 我想和你谈谈普瑞姆的事。

original: {Slight surprise}Primm? {Recalling to himself}Hayes' unit is stationed up there, were having problems with some of the NCRCF convicts. What can I help you with?
translation: 普瑞姆？海耶斯的部队驻扎在那里，他们正和NCR监狱的犯人们对峙呢，有什么我能帮你的吗？

original: Do you know where I can find the courier office?
translation: 你知道哪儿可以找到邮局吗？

original: Sure do. I run the courier office out of my shop. Leastaways I did before things went to hell around here.
translation: 当然，我自己在店外就开了个邮递处，至少在小镇乱成一锅粥以前，我就已经在做这份营生了。

original: What do you need to take over protecting the town?
translation: 要接管这座城镇你还需要些什么？

original: What we need, more than anything, is bodies.
translation: 我们最需要的是人手。

original: If we had just one more squad, we could easily install a sheriff and still handle our primary objective of protecting the interstate south of here.
translation: 如果我们能再有一小队人马，那在任命警长的同时，我们也能腾出手来继续保护南面公路的安全。

original: If you'd like to see the NCR include protection of Primm in its duties, then you'll have to get some more troops up here.
translation: 如果你想让NCR兼顾普瑞姆的防务，那就得再为我找些部队来。

original: Knight, at Mojave outpost, may be able to help.
translation: 莫哈维前哨站的奈特也许可以帮上忙。

original: That's it for now.
translation: 就这样吧。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I have some other questions.
translation: 我有一些别的问题。

original: I have some free time, ask away.
translation: 我现在有空，问吧。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: {warning}Yeah, forget about it.
translation: {warning}是的，当我没说。

original: < Speech 20 >
[SUCCEEDED] {listing his crimes}Robbed some people, burned some things, killed a few guys.
translation: [成功] {listing his crimes}抢了些人，烧了些东西，杀了几个家伙。

original: I just need to know if I should watch my step around you.
translation: 我只是想知道该不该提防你。

original: [FAILED] Like I said, mind your own damn business.
translation: [失败] 我说了，管好你自己的事就行。

original: I was just curious.
translation: 我就是好奇而已。

original: What were you in prison for?
translation: 你为什么会进监狱？

original: None of your damn business. You ought to know better than to ask a man that kind of question.
translation: 关你鸟事。你应该明白最好不要问别人这种问题。

original: This area is your territory?
translation: 这一带是你的地盘？

original: {pride}It is now. Me and the rest of the guys busted out of the NCR prison east of here and took over. Now we're calling the shots.
translation: {pride}现在是了。我和手下们逃出了NCR在东边的监狱，然后占领了这里。这地方现在我们是说了算。

original: You were a prospector - like digging for gold and silver?
translation: 你以前是淘金客——就是到处挖宝贝的那种？

original: Nah, nah - means I poked through old buildings looking for working tech and such. Some folks just call it "salvaging," but never liked the term.
translation: 不，不——我主要在老房子里转悠，看看有没有还能用的科技产品之类的。有人管这行当叫"捡垃圾，"但我是从来没喜欢过这个叫法。

original: Way I see it, salvage means it's broken, near-worthless. Me, I looked for the good stuff - guns, chems, spare parts. Good money in it.
translation: 在我看来，捡垃圾就意味着我找到的都是些坏掉的、没价值的东西。而我，我找的都是好东西——枪械，药，零件。都是值钱货。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Yup.
translation: 是。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: {WAH-lay}Vale.
translation: {WAH-lay}再见。

original: So what did you do?
translation: 然后你做了什么？

original: I left Mexico City behind. I made my way out to the Gulf Coast, eventually I found an old Petro-Chico refinery nobody had claimed.
translation: 我离开了墨西哥城，来到了湾岸，最后找到了一间老佩特罗-奇科炼油厂，那里空无一人。

original: I stayed there for a little while, and I thought a lot about my life. I thought about the guns I'd lived by and what they'd gotten me.
translation: 我在那儿待了一阵，思考人生。想着自己赖以生存的宝贝手枪，以及它们带给我的一切。

original: I decided my guns hadn't gotten me anything, and it was time to give it up. I took off that old vaquero outfit, and put on a Petro-Chico jumpsuit.
translation: 我得出结论，我的枪没有给我带来任何东西，是该抛弃这样的生活了。于是我脱下了那套牧马人套装，换上了炼油厂的连身衣。

original: The name tag said "Miguel," so I started using the name myself. Eventually I made it to Arizona... but that's another story, boss.
translation: 衣服的名牌上写着"米格尔"，我便开始用那个名字称呼自己。最后，我来到了亚利桑那……不过那就是另一个故事了，老大。

original: That's terrible, Raul.
translation: 那太可怕了，劳尔。

original: Terrible doesn't begin to cover it, boss. I'd let my whole family down - first the ranch, now Rafaela. I was the last Tejada.
translation: 可怕这个词不足以形容当时的情形，老大。我辜负了整个家族——先是农场，然后是拉法拉。我成了特哈达家的最后一员。

original: I guess maybe I went a little crazy then. I took my guns, and I went back to that market. I didn't have many bullets, but I had enough.
translation: 估计当时我已经有些疯了。我拿起枪，回到市场，我的子弹不多，但也够用了。

original: After the raiders were dead, I salvaged what I could from the store. I was tired... I just wanted to be alone forever.
translation: 那些掠夺者死后，我拿走了店里所有能拿走的东西。我感到身心俱疲……只想找个地方孤独终老。

original: Go on. What happened to Rafaela?
translation: 继续说啊。拉法拉怎么了？

original: She went out to find some food one day. {digressing, maybe justifying to himself a little}I was sick, so I stayed at our camp. I guess it must have been the beginnings of radiation poisoning.
translation: 有一天，她出去找吃的。{digressing，maybe justifying to himself a little}我病了，所以留在了营地。我估计当时辐射已经开始侵蚀我的身体了。

original: Anyway, it was supposed to be safe, but some raiders happened to pass through where she was scavenging. I won't speak of what they did to her.
translation: 总之，本来一切太平的，可就在她拾荒的时候，正好有几个掠夺者路过。我不想描述接下来她遭遇的事情。

original: When I found her body, the only way to recognize her was this funny little scar on her knee from when she was a little girl.
translation: 当我找到她尸体的时候，唯一能辨认出的，只有她小时候膝盖受伤后留下的伤疤。

original: Wasn't it dangerous to be dressed so... noticably?
translation: 穿得这么……引人注目，不会很危险吗？

original: It was. I started to build up a legend. Sometimes it headed off trouble, but most of the time it just started more.
translation: 当然。我渐渐成了传奇人物。虽然这名头能为我省下不少麻烦，但大多时候，它只会带来更多麻烦。

original: Young punks looking to prove themselves would come looking for me, but my eyes were sharp and my guns were quick.
translation: 那些想要扬名立万的小流氓都喜欢来找我，不过那时我眼神好，枪也快。

original: For a whle it seemed like we might even survive there, until... until Rafaela.
translation: 有段时间，我以为我们总算能过个安稳日子了，可……可拉法拉却…

original: Sounds pretty bad.
translation: 听起来相当不妙。

original: You're a poet of understatement, boss. But there were moments it was almost worth it. I still remember finding that novelty costume shop.
translation: 您还真是善于轻描淡写啊，老大。不过有些时候确实该这样，我还记得自己刚找到那间漂亮服装店时的情形。

original: I was just looking for something I could slice up to wrap my burns when I saw the vaquero outfit hanging on the rack, like it hadn't been touched.
translation: 我当时只是想找些布料来包扎伤口，结果就瞥见了架子上的牧马人套装，似乎还没人碰过。

original: I took it - not like anybody else needed it, you know? - and wore it back to our camp. Rafaela laughed for the first time since the bombs had fallen.
translation: 我拿走了——反正也没人要，对吧？——我穿着它回到营地。那是核弹爆炸后，我第一次看到拉法拉的笑容。

original: We'll talk later.
translation: 我们稍后再说。

original: Really? Thanks for the reminder, boss, I'd almost forgotten.
translation: 真的？多谢提醒，老大，我都快忘记了。

original: You're wrong. You can still fight, and you should take up your guns again.
translation: 你错了。你仍然可以战斗，你应该再次拿起枪。

original: [FAILED] I'm sure you've got a lot of ideas, boss, but how about if you let me make this decision?
translation: [失败] 我知道你很有想法，老大，可你为什么不让我自己来做决定呢？

original: Tell you what, I'll at least think about it for a while. Ask me about it again another time.
translation: 这样吧，我先考虑一阵子。等你下次有机会再问我吧。

original: You're wrong. You should give up the gun and focus on repairing things.
translation: 你错了。别再玩枪了，你应该专心修理东西。

original: You're right. You should give up the guns for good and focus on fixing things.
translation: 你说的没错。别再玩枪了，你应该专心修理东西。

original: I think you're right. You should focus on gunslinging. You'll do the memories of your family proud.
translation: 说的没错。你应该专心做个枪手。你会为你的家族带来荣耀的。

original: About your decision....
translation: 关于你的决定……

original: Yeah, boss?
translation: 怎么了，老大？

original: That's not true, Raul, you're great with a pistol.
translation: 你说得不对，劳尔，你的枪用得很好。

original: [SUCCEEDED] You think so? Well... you're the boss. Okay, I'll give it a try.
translation: [成功] 你真那么想？好吧……你说了算，好的。我会试试的。

original: But if I get killed, and if there's an afterlife, I'll haunt your ass.
translation: 不过我要是丢了性命，而这世上还有阴曹地府的话，那我做鬼也不会放过你的。

original: I don't think that's a good idea. You should focus on your mechanical skills instead.
translation: 我觉得这样不对。相反，你应该专注于维修技能。

original: [SUCCEEDED] I suppose you're right, boss. These bones are too old for that kind of action.
translation: [成功] 我想你是对的，老大。我这把老骨头确实不再适合做那种事了。

original: [FAILED] I'm sure you've got a lot of ideas, boss, but how about if you let me make this decision?
translation: [失败] 我知道你很有想法，老大，可你为什么不让我自己来做决定呢？

original: Tell you what, I'll at least think about it for a while. Ask me about it again another time.
translation: 这样吧，我先考虑一阵子。等你下次有机会再问我吧。

original: If that's what you think is best, I won't stop you.
translation: 如果你认为那样最好的话，我没意见。

original: Thanks, boss. I'd hate to think I was disappointing you with my life-altering decision.
translation: 谢谢，老大。我可不想看见你因为我改变人生态度而对我失望。

original: I think that's a great idea, Raul, and I hope you'll put them to good use with me.
translation: 我认为这主意很不错，劳尔，希望你能用你的枪和我并肩作战。

original: You can bet on that, boss.
translation: 没问题，老大。

original: Doubts? About what?
translation: 困惑？困惑什么？

original: About whether I still had what it took to carry my pistols proudly, to use them to do what's right.
translation: 困惑我是否还有能力骄傲地举起手枪，用它们去伸张正义。

original: And now that I've been traveling with you for a while, you've made me realize that I can still do that.
translation: 和你在一起的这些日子，让我明白了自己还是有能耐的。

original: Maybe I'm not as tough as I used to be, but my brains can make up for that, and my hands are still quick enough. It's time to put the guns back on.
translation: 虽然体格不行了，但我的头脑可以弥补，我的双手依旧灵活。也该重新捡起我那杆老枪了。

original: About whether I'm really too old to keep living the life of a gunslinger after all. And after seeing what you go through, boss, I think I am.
translation: 困惑我是否真的太老了，不再适合做枪手了。在目睹了你的经历后，老大，我觉得的确如此。

original: From now on, I'll let you deal with the fighting and stick to keeping your gear working. I don't want to slow you down more than I already do.
translation: 从今往后，你来应付战斗，我只负责为你保养装备。我不想再当你的累赘了。

original: What happened then?
translation: 之后发生了什么？

original: When I recovered - more or less, anyways - I left Tuscon and headed west. I ran into Tabitha at Black Mountain and, well, the rest you know.
translation: 我休养了一阵，多少恢复了些元气，就离开图森往西走。后来碰上了黑山的塔比瑟，剩下的你都知道了。

original: I swore I was done with the gunslinging life - I was too old, too slow, and too beat up to protect anyone anymore.
translation: 我当时发誓从此不会再碰枪了——我太老了，动作又慢，还被打得那么惨，已经谁都保护不了啦。

original: I thought I was done forever... but after traveling with you, I realize I've always had my doubts.
translation: 我一度以为这辈子就到此为止了……可自从和你一起踏上旅途以后，我发现自己心里还是有些困惑。

original: When I recovered - more or less, anyways - I left Tuscon and headed west. I ran into Tabitha at Black Mountain and, well, the rest you know.
translation: 我休养了一阵，多少恢复了些元气，就离开图森往西走。后来碰上了黑山的塔比瑟，剩下的你都知道了。

original: I swore I was done with the gunslinging life - I was too old, too slow, and too beat up to protect anyone anymore.
translation: 我当时发誓从此不会再碰枪了——我太老了，动作又慢，还被打得那么惨，已经谁都保护不了啦。

original: After seeing what you go through, I think I made the right choice. So thanks for that, boss.
translation: 在目睹了你的经历后，我觉得自己做出了正确的选择。非常感谢，老大。

original: When I recovered - more or less, anyways - I left Tuscon and headed west. I ran into Tabitha at Black Mountain and, well, the rest you know.
translation: 我休养了一阵，多少恢复了些元气，就离开图森往西走。后来碰上了黑山的塔比瑟，剩下的你都知道了。

original: I swore I was done with the gunslinging life - I was too old, too slow, and too beat up to protect anyone anymore.
translation: 我当时发誓从此不会再碰枪了——我太老了，动作又慢，还被打得那么惨，已经谁都保护不了啦。

original: I thought I was done forever... but after traveling with you, I realize that was the wrong decision. So thanks for that, boss.
translation: 我一度以为这辈子就到此为止了……可和你一起踏上旅途以后，我才意识到自己错了。非常感谢，老大。

original: How did you survive?
translation: 你凭什么活下来的？

original: By being a meaner old cuss than the rest of them, boss. I wanted to keep living until they weren't, so I just kept shooting until they were all dead.
translation: 就凭我这头老狼比他们更狠，老大。我只求活到他们死光为止。所以我不停地开火，直到看见他们全都中弹倒地。

original: I was in pretty bad shape in the end, though. I don't know how long I laid there with the sun baking me and the buzzards chomping at me.
translation: 但我的情况也好不到哪儿去。我不知道自己在地上躺了多久，太阳炙烤着我，连秃鹫都来咬我。

original: Eventually I got the strength to start moving. Some long time after that, I managed to drag my carcass back to town.
translation: 最后我总算有点力气动弹了。又过了很久，我才拖着半死的身躯回到城里。

original: Did you rescue her?
translation: 你去救她了吗？

original: I went after Dave and his brothers. They had a head start, but they slept nights. I didn't. Took me three days to catch up to them.
translation: 我一直追着戴夫和他的弟兄。他们虽然走的早，可他们晚上睡觉。我不睡。我花了三天时间才追上他们。

original: Claudia was dead when I got there. They'd put a bullet in each of her eyes. I couldn't do anything except avenge her, just like Rafaela.
translation: 我赶到的时候，克劳迪娅已经死了。他们在她的双眼里各打了一枪。我唯一能做的，只有为她报仇，就像当年为拉法拉一样。

original: I charged into the middle of their camp and started firing - two of them were dead before they knew I was there. The other five, though....
translation: 我冲进他们的营地，抬枪便射——他们还没反应过来，就有两个人命丧当场。可另外五个人……

original: They shot the shit out of me. I would have died, I think, if I wasn't so full of rage.
translation: 我可真被他们打得够戗。要不是当时我仗着一腔怒火，估计早就死了。

original: But they didn't, did they?
translation: 但他们没有，是不是？

original: No, boss. No they didn't.
translation: 是的，老大，他们没走。

original: As I was saying, I hoped they'd leave the town in peace. Instead, they decided to stop at Claudia's brothel to take the edge off.
translation: 正如我所说，我希望他们能老老实实地离开镇子。可恰恰相反，他们在克劳迪娅的妓院前停了下来，想进去消遣一把。

original: I don't know which one of them got rowdy first, but by the time I heard the screams and got my guns, it was too late.
translation: 我不知道究竟是谁先挑的头，可当我听到尖叫声，提着枪冲进去的时候，已经太晚了。

original: They'd shot up the brothel, killed four girls, and taken Claudia for their sport.
translation: 他们在妓院里大开杀戒，打死了四个女孩，还掳走了克劳迪娅。

original: What happened with her?
translation: 她后来怎样了？

original: This was a long time ago. Before Caesar's Legion pacified Arizona and brought the raider tribes to heel.
translation: 那都是陈年往事啦。那时候凯撒军团还没征服掠夺者部落，平定亚利桑那呢。

original: A tribe came into Tuscon one day - more a gang, really. Dirty Dave and his six brothers. They were looking for bullets, and I sold some to them.
translation: 某天，有个部落闯进了图森——其实叫匪帮更合适。下流的戴夫和他的六个兄弟。他们来找弹药，我就卖了一些给他们。

original: I figured if I did that, they'd leave town before they tore it up too much.
translation: 我寻思着这么做至少能让他们早点离开镇子，不会到处惹是生非。

original: Why aren't you still there, then?
translation: 那为什么你不在那儿待了？

original: Getting there, boss. I'd been in Tuscon - the locals can call it Two-Sun all they want, but it's Tuscon, dammit - about 75 years when she showed up.
translation: 正要说呢，老板。我去过图森——当地人管它叫双阳城，可那地方就是图森。她出现的时候，我在那儿已经住了将近75年。

original: Prettiest thing you ever saw, boss. Maybe it was just a trick of my senile brain, but I swear she looked just like my Rafaela. Her name was Claudia.
translation: 她是这世上最漂亮的人儿，老大。也许是我脑子生锈产生了幻觉，但我发誓她和我的拉法拉长得一模一样。她叫克劳迪娅。

original: She ended up taking work at one of the brothels in town. I never went to her, of course - how could I? But I looked after her in my own way.
translation: 她流落到了镇上的一家妓院里。我没找过她，当然，我怎么能呢？可我却以自己的方式照顾着她。

original: Fixing things?
translation: 修理东西？

original: Oh, sure, boss. I was always good at fixing things. Some I fixed for the town, some I fixed for other people, some I fixed just for the hell of it.
translation: 哦，当然，老大。我修东西很拿手的。有时候我为镇上修东西，有时候为其他人修东西，有时候只是闲着没事干。

original: It's a better way to use your hands than killing, and even then I wasn't getting any younger or faster.
translation: 干这种活总比杀人强，虽说那样我也不会变得更年轻、更灵活。

original: I lived there for a long time. Kept to myself, didn't get into any fights - hell, the only reason I even kept my guns oiled was professional pride.
translation: 我在那里住了很长时间。独来独往，与世无争——见鬼，我给枪上油仅仅是出于一种职业荣耀感。

original: Wasn't Mexico City basically annihilated in the Great War?
translation: 在大战中，墨西哥城不是几乎被毁灭了吗？

original: I don't think it was as hard hit as DC or Bakersfield, but it was bad enough. By the time we got there, the city was a radioactive ruin.
translation: 我认为它遭受的打击应该比不上华盛顿或贝克斯菲尔德，但也差不多了。我们到那儿的时候，整座城市已经化为废墟，到处遍布着辐射。

original: Still, the city was full of looters, already forming into the beginnings of raider tribes. Crime was bad before the War, but now it was a nightmare.
translation: 然而城里还是堆满了来抢劫的人，掠夺者部落已经开始形成。战前犯罪就很猖獗，现在简直就像地狱。

original: We were living like scavengers, scraping by on what little food we could find, always looking for medicine for my burns.
translation: 我们靠捡破烂为生，凡是能下咽的东西都成了我们的战利品，还得四处寻找能治疗我烧伤的药。

original: And then, of course, the radiation started to kick in, turning me into this handsome devil you see before you.
translation: 当然，后来我就感染了辐射病，把我变成了现在这副英俊的鬼模样。

original: What is it, Veronica?
translation: 这是什么，维罗尼卡？

original: Hardin. Er, {Correcting herself}Elder. I know why we're failing.
translation: 哈丁。呃，{Correcting herself}我是说，长老。我知道我们为什么失败了。

original: {Skeptical}Do you?
translation: {Skeptical}你知道了？

original: As long as we hide in here, ignoring the outside, our days are numbered.
translation: 要是继续躲在这个地方，无视外面世界的变化，那我们很快会完蛋的。

original: For once, I agree.
translation: 这次，我同意。

original: {Skeptical}You do?
translation: {Skeptical}真的吗？

original: We can't let people go on believing the Brotherhood has lost its teeth.
translation: 我们不能让人们觉得兄弟会已经断了脊梁骨。

original: We must strike while our enemies are distracted with each other.
translation: 我们要在敌人忙于内耗的时候发起反击。

original: {Disbelieving}Strike? That's how we got into this problem in the first place. We can't beat these armies.
translation: {Disbelieving}反击？我们一开始就是因为这个陷入麻烦的。我们无法与他们抗衡。

original: Our entire two hundred years of history say that a handful of troops with the best equipment and training can stand up to any army.
translation: 我们两百年来的历史已经证明，一支装备优良、训练有素的小队足以面对任何敌人。

original: And the loss of HELIOS One says things are different now.
translation: 可太阳神一号的失败说明时代已经不同了。

original: {Heated}That was a failure of strategy, not philosophy. If Father El{-ijah}- the Elder in charge were a Paladin and not a Scribe-
translation: {Heated}那是战略失误，不是道路错误。如果以利亚——如果当时的长老是圣骑士而不是学士的话……

original: {Finishing someone else's sentence}Our arrogance would still have been our downfall.
translation: {Finishing someone else's sentence}我们的自大终将导致衰亡。

original: History says otherwise.
translation: 历史不这样认为。

original: Maybe it's time you start looking forward.
translation: 也许现在是你展望未来的时候了。

original: Let's go. We're wasting our time.
translation: 走吧。别再浪费时间了。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: I don't care about your radio. Where did those guys go?
translation: 我才不关心你的收音机。那些家伙去哪了？

original: < Sneak 25 >
[SUCCEEDED] That does sound like a good plan. All right, you seem to know what you're doing, so you can count me in.
translation: [成功] 这计划听起来还不错。好吧，你看起来也像是有点本事的人，就算我一个吧。

original: Let me have a word with a few other folks and I'll see if I can't round up some more members for this militia you're creating.
translation: 我再找几个人谈谈，看看能不能再给你的民兵队增加几个成员。

original: While everyone does own a gun, we could stand to be a little better equipped. The general store probably has what we need in stock.
translation: 虽然人人都有枪，但我们还需要些更好一点的装备。杂货店里应该有我们需要的东西。

original: Near the saloon and store are good spots to stage an ambush - if I had the help.
translation: 酒馆和商店附近都是伏击他们的好地方——只要有人帮我。

original: [FAILED] No thank you. Good luck with your, uh, "ambush."
translation: [失败] 不，谢了。祝你，呃，"伏击"成功。

original: I could probably take out the powder gang by surprise, if I had help. Probably.
translation: 我应该可以打炸药帮一个出其不意，如果有人帮我的话。应该。

original: < Speech 25 >
[SUCCEEDED] I was planning on sitting this one out, but for some reason I can't help but like you. I'm with you.
translation: [成功] 我本来是打算坐山观虎斗的，但不知为何，我挺欣赏你这个人的。算我一个。

original: Let me have a word with a few other folks and I'll see if I can't round up some more members for this militia you're creating.
translation: 我再找几个人谈谈，看看能不能再给你的民兵队增加几个成员。

original: While everyone does own a gun, we could stand to be a little better equipped. The general store probably has what we need in stock.
translation: 虽然人人都有枪，但我们还需要些更好一点的装备。杂货店里应该有我们需要的东西。

original: You should help me take down the powder gang. Bullets, explosions, lots of fun.
translation: 你应该帮我拿下炸药帮。子弹横飞，爆炸不断，欢乐无限。

original: [FAILED] All the more reason for me to sit this one out. I'll be rooting for you, though.
translation: [失败] 我觉得还是不要掺和进来比较合适。不过我在精神上支持你。

original: Uh, we're a little outnumbered against the powder gang. Think you could help?
translation: 嗯，比起炸药帮，我们在人数上占点优势。也许你能帮忙？

original: < Barter 20 >
[SUCCEEDED] Not at all! I'm never sure how much is normally charged for this sort of thing. Here's some additional caps - that should be enough.
translation: [成功] 当然不是！我真不知道这样的工作应该付多少报酬合适。再给你一些瓶盖吧——这样应该够了。

original: Now, how about spending some of those caps in the saloon?
translation: 那么，不妨你现在就在酒馆里花点瓶盖怎么样？

original: That's it? Are you implying that I've done shoddy work?
translation: 就这样？你意思是我偷工减料了吗？

original: [FAILED] I could get another working radio with the caps I already gave you. Now, how about spending some of those caps right now?
translation: [失败] 我给你的瓶盖都够买一个新收音机了。那么，不妨你现在就在酒馆里花点瓶盖怎么样？

original: That's all? I think you could afford to pay me a little more.
translation: 就这些？我觉得你完全可以多付一点给我。

original: So I help Ringo, and Goodsprings will like me more. What if I help the Powder Gangers?
translation: 所以我帮林戈，清泉镇就会更喜欢我。那如果我帮炸药帮呢？

original: {slight anger - player just asked about helping criminals}Don't know why you'd want to go do a thing like that. Yeah, you'd get on their good side, but people around here wouldn't appreciate it one bit.
translation: 真不明白你为什么会这样想。没错，他们可能会给你点好处，但这里的人会和你翻脸。

original: What happens if I help Ringo?
translation: 如果我帮了林戈会怎么样？

original: If you were able to get Ringo out of this mess, you'd have a decent reputation around Goodsprings. I'd even set you up with a discount.
translation: 如果你能帮林戈收拾这个烂摊子，清泉镇对你的看法将大为改观。我甚至会给你折扣价。

original: Of course, helping Ringo would also make the Powder Gangers mad, and they've got a {emphasize "lot"}lot of friends out there.
translation: 当然了，你帮林戈的话，炸药帮肯定会发疯，他们在外面的朋友可不少呢。

original: Jack is interested in a girl.
translation: 杰克对一个姑娘有意思。

original: Well well, this is welcome news. Who is she?
translation: 噢，噢，有意思。那姑娘是谁？

original: She works for the Crimson Caravan.
translation: 她为深红商队工作。

original: She's with those traders? They've tried to contact us before, but I'm not interested in trading with greedy savages.
translation: 她和那些小贩是一伙儿的？虽然他们联系过我们，但我没兴趣和这些贪得无厌的野蛮人做生意。

original: This presents a bit of a problem. Jack isn't allowed to leave Nellis, and I doubt she would make it through the artillery alive.
translation: 这就有点麻烦了。杰克不能离开内利斯，而且我也怀疑她是不是真能活着穿越炮火隔离带。

original: Just some kookie dame looking for love.
translation: 一个怀春的少女罢了。

original: This presents a bit of a problem. Jack isn't allowed to leave Nellis, and I doubt she would make it through the artillery alive.
translation: 这就有点麻烦了。杰克不能离开内利斯，而且我也怀疑她能否活着穿越我们的炮火隔离带。

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才技能>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm, I suppose Jack deserves a chance at love. You can tell Jack she has a free pass to enter, but he is responsible for her actions.
translation: [成功] 唔，我想杰克确实应该谈次恋爱。你告诉杰克，她可以进来，不过他得对她的一切行为负责。

original: Do not make me regret this decision, outsider.
translation: 别让我因为这个决定而后悔，外来者。

original: It would mean a lot to Jack if she could come to Nellis.
translation: 如果她能来内利斯，那对杰克一定是件喜事。

original: [FAILED] Sorry, but I can't risk exposing the tribe to more savage outsiders.
translation: [失败] 抱歉，我不能让族人过多地与野蛮人接触。

original: She's a great gal, you'll love her.
translation: 她是一个好姑娘，你会喜欢她的。

original: <Ladykiller>
translation: <红颜杀手>

original: [SUCCEEDED] You're right. I'd be wrong to deny Jack such joy in his life.
translation: [成功] 你是对的。这关系到杰克一生的幸福，我不应当阻挠。

original: He's done right by the tribe many times over. Tell Jack this girl is free to enter, but he is responsible for her actions.
translation: 他对族人贡献良多。告诉杰克，这姑娘可以进来，不过他得对她的一切行为负责。

original: Do not make me regret this decision, outsider.
translation: 别让我后悔作出这个决定，外来者。

original: Come on, Pearl, think of the joy it would bring Jack. He's in love.
translation: 拜托，珀尔，想想这会让杰克多开心吧。他已经坠入爱河了。

original: <Reputation>
translation: <声望>

original: Very well, I'll take your word when you say she isn't a threat to the tribe. I will allow her entry if Jack will take responsibility for her.
translation: 很好，我就相信你的话。如果杰克愿意对她的行为负责，我就放她进来。

original: Do not make me regret this decision, outsider.
translation: 别让我因为这个决定而后悔，外来者。

original: I assure you, Janet would not be a threat to the tribe.
translation: 我向你保证，珍妮特不会是你们部族的威胁。

original: Sorry, but I can't risk exposing the tribe to more savage outsiders.
translation: 抱歉，我不能让族人过多地与野蛮人接触。

original: She couldn't hurt a fly. Let her into Nellis.
translation: 她连拍死只蚊子都不忍心。就让她进入内利斯吧。

original: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 别介意。我们说点别的。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: I'd like to talk about allowing Janet to visit Jack.
translation: 我还是希望您能同意珍妮特来见杰克。

original: I'd rather not allow more outsiders in, but I'll hear you out.
translation: 我觉得外来者还是少来一些的好，不过我愿意听听你的意见。

original: I'm still working on it.
translation: 我还在想办法。

original: Okay, well let me know what she says.
translation: 好的，如果她有答复，请告诉我。

original: I convinced her to pay you what you're owed. You're free to leave.
translation: 我说服她把该付你的钱付了。你现在可以走了。

original: That's great! I can't believe you went through all this trouble for me. Thank you!
translation: 太棒了！真不敢相信你帮我解决了这么个大麻烦。多谢了！

original: You're free to leave, but McLafferty won't pay you. That's the deal.
translation: 你可以走，不过代价是麦克拉弗蒂一毛钱也不会付给你。

original: I see. Well, thank you for trying. I'm off to go see my admirer now.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你为我做的一切。我现在要去见我的爱慕者了。

original: I won't do it.
translation: 我不干。

original: I'll begin looking immediately.
translation: 我马上就开始找。

original: I'm glad I can count on you. Oh, and one other thing. The patrols each had a holotape detailing their missions that you can use to track them.
translation: 我就知道能指望你。哦，还有件事。每支巡逻队都会携带全息磁带用于任务记录，你可以通过它来追踪他们。

original: The shielding of the bunker prevents us from actively tracking them, but their positions should show up on your map once you get to the surface.
translation: 地堡的防御系统让我们无法发现他们的踪迹，但等你上了地面，就能在地图上看到他们了。

original: Should our worst fears become realized, please bring back all three of the holotapes from the patrols. Otherwise, bring our brothers home.
translation: 如果最坏的情况发生，请你务必把全息磁带取回来。否则，一定要把我的兄弟们带回家。

original: I've given the order that you be given access to some of the equipment our scouts and patrols have scavenged over the years.
translation: 我已经下了命令，你可以使用我们的侦察队搜集到的部分装备。

original: You won't be allowed to purchase any prohibited equipment, but hopefully some of what's available will prove useful to you.
translation: 但你依然不能购买其他违禁军火。希望目前已有的这些武器装备能对你有所帮助。

original: What are the rules of Caravan?
translation: 商队牌的规矩是什么？

original: It's a two-player game, and the winner takes the whole pot. You build a "caravan" using the cards in your deck.
translation: 双人游戏，赢家通吃。规则就是你用你的扑克牌在桌上组一个"商队"。

original: The goal is to create caravan bids that beat your opponent's bids, so there's more strategy than luck involved.
translation: 目标是让你的商队点数高过对手的点数，所以更讲究策略而非运气。

original: It's why you won't see Caravan in any casino - too slow-paced, and more importantly, no house edge.
translation: 这就是你在赌场见不到商队牌的原因——节奏太慢，更重要的是庄家没有优势。

original: Here, take this holotape - it goes into more specifics about the rules. You'll also need a deck, so take one of my spares.
translation: 来，这盘全息磁带给你——里面有详细的规则介绍。你还需要一副牌，可以从我这拿一副。

original: So... you feel like playing a game?
translation: 那么……你要玩一把吗？

original: [PRESS DEMO] I'll look for your men and supplies. Send me to HELIOS One.
translation: [PRESS DEMO] 我去寻找你的人和补给。送我到太阳神一号那去。

original: Thanks. Watch your back out there. Never know when those Legion bastards might show up.
translation: 谢谢。在那要保持警惕。你永远都不知道那些军团杂种会什么时候出现。

original: HELLO
translation: 你好。

original: Not yet, but let me ask you about something else first.
translation: 等等，首先我想先问你一些问题。

original: Alright, ask away.
translation: 好吧，你问吧。

original: I'll let you know when I do.
translation: 有消息的话我会告诉你的。

original: Okay, hurry back. I don't want anyone to start shooting at me.
translation: 好的，早去早回。我可不想一直等到有人朝我开枪的那一刻。

original: Where should I go to get you a pardon?
translation: 我上哪给你弄赦免令呢？

original: There is a NCR camp down on the southern border of Nevada. Camp Mojave I think, try to find someone of authority there.
translation: 从这往南，在内华达边境有一个NCR营地。应该是叫莫哈维营地，到那儿找个当官的就行。

original: Primm has seen better days.
translation: 普瑞姆以前不是这样的。

original: {Sad}It has. It was a promising trade town - before the escape at the correctional facility. {Shakes head, recalling a bad memory}Lost a good bit of money at the Vikki and Vance.
translation: 是啊。它曾经是一座很有希望的贸易小镇——在那帮囚犯越狱之前。我还在维姬和万斯赌场输了不少钱呢。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Never mind, I'll be leaving now.
translation: 别在意，我这就走。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: <Bribe>
translation: <贿赂>

original: {Slightly uncomfortable, voice down}Well, having a sheriff who was a convict is better than no sheriff at all... and if he has the qualifications... all right, hand it over.
translation: 好吧，一个有前科的警长也比没有警长要强……如果他真能胜任……可以，就交给他吧。

original: Do you think I could "buy" a pardon for 200 caps?
translation: 你说如果我愿意出200瓶盖，能不能“买”到一个特赦呢？

original: If you {emph}had 200 caps, we could talk business - until then, we don't have anything to talk about.
translation: 如果你有200瓶盖，我们就可以做成这笔买卖——如果没有，那就别再浪费我们的时间了。

original: Do you think I could "buy" a pardon for 200 caps?
translation: 你说如果我愿意出200瓶盖，能不能“买”到一个特赦呢？

original: <Speech Options>
translation: <口才选项>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hmm.{Pensive pause} All right. If his sentence was closing up I can see about getting him pardoned.
translation: [成功] 唔。好吧。如果确实刑期快满了，我可以考虑给他特赦。

original: Primm is important to our trade up from California, so having someone there who owes us a favor... that couldn't hurt.
translation: 普瑞姆在本地和加州之间的贸易中扮演着尤为重要的角色，派个亏欠我们的人去那儿……也不是什么坏事。

original: His sentence was almost up, and he isn't tied to the Powder Gangers.
translation: 他的刑期就快满了，而且和炸药帮也没什么瓜葛。

original: [FAILED] I don't think so. I'm not going to put my word on the line for some random convict.
translation: [失败] 我可不这么想。我可不会把期望寄托在随便一个犯人身上。

original: Come on, he's just a convict. How bad could he be?
translation: 拜托，他就是个犯人而已，还能坏到哪去？

original: I'd like to know more about Mr. House.
translation: 我想知道更多豪斯先生的事。

original: I'm afraid I don't know much myself. Mr. House has got his own casino, the Lucky 38, but nobody goes in or out except his robots.
translation: 恐怕我知道的也不多。豪斯先生有他自己的赌场，幸运38，但是除了他的机器人，没人能进出。

original: The other casinos follow Mr. House's rules, so I guess that makes him the leader of New Vegas. As far as I know, nobody's ever laid eyes on the guy.
translation: 其他赌场都遵守豪斯先生定的规矩，所以他应该算得上是新维加斯的老大了。但据我所知，还没有人亲眼见过这家伙。

original: I think that robot who pulled you out of the dirt belongs to Mr. House. If Mr. House is looking after you, that's gotta be a good thing, right?
translation: 我认为把你从土里拽出来的机器人就是豪斯先生的手下。如果豪斯先生在关照你，那可是好事啊，对吧？

original: Why does your jumpsuit say "Miguel?"
translation: 为什么你的连身衣上写着"米格尔"？

original: You're the mechanic around here?
translation: 你是这里的机械师？

original: Actually, hang out here for a while.
translation: 你先在这里等一下吧。

original: Oh, sure thing. I haven't even remotely grown sick of staring at this place.
translation: 哦，当然。反正我还没到看着这地方就想吐的程度。

original: Very funny.
translation: 很有趣。

original: Talk to me at my shack, I've at least got tools there.
translation: 到我的小屋里找我，至少那儿有工具。

original: Then why does your jumpsuit say "Miguel?"
translation: 为什么你的连身衣上写着"米格尔"？

original: Probably because it used to be Miguel's. Whoever he was. How about if you let me go, huh boss?
translation: 也许它本来属于一个名叫米格尔的人。管他是谁呢。您就饶了我吧，老大，行吗？

original: Really?
translation: 真的？

original: <Sigh.> No. No, boss, I'm, a prisoner of the crazy Super Mutant with the wig and the glasses. I was kind of hoping you were here to set me free.
translation: <叹息。> 不。不，老大。我只是被那个戴着假发和眼镜的超级变种人扣起来的囚犯。我还希望你是来这儿解救我的呢。

original: But maybe I'm not a pretty enough damsel for that, huh?
translation: 只可惜我这模样算不上美人，对吧？

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Name's Raul. Raul Alfonso Tejada. I'm the mechanic around here.
translation: 我的名字是劳尔，劳尔·阿尔弗索·特哈达。我是这里的机械师。

original: You forget about me already, boss? You sure you didn't take a blow to the head or something?
translation: 你已经忘了我了，老大？你确信你的脑袋没被人打过一棍吗？

original: My name is Raul Alfonso Tejada. Can I leave now, or did you want to ask me again in five minutes?
translation: 我的名字是劳尔·阿尔弗索·特哈达。我现在能走了吗，或者待会你还想再问我一次？

original: What do you mean, took me long enough?
translation: 你说我太慢了是什么意思？

original: Sorry. I assumed the only reason you'd fight past a horde of Super mutants and pick the lock on my cell is if you heard my cry for help on the radio.
translation: 抱歉。我以为你是听到了我在收音机里的呼救声，才跑来杀死这一大群超级变种人，把我从牢笼中解救出来的。

original: But maybe you're just sightseeing. So, since the door's open and all, can I go now?
translation: 不过你兴许只是来看风景的。那么，既然门已经开了，我可以走了吗？

original: One more thing I wanted to show you.
translation: 我还有一样东西要教你。

original: Thought I might teach you about living off the land, and making useful things for yourself. Interested?
translation: 我会教你如何在野外生存，以及如何制作一些有用的东西。有兴趣吗？

original: [END TUTORIAL] No need. I think I've got it covered from here.
translation: [结束教程]不必了。我想我全搞清楚了。

original: Okay, say no more.
translation: 好，不说了。

original: Couldn't hurt.
translation: 也无妨。

original: All right, then. We'll need a couple ingredients to get started. Gonna want some Xander Root and a Broc Flower.
translation: 那好吧。首先，我们需要配料。得找一些山德根和一朵布洛克花来。

original: Lemme think now... I know I've seen Broc Flowers growing up at the graveyard. And I seem to remember there being Xander Root over by the schoolhouse.
translation: 让我想想……我在墓地里见过布洛克花。至于山德根，我记得好像是长在学校附近。

original: Bring those on back to me, and we'll get cooking.
translation: 把它们采回来给我，我们就可以开小灶了。

original: What's so important about Hoover Dam?
translation: 胡佛大坝怎么这么重要？

original: The Dam powers a lot of New Vegas. And then there's all that clean water lying in Lake Mead, too. Anybody who owns the Dam owns the territory.
translation: 大坝为新维加斯供电。另外，米德湖里还有纯净的淡水。控制了大坝就等于控制了这片地区。

original: Tell me about the Legion.
translation: 跟我说说军团的事。

original: They're slavers, led by a guy named {SEE-zer}Caesar. Or {less certainly, KAI-zar}Caesar. Not sure how you're supposed to say it.
translation: 他们是群奴隶贩子，由一个叫{SEE-zer}恺撒，或者“{less certainly, KAI-zar}凯撒”的人领导。看你怎么念了。

original: A couple of years ago they tried to take over Hoover Dam, but the NCR beat them back. The NCR didn't - or couldn't - finish the job, though.
translation: 几年前他们试图控制胡佛大坝，结果被NCR打得屁滚尿流。但NCR没有——或者说没办法，彻底解决他们。

original: The Legion's got its strength back and is getting ready for another round at the Dam. My money's still on the NCR winning, but you never know.
translation: 现在军团卷土重来，准备对大坝发动新一轮的攻势。虽然我依旧看好NCR赢，但结果到底会怎么样谁也说不准。

original: {warning}We've been hearing stories about Legionaries on the Nevada side of the river, so keep a gun handy. You don't want to get caught by them.
translation: {warning}我听说内华达那边的河岸有军团士兵出没，所以备好枪吧。要是被他们逮到可就完了。

original: What's wrong with the NCR?
translation: NCR哪儿不好了？

original: Don't get me wrong - the NCR's got a lot of decent folk in it. It's just that they make you part of them whether you like it or not.
translation: 别误会——NCR有不少好人。只不过无论你是否愿意，他们都会想要吞并你。

original: Towns like Goodsprings and Primm don't stay independent for long, not if you've got something the NCR wants. Still, the NCR keeps the Legion away.
translation: 像清泉镇和普瑞姆这样的地方，只要NCR觉得有用，那它们想要保持独立是不可能的。但不管怎么说，是NCR阻挡了军团的入侵。

original: No, I'm still working on it.
translation: 不，我还在想办法。

original: Remain diligent, outsider. If those patrols are in trouble, every second you delay lessens their chances of rescue.
translation: 加把劲，外来者。也许巡逻队正在遭遇危险，多耽搁一秒，他们生还的几率就会减少一分。

original: I've found two of the patrols. All of the paladins were dead.
translation: 我找到了两支巡逻队，所有的圣骑士都死了。

original: T-That is unfortunate. As long as there is a chance to find the remaining patrol, however, I must still ask you to try.
translation: 那……太不幸了。不过还有一支巡逻队，只要有一线希望，我们就不应当放弃。

original: Return when you have found them.
translation: 找到他们就回来向我复命。

original: No, I've only found one of them so far. Both paladins were dead.
translation: 不，目前我只找到了其中一支。所有的圣骑士都死了。

original: While that is disheartening news, there remains hope that the other two patrols may still be found alive.
translation: 这太让人沮丧了。不过另外两支巡逻队仍有生还的机会。

original: See me as soon as you've found them.
translation: 一旦发现他们就来找我。

original: Yes, here are their holotapes.
translation: 是的，这些是他们的全息磁带。

original: {Solemn}They were all dead, then. I suppose I'm not surprised. We have few friends in the world above, and many enemies.
translation: {Solemn}看来他们都死了。果然不出所料。我们在外面的世界没什么朋友，却有不少敌人。

original: But we must turn our minds to other matters. When I sent out those patrols, I also sent three Knights out on scouting missions.
translation: 这件事还是先放一边吧。我派出巡逻队的时候，还派了另外三名骑士外出执行侦察任务。

original: When the patrols failed to return, we assumed the worst and sent a single communication to the scouts to hold position and maintain radio silence.
translation: 巡逻队一直没有回来，于是我们做了最坏的打算，向他们发送了单向通知，要求他们继续坚守岗位，并且保持无线电静默。

original: I want you to contact those scouts and gather their reports. Like the patrols, they have devices on them that will enable you to track them.
translation: 我希望你能与这些侦察员取得联系，从他们那儿取得报告。和巡逻队一样，他们身上也带有追踪设备。

original: When you find them, tell them you're my representative and ask them if the bears are still hunting. That should get them to talk to you.
translation: 如果你见到他们，就说是我授权你来的，并问他们“熊是否还在出没”，这样他们才会与你讲话。

original: Return when you've gathered all of their reports.
translation: 拿到报告后就回来向我复命。

original: Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I think she's dead.
translation: 很遗憾，我不得不告诉你这个坏消息，她已经死了。

original: What?! No! I mean, I haven't seen her around for a while, but I thought she was just busy working.
translation: 什么？！不！我还寻思着怎么最近没见到她，我以为她在忙工作。

original: She was so beautiful... Now I'll never get to know her.
translation: 她那么美……我再也没机会认识她了。

original: Well, you won't be getting any caps, but McLafferty won't be a problem for you.
translation: 嗯，虽然你一分钱也拿不到，但是麦克拉弗蒂也不会找你麻烦了。

original: Oh, I see. Well, I guess I'm off to see my admirer now.
translation: 我明白了。嗯，我现在要去见我的爱慕者了。

original: <Black Widow>
translation: <黑寡妇>

original: You think I'm handsome? Wow, I wonder if she does, too!
translation: 你觉得我帅？哇哦，希望她也是这么想的！

original: A "personal matter," hmm? Handsome guy like you, I bet there's a girl involved.
translation: "私事"啊？像你这样的帅哥，这事肯定跟某位姑娘有关吧？

original: I'd like to hear about that personal matter you mentioned.
translation: 我想听听你刚才说到的那件私事。

original: I thought you weren't interested.
translation: 我还以为你不感兴趣呢。

original: <Speech>
translation: <口才技能>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Oh, I remember now! I was playing hide and seek in the big hangar! Mister Loyal made us leave though.
translation: [成功] 噢，我想起来了！我在大飞机库里玩捉迷藏！但罗亚尔先生不让我们玩。

original: Take a deep breath and focus, Lindsay. Where were you with him last?
translation: 深呼吸、集中精力，林赛。你最后一次见到他是在什么地方？

original: [FAILED] I don't know. I play all over. I'll never find him!
translation: [失败] 我不知道，我哪儿都找遍了，还是找不到他！

original: Any idea where I should start looking, kid?
translation: 你觉得我该从哪开始找，孩子？

original: I'll be going now.
translation: 我这就走。

original: Come back when you've made some progress.
translation: 有什么进展了再回来报告。

original: [NCR] I'm here to assist.
translation: [NCR] 我是来帮忙的。

original: Well, about time we got a soldier... and not a recruit, you look like you've seen some action.
translation: 很好，终于来了个像样的老兵……而不是新兵蛋子。你看起来应该是有点经验。

original: Could use a resupply.
translation: 我需要获得补给。

original: You mentioned a reward before?
translation: 你之前说要给我报酬？

original: No, I mentioned you might accidentally get supplied, and I meant it. Not allowed to contract mercenaries at the Outpost.
translation: 不，我说的是你可能会“意外”获得一些物资，我不会食言的。哨站这儿规定不允许雇佣外人。

original: Still, a requisition form or two can get lost, and they're not going to come check... so here you go, just between us.
translation: 不过，弄丢一两张物资申领表还是很正常的，他们也不会查……拿着吧，记住千万别声张。

original: Just get it to the NCR government.
translation: 就交给NCR政府来处理。

original: It felt like the right thing to do.
translation: 听起来就该这么做。

original: You're welcome.
translation: 不客气。

original: I'll do what I can - and those folks that got killed need to be answered for.
translation: 我会尽力而为——必须要给那些被杀害的人一个说法。

original: If you can promise it gets where it needs to go.
translation: 只要你能保证把它送到该到的地方去。

original: I can promise that, what happens after... {sighs}not even God himself could move the Congress in or out of session. And this... this is a tricky matter.
translation: 我保证，但之后的事……就算上帝也没法逼着国会审议这个案子。这……这问题毕竟太棘手了。

original: Sure... no problem.
translation: 当然……没问题。

original: Hmmm. All right - you change your mind and start shooting, then I can't help you. Show up here after, I'll put you in chains.
translation: 嗯，好吧。如果你反悔了，跑去把他们毙了，那我就没法帮你了，只要你再出现，我就得抓你进去蹲号子。

original: Get on now, I'll make sure this gets West and let the wheels of law start turning in the courts.
translation: 现在走吧，我要确保这东西被送回西部，好让法律的巨轮能在法庭上转动起来。

original: You have our word.
translation: 我们保证。

original: That'll have to do. {Beat}God, what a mess. People turning against each other when the Mojave's at risk of falling?
translation: 那就行了。妈的，都是些什么乱七八糟的。莫哈维都快保不住了，居然还有人在互相拆台？

original: If the Republics sinkhole-progress doesn't kill us, greed will. {Beat}Thanks for bringing me this, I know revenge must have been tempting.
translation: 就算我们没被共和国的这个狗屎计划害死，也会被贪婪害死。谢谢你把这个带给我，我知道放弃复仇对你们来说很难。

original: For what it's worth, I appreciate you didn't shed any more blood. We need to save our strength for the Legion.
translation: 为此，我还是要感谢你们没有闹出流血事件。我们必须保存实力，好应对军团。

original: {Beat}God, what a mess. People turning against each other when the Mojave's at risk of falling?
translation: 妈的，都是些什么乱七八糟的。莫哈维都快保不住了，居然还有人在互相拆台？

original: If the Republics sinkhole-progress doesn't kill us, greed will. {Beat}Thanks for bringing me this, I know revenge must have been tempting.
translation: 就算我们没被共和国的这个狗屎计划害死，也会被贪婪害死。谢谢你把这个带给我，我知道放弃复仇对你们来说很难。

original: For what it's worth, I appreciate you didn't shed any more blood. We need to save our strength for the Legion.
translation: 为此，我还是要感谢你们没有闹出流血事件。我们必须保存实力，好应对军团。

original: Can you get it to the right people?
translation: 你能把它送给相关负责人吗？

original: No. No, I can't. Because this evidence might be true... but it doesn't just implicate them.
translation: 不，不，我没办法。就算这个证据是真的……牵扯到的也不仅仅是他们。

original: It's a motive for what happened up North, someone went cruising through both compounds, killed them all.
translation: 这确实可以解释北边发生的事情，有人去了那两个营地，把他们所有人都杀了。

original: I'm guessing that was you. If so, you're not leaving this outpost except in chains.
translation: 我怀疑是你干的。如果确实是你的话，你就别打算大摇大摆离开这个哨站了。

original: {Cold}I can, if you make me a promise.
translation: 可以，但你必须向我做个保证。

original: {Cold}I need you to swear you won't take revenge on Gloria or Alice. If you do, then your case is over, and we can't see that justice is done.
translation: 我要你发誓不对格罗利亚和爱丽丝进行报复。如果你能答应，那咱们就结案，诉诸正义什么的都到此为止。

original: I know some things are hard to let go, but you and Miss Cassidy need to understand that, hear me?
translation: 我知道，有些事的确不能就这么算了，但你和盖西迪小姐必须要理解，明白吗？

original: I have evidence of a caravan conspiracy.
translation: 我有证据表明，有商队在耍阴谋。

original: What is it? Let me see.
translation: 是什么？我看看。

original: All right. This is... this explains a lot of the lost caravans. I thought it was Legion work, but...
translation: 好吧，这……这可以解释为什么会损失这么多商队了，我一直以为是军团干的，但是……

original: I've heard enough.
translation: 我听够了。

original: You sound frustrated.
translation: 你这语气听着很沮丧啊。

original: Frustrated? No. I have my orders - signed, and approved all the way up the chain from Kimball. And I understand the reasons.
translation: 沮丧？不。军令如山——毕竟是从金博尔那儿层层传达下来的。我也明白个中道理。

original: The Outpost isn't a Legion target, yet, not like Vegas or the Dam - but if the caravans get choked here, that's going to bite NCR hard.
translation: 哨站不是军团的目标，至少目前还不像维加斯或者水坝那样重要——但如果商队都卡在这里，那肯定会严重损害NCR的利益。

original: Anyway, didn't mean to talk your ear off. Some days... just feel like more requisition forms and daily reports come across my desk than results.
translation: 我不是有意要发牢骚，只是有时候……感觉我的桌子上堆满了各种申请表单和日常报告，却理不出个结果来。

original: Is NCR sending more troops?
translation: NCR派人来了吗？

original: Sending more troops, yes, to reinforce the Outpost, no. Troops head through here on their way to McCarran or to the frontlines at Forlorn Hope.
translation: 派人？派了，不过都不是派给我们哨站的。他们都直接穿过这里前往麦卡伦或者飘零希望营地了。

original: Or they're on leave, on their way to New Vegas to piss away their pay. All of them, passing through.
translation: 又或者他们正着急地赶去新维加斯找乐子呢。他们全部都是路过这里而已，路过。

original: You sure seem like you have enough soldiers.
translation: 你手下的士兵人数应该够了吧。

original: Soldiers, no, recruits, yes. And the Mojave Outpost has been ordered to have a standing force at the NCR perimeter at all times.
translation: 士兵？算不上，顶多是新兵蛋子。而且我们接到命令，要时刻保证有一支部队驻守在前哨站，以应对边境的突发状况。

original: So sending anyone out reduces the Outpost's numbers and would be in direct violation of my orders from back West.
translation: 所以向外派兵不但会减少我们的人手，同时也违反了上级给我的命令。

original: Let's move.
translation: 我们走。

original: Got it, let's start looting.
translation: 了解，我们开始搜吧。

original: Don't have to tell me twice, feel more alive than I ever have.
translation: 没必要跟我说两遍，我从来没有感觉如此有活力。

original: We'll make the time.
translation: 我们会抽出时间的。

original: All right then, let's move out.
translation: 好吧，我们走。

original: Want to check it out?
translation: 想去看看吗？

original: Yeah, something's wrong, I can feel it.
translation: 没错，有些不对劲，我能感觉到。

original: It's not any closer than the first, so if you'd rather let be, let me know.
translation: 和第一个相比基本没什么变化，如果你打算先放着，那就告诉我吧。

original: Let's leave it for now.
translation: 咱们还是先走吧。

original: If we have time, sure.
translation: 如果我们有时间的话，当然。

original: Let's go.
translation: 我们走吧。

original: Want to go check it out?
translation: 想去看看吗？

original: Yeah, it's a ways, though, hell of a detour. You sure?
translation: 好啊，也不失为一种办法，不过得绕路，你确定吗？

original: Is there anything salvagable?
translation: 还有什么可以捞的吗？

original: Not sure, let's look around.
translation: 不知道，我们找找吧。

original: All right, let's check the place out.
translation: 好吧，我们去那里看看吧。

original: Why would they have done it during the day?
translation: 他们为啥要在光天化日之下干这种事？

original: No idea. Maybe catch the sun in their eyes? Maybe they wanted the caravan to come to them, walk into an ambush?
translation: 不知道。也许是想让商队的人被阳光闪瞎？也许是他们计划引诱商队自投罗网，再发动伏击？

original: We should check the wagon, they may not have got everything.
translation: 我们应该检查一下货物，也许他们并没有把所有东西都抢走。

original: Whatever we find, it's yours - least I can do for hoofing it all this way with me.
translation: 如果还剩下能找到的东西，你就都拿去吧，也算是你陪我跑一趟的报酬了。

original: If there's time.
translation: 如果有时间。

original: I may have already searched the area.
translation: 我应该搜索过那个区域了。

original: Well, you have to know what to look for.
translation: 你也得知道要找什么啊。

original: Let's go, then.
translation: 那我们走吧。

original: Thanks, I appreciate it.
translation: 谢谢了，真的很感谢。

original: Some of the caravan might be ash, but we were expecting raiders and over-inquisitive NCR border guards. There might be something left.
translation: 虽然商队的一部分可能已经化成灰了，但我们毕竟提前做好了应对掠夺者和好奇心旺盛的NCR边防军的准备，也许还能剩下点什么。

original: If I'm there with you, shouldn't be hard to spot. And I'd prefer to see the bodies with my own eyes.
translation: 如果我跟你一块儿去，应该能认得出来。我想亲眼见见那些尸首。

original: Already been there, nothing worth finding.
translation: 我去过了，几乎什么都没剩下。

original: Well, I still wouldn't mind going there and crossing my heart a few times, if only to make me feel a bit better.
translation: 好吧，但我还是想到那儿去为他们祷告一下，希望这样能让我好受点。

original: {To herself, downnote}I got them into this mess, I owe them that much.
translation: {To herself, downnote}是我让他们倒了如此大的霉，我欠他们太多了。

original: Site's probably nothing but bones and sand by now.
translation: 现在那里大概只剩下骨头和沙子了。

original: Think there's anything left?
translation: 你觉得还会有东西留下来吗？

original: {Sighs}Only wishful thinking on my part, most likely. At the least, I'd like to pay my respects.
translation: {Sighs}估计也就只剩下我的执念了吧。至少，我也应该去悼念一下。

original: {To herself, downnote}I got them into this mess, I owe them that much.
translation: {To herself, downnote}是我让他们倒了如此大的霉，我欠他们太多了。

original: How did you catch word of it?
translation: 你是怎么得知消息的？

original: Got word back on what happened from Rangers, guess they found enough in the wreckage to identify it.
translation: 从游骑兵那里听到的，估计他们是翻了残骸后才认出那是我的商队。

original: Where was your caravan hit?
translation: 你的商队是在哪里被袭击的？

original: {Sighs}Up side of Vegas, hear tell. Trapped at the Mojave Outpost, so I wasn't able to run there when I heard.
translation: {Sighs}听说就在维加斯边上。那时我还被困在莫哈维哨站，所以知道消息后也没能赶过去。

original: Been weeks since it was hit, so the site's probably a Cazador nest by now.
translation: 距离袭击已经过了好几个星期了，估计那地方现在早就变成蜂巢了。

original: After all the shit I went through to get this, we're going to Jackson.
translation: 想想我为了这个结果费了多大功夫吧，我们去找杰克逊。

original: If he won't listen, then we can do things your way.
translation: 如果他不听，咱们再按你的方法来。

original: We have to try.
translation: 我们必须试一试。

original: All right, let's do it, listen to what he has to say.
translation: 好吧，就这么做，去听听他的意见吧。

original: Anyone you trust in NCR?
translation: 你在NCR有什么信任的人吗？

original: {Blinks}Well... Jackson in the Mojave Outpost could get it to folks in the West. I wouldn't trust anyone closer to the Colorado.
translation: {Blinks}嗯……莫哈维哨站的杰克逊可以把证据带回给西部。反正，只要是从科罗拉多附近来的，我一概不信。

original: {Thinking}And the Crimson Caravan and the Van Graffs have their heart back West. {Beat}Not sure it'll do any good, though.
translation: {Thinking}深红商队和范格拉夫在西部根基雄厚。{Beat}但不知道会不会有影响。

original: You know Gloria and Alice - what do you think?
translation: 你知道爱丽丝和格罗利亚吧——你觉得她们怎么样？

original: No one enters into a deal like this unless they have dirt on their partner.
translation: 想要把生意搞大，那迟早是要对自己的伙伴动刀子的。

original: {Blinks}No... No, I'd agree with that. And Alice and Gloria are two crows that'd keep something like that in their nest.
translation: {Blinks}不……不，我同意你这句话。爱丽丝和格罗利亚都精明得很，他们肯定藏了对方的把柄。

original: Because of what happened to your caravan.
translation: 因为你的商队遭遇了如此的灭顶之灾。

original: {Blinks}You're saying... they might need to do the same thing to each other some day. And evidence is easier than bullets.
translation: {Blinks}你是说……她们总有一天会自相残杀。而证据比子弹要有用得多。

original: Not yet.
translation: 还不行。

original: I held off on filling them full of holes, so unless you give me a good reason to cool my heels soon, I'm not waiting much longer.
translation: 我已经是强忍着不去找她们算账了，所以，你最好拿出个像样点的理由，否则我是一刻也坐不住了。

original: Here's both pieces of evidence.
translation: 两边的证据我都拿到了。

original: {Impressed}No shit. There it is, the blood, the motive, as clear as day. They must have penned these with snake venom.
translation: {Impressed}果然如此。就是这些了，手段，动机，一清二楚。她们居然能想出如此毒计，真是心狠手辣。

original: But... we got it, now what? Sure, this damns them, but only if someone listens.
translation: 但是……拿到了以后又该怎么办？确实，凭这些可以搞掉他们，但也得有人做主才行。

original: Here's the evidence of the deal. Without its twin, there's no proof.
translation: 证据我拿到了，但只有这一个，还需要别的旁证。

original: So there's just one more safe to crack? Hope you can get to it.
translation: 所以只要再捅开一道锁就行了？希望你能办得到。

original: {Frowns}Say what you will about the two leading ladies, they watch their lockers like crows. Still... you got one, so the other might not be impossible.
translation: 凭心而论，这两位女士看锁的功夫是一流的。不过……既然你能搞定其中一个，那剩下的那个也不是不可能。

original: If you get both, then let's talk. {Beat}And... I appreciate you putting yourself at risk like this. Thanks.
translation: 如果你能把两边的证据都搜集到，咱们再谈。另外……非常感谢你为我冒这么大的险，谢谢。

original: If I can get the evidence, will you consider it?
translation: 如果我能弄到证据，你会加以考虑吗？

original: The harm to the Van Graffs would last longer - and travel back West.
translation: 对范格拉夫的打击会更加持久，甚至能蔓延到西部。

original: All right, if you poke around the Van Graffs and Alice, fine.
translation: 好吧，你打算溜进范格拉夫与爱丽丝的老家搜集证据，可以。

original: But if I see either one, go into their camp? I'm going to start shooting, no matter what you find.
translation: 但我只要看到她们中的任何一个，或者走进她们的营地，我肯定会开枪，不管你找到什么。

original: There's another way - we can get evidence, let NCR take them down.
translation: 还有一个办法——我们可以搜集证据，然后让NCR解决他们。

original: NCR? Are you out of your fucking mind?
translation: NCR？你脑子进水了？

original: That'd take years... and with the war with the Legion, no way they're going to waste time running up the Crimson Caravan or the Van Graffs!
translation: 那得查到猴年马月……加上还要和军团打仗，他们是不可能再花时间去对付深红商队或是范格拉夫家族的！

original: And what makes you think any evidence can be found?
translation: 你觉得我们能找到什么证据？

original: I'm for that, let's go kill them.
translation: 我是没问题。咱们去杀了他们。

original: Don't care much for which one we kill first, whether settling accounts with McLafferty or making that bitch Gloria eat her hair.
translation: 先杀哪个都无所谓，反正找麦克拉弗蒂算账和送格罗利亚那婊子上西天都是差不多的事情。

original: The Van Graffs are going to be tougher, so we'll likely get killed there. If we go to the Crimson Caravan camp, we'll just need a lot of bullets.
translation: 范格拉夫比较难对付，咱们可能会送命。如果要先去深红商队的老窝的话，那咱们可得多备些弹药。

original: Still, we give the Van Graffs the what-for, that means all those guns they used on my caravan - we can take and use on the Crimson Caravan.
translation: 不过，如果我们能先搞定范格拉夫帮的话，那么他们当初用来袭击我商队的枪，我们就能拿来对付深红商队了。

original: Chasing the dead with more deaths isn't the way.
translation: 杀敌八百自损一千可不是好办法。

original: Better than the alternative.
translation: 总比别的方法好。

original: No... no, I know. Just hard to say how I feel right now.
translation: 不……不，我知道。只是一时间不知该如此形容现在的感受。

original: Are you all right?
translation: 你还好吗？

original: Feels... I don't know. I guess I feel relieved. I don't know what I feel.
translation: 感觉……不知道，也许是如释重负吧。我也不知道有什么感觉。

original: Wait, that's not true. I think the NCR back West, when riled, is going to be the worst enemy the Van Graffs and the Crimson Caravan ever had.
translation: 等等，不是这样的。我觉得，要是西部老家的NCR真的被惹毛了，那范格拉夫和深红商队都要吃不了兜着走。

original: They're all so mired in procedure and paper out there, the kind of evidence we gave is going to be worse than shooting them.
translation: 只是他们太过拘泥于各种程序和文书，我们给出的这些所谓证据，还不如用子弹招呼他们实在。

original: I think that settles accounts with me - and my men. {Beat}That was some tricky political maneuvering, but worth it, even if it takes a few years.
translation: 但至少是给我——还有那些手下们一个交代。虽然用了些政治伎俩，但还是值得的，哪怕结果得等上好几年。

original: You're welcome. Let's go.
translation: 客气了。走吧。

original: So that's it, then.
translation: 那么就这样了。

original: That's it. {Beat}Except for one thing... thanks.
translation: 就这样了。{Beat}不过我得说一声……谢谢你。

original: Not many people in my company would have done what you did for me without some hesitation or asking me to cool down.
translation: 我周围没几个人会像你这样对我，他们要么游移不定，要么就只会劝我冷静。

original: But you backed me, even when the odds were against us. Words aren't enough, but - thanks.
translation: 可你却支持我，哪怕情势对我们如此不利。我觉得言语并不足以表达我的感受，但——还是谢谢了。

original: You all right?
translation: 你还好吧？

original: {Takes a breath}Yeah... yeah, I am. Never realized had all that anger in me. {Beat, cold}Makes me wonder how much more I can settle with bullets.
translation: {Takes a breath}是……是啊，我很好。从未发觉我居然会如此愤怒。真不知要是再给我一些子弹，我会干出什么来。

original: You know, when I first heard about them, I was so mad, but there was this little part of me that said, "you can't do to them what they did to you."
translation: 你知道吗，当我第一次听到他们干的肮脏事，我都快气疯了，可有个声音却在对我说，"你不能用同样的暴行去对付他们。"

original: I say fuck that part. I feel purified, and I love the fact that there's no more loose ends.
translation: 我说去你妈的。我觉得自己得到了净化，这种大快人心的感觉实在太美妙了。

original: Time to move on.
translation: 也该忘掉过去了。

original: Got it. Let's loot the place.
translation: 明白。咱们把这个地方搜刮一通吧。

original: {Grim, pleased}Music to my ears.
translation: {Grim, pleased}这话中听。

original: You sure you want to do this?
translation: 你确定你要这么做？

original: Oh, I'm sure. Killing never felt so good, could almost hear the dead behind me guiding my hand.
translation: 哦，当然确定。从没感到杀人会是如此快意，我都觉得是死神在背后操弄着我的双手了。

original: Now that that bitch is in hell, they'll have a shot at her, too. So what are we waiting for? We've got more work to do.
translation: 既然那个婊子已经下地狱了，那魔鬼也是不会放过她的。所以我们还等什么呢？还有更多事情要做呢。

original: Any thoughts on the Legion?
translation: 你对军团有什么看法？

original: What do you mean?
translation: 你什么意思？

original: Some caravans deal with the Legion now because the security. If towns could get the same protection? A lot more tempting than you'd think.
translation: 有些商队是出于安全考虑才与军团做生意的。要是城镇也能受到同样的保护呢？也许更有吸引力。

original: A bunch of people would be willing to side with the Legion to not have to worry about Fiends and Boomers and Powder Ganger attacks.
translation: 会有一大堆人为了免遭恶魔帮、大炮族与炸药帮的骚扰而宁愿站在军团一边。

original: {Sad}It's not hard for some folks to sell freedom when the alternative is worse. Especially if being with NCR is going to get you on a Legion cross.
translation: 当没有更好的选择时，人们就会卖掉自己的自由。何况现在只要支持NCR，就会有被军团钉上十字架的风险。

original: There's other alternatives.
translation: 还有其他选择嘛。

original: Look... and what I'm about to say, I don't mean as any offense to you, I know where your sympathies lie.
translation: 听着……我要说的话，并不是有意要冒犯你的，我知道你同情谁。

original: So what's the alternative?
translation: 不然还能有什么选择呢？

original: Look, don't get me wrong.
translation: 听着，别误会我。

original: I wouldn't want the Brotherhood or the Followers or the Vegas families running the Mojave, all of them are a different kind of fuck-up.
translation: 我可不想看到兄弟会、天启追随者或者维加斯家族掌控莫哈维，他们都是一路货色，只是长相不同。

original: NCR just has some shaping up to do. Maybe Caesar kicking them in the nuts is a nice wake-up call, is all I'm saying.
translation: NCR只是需要点改观。也许让凯撒朝他们的裆部踢一脚，他们就会醒过来，我就这个意思。

original: I just wish Caesar would kick the heads of NCR, not the feet. {Beat}I've fucked a soldier in my time - they don't need to get fucked by their orders.
translation: 我只希望凯撒能给NCR当头一棒，但不是把他们打趴下。我已经操过一个当兵的了，我可不想看着他们因为命令而去送死。

original: So the Mojave suffers.
translation: 所以莫哈维就倒霉了。

original: Aside from the people in the towns, it's the soldiers that suffer for it most.
translation: 除了住在城镇里的居民，最倒霉的还是那些士兵。

original: Ever seen NCR troops asked to go after gangs at three-to-one odds? That bear flag doesn't make them bulletproof.
translation: 你见过NCR的士兵以三比一的代价去换那些黑帮暴徒的命吗？那面狗熊旗又不能让他们刀枪不入。

original: And  when those gangs were caused by NCR in the first place, like the Powder Gangers? Caesar on a crutch, don't get me started there.
translation: 还有些黑帮本身就是因为NCR才出现的，比如炸药帮。凯撒简直要乐坏了，别再让我提那些。

original: Back to NCR.
translation: 回到NCR的话题上来。

original: Yeah, I got that part, thanks.
translation: 好的，我明白了，谢谢了。

original: So NCR, tries to hold on to everything. They can't, because it's too big for them to get their arms around.
translation: NCR试图面面俱到，但这不可能。因为他们的臂膀不够长，无法容纳一切。

original: They can't guard the roads, they can't put a line of troops around the Mojave... it's just greed that makes the heads back West even try.
translation: 他们无法保护商路，连在莫哈维派驻巡逻队都做不到……他们居然还能在这儿死撑，纯粹就是因为贪婪。

original: So they lack direction?
translation: 这么说他们缺乏目标？

original: They try to put their stake in everything they see.
translation: 他们基本上是每见到一样东西，就把所有赌注都押在上面。

original: Nobody's dick's that long, not even Long Dick Johnson, and he had a fucking long dick. Thus, the name.
translation: 可惜他们鞭长莫及啊，就算巨根杰森来也一样，要知道他的阳具可是相当长啊，所以才叫这个名字。

original: You support it no matter what?
translation: 你不管怎样都支持？

original: I'm not some blind, flag-saluting do-as-they-will NCR lover. They're family, but let me tell you what family means.
translation: 我又不像某些瞎子，只懂得成天给NCR歌功颂德。他们虽然是我的家人，但我还是告诉你什么叫家人吧。

original: You ever had a brother? Some dumbass younger brother, say, who knocked up the pastor's daughter, can't hold a job, and his home-away is a jail cell?
translation: 你有过兄弟吗？这么说吧，一个傻瓜弟弟，把一个牧师女儿的肚子搞大，还丢了工作，最后被抓去蹲了班房？

original: That's NCR. Their compass is spinning, all the time.
translation: NCR就是这样。总是像一只无头苍蝇。

original: There's a "but" in there.
translation: 不过有个"但是"。

original: Yeah, there is.
translation: 有，当然有。

original: What do you think of NCR?
translation: 你怎么看NCR？

original: NCR's my country, and I support it. Anyone who says otherwise, I'll feed them my knee.
translation: NCR是我的祖国，我支持她。有人胆敢说她的坏话，我就让他尝尝我的厉害。

original: I know which side of the firing line I'm on in the Mojave, just so you know.
translation: 我知道在莫哈维应该支持哪一边，也算是告诉你一声。

original: Any other differences between Legion and NCR?
translation: 军团和NCR还有什么区别？

original: Much as I hate the Legion, caravan life would be a hell of a lot easier if they ran the roads.
translation: 尽管我痛恨军团，但如果让他们把守商路，我们的买卖会轻松许多。

original: {Thinking about it again}Well, as long as those companies were run by men. And that's the biggest issue I see.
translation: {Thinking about it again}好吧，只要把守的人是条汉子就够了。依我看这才是最重要的。

original: And it's a shame, but I think there's people on the NCR side who feel more strongly than I do.
translation: 虽然很丢人，但我猜NCR那边一定有不少人与我持相同看法。

original: There must be good parts to the Republic.
translation: 共和国还是有好的一面吧。

original: NCR tries. It's just that trying doesn't mean a whole lot when you're paying your respects to the dead.
translation: NCR是努力过，可再怎么努力，对那些死去的人也毫无意义。

original: And Legion, from what I've heard, they don't do the "stop tolls" on the roads or in the outposts like some NCR quartermasters do.
translation: 还有军团，据我所知，他们从来不会在商路或者驿站里收过路费，不像NCR的某些军需官。

original: You're lucky if you turn a profit sometimes if some new officer gets assigned a route, the fees just get worse.
translation: 能赚点利润已经算是运气不错了，要是某天商路碰到新长官上任，那过路费更是变本加厉。

original: NCR sounds like it has a lot to answer for.
translation: NCR似乎有很大的罪过。

original: You sound frustrated.
translation: 你听起来挺郁闷的。

original: I am. If NCR took the same stand and committed patrols to the roads, then I think that'd solve a lot of their problems right there.
translation: 没错。要是NCR也花同样的力气去保护商路，那么我想他们也可以轻松解决目前面临的问题。

original: But they don't. Caravans get butchered in the Mojave all the time, like mine. And so fucking close to Vegas, you could see it from the wall.
translation: 可他们偏不。商队在莫哈维完全就是任人鱼肉，比如我手下这支。而且还离维加斯那么近，你站在城墙边都能看到。

original: Do they deal with any caravans at all?
translation: 他们有和商队做过交易吗？

original: There's some caravans that deal with the Legion, yes. And as much as it pains me to say it, any caravan marked by the Legion is safe as houses.
translation: 确实有些商队和军团做过交易，没错。虽然我不想说，但凡是和军团关系好的商队，大多都很安全。

original: They guard their roads, their supply lines - even Fiends would hesitate before going after any trader dealing with Legion.
translation: 他们的商路和补给线都有保障……就连恶魔帮的人，在打劫与军团有生意往来的商队前都会三思。

original: All right, just asking.
translation: 好吧，只是问问。

original: Look, not meaning to fly off the handle like that.
translation: 听着，我并不是故意要发火的。

original: What about Caesar's Legion?
translation: 凯撒军团如何？

original: {Defensive, a little angry - hates these guys}The Legion? What about them?
translation: {Defensive, a little angry - hates these guys}军团？如何？

original: {Slight anger}I don't trade caps or supply anyone who keeps slaves, and treats women like Brahmin in those... "camps" of theirs.
translation: {Slight anger}我是不会和蓄奴分子，还有把妇女像牲口一样关在那些……"营地"里的渣滓做任何买卖的。

original: Do you deal mostly with NCR?
translation: 你经常和NCR做生意吗？

original: Anyone wise does. Vegas families pay on time, from what I've heard - even the Omertas. The White Gloves pay on time, but they're... creepy.
translation: 有脑子的人都会这么做。据我所知，维加斯的家族都挺阔绰的，包括黑手党。连白手套也是，但他们实在是让人有点……令人毛骨悚然。

original: Deal with anyone else, though, you're taking a big risk.
translation: 但是和其他人做生意，就得冒不小的风险了。

original: And caravan life's the same way?
translation: 商队生活也是这样子？

original: {Raises an eyebrow}The Caravan fighting here in the Mojave... it's been downright brutal. The amount of caravan space you reserve for ammo alone...
translation: {Raises an eyebrow}莫哈维这儿的商队竞争……实在太残酷了。你还得专门在货物里留下一点空间来装弹药……

original: {Sighs}And if it's not raiders, Powder Gangers, it's NCR tolls. They need to get the money from somewhere, even if it's Vegas-bound.
translation: {Sighs}要么是掠夺者、炸药帮，要么就是NCR收买路钱。他们总得找个方法雁过拔毛，即便这里是维加斯。

original: [Ladykiller] Miss Cassidy... are you flirting with me?
translation: [红颜杀手] 盖西迪小姐……你在和我调情吗？

original: Don't take that as anything more than my words. {Teasing}I bet you're a real sweetheart the way you leave that trail of broken-hearts behind you.
translation: 我没别的意思。{Teasing}我猜你这个花花公子肯定伤透了不少姑娘的心。

original: I know your look, you probably {emph}say all the right things... so we're clear, nothing's going to happen between us. You'd best respect that.
translation: 我知道你怎么想的，你也许{emph}说得没错……那咱们就这么定了，咱俩之间啥都没有。你最好记清楚了。

original: [Confirmed Bachelor] As long as we keep it on that level.
translation: [确认独身] 只要不过界就行。

original: {Frowns}What? {Beat}Oh. All right. {Beat}Guess you've got a Legion outlook on things. No problems here, there's a lot more of that in the Mojave than you see.
translation: {Frowns}什么？{Beat}哦。好吧。{Beat}看来你的思想和军团一样保守。在莫哈维，这种事早就见怪不怪了。

original: Not sure I understand your answer.
translation: 我不太明白你的回答。

original: [Black Widow] Soft men don't stay that way around me, I've found.
translation: [黑寡妇] 我发现，我也和娘炮处不来。

original: Well, don't let the soldiers drink too much, and I'd agree with you most time. Fucking whiskey dicks.
translation: 好吧，别让那些当兵的喝多了，我才算同意你的话。这些操蛋的酒鬼。

original: [Cherchez La Femme] That's... rarely an issue.
translation: [总找女人] 这……倒是没问题。

original: {Frowns}What? {Beat}Oh. Damn, no offense meant. Sometimes I get so drunk, I don't care who I share a bed with, so that's fine with me.
translation: {Frowns}什么？{Beat}哦。见鬼，我并没有冒犯之意。有时候我喝一多，也就不在乎和谁睡了，所以对我来说没什么。

original: My point before? Is that you know the Mojave, and it's a hard place.
translation: 我不都说了？莫哈维就是这样，过日子太难了。

original: How's caravan life in the Mojave?
translation: 在莫哈维开商队辛苦吗？

original: Well, I'm not one for soft living... or soft men, let me tell you. I'm guessing neither are you.
translation: 怎么说呢，我不是那种过安逸日子的人……也不喜欢娘炮。我估计你也一样吧。

original: Well, I'm not one for soft living or soft men, let me tell you. Otherwise, I wouldn't be talking to you right now - on both counts.
translation: 怎么说呢，我不是那种过安逸日子的人，也不喜欢娘炮。否则的话，我也不会和你说话了，因为你刚好都不是这两类人。

original: What, like a courier?
translation: 怎么说，就像邮差一样吗？

original: Well, not as glamorous, I guess - roads back West were safer in most places. {Beat, to herself}Most.
translation: 好吧，也没有那么刺激啦——西部的路大部分时候都挺安全的。{Beat, to herself}大部分。

original: Anyway, occurred to me I could scratch the traveling itch and get paid for it. Cassidy Caravans formed around me, rest is history.
translation: 总之，开商队不仅能让我过过云游四方的瘾，还能赚钱。所以盖西迪商队就这么成立了，接下来的事你也都知道了。

original: So you traveled a lot.
translation: 看来你去过不少地方。

original: Yeah. West, East - and passed through places enough times people would sometimes pay me some caps to take something to the next town.
translation: 对啊。东部，西部——等到熟门熟路了，人们就会付钱让我帮他们把东西带到下一个城镇。

original: So you just started in the caravan...?
translation: 所以你就开了商队…？

original: Actually, it sort of fell on me. My feet get antsy if I stay in one place, like the Mojave Outpost.
translation: 其实也算是水到渠成。我这人受不了老待在一个地方，比如莫哈维前哨站。

original: Was driving me crazy, that feeling of being trapped there, so thanks for that.
translation: 被困在那儿，简直都快把我折磨疯了。多亏你把我带出来。

original: [Intelligence] I'm familiar. Do *you* know what a fish is?
translation: [智力] 我很熟悉的，你到底知不知道什么是鱼？

original: {Suddenly unsure}Well... of course I do.
translation: {Suddenly unsure}那当然……我当然知道。

original: What the hell is a fish?
translation: 鱼是什么鬼东西？

original: It's this... slimy, scaled thing, like a Lakelurk, except no legs. Well, most times. They're like birds, except they stay underwater.
translation: 怎么说呢……滑滑的，带鳞片，有点像泥沼蟹，但没长脚。好吧，大部分。其实挺像鸟儿的，唯一的区别就是它们生活在水里。

original: Anyway, I've seen pictures. One guy even had one above his bar in Redding, except it was made of Pre-War plastic.
translation: 反正，我也只看过图片。倒是瑞丁城有个家伙把它挂在了酒吧墙上，只不过那是用战前塑料做的模型。

original: Used to say it could sing, but I figured he was on a Jet rush.
translation: 据说那玩意还会唱歌，不过我想他是杰特嗨过头了。

original: How'd you get started in the caravan business?
translation: 你是怎么开始商队生意的？

original: Started? Took to it like a fish to water... {hesitant}well, if you know what a fish is.
translation: 开始？对我来说简直是如鱼得水……好吧，也许你不知道什么是鱼。

original: Can we talk about something else?
translation: 我们能说点别的吗？

original: {Slight surprise}Oh. Well, all right.
translation: {Slight surprise}哦，行，好吧。

original: Have you lived here a long time?
translation: 你在这生活了很久了吧？

original: What do I do now?
translation: 现在我该做什么？

original: You shouldn't have gone through my stuff.
translation: 你不应该翻我的东西。

original: Didn't have much choice, I'm afraid. But I understand the sentiment.
translation: 恐怕我也没什么选择啊。不过，我能理解你的不快。

original: Thanks for patching me up, Doc.
translation: 谢谢你治好了我，医生。

original: Don't mention it. It's what I'm here for.
translation: 别客气。我就是干这行的。

original: Let me think about it.
translation: 让我想一想。

original: It's your choice, but those rangers are only coming if we get our support.
translation: 随你的便，但我们如果得不到增援，游骑兵也不会来的。

original: Yes. Tell the troops to come protect Primm.
translation: 是的。命令部队来保护普瑞姆吧。

original: Roger, I'll radio them over now.
translation: 了解，我会用无线电联系他们的。

original: Not yet, but I will soon.
translation: 还没有呢，不过我马上就去。

original: Roger.
translation: 了解。

original: Who did you say I should talk to again?
translation: 你刚才说让我去找哪个人谈谈？

original: Knight, he's at Mojave outpost.
translation: 奈特，他在莫哈维前哨站。

original: Can you tell me anything about this Platinum Chip?
translation: 你对这个白金筹码有什么看法？

original: {Suspicious}Well, no idea why your friend Mr. House wants it, but I'm guessing it's not for the caps.
translation: {Suspicious}不知道为什么你的朋友豪斯先生这么想要它，但我猜肯定不是为了钱。

original: {Impressed}Must've been one huge metal Bighorner that crapped that chip out.
translation: 肯定是从一只巨型金属铁牛身上掉出来的。

original: My guess? Leads to a big cashout at some casino - and if the "38" on it is any indication... well... Lucky 38 it is.
translation: 要我猜的话，也许拿去某间赌场还能换不少钱呢。如果这上面的"38"意有所指的话……那应该就是幸运38了。

original: What can you tell me about New Vegas?
translation: 你对新维加斯有什么看法？

original: Much as anyone else. Cazador trap - you fly in, the city sucks a pint out of you, then you're out on the street.
translation: 和其他人差不多。这座城市就像个捕蛾网，只要你飞进来，它就会榨干你，再把你丢到大街上。

original: NCR makes a habit of going there and dumping cash, only the Strip gets fat off it.
translation: NCR习惯去那儿撒钱玩，反正也只是肥了长街的腰包。

original: Couldn't tell you much more than that. Not really one for New Vegas when there's enough dumpwater bars in the Mojave to last me.
translation: 除此之外也没什么可说得了。反正我是对维加斯不感冒，莫哈维已经有够多酒吧供我消遣的了。

original: {Going stealthy, quiet}Bad guys won't see us coming.
translation: {Going stealthy，quiet}敌人休想看见我们。

original: {Going stealthy, quiet, "We're hunting wabbits"}Shhhh... we're hunting shitheads.
translation: {Going stealthy，quiet，"我们在追捕小白兔"}嘘……我们在追捕一群笨蛋。

original: {Going stealthy, quiet}Holding my breath.
translation: {Going stealthy，quiet}我会屏住呼吸的。

original: {Going stealthy, quiet}Keeping quiet.
translation: {Going stealthy，quiet}我会保持安静的。

original: {hushed, not confident in his abilities}O... kay. I'll do my best.
translation: {hushed，not confident in his abilities}好……的，我尽力。

original: {quietly}Just as a warning, my covert bandaging skills are a little rusty.
translation: {quietly}先说明一下，我的潜行包扎术有些生涩。

original: {Going stealthy, quiet}Staying low.
translation: {Going stealthy，quiet}别动。

original: Keeping quiet... unless my creaking knees give us away.
translation: 保持安静……除非我这咯吱作响的膝盖把我们暴露了。

original: Sure, boss. The old man will crawl around in the dirt to keep hidden.
translation: 当然，老大，我会把这身老骨头贴在地上保持安静的。

original: This crouch-walking is hell on my back, boss.
translation: 这样蹲着前进对我的背可不太好啊，老大。

original: Right, because a ghoul in a vaquero outfit is really going to blend in with the scenery.
translation: 没错，像我这样一身牛仔装的尸鬼，可以完美地隐匿在周围的环境里。

original: Oh, don't you worry about me, dearie, your {gramma}grandma knows how to stay quiet.
translation: 哦，不要担心我，亲爱的，你的{gramma}奶奶知道该怎么保持安静。

original: {Curious, walked into town}Looking to step on your own grave?
translation: {Curious，walked into town}在找自己的坟墓么？

original: {Curious, walked into town}Not every day you come back to your gravesite.
translation: {Curious，walked into town}来给自己扫墓，这种景象可不常见。

original: {Curious, walked into town}Heard the Doc here is a good guy.
translation: {Curious，walked into town}听说这里的医生不错哦。

original: {Curious, walked into town}Crimson Caravan had some trouble here.
translation: {Curious，walked into town}深红商队在这里遇到过麻烦。

original: {Curious, walked into town, "That..."}Hill where you got shot?
translation: {Curious，walked into town，"那个…"}小山丘，你是在那儿遭到枪击的吗？

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}Set an example, others will follow.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}你给其他人做了个榜样。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}Proud of you.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}我为你感到自豪。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}Color me impressed.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}真让我印象深刻。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}What I would have done.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}换了我，我也会这样做。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}You handled that well.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}你干得不错。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}Good job.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}做得好。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}Think that was a mistake.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}我想这样是错的。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}No call for that.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}我对此不敢苟同。

original: {To herself, commenting on player's behavior}Could have handled that better.
translation: {To herself，commenting on player's behavior}你不应该这么做。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}That was fucked up.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}这他妈算什么？

original: {Commenting on player's behavior}Can't believe you did that.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior}真不敢相信你居然会这么做。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior, to herself, neg}Just when I think I'd seen it all.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior，to herself，neg}原来我还不了解你。

original: {Commenting on player's behavior, to herself}That was lower than low.
translation: {Commenting on player's behavior，to herself}无耻之极。

original: {Narrating Her Own Ending}That night, Cass kicked in the door of his room to celebrate, only to find the man on the bed was an NCR soldier whose barracks had been destroyed.
translation: {Narrating Her Own Ending}那天夜里，卡丝踹开邮差的房门，想要与他一块庆祝，却只发现床上躺了一位营地被摧毁、无家可归的NCR士兵。

original: {Narrating Her Own Ending}He was cute, though, so after having her way with him, she got the hell out, leaving an empty whiskey bottle as a note.
translation: {Narrating Her Own Ending}不过，他倒是很可爱，在与他共度良宵之后，她转身离去，只留下一个空威士忌瓶。

original: {Narrating Her Own Ending}As she walked along the Dam in the night, she felt drunk, content, and happy to be alive. {Beat, end on a positive downnote}Which to her, was the whole point of it all.
translation: {Narrating Her Own Ending}她在夜色下沿着大坝漫步，虽然醉意正浓，却心旷神怡，能活着已经很幸福了。{Beat, end on a positive downnote}对她而言，这就是生命全部的意义。
