original: {Narrating Her Own Ending}She was about to tell the Courier not to get too proud of himself, then she figured he knew that already.
translation: {Narrating Her Own Ending}她本想告诉邮差，千万不要骄傲自满，但她却发现他早有自知之明。

original: {Narrating Her Own Ending}She was about to tell the Courier not to get too proud of herself, then she figured she knew that already.
translation: {Narrating Her Own Ending}她本想告诉邮差，千万不要骄傲自满，但她却发现她早有自知之明。

original: {Narrating Her Own Ending}So she laughed, said fuck it all, and raised a bottle to the Dam and the ones who had fought for it.
translation: {Narrating Her Own Ending}于是她仰天大笑，说了一句“干他娘的”，便举起酒瓶，向着大坝与所有为之奋战的人们致敬。

original: {Narrating Her Own Ending}As far as she was concerned, the whole thing was proof that playing out a bad hand can pay off in the end...
translation: {Narrating Her Own Ending}在她看来，这一切都证明了：哪怕开局拿了一手烂牌，也能在最后扭转乾坤……

original: ...as long as someone like the Courier was holding the cards.
translation: …只要这副牌是握在邮差这样的男人手里。

original: ...as long as a woman like the Courier was holding the cards.
translation: …只要这副牌是握在邮差这样的女人手里。

original: Okay children, it's time to read another chapter from The Patriot's Cookbook.
translation: 好吧，孩子们，该阅读《爱国者食谱》的另一章了。

original: Today, children, we are going to read another chapter from True Police Stories.
translation: 孩子们，今天我们要阅读《真实警事》的另一章。

original: Children, today we're going to read more from the Milsurp Review.
translation: 孩子们，今天我们要读的是《军资概况》。

original: For today's studies, please read the next chapter in Programmer's Digest.
translation: 今天的学习内容是《程序员文摘》的新一章。

original: Okay children, today we are going to be reading Lad's Life.
translation: 好吧，孩子们，今天我们要学习《年少今生》。

original: Science
translation: 科学

original: Speech
translation: 口才

original: [SUCCEEDED] I like the way you think. Oratory may indeed be a useful tool in our arsenal if wielded effectively.
translation: [成功] 我喜欢你的想法。只要运用得当，言语也能成为一把利刃。

original: I'll put together a debate curriculum and pull out some of those old philosophy books.
translation: 我要加一门辩论课，顺便找些老古董哲学书出来。

original: Talking enemies down is an effective way to get what you want and save ammo.
translation: 想办法说服敌人，不仅可以达到目的，也能节省弹药。

original: [FAILED] Talking? Seriously? Sorry pal, but nothing is more persuasive than bullets and bombs, and we're the experts!
translation: [失败] 动嘴皮子？真的？抱歉，伙计，但没什么比子弹和炸弹更有说服力的了，而我们是这方面的专家。

original: I could probably put together a debate curriculum and pull out some of those old philosophy books.
translation: 也许我可以添加一门辩论课，顺便找些老古董哲学书出来。

original: I think I can teach you things about public speaking.
translation: 我可以教你如何做到巧舌如簧。

original: Barter
translation: 交易

original: [SUCCEEDED] That sounds good for teaching the kids how to negotiate prices. I keep saying we need to open trade with the outside, but no one listens.
translation: [成功] 教孩子们如何交易，这想法不错，我经常说，我们需要开放对外贸易，但没人听我的。

original: There are some key principles to stick to when it comes to bartering with traders.
translation: 和商人们做交易时，有一些关键原则一定要坚持住。

original: [FAILED] It doesn't look like we're going to be trading with anyone outside of Nellis anytime soon, so I'd rather not bother.
translation: [失败] 近期我们不大可能和内利斯之外的人做生意，所以不麻烦你了。

original: I could teach you some tricks about trading.
translation: 我可以教授你一些做生意的技巧。

original: Guns
translation: 枪械

original: [SUCCEEDED] Wow, our stockpiles mostly included full metal jacket. I should start a reloading class for the children to learn how to make ammunition!
translation: [成功] 哇，我们的仓库里满是金属弹壳，应该为孩子们开设一门装弹课，教他们如何制作弹药！

original: I can teach how to make jacketed hollow points and other specialized ammo.
translation: 我能教你怎么去制造套壳空尖弹和其他特殊弹药。

original: [FAILED] Look around Nellis. We've got a stockpile of weapons, and we've all spent plenty of time at the range.
translation: [失败]去内利斯周围看看，我们有满满一仓库武器，而且我们每个人在练习枪法上都花了很多时间。

original: I appreciate the sentiment, but there isn't much you could teach us when it comes to firearms.
translation: 感谢你的热心，但在枪械方面，恐怕你教不了我们多少东西。

original: I bet I could teach you a thing or two about shooting.
translation: 我应该能在射击上教你一两招实用技巧。

original: Repair
translation: 修理

original: [SUCCEEDED] Hey, that's a great idea! This information might help with our training manuals, and maybe create a few new apprentices for Loyal.
translation: [成功] 嘿，这是个好主意！这些知识不仅能帮我们补充教科书里的空白，也许还能给罗亚尔送去几个新学徒。

original: I've done a lot of machining and lathe work over the years. I could write up a booklet for you.
translation: 我有丰富的机械和车床工作经验，我可以给你写一本小册子。

original: [FAILED] Right... when we repair stuff, we tend to use welding torches and plasma cutters. I think I still with Loyal and Jack for repair knowledge.
translation: [失败] 好吧……我们修理东西时，更喜欢使用熔接气炬和等离子切刀。关于维修知识，我想我还是听罗亚尔和杰克的比较好。

original: Oh the stories I could tell you about fixing stuff with duct tape and bubble gum!
translation: 噢，我可以告诉你们，我是如何用水管胶带和泡泡糖修理东西的！

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Anything else?
translation: 还有别的吗？

original: Well, up north a ways you'll see a big tower. That's HELIOS One. Used to be a power plant in its day.
translation: 向北走你会看见一座高塔。那是太阳神一号。曾经是一座发电站。

original: And there's a town just east of here called Nelson. Used to be such a quaint little place until those slavers took it over.
translation: 在这里的东边有一座叫纳尔逊的小镇子。是一个古色古香的小地方，但被一群奴隶贩子占领了。

original: But we got our wonderful snipers keeping an eye in that direction, and so far the slavers have left us alone.
translation: 不过有我们最好的狙击手盯着，他们暂时还没对我们有什么动作。

original: Please don't hurt us no more. I'm begging you.
translation: 求你不要再伤害我们了。求求你。

original: We'll... we'll pay you. Whatever we got, you can have it. We'll put together a collection every couple of days.
translation: 我们会……我们会上缴东西给你。你看中什么都给你。每隔几天我们就把东西集中一次交上来。

original: We'll leave it under a rock beneath the old windmill. Think of it as a... as a sign of respect.
translation: 就放在老风车旁的一块岩石下面。就当是……当是表达我们的敬意。

original: < Speech 60 >
[SUCCEEDED] {impressed by player's harsh attitude}Damn. Never had you pegged for the drill instructor type, but you got my attention.
translation: [成功] {impressed by player's harsh attitude}见鬼，没想到你说起话来还挺像教官的。你真把我唬住了。

original: You can tell the Lieutenant that I finally caved. I'll... {grudgingly}get help. There's a Doctor Usanagi who's supposed to be good at this sort of thing.
translation: 你去告诉中尉，我同意了。我会去……求人帮忙的。有个叫宇佐木的医生，在这方面挺在行的。

original: You're a weak link. I know it, you know it, and First Recon knows it. Do something about it.
translation: 你现在是在拖队伍的后腿。我清楚，你也清楚，侦察营的人都清楚，你得想点办法。

original: [FAILED] "People" ought to mind their own business.
translation: [失败] 他们就不该多管闲事。

original: Just get the help. People are worried about you.
translation: 找人帮帮你吧，人人都在操心你。

original: Corporal Betsy from First Recon will be coming to you for mental treatment.
translation: 第一侦察营的贝茜下士希望你能对她进行精神治疗。

original: Mental trauma can be just as debilitating as physical injuries. Fortunately, I'm well-qualified in such treatment. I'll make time in my schedule.
translation: 精神创伤与物理创伤一样，都会把人击垮。好在我对这类病症的治疗方法也很在行。我会安排时间出诊的。

original: I'm assuming you're referring to mental trauma. I'll make time in my schedule.
translation: 你说的应该是精神创伤，我会安排时间出诊的。

original: Sterling said that if he'd let his pride get in the way, he wouldn't be in First Recon.
translation: 斯特林说了，如果他也像你这么好面子的话，他根本都不会来第一侦察营。

original: I always wondered about that. First Recon is elite, but the rangers... I can't imagine what it'd be like to lose that kind of status.
translation: 我也一直在想这个问题。第一侦察营里都是精英，可游骑兵毕竟……我都不敢想象失去那种身份是什么感受。

original: Bitter-Root admitted that Usanagi was able to help him with his problems.
translation: 连苦根都说宇佐木医生帮他解决了不少问题。

original: Bitter-Root actually said that? I can't see him talking about his problems to anybody, much less admitting that someone else actually helped him.
translation: 苦根真这么说过？我都没见过他跟别人提起过自己有问题，更别说找人帮忙了。

original: 10 of Spades says his stuttering got better because of Usanagi.
translation: 黑桃十说宇佐木医生缓解了他的口吃。

original: {snorting, sarcastic}He got better? If he says so. Anyway, 10 of Spades is a good kid - maybe I ought to listen to him for once.
translation: {snorting, sarcastic}缓解？这可是他说的。算了，黑桃十是个好孩子，也许我该听他一次。

original: I'm guessing the other two had similar things to say. All right, consider me convinced. I'll go see Usanagi.
translation: 我估计其他两个人也都统一口径了吧，行。就当我信你们一次，我会去找宇佐木医生的。

original: You can tell the Lieutenant that I caved. {hesitating, not used to showing gratitude}And... thanks.
translation: 你可以告诉中尉，说不必再为我操心了。{hesitating, not used to showing gratitude}还有……谢了。

original: The rest of First Recon all agree that you should go see Doctor Usanagi.
translation: 侦察营的人都希望你能去看看宇佐木医生。

original: This was none of their business - or yours. You've got no right to talk to people behind my back about this.
translation: 他们瞎掺和什么，你也是。你们没有权利在背后对人说三道四。

original: I'm trying to get Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor. I heard you saw Usanagi yourself.
translation: 我正在想办法让贝茜下士去看医生。我听说你去见过宇佐木了。

original: 10 of Spades really ought to keep his mouth shut, but he's right. There were a lot of things in my past I just couldn't leave behind.
translation: 黑桃十真应该把嘴管严点，他说得没错。过去有很多事让我难以释怀。

original: It helped. {grudgingly}A little. Well, more than a little. Betsy ought to pay a visit to Usanagi since it can't hurt none.
translation: 找医生确实管用。有一点吧。好吧，不止一点儿。贝茜是应该去宇佐木那儿看看，反正也没什么大不了。

original: You're right - we've never met.
translation: 你说得对，我们是没见过。

original: Good to know.
translation: 很好。

original: Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?
translation: 有什么好主意能说服贝茜下士去看医生吗？

original: It's a pride thing with her, and totally unnecessary. I mean, look at me - I was {proudly announcing his rank and name}Ranger Sterling until the Legion got through with me.
translation: 她就是好面子，完全没必要。你看看我，在我被军团俘虏前，我可是大名鼎鼎的游骑兵斯特林。

original: I was bitter, but if I'd kept my mouth shut, the NCR would've discharged me and sent me home. Instead, I asked if there was still a place for me.
translation: 我也受了不少苦，要是那时我闭嘴的话，NCR可能早就送我回家种田了。但我还是要求继续服役。

original: I had to prove I could still handle a gun alongside all the recruits, but look at me now - First Recon and still going strong. You tell Betsy that.
translation: 我要证明自己的身手和那些新兵蛋子一样灵活，你看现在的我，在第一侦察营干了这么久，而且老当益壮。你去把这些话告诉贝茜。

original: Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?
translation: 有什么好主意能说服贝茜下士去看医生吗？

original: Any ideas on how to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor?
translation: 有什么好主意能说服贝茜下士去看医生么？

original: She... helped? You sure about that?
translation: 她帮你治……口吃？你确定？

original: Oh, y-yeah. My s-stuttering was w-w-way worse before.
translation: 哦，是、是啊。结果我的口、口吃还比以前更、更严重了。

original: Thanks for the tip.
translation: 谢谢你的建议。

original: N-no problem.
translation: 没，没关系。

original: I'm trying to convince Corporal Betsy to go see a doctor. Any ideas?
translation: 我正想说服贝茜下士去看医生。有什么好建议吗？

original: Oh, b-b-because of what that fuck Cook-Cook did? W-well, it's n-not the same thing, but D-Doc {OOS-uh-NAH-gee}Usanagi helped me with my s-s-stuttering.
translation: 哦，是因、因、因为大厨库克那个混蛋吗？好、好吧，虽然不是一档子事，不过宇佐木以前帮我治疗过口、口吃。

original: The d-doc has a c-clinic north of here. Can't m-m-miss it. You should t-talk to Bitter-Root, too. He's b-been to see the doc, too.
translation: 他在北、北边有家诊所。很、很好找，你可以去找苦、苦根谈谈，他以前也去看、看过医生。

original: I convinced Corporal Betsy to get help from Doctor Usanagi.
translation: 我说服了贝茜下士去找宇佐木医生寻求治疗。

original: Yes, the others in the squad said you'd come to them about her. It's a start, but let's hope she sticks with her treatment as long as it's necessary.
translation: 很好，队里的其他人也说你为她的事去找过他们了。这是个良好的开端，不过有必要的话，还是希望她能够坚持治疗。

original: I'm afraid she'll ditch Usanagi early if she feels its taking too long - she won't want to look bad in the eyes of the rest of First Recon.
translation: 我怕她万一知道治这种病需要花很长时间，就会开始抵触宇佐木。她还是不想让队里的其他人看笑话。

original: I caught the tail end of what you said to her. {grinning}Betsy looked like she'd been slapped right back into {basic training}basic for a few seconds there.
translation: 你跟她说的话，我稍微听到了一些。看上去贝茜好像一瞬间被打回了原形。

original: Let's hope that Betsy sticks with the treatment. Knowing her, she won't keep seeing Usanagi if she feels things are taking too long.
translation: 咱们还是祈祷贝茜能安心养病吧，我了解她，万一她发现治这病要花很长时间，她肯定不会再去看宇佐木医生。

original: I wish someone with your medical training had come along sooner. I think she'll actually stick with her treatment because of what you said.
translation: 真希望像你这样有医疗经验的人能早点来。我想她会听从你的建议，安心接受治疗的。

original: I was afraid that Betsy wouldn't go for long-term treatment because she didn't want to look bad in front of the rest of the squad. You settled that.
translation: 本来我还担心贝茜可能会不愿意接受长期治疗，毕竟她不想在队友们面前难堪。但你却把这事摆平了。

original: Do me a favor and let Usanagi know Corporal Betsy is coming. I'd like to make sure the medical clinic has time for her.
translation: 帮我个忙，去告诉宇佐木，说贝茜下士会过去。我希望诊所能提前为她安排时间。

original: Anything else you can tell me about Great Khans?
translation: 关于大汗帮，你还能告诉我些什么？

original: They're tough sons of bitches, mean but not crazy - they'll leave you alone unless you've got something they want.
translation: 这帮狗娘养的可厉害了，虽然坏，但还不至于丧心病狂——只要你没有他们想要的东西，他们就不会找上门。

original: The Great Khans deal in illegal chems. There's a good chance that most chems you come across were made by Great Khans.
translation: 大汗帮主要做毒品生意。你见到的大多数毒品基本都是大汗帮制造的。

original: Why are the Nightkin here in Jacobstown?
translation: 为什么夜行族会出现在雅各布斯镇？

original: {no cure}The Stealth Boys we use have cumulative, adverse effects on our minds. Jacobstown was supposed to be a sanctuary, a place to find a cure.
translation: 长期使用隐身小子会对我们的心智产生有害的副作用。本来雅各布斯镇是专门用来保护我们，并且研究解药的地方。

original: Instead, we wait and wait. I'm sick of waiting.
translation: 可我们等了又等。我已经等不下去了。

original: {cure}The Stealth Boys we use have cumulative, adverse effects on our minds. But, thanks to you, it seems a cure is on the way at last.
translation: 长期使用隐身小子会对我们的心智产生有害的副作用。不过多亏了你，解药似乎很快就能面世了。

original: Why do you think you let Betsy down?
translation: 为什么你让贝茜失望了？

original: She's my g-g-goddamn partner. See, we work in pairs. We spot for each other. W-watch each other's backs.
translation: 她可是我的搭、搭档。知道吗，我们都是两两行动，互相掩护，互相照、照应。

original: Nobody wanted to w-work with me. They said I was too green. But Betsy volunteered. Shit, you don't even know how big a d-d-deal that is.
translation: 没人愿、愿意和我搭档。他们都嫌我太、太菜了。可贝茜却自愿和我一组，该死，你不知道这对我有多、多、多重要。

original: She trusts her life to the newbie, and I sit there and let her get raped by that... p-p-piece of shit.
translation: 她把命交给了一个菜鸟，可我却只能眼睁睁看着那个……狗、狗杂种把她给强奸了。

original: If you were unconscious, how could you have done anything?
translation: 你当时根本就失去意识了, 哪还能救人呢？

original: Shit. You sound like the LT. I should've w-woken up. I shouldn't have gotten knocked out in the f-first place.
translation: 见鬼，你说起话来怎么跟中尉似的。我真该早点醒、醒过来。我不该一开始就被人打、打晕。

original: That shit was my fault. I don't want to talk about it anymore, all right?
translation: 全怪我，我不想再谈这件事了，行吗？

original: Doctor Usanagi at the New Vegas Medical Clinic can help you.
translation: 新维加斯诊所的宇佐木医生也许能帮你。

original: < Medicine 40 >
[SUCCEEDED] Just another injury to take care of, huh? Well, when you put it that way... all right. You can tell the Lieutenant I finally caved.
translation: [成功] 和其他病一样能治吗？好吧，既然你这么说……行，去告诉中尉，就说我同意了。

original: There's a Doctor Usanagi who's supposed to be good at this sort of thing.
translation: 这附近有位名叫宇佐木的医生，他在这方面很有经验。

original: Mental trauma can slow you down or distract you, but it's treatable - just like any bullet wound.
translation: 心理创伤有可能造成记忆力下降，注意力分散。但这是能治的，就像枪伤一样。

original: [FAILED] I already told you that I'm fine. I don't need a head doc.
translation: [失败] 我已经跟你说了我很好，我不需要什么心理医生。

original: Just get the help. You'll feel better, I promise.
translation: 接受治疗吧，你会好起来的，我保证。

original: You should get medical help for your trauma.
translation: 你有心理疾病，得治。

original: The Lieutenant's been talking to you, hasn't he? Look, I don't need a head doctor - I'm First Recon, damn it.
translation: 中尉和你说了，是吗？听着，我不需要医生。我可是第一侦察营的士兵，见鬼。

original: You don't see the others crying about every little bruise and scrape, do you?
translation: 你有见到这儿的其他人因为一点小病就呼着喊着要看大夫吗？

original: I can talk to Betsy about getting medical help for her trauma, if you want.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以和贝茜谈谈，让她去治疗治疗。

original: I'd appreciate it. As her {see-OH, commanding officer}CO, I could order her to get help, but I'd have her agree with the idea.
translation: 我会不胜感激。作为她的上司，我大可以直接命令她去接受治疗，但我还是希望她能打心眼里接受这个建议。

original: {hesitating because player isn't very smart}Yes. Talk to Betsy and try to convince her to get medical help for her trauma. {muttering to himself}I sure hope you understand what I'm asking.
translation: {hesitating because player isn't very smart}是的。想办法说服贝茜，让她去看医生。{muttering to himself}希望你能理解我的用意。

original: What happened to Sterling?
translation: 斯特林怎么了？

original: Corporal Sterling was an NCR ranger until he was captured by the Legion. They tortured him pretty badly.
translation: 斯特林下士曾是一名NCR游骑兵，后来被军团俘虏。他受到了严刑拷打。

original: He wasn't able to be a ranger after that, but his eyes are still sharp so I had him transferred to First Recon.
translation: 后来他就无法再当游骑兵了，不过他眼神很好，所以我把他调到了第一侦察营。

original: What's wrong with Betsy?
translation: 贝茜怎么了？

original: Cook-Cook, one of the fiends, ambushed her and Ten of Spades. They both managed to escape, but not before Cook-Cook raped her.
translation: 有个叫大厨库克的家伙，恶魔帮的，偷袭了她和黑桃十。虽然他们最后都逃出来了，可贝茜却被大厨库克给强暴了。

original: Betsy's shrugged it off like it was nothing, but her behavior keeps getting worse - always making passes at every woman who wanders by.
translation: 贝茜回来后始终都装着一副无所谓的样子，可她的脾气却一天比一天暴躁。基本上就是一看见女人就不老实。

original: It's inappropriate for anyone in First Recon to behave that way. I could discipline her, but I'd rather she get medical help.
translation: 这种行为不应该在第一侦察营出现。我本可以开除她，但我还是希望她能去看看医生。

original: Cheer up, kid. It's not that bad. Sure, your skin rots off and you start to stink like a public toilet after Cinco de Mayo, but... umm....
translation: 振作点，孩子。情况也不是那么糟。不错，你的皮肤的确在腐烂，而且闻起来就像是狂欢节后的公共厕所，不过……嗯……

original: What? How is that not bad? In fact, how could it get worse?
translation: 啥？这怎么能说不糟呢？还能更糟点吗？

original: Well, assuming you survive the radiation sickness, the lynch mobs, and the possibility of going feral, one day you'll get old and decrepit, like me.
translation: 好吧，就算你可以从辐射病中存活，从暴民手中逃脱，在野外不被野兽吃掉。但总有那么一天，你也会像我一样老去。

original: Oh god!
translation: 天呐！

original: What? Was it something I said?
translation: 啥？是我说了什么了么？

original: It's like looking into a mirror. A tacky, cowboy-festooned mirror.
translation: 感觉就像是对着一面镜子。而且是一面廉价的，牛仔风格的破镜子。

original: I can't believe I'm about to do this, boss. If I buy it out there, I want twelve mariachi bands playing at my funeral. A medal might be nice, too.
translation: 老大，真不敢相信我要这么做。如果我挂了，我想找12家墨西哥乐队在我的葬礼上演奏。能再有枚闪闪发光的勋章就更好了。

original: Eesh. These soldiers look how I feel, boss.
translation: 咿。这些士兵怎么和我一副德行啊，老大。

original: I guess hunting down ghouls like wild animals is okay. I mean, they're probably going to die anyways, right boss?
translation: 我觉得像杀野生动物一样杀掉尸鬼也没什么问题。反正它们早晚都是个死。对不？

original: Ah, he's young, boss. He'll bounce back. Unlike some of us.
translation: 啊，他还很年轻，老大。他会恢复过来的。不像我们中的一些人。

original: That wig is going to haunt my nightmares. Seriously.
translation: 那个假发会让我做噩梦的。我说真的。

original: {Hanlon has just committe suicide}See, that's why you should retire before your brain goes. Oh. Sorry, boss. Bad choice of words.
translation: {Hanlon has just committe suicide}看吧，所以说，你得在脑子还清醒的时候赶紧退休。呃。不好意思，老大。说错话了。

original: Just putting this out there, boss: if these Super mutants kidnap us and force us to fix toasters for them, it's on you.
translation: 老大，别乱碰东西，如果这些超级变种人绑架了我们，还逼我们去修面包机。那可都是你害的。

original: Hey, I'm one of you! Don't eat me, eat the smoothskin! Oh, uh, sorry boss.
translation: 嘿，我是你们的同类啊！别吃我啊，吃那个溜光水滑的！呃，哦，不好意思啊，老大。

original: Lots of older people are still useful to their friends and communities.
translation: 不少老人依旧能对朋友和社会做出贡献。

original: Yeah? Maybe you can introduce them to me if we find them, because I've never met one.
translation: 是吗？你要是能碰见他们，还得劳烦你帮我做个引荐啊，我从没见过这种人。

original: I don't have time for a game right now.
translation: 我现在没时间玩游戏。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: Let's play.
translation: 我们玩玩看。

original: Don't worry - I'm not that good of a player.
translation: 别担心——我也玩得不怎么样。

original: No, not yet.
translation: 不，还没。

original: Well, return when you have.
translation: 好吧，完成了再回来。

original: Yes, I did. Here are their reports.
translation: 是的，我找到了。这是他们的报告。

original: Good, let's take a look... Hmmm, if I'm reading this right, it appears that the NCR's grip on this region is nowhere near as firm as I thought.
translation: 好的，我看看……嗯，如果我没理解错，NCR在这片地区的势力已经不再像我过去认为的那么稳固了。

original: I'll have to review these in detail, but these reports have given me much to think about. Thank you, outsider.
translation: 我得好好研究一番，不过这几份报告的内容确实值得我深思。谢谢你，外来者。

original: You've become someone I can count on, so I believe I can share something rather confidential with you.
translation: 你已经证明了自己的可靠，我觉得是时候告诉你一些秘密了。

original: I'm not going anywhere with you.
translation: 我不会跟你走的。

original: {Sighs}Your call.
translation: {叹气}你自找的。

original: I appear to be lost. I'll just head back the way I came in.
translation: 我好像迷路了。我这就从原路回去。

original: Not on my watch you won't. You either go with me to the Elder or I put you in the ground right here. Choose.
translation: 休想从我面前溜走。要么跟我去见长老，要么你就横着出去。自己选吧。

original: So, you're the outsider that's been given leave to wander around freely. Desperate times call for desperate measures, I guess.
translation: 你就是那位获准自由进出的外来者啊。看来，非常时期的确需要一些非常手段。

original: Name's Hardin. I'm the Head Paladin of this chapter, and I think we might be able to help each other out.
translation: 我叫哈丁，是分会的圣骑士长，我想咱们应该可以相互帮助吧。

original: I don't know what the Elder talked to you about, but I can tell you this chapter is in trouble, and he's at the center of it.
translation: 我不知道长老和你谈了些什么，不过我可以告诉你，分会现在遇到麻烦了，而麻烦的源头就是他。

original: Are you willing to listen to what I have to say?
translation: 你愿意听听我的意见吗？

original: I'm still looking for them.
translation: 我还在找。

original: Please make all haste in your search. It is imperative that I know the results of his mission.
translation: 请你务必全力以赴，我必须尽快知道任务的执行情况。

original: I did. Lorenzo's on it.
translation: 我完成了。洛伦佐正在负责此事。

original: {Relieved, sighs}Good news for a change. Your efforts have humbled me, outsider. You have done more than I could expect, even from my Brothers.
translation: {Relieved，sighs}总算有好消息了。你的努力令我钦佩，外来者。你完全超出了我的期待，也让我的兄弟们对你刮目相看。

original: Moreover, I've been going over the scouts' reports and keep coming up with the same conclusion. The NCR is not the threat I've believed it to be.
translation: 另外，我审阅了一遍报告，得出了相同的结论。看来NCR已经不再是我们的首要威胁。

original: We should not have had to rely on your help in this crisis. I believed my actions were guided by caution and prudence, but I now see the truth.
translation: 我们本来没必要如此依赖你的帮助。我总以为自己小心谨慎，但我现在看到了真相。

original: People called me a hero after what happened at HELIOS, but I left that battle scarred by fear, and have allowed that weakness to govern my actions.
translation: 太阳神电站之后，人们都称我为英雄，可那场战斗却在我心头刻下了伤疤，让我被恐惧蒙蔽了双眼。

original: That ends now. I will undo the wrong I have done my brethren, and lift the lockdown. With luck, we will once again flourish.
translation: 该结束了。我愿意弥补自己的过错，解除封锁。如果我们运气好，也许还能东山再起。

original: Please, take this. It is a small token of my thanks, and scarcely begins to repay the debt owed you, but is all I am allowed to give an outsider.
translation: 请收下这个。权当是我的谢礼，也算是稍稍还了你一点人情。不过对于外来人，我也只能给这么多了。

original: This key will allow you to use our safehouse to the northeast. I hope it will prove useful in your travels.
translation: 这把钥匙可以打开东北方的安全屋。希望这会对你的旅途有所帮助。

original: What was the job you mentioned before?
translation: 你之前提到的工作是什么？

original: Interested now? {Beat, nods}All right.
translation: 现在感兴趣了？{Beat, nods}很好。

original: If that's all you wanted, I'm done.
translation: 如果你想知道的就是这些，那我的任务完成了。

original: Well, thanks for hoofing it there and back, even if it was bad news. Wish we could spare the troops to go hunting, but... {irritated}orders are to stay put.
translation: 好吧，谢谢你来回奔波，虽然你带回来的是坏消息。我很希望我们能派兵去收拾军团，但是……我们得到的命令是原地待命。

original: {Tired}Fucking Mojave's going to hell, and all I can do is sit here and watch.
translation: 该死的莫哈维沙漠都要完蛋了，我们却只能袖手旁观。

original: Didn't mean to be the bearer of bad news.
translation: 我并不是有意要给你带来坏消息的。

original: Unless you burned the town, don't take blame that's not due. Things are going to get uglier before the year's out.
translation: 又不是你烧的镇子，没必要为此自责。不过今年的情况真是越来越糟了。

original: Did you have friends there?
translation: 你在那里有朋友吗？

original: In Nipton? Hell no. Town was a shithole, asking to be burned. Just not by Legion. Nobody deserves that.
translation: 你说在尼普顿？逗我呢，那个地方就是个粪坑，活该被烧掉。可凶手居然是军团……他们不该落得如此下场。

original: Town's been attacked, not sure by who.
translation: 镇子被袭击了，但不知道是什么人干的。

original: {Skeptical}Well, if you didn't see anyone, they might be gone - be just like Powder Gangers to hit and run.
translation: 好吧，如果你没看到人的话，那他们大概已经溜了——估计是炸药帮，打了就跑。

original: See what you can find in the Town Hall, there might be survivors.
translation: 去市政厅看看吧，没准儿那还有人活着呢。

original: Legion turned that sinkhole into a graveyard.
translation: 军团把那个破地方变成了一片坟场。

original: Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
translation: 尼普顿被军团袭击了。

original: If I pass through there, I'll check it out.
translation: 如果我路过那边，我就去看看。

original: Better than nothing. {Beat}But close to it.
translation: 好吧，总比没人去要强。不过也强不到哪去了。

original: Not interested.
translation: 没兴趣。

original: Had to try. Smoke trail's getting thicker by the hour - {under her breath}wish Jackson could spare some men.
translation: 一定要得看看。那边的烟越来越浓了——真希望杰克森能派人过去。

original: I'll do it.
translation: 我会干的。

original: All right. {Beat, smiling}Look at you, all fired up and ready to go. Wish the others around here had that kind of attitude.
translation: 好吧。看看你，一副跃跃欲试的样子，我真希望其他人也能有你这样的精神气儿。

original: {Get serious}Listen - I don't want you getting killed for this, so if you head there and run into trouble, I'm asking for eyes and ears, {emph}not your life. All right?
translation: 听好了——我可不想你因为这事儿丢了小命，所以如果万一你惹上麻烦，别和人死磕，只要把你看到的和听到的回来向我报告就够了。明白了吗？

original: Legion turned that sinkhole into a graveyard.
translation: 军团把那个破地方变成了一座坟场。

original: What's the problem?
translation: 有什么问题？

original: Hear any news from the West?
translation: 西部那边都有什么消息？

original: {Dismissive}Kimball's Kimball, not sure which end is his ass or his head. Caravan families are causing trouble, Big Circle getting tense - the usual.
translation: 金博尔依然是金博尔，他连头和屁股哪边朝上都搞不懂。商队家族四处惹麻烦，大商路上的气氛越来越紧张——都是老生常谈了。

original: Look, you want gossip, go to the bar downstairs and listen to a whole lot of nothing. Me, I got to keep watch, {grumbles}then fill out the daily log.
translation: 听着，如果你是想打听小道消息，楼下的酒吧里什么都有。我得继续盯着，还得把报告写完。

original: Why don't you go check it out?
translation: 为什么你不去看看？

original: Got my post. Don't think I wouldn't go, too - if trouble's hit Nipton, town's got enough camping spots to rack up some easy kills.
translation: 我得站岗，不是我不想去。如果尼普顿真的遇到麻烦，镇上倒是有几个不错的制高点，可以多宰几个人。

original: Not about to have Jackson bust my ass again, though, even if I came back with Caesar's head - rather be sitting here than in a cell.
translation: 我可不想再被杰克森数落了，就算我能提着凯撒的脑袋回来，也得关禁闭——倒不如就在这待着呢。

original: Already been there, Nipton was attacked by the Legion.
translation: 已经去过了，尼普顿受到了军团的攻击。

original: {Surprised, not good news}Legion this far West? You're fucking kidding me.
translation: 军团已经深入到西部这么远的地方了？你他妈肯定是在逗我。

original: That's not {emph}outside the border, they're moving in - and fast. {To herself}Nipton wasn't the most friendly town, but...
translation: 这可是在我们的腹地啊，他们来的速度也太快了。尼普顿虽然对我们不是很友善，但是……

original: {Sigh}All right - thanks for checking on that, wish it set my mind at ease, now I'm more on edge than ever.
translation: 算了，谢谢你的情报，本来想着能松口气，结果现在更麻烦了。

original: [NCR] If I can help, I'm here to assist.
translation: 如果有什么我能帮忙的，我一定竭尽全力。

original: {Studying player}Hnh. Maybe Jackson got some additional soldiers after all. {Positive eval, player's not jaded}Didn't take you for a trooper at first, you seem a little... livelier than most.
translation: 哼，看来杰克森还是搬来救兵了嘛。我起初还以为你不是当兵的，你看起来比其他人……活泼得多。

original: All right, if you're here to assist, good, that's what I want to hear.
translation: 好吧，如果你是来帮忙的，那就正合我的意了。

original: Anything you can tell me about the Outpost?
translation: 你能和我说说哨站的情况吗？

original: Not much to tell, one of the worst posts in the NCR if you're looking to be anything more than a babysitter.
translation: 没什么好说的，这是所有NCR哨站里最烂的一个，待在这儿就跟做保姆似的。

original: {Slight frustration in these lines}Full up here, but just enough so we {emph}can't send out patrols. Got to maintain a "standing force," Jackson's orders... {corrects self}NCR's orders.
translation: {Slight frustration in these lines}虽然哨站已经满编，{emph}可要派遣巡逻队，我们的人手却刚好不够。说是要保证"驻防兵力"，这是杰克逊的命令……{corrects self}NCR的命令。

original: Can't spare men for patrols or escorts, so caravans are backing up here like a Brahmin with a bottle in its ass. {Sighs}Typical NCR bullshit.
translation: 无法派人巡逻，也无法执行护送任务。于是这下倒好，一群商队就跟牛屁眼里塞了个瓶子似的堵在这里。{Sighs}典型的NCR做派。

original: Never mind, I'll be going now.
translation: 没关系，我现在就走。

original: {Dismissive}Mind yourself on the plank going down.
translation: {Dismissive}留心飞来横祸。

original: What's the pay?
translation: 报酬怎么样？

original: {Mocking, but not to the player}The pay? The pay is a good goddamn thanks from the heart of the Republic!
translation: 报酬？报酬就是他妈的共和国打心底由衷感谢你！

original: {Scoffs}Just shitting you with the NCR line, done wonders for morale around here. President Kimball keeps saying getting shot at is its own damn reward.
translation: 官老爷们就爱说这狗屁不通的漂亮话，提振士气的效果可好了。金博尔总统还成天鼓吹什么伤疤就是最好的奖赏。

original: Do this job for me, though, I'll do what I can. People know I hate most everyone, so if {emph}I put in a word for you... that's gold.
translation: 不过如果你肯帮我，我绝不会亏待你。大家都知道我对人从来没有好脸色，所以要是连我都对你赞赏有加……那可就价值连城喽。

original: Depends on the work.
translation: 这就要看是什么工作了。

original: I think there's trouble in Nipton - no traffic from there on the roads, and while I can explain that away, the smoke from the town I can't.
translation: 我觉得尼普顿出事了——已经好久没看到那里有人进出了，就算这事能有个合理的解释，可镇上冒出的黑烟也说不通。

original: I'm sure it's been hit - what I need to know is if they survived it. Might be Powder Gangers with all that smoke in the air.
translation: 我敢肯定那里一定是遇袭了——我得知道有没有人活下来。很可能是炸药帮的人搞的这次袭击。

original: If there's anybody left, they'd be in the Nipton Town Hall. Go there, check it out, let me know what you find.
translation: 如果还有人活着，那他们应该都躲进城镇大厅了。去那儿看看吧，有发现就告诉我。

original: Know anything about Mr. House?
translation: 关于豪斯先生你知道些什么？

original: Not much, and I haven't had occasion to look for anything more than that.
translation: 没多少，我也没机会去深入了解。

original: I've heard what most people know... he's said to run New Vegas, he runs the robots, but... well, no one's really seen him.
translation: 我知道的和多数人差不多……据说他掌控着新维加斯，手下有一堆机器人，不过……从没有人真正见过他。

original: Well, except you, that is.
translation: 当然，除了你以外。

original: Of course, no one really will now that he's dead. Good thing, too, no idea what that contraption was on his pecker.
translation: 当然，现在他死了，也就不会有人知道了。也算是好事，天知道他葫芦里卖的什么药。

original: So if he wants to see you... well, that's a rare thing I wouldn't turn down. I'd ask him some hard questions if I were you.
translation: 所以如果他想见你……嗯，这么宝贵的机会我是不会拒绝的。如果我是你，一定会向他好好请教。

original: That hit the spot.
translation: 真是清爽通透。

original: {Shot of whiskey}All right, now for some ass-kicking.
translation: {Shot of whiskey}好啦，现在该瞧瞧谁厉害了。

original: {Shot of whiskey}Pass the bottle.
translation: {Shot of whiskey}把酒拿来。

original: {Shot of whiskey}Now all I need is some shame to wash it down with.
translation: {Shot of whiskey}我只要丢些节操来当下酒菜就行了。

original: {Shot of whiskey}Bottoms up.
translation: {Shot of whiskey}干杯。

original: {Shot of whiskey}Oh, now, there goes the pain.
translation: {Shot of whiskey}哦，又得头疼了。

original: Any idea what was up at the site of the last caravan?
translation: 你对于前一个商队地点所发生的事有什么见解？

original: Not sure yet, something's definitely wrong. They were massacred, we should look around, find out why.
translation: 不太确定，但肯定有问题。他们简直是被屠杀的，我们应该四处看看，找出原因。

original: See anything at the second caravan site?
translation: 你在第二个商队地点找到什么了吗？

original: Nothing yet, but... something's there. Just got to look around and find it.
translation: 还是什么都没有，不过……一定有什么东西。咱们再找找看吧。

original: See anything at the caravan site?
translation: 你在商队遇难地点找到什么了吗？

original: No... still eating at me, though. Wouldn't mind taking another look. Something's off.
translation: 没有……但我还是想不通。我不介意再去看看。似乎有哪里不对。

original: I think we should explore the next one, see what's up. Got my curiosity riled.
translation: 我觉得我们应该去下一处地方看看，搞清楚究竟是怎么回事。我突然产生了好奇心。

original: Let's do it, then.
translation: 那咱们就这么干吧。

original: Don't matter much how we settle this, as long as it gets settled.
translation: 用什么方法无所谓，只要能把这件事解决了就行。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
translation: 我就是关掉34号避难所排风扇的那个人。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
translation: 我就是关掉34号避难所排风扇的那个人。

original: How's the "surface world" treating you?
translation: "地表世界"待你们如何？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: How about a Vault trinket in exchange for my help?
translation: 用避难所里的小玩意儿来报答我怎样？

original: Don't mention it, your freedom is enough reward for me.
translation: 不用客气，你们能得救就是对我最好的奖赏。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: How's the "surface world" treating you?
translation: "地表世界"待你们如何？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: How's the "surface world" treating you?
translation: "地表世界"待你们如何？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: How's the "surface world" treating you?
translation: "地表世界"待你们如何？

original: I could use a Vault trinket.
translation: 我想要一件来自避难所的小玩意。

original: Of course, please, take this! We carried as much useful technology as we could, before our journey into the surface world.
translation: 当然，请收下这个！在我们上地表之前，把能带上的科技用品全都带上了。

original: I don't need anything in return for my help.
translation: 我帮助人不需要任何回报。

original: It fills me with hope to see that people from the surface world are kind, and brave. Again, thank you.
translation: 看到地表的人们如此善良勇敢，真是让我充满了希望。再次感谢你。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Until soon, I hope, outlander.
translation: 回头见，外乡人。

original: How's the "surface world" treating you?
translation: "地表的世界"待你们如何？

original: Kindly! The leaders of this fine community have accepted us among them. They give us food and protection from the outside.
translation: 很友善！这个社区的负责人已经完全接纳了我们。他们为我们提供食物，还保护我们免受外界侵扰。

original: Some people here seem extremely unhappy. They keep talking about getting "shafted," "swindled," and "fucked."
translation: 不过有些人好像不太高兴。他们一直在说什么"不公平"，"被骗"，"操蛋"之类的话。

original: Apparently somebody did them ill, all the way inside the surface-city with lights - the Strip, and Freeside, they call it.
translation: 显然是有人在对他们使坏，那人据说就住在亮着灯的地表城市里——他们管那儿叫长街，和自由城。

original: We're lucky to be here, alive and well. The land's a mystery to us, but we'll find our place in it.
translation: 我们能来这儿真是太幸运了。虽然这片土地对我们来说依旧很神秘，但我们会找到自己的容身之处的。

original: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.
translation: 我就是关掉34号避难所排风扇的那个人。

original: You? Did you re-direct the power stream back to our section?
translation: 你？是你把电力重新导回到我们这片区域的么？

original: {Almost incredulous}We thought nobody would ever manage to get past the radiation, and the ghouls!
translation: {Almost incredulous}我们还以为不可能有人能穿过那片辐射区域，何况尸鬼那么多！

original: We owe you our freedom, outlander. Please, if there's anything we can do for you...
translation: 我们都欠你一个人情，外乡人。如果有什么需要，请尽管开口……

original: Yes, I believe that, outlander. We owe you our freedom.
translation: 是的，我知道，外乡人。我们都欠你一个人情。

original: As I said, I saved you from being trapped down in Vault 34.
translation: 我说了，是我把你从34号避难所里救出来的。

original: {Calming down, just avoided a surprise attack}What the hell was that all about?
translation: {Calming down，just avoided a surprise attack}到底是怎么回事？

original: {Attacked out of the blue}What the hell is this shit?
translation: {Attacked out of the blue}这又是干什么？

original: Interested in... uh... following me to Freeside?
translation: 你有兴趣……嗯……跟和我一起去自由城吗？

original: I'm already shadowing you, aren't I? Lead on, I'll follow.
translation: 我早就和你形影不离了，不是吗？带路吧，我会跟着你的。

original: Ask me to come with you, I'll think about it on the way.
translation: 让我和你一起走吧，我会在路上好好想想的。

original: Not leaving here until my caravan papers clear, or my title goes away.
translation: 把商队的事务都清理完之前我是不会走的，否则我的名声就没了。

original: If you were looking for someone to caravan with, I'd try the Crimson Caravan up north. They pretty much run the roads now.
translation: 如果你想在商队找活干，我建议你去北边找深红商队。现在这条商路基本是被他们独霸了。

original: Don't know, not sure where to head to next.
translation: 不知道，我也不懂下面该去哪里。

original: He's with the Van Graffs.
translation: 他和范格拉夫是一伙的。

original: {Thinking}The only Van Graffs I know are the ones out West - well, except for Gloria Van Graff, and I don't know her all that well, nor do I want to.
translation: 我只认识一个范格拉夫家族，是从西部来的……好吧，格罗利亚·范格拉夫除外，我和她不熟，也不想和她熟。

original: Don't have any objections speaking with him, though if he's with the Van Graffs, he should know I'm not looking to buy weapons.
translation: 和他说话倒也没什么，不过如果他真和范格拉夫是一伙的话，那他应该知道我不是来买武器的。

original: Jean-Baptiste in Freeside wanted to meet with you.
translation: 自由城的杰·巴普迪斯特想要见你。

original: "Jean-Baptiste?" Sounds like someone got knocked out of the good book so hard his name broke.
translation: "杰·巴普迪斯特？"这名字听着就像是某个书里的人物被硬生生从纸页里拽了出来，名字还摔成了两半。

original: {To herself, "Canadarian" is intentional fuckup}Either that or it's Canadarian or some such shit. {Frowns, to player}So who is this... "Baptiste" and what does he want?
translation: 要不是这样，那肯定就是加拿大人起的名字了。那么，这个…"巴普迪斯特"是谁，他想干嘛？

original: What makes the surplus ammo inferior?
translation: 军需备用子弹为什么会差一些？

original: It's all about quantity over quality. Trouble is, you'll be cleaning and fixing your gun a lot more than usual when you use those kind of bullets.
translation: 因为它追求的是数量，而非质量。使用这类弹药最大的麻烦就是，你需要更加频繁地保养和维护你的武器。

original: Tell me about weapon mods and special ammo.
translation: 跟我说说武器模组和特种弹药。

original: Weapon mods are things like silencers, scopes, bigger magazines.
translation: 武器模组就是消音器，瞄准镜，弹夹拓展槽这一类的东西。

original: Special ammo includes things like armor-piercing bullets which don't hurt the target as much but let you punch through armor easier.
translation: 特种弹药包括穿甲弹这样的玩意，威力比普通弹药小一些，但是更容易击穿护甲。

original: There's also hollowpoint bullets which have the opposite effect - you can kill unarmored targets easier, but they don't do shit against armor.
translation: 还有一种中空弹，效果和穿甲弹完全相反——对无护甲的目标能造成更高的伤害，但对护甲就完全没办法。

original: For how long will I get this benefit?
translation: 这样的好处我能享受多久？

original: Stay an ally of the Legion and we will share our loot with you. If you start working against us - or become an enemy - our deal ends.
translation: 只要你和军团保持盟友关系，我们就会和你分享战利品。一旦你与我们作对——或是与我们为敌——那所有好处就一笔勾销。

original: How long will I get this benefit?
translation: 这样的好处我还能享受多久？

original: As long as you don't become an outright enemy of the Legion, payment will continue.
translation: 只要你不与军团为敌，报酬就一直都有。

original: I have some things to take care of before the battle.
translation: 在开战之前，我还有些事要处理。

original: {tense}Then handle them with dispatch. The Legion's assault is imminent.
translation: {tense}那么抓紧时间吧。 军团马上就要攻过来了。

original: I'm ready. Let's finish this.
translation: 我准备好了，让我们结束这一切吧。

original: We've accomplished a great deal, you and I. One last task, and our work is complete. I'll see you in the control room.
translation: 我们俩已经做了这么多，还差最后一步，就能大功告成了。我会在控制室等你的。

original: If you're going to shoot, you'd better not miss.
translation: 如果你要开枪，那最好别打偏。

original: I'm not an enemy, if that's what you're asking.
translation: 我不是敌人，希望能消除你的顾虑。

original: Sorry about the gun. You just caught me off guard, that's all.
translation: 抱歉拿枪指着你。全都是因为你突然闯进来，吓了我一大跳。

original: {apologetic}We got off to a bad start. What say we start over with a friendly game of Caravan? {questioning}You know how to play?
translation: 我们这次照面似乎不太顺利啊。要不这样，用一局象征友谊的商队牌来修复一下我们的关系如何？你知道怎么玩吗？

original: I'm just having a look around.
translation: 我就是四处逛逛。

original: I see.
translation: 我明白了。

original: Did you want something else?
translation: 你还想要点别的吗？

original: I have some questions first.
translation: 我得先问几个问题。

original: What do you know about the other group?
translation: 关于另外那伙人，你知道什么？

original: Got a funny name. Call themselves Caesar's Legion. Never seen 'em in these parts, so I couldn't tell you much.
translation: 他们自称凯撒军团。真是搞笑的名字。我还没在这附近见过他们，所以也没法告诉你太多。

original: I hear rumors, that's about it. Supposedly they keep slaves and they got some real nasty ways of killing folks.
translation: 我听说过关于这些人的传言。据说他们使役奴隶，而且还用非常残忍的方法杀人。

original: But maybe that's just something folks in the NCR cooked up to make themselves seem more useful here. Less uninvited.
translation: 但也许这些都是NCR为了彰显自己的必要性而故意编造出来的。这样就不会让他们显得那么没用。也不会显得不请自来了。

original: What does the NCR keep you safe from?
translation: NCR主要给你们提供哪种保护？

original: Well, the wildlife for one thing. Rowdy locals for another.
translation: 这个嘛，主要是防范野生动物之类的。还有粗暴的当地人。

original: They're protecting their own. Just happens to help us.
translation: 其实他们是在保护他们自己。只不过碰巧帮助了我们。

original: They've been holding off this other group from the East, too.
translation: 他们同时还在抵御东边的另一伙人。

original: Cass isn't around anymore, so I won't be able to complete the negotiation for you.
translation: 卡丝已经不在了，所以我没办法完成谈判。

original: A pity. I guess I'll have to find some other way to acquire her caravan's assets. Thanks for letting me know.
translation: 可惜。看来我得另想办法弄来她的商队资产了。谢谢你告诉我。

original: If you run the town, they'll have to work for you. Food, water, and money will be yours.
translation: 如果你占领了镇子，他们就得为你干活。食物、水和钱全都是你的。

original: {realizing player has a good idea}Shit, yeah. Mayor Cobb - I like the sound of that. Running my own town will give me more pull with the guys at the prison, too.
translation: {realizing player has a good idea}我操，对啊！科布镇长——我喜欢这个称呼。如果我有自己的镇子，对监狱里的那些家伙也有好处。

original: First things first, though. You go settle things with Ringo and put a bullet between his eyes while I round up my crew and let them in on the plan.
translation: 但先处理要紧的。你去让林戈脑袋开花，我会召集其他人来执行这个计划。

original: Tell me about the NCR.
translation: 跟我说说NCR的事。

original: {contempt}"New" California Republic - nothing new about it. Just a bunch of people with money and power pushing everyone else around.
translation: {contempt}"新"加州共和国——新个屁。就是一群有钱有权的大佬牵着别人的鼻子四处跑。

original: They've got troops all over the Mojave, but it's a big desert so it's pretty easy to avoid them if you want.
translation: 莫哈维到处都有他们的士兵，不过好在沙漠够大，如果你想避开他们也挺容易的。

original: What do you know about the Legion?
translation: 军团的事你知道些什么？

original: I've run with some tough gangs, but I gotta admit they all got nothing on the Legion. I hear they stick you up on poles and it takes awhile to die.
translation: 我曾经遇见过一些厉害的帮派，但必须承认，他们和军团比起来都是小巫见大巫。我听说军团会把人活活钉死在杆子上。

original: I ain't saying I'm afraid of them or nothing, but I'll be staying out of their way.
translation: 我不是说我怕他们还是怎么样，但我会尽量和他们保持距离。

original: What's been going on in the rest of the wasteland?
translation: 废土的其他地方发生了什么？

original: Same old shit that's been going on for years. The NCR and Legion are still fighting over Hoover Dam for some reason.
translation: 还不都是一个鬼样子。NCR不知为何又在为了胡佛大坝和军团打得不可开交。

original: Forget I said anything.
translation: 忘了我说的吧。

original: Make up your damn mind.
translation: 快给我下定决心。

original: Free food, I guess.
translation: 比如，免费的食物咯。

original: {thoughtful}Having all the food we want ain't a bad idea, actually. Getting sick of eating prison rations.
translation: {thoughtful}确实，搞一些可口的食物也不是坏主意。监狱里的东西吃得人恶心。

original: First things first, though. You go settle things with Ringo and put a bullet between his eyes while I round up my crew and let them in on the plan.
translation: 但先处理要紧的。你去让林戈脑袋开花，我会召集其他人来执行这个计划。

original: Where should I look for spare parts?
translation: 我该去哪找备用零件？

original: Ha! If we had spare parts, do you think I'd be asking you to fix the damn things? That's rich.
translation: 哈！要是我们有备用零件，还会叫你去修这些鬼东西吗？那我也太浪费了。

original: No, we ran out of spares a while back, and Jack and I have been doing our best to patch the arrays up as best we can. Sadly, we're at our wit's end.
translation: 我们早就没有备用零件了，虽然杰克和我已经尽了全力让电池板保持正常运转，但我们现在已经无计可施了。

original: There have to be spare parts somewhere around the wasteland, but I just don't know where to direct you. You may have noticed we don't get out much.
translation: 废土上的某些地方肯定有备用零件，但我没法给你指出确切的方位。你应该也注意到了，我们和外界基本没什么交流。

original: Funny you should mention that, I have array parts right here.
translation: 真是无巧不成书，我正好就有电池板零件。

original: Hey, that's great! You shouldn't have much trouble getting those fixed up, then. Just stop back when you're done.
translation: 嘿，那太好了！这样一来，你修好那些东西肯定不成问题了。等修好了以后再来找我吧。

original: I passed through a place called Helios One. Maybe I could find parts there.
translation: 我路过了一个叫太阳神一号发电站的地方。也许在那里能找到零件。

original: Are you talking about that damn bright light we've seen blast off to the south occasionally? I was wondering what the hell that was.
translation: 你说的是偶尔会在南边闪现的那道亮光吗？我还一直在想那到底是什么鬼东西。

original: If they've got the parts, bring them on back. We need to get the array back up and charging.
translation: 如果他们真有零件，赶快带回来。我们需要尽快修好电池板并进行充电。

original: Ringo's dead. What now?
translation: 林戈死了。现在干什么？

original: Good. We'll still need a plan before we rush the town. I don't want to embarrass myself and get beat by a bunch of townies.
translation: 很好。但在突袭镇子之前我们还是要定个计划。我可不想被一群镇民暴打，丢死人。

original: We ain't got much in the way of supplies, so if you could shake down the old doctor and the store owner for some stuff, we'd be in good shape.
translation: 我们的补给不多了，如果你能从那个老医生和店主那里敲诈点东西来，我们就有优势了。

original: Once you're done with that stuff - or none of it - say the word and we'll make our move.
translation: 等你搞定了补给——无论有没有，都说一声，我们马上开始行动。

original: I've done all I can. Let's take over Goodsprings.
translation: 我能做的都做了。我们占领清泉镇吧。

original: It's about time. I saw some of the townies gathering at the saloon, so we've got a militia to take down. We get rid of them and we own this place.
translation: 是时候了。我看见有些镇民聚在酒馆，正好可以一网打尽。只要搞定他们，这地方就归我们了。

original: < Medicine 25 >
[SUCCEEDED] All right, that does sound bad. Here, take these - it should be enough. Good luck!
translation: [成功] 好吧，听起来是很糟。拿去，都拿去吧——应该够了。祝你好运！

original: Breathing is uneven, and he's coughing up blood. Possible internal injuries.
translation: 呼吸紊乱，伴有咳血。很可能受了内伤。

original: [FAILED] That does sound messy, but not too bad. I can't spare supplies for cuts and bruises.
translation: [失败] 听起来是不太好，但也没那么糟。我可不能为了一点外伤就把药都给你。

original: Well, there's lots of blood. And bruises. And maybe some other stuff, too.
translation: 好吧，流了不少血。还有淤青。可能还有其他什么伤吧。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Must not be that serious, then.
translation: 那肯定没那么严重。

original: <Lie> I'll need all the medical supplies you can spare for an injured man down by the highway.
translation: <撒谎> 我需要你所有的药品，高速公路边上有个伤员。

original: Are you sure? What kind of injuries are we talking about?
translation: 你确定？他伤势如何？

original: Has this person's condition worsened? What are the symptoms?
translation: 这个人的伤势恶化了吗？有什么症状？

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Yeah, quit it with the crazy talk.
translation: 对，少在这儿扯淡。

original: < Speech 25 >
[SUCCEEDED] All right! I can give you some of my extra leather armor and spare ammo. {pleading}Just don't hurt anybody if you don't have to, all right?
translation: [成功] 好吧，好吧。我给你一些额外的皮甲和弹药。{pleading}不到万不得已不要伤害任何人，好吗？

original: This is your chance to join the winning side. You have three seconds to decide. One...
translation: 所谓识时务者为俊杰啊。给你三秒考虑。一……

original: [FAILED] Look, just leave me out of this, all right?
translation: [失败] 听着，别把我扯进来，好吗？

original: It's better if you help me out, so just do it.
translation: 你给我总比我亲自动手好，照我说的做。

original: < Barter 25 >
[SUCCEEDED] All right, all right. I've got some extra leather armor and spare ammo for you. {pleading}Don't hurt anybody if you don't have to, all right?
translation: [成功] 好吧，好吧。我给你一些额外的皮甲和弹药。{pleading}不到万不得已不要伤害任何人，好吗？

original: Give up some supplies now and you won't get your store looted later.
translation: 现在舍弃一点物资，将来可保你店铺平安。

original: [FAILED] "Maybe" doesn't do much to convince me. No, just leave me out of this, all right?
translation: [失败] "可能"这词儿还不足以说服我。不行，别把我扯进来，听懂没有？

original: Maybe the Powder Gangers will reward you later.
translation: 炸药帮以后可能会报答你。

original: The Powder Gangers need you to donate some supplies to them.
translation: 炸药帮要你捐赠一些物资给他们。

original: What? Why the hell would I want to do that?
translation: 什么？我他妈为什么要这样做？

original: {annoyed}This again. What makes you think I've changed my mind?
translation: 又来了。你凭什么觉得我会答应你？

original: Way ahead of you - I killed Ringo earlier.
translation: 我已经先行一步了——我把林戈杀了。

original: Ringo's already settled. What's next?
translation: 林戈已经处理掉了。下一步呢？

original: I already took care of Ringo.
translation: 我已经料理掉林戈了。

original: No shit? I guess the next thing we need to do is hang out and wait for the rest of my gang to show up so we can talk about the plan.
translation: 没遇到麻烦？看来下一步要做的就是呆在这儿，等我的人到齐，我们就能讨论进攻计划了。

original: {Irritated}Fine. I guess it doesn't matter anyway, keep it. I won't ask again.
translation: {Irritated}好吧。我猜它也没多重要，收着它吧。我不会再问你要了。

original: Would you mind if I listened to the message you found?
translation: 你介意我听听你找到的消息吗？

original: Would you mind if I looked at the message you found?
translation: 你介意我看看你找到的消息吗？

original: Would you mind if I listened to the message?
translation: 你介意我听听这消息吗？

original: Would you mind if I looked at the message?
translation: 你介意我看看这则消息吗？

original: Oh god. He... {sighs}I guess he was lost a long time ago. Even at the end...
translation: 哦，上帝。他……{sighs}我想他在很久以前就迷失了。即使到最后……

original: Still... thanks for bringing word. At least, now I know.
translation: 还是……感谢你的转达。至少我现在知道了。

original: {Drifting, dismissive}Hmm. Unlikely. He was a little too focused on gears and diodes... tech was the cure-all.
translation: {Drifting, dismissive}嗯。不太可能吧。他很痴迷于齿轮和二极管……他觉得技术才能治愈一切。

original: {Sadly accepting}Yeah. Yeah. Thought as much. He'd been fading away for a long time.
translation: {Sadly accepting}是，是。所见略同。他已经神志不清很长一段时间了。

original: {Waiting for player to step out of simulator}What was on it? What did he say?
translation: {Waiting for player to step out of simulator}内容是什么？他说了些什么？

original: {Still a little dizzy}Sorry... feel a little out of it. Head's spinning a bit...
translation: {Still a little dizzy}对不起……感觉有点难受。头有点晕……

original: {Surprise, knowledge downloading}Oh. Oh!
translation: {Surprise, knowledge downloading}哦，哦！

original: {Blinking, just gained downloaded defense programs}I think he left me a gift. {Quiet}Maybe I can use it better than he did.
translation: {Blinking, just gained downloaded defense programs}我想他还给我留了一件礼物。{Quiet}也许我能用得比他更好。

original: {Confused, a little disoriented}The parts I understood? Didn't matter. Past all the garbage, all it amounted to was goodbye.
translation: {Confused, a little disoriented}你是说我理解了的那部分？没什么。去掉那些没用的话，总结起来就是告别。

original: {Watched a goodbye message, slightly choked up}That was... that was hard to watch.
translation: {Watched a goodbye message, slightly choked up}这……这怎能让人忍心看完。

original: {Given a farewell message}All right, I'll watch it.
translation: {Given a farewell message}好吧，我会看看的。

original: {Given a farewell message}All right, I'll listen to it.
translation: {Given a farewell message}好吧，我会听听看的。

original: Where did you get this?
translation: 你从哪弄到的？

original: {Wary}Guess I was right about the bad news, huh? Same look Elder McNamara always gave me when I was up for promotion.
translation: {Wary}看来我猜对了，是个坏消息，是吧？你的表情就跟麦克纳马拉长老要提拔我时一样。

original: Did he say anything when you met him? Anything...{about me, stops herself}anything at all?
translation: 你遇到他时他有没有说什么？什么事……{about me, stops herself}什么事都没说吗？

original: {Trapped only}And I don't like saying this, but the Mojave's safer with him... there.
translation: {Trapped only}虽然我不喜欢这么说，可把他留在那儿，莫哈维确实会更安全些……

original: {Default Choke Node}...it doesn't matter. He died when we all retreated to Hidden Valley. I didn't expect to see him again, no one did.
translation: {Default Choke Node}……无所谓了。他在我们向隐谷撤退时就死了。我没想过还能再见到他，没人想过。

original: Trapped him? Where?
translation: 困住了他？在哪里？

original: You killed him? {Beat}But...
translation: 你杀了他？{Beat}但是……

original: {Surprise, player found someone she thought was dead}You did? Where? Oh my God, I mean... I thought... I don't even know what I thought might have happened to him.
translation: {Surprise, player found someone she thought was dead}真的吗？在哪里？天啊，我的意思是……我以为……我都不敢相信还能听到他的消息。

original: {Wary}But... you don't have a "this is good news" expression on your face.
translation: {Wary}但是……从你的表情来看，似乎不是什么好消息啊。

original: Chairmen, Omertas... a whole bunch of families rule Vegas, don't step out a line as long as money's to be made.
translation: 会长帮，黑手党…维加斯被好几个家族掌管着，只要你不打扰他们赚钱，就不会惹麻烦。

original: Welcome to sin. Watch where you step.
translation: 欢迎来到罪恶之城。小心你的脚下。

original: Watch for NCR vomit.
translation: 留心NCR的废物。

original: Hope you're not here to chase your losses.
translation: 希望你不是来赢回头钱的。

original: Now to find a bar.
translation: 该去找个酒吧了。

original: Don't understand how the missiles could have missed a target like this.
translation: 真不明白那些导弹怎么会忽略这个地方。

original: Beats Freeside.
translation: 比自由城好。

original: Can't believe we got in here.
translation: 真不敢相信我们居然到这儿来了。

original: Dad used to say this place was what Reno tried to be. {Beat}Fucking Reno.
translation: 老爸以前常说这地方是里诺的榜样。{Beat}干他娘的里诺。

original: Place feels like the Sorcerer of Oz sometimes.
translation: 这个地方有时候有一种绿野仙踪似的魔幻感。

original: Heard stories about the Lucky 38, how nobody's ever gone inside - 'cept you, that is.
translation: 听过很多关于幸运38的故事，但是从没看人走进去过，当然，你是例外。

original: Hometown of the Van Graffs, don't care for this place too much.
translation: 这是范·格拉夫的老家，别太在意这个地方。

original: We shouldn't be in here.
translation: 我们不该来的。

original: Water's scarce, but between things like this and Lake Mead, ain't too bad in the West as in other places.
translation: 水很精贵，不过对比一下这里和米德湖，西部的水量还算过得去，不像其他地方那么糟。

original: Watch out for the Kings, they're unpredictable.
translation: 小心猫王帮，他们非常危险。

original: {Slight contempt}Kings dress like strutting girls, all fancy like.
translation: {Slight contempt}猫王帮穿得就像一群花枝招展的小姑娘，滑稽死了。

original: Once had a King following me like I was following you - had to chase him off with a shotgun finally.
translation: 有次一个猫王帮的家伙老跟着我，就像我跟你似的，最后还是我用枪把他给逼走的。

original: Kings told me I couldn't deal water here, fuckers. They like having mono. As in monopoly.
translation: 猫王帮跟我说，我不能在这里卖水，妈的，他们想吃独食，搞得像有专营权似的。

original: Ralph might be able to forge a pass into the Strip for you, you need one.
translation: 如果你需要的话，拉尔夫可以给你造个假证，让你能进入长街。

original: Looking for weapons, check out Mick and Ralphs... Mick's probably a sight better than Ralph, always trying to talk me out of my pants.
translation: 如果要兵器的话，可以去找米克和拉尔夫……米克可能比拉尔夫好一点，他总是想和我上床。

original: Kings are led by the King. Has some kind of robot dog. Guess it hunts robot rats.
translation: 猫王是猫王帮的头头。他有头机器狗，估计是用来捕猎机器兔的。

original: Kings hold control over the water pump 'round here.
translation: 这里的水源被猫王帮掌控了。

original: Not much reason to ship water here, but liquor... hard to meet demand.
translation: 这儿倒是不缺水，不过酒呢…那可是供不应求啊。

original: If NCR didn't grate me so, I'd come here for water resupply.
translation: 如果不是NCR老给我添堵，我就到这里补给淡水了。

original: Used to ship a lot of liquor here, soldiers here have too much free time.
translation: 我以前往这儿卖了不少酒。这里的士兵倒是都很闲。

original: If there's a reason to attack NCR, Camp Golf's a reason.
translation: 要是有人想攻打NCR，那高尔夫营地肯定是块肥肉。

original: Watch out for the Misfits here - 9th Platoon, word of their fuck-ups is legendary.
translation: 当心这里的后进生——九排，他们不着调可是出了名的。

original: Golf was a president, I think. Maybe for NCR.
translation: 我觉得高尔夫这名字应该是位总统。可能是NCR的。

original: Heard this used to be a mine field from some of the troopers here.
translation: 听说这里曾是当地部队的雷场。

original: Each spot for a land mine is numbered, hear tell.
translation: 标出的每个点都是枚地雷，听人说的。

original: {Under her breath}If you're looking for NCR's spine, ain't going to find it here.
translation: {Under her breath}如果你想找NCR的脊梁骨，这里可找不到。

original: Well, Hanlon sure let this place go to shit.
translation: 嗯，确实是汉隆让这地方堕落了。

original: Lot of sites to this guy Golf all over the West.
translation: 西部有不少地方貌似都和这个叫高尔夫的人有关系。

original: Should hit the Big Horn saloon here.
translation: 应该去一下这里的大角酒馆。

original: Heard there's still mines in the city - and maybe drunk NCR soldiers spoiling for a fight.
translation: 据说城里还埋着地雷，而且喝醉的NCR士兵会寻衅滋事。

original: {To herself}Rubble city, more like it.
translation: {To herself}废墟一座，基本就是这样。

original: There's a bar in the intact section, careful if you go wandering around the ruined section.
translation: 在未受破坏的地区有个酒吧，如果你要去废墟里转悠可得多长个心眼。

original: Folks here have access to Lake Mead, fresh drinking water.
translation: 这儿的人能够喝到米德湖的水，清澈的淡水。

original: Careful, Boomer territory. They ain't hostile, but they're a bit trigger happy.
translation: 小心，这里是大炮族的地盘。他们虽然没有敌意，但是他们的子弹却是不长眼。

original: Boomers are a might twitchy.
translation: 大炮族可是相当喜怒无常。

original: Folks here aren't friendly to anyone.
translation: 这里的人无论对谁都不友善。

original: Don't be shooting wild in here - might set something off.
translation: 别在这里乱开枪，可能会引爆什么东西。

original: First time I seen a fence made out of artillery.
translation: 我第一次看到用炮管做成的栏杆。

original: Some of these weapons look like they came from Hawthorne Army Depot, place has a lot of history.
translation: 这里的某些兵器似乎来自霍桑陆军军火库，一个历史悠久的地方。

original: Can hear the screaming of rockets and explosions in this place at night.
translation: 这地方晚上能听到火箭弹的啸叫声和炸弹的爆炸声。

original: Got nests for planes here.
translation: 这儿居然还停着飞机呢。

original: An assault on this place would be suicide.
translation: 攻击这个地方无异于自杀。

original: Shit. Fiends.
translation: 妈的。恶魔帮。

original: Smells like Fiends.
translation: 闻起来像恶魔帮的味道。

original: Can smell the chem labs and Jet from here.
translation: 在这里能闻到毒品和杰特的味道。

original: Make sure you have a backup weapon, Fiends don't go down easy.
translation: 最好留一件备用武器，恶魔帮可不是那么好对付。

original: Watch for dogs.
translation: 小心狗。

original: Heard tell there was a Vault somewhere around here.
translation: 听说这个地方附近有个避难所。

original: This place reminds me the Old World had too much time on its hands.
translation: 这地方让我想起旧世界那悠哉的时光。

original: Named this place after the hotel.
translation: 这个地方是以一个酒店命名的。

original: NoVac's the hotel, not the lizard.
translation: “诺瓦克”这名字指的是酒店，而不是那头蜥蜴。

original: Smells like junk.
translation: 闻起来像是垃圾的味道。

original: Can see Dinky for miles, good landmark.
translation: 在几英里之外就可以看到丁奇，好路标。

original: First saw this place, thought the giant gecko was real.
translation: 第一次见到这个地方的时候，还以为那个大蜥蜴是真的呢。

original: Read a book that giant lizards walked the earth like this one - might be a gecko this size.
translation: 在一本书里看到过，地球上曾经有过这么大的巨蜥——可能指的就是这种尺寸的蜥蜴。

original: Said there's a courier office here?
translation: 据说这里有个邮局？

original: Sign of the buffalo.
translation: 水牛的标记。

original: Ah, Bison Steve, you old shithole.
translation: 啊，野牛史蒂夫，你这老狗屎。

original: Those post office boxes in these old towns still work.
translation: 这些老镇子上的邮箱还能用。

original: Good contact, Nash, used to be here. Had a son that went West.
translation: 我有个联络人，名叫纳什，以前在这儿呆过。他有个儿子去了西部。

original: Old World had cars that ran on roads like these above the ground, 'cept they didn't go anywhere.
translation: 旧世界里有种车子必须在这种高出地面的轨道上行驶，否则它们哪都去不了。

original: The sheriff here ain't worth a damn.
translation: 这儿的警长一文不值。

original: Crazy ass shit.
translation: 他奶奶的。

original: Looks like prisoners are in charge now.
translation: 看来现在是囚犯做主了。

original: No guards in the towers, not a good sign.
translation: 塔上没有守卫，不是个好兆头。

original: Guess NCR fucked this place, too.
translation: 看来NCR也把这地方清洗了一遍。

original: Rest stop.
translation: 可以休息了。

original: NCR's friendly, might be able to resupply.
translation: NCR是友善的，可以弄点补给。

original: A little safe ground.
translation: 一个安全的小地方。

original: NCR flag - not safe, close to it, though.
translation: 有NCR的旗帜，虽然并不算安全，不过也差不多了。

original: I changed my mind - I'll help you with your mercenary problem.
translation: 我改变主意了——我会帮你解决雇佣兵问题的。

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: {Cheery}That's a great idea.
translation: {Cheery}好主意。

original: How did they end up here?
translation: 它们怎么会跑到这儿来的？

original: Well, they unloaded what they had left on the Dino Bite as a tax write-off. But that was before my time.
translation: 这个嘛，他们为了抵税，就把剩下的玩具全都扔到大恐龙肚子里了。不过那是我来之前的事了。

original: Plenty of demand for them, seeing as they're one-of-a-kind collectors items. But I might still have some in back.
translation: 这玩意倒是挺抢手的，毕竟是卖一件少一件的限量收藏品。不过，我后面倒还有些存货。

original: [FAILED] Are you kidding me? I can't ship these things fast enough. People love them!
translation: [失败] 你在开玩笑吗？我进货都来不及，这可是畅销款！

original: But... the price tag seems so excessive on the souvenir rockets. Could you make it lower?
translation: 但是…纪念品火箭玩具上的价格标签看起来太离谱了。能便宜点么？

original: Tell me about the Rangers.
translation: 给我讲讲游骑兵吧。

original: They're the NCR's finest. A one-man platoon, each of 'em.
translation: 他们是NCR最强悍的士兵。每个人都顶得上一个排。

original: You got a job where even thinking about it would scare a man senseless, that's when you bring in the Rangers.
translation: 每当遇到那种能把人都吓得六神无主的差事，就是游骑兵该登场的时候。

original: And if you see a squad of the veterans - guys who earned their black armor... well... you won't find a more beautiful sight.
translation: 要是你能遇见游骑兵中的精锐——穿着象征他们地位的漆黑护甲……呵，那我敢说你这辈子都值了。

original: Well, thanks for telling me. I know that knowledge didn't come without risk.
translation: 好吧，谢谢告诉我这些。我知道，这都是你冒着生命危险换来的信息。

original: Here. Take this, courtesy of the Ranger veterans fund.
translation: 收下吧，这是一个退伍老兵的一点心意。

original: Tell you what. I'll pay you for what you did, but I'll do you one better, too.
translation: 这么着吧，我会付给你报酬的，同时我还打算附赠你一样东西。

original: There's a move we have in the Rangers for knocking an opponent off his feet. Saved my butt a bunch of times, maybe it will for you too.
translation: 我们游骑兵内部流传着一套独特的招式，可以瞬间将敌人放倒。这套招式救了我很多次，希望你也能受用。

original: Let me show you how it's done.
translation: 我来示范给你看。

original: What did you do?
translation: 你做了什么？

original: I go to grab him out of there and I notice he's holding something in his hand. Something metal.
translation: 我把他拉了出来，发现他手上攒着个东西。是铁制的。

original: He shuts himself back inside the closet and that's when I see the grenade he's left by my feet.
translation: 他又迅速把自己关进了衣柜里，我这才看清他扔在我脚下的是个手榴弹。

original: They do it a lot, the Legion. Using kids. They know we'll hesitate.
translation: 军团就喜欢这么干。利用孩子。他们知道我们见到孩子就会犹豫。

original: Anyway, that was the first time. Second time I fell down those stairs in front of the motel. Just in case I got to thinking I'd put it all behind me.
translation: 不管怎样，那是第一次。第二次是我从旅馆前面的楼梯上摔了下来。我本来还以为自己已经能够忘掉这一切了。

original: Hey, just because you're idle and you'll never walk again... I forgot where I was going with that.
translation: 嗨，别以为你腿脚不好又无所事事就……我忘了我要说什么了。

original: {Trying to be polite after getting unintentionally offended}I'm sure it was very inspiring.
translation: {Trying to be polite after getting unintentionally offended}你是想鼓励我对吧。

original: <Lie> I think the attackers were dead too... so it's... hard to tell.
translation: <撒谎> 我认为袭击者也已经死了……所以……很难说。

original: In Ranger school, they teach you how to spot a liar. I don't know why you're lying, but have it your way. We'll protect this town or die trying.
translation: 我在游骑兵学校学过怎么识破谎言。我不知道你为什么要说谎，不过我无所谓。我们会保护这座镇子的，即使战死也在所不惜。

original: Cowboy robot? You mean Primm Slim?
translation: 牛仔机器人？你是说普瑞姆·斯利姆么？

original: Nope. Different fella. Bigger. Had himself a face on a screen, and he talked more like you or me.
translation: 不。是另一个家伙。更大一些。它的正脸上有个显示屏，而且说话的语气就跟你我一样。

original: Cowboy robot? You mean the one over there?
translation: 牛仔机器人？你是说那边那个么？

original: Nope. Different fella. Bigger. Had himself a face on a screen, and he talked more like you or me.
translation: 不。是另一个家伙。更大一些。它的正脸上有个显示屏，而且说话的语气就跟你我一样。

original: One of those men shot me. I need to know the best way to get to them.
translation: 这帮人中有一个朝我开枪了。我想知道怎样才能逮着他们。

original: {edited line}Well for that your best bet is going to be talking to Deputy Beagle.
translation: {editedline}那样的话，你最好和副警长比格尔谈谈。

original: Since they came to town he was keeping a good bit of notes on them, and he was slinking around Bison Steve when your pretty-boy friend came through.
translation: 自从他们来到镇上以后，他就一直在留意他们，当你要找的那个帅小伙经过这里的时候，比格尔正在野牛史蒂夫旅馆附近转悠。

original: He may have heard where they were going.
translation: 也许他知道他们去了哪里。

original: {edited line}Deputy Beagle would have been your best bet, before he met that tragic end.
translation: {editedline}本来你应该去找副警长比格尔了解的，可惜他遭遇了不幸。

original: Since they came to town he was keeping a good bit of notes on them, and he was slinking around Bison Steve when your pretty-boy friend came through.
translation: 自从他们来到镇上之后，他就一直在留意他们，当你要找的那个帅小伙经过这里的时候，比格尔正在野牛史蒂夫旅馆附近转悠。

original: Maybe you can track down whatever notes he was keeping and find some thing to help you there.
translation: 或许你可以找一找他留下的纸条和其他记录，看看有没有东西能帮到你。

original: So what's next for you guys?
translation: 你们下一步有什么打算？

original: I figure we'll hang around Goodsprings for awhile, maybe get some of the other gangs to join up with us.
translation: 我的打算是在清泉镇先呆一段时间，可能会有其它帮派加入我们。

original: Won't kill anybody else unless we have to. Just as long as people do what we tell them, they'll be all right.
translation: 除非必要，不要再杀人了。只要照我们说的做，大家就不会有事。

original: It's easy pickings. Why, you got somewhere else to be?
translation: 挑软柿子捏啊。怎么，难不成你还想去别的地方？

original: Yeah, I guess me and the guys could push this place over pretty easily.
translation: 对，我想我和手下们轻而易举就能拿下这个地方。

original: First things first, though. You go settle things with Ringo and put a bullet between his eyes while I round up my crew and let them in on the plan.
translation: 但先处理要紧的。你去让林戈脑袋开花，我会召集我的人来执行计划。

original: Here - the spare medical supplies from Doc Mitchell.
translation: 拿去——这是从米切尔医生那里搞来的医疗用品。

original: All right! We got all sorts of shit in here. Nice job. Better take some for yourself in case you get hit.
translation: 很好！这下万事俱备了。干得漂亮。你自己也拿点，以防万一。

original: What is this place?
translation: 这是什么地方？

original: All right, here's your money.
translation: 好吧，钱给你。

original: Here's your money.
translation: 这是你的钱。

original: On second thought, I'll be fine.
translation: 我又想了想，没什么大碍。

original: All right, fix me.
translation: 好的，治好我吧。

original: {Drawing out the 'e' a little}Easy, boy.
translation: {Drawing out the 'e' a little}放松点，孩子。

original: Shh...
I'd really like my beret back, please.
translation: 我还是想拿回我的贝雷帽。

original: Uh... yeah. I guess it works.
translation: 嗯……是的。我想它起作用了。

original: You think that did it? Maybe we should test the rangefinder outside.
translation: 你觉得这就行了？也许我们应该在外面试试测距仪。

original: What happened then?
translation: 之后发生什么了？

original: That wicked old Master got what was coming to him, that's what! After his cathedral blew up, I decided it was high time to go home.
translation: 那个老魔头最终恶有恶报！他的教堂被炸毁了以后，我就决定要返回家乡。

original: Who was the Master?
translation: 主教是谁？

original: Oh, he was a nasty man, dearie. You don't want to know about him. He was the one who made that Super mutant army I told you about.
translation: 哦，他是个讨厌的家伙。你还是别认识他的好。是他造出了那支变种人大军。

original: You were a soldier?
translation: 你以前当过兵？

original: {Correction}A spy. Sometimes an assassin. I killed a lot of folks for the Master. {Aside}Yes, Leo, you helped, too.
translation: 当过间谍。有时是刺客。我为主教杀了很多人。是的，利奥，你也帮了不少忙。

original: Where did you come from?
translation: 你是从哪里来的？

original: I grew up in Vault 17. I never even saw the sun until I was 75 years old - that was when Super mutants raided the Vault and carried a lot of us off.
translation: 我是在17号避难所长大的。直到75岁那年，我才第一次见到太阳。当时变种人袭击了避难所，把我们中的大部分人都掳走了。

original: {Aside}Yes, Leo, I'm getting to that part! {Back to player}They made me one of them, and they put me to work in an army that was going to conquer California.
translation: 是的，利奥，我马上就要说到了！他们也将我改造成了变种人，然后就送我去参军，准备征服整个加州。

original: Never mind, I had some other questions.
translation: 算了，我还有别的问题。

original: What do you need, sugar?
translation: 你想知道什么，甜心？

original: What's the best way for me to use your skills?
translation: 你的技能运用在哪个地方最合适？

original: Isn't that sweet of you to fret about me? Such a good boy. I can always help you stay hidden from the bad people so you won't get in trouble.
translation: 居然如此关心我，真是个好孩子。我可以让坏人看不见你，这样你就不会惹上麻烦了。

original: I don't mind fighting - especially to protect you, dearie - but I don't like guns. Give me a good chopper, and Leo and I will go right to work!
translation: 我也不介意动武，尤其是需要保护你的时候，但我不喜欢用枪。给我把好斧头，利奥和我就能把它舞得风生水起！

original: Isn't that sweet of you to fret about me? Such a good girl. I can always help you stay hidden from the bad people so you won't get in trouble.
translation: 居然如此关心我，真是个好姑娘。我可以让坏人看不见你，这样你就不会惹上麻烦了。

original: I don't mind fighting - especially to protect you, dearie - but I don't like guns. Give me a good chopper, and Leo and I will go right to work!
translation: 我也不介意动武，尤其是需要保护你的时候，但我不喜欢用枪。给我把好斧头，利奥和我就能把它舞得风生水起！

original: Tell me about yourself.
translation: 和我说说你自己吧。

original: Aww, someone wants to hear {gramma's}grandma's stories! What would you like to hear, pumpkin?
translation: 啊，有人要听奶奶讲故事了！你想听什么呢，小南瓜？

original: Time for medicine!
translation: 吃药时间！

original: {Gramma}Grandma has to take her pills now, dearie!
translation: {Gramma}亲爱的，奶奶要吃药了。

original: Medicine time!
translation: 吃药时间！

original: There's my alarm - time to take my pills.
translation: 闹铃响了——该吃药了。

original: Hush, Leo, it's medicine time now!
translation: 嗨，利奥，吃药的时候到了！

original: Lily, I'd like to talk to you about your medication.
translation: 莉莉，我想和你谈谈服药的事情。

original: Oh, don't you worry your silly little head about that, pumpkin. {Gramma}Grandma knows what she's doing.
translation: 哦，就别再用你那小脑袋瓜瞎操心了，小笨蛋。奶奶知道该怎么办。

original: I have some questions to ask you.
translation: 我有点事要问你。

original: Such a curious little munchkin, aren't you? What do you want to know?
translation: 真是个好奇的小家伙，不是吗？你想知道什么？

original: Never mind. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 没关系。让我们聊点别的吧。

original: Of course, Jimmy.
translation: 好的，吉米。

original: I think you have me confused with someone else.
translation: 我想你可能是认错人了。

original: I... {confused, realizing she's hallucinating}Oh, of course I have, dearie. How silly of me. I didn't take my medicine yet today. How can I help you?
translation: 我……哦，当然，亲爱的。瞧我多蠢。我今天还没吃药呢。您有什么事吗？

original: Who's Jimmy?
translation: 吉米是谁？

original: Oh, Jimmy, don't you go being silly now! Come over here and give your {gramma}grandma some sugar!
translation: 哦，吉米，别装傻了！过来，给你奶奶一个吻！

original: Goddamn Legion.
translation: 该死的军团。

original: I don't have the caps.
translation: 我没那么多瓶盖。

original: All right, then.
translation: 好吧，那。

original: What's that hum?
translation: 那个嗡嗡叫的是什么？

original: Watch for scorpions.
translation: 小心蝎子。

original: Doesn't fell like the rest of the Mojave here.
translation: 这里和莫哈维沙漠的其他地方有点不太一样。

original: Storms pick up quick around here.
translation: 这里很容易起沙尘暴。

original: Smells like deathclaw.
translation: 闻到了死亡爪的味道。

original: Looks like this place got wrecked.
translation: 看起来这个地方遭到了破坏。

original: Looks like this place go mined - in the wrong ways.
translation: 看来这里似乎在开矿——不过好像挖错了地方。

original: Crazy ass radio signals around here, couldn't make sense of them.
translation: 这周围到处是让人抓狂的无线电信号，根本搞不明白。

original: Place sets geiger counters ticking.
translation: 盖格计数器对这地方有反应。

original: No idea why the highest point in the Mojave is so rad-lit.
translation: 不明白为何莫哈维的最高处辐射量居然如此之大。

original: {To herself}Should kill all these slavers.
translation: {To herself}应该把这些奴隶贩子都杀了。

original: {To herself}Damn slavers.
translation: {To herself}他妈的奴隶贩子。

original: Those dogs look like they could savage a Securitron.
translation: 这些狗看样子连电子保安都能撕得粉碎。

original: We go across that launch, we may not come back.
translation: 要是去了另一边，我们可能就回不来了。

original: This is the only place to cross the Colorado safely.
translation: 这是唯一一个能安全穿过科罗拉多峡谷的地方。

original: I hope we're not planning to cross the river.
translation: 希望我们没打算过河。

original: Only merchants, slaves and Legion come here.
translation: 来这里的只有商人、奴隶和军团。

original: I think I'm going to be sick.
translation: 我觉得我要吐了。

original: Nipton wasn't the best towns, but...
translation: 尼普顿虽然算不上有多好，但是…

original: Mayor Steyn got what was coming to him, looks like.
translation: 看起来斯泰恩市长得到了应得的下场。

original: Mayor here used to shelter gangers, hear tell. Guess it didn't save him.
translation: 据说这里的市长以前庇护过黑社会。看来黑社会也帮不了他。

original: {Confused, horrified}Should we cut the people down...
translation: {Confused，horrified}我们是不是该把那些人放下来…

original: Who the hell was that?
translation: 那人到底是谁？

original: I... hope they don't hit the Mojave Outpost.
translation: 我……希望他们不会攻击莫哈维前哨站。

original: Just goes to show you, no matter where you go, there's NCR trying to hold onto every corner of the world.
translation: 这地方的存在就是为了告诉你，无论你走到哪儿，都会看到NCR在企图侵占每一寸土地。

original: Guess they chose this spot to spy on Caesar.
translation: 我想他们选择这个地方是为了监视凯撒。

original: Poor bastards.
translation: 可怜的杂种。

original: Guess NCR's fish food.
translation: 看来是NCR的鱼饵。

original: Nice sign.
translation: 好兆头。

original: These boys and girls can really down the bottles.
translation: 这里的男男女女们还真能喝。

original: Whiskey and liquor don't last long around here, by the sight of it.
translation: 看来任何酒水在这儿都不会积存太久。

original: Wonder if any of these folks would be up for shots of courage - and a wager.
translation: 不知道这里的人有没有勇气和人吹瓶，或者赌酒喝呢。

original: Be *really* careful what you say here.
translation: 在这里真得*管住*你的嘴。

original: Should have heard stories of the Khans years ago - they were one tough bunch, now...
translation: 我记得曾经听过大汗帮的事情，他们以前很强大，现在么…

original: Khans lost their strength after Bitter Springs, came here to lick their wounds.
translation: 大汗帮在苦泉之战后元气大伤，只能躲到这里苟延残喘。

original: Let's not split up here, all right?
translation: 千万别在这里落单，懂么？

original: Don't take any chems here - hell knows what they're laced with.
translation: 别嗑这里的药，谁知道里面掺了些什么东西。

original: Won't trade with Khans - they've poisoned most of the villages west of Vegas with chems.
translation: 别和大汗帮做生意，他们用毒品坑害了维加斯西部大多数的村庄。

original: Fiends would suffer withdrawal and die without the Khans.
translation: 没有大汗帮，恶魔帮肯定是没有活路的。

original: Place would be beautiful... without the chem addicts and dealers.
translation: 这是个美丽的地方…如果没有瘾君子和毒贩的话。

original: |Annihilation| {To herself}Guess someone had to put them down.
translation: |Annihilation|{To herself}真该有个人来干掉他们。

original: Have a Vegas-style boxing ring in the center there.
translation: 中心有个维加斯风格的搏击台。

original: Really wish we could go to some civilized places.
translation: 真希望我们能去个文明点的地方。

original: Even the flies here are chemed.
translation: 这里甚至连苍蝇都有药瘾了。

original: God, you can smell the Brahmin shit from the jet all over this place.
translation: 天哪，这里你到处都可以闻到杰特味儿的双头牛粪便。

original: {Shivers}Place is fucking cold.
translation: {Shivers}这地方真他妈的冷。

original: Pine trees?
translation: 松树？

original: {Frowns}Can't believe we're in a refuge for crazy super mutants.
translation: {Frowns}真不敢相信我们正在一所专门收容疯狂超级变种人的避难所里。

original: Wish I'd packed a jacket.
translation: 我真该带件外套的。

original: Only seen snow, not walked through it. Crazy - frozen water? Should package this shit.
translation: 只见过雪，但从未在上面走过。太可怕了，冻起来的水？我真该包一点回去。

original: Heard they could make "ice" in the Old World and carry it around.
translation: 据说在旧世界，他们可以自己造"冰"，还能带着到处走。

original: {Skeptical}Dad used to say that in the Old World, people would put boards on their feet and soar down the mountains.
translation: {Skeptical}老爸过去经常说，在旧世界，他们会在脚下放个板子，然后顺着雪滑下山去。

original: {Slight irritation}Back here again?
translation: {Slight irritation}又回到这里了？

original: {Slight sarcasm}What, didn't see enough of the sites here the first time?
translation: {Slight sarcasm}怎么，难道以前还没看够么？

original: Once here, most just stall out, can't go deeper into territory.
translation: 不少人到了这里就被拦住了，无法再往前进入NCR的领地。

original: Fucking monument.
translation: 他妈的纪念碑。

original: From here, it's Nipton to the east or Primm to the north.
translation: 从这里看，东边是尼普顿，北边是普瑞姆。

original: And here's the slice of the world where NCR's hands start slipping.
translation: 这里就是NCR最初开始实现野心的地方了。

original: Check out those guns - rumor had it they used to shoot planes down before the war.
translation: 瞧瞧那些大炮——据说在战前，它们是用来打飞机的。

original: {To herself}Place looks like how my bladder feels.
translation: {To herself}这地方看得我有种想要一泻千里的感觉。

original: Place always wants me to take a piss.
translation: 这地方让我想撒尿。

original: Ever look down the Dam? Sends your head spinning.
translation: 你有没有从水坝上往下看过？能把你弄晕。

original: Heard NCR recon fucked up here once, with the Khans.
translation: 听说NCR的侦察兵和大汗帮的部队曾在此曾有过一场激战。

original: Heard NCR drove the Khans out of here, to Red Rock.
translation: 听说NCR把大汗帮的部队从这里一直赶到红岩峡谷。

original: Place stinks of sand, piss, and vomit.
translation: 这地方到处都是沙子、排泄物与恶臭。

original: Refugees.
translation: 难民。

original: Watch out - easy to get sick around here.
translation: 小心——在这周围很容易得病。

original: Can't belive we're fucking back here.
translation: 不敢相信我们他妈的又回到这里了。

original: Testing our luck coming back here.
translation: 咱们回来是为了看自己是否命大的吧。

original: You sure you know what you're doing?
translation: 你确定你知道自己在做什么吗？

original: They try and put one of those Brahmin packs on me, they're asking for a gelding. Going to get gelded.
translation: 他们要是敢把双头牛背上的行李挪到我身上，那他们就是嫌老二太长了。我得帮他们净净身。

original: Can't say I've seen a smile on anyone's face since we arrived.
translation: 来这儿之后，我就还没看过一张笑脸。

original: Hope NCR wipes Caesar off the map.
translation: 希望NCR能把凯撒从地图上抹掉。

original: Guess the tent belongs to the big man.
translation: 看来这帐篷是个大人物的。

original: Not much future in the Legion if you don't have a dick.
translation: 要是你不带把的话，那你在军团里的前途可堪忧啊。

original: I'm heading back West if Caesar moves on the Dam.
translation: 如果凯撒进军水坝，我就回西部去。

original: Not looking forward to being a Legion wife.
translation: 我可不想给军团士兵当老婆。

original: Be damn careful here.
translation: 这里最好小心点。

original: Don't like the way the men are looking at me.
translation: 我不喜欢那些男人看我的眼神。

original: {Muttering}Keep your eyes to yourself, Legion asshole.
translation: {Muttering}管好自己的两只眼睛，军团的混蛋。

original: Can't believe you want to talk to this guy.
translation: 不敢相信你居然想跟这个人说话。

original: {Sarcastic, looking at crucifix}Love how he's decorated the place.
translation: {Sarcastic，looking at crucifix}我喜欢这地方的装饰。

original: Women might as well be dirt... not anxious to join them.
translation: 女人在他们眼中就如尘土……我可不想和她们一样。

original: Wish these women would take knives to Caesar's troops in their beds.
translation: 真希望这些女的在上凯撒士兵的床时能带把刀。

original: {somber}Guess the miners got fucked.
translation: {somber}看来矿工们全完了。

original: Where's the mine from here?
translation: 矿场在哪呢？

original: {Wary, somber}If this place got hit, Novac's next.
translation: {Wary，somber}如果这个地方遭到攻击，那下一个就轮到诺瓦克了。

original: Another proud NCR camp.
translation: 又一个自大的NCR营地。

original: Probably chose this place because of the water supply.
translation: 选择这地方大概是因为这里有淡水供应。

original: Morale looks low.
translation: 士气好像并不高。

original: I smell Hydra in the air, just a whiff.
translation: 我在空气中闻到了九头蛇的味道，不过只有一点点。

original: "The Street" - Vegas Boulevard.
translation: "那条街"就是维加斯大道。

original: Fancy town... let's hit some bars.
translation: 地方不赖…我们去找间酒吧好了。
