translation: 你把我的武器放哪儿了？

original: They'll be handled with the utmost security in our bank.
translation: 它们会被存放在我们最可靠的保险柜里。

original: [Attack] Looks like I'll have to kill you, then.
translation: [攻击] 那我只好杀了你了。

original: Well, I never.
translation: 哎呀，做你的梦。

original: Could I trouble you to blow it out your ass?
translation: 能麻烦你把屁放得再响点吗？

original: {Offended}How frightfully uncouth. I'm afraid I must insist you relinquish your weapons.
translation: {Offended}您的用词真是太无礼了。我执意要求您交出武器。

original: Why do you need my guns?
translation: 你为什么要拿走我的枪？

original: I'm afraid those are the rules. If you don't like it you can take your business elsewhere.
translation: 很遗憾，我们的规定就是这样。如果您不喜欢，那就只好请您去照顾别家的生意了。

original: <Keep holdout weapons> Sure, here you go.
translation: <保留可藏匿武器> 当然，给你。

original: My deepest apologies for the slightest inconvenience. You have my assurance that everything will be returned upon your departure.
translation: 若给您带来轻微不便，我在此向您表示最诚挚的歉意。我保证在您离开时，所有财物都会悉数奉还。

original: But we simply can't have anyone waving their weapons around in the hotel.  It's not the atmosphere we wish to cultivate.
translation: 我们并不希望有人在酒店里携带武器。那会破坏我们极力想要营造的高雅氛围。

original: Please, enjoy your stay.
translation: 祝您过得愉快。

original: Sure, here you go.
translation: 当然，给你。

original: My deepest apologies for the slightest inconvenience. You have my assurance that everything will be returned upon your departure.
translation: 若给您带来轻微不便，我在此向您表示最诚挚的歉意。我保证在您离开时，所有财物都会悉数奉还。

original: But we simply can't have anyone waving their weapons around in the hotel.  It's not the atmosphere we wish to cultivate.
translation: 我们并不希望有人在酒店里携带武器。那会破坏我们极力想要营造的高雅氛围。

original: Please, enjoy your stay.
translation: 祝您过得愉快。

original: <Upgrade Status::Verification>
translation: <升级状态：：确认>

original: Why don't you want the Brotherhood to have it?
translation: 为什么你不希望兄弟会得到它？

original: The Brotherhood{Spoke with distain} is all about keeping technology to themselves, and using what they find to protect themselves.
translation: 兄弟会{Spoke with distain}只会把科技据为己有，为了自保，他们无所不用其极。

original: They are isolationist and belligerent. I have no doubt that they plan to use the data for weapons research.
translation: 他们都是孤立主义者和战争贩子。我毫不怀疑他们会把这些数据用于武器研究。

original: Ok, you can take it for a little while.
translation: 好吧，那我就把它借给你一段时间。

original: Thank you. I'll get it back to you as soon as I can with the upgraded weapons systems.
translation: 谢谢你。等我升级了武器系统，我会马上把它还给你。

original: What are you going to do with it?
translation: 你会对它做什么呢？

original: First I'm going to pull off whatever log data I can. Then, I'll use some of the tech around here to upgrade its weapons systems.
translation: 首先，我会将所有日志全都提取出来。然后，我会利用这里的技术升级它的武器系统。

original: Shouldn't be more than a few days work.
translation: 用不了几天时间的。

original: What would you like it for?
translation: 你想要拿它做什么呢？

original: I've heard through our channels that it has some research that may be related to Enclave and Poseidon Energy technology.
translation: 我从自己人那里听说，它储存了一些与英克雷及海神能源计划有关的研究数据。

original: I'd like to get what I can from it and use that data for the good of humanity... ALL of humanity, unlike the Brotherhood.
translation: 我想提取这些数据，用来造福人类……是全体人类，不像兄弟会。

original: Can you tell me about the followers?
translation: 你能和我说说天启追随者吗？

original: There are plenty of people here to talk to you about us and our mission. Let's get to brass tacks and talk about that robot.
translation: 想了解我们，或者我们的使命，这儿有很多人可以告诉你。咱们还是说正经的，聊聊你那个机器人吧。

original: I'll have to think on this more.
translation: 我需要再考虑考虑。

original: {Sad}Okay, but I'd really like to take a look at him. Remember, I'll be able to give his armor some extra plating while I've got him here.
translation: {Sad}好吧，可我真的想好好研究它一下。记着，我可以给它的护甲加装额外保护。

original: Step closer to the demonstration area, please!
translation: 请上前到演示区来！

original: Okay, so you're familiar with Securitrons by now, obviously! I mean, some of your best friends are Securitrons, right?{chuckle}
translation: 好的，想必你对电子保安已经很熟悉了。毕竟你最要好的朋友里就有一位电子保安，不是吗？

original: Our titanium alloy housing does a good job of protecting our delicate electronic insides from small arms fire and shrapnel!
translation: 我们的钛合金外壳提供了极佳的防护，可以使内部的精密元器件承受住轻武器和榴弹的打击。

original: Our left arm contains an X-25 gatling laser, quite deadly against soft targets at medium range. That looks like fun!
translation: 我们的左臂还安装了一挺X-25激光加特林，能对中等距离的普通目标给予致命打击。很有趣吧！

original: And for close-range suppression and crowd control, we have this handy-dandy 9mm submachinegun! Nice!
translation: 而针对近距离的火力压制和镇压暴乱，我们还别出心裁地装备了9毫米冲锋枪！漂亮吧！

original: All of this is old hat, right?
translation: 不过这些玩意都老掉牙了，对吧？

original: Here's where it gets interesting! Turns out those are our {emph}secondary weapons!
translation: 接下来才是重头戏！上面提到的这些其实都只是我们的辅助武器！

original: All this time we've been running the {emph}Mark I operating system, which doesn't have drivers for our primary weapons! Imagine!
translation: 长期以来，我们使用的都是I型操作系统，这个系统居然没有预装主武器的驱动程序！难以置信吧！

original: Now watch this - I'm downloading the Mark II OS to all the Securitrons on the network. Makes quite a difference!
translation: 现在看好了，我正在为所有已联网的电子保安下载II型操作系统。咱们马上就要改头换面了！

original: With the M-235 Missile Launcher, we can engage ground and air targets at long range!
translation: 有了M-235导弹发射器，我们就可以从远距离对地面和空中目标发动有效打击！

original: And a rapid-fire G-28 grenade launching system makes us deadly in close-range engagements! Whoo, look at that!
translation: 而高速G-28榴弹发射系统将会令我们在近距离交战中所向披靡！喔，你瞧啊！

original: The OS upgrade also includes drivers for our onboard auto-repair systems! Just try to hurt us now!
translation: 系统升级包中还内置了自我修复系统的驱动程序！现在看谁还敢欺负我们！

original: All together, this {emph}software upgrade confers a 235% increase in combat effectiveness - per unit!
translation: 综上所述，这次的升级将会令每个单位的作战效率提升235%！

original: New Vegas finally has soldiers worthy of protecting it!
translation: 新维加斯终于迎来了一批骁勇善战的保卫者！

original: I hope you enjoyed this demonstration! You can come back up and see me or be on your way - I know you're a busy person!
translation: 希望你喜欢这个演示！你可以回来找我了，当然你也可以随时离开——我知道你是个大忙人！

original: What do I do?
translation: 我该怎么做？

original: All you have to do is destroy the power generators! Without the generators, Hoover Dam's just a big bunch of concrete!
translation: 你只要摧毁发电机组就行了！一旦发电机失效，胡佛水坝就只剩下一堆混凝土了！

original: Take this override module - it's just like the one you used at the El Dorado Substation.
translation: 拿着这个强制覆写模组，这和你在埃尔多拉多变电站用过的那个一模一样。

original: Install the override module on the terminal in the power control room! I'll disable the generator failsafes, and you can do the rest.
translation: 将模组安装到电力控制室的终端上！我会关掉发电机组的故障保险系统，剩下的就交给你了。

original: Good luck! See you at the dam!
translation: 祝你好运！水坝上见！

original: You want me to destroy Hoover Dam?
translation: 你想让我摧毁胡佛水坝？

original: Not the whole thing, thank goodness! That'd be really hard!
translation: 不是让你整个炸掉，我的天哪！那可就太困难了！

original: Fine, just tell me how.
translation: 好吧，告诉怎么做。

original: The dam is too valuable to destroy!
translation: 水坝太珍贵了，不能摧毁啊！

original: That's exactly why this will work! Just hear me out...
translation: 所以这计划才能奏效嘛！你听我说……

original: What are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么？

original: You remember how the Securitron army at the Fort got destroyed? For very, very good reasons, of course...
translation: 你还记得堡垒里的机器人部队是如何覆灭的吗？当然，理由非常、非常充分……

original: Well, the problem is that's left us with enough Securitrons to drive off a weakened NCR force -  but not enough to keep them from coming back!
translation: 没错，问题就在于我们剩下的这些机器人只够将NCR的残留部队赶出这里——却无法阻止他们卷土重来！

original: So what we do is take away the whole reason why they'd want to come back! Smart, huh?
translation: 所以我们得制造个理由，让他们不会再回来了！你觉得如何？

original: Just tell me what to do.
translation: 告诉我怎么做。

original: I wish I could, but I'm neuro-computationally incapable of making decisions like this one! It's up to you!
translation: 我也想告诉你该怎么做，可我的神经演算根本无法作出决定！只能靠你自己了！

original: What sort of options?
translation: 有哪些办法可以选？

original: You could rout the dam's power output to the facility under Fortification Hill. That'll restart its reactor, just like you did with the Lucky 38!
translation: 你可以将水坝的电力输出转移至堡垒山下的工厂中。那样就能重启整个反应堆，就像你对幸运38所做的一样！

original: That'll wake up the Securitron army you left on standby and give us enough force to push the Legion {emph}and the NCR straight out of the Mojave!
translation: 然后，那些还在待命的机器人部队就会苏醒，我们就能有足够的兵力，将军团连同NCR一块儿赶出莫哈维！

original: The other option is destroy the dam's generators. Without those, it's just a big bunch of concrete! The NCR won't have any reason to stick around!
translation: 另一个选择是摧毁水坝的发电机组。一旦机组被毁，这里留下的就只又一堆混凝土而已。NCR也就失去了在此屯兵的价值。

original: You don't have to decide yet! For now, all you have to do is take this override module and install it on the terminal in the power control room!
translation: 用不着马上决定！现在，你要做的就是将这个强制覆写模组安装到电力控制室的终端上。

original: {DUPLICATE?}Good luck! See you at the dam!
translation: {DUPLICATE?}祝你好运！水坝上见！

original: I have some things to take care of before the battle at Hoover Dam.
translation: 胡佛水坝之战开始前，我还有些事情要做。

original: Forget the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam.
translation: 不要管天启追随者了。水坝之战我已经准备好了。

original: I've already made arrangements with the Followers. I'm ready to fight at the dam.
translation: 我已经和天启追随者达成了协议，水坝的战斗我也准备好了。

original: Great! So I've been looking over Mr. House's force projections and running some calculations...
translation: 太棒了！我刚刚查阅了豪斯先生就双方兵力所作的评估，还进行了一番运算……

original: It turns out there are two ways we can win this thing! Hear that? We have options!
translation: 结果是，我们有两种方法可以取胜！听见没？我们有得选！

original: Great! So I've been looking over Mr. House's force projections and running some calculations...
translation: 太棒了！我刚刚查阅了豪斯先生就双方兵力所作的评估，又进行了一番运算……

original: It turns out there's only one way for us to win this battle and make it stick! We have to render Hoover Dam inoperable!
translation: 结果是，我们只有一种方法可以彻底取胜！那就是废掉整座胡佛水坝！

original: All right, I'll go talk to the Followers.
translation: 好吧，我去和天启追随者的人谈谈。

original: Wonderful! I'll keep tabs on the situation at the dam! See you in a bit!
translation: 好极了！我会继续关注水坝那边的形势的！路上小心！

original: I have a few things to take care of before the battle at Hoover Dam.
translation: 胡佛水坝之战开始前，我还有些事情要做。

original: Sure, no problem! So long as the Legion doesn't attack before you can get there! Which I'm sure they won't!
translation: 当然，没问题！只要军团不比你先到，那就没关系！我相信他们没那么快的！

original: What is the final phase of the plan?
translation: 计划的最终阶段是什么？

original: {upbeat}Well, the Legion is going to attack Hoover Dam one of these days! And the NCR is going to defend it!
translation: {upbeat}嗯，军团过不了多久一定会进攻胡佛水坝的！而NCR肯定会全力防守！

original: {upbeat}One side will lose, and the other will win! But the side that wins will be weak, because a lot of its soldiers will be dead!
translation: {upbeat}既然是打仗，就必然有一方会输、一方会赢！而赢的那一方必将变得孱弱，因为损失了大量兵力！

original: {upbeat}That's when all our Securitrons will show up! We'll declare an Independent Vegas, and tell the side that won the dam - to scram!
translation: {upbeat}那时，我们的机器人部队就伺机而动，上演一出渔翁得利的好戏！维加斯将趁机宣告独立，而占领水坝的那一方——也得卷包袱走人！

original: {upbeat}Or the Securitrons will kill all of them, too!
translation: {upbeat}否则，我们的机器人也将把他们杀得片甲不留！

original: Here, take a look at this print-out. It covers all the details!
translation: 来，你看看这份打印稿，上面列出了所有细节！

original: This print-out describes the situation in more detail!
translation: 这份文件已经把所有事情交待得一清二楚了！

original: Take this print-out. It'll tell you what to do!
translation: 拿着这份打印稿。它会告诉你该怎么做的！

original: Here's another one of my print-outs! Read up!
translation: 这是另一张打印稿！研究一下吧！

original: This print-out covers everything you need to know!
translation: 这张打印稿上有你想要知道的一切东西！

original: Take a look at this print-out. I may have said things wrong a moment ago.
translation: 看看这张打印稿吧。我刚才说的可能不太对。

original: Here's a print-out with some additional information.
translation: 这张打印稿上列有一些其他的信息。

original: Who am I to argue with a solution like that?
translation: 这种方法还有什么好说的？

original: If you say so, that's good enough for me!
translation: 既然你这么说，那我只能说好了！

original: All right, I'll cross them off the list!
translation: 好的，我会从表单上划掉他们！

original: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}So this is what the rest of the world looks like!
translation: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}原来这个世界是这样的！

original: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}Everything looks bigger than I imagined!
translation: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}所有东西都比我想象的要大！

original: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}Isn't this exciting? I know I'm excited!
translation: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}难道这还不令人激动吗？我可是非常兴奋啊！

original: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}I have a good feeling about this! It's going to be great!
translation: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}我觉得不错！一定会越来越好的！

original: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}I bet I'm going to like it in that mainframe!
translation: {excited, on way to Lucky 38}我打赌我会爱上那台主机的！

original: Nice puppies - do doggies want treats?
translation: 好漂亮的小狗——小狗想要糖果吗？

original: {Panicking}Ahh! Loud! Onetwothreefourfivesixseveneightninetenonetwothreefourfivesixseveneightnineten!
translation: {Panicking}啊！好大声！一二三四五六七八九十一二三四五六七八九十！

original: My, my, this reminds me of when I was a girl. Right over there would have been where your {grampa}grandpa and I had our first kiss!
translation: 上帝啊，上帝。这让我想起我还是个小女孩的时候。那里就是你{grampa}爷爷和我初吻的地方。

original: Ooh, look, pumpkin! A dinosaur! Do you want to ride the dinosaur?
translation: 哦，看呀，小可爱！一只恐龙！你想骑恐龙吗？

original: My, aren't all these lights fancy?
translation: 我的天，这些灯可真漂亮！

original: I wonder if Marcus knows about this place....
translation: 不知道马可世是否认得这个地方…

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Oh. Well, all right.
translation: 哦，好吧。

original: Your room will be the one upstairs, closest to the lobby side.
translation: 你的房间就在楼上，最靠近大堂的那间。

original: Here's your key. Let me know if there's anything I can do to make your stay better for you.
translation: 给你钥匙。有什么需要的话告诉我，我会竭诚为您服务。

original: I can't afford 100 caps right now.
translation: 我暂时付不起100个瓶盖。

original: Well that's nothing to be ashamed of. We all have money troubles from time to time.
translation: 好吧，没必要感到羞愧。我们都有手头拮据的时候。

original: You just come on back when you can afford it, and that room's all yours.
translation: 等你有钱的时候再回来也行，房间我会为你留着的。

original: Here's 100 caps.
translation: 给你100个瓶盖。

original: I'm glad you can stay with us.
translation: 我很高兴你能留下来。

original: I'd like to rent a room.
translation: 我想租个房间。

original: I can't see as how I'd charge you after the generous things you've done for the town. The room's on me.
translation: 你为我们的镇子做了这么多好事，我没理由还收你钱。这房间算我请你的。

original: Well, I think that's a fine idea. I'll give you a good flat rate, and you can stay as long as you like. Least till the busy season comes. Sound good?
translation: 哎呀，我想到个好提议。我给你出一个超低的价钱，你想住多久住多久。至少可以住到旺季来临。怎么样？

original: I'm sure I can get help with supply shortages.
translation: 我相信我可以解决物资短缺的问题。

original: Even if that were the case, we still need more incentive to help Vegas.
translation: 即便如此，想要帮助维加斯，我们还是需要更充分的理由。

original: You would establish a foothold in the region and be one step closer to rebuilding the Mojave.
translation: 你可以在这里设立一个据点，这样就离重建莫哈维又进了一步。

original: I think I see now what you intend to set in motion.
translation: 我想我明白你的意图了。

original: If this plan will bring us one step closer to revitalizing the region, you can count on our support.
translation: 如果这个计划能帮助我们重振整个地区的话，那我们完全支持你。

original: So long as you can keep us supplied, we will stay in the Mojave to provide care and education for those in need.
translation: 不过前提是你必须保证我们的物资供应，这样我们才能在莫哈维站稳脚跟，为有需要的人提供医疗和教育。

original: I'll be on my way.
translation: 我先告辞了。

original: Be careful out there! It won't be long before the Legion makes its move!
translation: 在外面要小心！军团很快就要大军压境了！

original: What will the override module let you do?
translation: 强制覆写模组有什么用？

original: I'll use the Substation to send a {emph}huge jolt of electricity to the Lucky 38! Turns out this casino has its own reactor! All it needs is a jumpstart!
translation: 我会用变电站向幸运38输送一组强大的电力！事实证明，这座赌场本身也是有自己的反应堆的！所以只需冷启动一下就行了！

original: With the reactor running at full-tilt, I can boost the transmission strength of the Lucky 38's command and control network!
translation: 一旦反应堆满负荷运转，我就能令幸运38的内部指令网络信号瞬间增强！

original: Okay, I'll get it done.
translation: 好吧，我会解决的。

original: Great! When this is taken care of, we'll be all set for the Legion to make its move.
translation: 好极了！等这件事办妥了，我们就只需要守株待兔，等着军团来就行了。

original: I don't care what happens to Kimball.
translation: 金博尔怎么样和我无关。

original: Fine by me! We've got more important things to take care of!
translation: 无所谓！我们还有更重要的事情要做！

original: {Terrible NCR rep}The NCR hates me. They won't let me within 1000 feet of Kimball.
translation: {Terrible NCR rep}NCR十分讨厌我。他们不可能让我靠近金博尔的。

original: You are so misunderstood! Well, it's their loss!
translation: 你居然和他们有这么大的误会！好吧，那是他们的损失！

original: Forget about the President! We've got something more important to take care of!
translation: 忘掉总统吧！我们还有更重要的事情要做呢！

original: {mixed/unknown NCR rep}I might be able to convince the NCR to let me help out.
translation: {mixed/unknown NCR rep}或许我能够说服NCR让我来帮忙。

original: All right. A Ranger named Grant is in charge of security for the visit. He's the one you'll have to convince.
translation: 好吧。有个叫格兰特的游骑兵，专门负责总统视察期间的安保工作。你得先说服他。

original: After you've resolved the situation with the President, there's one more thing for you to take care of!
translation: 等你解决了总统那边的情况，那就万事俱备只欠东风了！

original: {good NCR rep}I'm on good terms with the NCR. They'll let me help protect him.
translation: {good NCR rep}我跟NCR的关系还不错。他们会让我帮忙保护他。

original: Great! A Ranger named Grant has been placed in charge of security for the President's visit. You'll want to talk to him.
translation: 好极了！有个叫格兰特的游骑兵，专门负责总统视察期间的安保工作。你可以找他谈谈。

original: Once the President is safe, there's one more thing for you to take care of!
translation: 等总统安全了，就万事俱备只欠东风了！

original: Why did Mr. House want Kimball kept alive?
translation: 为什么豪斯要让金博尔活着呢？

original: Mr. House ran projections on how the NCR public will react to a defeat at Hoover Dam! Overwhelmingly, they'll blame Kimball!
translation: 豪斯先生推演过，万一NCR失去胡佛水坝，公众会是什么反应。答案毋庸置疑，金博尔会变成众矢之的！

original: But if Kimball dies at Hoover Dam, there's no obvious scapegoat for them to blame! So they'll blame New Vegas instead!
translation: 可要是金博尔死在了水坝上，那他们就失去了这个替罪羊！公众的矛头就会指向新维加斯！

original: So that means reduced tourism for up to five years! The equations are pretty complicated! Mr. House sure liked numbers!
translation: 那样的话，五年内这儿的游客数量就将锐减！多么复杂的一组方程啊！看来豪斯先生真的很擅长数学！

original: I'm not going to let Benny get away.
translation: 我没打算让本尼逃走。

original: I can't say I understand your obsession, but for that I suppose I'd have to spend a night in your grave.
translation: 我不能理解你对这件事的执着，不过我估计去你的坟墓里躺一晚上应该就能明白了。

original: Fine. I'll stick with you. Just remember this. If you want something from Caesar, sooner or later you'll have to give him his due.
translation: 好吧，我会跟着你的。不过记住这句话，如果你想从凯撒身边取走一样东西，那你迟早都得还。

original: Once we get close to Caesar, we can strike.
translation: 一旦我们接近凯撒，我们就可以刺杀他了。

original: {"And you, my friend?" eht too mee ah-mee-kay?}Et tu, mi amice?
translation: {"And you，my friend?" eht too mee ah-mee-kay?}（拉丁文）你也有份吗，我的朋友？

original: {"And you, my friend?" eht too mee ah-MEE-kah?}Et tu, mi amica?
translation: {"And you，my friend?" eht too mee ah-mee-kay?}（拉丁文）你也有份吗，我的朋友？

original: I have to commend you on your sense of historical propriety, but have you given more than a passing thought to how we would escape?
translation: 你很忠于历史，我表示赞赏。但是，你有想过我们该怎么逃跑么？

original: No disrespect intended, but you aren't the first person to dream up the idea.
translation: 恕我直言，你不是第一个做此白日梦的人。

original: Just give me a sign when you're about to pull out the dagger so I know when to make a run for the cliffs.
translation: 当你准备拔匕首的时候记得提醒我一下，这样我就知道该去跳崖了。

original: Let's just listen to him, figure out what he's up to, and get out.
translation: 我们干脆就听听他的话，看他到底有什么目的，然后就离开。

original: Short of canceling our imminent travel plans, that's the best thing you could have said.
translation: 除了立刻打道回府外，这真是你能说出的最妙的话了。

original: Just be careful. If we travel at Caesar's pleasure, he may not let us out as easily as he lets us in.
translation: 小心点，如果我们真的对凯撒言听计从，说不定他就不会轻易放我们走了。

original: I just want to hear Caesar out.
translation: 我只想听听凯撒想说什么。

original: Very optimistic of you. You'll make a good Follower someday assuming Caesar doesn't have us both crucified.
translation: 你很乐观。要是凯撒没有把我们都钉在十字架上的话，我相信你会成为一名优秀的天启追随者信徒。

original: If you say so.
translation: 随你的便咯。

original: Did I say something? Sorry. Don't pay any attention to me. Just babbling. {becoming more quiet}Nonsense, really. {drifting off}Babbling nonsense.
translation: 我刚说什么了？抱歉。别在意。我就是嘟哝两句。{becoming more quiet}废话而已，真的。{drifting off}无聊的废话。

original: Memories of what?
translation: 什么样的往事？

original: Oh, uh... {trying to cover}of hearing stories. About energy weapons. {drifting off}They're... pretty crazy. {quietly}Yeah.
translation: 哦，呃…{trying to cover}只是些传闻罢了。关于能量武器的。{drifting off}它们…很疯狂。{quietly}对。

original: Do the Followers use a lot of energy weapons?
translation: 天启追随者大多使用能量武器吗？

original: {off-hand, not realizing he's revealing something bad}Energy weapons? Of course not.
translation: {off-hand，not realizing he's revealing something bad}能量武器？当然不。

original: {catching himself, trying to cover}I mean... but, we study all sorts of science and technology so, you know, we... you just kind of get familiar with them. Yeah.
translation: 我是说……我们对各种各样的科技都有研究，所以，我们……只是对这种武器比较熟悉罢了，对。

original: Why don't you come with me?
translation: 你为什么不和我一起走呢？

original: I can't leave now. Caesar has gained too much ground. I need to be here in case the NCR fails to hold Hoover Dam.
translation: 我现在不能走。凯撒已经占了不少地方了。我得待在这儿，以防胡佛水坝失守。

original: No offense intended, but why should I go anywhere with you?
translation: 恕我冒昧，但为什么我要跟着你？

original: Do you know much about Caesar?
translation: 你对凯撒很了解吗？

original: {sighs}I don't know anything that the others couldn't tell you. Caesar was one of the Followers. Before my time, of course.
translation: 我知道的也和别人差不多。凯撒曾经也是我们的一员。当然，是在我加入之前。

original: He wanted to rebuild the new world in the image of the old. A sad story of good intentions gone bad. In that regard, he's hardly unique.
translation: 他想模仿旧世界重建一个新世界。想法是好的，可惜最终却变了味。从这一点上说，他和其他人也没什么不同。

original: If you set aside his leadership capabilities, extensive knowledge, and ruthless cunning, he's just another jerk who steps on people to get his way.
translation: 撇开他出众的领导能力、渊博的学识与下作的手段，他也不过是个踩着别人肩膀往上爬的混蛋罢了。

original: Where did you learn that?
translation: 你从哪儿学的这句话？

original: Not from the Legion, if that's what you're getting at. Books. Sheet music. Gladiator movie holotapes. Bits and pieces here and there.
translation: 你是想问从军团学的吗？不是。书籍、乐谱、还有角斗士电影磁带，我是从这些零星的碎片中得到的知识。

original: The Followers have extensive libraries, but we all draw water from the same old well. Even Caesar.
translation: 天启追随者有不少图书馆，但我们都是师承一家，水出同源，包括凯撒。

original: Nihi-what?
translation: 什么鸟语？

original: Oh. {sincere}Sorry. "There is nothing new under the sun."
translation: 哦。{sincere}对不起。"日光之下无新事。"

original: If agave and mesquite were that miraculous, the locals would have figured it out a few thousand years ago.
translation: 如果龙舌兰和牧豆树真那么神奇，那当地人早在几千年前就应该发现了。

original: Isn't that the language that Caesar's Legion speaks?
translation: 这不是凯撒军团所用的语言吗？

original: {“Yeah, well...”}{SEE-zar}Caesar can cite {KAY-toe}Cato to suit his purpose. Many people have spoken Latin. Some of them were quite pleasant.
translation: 凯撒不过是喜欢引用{KAY-toe}加图的话来为自己张目罢了。会说拉丁文的人有很多。其中有些人可是相当善良的。

original: It's unfortunate that the language is now associated with the gentlemen across the river.
translation: 遗憾的是，如今这门语言却成了河对岸那帮先生们的专利了。

original: What kinds of illnesses and injuries?
translation: 什么样的病痛？

original: Cuts, lacerations, broken bones. Infections resulting from all of the above. Common cold, influenza. Take your pick.
translation: 刀伤，撕裂，骨折，以及由以上这些伤病所导致的感染。普通感冒，流行性感冒。五花八门。

original: There are plenty of ways to die out here, and most of them, surprisingly, don't have anything to do with war. Just common human fragility.
translation: 想要让人类灭绝，方法有很多，更加惊人的是，这当中大部分都与战争无关，只不过是由于人类自身的脆弱。

original: What's the goal?
translation: 你们的目标是什么？

original: For the past hundred years or so, the Followers have managed to get by using salvaged medical supplies from the Old World.
translation: 过去的数百年里，天启追随者都靠搜集旧世界遗留下的药品来帮助人们度过难关。

original: But the side effect of medical success is that more people live longer. Funny how that works.
translation: 不过医学的进步却让人们的寿命普遍增加了。真是个可笑的结果。

original: Eventually, we'll run out of hospitals to loot. We need new ways to produce those supplies. Or maybe old ways, if this research goes anywhere.
translation: 这样下去，能用的医疗品迟早会耗尽。我们必须想些新方法来生产这些用品。或者假如这项研究能成功的话，我们也可以复兴以往的科技。

original: You don't sound too enthusiastic about it.
translation: 听起来，你对此不是很热衷。

original: I'm enthusiastic about helping people, but {nih-hill noh-wee soob soh-lay}nihil novi sub sole.
translation: 我是热衷于帮助他人，不过常言道{nih-hill noh-wee soob soh-lay}，（拉丁文）日光之下无新事。

original: Why do you do research instead of providing medical assistance?
translation: 为什么你要做研究而不是去给人看病呢？

original: Not all Followers are "people persons." Besides, someone needs to do research. I have no problem with Julie sticking me back here.
translation: 不是所有的天启追随者都喜欢和人打交道。另外，总得有人来做研究。朱莉让我呆在这儿，我没意见。

original: Out of sight, out of mind. There are worse things one can be, though I do admit, it is a bit boring.
translation: 离群索居，避人耳目。虽然也不算太糟，但我还是得承认，的确有点枯燥。

original: Though it has a noble goal, I don't think this research will yield much fruit. No pun intended.
translation: 尽管目标很高尚，但我并不认为这个研究会带来多少成果。我不是在开玩笑。

original: Like I said before, not all Followers are good with people.
translation: 像我之前说的，不是所有的天启追随者都善于与人交往。

original: I'm fine doing research back here, even if it is a bit boring... and pointless... and a complete waste of time.
translation: 我觉得待在后方做研究挺好的，虽然有点枯燥……有点漫无目的……完全是在浪费时间。

original: Don't mind me. I'm just voicing my thoughts so they don't burrow out of my skull in a fit of abject despondency.
translation: 别管我。我只是发泄一下，这样他们就不会从我的脑壳里挖出悲观情绪了。

original: What kind of research?
translation: 什么样的研究？

original: Oh, you know. Finding alternative treatments for common illnesses and injuries. Stimpaks out of barrel cacti and other fantastic improbabilities.
translation: 哦，你懂的。为一般的病痛寻找替代疗法。比如用仙人掌刺制作治疗针，还有其他五花八门的东西。

original: As far as fruitless wastes of time go, it's quite noble in its aims.
translation: 虽然目前毫无进展，但至少这个计划的目标是高尚的。

original: Look out, behind you! <Pistol Whip Carlyle>
translation: 小心，在你背后！<用枪托击打卡莱尔>

original: Huh? Hey, I think you dropped your gun there. Here. Here you go. Just don't point it at me, okay?
translation: 嗯？嘿，好像你的枪掉了。给你，拿好。别用它指着我，行吗？

original: I'm paranoid now, and even though you clearly don't know how to hold that thing, it'd be one less thing for me to worry about. Thanks.
translation: 我的神经已经够紧张的了。虽然你明显不懂得怎么握枪，但我还是希望这玩意不会伤到我。谢了。

original: Did you know there's a nerve on your neck that helps you sleep? It's... uh... I know it's here...
translation: 你知道脖子上有一根神经可以帮助睡眠吗？就在……嗯……我知道就在这附近……

original: You're weird. Please stop that.
translation: 你好奇怪。请别碰我。

original: Maybe beating your head on a rock will fix it.
translation: 也许拿石头往你的脑袋来一下，你就好了。

original: Who are you, again?
translation: 再问一下，你到底是谁？

original: Maybe my weak and flimsy hands can massage that out for you.<Apply Sleeper Hold>
translation: 也许用我柔软白嫩的手给你按按摩。<按压颈部>

original: What the-? Don't touch me. I could get a better massage from a baby.
translation: 你干什——？别碰我。婴儿都按得比你舒服。

original: Er... join the White Glove Society. They're cannibals, but that's probably a step up for you.
translation: 呃……加入白手套社团吧。虽然他们是食人族，但加入他们或许能改善的处境。

original: What? Are you crazy?
translation: 什么？你疯了吗？

original: Will you serve human flesh at the Gourmand?
translation: 你们会在美食家餐厅供应人肉吗？

original: Oh, I very much doubt that. What fun would it be if everyone could have it?
translation: 噢，我很怀疑。如果人人都能吃到的话，那还有什么意思？

original: Then again, I wouldn't be surprised if our chef used it here and there as a secret ingredient to make his dishes really come alive.
translation: 但话说回来，如果我们的大厨想要偶尔拿它当秘方，给我们的菜肴增添一些鲜味，那我也不会介意。

original: What's next, now that the White Glove Society has tasted human flesh again?
translation: 既然白手套社团再次开始吃人了，接下来你们打算怎么办？

original: Now that it's been accepted, it will become a regular course for us.
translation: 既然大家都接受了新品，那它今后就会出现在我们的日常菜单上。

original: It's a new and exciting frontier for our chef. I've never seen him so cheerful.
translation: 对我们的大厨来说，这是一个令人激动的新领域。我从没见过他这么开心过。

original: How is your new cuisine faring?
translation: 新饮食习惯的反响如何？

original: Why it's splendid. Simply to die for.
translation: 好得不得了。大家都爱得要死。

original: {affably}Mortimer told me about you, you know. What a pair of mischief makers you two are!
translation: {affably}你知道吗，莫蒂默和我说起过你。你们两个家伙真够阴险的！

original: But the new entrees are fresh and bold and I have the two of you to thank for it.
translation: 不过咱们的新主菜能够新鲜又夺目，可全都是你们俩的功劳。

original: How do I get in?
translation: 我该怎么才能进去？

original: Anything you can do to help me?
translation: 你有什么能帮到我的？

original: What can you tell me about the Great Khans?
translation: 关于大汗帮你有什么可以告诉我的？

original: We know they supply the Fiends with illegal chems, but they never stick around in NCR territory for long. They know the land, and move quick.
translation: 我们知道他们在向恶魔帮提供非法药物，但他们从不在NCR的领地上久呆。他们熟悉地形，行动迅速。

original: There's talk from time to time about taking out their base at Red Rock Canyon, but nothing ever comes of it. The Great Khans are tough fighters.
translation: 常有人提出要清剿他们位于红岩峡谷的大本营，但就是没见人付诸行动。大汗帮很难对付。

original: If we ever did go up against them on their home turf, we'd win, but casualties would be high.
translation: 要是我们真跑到他们的地盘上跟他们打，即便能赢，伤亡也会很惨重。

original: You were at Bitter Springs, I'm told.
translation: 我听说你在苦泉待过。

original: {painful memory - it was a massacre of innocents}Yeah, I was there. I was Captain Dhatri, then. That whole situation was a mess and could easily have been avoided with good intel.
translation: {painful memory - it was a massacre of innocents}是的，我在场。那时我还是上尉。当时情况已经彻底失控。如果我们的情报能更准确一点，这场悲剧其实完全是可以避免的。

original: The major in charge at the time made a bad call - he thought Bitter Springs was full of Great Khan raiders, so we surrounded the place.
translation: 那天指挥我们的少校犯了个大错误——他认为苦泉已经被大汗帮掠夺者占领，于是命令我们包围了那个地方。

original: By the time any of us realized there were civilians down there - women and children - the shooting had already started.
translation: 当我们中有人意识到下面那些大汗帮其实都是妇孺平民时，枪已经响了。

original: The major froze up at the news, and we couldn't get another word out of him. I took over and salvaged the situation as best I could.
translation: 少校当时就惊呆了，一句话也说不出来。我迅速接过了指挥权，并尽我所能挽回局面。

original: For my effort, I was promoted to major. Not quite the way I'd have wanted it.
translation: 后来因为我在此次事件中的表现，我晋升为了少校。但我并不想以这种方式得到提拔。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: What happens if I hang around one of your camps?
translation: 如果我出现在你们的营地里会怎么样？

original: Then'll we have to make you leave by force. Your own fault, you understand.
translation: 那我们就只好用武力驱赶了。这可是你自己的错。

original: I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 我会记住的。

original: See ya.
translation: 再见。

original: {Edited Line}{Speaking in Audio Log/Journal}This is most unusual! The Powder Gangers have visitors today. I guess there's a first for everything!
translation: {Speaking in Audio Log/Journal}这实在是太不正常了！炸药帮居然会有客人。果然凡事都有第一次！

original: Now those tough-looking fellows must be Great Khans. I recognize those funny helmets and leather vests from stories I've heard...
translation: 那些五大三粗的家伙想必就是大汗帮的人了。那滑稽的头盔和皮背心，还真是和传闻里的一模一样……

original: So what are they doing with that dapper gentleman who wears a checked suit? I wouldn't mind a suit like that.
translation: 他们和那个穿格子西服的优雅绅士在一起做什么呢？我可不介意来一套这样的行头。

original: They're talking about heading south toward Nipton, then west to Novac where they'll meet up with someone...
translation: 他们好像说要先向南到尼普顿，再向西到诺瓦克，在那里会见某个人……

original: I guess I could track them if I needed to, but {beat, cowardly justification}the town of Primm needs me here, to serve and protect.
translation: 有必要的话我可以跟着他们，但是普瑞姆需要我，需要我的服务，需要我来保护。

original: Oh my. I think I've been spotted...
translation: 噢，天。他们好像发现我了……

original: <Speech Options>
translation: <口才选项>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Well, you look to be the trustworthy sort. Okay, I'll tell you what I know.
translation: [成功] 好吧，你看起来还算可靠。好的，我会告诉你我知道的事情。

original: You can tell me or you can rot in here.
translation: 要么告诉我，要么就烂在这里吧。

original: [FAILED] I'm sure you mean well, but I'm afraid you'll have to wait until I'm in a calmer emotional state before my memory is going to function.
translation: [失败] 我明白你的好意，但恐怕你还得等上一段时间，让我的情绪先稳定下来。现在我的记忆一片混乱。

original: I'll free you... right after you tell me...
translation: 我会放了你的…前提是你得先告诉我…

original: Can you tell me about the people who passed through town now?
translation: 你能和我说说最近路过这个小镇的那些人吗？

original: {Edited Line}Indeed I do good sir, and I would be thrilled to share that information with you as soon as I am released from captivity.
translation: {Edited Line}当然可以了，我的好先生，只要你把我救出去，我会很乐意把这些信息告诉你的。

original: I hear you may have information on some Khans that came through here with a guy in a checkered suit.
translation: 我听说你曾经见过几个路过的大汗帮，他们中有个穿格子西装的家伙。

original: {Edited Line}My good lady, I believe I may have some information that would prove useful.
translation: {Edited Line}我的好女士，我相信我知道的情报会对你大有帮助。

original: If you would just untie my hands I'd be more than happy to share what information I have with you.
translation: 如果你能为我松绑，我会很乐意把它告诉你。

original: I hear you may have information on some Khans that came through here with a guy in a checkered suit.
translation: 我听说你曾经见过几个路过的大汗帮，他们中有个穿格子西装的家伙。

original: {Edited Line}I'm in quite a state here. If you help me with my bonds I'll be more than happy to tell you anything, and everything about those Khans.
translation: {Edited Line}我现在身处危险境地。如果你给我松绑，我可以把所有情报都告诉你，包括那几个大汗帮的去向。

original: {Edited Line}Ahh yes, my memory is much clearer now that I am free from my bondage.
translation: {Edited Line}啊，是的，自从松了绑以后，我的记忆就变得清晰了不少。

original: I was sku{skulking, rethinking}... er, performing recon, gathering information on some of the Powder Gangers, when some great Khans arrived with your friend in the suit.
translation: 我在藏{skulking，rethinking}……呃，执行侦察任务，收集炸药帮情报的时候，遇到了几个大汗帮的人，同行的还有你那位西装革履的朋友。

original: They were talking about some delivery they took from a courier, I assume that was you.
translation: 当时他们在谈论从某个邮差身上弄到的一批货，我想那个邮差就是你吧。

original: They said they'd be heading through Nipton to Novac to meet a contact there.
translation: 他们还说会经过尼普顿到诺瓦克去，在那里跟某人碰头。

original: Can you tell me about the man in the checkered suit who came through here?
translation: 你能和我讲讲那个路过这里的穿格子西装的男人吗？

original: {Edited Line}I overheard them saying that they are on their way to Novac. If you want to follow them I strongly suggest that you follow the road through Nipton.
translation: {Edited Line}我听到他们说要去诺瓦克。如果你想追踪他们，我强烈建议你顺着大路穿过尼普顿。

original: There are a lot of dangerous things out in the desert, and you won't have me with you to protect you, as I need to stay here and keep Primm safe.
translation: 沙漠里处处险恶，我也没法在你身旁护送你，因为我还得留下来保护普瑞姆。

original: Can you tell me where the man in the checkered suit went again?
translation: 你能再和我说下那个格子西装男去哪了吗？

original: Earlier, it seemed like you knew Tabitha. What's the story there?
translation: 你好像认识塔比瑟，你们俩有啥故事吗？

original: Tabitha was {gramma's}grandma's squad leader when we both worked for the Master. She wasn't very nice at all, but she was good at the chopping.
translation: 我们以前都曾为主教卖命，那时塔比瑟是奶奶小分队的队长。她脾气不大好，但砍人的技巧却是一流的。

original: Almost as good as Leo....
translation: 就和利奥一样……

original: Tabitha! You naughty, naughty girl! Leo remembers what you did!
translation: 塔比瑟！你这个调皮的丫头！利奥可记得你干的好事！

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: What'd you have in mind?
translation: 你在想什么？

original: Is that when you settled out here with your wife?
translation: 你就是那时和你妻子搬到这里来定居的吗？

original: Eventually we made our way out here. But uh...
translation: 我们最后的确是在这里落了脚。但是，呃……

original: Well, when folks spend their lives in isolation, sometimes that ain't the best of things for learning to fight off germs.
translation: 这么说吧，长期在封闭环境中生活的人，对病毒的免疫力有时会很差。

original: We was going to California, but Goodsprings was as far as we got. After she passed, wasn't no reason to keep going.
translation: 我们原本是打算去加州的，但最后只走到了清泉镇。她去世以后，我也没什么理由再继续往前走了。

original: I stayed so I could keep close to her.
translation: 所以我留了下来，只为了离她近一些。

original: I saw your old vault on the Strip. Vault 21, right? Mr. House filled it with concrete?
translation: 我在长街看到了你以前待的避难所。21号避难所，对吧？就是豪斯先生用水泥填起来的那座？

original: {Bitter, attempting to hide it}Yep. He sure did. Wanted himself a hotel, and to make sure once he made the change there'd never be any going back.
translation: {Bitter, attempting to hide it}对。是他干的。他就是想给自己造个酒店，还要确保那地方不会变回原样。

original: We didn't get a say. Don't know how you'd argue with a fella like that anyways, everywhere and nowhere all at once.
translation: 我们也不好说什么。毕竟你跟那种家伙讲道理无异于对牛弹琴，完全是浪费时间。

original: So just like that, we was all homeless. Went our separate ways, and that was all she wrote.
translation: 于是就这样，我们都无家可归了。从此大家各奔东西，过去的美好日子戛然而止。

original: You said before you had something taken from you.
translation: 你之前说你有什么东西被掏走了。

original: Well, ain't we all, right? That was a long time ago. {Lying}I don't pay it much mind anymore.
translation: 啊，我们都一样，对吧？都是很久以前的事了。{Lying}我都快记不得了。

original: Give me a name, and I'll take care of it.
translation: 给我个名字，我会搞定的。

original: Can you tell me anything more?
translation: 你能告诉我些别的事吗？

original: Forget it, I'll bring her here.
translation: 别介意。我会把她带到这里来的。

original: Good, getting tired of questions from you when I should be getting answers. Bring her here.
translation: 很好，本来该我问你的，结果你倒问个没完，烦死了。把她带过来就对了。

original: I'm not doing this for you.
translation: 我不想为你干这事。

original: {Frowns}Guess Gloria was wrong about you, then. Get out of here, you're no use to me.
translation: {Frowns}原来格罗莉亚看错你了。滚，你没用了。

original: Nowhere.
translation: 也没哪儿。

original: "Nowhere's" a strange place to get an idea like that.
translation: "没哪儿"还能得出这种想法，真是怪事。

original: You know what, you're new. Gloria's not going to miss you. And I'm not going to risk you saying the same thing to that bitch I'm hunting for.
translation: 知道吗，你是新面孔。格罗莉亚不会惦记你的。我也不会冒险放你走，让你把同样的话告诉我正在追踪的那个婊子。

original: Found out from investigating the wreckage.
translation: 搜索遇难残骸后发现的。

original: And after all the trouble I went through to kill all those witnesses. Guess now I have one more than I thought.
translation: 没想到费了那么多功夫杀掉所有目击者还不够。看来我得再杀一个啊。

original: These contract papers, for one.
translation: 这些合同文件，都是。

original: So, looks like we have us a thief. All right, guess I'm talking to you instead of the girl.
translation: 哦，看来我们这儿出了个贼。也罢，我就不和那姑娘谈了，直接找你谈吧。

original: If I run across her, I'll let her know.
translation: 如果我遇到她，我会告诉她的。

original: What did you want to talk to her about?
translation: 你想和她谈点什么？

original: {Irritated}If your answer isn't "yes, I'll bring her here" or "no, I won't, cause Gloria had me pegged wrong," then we're done here.
translation: {Irritated}要么你回答我："是，我会把她带过来"；要么说"不，我不做，格罗莉亚错看我了"，否则咱俩没什么可说的。

original: Anything you can say to her, you can say to me.
translation: 把你想跟她说的话都告诉我吧。

original: {Cold, angry that player is challenging him}You don't want {emph}us chatting, trust me. {Smooths out}As for the girl - I just want to talk to her.
translation: {Cold, angry that player is challenging him}你不会想和我聊天的{emph}，相信我。{Smooths out}那个姑娘，我只想找她谈谈罢了。

original: And if you can't bring her here, you're no use to me - or Gloria. So if you want to cause trouble in here over nothing, then go on - try.
translation: 如果你不能把她带来，那你对我或者格罗莉亚就没有任何价值。如果你想在这儿惹麻烦，那可以啊，随你。

original: Why don't you do it?
translation: 你为什么不自己去干？

original: I got business here, need to watch the shop, make sure things are running - smoothly.
translation: 我在这里还有活干，要帮忙看铺子。我得确保这儿的一切正常。

original: {Slight mockery}Besides, if I came for the girl, I'm not all friendly and charming like you are. She might get the wrong idea.
translation: {Slight mockery}再说了，我可不像你这么友善，这么有魅力。她可能会误解我的意思。

original: Is it because the Van Graffs attacked her caravan?
translation: 是因为范·格拉夫家族攻击了她的商队吗？

original: {Frowns}I had nothing to do with that, and neither did anyone here. Now where would you have gotten an idea like that?
translation: {Frowns}我和此事没有半点关系，这里的其他人也扯不上边。你是从哪儿得出这个想法的？

original: Do you know where she is?
translation: 你知道她在哪里吗？

original: Fuck, no. If I knew where this bitch was, do you think I'd be asking you?
translation: 操，不知道。如果我知道这婊子在哪，还要你干什么？

original: Still, there's someone who might - old Alice McLafferty, Crimson Caravan, might know something.
translation: 不过，有人可能知道——老爱丽丝·麦克拉弗蒂，深红商队的，可能知道点情况。

original: She keeps tabs on caravan traffic in the Mojave, wouldn't put it past her to keep track of Cassidy Caravans and its owner.
translation: 她一直在密切注意莫哈维地区的商队情况，要想知道盖西迪商队和它主人的下落，就不得不通过她。

original: I doubt Cass will listen to anything I have to say.
translation: 我觉得卡丝根本不会听我说一句话。

original: {Slight mockery}What? You two on the outs? Ain't that a shame.
translation: {Slight mockery}怎么，你跟她有过节？真可惜。

original: Guess you misheard me - I wasn't asking you a question. Find a way to get her here.
translation: 估计你没听明白我的意思——我不是在征求你的意见。你得想法子把她弄过来。

original: If you can't bring her here, then make sure she never leaves the Outpost, and that's {draws it out}fine with me.
translation: 如果她不肯来，那你就让她永远也走不出前哨站。{draws it out}对我来说，这样也行。

original: Cass? She's in the Mojave Outpost.
translation: 卡丝？她在莫哈维沙漠前哨站。

original: {Chews it over}Really. NCR all around her.
translation: {Chews it over}是吗。她周围都是NCR。

original: Well, tell you what. You find a {emph}way to bring her here. She'll want to hear what I have to say.
translation: 好吧，这样。你想个{emph}法子把她弄到这儿来，告诉她我有话要和她说。

original: Cass is dead.
translation: 卡丝死了。

original: Dead? {Beat}What... by you? {Beat, admiring}Yeah, I can tell, you had something to do with it.
translation: 死了？{Beat}是……你干的？{Beat, admiring}是的，我能看出来，和你有关系。

original: {Nods, impressed}Gloria was right about you. You take care of business before it's a problem.
translation: {Nods, impressed}格罗莉亚果然没看错你。你在问题爆发之前就把它给解决了。

original: [Terrifying Presence] Raise that gun, and I'll kill everyone in here.
translation: [凶神恶煞]你要是敢举枪，你们一个都活不了。

original: {Pauses, a little uneasy}You know what, I think you mean that. All right... maybe...
translation: {Pauses, a little uneasy}我觉得你是认真的。好吧……也许……

original: You shoot, you'll regret it.
translation: 如果敢开枪，你会后悔的。

original: {Scoffs}Really. We'll see about that.
translation: {Scoffs}是吗，我倒想看看。

original: I'm not with her, so watch the spread.
translation: 我和她不是一伙的，所以别打着我。

original: Sounds good, kill her.
translation: 好极了，干掉她吧。

original: {Eager}Waited too long to finish this, last loose end, all wrapped up.
translation: {Eager}为这天我已经等了好久，最后一点小尾巴，除掉就万事大吉了。

original: Don't think everyone around here is going to tolerate your actions, outsider. A few of us have a mind to put you down like the animal you are.
translation: 别以为这儿的每个人都能忍受你的行为，外来者。我们中有些人恨不得马上就把你宰了。

original: If I or one of the others hears that you're topside, we might just come out and have a little chat.
translation: 要是我或者其他人在地表碰见你的话，那估计我们就得好好谈谈了。

original: You may have questionable methods, outsider, but some of us realize you get the job done.
translation: 虽然你的行为不太合道义，外来者，不过还是有人欣赏你的本事。

original: We've talked Torres into giving you access to gear for a little cheaper, to help out with your travels. Hope it helps!
translation: 我们已经和托雷斯打过招呼了，他会在装备上给你点折扣，好为你的旅程添加些便利。希望能帮上忙！

original: There you are! A few of us wanted to thank you for being such a good friend to the Brotherhood, so we've set aside some of our recycled energy cells.
translation: 你在这儿啊！我们有些伙计很想感谢你为兄弟会做出的贡献，所以特意留了一些回收的能量电池给你。

original: We'll leave a few of them in that footlocker in the corner every so often. The Paladins scoff at using recycled ammo, so no one should mind.
translation: 我们偶尔也会把电池丢在各地的物资箱里。圣骑士不屑于使用回收过的弹药，所以你拿走也没人介意的。

original: {Narration, Good Karma, NCR Victory, Female}The Courier, fair and even-handed in her dealings throughout the Wasteland, was honored by the NCR for her support of the military at Hoover Dam.
translation: 以刚正不阿闻名废土的邮差，因在胡佛大坝一战中的杰出贡献而获得了NCR的表彰。

original: {Narration}She was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.
translation: 她被授予金枝奖章，这是共和国给予公民的最高荣誉。

original: {Narration, Neutral Karma, NCR Victory, Female}Though the Courier's agenda was a mystery to many, she was honored by NCR for her support of the military at Hoover Dam.
translation: 即便邮差的品行令人捉摸不透，但她还是因胡佛大坝一战中对军队的支援而获得了NCR的嘉奖。

original: {Narration}She was presented with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.
translation: 她被授予金枝奖章，这是共和国给予公民的最高荣誉。

original: {Narration, Evil Karma, NCR Victory, Female}With brutal methods that few in NCR would approve of, it was the Courier who secured NCR's victory at Hoover Dam.
translation: 邮差以NCR难以接受的野蛮手段帮助其获得了胡佛大坝一战的胜利。

original: {Narration}Despite her extreme actions, she was awarded with the Golden Branch, the highest civilian decoration given by the Republic.
translation: 尽管方法极端，但NCR还是授予了她金枝奖章，这是共和国给予公民的最高荣誉。

original: {Narration, Good Karma, Legion Victory, Female}Though the Courier herself was just and forthright in her dealings throughout the Wasteland, she helped the Legion achieve victory.
translation: 虽然邮差以侠肝义胆的品行扬名废土，可她最终却帮助凯撒军团获得了胜利。

original: {Narration}Caesar honored her with a golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
translation: 凯撒特意为她铸造了一枚金币，以表彰她的卓越功勋，并在废土全境发行。

original: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Legion Victory, Female}The Courier, a mercenary at heart, helped the Legion achieve victory at Hoover Dam.
translation: 秉持着拿人钱财、与人消灾的信条，邮差帮助军团赢得了胡佛大坝之战的胜利。

original: {Narration}Caesar honored her with a golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
translation: 凯撒特意为她铸造了一枚金币，以表彰她的卓越功勋，并在废土全境发行。

original: {Narration, Evil Karma, Legion Victory, Female}The Legion marched over the Hoover Dam with the help of one who was as brutal and merciless as the worst of them: The Courier.
translation: 军团的铁蹄踏过了胡佛大坝，助他们完成这一暴行的，正是与军团同流合污，集凶残和无情于一身的邮差。

original: {Narration}Caesar honored her with a  golden coin, minted in celebration of her contributions and distributed throughout the wasteland.
translation: 凯撒特意为她铸造了一枚金币，以表彰她的卓越功勋，并在废土全境发行。

original: {Narration, Good Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, fair and kind-hearted to those in the Wasteland, ensured that Mr. House would keep New Vegas stable and secure for future generations.
translation: 凭借着享誉废土的正直与善良，邮差帮助豪斯先生为新维加斯日后的长治久安奠定了基础。

original: {Narrating}Mr. House afforded her every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, both out of gratitude and a quiet pride in his choice of lieutenants.
translation: 豪斯先生将幸运38中的所有豪华设施都提供给她尽情享用，不仅出于感谢，也是为自己能物色到这样一名优秀的助手而暗中得意。

original: {Narration, Neutral Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, who had a mixed history in the Wasteland, kept the status quo at Hoover Dam.
translation: 尽管邮差的名声毁誉参半，但她还是成功维持了胡佛大坝的现状。

original: {Narration}Mr. House kept New Vegas stable, if not free, for generations, and afforded the Courier every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38.
translation: 豪斯先生为新维加斯带来了延续数代的稳定，乃至自由。他也慷慨地将幸运38中所有的豪华设施都赏给邮差尽情享用。

original: {Narration, Evil Karma, House Victory, Female}The Courier, cruel and merciless, had ensured that Mr. House would maintain complete control over New Vegas and everyone in it.
translation: 冷酷无情的邮差帮助豪斯先生稳固了对新维加斯及其人民的统治。

original: {Narration}Mr. House afforded her every luxury at his disposal in the Lucky 38, mostly as a reward, but partly out of fear.
translation: 豪斯先生为她提供了幸运38中的所有豪华设施，多半是出于奖励，但也有一部分是出于恐惧。

original: {Narration, Good Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Supporting the ideals of independence, the Courier was recognized as the woman responsible for a truly free New Vegas.
translation: 始终坚持独立理想的邮差，成为了人民眼中为新维加斯谋得自由的大功臣。

original: {Narration}She ensured that Mr. House's tyranny was broken and that neither Caesar's Legion nor NCR would ever gain control over New Vegas.
translation: 她不仅彻底推翻了豪斯先生的暴政，也令凯撒军团与NCR从此再也无法觊觎新维加斯。

original: {Narration, Neutral Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Preferring neither the best of the NCR nor the worst of the Legion, the Courier was the woman responsible for a truly independent New Vegas.
translation: 既不想讨好NCR，也不愿讨好军团的邮差，成为了新维加斯独立的最大功臣。

original: {Narration}She had removed Mr. House from power over the Strip and broken the influence of the NCR and Caesar's Legion in the Mojave Wasteland.
translation: 她不仅推翻了豪斯先生对长街的统治，也清除了NCR与凯撒军团对莫哈维废土的影响。

original: {Narration, Evil Karma, Indy Vegas, Female}Supporting all of the chaos that comes with independence, the Courier was the woman responsible for a truly free New Vegas.
translation: 盼望着独立之后天下大乱的邮差，成为了为新维加斯谋得自由的大功臣。

original: {Narration}She ensured the fall of Mr. House and the end of the Legion's and NCR's influence over New Vegas.
translation: 她不仅杀死了豪斯先生，也消除了军团和NCR对新维加斯的影响。

original: I'm not actually armed.
translation: 其实我身上没带武器。

original: Smooth and easy, just the way I like it. Don't worry, they'll be as safe as kittens till you're ready to leave.
translation: 爽快利落，我喜欢。别担心，在你离开前，它们都会像小猫一样乖乖地躺在我这儿的。

original: Oh, and a friendly word of advice: if you happen to "stumble across" any weapons during your stay here, well... just don't wear them openly. You dig?
translation: 喔，顺便给你一句忠告：就算你在这儿不小心"摸到"一两件武器，也别……公开拿出来，明白吗？

original: Now that we got that little business out of the way, what can I do to make your Tops experience the tops?
translation: 这样咱们就算例行完公事了，不知您还有什么问题，能让我为您的九重天之行增光添彩的？

original: Here you go.
translation: 给你。

original: Pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 很高兴和你做买卖。

original: You still haven't said where these guys were going.
translation: 你还没说那些家伙去哪了。

original: Go on.
translation: 继续。

original: Get him!
translation: 干掉他！

original: Get her!
translation: 干掉她！

original: Ooh, look. A body. I really should be going.
translation: 哦，瞧啊。一具尸体。看来我得走了。

original: What's your rush? The boys and I here want to get to know you better.
translation: 你着什么急啊？我和我的伙计们还想好好认识一下你呢。

original: Friend of yours?
translation: 这是你朋友？

original: Nah, just some idiot that wandered down the wrong alley. Sound familiar?
translation: 不，只是个不小心钻错巷子的白痴罢了。是不是和你很像？

original: Who is that?
translation: 那是谁？

original: The last person stupid enough to follow me down this alley. Get this fool, boys!
translation: 上一个跟着我进巷子的家伙。伙计们，干掉这个傻瓜！

original: Hey, you're the one who's been going around helping people around here, right? The King says to keep up the good work, and said to give you this.
translation: 嘿，你就是那个经常乐于助人的家伙吧？猫王希望你能再接再厉，他让我把这个送给你。

original: You're starting to get quite the reputation around here, aren't you? Don't get me wrong, I'm not passing judgement or anything.
translation: 你在这儿似乎已经小有名气了啊，对吧？别误会，我不是来对你评头论足的。

original: The fine proprietors of Mick & Ralph's appreciate that kind of attitude, and would like to offer you a discount on their fine wares.
translation: 米克与拉尔夫杂货店的两位合伙人对你近来的表现十分赞赏，他们决定给你在本店购物时打个折扣。

original: Just as long as you keep making waves, that is. Be seeing you.
translation: 希望你能继续保持这种优良的品格。再会了。

original: {Starts off blustering, ends up blubbering}Give me all of your {caps}ca- whoa, I'm sorry. I-I didn't know it was you. Please don't hurt me. I've got a wife! And kids! And pets and stuff!
translation: {Starts off blustering，ends up blubbering}把你的瓶盖通通交出——哇，抱歉！我，我不知道是你！请不要伤害我。我有妻儿老小！还有宠物和家当！

original: Great Khans! Drive Caesar's dog out of our camp! If he's too slow to flee, kill him!
translation: 大汗帮的子民们！把凯撒的走狗赶出我们的营地！如果他跑慢了，就送他归西！

original: You need me more than I need you - don't forget that.
translation: 你们需要我，可我却不一定需要你们，别忘了这一点。

original: {cooly responding to the player's threat}We'll see about that. In any case, we can't let {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death get in the way of the Legion's goals.
translation: {cooly responding to the player's threat}咱们走着瞧。无论如何，军团绝不能因为凯撒的死而停下脚步。

original: Our scouts have reported that the NCR's President Kimball will be visiting the Dam. This is an excellent opportunity to assassinate him.
translation: 我们的斥候报告说NCR的金博尔总统将会造访大坝。这将是刺杀他的绝佳机会。

original: You are to meet with Cato Hostilius - he'll have more information on ways to eliminate Kimball.
translation: 你去找加图·荷提留斯——他会告诉你刺杀金博尔的详细计划。

original: Let's move on, then.
translation: 那咱们就继续努力吧。

original: Yes, we can't let {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death get in the way of the Legion's goals.
translation: 是的，军团绝不能因为凯撒的死而停下脚步。

original: Our scouts have reported that the NCR's President Kimball will be visiting the Dam. This is an excellent opportunity to assassinate him.
translation: 我们的斥候报告说NCR的金博尔总统将会造访大坝。这将是刺杀他的绝佳机会。

original: You are to meet with Cato Hostilius - he'll have more information on ways to eliminate Kimball.
translation: 你去找加图·荷提留斯——他会告诉你刺杀金博尔的详细计划。

original: Apology accepted.
translation: 我接受你的道歉。

original: {KAI-zar's}Caesar's death is regrettable, but we can't let it stand in the way of the Legion's goals.
translation: {KAI-zar's}凯撒的死的确令人遗憾，但军团绝不会因此而停下脚步。

original: Our scouts have reported that the NCR's President Kimball will be visiting the Dam. This is an excellent opportunity to assassinate him.
translation: 我们的斥候报告说NCR的金博尔总统将会造访大坝。这将是刺杀他的绝佳机会。

original: You are to meet with Cato Hostilius - he'll have more information on ways to eliminate Kimball.
translation: 你去找加图·荷提留斯——他会告诉你刺杀金博尔的详细计划。

original: Can I buy out the rest of his contract for 300 caps?
translation: 我用300个瓶盖把他剩下的合同买断怎么样？

original: {Pensive}Yeah, that sounds alright to me. I bet we can find someone to do his work for that much. Tell him to get going.
translation: {Pensive}当然，听起来不错。而且我打赌用这笔钱，我们还能找到一个比他更合适的人，叫他卷铺盖走人吧。

original: What about Primm Slim? Could he be sheriff?
translation: 普瑞姆·斯利姆怎么样？他可以做警长么？

original: Well I guess I never thought of that. I guess he could be sheriff, if you think he could be reprogrammed for it.
translation: 我从来没想过。他应该是可以做警长的，不过你得先重新编写他的程序。

original: Well I reckon he could be a sheriff if you have the skills to reprogram him.
translation: 如果你可以重新给他编一套程序，那么我觉得他应该可以胜任警长。

original: Do you think Primm Slim could be sheriff?
translation: 你觉得普瑞姆·斯利姆能做警长么？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Yeah, {as in, "go on, get out"}go on.
translation: 是啊，{as in, "go on, get out"}走吧。

original: {Player has tried to use elevator to leave}That elevator is nowhere, baby. Step over to the mic.
translation: {Player has tried to use elevator to leave}那电梯动不了啦，宝贝。走到对讲机跟前来吧。

original: {Small Fry}Wow, this is our first hot streak since we opened this place back up! Here's a little something, on the house.
translation: {小赢一把}哇，这还是我们重新开张以来，第一次有人手气这么旺呢！这是给你的，免费。

original: {Big Winner}You're doing great! Keep on spending money, hopefully we'll get some extra action in here.
translation: {大赚一笔}你的手气太棒了！继续消费吧，看来我们是有希望再大展宏图了。

original: {Whale}You're the luckiest player I've ever seen. Keep up the good work in here.
translation: {赚翻了}你是我见过的运气最好的玩家。继续加油吧。

original: {Banned}I'm sorry, you've done so much good stuff for us here in Primm, but we just can't afford to lose any more money to you.
translation: {禁赌}实在抱歉，你在普瑞姆已经赚到不少的钱了，我们都快被你赢破产了。

original: I can't let you play here anymore.
translation: 不能再让你继续玩下去了。

original: Ted's dead.
translation: 泰德死了。

original: {Breaking - his son died}Confound it. I knew I shoulda stayed with him. Ted, I'm so sorry, boy.
translation: {Breaking - his son died}畜生。我就该和他待在一起的。泰德，对不起，孩子。

original: I demand to know who did this!
translation: 我想知道这是谁干的！

original: Ted's been kidnapped. He's here in the hotel.
translation: 泰德被绑架了。他就在这个酒店里。

original: He's here? Bless you, I thought he was a goner for sure.
translation: 他就在这里？上帝保佑你，我还以为他已经完蛋了。

original: Listen, you do what you gotta do to find him. I'd send my men with you but I'm worried they'd kill Ted if we got close.
translation: 听着，不管你用什么办法，一定要找到他。我本来想派人跟着你的，但我担心如果我们打草惊蛇，他们会杀了泰德。

original: Reckon you might need one of these. Take it. Just don't wave it around here where they might take it from you.
translation: 估计这东西你能用得上。拿着吧，不过没事别掏出来显摆，否则可能会被他们没收。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: {neutral}Whatever suits you.
translation: {neutral}随你的便。

original: What are they doing?
translation: 它们在做什么？

original: I don't know what they're up to and I don't want to know. I just hope no harm comes to Novac.
translation: 我不知道它们在做什么，也不想知道。我只希望不会损害到诺瓦克的安全。

original: Not much to live off of around here, except salvage from that factory. If they made off with anything expensive, we'd be hurting something fierce.
translation: 除了去那家工厂里捡废品，这附近没什么能赖以为生的活计。如果它们拿走了什么值钱的东西，那我们损失可就大了。

original: But I will say this. If all of 'em turned up dead tomorrow, I couldn't see as to how they'd be missed.
translation: 不过我可以这么说。要是它们明天早上全死了，也没人会惦记它们。

original: That might even be a desirable thing, knowing the town was safe from the likes of them. There'd be a reward in it if some brave soul made it happen.
translation: 如果镇子能不受它们侵害的话，那真的很让人高兴。如果有哪位勇士能让这愿望成真的话，我们是不会亏待他的。

original: Attention. ARCHIMEDES I Laser is now armed. Move all personnel to minimum safe distance before initiating test fire.
translation: 注意。阿基米德激光系统准备完毕。在火力测试开始前，请所有人员迅速撤离到安全距离外。

original: Warning. Retargeting sequence initiated for HELIOS One reflector banks.
translation: 警告。太阳神一号反光镜群重聚光程式已经启动。

original: The ARCHIMEDES laser systems will automatically initiate test fire upon completion.
translation: 阿基米德激光系统启动后将自动进行火力测试。

original: This concludes our firing test of the ARCHIMEDES I and II laser systems. Thank you for observing Poseidon Energy safety protocol. Have a nice day.
translation: 阿基米德I型与II型激光系统实验到此结束。感谢您参与监督海神能源安全协定。祝您愉快。

original: ARCHIMEDES II orbital laser bombardment will commence in T-minus 5... 4... 3... 2... 1.
translation: 阿基米德II型轨道激光轰炸即将开始，倒计时5… 4… 3… 2… 1。

original: Why is the NCR interested in this desert?
translation: 为什么NCR对这片沙漠感兴趣？

original: It is no secret. Our interest here is two fold.
translation: 这不是什么秘密。我们的对这里感兴趣的原因有两个。

original: First, we want to remain in control of Hoover Dam. It supplies the Republic with power, and is a source of fresh water.
translation: 首先，我们想要控制胡佛水坝。它不但为共和国提供电力，也是一个洁净的水源。

original: Second, we want to prevent the Legion from advancing across the Colorado River and endangering the home states.
translation: 其次，我们要阻止军团跨过科罗拉多河，威胁我们的领土。

original: What's the Legion?
translation: 军团是什么呢？

original: Caesar's Legion.{Lots of spite}
translation: 凯撒军团。{Lots of spite}

original: A bunch of degenerate slavers, led by a madman who calls himself Caesar. Every one of them is a barbarian to the last.
translation: 他们是一群堕落的奴隶贩子，由一个自称凯撒的疯子领导。他们每一个都是彻头彻尾的野蛮人。

original: I've even heard one of their leaders, the Legate or something, goes around with a human skull on his head. Savages to the last.
translation: 我甚至听说他们的头领之中，有个叫什么特使的，头顶着一个骷髅四处招摇。彻头彻尾的蛮子。

original: Can you tell me more about the NCR?
translation: 你能和我讲讲NCR的事吗？

original: Sure can. The NCR was founded from the survivors of one of the great Vaults. We started as a small settlement called Shady Sands.
translation: 当然可以。NCR是由避难所的幸存者创立的。我们起先在一个叫沙荫镇的地方安营扎寨。

original: We now consist of 5 states, that make up the greatest nation since the Great War.
translation: 但现在我们的版图横跨5个州，是大战之后建立的最伟大的国家。

original: What's the New California Republic?
translation: 新加州共和国是什么？

original: Where do you come from that you haven't heard of the NCR? Nevermind, it doesn't matter much.
translation: 你是从哪里来的，连NCR都没听说过？不过无所谓，也没什么大不了的。

original: If you haven't heard of us, you must not be from the Legion. Put simply, the NCR is the greatest nation currently functioning.
translation: 如果你以前没有听说过我们，那么你肯定也不是军团的人。简言之，NCR是当今最伟大的国家。

original: What was Project SEMELE?
translation: 塞莫勒计划是什么？

original: Another one of Poseidon Energy's many secret weapons projects. Before the Great War. It didn't go anywhere.
translation: 是海神能源公司诸多秘密武器项目中的一个。在大战前启动，可惜毫无成果。

original: That's how REPCONN got their shot. So to speak.
translation: 可以说，瑞普康就是藉此发家的。

original: An odd combination.
translation: 一个奇怪的组合。

original: REPCONN went through some rough times. When their rocket business was shaky, Mr. House purchased the company.
translation: 瑞普康当时遇到了危机。他们的火箭在市场上遭到冷遇，于是豪斯先生就趁机收购了这家公司。

original: It didn't take long for him to repurpose their plasma technology for a government weapon contract.
translation: 没过多久，他就与政府签订了武器开发协议，重启了公司在等离子领域的研究。

original: What kind of prototypes?
translation: 什么原型机？

original: Plasma rifles. They were intended to replace the P94 plasma caster.
translation: 等离子步枪。原本是要取代P94等离子投射器的。

original: There was some corporate espionage going on between Poseidon Energy's Project SEMELE and whatever was going on here.
translation: 海神能源公司的“塞默勒”计划以及这儿的某个项目之间似乎存在着不少商业间谍活动。

original: I need a good-looking doctor to help take care of me in the big, bad wasteland.
translation: 我需要个帅气的医生来照顾我，在这个又大又破的废土上。

original: Overt flirtation will get you everywhere, you know.
translation: 甜言蜜语说得倒是挺动听的嘛。

original: On a slightly more serious note, if you're interested in helping out with the troubles plaguing Freeside, I can come with you.
translation: 咱们还是严肃点吧，如果你对解决自由城的问题有兴趣，我可以跟你一起走。

original: Just don't do anything obnoxious, like trying to help Caesar's Legion, and we should be fine. Understood?
translation: 只是别做那些让人讨厌的事情，例如帮助凯撒军团之类，这样对我们大家都好。明白吗？

original: Well, uh... on second thought...
translation: 嗯，呃…重新考虑了一下…

original: Of course. I'm not interested in helping the Legion.
translation: 当然。我对帮助军团没兴趣。

original: Oh, well... in that case, never mind.
translation: 哦，嗯…既然那样，那算了。

original: I'm not sure why you thought a Follower would want to help Caesar after all of the misery he's visited on us and the people we try to help.
translation: 我不明白你怎么会觉得天启追随者的人愿意帮助凯撒，他给我们和我们所帮助的人带来了无尽的苦难。

original: Well, good luck to you in your future endeavors, assuming they don't involve Caesar.
translation: 嗯，祝你今后一切顺利，只要不是和凯撒有关。

original: Fair enough.
translation: 可以。

original: All right. Let's not waste any time. {a bit of enthusiasm}There are people out there to help, things to learn. Maybe not in that order, but let's get to it.
translation: 很好，那我们就别再浪费时间了。外面还有很多人需要帮助，有很多东西需要学习。也许并非事事井然，但我们还是应当努力。

original: Uh... it beats sitting around here all day, doesn't it?
translation: 呃……至少比一整天坐在这儿要好得多，是不？

original: {slight mockery}Uh... probably not. Until things settle down around here, alleviating my boredom isn't a good motive to leave. Sorry.
translation: {slight mockery}嗯……也不尽然。除非这里的事情都尘埃落定，否则我可不想为了寻求刺激而丢下手头的工作。对不起。

original: Ugh. Well if you're going to be like that then never mind.
translation: 啊。既然你那么想，那就算了。

original: Yes. The Followers do not like Caesar or Caesar's Legion. You should also not like them. If you do, you like hurting people and that is bad. Goodbye.
translation: 对。天启追随者不喜欢凯撒和他的军团。你也不应该喜欢他们。如果你喜欢他们，那就等于你喜欢伤害民众，而这是不对的。再见。

original: Yeah, I guess. So are you coming with me or what?
translation: 嗯，我明白。你会跟我一起来吗？

original: This place is really complicated and stuff. You're smart. Can you help me do... things?
translation: 这个地方太乱了。你很聪明。你能帮我…做些事吗？

original: Hmm. Wow. You sound like you really do need some help. Look, I can help you out, but you can't do anything stu-
translation: 嗯。哇，你听起来确实需要帮助。听着，我可以帮你，但你不能光想着做蠢……

original: I mean, you can't... help bad people, who want to hurt the locals in Freeside. If you do, I'll leave. Does that make sense?
translation: 我是说，你不可以……帮助坏人，就是那些会伤害自由城人民的家伙，如果你这样做，我就走。明白了吗？

original: Things are bad around here. I'd like to make a difference, and I'd like you to help me.
translation: 这儿的情况太糟了，我想做出些改变，希望你能帮我。

original: Hmm. That seems appropriately resolute and yet vague. I'll give you the benefit of the doubt and go with you, but let me be clear about something.
translation: 嗯。语气很坚定但似乎又有点含糊。我就姑且相信你，跟你走，不过我得先声明一件事情。

original: If you plan to help Caesar's Legion, this is going to be a brief relationship.
translation: 如果你打算去帮助凯撒军团，那我们的友谊就到此为止。

original: I may not have all the answers for how to fix Freeside's problems, but Caesar taking control isn't part of the solution. Fair?
translation: 虽然我也没什么好办法能解决自由城当下的问题，但我也绝不会同意让凯撒占领这里。可以吗？

original: The NCR oppression around here would disappear if the Legion took control. I could use your help.
translation: 一旦军团控制了这里，NCR就不会再压迫这里的人民了。我需要你的帮助。

original: Only because everyone would be conscripted or enslaved. And the people who are unfit for military service or slavery would be put down. Swell plan.
translation: 所有人都要服兵役或劳役。任何反对兵役或劳役的人都会遭到镇压。雄伟的计划。

original: Yes, a veritable {pahx roh-MAH-nah}Pax Romana for post-nuclear America. My political beliefs are a bit more progressive than outright fascism, so I'll pass. Thanks.
translation: 没错，这就是名副其实的罗马式和平，专为核战后的美国所设计。可惜我的政治理念要比纯粹的法西斯主义更为进步，所以我不会参与的。谢谢。

original: If New Vegas can remain independent, I'm going to find a way to do it. I could use your help.
translation: 如果新维加斯真的能保持独立，我愿意会为此奋斗终生。我需要你的帮助。

original: If that's really what you're trying to do, I'll go with you.
translation: 假如这就是你奋斗的目标，那我愿意跟着你干。

original: Things are hectic around here, but it won't mean anything if NCR or the Legion take control. I'm sure the Followers can manage without me.
translation: 尽管这儿工作繁忙，可要是让NCR或者军团占领了这里，那我们的所有努力也就白费了。我相信天启追随者就算少了我也可以应付得来。

original: Just don't try to help the Legion, and we shouldn't have any problems. Sound good?
translation: 只要你不去帮军团的忙，我就没意见。可以吗？

original: I'm trying to help Mr. House keep New Vegas independent.
translation: 我在帮助豪斯先生保持新维加斯的独立。

original: That's funny. Mr. House doesn't want to keep New Vegas independent. He just wants to keep the NCR and Caesar's Legion from pushing him around.
translation: 真有趣。豪斯先生并不想让新维加斯保持独立。他只是不想受NCR和凯撒的摆布。

original: He must be pretty convincing if he's roped you into helping him, but you can count me out.
translation: 他能让你心甘情愿替他卖命，说明他口才不错，可惜我不吃你这一套。

original: The NCR needs help against the Legion before Caesar moves on the dam. We could use your skills.
translation: 为了阻止凯撒进军水坝，NCR需要团结一切可以利用的力量，你的能力会派上用场的。

original: The NCR had a chance to use the Followers' skills before, but being imperialists mattered more to them. No thanks.
translation: NCR不是没机会得到天启追随者的支持，可惜他们骨子里的沙文主义却更胜一筹。不，谢了。

original: I'm going after a man named Benny for revenge and I need someone to keep me patched up.
translation: 我正在追杀一个名叫本尼的男人，他与我有仇，我需要有个人来替我疗伤。

original: Pulling bullets out of a vengeance-crazed drifter is truly a noble step up from tending to the downtrodden of Freeside, but I think I'll pass.
translation: 帮一个满脑子只想着复仇的家伙取子弹，是比照顾自由城那帮穷鬼要好得多。不过我还是算了吧。

original: What do you know about them?
translation: 关于他们你都知道些什么？

original: Uh, what does anyone know about them? Big... flying machines, right? Crazy helicopters. {quietly}So weird.
translation: 呃，一般人对他们都有什么印象？巨大的……飞行器，对不？还有诡异的直升机。{quietly}反正就是稀奇。

original: When was that?
translation: 什么时候的事？

original: Huh. {trying to think of a plausible lie}Good question. Must have been in a book.
translation: 啊。{trying to think of a plausible lie}问的好。肯定某本书里有写。

original: Anderson killed White. He deserved to pay for what he did.
translation: 安德森杀了怀特。他就该血债血偿。

original: Fantastic. Now the only influential person who gave a damn about Westside is gone. Great job.
translation: 棒极了。这下唯一一个关心西区人民福祉的头面人物也嗝屁了。你可真棒。

original: In case I'm not laying down enough sarcasm, you just screwed up the lives of a bunch of struggling people.
translation: 如果你嫌我这句话还不够刺耳，那这么说吧，你这是等于把一群还生活在水深火热中的人们置于死地。

original: What's done is done.
translation: 覆水难收。

original: {irritated}I guess that means you don't have to apologize to all of the people in Westside you just screwed over.
translation: {irritated}我看你的意思是，就算你毁了所有西区老百姓的生活，你也丝毫不觉得需要道歉。

original: In case you weren't paying attention, you killed the only person who ever gave a damn about them.
translation: 那我告诉你好了，免得你一脸无所谓，你杀死的这个人，是唯一还关心他们死活的人。

original: I'm sorry. I didn't realize it would end like this.
translation: 抱歉。我没想到会是这个结果。

original: {sighing, pause}Neither did Anderson.
translation: {sighing,pause}安德森也没想到。

original: Let's keep moving.
translation: 咱们接着走吧。

original: Of course.
translation: 当然。

original: If you say so. I'm not arguing.
translation: 随便你怎么说吧，我不打算和你争。

original: I do say so. The Followers aren't a military organization. If anyone knew what he was up to, they weren't talking.
translation: 我就这个看法。天启追随者不是什么军事组织。就算有人知道他的企图，他们也不会明说的。

original: And if they knew he was stealing water, so what? Westside has more of a right to that water than the NCR.
translation: 哪怕他们知道他在偷水，那又怎样？西区比NCR更需要这些水。

original: Right. "The Followers don't endorse his actions," and all that.
translation: 对。"天启追随者不认同他的行为。"你们就会这一套。

original: Well {emph}I don't. I'm sure there were a few people turning a blind eye, but can you blame them?
translation: 好吧，{emph}我没有。我知道肯定有人睁一只眼闭一只眼，但你能怪他们吗？

original: NCR's sharecropper farms had all of the water. The nearest fresh source is the lake, and that's a bit of a hike.
translation: NCR的佃户农场把附近的水源都给霸占了。离这儿最近的淡水源就是那个湖，可要走很远。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: See you around.
translation: 后会有期。

original: What kind of research do you do?
translation: 你做的是哪种研究？

original: Do you need any help?
translation: 你需要帮忙吗？

original: Me, specifically? No. I'm sure Julie Farkas does, though. Lab coat, pointy hair. Answers to the name "Julie Farkas," strangely enough.
translation: 你说我？不，我想朱莉·法卡斯更需要帮助。白大衣、尖头发，和"朱莉·法卡斯"这个名字还真是相称啊，有意思。

original: I'm sure she can find something for you to do. It might be kind of... depressing and terrible, though. {cah-WEE-aht sah-mahr-ee-TAH-noos, "Samaritan, beware."}Caveat Samaritanus.
translation: 她会给你找些事做的。不过，估计是那种……既糟糕又骇人的差事。（拉丁文）可得当心啊，好心人。

original: Personally, no. But thanks to you, Julie says we're a lot better off these days. I'll take her word for it. So, thanks.
translation: 就我而言，不需要。但多亏了你，朱莉说我们现在的情况已经好多了。我也认同她的话。所以，谢谢。

original: It says a superior is not allowed to give orders to the men under his subordinate.
translation: 意思是上级不可越级下达命令。

original: Then that means I can cast McNamara down for giving those secret orders to my Paladins! Well done! That's exactly what I was looking for!
translation: 也就是说，如果麦克纳马拉擅自对我的圣骑士下令，我就能把他拉下马！很好！这正是我想要的东西！

original: That is the standard procedure, yes. For example, McNamara gives orders to Head Scribe Taggart, who then relays further orders to the scribes.
translation: 正规流程确实如此。比如，麦克纳马拉要先下令给首席学士塔格特，再由其传令给各位学士。

original: I wasn't aware that failing to do so was punishable, however. Interesting...
translation: 但是，我从没想过如果不按规程走会有什么后果，有意思……

original: If we can just find an instance where McNamara went around someone and gave orders to their subordinates, we'll have him.
translation: 如果我们能发现麦克纳马拉越级下达了命令，那我们就能对付他了。

original: Did you know there's a second part to it?
translation: 你知道还有第二层含义吗？

original: Second part? What are you talking about?
translation: 第二层含义？你在说什么啊？

original: One of the few times an Elder was dismissed was due to it.
translation: 有几位长老就是因为这个而遭到罢免。

original: I could be wrong, but I think that's a dead end. McNamara's always followed orders, and we've been incommunicado since fleeing HELIOS.
translation: 依我之见，这恐怕行不通。麦克纳马拉向来服从命令，而且自从我们撤离了太阳神一号后，就与上级失去了联络。

original: Do you know anything about the Chain That Binds?
translation: 你知道什么是“忠如锁链”吗？

original: I could hardly call myself Head Paladin if I didn't. It's one of the first things every initiate learns when they start training. What about it?
translation: 我要不知道，还当什么圣骑士长。打新兵训练的头一天开始，他们就必须学习这句话。怎么了？

original: I found the patrols for the Elder, and they had mission discs with orders from McNamara on them.
translation: 我找到了巡逻队，任务磁盘上记录着麦克纳马拉的命令。

original: {Increasingly angry}Just as I thought, McNamara gave my men new orders without telling me. The nerve of that man!
translation: {Increasingly angry}不出所料，麦克纳马拉给我的人下了新指令，却连通知我一声都没有。好大的胆子！

original: This little stunt is probably what got them killed in the first place. Our normal patrol routes are known to be relatively safe.
translation: 也许正是这个小插曲让他们丢了性命。按理说我们平时的巡逻路线应该很安全才对。

original: This is exactly what I've been looking for! McNamara gave my men new orders without telling me, thereby breaking the Chain That Binds!
translation: 这正是我要找的东西！麦克纳马拉给我的人下了命令，却不告诉我，还谈什么“忠如锁链”！

original: With this, I can finally have him removed as Elder, and end this ridiculous lockdown.
translation: 有了这个，我终于能把他拉下马，结束这场荒唐的封锁了。

original: This is exactly the kind of thing I'm trying to avoid by ousting McNamara.
translation: 罢免麦克纳马拉就是为了防止这种事再次发生。

original: I wanted to ask you some other questions.
translation: 我想再问你一些问题。

original: If you must.
translation: 你问吧。

original: The Elder has me looking for parts to fix the bunker's air filtration system.
translation: 长老让我去寻找用于修复地堡空气过滤系统的零件。

original: The filtration system? He wouldn't have you looking if we didn't need those parts badly, which means that system's in real trouble.
translation: 过滤系统？若不是有紧急情况，他是不会给你分派这种任务的。看来过滤系统真的出问题了。

original: If the air filters go, it will become impossible to breathe down here. We'd be forced to evacuate the bunker!
translation: 不能过滤空气的话，在这地下也就根本无法呼吸。那样我们就只能撤离地堡了！

original: I can't believe he's kept something like this to himself! We should have every able-bodied person in the chapter working on this.
translation: 真不敢相信他居然一直隐瞒这件事！我们应该让所有四肢健全的人都来想办法解决这个问题。

original: All the more reason for you to find a way to get McNamara out of that chair, before he dooms us all.
translation: 由此也可以看出，让麦克纳马拉下台是有多么必要，再这样下去我们迟早会被他害死。

original: The Elder tasked me with contacting several scouts out in the waste.
translation: 长老让我去和几个身在外面的侦察兵取得联系。

original: That's a sensible notion. Your familiarity with the nearby terrain makes you perfect as a liason.
translation: 这个决策还算明智。毕竟你对这附近的地形很熟悉，让你去再合适不过。

original: I've been trying to get the Elder to send out scouts for years, and he's always been resistant to the idea. Said they'd be a vulnerability.
translation: 这些年我一直在鼓动长老派遣侦察兵，可他就是不乐意，还说什么他们容易受到攻击。

original: I wonder what changed his mind.
translation: 我很好奇他是怎么改变主意的。

original: The Elder has me looking for the lost patrols and retrieving their mission discs.
translation: 长老让我去搜寻失踪的巡逻队，还让我把他们的任务记录磁盘带回来。

original: Yes, I know the loss of the patrols has weighed heavily on his mind for some time. He took it very personally when they first went missing.
translation: 是，我知道巡逻队失踪这件事让他坐立不安。得知他们失踪的时候，他甚至还为此大发雷霆。

original: That was when I first began to seriously question his ability to lead us. A commander has to be able to deal with the potential loss of his men.
translation: 从那时起，我就开始怀疑他的领导能力。身为指挥官，应当对任何可能的人员损失都做好心理准备。

original: It's strange that he would ask you to find mission discs on them, however. The missing paladins were all on standard patrols, which don't need them.
translation: 不过他居然会让你找任务磁盘，真是奇怪。那些失踪的圣骑士执行的是常规巡逻任务，不需要磁盘。

original: Only Brothers sent on special assignments are given mission discs. If you should find any on the lost patrols, let me know.
translation: 只有在遇到特殊任务时，才会发放任务磁盘。如果你在失踪的巡逻队员身上发现磁盘，请务必告诉我一声。

original: I wanted to ask you some questions.
translation: 我想问你一些问题。

original: Sure, what about?
translation: 可以，关于什么的？

original: No, I haven't found any of them yet.
translation: 不，我还一个也没找到呢。

original: I don't want to rush you or anything, but time is of the essence. Please try to find those components as soon as you can.
translation: 我不想催你，但是时间宝贵。请尽快收集零件。

original: Not all of them.
translation: 还没找全。

original: It's amazing that you've found any of them and not gotten gruesomely mangled. Keep up the good work!
translation: 你能毫发无损地找到这些东西已经很不错了。继续努力吧！

original: They're all right here.
translation: 都在这了。

original: {Had serious doubts the player could do it}Really? I mean, that's great! I knew you could do it all along. I'll get right to work installing these.
translation: {Had serious doubts the player could do it}真的吗？我是说，真是太棒了！我就知道你能办到。我马上就把这些零件更换上去。

original: Why don't you go tell the Elder the good news. I'm sure it'll be a huge load off of his shoulders.
translation: 为什么不把这个好消息告诉长老呢？我敢说他听到后一定会松口气的。

original: Just give the details.
translation: 告诉我细节。

original: The items I'll need to keep the system running are a differential pressure controller, a reverse pulse cleaner, and several {HEP-uh} HEPA cartridge filters.
translation: 要维持系统运作，我需要一个压差控制器，一个超声波清洁器，还有一些{HEP-uh}HEPA20型过滤器。

original: At present, my best guess for finding the items would be to search any of the old vaults in the area.
translation: 目前看来，最有可能找到这些东西的地方就是遍布这附近的旧避难所了。

original: Those vaults were usually built much like these military bunkers, even using the same contractors in their constructions at times.
translation: 那些避难所都盖得像军用碉堡似的，承建商还都是同一批人。

original: I'll mark the vaults' locations on your map. Best of luck to you.
translation: 我会在你的地图上标记出各大避难所的位置。祝你好运。

original: Maybe you misheard me.
translation: 你听错了吧。

original: No, I heard you quite clearly. You're being sent off to be killed like the others.
translation: 不，我听得很清楚。你和其他人一样，都是去送死的。

original: Er, what?
translation: 呃，什么？

original: {scornful, with a little hysteria}You think you're the first person the Elder's trusted with this? He sent three of our patrols out looking for those components, and they're all dead.
translation: {scornful，with a little hysteria}你以为长老只吩咐了你一个？他派了三支巡逻队出去寻找零件，结果他们都挂了。

original: I was the one who supplied the Elder with the location of possible sites where we could find the components, so their deaths are my fault.
translation: 是我告诉长老哪些地方能找到零件的，所以他们的死有我一部分责任。

original: {speaking somewhat quickly, nervous}And now it's your turn. Well, don't say you weren't warned. I won't take the blame when you die horribly. But I can tell you're getting impatient.
translation: {speaking somewhat quickly，nervous}现在这倒霉差事落到你头上。好吧，别说我没警告过你。你死了我也不会内疚到哪儿去，但我知道你有点不耐烦了。

original: The Elder wants me to retrieve components to help fix the air filtration system.
translation: 长老让我寻找维修空气过滤系统的零件。

original: {Beat}...So now I'm going to have your death on my conscience, too. Great.
translation: {Beat}……万一你也死了，我的良心会更不安的。好极了。

original: Go on.
translation: 继续。

original: The device that creates the sandstorms above, that masks our comings and goings, was only intended to be used in case of emergencies.
translation: 那个制造沙尘暴的装置，目前被用来隐藏我们的行踪，但它原本只是用于紧急情况。

original: It was never meant to be used with any regularity, and the other systems here were not designed to accommodate such usage.
translation: 这东西不能频繁使用，地堡里的其他系统在设计时也没有考虑要长期使用。

original: In particular, the air filtration system simply cannot handle the quantity of sand and grit that it's been forced to cope with these last few years.
translation: 尤其是空气过滤系统，这些年来积了好些尘土，已经快要不堪重负了。

original: As a result, the system is failing, albeit slowly. I'm told we have scant few months before it shuts down completely.
translation: 结果就是，系统正在逐渐失灵。再这样下去，过不了几个月它就会彻底报销。

original: Should that happen, it will quickly become impossible to breathe here in the bunker. Already the air quality begins to slightly worsen.
translation: 万一真出了事，我们全都会憋死在地堡里。目前空气质量已经开始有些恶化了。

original: Just tell me what you want me to do.
translation: 想要我干什么，说就是了。

original: I would like you to find the components we need to fix this bunker's air filtration system. I cannot overstate the importance of this task.
translation: 我需要你去寻找可以用来修复空气过滤系统的组件。这项任务无比重要。

original: See Senior Knight Lorenzo for the details. He's the one who brought the matter to my attention, and the only other person who is aware of it.
translation: 具体事宜去找高阶骑士洛伦佐了解吧。这件事是他报告的，他也是除我之外唯一知道此事的人。

original: One of the datastore entries mentioned the Chain That Binds. What is that, exactly?
translation: 数据库中有一条提到了“忠如锁链”，那是什么意思？

original: That's an old, old principle that's been around since the Brotherhood was founded. It basically means that you have to obey a superior officer.
translation: 那是自兄弟会成立起就存在的一条古老准则。大意是你必须绝对服从上级的命令。
