original: It's a simple procedure... as brain surgeries go.
translation: 程序很简单…就如脑部手术一样。

original: [FAILED] If you think this is funny, you should give crucifixion a try. Now that's hilarious.
translation: [失败] 你要觉得有趣，我可以让你体验一下耶稣是怎么受难的。真是荒唐。

original: If you can't help me, who can?
translation: 如果你帮不了我，还有谁可以？

original: I'll need a vise... or a large nutcracker...
translation: 我需要一个老虎钳……或者一个大的胡桃夹子……

original: [SUCCEEDED] Then gather those items together and hurry back to perform the operation. I don't know how long I've got.
translation: [成功] 那么就快点去把东西找齐，再赶紧回来做手术。我不知道我还剩多少时间了。

original: I can perform the surgery, but I'll need proper tools and supplies from a Doctor's Bag.
translation: 我可以做手术，但我需要一套合适的器械，以及医用手提包里的物品。

original: [FAILED] Then gather the tools you need, and study up on your medical skills.
translation: [失败] 那就去把要用的东西找齐，再提高一下你的医术吧。

original: When you're confident you can perform the operation, hurry back. I don't know how long I've got.
translation: 等你有自信给我开刀，再回来找我吧。我不知道自己还能坚持多久。

original: Even with proper Surgical Tools, an operation of this sort might be beyond me.
translation: 就算有合适的手术器械，这个手术的难度还是超出了我的能力范围。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {no idea what that diagnosis is}I'm not familiar with that condition. Is it treatable?
translation: [成功] {no idea what that diagnosis is}我对这种疾病不太了解。可以治愈吗？

original: Straight-forward case of intra-cranial blastoma fibrolosis, I wager.
translation: 我敢打赌，这是典型的脑肿瘤。

original: [FAILED] {the player is full of shit}There's nothing "moderate" about the severity of this. And if you're going to make up names for diseases, come up with good ones.
translation: [失败] 我可不觉得这是"一般"严重。还有，如果你想给这种病起名，最好给我挑个漂亮一点的字眼。

original: If you can't help me, who can?
translation: 如果你不能帮我，又有谁可以？

original: Sounds like a moderately severe case of Skullatosis.
translation: 听起来也就是一般严重的脑浆糊嘛。

original: [Medicine Check]
translation: [医疗鉴定]

original: [SUCCEEDED] {not surprised}I figured as much.
translation: [成功] {not surprised}所见略同啊。

original: Congratulations, you just became my personal physician. Do you have what you need to treat my condition?
translation: 恭喜你，你刚刚成了我的私人医生。你手上有治疗用的器材吗？

original: I'm afraid your symptoms are consistent with a brain lesion, most likely a tumor.
translation: 恐怕你的症状与脑部损伤有关，也许是肿瘤。

original: [FAILED]{pretty obvious, asshole} Yeah, it does. So if you can't help me, who can?
translation: [失败]{pretty obvious, asshole}是的，没错。不过既然你不能帮我，又有谁能呢？

original: I don't know. Sounds serious, though.
translation: 我不知道。不过听起来很严重。

original: Seriously, let's talk about your health.
translation: 说真的，还是谈谈你的健康问题吧。

original: {back the fuck off}I said, take care of the Brotherhood. Then we talk - maybe.
translation: {back the fuck off}我说了，摆平兄弟会，谈不谈以后再说。

original: I think we should talk about your health.
translation: 我认为我们应该谈谈你的健康问题。

original: Take care of the Brotherhood. {beat - considering it, tantamount to admitting there's a problem}Maybe then we can have a conversation.
translation: 先把兄弟会摆平。到那时候再来谈别的事情。

original: [SUCCEEDED] {tired}Don't... just leave it alone. I'm fine. Now what was I saying...? Right.
translation: [成功] {tired}别……别管它……我很好。我刚才说到哪里了…？对了。

original: I'm concerned you may have a serious neurological condition.
translation: 我认为你的头疼反映出你身上可能潜伏着更严重的疾病。

original: Where do I find the Brotherhood? How do I destroy them?
translation: 我要去哪儿找兄弟会？要怎么消灭他们？

original: {tired}Look for the Brotherhood's bunker around, uh... {trying to remember}Hidden Valley. My scouts... saw some things.
translation: {tired}兄弟会的地堡应该就在，呃……{trying to remember}隐谷。我的探子…曾经见过他们。

original: I'm going to bed. We'll talk later.
translation: 我要去睡觉了。我们以后再谈吧。

original: You just blanked out for several seconds.
translation: 你刚才突然愣了几秒。

original: {tired}It's nothing. Just tired, that's all.
translation: {tired}没事。只是累了而已。

original: [Medicine options]
translation: [医学选项]

original: [SUCCEEDED] {tired}I don't know... There have been a couple...
translation: [成功] {tired}我不知道…已经好几次了……

original: You just experienced an Absence Seizure. Was this the first time?
translation: 你刚才失神了，这是头一次吗？

original: [FAILED] {tired}I'm... I'm not sure. {confused}What was I saying? {remembering, to yourself}That's right, the Brotherhood...
translation: [失败] {tired}我…我不知道。 {confused}我刚才说了什么？{remembering, to yourself}对了，兄弟会……

original: What were you daydreaming about?
translation: 你在做什么白日梦啊？

original: Hello! We were talking?
translation: 喂！听得到我说话吗？

original: Are you okay?
translation: 你还好吗？

original: Hmm...{breathe through nose}
translation: 唔…{breathe through nose}

original: {as though waking from a cat nap}Huh... Yeah. Yeah.
translation: {as though waking from a cat nap}唔……嗯。还好。

original: {tired, unaware you aren't making sense}Yeah, the Brotherhood. Them.
translation: {tired, unaware you aren't making sense}对，兄弟会。

original: [Medicine options!!!]
translation: [医学选项 !!!]

original: [SUCCEEDED] I appreciate your concern, but I'm in excellent health. And we have other matters to discuss.
translation: [成功] 感谢你的关心，我很好。我们还有其他更重要的事要讨论。

original: I'm concerned your headaches might be symptoms of a more serious condition.
translation: 我认为你的头疼反映出你身上可能有更严重的疾病。

original: [FAILED]{irritated} Only when you're around.{leads to "So I get headaches every once in a while..."}
translation: [失败]{irritated} 只要你在身边我就疼。

original: Do you get headaches a lot?
translation: 你常常头疼吗？

original: Yes, you said I should forge an alliance between the White Gloves and your Legion.
translation: 是的，你说过要我去促成白手套和军团达成同盟。

original: What about the White Glove Society?
translation: 白手套怎么办？

original: I was saying that I'd planned to ask you to forge an alliance with them, but you killed their leaders.
translation: 我原本的意思是让你去和他们结盟，结果你却把他们的头领给杀了。

original: By the time the White Gloves sort themselves out, the battle for Hoover Dam will have come and gone. So, on to the next matter at hand...
translation: 等到白手套恢复元气，估计胡佛大坝的战斗早就结束了。算了，我们还是说下一件事吧……

original: The last time we met, your head seemed ready to explode.
translation: 上次我们见面时，你的头好像就要爆炸似的。

original: {irritated}I get headaches every once in a while. So what? {switching modes}Anyway, we have other matters to discuss.
translation: {irritated}我的头每隔一阵就会疼。那又怎样？{switching modes}无论如何，我们还有其他事要讨论。

original: What were you saying about the White Glove Society?
translation: 你上次想说白手套怎么了？

original: {meaning it}Disturb me again and I'll have you killed!
translation: 再来烦我，我就杀了你！

original: [SUCCEEDED] {intense pain}A week, maybe two... {frustrated}it doesn't matter!
translation: [成功] {intense pain}一两个星期吧…… {frustrated}那不重要！

original: You're limping when you walk. How long has that been going on?
translation: 你的腿似乎有点瘸。这种情况已经持续多久了？

original: [FAILED] {growled, drawn out}Fuck off.
translation: [失败] {growled, drawn out}滚开。

original: You don't look so good.
translation: 你好像不大对头。

original: Sorry, I'll let you sleep.
translation: 对不起，你还是睡吧。

original: [Medicine 40+]
[SUCCEEDED] {having some difficulty speaking}Never this... bad before.
translation: [成功] 以前都没有……这么糟过。

original: Is this the first time you've experienced sudden onset headaches?
translation: 这是不是你第一次感到突然头痛？

original: [FAILED] {fighting through the pain}What's it look like, you asshole?
translation: [失败] 你觉得呢，混蛋？

original: Does your head hurt?
translation: 你的头受伤了吗？

original: You were saying?
translation: 你的意思是？

original: Are you all right?
translation: 你还好吗？

original: {fighting through the pain}Fuck this, I'm going to lie down!
translation: {fighting through the pain}妈的，我要躺一下！

original: {fighting through the pain}Come back later - tomorrow!
translation: {fighting through the pain}待会——明天再来！

original: What is that machine in your tent?
translation: 你帐篷里的机器是什么？

original: It's called an Auto-Doc. As the name suggests, it's an automated physician - more or less.
translation: 它叫做自动医生。顾名思义，它或多或少——算是个自动化的医生。

original: It can treat broken bones, cuts, punctures, scrapes. Sometimes I bestow its use upon someone I favor.
translation: 它可以医治骨折，割伤，刺伤，擦伤。有时候我也会恩准我青睐的人使用它。

original: Makes for a powerful gift, in a culture that forbids painkillers and is largely ignorant of medical science.
translation: 在一个禁止使用止痛药，周遭的人又对医学一无所知的文化中，这也算是莫大的恩赐了。

original: I just killed everyone the old-fashioned way.
translation: 我只是用最简单粗暴的方法杀了所有人而已。

original: I killed everyone in the camp.
translation: 我把营地里的人都杀了。

original: {irritated}Let me get to my chair.
translation: {irritated}让我先坐下来。

original: {even more irritated}I said, let me get to my chair.
translation: {even more irritated}我说，让我先坐下来。

original: Who is this Legatus you mention?
translation: 你提到的这个特使是谁？

original: {admiring}Legatus Lanius, Monster of the East! Quite a man, if man he be.
translation: {admiring}特使拉尼厄斯，东方之兽！真正的男子汉，甚至这个词都不足以形容他。

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar prides himself on selecting the right tool to overcome each new obstacle. In Lanius, he found his hammer.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒最引以为傲的是用人，他总能选出正确的工具来克服新障碍。而拉尼厄斯，就是他找到的一把铁锤。

original: He's never been defeated in battle. 14 tribes have laid down arms at his boots. Another five, rendered extinct.
translation: 他从未吃过败仗。有14个部落臣服在他的脚下，另外5个不愿投降的都已经化为了尘埃。

original: His latest campaign in the wilds of the Utah has concluded, and he is en route. When he arrives, your doom arrives with him.
translation: 他刚刚结束犹他州的战役，正在赶来的路上。等他一到，你们的末日也将接踵而至。

original: Tell me about Caesar.
translation: 跟我说说凯撒的事。

original: What can be said? He's a man of towering intellect, the founder of the Legion, conquerer of 86 tribes.
translation: 有什么好说的？他智力超群，是军团的创建者，征服了86个部落。

original: {KAI-zar}Caesar is the salvation of mankind, his Legion the rebirth of civilization in a benighted age.
translation: {KAI-zar}凯撒是人类的救星，他的军团象征着文明在这个黑暗时代的重生。

original: Don't worry, you'll know him well when you serve him. Or you'll be dead.
translation: 别担心，等你服侍他的时候，自然会了解他。不了解的人是会有性命之忧的。

original: Your "civilization" sounds like a pack of snarling dogs.
translation: 你们所谓的"文明"听起来就像一群疯狗乱吠。

original: {scoffing guffaw}Indeed, our hounds demonstrate greater loyalty to each other every day than the wretched inhabitants of this town.
translation: {scoffing guffaw}的确，我们的猎犬对彼此都很忠诚，比这座城镇里卑鄙的居民好多了。

original: How can I serve the Legion?
translation: 我该如何为军团效力？

original: You bear the Mark of {KAI-zar}Caesar. That makes you special.
translation: 你带着凯撒的印记。看来你不同寻常。

original: Do whatever {KAI-zar}Caesar tells you to do. And whenever the opportunity presents, strike at the Profligates. Pile body upon body.
translation: 你要遵照凯撒的命令行事。并且一有机会，就攻击荒淫之人，让他们尸横遍野。

original: Tell everyone you meet of what you saw here. The Legion can handle the rest.
translation: 你要把这里的所见所闻告诉每一个人。剩下的交给军团就行。

original: That said, if you were to strike at the Profligates, butcher them, trouble their operations... this will not go unnoticed.
translation: 话虽如此，如果你将来袭击荒淫之人，屠杀他们，或者干扰他们的行动……军团也会看在眼里。

original: I admire the purity of the Legion's justice.
translation: 军团的正义如此纯粹，令我钦慕。

original: You're unusually bright for a Profligate. Well done.
translation: 你居然如此开窍，作为一名荒淫之人真有些不同寻常。很好。

original: Now go, and teach what you've learned here. There will be more lessons in the days ahead.
translation: 你可以走了，把在这里看到的一切告诉其他人吧。在未来的日子里，你们还会学到更多。

original: It has a stark beauty, doesn't it? I'm glad you can appreciate it.
translation: 这显然是一种质朴的美，不是吗？我很高兴你能欣赏它。

original: Now go, and teach them what you learned here. There will be more lessons in the days ahead.
translation: 你可以走了，把在这里看到的一切告诉其他人吧。在未来的日子里，你们还会学到更多。

original: Sounds like they got what was coming to them.
translation: 听起来他们罪有应得。

original: It has a stark beauty, doesn't it? I'm glad you can appreciate it.
translation: 这显然是一种质朴的美，不是吗？我很高兴你能欣赏它。

original: Now go, and teach the Mojave Outpost what you learned here. There will be more lessons in the days ahead.
translation: 你可以走了，把在这里看到的一切告诉莫哈维前哨的人吧。在未来的日子里，你们还会学到更多。

original: Yes, they did. As will all the rest of you, in due time.
translation: 对，确实如此。你们其他人迟早也会这样。

original: Now go, and teach the Mojave Outpost what you've learned here. There will be more lessons in the days ahead.
translation: 你可以走了，把在这里看到的一切告诉莫哈维前哨的人吧。在未来的日子里，你们还会学到更多。

original: You slaughtered innocent civilians?
translation: 你屠杀了无辜的村民？

original: {scoffing Ha!}Innocent? Hardly.
translation: {scoffing Ha!}无辜？我看不出来。

original: Cowardly, though. They outnumbered us, yet not once did they try to resist.
translation: 倒是很懦弱。他们人数比我们多，却一点儿也不敢反抗。

original: They stood and watched as their fellows were butchered, crucified, and burned, one by one.
translation: 他们只会呆站着，眼睁睁看着自己的同伴一个个被杀死、钉死、烧死。

original: They stood and hoped their turn would not come. Each cared only for himself.
translation: 他们只希望同样的厄运不会落到自己身上。每个人都只关心自己。

original: I've heard enough.
translation: 我听够了。

original: I think your eyes will see more than I could ever tell you. Take your time. Enjoy the sights.
translation: 我觉得你应该亲眼见识一番，比我的言语更有说服力。别着急。慢慢欣赏。

original: {curious}Why, then, do you keep asking?
translation: {curious}你为什么非要刨根问底呢？

original: You captured everyone?
translation: 你抓住了所有人？

original: Yes, and herded them to the center of town. I told them their sins, the foremost being disloyalty.
translation: 是的。我把他们驱赶到镇中心，宣布他们的罪状，第一条就是不忠。

original: I told them that when Legionaries are disloyal, some are punished, the others made to watch. And I announced the lottery.
translation: 我告诉他们，军团士兵如果不忠，其中一部分人会受到惩罚，而另外的人则必须看着。接着，我宣布开始抽奖。

original: Each clutched his ticket, hoping it would set him free. Each did nothing, even when {mocking the term}"loved ones" were dragged away to be killed.
translation: 每个人都紧紧抓着自己的彩票，希望能靠它获得自由。就算{mocking the term}"深爱的人"被拖出去处死，他们也无动于衷。

original: What exactly happened here?
translation: 这里到底出了什么事？

original: Nipton was a wicked place, debased and corrupt. It served all comers, so long as they paid.
translation: 尼普顿是个邪恶的地方，腐败又堕落。只要付钱，它会向任何人敞开大门。

original: Profligate troops, Powder Gangers - or men of the Legion. The people here didn't care. It was a town of whores.
translation: 无论荒淫之人的部队，炸药帮，还是我这样的军团士兵——这里的人都不在乎。他们就是一群娼妓。

original: For a pittance, the great {WUHL-pace in-CUHL-tah}Vulpes Inculta {in-VAY-gulled}inveigled this town to lead those it had sheltered into a trap.
translation: 不久前，{WUHL-pace in-CUHL-tah}沃尔普斯·因库塔{in-VAY-gulled}欺骗了镇上的人，将整个镇子诱入了全套。

original: Only when it was sprung did they realize they were caught inside it, too. {beat, regret}I only wish {WUHL-pace}Vulpes had lived to see the scheme come to fruition.
translation: 若不是他亲自点破，镇民们还不知道自己已经成为瓮中之鳖。{beat, regret}我真希望{WUHL-pace}沃尔普斯能活着看到计划实现。

original: Your crimes are unforgivable.
translation: 你的罪行不可饶恕。

original: So you've said.
translation: 你说过了。

original: Tell me about Caesar's Legion.
translation: 跟我说说凯撒军团的事。

original: The Legion is civilization reborn. Our culture is based on virtues such as martial excellence, loyalty, and justice.
translation: 军团象征着文明的重生。我们的文化植根于尚武、忠诚和正义之类美德之上。

original: But you'll learn all there is to know in due time. {Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}Legatus Lanius, Monster of the East, will soon arrive to command {KAI-zar's}Caesar's troops in battle.
translation: 不过这些还是留着你以后慢慢学习吧。{Le-GAH-tus La-nee-OOS}特使拉尼厄斯，东方之兽，很快就要来指挥{KAI-zar's}凯撒的部队作战了。

original: The Dam will fall, and the rest of the Profligate west will soon follow.
translation: 大坝必将落入我们手中，西部其他的荒淫之人也会随之灭亡。

original: What "lessons" did you teach here?
translation: 你给了他们什么"教训"？

original: Where to begin? That they are weak, and we are strong? This much was known already.
translation: 从哪开始说呢？他们很弱，我们很强？这个已经是众所周知的了。

original: But the depths of their moral sickness, their {a beat}dissolution? Nipton serves as the perfect object lesson.
translation: 但说起他们的劣根性，{a beat}吃里扒外？尼普顿就是个很好的例子。

original: Where to begin? That you are weak, and we are strong? This much was known already.
translation: 从哪开始说呢？他们很弱，我们很强？这个已经是众所周知的了。

original: But the depths of your moral sickness, your {a beat}dissolution? Nipton serves as the perfect object lesson.
translation: 但说起他们的劣根性，{a beat}吃里扒外？尼普顿就是个很好的例子。

original: I'll do as you ask.
translation: 我会照你说的做。

original: Then I bid you {WAH-lay}"Vale" - until we meet again.
translation: 那么我们"后会有期"——下次再见。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: I am {GAB-en}Gabban, of {KAI-zar's}Caesar's Legion. I serve my master as the one of his {froo-men-TAR-ee}Frumentarii.
translation: 我是{GAB-en}加本，隶属{KAI-zar's}凯撒军团。我以军团特工的身份为我的主人效命。

original: We Frumentarii are soldiers of a different stripe, capable in battle, but skilled as infiltrators and agents as well.
translation: 我们特工和其他军士不同，虽然我们一样骁勇善战，但最擅长的还是渗透和谍报。

original: I'm going to wear your head like you wear that dog's.
translation: 我会拿你的脑袋当帽子戴，就像你戴着狗头一样。

original: {calling to arms, frightened}Legionaries - we have a problem!
translation: {calling to arms, frightened}将士们——我们这儿遇到了点问题！

original: On second thought, hold off.
translation: 再等等。让我考虑一下。

original: {annoyed with player}{KAI-zar}Caesar's health worsens, and your indecision is unhelpful.
translation: 凯撒的身体每况愈下。你的犹豫可派不上什么用场。

original: He's all yours.
translation: 他归你处置了。

original: It will be done.
translation: 没问题。

original: I've brought a doctor, Arcade Gannon, who can take care of Caesar. He's outside.
translation: 我带来了一个叫阿卡德·甘农的医生，他可以照顾凯撒。他就在外面。

original: Very well. I'll have him seized and brought to {KAI-zar}Caesar as his personal physician.
translation: 很好。我会把他抓来给{KAI-zar}凯撒当私人医生。

original: So shall I have him seized or not?
translation: 我要不要去把他绑过来？

original: Got it.
translation: 明白了。

original: Anything else I should know?
translation: 还有什么我应该知道的吗？

original: What else can you tell me about Little Buster?
translation: 关于小巴斯特你还有什么要告诉我的？

original: Sounds like fun. I'll get on it.
translation: 听上去挺有趣的。我接了。

original: Got it.
translation: 明白了。

original: Lot of soldiers around - where's First Recon?
translation: 这儿附近全是士兵——第一侦察营在哪？

original: All right, got it.
translation: 好的，明白了。

original: I can handle the dogs. Where do I need to go?
translation: 我能对付那些狗。我该去哪儿？

original: You don't have to worry about House. I disconnected him from his system.
translation: 你不必担心豪斯。我切断了他和他系统的链接。

original: You don't have to worry about House. I already killed him.
translation: 你不必担心豪斯。我已经把他杀了。

original: I thought Mr. House already agreed to hand over New Vegas to the NCR.
translation: 我还以为豪斯先生已经同意把新维加斯移交给NCR了。

original: Yes, that's what he wants us to believe. And when we turn our attention to other threats, he'll begin moving against us.
translation: 对，他是想制造这种假象。当我们把注意力转向其他威胁的时候，他就又开始和我们作对。

original: No, far safer to simply eliminate him and the risk he represents now. Besides, with him gone, New Vegas will truly be ours once the dust settles.
translation: 不，把他和他带来的风险消灭掉才是最保险的做法。另外，只有他死了，新维加斯才有可能真正成为我们的领土。

original: Any other objections or questions?
translation: 还有其他意见或问题吗？

original: Do you know who he was? Where he went?
translation: 你知道他是谁么？他去哪里了？

original: I'm still working on that, actually.
translation: 事实上我还在想办法。

original: You had your chance. Now you die.
translation: 给过你机会了，现在去死吧。

original: No, I haven't.
translation: 不，还没有。

original: Then you die.
translation: 那你去死吧。

original: A man who can cure Caesar, Arcade Gannon, waits outside. He's all yours.
translation: 有个人可以治好凯撒，他叫阿卡德·甘农，正在外面候着呢，他归你处置了。

original: Good. I'll have my men seize him immediately.
translation: 很好。我会让我的人马上把他控制住。

original: I have what's needed to do the surgery.
translation: 我准备好了动手术所需的东西。

original: Do it, then. You're not leaving until it's done and {KAI-zar}Caesar lives.
translation: 那赶紧开始吧。在治好凯撒之前你不能离开。

original: I've brought something to fix the Auto-Doc.
translation: 我拿到了能修理自动医生的东西。

original: Fix it, then. You're not leaving until it's done and {KAI-zar}Caesar lives.
translation: 那就赶紧修好它。在治好凯撒之前你不准离开。

original: No trick, and I'm only trying to help.
translation: 不开玩笑。我真是想帮忙。

original: We'll see.
translation: 再说吧。

original: Out of my way, Lucius.
translation: 走开，卢修斯。

original: {dismissing}Go.
translation: {dismissing}走。

original: I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 我会记住的。

original: See that you do.
translation: 很好。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: The terms are fair, refusing them would not be in your best interest.
translation: 这些条款很公道，拒绝可不明智。

original: <Attack> If you won't surrender, then you'll die.
translation: <攻击> 如果你不投降，那就受死吧。

original: Singing isn't necessary, but I do have a paper for you to sign.
translation: 唱歌就没必要了，不过我有一份文件需要你签署。

original: I have the terms of your surrender here for you.
translation: 我把你们的投降书给你带来了。

original: What the hell are you talking about? {Accepts paper}What is this?
translation: 你他妈在说些什么？{Accepts paper}这是什么？

original: "The Free Economic Zone of New Vegas..." What the {emph}hell does that mean?! {Angry at end}Oh, wait, here we go.
translation: "新维加斯自由贸易区……"这{emph}他妈是什么意思？！{Angry at end}噢，等等，下面还有。

original: "Demands NCR's immediate withdrawal..." {Building anger}Withdrawal? Like fucking {emph}hell we're withdrawing... we just held the dam, we didn't do it to let it go!
translation: "要求NCR立即撤退……"{Building anger}撤退？操{emph}他妈的要我们撤退……大坝在我们手上，撤个屁的退！

original: {Cold, pissed}This paper of yours? Isn't fit to wipe my ass. If you think after all that's happened, I'm going to grab my ankles and take it like the Legion...
translation: {Cold, pissed}你这几张纸？擦屁股我都嫌硬。你难道以为，在经历这一切之后，我还会像军团那样跪地求饶吗……

original: Ally the White Glove Society with the Legion.
translation: 让白手套社团与军团结成联盟。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Ally the Boomers with the Legion.
translation: 让大炮族与军团结成联盟。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Never mind.
translation: 没事。

original: Okay.
translation: OK。

original: Kill Mr. House.
translation: 杀死豪斯先生。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Complete Securitron Vault.
translation: 完成电子防护系统。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: What do you want done?
translation: 你打算怎么处理？

original: Destroy the Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 毁掉钢铁兄弟会。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Do you know where she is?
translation: 你知道她在哪里吗？

original: Fuck, no. If I knew where this bitch was, do you think I'd be asking you?
translation: 操，不知道。如果我知道这婊子在哪，还要你干什么？

original: Still, there's someone who might - old Alice McLafferty, Crimson Caravan, might know something.
translation: 不过，有人可能知道——老爱丽丝·麦克拉弗蒂，深红商队的，可能知道点情况。

original: She keeps tabs on caravan traffic in the Mojave, wouldn't put it past her to keep track of Cassidy Caravans and its owner.
translation: 她一直在密切注意莫哈维地区的商队情况，要想知道盖西迪商队和它主人的下落，不找她可不行。

original: So tell me, did you really think I'd be stupid enough to fall for this again? One of my men saw you go in and out of the Kings' place.
translation: 我说，你真以为我会蠢到再一次中你的计吗？我的人可是亲眼看到你从猫王帮的老窝里走出来了！

original: As much as I hate to lose a customer, it's just unavoidable sometimes.
translation: 虽然我也不想失去一个主顾，但有时候情况特殊，只好委屈你了。

original: Kill the leaders of the White Glove Society, Marjorie and Mortimer.
translation: 杀死白手套社团的首领玛乔里和莫蒂默。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Howdy, Pardner! Let's skedaddle! Got something to show ya!
translation: 你好啊，搭档！过来！我给你看样好东西！

original: It's just at the top of the ridge here...
translation: 就在山顶上……

original: There you have it - New Vegas, pretty as a diamond flush.
translation: 看见了吧——新维加斯，漂亮得就像方片同花顺一样。

original: Well, rambler, it's a royal flush that beats all! So let's crown this hand!
translation: 不过，小哥，同花大顺才是最大的！现在就让咱们亮一手吧！

original: Well, darling, it's a royal flush that beats all! So let's crown this hand!
translation: 不过，亲爱的，同花大顺才是最大的！现在就让咱们亮一手吧！

original: {the tower of the Lucky 38 lights up brilliantly in the distance}Yee-haw! Ain't that {purty}pretty?
translation: {the tower of the Lucky 38 lights up brilliantly in the distance}咦-哈！漂亮吧？

original: Don't take in the view for too long, though - word is, the Legion's on the move!
translation: 不过，可别光顾着欣赏美景啊——外面传说，军团已经蠢蠢欲动了！

original: Head on back and see the boss real soon, hear? Evening.{face screen blinks to default Securitron}
translation: 还是快点回去见老大吧，听到没？晚安啦。{face screen blinks to default Securitron}

original: The basement.
translation: 底层。

original: The casino floor.
translation: 赌场大厅。

original: The Cocktail Lounge.
translation: 鸡尾酒厅。

original: The High-Roller Suite.
translation: 高级套房。

original: All aboard!
translation: 快上来！

original: Right away!
translation: 马上！

original: Heading up!
translation: 上去咯！

original: Heading down!
translation: 下去咯！

original: The penthouse.
translation: 顶层阁楼。

original: The boss is waiting for ya.
translation: 老板正在等你呢。

original: Who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

original: Allow me to introduce myself! I'm the Securitron that dug you up in the bone orchard outside Goodsprings.
translation: 请允许我做个自我介绍！我就是把你从清泉镇外面的乱坟岗里挖出来的电子保安。

original: I thought you'd gone up the flume, but that Doc Mitchell knows his trade. It's good to see you up and around, right as a trivet!
translation: 看来米切尔大夫医术挺高明，我还以为你已经被丢进下水道了呢。看见你胳膊腿还能动弹，感觉真不错。

original: I thought you were destroyed.
translation: 我以为你已经玩完了。

original: Do I look destroyed, pardner? It's harder to put {Ol}old Vic in Boot Hill than you might think!
translation: 朋友，你看我像是玩完了吗？让老维克多入土，可比你想象的要难多了！

original: I wouldn't be much use stuck inside just one Securitron! No, if the one I'm in turns up a goner, I just find another, fine as cream gravy!
translation: 我才不会永远都呆在同一台电子保安体内呢！如果我的躯体完蛋了，那再找一个就行了，就这么简单！

original: Benny fled and got captured.
translation: 本尼逃掉了，然后被抓。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Kill Benny at the Tops.
translation: 在九重天杀死本尼。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Give me the Auto-Doc part and put Caesar in a coma.
translation: 把那个自动医生部件给我，让凯撒进入昏迷状态。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Fail to revert the White Glove Society to cannibalism through non-violence.
translation: 通过非暴力行动让白手套社团食人主义的努力失败。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Destroy the Boomers' leaders, Loyal and Pearl.
translation: 杀死大炮族的首领罗亚尔和珀尔。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Let's go back to Cottonwood Cove.
translation: 我们回棉白杨湾吧。

original: Never mind. I'm staying here.
translation: 不用担心。我会呆在这里。

original: Here's the chip.
translation: 芯片在这里。

original: The guard in the weather station will return the Chip to you when you're ready for {KAI-zar's}Caesar's mission. Otherwise, we can return to Cottonwood Cove.
translation: 如果你准备好执行凯撒交待的任务了，气象站里的守卫会还给你芯片。否则，我们也可以返回棉白杨湾。

original: Never mind. I'm staying a bit longer.
translation: 算了，我再待一会吧。

original: As you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。

original: Here you go.
translation: 给你。

original: You're free to leave. The guard in the weather station will return the Chip to you when you're ready for {KAI-zar's}Caesar's mission.
translation: 你可以离开了。等你准备好执行凯撒交待的任务了，气象站的守卫就会把芯片还给你。

original: Not yet.
translation: 还没有。

original: Very well.
translation: 那好吧。

original: Yes. Return what you took from me.
translation: 是的，把东西还给我。

original: Done.
translation: 完成。

original: Actually, never mind.
translation: 其实，算了。

original: {annoyed}You waste time, then.
translation: 你是在浪费时间。

original: <Keep holdout weapons> Here you go.
translation: <留下贴身武器。> 给你。

original: Speak to me when you are ready and I'll have your weapons returned.
translation: 准备好了就来找我，我会把武器还给你的。

original: Here you go.
translation: 给你。

original: Speak to me when you are ready and I'll have your weapons returned.
translation: 准备好了就来找我，我会把武器还给你的。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: {WAH-lay}Vale.
translation: 再见。

original: Yes, I need more time to prepare.
translation: 是的，我还需要点儿时间来作准备。

original: Very well. I must confiscate your weapons.
translation: 很好。我必须先保管你的武器。

original: The pay is good, and you can make your own hours.
translation: 报酬很不错，而且你可以自由选择工作时间。

original: Sorry, friend, but I just can't do it.
translation: 抱歉，朋友，我真的不想做。

original: Heck Gunderson is dead. You won't have to worry about him any more.
translation: 赫克·冈德森死了。你不用再担心他了。

original: How can I help you with your plan?
translation: 我该怎么帮你完成计划？

original: The password is "The better part of valor."
translation: 密码是"谨慎即大勇"。

original: {Thinks you're from one of the lost patrols}[You hear static.]
translation: {Thinks you're from one of the lost patrols}[你听到了静电的声音]

original: We were getting a little worried. Where's your partner? No, on second thought, don't tell me.
translation: 我们都有些担心。你的同伴呢？不，算了，你还是别告诉我了。

original: Give your report to the Elder, then have the doc look your over. Oh, and welcome back.
translation: 去向长老报告吧，再去找个医生给你看看。哦，还有，欢迎回来。

original: [You hear static.]
translation: [你听到了静电的声音]

original: Stay where you are. I'm sending someone up to meet you.
translation: 待在原地别动，我派个人去接你。

original: The password is "And to dare to do it."
translation: 密码是"坚毅果敢"。

original: {Thinks you're from one of the lost patrols}[You hear static.]
translation: {Thinks you're from one of the lost patrols}[你听到了静电的声音]

original: We were getting a little worried. Where's your partner? No, on second thought, don't tell me.
translation: 我们都有些担心。你的同伴呢？不，算了，你还是别告诉我了。

original: Give your report to the Elder, then have the doc look your over. Oh, and welcome back.
translation: 去向长老报告吧，再找个医生来给你看看。哦，还有，欢迎回来。

original: [You hear static.]
translation: [你听到了静电的声音]

original: Stay where you are. I'm sending someone up to meet you.
translation: 待在原地别动，我派个人去接你。

original: Seems like you pop up everywhere, Victor.
translation: 维克多，你真是无处不在啊。

original: Aw shucks, pardner. I {s'pose}suppose it can't hurt to let you in on my little secret!
translation: 噢，该死，朋友。不过让你知道我的小秘密也没什么不妥。

original: {Ol'}Old Victor woudn't be much use stuck inside just one Securitron! No, I can move from one to another with the snap of a finger!
translation: 老维克才不会永远呆在同一台电子保安里头呢！相反，我只要动几下手指头，就能从一台机器跳到另一台机器里去！

original: {Purty}Pretty nice trick, ain't it? Just don't ask me how I do it, {cuz}because I don't know!
translation: 这把戏不错吧？别问我是怎么做到的，因为我自己也不知道！

original: < Keep holdout weapons > Sure, I agree to disarm.
translation: <留下藏匿的武器> 当然了，我同意解除武装。

original: Your belongings will be returned to you when you leave.
translation: 等你离开时，你的物品会退还给你。

original: Your belongings will be returned to you when you leave.
translation: 等你离开时，你的物品会退还给你。

original: You're platinum, pussycat! You know how to swing!
translation: 你真是棒极了，小浪猫！你的功夫挺不赖的啊！

original: {complimenting her breasts}Nice charlies, too! Give {'em}them a shake for the Ben-man, will ya? {catcall}Hello!
translation: {complimenting her breasts}奶子不错！摇起来{'em}让本大爷看看，如何？ {catcall}来啊！

original: {worn out from vigorous love-making}{long sigh}That was a nice bit of hey-hey, girlie. You're a real ring-a-ding broad!
translation: {worn out from vigorous love-making}{long sigh}这一炮打得也未免太刺激了，小骚狐狸。你可真是顶呱呱的名器啊！

original: {unexpectedly vulnerable}Hold me, will ya? I swear you wore me out... {soft snoring}
translation: {unexpectedly vulnerable}抱紧我，好不？我都要被你榨干了……{soft snoring}

original: <Give Kenny the key from Canyon Runner>
translation: <把峡谷行者那儿得到的钥匙交给肯尼>

original: {Shocked disbelief}Freedom? Thank God Frank thinks we're enslaved.
translation: {Shocked disbelief}我自由了？感谢老天，弗兰克以为我们成了奴隶。

original: Now we can actually start fresh. Thank you for helping us.
translation: 现在我们终于能重新开始了。谢谢你救了我们。

original: <Give Kenny the key from Canyon Runner>
translation: <把峡谷行者那儿得到的钥匙交给肯尼>

original: {Doesn't make sense}Why free me now? After what you done? I ain't saying thank you.
translation: {Doesn't make sense}为什么放了我？瞧瞧你干的好事，我不会对你说谢谢的。

original: <Give Sammy the key from Canyon Runner>
translation: <给萨米从峡谷行者那里得来的钥匙>

original: {Doesn't make sense}Why free me now? After what you done? I ain't saying thank you.
translation: {Doesn't make sense}为什么放了我？瞧瞧你干的好事，我不会对你说谢谢的。

original: <Give Sammy the key from Canyon Runner>
translation: <把从峡谷行者那里得来的钥匙交给萨米>

original: {Shocked disbelief}Freedom? I don't know where we'll get a new start, but any place is better than rotting with the legion or Frank.
translation: {Shocked disbelief}我自由了？不知道我们接下来该去哪里，但去哪儿都比和军团或者弗兰克呆在一块儿要强。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Be seeing you.
translation: 回头见。

original: Allowing Anderson to get away with murder tells him and everyone else that it's permissable.
translation: 如果放安德森走，就等于告诉所有人哪怕杀人也可以逍遥法外。

original: There are other ways to punish people, other ways to condemn their actions.
translation: 惩戒人们的方法有很多，并不是非得以命抵命。

original: It was either this or spend the rest of his life in an NCR chain gang.
translation: 若不这么干，那他下半辈子也得在NCR做苦役了。

original: That was his decision to make, not yours.
translation: 那该由他来决定，而不是你。

original: It's cleaner this way, without bringing NCR in. No connecting Anderson back to the locals.
translation: 这么下手更干净点，不会导致NCR介入。更不会让他们从安德森联想到本地人身上。

original: That's a grim deal to make. But when it came down to it, it's the same choice he made. Not all sacrifices are made by the willing.
translation: 这决定实在残酷。不过要真到那种时刻，换成他也会作同样的选择。并非所有的牺牲都是心甘情愿的。

original: {quoting the bible}But where is the lamb for this burnt offering?
translation: {quoting the bible}可燔祭的羔羊又在哪里呢？

original: You're assuming a motive without evidence. Please be rational.
translation: 你这样完全是只问动机，不讲证据。理智点吧。

original: Fine. Would you mind explaining {emph}why you killed Anderson?
translation: 好。那你能解释一下{emph}为什么杀死安德森吗？

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: <Sad stare>
translation: <悲伤的凝视>

original: <Speech more money>
translation: <要求加钱>

original: [SUCCEEDED] Alright. 50/50 it is, but you better bring back all of the caps. If we hear you crossed us, the next bounty hunter will be coming for you.
translation: [成功] 好吧。五五分，但你最好能把所有的瓶盖都收回来。要是让我们知道你在耍我们，那下个赏金猎人的目标就是你的脑袋。

original: Hey, I'm doing all of the work here.  50/50 and I'm game.
translation: 喂，脏活累活我都干了。五五分成才行。

original: [FAILED] Who the hell do you think you're talking to? Keep talking like that and your ass is going to be in the gutter. 25%. Take it or leave it.
translation: [失败] 你知道自己在和谁说话吗？再用这种口气和我讨价还价，小心我捅爆你的屁眼。25%，不能更多了。

original: Twenty-five percent?!  Fifty-fifty, or I walk.
translation: 25%？！五五分成，不然我不干。

original: <Speech more money>
translation: <要求加钱>

original: <Barter>
translation: <交易>

original: [SUCCEEDED] All right. 50/50 it is, but you better bring back all of the caps.
translation: [成功] 好吧。五五分，但你最好能把所有的瓶盖都收回来。

original: If we hear you crossed us, the next bounty hunter will be coming for you.
translation: 要是让我们知道你在耍我们，那下个赏金猎人的目标就是你的脑袋。

original: This kind of work costs time and money.  50/50 would cover my expenses.
translation: 这个活吃力又不讨好。必须五五分成，我才能接受。

original: [FAILED] Who the hell do you think you're talking to? Keep talking like that and your ass is going to be in the gutter. 25%. Take it or leave it.
translation: [失败] 你知道自己在和谁说话吗？再用这种口气和我讨价还价，小心我捅爆你的屁眼。25%，不能更多了。

original: Are you crazy?!  I'll be walking all over the place looking for these people.
translation: 你疯了吗？为了找那几个家伙，我得把整个镇子都翻个遍。

original: What happens in Freeside won't make any difference if the Legion takes the dam. Fight with them.
translation: 万一军团夺下了大坝，那自由城也不能幸免。还是和他们并肩作战吧。

original: Good point. You've been encouraging the others to stand up and fight, maybe I should take the same advice. After all, I also lived in Navarro.
translation: 说得好。你鼓舞了他们的斗志，或许我也应该接受你的建议。毕竟，我也在纳瓦罗生活过。

original: There's something I need to go do, but I'll catch up with you later. Thanks again for your help with the others. It means a lot to me.
translation: 我还有些事要去做，不过到时候我会与你会合的。多谢你对他们的帮助。对我而言真的意义非凡。

original: I'm surprised to hear you say that. I thought you had a problem with people who hold on to the past.
translation: 听你这么说，真让我吃惊。我还以为你对沉溺于过去的人始终抱有成见呢。

original: Suiting up to fight against Caesar with the Navarro veterans seems like... I don't know, like a kid playing dress up in his father's clothes.
translation: 与纳瓦罗的老兵们一起披挂上阵，共同对抗凯撒……感觉就好像是孩子穿着父亲的衣服在玩过家家一样。

original: If you're so sure it's going to be a bloodbath, maybe you should stay in Freeside.
translation: 既然你觉得这将会是一场血战，那你还是应该留在自由城。

original: I figured you'd say that. Sometimes staying put is the best thing you can do.
translation: 我知道你会这么说。有时候，最好的选择就是别添乱。

original: I'll leave the fighting to the old warhorses. It's what they were made for.
translation: 我会让那些老将们出马的。毕竟他们都是久经沙场。

original: I need to go take care of something before I set up at Freeside. I'll see you soon. And again, thanks for your help with the others.
translation: 去自由城前，我还有一些事情要处理。到时候再见吧。另外，再次感谢你对其他人的帮助。

original: I honestly didn't expect you to say that. When I talked to you about Daisy and the others, you seemed to put a lot of value in loyalty to the past.
translation: 我真没想到你会这样说。记得当初我和你聊起黛西以及其他人时，你似乎还对那种矢志不渝的忠诚褒奖有加。

original: What's changed since then?
translation: 后来你怎么又改变看法了？

original: Time for the NCR to roast.
translation: 我要好好让NCR烤烤火。

original: Oh, to hell with this!
translation: 哦，别这么干！

original: I'm thinking I'm going to get a sweet Pre-War laser. What are you thinking?
translation: 我在考虑要不要搞个牛逼的战前激光武器呢。你怎么想？

original: I'm thinking that I'm leaving because you are a sociopath. Good riddance.
translation: 我在考虑我应该离开你，因为你就是个反人类反社会的疯子。后会有期。

original: Oh, uh... whoops, I thought that was to turn it off.
translation: 哎呀……我还以为那个按钮是用来关掉它的呢。

original: Argh, you moron! You're going to kill all of the troopers down there!
translation: 啊！你这个白痴！你会害死下面所有士兵的！

original: That's it. I'm out. Good luck getting out of this place without being shot to pieces by NCR soldiers, assuming they aren't going to fry to death.
translation: 够了。我不干了。祝你能平安从这儿出去吧，别被NCR士兵打成蜂窝，前提是他们还没被烤成焦炭。

original: Er...
Yeah, exactly. They don't.
translation: 对，他们不需要。

original: You can always use more power, right?
translation: 反正电力怎么也不嫌多吧？

original: Maybe if you're Mr. House you do. I bet the people in Freeside need it a lot more than he does.
translation: 如果你是豪斯先生，那也就罢了。但我敢说自由城的人民比他更需要这些电。

original: Redundancy. If Caesar takes the dam and cuts off power, it will be chaos all over New Vegas.
translation: 战略储备啊。万一凯撒夺取了大坝，切断电力，那新维加斯不就乱套了。

original: Hmm. That's a valid point. I'm not really behind the NCR in all of this, but the last thing I want is panic in the streets.
translation: 嗯。有道理。虽然在供电这件事上我并不支持NCR，但我更不愿意看到街头一片混乱。

original: Noted.
translation: 了解。

original: {nervous}O... kay.
translation: {nervous}好…吧。

original: Why not to the whole area equally?
translation: 为什么不干脆给整片区域平均供电？

original: NCR troops control Hoover Dam. Why do they need {emph}more power?
translation: NCR控制着胡佛水坝。他们要{emph}那么多电干嘛？

original: Of course.
translation: 当然。

original: Great. Glad we're on the same page.
translation: 很好。看来咱们意见一致。

original: I mean, I didn't expect that you'd want to... activate the super weapon or anything.
translation: 我是说，我没想到你居然打算……激活超级武器什么的。

original: {nervous}Heh.
translation: {nervous}呵。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: {sounds reasonable}All right.
translation: {sounds reasonable}好的。

original: I'll say.
translation: 深有同感。

original: Okay, okay, you don't have to agree with me {emph}that much.
translation: 好吧，好吧，你不必那样{emph}附和我。

original: Why don't you like talking about yourself?
translation: 你为什么不喜欢谈自己的事呢？

original: Some people do. I just... don't.
translation: 有些人喜欢，我只是……没兴趣。

original: Look, I appreciate that you're trying to be friendly, but I'd just rather not discuss it.
translation: 听着，我知道你是想多了解我，但我宁可不谈这个。

original: Arcade, I'm asking you because I'm interested. Don't put yourself down.
translation: 阿卡德，我问你是因为我有兴趣。别老妄自菲薄。

original: Oh, all right. I'm thirty-ish. {admitting}Well, late thirties. I was born... {guarded}west of here. I was an only child and spent most of my time with my mother.
translation: 哦，好吧。我三十多岁。 {admitting}呃，其实快四十了。我出生于……{guarded}西边。我是家中独子，基本和母亲一起过。

original: My father died when I was young and I never got over it. Oh... and I like medicine and reading books about failed Pre-War socioeconomic policies.
translation: 我父亲在我小时候就去世了，我一直忘不掉这事。哦……我喜欢医学，还喜欢阅读那些与战前失败的社会经济政策有关的书籍。

original: {a bit of sarcasm}Right now, I'm sure you're asking yourself, "Why hasn't some lucky man scooped this bachelor off his feet?" {serious}Like I said, I'm boring.
translation: {a bit of sarcasm}我知道，你肯定在想"怎么就没有个幸运的男人收了这个单身汉呢？"就像我说的，我已经厌倦了。

original: You can do better than that.
translation: 你比他们强多了。

original: No, really. Have you ever snorted a ground up Cazador venom sac? Neither have I, but I can guarantee you that a Freeside junkie {emph.}has.
translation: 不，我看不行。你有没有吸过胡蜂毒的粉末？我没有，但我敢保证，自由城的那些瘾君子肯定吸过。

original: What will you do if Caesar wins?
translation: 如果凯撒赢了，你要怎么办？

original: {melancholy}What the Followers always do. Whatever we can.
translation: {melancholy}天启追随者怎么办，我就怎么办。尽我们所能吧。

original: What do you think the others will do at Hoover Dam?
translation: 你觉得他们会在大坝之战中有什么表现？

original: I don't think you need to worry about the specifics. Basically, expect a lot of firepower and dead bodies.
translation: 我认为你不必在意细节。基本上，你只需要等着听枪声四起，接着就会看到尸横遍野。

original: Enclave technology is even more advanced than Brotherhood equipment, and in the hands of soldiers as experienced as Moreno and the others...
translation: 英克雷的科技甚至比兄弟会的还先进。而在莫雷诺他们这样的老兵手中……

original: Let's just say it's truly a sight to behold.
translation: 我只能说那绝对会叫人叹为观止。

original: I don't think either of us can fully understand what he and the tribes have gone through.
translation: 我觉得也许我们并不能真正理解他和部落所经历过的苦难。

original: A fair point, but from the perspective of someone on the east side of Arizona, the man is clearly out of his mind.
translation: 说得在理，但作为一个从亚利桑那东部过来的人，我可以告诉你，他绝对是疯了。

original: Maybe he didn't intend for things to wind up this way, but that doesn't mean he needs to perpetuate this bizarre anachronistic myth.
translation: 或许他当初没料到会是这样的结果，但并不意味着他可以继续去兜售一个早该被丢进历史垃圾堆中的神话。

original: And it doesn't mean that we should sit by and nod our heads at every absurd faux-Roman {kah-soos beh-lee, "case of war"}casus belli he can dream up.
translation: 也不意味着我们可以容忍他效仿古罗马编出各种荒谬的开战理由，还在一旁拍手叫好。

original: He's a tyrant. The bad kind. And there's no way we're letting him take Hoover Dam.
translation: 他是个暴君，一个残忍无道的恶魔。我们绝不能让他占领胡佛水坝。

original: He's a madman. What did you expect?
translation: 他是个疯子。你还期望什么？

original: Well, yeah! Right. What {emph}did I expect? The man's a megalomaniac. He acts like this is some pre-ordained cycle we're returning to.
translation: 是，对！没错。我干嘛要有所期望呢？这个男人就是个自大狂。他所做的一切不过是在将我们拖入历史的轮回。

original: Of all the people who could learn from our past mistakes, he goes and throws all of our knowledge off of a cliff.
translation: 明明该从过去的错误中吸取教训，他却反过来将人类千百年来积累的知识统统抛下悬崖。

original: Instead of trying to learn from the past, he re-creates it, runs back over the same old barren ground.
translation: 他不但没有正视历史，反而企图重蹈覆辙，将人们重新带回到蛮荒时代。

original: He seemed pretty smart to me.
translation: 在我看来，他是个十足的聪明人。

original: Being "smart" doesn't matter if you're insane. Everything makes sense to Caesar because he's twisted everything to his world view.
translation: 如果你脑子不正常，再聪明也没用。凯撒之所以觉得自己是正道，是因为他在用扭曲的眼光看待这个世界。

original: He's Caesar reincarnated, the NCR is the corrupt Roman senate. I wouldn't be surprised if he thought the Colorado River were the new Rubicon.
translation: 他觉得自己是凯撒再世，而NCR就是那腐朽不堪的罗马元老院。如果他将科罗拉多河当成卢比孔河，我也不会感到意外。

original: He abdicates responsibility to a myth of historical inevitability. But he's {emph}not Caesar. This isn't Rome. {defiantly}And he isn't going to get away with this.
translation: 他如此坚信自己的神话，将一切都归咎于历史的必然。但他{emph}不是凯撒。这儿也不是罗马。{defiantly}而他更是难逃罪责。

original: Who, Caesar?
translation: 谁，凯撒？

original: Of course, Caesar! You can hardly even hold his men responsible, given how they're practically raised to worship him as a living deity.
translation: 当然是凯撒！你甚至都难以追究他那些部下的责任，因为他们从小就被灌输一种可怕的观念，要将他像神祗一样来崇拜。

original: What's the point of surviving the war? Why did the founders of the Followers crawl their way out of vaults to bring knowledge back to the wasteland?
translation: 人类从战争中生存下来的意义何在？天启追随者的创立者们当初为何要挣扎着爬出避难所，将知识的火种重新撒播到废土上？

original: So we could act like the last two thousand years didn't happen? Play dress up so we can fight ancient wars all over again?
translation: 难道过去两千年的历史就可以当作没发生过吗？然后我们就能穿上滑稽的戏服，像过家家一样重演古人的战争？

original: {defiantly}No way is he getting away with this. I'm not letting it happen. You're not letting it happen.
translation: {defiantly}绝不能让他就这样逃脱惩罚。我不会放过他，你也不应该放过他。

original: You're right. Freeside needs doctors. It needs you.
translation: 你说得没错。自由城需要医生。他们需要你。

original: You're right. They'll need every ally they can get at the dam.
translation: 你说的没错。一旦大坝的战斗打响，他们随时都可能需要帮忙。

original: That was just talk. It's not the same for you.
translation: 不过是说说罢了。对你来说可不一样。

original: No, I think it {emph.}is the same for me. Maybe for a different reason, but... you can't hold on to a past you've never had.
translation: 不，我想{emph}对我来说是一样的。虽然也许原因不同，可……你总不能执拗于一个根本不存在的过去吧。

original: For better or worse, I am not my father. I never had a life with the Enclave, and it would be silly for me to try to start one now.
translation: 再怎么说，我也不是我父亲。我从未加入过英克雷，再去假扮他们也未免太过愚蠢。

original: I'll stay with you until the Legion moves on the dam, but once the attack starts, I'm going to have to go to back to Freeside. It's where I belong.
translation: 我会跟着你到军团进攻大坝为止，一旦战斗打响，我就要返回自由城。那里才是我的归宿。

original: I need to take care of something, but I'll see you soon enough. Thanks for all of the help. It means a lot to me.
translation: 我还有些事要处理，不过我们很快会再见面的。谢谢你的帮助，对我真的意义非凡。

original: You aren't like the others, Arcade. You're still young. It's up to you to decide who you want to be.
translation: 你和他们不一样，阿卡德。你还年轻。你可以自己决定自己的前途。

original: True enough. Maybe I can't fill my father's shoes. I wouldn't even know how.
translation: 这是实话。看来我也无法继承家父的衣钵。我甚至都不知道该怎么做。

original: But if following in his footsteps for a while means I can do some good out here, I will do my best.
translation: 但如果我能追随他的脚步，做一些善事的话，我还是会尽力而为的。

original: I need to go do something. I won't be gone long, but I'll catch up with you later. Thanks for your help with the others. It means a lot to me.
translation: 我还有事要处理。我不会去太久，过一阵就回来。谢谢你帮助了他们，对我而言真的意义非凡。

original: Well you... you're different.
translation: 你……你不一样。

original: I am, but they're still my family. I think you were right the first time. If there's something I can do to help hold the dam, I'll do it.
translation: 是不一样。但他们毕竟是我的家人。我觉得一开始你是对的。只要能为守卫大坝做出贡献，我都会去做的。

original: Look, there's something I have to do, but I promise I'll be back in a while. Trust me. And thanks again for your help. It means a lot to me.
translation: 听着，我还有些事情要做，不过我保证很快就会回来的。相信我。再次感谢你的帮助。对我而言真的意义非凡。

original: You were born at Navarro, but you are your own man. They have their fight, and you have yours.
translation: 你的确生在纳瓦罗，但你是一个会独立思考的人。他们有他们的战场，你也有你的战场。

original: True enough, I suppose. Getting them back together must be worth more than me spraying plasma all over the dam.
translation: 这是大实话。把他们召集起来肯定比我自己端起等离子枪朝大坝胡乱开火更有意义。

original: Back to Freeside it is. I need to make a stop before I settle in. I'll be back in a while. Thanks again for your help. It means a lot to me.
translation: 那我还是回自由城吧。在我准备就绪前，我还有些事情要做。过几天我就回来。再次感谢你的帮助。对我而言真的意义非凡。

original: Now that you're free to leave you don't need your dog tag anymore do you?
translation: 反正你已经可以随意离开了，狗牌留着也没用，对不对？

original: You're probably right. Here, take it.
translation: 或许你是对的。给，拿着。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Could we go lower than 300 caps?
translation: 少于300个瓶盖可以吗？

original: {scoffing}This isn't the total we agreed upon. Don't waste my time, wastelander.
translation: {scoffing}这和我们说好的不一样。别浪费我的时间，废土游民。

original: What do you think I should do about ED-E? Brotherhood or Followers?
translation: 你觉得ED-E的事，我该选哪边？兄弟会还是天启追随者？

original: This shouldn't be too surprising, but I'd prefer you let the Followers examine him. {unsure}Hopefully the reasons are obvious.
translation: 你应该能料到我的回答，我当然更倾向于让天启追随者去检查它。我想原因是显而易见的。

original: Don't worry. I agree.
translation: 别担心，我同意。

original: Great. Then all is right with the world.
translation: 太好了。那样世间太平依旧了。

original: Understood.
translation: 了解。

original: {a little concerned}Okay. Don't have to make a decision now. Just... sleep on it or something.
translation: {a little concerned}好吧。不用现在做决定……你可以多考虑一阵。

original: Why not the Brotherhood?
translation: 为什么不选兄弟会？

original: The Brotherhood hoards knowledge and is obviously a smidge more violent than the Followers.
translation: 兄弟会只懂得封存知识，而且他们明显比天启追随者更信奉暴力。

original: Don't get me wrong. I'd rather the Brotherhood get the intel than see it lost somewhere in the desert, but I'd prefer the Followers overall.
translation: 别误会我的意思。让兄弟会掌握那些情报，总比让它们烂在沙漠里强。但总体来说，我更倾向于天启追随者。

original: Is the Enclave's treatment by the Brotherhood influencing your opinion?
translation: 兄弟会对待英克雷的态度影响了你的看法吗？

original: Some of the old-timers like Moreno hold grudges against the Brotherhood and the NCR. I'd like to think I'm above that, but you may be right.
translation: 像莫雷诺这样的老一辈，有不少人对NCR和兄弟会积怨难消。我是根本不在意这些，但或许你说的没错。

original: I'm not going to pout and cry if you give him to the Brotherhood. I'd rather they have it than allow all that knowledge to disappear.
translation: 如果你把他交给兄弟会，我也不会撅起嘴来哭鼻子的。但我觉得将知识拿来运用还是要比封存起来好。

original: I'd just prefer that it goes to an organization like the Followers, who are less likely to use it for... violent purposes.
translation: 我只是更希望它能被天启追随者这样的组织所掌握，至少不大可能会被用于……暴力。

original: I don't know if you care about my opinion, but I'd prefer that you turn ED-E over to the Followers. Surprised, right?
translation: 不知道你是否赞成我的观点，但我希望你能把ED-E交给天启追随者。有点吃惊吧？

original: Wow. That thing is definitely carrying around a bunch of Enclave intel. Adams is on the eastern seaboard of the country.
translation: 哇哦。那玩意里头肯定装了不少关于英克雷的情报。亚当斯位于东海岸。

original: Which means this little "Duraframe" sucker somehow managed to survive for over {thinking}two thousand miles. {impressed}Certainly lives up to its model name.
translation: 也就是说，"杜拉骨架"这个小杂种居然跨越了{thinking}整整2000英里的距离。{impressed}还真是名副其实。

original: I don't want to be... alarmist or anything, but maybe you should ditch that Eyebot. {catching himself}Robot. Whatever that thing is.
translation: 不是我...大惊小怪，但你最好还是扔了那个眼球...{catching himself}机器人。不管它是什么玩意。

original: Who knows what it's programmed for? Maybe tomorrow you'll take out an iguana-on-a-stick and that'll activate its {searching}mini-nuke self-destruct sequence.
translation: 谁知道它体内装了什么程序？没准哪天你拿串蜥蜴肉串出来，就把它的{searching}微型核弹自毁系统给激活了。

original: Moreno was a lost cause, but at least the others made it.
translation: 莫雷诺是回不了头了，可至少其他人还是想通了的。

original: What are you going to do now?
translation: 你现在要做什么？

original: Back to Old Mormon Fort, where I can do some good. We Followers may be idealistic but even I know this is going to end in blood.
translation: 返回旧摩门教要塞，至少在那儿我还能做点事情。虽然天启追随者向来有些理想主义，可即便是我，也知道今天必将血流成河。

original: {"fortune favors the bold" for-tees for-too-nah ah-dee-oo-vah-t}Fortis fortuna adiuvat. Good luck, and good bye.
translation: （拉丁文）命运总会眷顾勇士。祝你好运，再见。

original: Thanks, I guess.
translation: 多谢了。

original: {disappointed}I have to admit, I did not expect that sort of response.
translation: {disappointed}我得承认，我没想到你会是这种反应。

original: {deflated}This is one of the last surviving suits of original-issue Tesla armor from Navarro and it was worn by my father but... yeah I guess it's no big deal.
translation: {deflated}这可是纳瓦罗仅存的几套初始型特斯拉装甲之一，我父亲曾经穿过……不过我也觉得没什么大不了的。

original: Good luck at Hoover Dam. I'll uh... be going now, I guess.
translation: 祝你在胡佛大坝能有好运气。我，呃……要走了。

original: I'm honored.
translation: 我很荣幸。

original: It's the least I could do. All I ask is that you put it to good use. This place has lived in the shadow of Caesar for long enough.
translation: 我能做的也只有这些了。我唯一的要求是好好使用它。这地方已经笼罩在凯撒的阴影之下太久了。

original: I may not be the one to help stop him here, but you are. {"fortune favors the bold" for-tees for-too-nah ah-dee-oo-vah-t}Fortis fortuna adiuvat. Good luck, and good bye.
translation: 也许我没有办法阻止他，但你可以。（拉丁文）命运总能眷顾勇士。祝你好运，再见。

original: {paragraph 1}War. War never changes.
translation: {段落 1}战争。战争从未改变。

original: {paragraph 2}When atomic fire consumed the earth, those who survived did so in great underground vaults.
translation: {段落 2}当核爆的烈焰吞没了大地时，只有那些栖身在地下大型避难所里的人们才得以幸存。

original: {paragraph 2}When they opened, their inhabitants set out across the ruins of the Old World to build new societies, establishing villages, forming tribes.
translation: {段落 2}沉重的大门再度开启，避难所的居民们穿越旧世界的废墟，建立起了新的社会和村落，形成了新的部族。

original: {paragraph 3}As decades passed, what {slight emphasis}had been the American southwest united
translation: {段落 3}数十年光阴倏然而逝，原本的美利坚西南部

original: {paragraph 3}beneath the flag of the New California Republic, dedicated to Old World values of democracy and the rule of law.
translation: {段落 3}又一次团结在了新加州共和国的旗帜之下，致力于延续旧世界的民主和法治。

original: {paragraph 4}As the Republic grew, so did its needs. Scouts spread east, seeking territory and wealth in the dry and merciless expanse of the Mojave desert.
translation: {段落 4}随着共和国逐渐壮大，它的需求也与日俱增。大批侦察兵向东挺进，在拓展版图的同时，也发掘着埋藏在荒芜凋敝而又广袤的莫哈维沙漠之下的财富。

original: {paragraph 4}They returned with tales of a city untouched by the warheads that had scorched the rest of the world - and a great wall spanning the Colorado River.
translation: {段落 4}他们带回一个传说，有一座城市在核弹的余波中毫发未损——他们还发现了一面矗立在科罗拉多河之上的巨墙。

original: {paragraph 5}The NCR mobilized its army and sent it east, to occupy Hoover Dam and restore it to working condition.
translation: {段落 5}NCR开始动员它的军队向东进发，只为占领胡佛水坝，使其恢复运作。

original: {paragraph 5}But across the Colorado, another society had arisen, under a different flag.
translation: {段落 5}然而在科罗拉多河的对岸，新的势力却在另一面旗帜下悄然崛起。

original: {paragraph 5}A vast army of slaves forged from the conquest of 86 tribes - Caesar's Legion.
translation: {段落 5}这是一支征服了86个部落，由奴隶组成的军队——凯撒军团。

original: {paragraph 6}Four years have passed since the Republic held the dam - just barely - against the Legion's onslaught. The Legion did not retreat.
translation: {段落 6}四年前，共和国拼尽全力挫败了军团的进攻，占领了水坝。但军团并未放弃。

original: {paragraph 6}Across the river, it gathers strength. Camp fires burn, training drums beat.
translation: {段落 6}在河的另一侧，军团仍蓄势以待。营地里篝火熊熊，战鼓嘹亮。

original: {paragraph 7}Through it all, the New Vegas Strip has stayed open for business, under the control of its mysterious overseer, Mr. House,
translation: {段落 7}与此同时，新维加斯的长街依旧灯火通明，它的主人是神秘莫测的豪斯先生，

original: {paragraph 7}and his army of rehabilitated tribals and police robots.
translation: {段落 7}以及他手下受其开化的部落民众和警卫机器人。

original: {paragraph 8}You are a Courier, hired by the Mojave Express to deliver a package to the New Vegas Strip.
translation: {paragraph 8}你是一名受雇于莫哈维快递的邮差，奉命将一个包裹送往新维加斯。

original: {paragraph 8}What seemed like a simple delivery job has taken a turn for the worse.
translation: {段落 8}然而一次看似简单的投递，却演变成了一场噩梦。

original: Fuck you man, I ain't going nowhere with you.
translation: 干你丫的，我才不跟你走呢。

original: Why don't you go cry to your wife, then - oh that's right! She left your worthless stinking ass!
translation: 你怎么不躲到你老婆怀里哭鼻子去呢——哦，对了！她早就离开你这个窝囊废了！

original: I killed the Deathclaw Alpha Male.
translation: 我干掉了雄性死亡爪首领。

original: I spoke to Marjorie. I say leave the White Glove Society alone.
translation: 我已经和玛乔里以及莫蒂默谈过了。白手套社团就不要再管了。

original: Say no more, say no more... if you say they're good, they're good!
translation: 不用说了，不用说了……只要你说好，那就是好！

original: I spoke to Mortimer. I say leave the White Glove Society alone.
translation: 我和莫蒂默谈过了。不用再管白手套社团了。

original: Say no more, say no more... if you say they're good, they're good!
translation: 不予评论，不予评论……既然你说他们好，那就好！

original: {QUEST FAILURE}Forget the Omertas. They're more trouble than they're worth.
translation: {QUEST FAILURE}忘掉黑手党吧。他们根本不值一提。

original: {CONDITIONALIZE FOR QUEST FAILURE}You got it! I won't say another word about them!
translation: {CONDITIONALIZE FOR QUEST FAILURE}了解！我不会再谈论有关他们的事情了！

original: {WGS LEADERS KILLED}I've killed the White Glove Society's leaders. They're no longer a factor.
translation: {WGS LEADERS KILLED}我已经杀了白手套社团的首领。可以不用再考虑他们了。

original: Whatever you say!
translation: 行啊！

original: The President's visit was cancelled. I never got the opportunity to attack him.
translation: 总统的访问取消了。我没有机会袭击他了。

original: {controlled anger}When I command you to complete a mission, you will complete it, or you should die in the attempt.
translation: {controlled anger}既然我已经给你下了命令，你就必须全力以赴，否则应当提头来见。

original: I will overlook this error, but only because I think you can still be useful.
translation: 我这次且饶你一命，不过只是看在你还有点用处的份上。

original: President Kimball survived. His visit to the Hoover Dam was cancelled.
translation: 金博尔总统没死，他的大坝之行被取消了。

original: Killing Kimball would've struck fear into the NCR. It's unfortunate that you weren't able to take advantage of this opportunity.
translation: 刺杀金博尔本可以在NCR内部制造恐慌，可惜你没能利用好这个机会。

original: We are preparing to move against the Dam, and Legate Lanius has a part for you to play in the battle. Report to him at his camp.
translation: 我们已经准备向大坝进发了，特使拉尼厄斯有作战任务要交给你。去他的营地向他报告吧。

original: {exulting}Hey, Nipton! Eat me!
translation: {exulting}嘿，尼普顿！咬我啊！

original: {exulting}Who's the winner? Oliver Swanick, that's who! Yeah!
translation: {exulting}谁赢了？奥利弗·斯瓦尼克，就是我！耶！

original: {exulting}I won the fucking lottery, hear me! So fuck y'all! Whoohoo!
translation: {exulting}这狗日的抽奖，我赢了！听见没！操你们丫的！哦呼！

original: {exulting}Ain't gonna see me up on a cross or my head on no pole, uh uh! That's for {emphasis}loooooosers!
translation: {exulting}我不会被钉在十字架上，脑袋也不会插在杆上了，哈哈！输了才那么惨！

original: {exulting}{chanting}I am a win-ner! I am a win-ner!{delighted laugh}
translation: {exulting}{chanting}我是赢家！我是赢家！{delighted laugh}

original: So... maize, 2 mutfruits, yeast, and a... uh... fission battery? Next time, maybe.
translation: 我看看…玉米, 2个变异果, 酵母片, 还有一只…嗯…裂变电池？下次再说吧。

original: Any idea what I should do with it?
translation: 你知道我该怎么修好它吗？

original: {New Line}Not a bit. I imagine there must be some people around curious about that kind of technology.
translation: {NewLine}没主意。我猜想附近会有别的人对这种技术感到好奇吧。

original: Did you ever hear it say anything odd?
translation: 你就没听它说过什么奇怪的事情吗？

original: {New Line}Can't say that I have, of course I never saw it running for long, so I never heard it do much of anything.
translation: {NewLine}还真没有，当然它运转的时间并不长，所以我也没发现它有什么特别的。

original: Where did it come from?
translation: 它到底从什么地方来？

original: {New Line}A courier dropped it off a little bit ago. I'd hoped to get it up and running for some courier work, but never could get it running.
translation: {NewLine}我没法修好它。我原本还希望能用它进行一些邮递工作，可就是没法启动它。

original: I have some questions about ED-E.
translation: 关于ED-E我有几个问题。

original: {New Line}That beat up old pile of bolts? What do you want to know?
translation: {NewLine}那个老破烂？你想知道什么？

original: Do you mind if I try to fix it?
translation: 你不介意我试着修理一下吧？

original: {New Line}You're welcome to try. Its yours if you can get it working.
translation: {NewLine}请便吧。如果你能修好，它就归你处置了。

original: {New Line}If I had my way I'd dump it in the scrapyard in Novac and be done with the damn thing.
translation: {NewLine}不过要我说，倒不如一脚把它踹进诺瓦克的废品场，眼不见心不烦。

original: What is wrong with it?
translation: 它怎么了？

original: {New Line}Hell if I know. I don't think its serious, but my tinkering days are long gone.
translation: {NewLine}鬼知道咧。我估计应该不太严重，但我已经很多年没干过修理工了。

original: Where did it come from?
translation: 它是从哪里来的？

original: {New Line}A courier dropped it off a couple months back. I got it working for a little while, but the darn thing pooped out.
translation: {NewLine}几个月前一个邮差送过来的。我让它工作了一段时间，但这破玩意后来不知怎得就报销了。

original: {New Line}I haven't been able to get it up and running again. I was hoping to use it for some courier work, but that ain't gonna happen.
translation: {NewLine}我修不好它。原本还希望能用它进行一些邮递工作，但看样子是没戏了。

original: I have some questions about your robot.
translation: 我对你的机器人有些疑问。

original: {New Line}That beat up old thing? What do you want to know?
translation: {NewLine}那个老破烂？你想知道什么？

original: Why can't you protect them?
translation: 你们为什么没能力保护他们？

original: We don't have the equipment to take out the convicts, and even if we did we need some extra hands for backup.
translation: 我们的装备不够，没法对付那些逃犯。而且就算有了装备，我们的人手也不足。

original: You should talk to Lieutenant Hayes. He's in a tent down the road. Just stay on the west side of the overpass if you don't want to get shot.
translation: 你应该去和海耶斯中尉谈谈。他就在那头的帐篷里。最好待在高架桥的西边，否则可能会吃枪子。

original: Shouldn't you be protecting the town or something?
translation: 你们不是该去保护村子吗？

original: We'd love to, but they don't fall under NCR jurisdiction. Even if they did we're in no shape to protect them.
translation: 我们倒想，可他们并不在NCR的管辖范围之内。就算归我们管，我们也没有能力去保护他们。

original: Thanks for the warning.
translation: 多谢提醒。

original: Be careful. You may want to talk to Lieutenant Hayes.
translation: 小心点。你最好还是去和海耶斯中尉谈谈。

original: He's in a tent down the road. Just stay on the west side of the overpass if you don't want to get shot.
translation: 他就在那头的帐篷里。你最好待在高架桥的西边，否则可能会吃枪子。

original: I can take care of myself.
translation: 我能照顾好自己。

original: It's your ass. Don't say you weren't warned.
translation: 反正命是你自己的。别说我没有警告过你。

original: What's going on in Primm?
translation: 普瑞姆出什么事了？

original: Some convicts from the prison up the road have taken over the town. Everyone inside is either dead or in hiding.
translation: 前面那座监狱里跑出来一伙囚犯占领了镇子。镇上的人要么死了，要么就藏起来了。

original: What's more, there are two tribes of raiders causing trouble in this area as well. You'd be safer heading back up to Goodsprings.
translation: 更可怕的是，这附近还有两伙掠夺者在为非作歹。我看你还是回清泉镇会更安全一点。

original: Hey, where the hell do you think you're going? Primm is off limits.
translation: 嗨，你在干啥？普瑞姆现在禁止入内。

original: This is a null line no one will ever see.
translation: 这是一条永远不会有人看见的空行。

original: This is a null line no one will ever see.
translation: 他在路尽头的帐篷里。如果你不想吃枪子的话就老实待在天桥的西侧。

original: I don't think Jackson can help us with the Caravan evidence.
translation: 我觉得在商队证据这件事上，杰克逊帮不了什么忙。

original: Uh... Jackson? He can't help us, he's... gone.
translation: 呃……杰克逊？他帮不了我们，他……不在了。

original: Don't matter much how we settle this, as long as it gets settled.
translation: 用什么方法无所谓，只要能把这件事解决了就行。

original: Fine, let's deal with this the old-fashioned way.
translation: 好吧，咱们还是老办法解决吧。

original: I took care of Jackson. Er, the Jackson problem.
translation: 我搞定杰克逊了。呃，我是说杰克逊的任务。

original: {Takes a breath}Guess that settles that, then.
translation: {Takes a breath}那就这么着吧。

original: He's... gone, don't think he can help. Anything else?
translation: 他……走了，我不认为他能帮上什么忙。还有其他什么事吗？

original: I don't know, seems to be a lot of attention on Nipton. Word is, one of the snipers in the nest on the roof spotted smoke from the East.
translation: 不知道，好像尼普顿最近挺受关注的。据传屋顶上的狙击手发现东方飘起了黑烟。

original: I already took care of Jackson. Er, the Jackson problem.
translation: 我已经料理了杰克逊。呃，我是说他交给我的任务。

original: {Blinks}No shit? Drink's on me, then.
translation: {Blinks}真的？那这杯我请了。

original: Still, not like I'm going anywhere. Caravan title's still keeping me here, even though it's dead and gone.
translation: 不过，我还是走不掉。商队的名号把我束缚在这里，哪怕它早就连根毛都不剩了。

original: Any other work?
translation: 其他工作呢？

original: That Loyal guy. He's getting up there in years, but he still finds a way to make himself useful to his people.
translation: 那个叫罗亚尔的家伙。他年纪已经不小了，但是他仍然在为自己的族人作贡献。

original: If you ask me, that's better than withering away all alone, or holding on to some faded piece of glory from your past.
translation: 要我说，我觉得这比孤独终老要好的多，也远胜于沉醉在过去的荣耀之中。

original: You seemed like you wanted to say something about Loyal.
translation: 看来你好像对罗亚尔有点看法。

original: Your memory is like a steel trap, boss. What do you think of guys like Ranger Andy?
translation: 老大，你的记忆力真是超群。你觉得那个游骑兵安迪人怎么样？

original: You wanted to ask me something before, when we left Ranger Andy's.
translation: 我们离开游骑兵安迪家的时候，你说要问我一件事？

original: Meeting Corporal Sterling, well... it kind of got me thinking.
translation: 见到斯特林下士……确实让我产生了一些想法。

original: Here's a guy that's been beat all to hell, right? I mean, he could have retired from the service, but instead he signs back on and does what he can.
translation: 这个人真是不能再惨了，对吧？我是说，他其实大可以选择就此退休养老，但他却留了下来，继续奉献自我。

original: You think he did the right thing?
translation: 你觉得他做得对吗？

original: You wanted to say something about Corporal Sterling before?
translation: 你刚才是不是想谈谈斯特林下士？

original: Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff using parts.
translation: 使用零件来维修普瑞姆·斯利姆，将其调整为普瑞姆的警长。

original: Bzzzt... Law Enforcement Protocols reinstated, pardner. Initializing use of force authorization... authorization found. Yee-haw!
translation: [成功] 滋滋…执法数据已恢复，朋友。初始化武力使用许可…获得许可。咦哈！

original: <Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff using 3 fission batteries and 4 conductors.>
translation: <使用3份核聚变合电池和4份导体来维修普瑞姆·斯利姆，将其设定为普瑞姆的警长。>

original: Aw, shucks, SYSTEM RUNTIME ERROR! Unable to initialize Law Enforcement Protocols, pardner!
translation: [失败] 喔，哼，程序运行错误！无法初始化执法数据，朋友！

original: <Reprogram Primm Slim to serve as Primm's Sheriff using 3 fission batteries and 4 conductors.>
translation: <使用3份核聚变合电池和4份导体来维修普瑞姆·斯利姆，将其设定为普瑞姆的警长。>

original: I've helped out around here, sending troops to Primm will fortify the NCR in the region.
translation: 我把这附近的问题都解决了，往普瑞姆派兵可以增强NCR在这一地区的防御力量。

original: I see the wisdom in that. I'll radio for a unit to head up to Primm and offer some additional support.
translation: 言之有理，我会派一支部队去普瑞姆，并且给那边提供一点额外的补给。

original: Earlier you said something about asking the Followers to provide medical aid?
translation: 我记得你早前说过要让天启追随者为我们提供医疗援助？

original: About Hoover Dam...
translation: 关于胡佛水坝……

original: We are preparing to move against the Dam, and Legate Lanius has a part for you to play in the battle. Report to him at his camp.
translation: 我们已经准备向大坝进发了，特使拉尼厄斯有作战任务要交给你。去他的营地向他报告吧。

original: Astor says there's a Ranger Station up north.
translation: 阿斯特说北边有一个游骑兵驻站。

original: I can keep killing you, if that's what you want.
translation: 我还可以再杀你一次，只要你愿意的话。

original: Guess I owe you an apology for wrecking you the last time we talked.
translation: 看来我应该为上次把你砸烂的事情道歉。

original: {player killed you last time}That was my fault! But I've changed!
translation: {player killed you last time}那是我的错！不过我已经反省了！

original: I thought you were dead.
translation: 我还以为你死了。

original: I feel really bad telling you this, but I kind of... can't die. I mean, {brightening}go ahead and destroy this Securitron, get it out of your system!
translation: 其实我也不想和你说这个，但从某种程度上来说……我是死不了的。我的意思是{brightening}，你大可以把这个机器人摧毁，可那样也只不过是把我赶出它的系统而已！

original: The problem is that a distributed image of my neuro-computational matrix is backed-up to the network several times a day, or when I'm {pause, upbeat}threatened!
translation: 奥妙在于，我的神经运算系统有一套分布式镜像，每天都会进行多次网络备份，在我受到威胁的时候，它也会自动备份！

original: I can't help it! There's a little bit of me in every Securitron out on the Strip, so if this instance gets destroyed, I just download to a new one.
translation: 我也没办法！长街上的每台电子保安身上都嵌入了我的数据，所以即便你毁掉了眼前这台机器人，我只要再下载一组新的就可以了。

original: If I could stop it from happening, I would! I mean, {sympathy}your vengeance is going to feel so incomplete!
translation: 我当然不希望这样！像我现在这个样子，你就算报了仇也没有快感！

original: Let's talk about something else.
translation: 我们说点别的吧。

original: Sorry if that was getting boring!
translation: 抱歉让你觉得无聊了！

original: Is this because I didn't upgrade that army of Securitrons under Caesar's Fort?
translation: 难道是因为我没有给堡垒里的机器人部队更新装备吗？

original: Well, problem is that's left us with enough Securitrons to drive off a weakened NCR force - probably - but not enough to keep them from coming back!
translation: 呃，问题就在于，我们手头的机器人虽然能打败一支元气大伤的NCR部队——当然这也没个准——却不能阻止他们卷土重来！

original: So what we do is take away the whole reason why they'd want to come back! Smart, huh?
translation: 所以我们得制造个理由，让他们不会再回来了！你觉得如何？

original: I want this dam out of operation.
translation: 我想让水坝停止运转。

original: Right, who wants a vast army of mechanical servants to savage your enemy? Why make it easy?
translation: 没错，谁乐意就这样派一支机械部队去把敌人打的七零八落呢？何必如此便宜他们？

original: I'm setting the generators to blow, just like you asked. Hit the manual switch, then go topside and deal with the Legion and NCR.
translation: 我会把发电机炸掉。你只要去手动拉下开关，然后就可以上去解决NCR和军团了。

original: Send power to the Fort.
translation: 向城堡提供能源。

original: {enthused}Yes! This is going to be fun!
translation: {enthused}明白！似乎变得有趣了！

original: I'm unlocking the East Power Plant. Hit the manual switch, then go topside and deal with the Legion and NCR.

translation: 去卡莱尔·圣克莱尔位于长街北部的住所找他。

original: Secure an acceptable replacement for Ted Gunderson as the White Glove Society's main course.
translation: 寻找合适的替代品来担当白手套社团的主菜。

original: (OPTIONAL) Get rid of Philippe and cook for the banquet using his recipe for human flesh.
translation: (可选)除掉菲利普，并为晚间的宴席烹制伪造的人肉宴。

original: (OPTIONAL) Drug the wine at the White Glove Society banquet.
translation: (可选)在白手套社团的酒里下药。

original: (OPTIONAL) Use the intercom to call in the head waiter.
translation: (可选)用厨房的对讲机呼叫服务员领班。

original: (OPTIONAL) Bring Ted to the Members Only section to expose Mortimer at the end of his banquet speech.
translation: (可选)带着泰德前往会员专区，在宴席最后揭露莫蒂默的行为。

original: Return to Mortimer in the Ultra-Luxe.
translation: 回到奢华殿堂的莫蒂默处。

original: Collect samples off of Ted's corpse for use in framing his father.
translation: 收集泰德尸体上的血液，用来栽赃他的父亲。

original: Distribute your samples around Heck Gunderson's bed and sink in his Ultra-Luxe penthouse suite.
translation: 将你收集来的血洒在冈德森所住套房的床边和水池里。

original: Send a securitron from the Strip to investigate Heck Gunderson's suite.
translation: 请求长街的电子保安前去调查赫克·冈德森的酒店房间。

original: Kill Ted Gunderson.
translation: 杀死泰德·冈德森。

original: Drag Carlyle's body into the dumpster alongside his house.
translation: 将卡莱尔的尸体拖到他住所旁的垃圾桶中。

original: Return Ted to his father at the Ultra-Luxe's Top Shelf bar.
translation: 将泰德送回奢华殿堂云巅酒吧的父亲处。

original: (OPTIONAL) Lock one of your human companions in the Ultra-Luxe kitchen freezer as a replacement for Ted.
translation: (可选)挑一位你的人类同伴，将其关进冰库，以替代泰德·冈德森。

original: Search the Investigator for clues.
translation: 调查私家侦探的下落。

translation: A站

translation: B站

translation: C站

translation: D站
