original:
The Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System, or V.A.T.S., allows you to pause the game, assess any combat situation tactically, and target the specific body parts of any enemies onscreen.

Pressing and holding &-sUActnVats; will pause the game and scan the area of targets; arrows to the left and right indicate threats that are currently offscreen.

To zoom in on an enemy, simply select it and release &-sUActnVats;. You are now able to target the individual body parts of that enemy. 

The percentage value next to a body part indicates the chance to hit that body part with each shot. The small bar next to the body part indicates its condition; when the condition of a body part is completely reduced, that body part is crippled, and the targeted enemy will suffer the obvious ill effects -- crippling the legs reduces movement speed and any lunging attacks; crippling the arms affects accuracy, etc.

When using a melee weapon or unarmed combat, you will need to be close to have a chance to hit. Both melee and grenades are "full body" attacks, and you cannot specify a specific body part. As you raise your Melee Weapons or Unarmed skill, you will gain the ability to perform special attacks with weapons using those skills.

Every attack on a body part uses up Action Points. Generally, the smaller a weapon, the fewer Action Points are required for every shot. Keep in mind that you're not limited to shooting at just one target -- at any time, you can switch available targets, and attack them as well, so long as you have remaining Action Points.

When you've used up all of your Action Points, and are ready to leave V.A.T.S., press &sKBSpace;.
translation:
避难所科技辅助瞄准系统（简称 V.A.T.S.），允许你暂停游戏，战术性地评估任何战斗情形，并瞄准屏幕上任何敌人的特定身体部位。

按住&-sUActnVats;会暂停游戏并扫描目标区域；左右箭头表示当前屏幕外的威胁。

要拉近查看敌人，只需选中它并松开&-sUActnVats;。此时你就能瞄准该敌人的各个身体部位。

躯体部位旁边的百分比数值表示每次射击命中该部位的几率。躯体部位旁边的小条表示其状况；当某个躯体部位的状况值完全耗尽，该部位就会残废，被瞄准的敌人将受到明显的不良影响——腿部残废会降低移动速度和任何突进攻击；手臂残废会影响精准度，等等。

当使用近战武器或徒手战斗时，你需要靠近敌人才能有机会命中。近战和投掷手榴弹都属于“全身”攻击，你无法指定特定的躯体部位。随着你的近战武器或徒手技能提升，你将能够使用这些技能施展武器特殊攻击。

对躯体部位的每次攻击都会消耗行动值。一般来说，武器越小，每次射击所需的行动值就越少。请记住，你并非仅限于射击一个目标——只要你还有剩余行动值，随时都可以切换到其他可用目标并对其发动攻击。

当你用尽你所有行动值，并准备离开V.A.T.S.，按下&sKBSpace;。

original: The aircraft above is the original Wright Flyer I designed by Orville and Wilbur Wright. On December 17, 1903 in Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, the vehicle performed its maiden flight for a mere 12 seconds, covering a distance of only 120 feet . This historic event marked the first sustained and controlled heavier-than-air powered flight.
translation: 上面的这架飞行器是奥维尔·莱特和维尔伯·莱特兄弟设计的原版莱特飞行器一代。1903年12月17日，在北卡罗来纳的基蒂霍克，这架交通工具展现了它为时仅12秒的首飞，仅涉及了120英尺远。这一历史性的事件标志着首次持久可控的超空气比重动力飞行。

original: The Type 1861 "Springfield" Rifle-Musket was the standard weapon for the infantry soldier in the American Civil War. It was a muzzle-loaded weapon which fired a .58 caliber "Minie Ball" using percussion caps instead of the traditional flintlock. Almost a million of these weapons were manufactured for the soldiers during the war.\n\nOn loan from the International Ordnance Museum, these cases display the various types of weapons and ammunition used by the military in past conflicts all over the globe.
translation: 1861型“斯普林菲尔德”步枪是美国南北战争中的步兵制式武器。它是一种利用撞击雷管而不是传统燧石发火装置发射.58“米尼弹”的枪口装填式武器。战时几乎生产了一百万支此种武器分发给士兵。\n\n从国际军械博物馆中借来的这些箱子展示了在过去遍布全球的军事冲突中被使用的不同种类的武器和弹药。

original: Perhaps the most well-recognized weapon in the modern U.S. Military arsenal, the M199 earned its nickname "The Backtalker" from the unusual report the firing mechanism makes as it ejects a spent shell. Firing standard 5.56mm rounds, the M199 is still the official infantry weapon of the U.S. Army.\n\nOn loan from the International Ordnance Museum, these cases display the various types of weapons and ammunition used by the military in past conflicts all over the globe.
translation: 现代美国军事装备库中可能最众所周知的武器，M199，是由其发出的异样枪响而得名“刺儿头”。发射标准.5.56子弹，M199仍然是美国军方步兵制式武器。\n\n从国际军械博物馆中借来的这些箱子展示了在过去遍布全球的军事冲突中被使用的不同种类的武器和弹药。

original: This is the only known prototype of the X277 "Viper" Magnetic Rail Cannon developed for the U.S. Military by West-Tek. Also commonly referred to as a "Railgun", the weapon uses energy cells to propel a depleted uranium round across a series of magnets discharging it at extremely high velocity. Deemed too costly to produce on a mass scale, the project was abandoned in 2044.\n\nOn loan from the International Ordnance Museum, these cases display the various types of weapons and ammunition used by the military in past conflicts all over the globe.
translation: 这是唯一一支现存的由West-Tek为美国军方开发的X277“毒蛇”磁轨炮原型。也被普遍称之为“轨道枪”，这武器利用能量电池，以对一系列磁铁的快速放电，通过电磁感应现象来推进贫铀弹以极高速射出。被认为量产成本太高，该项目在2044年被中止。\n\n从国际军械博物馆中借来的这些箱子展示了在过去遍布全球的军事冲突中被使用的不同种类的武器和弹药。

original: This flag was recovered from the wreck of the U.S.S. Ebon Atoll, a U.S. Navy Missile Cruiser, sunk off the coast of Alaska in 2066 with all hands lost. The cutting edge vessel's loss was due to a nuclear torpedo strike from the U.S. Navy Submarine, the U.S.S. Interference during the Anchorage Campaign. The submarine mistook the cruiser for an enemy vessel during radio silence and sunk it before obtaining visual confirmation. This ranks as one of the most tragic disasters in U.S. Naval History since World War II.
translation: 这面旗帜是从美国军舰埃崩环礁号的残骸上找回来的。该舰是美国海军的一艘导弹巡洋舰，于2066年在阿拉斯加海岸边沉没，无一人幸免。这一尖端技术船只的丧失归咎于安克雷奇战役时期美国海军潜水艇协调号的一次核鱼雷攻击。潜艇在电台静默时期误将巡洋舰当成敌方船只，在获得图像确认之前就击沉了它。这被列为美国海军历史上自从二战以来最惨痛的灾难之一。

original: These portraits created by the renown Contemporary Artist Lincoln Myers depict some of the more overlooked American Inventors. From top to bottom, left to right: Richard G. Drew (adhesive tape, 1925), James Ritty (cash register, 1879), Carl C. Magee (parking meter, 1935) and Mary Anderson (windshield wiper, 1903).
translation: 这些由著名当代艺术家林肯·迈尔斯创作的画像描绘出一些更被人所忽视的美国发明。从上到下，从左至右：Richard G. Drew(透明胶带，1925)，詹姆斯Ritty(收银机，1879)，卡尔 C. Magee(停车计费器，1935)和玛丽·安德森(汽车雨刷，1903)。

original: You can't use this now.
translation: 现在无法使用这个。

original: This rollerskate is awfully close to the stairs. A simple push could put it in a very dangerous position.
translation: 这旱冰鞋离楼梯非常近。轻轻一推就能把它弄到非常危险的位置上。

original: Do nothing.
translation: 什么都不做。

original: Push the skate.
translation: 推这溜冰鞋。

original: The roller skate is in a precarious position at the edge of the stairs. Be careful...
translation: 四轮滑冰鞋在楼梯边一个很危险的地方。小心……

original: Be careful!
translation: 小心！

original: You give the skate a hearty push.
translation: 痛快地推了溜冰鞋。

original: The simulation prevents you from tampering with the body.
translation: 模拟防止对尸体动手动脚。

original: Only residents wearing Vault 112 suits may access this lounger.
translation: 只有穿112号避难所服装的居民才能使用睡眠舱。

original: The medals in this case were typically awarded to American pilots in World War II. From left to right, top row to bottom: Medal of Honor, Distinguished Service Cross, Silver Star, Distinguished Flying Cross, Navy Cross, Air Medal, Bronze Star, and the Purple Heart.
translation: 这个箱子中的奖章是二战时期具代表性的用以授予美国飞行员们的。从左至右，至上而下：荣誉勋章，铜十字英勇勋章，银星勋章，飞行员十字勋章，海军十字勋章，空军奖章，铜星勋章，和紫心勋章。

original: This is the actual USSA Deep Space Suit worn by Captain Carl Bell on May 5, 1961. Captain Bell is credited as being the first human in space on board the Space Capsule Defiance 7, but this has been constantly refuted by both the Soviet Union and China. Defiance 7's flight lasted for a total of 12 minutes and 7 seconds as it achieved one full revolution around the Earth.
translation: 这是1961年5月5日的卡尔·贝尔上校穿着的本人的美国空间管理局太空服。贝尔上校被赞颂为站在挑战者7号太空舱甲板上的首个太空人，但这经常被苏联和中国两国所驳斥。挑战者7号的飞行持续了12分7秒，它绕了地球一圈。

original: This is the actual skeleton of Captain Carl Bell who died on May 5, 1961 after his Space Capsule crash landed. Captain Bell is credited as being the first human in space on board the Space Capsule Defiance 7, but this has been constantly refuted by both the Soviet Union and China. Defiance 7's fight lasted for a total of 12 minutes and 7 seconds as it achieved one full revolution around the Earth. Donated by Edwina Bell.
translation: 这是1961年5月5日死去的卡尔·贝尔上校在他的太空舱坠毁着地后留下的骸骨。贝尔上校被赞颂为站在挑战者7号太空舱甲板上的首个太空人，但这经常被苏联和中国两国所驳斥。挑战者7号的飞行持续了12分7秒，它绕了地球一圈。由爱德华·贝尔捐赠。

original: On July 16, 1969, the Virgo II Lunar Lander "Valiant 11" became the very first manned space vehicle to touch down on the moon. The Valiant 11's crew consisted of Captain Richard Wade, Captain Mark Garris and Captain Michael Hagen of the USSA. We salute these brave and noble men who took the very first steps on a planetary body other than our own.
translation: 1969年7月16日，室女II登月飞行器“Valiant 11”成为了最早的着陆月面的载人航天交通工具。Valiant 11的乘员班子包括美国海难援救协会的Richard Wade上校，Mark Garris上校和迈克尔 Hagen上校。我们向他们这些首次涉足我们自己星球之外的行星体的勇敢高尚的人致敬。

original: This unusual flag was recovered from the surface of the moon by the very last manned flight to its surface in 2052. The flag is from the old "Valiant 12" Virgo III Lunar Lander that touched down November 14, 1969. Its remarkable condition can be attributed to its construction; the flag is actually made of special materials to withstand the harsh environment of space.
translation: 这面不寻常的旗帜是2052年最后一架载人飞行器从月面带回来的。旗帜来源于1969年11月14日登月的古老的"Valiant 12" Virgo III登月飞行器。它仍然保存得如此完好归功于它的做工：旗帜事实上是用可以承受严酷空间环境的特种材料制成的。

original: This exhibit is undergoing renovation and should return soon. Thanks!
translation: 该展品正在修复，很快就会回到展览。感谢理解！

original: The Delta IX Rocket was donated by the United States Space Administration and by a grant from the United States Department of Antiquities.
translation: D9型火箭是由美国航天局捐赠的，同时获得美国文物部授权批准。

original: This is a scaled model of a prototype military transport vehicle being developed by the U.S. Military. The XVB02 "Vertibird" is a VTOL ("Vertical Take Off and Landing") craft with an extremely durable armored fuselage and can be armed with a variety of offensive weapons and defensive countermeasures. This is the most advanced aircraft of its kind ever developed, and the military hopes to press them into service by 2085.
translation: 这是一架成比例缩小的美国军方开发的军用运输交通工具原型。XVB02“飞鸟”是一种VTOL（“垂直升降”）航空器，带有极其耐用的装甲机身，并能装备大量攻击性武器和防御性设施。这是曾经开发过的该种机械中最先进的飞行器，军方希望在2085年将其投入使用。

original: No encounters currently available in this set -- resetting trigger zone.
translation: 该设备当前没有可用敌方目标--正在重设触发域。

original: Addictions Removed
translation: 瘾症解除

original: You are a little woozy.
translation: 你有一点晕眩。

original: This computer trap is disarmed and won't explode unless it it rearmed.
translation: 电脑陷阱已经被解除，除非重新启动否则不会爆炸。

original: To our new friend, we say thanks, and promise never to forget how he drove off the demons who sought to keep us from reaching the promised land.
translation: 对我们的新朋友，我们由衷感谢，他为我们驱逐了妄图阻碍旅程的魔鬼，打开了前往光明的通路，此等义举，我们必定铭记在心。

original: JasonBrightSpeechMessage5
translation: 杰森.布莱特讲话信息 5

original: But to Chris, we owe more than thanks. To him, we owe our salvation. Chris, you have made the Great Journey a reality.
translation: 至于克里斯对我们之恩情，更是无以言谢。对他的救赎之恩，我们永生难报。克里斯，是你，将这伟大旅程从预言变为了现实。

original: JasonBrightSpeechMessage6
translation: 杰森.布莱特讲话信息 6

original: From this moment forward, we shall each and every one of us revere you as the Saint of the Great Journey. We shall never forget you.
translation: 从今往后，你将作为伟大旅程的圣徒，被世人所传颂。你的名字，你的事迹，我们将永世不忘。

original: JasonBrightSpeechMessage7
translation: 杰森.布莱特讲话信息 7

original: We ask that you forgive us, Chris, and give us your blessing, as we bestow ours upon you. We are but humble servants of the creator's divine and mysterious will.
translation: 我请求你原谅我们，克里斯，你的祝福将与吾等同在，吾等也将为你祈祷。我们不过是遵从了造物主的意志与神示。

original: JasonBrightSpeechMessage8
translation: 杰森.布莱特讲话信息 8

original: It is your sacrifice that will bring us to the promised land. Seekers, board the rockets, take your seats. The Great Journey awaits! We go now to the Far Beyond!
translation: 正有你的牺牲，我们才能前往应许之地。登上火箭吧，寻道者们，找到你的座位。伟大旅程在等着我们！前往遥远彼岸吧！

original: JasonBrightSpeechMessage9
translation: 杰森.布莱特讲话信息 9

original: Current # of Kills: %g
translation: 目前杀死 # 的数量： %g

original: The terminal seems to be locked into its new settings.
translation: 终端机已经将新的设定参数绑定在了系统中。

original: Oops! You're not sure what you just did, but it probably isn't good...
translation: 哇哦！你不知道自己刚刚做了什么，但可能不太妙……

original:
Examining the trajectories a little further, it looks like the computer is set to take a non-optimal route to the specified destination.

You surmise that with minor alterations, you can plot a course that will take them about 12.5%% closer to their intended destination.

Do you wish to alter the rockets' course?
translation:
检查了火箭的航向之后，你发现电脑并没有设定目的地的最佳航线。

你推测，只需稍作调整，你就可以让航线离既定目标再偏近12.5%。

你希望调整火箭航向吗？

original: Make the change.
translation: 调整。

original: Don't make the change.
translation: 不管它。

original: You modify the path of the rockets to land closer to their target.
translation: 你调整了火箭航向，让它能在离目标更近的地方着陆。

original: You alter the trajectory of the rockets so that they will crash into one another on launch.
translation: 你偏转了火箭的轨迹，它们在发射途中会撞在一起。

original: The console displays a wealth of information concerning the predicted trajectory of the rockets.\n\nWhat do you wish to do?
translation: 主机上显示了关于火箭航向的一大堆信息。\n\n你想怎么做？

original: Examine the navigation data further.
translation: 检查数据。

original: Set the rockets to crash into one another.
translation: 设定火箭与另一火箭相撞。

original: Leave the console alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: You don't think you accomplished much, but you feel better.
translation: 虽然你感觉啥也没做，但至少舒服了一些。

original: You see a bunch of numbers and words on the screen, but none of it really means anything to you.
translation: 你在屏幕上看见了一堆文字，但它们对你来说毫无意义。

original: Mash on the keys.
translation: 脸滚键盘。

original: Leave the console alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: The console seems to have something to do with the course plotted for the rockets, but you can't make heads or tails out of how it works.\n(Science 55 required)
translation: 控制台似乎与火箭的航向有关，但你完全不知道它是怎么运作的。\n（需要55点科学技能）

original: Leave the console alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: The 9mm submachinegun preserved in the glass case to the left of this plaque is the ACTUAL weapon Vance carried in a paper-wrapped box under some suitcases in the trunk of his car during his and Vikki's crime spree! Never fired, and luckily untouched by the hail of bullets that ended its notorious owner's life, the weapon's mint condition inspires dread in all who look upon it. Experts speculate that Vance might have killed as many as fifty people had he ever fired the gun - so long as his aim was exact and he was starting off with a full clip - or even more if he had additional ammo clips and remembered to reload!
translation: 展板左边玻璃柜中展出的9毫米半自动枪，正是万斯和维姬逃亡时装在车厢手提箱下纸盒里的真品！这把枪从未开过火，在其主人命丧于枪林弹雨中时，它也所幸未受波及。但凡看到它的人，都会因其崭新的样貌而由衷感到畏惧。据专家估计，如果万斯当时开枪的话，那么在他百发百中，并且子弹充足的情况下，将有至少50人成为他的枪下游魂。要是他能再多带些子弹，并且记得换弹夹的话，也许死的人会更多！

original: Vance's Gun
translation: 万斯之枪

original: The generator looks to be fine, but some kind of large vermin has chewed into the power cable. With the proper know-how and some scrap metal, you could repair the connection and improve its output bandwidth. Otherwise you'll need help.\n\n(Repair of 35 or higher and one piece of scrap metal required)
translation: 发电器看起来还算完好，但电缆似乎被某种巨大的害虫给咬坏了。如果你掌握了相关知识，手头也有废金属的话，你可以修复电路，改善其输出宽带。否则只能寻求他人帮助了。\n\n（需要35以上修理技能和一块废金属）

original: Auxiliary Generator
translation: 辅助发电机

original: Do nothing.
translation: 不管它。

original: Repair the wire.
translation: 修复电线。

original: This mainframe is currently unresponsive. The amount of power reaching the terminal seems to be insufficient.
translation: 中枢主机目前没有反应。似乎是因为电力不足。

original: Mainframe
translation: 主机

original: Leave.
translation: 离开

original: You fixed the wiring. Sufficient electricity should now be flowing to the mainframe computer.
translation: 你修复了电线，现在应该有足够电力可以输入中枢主机了。

original: Auxiliary Generator
translation: 辅助发电机

original: This robot has been fitted with a variety of tools specialized for industrial maintenance. There is a slot at the back of the head where it looks like a keycard could be fit. \n\n(Science of 45 or Poseidon Energy ID Card required)
translation: 这台机器人身上装备了各种各样专门用来进行维护的工具。它的后脑勺上有一个插槽，似乎可以插入一张钥匙卡。\n\n（需要45以上科学或海神能源公司的ID卡）

original: PYTHON
translation: 巨蟒

original: Do nothing.
translation: 不管它。

original: [Science] Hardwire the robot to run on autopilot in repair mode.
translation: [科学] 将机器人设定成自动修理模式。

original: Insert Poseidon  Energy ID Card.
translation: 插入海神能源ID卡。

original: These replica outfits show just how conscious Vikki was of the styles of the period. Vikki was well known for her sense of fashion and her fixation on expensive clothing was thought to be one of the reasons the pair chose a life of crime.
translation: 这套服装（复制品）展现了维姬对于当时潮流的重视。维姬以其时尚品味闻名于世，据说正是因为她对高档服装的痴迷，才令这对夫妇最终走上了犯罪的道路。

original: Vikki's Outfits
translation: 维姬的外套

original: These mannequins display replicas of some of the clothing that was found in the trunk of Vikki and Vance's death car. Vance didn't share Vikki's sense of fashion, and chose to dress himself how he envisioned a gangster would dress.
translation: 模特身上展示的服装（复制品）是从维姬和万斯所驾驶的亡命跑车后备箱中发现的。不同于维姬所追求的时尚感，万斯完全依照心目中劫匪的模样给自己置办了一套特别的行头。

original: Vance's Outfits
translation: 万斯的外套

original: The collar has begun to emit a high-pitched beeping noise.
translation: 项圈开始发出短促的蜂鸣声。

original: Your collar has begun beeping more insistently.
translation: 你的项圈开始发出更加急促的蜂鸣声。

original: The elevator is broken, but it looks as though it could be repaired. (Repair 35 or higher required)
translation: 电梯坏了，但还能修。（需要35或以上的修理技能）

original: Broken Elevator
translation: 损坏的电梯

original: Leave It Alone
translation: 不管它

original: Repair Elevator
translation: 修理电梯

original: The console is unresponsive. For it to operate properly, it would need to be activated during peak sunlight hours (9 AM - 3 PM), a power configuration would need to be set up in the tower's mainframe, and the two ground-level terminals would need to have an active uplink to the mainframe.
translation: 控制台没有反应。只有在日照高峰时段（上午九点到下午三点）启动，才能使它正常运转。首先必须为塔里的中枢主机配置好电力，其次还要启动位于底层的两台终端，与主机建立连接。

original: Reflector Control Console
translation: 反射板控制面板

original: Leave.
translation: 离开

original: The radio appears to be broken.
translation: 无线电台似乎坏了。

original: This robot has been fitted with a variety of tools specialized for industrial maintenance. However, there is nothing left in the room for it to repair.
translation: 这个机器人身上装备了各种各样专门用来进行维护的工具。不过，这个房间里也没什么可修的东西。

original: PYTHON
translation: 巨蟒

original: Leave.
translation: 离开

original: "This godforsaken radio still doesn't work. Damn it, I'm a scout, not an electrician. Must've got some sand in it or something. At least that crazy storm is good for keeping people away. This place wouldn't make much of a safehouse if other people were traipsing in and out all the time. I'd hate to have to find another location again, but if the supplies, and especially the equipment weren't safe, I guess I'd have to."
translation: “这天杀的无线电台还是不工作。可恶，我是个斥候，又不是电工。肯定是进沙子了。好在这里疯狂的沙暴可以使人难以靠近。要是有其他闲人进进出出的话，这儿也当不了藏身处了。我真不想再去找其它地方，可如果物资尤其是设备都不安全的话，估计还是得另寻他处。”

original: Put the journal back down.
translation: 将日记放回去。

original: "This location looks like it might make a good safehouse. Warm, dry, and some sort of crazy natural phenomenon at night that should keep the predators away. I'd love to start getting set up, but there are a few nearby points of interest I need to gather intel on first. Not sure how long that'll take."
translation: “这地方似乎可以当个不错的临时藏身处。温暖，干燥，晚上还会刮起疯狂的天然沙暴，驱逐大型食肉动物。我很乐意马上开始扎营，但附近有几个地方感觉值得一去，我打算先去搜集一下情报。不知道得花多长时间。”

original: "Finally got started getting this place in order. Put out enough supplies to last a while, swept up some. Gonna hit the hay and continue tomorrow."
translation: “终于把这个地方整理好了。弄了些补给，足够撑一阵子了，开始大扫除。睡了。明天继续。”

original: Put the journal back down.
translation: 将日记放回去。

original: Read the next entry.
translation: 看下一篇。

original: "Found a nice little spot to scout the prison from. Place has been pretty active recently. Those thrice-damned powder gangers have been spreading out, so I need to be careful to avoid them. It doesn't help that I have to get back early each night or risk getting blinded by the sand."
translation: “找到了一个可以盯着监狱的好地方。那地方最近相当热闹。这群挨千刀的炸药帮正在四处向外扩张，我得小心防着他们。雪上加霜的是，我晚上必须早点回去，否则沙子可能会把我弄瞎。”

original: Put the journal back down.
translation: 将日记放回去。

original: Read the next entry.
translation: 看下一篇。

original: You're listening to Black Mountain Radio.
translation: 你正在收听黑山电台。

original: Now, MUSIC!
translation: 现在是音乐时间！

original: <Sound that can only loosely be labeled music comes from the speaker.>
translation: <喇叭里传来了只能勉强算是音乐的声音。>

original: Leader: Good luck getting that door open. It will only open if you know the password, which you'll never guess!
translation: 首领：祝你能打得开那扇门咯。只有知道密码那扇门才会开，而你永远猜不到密码会是什么！

original: Raul: Yes, they'd have a 1 in 739452466138 chance of guessing it. But we both know that will never happen.
translation: 劳尔：是啊，他们有739452466138分之1的几率猜中。但我们都知道那是不可能的。

original: Leader: So tru- Hey, that number was the same as the password. What are the odds of that?
translation: 首领：没错——嘿，这串数字和密码一模一样。怎么那么巧？

original: Raul: Sigh.
translation: 劳尔：叹气。

original: Raul has returned to his shack.
translation: 劳尔回到了他的棚屋。

original: Tabitha: Shut - up - Raul!
translation: 塔比瑟：闭 - 嘴 -劳尔!

original: Raul: Dead's not a place. You can't go *to* Dead. No one vacations in Dead.
translation: 劳尔: “死”又不是个地方。你去不了一个叫“死”的地方。没人会去“死”度假。

original: Tabitha: Dead! That's where they are.
translation: 塔比瑟：都去“死”了！那就是他们的归宿。

original: Tabitha: I know what you're here for! You think you're the first to try to take over this array!? Well guess where the ones who came before you are?
translation: 塔比瑟：我知道你来这里的目的！你以为你是第一个企图霸占这片天线的人吗？！你知道之前来这儿的那些人都去哪儿了吗？

original: Tabitha: Fine! You want the equipment here so badly!? Here, I'll let you have a piece!
translation: 塔比瑟：好吧！你就那么想要这里的装备？来吧，我就给你几件！

original: Tabitha: I'm not screwing around here. I'm prepared to blow this whole place to hell if I have to.
translation: 塔比瑟：我才不要呆在这个破地方。我已经做好了准备，如果有必要，我会把这个地方炸上天。

original: Raul: But you only had me place the one explosive...
translation: 劳尔：可你只让我安了一个炸弹呀……

original: Tabitha: Not now, Raul!
translation: 塔比瑟：别打岔，劳尔！

original: There appears to be an automated door hidden behind this wall. It looks like it could be jammed shut, with the proper skills. (Repair 65 or higher required)
translation: 墙后似乎藏着一扇自动门。只要懂得相应的技能，你就可以将这扇门彻底卡住。（需要65以上修理技能）

original: Automated Door
translation: 自动门

original: Leave It Alone
translation: 不管它

original: Jam Opening Mechanism
translation: 破坏自动门机构。

original: A thorough examination of the nearby machinery reveals that the radio is directly linked to another system somewhere in the area, but isn't connected to the overall broadcast hub. It would be relatively simple to patch it into the speakers that dot the area.
translation: 在对附近的机械设备进行彻底的检查后，你发现这个无线电是与该地区的某个系统直联的，但它并没有连接到广播中心上。要将它连上这一地区的扩音器并不是什么难事。

original: Leave the radio alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: Press the button.
translation: 按下按钮。

original: Patch the radio into the broadcast system.
translation: 将无线电连接到广播系统上。

original:
The tattered message paper looks hastily scrawled by a shaky hand. It reads:

"If you can read this, please know that you are in great danger if you continue on this path. If you value you life, turn back now. If you must proceed, I implore you to head west past the gate, which will take you to my dwelling. Take the trails rather than the roads, and you may live long enough for us to meet face to face.

Neil"
translation:
破破烂烂的小纸条上可以看到一些文字，似乎是由一只颤抖的手匆匆书写而成的。内容如下：

"如果你看到了这张纸，请一定要明白，如果你再继续沿着这条路走下去，将会陷入巨大的危险。如果你还珍惜自己的命，那现在就回头吧。如果你执意要前进，我恳求你向西走，到我的住所来。走小路，不要走大路，如此一来你或许能活到我们见面的时候。

尼尔"

original: The radio appears to be connected to a series of nearby machines. The microphone hooked into it has a blinking button on the side.
translation: 无线电台似乎与周围的一系列仪器相连接。挂在电台上的麦克风旁边似乎有一个闪闪发光的按钮。

original: Leave the radio alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: Press the button.
translation: 按下按钮。

original: A second after you press the button, a harsh voice comes over the radio's speaker.
translation: 在你按下按钮的下一秒，收音机的喇叭中传来了一个嘶哑的声音。

original: The radio remains patched to the broadcast system.
translation: 无线电已经连接上了广播系统。

original: Leave the radio alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: Link the radio to its original connection.
translation: 将无线电接回原来的系统。

original: Broadcast along the paths leading up to the mountain.
translation: 向山路上发出广播。

original: Broadcast inside the village.
translation: 向村内发出广播。

original: Broadcast on the summit.
translation: 向山顶发出广播。

original: Your voice echoes somewhere below you. A moment later, the equipment around you loses power.
translation: 你的声音在你下方回荡。过了一会儿，你周围的设备停电了。

original: You hear your voice clearly just outside the building. A moment later, the equipment around you loses power.
translation: 你清楚地听见自己的声音在建筑物外面回荡。过了一会儿，你周围的设备便停电了。

original: You voice echoes from somewhere above, further along the road. A moment later, the equipment around you loses power.
translation: 你的声音在半空中回荡，沿着道路飘了好远。过了一会儿，你周围的设备便停电了。

original: It looks like you can only connect it to one part of the system at a time. Judging from the wires leading from the system, you have a general idea of where your broadcast will be heard. You guess that wherever your voice is heard, an armed response will shortly follow.
translation: 看样子你只能将无线电连接到其中一个系统上。通过系统延伸出的电路，你可以大致判断广播会传播到何处。你猜想，无论你的广播在何处响起，过不了多时都必定会有敌人出现。

original: Leave the radio alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: Broadcast along the paths leading up the mountain.
translation: 向山路发出广播。

original: Broadcast inside the village.
translation: 向村庄内发出广播。

original: Broadcast on the summit.
translation: 向山顶发出广播。

original: The mother deathclaw goes berserk at the death of her baby!
translation: 死亡爪母兽由于幼崽的死而狂暴了！

original: Some sort of data corruption has made the user interface illegible. The damage doesn't seem to go any deeper than that since the pump station is still online.\n\n[Science of 50 or greater required to repair.]
translation: 由于数据损坏，操作界面变得难以辨识。因为水泵站还在运转，所以故障应该不算太严重。\n\n[需要51或以上的科学才能修复。]

original: Pump Station Terminal
translation: 水泵站终端机

original: Leave the terminal alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: Repair the network connection.
translation: 修复网络连接。

original: Activate the terminal.
translation: 激活终端。

original: You restored the pump station's network connection.
translation: 你成功修复了水泵站的网络连接。

original: You quickly ascertain that the robot's current AI state is set to hibernate, likely a self-defense mechanism after the unit suffered catastrophic damage. Whoever repaired it probably didn't know how to reset its AI. After flipping the right switch, the robot jumps to life.
translation: 你很快确认了机器人目前的AI处于待机状态，似乎是处理单元受到了严重破坏而启动了自保机制。修复它的人可能不知道如何重新启动AI。在拨动正确的开关以后，机器人动了起来。

original: There's an intruder in the dish hut! Get him, you fools!
translation: 有人闯进了锅盖天线棚子！抓住他，你们这些白痴！

original: The transceiver is now dead. The connection must have been cut from the other side.
translation: 收音机静默了。一定是另一边切断了连接。

original: The robot lies inert on the table, giving no indication of having worked recently, or ever. A nameplate on part of the surface is scratched and mostly faded, but you can still make out the faint word "Rhonda". If you knew more about how robots function, you might be able to get it working again.\n(Science 60 required)
translation: 机器人一动不动地躺在桌上，没有最近启动过的痕迹——似乎它从来就未被启动过。机器表面有一块名牌，上面满是刮痕，几乎已经褪色，但你还是能识别出淡淡的“朗达”二字。\n（需要61科学）

original: Rhonda
translation: 朗达

original: The robot lies inert on the table, giving no indication of having worked recently, or ever. A nameplate on part of the surface is scratched and mostly faded, but you can still make out the faint word "Rhonda".
translation: 机器人一动不动地躺在桌上，没有最近启动过的痕迹——似乎它从来就未被启动过。机器表面有一块名牌，上面满是刮痕，几乎已经褪色，但你还是能识别出淡淡的“朗达”二字。

original: Leave the robot alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: [Science] Check the robot's circuitry.
translation: [科学] 检查机器人的电路系统。

original: As you flip the switch, the radio station goes silent. Only static plays over the speakers.
translation: 你拨了一下开关，电台静默了。喇叭里只传来一阵杂音。

original: [Tabitha] Did you kill some and they overreacted? Are two-head-bear people shooting at you, and battle cattle mooing? Beware the battle cattle...
translation: [塔比瑟] 你是否因为人类的反应过度而大开杀戒？那些加州佬是不是还会对着你们开火，凯撒的崽子们是不是还会对着你们大呼小叫？

original: [Rhonda]<whispering a line prompt> "Leave the fear behind."
translation: [朗达] <随即喃喃自语>[QUOTE]置恐惧于身外。[QUOTE]

original: [Tabitha] Leave the Fear Behind. Meet at the Mountain Top! Enjoy life in a state of Utobitha - Free, Safe, Secure!
translation: [塔比瑟] 置恐惧于身外。居与山峦之巅！享受在乌托比萨的每时每刻吧——自由，安全，顺心！

original: [Rhonda] <rushing sotto voce like disclaimers at the end of prescription ads> Freedom limited to following the commands of Best Friend Tabitha...
translation: [朗达] <无法抗拒般的低声嘟囔>自由的前提是您必须遵循好朋友塔比瑟的命令……

original: [Rhonda] <Cont.> Safety not guaranteed against siege or assault by two-head-bear people or battle cattles.
translation: [朗达] <继续>由于可能遭遇加州佬和凯撒牲口们的的围追堵截，此地并不保障安全。

original: [Rhonda] <Cont.> Many infractions are punishable by death, no allowances for dumb-dumb "misunderstandings".
translation: [朗达] <继续。>多数违令者都将被处死，不允许出现所谓的“误会”。

original: [Tabitha] Utobitha! Come feel the difference!
translation: [塔比瑟] 乌托比萨！来感受全新的生活吧！

original: [Rhonda] Welcome back, Utobitha. It's time!
translation: [朗达] 欢迎回来，乌托比萨。是时候了！

original: [Tabitha] Time for what, Rhonda?
translation: [塔比瑟] 什么时候，朗达？

original: [Rhonda] <sing-song> True Eye Seeing Time!
translation: [朗达] <唱歌>真理时刻！

original: [Applause track.]
translation: [掌声响起。]

original: [Rhonda] I see that you're already wearing the True Eyes, Best Friend Tabitha, along with your head of True Hair. What do you see?
translation: [朗达] 塔比瑟，我看到你已经拥有了真理之眼，还有了一头浓密的真理之发。你看到了什么？

original: [Tabitha] Uh... I see Neil...
translation: [塔比瑟] 啊…我看到尼尔…

original: [Tabitha] Standing outside his shack down there.
translation: [塔比瑟] 站在他的窝棚外面。

original: [Rhonda] In the same spot as before, or has he moved?
translation: [朗达] 还是站在原地？就没有挪个身子？

original: [Tabitha] A little.
translation: [塔比瑟] 一点点。

original: [Rhonda] Wow! It must be so exciting to see and know all. What a powerful reminder of your ultimate authority and power for our listeners!
translation: [朗达] 哇！这真是太令人激动了。再次向我们的听众证明了你的无上的权威和伟大的力量！

original: [Tabitha] I see Moe...
translation: [塔比瑟] 我看到了阿萌…

original: [Rhonda] Moe, the Centaur? Favorite Centaur Moe? What's he up to?
translation: [朗达] 阿萌，那个多脚兽？可爱的多脚兽阿萌？他在做什么？

original: [Tabitha] Licking the gate. Wants out of the pen.
translation: [塔比瑟] 舔着大门。想从圈中出来。

original: [Rhonda] Now, I'm almost afraid to ask, but do you see any - you know - threats out there?
translation: [朗达] 啊！是的！那么，我虽然有点不敢问了，但你是否看到了……或者预见到了……威胁？

original: [Tabitha] Threats all around us... converging... like a noose, tightening! Two-head-bear people astride battle cattles!
translation: [塔比瑟] 威胁从未离去，它一直萦绕在我们身边…就像一股绞索，越勒越紧！加州佬还有凯撒军团，他们是不会善罢甘休的！

original: [Rhonda] <unnerved> Not the dreaded battle cattle training to hunt mutants?
translation: [朗达] 难道不只是那些可怕的凯撒战士们在训练捕杀变种人吗？

original: [Rhonda] <calmer> Would it be going too far to say that your gift of True Eyesight is the only thing saving our community from annihilation?
translation: [朗达] 我是不是可以这么说，只有你的真实之眼才能够阻止我们的族群遭受灭绝？

original: [Rhonda] Because I think it's so important for everyone - even the dumb-dumbs - how impossible it is to sneak up on us! More after this!
translation: [朗达] 我觉得这对大家至关重要——甚至对那些蠢蛋也是——这种神迹竟然会悄悄的降临在我们身上！尤其在这种危难时刻！

original: [Rhonda] First-generation Neil from down the mountain? And what is he up to?
translation: [朗达] 山下来的第一代变种人？他在做什么？

original: [Rhonda] We'll be right back after this musical interlude! Enjoy!
translation: [朗达] 在欣赏完这悦耳的片段之后，我们马上回来！好好享受吧！

original: [Rhonda] You're listening to Radio Free Utobitha, bringing truth to Utobithians 24 hours a day! Welcome!
translation: [朗达] 您现在收听的是乌托比萨自由频道，我们将全天24小时向每个乌托比萨人传播真理！欢迎收听！

original: [Tabitha] I am in control here!
translation: [塔比瑟] 在这里我说了算！

original: [Rhonda] That was today's and every day's extra special guest, Best Friend Tabitha, supreme commander of Utobitha and Wearer of the True Eyes!
translation: [朗达] 现在来欢迎今天同时也是每天的特别来宾，我们最好的朋友塔比瑟，同时也是乌托比萨的最高统治者和真实之眼的持有者！

original: [Tabitha] I still miss you, Rhonda. After all these years...
translation: [塔比瑟] 朗达，这么多年过去了，我对你的思念丝毫未减……

original: [Rhonda] Also joining us from his locked cell is Raul Tejada, master mechanic who can be executed at any time! Hello, Raul. Or should that be "Hola?"
translation: [朗达] 同时，还有劳尔·特耶达，从监狱里专程赶来参加我们的节目！他是一名随时可能被处决的机械大师！你好，劳尔。或者说我该说[QUOTE]吼啦？[QUOTE]

original: [Raul] Uh, either one works.
translation: [劳尔] 呣，都可以。

original: [Tabitha] Today you die, Raul! I command it!
translation: [塔比瑟] 你今天死定了，劳尔！我已经下定决心了！

original: [Rhonda] Ooooh, Raul. Supreme commander Tabitha says you die today. Any reaction.
translation: [朗达] 哦哦哦，劳尔。最高指挥官塔比瑟叫嚣你今天一定会死。对此你有什么感想？

original: [Raul] I going to obey supreme Tabitha, claro, whatever she say. Just I feel so bad I die before I fix her special robot.
translation: [劳尔] 我当然会听从至高无上的指挥官塔比瑟的命令。只是很遗憾，我还没能修好她的机器人，就得一命呜呼了。

original: [Silence.]
translation: [沉默。]

original: [Tabitha] <Growls in frustration.>
translation: [塔比瑟] <沮丧的咆哮着。>

original: [Rhonda] You're listening to UNC - the Utobithian News Channel - with breaking news!
translation: [朗达] 你们正在聆听的是乌托比萨新闻频道——马上发布震撼消息！

original: [Rhonda] The execution of master mechanic Raul Tajeda has again been commuted for a period of 24 hours to allow time for important repairs.
translation: [朗达] 由于需要处理繁重的修理工作，总工程师劳尔·特耶达的处决再次被推迟24个小时。

original: [Tabitha] <snarling> This time you will get it done, Raul!
translation: [塔比瑟] <咆哮>这次你必须把她修好，劳尔！

original: [Rhonda] Joining us from his cell to comment on the situation is Raul Tejada. Raul?
translation: [朗达] 下面请正在服刑中的劳尔·特耶达说话。劳尔要自己评论一下目前的状况，请说吧？

original: [Raul] Hi, Tab - <catches himself> Rhonda.
translation: [劳尔] 你好，塔比-<哽咽着>朗达。

original: [Rhonda] What's your take on the situation?
translation: [朗达] 你对现在的情况有什么看法？

original: [Raul] All I want is to make that special robot work again, you know? I give it my best.
translation: [劳尔] 您应该明白，我现在唯一想做的就是让这个独一无二的机器人重新运转起来。我已经竭尽全力了。

original: [Rhonda] We'll be right back after this word from our sponsor during which Raul will contemplate how lucky he is to be alive.
translation: [朗达] 接下来进一段赞助商广告，我们马上回来。同时劳尔将会重新审视自己能活着是多么的幸运。

original: [Tabitha] Are you tired of getting chased because you're bigger than humans, and scaring them?
translation: [塔比瑟] 你是否已经厌倦了被四处驱赶的生活，仅仅因为你比人类高大，会吓着他们？

original: V29-321G may look like a big, fat, red rocket, Rocketeers, but Ol' Fatty here ran circles around the Earth not so long ago, so let's see you keep up! Sure, V29-321G's re-entry gave it its more commonly-known nickname "Big Fat Fiery Fred," but here at REPCONN we chose to focus on the successes and apply what we learned about explosive-resistant shielding to future models and even our landing platforms!*\n\n* The newly-(re)constructed REPCONN Launch Facility was a direct beneficiary of this discovery.
translation: 虽然V29-321G看起来像是一个巨大、笨重的红色火箭，但这个大胖子不久前才刚刚绕着地球飞过圈，所以千万别小看哦，火箭专家们！当然，V29-321G的归来也让它获得了一个更广为人知的绰号：“暴躁的大胖子弗雷德”，但在瑞普康，我们更乐意从成功中汲取经验。未来我们将把本次发射中所学到的防爆技术应用到新型火箭，甚至是降落平台上！*\n\n* 新（重）建的瑞普康发射场将直接受益于这一发现。

original: "Big Fat Fiery Fred"
translation: "暴躁的大胖子弗雷德"

original: Officially called the "Z43-521P" by silly engineers, we prefer to call this little scrapper by its true nickname, the "Green Bean." After all, which would you prefer in your backyard garden - a smoldering Z43-521P, or a green bean?* One sounds like it belongs if mentioned on the news, and make news it did... featuring REPCONN's plasma engine, it was soooo newsworthy that we decided to take the Quantum Matter Modulation unit out and see if we could use it for non-explosive uses. \n\n* Rocket nickname chosen after results of first trial landing.
translation: 愚蠢的工程师们给它的官方名称是“Z43-521P”，但我们更倾向于用绰号来称呼这块小废铁——“青豆”。毕竟，你是想在后花园里发现一坨报废的Z43-521P，还是一株青豆呢？*这名字适合在新闻里播，也确实上了新闻……它搭载了瑞普康研制的等离子引擎，这实在是太太太太有新闻价值了，所以我们才决定将量子物质调节单元取下来，看看能否将它运用到不会爆炸的场合。\n\n* 火箭的绰号是根据第一次实验性着陆的结果而确定的。

original: "Green Bean"
translation: "青豆"

original: We've all heard "stories" that radiation is dangerous - fact or fiction?* A common site in factories, military installations, and the basements of selected government-funded middle schools, these safety barrels* are just what the name implies - safe. While their attractive coloring can be interpreted as a warning, for REPCONN, it's an invitation to a future filled with nuclear power!\n\n* Rhetorical questions and nomenclature of exhibit items cannot be used as a basis for criminal prosecution.
translation: 我们都听说一些关于辐射很危险的“故事”——是真实，还是谎言？* 安全桶在工厂、军事设施以及部分公立中学的地下室内十分常见，顾名思义，它们很安全。虽然其诱人的颜色可以理解成警告，但对瑞普康来说，它就是前往未来核能世界的邀请函！\n\n* 展品介绍中的反问句和相关术语不能作为刑事诉讼的证据。

original: "Radioactive Waste?"
translation: "辐射废料？"

original: Whoa, watch your step! You don't want to be facing this fearsome fellow if you accidentally stumble into a restricted area. Whether sporting the latest in dual miniguns, rockets, or laser cannons, the Sentrybot not only takes it job seriously, it also takes no prisoners! It's proof of RobCo's commitment to defense that these deadly guards are concealed in chambers throughout this facility, so let this be a warning: Watch where you step, or out'll come RobCo, guns blazing!\n\nExhibit Brought to You By Your Friends at RobCo
translation: 哇，小心！要是你一不小心踏入禁区，那这个大块头绝对会成为你的噩梦。无论装备的是双重转轮机枪、火箭，还是激光加农炮，铁卫兵不仅恪尽职守，也绝不留活口！为了证明罗科信守诺言，这些致命的守卫已经被封存在工厂的各个角落，所以权当这是个警告吧：小心行事，否则你将面对罗科的炮火制裁！\n\n本展品由罗科倾情赞助

original: "Watch Your Step!"
translation: "注意脚下！"

original: RobCo's always had an eye for robotics, and this little fellow is no different! This robotic marvel can not only recognize your face and voice with advanced facial and auditory recognition technology, it can also broadcast video and audio as well! Think of it - all the sights and sounds of your radio and TV in your living room at home blasted directly at you on the street, subway, bathroom, or wherever you may be! Never fear, you'll never miss a news bulletin or presidential address again, no matter where you are!\n\nExhibit Brought to You By Your Friends at RobCo
translation: 罗科在机器人科技方面总是具备独到的眼光，这个小家伙也不例外！这个新奇的机器人不但能凭借先进的面部和声音识别技术识别出你的脸和嗓音，还可以播送视频和音频！想想吧——只要是出现在客厅收音机和电视中的音乐与画面，你都能直接在街道、地铁、洗手间或任何地方尽情享受！不必再担心，无论你身处何方，都不会再错过新闻简报或总统演讲了。\n\n本展品由罗科倾情赞助

original: "The 'I' in 'Eyebot.'"
translation: "“眼球机器人”的“眼”"

original: You never can have too many hands - three, why not four? That was RobCo's inspiration behind the popular (and cost-effective) Mr. Handy model, the first of the line shown here. Always a help around the household, whether with Mom in the kitchen using its titanium circular power saw or in the garage with Dad using its armor-piercing laser array, Mr. Handy is not just helpful... he's your friend, too.\n\nExhibit Brought to You By Your Friends at RobCo
translation: 人们总觉得无论几双手都不够用——如果是三头六臂呢？这正是罗科广受欢迎（且性价比极高）的“巧手先生”背后的灵感来源，正如前排所示。它永远是家中的好帮手，在厨房里，他能用钛金电锯帮妈妈烹出一桌好菜，在车库里，他也能用穿甲激光阵列帮爸爸修好机车。巧手先生不但是个好帮手……他也是你的朋友。\n\n本展品由罗科倾情赞助

original: "The 'Hand' in 'Handy'"
translation: "“巧手”的“手”"

original: Some folks have asked - why not a Protectron with wheels? RobCo wasn't afraid to answer that question: The Protect-O-Bot is theanswer. While safety standards prevented this free-wheeling dynamo from entering mass market production despite RobCo's best intentions and teams of lawyers, we take consolation in letting you can see this extremely well-funded experiment as it was intended - a robot moving so fast it looks like it's standing still!\n\nExhibit Brought to You By Your Friends at RobCo
translation: 有些人问——为什么没有带轮子的保护者呢？罗科并不惮于回答这个问题：O型保护者就是答案。尽管罗科抱有极大的诚意，也拥有优秀的法律团队，但在安全标准的限制下，这些灵活自如的机器人最终还是无法被量产。为了表达歉意，我们决定向各位展示这个高成本实验的本来面貌——一个速度快到看起来几乎是站在原地的机器人！\n\n本展品由罗科倾情赞助

original: "It's Got Wheels!"
translation: "它有轮子哦！"

original: Just like the rocket you see here, we're aimed at the sky, but we've got a ceiling in the way! See, Rocketeers, while REPCONN is (was) focused on non-radioactive* propulsion engines, we still need to sneak back and use some of our older "proven" techniques with nuclear-driven engines to make space travel a reality. Partnered with our new buddy RobCo, we've dug up older, cheaper technology for upcoming orbital projects. No worries, even if you can't always see what we're up to up there - we can see you!\n\n* Any implication of radioactive material as negative is unintentional and in no way reflects RobCo or its subsidiary REPCONN.
translation: 正如你面前的火箭一样，我们瞄准的目标是宇宙，只不过还要突破一层房顶！这么说吧，火箭专家们，尽管瑞普康正在（或曾经）专注于非辐射*推动引擎的研究，但我们依然需要偷偷借用一些古老而“可靠”的核能引擎技术才能实现太空旅行。在与新伙伴罗科的合作过程中，我们采用了更古老而廉价的技术，以应用到将来的轨道计划中。不用担心，就算你不明白我们的远大规划，我们也能从太空中俯瞰你！\n\n* 有关辐射材料的暗示皆非有意为之，也不是在影射罗科与其子公司瑞普康。

original: "Rockets Away!"
translation: "火箭出击！"

original: What's this? A dull rod? Not so, Rocketeers! This "dull rod" once powered REPCONN's old nuclear-propelled rockets and still contains harmless* traces of radioactive material. As an exercise, stare closely* at the rod and try to spot the telltale glow!\n\n* While this case is lead-lined (standard in these cases, not specifically requested for this display), do not touch, look, or stand too close to this exhibit - keep your legs moving and see the rest of the museum!
translation: 这是什么？只是一根铁棍？不，火箭专家们！这根“铁棍”曾经为瑞普康的核能火箭提供过能源，其中含有一些无害*的辐射材料。来做个练习：仔细观看*这根铁棍，找出关键的发光部位吧！\n\n* 这个盒子是衬铅盒（标准型号，不是为了这一展品特别定制的）不要触碰、参观或站得离此展品过近——别停下，去参观博物馆的其它部分吧！

original: "Boring Old Rod? Or..."
translation: "只是一根破铁棍吗？"

original: Why, look here! A pile of itty-bity safety barrels,* all nestled together like a family sitting down to dinner! Now, while it's claimed even the safest nuclear waste disposal procedures seep poison into the environment that never, ever goes away, in REPCONN's case, we say it all depends on where you put them - and Nevada's just the place!\n\n* Nomenclature for "hazardous waste barrels" as per REPCONN glossary specs.
translation: 嗨，看这边！这是几只小巧玲珑的安全桶，*相互依偎在一起，就像坐下来吃完饭的一家人！虽然有人宣称，即便是最安全的核废料清理过程，其向周围环境所释放的辐射也永远不会消失，但对瑞普康来说，我们认为这完全取决于你把废料往哪儿排——内华达正是个合适的好地方！\n\n* “有害废料桶”是瑞普康的专用术语。

original: "Nuclear Family!"
translation: "核能家族！"

original: Hold up, Rocketeers, what's this? This trio of cylinders isn't a trio of cylinders at all!* They're containers holding what some* scientists call "plasma." Can you say "plasma?" REPCONN's always looking to the future, and in our future, we don't have to worry about radiation, health risks, or lawsuits when using this new and improved fuel source to blast our rockets into and out of the sky!\n\n* Clarification: "Cylinders" and "plasma" are factually correct designations of display items, both by definition and by the scientific community.
translation: 等一下，火箭专家们，这是什么？这三个圆桶可不单单是圆桶而已！*里面装的是某些*科学家称之为“等离子”的东西。你会说“等离子”吗？瑞普康总是面向未来，而未来有了这一新型能源，我们再也不必担心在发射火箭时承担辐射和健康风险，也不必再担心吃官司了！\n\n* 申明：无论是从定义上，还是科学界公认的概念上，“圆桶”和“等离子”都是展出物的正确名称。

original: "Plas-Ma What?"
translation: "等什么离子？"

original: A model of our solar system (not actual size). Beautiful, isn't it? RobCo, with its subsidiary REPCONN, has often gazed into the night sky, seeing the rich pageant of stars and planets above us. Our goal? To send unmanned rockets to these other systems, seeing their beauty firsthand while mining ever deeper into each planet's surface for precious resources needed here at home. This is our promise to mankind, extending our reach into a future where the number of RobCo and REPCONN rockets match the stars in the sky.\n\nThis Exhibit Brought To You By Your Friends at RobCo
translation: 我们太阳系的模型（非真实大小）。很美，对吧？罗科与其子公司瑞普康经常夜观天象，仰望我们头顶那些富饶的星球。我们的目标？将无人火箭送去其它星系，一边从近处欣赏它们的美貌，一边在行星的表面开凿，挖出珍贵的矿产，以供资源紧缺的家乡使用。这是我们对全人类的承诺，有朝一日，罗科与瑞普康发射的火箭将多如繁星，带领着我们飞向未来。\n\n本展品由罗科倾情赞助

original: "Our Rich, Rich Solar System.'"
translation: "我们富饶的太阳系"

original: This sleek and purple R77-293A "Needlenose" is what happens when you mix fossil and plasma in a rocket and shake it up! The fossil fuels punch this sharp-nosed terror through the sky, and the plasma is used to shoot it through space to planets where REPCONN can mine more fossil fuels,* continuing the whole cycle again!\n\n* Interplanetary mining and resource rights still in negotiation.
translation: 这个紫色而又光滑R77-293A“尖脑袋”，正是将化石与等离子在火箭燃料舱中混合后所得到的产物！化石燃料可以令这只尖头飞鼠划破天际，而等离子则能将其送入宇宙，前往其他星球挖掘更多的化石燃料，*周而复始，永不枯竭！\n\n* 跨星球采矿和能源采集权还在协商之中。

original: "Needlenose"
translation: "有尖脑袋"

original: Force your parents a short drive south, and you'll see the retractable dome of REPCONN's launch facility (not actual size!). You may have heard wild stories about rocket flights and their impact* on nearby towns and communities, but REPCONN feels you can't put a price of space exploration - after all, Rocketeers, you do want to go into space someday... don't you?\n\n* Statement is figurative and inadmissible as evidence in a court of law.
translation: 让你的父母再往南开一小会儿车，你就能看见瑞普康发射工厂可伸缩的穹顶（非真实大小！）。你可能听说过一些关于火箭发射会对周边小镇和社区带来负面影响*的谣言，但瑞普康觉得宇宙探索是无价的——毕竟，火箭专家们，你们也想要有一天飞向宇宙……对不对？\n\n* 以上陈述均属虚构，不可作为诉讼证据。

original: "Ready, Set, Launch!"
translation: "准备，就位，发射！"

original: Tabitha: You see that! *I* get to do that! *You* don't!
translation: 塔比瑟：你懂了吗！只有*我*可以！*你*不行！

original: Tabitha: Ooooh! No one touches the equipment around here except me!
translation: 塔比瑟：噢噢噢！除我以外没人能碰这里的设备！

original: The radio immediately cuts to static.
translation: 收音机里突然只剩下了杂音。

original: Donnie
translation: 唐尼

original: Marie
translation: 玛丽

original: The elevator door opens without a hitch. Buttons corresponding to the different levels of the vault glow faintly along the wall. Which one do you press?
translation: 电梯门流畅地打开了。墙上代表避难所不同楼层的按钮正微微发光。你要按哪一个？

original: Leave the elevator alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: First Level - Entrance
translation: 一楼 - 入口

original: Second Level - Oxygen Recycling
translation: 二楼 - 制氧区

original: Third Level - Food Production
translation: 三楼 - 食品加工区

original: Fourth Level - Common Areas
translation: 四楼 - 公共区

original: Fifth Level - Pest Control
translation: 五楼 - 虫害防治区

original: The elevator does not seem to be working. You could probably pop open the nearby panel and tinker with it to get the elevator working.
translation: 电梯似乎无法运转。你也许可以打开旁边的面板，做一些小修理，让电梯运作起来。

original: Leave the elevator alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: Repair the elevator.
translation: 修复电梯。

original: The elevator does not seem to be working. If you had more experience with fixing machinery, you could probably get it working.\n(Repair 50 required)
translation: 电梯似乎没有在工作。如果你对修理机械有更多的经验，也许可以让它运作起来。\n（需要50以上修理。）

original: Leave the elevator alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: Repair the kitchen's food processor?
translation: 修理厨房的食品加工机？

original: Yes
translation: 是

original: [Repair 80] Jury rig the machine.
translation: [修理80] 应急抢修机器。

original: No
translation: 否

original: You have repaired the food processor!
translation: 你修好了食品加工机！

original: You do not have all of the required items.
translation: 你缺少必要的物品。

original: [Failed] You lack the skill to jury-rig the machine.  After digging through all of the broken parts you are overwhelmed and give up.
translation: [失败] 你缺少抢修机械所需要的技能。在研究过所有坏掉的部分后，你感到力不从心，于是放弃了。

original: [Success] Bypassing several broken redundant coprocessors using nothing more than bobby pins, tape, and a trooper's swiss army knife, you manage to get the machine running!
translation: [成功] 你只用了发夹、胶带和一把瑞士军刀，就绕过了严重损坏的备用协处理器，成功让机器重新运作了起来！

original: This device looks as though it is armed and could go off at any moment. \n\n(Explosives of 35 or higher or Science of 45 or higher required to defuse.)
translation: 这个装置看上去已经启动了，随时可能会爆炸。\n\n（需要35以上爆破技能或45以上科学技能拆除）

original: Explosive Charge
translation: 定时炸药

original: Do nothing.
translation: 不管它。

original: [Explosives/Science] Defuse the charge.
translation: [爆破/科学] 拆除炸弹。

original: Input deactivation code.
translation: 输入中止密码。

original: Cook-Cook becomes frenzied at the death of his favorite brahmin.
translation: 大厨库克由于他最爱的双头牛死了而变得狂暴。

original: You successfully extracted and defused the bomb.
translation: 你成功解除了炸弹。

original: Explosives Defused
translation: 爆炸物已拆除

original: This sentry bot looks like it's seen some heavy fighting recently. You could probably get it running again if you knew a little more about machines.\n(Repair 40 required)
translation: 这个铁卫兵看上去最近经历了激烈的战斗。如果你懂得更多机械知识，也许可以让它再次运作起来。\n（需要40修理）

original: This sentry bot looks like it's seen some heavy fighting recently. You could probably get it partially running again with a little work.
translation: 这个铁卫兵看上去经历过一场激烈的战斗。也许经过你的努力，可以让它再运作起来。

original: Leave the robot alone.
translation: 不管它。

original: [Repair] Fix the sentry bot.
translation: [修理] 修复铁卫兵。

original: Koch
translation: 科赫

original: The note reads: "Your debt still remains unpaid. We have warned you twice. There will not be a third warning, only consequences. You have one day."
translation: 字条上写着：“你的债务尚未还清。我们已经警告过你两次了。不会再有第三次，到时你就自食其果吧。你还有一天时间。”

original: Threatening Note
translation: 威胁字条

original: This appears to be a good location to attach one of the deployable ballast packages. Would you like to attach it to the plane?
translation: 这里可以放置一个可展开式浮袋。你想把它装在飞机上吗？

original: Deploy Ballast
translation: 展开浮袋

original: Attach Ballast
translation: 放置浮袋

original: Leave
translation: 离开

original: This man looks like he has a serious infection. Improper treatment will kill him, would you like to treat him? (Medicine 40 or higher Required)
translation: 这个男人看起来受到了严重感染。治疗不当可能会导致他死亡。你想要治疗他吗？（需要40或以上医疗）

original: Leave him alone.
translation: 不管他。

original: Attempt to treat him.
translation: 进行治疗。

original: With a combination of natural herbs, bandages, and some disinfectant, you are able to clean the wounds and help boost the patient's immune system enough that he'll survive.
translation: 你使用草药、绷带和一些抗感染药物清理了病人的伤口，病人的免疫力也得到了提高，现在他能活下去了。

original: You decide you need to perform a tracheotomy to open up his air pathway.  As you haphazardly stab the patient in the neck, a piece of your straw snaps off in his throat causing the patient to choke to death.
translation: 你决定执行气管切开术，好缓解他的呼吸困难。你往病人脖子上随意地一戳，吸管断在了病人的喉咙里，病人被呛死了。

original: Without examining the leg further, you decide it requires amputation.  Before you even make it down to bone, you realize you might have skipped a few important steps...  The patient quickly bleeds to death from a severed artery.
translation: 你没有做进一步诊断就决定对腿部进行截肢。在你切到骨头之前，你突然想起自己好像跳过了什么重要的步骤……病人在动脉被切断后很快失血身亡了。

original: With limited medical knowledge, you mistakenly administer a lethal dose of painkillers mixed with antibiotics.  The patient lets out one last labored breath before succumbing to the overdose.
translation: 由于你的医疗知识有限，你给病人注射了过量的止痛剂和抗生素。病人吃力地吐出最后一口气，死于药物中毒。

original: This man looks like he has a serious infection. Improper treatment will kill him, would you like to treat him? (Medicine 40 or higher Required)
translation: 这个男人看起来受到了严重感染。治疗不当可能导致死亡。你想要治疗他吗？（需要40或以上医疗）

original: Leave him alone.
translation: 不管他。

original: Treat the infection.
translation: 治疗感染。

original: This man's leg is seriously damaged and will require amputation. Improper treatment will kill him.  Are you sure to want to attempt the operation? (Medicine 50 or higher Required)
translation: 这个男人的腿受了严重的伤，需要截肢。操作不当可能会导致死亡。你确认要进行手术吗？（需要50或以上医疗）

original: Leave him alone.
translation: 不管他。

translation: 进行手术。

translation: 切掉！切掉！切掉！（低智力）

translation: 这个男人的腿受了严重的伤，需要截肢。你确认要进行手术吗？（需要50或以上医疗）

translation: 不管他。

translation: 进行手术。

translation: 切掉！切掉！切掉！（低智力）

original: This man appears to be severely injured.  Swelling around his face and neck is interfering with his breathing.  Are you sure to want to treat him? (Medicine 60 or higher Required)
translation: 这个男人看起来受了很重的伤。脸和脖子肿胀得厉害，阻碍了他的呼吸。你确定要治疗他吗？（需要60或以上医疗）

original: Never mind. Leave him alone.
translation: 不管他。

original: Treat the patient.
translation: 进行治疗。

original: This man appears to be severely injured.  Swelling around his face and neck is interfering with his breathing.  Improper treatment will kill him.  Are you sure to want to treat him? (Medicine 60 or higher Required)
translation: 这个男人看起来受了很重的伤。脸和脖子肿胀得厉害，阻碍了他的呼吸。治疗不当可能导致他死亡。你确定要治疗他吗？（需要60或以上医疗）

original: Leave him alone.
translation: 不管他。

original: Attempt to treat him.
translation: 进行治疗。

original: Upon further examination after cleaning the leg, you realize it can be saved.  You carefully remove the existing stitches, clean the wounds thoroughly, then re-stitch the wounds closed using a much more effective procedure.
translation: 你清洗了病人的腿部，并做了进一步诊断，发现这条腿还有救。你小心翼翼地移除了腿上的针线，用更有效的方法对伤口重新进行了缝合。

original: After carefully considering treatment options, you realize the patient is merely having a strong allergic reaction.  By cleaning all wounds of ant venom, and administering a steroid compound, you reduce the swelling and the patient's breathing returns to normal.
translation: 仔细考虑治疗方案后，你发现病人的症状其实是强烈的过敏反应。你清理了伤口中的蚁毒，为他注射了合成类固醇。病人的肿胀得以缓解，呼吸也恢复了正常。

original: The note reads: "I'm taking most of the boys west to go check out this vault we heard about. Stay here and keep an eye on things until we get back, and keep a closer eye on the Fiends - those guys are crazier than Scrambler. If there's any trouble, radio ahead."
translation: 笔记上写着：“我带人去之前听说的那个西边的避难所看看。你留在这儿看家，等我们回来。小心恶魔帮——那些家伙比胖揍还可怕。如果遇到麻烦，就呼叫我们。”

original: Powder Ganger Note
translation: 炸药帮帮众字条

original:
This purifier would provide clean water to Underpass, if it were functional. Whoever assembled it had no idea what they were doing - many parts are connected incorrectly or hooked up backwards. Someone with the proper knowledge could easily get the purifier operational.

[Repair of 35 or greater required to fix the generator.]
[Science of 35 or greater required to modify the generator's settings.]

这个净化装置如果能够运作，可以为地下通道提供干净的水。安装它的人完全是在胡闹——许多零件都接错了，有些甚至接反了。只要懂得恰当的知识，就可以轻易使净水装置运作起来。

translation: 发电机

translation: 你修好了净化装置。现在它能够生产干净的水了。

translation: 你调整了净化装置的设置。现在它可以生产出更加干净的水了。

translation: 这个病人的病情恶化了，但还算稳定。没有什么你能做的了。

translation: 以你的水平，很快你就发现了自己是在帮倒忙。为了避免造成严重的并发症，你停止了医治。

original: As you start to administer medications to the patient, his fever spikes and his breathing quickens. His sickness is well beyond your skill to treat.
translation: 你对病人展开治疗，但病人很快开始发起高烧，呼吸也变得急促。你的医疗水平完全不足以应付他的病情。

original: Choose Sex
translation: 选择性别

original: Mister
translation: 先生。

original: Ma'am
translation: 女士。

original: To grab the Brahmin skull, look at it and &sUActnGrab;.
translation: 要拿起双头牛的头骨，看着它然后按下&sUActnGrab;。

original: Good! Now &sUActnGrab; again to let go of the skull.
translation: 很好，现在按下&sUActnGrab；再次放下头骨。

original: Thinking the patient has an infection, you administer a large dose of antibiotics. The patient suffers a severe allergic reaction and slips into a deep coma.
translation: 你认为病人的伤口被感染了，于是注射了大量的抗生素。病人产生了严重的过敏反应，陷入了昏迷。

original: Argyll has revoked your operating privileges in his medical bay. You can no longer operate on any patients.
translation: 阿盖尔收回了你在他的医疗室内为病人看病的特权。你无法再给病人做手术了。

original: This one of Argyll's patients. You should speak to him before you investigate them.
translation: 这是阿盖尔的病人。在检查病人之前你应该先和阿盖尔打声招呼。

original: You begin to operate on the patient's leg, and things quickly start to go bad. You manage to tourniquet the wound to staunch the bleeding, but it is clear that the leg will never be fully functional again.
translation: 你开始为病人的腿动手术，情况很快恶化。你设法用止血带止住了血，但这条腿显然再也无法完全恢复了。

original: You pull out your blade and hack blindly at the leg. After a series of random and frenetic cuts you notice the leg is looking better. It looks like he'll be able to keep it after all.
translation: 你拔出刀，开始疯狂地砍他的腿。在乱砍几刀过后，你发现他的腿似乎比原来好多了。看来他还是能保住这条腿的。

original: The dynamite contained within this box is very old and unstable. Only someone skilled with explosives could hope to salvage any of the dynamite.\n\n[Explosives of 25 or greater required.]
translation: 盒中的炸药已经很旧了，十分不稳定。只有懂得爆破技能的人才有希望从中回收一些炸药。\n\n[需要25或以上爆破。]

translation: 一箱旧炸药

translation: 不管它。

translation: 尽可能回收炸药。

translation: 这把9毫米冲锋枪已经坏了，但应该可以重新修好。\n\n[需要25或以上修理。]

translation: 损坏的9mm冲锋枪

translation: 不管它。

translation: 修理9毫米冲锋枪。

translation: 这里似乎有足够的化学原料，如果你了解相关知识，应该可以用它们制作出一些药品。\n\n[需要25或以上科学。]

translation: 化学实验组

translation: 制造一些治疗针。

translation: 制造以下药物：疯狂药、壮大灵、曼他特、稳定剂和振奋剂。

original: Reflector panels on this array are damaged.  Inspecting the damage, you quickly realize you lack the skill to repair the array without replacement parts. (Repair 65 or higher Required or Use Solar Array Parts)
translation: 阵列上的反射板破损了。你检查了一下故障情况，很快发现在缺少备用零件的情况下，凭你目前的能力是不足以修好这块发电阵列的。（需要65或以上的修理技能，或使用太阳能阵列零件进行维修）

translation: 凭借着你在光伏发电方面的知识，你彻底清洁、抛光、升级了太阳能电池板，还替换了一些老旧的电路。发电阵列的效率提高了50%。

translation: 阵列上的反射板破损了。回收的备用零件可以用来修复阵列。你想要修复这个阵列吗？（需要65或以上的修理技能，或使用太阳能阵列零件进行维修）

translation: 使用从太阳神一号回收的组件修复阵列。

translation: 检查收音机的内部组件后，你发现其中一些零件和缆线在收音机被砸到地上时松掉了。简单的修理应该就可以让它再次工作。\n\n[需要20以上修理。]

translation: 笔记上写着：“最近没多少巡逻队，所以也没什么战利品。我们正在考虑换个地方。沿着铁轨向北，去往长街。你要加入吗？虽然我们不是狱友了，但还是应该一起行动。”

original: "We're cut off from the rest of the platoon, and there are legionnaires all over the place. There's no chance we can get out of here before they blow the town, so we're going to hold out against them as along as we can. If anyone ever gets this, I'd like to make sure that Private Jeffery Hui and Corporal Marcus Christensen are commended for their valor and sacrifice. original: Fallout: New Vegas allows you to play in a new Hardcore mode that greatly increases the challenge of the game. In this mode, Stimpaks heal over time and cannot mend broken limbs, Rad-Away removes radiation over time, ammunition has weight, and dehydration is a constant concern. This mode is only recommended for advanced players.\n\nYou may turn Hardcore mode on or off at any time in the Gameplay menu, but if you activate Hardcore mode now and maintain it through the end of the main storyline, you will receive a special reward.
